title: won't move tomorrow. My Actifit Diary: May 5 2026
body:
Everything hurts. Especially my legs. What was I thinking? Clock sits at 16,500 steps, and on top of that I decided to go to the gym and do leg training. After doing Tang Soo Do yesterday. And having a million meetings today. And having to do a lot of financial Excel work. And going to the courthouse – twice. And having to re-configure our automated messages. And having an early training session at the factory, with me as translator from English to Spanish. And having to learn vocabulary in both English and Spanish for that because I really don’t know much about sewing, even in German, my native language. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0b0aea5d-96c7-4b7e-ba50-3724004aee98.jpg) I didn’t even take a picture today. These are old ones. Not a single one. No screenshot, nothing. I LOVE taking pictures, but I usually do some leisure walk for that. Today? No time. Head full all the time. I finally found out why my case hadn’t been touched at the courthouse yet – officially, they didn’t receive it on time because it was sent in electronically and that caused some chaos and the woman working there is only there for 8 days by now and also they forgot to send the physical documents up… They basically played the blame game, as always. Can’t get a single “I screwed up, sorry.” out of anyone here. I know that, and they assured me that they will have an answer by to today, and they did. “Oh, hey, we need that information to be able to qualify the case.” 30 days just to let me know that they need an E-Mail address, basically. Mesmerizing. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8e94266e-605d-41e0-ac43-8a66175e3281.jpg) So, I still say it’s a good day. It’s something. I can run around a little more again tomorrow, doing more errands. But mainly, I’m going to work on the computer tomorrow, and make bread experiments. Last round. I’m excited how that will go! Which means I hope it’s the last round… I now had two people asking for the coconut bread again, so I’m throwing in a round of that, too. It’s easy to make, short fermentation, and a sweet yeast dough. Nobody would ever mistake it for a healthy bread. And yet, it’s probably still better than bread in stores… So far for today! Thank you for reading, I wish you a good night/morning/day!

title: Mi embarazo / my pregnancy  ESP / ENG
body:
![IMG-20260326-WA0026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/23ynjD1BhhFMVvsE3T83SeGyVjf9Swti9jUJ8WeyTqoMvXujMSA9hQhkpd8xE3pzUyNor.jpg)
 Hoy quiero contar una parte muy importante de mi vida:
 mi embarazo.
Todo comenzó mientras estaba trabajando en el hotel. Yo soy bartender en un restaurante VIP que también tiene café bar, y pasaba el día preparando capuchinos, cortaditos, café con leche… pero de repente, algo cambió.
Cada vez que la leche se calentaba y salía el vapor del espumero, me daban unas náuseas terribles. Mareos, debilidad… sentía que mi cuerpo ya no era el mismo.
En ese momento, en Cuba se hablaba mucho de una enfermedad llamada “oropuche ”, transmitida por un mosquito, y todos pensaban que eso era lo que yo tenía. Incluso los médicos lo asociaron a eso, porque también empecé con fiebre.
Seguí trabajando así, sintiéndome mal, sin saber realmente qué pasaba.
Hasta que un día, en agosto, la cocinera del restaurante, Lisandra, me dijo algo que me marcó: “Moana” —como me dicen mis compañeros por mi apariencia—, “a mí me ha dado esa menstruación tres veces… ¿y a ti no te ha dado ni una vez ? ¿No te has hecho una prueba de embarazo?”
Yo le dije que no, que estaba tomando pastillas anticonceptivas… pero esa pregunta se me quedó en la cabeza.
Ese mismo día, el 4 de agosto de 2024 a las 8 de la noche, decidí hacerme la prueba.
Estábamos mi esposo y yo en el baño, nerviosos, esperando el resultado… y ahí aparecieron: dos rayitas rojas.
Positivo.🥰 
![IMG-20260504-WA0006.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/243fxkyCooLQP11KbVtHiRn8u4xAG8Tk8CQu2QQSFB6gpoNQHD4eTD8e56pJtuYMZy8Yr.jpg)

![IMG-20260504-WA0016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/23wMcojhicaaFevbpMMxWDpe4vP6P5Cm4NQ1Fb4cYMXs4e2KzbRwJKShAT3V7WUv85cmF.jpg)

No lo podíamos creer. Aun así, compré otra prueba para hacerla al día siguiente, como recomiendan los médicos… pero yo no pude esperar. Y sí, volvió a dar positivo.
El 6 de agosto fuimos al centro de maternidad en Matanzas, y en el ultrasonido vimos una pequeña bolsita… con latidos. Tenía ya 7 semanas y 2 días.
Ahí empezó todo.
![IMG-20260505-WA0093.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/243zjqeM3PP4AuJXH8SBL56qaJ89ziTFx8jyP9s5h4iocLoh7uAoyHNzJTKdrHMeNPwNg.jpg)

No sé si fue mental o físico, pero desde ese momento me sentí aún más débil. Mi cuerpo ya estaba en pleno cambio, y trabajar se volvió imposible. Los bartenders caminamos mucho, pasamos horas de pie… y mis pies terminaban hinchados, agotados. No me servía la ropa, tuve que ir a trabajar con lo que podía, incluso sin uniforme.
Y aún no tenía ni tres meses.
A los tres meses llegó un momento difícil: tuve amenaza de aborto. Fue un susto muy grande. Después también tuve una infección en los riñones y estuve ingresada, recibiendo antibióticos. Fue una etapa dura, sobre todo porque le tengo mucho miedo a las agujas… pero todo lo hice por mi hijo.
Todo.
A pesar de los momentos difíciles, también fue una etapa muy bonita como pareja. Lázaro empezó a cuidarnos de una manera increíble. Incluso dejó de dormir conmigo para dormir abrazado a mi barriga. Asumió todos los gastos, el alquiler, las cosas del bebé… todo, mientras yo ya no podía trabajar.
Fue un apoyo inmenso.
![IMG-20260505-WA0090.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/23wCEDgzBQzKWq8nsPSkEyZDrjyCdrmZWT8QqRgoPTCTy31JfbNW37mr8zARcrNoLx4y2.jpg)

Mi barriga creció muchísimo, y fue una etapa hermosa. Caminaba, hacía ejercicio, me sentía activa. Comía de todo (aunque sé que no todos los embarazos son iguales), y gracias a Dios no tuve ni hipertensión ni diabetes. Mi bebé crecía sano.
Tuve muchos cambios de humor: lloraba, reía… pero también me sentía más linda. En mi barrio decían que cuando la barriga es de varón la mujer se pone fea, y todos aseguraban que yo tendría una niña.
![IMG-20260505-WA0086.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/245myMwUqmrahUA2HzfGCEDoBmk8peqrBFQfB4Ei6GAycQWPh1FFtpdtWfSN7pD5F6jbX.jpg)

Pero hicimos un gender reveal muy a nuestro estilo, como bartenders: preparando un trago. Si salía azul era niño, si salía rosado era niña.
Y salió azul.
![IMG-20260505-WA0092.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/23u652J473sbBMpdo884UCA5pxoLZw1g1EXwhJQNdKXFHeaz1sBbsg9mRMmWhkxkJQsQo.jpg)

Hoy quise compartir cómo fue mi embarazo, con sus momentos difíciles y sus momentos hermosos. Mañana les contaré cómo fue el día más importante: el nacimiento de mi hijo.
Gracias por leerme, por acompañarme siempre.
Muchos besitos 💛

ENGLISH 🇬🇧

Today I want to share a very important part of my life: my pregnancy.
It all started while I was working at the hotel. I’m a bartender in a VIP restaurant that also has a coffee bar, and I spent my days making cappuccinos, cortaditos, coffee with milk… but suddenly, something changed.
Every time the milk heated up and the steam came out of the frother, I felt terrible nausea. Dizziness, weakness… I felt like my body wasn’t the same anymore.
At that time in Cuba, there was a lot of talk about an illness called “oropuche,” transmitted by a mosquito, and everyone thought that was what I had. Even the doctors associated my symptoms with that, because I also started having a fever.
So I kept working like that, feeling unwell, without really knowing what was happening.
Until one day in August, the restaurant’s cook, Lisandra, said something that stayed with me: “Moana” —that’s what my coworkers call me because of my looks— “I’ve had that periodo three times… and you haven’t had it even once? Have you taken a pregnancy test?”
I told her no, that I was taking contraceptive pills… but that question stuck in my mind.
That same day, on August 4th, 2024, at 8:00 at night, I decided to take the test.
My husband and I were in the bathroom, nervous, waiting for the result… and there they were: two red lines.
Positive.🥰
![IMG-20260505-WA0101.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/23zkgFCo9gkhLf4kjb3c6WCUoJ96Spty6YctRzWACvtyMoaZEjeMqPWLGu2bmgF6VP3tG.jpg)

We couldn’t believe it. Even so, I bought another test to take the next morning, as doctors recommend… but I couldn’t wait. And yes, it was positive again.
On August 6th, we went to the maternity center in Matanzas, and during the ultrasound we saw a tiny sac… with a heartbeat. I was already 7 weeks and 2 days pregnant.
That’s when everything truly began.
I don’t know if it was mental or physical, but from that moment on I felt even weaker. My body was already going through big changes, and working became impossible. As bartenders, we walk a lot and spend many hours standing… and by the end of the day my feet were swollen and exhausted. My clothes didn’t fit anymore, and I had to go to work wearing whatever I could, even without my uniform.
And I wasn’t even three months pregnant yet.
At three months, a very difficult moment came: I had a threatened miscarriage. It was a huge scare. Later, I also had a kidney infection and had to be hospitalized and treated with antibiotics. It was a hard time, especially because I’m very afraid of needles… but I did everything for my baby.
Everything.
Despite the difficult moments, it was also a very beautiful stage in our relationship. Lázaro started taking care of us in an incredible way. He even stopped sleeping beside me just to sleep hugging my belly. He took on all the responsibilities—rent, baby expenses, everything—while I could no longer work.
His support meant everything.
My belly grew a lot, and it was a beautiful stage. I kept walking, exercising, staying active. I ate everything (although I know every pregnancy is different), and thank God I didn’t have hypertension or diabetes. My baby was growing healthy.
![IMG-20260505-WA0108.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/2423sCMdGrrmn6mP4Nn6G59AKFdqXeLMsGrev8tLYFAKGLzP7qzvnJuXXpKa3J9PisEts.jpg)

I had many mood swings: I cried, I laughed… but I also felt more beautiful. In my neighborhood, people say that when you’re having a boy, you look less pretty, so everyone thought I was having a girl.
But we did a gender reveal in our own bartender style: making a drink. If it turned blue, it was a boy; if it turned pink, it was a girl.
And it turned blue.
Today I wanted to share what my pregnancy was like, with its difficult moments and its beautiful ones. Tomorrow I’ll tell you about the most important day: the birth of my son.
Thank you for reading me, for always being there.
Many kisses 💛
![IMG-20260505-WA0106.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/23xetCj9sdXpC6PX5m9suwaSNh2vXw5Em9YGRZyt8ErQQPhCuismaJ9WBzrjdMFAQr634.jpg)

Gracias a mi esposo, @valderalazaro, por ser mi apoyo incondicional en cada etapa de mi vida, incluso en las más difíciles.
A @bradleyarrow y a su esposa @cathyarrow, por formar parte de mi familia y por ser personas tan maravillosas.
Y a todos los seguidores de PEAKD, gracias por estar, por leer y por acompañar cada historia. Los invito a seguir apoyando la comunidad BBH, para que juntos podamos seguir ayudando a quienes más lo necesitan.
Acknowledgements (English):
Thanks to my husband, @valderalazaro, for being my unconditional support through every stage of my life, even the hardest ones.
To @bradleyarrow and his wife @cathyarrow, for being part of my family and for being such wonderful people.
And to all the peakd followers, thank you for being there, for reading, and for supporting every story. I invite you all to continue supporting the BBH community, so together we can keep helping those in need.

body.title: My Actifict report: May 5, 2026 - Exercise Routine / Rutina de Ejercicios
body.body:
>

***English***

### <center>**Exercise Routine**</center>  

The week has begun, and with it I’ve started with renewed enthusiasm to maintain my physical fitness in the long term; that’s why I’ve decided to begin a regular exercise routine that allows me to work the different muscles in my body. The idea behind this is to maintain full mobility, combat a sedentary lifestyle, and counteract the weight gain that comes with age, thereby ensuring a much more active and healthy future.

<div class=\

> >***Español*** >###
**Rutina de Ejercicios**
>Comenzó la semana y con ella arranqué un espíritu renovado que busca mantener mi condición física a largo plazo; es por esta razón que he decidido comenzar un patrón rutinario de ejercicios que me permitan trabajar los diferentes músculos de mi cuerpo. La idea detrás de esta acción es mantener una plena movilidad, combatir el sedentarismo, el aumento de peso que llega con la edad y así poder garantizar un futuro mucho más dinámico y saludable. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1d5fda47-e25a-4e03-bc19-1b25f58aae4c.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c8d7d5b9-1358-49ba-ad50-a4218c9ec5b7.jpg) For as long as I can remember, I’ve been quite thin with very little muscle development, which needs to be properly worked on so that, over time, it begins to grow evenly, resulting in a physique that’s both visually appealing and functional in daily life. Today I started with a chest and back routine; each day I’ll work a different area of the body, and I hope that by the end of the year the results will be visible and feel good. >Desde que tengo memoria, yo soy bastante delgado y con un desarrollo muscular bastante pobre, el cual debe ser trabajado de manera adecuada para que con el pasar del tiempo comience a crecer de forma bastante pareja, logrando así una definición corporal agradable a la vista y al mismo tiempo funcional en el día a día. Hoy comencé con una rutina de pecho y espalda; cada día trabajaré un área distinta del cuerpo y así espero que para el final de año los resultados se vean y se sientan de forma agradable. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d6cf2fc9-5b99-442b-af6f-a5dec16cc64a.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/01d6b2c8-0f59-423d-8b7d-118ace89af43.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/bdd2da8a-6dff-4b6a-9e6f-82d775456440.jpg) For all the exercises I’ve been doing, I follow a routine of 15 or 20 reps, with three sets; as for the weight, I’m using about 8 kg per dumbbell. You might think this is too little or too moderate, but for someone who isn’t used to this type of training, it’s a real challenge, and I’m sure that over time my body will start asking for more weight. For now, I want to take things slowly, but I’m confident I’m on the right track. >En todos los ejercicios implementados, una rutina de 15 o 20 movimientos, con tres repeticiones; en cuanto al peso, estoy trabajando con alrededor de 8 kg por cada mancuerna. Quizás ustedes puedan pensar que se trata de muy poco o demasiado moderado, pero para una persona que no está acostumbrada a este tipo de entrenamientos, esto es un verdadero reto y estoy seguro de que con el pasar del tiempo mi cuerpo irá pidiendo más kilos. body.title: TIB - An Investors Journal #808 - Uranium, Lithium, Battery Technology, Platinum, Coal Mining, Aerospace/Defense, ASX Stocks, Gold Mining, Oil Shipping + more
body.body:
A step back week to listen to interviews and gear up a few commodity angles - some will surprise - like coal and platinum ![May1Trades.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23xVaGbnk63XRhdAAEMtnV5kCkweSrDZEfBULaEc81nS37VzwEukGPbRqgsGGjiDrxEYZ.png)

Portfolio News

In a week where S&P 500 rose 0.94% and Europe rose 0.11%, my pension portfolio dropped 0.56%. In fact all the larger portfolios dropped - all heavily weighted to commodities Big movers of the week were Cauldron Energy (CXU.AX) (32.7%), NICO Resources (NC1.AX) (28.9%), Arizona Eagle Mining (AZEM.V) (27.5%), AdAlta (1AD.AX) (25%), Lithium Americas (LAC) (23.1%), Fortuna Metals (FUN.AX) (22.2%), Casino, Guichard-Perrachon (CO.PA) (21.6%), Panasonic Holdings Corporation (6752.T) (15.5%), Peabody Energy Corporation (BTU) (14.4%), Fiverr International (FVRR) (14.2%), Aurelia Metals (AMI.AX) (13.7%), Tess Holdings (5074.T) (13.5%), Gevo, Inc. (GEVO) (12.8%), Neo Energy Metals Plc (NEO.L) (12.2%) Only 14 stocks in the big movers list on a week where S&P500 made new highs. The big themes have a few representatives - from the top: uranium (2 stocks), alternate energy (4 stocks), gold mining (2 stocks) ![May1News.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23vsojqfetK4rYyS3qSAUHXanzvDF8HpiSDnPwHM7chMb4VZUx6RomWjaMQPCupWZDSTE.png) A news full week had markets bouncing up and down - from war to the Federal Reserve to earnings and record closes. Meant to get into the routine of doing portfolio comparison monthly - forgot last month - here is the 12 month relative showing for pension portfolio - cumulative 50% annual return is better than double the S&P500 - note this does not include all ASX assets - only those on Interactive Brokers ![May1Super.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23viTAzJPe3xeHWPgU7rxgSeeHS9HGH2M9hTkhqJd1egr3XgMUh3JpYfZ48DTsYveTvGV.jpg) And for personal portfolio - better than 3 times more - this portfolio does have a large ASX holding which is not included ![May1MC.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23viTPXrCK3va6xpNjuWXYnuhms37eTisKwofLQGqhuHUkEo6VqWJ2PcsXF61c9dor7NN.jpg) **Crypto Grows** Bitcoin price pushed lower to start the week and then found buyers finishing the week 1% higher lower than the open with a trough to peak range of 7.3%. Did test up to $80k level a few times and then snuck through ![May3BTC.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23w3EVhVrc38giksRyaqLGhHMVZtHmsmjp5yRZzQtey7uEDFZY3juWCnUWWhhwipJkBnv.jpg) Ethereum chart looks the same but different with price pushing lower, finding buyers finishing the week 0.3% lower than the open with a peak to trough range of 7.3%. ![May3ETH.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23vsqxy54Hk6CHBqsUK3FU8Fo9jkjBR4Pv8ucokARwD6yNzTfixyHKXyNxPhFaKFwv3fN.jpg) **Nuclear Energy Holdings** A few additions and one sale and a 2.1% drop in valuations. ![May1NuclearChange.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23viRck6G3mXga1aNJfze88qdpWC7cpe1Q2xzo7A7GTKWpoJbAsizFBG8nKe7muYm6apq.jpg) One change in the mix of holdings with Ur-Energy (URG) and Silex Systems (SLX.AX) swapping places in slots 8 and 9. Number of stocks in Others goes up 2 with the additions made. Share of portfolios goes up 0.1 points. ![May1Nuclear.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/245nCGx4M6KudhoFYfZA5cny6GQg1t8G6sByz1FwNXDZ7iRU2Yp7kKmdqjeVR82fMJNkY.jpg) A few changes in holdings by state with Near Producing dropping half a point, and the bigger change of 1.7 points in Technology with the addition there. ![May1NuclearbyStage.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/EoeLmtSueGJZ2EbcJ8YzHipctzGSoQkEWzTqWq75wraoJvwFMBeW5JwphAwZYxoA3pF.jpg) **Alternate Energy Holdings** Two changes in holdings and a modest 0.4% increase in valuation. ![May1LithiumChange.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23viTAxxvpSJkm39DN93YUHphvhk9JQvqng34KBHNk1t8drWwTzEGwyv5F6j2VAdPAGCQ.jpg) ![May1Lithium.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/244eT7SsV55FwUNZ4vcvXHmt8UoR6Vcd9ZVuyeg34GhLiQmetGXv8XEtHdrqAxukFT9ff.jpg) Mix of holdings has a few changes with QuantumScape Corporation (QS) and PLS Group (PLS.AX) changing places in slots 6 and 7. Vulcan Energy Resources (VUL.AX) comes into the Top 10 in slot 9 and Frontier Nuclear and Minerals (FNUC) drops out despite the addition there. Share of portfolios goes up 0.3 points. **Precious Metals Holdings** Quite a few additions and a disappointing 4.5% drop in valuations ![May1PreciousChange.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23vsojrKynG4PHztX5wVwHg3HWHo7RXonGR79dFXxvqBwGo4xFs9gvCnP3eav4zYYGvss.jpg) A few changes in the mix of holdings. WisdomTree Physical Gold (PHGP.L) and Coeur Mining (CDE) change places in slots 4 and 5 and Pilbara Gold (PGL.AX) and Alamos Gold (AGI) swap places in slots 7 and 8. Share of portfolios rises 0.2 points and share of Others rises 1.3 points with 2 new stocks added. ![May1Precious.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/244yENugFJgH9DX5hYJTFjT1ZfR2Ua7oC5ZC955TTUAuHP9wz5aXtHxACxwa4fm2ENK65.jpg)

Bought

**Frontier Nuclear Minerals was Snow Lake Resources**: (FNUC): Uranium/Lithium. Averaged down in pension portfolio. Company is making a switch to focus on uranium - lithium assets will be spun off into a separate entity - maybe then the management team will have a stronger focus. **QuantumScape Corporation** (QS): Battery Technology. Following the spike in price on one day the previous week am exposed to a sold put that is well in-the-money. Got two paths to work through this. 1. Kick the can down the road on the sold puts until price moves in the right direction. 2. Buy a new parcel of stock to average down in the event price stays around currently levels and used covered call to find an exit point. Bought the parcel in pension portfolio - same size as the sold put contract. **Valterra Platinum** (VALT.L): Platinum. Watched the Triangle Investor video with Trader Ferg - almost an afterthought comment about platinum group metals - catalytic converters are not dead and this company is a bit better than the others >Valterra Platinum, formerly Anglo American Platinum (Amplats), is a South African mining company and the world's largest primary producer of platinum, accounting for approximately 38% of global annual supply. The company traces its origins to 1995, when Johannesburg Consolidated Investments unbundled its platinum interests to form Amplats, which later became a majority-owned subsidiary of Anglo American A small bit of history my father was a director of JCI a bit before this time when JCI owned RustPlats Watched a segment on Triangle Investor with TraderFerg. He talked about the energy challenges of poorer nations facing LNG shortages with the closure of the Straits of Hormuz. Going to ignite the demand for coal and extension of coal power was his view. Went digging into thermal coal stocks and the Coal ETF. A few charts starting off with the Top 15 Holdings in the Range Global Coal ETF (COAL) - thermal coals miners highlighted ![Apr28COALMix.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23tcNRVyjGs7btrQKKgyJthkB2Fp8ioehfr4u1txQXJP6nCYtVtMgsX7gKbGNpUA6rhMv.jpg) First chart studied goes back to cycle low to October 2025 - this shows two thermal coal stocks lagging - added those first in pension portfolio ![Apr28COAL.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23u6YZFBnoUzBbeC3QEiet2ZciHaDmqjWh2GkcYq4mTmEXcCYVjVFTpkuznsJGYHeH9Xu.jpg) **Peabody Energy** (BTU): Coal Mining. Largest exporter of US thermal coal - long run view is great but under-performing in the shorter view. Dividend yield 1.12%. 1.35% 17.2% **Core Natural Resources** (CNR): Coal Mining. Dividend yield 0.45% ![Apr28COALOneYear.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23vsqqLYSBYxbtC6stWXCDkGti4idegEWXrUUEpuSPZ1TGgjmENBTevTZPwS4yEBUfYtn.jpg) Then a chart looking at all the coal stocks in the Top 15 going back 12 months to when two of the thermal stocks made it into Sharesies portfolio. This chart shows those two stocks Yancoal Australia (YAL.AX) and New Hope Corporation (NHC.AX) lagging the ETF and the leader by some margin. Also included the Steel ETF (XLX) - it is leading the Coal ETF. This is somewhat ahead of the coal stocks - going to drag metallurgical coal along is my take. **Range Global Coal ETF** (COAL): Coal Mining. Dividend yield 2.19%. Added this to grab any of the steel driven metallurgical coal momentum **Noble Plains Uranium** (NOBL.V): Uranium. Watched Triangle Investors interview with CEO, Drew Berryman talking about the Duck Creek minerals resource estimate just released. Was impressed with the rate of progress of getting the estimate ready in just 8 months. More interesting was the discussion about expanding the resource and the relationship with UR-Energy (URG) for processing. >With the additions of Duck Creek and Shirley Central, alongside our 100%-owned Shirley East, Noble Plains now controls a district-scale position (~4,965 acres / ~20 km²) across Wyoming’s premier ISR uranium basins (Shirley and Powder River). The portfolio combines brownfield datasets (4,000+ historic holes at Duck Creek) with proven ISR geology and proximity to established operators, providing a clear pathway to compliant resources with upcoming drill programs as key catalysts. https://nobleplains.com/ **Ur-Energy Inc** (URG): Uranium. Added a holding in personal portfolio based on the discussion about the relationship between Noble Plains Uranium (NOBL.V) and the company - the continuity potential in the Shirley Basin was a strong under-current. Later in the week added also to managed portfolio. **Rolls-Royce Holdings plc** (RR.L): Aerospace/Defense. Price has dropped below strike on sold puts - bought a first parcel to average down should those sold puts go to assignment. Will kick the can down the road on portion of the sold put contracts - too big a slice to take on just yet. Wrote covered call for 1.1% premium with 11.3% price coverage. **ACDC Metals** (ADC.AX): Rare Earths/Gold Mining. Read a tweet about the relative valuations of the company and VHM Limited (VHM.AX) both developing minerals sands projects in Goschen, Victoria. Stock was in a trading halt - the halt was this announcement >ACDC Metals has secured rights to earn a 100% interest in the Mount Jackson Gold-Silver project in the highly mineralised Walker Lane district, Nevada >Mount Jackson is proximal to major miners and explorers: ▪ Round Mountain (Kinross Gold) ▪ Arthur Gold (AngloGold Ashanti) ▪ North Bullfrog (AngloGold Ashanti) Gives two reasons to own the stock - close the valuation gap and add in gold/silver potential. Disadvantage - loss of focus is always a factor. ![May1ADCvsVHM.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23tSzLNvtkU3wR9CDnTBpySGcfx2byE7PLNZ7TAxXpTu93nGirsCfmVrHsevFyTtKv87N.jpg) Chart shows the valuation gap is not that large - just 35 percentage points **Lithium Universe** (LU7.AX): Lithium. Stock has appeared on big movers list a few times in recent weeks. Averaged down with another holding in personal portfolio. A few reasons to plunk more money down on a stock that has not done very well. Rick Rule mentioned in an interview in the week that the problem in lithium is not supply of material but it is in processing capacity. The company is re-engaging the development of Bécancour Lithium Carbonate Refinery in Québec, Canada and have identified a second U.S. refinery site at Port of Brownsville, Texas which will use the Bécancour design and has a feedstock sourced. Also progressing to commence engineering phase for PV (solar panel) recycling plant (using the Texas site) - recycling silver. Last point is Iggy Tan has been appointed as CEO - he was CEO of Galaxy Resources all those years ago - that worked. **Lotus Resources** (LOT.AX): Uranium. Company announced quarterly activity that disappointed the markets. They seemed to focus on this line: 119.8kt ore milled and production of 78.3klb drummed uranium for the quarter and not on the words > Lotus continues to ramp up operations at its Kayelekera Uranium Mine in Malawi towards nameplate production, while also advancing its large-scale Letlhakane uranium project in Botswana. The words in the statement seem solid enough - getting over sulphuric and reagent supply chain issues and progressing. Key words around the Letlhakane project - to date this is basically carrying no value in the valuations. Added another small parcel in pension portfolio which has the smallest holding. **NANO Nuclear Energy** (NNE): Nuclear Technology. With price opening at $24.07 (Apr 27) scaled into January 2027 40/20 risk reversal in pension portfolio. The call option is fully funded (many times over) and breakeven on the sold puts should they get assigned is $11.31 - some way to go before the call option goes in-the-money. Started some analysis of precious metals holdings across the portfolios compared with the sector ETFs. In the process noticed that the managed portfolio is seriously under-invested in gold and silver stocks. The talk from the likes of Don Durrett and Trader Ferg and David Erfle is the next leg up is not far off. Put in place a few new positions in managed portfolio - and a bunch of sold puts too to find lower entry prices if there is still a leg down. **OR Royalties** (OR): Gold. Dividend yield 0.60%. Picked this as it appears in the Top 15 holdings of Global X Silver Miners ETF (SIL) and Rick Rule likes the royalty idea - I do too - less capital risk. >OR Royalties Inc. holds a North American focused portfolio of over 195 royalties, streams and precious metal offtakes. OR Royalties Inc.’s portfolio is anchored by its cornerstone asset, a 3-5% net smelter return royalty on the Canadian Malartic Complex, one of Canada’s largest gold mines. **Amplify Junior Silver Miners ETF** (SILJ): Silver Mining. Yield 1.87%. Picked this rather than try to find juniors that could win. That can be next stage analysis. **Wheaton Precious Metals Corp** (WPM): Gold/Silver Mining. Also a royalty business with 61% gold/39% silver. Dividend yield 0.62%. Sold puts all with May expiry offer returns greater than 1% and price protection over 5%. Contract sizes all in line with stock positions would be happy to hold. - VanEck Gold Miners ETF (GDX): Gold. Return 1.49% Coverage 7.1% - VanEck Junior Gold Miners ETF (GDXJ): Gold. Return 1.36% Coverage 9.4% - OR Royalties Inc. (OR): Gold. Return 1.83% Coverage 8.1% - Global X Silver Miners ETF (SIL): Silver. Return 1.10% Coverage 11.8% - Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. (WPM): Gold/Silver. Return 2.18% Coverage 8.0%

Sold

**Northern Star Resources** (NST.AX): Gold Mining. Closed out a small parcel in pension portfolio to release cash to pay next month's pension. Locks in 3,905% profit since April 2025. Holding came from initial investment in De Grey Mining since taken over by Northern Star **F4 Uranium Corp** (FFU.V): Uranium. Price has been on a tear - closed out a portion to fund purchase of Noble Plains Uranium (NOBL.V) above and locked in 218% blended profit since August 2024/May 2025. Still retain a holding. **Robin Energy** (RBNE): Oil Shipping. Tender offer processed - partial fill in personal portfolio for 15.6% profit since March 2026. Because of a trading mistake between accounts had more than an odd lot. Some way to go to recover the shortfall in this account. Did get the full teneder off in pension portfolio for 15.4% profit - not bad for one month. Swiss Transparent Portfolio idea. Sure hope their one ship is south of the Straits of Hormuz.

ASX Portfolio

The segment reports trading in ASX fractional share portfolio. Trade entries are made based on stock screens looking for undervalued stocks (price to book, price earnings, price to sales) that are showing technical signs of breaking a downtrend. Exits are made at 35% profit or 25% if 52 week high is lower than 35% advance. New buys are in $500 lots. Scale ins and top ups in $250 lots **New Buys** Following on the analysis of thermal coal stocks done above chose to add back holdings of ASX thermal coal stocks in this portfolio as there is history here - chose to split the New Buy amount of $500 between the two stocks. **Yancoal Australia** (YAL.AX): Coal Mining. Dividend yield 2.41% **New Hope Corporation** (NHC.AX): Coal Mining. Dividend yield 3.65% **Scale Ins** **Top Ups** **Betr Entertainment Limited** (BBT.AX): Gaming. Signal came up for PointsBet Holdings (PBH.AX) with a a chart looking pretty well beaten up. ![Apr29BBTPBH.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23wXNdGooKK9mFnVniiHP8BzjrTc5qp2JTydNWaUkuzsoDfXEsG9FeQkAUSZSEXK6Rs4p.jpg) Did some digging into the gaming stock already held - discovered that Betr Entertainment (BBT.AX) has an important stake. Rather than follow the signal, chose to scale into existing holding to average down entry price - maybe a rising tide will lift both stocks. **Sold** No sales

Income Trades

**Covered Calls** 7 covered calls written across 3 portfolios (UK 1 US 6) **UBS EXTRACS Silver Shares Covered Call ETN** (SLVO): Silver. Added to holding in pension portfolio on a down day - what is not to like about this yield - 38.15% **UBS EXTRACS Crude Oil Shares Covered Call ETN**: (USOI): Oil. UAE pulls out of OPEC - probably not good for rising oil prices long term - but a shorter term shock. Yield 21.08% **The Mosaic Company** (MOS): Fertilizer. Managed to sell more call options than stock to cover in managed portfolio - well out the money - will not be a problem. **Naked Puts** Sold puts happy to own at lower prices - Equinox Gold Corp (EQX): Gold Mining. Return 2.2% Coverage 13.2% - Mirion Technologies (MIR): Nuclear Technology. Return 2.46% Coverage 13% - Pan American Silver Corp (PAAS): Silver Mining. Return 3.87% Coverage 4.6% - now ITM - Peabody Energy Corporation (BTU): Coal Mining. Return 1.6% Coverage 18.3% - Core Natural Resources (CNR): Coal Mining. Return 1.4% Coverage 12.2% - Oklo Inc. (OKLO): Nuclear Technology. Return 4.6% Coverage 19.2% - The Mosaic Company (MOS): Fertilizer. Return 2.2% Coverage 7.6% - NuScale Power Corporation (SMR): Nuclear Technology. Return 4.9% Coverage 17.6% - Glencore plc (GLEN.L): Base Metals. Return 0.6% Coverage 11.8% - Fresenius SE & Co (FRE.DE): German Healthcare. Return 1.3% Coverage 6.4% - State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLK): US Technology. Return 0.77% Coverage 6.7% - iShares U.S. Regional Banks ETF (IAT): US Regional Banks. Return 1.04% Coverage 2.7% - State Street SPDR S&P Regional Banking ETF (KRE): US Regional Banks. Return 0.59% Coverage 0.9% - 2 days - SLB N.V. (SLB): Oil Services. Return 0.74% Coverage 3.9% - one week - Baker Hughes Company (BKR): Oil Services. Return 1.5% Coverage 7.7% - ChargePoint Holdings (CHPT): Electric Vehicles. Return 2.5% Coverage 13.8% - ASP Isotopes (ASPI): Nuclear Technology. Return 8% Coverage 10.5% - Aurora Cannabis (ACB.TO): Marijuana. Return 0.9% Coverage 18.3% - after high TSX commissions - Westwater Resources (WWR): Graphite. Return 2% Coverage 30% - First Majestic Silver Corp (AG): Silver Mining. Return 4.4% Coverage 2.7% - Alamos Gold (AGI): Gold Mining. Return 4.3% Coverage 8.1% - June expiry Sold puts on stocks that might get assigned on covered calls - Helmerich & Payne (HP): Oil Services. Return 1% Coverage 15.4% Kicked the can down the road on sold puts that could be assigned - iShares U.S. Aerospace & Defense ETF (ITA): Aerospace/Defense 20.6% loss on buy back. 3.7% cash positive - a frustrating investment. - Invesco Solar ETF (TAN): Solar Power. 33% profit on buy back. 18.9% cash positive **Energy Fuels** (UUUU): Uranium. With price opening at $21.64 (May 1) converted a 15/25 call spread to a call spread risk reversal in pension portfolio. Return on sold put of 6.7% with 20% coverage now. **Credit Spreads** One new credit spread - State Street Financial Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLF) ROI 28.2% Coverage 0.6% Exercise risk is withing cash margin. Total risk looks a bit high in both sets - in managed that is around the cash holdings which are a bit higher than normal at the momement.

You cannot give away your sole authority to rule you, even if you want to.  You cannot be property, not even your own property, because you cannot assign to another the right to do with you as you wish.  You will always have the sole authority over you.  

So no claim of higher authority over you is factual.  Government is the claim of higher authority over the people, and it is a lie.  It is a crime against all people, because all people are sovereign.  We can agree amongst ourselves to act in ways that limit our autonomy.  That can be lawful and just.  But no claim to exceed our personal authority over ourselves is true, nor just.  

Scribbles on paper defend nothing.  Free men with arms defend them.  The Heller decision makes this plain, and history reveals the truth of this assertion.  More than 1000 times in history head were mounted on pikes, policitians danced, dangling from lamp posts, and in the Seventeenth Century the Dutch cooked and ate the liver of their corrupt, despised Prime Minister.  That will happen soon.

This, I believe, will be the last time it happens, because as we seize the means of production we eliminate the parasitism overlords depend on.  When you grow a potato you keep 100% of your production.  No overlord gets a cut.  No middleman earns a wage.  No taxable event occurs, and when you make what you need with a 3D printer, a laser cutter, or DIY solar panels, that is just as true. When we eliminate centraliztion we will eliminate overlords, and government.  Then we will be free.

body.title: My best game with Clint in Mobile Legends🎮(EN/ES)
body.body:
> I hope you’re all doing well; I’m fine, thank God. I won’t lie to you – I was a bit absent from Hive last week. Between work, some personal errands I’d been putting off that just wouldn’t let up, and the fact that I’ve gone back to studying – this time for a postgraduate degree and finishing off a few courses – I simply couldn’t keep up 😅. So I’m in the process of organising my time better so I can get everything done. However, this week I’m already catching up 💪 The gameplay I’m bringing you—it’s been a while since I uploaded one—is from Mobile Legends: Bang Bang, that MOBA that sometimes drives me up the wall but that I just can’t stop playing 🤣. This time I want to share a match with you using Clint, a fairly versatile ADC hero. Remember that ADC heroes are marksmen, but Clint has something that sets him apart from the rest: he’s an explosive hero. In other words, his damage doesn’t depend solely on basic attacks; much of his potential lies in his abilities. Plus, his passive means that every time you use a skill, your next basic attack hits much harder 🔥 That’s why the combo is quite simple: Ultimate + basic attack + first skill + basic attack, whilst the second skill is mainly used for escaping, as Clint has very good survivability if used well. Now, getting into the game, I’m not going to lie to you – I SWEATED 🤣 And it wasn’t because of anything specific, but the usual thing: playing solo. I don’t have a team to communicate with, so I have to ‘trust’ that the others will do their job properly, which most of the time doesn’t happen 😅 The good thing is that the enemy ADC was way below me in terms of damage. As I said before, with a single combo I could take him out without much trouble. Now, the enemy jungler also made two key mistakes. The first was focusing on me and even taunting me, which I took as a “see you at the bottom” 😌. And the second was prioritising kills over objectives, and that, in this game, practically decides 80% of matches. There was a point where we were on the brink of losing the game, literally hanging by a thread. If it hadn’t been for holding out under the pressure, not letting them advance and eliminating them at just the right moment, we would have lost right there and then. The real problem was the enemy mage, who was the one holding the whole game together for them. So when we took the second upgraded Lord, I knew he was going to try to steal it. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarqm/Eo6D9CfAA1fvDHitgL4NpRGRRC4Yvm4GFNx7YwRbWPpnVCDUAhQAyQquPfdWTVxbe9Z.jpg As I didn’t have a tank to check the bushes, I decided to do the one thing I hate most when others do it to me 🤣 but it’s just part of the game mechanics: camping. And well, you can see the result at the end. I’ll leave the rest of the game’s progression for you to watch in the video. I hope you enjoy it! 💜

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarqm/23yU8Zfg24LstJWiiJHyvYoWwxmTc5uBuGGdwuDb2EeUUqfSD6aLWz7DAeJdRrtGejw6g.png **

Versión en Español

** **
¡Saludos comunidad de Hive!
**

> Espero que se encuentren muy bien, yo bien gracias a Dios. La semana pasada estuve un poco ausente de Hive, no les voy a mentir. Entre el trabajo, unas diligencias personales que tenía pendientes y que no me daban tregua, además de que retomé los estudios esta vez con un postgrado y culminando algunos cursos, simplemente no me daba abasto 😅. Así que ando en ese proceso de organizar mejor mi tiempo para poder cumplir con todo. Sin embargo, esta semana ya me estoy poniendo al día 💪 El gameplay que les traigo, que tenía rato sin subir uno, es de Mobile Legends: Bang Bang, ese MOBA que a veces me saca canas verdes pero que no puedo dejar de jugar 🤣. En esta oportunidad quiero compartirles una partida usando a Clint, un héroe ADC bastante versátil. Recordemos que los héroes ADC son de tipo tirador, pero Clint tiene algo que lo diferencia bastante del resto: es un héroe explosivo. Es decir, su daño no depende solo de los ataques básicos, sino que gran parte de su potencial está en sus habilidades. Además, su pasiva hace que cada vez que uses una habilidad, el siguiente ataque básico pegue mucho más fuerte 🔥 Por eso, el combo es bastante sencillo: Ulti (definitiva) + básico + primera habilidad + básico, mientras que la segunda se utiliza más que todo para escapar, ya que Clint tiene muy buena supervivencia si se usa bien. Ahora, entrando en la partida, no les voy a mentir SUDE 🤣 Y no fue por algo específico, sino por lo de siempre juego solo. No tengo un equipo con quien comunicarme, así que me toca “confiar” en que los demás hagan bien su trabajo cosa que la mayoría de las veces no pasa 😅 Lo bueno es que el ADC enemigo estaba muy por debajo de mí en daño. Como les decía antes, con un solo combo podía desaparecerlo sin mucho problema.Ahora, el jungla enemigo también cometió dos errores clave. El primero fue enfocarme y hasta burlarse cosa que yo me tomo como un “nos vemos en la bajadita” 😌. Y el segundo, priorizar kills en lugar de objetivo y eso, en este juego, define prácticamente el 80% de las partidas. Hubo un punto donde estuvimos a nada de perder la partida, literal a caramelito. Si no hubiese sido por aguantar la presión, no dejarlos avanzar y eliminar en el momento justo, ya hubiésemos perdido ahí mismo. El verdadero problema era el mago enemigo, que era el que estaba sosteniendo todo el juego para ellos. Así que cuando hicimos el segundo Lord mejorado, yo sabía que él iba a intentar robarlo. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarqm/Eo6D9CfAA1fvDHitgL4NpRGRRC4Yvm4GFNx7YwRbWPpnVCDUAhQAyQquPfdWTVxbe9Z.jpg Como no tenía tanque que revisara arbustos, decidí hacer lo que más detesto que me hagan a mi 🤣 pero son mecánicas del juego, campear. Y bueno, el resultado lo pueden ver al final. El resto del desarrollo de la partida se los dejo en el video. ¡Espero que lo disfruten! 💜

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarqm/23yU8Zfg24LstJWiiJHyvYoWwxmTc5uBuGGdwuDb2EeUUqfSD6aLWz7DAeJdRrtGejw6g.png

body.title: Three Tune Tuesday || Marcos left (En-Es)
body.body:
<center>
![Audifonos para mi Gamer favorito (85).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mafalda2018/48RPmWaKjTQmak3AsBWFfnEMnqCwQs6X15qoW9pek2GC1xRiQkjCHprWRHXUkbv4N1.png)
</center>




#
<center>
## “Music expresses what cannot be said and that about which it is impossible to remain silent.”
(Victor Hugo) 
</center>
#

<div class=\

> **Friends, I’m just wandering through this lovely community, enjoying songs that speak the language of the soul and of love. Love upon love. Dance, be happy, and enjoy yourselves, because you only live once. If heartbreak comes knocking later, it doesn’t matter—because you lived it. I send you a hug and keep humming my song:** **“La, la, la…”** **Play it, DJ!…**

> >![Spanish] > >“La música expresa lo que no puede ser dicho y aquello sobre lo que es imposible permanecer en silencio.” ( Victor Hugo) Amigos, volandito por esta linda comunidad, disfrutando de canciones que expresan el lenguaje de alma y del amor. Amor más amor. Bailen, sean felices y disfruten pues la vida es una sola. Si después el despecho toca la puerta, pues no importa porque se vivió. Les dejo un abrazo y sigo tarareando mi canción: “La, la, la…” ¡Suenala DJ!…**
![Romantic and unforgettable melodies from the movies (26).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mafalda2018/EouACSo7utD4q3jUR9W1HqnQv2WKXQAUWZHb9GajJeFaxdZXPVBAP9PGKCReWqjQeJn.png)

> On life’s journey, we see all kinds of people come and go. Some don’t show their true selves, and others—like me—don’t care what anyone thinks of them. I am who I am, and I don’t like to imitate anyone. Well, things happen to me that I don’t think happen to ordinary people. Maybe it’s because I’m very absent-minded and live in my own world without noticing what’s going on around me. Actually, at this point in my life, I don’t know what it means to be normal. But what is certain is that I’m always focused on my goals. I think what matters is living, feeling, loving, and learning from my mistakes. When it comes to music, I’ve had every disappointment you can’t even imagine. Sometimes I like a song and get the singer’s name mixed up. OMG! Me and Donald Duck. That’s not all; I can argue about it and still be right. Many years ago, at a party on campus, Reinaldo Armas was performing, and my friend—who was presenting his thesis—was his cousin. To win me over, since he was hitting on me, he asked Reinaldo to dedicate a song to me. This guy, who wasn’t famous back then and was just starting his career, asked which song I wanted him to sing. And I told him: “Mi casa bella”—and not only that, I told him that was my favorite of his songs. He smiled and replied: “That song isn’t mine; it’s by Cristóbal Jiménez, but I’ll sing it for you.” Plop! Just like Condorito, I turned every shade of red. How embarrassing! To me and to Donald Duck. This happens to me all the time. And the reason for this post is to talk about my friend Marcos and his singer. I know you don’t know who Marcos is? Well, he’s a guy who left… He left. He left behind such a deep trauma and wound that even the singer herself couldn’t take it anymore and dedicated the song to him: “He left and he’s gone.” One night at a karaoke bar in my town, a group of friends and I decided to have some fun and sing. We made a bet to see who was brave enough, and, as always, Paraulata said: “Who said anything about being scared?” And she grabbed the microphone. Inside, Mafa and Beckyta were terrified of this girl’s crazy antics. She told the host that she wanted to sing “Marcos.” The guy, all friendly, replied: “Marcos, the one from the comic strip.” Paraulata, being bold, asked him how it was possible that he didn’t know the song “Marcos.” It was one of the most popular songs at karaoke. The poor guy, puzzled, didn’t know what to say. Then she answered him. “Honey! Marcos, the one who left, didn’t arrive on the train and didn’t come back.” Girls from #Music, you know which song this is, don’t you? Don’t worry, we’ve all suffered from heartbreak.

> >![Spanish] > >En el camino de la vida vemos transitar todo tipo de gente. Algunas no demuestran lo que son y otras, como yo, a las que les da igual lo que piensen de ellas. Soy como soy y no me gusta imitar a nadie. Pues a mí me suceden cosas que no creo que les sucedan a las personas corrientes. Quizás es porque soy muy despistada y vivo en mi mundo sin percatarme de lo que sucede a mi alrededor. En realidad, a estas alturas de mi vida no sé qué es ser normal. Pero lo que sí es cierto es que siempre estoy enfocada en mis metas. Creo que lo importante es vivir, sentir, amar y aprender de mis errores. Cuando se trata de música, me ha pasado cada chasco que ni se imaginan. A veces me sucede que me gusta una canción y confundo el nombre del cantante. ¡OMG! A mí y al pato Donald. Eso no es todo; puedo porfiar sobre ello y tengo la razón. Hace muchos años, en una fiesta en el campo universitario, estaban presentando a Reinaldo Armas y mi amigo, que presentaba la tesis, era su primo. Para congraciarse conmigo, pues me estaba “echando los perros”, le dijo que me dedicara una canción. Este señor, que en aquella época no era exitoso, estaba comenzando su carrera artística, preguntó cuál canción deseaba que él interpretara. Y yo le dije: “Mi casa bella” y no solo eso, le dije que esa era la que más me gustaba de él. El sonriente me respondió: —Esa canción no es mía, es de Cristóbal Jiménez, pero te la voy a cantar. ¡Plop!, como Condorito, puse de todos los colores. ¡Qué vergüenza! A mí y al Pato Donald. Esto suele pasarme. Y el motivo de esta publicación es hablar de mi amigo Marcos y de su intérprete. ¿Sé que ustedes no saben quién es Marcos? Pues, es un chico que se fue… Se fue. Dejó un trauma y una herida tan profunda y de tal manera que la misma cantante ya no pudo soportarlo y le dedicó: “Se fue y se fueee”. Cierta noche en un karaoke de mi ciudad, un grupo de amigas y yo decidimos echar broma y cantar. Hicimos una apuesta a ver quién tenía el valor y, como siempre, Paraulata expresó: ¿Quién dijo miedo? Y agarró el micrófono. Por dentro, Mafa y Beckyta estaban aterradas de las locuras de esta muchachita. Le dijo al anfitrión que ella quería cantar “Marcos”. El muchacho, todo simpático, le respondio: —Marcos, el de la comiquita”-. La Paraulata, de atrevida, le dijo que cómo era posible que él no conociera la canción de Marcos. Era una de las más sonadas en karaoke. El pobre chico, extrañado, sin saber qué decir. Entonces ella le contestó. —¡Mijo! Marcos, el que se fue, no llegó en el tren y no volvió. Chicas de #Music, ya saben de qué canción se trata, ¿o no? No se preocupen todas hemos sufrido mal de amores.

body.title: Our House, in the Middle of BC
body.body:
Soccer madness is beginning to hit the city of Vancouver as the 2026 World Cup approaches. While soccer is not wildly popular in Canada, Metro Vancouver has a team in Major League Soccer and in other leagues, including the Canadian Premier league. The city will host a number of matches, and in the lead up to the festivities, soccer-themed experiences are popping up throughout the city.

<center>![WC_Street.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EppHh9vubmev2QjvZyJxu8vkho6ZrnEirThkzzzdcwUiFCLhqVo3PYqUCGS1s2SJ4eF.jpg)</center>

The CONCACAF house was showcasing at Jack Poole Plaza, where the Olympic cauldron is located. The term CONCACAF refers to The Confederation of North, Central America and Caribbean Association Football. Canada is part of this confederation and has thus earned its rightful place in the CONCACAF house.

<center>![concacaf house.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/23rysmtLRDQUWbaEFrQA7gHy4kS4VossCxdUQWVnonjVkjijAgoMCJNU2W8yUHBgfQBTG.jpg)</center>

Inside the space, organizers set up a number of soccer related activities such as video games and ball games, installations and displays with soccer paraphernalia, and even a bar with free ice cream. 

<center>![Soccer House02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/23xejg5KgwmBgb5RQqLCMRmATpPkhFLEyESSoZo6iLAy4iEYgwKwNRRkvA6NwzFvWWTTv.jpg)</center>

These were colourful hand-painted soccer cleats representing each country of the football confederation.

<center>![Soccer House01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/23uQp4RQKpGradoK9t4H38uMQfqbaLPQLEa8c2dZjfuL91JwVfYEDwQt6VCDsB7nDfVNt.jpg)</center>

<center>![Soccer House05.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/23xAdqU7Avu9hPdVeJ6VKCaaqqqSJDZvE7PQv4xG7jCAffo7NXidcjunCdrbLmdNSMJP6.jpg)</center>

<center>![Soccer House04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/23yJJcXjs3dmEA9QhLSRhPxXVXhkFwEt4MHsHtXzKHnNGkyXhY5t2mAaRJrV69Auni5uM.jpg)</center>

What an excellent idea to showcase each country through the spirit of art and sports.

<center>![Soccer House06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/Ep5oCXAocY8MiKZct9EFXMKhHUk6xvuJtK4NiQt1GK1FNBYZhv5y8s94md7D71aoPVv.jpg)</center>

There were soccer table where visitors could sit and play with an opponent with a small ball.

<center>![Soccer House07.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/23uQjurBZm5vG8LFwtcQ8pDiyo47vBrmhcnDxL22xy6ZRXL43wqFAmLNasyTVm9mHnhgx.jpg)</center>

There were also various trophies and miscellaneous items on display from past competitions in the region.

<center>![Soccer House08.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/23xyVDATp2HP2yXEgVabawgNGeKyuXrgvXcgp8C4rSU3giWp4DtRtqk6H7iN2Vaduj7uA.jpg)</center>

<center>![Soccer House11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/23uQzjwbs7bxMmcvd3ju2Hrdwyfoj1AKbyPW4kd6Ny4rwTrZoi5jxEMZdurMA8FL1hzJw.jpg)</center>

I saw an area where you could kick balls to try and score into holes of various sizes on the wall. I was going to try my fancy moves, but things got really wild in there with a group of adults and kids, so I just moved on. There were assistants walking around and ensuring that everyone understood the games and was having a good experience with a serving of ice cream. 🍧

In the following photo, the 2010 Winter Olympics cauldron is visible thorough the translucent wall of the house. The see-through walls was a great touch because it made me feel as if I was still on the plaza with a great view of the mountains in the background.

<center>![Soccer House10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/23xATuzSdsCLYn2agXoTo11NuWWnVxT817jQdyiMGmED8Rix7XdmCXjR8YTsBeQYSm4kj.jpg)</center>

I look forward to our city welcoming the soccer world with open arms and bear hugs.

body.title: Celebrando el Cumpleaños n*6 de mi princesa [Esp/Eng].
body.body:
![IMG_20260505_220708.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX3tDkZsJvHmtypMkHYysWfmNR8qVEK5GNp3mPyuo6vyB/IMG_20260505_220708.jpg)

Saludos queridos y apreciados amigos, un gusto y un gran placer el saludarlos, en esta oportunidad quiero compartir con todos ustedes unas fotografías de un día maravilloso y muy especial, para mí y mi pequeña familia, pues el pasado 30 de Abril mi muñeca Emma estuvo cumpliendo sus 6 añitos y como toda niña de su edad tenía esa ilusión de celebrar junto a sus amiguitos, tanto así que ni siquiera quiso dejar pasar el día y celebrar el fin de semana si no que quería que fuera ése mismo día. Lamentablemente la situación económica no nos permitió realizarlo una fiesta como ella deseaba pero tampoco lo dejamos pasar, pues decidimos realizar algo muy íntimo entre la familia para celebrar este día tan especial. > Greetings dear and cherished friends, it's a pleasure to greet you all. On this occasion, I want to share some photos from a wonderful and very special day for me and my little family. Last April 30th, my little girl Emma turned 6, and like any girl her age, she was so excited to celebrate with her friends. She didn't even want to wait until the weekend to celebrate; she wanted it to be that very day. Unfortunately, our financial situation didn't allow us to throw her the big party she wanted, but we didn't let it go by unnoticed. We decided to have a small, intimate family celebration to mark this special day. ![IMG_20260505_220529.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbTte9XLfW3A7EiodKn23erLcVr9xAtJhVXJQmi6NyMgj/IMG_20260505_220529.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_220544.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbuWmACQTDRaLNgvojqXHmeceuGkKessMjiMYa23BVbta/IMG_20260505_220544.jpg)

Así pues la abuela realizó un muy hermoso pastel con motivo de las guerreras k- pop , unas comiquitas que ahora están muy de moda y pues a mi pequeña le encanta, así que la abuela hizo lo posible para complacerla, también compramos unas galletitas, refresco y globos para decorar para motivar a mí pequeña. El mismo día invitamos a los primitos más cercanos y a eso de las 7 de la noche ya todos reunidos, los niños le dieron vida a esta celebración, mi hija estaba feliz. > So, Grandma made a beautiful cake with a K-pop warrior theme, a cartoon that's very popular right now, and my little girl loves it. Grandma did her best to please her. We also bought cookies, soda, and balloons to decorate and get my little girl excited. That same day, we invited her closest cousins, and around 7 p.m., when everyone was gathered, the children brought the celebration to life. My daughter was so happy. ![IMG_20260505_220601.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ6eH2CQAefkd9T94cWL7a2bh3EQMFy6Z9pkDzqM1PrLU/IMG_20260505_220601.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_220618.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQXCgpcKkKhXM7keAcSGXYaxrNEcdFRLk1cnRF1ZBB3Ai/IMG_20260505_220618.jpg)

Yo aproveché para tomar algunas fotografías de mi hija con sus amiguitos y luego procedimos a cantar cumpleaños y compartir el pastel, la verdad fue algo súper sencillo pero pudimos complacer a mi niña y mirar esa sonrisa de felicidad lo vale todo. Yo a pesar de que no pude probar el pastel ni tomar refresco con mi situación de salud me sentí feliz y muy satisfecha de este pequeño compartir familiar. > I took the opportunity to take some pictures of my daughter with her friends, and then we sang \

and shared the cake. It was really simple, but we were able to make my little girl happy, and seeing that happy smile made it all worthwhile. Even though I couldn't try the cake or drink soda because of my health situation, I felt happy and very satisfied with this small family gathering. ![Polish_20260505_220211938.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdWPsmyVLSNc4ZxbmXtvF4xYpVCuGWzc47gaZ45C3sovU/Polish_20260505_220211938.jpg) ![Polish_20260505_220254861.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPKP43CZjkgKRqDGAFMVeN4xLnCFzYQZnDnAB6nyWuzVX/Polish_20260505_220254861.jpg)

El contenido de esta publicación es completamente original y todas las fotos son mías y fueron tomadas con mi celular Redmi note 13. > The content in this publication is completely original and all the photos are my own and were taken with my Redmi note 13 cell phone.

body.title: Activando Gemelos [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
>

Activando Gemelos. Hoy tenemos una sesión de ejercicios enfocados en los gemelos; éstos, son los músculos que se encuentran en las famosas pantorrillas y más allá de la estética al desarrollarlos; de acuerdo a mi experiencia y a muchas conversaciones que he tenido con entrenadores y traumatólogos, éstos músculos son olvidados sin saber lo vital que es tenerlos fuertes y bien dessrrollados. Ellos funcionan como el principal estabilizador del tobillo y protegen toda la zona del pie de cualquier impacto, alejando lo más posible la ocurrencia de lesiones. Por otra parte; son músculos esenciales en la salud cardiovascular. En definitiva; si las pantorrillas están fuertes y bien desarrolladas, nuestro cuerpo tendrá mucha estabilidad, agilidad y equilibrio. Muy importante; para la rutina de hoy vamos a utilizar un botellón de agua de 18 litros, que representa 18 kilos y una botella de 5 litros equivalente a 5 kilos. También tendremos a la disposición una silla. Ustedes pueden usar este tipo de material o cualquier que genere menor, igual o mayor peso; todo depende de la condición física de cada quien. No te quedes atrás, vente conmigo y dale movimiento a tu vida. >Working the Calves. Today we have a workout session focused on the calves; these are the muscles found in the lower legs, and beyond the aesthetic benefits of strengthening them, based on my experience and many conversations I’ve had with trainers and orthopedic specialists, these muscles are often overlooked, even though it’s vital to keep them strong and well-developed. They act as the primary stabilizers of the ankle and protect the entire foot area from impact, minimizing the risk of injury as much as possible. Furthermore, they are essential muscles for cardiovascular health. >In short, if your calves are strong and well-developed, your body will have great stability, agility, and balance. Very important: for today’s routine, we’ll be using an 18-liter water jug, which weighs 18 kilograms, and a 5-liter bottle, which weighs 5 kilograms. We’ll also have a chair available. You can use these items or any others that weigh less, the same, or more; it all depends on your individual fitness level. Don’t fall behind come with me and get your life moving.

![1000456235.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKNKGs8H328wjhfvgd4t8e3pg1hha9NsGCgSDcnJzYPWcgKhVR2BQahUwM2Sskh.gif)Portada de mi Autoría Editada en/Cover of my Authorship Edited in [Canva](https://www.canva.com/es_419/)
Logos propiedad de/ logos owned by @hiveio, @fulldeportes
# **
[Fase de Calentamiento]()
** Cuando vamos a realizar cualquier actividad física; siempre es recomendable; es más, debe ser un hábito obligatorio el de realizar ejercicios de calentamiento. Con ellos; ponemos a tono todo el cuerpo y alejamos la posibilidad de adquirir cualquier tipo de lesión. No realices ejercicios bruscos sin antes calentar; no arriesgues tu cuerpo por saltarte un minuto para calentar; vamos, activos. ># **
[Warm-up Phase]()
** >When we are going to do any physical activity, it is always advisable, in fact, it should be a mandatory habit to do warm-up exercises. With them, we get the whole body in tune and reduce the possibility of acquiring any type of injury. Do not do sudden exercises without warming up first; do not risk your body by skipping a minute to warm up; come on, let's get active. [**Calentamiento 1**, **RODILLAZOS ALTERNOS MÁS GOLPES CRUZADOS ADELANTE Y ATRÁS**]() [Postura]() Separamos las piernas al ancho de la cadera; brazos abiertos a los lados, con codos flexionados y manos empuñadas. >[**Warm-up 1**, **ALTERNATING KNEE LIFTS WITH CROSS-BODY PUNCHES FORWARD AND BACK**]() >[Stance]() >Stand with your feet hip-width apart; arms out to the sides, elbows bent, and hands clenched into fists.
![1000456170.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKGa1EYZGHRoy4UwJ4FJYi4dGqMKxgfrVXjUSQvTTEQaiRnjW6bTkXtjDNeZq6L.gif)
[Ejecución]() De forma rápida, vamos ejecutar los rodillazos alternos. Cuando la rodilla esté arriba, lanzamos el golpe cruzado sobre la misma. Cuando la rodilla esté abajo, lanzamos el golpe cruzado detrás de la espalda. 3 minutos de acción. >[Execution]() >Let's quickly move on to alternating knee strikes. When the knee is up, throw a cross punch over it. When the knee is down, throw a cross punch behind your back. 3 minutes of action.
![1000456174.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKDhuFRJHynmY3FxfdVTWizfskDzK6Jer7AGfUokBgefqos3VgfFHVVY9jUqkwn.gif)
[**Calentamiento 2**, **TROTE RÁPIDO SIN DESPEGAR LOS PIES DEL SUELO**]() [Postura]() Piernas al ancho de la cadera; brazos a los lados con codos flexionados. >[**Warm-up 2**, **FAST JOGGING WITHOUT LIFTING YOUR FEET OFF THE GROUND**]() >[Posture]() >Feet hip-width apart; arms at your sides with elbows bent.
![1000456176.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKJ1e1gS1PiejbwJYTYrPpRPYTqvhYRNu26LvVXqhkgHJocovCm3Rh5hLGPZmoV.gif)
[Ejecución]() Durante 3 minutos continuos; vamos elevando los talones y flexionando las rodillas de forma alterna y rápida. La punta de pies siempre queda en el suelo; se acompaña el ejercicio con el movimiento de brazos. >[Execution]() >For 3 continuous minutes, lift your heels and bend your knees alternately and quickly. Keep the balls of your feet on the floor at all times; accompany the exercise with arm movements.
![1000456180.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKAqRyDd7g4fywqLxs49QRRQtoWHWGoQm8Q3SPojwassu95UGmKJtgUz6S4U2VX.gif)
Es muy importante determinar que si el cuerpo aún no está activo para la acción fuerte, se debe calentar un poco más. No olvides hacer pausas de 20 segundos entre ejercicios, y de 1 a 2 minutos entre series; la hidratación es extremadamente importante para reponer los líquidos y sales perdidas durante la acción. Por otro lado, debemos tratar en la medida de lo posible mantener una alimentación balanceada y un descanso adecuado, que contribuyan a la obtención de mejores resultados corporales. >It is very important to determine that if the body is not yet ready for intense activity, it should be warmed up a little more. Don't forget to take 20-second breaks between exercises and 1-2 minute breaks between sets; hydration is extremely important to replenish fluids and salts lost during exercise. On the other hand, we must try as much as possible to maintain a balanced diet and adequate rest, which contribute to achieving better physical results. # **
[Estaciones de Trabajo]()
** Luego de realizar el calentamiento y comprobado de que el cuerpo está apto para la acción fuerte; nos vamos a la ejecución de los ejercicios centrales de la rutina. Si aun sientes que no estás listo, vuelve a calentar, evita lesiones. Recuerda que cada ejercicio debes hacerlo de acuerdo a tu condición física, vamos poco a poco hasta dominar los movimientos. ># **
[Work Stations]()
** >After warming up and checking that the body is ready for the strong action, we go to the execution of the core exercises of the routine. If you still feel that you are not ready, warm up again, avoid injuries. Remember that each exercise should be done according to your physical condition, we go little by little until you master the movements. [**Estación 1**, **ELEVACIÓN TRIDIRECCIONAL DE TALÓN CON BOTELLON DE 18 LITROS**]() [Postura]() Este botellón representa un peso de 18 kilos. Tomamos el botellón con ambas manos; flexionamos los codos, brazos casi pegados al cuerpo y manos a nivel de la parte alta del abdomen. Los pies inician con los talones pegados y punta de pies hacia afuera. >[**Station 1**, **THREE-DIRECTIONAL HEEL RAISE WITH AN 18-LITER WATER BOTTLE**]() >[Posture]() >This bottle represents a weight of 18 kilograms. Hold the bottle with both hands; bend your elbows, keeping your arms close to your body and your hands at the level of your upper abdomen. Start with your heels together and your toes pointing outward.
![1000456199.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK9PqzrHwjaQARYsowQszFz1YBzjg7swV9SWrUdAAodSE44xCoZKJDeSw3LWQUK.gif)
[Ejecución]() Con este ejercicio trabajamos de forma completa los gemelos. De igual manera; se siente mucha tensión en el abdomen, antebrazos y glúteos. Para realizar el movimiento; debemos mantener la tensión siempre con el botellón, mientras elevamos los talones que inician juntos. Bajamos; giramos los pies, quedan de frente y elevamos nuevamente los talones; bajamos, ahora giramos los pies y pegamos la punta de los mismos, para en esa posición elevar nuevamente los talones. Regresamos de la misma forma hasta llegar a la posición inicial. Ejecutamos 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series; es decir, cada elevación es una repetición. >[Execution]() >This exercise provides a full workout for the calves. You’ll also feel significant tension in your abs, forearms, and glutes. To perform the movement, maintain constant tension with the water bottle while lifting your heels, which start together. Lower; rotate your feet so they face forward, and lift your heels again; lower, now rotate your feet and bring the toes together, then lift your heels again from that position. Return in the same way until you reach the starting position. Perform a total of 20 repetitions in 4 sets; that is, each lift counts as one repetition.
![1000456212.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKF8rNnxDhFYjX5q5ShG6mCo2o8HvZwW4gXcsQ2nk3ae3AbXTuQ6c9SWXKoHK1G.gif)
[**Estación 2**, **ELEVACIÓN FRONTAL DE TALONES CON APOYO DE SILLA Y BOTELLA DE 5 LITROS ENTRE PERNAS**]() [Postura]() Usamos una silla o cualquier material similar. Nos sentamos; colocamos la botella entre piernas y sostenemos con la parte interna de los muslos. Punta de pies ligeramente hacia afuera. Colocamos las manos en los pasadores de la silla y elevamos la cadera; brazos extendidos, cuerpo suspendido. >[**Station 2**, **FRONT HEEL RAISES WITH CHAIR SUPPORT AND A 5-LITER BOTTLE BETWEEN THE LEGS**]() >[Posture]() >Use a chair or similar piece of equipment. Sit down; place the bottle between your legs and hold it with the inner thighs. Point your toes slightly outward. Place your hands on the chair’s armrests and lift your hips; arms extended, body suspended.
![1000456218.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKGa1ERkoBLHiTRBeQg6Sd2t2FbKdMJxnwrJmNELzyKFpZcm2cdLMWtwD4CvX2T.gif)
[Ejecución]() Ejercicio que mantiene en absoluta tensión todo el tren superior; trabajo en abdomen, glúteos y parte interna del muslo mientras se elevan los talones. Las pantorrillas trabajan doble. Ahora; estando en la posición indicada, simplemente elevamos ambos talones, los dejamos elevados por los menos 1 segundo y bajamos; los glúteos nunca tocan la silla. Ejecutamos 20 repeticiones en 4 series. >[Execution]() >This exercise keeps your entire upper body under constant tension; it works your abs, glutes, and inner thighs as you lift your heels. Your calves get a double workout. Now, from the starting position, simply lift both heels, hold them up for at least 1 second, and lower them; your glutes should never touch the chair. Perform 20 repetitions in 4 sets.
![1000456220.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKCGPmyYjQQJyBN2bVvwicGVNSvorfCUToH2BL2W1tg4fHZjz7y7LGQWBs1Vnht.gif)
[**Estación 3**, **ELEVACIÓN ALTERNA DE TALÓN CON BOTELLA DE 18 LITROS**]() [Postura]() Tomamos el botellón con ambas manos; codos flexionados y ubicación a nivel del pecho. Piernas al ancho de la cadera, iniciando con cualquier talón elevado. >[**Station 3**, **ALTERNATING HEEL RAISES WITH AN 18-LITER BOTTLE**]() >[Starting Position]() >Hold the bottle with both hands; keep your elbows bent and the bottle at chest level. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, starting with either heel raised.
![1000456222.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKCFzmgmrpuSWZg7HQMtBNu46iCwDwcNoZLRC8MCWYxcAV14g1MgXTEU8CwRutK.gif)
[Ejecución]() Sin duda alguna que los gemelos se activan de forma exponencial; sin embargo, también existe un trabajo importante en pecho, brazos, abdomen y glúteos. Para llevar a cabo el ejercicio; de manera controlada, vamos flexionando las rodillas y elevando los talones de forma alterna. Esto parece una caminata sin despegar del suelo la punta de los pies. Nos vamos con 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >There’s no doubt that this exercise really works the calves; however, it also provides a good workout for the chest, arms, abs, and glutes. To perform the exercise in a controlled manner, bend your knees and lift your heels one at a time. It’s like walking without lifting the balls of your feet off the ground. We’ll do a total of 20 repetitions in 4 sets.
![1000456226.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKCGP6YKXoohpRPTpx6UjJTACkoqzxjV5fHneBXpyh1fJqhqMjqq6w5cBMK8LP3.gif)
[**Relajación**, **CRUCE DE BRAZOS Y PIERNAS**]() [Postura]() Piernas separadas al ancho de la cadera; brazos a los lados con codos flexionados. >[**Relaxation**, **CROSSED ARMS AND LEGS**]() >[Posture]() Legs hip-width apart; arms at your sides with elbows bent.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNtaJ3pQe7NpUt9fTBrEW4zS7KaQfqWfEu4m4eNEyAYg9/1778004690269.gif)
[Ejecución]() Respirando y exhalando; durante 3 minutos de relajación y paz corporal, de forma suave vamos cruzando al frente brazos y piernas opuestas. >[Execution]() >Breathing in and out; for 3 minutes of relaxation and physical calm, gently cross your opposite arms and legs in front of you.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTUppYuoye5Xn2DUFing3KVFterME88B4hwRhcnZbEkME/1778004690406.gif)
Gracias por preferir nuestro canal. Recuerda que debes tomar descansos de calidad, hidratarte y alimentarte sanamente. Hasta la próxima y si deseas una rutina en particular, en los comentarios la puedes solicitar. >Thank you for choosing our channel. Remember to take quality breaks, hydrate and eat healthy. Until next time and if you want a particular routine, you can ask for it in the comments. #
**
