body.title: The Economic Reality of “Splinterlands” in 2026: Is It Possible to Earn $10 to $15 a Day? (Introduction) [ES-EN]
body.body:
> En la comunidad de Splinterlands los nuevos jugadores siempre hacen la misma pregunta, es posible ganar de $10 a $15 diarios y en cuanto tiempo recuperaran la inversión, esto es algo típico, lo primero que se preguntan en cuanto pueden sacar del juego y la realidad es que las cosas no funcionan así, si quieres ganar tienes que invertir, ademas, Splinterlands es un ecosistema completo, si es verdad que todo gira alrededor de lo que es el juego, las cartas, las batallas y el TCG, pero, si quieres ser prospero, debes pensar como un inversor, por lo que el funcionamiento económico del juego va más allá de los convencional. Es por eso que veo muy importante realizar mas publicaciones y contenido relacionado con la economía de “Splinterlands”, ya que muchos entran con ideas equivocadas, como si el juego fuera una especie de minería, aunque, justo en la actualidad eso sería imposible de pasar si no juegas tus verdaderas cartas correctamente (Una metáfora estratégica), pero, en este post aclarare por fin esas dudas, donde mostrare el sistema de recompensas, los factores que impulsas esas ganancias y el calculo de ese escenario que cualquiera se pregunta ¿Se puede ganar de $10 a $15 diarios? **Así que, si quieres entender cómo funciona la economía del juego, enterarte si la posibilidad de ganar esa cantidad de dinero diaria es posible y que es lo que realmente necesitas para hacerlo. Así que, quédate en este post, seguramente aprenderás muchas cosas.** ![Separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u5taptEapzzNue7bMpgSFfTdVR9QsYdtt6rtQonQ5t8iCj5Bh3Xxf1yBs5u9aNdxzNy.png)
# Anotomía del sistema de Recompensas: El Motor de Ingresos
https://i.imgur.com/7u1AW7Q.png

> Con la intención de entender la rentabilidad que ofrece “Splinterlands”, debemos comenzar por evaluar los flujos que generan estas recompensas, básicamente que fuentes tanto de liquidez y activos tiene el juego y el ecosistema en su conjunto, con esto claro, el objetivo es determinar y responder lo que queremos saber que es la pregunta realizada en la introducción, así que, comencemos con esto: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
Sistema de Recompensas (Motor de Ingresos)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23vsL5bsGtURQrSUMcPscH4uSRhuSDMxbBkvAz6RMX2yWLyvoEkMNk5Yyu8qMd8PHfTdd.png) >* **SPS (Splintershards):** Este es el token de Gobernanza del juego y el principal motor de las recompensas que todo jugador percibe diariamente. Básicamente aquí lo que debemos saber es que la emisión se distribuye en 3 pools de batalla de alrededor de 900000 SPS por temporada, la división seria entre los 3 formatos mas famosos que son (Modern, Wild y Survival). Esto es algo que se deben tomar en cuenta si de verdad queremos proyectar esos ingresos diarios. > >* **GLINT:** Este es una especie de token de recompensas que no posee valor, no es transferible y se obtiene mediante la acumulación de victorias en cualquiera de estos formatos que ya mencioné, ahora bien, su uso se enfoca en usarlos en la ”Tienda de Recompensas” donde podemos comprar distintos “Items” y cartas que nos permitirá completar el mazo actual de recompensas y en el proceso generar ganancias, ya que en la actualidad podemos obtener flujo de caja vendiendo las cartas de “Lamina Dorada” que ganemos del SET de recompensas actual. > >* **Loot Chests:** Estos son los cofres de recompensa, clasificados en 3 niveles o rarezas que son (Minor , Major y Ultimate), aunque, si bien su valor no se enfoca en obtener dinero de forma rápida como si estuvieras jugando cada batalla, la idea de estos cofres es obtener las cartas del SET de recompensa, ahora bien, estas cartas son muy importantes porque aumenta el nivel de tu mazo prácticamente gratis, lo que me lleva también a mencionar a los “Rarity Draws” donde obtienes estas cartas directamente. --- ***Lo siguiente que debemos conocer es como todos estos factores se combinan y los necesitamos para al final producir esas ganancias que estamos buscando, al final lo que estamos buscando es elevar ese porcentaje que ganamos de las “Pools de Recompensas”, pero, para eso los factores que necesitamos para que suceda deben interactuar y es aquí donde todo se complica. Pero lo explicare de forma más clara en breve.***

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23u5xiwFjL73RxLkcbQBjfTdCWek7tXcDgYZzrgJ8aztjQtJvKRBNn3RFJSyFMvd3Yb4t.png
# ¿Cuáles son esos Factores que optimizan las recompensas? https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

> Lo principal viene dado por la cantidad de SPS que podemos ganar por victoria, bien sea si obtenemos una racha o al menos ganamos el 55% de la totalidad de las batallas que jugamos con frecuencia diaria. Con esto claro, sin que los siguientes factores que compartiré no se unen, ganar mas porcentaje de las pools de recompensas de SPS, será una dura batalla para nosotros. Así que veamos cuales son esos factores de optimización que tanto he comentado: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
Factores de Optimización

* **Rating:** Básicamente esto es lo que impulsa el multiplicador de tus recompensas, es lo que te hace subir de liga, por lo que, mientras más alto sea, más porcentaje extraerás de dicho pool. Por lo general un buen “Rating” seria igual o superior a 3100. * **SPS en Staking:** Este es uno de los factores clave, ya que determina el multiplicador de batalla, los famosos RSHARES (Rewards Shares). Básicamente mientras más SPS tengas, mayor será ese multiplicador y más SPS por batalla ganaras al final del día. * **Tu mazo y el nivel de tus cartas:** Este es otro de los puntos fuertes, ya que es muy importante tener un buen mazo completo y en el nivel correspondiente, porque si no sufrirías penalizaciones en las recompensas. * **Energía:** Puede que se vea que la “Energía” no es importante, pero, la realidad es que es fundamental, ya que, sin esta energía, al menos en los 2 primeros formatos no podrás generar la cantidad de SPS que necesitas y es justo con los “Chests” toman relevancia, pues aquí se ganan muchas energias y donde el GLINT que ganemos es crucial para adquirir estos cofres. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####

La Viabilidad

Aquí es donde se pone interesante, sin embargo, para sentar las bases de este análisis tengo que cubrirlo en un siguiente post, puesto que las bases y el “Prologo” de este post se extendió demasiado, pero, mi siguiente post será la continuación de este y quiere mostrar cálculos simples pero que puedan usar para medir la verdadera rentabilidad.

![Separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u5taptEapzzNue7bMpgSFfTdVR9QsYdtt6rtQonQ5t8iCj5Bh3Xxf1yBs5u9aNdxzNy.png)
# Consideraciones Finales https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

> Si quieren saber estos cálculos, tienen que seguir la publicación, sin embargo, a pesar de no responder realmente la pregunta en este post, este “Prologo” es sumamente importante, ya que explica como funciona todo lo que necesitas para entrar en las ganancias. Así que, si tienes alguna duda sobre esto, no dudes en comentar, sé que quisieran saber cuánto podrían ganar y estas son las bases que necesitan.
### Nos vemos en el \

> In the Splinterlands community, new players always ask the same question: Is it possible to earn $10 to $15 a day, and how long will it take to recoup their investment? This is typical—the first thing they wonder is how much they can make from the game—but the reality is that things don’t work that way. If you want to make money, you have to invest. Furthermore, Splinterlands is a complete ecosystem. While it’s true that everything revolves around the game itself—the cards, the battles, and the TCG—if you want to be successful, you must think like an investor, so the game’s economic mechanics go beyond the conventional. That’s why I think it’s very important to publish more content related to the “Splinterlands” economy, since many people come in with misconceptions, such as thinking the game is a form of mining—although, right now, that would be impossible to achieve unless you play your cards right (a strategic metaphor). but in this post, I’ll finally clear up those doubts by explaining the reward system, the factors that drive those earnings, and the math behind the scenario everyone’s wondering about: Can you really make $10 to $15 a day? **So, if you want to understand how the game’s economy works, find out if it’s actually possible to earn that much money every day, and learn what you really need to do it, stick around for this post—you’re sure to learn a lot.** ![Separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u5taptEapzzNue7bMpgSFfTdVR9QsYdtt6rtQonQ5t8iCj5Bh3Xxf1yBs5u9aNdxzNy.png)
# Anatomy of the Rewards System: The Revenue Engine
https://i.imgur.com/7u1AW7Q.png

> To understand the profitability offered by “Splinterlands,” we must first assess the flows that generate these rewards—specifically, the sources of both liquidity and assets within the game and the ecosystem as a whole. With that in mind, the goal is to determine and answer the question posed in the introduction. So, let’s begin: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
Rewards System (Revenue Engine)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23vsL5bsGtURQrSUMcPscH4uSRhuSDMxbBkvAz6RMX2yWLyvoEkMNk5Yyu8qMd8PHfTdd.png) >* **SPS (Splintershards):** This is the game's governance token and the main driver of the rewards that every player receives daily. Basically, what we need to know here is that the token supply is distributed across 3 battle pools of approximately 900,000 SPS per season, divided among the 3 most popular formats: Modern, Wild, and Survival. This is something to keep in mind if we truly want to project those daily earnings. > >* **GLINT:** This is a type of reward token that has no monetary value, is non-transferable, and is earned by accumulating wins in any of the formats I mentioned earlier. That said, their use is focused on the “Rewards Store,” where we can purchase various “Items” and cards that will allow us to complete the current rewards deck and, in the process, generate profits, since we can currently generate cash flow by selling the “Golden Foil” cards we earn from the current rewards set. > >* **Loot Chests:** These are the reward chests, categorized into three tiers or rarities: Minor, Major, and Ultimate. Although their value isn’t focused on making quick money—as if you were playing every battle—the point of these chests is to obtain cards from the reward set. That said, these cards are very important because they boost your deck’s level practically for free, which also brings me to mention the “Rarity Draws” where you get these cards directly. --- ***The next thing we need to understand is how all these factors come together and how we need them to ultimately generate the profits we’re looking for. Ultimately, our goal is to increase the percentage we earn from the “Reward Pools,” but for that to happen, the factors involved must interact—and that’s where things get complicated. But I’ll explain it more clearly shortly.***

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23u5xiwFjL73RxLkcbQBjfTdCWek7tXcDgYZzrgJ8aztjQtJvKRBNn3RFJSyFMvd3Yb4t.png
# What are the factors that maximize rewards? https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

> The key factor is the amount of SPS we can earn per victory, whether we go on a winning streak or simply win at least 55% of all the battles we play on a daily basis. With that in mind, even if the following factors I’m about to share don’t come into play, winning a larger share of the SPS reward pools will be an uphill battle for us. So let’s take a look at those optimization factors I’ve been talking about: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
Optimization Factors

* **Rating:** Basically, this is what drives your reward multiplier—it’s what helps you move up in the league—so the higher it is, the larger a percentage you’ll receive from that pool. Generally speaking, a good “rating” would be 3100 or higher. * **SPS Staked:** This is one of the key factors, as it determines the battle multiplier—the famous RSHARES (Rewards Shares). Basically, the more SPS you have, the higher that multiplier will be, and the more SPS per battle you’ll earn at the end of the day. * **Your deck and the level of your cards:** This is another key point, as it’s very important to have a well-rounded deck at the appropriate level; otherwise, you’ll receive reduced rewards. * **Energy:** It might seem like “Energy” isn’t important, but the reality is that it’s essential, since without this energy—at least in the first two game modes—you won’t be able to generate the amount of SPS you need. This is where “Chests” come into play, as they’re a major source of energy, and the GLINT we earn is crucial for acquiring these chests. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####

body.title: After the Rain, Life Blooms
body.body:
Rain can be annoying sometimes, especially when it interrupts our plans or makes the day feel gloomy. There are moments when we wish for clear skies instead, but I also realized that the rain brings something important. It provides nourishment to the plants in the garden, and because of that, I really cannot complain too much. ![1000072688.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo8KdXPCR6DJBKTZt4xzF5pCHJUC1zTSbpgmfdLdoNyCjM6691hLkq6UQaotnzyxL5k.jpg) After the rain, the garden feels more alive. The flowers begin to bloom, the leaves look refreshed, and the small raindrops resting on them create a beautiful scene. These are the moments that I enjoy photographing, especially in black and white. Without color, the shapes and contrast become more noticeable. The bright petals stand out against the darker leaves, while the droplets add a quiet detail that makes the scene more interesting. I think this kind of weather reminds us that change is necessary. We may not always like it, but it often brings something good in return. Just like the plants need rain to grow, maybe we also need certain changes in life to appreciate things better. Some days may feel inconvenient or uncomfortable, but they can still bring lessons, beauty, and growth. These photos are a simple reminder for me to look around and appreciate what life has to offer. Sometimes, beauty is already there, waiting to be noticed. It can be in a flower blooming after the rain, in droplets resting on leaves, or in the quiet atmosphere that comes after a heavy downpour. My advice is to slow down, look around, and appreciate the small blessings around you. Life may not always give us perfect weather, but it always gives us something worth noticing. Have a good day ahead. *** ![1000072688.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo8KdXPCR6DJBKTZt4xzF5pCHJUC1zTSbpgmfdLdoNyCjM6691hLkq6UQaotnzyxL5k.jpg) ![1000105849.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EonjUdUpUx2pmj5UENBwF9qXAU4uZ6DgEYAwfKzTU9RADy79XU5qCGHopprmy2APNjV.jpg) ![1000072179.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo6Bdd4mvjv2raJ6gpCCvpwNhaLqwDhiSmdJERsYjRbvoVpNUgppjeXEkypza8jCMXd.jpg) ![1000072177.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo1vQeC6rCEi47S9bL5UtqpYbidKf5mXcdTw54PjiWDMyoSUq1EpzVL8o2g9HhA7ir6.jpg) ![1000116504.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoAYsAjEzDCfUwwHDJnSCDtBGv45u3YPvrg8Jb9sVPzEmM7yhRVkCE6Cc2Dtgiht2yv.jpg) ***

body.title: Palindromes and Pavements 11,112 Steps in New Jersey.
body.body:
​There is something incredibly satisfying about hitting a number like 11,112. It’s almost a palindrome, and it’s definitely a sign of a productive day! Today, Tuesday, May 5, 2026, was my second full day in the USA, and I spent it deep diving into the suburban charm of Old Bridge, New Jersey. ​The Beauty of the American Streetscape ​As I continue to adjust to the local time, my afternoon walks have become the highlight of my day. The photo I captured today shows the classic American residential layout spacious houses, clear blue skies, and those long, asphalt roads that invite you to just keep walking. The weather was absolutely perfect, not too hot, with a light breeze that made the 11k steps feel like a breeze. ​What I love about walking here is the sense of scale. Everything is bigger the roads, the yards, and even the distances between shops! This naturally encourages me to walk more. I found myself wandering through different blocks, admiring the blooming trees and the quiet, safe atmosphere of the neighborhood. ​Actifit Progress & Community Engagement ​My Actifit dashboard is showing some great numbers today ​Total Steps 11,112 ​AFIT Balance 20,567.662 ​User Rank 38.31 ​Voting Power 98.89% ​I’ve noticed a significant peak in my activity graph between 4:00 PM and 7:00 PM (16:00 - 19:00). That was my power hour where I really pushed the pace to make sure I cleared the 10k mark. I’m also happy to see my AFIT balance steadily climbing. Every step is an investment! ​A huge shoutout to the community members like @captainquack22 who have been reaching out in the comments. The social aspect of Actifit and Hive is what keeps me motivated. It’s not just about the numbers it’s about sharing this journey with people from all over the world. ​Beating the Jet Lag for Good ​I can officially say that the jet lag is losing the battle. By staying active and reaching over 11k steps today, I’ve managed to stay awake until the evening, helping my body fully calibrate to Eastern Standard Time. I’m feeling more energized and less like a travel zombie than I did 48 hours ago. ​Tomorrow, I’m planning to perhaps explore a local park or a different part of the town to keep the scenery fresh. Staying consistent is much easier when you have such beautiful surroundings to explore. ​Join the Conversation! ​To my fellow walkers do you prefer walking in quiet residential areas or busy city centers? I’m starting to really enjoy the peace and quiet of these Jersey suburbs. ​Let’s keep those legs moving and those trackers syncing! ​Daily Recap ​Steps: 11,112 (New Personal Best for this trip!) ​Location Old Bridge, NJ 🇺🇸 ​Vibe Energetic and Exploratory ​Wallet Update Over 20.5k AFIT and counting.

Not by any definition I can support.  We are ruled by a nest of vipers, and the few exceptions are only allowed to give us false hope the system of governance can be saved.

SCOTUS stated clearly in the Heller decision what hope we have, and history reveals the truth of that decision.  It is sad, but the bare fact is that when the ballot box fails, the bullet box succeeds.  From time to time the verminous knaves that worm their way into power exceed the people's ability to tolerate, and then, beyond reason, people act with authority to eliminate the vermin.

That will happen.  I have no doubt.  The real answer to our dilemma is what follows the pest removal process?  My money is on decentralization of production and wealth.  My recommendation is to seize the means of production suitable to your personal circumstances, in your case probably aquaponics, because you already garden.  Adding fish and hydroponics would be relatively facile for you.  For me it is aquaponics - which is in motion - and wood gasification, because I am surrounded by almost unlimited free wood I can gasify to produce electricity.  That is also in progress, and I am intent on spreading that power - ahem! - as far and widely as I am able.  3D printers, CNC, Laser cutters, inkjet printers, all these tools enable people to make the good they need, such as dinnerware, parts, and solar panels.  

We transcend a clinal boundary today that has not before occurred in history, as the laws of physics mandate the decentralization of the means of production, which decentralizes wealth.  This transcendence will not be easy.  It will not be gentle.  But, it will be a permanent change in economic power, eliminating overlords forever.

Be good to good people and they will be good to you. That is the best we can do while we imprison dragons in their deep, dark caverns with their hoards of shiny gold they think is wealth, and create the world to come with our good company.

这两天刷到不少帖子说:豆包和红果都开始收费了，不少人反馈不合理……有种好起来就过河拆桥的样子(然后我还跑去问豆包是否真的要收费了，对方回复我普通使用不收费，高端项目是要收费的

其实想想以前我看小说的时候，很多都是先免费后收费的，一些新入驻的作者基本全本免费，等后面用户积累起来后，或者很火的小说都会变成免费多少章节，再看得付费了(我也是开通很多次VIP😂

好些app或小程序大部分都是初期免费，你帮分享推广还给你钱💰，你花时间看也奖励金币(可以兑换钱)，一旦成熟了，用户积累够多后(盲猜)，都会开始收费，先从小钱收起，再逐渐增多，同样的app质量和功能也在提高增多

就说平时使用的支付宝或美团等等平台，要是好久不使用再回来，平台会送你优惠券，你下单给的折扣也更大些，要是经常使用的用户，优惠力度就会再小一些

用户每次在平台有改革时，部分人都会反馈、抗议，然而随着时间的推移，能活下来的，跟随时代步伐的平台，基本都乖乖遵守交费规则，慢慢的好像也就习惯了

上个月买了流量包后，移动也送了我流量，客服还告诉我用的多送的多，前提是我得先买先用，对方才能送。免费的并不是真的免费，平台的最终目的也是为了挣钱，不然耗费那么多，人家拿什么生活？

**感谢阅读！祝你生活明媚，阖家安康！财源滚滚，好运连连🤑**

No wonder we had to remove our Silver and Gold Coins from Circulation…

body.title: My experience in tournaments: Splinterlands Survival: Ascension. Social Media. (Eng/Esp).
body.body:
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRFeNYTf9wXuCnaFrmpFbY1Ca62G8czLbDybyvZRaBLQh/torneos1y2.png)</center>   
      
 <center><sub>Imagen elaborada en Canva / Image created in Canva </sub></center>   
    
 ----   
      
 <center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJ8tCPyJpnK58wnnzYgWFSMR4vYHQgFpq8FWFULfjD3d/image.png)   
</center>   

<div class=\

> Hello, my dear fellow Praetorians I want to tell you how I did in the two Survival tournaments that have been held and what I got with the reward. Note: Before I tell you how I did, I tell you that to participate in these tournaments you must win an Ascension ticket in the Survival format. The battles in these tournaments will take place with ghost cards at the highest level and the available sets will be rotated in each event. --- ---
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

The First Survival Tournament

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
----

> When I signed up for the tournament, I knew that it would be a slightly different and more difficult fighting experience. I would face 115 other players, many of them with a lot of experience in the different sets of the game. When I saw that I would have the Chaos Legion and Conclave Arcana sets available, I had a little more confidence, but I was realistic that I am an average player and more or less with that idea I considered trying to stay between the middle positions.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYBiCETP9g3ZuhETHidzwyhN96KGELC26WBP77MPpHfaQ/image.png)
He had fourteen opponents assigned to him; two of them did not show up. In the end I only faced twelve and, even with the confidence I had, I only won four direct battles and lost eight, lol. But hey, I managed to sneak in a good post and earn an acceptable amount of Glint.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUt6nTNoCkTN1iy3AUQXDLVMeaeNuMoAZGGTDBpLqRzgd/image.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZwBL8dYFpigaeyDac1PhoeA2AkoFW4gT571dV9k5R9RP/image.png)
--- The 30k Glint I won was used directly for Epic Draws; I was focusing on completing my first copies of each epic reward. The warrior Rodentian Saltwraith Pirate was the one that was missing to add to my deck and hopefully I found it this time.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNP15h8nN2PgSy2GEUNKSCfNxrHCXjoartF1VFhLtudDw/image.png)
--- ---
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Second Survival Tournament

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
----

> Second tournament and I knew practically nothing about the Beta and Untamed sets, lol. Although I had a little more experience with the past in the previous one, I would take the time to think about which formation to send to the battle.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc1ZxLVLaR6CvwkPQo4EJEqjE1jkE5tA4QweaFcJKeZLh/image.png)
My thirteen opponents did show up this time, which allowed me to earn my place by facing everyone. If I was going to get in a good spot at the end, I wanted to earn it. In the end I lost more than I gained, but I liked this result.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS4e5B35aZPLv3iwABt9967kq1WqYLCrcwvjD4kKRzKig/image.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRXoVxXvBEDZSUreoW7MHEAKhTiMHJoKZqJnQsAx4YZRP/image.png)
---- I added up the reward from the end of the season that I won in Survival and what I won in this tournament to aim for my next goal in rewards cards. I had been acquiring copies of common, rare and then epic to strengthen my fighting deck in Modern, because it was time to move on to the Legendary Draws.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTqogu95puEjzFKNhzb7kDjFheHUoH4HMmLtZjWD2H8bX/image.png)
Nullwrought is the new legendary elemental in my deck and I hope to continue adding others in the coming seasons. ---
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Thoughts

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
---

> I have liked these tournaments so far, an interesting event that invites the players with the best results in Survival to participate on more or less equal terms in terms of the available cards and win a reward in Glint. By having any set available and changing every season, it makes it more entertaining. We have to adapt to the available cards, skills and rule sets to get to the top of the survival survivors. ---- Currently, I am already close to securing a reward for the end of the season in Survival and my entry to the next tournament.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma8fYpDdNxrTNKkM2rqx5z6yjiaznZ3VPkZE1BssaySUu/image.png)
----- -----

> Thank you for taking the time to read this, and a huge thank you to those who have voted or commented. You can join the game and discover this fantastic world at the following link: [freed99](https://next.splinterlands.com/register?ref=freed99). I hope to see you soon in a Challenge, sharing your battles and experiences in this fantasy world. Note: This post is not investment advice; please do your own research. --- ---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJ8tCPyJpnK58wnnzYgWFSMR4vYHQgFpq8FWFULfjD3d/image.png)

> Hola, mis queridos compañeros pretorianos. Quiero contarles cómo me fue en los dos torneos Survival que se han realizado y qué conseguí con la recompensa. Nota: Antes de contarles cómo me fue, les cuento que para participar en estos torneos se debe ganar una entrada Ascension en el formato Survival. Las batallas en estos torneos se desarrollarán con cartas fantasma a máximo nivel y los sets disponibles serán rotados en cada evento. --- ---
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Primer Torneo Survival

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
----

> Al momento de inscribirme al torneo, sabía que sería una experiencia de lucha un poco diferente y con más dificultad. Me enfrentaría a otros 115 jugadores, muchos de ellos con mucha experiencia en los diferentes sets del juego. Al ver que tendría disponible los sets Chaos Legion y Conclave Arcana, tuve un poco más de confianza, pero era realista en que soy un jugador promedio y más o menos con esa idea me planteé intentar quedar entre los puestos medios.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYBiCETP9g3ZuhETHidzwyhN96KGELC26WBP77MPpHfaQ/image.png)
Tenía asignados catorce oponentes; dos de ellos no se presentaron. Al final solo me enfrenté a doce y, aun con la confianza que tenía, solo gané cuatro batallas directas y perdí ocho, jajaja. Pero bueno, logré colarme en un buen puesto y ganar una cantidad aceptable de Glint.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUt6nTNoCkTN1iy3AUQXDLVMeaeNuMoAZGGTDBpLqRzgd/image.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZwBL8dYFpigaeyDac1PhoeA2AkoFW4gT571dV9k5R9RP/image.png)
--- Los 30k Glint que gané fueron usados directamente para Draws Épicos; estaba enfocando en completar mis primeras copias de cada reward épica. El guerrero Rodentian Saltwraith Pirate era el que faltaba sumar a mi mazo y con suerte lo encontré en esta oportunidad.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNP15h8nN2PgSy2GEUNKSCfNxrHCXjoartF1VFhLtudDw/image.png)
--- ---
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Segundo Torneo Survival

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
----

> Segundo torneo y no conocía prácticamente nada de los sets Beta y Untamed, jajajaja. Aunque tenía un poco más de experiencia con lo pasado en el anterior, me tomaría el tiempo en pensar qué formación enviar a la batalla.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc1ZxLVLaR6CvwkPQo4EJEqjE1jkE5tA4QweaFcJKeZLh/image.png)
Mis trece oponentes sí se presentaron en esta ocasión, lo cual me permitió ganarme mi lugar enfrentándome a todos. Si iba a quedar en un buen lugar al final, quería ganármelo. Al final perdí más de las que gané, pero me gustó este resultado.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS4e5B35aZPLv3iwABt9967kq1WqYLCrcwvjD4kKRzKig/image.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRXoVxXvBEDZSUreoW7MHEAKhTiMHJoKZqJnQsAx4YZRP/image.png)
---- Sumé la recompensa del final de temporada que gané en Survival y lo ganado en este torneo para apuntar a mi siguiente objetivo en cartas rewards. Había estado adquiriendo copias de comunes, raras y luego épicas para fortalecer mi mazo de lucha en Modern, pues llegó el momento de pasar a los Draws Legendarios.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTqogu95puEjzFKNhzb7kDjFheHUoH4HMmLtZjWD2H8bX/image.png)
Nullwrought es la nueva legendaria elemental de mi mazo y espero seguir sumando otras en las próximas temporadas. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Pensamientos

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
---

> Estos torneos hasta ahora me han gustado, un evento interesante que invita a los jugadores con mejores resultados en Survival a participar en más o menos igualdad de condiciones en cuanto a las cartas disponibles y ganar una recompensa en Glint. Al tener cualquier set disponible y que va cambiando cada temporada, lo hace más entretenido. Nos tenemos que adaptar a las cartas disponibles, habilidades y los conjuntos de reglas para llegar a la cima de los sobrevivientes del survival. ---- Actualmente, ya me encuentro cerca de asegurar una recompensa para el final de temporada en Survival y mi entrada al siguiente torneo.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma8fYpDdNxrTNKkM2rqx5z6yjiaznZ3VPkZE1BssaySUu/image.png)
----- -----

> Le agradezco por haber tenido el tiempo de leerme y le agradezco enormemente a aquellos que me han otorgado un voto o comentario. En el siguiente enlace podrás unirte al juego y conocer este fantástico mundo: [freed99](https://next.splinterlands.com/register?ref=freed99) y espero verlos pronto en un Challenge contando tus batallas y experiencias en este mundo de fantasía. Nota: Esta publicación no es un consejo de inversión; realicen sus propias investigaciones. ___
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQxXswzbWQTYK9VKwK2Wy5BQfQUwDKD8c2TK4EK89eWbb/image.png)
![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23uFMJtwBYqobHGRfKciFJvEUovh86N3Qbweq2XJqMVxibXhLkqGtxyReVgTmL1Kqs5mU.gif)
___
Gracias por tomarse el tiempo de leerme. Imágenes obtenidas del discord de Splinterlands y NFTGame Latino. Editadas en Canva. Traducido en la herramienta [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com/es/translator)
Thank you for taking the time to read me.

body.title: Harmony.
body.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gc5e23c2907ecbfeae9906aad1aacd7796520b6d55486bb1a678b63f761ce4b9abe64be3be1dff19427d08f520d7c52371fc9ee48e98dfebde54c924d25207090_640.jpg)</center>

***

# The Tale of the Harmonious Village

In a small village nestled between two mountains, there lived a community known for its extraordinary harmony. The villagers worked together, celebrated together, and supported one another through thick and thin. They believed that harmony was the key to a happy life and that everyone should always agree to maintain peace.

## The Seeds of Discord

One day, a traveler passing through the village noticed the villagers’ unwavering commitment to harmony. Curious, he decided to stay for a while. As he observed their interactions, he realized that the villagers often suppressed their true feelings and opinions to avoid conflict. They would nod in agreement, even when they disagreed, fearing that any dissent would disrupt their peaceful existence.

The traveler, concerned for the villagers, approached the village elder and said, “Your harmony is admirable, but have you ever considered that true harmony cannot exist without honesty and diversity of thought?”

The elder smiled politely but dismissed the traveler’s concerns. “We have learned to live in peace. Disagreement only brings chaos.”

## The Storm of Silence

As time passed, the traveler noticed that the villagers began to feel increasingly resentful. Small disagreements festered beneath the surface, and the once-vibrant discussions turned into silence. The villagers, afraid to voice their opinions, began to withdraw into themselves, resulting in a growing sense of isolation.

One fateful day, a severe storm hit the village. The river swelled, and the villagers needed to decide quickly on a plan to protect their homes. But when the time came to speak up, no one voiced their thoughts. The fear of conflict had silenced them, and the village was unprepared. The floodwaters surged, causing significant damage and loss.

## The Awakening

After the storm, the villagers gathered to assess the destruction. It was in this moment of vulnerability that they finally began to share their feelings. They expressed their fears, frustrations, and regrets about not speaking up before the disaster. The air was thick with emotion, but it was also filled with a newfound understanding.

Realizing that harmony does not mean the absence of conflict, but rather the presence of open communication, the villagers vowed to embrace both their differences and their similarities. They began to hold regular meetings where everyone was encouraged to share their thoughts, even if they disagreed.

## The True Meaning of Harmony

As the seasons changed, so did the village. The bonds among the villagers grew stronger, as they learned to navigate their differences with respect and empathy. They discovered that true harmony arises from understanding and valuing diverse perspectives, not from suppressing them.

The traveler, witnessing this transformation, smiled and continued on his journey, knowing he had planted a seed of wisdom in the hearts of the villagers.

## The Lesson

**Harmony is not the absence of conflict but the ability to embrace and understand differences. True peace comes from open communication, where every voice is valued, and every opinion has a place.**

---

In the end, remember: **To maintain harmony, cultivate honesty. To foster understanding, encourage dialogue.**

body.title: Krampus Esp / Eng
body.body:
![MV5BMjk0MjMzMTI3NV5BMl5BanBnXkFtZTgwODEyODkxNzE@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23wBdZApFVvhVMM1ASwGXaec8nkPCEtfZh6N1imeRyZ3hqMpCwyxUCu6zCF188idqxsVo.jpg)

(Esp)

Hoy quiero escribir sobre el Krampus, una figura mitológica que sin duda hace que la Navidad se sienta muy distinta. Y sí, esto se va a poner interesante.

El Krampus es una figura central del folclore alpino, especialmente presente en regiones de Austria, Germany y Slovenia. Su origen se remonta a tradiciones paganas precristianas, asociadas al invierno y a rituales para ahuyentar espíritus malignos. Con el paso del tiempo, estas creencias se integraron en las celebraciones navideñas, convirtiendo al Krampus en el contrapunto oscuro de Saint Nicholas (o Papá Noel).

A diferencia de las figuras benevolentes, el Krampus representa el castigo y la advertencia. Se le describe como un ser híbrido: cuernos, pelaje oscuro, lengua larga y una apariencia demoníaca. Según la tradición, acompaña a San Nicolás durante las festividades y se encarga de castigar a los niños traviesos, ya sea con varas de abedul o mediante amenazas simbólicas como llevárselos en un saco.

Una de las celebraciones más conocidas es la Krampusnacht, que tiene lugar el 5 de diciembre. Durante esta noche, personas disfrazadas de Krampus recorren las calles en eventos conocidos como “Krampuslauf” (carreras de Krampus), creando un ambiente festivo pero oscuro, donde el terror se mezcla con la tradición y el entretenimiento.

Hoy en día, estas celebraciones han evolucionado y se presentan en distintos formatos. En Europa Central, especialmente en Austria y Germany, el Krampus sigue siendo parte importante de los desfiles y festivales de invierno. También existen los Krampuslauf, donde grupos organizados recorren las calles como parte de un espectáculo cultural. Además, muchos mercados navideños incluyen su figura como parte del folclore local.

Pero lo interesante es cómo esta tradición ha cruzado fronteras. En ciudades como Los Angeles, Portland e incluso Miami, han comenzado a surgir versiones modernas: desfiles alternativos, fiestas temáticas y eventos con estética “dark Christmas”.

El Krampus también ha dejado su huella en la cultura pop. Ha inspirado fiestas de terror navideño, cosplay, eventos underground y producciones como la película Krampus, que ayudó a popularizarlo fuera de Europa.

Y aquí es donde vale la pena detenerse un momento. Hoy, el Krampus ya no es solo una figura de castigo. Se ha transformado en un símbolo cultural versátil, presente en la moda, el arte, el entretenimiento y las redes sociales. Representa una estética alternativa de la Navidad: más oscura, rebelde y, para muchos, más auténtica.

Su popularidad refleja algo interesante: un deseo de rescatar tradiciones antiguas y interpretarlas en contextos modernos. El miedo deja de ser literal y se convierte en espectáculo, identidad cultural y creatividad.

Ahora la pregunta queda abierta:
¿adaptarías esta visión más oscura de la Navidad a tu entorno, o prefieres mantener la versión clásica?
 Cómo siempre agradecer a la comunidad BBH que está haciendo un trabajo súper genial 
 A mí amiga @cathyarrow y su esposo @bradleyarrow quien es el mejor maestro que se pueda tener 
 Que apoyen a @marian.liz que recién empieza en esta comunidad 
Gracias por su tiempo espero les guste el contenido que les traigo 
 Bendiciones 🙏 y que Dios los proteja a todos ❤️❤️❤️

![MV5BMjk0MjMzMTI3NV5BMl5BanBnXkFtZTgwODEyODkxNzE@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23wBdZApFVvhVMM1ASwGXaec8nkPCEtfZh6N1imeRyZ3hqMpCwyxUCu6zCF188idqxsVo.jpg)

(Eng)
Today I want to write about Krampus, a mythological figure that definitely makes Christmas feel very different. And yes, this is going to get interesting.

Krampus is a central figure in Alpine folklore, especially present in regions of Austria, Germany, and Slovenia. Its origins date back to pre-Christian pagan traditions, associated with winter and rituals to ward off evil spirits. Over time, these beliefs were incorporated into Christmas celebrations, turning Krampus into the dark counterpart of Saint Nicholas (or Santa Claus).

Unlike benevolent figures, Krampus represents punishment and warning. He is described as a hybrid being: horns, dark fur, a long tongue, and a demonic appearance. According to tradition, he accompanies Saint Nicholas during the festivities and is responsible for punishing naughty children, either with birch rods or symbolic threats, such as taking them away in a sack.

One of the best-known celebrations is Krampusnacht, which takes place on December 5th. On this night, people dressed as Krampus roam the streets in events known as “Krampuslauf” (Krampus runs), creating a festive yet dark atmosphere where terror mixes with tradition and entertainment.

Today, these celebrations have evolved and appear in various forms. In Central Europe, especially in Austria and Germany, Krampus remains an important part of winter parades and festivals. Krampuslauf events still take place, where organized groups walk through the streets as part of a cultural spectacle. Many Christmas markets also include his figure as part of the local folklore.

What’s interesting is how this tradition has crossed borders. In cities like Los Angeles, Portland, and even Miami, modern versions have started to emerge: alternative parades, themed parties, and events with a “dark Christmas” aesthetic.

Krampus has also left his mark on pop culture. He has inspired holiday horror parties, cosplay events, underground celebrations, and productions such as the movie Krampus, which helped popularize him outside of Europe.

And this is where it’s worth pausing for a moment. Today, Krampus is no longer just a figure of punishment. He has become a versatile cultural symbol, present in fashion, art, entertainment, and social media. He represents an alternative Christmas aesthetic: darker, rebellious, and, for many, more authentic.

His popularity reflects something interesting: a desire to rescue ancient traditions and reinterpret them in modern contexts. Fear is no longer literal—it becomes spectacle, cultural identity, and creativity.

Now the question remains:
Would you adapt this darker vision of Christmas to your environment, or do you prefer to stick with the classic version?

body.body: >\n\nÓsea esta semana sabia que era el día de la madre e iba a cantar temas relacionados a las madres y me alegra que el tema de la semana sea la misma, elegí un tema que cantaba un compatriota, Julio Jaramillo, \

y es mi tema favorito del día de la madre, es la que siempre le canto a mi madre, Carmen, cada año le hago una serenata personal y este es el tema con el que termino, siempre quiero estar a su lado toda mi vida, con esta música me presento en Hive Open Mic en su semana 317. Este actividad es organizado por @hiveopenmic y este es el [post](https://ecency.com/hive-105786/@hiveopenmic/hive-open-mic-316-i-know-whats-coming-worldwide-live-music-event?referral=josueelinfame), para que puedan unirse.

>\n\nSo, this week I knew it was Mother's Day and I was going to sing songs related to mothers, and I'm glad that the theme of the week is the same. I chose a song that a fellow countryman, Julio Jaramillo, sang, \

body.title: Pollo con malta y jengibre/ Chicken with malt and ginger 🍗😋
body.body:
> Hello foodies! Espero que todos se encuentren muy bien ! El día de hoy les quiero compartir una receta que es la primera vez que la preparo y la verdad me quedó súper deliciosa, se trata de **pollo con malta y jengibre**, una combinación dulce y picante que es un deleite para tus sentidos, porque no solo se trata del sabor, sino de los aromas y ese caramelizado tan lindo que en cuanto lo ves te invita a comerlo.
Hello, foodies! I hope you’re all doing well. Today I want to share with you a recipe I’m making for the first time and which, to be honest, has turned out absolutely delicious: it’s **chicken with malt and ginger**, a sweet and spicy combination that’s a treat for the senses, because it’s not just about the flavour, but also the aromas and that lovely caramelised finish which, as soon as you see it, makes you want to tuck in.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ1KBpxsyeFKAYXp9jy6RYgBVtiqkyBp96XetAwppctou/1778032610655.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) No sé si recuerdan que hace un tiempo compartí con ustedes una receta con cerveza que la verdad me sorprendió muchísimo por el sabor que le aportó al pollo y, buscando preparar algo diferente para el día de hoy se me ocurrió podía utilizar malta, pero para darle un plus pensé en agregar jengibre, pero como era una combinación que nunca había probado, decidí preguntarle a la IA qué tal combinaban estos sabores y me dijo que era una combinación perfecta, así que nos lanzamos a la aventura de preparar un nuevo platillo. Y sin más aquí les dejo los ingredientes y el procedimiento para preparar esta deliciosa receta.
I don’t know if you remember that a while back I shared a beer-based recipe with you that really surprised me with the flavour it gave the chicken. Looking to make something different today, it occurred to me I could use malt, but to give it an extra kick I thought of adding ginger. However, as it was a combination I’d never tried before, I decided to ask the AI how well these flavours went together, and it told me it was a perfect combination, so we set off on an adventure to prepare a new dish. Without further ado, here are the ingredients and method for preparing this delicious recipe.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYbPsrn7SygL2TR5e9FbYL4cqDp6rrwXF9nx419Go9hgj/1778032611001.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) ## Ingredientes Pollo (según la cantidad de comensales) 1 y 1/2 taza de malta 1 cebolla 1 ramita de cebollín 1 ramita de ajoporro 2 dientes de ajo 3 cucharaditas de jengibre en polvo 2 cucharaditas de paprika 1 cucharada de maicena (almidón de maíz) Sal Aceite
## Ingredients Chicken (depending on the number of guests) 1½ cups of malt 1 onion 1 spring of chives 1 spring of leek 2 cloves of garlic 3 teaspoons of ground ginger 2 teaspoons of paprika 1 tablespoon of cornflour Salt Oil
## Procedimiento/Procedure Lo primero que hice fue condimentar el pollo con sal, jengibre y paprika y unté cada pieza muy bien, para luego dejarlo marinar en el refrigerador por al menos una hora.
The first thing I did was season the chicken with salt, ginger and paprika, rubbing the seasoning thoroughly into each piece, and then leave it to marinate in the fridge for at least an hour.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmarzvV84kXt4nnJf4d9A64yd2FwRBRMcv4CuXCBLxws1c/1778033108995.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Transcurrido el tiempo de espera ha llegado la hora de comenzar con la preparación del platillo, y en este punto lo que haremos será cortar nuestros vegetales que van a ser la base del sofrito.
Now that the waiting time is over, it’s time to start preparing the dish, and at this stage we’ll be chopping the vegetables that will form the basis of the sofrito.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWtxojFDP2E6oXmmgCHruVqSfHKJPE5sxiv6FdL5oeM8R/1778032613971.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Una vez que están listos los vegetales agregamos dos cucharadas de aceite en la sartén y en cuanto esté caliente los agregamos y sofreímos hasta que la cebolla se cristalice.
Once the vegetables are ready, add two tablespoons of oil to the frying pan; as soon as it is hot, add the vegetables and fry gently until the onion becomes translucent.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPc7uKjH5vVF5g8BneGLjecikrSXWUmdMFhdpxMH5VcDi/1778032614168.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdgScoFqjoi7Gt7tdWWNEQJdqJaapX5pMHCtVtkUbpGyd/1778032749449.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) En este punto incorporamos el pollo, tapamos la sartén y los dejamos cocinar por 15 minutos.
At this point, add the chicken, cover the pan and leave it to cook for 15 minutes.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcuAiesdut8qUGUxh4tr8q2aF7cnNL2tKuHtpDCxYP4n7/1778032749636.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Transcuridos los 15 minutos agregamos la malta y damos la vuelta a las piezas de pollo. Volvemos a tapar y cocinamos durante 15 minutos más. >After 15 minutes, add the malt and turn the chicken pieces over. Cover again and cook for a further 15 minutes. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNZwoCeZcMDX6vDiYTXpKNGh1GQBgyWr8fzE3p9LqzeB1/1778032749820.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdkXokG1HqwsUeidCM6UCksX7zxmTptgH5oo8E9QXcw7N/1778032750173.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Una vez pasaron los 15 minutos retiramos un poco de la salsa y le agregamos una cucharada de almidón de maíz, mezclamos muy bien e incorporamos nuevamente a la sartén integrándola con el resto de la salsa y dejamos cocinar sin tapa por 10 minutos más y estaría listo para disfrutar. En casa lo acompañamos con arroz y puré de papas y por dicha a todos les encantó, así que disfrutamos de un delicioso almuerzo.
Once the 15 minutes were up, we removed a little of the sauce and added a tablespoon of cornflour, mixed it in thoroughly, then returned it to the pan, combining it with the rest of the sauce. We left it to cook uncovered for a further 10 minutes, and it was ready to enjoy. At home, we served it with rice and mashed potatoes, and luckily everyone loved it, so we enjoyed a delicious lunch.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuWcWraZQ3T26CKgjMh5Y658D2yuE5Y1YLYUqvGXtFPx/1778032964623.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdgqzaVjByC5JA1fvbxEacm4RYGyLKbVfEz2XzXA2LqSc/1778032964827.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYbPsrn7SygL2TR5e9FbYL4cqDp6rrwXF9nx419Go9hgj/1778032964964.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Como pueden ver es bastante sencillo de preparar y su sabor es realmente increíble gracias a la combinación de sabores dulce y picante, por lo que si eres amante de los platillos llenos de sabor, esta receta es para tí. >As you can see, it’s quite simple to make and tastes absolutely amazing thanks to the combination of sweet and spicy flavours, so if you love dishes bursting with flavour, this recipe is for you.
📷*Photography by|Fotografía por:@rlathulerie,🔅 Cover created in/Portada creada en [Canva](https://www.canva.com), [Separator and banner/separador y banner](https://hive.blog/hive-148441/@ikasumanera⁰⁰/eng-es-i-made-hive-free-use-art-of-for-all-of-you-part-1-dividers-and-banners-or-hice-arte-de-libre-uso-para-todos-parte-1), 🇺🇸Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)*

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 5 2026
body.body:
Good day folks 😊, Today definitely wasn’t one of those high-energy mornings. I stepped out mostly to clear my head more than anything else. Started with a relaxed walk while the streets were still quiet, then mixed in a short jog once my body loosened up a little. Took a pause for some stretching halfway through because my legs felt tighter than usual. Nothing intense today, just small bits of movement stitched together. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/16bde21a-c312-42bf-892a-8ce76d5d5928.jpg) Ended up with around 8,000 steps, and honestly, I’ve noticed my step count keeps dropping lately. Been getting a little too comfortable skipping extra movement, so I think it’s time to reset things before that turns into a habit. So yeah… starting a small personal challenge: 21 days of hitting at least 10k steps daily. Nothing extreme, just trying to bring back consistency one day at a time. Low-energy days will happen, but I’d rather move a little than fall completely out of rhythm. Anyone else trying to rebuild consistency lately? 👟

body.title: 🎨🖌 [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
>
![Hive portadas.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuusaa/AJizZ3CjuuicAUbk2S6NoFEYufk4appiseXJB7sv7WGbHEyW6oqmx6HaprDQW4w.jpg)
¡Hola a todos en esta linda comunidad de Hive Margarita! Espero que se encuentren bien en estos días de mucho sol. Por acá les vengo a compartir que desde hace unos meses caminar por el centro comercial Parque Costazul es algo diferente porque, además de las tiendas que puedes visitar, te puedes encontrar con algunos de estos murales gigantes ubicados por todo el centro comercial. Estos, aunque ya lleven algún tiempo desde su creación, me siguen pareciendo de lo más bonito, además de que se nota mucho que cada mural cuenta con una esencia o estilo diferente de quien lo pintó.
English Version

Hello everyone in this lovely Hive Margarita community! I hope you are all doing well during these sunny days. I'm here to share with you that for a few months now, walking through the Parque Costazul shopping center has been a little different because, in addition to the stores you can visit, you can find some of these giant murals located throughout the mall. Although they have been there for some time now, I still think they are beautiful, and you can really see that each mural has a different essence or style from the person who painted it.

![1000488620.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuusaa/Eoke6sEHjYzZQcwc2DBEKs7vhXUFzYDEq7SEacFHFYw6maUJBPBoJ34aEMvSNYKWUCe.jpg) | ![1000488616.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuusaa/EqBcgQvYEzTZ8nqGfKnhDXUPQ941uc5T2NN5NFMUWHfA1AZChQRsRSCLGAjrpdyhVN1.jpg) | ![1000488619.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuusaa/Eoke1vThhWtkZbKzEvDw7j3oUtsTU1eg36XSVupJDMpPC4zjttyv4KhXDt51spZA6VH.jpg) | ![1000488797.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuusaa/23u5vyCP2HckQJdL2r2r1Q13eHLVC3zB2r3Vkw4pW8q9uAdTJd45kyS6WEkqoUnGW3kgG.jpg) -|-|-|-
Tengo entendido que para hacer estos murales el centro comercial buscó a personas que tuvieran el talento de hacer estas bellezas; en mi caso, yo sigo desde hace tiempo a Charlotte o como la conocen por su Instagram, @charlaarte, una de las artistas, y por ahí pude ver cómo ella iba todos los días junto con las personas de los otros murales a pintar. Fue un proceso largo debido a que de verdad son murales grandes. Me gusta mucho que cada mural represente muchísimo lo que es Margarita.  Hay uno en el que se pueden ver pescadores, en otro catalanas, el mar, flores, una guacamaya, morrocoy, mangos y sobre todo que son muy llamativos y coloridos, si pasas al lado de ellos tienes que verlos.
English Version

I understand that to create these murals, the shopping center sought out people who had the talent to make these beautiful works of art. In my case, I have been following Charlotte, or as she is known on Instagram, @charlaarte, one of the artists, for a long time, and I was able to see how she went every day with the people working on the other murals to paint. It was a long process because they are really large murals. I really like that each mural represents so much of what Margarita is.  There is one where you can see fishermen, another with Catalan women, the sea, flowers, a macaw, morrocoy, mangoes, and above all, they are very striking and colorful. If you pass by them, you have to see them.

![1000488808.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuusaa/23vhyjHWFZb7kNKb7e21hGEvwp5D25wwE8U8C5ucQm7fvyKarMQHUfsLkqy7Uh4GU6Fak.jpg) | ![1000488814.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuusaa/23vsJAs1TduyFdEtwYVk81VnQ5ov1B27VmAkZ5zM5cu8KKdncjtXhJ6pAHk5kuXWp9KEV.jpg) | ![1000488843.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuusaa/23xp4L7LysfN4CMetWtvoQg8v3QC3oh3qKC1JC2he6wWChuHKmZZfqZV8LrU72jZcXx8u.jpg) | ![1000490192.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuusaa/23w2qRyhC4TTwJ16FJBjhzfo9n1taM4iazL4UAvEL6nqYCpnP8uzABd6geTwzhSJmYHGP.jpg) -|-|-|-
Lo que les estaba diciendo sobre el estilo es que cada mural fue pintado por una personas diferente y eso se nota bastante debido a que por ejemplo hay uno con estilo grafitti, otros en los que todo está bordeado con negro y otros en los que fueron más libres y no hay líneas como de separación, genuinamente me gustaron mucho y mi favorito diría que es el del morrocoy con un niño, mangos y algunas flores de cayena pintado por Charlaarte, incluso vi que hubo un concurso entre los artistas, sin embargo no se que mural ganó, muchas gracias por leer hasta aquí y espero que les haya gustado este post!
English Version

What I was saying about the style is that each mural was painted by a different person, and that is quite noticeable because, for example, there is one with a graffiti style, others where everything is outlined in black, and others where they were more free and there are no separating lines. I genuinely liked them a lot, and my favorite would be the one with the morrocoy tree, a child, mangoes, and some cayenne flowers painted by Charlaarte. I even saw that there was a contest between the artists, but I don't know which mural won. Thank you very much for reading this far, and I hope you enjoyed this post!

![1000488840.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuusaa/EoiWE2En35JrTPkrCbmbJ5v2Zz6rmu2keqAthMx8npyTuyMP6Ep8gef1DLEFmDLTxpP.jpg) | ![1000490190.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuusaa/23w2aUTtrPBsya2EXKQeUHQBJZkRsj3BoNHc5BMk29sNcX3J1MDXeRs2gZfT1Cy5SMiD8.jpg) | ![1000490193.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuusaa/23x14iJggt4MPCYQAnpL4fAv4FCjy4ScEUdpWFLReUaVoxfFYVCL53R1bG1XW9xGNzCoM.jpg) | ![1000488842.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuusaa/EoiVh1fpFzgQst2qS79KLKs5qjNL1aQjUunHhuoTHxemdzZbYw5hn2EzAAnM5E3fihv.jpg) -|-|-|-
![1000286587.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yuusaa/48HCVMQZMnETHG9HcuWAhnGcKYvezKL2LASHZGwe9ZBrTUYfQkmV9P2Tm4cxwF1ggt.jpg)

body.title: The importance of hard work in students' lives
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcYN2XCWrmQfSuBrobLjuasZDt3gNFu8Nm5SgYxX2KTU9/pexels-peterjkambey-16007661.jpg 

[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/young-woman-sitting-in-a-computer-classroom-and-using-a-laptop-16007661/)

Greetings students. How are you all. I hope that by the infinite grace of Allah, you are all doing well. Today I want to discuss with you about your hard work. 

Basically, a student must work hard to manage his own life. We should keep one thing in mind, without hard work, no one can ever bring success in life. To bring success in life, we must work hard. 

By working hard, we can revive our luck again and again. There are many people who do not want to work hard. Basically, it is never possible to achieve happiness in this world without hard work. If we work hard in life, then happiness can be expected from there. Otherwise, we will never be truly happy in life.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmf4FuY7GbF3sEndHWJkGMUuGEMVgVxuxwbV6uVczXXxKU/pexels-mt-photography-503025765-33940741.jpg 


[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/young-man-studying-at-night-with-lamp-light-33940741/)



There are many students in our society who work very hard. I had a cousin from a neighborhood. I saw him working very hard. 

My cousin's family was very poor. Due to being poor, he did not get any kind of educational help or support from his family. But even then he did not give up and he continued his educational activities. 

Basically, my cousin used to keep goats all the time. Moreover, he used to weave flower garlands and sell them. We had a flower garden next to it and he used to collect flowers from there. He continued his educational activities with great difficulty and at one stage he saw success. 

Currently, my cousin is doing his honors at Rajshahi University. In addition, he has been appointed as a medical assistant in a private medical clinic. His salary is twenty thousand taka per month. 

Basically, we can learn a very good lesson from this story. If we want to achieve success in life, we must achieve it through hard work.  Because no success in this world comes easily.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPbpeoxVBePd8sXXrqNDZMvBVwYPXYsmxeGpC5kmebrgn/pexels-c-t-phat-546614745-18814834.jpg 


[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/woman-in-eyeglasses-sitting-by-table-and-writing-18814834/)


Today you are a student. While you are a student, you have to follow many rules and regulations to lead your life. Especially after waking up in the morning, you have to freshen up and do some exercise. Then you have to sit down with a book and go to school after some time. After returning from school, you have to take a bath and go to various coaching centers again to learn. At the end of the year, you have to participate in exams and if you pass the exams, then we can call you successful. 

This is so much hard work. But if you do not work hard in life, you will never see the face of success. Now, if you do not waste your free time and study, it will work towards changing your life. So continue your education activities constantly. Work hard in your student life and you will see that you will be quite peaceful in your working life. 

So come, let us take inspiration from today's story. Along with this, we have the ability to understand the value of hard work in the life of students. 

I hope today's educational post will be very important for you. Thank you very much for reading my blog. Thank you very much for being with the education community.

body.body:

<center>
![EUhPf5NKs90aYd2c_1f67b3f046f5f1068875c9d3551490.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/EUhPf5NKs90aYd2c_1f67b3f046f5f1068875c9d3551490/EUhPf5NKs90aYd2c_1f67b3f046f5f1068875c9d3551490.webp)
![n5tDebVaghkGJBEF_10ba12fdbd76ff1dc867e8e47f786d.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/n5tDebVaghkGJBEF_10ba12fdbd76ff1dc867e8e47f786d/n5tDebVaghkGJBEF_10ba12fdbd76ff1dc867e8e47f786d.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>



最近我渐渐察觉到，一位相识已久的朋友，正在持续不断地向我倾倒负面情绪，时间久了，我心里难免生出疲惫与厌烦。

起初面对她的倾诉，我始终抱着耐心，认真倾听她的烦恼，也真心实意地为她分析情况、给出建议。可慢慢我才发现，她从始至终都不需要任何解决方案，也根本不会采纳我提出的任何意见，她只是单纯需要一个倾听者，一个可以无条件承接她所有抱怨、发泄所有不满的出口。至于别人告诉她该如何化解困境、调整心态，对她而言毫无意义。

这让我忍不住反复问自己：我为什么要平白无故做别人的情绪垃圾桶？

这位朋友多年来和伴侣的关系一直十分糟糕，两人始终矛盾不断，要么为金钱争执，要么为子女琐事闹别扭，感情磕磕绊绊、争吵不休。很早之前我就坦诚地劝过她：如果实在无法接受这段关系带来的种种不如意，就勇敢放手；如果选择继续留在这段关系里，就要学着接纳对方的全部，放下无休止的抱怨。可她始终处在不清醒的状态里，既不甘心将就度日，又没有勇气结束这段关系，就这样一直内耗自己，也消耗着身边的人。

最近她和伴侣的矛盾彻底激化，便开始近乎疯狂地向我倾诉，每天至少发来几十条消息吐槽两人之间的鸡毛蒜皮和针锋相对。这让我越来越烦，我明明已经给出过最直白的建议，可她既不肯分开，也不肯妥协，明明是两个人的事情，却非要把所有的负面情绪一股脑甩给我。

我已经开始刻意放慢回复和减少回应，试图用沉默拉开距离，可她依旧日复一日地发来满是负能量的内容。

我每天都在心里反复提醒自己，要远离负能量，守住自己阳光的生活，不想被别人的内耗拖入情绪的泥潭。可面对这样的朋友，我始终不知道该如何妥善处理。我多希望自己能有足够的勇气，坦诚地告诉她：别再一味发泄负能量了，成年人，要学会消化自己的情绪，与其困在抱怨里，不如试着自己活成照亮生活的那束光。

body.title: Empire Records (1995) Is One Of The Most Underrated Nineties Cult Classics And A Perfect Snapshot Of Youth, Music, And Chaos. It Captures That Feeling Of Trying To Hold Your Life Together While Everything Around You Feels Like It Might Fall Apart.
body.body:
Released in 1995 and directed by Allan Moyle, Empire Records did not become a massive hit when it first came out, but over time it built a loyal following and became a true cult favorite. It is one of those movies people discover years later and immediately wonder how it was not bigger from the start.

![IMG_1201.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSdtn1Qi3v6eKW15kV9RmzYPvNNYqdaipWKVnRKyLMSK7/IMG_1201.webp)

The story takes place over the course of a single day inside an independent record store called Empire Records. The employees are trying to save the store from being turned into a corporate chain while also dealing with their own personal drama, relationships, and identity crises. It sounds simple, but the charm is in the characters.

Anthony LaPaglia plays Joe, the manager trying to keep the store and his group of chaotic young employees from completely collapsing. He brings a grounded presence to the film, acting almost like the reluctant father figure in a place where nobody seems fully in control.

Liv Tyler plays Corey, the overachiever with pressure building beneath the surface. Tyler gives the role real emotional weight, showing how someone who looks like they have everything together can still be struggling deeply underneath.

Renée Zellweger as Gina brings confidence and attitude, while Robin Tunney as Deb gives one of the film’s most memorable performances. Deb’s shaved head and quiet emotional struggle make her one of the most human characters in the movie, and Tunney handles it with honesty rather than melodrama.

Then there is Rory Cochrane as Lucas, the unpredictable employee whose impulsive decision to take the store’s money to Atlantic City sets everything in motion. Lucas feels like the kind of person every friend group had in the nineties—smart, strange, and impossible to fully trust.

Johnny Whitworth as A.J. and Ethan Embry as Mark help round out the cast, while Coyote Shivers as the washed up rock star Rex Manning gives the movie one of its funniest running jokes. “Damn the man, save the Empire” became the perfect summary of the film’s entire spirit.

Director Allan Moyle keeps the energy moving with a style that feels loose and alive, matching the unpredictable nature of the characters. The film does not rely on a huge plot twist or dramatic structure. It works because it feels like spending a day with people you actually know.

The soundtrack is a massive part of why Empire Records works so well. Like Dazed and Confused or Singles, the music is not just background noise. It defines the mood and identity of the film. The songs make the store feel like a real place and the characters feel connected to a specific moment in time.

What makes the movie special is that it understands how important small places can be. A record store is not just a business here. It is a home, a community, and a symbol of independence. That feeling resonates even more now in an era where places like that keep disappearing.

The film also captures the uncertainty of being young. Nobody in the story fully knows what they are doing. They are trying to figure out love, careers, friendship, and who they want to become. That uncertainty gives the movie its emotional core.

Some critics at the time dismissed it because it did not fit neatly into a traditional structure, but that is exactly why it lasts. Life at that age often feels messy and unstructured. The movie reflects that honestly instead of forcing a cleaner narrative.

Over the years, Empire Records became more appreciated because people connected with its attitude and authenticity. It is not polished, but it has personality, and personality lasts longer than perfection.

In the end, Empire Records is an excellent film because it understands that music and community can shape your life just as much as major life events. It is funny, emotional, messy, and full of heart.

![IMG_1202.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfT4igKiwfV9oT8dGPTPX72hDmNzDGvQMEwMDGagLffft/IMG_1202.webp)

It remains one of the best cult films of the nineties and a reminder of why independent record stores meant so much to so many

body.title: Lo planificado vs lo ejecutado.🤔🏃🏽🙌🏽
body.body: > Dia martes, dia de series, hoy sali como todos los dias temprano a realizar mi entrenamiento, pero ya algo no venia bien en este entrenamiento porque ya mi cuerpo tenia indisposicion, a penas sali de casa, me dije a mi misma no yo como que no voy a poder hoy con las 12 series de 400 mts, bueno me dije hare 10, ya sin empezar ni a calentar mi mente predijo que no lo iba a lograr las 12 repeticiones, bueno hice mi calentamiento de 2 kilometros, fuera del estadio, al llegar al estadio comence las series las 3 primeras salieron bien, ya la cuarta sentia muy pesadas las piernas, hasta sentia fastidio, mi mente comenzaba a sabotearme, bueno me dije terminare pero bajare intensidad, ya los tiempos y ritmos no estaban en el orden de mis ultimas series de 400 mts, ya comenzaron a subir entre 5-15 segundos. Los t,iempos de descanso estaban en 60 segundos, ya al final tuve que hasta subirlos, y al llegar al intervalo 8, me dije no ya no puedo mas, senti mucha pesades en las piernas, y me sentia derrotada, y no culmine ni las 10 series de 400 mts, bueno me retire, quizas por precaucion, o bueno porque no confie en mi, y me sentia debil que la mente saboteo mi entrenamiento. --- Sin duda alguna no se siente bien cuando no podemos culminar un entrenamiento, pero esto es parte del crecimiento no todos los dias son iguales, lo que debemos es no dejarnos caer, y seguir, ya que de las derrotas es que nos hacemos fuertes cuando nos levantamos y asumimos y trabajamos nuestras fallas, no es de buscar culpas, pero se que un factor que influyo mucho en mi desempeño de hoy fue que no descanse bien la noche anterior, por malestar de gripe. Y no es para justificarme sino para entender que no todos los entrenamiento deben salir como lo planificamos, muchos factores puyeden cambiar en el momento y debemos trabajarlos para que no nos afecten. Al final de mi entrenamiento solo realice 8 series de 400 mts, con ritmo promedio de 5:05 min/Km. De regreso a casa disfrute de mi camino, me encontre unas lindas palomitas en la calle, y me animaron mucho. Hasta otro dia runners. 💕💕🏃🏽‍♀️‍➡️ . >Greetings and blessings.! >

>Tuesday, set day. Today I went out early, like every day, to do my workout, but something didn't feel right from the start because my body was already feeling off. As soon as I left the house, I told myself, “No, I don't think I'm going to be able to handle the 12 sets of 400 meters today.” Well, I told myself I’d do 10. Even before I started or warmed up, my mind predicted I wouldn’t make it through the 12 reps. So I did my 2-kilometer warm-up outside the stadium. When I got to the stadium, I started the sets. The first three went well, but by the fourth, my legs felt really heavy—I even felt annoyed. My mind was starting to sabotage me. Well, I told myself I’d finish but lower the intensity. My times and paces weren’t on par with my last 400-meter sets; they started increasing by 5–15 seconds. My rest periods were 60 seconds, and by the end I even had to extend them. When I got to the eighth interval, I told myself, “I can’t do this anymore.” My legs felt incredibly heavy, and I felt defeated. I didn’t even finish the 10 sets of 400 meters. Well, I stopped—maybe out of caution, or maybe because I didn’t trust myself— and I felt so weak that my mind sabotaged my workout. --- >There’s no doubt that it doesn’t feel good when we can’t finish a workout, but this is part of the growth process—not every day is the same. What we must do is not let ourselves get discouraged and keep going, because it’s through setbacks that we grow stronger when we pick ourselves up, own up to our mistakes, and work on them. It’s not about assigning blame, but I know that one factor that greatly influenced my performance today was that I didn’t rest well the night before because I was feeling under the weather with a cold. And I’m not saying this to make excuses, but to understand that not every workout has to go as planned; many factors can change at the last minute, and we have to work on them so they don’t affect us. At the end of my workout, I only managed 8 sets of 400 meters, at an average pace of 5:05 min/km. body.title: Technology: Tool for Innovation or a Threat to Independent Thinking?
body.body: Technology is created to assist human creativity and not to make humans less creative. It takes a creative person to utilize technology to the fullest. I believe technology compliments humans. Through technology, our work has been made easier, difficult tasks are now easy to execute. With a technology like Ai, we now have aids to generate pictures in different parts of the world, we can now edit and create creative videos at ease and acquire knowledge easier and faster. Technology keeps evolving, from the age of printing press to our current devices, from the use of Abacus computer to our current digital devices. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf8kLeUuQ95ZfaaEe9tLKySUoQ7H7qW2dRq4cQuM3vqz4/1778031784319.jpg) [PICTURESOURCE](https://unsplash.com/photos/white-robot-near-brown-wall-2EJCSULRwC8) Technology has just helped human creativity and not taken the human creativity or mind. I agree it has it advantages and disadvantages. The negative side of laziness amongst those who totally depend on Ai, reduces critical and independent thinking and reduces the ability of their brain to function in diverse ways, but we still have a broader position aspect of technology to humanity. The use of technology enhances creativity in many ways. With the use of technology like our phones and the features in our phones, creativity is now easy. For instance: Using phone cameras used for videoing, with current technology we aren't only given a brighter camera to capture, but with technology that takes us to different locations and places without traveling there to capture the moment. We find interesting adverts and commercials that are generated by Ai. Also, with the intelligence and creative mind of humans, technology won't be utilized or explored to its maximum potential without humans. With the help of technology, we now have countless resources and tools in different fields and works of life. Technology advanced the banking system and that didn't take away creativity from humans, but gave them the privilege to work faster and at ease . It gives bankers the opportunity to manage multiple customers and still work efficiently. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbmHXjG1TYWFzs7sjGGq66Lpsqd1vkWVbYPiM26Nw6DU2/1778031806384.jpg) [PICTURESOURCE](https://unsplash.com/photos/macro-photography-of-black-circuit-board-FO7JIlwjOtU) We can all agree that technology has always been a solution to our problems, it solves our problems effortlessly and helps in every field of life. It has never made us less creative from the beginning or evolution, but has proven to compliment humans and make tasks easier to execute in every work of life, has saved costs and provides comfort not total dependence. Technology plays an important function in our lives. Technology has evolved, and now the world is full of innovative and creative technology that is assisting humans achieve their multiple tasks effortlessly. Where it gets wrong with technology is when humans become totally dependent on technology and fail to utilize our potential as humans. Just last week, I heard someone praising technology, and she made a comment; she said can't chat without utilizing ChatGPT. ChatGPT composes her messages on WhatsApp, felt bad because that a limitation of the human mind. For something as little as holding a conversation/ chatting, the human brain can execute that task and not an AI bot. While we explore the use of AI in phones, it's also necessary to be able to execute simple acts with the aid of technology. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXRohjwPVuonHZVMMkkQkqfYMYmHKc36U3gm8TMcNAQ3a/1778031829512.jpg) [PICTURESOURCE](https://unsplash.com/photos/gray-and-black-laptop-computer-on-surface-Im7lZjxeLhg) The real problem is being dependent on technology to execute minor or regular tasks that the human brain can actualize effortlessly. The problem isn't technology, it's the humans that limit its use and depend on technology for simple daily tasks. Technology is now beneficial to every career path, including music, architecture, content creating, medicine, teaching and many other professions or career paths. To stay creative in a digital era and not depend solely on Ai, the key is for humans to see Ai Technology as an assistant and not depend on it for perfection. Instead, while utilizing Ai , try, as much as you can, to also create an original masterpiece with the help of the human brain and Artificial intelligence and that makes a perfect masterpiece. Think independently and believe in yourself. ### Thanks for reading ♥️ ### Vanilla 💗

body.title: Your Life in Their Hands: What You Need to Know About Pharmacy Errors and Your Rights
body.body:
>Just as we have Medical malpractices and accidents, so do we have pharmaceutical accidents, medication accidents, and pharmacy malpractice. To me, I see them as the same, no matter what name people call them. Millions of people are injured worldwide as a result of medication errors, which could result from a pharmacist being nonchalant, not concentrating, or taking advantage of ignorant people who cannot read the prescription properly.

\n\n

>Nobody is perfect, and no one is above mistakes, but for the majority of pharmacy drug mistakes, it is associated with pharmacy in high-volume and high-stress pharmacies. Have you seen pharmacies with high traffic? You would think it is a fast-food restaurant, and you would be surprised when some employees tell you they have a quota to sell medications, which is very disturbing.

\n\n

>Another reason I have seen why pharmacies would give the wrong medications, which can sometimes lead to a deadly mistake, is the sound-alike error, which is caused by medications with similar names. Examples of Sound-alike mistakes are Celebrex vs Celexa (one a Painkiller and the other an antidepressant), Lamictal vs Lamisil (a Seizure medication and the other an antifungal med), Losec vs Lasix (an Ulcer drug and a diuretic med), and so on.

\n\n

>As a pharmacist, one common malpractice is dispersing medications that are past their expiration date, which is wrong and harmful, and it can cause a patient to be undermedicated. This should not be taken lightly. If you suspect a drug error, you must call your doctor immediately. If your doctor confirms there is an error, the next thing is to call the pharmacy. Do not return the misfilled medication under any circumstances. Save the medicine, the receipt, the pack, and the bag it was packed in. If you were not affected by the medication in the case where you have not used it and it has not caused any damage, you can go to the pharmacy if it was a genuine mistake, but if you notice it is as a result of negligence or any other questionable reason, reach out to the authorities (In Nigeria, you can reach out to Pharmacists Council of Nigeria (PCN) and NAFDAC), and consider legal actions in cases of Injurym Complications, and Financial loss.

\n\n

>Health, they say, is wealth, and for you to be healthy, you need to be watchful when you are at the pharmacy. One wrongdoing can be the difference between life and death, getting well and deteriorating health. Take your health seriously.

\n\n
