body.body:
> **English** ###
**Capturing Natural Beauty**
Greetings to all #monomad contest enthusiasts. In these photographs, I captured the tranquil magic of the park on a pleasant, cool, and sunny day. I wanted to focus on the paths and the people in the park, the street vendors, and the surrounding undergrowth, but everything changed when I wandered off along more remote, intricate, and solitary paths; all I could hear were the birds. Then I saw this beautiful arrangement of stones placed at the base of the trees, and I loved it for my black and white photos. >***Español*** >#####
**Capturando La Belleza Natural**
>Un saludo amante de #monomad contest. En estas fotografías capturo la magia tranquila del parque en un día con buena luz, agradable y fresco, y quería enfocarme en los caminos y la gente en el parque, en los vendedores ambulantes y su maleza, pero todo cambió cuando me desvié por caminos más alejados e intrincados y solitarios; entonces solo oía el ruido de las aves. Hasta que vi este escenario de piedras que me encantaron, colocadas a los pies de los árboles, y me gustó para mis fotos de blanco y negro. ![IMG_20260425_132610~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EoEqWaYdhqoYpARAnXSNfbGnHD9pCPNhBN13E4NBRU4aP5nEt2Kzq9fh3schyLAxiwr.jpg) ![IMG_20260425_132942~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23xehtUbZ3j3dNfP6VrjwJ92RNARXXphMv4fnfPhdsNR2D3GRQkF3sG3tcoJtoQj122AE.jpg) ![IMG_20260425_130756~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23y8sw2BPHKt1MawzjEJANRgEENT7zWwcJ4hgDtGJiMtGHhSChxVRe9vJyRjSJUAUm4L8.jpg) ![IMG_20260425_125453_MP~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23uQpei8vWTRPxbCqcoussGAcfvHwGg3TtPtNNATNcHCtkTonNkycD3BCxfwpLKwmQxM7.jpg) And then I noticed this girl sitting on the rocks, completely undisturbed by my presence. The entire time I was taking my pictures, she remained motionless, so engrossed in her phone. Although we were both absorbed in our own worlds, I later realized that from the different angles I took the photos, she came across as the focal point, the delicate flower amidst those rugged elements of nature. >Y luego observé a esta chica sentada en las piedras, que no se perturbó por mi presencia; todo el rato que estuve capturando mis fotografías, ella permaneció inerte; estaba tan concentrada mirando su celular. Aunque ambas estábamos entretenidas, después me di cuenta de que en los diferentes ángulos que tomé las imágenes, ella resultó ser el centro o la flor delicada de esos elementos rudos de la naturaleza. ![IMG_20260425_133629~2-COLLAGE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EoCj1bH8cw6zBqRmSManozcDdSkpnCDPsJwV92pnUg7NXNy997Q6ULeeNzHh6rN8CiU.jpg) ![IMG_20260425_133042~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23tmHRdcK34d9ALWLvDdNF52CabrBv3mqXyEndgkp972btZuSiBAjjMFqSCu5dwxAoCUV.jpg) ![IMG_20260425_133444~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EoCieQKW1c2jPtU52cqpmvZzp5YNNDKsCpgjmgQvRmsTpr8iHjKNv88Mranh5DobLuG.jpg) ![IMG_20260425_133552~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EoCiB6MYBdYLwzdZjgNYcfTd17D5H54stqo8v38pZzrn6ctmUzXC4GvzdozimrTex9X.jpg) I left the rocky area and began to see people in the distance. Another thing that caught my eye was the tree roots, the network of roots with their protrusions and branches extending across the ground; I've always loved capturing those images. The park filled me with energy; I was very happy and excited about my photos for the #monomad contest. >Salí del entorno de las piedras y comencé a ver personas a la distancia. Otra cosa que me llamó la atención fueron las raíces de los árboles, el conjunto de raíces con sus protuberancias y vertientes que se extiende a lo largo del suelo; siempre me gustó capturar esas imágenes. <center>Español
#### La rubia que quiso escribir poesía</center>

<div class=\

>

Los dorados cabellos yacen sobre el papel, donde unos versos han sido esbozados con tinta negra. Los ojos azules se han ocultado bajo los párpados, y la respiración sosegada sale por su encantadora nariz respingada. Los labios sensuales con un encantador pintalabios rosado, han dejado huella sobre el papel blanco.

Su piel tan blanca como la porcelana casi es un mimetismo con aquel blanco. Una encantadora escena de belleza y talento esbozado en unos versos salidos del alma. De entre sueños ella va formando cada letra, cada palabra, cada verso. Es como si su subconsciente tomara el control creativo, formara a la poetisa, sacara su mejor versión y lo plasmara sobre el lienzo creativo.

Allí sigue ella, aquella rubia que quiere ser poeta de la vida, del amor y la pasión. Ha sentido dentro de ella ese llamado interno, ese llamado de la musa poética, que se apodera de cada fibra del ser, llegando hasta el alma, hasta la esencia misma del ser. 

Ella siempre quiso escribir versos, quiso mostrar que había cerebro detrás de su belleza angelical. Tal vez, la belleza que le abrió muchas puertas ha sido su maldición. No fue tomada en serio. Los halagos caprichosos dieron paso a obsesiones, no por su escritura, sino por su belleza. Descartó a muchos que se había acercado con intenciones siniestras, ya no confiaba en nadie que le ofrecía poner el mundo literario a sus pies.

La poetisa angelical quiso abrirse paso entre este mundo superficial y destruir su imagen de diosa, para convertirse en una labradora de letras, en una poeta que respira prosas, métricas, rimas y versos que exponen su alma, a veces vulnerable, a veces inmensamente completa, a veces ser ella misma bajo un pseudónimo.

Allí sigue la poeta de cabellos lacios como los rayos del sol. Cansada de tanto exponer sus sentimientos, sus pensamientos, se ha refugiado en sus sueños donde la pluma sigue fluyendo, entre nubes mórficas, entre mundos irreales, entre fantasía que fluyen libremente y se convierten esbozos de poesía. 

La constructora de poesía abre sus bellos ojos azules, levanta su tez intentado asimilar la realidad, que la tiene atrapada en un mundo gris y muerto, pero que ella, como muchos más, intenta darle vida, hacerlo más colorido, darle una magia que parece haber perdido durante tanto tiempo. La de cabellos dorados se ha convertido en una rebelde, como tantos poetas, que van contra la corriente e intentan ver más allá de la superficialidad y de existencias banales.

La diosa de letras, como algunos la llaman, sigue esbozando sus caracteres, uno tras otro con su pluma, quiere mostrar al mundo que su cara bella y radiante, no le impide poder crear bellos versos, poesías que llegan al alma y tocan corazones con su sensibilidad emocional. Sus dedos largos y elegantes mueven la pluma, en una conexión casi sagrada con su alma.

La rubia sigue escribiendo, como si el mañana se extinguiera en un apocalipsis de ignorancia y sus letras fueran el único testigo de la belleza poética, del alma humana. 

La rubia sigue escribiendo, alguna veces ocultando su fachada perfecta de los ojos morbosos y mostrando su talento innato, ese talento que ha florecido y lo ha pulido con el paso de sus 27 primaveras, pero el camino es largo para seguir aprendiendo hasta el fin del horizonte, donde la belleza se extingue y solo queda la esencia de sus versos, que vivirán por siempre y no morirán jamás.


***
![bannerhive.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVHP6CkxhCEAu67zAoPbfRAJc6QCPZdGNXvJLHraenhgL/bannerhive.jpg)

***
<center>English

#### The blonde who wanted to write poetry</center>

<div class=\

> The golden hairs lie on the paper, where some verses have been sketched with black ink. The blue eyes have been hidden under the lids, and the calm breathing comes out through her charming upturned nose. The sensual lips with a lovely pink lipstick, have left their mark on the white paper. Her skin as white as porcelain is almost a mimicry with that white one. A charming scene of beauty and talent outlined in a few verses out of the soul. From between dreams she is forming every letter, every word, every verse. It's as if her subconscious took creative control, formed the poet, brought out her best version and put it on the creative canvas. There she is still, that blonde who wants to be a poet of life, of love and passion. She has felt within her that inner call, that call of the poetic muse, which takes hold of every fiber of being, reaching to the soul, to the very essence of being. She always wanted to write verses, she wanted to show that there was a brain behind her angelic beauty. Perhaps, the beauty that opened many doors for her has been her curse. She was not taken seriously. Whimsical flattery gave way to obsessions, not for her writing, but for her beauty. She dismissed many who had approached her with sinister intentions, she no longer trusted anyone who offered to put the literary world at her feet. The angelic poet wanted to break through this superficial world and destroy her image of a goddess, to become a tiller of letters, a poet who breathes prose, metrics, rhymes and verses that expose her soul, sometimes vulnerable, sometimes immensely complete, sometimes being herself under a pseudonym. There follows the poet with straight hair like the rays of the sun. Tired of exposing her feelings, her thoughts so much, she has taken refuge in her dreams where the pen keeps flowing, between morphic clouds, between unreal worlds, between fantasy that flow freely and become sketches of poetry. The poetry builder opens her beautiful blue eyes, lifts her complexion trying to assimilate reality, which has her trapped in a gray and dead world, but that she, like many others, tries to give it life, make it more colorful, give it a magic that seems to have been lost for so long. The one with golden hair has become a rebel, like so many poets, who go against the current and try to see beyond superficiality and banal existences. The goddess of letters, as some call her, keeps sketching her letters, one after another with her pen, she wants to show the world that her beautiful and radiant face does not prevent her from being able to create beautiful verses, poems that reach the soul and touch hearts with her emotional sensitivity. Her long, graceful fingers move the pen, in an almost sacred connection with her soul. The blonde keeps writing, as if tomorrow was extinguished in an apocalypse of ignorance and her letters were the only witness to the poetic beauty, of the human soul. The blonde keeps writing, sometimes hiding her perfect facade from morbid eyes and showing her innate talent, that talent that has blossomed and polished it with the passage of her 27 springs, but the road is long to keep learning until the end of the horizon, where beauty becomes extinct and only the essence of her verses remains, which will live forever and will never die. *** ![bannerhive.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVHP6CkxhCEAu67zAoPbfRAJc6QCPZdGNXvJLHraenhgL/bannerhive.jpg)

---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

---

body.title: Haciendo logo a crochet
body.body:
> Saludos querida comunidad, muchas personas dicen que no hay nada imposible para una crochetera, yo no creo que sea totalmente cierto, pero si estoy segura que se pueden hacer muchas mas cosas de las que pensamos, sin embargo a veces dudamos un poco de nuestras capacidades pero al final del día la mejor satisfacción es poder resolver todos esos problemas y superar todos los retos que se nos presentan en el trabajo con agujas, en este mismo orden de ideas hace unos días me escribió un cliente preguntándome si no podía hacer el logo de un negocio a crochet, me lo envió como imagen y era un logo de formato circular, con figuras con colores planos y letras sencillas, luego de pensar un rato la mejor manera de abordar el proyecto le dije que aceptaba el encargo. > Greetings, dear community. Many people say that nothing is impossible for a crocheter. I don't believe that's entirely true, but I am sure that we can do much more than we think. However, sometimes we doubt our abilities, but at the end of the day, the greatest satisfaction is being able to solve all those problems and overcome all the challenges that come our way when working with needles. Along these same lines, a few days ago a client wrote to me asking if I could crochet a logo for a business. He sent it to me as an image, and it was a circular logo with figures in flat colors and simple lettering. After thinking for a while about the best way to approach the project, I told him I accepted the commission.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AKKUntA2hkeVKcxbqUKgsLwADsBpzZo1d6SsKh8jkUQLJMw1jrJ3C7NMnFua8u9.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

Proceso / Process

Lo primero que hice fue dibujar el logo en una hoja de papel, de ese modo pude determinar las medidas de cada elemento de la imagen para que tuvieran las proporciones correctas, a partir de allí hice las figuras con hilo acrílico y ganchillo de 1.25mm, primero la botella y su etiqueta, luego la sandía, el pan y la lechuga, la cesta y su tirante, trabajando en plano, es decir para que se pudieran ver bidimensional. > The first thing I did was draw the logo on a sheet of paper. This allowed me to determine the measurements of each element of the image so that they would have the correct proportions. From there, I made the figures with acrylic yarn and a 1.25mm crochet hook. First, the bottle and its label, then the watermelon, the bread and the lettuce, the basket and its strap, working flat, so that they could be seen in two dimensions.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AJeho9fdcrGrpB2NMiWdsj7VyUjx3t3NrHixHNaZwJavCXFDUeLboha4imTN2ub.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
Luego con hilo rosado claro hice el círculo base del logo, sobre el cual cosí cada una de las figuras superpuestas en el orden de la imagen y bordé los detalles. > Then with light pink thread I made the base circle of the logo, on which I sewed each of the overlapping figures in the order of the image and embroidered the details.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AJhaFyM2MJXt2XAa57wKtj8FnyFb58HCGm6Mgu4ygXkaWxju9R3CyEWXhCEK8pF.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
Luego bordé el nombre del negocio, hice otro circulo igual, a cada circulo hice dos hileras adiciones de puntos bajos para que quedaran con espacio para el relleno, luego uní las piezas con una hilera de puntos bajos de color beige y rellené antes de cerrar, por ultimo coloqué la argolla para el llavero. > Then I embroidered the business name, made another identical circle, added two rows of single crochet stitches to each circle to create space for stuffing, then joined the pieces with a row of beige single crochet stitches and stuffed before closing, finally attaching the keyring.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AJmsxthUQRaKry1ij4ke6CkBn1APg43jdfLPjmHXMJcZShXd8LhrEUzHUSi4cJC.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

Resultado / Result

Me encantó trabajar en este proyecto, la apariencia parece de un mini cojín con el logo del negocio, hoy vinieron a buscarlo y el cliente quedó muy satisfecho con el resultado, espero que otras personas se animen a encargarme sus logos de negocios a crochet 😊 > I loved working on this project; it looks like a mini cushion with the business logo. The client came to pick it up today and was very happy with the result. I hope others will be encouraged to order their crocheted business logos from me 😊

>
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AKDjAuSXPp9YoPdetAxLwnHXM7RyZftasUffF6Bwt9boAjoH4TkkMUTtKc4V8tx.jpg https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AK7yGRyHaqdRRoDjZLsQ3Lq2QxQVq3xu9yQbEnNhy2JGrnFjNXb9WdEuH1ev6Tv.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
##### Imágenes tomadas con dispositivo Samsung A54. Portada editada en Inshot >##### Pictures taken with Samsung A54 device. Cover edited in Inshot
https://img.inleo.io/DQmYM3K826shf3f1DvqMGnC34RWNHDXFJYfxPvrtT6jq3K3/1000143682.png
##### Espero les haya gustado. Les invito a leer mis próximas publicaciones y siempre estaré dispuesta a responder sus preguntas y comentarios, también pueden seguirme y contactarme en cualquiera de mis redes sociales. ¡Muchas gracias! >##### I hope you liked it. body.title: ZCASH IS ON FIRE The Original Privacy Coin Just Hit $550 and It's Only Getting Started!
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmetPWLETcKegQZH9y4UshaaEQPkNVRqUx4HErrW5xJBrL/1778031012351.jpg)



Zcash (ZEC) is posting one of the most powerful moves in the entire crypto market right now  +21.17% on Binance, blasting from $371.38 all the way to a 24-hour high of $550.00 on massive volume of $216 million USDT. The chart is a perfect staircase of higher lows grinding upward for days  then one explosive vertical candle to $550. Here's the full story behind this beast of a rally.

Catalyst 1  Robinhood + Thorchain Double Listing

This is the biggest catalyst. The surge is anchored to two verified catalysts first, U.S. brokerage Robinhood added ZEC spot trading, and second, Thorchain enabled native cross-chain ZEC swaps  directly increasing retail access and DeFi utility for Zcash simultaneously.   Robinhood has tens of millions of retail users. Every single one of them can now buy ZEC in seconds. And Thorchain means you can swap native ZEC directly for Bitcoin, Ethereum, or 35 other chains without a centralized exchange. Two game changing integrations in the same week.

Catalyst 2  Barry Silbert Goes Mega Bullish

Digital Currency Group founder Barry Silbert publicly responded to a ZEC chart with an even more bullish outlook suggesting Zcash could replicate Bitcoin's historic 2013–2014 boom phase, linking this to the growing financial privacy ecosystem and highlighting that Foundry's institutional mining pool captured 30% of the network's hashrate in March 2026.  When one of the most powerful figures in institutional crypto publicly compares your coin to early Bitcoin, the market listens.

Catalyst 3  Grayscale ETF Filing

Grayscale has filed to convert its Zcash Trust into a spot ETF a landmark development that would provide a regulated on-ramp for institutional capital, significantly boosting liquidity and legitimacy. The Zcash Open Development Lab secured $25 million in funding to accelerate private financial tools. A ZEC spot ETF would be the first privacy coin ETF ever approved  and that filing alone is worth billions in potential institutional inflows.
Grayscale's Zcash Trust volume has doubled as ZEC's shielded supply hits record highs   institutional money is already positioning before the ETF is even approved.

The On-Chain Numbers Are Real

This is not just hype. Zcash's shielded-pool activity reached all time highs in April 2026, with shielded supply climbing to approximately 5.17 million ZEC  representing 31% of circulating supply, up sharply from just 11% a year earlier. Shielded transactions accounted for 59.3% of total activity, and the Orchard pool alone holds over 4.5 million ZEC.   People are not just buying ZEC  they are actually using it for private transactions at record levels. That is real demand, not speculation.

The Weekly Performance Is Historic

ZEC has surged nearly 16.8% over the past week, ranking among the strongest weekly performers in the top 100 cryptocurrencies  outperforming majors like Bitcoin and Ethereum during the same period.  And that was before today's $550 spike. The 30-day gain is over +66% and accelerating.

The Technical Picture Is Textbook Breakout

The Binance 1H chart is one of the cleanest setups you will ever see. Price built a beautiful staircase from $371.38 steady higher lows for days  then launched vertically through all three EMAs EMA(25) at 458.72, EMA(50) at 437.69, EMA(100) at 414.71. All three EMAs are fanning out perfectly upward. A sustained hold above $400 opens the path toward $450–$457, and analysts now have short-term targets of $400–$500 for May June 2026 targets that ZEC has already blown past.  (Kraken)

The Bigger Picture

Zcash has a fixed 21 million coin supply with halvings every four years  identical to Bitcoin's monetary policy with faster 75-second blocks and near-zero transaction fees. Privacy has always been optional, but 2025–2026 has seen a massive surge in adoption as users seek a hedge against financial surveillance.  
ZEC's all-time high was $3,191 in January 2018. At $550 today, it is still 82% below that peak  with a Grayscale ETF pending, Robinhood listing live, Thorchain integration active, and shielded usage at all-time highs. The setup for the next leg is very much intact. 

DYOR. Not financial advice.

</center>
</liketuimages>

那天去抽血不懂做糖耐量检测的可以优先采血，师姐提醒之后就加快了进度。抽完血还发了那个优先采血的卡给我们，说到一小时后第二次采血可以直接拿着卡过来不用排队。

后面出来接水发现没有热水，工作人员提醒之后就知道要解锁的事。后面在等待的过程中发现饮水机旁边有温馨提示：打热水需要先解锁。只是我们关注点在饮水机上都没有注意墙上有字。

然后走廊旁边有一长排的椅子给我们坐，墙上还有充电口可以免费充电，上面清晰地写着便民充电，免费充电等字眼。

我感觉医院实在是太人性化了，而且也有饮水机还提供一次性杯子，饮水机上面写着没有杯子可以去问诊台领取。

然后洗手间也在抽血室的旁边，附近还有早餐售卖点，信息就贴在抽血室门口，我想这大概是怕早上空腹抽血的人想买早餐不方便，所以特地贴到了抽血室的门口。

以上就是我发现的一些医院的人性化的设计。

What haven't I built... The most difficult and yet easiest thing was the relationship to Lily. Difficult because all the boulders that were laid in my way, easiest because it just was so natural to overcome them by any means necessary. 

The business was very hard to build, and it had many setbacks within the time. Still has. Although I just recently started studying Stoicism, one rule I always applied - building it on who I am and wanted to be, a business based on my principles. That made every decision easier.

Talking about, that also caused me to destroy. Building the business severed my marriage. And my relationship to some people. Jealousy was always a thing, and sometimes misconception, for not asking me but assuming, or worse, listening to gossip. I don't mind having lost those connections. Those who indulge into jealousy and gossip are not relationships I want to have, anyway. And the connection to my ex-wife is quite good now again. 

And as for opportunity - a mix of everything. Always looking for it, always creating some, and I did get lucky once or twice.

body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUmMBzASh9h7HyYn6cPPsWG2k3eShHNDydH5t75VC1Q4d/1778031017914.jpg)

ဆင်ပျံကြီး Arsenal ကတော့ UCL ဗိုလ်လုပွဲအဆင့်သို့ တက်လှမ်း သွားခဲ့ပြီ ဖြစ်၏။ ပထမပိုင်း ၄၅ မိနစ်မှာ သွင်းယူခဲ့တဲ့ Saka ရဲ့ တလုံးထဲသော သွင်းဂိုးနဲ့ ၁-၀ ဖြင့် အနိုင်ရကာ နှစ်ကျော့ပေါင်း ၂-၁ ဖြင့် Atletico Madrid ကို ကျော်ဖြတ်ကာ ဗိုလ်လုပွဲသို့ ရောက်သွားခဲ့ပြီ ဖြစ်၏။ Atletico Madrid အနေဖြင့် ဆီမီးဖိုင်နယ် အဆင့်နဲ့သာ ကျေနပ်ခဲ့ရလေတော့၏။ ဂုဏ်ယူပါတယ် Arsenal ရေ။

UCL မှာ ဗိုလ်လုပွဲ တက်သွားသည့်အပြင် EPL မှာလည်း အနီးကပ် ဖိအားပေးနေသည့် City က Everton ကို သရေကျသွားသဖြင့် ချန်ပီယံ အိပ်မက်တွေ အားကောင်းလို့ လာနေပြီ ဖြစ်၏။ နည်းပြ Arteta အနေဖြင့်လည်း ၂၀၂၅/၂၆ မှာတော့ ဗိုလ်လုပွဲအဆင့်သို့ တက်လှမ်း နိုင်ခဲ့ပြီ ဖြစ်၏။ ၂၀၂၃/၂၄ မှာ ကွာတားဖိုင်နယ်၊ ၂၀၂၄/၂၅ မှာ ဆီမီးဖိုင်နယ်အဆင့်ထိသာ တက်လှမ်း နိုင်ခဲ့၏။ ဒီတကြိမ်မှာတော့ ဗိုလ်လုပွဲထိ တက်လှမ်းနိုင်ခဲ့ပြီ။ ဗိုလ်စွဲသွားမလားကတော့ စိတ်ဝင်စားဖွယ် စောင့်ကြည့်သွားရမည် ဖြစ်၏။


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmboauSZc2NyN52GNWTFkV9UiCfFs3Cp4RCkUULthrLcmJ/1778031017943.jpg)


ဒီနှစ်သင်း ဆီမီးဖိုင်နယ် ပွဲစဉ်ကတော့ သိတဲ့အတိုင်းပင် ပထမကျော့မှာ ၁-၁၊ ဟော ခု ဒုတိယကျော့မှာလည်း ၁-၀ နဲ့သာ ပြီးသွားခဲ့၏။ သူတို့ နှစ်သင်း နှစ်ကျော့ပေါင်း သွင်းဂိုးက PSG vs Bayern Munchen တို့၏ ပကျော့ တသင်းထဲက သွင်းသည့် ဂိုးတွေလောက်ပင် မရှိပေ။ PSG vs Bayern Munich ပကျော့က ၅-၄ ဖြင့် ပြီးထားသည် မဟုတ်လား။ ပရိတ်သတ်ကတော့ ပရိတ်သတ်လိုပဲ တွေးမှာပေါ့။ ဂိုးများများ မြိုင်မြိုင်ဆိုင်ဆိုင် ကြည့်ချင်ကြသည် မဟုတ်လား။

နက်ဖြန် မနက် ၁ နာရီခွဲမှာတော့ Bayern Munchen vs PSG အသင်းတို့၏ ဒုတိယကျော့ ပွဲစဉ် ကစားမည် ဖြစ်၏။ PSG အနေဖြင့် ၁ ဂိုးအသာဖြင့်သာ အနိုင်ရထားသည်မို့ Bayern Munchen ၏ အိမ်ကွင်းပွဲစဉ်က သူတို့အတွက် အနည်းငယ် ခက်ခဲပေလိမ့်မည်။ Bayern Munchen အနေဖြင့်ကတော့ အိမ်ကွင်း အားသာချက်ကို အသုံးချပြီး PSG ကို အနိုင်ရဖို့ ကြိုးစားပေလိမ့်မည်။

# <center>The Art of Making Bracelets: Patience and Knots</center>

|<center>English</center>|<center>Español</center>
|-|-|
------
<div class=\

>

Greetings and respect to everyone in the Hive community. This time I want to talk a little about another of my hobbies — one that requires a lot of patience but also helps me reflect, relax, and clear my mind.

#

Today I got out of bed a little later than usual. To be honest, simply because today is my day off — no work or shopping for the business. I allowed myself to sleep in and rest. Also, these past few days I haven't been feeling very well health-wise. While I was having breakfast, my mom sat down with me and we started talking about the news we were listening to.

#

After getting up from the table, I went to the kitchen, washed my dishes, and left them to dry. Then I went to my room, and at that moment the scheduled power outage of the day occurred. To make a long story short, a couple of hours had passed since the blackout, and I began to feel the harsh heat of the day. Then I remembered that I had a bag full of rolls of material to make bracelets.

#

Making bracelets is a hobby that started to interest me back in high school. Here in Venezuela we know this stage as \

That's when, through YouTube tutorials, I learned to make bracelets — from simple designs to some more complex ones. To be completely honest, at that stage of my life I couldn't afford the material used in the tutorials, which was Paracord 501 for survival. They used to make the famous military bracelets that came with a compass, knife, and flint — which made their price skyrocket. # But I never gave up. I practiced with shoe laces or headphone cables to learn the knots and memorize as many as I could. I remember when I was in university, in the 5th semester of Modern Languages with a mention in English, I started an enterprise selling custom-made bracelets to cover my high university expenses. I also sold handmade candies. The Paracord bracelet trend passed, and it remained as a beautiful memory. # To be honest, it taught me patience and showed me that even if things don't go well, or you're not in the best moment of your life — the knot can be untangled, or if necessary, you can start over. There's nothing wrong with that. It doesn't matter what situations life puts in front of you. What matters is the attitude with which you face them. # Here I leave you a handful of photos of what I did today. I hope you enjoy them completely. Thanks for your attention, and stay tuned for upcoming publications.

> Mis saludos y respetos tengan todos en la comunidad Hive. En esta oportunidad les hablaré un poco acerca de otro de mis pasatiempos — uno de los cuales amerita de mucha paciencia pero que también me ayuda mucho a reflexionar, relajarme y aclarar la mente. # En el caso de hoy me levanté de mi cama un poco más tarde de lo habitual. Para ser honesto, simplemente porque hoy es mi día libre — sin trabajo ni compras para el negocio. Me tomé la libertad de dormir para poder descansar. También porque estos últimos días no me he sentido muy bien de salud. Mientras estaba tomando el desayuno, mamá se sentó conmigo y nos pusimos a hablar sobre las noticias que estábamos escuchando. # Luego de levantarme de la mesa, fui a la cocina y lavé mis trastes y los dejé secar para irme a mi habitación. En esto ocurre el corte eléctrico programado del día. Para no hacer el cuento largo, ya había pasado un par de horas desde el corte de electricidad y comencé a sentir el calor inclemente del día. Recordé que tenía una bolsa llena de rollos de material para hacer pulseras. # Hacer pulseras o brazaletes es un hobby que comenzó a interesarme desde que estaba yo en la preparatoria. Aquí en Venezuela conocemos esta etapa como el Bachillerato. Fue allí cuando por medio de YouTube viendo tutoriales aprendí a hacer pulseras de diseño sencillos hasta algunos más complejos. Para ser completamente honesto, en esa etapa de mi vida no tenía la posibilidad de comprar el material que se usaba en los tutoriales, el cual era Paracord 501 para supervivencia. Se solían hacer las conocidas pulseras militares que traían brújula, navaja y pedernal — lo cual hacía que su precio aumentara una barbaridad. # Pero yo nunca me di por vencido. Practiqué con trenzas de zapatos o cables de audífono para aprender los nudos y poder memorizarlos todos cuanto pudiera. Recuerdo que cuando estaba en la universidad estudiando en el 5to semestre de Idiomas Modernos Mención Inglés, emprendí vendiendo las pulseras por encargo para poder costear mis gastos de la universidad, los cuales eran altos. Al igual que vendía dulces artesanales. La moda de las pulseras de Paracord pasó y se quedó como un bonito recuerdo. # Para ser honesto, me enseñó la paciencia y me mostró que aunque las cosas no salgan bien, o no estés en el mejor momento de tu vida — el nudo se puede desenredar, o en su defecto puedes empezar de nuevo porque no hay nada malo en ello. No importa las situaciones que la vida te ponga por delante. Lo que sí importa es con cuál actitud las enfrentas. # Aquí les dejo un puñado de fotos de lo que hice hoy. Espero que sean de su completo agrado. Gracias por la atención y estén pendientes de las próximas publicaciones. ------ ---- |

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 5 2026
body.body:
It's been a big change in the weather here in the Black Hills from Arizona as it was freezing overnight with gray overcast skies all day. Even a light bit of snow flurries up in Spearfish Canyon late this afternoon. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4f635c0f-c784-4ded-9fc1-56a185d03bfa.jpg) It was a long and tedious day of training for our volunteer duties so I didn't have much time to get out. Lulu and I were able to do our mule and a half morning walk The sky looked like it would rain and a cold wind really made it cool. At least Lulu got to chase a squirrel so she was happy. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3b9d3e66-6187-49fb-a0f2-df344e1d4b4d.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/33747d5b-118b-4dbe-98c4-19b33ce6756c.jpg) We enjoyed a couple of miles up in Spearfish Canyon in the afternoon after training undwrdark skies. A few light snow flurries swirled around us as we trekked down to Spearfish Falls on quiet trails (seems no one else wanted to be out). ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/94ee4c52-8c98-44b7-94b1-bafabed99d68.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e8742c20-c878-46e3-b899-7ab7da9b0148.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3bc06525-6376-4961-bbe1-5057d5a731cf.jpg) The trees haven't leaved out as much higher in the canyon so it will be a while before I'll be collecting wild berries and nuts. For now it was a very nice hike despite the frigid weather and it will be nice to get back to running once training days are done. One more training day tomorrow then half days of volunteer work so I'll be glad to get back to a regular schedule. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/50d5aaac-8b5f-44cf-8976-c69f44da482c.jpg)

body.title: We have to fulfill our duties./Tenemos que cumplir con nuestras obligaciones.[Eng- Spa]
body.body: > https://images.pexels.com/photos/7551678/pexels-photo-7551678.jpeg [sourch]( https://www.pexels.com/photo/man-in-white-long-sleeve-shirt-holding-a-man-in-blue-sweater-while-walking-7551678/ ) Even if we live a very good life from childhood, after a certain age, responsibilities surround us from all sides. There are some people who fulfill these responsibilities very well, while there are some people who neglect them a little. But every person has to fulfill their responsibilities and duties towards someone or the other in some way or the other, whether it is forced or voluntary. In fact, even if we want to, we cannot turn our backs on our responsibilities and duties. Some of the responsibilities and duties in our life fall on us in such a way that we cannot back down from fulfilling those responsibilities and duties even if we want to. In fact, the head of every house does not have to be given any formal responsibilities and duties. In fact, every person becomes dependent on him. In a house or a family where there is no man, the women have to fulfill the responsibilities and duties of the entire family. Since that ancient era, the elders of the family have been fulfilling the responsibilities and duties of every member of the family. However, nowadays even the young ones are trying to understand their responsibilities at a young age. Nowadays, it is seen that despite their young age, both boys and girls are trying to fulfill the wishes and aspirations of their family members by doing various jobs and trying to be financially capable alongside the family. Many people try to be financially capable along with their studies and fulfill their family responsibilities. However, many times it is seen that despite the child being very young, after the death of the father, the burden of the family i.e. the responsibility falls on the shoulders of the child at a young age. In many families, the responsibilities and duties of the family and various people in the family are seen to be fulfilled at a young age. However, it is also seen that in many families, even though the child has grown up a lot and the parents have become very old, the child does not understand his/her responsibilities and does not fulfill the responsibility of taking care of the elderly parents and meeting their needs. In fact, each of us should fulfill our own duties. If we understand our responsibilities well and fulfill our duties properly, only then can we become a proper person and our parents' hard work in raising us will be fruitful and with it, we can feel proud of ourselves. When we fulfill our responsibilities from our heart and keep everyone happy, we ourselves will also feel much happier from our heart and will be able to sleep peacefully at night. In fact, only when we have peace from our heart can our lives be peaceful. If we do not fulfill our responsibilities properly, then our future generations will not be able to learn to fulfill their responsibilities by watching us. In fact, children learn by watching their elders, and children will not be able to learn well if they are told only by word of mouth. As much as we have to explain through words, we have to explain practically through actions, only then will they be fully educated. If we only tell our future generations that we have to fulfill our responsibilities, but if we ourselves do not fulfill our responsibilities properly, then our future generations will not be able to learn to fulfill their responsibilities. Therefore, we have to fulfill our responsibilities properly and try to keep our family members happy. When we fulfill our responsibilities or the burden of responsibilities and duties falls on our shoulders, different people will express different opinions. We may even hear a lot of bad and negative things, but we should not listen to them. We should try to fulfill everyone's needs as much as we can and we should continue to fulfill our responsibilities. Just as we have a duty towards a small newborn baby and we take care of him with a beautiful and cheerful heart and fulfill our responsibilities, similarly we should fulfill our responsibilities towards our elderly parents from our heart and with a cheerful heart. *** *** https://images.pexels.com/photos/7551678/pexels-photo-7551678.jpeg [sourch]( https://www.pexels.com/photo/man-in-white-long-sleeve-shirt-holding-a-man-in-blue-sweater-while-walking-7551678/ ) Aunque llevemos una vida plena desde la infancia, al llegar a cierta edad, las responsabilidades nos rodean por todas partes. Hay quienes las cumplen muy bien, mientras que otros las descuidan un poco. Pero todos debemos cumplir con nuestras responsabilidades y deberes hacia alguien, de una forma u otra, ya sea por obligación o voluntariamente. De hecho, aunque quisiéramos, no podemos eludir nuestras responsabilidades y deberes. Algunas responsabilidades y deberes en nuestra vida nos llegan de tal manera que no podemos evitar cumplirlos, aunque quisiéramos. De hecho, el cabeza de familia no tiene por qué tener responsabilidades ni deberes formales. En realidad, todos dependen de él. En un hogar o una familia sin hombre, las mujeres deben cumplir con las responsabilidades y deberes de toda la familia. Desde la antigüedad, los mayores de la familia han cumplido con las responsabilidades y deberes de todos sus miembros. Sin embargo, hoy en día, incluso los más jóvenes intentan comprender sus responsabilidades desde temprana edad. Actualmente, se observa que, a pesar de su corta edad, tanto chicos como chicas se esfuerzan por cumplir los deseos y aspiraciones de sus familiares trabajando en diversos empleos y buscando la independencia económica. Muchas personas intentan ser económicamente independientes mientras estudian y cumplen con sus responsabilidades familiares. Sin embargo, a menudo se observa que, a pesar de la corta edad del niño, tras el fallecimiento del padre, la carga familiar, es decir, la responsabilidad, recae sobre sus hombros desde muy temprana edad. En muchas familias, las responsabilidades y los deberes familiares y de los distintos miembros de la familia se cumplen desde temprana edad. Sin embargo, también se observa que en muchas familias, aunque el hijo haya crecido mucho y los padres sean muy mayores, el hijo no comprende sus responsabilidades y no cumple con la responsabilidad de cuidar a sus padres ancianos y atender sus necesidades. De hecho, cada uno de nosotros debería cumplir con sus propios deberes. Si comprendemos bien nuestras responsabilidades y cumplimos con nuestros deberes adecuadamente, solo así podremos convertirnos en personas íntegras y el esfuerzo de nuestros padres al criarnos habrá dado sus frutos, lo que nos permitirá sentirnos orgullosos de nosotros mismos. Cuando cumplimos con nuestras responsabilidades de corazón y procuramos la felicidad de todos, nosotros mismos también nos sentiremos mucho más felices y podremos dormir tranquilos por la noche. De hecho, solo cuando tenemos paz interior podemos vivir en paz. Si no cumplimos con nuestras responsabilidades adecuadamente, las futuras generaciones no podrán aprender a cumplir con las suyas observándonos. Los niños aprenden observando a sus mayores, y no aprenderán bien si solo se les habla de palabra. Si bien debemos explicar con palabras, también debemos explicar con acciones; solo así recibirán una educación completa. Si solo les decimos a las futuras generaciones que debemos cumplir con nuestras responsabilidades, pero nosotros mismos no las cumplimos adecuadamente, ellas no podrán aprender a cumplir con las suyas. Por lo tanto, debemos cumplir con nuestras responsabilidades adecuadamente y procurar que nuestros familiares sean felices. Cuando cumplimos con nuestras responsabilidades o cuando la carga de responsabilidades y deberes recae sobre nuestros hombros, diferentes personas expresarán diferentes opiniones. Incluso podemos escuchar muchas cosas negativas, pero no debemos prestarles atención. Debemos intentar satisfacer las necesidades de todos en la medida de lo posible y seguir cumpliendo con nuestras responsabilidades. Así como tenemos un deber para con un recién nacido y lo cuidamos con amor y alegría, cumpliendo con nuestras responsabilidades, de igual manera debemos cumplir con nuestras responsabilidades hacia nuestros padres ancianos con cariño y alegría. *** > Translated by Google Translate. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPXgCmi4rcHAXR3REo7tCVTifJevHsbbE757ur6BRfc4G/img_1434.jpg)


吃完飯, 大家頭不暈了, 然後雲兄在網上看見一條海邊的棧道, 說是女生很喜歡去打卡的地方, 不過要晚上才好看, 問我有沒有興趣去, why not? 我們又不是女生, 用不著等最好看的時候才去看啊. 晚上肯定要去二馬路夜市啦. 走, 現在出發.

那個海邊的棧道叫善美廣場, 我都不知道為甚麼要叫廣場, 先不管他了, 開車出發再說. 廣場距離餐廳約30分鐘車程, 不算太遠啦,十來公里, 慢慢開過去就是, 去到停車場發現一台車都沒有, 任我停. 然後雲兄突然叫我試一下自動泊車給他看.哎啊我去, 不早說, 剛停好車嘛. 沒事, 再開出去, 表演一次給他看.

雲兄看完覺得挺有趣, 不過略嫌自動停車有點慢, 嗯, 我也是這麼想的, 所以現在這個輔助功能對我來說成為了擺設了, 基本上不管甚麼路況, 我現在都是自己手動的. 簡單的路況用不著, 複雜的不敢用, 情可自己來來回回倒多幾把. 自己刮到認命, 用自動泊車刮到, 會怨. 所以, 我還有甚麼理由去用自動泊車這玩意呢?

停完之後, 又發現, 不對, 這邊平電充電價也不貴, 加上充電的話可以免停車費喔. 那就順便充個電, 然後我又開出來, 泊在對面. 因為這邊只有三十分鐘免費, 我跟雲兄趕集式的在棧道看一下風景, 大家拍拍照, 然後傻傻的看看海.

你別說, 兩個男人去這些地方雖然無聊, 但無聊期間的閒談才有趣, 說一下如果住這邊會咋咋咋的, 買房多少錢, 租房多少錢? 由這邊坐高鐵回香港時間多少? 車票多少錢? 講這些有的沒的都差不多花了二十分鐘. 臨走之前, 當然是大家幫大家拍一下交差, 證明我們沒約美女出去玩啦嘿嘿.

看看時間, 都下午3點30了, 差不多成了, 先回酒店休息. 但回程路上不知為甚麼又被導航指了一條鄉道來走, 又看到好多牛牛, 這時候拿手機出來拍, 晚了, 錯過了最佳的角度了哈. 回到酒店, 大家小睡一下, 晚上7點左右出發去二馬路夜市吃吃吃.

2026.5.6

今天五一假期最后一天，我们五一假期那也不去，不去跟你们争人多的地方。我们见是假期最后一天，我们想超市特价大米还有，我得去抗一袋回来！一来能省点钱，二来我可以锻炼锻炼身体。其他大米我都不怎喜欢吃就喜欢吃增城丝苗米！哈哈～五一假期我看好多人一车一车来买！

我只是假期第一天和最后一天家没有什么人过来抬一袋回去。哈哈～买到就是赚到啊！今天我吃完早餐再去抬米的，不吃饱我都没有力气抗，我早上吃了鲜虾云吞！我还是一如剧往喜欢吃云吞，吃饱饱等下去大润发抬大米！别人都是游山玩水的，我却去抢大米。哈哈～看别人去好多美丽的地方看人潮涌涌，看到我都害怕，我本来说准备去爬山的，但是这天气真的不做美，天天下雨，我都不散出门，短视频看到让我们最近少淋雨，能不能出门就不出门。唉～这天气真的烦人啊！

下雨天，做事都麻烦，今天我网上下单买菜，快递还送错地方了。感觉下雨天脑袋都不灵活！快递还送错地方了，后来他又返回拿过来给我，他送到隔壁小区了！以前都没有试过送错地方，我网上都经常下单，没有试过写完了的！可能这次是个新手吧！下雨天辛苦他们送货上门。赚点钱实在是不容易啊！刮风下雨～我理解他们都很辛苦的！就这样又过完平静了很多～五一假期就平平淡淡低路过！啥也没有去～

body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gd68348c9c79acad66b9911662c0f130626eafd9d9eecb6db45e35bdf4f4e424006069e9290a929ea83c1d34df5ea37a5d5e5940e4085e2191a00bd01fdd18b4c_640.jpg)
Hoy, mi caminata por la ciudad fue realmente revitalizante. Comencé mi recorrido en el parque central, donde el aire fresco y el canto de los pájaros me llenaron de energía. Mientras caminaba, me encontré con un artista callejero que pintaba un mural vibrante; su técnica era impresionante y atrajo a un pequeño grupo de admiradores. Me quedé unos minutos observando, y tuvimos una breve charla sobre su inspiración y el proceso creativo detrás de su obra. Más adelante, me crucé con un grupo de corredores que se detenían para hidratarse. Hablé con una chica que había empezado a correr recientemente y me contó cómo había mejorado su salud y bienestar en solo unos meses. Su entusiasmo era contagioso, y me motivó a seguir con mi propio entrenamiento. Finalmente, pasé por una pequeña cafetería donde el aroma del café recién hecho me atrapó. Entré y conocí a un barista que compartía su pasión por los cafés de origen único. Me recomendó probar un espresso de Etiopía, y definitivamente no me decepcionó. Fue un día lleno de nuevas experiencias y conexiones, recordándome lo enriquecedor que es caminar por la ciudad y descubrir todo lo que tiene para ofrecer. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). body.title: Una tarde de té con nuevas amigas / An afternoon tea with new friends
body.body:
Hace más de un mes, recibí una invitación para una tarde de té con mujeres, justo en el momento cuando iba a buscar a mi hijo a la escuela, y aunque en un principio dudé en ir, algo me decía que no estaba de más pasar ese rato con nuevas personas, pues en medio de la vorágine de cambios que yo misma estoy propiciando, capaz y encontraba en ese lugar, alguna de las respuestas a las miles de preguntas que vengo haciéndome.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmPPRNsCS3atn9nKWrASvvcrSyeekZ2WRxxLPSESWCMSkC/una_tarde_de_t_y_regalitos.png</center>

Ese día, llegué de trabajar, hice el almuerzo rápidamente, y terminando de comer, salí al encuentro, al que llegué un poco tarde, justo cuando estaban en medio de una dinámica de karaoke, aunque en este caso, con música religiosa.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMUQKujzuGU5EpjEirgVh6QciQJCzWETGohNyL8dpdMH/20260429_161210.jpg</center>

Si bien ya sabía que se trataba de un grupo cristiano, profesando yo la religión católica, no me molestó experimentar estar en ese ambiente, pues la verdad es que buscaba más la compañía de mujeres, que la evangelización o la conversión de mis creencias, aunque desde siempre he pensado que Dios es uno solo, y que depende de cada quien en cómo mantiene su relación con él.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmU5ef6WVU1vSNfvv7zz9ZeZiY1NhWhV9D8dgK6uz7Cc2z/una_tarde_de_t_y_regalitos_1_.png</center>

Fue bonito que al llegar, me recibieron con alegría, como si me conocieran desde hace mucho, brindándome una taza de té, pastafrola, y algunas facturas dulces, que compartimos mientras conversábamos un poco sobre quien era yo y la finalidad del grupo, que está compuesto por 5 mujeres contemporáneas conmigo, por lo que fue una tarde bastante animada, que me sirvió para cambiar la rutina de mis tardes.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmcXyTzAWSJDKgJEyZAkhqhZFtLwNUuYKTkmx5UrZXS8MF/una_tarde_de_t_y_regalitos_2_.png</center>

Luego de charlar un buen rato, las anfitrionas nos dieron un pequeño obsequio, y luego recogimos la mesa entre todas, para dar por terminada la reunión, quedando pendiente la siguiente para los domingos, pero a una hora en la que no puedo asistir porque estoy trabajando, así que en mi caso, será solo los días miércoles.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmfM1PS8Y4fodEv95xRBSa8nEM5KK8HWLven2onuQY4kBj/20260429_161555.jpg</center>

Escuchar un poco sobre la biblia, charlar con mujeres que tienen intereses similares a los míos y pasar un momento diferente, fue realmente un regalo en medio de todo el estrés diario, que realmente agradezco por haberlo encontrado tan cerca de casa.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmbz81LR7DvRTQLccggvLEhAgbFVJjE6LML87KKHK6mwpJ/20260429_162652.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMNxZLX3nyQd4z3z36B8GmMQ8e8PN44qLnocC8hsWu8u/separador_ingles.png</center>

Over a month ago, I received an invitation to a ladies’ tea party, just as I was about to pick up my son from school, and although I was initially unsure about going, something told me it wouldn’t hurt to spend some time with new people; after all, amidst the whirlwind of changes I’m bringing about myself, perhaps I might find there some of the answers to the thousands of questions I’ve been asking myself.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmSk2xg1vUv5AqR89XHjNnwWbtMdnGu6Uz5giGRJquebav/una_tarde_de_t_y_regalitos_3_.png</center>

That day, I came home from work, quickly made lunch, and after finishing my meal, I set off for the gathering, arriving a little late, just as they were in the middle of a karaoke session, although in this case, with religious music.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMUQKujzuGU5EpjEirgVh6QciQJCzWETGohNyL8dpdMH/20260429_161210.jpg</center>

Although I already knew it was a Christian group, and as a Catholic myself, I didn’t mind being in that environment, as the truth is I was seeking the company of women more than evangelism or a change in my beliefs, although I have always believed that there is only one God, and that it is up to each person how they maintain their relationship with Him.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmU5ef6WVU1vSNfvv7zz9ZeZiY1NhWhV9D8dgK6uz7Cc2z/una_tarde_de_t_y_regalitos_1_.png</center>

It was lovely that when I arrived, they welcomed me with such warmth, as if they’d known me for ages, offering me a cup of tea, pastafrola, and some sweet pastries, which we shared whilst chatting a bit about who I was and the purpose of the group, which consists of five women around my age, so it was quite a lively afternoon, which helped me break up my usual afternoon routine.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmcXyTzAWSJDKgJEyZAkhqhZFtLwNUuYKTkmx5UrZXS8MF/una_tarde_de_t_y_regalitos_2_.png</center>

After chatting for quite a while, the hosts gave us a small gift, and then we all helped clear the table to bring the meeting to a close. The next one is scheduled for Sundays, but at a time when I can’t attend because I’m working, so for me, it’ll just be on Wednesdays.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmfM1PS8Y4fodEv95xRBSa8nEM5KK8HWLven2onuQY4kBj/20260429_161555.jpg</center>

Hearing a little about the Bible, chatting with women who share similar interests to mine and enjoying a change of pace was truly a gift amidst all the daily stress, and I’m really grateful to have found it so close to home.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmbz81LR7DvRTQLccggvLEhAgbFVJjE6LML87KKHK6mwpJ/20260429_162652.jpg</center>

body.title: Life Interrupted - Cracked By Migraine | LMAC FreeStyle Collage No. 161
body.body:
>

Hello everyone. I wanted to share with you my current collage with a theme of endurance. My style of collage is a Freestyle. Often I do, but I wasn't required to utilize any contest photo in my design. However, if you'd like to join in visit the [LMAC Community page](https://peakd.com/c/hive-174695/created).

<center>![262866.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23swXV8TTdSfCAMefZgEG2MHmtqq9ibT4QeFL1viVbJRuMz1ESKLDzDm4NkSDENoFbtBM.png)</center>

For individuals like me who suffer from migraines, ours is a test of true endurance and resilience. You may not realize it, but 40 million people suffer from a migraine. Many refer to it as a migraine headache.

However, I discovered it's much more.

Migraine is more than a headache. As a complex neurological condition, migraine is a disorder that affects the brain and can cause intense pain on one or both sides of the head. Symptoms can include nausea, vomiting, sensitivity to light and/or sound, and poor concentration. A migraine attack can last 4 to 72 hours.

As a young adult, I worked full time with a stressful legal career, added to that a family, attempting to continue my education, and assisted with the care of elderly parents. I was too busy to realize my headaches were more just being \

.

For me, when I feel an attack is imminent, I can immediately assess what level it may rise to. I feel as though my head is being split in half and running amuck in different directions. I can't grab it quick enough to put it back together. Blinding light erupts from my pupils throbbing at a high rate of speed. I literally have to pause what I'm doing and immediately take my medication and lie down. Naproxin works well enough for me to calm my muscles.

Since all individuals are different, any one or a combination of events can summon a migraine attack. Some of the more common events include:

*Stress. Certain foods. Alcohol. Skipping meals. Sudden changes in weather/barometric pressure. Hormonal changes in women around the time of their menstrual cycles. Changes in sleep patterns. And, over-medicating.*

My daily intake of medications for several underlying conditions is taxing on my mind and body. I have noticed that as I aged to senior citizen, my attacks are less frequent and severity less intense.

In addition to the above, the degree to which one may experience a migraine is affected by one's age, gender, and genetics. Scientists aren't one hundred percent certain but theorize that due to hormonal changes women are thirty percent (30%) more prone to migraine attacks.

Presently, there is no cure for migraines. However, in today's medical advancements, numerous methods and treatments exist to reduce the frequency and severity. Since each person may respond differently to treatments, those treatments must be tailored to the individual's needs and lifestyles.

As I did, consult with your physician if unsure whether you are susceptible to possible migraine attacks.

<sup>[1 Source](https://www.pfizerforall.com/migraine/?cmp=5bcbd06e-ed05-4347-a15b-e3102570ce7d&ttype=PS&cmp=163790526662&utm_source=GOOGLE&utm_medium=paidsearch&pid=Treatment&utm_term=what%20does%20a%20migraine%20headache%20feel%20like&network=g&gclsrc=aw.ds&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=21639689644&gclid=Cj0KCQjwh-HPBhCIARIsAC0p3ccFhMvsNmFA5ik77AdaedEGDEvtLlv6JAebQXBdas-L-mdnLTk5uHsaAnyWEALw_wcB)</sup>

<center>![262866.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23swXV8TTdSfCAMefZgEG2MHmtqq9ibT4QeFL1viVbJRuMz1ESKLDzDm4NkSDENoFbtBM.png)</center>

In preparing my collage, I wanted to portray how I personally feel when a migraine attacks. I utilized a free-sourced image of a female with her head split with one side having fallen. I included an abstract wavy image to replicate how my immediate surroundings are clouded. Sight, smell and feeling are heightened. The experience reminds me of a person alone on an island. No one can empathize if they have never experienced one. It's difficult to explain the emotions rendered and physical pain.

Finally, I included one of my pure fractals that resemble a lightning strike. Members from the LMAC Community through their contributions to the #LIL database contributed the seagull standing near the shore and a giraffe on stilts.

<center>![rinreMr4T-dividerline-Resized.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23tv8hvCs9XJ6jvySDHoq8PqyG4YaAkLbtNT5rMVejff3KMvBDdAtpvqbHwZFE1k5MRdW.png)</center>

Below are my steps in which I began with a blank, white canvas, then added layers of elements, removing backgrounds, resizing, detaching elements from their backgrounds, duplicating, colorizing, and repositioning items as needed incorporating the tools at my disposal in my Annual Pro Membership Subscription.

body.title: Monday Momentum, Precision Moves, and System Control
body.body:
# ChronoCrypto Journal Entry  

Today is Monday and the system feels calibrated.

Not perfect. Not easy. But aligned.

This past stretch has been one of the clearest examples of what happens when execution meets awareness. I have been dialing in multiple variables at once. Health, income, mindset, and structure. Not just thinking about them but actually tracking them in real time and adjusting based on feedback.

That is the difference.

Most people react. I am starting to operate.

## Health Optimization in Real Time

Let’s start with the biggest lever right now. Retatrutide.

Today’s dose moved up to 4 mg. That was not random. That was based on actual feedback from the last few days. Hunger started creeping back in slightly, energy stayed stable, side effects minimal. That is data. Not emotion.

After the dose today, I felt it immediately. Appetite suppression locked back in. Energy clean. No crash. No weird sides beyond slight manageable anxiety which has already been part of the baseline.

That tells me the protocol is working.

MOTS c is still running on schedule. Monday Wednesday Friday structure. There was a miss last week and an accidental Tuesday injection, but that is exactly why tracking matters. Systems catch errors. Memory alone does not.

Right now this stack is doing what it is supposed to do

Lower appetite  
Increase metabolic efficiency  
Keep energy stable  
Allow controlled intake  

That matters because food intake has not been perfect. There were days with higher calories. Milkshakes. Tacos. Extra meals. But here is the key

I am aware of it in real time

That awareness changes the outcome

Weight is hovering around 191 to 192. That is stable considering intake fluctuations. Protein target remains aggressive at 186 grams. That is intentional. Preserve muscle while cutting fat.

This is not guessing. This is controlled experimentation.

## Income Reality and Pressure

Now let’s talk about the real battlefield. Money.

Everything runs through cash flow.

There is no pretending here. Expenses are real. Transfers cost money. Even moving rent required breaking it into 1000 dollar chunks with fees attached. That is friction. That is inefficiency.

But it got done.

That is what matters.

Gig work remains the engine. Instacart specifically. It is not glamorous but it is liquid. It produces immediate cash. That is critical when timelines are tight.

There is always a decision tree when taking orders

Distance  
Items  
Store familiarity  
Tip probability  
Time of day  

Every order is a micro trade

Some hit. Some do not. But the goal is consistency over time, not perfection per order.

There was a cancelation. There were low paying batches. There were smart quick decisions like taking a small order because I was already in position and knew the item was out of stock. That saved time while still generating a payout.

That is edge.

Edge is not always in big wins. It is in reducing wasted movement.

## Time Compression and Execution

Time has been compressed lately.

Wake up early  
Work blocks  
Charge vehicle  
Eat strategically  
Handle life logistics  
Repeat  

There is no excess.

Even charging the Tesla becomes part of the system. Not just plugging in, but timing it. Before trips. Before early morning runs. Keeping battery at functional levels without overcharging. Managing cost windows.

Everything ties together

Energy  
Time  
Money  

You cannot separate them.

Even something simple like grabbing In N Out before a 4 AM departure is a calculated move. Fuel the body, prepare for the next window, minimize friction later.

That is system thinking.

## Mental State and Control

Here is the truth

The mind has been more stable recently

Not perfect. But controlled.

There is less chaos when there is structure. Even when things go wrong, there is a baseline to return to.

That matters more than motivation

Motivation is inconsistent

Systems are not

There are still stress points. Financial pressure. Relationship tension. Responsibilities stacking up. But instead of spiraling, there is more observation now.

Almost like stepping outside and watching the situation instead of being trapped inside it

That shift is everything

Because once you can observe, you can adjust

## Relationship and Responsibility

There is a lot happening in the background that does not show up on paper

Family  
Partner  
Son  
Responsibilities  

These are not side quests. These are core.

There are moments of tension. Misalignment. Miscommunication. But there is also effort being made to stabilize things. Small actions matter

Helping with food  
Handling tasks  
Being present  

Not perfect. But intentional.

That is the difference right now

Intentional effort versus reactive behavior

## Strategic Awareness

There is a bigger layer to all of this

Everything is being tracked

Income  
Expenses  
Health  
Habits  
Decisions  

This is where most people fail

They operate without feedback loops

Right now, the system is slowly building those loops

When I spend, I know where it went  
When I eat, I know what it was  
When I work, I know the return  

That creates leverage

Because once you can measure something, you can improve it

## Short Term vs Long Term

There are two timelines running at the same time

Short term survival  
Long term positioning  

Short term is rent, food, gas, daily cash flow

Long term is health optimization, body composition, financial systems, automation, scaling income beyond gig work

Both matter

Ignoring short term destroys stability  
Ignoring long term traps you in cycles  

Right now, the balance is not perfect but it is being actively managed

That is progress

## Final Reflection

Today felt like a reset point

Not because everything is solved

But because direction is clear

Health is being dialed in  
Income is being managed  
Systems are being built  
Awareness is increasing  

That is momentum

Not hype. Not fake motivation. Actual measurable forward movement

The goal now is simple

Repeat what works  
Adjust what does not  
Track everything  
Stay disciplined  

No guessing

Just execution

This is what it looks like when you stop drifting and start operating

ChronoCrypto mode active

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@chronocrypto/monday-momentum-precision-moves-and-system-control-9vq)

body.title: Street-Side Comfort Food in Ban Luang, Chiang Mai
body.body:
One thing I quickly noticed about Ban Luang in Chiang Mai is that food is everywhere, especially once the sun starts to go down. During the day, the area feels quite calm, but as soon as dusk arrives, the side of the road slowly becomes alive with food stalls, bright lights, smoke from the woks, and of course, the delicious smell of food being cooked fresh.


![1000141751.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eoc9vkm8xa3cTbaogpfuDq7NoPNhLA4NWiT2WGLnZmuzRjzNKjiCH58xYh3m1koAzmE.jpg)


No wonder some restaurants close early here. The real dinner scene seems to happen outdoors, right by the roadside. Just a few kilometers away, you can already find another food bazaar, which I think is amazing. It gives the area a very local and lively feeling, like food is naturally part of the evening routine.


![1000140759.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoAYrrnkBEynxEid9TLxsjx9v3TZkqQU14xEdsfdp3YtxCanpKZFpbzExycAJUz3LPA.jpg)

![1000140766.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eoc6aaJLuyGe7Gq6big8hCV1Qp8jiZ6JLUfEEjLSaPX7ZxNG4eekB1XW5jCTinDpUPe.jpg)

![1000140764.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoEobQtbYDnaMrRiVSnfYuMy6ke5F1j5QH5Srv5FG2uPZLz95xvCbjnEtXmzP1qB1H2.jpg)

![1000140760.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoAaAY7E7YL9XEjZyZsmZvt4sAzAhf79nMqysUE7bZpEiprUaa1NynsiNnAecwpuyZu.jpg)


I decided to check out the food bazaar near where I was staying, close to Wat Phra That Chom Tong. It was not as big as the night markets I have seen in other places, but I still thought it was worth exploring. Sometimes, smaller food spots feel more personal and less overwhelming, which I actually enjoy.

There were stalls selling ready-made meals, snacks, drinks, and desserts, but I was looking for something cooked on the spot. I wanted that freshly made, hot-from-the-wok kind of meal. So when I saw one stall actively stir-frying with a wok, it immediately caught my attention.


![1000141743.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoCgaidCMKBSjckGMvTUKpGt3C21j8BEezGQCAgDcb8HQDCYhyG9nPzFERqQ8eMCNTr.jpg)

![1000141747.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23tSSXYFjGpfkq6WZusDNaKgnuRGLE6qbDu4xrnu3QdLN3N4awCKbjtWExMPXr2yGxoBq.jpg)

![1000141744.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23wCBw7Hemn9c47JWgPhUf2iW9Ny74bdnXJK7F3Y83oGF6RAr8CjUTPzGbQSnrwGNaCXA.jpg)


The name of the stall, based on the literal translation from the signage, is **Bua Khao Pad Krapow Restaurant**. I hope I got that right haha. Their menu had plenty of choices, but since I was not sure what to order, I went for something familiar: **Pork Basil Rice**.

I have eaten pork basil rice many times back in Singapore, so I had a little basis when it comes to flavor and taste. It made me curious whether a street-side version in Chiang Mai would be as good as the ones from restaurants. Who knows, maybe I would be surprised.

There was already a queue when I arrived, which is usually a good sign. A lot of locals were ordering food to bring home, so I also ordered mine for takeaway and planned to eat it back at the hotel.


![1000141746.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EonkURvGPEaWDmmZn7KvBoUbM1kVEaRaKvRXdCWsLMB9j7bphB96W6xZZieKMjJFDmF.jpg)

![1000141745.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpCASYSzzAzw4qA1brazYcTQhyXuw33mZK9pcgVecUz3sfNsWgB3DEuEcAtqoVd7Rxs.jpg)



While waiting, I enjoyed observing how the stall worked. It seemed to be family-run, which was wonderful to see. The mother was the main chef, confidently handling the wok. The father and elder son helped with packaging and serving, while the youngest son managed orders, tickets, and even cooked the eggs. I have to say, they were very organized. Everyone had their own role, and the whole process looked smooth even with many orders coming in.


![1000141752.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EonnuidNBbR5bVJS1k6yCsz6XRz3vcaRmTqEcFwMR8PrV2ju9Vf5JeKbyLKQiR7jCNu.jpg)

![1000141750.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eopvm37kSmvUQAQ6fYkfCMoLXDEFJdJsNPGTunaWXUzr24VePvxH2saogaj8mh8GWDV.jpg)


Once my food was ready, I brought it back to the hotel, already excited to try it.

First impression: the presentation was neat! For only **50 Thai Baht**, I was honestly impressed. The meal came with rice, pork basil, cucumber slices, extra sauce with chili, and a sunny-side-up egg that looked freshly cooked and perfectly done. The yolk was bright and glossy, and the pork basil looked so appetizing with fresh basil and bits of red chili.



![1000141754.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EowJ725bFZ6JPdDfp8MX4FCDmdZepXFUB8ohzYeqj79No6LMfxQgRD3PJPiwFsgqZdE.jpg)

![1000141753.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Ep1YojgeKPaYjtJXJwKSTVWNzNcHYCRpZnRySNYUXFHe533iaYjSfXBbnRzwTBjKVYE.jpg)
![1000141755.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EowJ1LvEhHHGa6k7oViEXgwJMxbCvcMPASgdbqfD9k9wuc89jvKM4bVyEMjdAVzzM2Z.jpg)


Mind you, I ordered the less spicy version, but I was still a bit worried it might be too spicy for me. So before going back, I also bought watermelon just in case I needed something refreshing. Good decision, LOL.


![1000141756.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Ep3gg85nHeJPWfrddkf49kLbad6TvUKQqbZiMt8m4PFkpXFm49sRWeTCvPDwQ27sjD3.jpg)


And yes, the spice level was still a bit much for me, but in a good way. It had that strong, savory, spicy kick that makes you keep eating even while reaching for water. The basil was fragrant, the pork was flavorful, and the rice helped balance everything. The cucumber also gave a nice fresh crunch in between bites.

The watermelon was another small happiness. It only cost **17 Thai Baht**, but it tasted so sweet and refreshing. It was the perfect side snack after the spicy meal.

***Overall, my dinner cost **67 Thai Baht**, which is roughly around **2 USD**. Amazing, right? For that price, I got a freshly cooked, filling, flavorful meal plus fruit on the side.***


![1000141749.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoJy9sm1V1DcGPnanFNm6spaB6HNAQAEArBxzpRCArPjGzzfQLNcjpu8MBpPTNGNbGs.jpg)


***This was my first street-side comfort food experience in Ban Luang, and it definitely made me excited to try more food here in Chiang Mai.***

## Bon appétit.





***


https://images.ecency.com/p/x7L2VSNEiyAB5Ux7nxKqZetUQAKDhXE3SwQAvkNJXbDxJbhhbSoDYkFW3TPedgzbYRsZXheJpwhchfs.png?format=match&mode=fit

![IMG_20260503_174910_440~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZdMVuQ3MAZJD2FMUWwmsVvmiGsym1hWfKeBoRwdtaUYM/IMG_20260503_174910_440~2.jpg)

.

Después, lo entinté con un bolígrafo negro Offi-Esco y con un marcador negro Kores.
.

![IMG_20260429_203305_817.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNcsQcSjnatnJEW8Mr2Rk1aaNntsoJdmfxA7hhMZaALYi/IMG_20260429_203305_817.jpg)
Por último, le agregué color con algunos lápices Faber-Castell.
.
Finally, I added some color using Faber-Castell colored pencils.
![IMG_20260503_174910_440~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZdMVuQ3MAZJD2FMUWwmsVvmiGsym1hWfKeBoRwdtaUYM/IMG_20260503_174910_440~2.jpg)

.
That's all for today. Thank you very much for reading.

body.title: Two wonderful fruits make a delicious juice [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
I mixed a couple of my favorite fruits, and it turned out to be a really tasty juice. 

>Mezclé un par de frutas que me encantan y resultó un jugo muy sabroso. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTK1m9SAnN3M1yrDm7XBtCfnhbRDfDGmM8usbWn6BMa3r/1777982204004.jpg)

Naturally sweet and delicately flavored: Papaya and soursop come together in a delicious tropical drink, perfect for cooling off and staying hydrated on these sweltering days.

>Naturalmente dulces y de sabores delicados: La papaya y la guanábana se fusionaron en una deliciosa bebida tropical, ideal para refrescarnos e hidratarnos estos días de calor intenso.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeoqEMys2KRkikyYHfaHhdZ5znmSg6rZsXU8q77vz5NgE/1777982204509.jpg)

**Let's get started on the preparation** 😉

>**Vamos a su preparación** 😉

----------------------------------
-------------------------------------------------------

# Ingredients for 2 small glasses:

- 3 tablespoons of soursop pulp.
- 3/4 cup of chopped papaya.
- 1 1/4 cups of water.
- 1 tablespoon of sugar.

># Ingredientes para 2 vasos pequeños:
>
>- 3 cucharadas de pulpa de guanábana.
>- 3/4 tazas de papaya picada.
>- 1 y 1/4 tazas de agua.
>- 1 cucharada de azúcar.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVq8aH6qL46n2LVCWGBGNXcomrTsJntfzvtnXimmS8o1b/1777982171990.jpg)

# Preparation // Preparación: 

First, I blended the soursop thoroughly with the water and strained it to achieve a completely liquid consistency.

>Primero, licué muy bien la guanábana con el agua y colé para una textura totalmente líquida.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUcdASuF4A7upDU4cqvLQ674JoRpHwFZejXKkdBYhfyjn/1777982172174.jpg) | ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd8yozNjcfP8dCFDQSKb5avrjBHaUndiMQanGaCKwhtnk/1777982172300.jpg)
-|-

Then I blended the papaya with the soursop juice I made in the first step. I added sugar and served it.

>Luego licué la papaya junto al jugo de guanábana que obtuve en el primer paso. Agregué azúcar y a servir.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUcViEhUy34zFgu6rSt6bb6sdR1vQXrzhGThU6FxDeVAv/1777982172426.jpg) | ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXPSxnGcSwmAPKB38Mav7SMkCWFS5kmTSuVTrqA6SnPGt/1777982172735.jpg)
-|-

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVhNEDKVcsMWG8BgGSBweRca9AA8Vk8cEPVw58hobn7H8/1777982203716.jpg) | ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYxzxvwWvaMCXdRhoFTda7YTf7UA7CvBt7qGq3dtdJUAH/1777982203875.jpg)
-|-

I love it when I open the fridge and suddenly some ingredients seem to speak to me. This time, papaya and soursop wanted to go together, and I really liked the result.

>Me encanta cuando abro la nevera y de pronto algunos ingredientes parecen hablarme. Esta vez la papaya y la guanábana quisieron ir juntas y el resultado sí que me gustó.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYTEms1aqpPFyc2Tc92rudrtQRf5pTD6LLpyJa6ZVmzWx/1777982204190.jpg)

----------------------------------
-------------------------------------------------------

# <center>Thank you for accompanying me 😉</center>

body.title: Haciendo unos lazitos super fáciles [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
>  ![351698.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23x1L7zsdSjfQHtCgHYn7mTanzEGBHpNKUnUgDN9f18s4nvf1uhkkevDpC3cHCBMtyN4d.png) Hola, ¿qué tal, amigos? ¿Cómo están todos? Espero que se encuentren muy bien; por aquí todo muy bien, gracias a Dios, aunque no sé por qué extrañamente el día de ayer me estaba doliendo mi ojito y hoy extrañamente se me hinchó horriblemente, que en la mañana casi no podía ver, pero bueno, son detalles. El día de hoy me puse creativa para hacer unos lazitos; tenía rato que no le hacía unos lazitos nuevos a Jade y dije: “Voy a inventar un ratico para olvidarme lo que me molestaba en el ojo; para esto necesité cinta, aguja e hilo, pega, ganchitos y un yesquero para quemar sus puntitas.
Hi there, how are you all? I hope you’re all doing well; everything’s fine here, thank goodness, although I don’t know why, strangely enough, my eye was hurting yesterday and today, strangely enough, it’s swollen up terribly—I could hardly see this morning—but anyway, these are just minor things. Today I got creative and made some little bows; it had been a while since I’d made any new ones for Jade, so I said to myself, ‘I’m going to take a little while to take my mind off the discomfort in my eye.’ For this I needed ribbon, a needle and thread, glue, little clips and a lighter to singe the ends.
![20260505_175226.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23xeg3wbTJNL7XReqQmpAQoHPkKyKmZ5Yfhw5fsaMGnzRcBmw7Xv3Kbbu3yksM37BkpXz.jpg) Inicié cortando cuatro pedazos de cinta grandesitos, los cuales calculé haciendo el círculo que quedaran acordes con el tamaño de la pinza; así mismo, corté dos para que sobresalieran un poquito tipo ramita y es muy importante que quememos las puntas en cada corte que hagamos en cinta.
I started by cutting four fairly large pieces of ribbon, which I measured out by drawing a circle to ensure they were the right size for the hair clip; I also cut two pieces so that they stuck out a little like twigs, and it’s very important to singe the ends of every piece of ribbon you cut.
![20260505_175241.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/242NmFWmHr9iCVm261xK9CZiJkeUEgtjgbBb6UG6kXPMnbZ7m6rigLfrc474bGT5NrqXv.jpg) Con las cuatro cintas del mismo tamaño vamos a hacer pequeños círculos y vamos a pegar, y todo lo que esto secaba, porque en mi casa usé silicona fría, tardó en pegar, así que mientras secaba, usé los pedazos largos para hacerles unos pequeños piquetes en las puntas y quemar.
Using the four strips of the same size, we’re going to make small circles and stick them down. Once everything had dried – because I used cold silicone at home, it took a while to set – I used the long pieces to make little notches at the ends and singe them.
![20260505_175503.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23wMepKTFvZ8PJvuh2dNddiAW4dUjEZ3j58rKf2DQRvyGeZ9jAgQYh22W7ABhFvUF3bB8.jpg) ![20260505_175729.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23vi1oHLH9CcAcmFj143H3R9sCGVcZ9c5Nh5mD4cJ7J42t7HxJyyAMoazpSuR75Dor8LG.jpg) El siguiente es el paso un poco más complicado; lo que vamos a hacer aquí es unir los círculos de frente y con una aguja vamos a coser por el medio. En esta parte debemos asegurarnos de apretar muy bien para que pueda quedar la forma deseada.
The next step is a bit trickier; what we’re going to do here is join the circles together at the front and sew down the middle with a needle. At this stage, we need to make sure we pull the stitches tight so that it takes on the desired shape.
![20260505_181140.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23u6DhwELUzivhkB43SLma3xjXFjTpoa79YZMBWvmjJ32nMdM2Y19JCg3eXGRu84CHx8Q.jpg) ![20260505_180422.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23vsZ45ot2HRivZTZZfj23TPC4nUcAafw91zbiZZLTDCPpm7i9nVLgDTDJh5TV2k6WDSG.jpg) Luego de que ya tenemos este paso vamos a forrar nuestra pinza y procedemos a medir en cruz las espiguitas junto con los lazitos y vamos a calcular como quedara en la pinza.
Now that we’ve completed this step, we’re going to cover our hair clip and measure the small tassels and bows diagonally to work out how they’ll look on the clip.
![20260505_182635.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23tc1rp7A1jmx6mWViXwLDoyijjHkbYTma7VjF68nAf8hpqZPD3NFKm8B6nhZNS2jMvH2.jpg) ![20260505_182520.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23vsWY5Kw33JMrJ4PW6qrDdfDHWVRXCSKRjVBV2gcQf3d4CCw3LZ97kDEZC5pQsvGfpjS.jpg) ![20260505_181702.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23wMh2ZXo4jwz2AdMh5e1yczxNhuEKP69Y15gPe7sdZDxUM8TymDxomkSdBD49omNRkh9.jpg) Por último para fijar vamos a unir con una cinta por el medio del lazito con nuestra pinza para fijarlos y que queden listos, aqui me van a disculpar porque admito que me distraje viendo la novela y me quedo uno un poco mas cerradito que el otro pero para mi quedaron bellos ¡saludos!
Finally, to secure them, we’ll tie a piece of ribbon through the middle of the bow using our hair clip to hold them in place and get them ready. Please bear with me here, as I must admit I got distracted watching the soap opera and one ended up a bit tighter than the other, but I think they look lovely! Best wishes!
![20260505_183650.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23tvo2Rvj69WkxdCFgd9TrFUev9dXtcxKCRkrzyUkywbx1Qti5P3uc3RbJyaPgDwa6JXV.jpg) ![20260505_190207.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23uQtaFXnJV9VKuwmZDkrUoHcdrQAw9RKC48VAtDCtG35vQgLFwZ9becJMMxaRZBUzVsS.jpg)
https://images.hive.blog/DQmPp3w4d7XKqyHe7ehy2vRmWfJDa3A7FvafWG3WpoLJcc5/11.png
 
📷*Photography by|Fotografía por:@emilypino,🔅 Cover created in/Portada creada en [Canva](https://www.canva.com), [Separator and banner/separador y banner](https://hive.blog/hive-148441/@ikasumanera/eng-es-i-made-hive-free-use-art-of-for-all-of-you-part-1-dividers-and-banners-or-hice-arte-de-libre-uso-para-todos-parte-1), 🇺🇸Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)*

body.title: 「Vicky's Life」短剧｜《绯色过浓》（王道铁x赵佳）
body.body:
![IMG_4180](https://s1.img-e.com/20260309/69ae80efcbabe.jpeg)

我前阵子在刷红果主页的时候，无意间发现这部赵佳前阵子的剧。基于对她挑选本子无条件的相信，就丢进待看清单。今天起床翻开这部，没想到居然一口气就看完啦。

从剧情的角度来说，这是部渣男眼瞎被女主放生后悔追妻失败的剧。女主的外公投资失败不得不跟渣男结婚，当时他俩有些渊源女主也是真喜欢渣男，却被对方伤透了心。

我也是第一次见到舞到正宫面前的小三，事实证明全是男人不做人。这渣男为了得到爷爷家产继承权，以帮女主还债为要挟要求她跟别人上床怀孕，女主遇到了男主。

女主以为是保养男模，到剧最后才知道原来人家是财阀。男女主间的互动超级带感，这才是我们成年人该看的剧！到后来绿茶做的坏事败露，看渣男追悔莫及简直太爽了。

从演员的角度来说，男女主的颜值和演技都在线。男主是那种男性荷尔蒙拉满的类型，四肢修长身高身材拉满。女主的长相就非常高级，我很期待哪天能看她拍电影啦。

从剧集拍摄和服化道角度来说，我超喜欢这部剧的色调。如果不说是短剧的话，我觉得当成电视剧来看也没有问题。里面角色的妆造都很漂亮，就是那条绿色礼服一般。

总的来说，这部剧非常棒，推荐推荐！


（本篇完）


————————


喜欢影视剧、美食和旅行的天秤座80后妹纸，喜欢一切新奇温暖的事物
