body.title: Splinterlands:One Soothsayer Heals Them All!
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme6RFDCX5fpJq5NFmMhKZwpBPRMfb5UFmfvznZjo95KzT/1777977001703.jpg)




Good morning warriors! It is mid-week already and five days into the new season.Welcome to my blog @zusi78 .



Majority of my wins in both Modern and Frontier ranked battles come from my Water deck. It's been carrying me hard, but I've always felt like something was missing for my damage dealers and frontline tanks — that dedicated, reliable healer support I already enjoy in my Death, Life, and Earth splinters.Where I have **Satha Toledo, Arachne weaver,and meriput magician**.




That missing piece? **Anasth Soothsayer**.
I just rented him, slotted him into my lineup, and paired him with **Doomshield Warden** in position 1. The difference was night and day,it was a total mismatch in my favor. While my tank soaked up damage, **Anasth** kept pumping healing into him round after round, keeping the **Warden** alive and healthy far longer than usual. My water monsters could focus on dealing damage without constantly worrying about the frontline collapsing.



**Splinterlands is no walk in the park, but that's what amps up the excitement.A winning strategy weighs stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and beyond. That's why you must factor them all into your deck building. Toss in strong cards to boost your setups, and push hard to rack up as many victories as possible**! 🔥


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)


**FEATURED CARD**:![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeuKQZiULxoMmGnzqnTiQVgi4QPC5RekZeut7QtjgX58v/1777980701017.jpg)
**Anasth Soothsayer** is a Water Rare from the Rebellion edition. At just 6 mana, he's surprisingly easy to fit into most lineups,from medium to high mana battles (and sometimes even lower if you're creative).


**STATS PROGRESSION AND ABILITIES**. (Focus on max level).![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYVWf1xgjunyV2Jhs88utamGUS1XK1FMyTyGu5fYSVZd3/1777986284921.jpg)




**Core Stats** (at higher levels) 8, my focus point.
Low but consistent Magic attack (1),even at max.

Solid Speed (4)

Impressive Health that scales well (up to 9 at max level)

But the real value is in his stacked ability kit — one of the best support toolkits in the game:

At level 1(Bronze),it has just the **Cleanse** ability.![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRVmw1pAP3AY3q7HMtuMnHwaPWyRdqDcoLNe2Yhpvr7EN/1777984327913.jpg)**Cleanse**,removes all negative effects (debuffs, poisons, etc.) from your tank at the start of the round. Huge against affliction-heavy or control decks.


At level 2(Silver),it unlocks the **Tank heal** ability.![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRLKWgacUPVbDbisZZw79FAGLjZbPzKztXDi7uPp4uzDN/1777986117363.jpg)**Tank Heal**: Every round, he restores a significant portion (about 1/3 of max health, rounded up) to your Position 1 tank. This is exactly what aggressive water decks need — sustained frontline longevity.




At level 4 (gold),it unlocks another ability called the **Lookout**.![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaKD2B1JaUGN59GRJDNgKf2qkozFd6T4FcZJcDUKyj6sb/1777986323199.jpg)**Lookout**: Reduces damage from **Sneak, Snipe, and Opportunity** attackers on adjacent units.It also gives your whole team half damage reduction from **Ambush** as long as he's on the field. Great defensive utility.


At level 6 (Diamond),it unlocks **Dispel**.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2bNtG7M31MmwTEeR5A3BsMpXGMfon9bHYmZcjmfNX2j/1777986583132.jpg)**Dispel**: When hits an enemy with his magic attack, he clears positive buffs (including Bloodlust and Martyr boosts).Annoying for opponents!



At max level 8 (Champion),it unlocks its final ability called Evade/Dodge.![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV7D7EWccAVBXbGhqFpuTK2SVmn3Enp7bVphUFxDYULhs/1777986761753.jpg)Evade/Dodge (at max level): Helps him survive in the backline so he can keep healing.


He's not just a pure healer, he's a versatile support monster that heals, cleanses, disrupts enemy buffs, and adds team-wide defensive value. Many players call his kit \

for a reason. He shines especially in prolonged battles where keeping your tank alive lets your damage dealers grind out the win.

body.title: FENMOOR PLATYPUS Mundane Beast
body.body:
This card is Fenmoor Platypus, which is a very effective strategically important card in the Splinterlands game. As simple as this card may seem at first glance, it is actually quite powerful—especially when used in the right situation, it can turn the tide  match. Now I will explain in detail benefits  this card, its usage strategies real-world experience in my own words.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ6DxQL33Su6mPgvuKRjivLrsHHfzNotcrYrAeLcuUf2S/1778029366273.jpg)

🔰 Introduction and basic concept of the card

Fenmoor Platypus is an Earth splinter card, with a mana cost of only 3. Due its low mana cost, it plays a very effective role in low-mana matches. One of the big advantages this card is that it fits into team very easily, because you can put an additional unit on field at a low cost.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdX9AKRaTscx4eww7hiPLSMX6me987JissWmJyHW4yFSP/1778029366353.jpg)

Looking at its basic stats, it can be understood that it is a melee attacker, with fairly good speed and not bad health. Although it does not seem very strong at first level, it becomes quite deadly as the level increases.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR5BGinSoy2QsWwHnHucjMLCZ4JJSeBCePCc36uJ9Q1P8/1778029366448.jpg)

 ⚔️ Sneak Ability – The real power of this card

Fenmoor Platypus's biggest power is its Sneak ability. Due to this ability, it directly attacks the opponent's last line cards.

Now let's put it a little simpler—

Usually the cards we use hit the tanks in the front. But the cards with Sneak ability hit the weak cards in the back. As a result, the opponent's healer, support or low health cards are destroyed very quickly.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTyazUWVuzoyvhPQLipGfn9cyKULu72iMos6fnYGkuAfa/1778029366567.jpg)

👉 In my experience, many times I have removed the opponent's healer card just by using this card, which has made the whole match easier.

🧠 Strategic use

It's not enough to just use this card, the real thing is to use it correctly.

1. Best performance in Low Mana Battle

Big cards cannot be used in low mana matches. Then low mana cards like Fenmoor Platypus are very useful.

 👉 If you play a 12 or 15 mana match, using this card will allow you to increase your attack on one hand, and maintain your team balance on the other.

2. Use in Sneak Strategy Team

If you create a team based on Sneak, then this card will play an important role there.

Sand Worm (high damage sneak)

Uraeus (cheap sneak)

Fenmoor Platypus (support sneak)

If you use these three together, the opponent's back line will collapse very quickly.

3. As a Healer Counter

Many times, the opponent uses healers to keep their tanks alive. Then attacking from the front is not beneficial.

👉 In this situation, using Fenmoor Platypus can quickly remove the healer.

📈 What are the benefits of leveling up?

As the Fenmoor Platypus level increases, its power increases a lot.

 Increases Attack

Increases Speed

Increases Health

Adds new abilities

It becomes more effective especially at higher levels, because then it becomes not just a sneak attacker, but a balanced attacker.

🛡️ Defensive advantage

Although it is primarily an offensive card, it also has some defensive advantages.

Due to its low mana, it can be used to keep extra units on the team

Destroys the opponent's backline and breaks their strategy

Breaks the enemy formation by attacking quickly

🎯 In what situations does it work best?

Fenmoor Platypus is not equally effective in all matches. It is more powerful in certain situations.

✔️ Little League Rule (Low Mana)

This is one of the best cards in this type of match.

✔️ Weak Backline Enemy

If the opponent's back cards are weak, it can finish them off very quickly.

✔️ No Armor Battle

If there is no armor, its damage goes directly to health, so it can be killed quickly.

 ❌ Less effective in which situations?

❌ High Armor Enemy

If the opponent's card has more armor, then its damage has less effect.

❌ Taunt Ability

If the enemy team has taunt, then the sneak attack is redirected.

💡 My personal experience

When I first used this card I thought it was  very common card. But after playing few matches I realized it is actually very underrated.

Once I used a full Sneak strategy in a match. Fenmoor Platypus was the key player there. The opponent's healer died very quickly, and then the whole team collapsed.

👉 From that match, I understood—if you can use this card correctly, it can be a game changer.

🔄 Synergy with other cards

Fenmoor Platypus is good alone, but it becomes even stronger with some cards.

🌿 Earth Summoner

Using Earth splinter summoner improves its stats even more.

🐍 Poison Card

Sneak + Poison combo is very deadly. 

⚡ Speed Boost Card

Boosting speed allows it to attack earlier, which is very important.


📊 Why should you keep this card?

👉 For new players:

Easy to use

Low mana

Quick to learn

👉 For experienced players

Can create advanced strategies

Can build sneak combos

Can dominate low mana battles

All things considered, Fenmoor Platypus is a small but very effective card. It may not be a big damage dealer, but its strategic value is very high.

👉 When used in the right places:

Can destroy enemy backline

Can eliminate healers

Can change the flow of the match

From my own experience, I use this card quite often now—especially when building low mana matches or sneak strategies.

Fenmoor Platypus is a card that, while it may seem simple at first, its true power becomes clear over time. For those who play Splinterlands, it is a valuable asset.

body.body:
Hello friends of the hive, it's a pleasure to greet you on this new occasion. I hope you are well and had a happy day. Today I want to present this delicious Mexican food recipe: birria-style tacos. I hope you like it.




![283331.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/23xAiMHymvH1fP9dTFq9mQADsPrrStLhsbnkgQJErodbztyn48icfnGQNZsaQFdwGbZ9K.jpeg)






*beef *pre-cooked yellow flour *vegetables *lemon *ciracha





![IMG_8002.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/23w2uFGR5Sko415Q3Qp3mjxVYezxZEJqstvuUZEa4xe1BhocWKcdc3DyzFUetuK8BumVC.jpeg)



The first step is to cook the beef. I chop it into pieces, add water, parsley, and salt, and put it in the pressure cooker. Separately, I chop the vegetables, add oregano, garlic sauce, soy sauce, and oil, and cook them until they reach the desired tenderness. Then I blend them in a blender. Once the beef is cooked to my liking, I shred it and add it to the vegetables. I knead the dough and then shape the taco.




![photo-output.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/AKLuP1gXWHjRRSbYzeFB6XP6hK35JGTwL6xne9N44YeFFikpC9hqwp7kX4tZy2C.jpeg)




I start by cooking the taco base on a griddle, I chop the onion and parsley, when the meat is cooked to my liking and the taco base is ready I start filling it, adding the meats, vegetables and cilantro, in a pan I add a little of the meat broth and margarine, there I brown the tacos




![photo-output.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/AK6Z1tdVCSuXj7Jyjo8CSHgyPupBTsNnCr3rzUB1f73wTQJpz5rKona3tnuXbGs.jpeg)



The final result is as follows



![IMG_8021.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/23xVa8n9Knk5XCAXUUa4nErEUmWxQfsyPpyyZ6eGtJJrPhbqmS815vAou2HC9EMW1LACD.jpeg)

body.title: Living Without Fear of Judgment: The Freedom We Often Forget
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRvDGCkGU91TNdoWixH2H3kfnxN2mV13CRzq2pBAaGqNF/1000690931.png

In today’s hyper-connected world, there’s one silent force holding many people back: the fear of being judged. We often think, “What will people say?”, “What if they think I’m not good enough?”, or “Do I look acceptable in their eyes?”
But here’s a simple truth that’s often hard to accept:
Those who judge you are not necessarily better than you.
The Illusion of Other People’s Opinions
From a young age, we are raised in a system of evaluation. Grades in school, comments from family, and societal expectations slowly shape how we see ourselves. Without realizing it, we begin to measure our lives not by what we truly want, but by what others will accept.
The problem is, those standards constantly change. Today you’re right, tomorrow you’re wrong. Today you’re praised, tomorrow you’re criticized. If your life depends on that, you will never truly feel enough.
When Fear Becomes a Cage
The fear of judgment often makes us:
Afraid to try new things
Delay our dreams
Hide who we really are
Follow the crowd even when it doesn’t feel right
We become a “safe version” of ourselves—not a real one.
Ironically, the people we fear are often dealing with the same thing. They, too, are worried about being judged. So in the end, everyone is trapped in the same invisible loop.
A Truth Many Ignore
Not everyone who criticizes you has a better life. Not everyone who judges you understands your journey.
Most judgments come from:
Lack of understanding
Envy
Narrow perspectives
Their own personal experiences
So why should you let opinions like that control your life?
Authentic Living Requires Courage
Living without fear of judgment doesn’t mean being selfish or ignoring others completely. It means:
Knowing who you are
Respecting your own values
Making decisions aligned with your conscience
Authentic people are not free from criticism. In fact, they are often misunderstood. But they keep moving forward because they know who they are.
The Process of Accepting Yourself
Letting go of the fear of judgment is a process, not an instant switch. Here are a few steps you can start with:
1. Understand what truly matters to you
Not what people say—but what makes you feel alive.
2. Stop comparing yourself constantly
Social media often shows highlights, not reality.
3. Accept that not everyone will like you
And that’s perfectly okay. You are not here to please everyone.
4. Focus on growth, not validation
It’s better to grow slowly and genuinely than to look perfect but feel empty.
Real Freedom
The moment you stop living to meet other people’s expectations, something powerful happens—you feel lighter. There’s no more pressure to always “look right.” No more burden to always be “approved.”
You start living… truly living.
Closing
Life is too short to be controlled by the fear of judgment. People will always have something to say, no matter what you do. So the best choice is not to avoid judgment, but to stop letting it control your life.
Because in the end, you are the one living your life—not them.

It represents the four elements: air, fire, water, and earth (from right to left in the photo).

> *Pour le [**CCC's Street Art Contest #299**](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@digi-me/ccc-s-street-art-contest-5dacab372acc4) organisé par **@digi-me**, je vous propose une collaboration faite lors de **Art Basel Miami 2024** par quatre artistes [**Hefster**](https://www.instagram.com/jamiehef/), [**Pilot**](https://www.instagram.com/pilot_graff/), [**Bert**](https://www.instagram.com/bert_mta/) et [**Loomit**](https://www.instagram.com/loomit_official/). Elle représente les quatre éléments, l'air, le feu, l'eau et la terre (de la droite à la gauche sur la photo).*

![Hefster & Pilot & Bert & Loomit, Art Basel 2025](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/2432FyTzvMxNrTunuSUPtJRbAzWxZZGhzXA5g1Fm2GRQ9S2xnTgGBDtKXj6HpNteshP2a.JPG)

# ෴ ᴡʜᴇʀᴇ
![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

This wall is located on 3rd Avenue at the corner of 25th in the Wynwood neighborhood of Miami, in the heart of the Wynwood district, very close to the Graffiti Museum. On the map, I'll try to list all the posts about this neighborhood. The number in red corresponds to the relevant #StreetArt post. Example: 880 = [StreetArt #880](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-880-wynwood-miami-part-i--el-mac-dface-and-maxi-bagnasco).

> *Ce mur se trouve sur la 3ème avenue au coin de la 25ème dans le quartier de Wynwood à Miami, au coeur du quartier de Wynwood, tout près du Musée du Graffiti. Sur la carte, je vais essayer de lister tous les posts au sujet de ce quartier. Le numéro en rouge correspond au post StreetArt correspond. Exemple : 880 = [StreetArt #880](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-880-wynwood-miami-part-i--el-mac-dface-and-maxi-bagnasco).*

# ෴ ᴡʜᴏ
![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

## Hefster & Pilot & Bert & Loomit 

![Hefster & Bert](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23yJCAU9xkbbaXXg1E2UDBDq5S3RmZiv3vBxd9SsxYFiLA8q27TBw4PEULS3zssJGbyct.JPG)

In the first photo, on the right, you can see the section done by [**Bert**](https://www.instagram.com/bert_mta/), a German artist renowned worldwide for his ladybugs 😀. Next to it's the fire by [**Hefster**](https://www.instagram.com/jamiehef/) aka **Jamie Heff**, an artist from Brooklyn (US). It was his first time in Miami, and quite a success with this dragon emerging from the flames.

> *Sur la première photo, sur la droite, on peut voir la partie réalisée par [**Bert**](https://www.instagram.com/bert_mta/), un artiste allemand reconnu mondialement grâce à ses coccinelles* 😀. *A côté, il s'agit du feu de [**Hefster**](https://www.instagram.com/jamiehef/) aka **Jamie Heff**, artiste de Brooklyn (US). C'était sa première fois à Miami, plutôt réussi avec ce dragon sortant des flammes.*

![Pilot & Hefster](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23uQkGbA1KUoXDcZHPViyDduFgNHDBFSw8ZmoCyAPXnTVfQ8HCBoD3PtdeSUTDX1VEAH7.JPG)

After the fire, the water was painted by [**Pilot**](https://www.instagram.com/pilot_graff/), an artist from Houston, Texas. I don't know why I didn't take a picture of that fish. It was truly stunning with beautiful lettering underneath. And the wall is finished with earth by [**Loomit**](https://www.instagram.com/loomit_official/), based in Berlin, Germany.

> *Après le feu, l'eau a été peint par [**Pilot**](https://www.instagram.com/pilot_graff/), un artiste en provenance Houston (US). Je ne sais pas pourquoi je n'ai pas pris une photo de ce poisson. Il était vraiment superbe avec un beau lettrage en dessous. Et le mur se termine avec la terre de [**Loomit**](https://www.instagram.com/loomit_official/) basé à Berlin (Allemagne).*

![Loomit](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23wgFgggNrRbFASQ2J7H46issJZkTPj6TFbuzpWhV4x6Ux6HbubEi4JHyiyeLdts86U6C.JPG)

**What is your favorite part? Water, Fire, Earth or Air?** 
As I was saying, I really like the fish although against the dragon I wouldn't give it much of a chance.

> ***Quelle est votre partie préférée ? Eau, Feu, Terre ou Air ?** 
Comme je le disais, j'aime beaucoup le poisson bien que contre le dragon je ne donne pas cher de sa peau*.

body.title: Freewrite || Between the Ropes and the Calm Sea
body.body:
![PSX_20260505_224657.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRurtLnyTtdy4BjNL4sueMLuquVbmkYJ8FxGzq4jZaGYL/PSX_20260505_224657.jpg)
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)
That morning, the sea looked so calm, as if holding many stories yet to be told. A fishing boat sat quietly on the water's surface, tied by ropes that stretched like lifelines, holding it in place. The sky was slightly overcast, giving the impression that the day would pass slowly, unhurriedly.

I stood watching from a distance, noticing how the boat became the center of simple yet meaningful activity. Around it, small boats could be seen occasionally moving slowly, as if following the rhythm of the water that never truly stands still. There was a sense of peace that was hard to describe, as if time passed more slowly in this place.

But behind that tranquility lay the struggles of the fishermen who depend on the sea every day. They not only battle the waves, but also uncertainty. Sometimes they return with abundant catches, sometimes they have to accept the fact that the sea doesn't always provide. But they keep returning, again and again, with the same hope.

I realized that life is not much different from that boat. Sometimes we have to pause, bound by circumstances, waiting for the right time to set sail again. Not every day is about moving forward. There are times when silence is an essential part of the journey.

The wind blew gently, rustling the ropes tied to the front. The ship was still there, steady, waiting for its time to set sail again. And perhaps, that's how we should live our lives. Not in a rush, but ready when the opportunity arises.
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)

Assalamu Alaikum friends, how are you all? I hope you are all doing well and healthy by the grace of Allah Ta'ala and that you are always doing well and healthy. I wish you all the best for your family. I am also doing well by your prayers and the mercy of Allah Ta'ala. For this, I am grateful to Allah Ta'ala a million times. Alhamdulillah.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQXjhWSFwr2wRHDtjnUZ6EzJa46b815Eu8Vt9jD6EDtuK/1777996704225.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQHkdvzGVcYKdNs6AJg9zfB6zPv4VWH4mNUNS49eu8NS6/1777996704335.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb4btayPieoUMW9zmw7UsCcvKqPjBPzdPhVQ81zhCrwCU/1777996704590.jpg)

Friends, today I have come up with a new video for you. The video is a scene of my daughter taking a bath where I tried to show how my daughter finishes her bath by herself without anyone's help because she feels much more comfortable taking a bath alone. She can actually do everything by herself, that is, she can apply soap, shampoo, and everything by herself. So I took this opportunity to make a video of her. I will share that video with you today, Insha Allah.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmczSDU3Rir2p1wgURhZNhEgj1D84vPR2LoMdMrC9vTAYV/1777996739291.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU9oHUxRnq74MCRdfTwHFm5QeD6g91WwBbjkvJXu5csh1/1777996739431.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbrf4UJU1hESR34SdcS6opmzULWehvaN6YbT1Tejccunv/1777996739544.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPkmcgDRR5vYTUpVWrKvyDYH2TqjptptFXcMuV7NtvPrP/1777996739648.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPTRJPuqxEjnWebRLZUWgXWGCNMMMajx9S4Hiaqbs36Hi/1777996739743.jpg)

As you can see here, I poured a bucket of water for her and left. After a while, she went to get shampoo. So I gave her some shampoo and when she finished shampooing, after the shampoo foamed on her head, I told her to make a video of you. She agreed, so I started her video. She is applying it very beautifully on her head, which I have shown you through the video. She has been applying these shampoos on her head for a long time, for which I have been warning her repeatedly that it may cause her to catch a cold. One of my daughter's hobbies is that she will apply shampoo every day.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcDDQoAJyvBcB3sy8u5TgpyfsPD84ni6jCAjj4YqfKRWk/1777996763938.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPTRJPuqxEjnWebRLZUWgXWGCNMMMajx9S4Hiaqbs36Hi/1777996764055.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme15VRrz8tmrFY2VnwmhRqLK4N9Z8XnaPKSpfR5eKCg6d/1777996764143.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSN8Q4LzY3ghca4MeDdMMySKZrZvJusMDvKzcYdhsR6kk/1777996764250.jpg)

After finishing with your shampoo, he washed all his hair and I also helped him because he was having a little trouble taking water in his head alone, so I cleaned his head with the help of a mug. Then he asked me to give him soap, so I gave him soap and he started to lick it with his mouth. I kept telling him not to let it drip for too long, because he was very small, it could burn his eyes, so I quickly gave him water to play with the soap and he washed his face with water as I told him.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmck74bTY5tTvvyML6z1Qvajk9yCbvz1WF5781P4LTzGQC/1777996797808.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPeHQtaBax61BYiDyhSLHMvKr9qK9uPp6x5yGWLT2sg2e/1777996797913.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQXjhWSFwr2wRHDtjnUZ6EzJa46b815Eu8Vt9jD6EDtuK/1777996798005.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPkmcgDRR5vYTUpVWrKvyDYH2TqjptptFXcMuV7NtvPrP/1777996798095.jpg)

Then I took her out of here with a few more mugs of water because she might catch a cold but she took her clothes and entered the bathroom and locked the door. She changed her clothes and wiped her head, body, hands and feet with a towel and came out of there and I helped her out and brought her home with my help. She wiped her hair very nicely and then when she finished the massage, she combed it very nicely and put it on her head and my daughter was completely ready after the bath and she looked so beautiful and cute that I petted her a lot and finally I combed her hair more beautifully myself.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf7sXjdka5WnKzbosaPEQvp94PQ5NZXd2hRfpgyETueyR/1777996818259.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU9oHUxRnq74MCRdfTwHFm5QeD6g91WwBbjkvJXu5csh1/1777996818373.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmczSDU3Rir2p1wgURhZNhEgj1D84vPR2LoMdMrC9vTAYV/1777996818459.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme1gbbT7qE8GFjRsxEE5TEfH4LK9CF2HzEyDES88PNrfB/1777996818556.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV3MTCaXL1KFBmxUECbDCyW1FaSUpksFCjLjDLskNLAaR/1777996818661.jpg)

So friends, how did you like my daughter's bath video today? Please let me know your valuable feedback and stay with me to get more beautiful videos in the future and extend your support. I am leaving you today with the promise of giving you a new video. May everyone be well and healthy. May Allah protect you.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmck74bTY5tTvvyML6z1Qvajk9yCbvz1WF5781P4LTzGQC/1777996843661.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUzMj4ZNdFSugwEKWXyVjBvhMZakokiikoGJ2wn8uBD7J/1777996843770.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS7Gz7ER4k4P2LT2pnDsKMqzfz8Hwkp43AeNWoaRBEauv/1777996843874.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfUwSvDJJkBdN5hWYxZr1hzU9ghxJUdNJ6aSWdGBPkBqQ/1777996844002.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQXjhWSFwr2wRHDtjnUZ6EzJa46b815Eu8Vt9jD6EDtuK/1777996844112.jpg)

body.title: RUN: The Commodore 64/128 User's Guide (April 1990)
body.body:
>
Cover of the April 1990 issue of RUN
RUN was perhaps my favorite computer magazine. It was dedicated to Commodore 8-bit computers which primarily meant the Commodore 64 and 128. Things were definitely winding down commercially for the Commodore 64 in 1990 but a few major games were still coming out and RUN would be published for a couple more years. The April 1990 issue includes:

Features

  • Bach to the Future - A look at software and hardware for creating music with your Commodore. Products here include The Music Studio, The SID Symphony Stereo Cartridge, Music Construction Set, Enhanced Sidplayer, and more.

  • 128 BASIC Enhancers - A type-in program to add four new commands to BASIC on the Commodore 128.

  • Doing The Alphabet Shuffle - A type-in sliding letter game in which you must get the letters in order as quickly as possible.

  • Alien Strike - A type in game that is similar to games like Space Invaders and Galaga.

  • Basic Dater - A type-in utility for the Commodore 64 and Commodore 128 that automatically tags your BASIC programs with the date and time they are saved.

  • Connex - A type-in Tetris-like game for the Commodore 128.

>
Table of Contents from the April 1990 issue of RUN

Departments

  • RUNning Ruminations - A report from the Consumer Electronics Show. Fifty new games were planned for the Commodore 64 in 1990. At the time, it was still the second largest computer game market behind DOS.

  • Magic - Short type-in programs for creating a bouncing title, generating multicolored lights along the boarder of the screen, creating colorful text, and more.

  • News and New Products - Upcomig games (and other stuff) include Ghostbusters II, Beyond Dark Castle, Grave Yardage, Face Off, Power Drift, Batman: The Movie, The Untouchables, Pro Tennis Tour, Iron Lord - The Crusader of Justice, Pipe Drea, My Grand Piano, Bowling Alley, School Bus Driver, I Can Remember, Firehouse Rescue, Perfect Fit, Castlevania, Double Dribble, Blades of Steel, Super C, The Muscle Cars, Heat Wave Offshore Superboat Racing, and more.

  • Mail RUN - Letters from readers about Personal Ancestor File for the C-128, software for the Commodore 128 mouse, the Sears SR-2000 printer, and more.

  • Software Gallery - Reviews of Aussie Games (Australian themed sports), Empire (a strategy game), Space Rogue (start your career in space as a merchant marine - I always wanted this one), Life Force (the classic side-scrolling shooter), Time To Die (a mystery adventure game), Thud Ridge (an apparently terrible combat flight game), Superman (a comic book adventure), Dark Side, Zero Gravity, License To Kill (based on the James Bond Movie), and Heroes of the Lance (this action game is not nearly as good as the Gold Box RPG series).
  • Gold Mine - Game tips for Arkanoid, Batman, BattleTech, Caveman Ugh-Lympics, Curse of the Azure Bonds, Double Dragon, Double Dragon II, Grand Prix Circuit, Hillsfar, Impossible Mission II, Test Drive II, Sim City, Times of Lore, Wasteland, Who Framed Roger Rabbit?, and more.

  • 128 Mode - A guide to the Commodore 128's Directory command.

  • geoWatch - A look at hardware useful for enhancing your GEOS experience including various printers, GEORAM 512, the Right Time cartridge, JiffyDOS, CMD's RAMLink, and more.

  • Commodore Clinic - Questions answered a Commodore 128 glitch, 1571 disk drive problems, 1571 disk drive alignment, sharing a printer, and more.

>
Back cover of the April 1990 issue of RUN

body.body: Good Morning.. all my wonderful friends.. here. I am in Bintulu, and this view is stunning from my hotel. Lots of clouds and the beautiful skyline. Not too busy, but in the type of situation Goldilocks would proudly state that it is home. At the moment, it is not too sunny and the weather is just right. THE SKYLINE OF BINTULU, SARAWAK ===============================
/> The first thing to do is to get some food. We are heading to Srikandi Cafe and Catering for some breakfast. I am going to have some rice here.
/> This place is quite popular for its huge portion of meatballs. My wife ordered some meatballs here, but not the huge ones.

/> MILK TEA ======== At the bottom of this milk tea are some of the jelly that you can chew on while you are drinking this cup of milk tea. On a hot day, this drink is great to quench the thirst. However, I ordered with no sugar to make sure I don't get a sugar rush.

/> The Bakso dish The famous signature dish of this shop. Many people come here for their huge meatballs. We did not order the huge meatball. May not be able to finish the meatball. The soup is the best part of this dish because the meatball has been boiled inside the soup for a long time and you can taste the soup. It is quite flavourful.

/> Nasi Lalapan Ayam ================= This dish originates from Indonesia. The fried chicken portion is huge. Served with raw veggies like lettuce, and the chicken is fried with different types of spices. Other than this, there are also some slices of cucumbers inside.
/> Do you want to try this dish?
/> Thank you very much for reading my post. Have a wonderful day ahead. @luueetang YouTube : www.youtube.com/luueejanice Tiktok: www.tiktok.com/@luueejanice

body.title: It's like that childhood
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1778028158178-354124b85bb071ab.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=angelmitu/cde96276)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=angelmitu/cde96276)


---

About 28 years ago, I was young and immersed in the traditions of rural bengal.Yes that was in the late 90s when there was no light or internet tower in our village or on the road.There was no SIM card tower or any mobile phone.There was internet, Android mobile phone and even a button phone then.It feels like I left my childhood behind a few days ago.I've left those behind, it's been many years now.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRRm9Kcj23e9KST7XQDZEXdUYQkNVzWGMG61kvKq4fCui/img_20260505_wa0025.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVzvXDSjyVJjmFuZbtrVYunA1dMqPA6wXWJyNKsdtaSwW/img_20260505_wa0022.jpg)

Today I would like to briefly share some memories from the late 90s that are deeply ingrained in my soul.Hey at the end of the 90s, when we had only a village surrounded by nature.There was no light or internet tower around.Yes there was electricity, but it wasn't very developed.Not all houses had electricity lines, only some developed houses had electricity lines.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXwPJJBKB6F8mNme1pVHwBo35uPNpXA9WFvENNkm2JEHx/img_20260505_wa0003.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQSdCV8QacDXMqLrUdDwTjr2FVN2k8uDyicHqWk2U5UXY/img_20260505_wa0027.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbwrxE7CuE76mE1hMdeEFJK4SdYV4kiPYmsSZD9KhPEdV/img_20260505_wa0021.jpg)

At that time, our only place of entertainment was the nature of rural Bengal or the Metho Path.We used to walk along the Metho Path and often ride our domestic animals in the fields.\

Metho path, I meant the dirt road.We had various rural games and dances for entertainment.We could only watch one movie a week on government television.However in the modern digital age, it seems like how sweet those late nineties were.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmacpwtGys9fnBp9nGifSZEhrfmrk2Y3k5dqsbWukERr9S/img_20260505_wa0016.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaEXvVz83ByxfevZ9vUroHydEWQem1yhEkmxzsZCzE3Cs/img_20260505_wa0017.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWqexV3hhSn9evqLzySuAzfSLMq1of1G1wpjWvh5oqtZ2/img_20260505_wa0019.jpg)

One of the most enjoyable times of the year was summer.During some times of the summer, such as the month of Baishakh, we would pick juicy summer fruits during stormy rains.One of the main forms of entertainment in rural towns was the rural fair.Every year in the month of Baishakh, rural fairs were held at different places and were the best form of entertainment for us.We all used to have so much fun at rural fairs but those days are gone.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTjTGoXkc2GXpopbXzvLf4YKFkiXTGUaa5kQ3ewM9CD6U/img_20260505_wa0010.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR6xBKpb9dREx4Q3Vai6SR6kT5hDx5ThFtiohwr9S5Mts/img_20260505_wa0011.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeVgGaCw1gSUrp1kwczakTVCdAcpkm1JEVD89gswenkwZ/img_20260505_wa0013.jpg)

Even though that day is gone, Baisakhi fairs are still observed in some places in rural areas.For example a Baisakhi fair is being held in our neighboring village, Sampati.Recently I went to that fair with my daughter and I got my childhood back.My daughter enjoyed these fairs as much as I did in my childhood.My neighbors went to the fair with me.This rural fair has given me joy after a long time.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY5ukLKDtkoUAzM3w9bPiYAyLWEEMPAxzG9utk5UcCPoY/img_20260505_wa0015.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRrf826DPEkNGHrUTfZZXYvhEEw15gjZFeZRyf5pYE93K/img_20260505_wa0012.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfZcSpiaMRq9udGPnH7TwyDjWuzbf1GJzoEsnSgitFrjp/img_20260505_wa0009.jpg)

body.title: Construir sin ver el fondo /  Building Without Seeing the Bottom
body.body: /> Hay una sensación que conozco bien. No es angustia. Es más como estar parada frente a una puerta que ya abriste, mirando hacia adentro, y darte cuenta de que no puedes ver el fondo. Sabes que quieres entrar, que afuera ya no cabe, pero adentro todavía está oscuro. Yo llevo un tiempo en ese umbral. Tengo claridad en algunas cosas: sé que me muevo mejor cuando mi cuerpo se mueve primero. Que la estera de yoga a las 6 de la mañana no es disciplina, es el único idioma que mi mente entiende antes de que el mundo empiece a hablar. Sé que las palabras me importan. Que escribir aquí, en Hive, ha sido durante mucho tiempo la única forma que tenía de procesar lo que vivo y de construir algo que me pertenece. Pero cuando la pregunta se vuelve más concreta: ¿en qué exactamente estás trabajando? ¿cuál es tu proyecto? ¿hacia dónde vas? ahí aparece el silencio. Y he aprendido que el silencio no siempre es vacío. A veces es el espacio justo antes de que algo tome forma. Lo que he notado es que la urgencia de tener ya una respuesta clara es casi siempre más dañina que el no saber todavía. Porque te empuja a elegir cualquier cosa con tal de poder decir que elegiste. A comprometerte con algo que todavía no entiendes solo para callar la incomodidad. Y yo he caído en eso varias veces. He empezado cosas que se sentían lógicas en el papel pero que no venían de ningún lugar real en mí. Y siempre, en algún punto, el cuerpo lo sabe antes que la mente. Se pone pesado. La motivación se vuelve voluntad forzada. Y termino abandonando no porque sea inconstante, sino porque estaba construyendo sobre terreno que no era mío. Ahora intento hacer algo distinto: quedarme aunque no vea el final. No sé todavía exactamente la forma que va a tomar lo que estoy haciendo. Pero sé que ya estoy dentro. Y eso, por ahora, es suficiente. * * * * * * There's a feeling I know well. It's not anxiety. It's more like standing in front of a door you've already opened, looking inside, and realizing you can't see the bottom. You know you want to go in. You know there's no more room outside. But inside, it's still dark. I've been standing at that threshold for a while now. I have clarity on some things: I know I move better when my body moves first. That the yoga mat at 6 in the morning isn't discipline — it's the only language my mind understands before the world starts talking. I know words matter to me. That writing here, on Hive, has been for a long time the only way I had to process what I live and to build something that belongs to me. But when the question gets more specific — What exactly are you working on? What's your project? Where are you going? — that's when the silence appears. And I've learned that silence isn't always emptiness. Sometimes it's the space right before something takes shape. What I've noticed is that the urgency to already have a clear answer is almost always more damaging than not knowing yet. Because it pushes you to choose anything just so you can say you chose. To commit to something you don't yet understand, just to quiet the discomfort. And I've fallen into that. More than once. I've started things that felt logical on paper but didn't come from any real place in me. And at some point, the body always knows before the mind does. It gets heavy. Motivation turns into forced willpower. And I end up quitting — not because I'm inconsistent, but because I was building on ground that wasn't mine. Now I'm trying to do something different: stay, even when I can't see the end. I don't yet know exactly what shape what I'm doing will take. But I know I'm already inside. And for now, that's enough.

body.title: MCGI Topic Review | DOES GOD ALLOW POLYGAMY
body.body: > https://youtu.be/fK9Fo0xgtlE?si=fuqSQudlrW08FeLO One question that I have been pondering over is the question of whether God permits polygamy or not. I find in the Bible that there were men who had more than one wife. As an illustration, Abraham, Jacob and David all had more than one wife. However, as I read attentively, I also see that their houses were frequently filled with issues, envy and suffering. This started to make me realize that although it might have occurred in the past, it was not the perfect plan of God. I look at the start and I can see the real intention that God had of marriage. The bible says in Gen 2:24, that a man shall leave his father and his mother and shall cleave unto his wife and they shall be one flesh. It does not tell us about wives, it tells us about wife. This shows me that God’s original plan is one man and one woman. Jesus further affirmed this in Matthew 19:5-6 where he taught that two will become one flesh not many. At one point, I felt like maybe, polygamy was okay due to the things I observed in the Old Testament. However, as I kept on learning I understood that God permitted certain things because of human weakness and not because He actually desired it. Jesus just as in Matthew 19:8 stated that certain things were permitted due to the hardness of the hearts of people. I also got to know that the church leaders should only have one wife. In 1 Timothy 3:2, it is stated that a bishop should be the husband of one wife. This lesson helped me better understand the fact that God blesses one man and one woman when they are married. Now, in my heart, I feel that it is not polygamy that is the will of God. His is love, unity, and peace between a single man and a single woman. I think that when I am doing what God wants me to do, I will have a more peaceful and blessed home.

body.title: 痴呆母后护理日常
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![DbUK9Q3f5ifmggRk_1.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/huigezi/images/DbUK9Q3f5ifmggRk_1/DbUK9Q3f5ifmggRk_1.webp)
![kcu6JVwQxi9ku2Nb_2.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/huigezi/images/kcu6JVwQxi9ku2Nb_2/kcu6JVwQxi9ku2Nb_2.webp)
![KSiCboCNZy18XT6K_3.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/huigezi/images/KSiCboCNZy18XT6K_3/KSiCboCNZy18XT6K_3.webp)
![sTqA41ehAMCJftMf_4.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/huigezi/images/sTqA41ehAMCJftMf_4/sTqA41ehAMCJftMf_4.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

这几天的早上，我基本上都没做过饭，因为老畜生去外面吃饭，痴呆母后挑食厉害，我做的米粥，她说熬的火候不够，不好喝，包子她不爱吃，放几天也不吃，油条也不吃，大早上非要吃凉皮和红烧肉，我不会做，于是索性不做，她胖嘟嘟的，天天说自己没吃过饭，让人气死，不能跟痴呆病人计较。

哄着她，把一大缸子中药喝了，我自己的中药也一大瓶子，喝完以后，肚子里满满的，啥都吃不下去了，这不是省了早餐吗，于是这几天都按这个习惯进行，还是饿的轻，越来越挑食了，医生说这样的病人，不用伺候的太细致，太细致她会越来越懒，何况她清醒的时候也是世界第一懒呢，越是使用她，她才越机灵，伺候痴呆，真是难啊。

买得南瓜，我都在院子里种了，都过去四天了温度没有上来，一直没看到发芽，再等四天，看会不会发芽，温度还是不太热的缘故吧，五一假期过完了。业绩不算好，但是比平时好，所以也是差强人意，但是这五天以后，批发商的要账电话该来了，结账，这就是拉锯了，能不能保住手里这可怜的一点营业额呢，都是套路，每年都是这样，表演。

我喜欢吃包子，各种包子，而痴呆母后一个也不吃，我觉得是饿的轻，我准备多买点零食，这样让她吃，反正也不会饿着她。

今天是五月六号，给两个批发商转了钱，还了一个光大信用卡，发现手机里又空空如也了，人活着真难啊，就是穷急，我又想念钱了，希望今天也能爆发，让我开心一天是一天，开心一秒是一秒。

导师亲哥给我的京东购物券，我昨天在京东上卖了德克士全家桶，花了120，这是我不舍得的，给自己的外甥，和外甥女点，的，吃吧，孩子们也应该过节，快快乐乐的就好，全家健康，人在一起是聚会，心在一起是团队，希望丁家重新崛起，丁家占领地球，丁家通知宇宙。加油，又是美好的一天。

元气慢慢的做个搞钱哥。我又开始想钱了，加油啊

---

body.title: Construyendo más casas para la granja [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
![casas.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZMdZW5F5vVp87kSpcFCSteocaLWshpYUQYJ413qKcqRR/casas.jpg) Saludos amigo, comenzamos una nueva semana y por eso vamos con todo para así poder completar cada una de las actividades de la granja que nos están pidiendo, además es el momento de seguir expandiendo con cosas nuevas y de esa manera poder darle la oportunidad a muchas más personas para que trabajen en la granja. Donde hoy vamos a continuar con las tareas que están disponibles, donde la primera de ellas consiste en sembrar cualquier cosa y la cantidad son cuatro, por eso para completar esa tarea sembré en toda mi tierra zanahoria y eso nos servirá para muchas cosas dentro del juego, que nos permitirá tomar ventaja y ganar muchas recompensas. >Hello, friend! We’re starting a new week, so let’s give it our all to complete every farm task we’ve been asked to do. It’s also time to keep expanding with new things, which will give many more people the chance to work on the farm. Today we’ll continue with the available tasks. The first one involves planting anything—four of them, to be exact. So, to complete that task, I planted carrots all over my land, which will be useful for many things in the game, giving us an advantage and helping us earn lots of rewards. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmedQR94sRnSXXLoeQfNUYTTY7P2DAsR7Au4JjCGMVFzUP/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbNz5Q6RZ7ABSWMcoskzNoiVHejwi4cfKodagzYCpqVhf/image.png) Para poder producir más cosas en la granja y es necesario poder contar con más personas que sean trabajadores fijos de la granja y por eso dentro de la sección de construcción de viviendas tenía la oportunidad de poder construir una casa suburbana, con una capacidad de 45 personas más que llegarán a formar parte del equipo. La casa tenía un costo de 225 monedas y ya las tenía lista para así poder hacer esa inversión que seguramente nos dará mucho más recompensas y beneficios, donde la construcción tendrá una duración de 3 horas para que así esté lista y la granja siga creciendo y poder llegar a la cima. >In order to produce more on the farm, we need more permanent farm workers, which is why, in the housing construction section, I had the opportunity to build a suburban house with a capacity for 45 additional people who will join the team. The house cost 225 coins, and I already had the funds ready to make that investment, which will surely bring us many more rewards and benefits. Construction will take 3 hours to complete, so the house will be ready and the farm can continue to grow and reach the top. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ5Jo6ZphrXEPWNp4EuNnpfvdgu4RYPyJqghxMryDn3fg/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWh32JSgXPuGzhRn77aRdErPfsFfmeA1QskwR1cs6153R/image.png) Uno de los trenes regresó a casa con materiales que nos hacían falta para poder dar inicio a otra construcción, la cual es algo muy bueno que se tiene que saber aprovechar y a la vez siempre seguir cargando para poder ganar. Mientras que el otro nos hace falta sembrar caña de azúcar para así poder cargar y que salga de una vez a su destino, donde es algo que no está frenado el proceso de envío mediante trenes, sin embargo, ya vamos a comenzar a producir todo es al igual que una dona en el otro tren para que también salga, por eso espero que dentro de un par de horas poder tener todo listo y enviar cada cosa a su destino. >One of the trains returned with materials we needed to start another construction project, which is a great opportunity we must take advantage of while continuing to load cargo so we can succeed. Meanwhile, on the other train, we need to load sugarcane so it can be shipped and reach its destination right away—since the shipping process by train isn’t delayed there. However, we’re about to start loading everything onto the other train as well, so it can leave too. That’s why I hope to have everything ready in a couple of hours and send each item to its destination. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY2XqUicjYREgr1mhH2JD7w7wVNAuE5UBqP1tKT4WXJTZ/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYgnJGoRGECpXVTZPCrJDYqyHACd5irRXqXio2eWZGxXL/image.png) Luego de cada una de las tareas que nos pidieron, largas horas de trabajo y sobre todo tener que invertir para poder llegar hasta donde estamos llegó el momento más feliz de todo y es que ya puedo mejorar lo que sería el granero, ese lugar donde se va almacenando todo lo que vamos producción, sin embargo, lleva un punto donde eso se llena y no podemos hacer nada. Pero con más recompensas que nos dieron de los trenes que fueron materiales ya tengo todo lo necesario que nos están pidiendo para así poder dar ese siguiente paso en el juego, donde la mejore martillo, clavo y pintura, y con esos materiales nos dará una capacidad de 110 cosas para guardar. >After completing each of the tasks they asked us to do—long hours of work and, above all, having to invest in order to get where we are now—the happiest moment of all has arrived: I can finally upgrade the barn, that place where we store everything we produce. However, there comes a point where it gets full and we can’t do anything else. But with the extra rewards we received from the trains—which were materials—I now have everything needed to take the next step in the game: upgrading the barn with a hammer, nails, and paint. With those materials, we’ll gain a storage capacity of 110 items. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTefeGiygnVM8dfAmjbw7nmaDxVofNXwcSczcUdg55DyR/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVraCX6QzySRjmFf7Ao3iTiTsNjrW5V1vVamSVCTZovB1/image.png) Vamos progresando de una gran manera en este jugo de la granja, la cual es sumamente emocionante ya que eso es una muestra de que estamos haciendo las cosas bien para así poder llegar a la cima, mientras que, por otro lado, dejamos produciendo y construyendo algunas cosas que más adelante nos dará esas ganancias necesarias para así poder avanzar. Por eso amigos no te puede perder el próximo gameplay de este juego y ver ese cambio que tuvo la granja. >We’re making great progress in this farm game, which is incredibly exciting because it shows we’re doing things right to reach the top. At the same time, we’re continuing to produce and build things that will eventually provide us with the profits we need to move forward. So, friends, don’t miss the next gameplay video for this game and see the changes the farm has undergone.

body.body:
**“Bosque”** está perfecto, y la frase **“Los bosques son muy importantes para la tierra”** funciona bien para aprendizaje básico.

Si quieres que suene un poco más natural en español, yo haría este ajuste: **“Los bosques son muy importantes para la Tierra.”** También podrías usar **“para el planeta”**, que suena más idiomático en muchos contextos. Lo de **“la tierra”** no está mal, pero en minúscula puede sentirse más como “suelo” que como “el planeta”. Tu enfoque visual sigue siendo bueno: imagen simple + frase útil + apoyo bilingüe. Eso enseña sin marear, que ya es más de lo que logra mucho material “educativo”.

Como contexto de tu serie, tu post anterior [A Daily Word in Spanish (393)](https://inleo.io/@aljif7/a-daily-word-in-spanish-393-morvngfteebee92b?referral=aljif7) deja claro el formato secuencial que estás construyendo, y eso le da consistencia al proyecto. Tu blog de [@aljif7](https://inleo.io/@aljif7) ya tiene una línea bastante reconocible: vocabulario, traducción y uso práctico.

body.title: NATURAL COLORS // The scenery and serene natural atmosphere within the Langsa City Protected Forest
body.body:
## Good night to all my beloved hive friends ♥️ ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTS3jB2MQ67iPeKXZCzQSpK7bXQ9DVsYrNdfHvnPFeDXU/1778016763458.jpg) In this post, I’ll share my experience visiting and exploring the Langsa City Protected Forest. From what I’ve heard, this forest is so vast that it serves as one of the lungs of Langsa City. Within the protected forest,we can also find several parks and tourist attractions, such as a wildlife park, an urban forest, a complex of traditional Acehnese houses, and a variety of exciting rides. However, what is even more interesting is that the forest ecosystem is still very well maintained and is a place for interaction between living creatures and their physical environment. Here, we can find many lush trees that provide natural shade, and we can also find a wide variety of flora and fauna, both domesticated and wild. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNNxdCjwbzXV3XPgbtKeQB3cv9yDAG9AguuYSUSpnfuNH/1778016763530.jpg) Green is the dominant color here, and it’s a very soothing natural hue,there are so many areas to visit and explore,and it could take hours to complete them all. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZLuYnNSNzogwpVnAwzA9ZjiDBuohp2ZF7aFpr1en59gA/1778016763636.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNz9R5uNdApEd4dzRXJc4zK1RjiMVYJZeoLz1wpCBNi1i/1778016763741.jpg) I kept walking until I arrived at a garden filled with ornamental plants and colorful flowers, but what caught my attention most was the topiary on the side of the garden. Of course, this was a garden ornament that had been shaped as attractively as possible,there were plants shaped like hearts, which looked absolutely beautiful, especially since the surrounding atmosphere was so natural. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaS5rdRQs5WQvhsDeR3KFT87Hk9BRSNFKyvxoV5dzGvYm/1778016763841.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTRxZEM99VyZAg1AoZLCRxFLTh7xTqfDxWxmpXdohVcNA/1778026240615.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPY7RpQNDmhWGW2tcYEEP5zv1ky1CY4ULUosYFfgMPPbw/1778026240738.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVkBrtUjok1Tzt8au6PJs8yAJkZ2PdE8AfrmThEFRpvUr/1778026240857.jpg) The atmosphere here is incredibly romantic, making this park the perfect place to visit with your partner. There are so many spots that are ideal for taking photos and capturing every special moment. The vibrant colors of nature are always a sight to behold,all we need to do is look and enjoy . There are also plenty of benches and pavilions around the park, allowing visitors to take a break while enjoying everything this park has to offer. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdmGuExKq4awG4fvgwuQoobGPrEuzhJJsQZHZk59ECR1B/1778026506259.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWPWzUBt6bcD3NmeKaozWkBC2r7dWJFisBcrTRx5PWzQp/1778026506353.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdaFm1X4jeRwZ5pDxuycwi2ch18mKCvbx7GLXV5pcNcE2/1778026506559.jpg) After exploring this part of the park, I immediately decided to explore the protected forest further. I kept walking until I arrived at an area that looked very serene, surrounded by lush trees.This place is very peaceful without any noise,there is only the sound of nature itself, the sound of birds chirping sounds quite melodious and the sound of the wind blowing through the trees also feels very peaceful. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYKa47C76CdZptzcL6deyPKT7XudmKtHybhzSdxJK18hV/1778026896190.jpg) We also don’t need to worry, because there are chairs available almost everywhere, so we can rest right away when we start to feel tired. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZkbmgYvYVNBB9z2bnWd3WhAfjKSPDUNJjTZNX6wTC58x/1778026969822.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUGU88Saig2y1N32vZYhGMQFQiHzBJ82rsG4H6DgH3Paf/1778026969936.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUSDcgKjt5XmEZw2qGz2KK9JB3F9ex8kKjXQ27g4hjWwH/1778026970032.jpg) The further we walk, the more new things we’ll discover. At that time, I also came across many abandoned buildings and facilities,the place is very large, and perhaps that’s only to be expected. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcL5J9HWrrwPo4uiwcE5X3xw5UqNndPefLrAxZwdWRJs9/1778027187137.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWpegqoVcRNVHsQatr6m1o4onHzB6vJMEUTNsqicsGkud/1778027187254.jpg) When I arrived at the lakeside, I came across an abandoned building with a traditional horse-drawn carriage inside,a vehicle from days gone by with a rich history. If I’m not mistaken, these traditional horse-drawn carriages can still be found in the province of Yogyakarta, Indonesia. ----

##### Era 1: Age of Abundance & Ruin
###### Episode 2: Calamities

> The world, it seemed, had been tallying its wounds. Every splinter signed in a ledger. And when it came to collect, it came for everything.
> 
> A thick cloud of poison rolled across the land, choking the air from coast to coast.
> 
> The sun swelled. Bloated beyond reason. Too hot. Too close.
> 
> The floods came next. Then the storms. Then earthquakes that shook and shattered the land. Great mountains, standing since the dawn of time, came down like stacked stone.
> 
> Observing this unfold, from high atop his mountain, was the mighty red wyrm, Rage. He had been there long before the first empire drew a border, and would be there long after it fell. He did not stir, but simply watched, and found the whole affair rather beneath him...
> 
> When the boundaries between worlds finally gave way — quietly, without warning — it wasn't a negotiation. The world wasn't ending. It was buckling.
> 
> The empires had wanted more... Well, friends, they were going to get more indeed...

body.title: 11K steps and pictures from a long walk in the park.  My Actifit Report Card: May 5 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0c1583f7-07d4-4fd4-b60b-64fced1ac719.jpg) Well, I walked the Port Coquitlam trail. Not the whole thing because it is a very long trail. I did it in two parts. The first part I just walked along the trail while my wife was busy to see if it was any good. Result: ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ba6e793f-42a7-430f-8b74-644344b34977.jpg) 1.9km Just for walking *back* from the end of the route. I did 3.8km before I even started my walk with my wife. Then I asked my wife to go on a walk and we enjoyed the walk for sure. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8fbdd5c0-b070-44ce-9b02-fd55b72f9fed.jpg) That was another 4km and by the end of 8km of walking I was pretty tired. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/abdbb47d-24c3-4c94-80e6-df2006be9a29.jpg) As for the walk in the park. It was really nice that it was shady. It made things not too hot (it was a hot day in the sun) and the river made it beautiful to look at. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/65eaef29-85be-49ea-a9a7-a850580e861b.jpg) Some of it was concrete and some was gravel but most of it was treed. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8105de21-d3d6-4eed-a76a-94e4a833146e.jpg) Still being in the trees made for a very nice view whether it was concrete or not. There were flowers that were beautiful. Trees that were green and nice. Plus the sun filtering through the trees made it peaceful. In addition I've never been through the park before and just walking through a new path felt good. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a92fafc9-5847-4b6b-ada7-084c18ed3e1e.jpg) Then again, there was one part of the trail that was blocked off for work :( We went that way and had to turn around. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d9e5aae0-3a2c-4aea-90e2-664254b1e359.jpg) As for the river there was this image here. Under the bridge there were decorative salmon. On the one side it was kind of cool to see the reminder that there are fish in the water. Then again there is the hidden reason for the fish... To keep homeless people from sleeping underneath the bridge. That's a little sad that there are people who would sleep there so the city has to put the fish place. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/210d6a38-24e6-4548-8b3c-0cd299803426.jpg) There was also the river which was nice to see and my wife commented how nice it would be to picnic there. Indeed there were places to go right down to the waterfront which would be perfect for a picnic. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d846a528-8a8f-4a7b-abcf-5e99d6f5f6c8.jpg) Add in an actual play park with places to sit and enjoy with family. Or let the kids play while sitting to watch them. For me? The washroom... So nice to know its there when walking that far :) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f44b467d-09d6-421b-9dde-6b31ee5ddb41.jpg) And I think that's it for the day. Well, add in walking the dog morning and evening and there we go, that was the day. :)
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@terganftp/actifit-terganftp-20260506t002032384z)_

body.title: Linda maceta artesanal para obsequiar el día de las madres 🌱🪴☺️❤️ [esp/eng]
body.body:
Maceta artesanal para obsequiar a Mama

___Saludos queridos amigos de HIVE DIY!___ 💖

Ya se acerca del día de la mujer más importante en nuestras vidas, nuestra madre y es por esto que hoy quiero compartir con ustedes una linda idea para hacer unas macetas artesanales y obsequiarle hermosas, plantas, acompáñame y te comparto el paso a paso:

> Greetings, dear friends of HIVE DIY! 💖
>
> Mother's Day is just around the corner, and that's why today I want to share with you a lovely idea for making some handcrafted flower pots to give her as a gift. Join me, and I'll share the step-by-step instructions:


<div class=\

> ___MATERIALES___ > MATERIALS Éste obsequio es especial para esas madres que les encantan las plantas, podemos idearnos unas lindas Macetas ￼con muy pocos materiales entre ellos material de reciclaje, lo mejor es que podemos dar un hermoso obsequio sin gastar casi nada, en lo personal, me gustan mucho las plantas, en especial, los cactus y suculentas, es por esto que quise idearme unas lindas macetas artesanales, ideales para obsequiarles a esas madres que les encantan las plantas, así que manos a la obra, aquí les dejo la lista de materiales a utilizar: - una pequeña porción de cemento - Una pequeña porción de arena - Algún envase, pequeño para usarlo como molde - Agua - Pinturas, acrílicas, esto es opcional - Envase de refresco > This gift is perfect for mothers who love plants. We can create some lovely planters with just a few materials, including recycled items. The best part is that we can give a beautiful gift for almost nothing. Personally, I love plants, especially cacti and succulents, which is why I wanted to create some beautiful handmade planters, ideal for gifting to mothers who adore plants. So, let's get started! Here's the list of materials you'll need: > > - A small amount of cement > - A small amount of sand > - A small container to use as a mold > - Water > - Acrylic paints (optional) > - A soda bottle

> ___PASO A PASO___ > STEP BY STEP Vamos a comenzar haciendo la mezcla, para esto vamos a utilizar una pequeña porción de cemento y una pequeña porción de arena de la que se usa para construcción, la colocamos en un recipiente y mezclamos con agua, una vez lista la vamos a colocar en el envase que escogimos de molde, en mi caso, también voy a hacer una base para mi pequeña maceta para esto. Voy a utilizar el fondo de un envase plástico de refresco, cortamos el fondo y le colocamos cemento, me gusta mucho la forma que tienen estos envases en el fondo y me pareció bonito para utilizarlo también como molde,, luego de colocarle el cemento mezclado, lo dejamos secar si es posible dos o tres días y luego desmoldamos. > Let's start by making the mixture. For this, we'll use a small amount of cement and a small amount of construction sand. We'll put it in a container and mix it with water. Once it's ready, we'll put it in the container we've chosen as a mold. In my case, I'm also going to make a base for my little flowerpot. I'm going to use the bottom of a plastic soda bottle. We'll cut off the bottom and put cement in it. I really like the shape these bottles have at the bottom, and I thought it would be nice to use it as a mold as well. After putting in the mixed cement, we'll let it dry, if possible, for two or three days, and then we'll unmold it.

> |![IMG_9661.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcba5fZFTPmfDtZGUFgwQKhL5Sdon2ZpHyJYQCmDg7zNt/IMG_9661.jpeg)|![IMG_9662.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXpZtSkRcPDNFCKJP3cJn8g8qDe746gL2bFZXXRnDDBHN/IMG_9662.jpeg)| |---|---| |![IMG_9919.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNuz5R1A9dmYsiYCQq6DKagiNNYsWWJmx8jAUAwhBq2HV/IMG_9919.jpeg)|![IMG_9920.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ6kYerXC97YtXbPYGLvvUMsLk1FyaqdcwdXeKSijVEcT/IMG_9920.jpeg)| |---|---| |![IMG_9922.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvnXiRWqZQMgfYp7jsgotAC7PeWqqVS9PkBCqMhaK9ot/IMG_9922.jpeg)|![IMG_9923.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUoHe8LhshWieF7FFCwjwn31iH1XpKtiBQFr8yiiegfRr/IMG_9923.jpeg)| Una vez lista nuestra maceta, vamos a pintarla si deseamos, puedes dejarla sin pintura, ya que el color del cemento también se ve muy bonito, en mi caso pinté sólo la pequeña maceta, le coloqué pintura acrílica blanca, luego de esto le coloqué abono y luego me fui hasta mi patio a escoger una linda y pequeña planta. Lo maravilloso de los cactus es que no necesitan una maceta con demasiado abono, no necesitan tanto riego y combinan con cualquier decoración, así que entre mis plantas conseguí unos pequeños botones de cactus, muy lindos, busqué mi pinza para agarrarlos, ya que no me gustan las pequeñas espinas que tienen, de verdad que son muy dolorosas cuando te tocan los dedos, la coloqué con mucho cuidado sobre el abono, y así ya está lista está linda maceta ahora vamos a ponerle una pequeña decoración > Once our pot is ready, we can paint it if we want. You can leave it unpainted, as the cement color also looks very nice. In my case, I only painted the small pot with white acrylic paint. After that, I added compost and then went to my patio to choose a pretty little plant. > > The wonderful thing about cacti is that they don't need a pot with too much compost, they don't need much watering, and they go with any decor. So, among my plants, I found some small, very cute cactus buds. I looked for my tweezers to pick them up, since I don't like the small spines they have; they really hurt when they touch your fingers. I carefully placed them on top of the compost, and now this pretty pot is ready. Now let's add a little decoration.

> |![IMG_9927.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeACpKNdnRyWWGtXwNfsYY2mALje573FUhPhscfiZhTq9/IMG_9927.jpeg)|![IMG_9947.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfGrtz5NcHyVwkNwF4WXnAK5SMGQwY1NNdKQdUZxQTdK2/IMG_9947.jpeg)| |---|---| |![IMG_9948.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbTtXtZR2Y3cjVqSNr28nEKFjZ4WnsbQVHPnnrt6CZgWy/IMG_9948.jpeg)|![IMG_9949.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNypPPD4Mug6nnCTwmorx54MD3wUtAFp6GJDyME921s1L/IMG_9949.jpeg)| Para la decoración, recordé que tenía unas calcomanías que mandé a imprimir el año pasado, la coloqué sobre foamy recorté por toda la orilla, dejando un excedente de aproximadamente me dio centímetro, le coloqué una pequeña paleta y luego la incrusté en la tierra, para exhibirla coloco primero la base que hice con el fondo de envase de refresco y luego coloco mi maceta encima y así ya está lista esta linda Maseta > For the decoration, I remembered I had some stickers I had printed last year. I placed them on foam sheets, cut around the edges, leaving an excess of about a centimeter. I attached a small lollipop and then stuck it in the soil. To display it, I first placed the base I made from the bottom of a soda bottle, and then placed my flowerpot on top. And that's how this cute flowerpot is ready!

> |![IMG_9944.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTeWCxM2x3XWbNyKcY3RKZqFCZxMhvqChmbhG9TWqNZZv/IMG_9944.jpeg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXtyiNBc5G6LJzmobyFKGaoJgQKPXZNnzxD6mrUd6pfFf/img_9945.jpg)| |---|---| |![IMG_9946.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX3PD67aNeN5LFTVLgnk1iEu1SX3hnrppBD7Gza6grmp2/IMG_9946.jpeg)|![IMG_9951.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPs4MSM6FYGsswjAysnbDfzweGzZswoJdSvikHpjSGssz/IMG_9951.jpeg)| Amé el resultado de esta maceta, ahora quiero hacer muchísimas para decorar mi patio y mi hogar y también para obsequiarlas el día de las madres a las chicas de mi familia y amigas, eso es todo por hoy, espero les haya gustado esta linda idea, me despido deseándoles muchas bendiciones, hasta otra oportunidad > I loved how this flowerpot turned out! Now I want to make lots of them to decorate my patio and home, and also to give as Mother's Day gifts to the women in my family and friends. That's all for today. I hope you liked this cute idea. I'm signing off wishing you many blessings, until next time!

body.title: A clearing tea [EN/ES]
body.body:
> Good morning, Cinnamon Cup Coffee community! This is the first of many posts I'll be making here, as I'm a huge tea lover. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZLke9QwSxEEPdaxQ4YxuD1JkRiPJD3YvaHy8Kzui8BCA/1777987727302.jpg)
It's been a while since I've left the house, since not having university meant I had no reason to, but today I decided to make a short trip to try to clear my mind and get out of the routine a bit to Café Europa, which is one of my favorites in the city.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP2z6j3qTgAJx29ShZ5KZTawgcUrKcQabPpn1QhF52exp/1777987628681.jpg)
Here I asked the clerk for a hot black tea as usual and they brought it to me quite quickly, almost as if they had been waiting for me, something that this establishment has always been known for, in addition to good service.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNgXAv9UVuQkLtpcTdKJ56v3mSEsm8jeTfeH83pBnZ12d/1777986840418.jpg)
I added just one teaspoon of white sugar to this one, although I would have preferred a little honey, but they didn't have any this time, and I beat it for a while to let it cool down a bit while I watched the large number of people and cars passing by the shop and also the children playing in the park in front of the shop.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc2eUsjAgjQyPPTponMeWoeGgE1twsGy468rPxPRdidgN/1777986880909.jpg)
After my short wait, I was able to enjoy this delicious tea, which had a rather strong flavor. I've always liked it, and the taste lingered in my mouth for quite a while on my way back home. I was already thinking about where my next outing would be, which I plan to do more often thanks to this wonderful experience I've found in this community.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdj3zfYDj9ZWqQsmdLBHn89NmqhfdL4U5Vv9okWuMaqmd/1777986903411.jpg)
I hope you also enjoy a good tea and can recommend another one, considering I almost always order black tea. ###

>Thank you very much for your visit!

*** ***
**En Español**
*** ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU4rpAKuQQg9FouiTgyRnCUe1dnx9bbwSnk2vZrXj2ixt/1777986518329.jpg)
***

> ¡Buenos días comunidad de Cinnamon Cup Coffee! Esta es mi primera de muchas publicaciones aquí ya que soy un gran amante del té. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZLke9QwSxEEPdaxQ4YxuD1JkRiPJD3YvaHy8Kzui8BCA/1777987727302.jpg)
Hace un tiempo que no salía de casa, ya que al no tener universidad no tenía ningun motivo, pero hoy he decido hacer una pequeña escapada para tratar de despejar la mente y salir un poco de la rutina al café Europa que es uno de mis favoritos en la ciudad.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP2z6j3qTgAJx29ShZ5KZTawgcUrKcQabPpn1QhF52exp/1777987628681.jpg)
Aquí le he pedido a la dependiente un té negro caliente como de costumbre y me lo trajeron bastante rápido, casi como si me hubiese estado esperando, algo por lo que siempre se ha caracterizado este establecimiento, además de un buen trato.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNgXAv9UVuQkLtpcTdKJ56v3mSEsm8jeTfeH83pBnZ12d/1777986840418.jpg)
A este le eché una sola cucharadita de azúcar blanca, aunque hubiese preferido un poco de miel, pero en esta ocasión no tenían y lo batí un rato para dejarlo refrescar un poco mientras observaba a la gran cantidad de personas y autos que transitaban por los alrededores del local y también a los niños jugando en el parque de al frente el local.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc2eUsjAgjQyPPTponMeWoeGgE1twsGy468rPxPRdidgN/1777986880909.jpg)
Después de mi breve espera pude disfrutar de este delicioso té, el cual tenía un sabor bastante fuerte. Siempre me ha gustado, dejándome ese gusto en mi boca durante un buen rato en mi viaje de vuelta a casa donde ya estaba pensando hacia dónde sería mi próxima salida, las cuales pienso hacer más a menudo gracias a esta hermosa experiencia que he encontrado en esta comunidad.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdj3zfYDj9ZWqQsmdLBHn89NmqhfdL4U5Vv9okWuMaqmd/1777986903411.jpg)
Espero ustedes también disfruten de un buen té y me recomienden algún otro considerando casi siempre me pido el negro. ###

>¡Muchas gracias por tu visita!

body.title: 𝑇ℎ𝑒 𝑡𝑎𝑠𝑡𝑒 𝑜𝑓 𝑚𝑦 𝑟𝑜𝑜𝑡𝑠.
body.body:
> Since I emigrated to Canada in 2010, my palate has grown accustomed to other wonderful flavours, other textures and, above all, to the nostalgia of empty chairs at Christmas. Thirteen years may not sound like much, but they amount to thousands of days longing for the warmth of the tropics and the bustle of a Venezuelan dinner table. That is why December 2023 was no ordinary month; it was the month when my camera and I finally returned to Valencia, in Carabobo State, to reconnect with what really matters: yes, family. This chronicle isn’t just about a meal; it’s about the ritual of being together. Our friends at Silver Bloggers invite us to recall a memorable meal, and for me, nothing will ever top the dinner at my younger brother Jhonny’s house.
# **
𝑇ℎ𝑒 𝑡𝑎𝑠𝑡𝑒 𝑜𝑓 𝑚𝑦 𝑟𝑜𝑜𝑡𝑠
** Even before the dishes reached the table, the kitchen was already a scene of joy. I looked through my camera’s viewfinder and felt as though time had stood still. In one of the first photos I took that day, I see the little girls of the house. There they are, with their bright smiles, holding a tray of freshly baked biscuits they had made themselves. Those treats weren’t just sweet; they carried the legacy of a tradition that refuses to die, despite the hardships of my beloved country. Seeing the new generation involved in the kitchen made me realise that, even though I was far away, the essence of our family remained intact. I only knew those little girls—Angie and Solisbeth—through video calls.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYU7rvFvsRS92zk3h2AqLRnnvBAYB1GS1Pym2YApzw2Di/1.jpeg)
Then, I captured the ‘behind the scenes’. In the second photograph, you can sense the movement, the beautiful chaos of a family preparing the feast. There are hands chopping, sorting, arranging. It is that moment beforehand when the scent of smoked banana leaves and the hallaca stew permeates even the walls. It is a hustle and bustle that I missed in Canada with a lump in my throat... the sound of laughter drowning out the clatter of pots and pans. And finally, the moment arrived. We sat down at the table. That third photograph I’m sharing with you is, for me, the very picture of happiness. There we were, ready to savour the quintessential national dish… yes, the hallaca, accompanied by its ever-present chicken salad.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYVXdqSkm2zEsYqQKNttSHTSeyWVj6NCZBufEBzeCoPBu/2.jpeg)
On the left, almost hidden by shyness and the angle of the shot, is my son Matthew. Next to him is his great-great-grandmother, Mrs Victoria (my brother’s mother-in-law); between them is the mischievous Solisbeth, Angie’s little sister, completing that generational picture that reminded me just how much everyone had grown whilst I was up north. And to think my visit was only supposed to last twenty days. In the centre of the picture, with a look that radiates peace, are my brother Jhonny and his wife Yusbeth, the hosts who opened their hearts to this reunion. We can also see my nephew Jhonny Alí, Angie’s father, and Angie herself, whose joy lit up the whole room.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWoBm7feMSBFdGM2q88KPtVSH7KCT2yL98Pa8eqTwgU7d/3.jpeg)
When I finally tasted the first bite of that hallaca, I savoured the flavour of the onoto that I had long forgotten, the raisins and the perfect stew... I felt the chill of thirteen Canadian winters melt away. Eating with my family, in my homeland, listening to the accents of my loved ones and feeling the warmth of Valencia, was an indescribable experience. That dinner was memorable because, after so long, I didn’t have to see them through a screen. I could smell the food, I could hug Jhonny, I could watch Matthew spending time with his cousins, and I could see for myself that, even if you leave Venezuela, Venezuela never leaves you. This is my entry for the [𝑆𝑖𝑙𝑣𝑒𝑟 𝐵𝑙𝑜𝑔𝑔𝑒𝑟𝑠](https://peakd.com/c/hive-106316/created) [𝑖𝑛𝑖𝑡𝑖𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑣𝑒](https://peakd.com/hive-106316/@hive-106316/the-silverbloggers-chronicles-prompt-45-memorable-meals-youve-ever-had). ***Because sometimes, a simple hallaca and a table full of loved ones are all we need to feel that, finally, we have come home, even if only for a few days.*** *** ***

물의 노래

맑은 샘물 흐르며  
부드러운 속삭임,  
바람에 실려오는  
자연의 노래.

작은 계곡 속에서  
돌과 나무를 감싸고,  
햇살 아래 반짝이며  
영원히 흐른다.

비 오는 날,  
구름의 눈물 되어  
땅을 적시고,  
새싹을 키운다.

물은 생명의 원천,  
모든 것의 시작,  
그리하여 우리는  
함께 노래한다.

body.title: Angry, and the next day regretful ...?
body.body:
>

There are moments in life that last three seconds and take years. What I'm talking about is the crudest example of something that happens to all of us in different versions, because the difference between him and anyone who has said something he shouldn't have, who has reacted in a way that he later regretted, who has lost control at the worst possible moment, is just the context, because the mechanism, is the same. What no one teaches us is that the *intense* emotion is not managed at the moment it explodes, it is managed before, in the process of understanding what is fueling it, of learning to sustain it when there is still time to choose, especially if the emotion is negative and drives us to make mistakes or do some harm to third parties, this I call premeditated emotion, and even sometimes with malice aforethought. Until we repent afterwards, we apologize, we assume the mistake; in the end repentance comes when the damage is already done, and there is no turning back. Look, what changes the story is not what we do after the mistake, (in fact that's the easy part) the real change is what we build before so that mistake doesn't happen. It seems a lie, but an outburst without previous work can cost a lot. Do you know why? Because repentance is not always enough to repair the damage caused. Aristotle, posed it in an almost surgical way in relation to rage, he says that anyone can get angry, and that's very easy, but that we can be able to graduate that energy of rage, anger, anger so that it is useful and not destructive is an *emotional mastery*. Anger, seen from a biological perspective, is simply an alarm signal that tells us that we have crossed a boundary or an injustice has been perceived. The problem arises when the reaction overflows and we lose the coherence between what we feel and how we express it. And that emotional mastery is trained, developed, and achieved with well-guided emotional work. *The real strength is knowing how to lose and keep building. I am going to share this personal experience with you...* Years ago a line manager, he told me, when he saw me very upset about something that had happened at level.I work in the managerial line of command *Jani, you are always right, and really the reason for your anger does not cease to be true, the problem is not that you are right or not, but in how you react* at that time I did not understand it, now with more than 30 years older (age), I understood and learned the lesson, with the help of professionals and my faith in myself (they are the perfect pair), I also learned that I can choose my battles better, that I must control my emotions, even in moments of despair. Being right and reacting well are two different things, and learning that, changes everything. Because the one who loses control by *getting angry* always pays more dearly, for the consequences, than the one who receives the damage, the lashing out. The worst thing about anger is not now but tomorrow when maybe you wake up regretful, but the damage has already been done, because regret comes alone, the difficult thing is to build before, so that there is nothing to regret... The impulse of anger comes from within and if we can avoid it, it's much better, because coherence, reasoning or reason always has to come sooner. Janitze.🌷
