body.title: My Magic Team in the Death Splinter
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVk3QFpZtMWj5GNNXGqTPPYYTExuyNvixQN2TkZ5bB3RX/image.png)



Hello Splinterlands summoners and welcome back to my blog!

Magic is especially effective in the lower levels because there's not much abilities unlocked to counter them yet. I've been using magic teams Water with the Frontier archon Marlai Singariel who buffs the team's magic attack. However, this team can be formed in all splinters. In today's post, I'll be highlighting the Death splinter magic team I'm using in Silver and Gold Leagues and how they can be effective in battle.

***

# Archon - Thalgrimore

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYVosgxbskUx3FbaSNJhRcYx9aNWu7yaHd9wYqpmyiHKt/image.png)

For players with limited budget, Thalgrimore is good enough. True, he is weaker than the core set or legendary archons but he is cheap to have at Silver and Gold levels. Even a max gold foil version will cost below $2. Compare that to the core set archons and you'll see the difference. He's not that bad as he debuffs the enemy team by decreasing their health by one. Combo it with another Frontier card, Sorrow Harvester and you already decreased the enemy's health by two even before the battle starts.

***

# Units

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcyAMeGTA4doV4bzXWRBBEWxnNmFXSuv2bpDbpjrHE6Fa/image.png)

I have a decent magic deck in my Death splinter that I use in battles interchangeably. Often I also use units from the Neutral splinter. 

## Grimshield Hexpriest

I recently bought and upgraded the Grimshield Hexpriest to level four. At this level he deals a high magic damage of three. He also has the Apex Strike ability that targets the enemy unit with the most power. To punish enemy magic attackers, he has the Magic Reflect ability. 

## Graybeard Warlock

Graybeard Warlock is a reward card that I also recently upgraded to four. He also has a high magic attack of three and has the Swiftness ability to increase the speed of the team. At level four, he gained the powerful  Execute ability that allows him to hit his target a second time when its health drops to two or below.

## Dark Arborist

I use the Dark Arborist in low mana battles. It deals decent magic damage and has two abilities. Demoralized decreases the enemy melee attack and Magic Reflect to return the enemy's magic attack.

## Arachne Weaver

The Arachne Weaver is a key card in many battles. It has a dual purpose of sustaining the team with its Corrupted Healing ability and it's also a card good for survival rulesets because of its Scavenger ability. It's health increases as enemy and allied units die.

## Silverleaf Warlock

Silverleaf Warlock is from the core set. It deals decent damage and has the Swiftness ability. I pair it with Gravebrand Warlock to increase the team's speed by two and enjoy the advantage of attacking first.

## Shadowfey Sheik and Little Sister

These two cards have similar attack stats and abilities. I often use these cards together in Earthquake rulesets because of their flying ability.

## Sorrow Harvester

The Sorrow Harvester is an epic card from the Frontier set. She deals decent damage and decreases the enemy's health with its Weaken ability. She's a good card to pair with the archon as they decrease the enemy team's health by two.

***

# Featured Battle

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc8ed7Yx2J5WMdM3JCq3fNfSVzNF6z2ZpHYwFU2gwe2jy/image.png)

I used most of the cards mentioned above in this battle save for the neutral card, Mindless Thrall. It also deals three magic damage and good to combo with the other magic units with three attack stats. I used the Escalation set card Doomshield Warden as my tank. 

The enemy also used a Death magic team that I didn't anticipate. In this case, he chose the better tank, Ujurak Brave. He's a key card in this battle because he decreases my team's magic attack with his Silence ability. On the other hand, my tank's ten health will quickly be decimated by the enemy team's strong magic attack. 

The early round were rough as my tank was quickly defeated. Grimshield Hexpriest took the tank role and returned some damage with his Magic Reflect ability. Thankfully, the enemy didn't have a healer in the team. My team had to defeat the enemy's Taunt unit first and then Ujurak Brave by round two to remove the debuff. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma3Gn8r9qVDCSSciXo9cbLvijLnwYWAjrJ2a38RRUMUtt/image.png)

At this point, the tide is turning in my direction as the enemy team had lower health while my Arachne Weaver has increased its health to seven and still increasing as more units die. When the enemy's Warborn Shaman was defeated, victory was assured for my team. 

[Replay the Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_9a6116b96bf7a30a953fd5ae2dee27d9?ref=logen9f)

***

# Come Play Splinterlands!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAX3xcPAwc8omveh7imyKtqbHntKgVLqLckGTCHSjPyw/image.png)

Start your Splinterlands adventure today with my [referral](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=logen9f). You can play the game for free in the Frontier Mode or take your game to the next level by purchasing a spellbook. Buying a spellbook allows you to earn SPS tokens and use the  market to sell in game assets. Also, we will both get 500 Credits which can be used top purchase cards once you buy a spellbook.

body.body:
I was just heading to CS Park, Market road, located at the street behind my office. I needed to catch up with a friend, who was already waiting there, so I was kind of hurrying along. 

A few steps away from my office building, I saw these guys standing by the road, caught up in their own worlds. Apparently, they're factory or construction workers, judging by their yellow hardhats or protective 

Both of them had one thing in common — they were holding sachet water. One was drinking, eyes fixed on his phone. The other was just holding it casually.  



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYCpV8n1BTho3uSwScGJPuVh5K6NV6Uny5Pq3YxhFAN4f/1778012992066.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeuqNxyBiw65SxttghqYQZAA6QWjXmi8r5SA9gNXCSj5B/1778012991863.jpg)

body.title: Panda inspirado en Lily Shieldpaw. (ESP/ENG)
body.body:
Saludos amigos de la comunidad creativa Hivediy, bienvenidos una vez más a mi blog, un gusto saludarles espero se encuentren bien, y que esta semana sea productiva y bendecida, por mi parte esta semana ha sido un poco difícil ya que nos cambiaron el horario en el hospital y ahora debo ir todos los días, un poco complicado pero aquí seguimos.

>Greetings friends of the Hivediy creative community, welcome once again to my blog. It's a pleasure to greet you all, and I hope you are well, and that this week is productive and blessed. For me, this week has been a bit difficult since they changed our schedule at the hospital and now I have to go every day. It's a bit complicated, but we're still here.



https://images.ecency.com/DQmRiwCM66KzrXzp9UziY3QNfaFYv9zv9Z64wCVTFX5jzwT/1001449617.jpg



En esta oportunidad les quiero compartir un bonito oso panda inspirado en la carta Lily Shieldpaw de Splinterlands, en esta carta se muestran tres figuras distintas entre ellas el panda, por lo que decidí elaborarlo en limpiapipas.



>This time I want to share with you a cute panda bear inspired by the Lily Shieldpaw card from Splinterlands. This card shows three different figures, including the panda, so I decided to make it out of pipe cleaners.


<center>
![Lily Shieldpaw.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcU4LBJHghWtqRsCdxVjPWY6ZgZnQXgQVYyGxS1vAi1Ss/Lily%20Shieldpaw.png)
[Lily Shieldpaw](https://www.splintercards.com/chaos_core_lily-shieldpaw) 
</center>


Este osito es súper facil de realizar y lo puedes llevar como llavero a donde quieras, les muestro el tutorial y los materiales que utilicé, espero les pueda servir útil en algún momento.

>This little bear is super easy to make and you can take it with you as a keychain wherever you go. I'll show you the tutorial and the materials I used; I hope it might be useful to you at some point.

<center>
![ezgif-59850fa59e0bb620.gif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ3b8cZNpiS2iEdihZH4XHkfG14Adacn7dPZGAxDtTJRZ/ezgif-59850fa59e0bb620.gif)
</center>



![1000100308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQX1QCU8EKjdgAjeZpBNuDdZqxkg2pWGQEVHPRjdtuyPX/1000100308.png)



| Materiales|Materials|
| --------|---------|
| Limpiapipas blanco, negro|White and black pipe cleaners|
| Tijera, silicón | Scissors, silicone |
| Esfera de anime #3|Anime Sphere #3 |
| Encendedor|Lighter|


![1001445147.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23vsSN23GvmT7NYMKMiAHvMHzoM8vfmCLVp9UxCwm491sgE1bpQWU363msAza42JT8nTN.jpg)


![1000100308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQX1QCU8EKjdgAjeZpBNuDdZqxkg2pWGQEVHPRjdtuyPX/1000100308.png)



### *Paso a paso*
#



El primer paso que voy a realizar será seleccionar las dos esferas de anime #3 ambas las vamos a aplanar un poco y para la cabeza vamos a afinar un poco en la parte superior. También puedes utilizar servilletas y adhesivo para formar el cuerpo si no tienes anime.


>The first step I'm going to take is to select the two #3 anime spheres. We're going to flatten both of them a little, and for the head, we'll thin them out a bit at the top. You can also use napkins and glue to form the body if you don't have anime.



|![1001445177.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23vi21M3n4cdNN9kR6oVQSA1Ud6LzwAMMGMmSSopCBY812ED5AMp49cxKVB5kKRmZeDo3.jpg)|![1001445178.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23uFVb71GodvqykpYiN9phYxS3Byg2zi9GxuBrhURaPbneGx6v18Ped78CrAWSPGLVGQd.jpg)|![1001445201.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23uQvSFhsUruBnWtotRGuxrjtfayu6wLgUN3FfHYH29AL6iG2BYp4wEQGkH3CvS34ABe1.jpg)|
|-|-|-|




Ahora vamos a comenzar a cubrir con limpiapipas blanco toda la cabeza, así mismo cubrimos el cuerpo y en la parte inferior terminamos de cubrir con limpiapipas negro. Puedes elegir o no enrollar los limpiapipas en un palillo.

>Now we're going to start covering the entire head with white pipe cleaners, then the body, and finally the bottom with black pipe cleaners. You can choose whether or not to wrap the pipe cleaners around a toothpick.


|![1001445202.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23vi1x1DqLdxSFB9oct2fqFMWsUm99v9Kknvd3ghNcQJkG71Pm4A4MGKmSRdV63d7unzd.jpg)|![1001445243.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23w2qZLAt87FJxtg12CZw3pkgUbgT4W9EcobGTMAfb6nyJTrMcKPbGUBRYpSfxAy1Cj4b.jpg)|![1001445302.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23uQvjbDDeBTkbn8VLZ5npdxCB4wZZ6tunSR8EXbwVrdopsdgqyt5tAD1ChWKgiyydYE8.jpg)|
|-|-|-|




Para la cabeza realicé las orejitas en color negro, pegamos de ambos lados, y luego unimos la cabeza con el cuerpo, ahora vamos a realizar los brazos para esto debemos cortar una pequeña pieza de limpiapipas negro y cubrimos hasta que quede gruesa.



>For the head I made the little ears in black, we glued them on both sides, and then we joined the head to the body. Now we are going to make the arms. For this we must cut a small piece of black pipe cleaner and cover it until it is thick.


|![1001445202.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23vi1x1DqLdxSFB9oct2fqFMWsUm99v9Kknvd3ghNcQJkG71Pm4A4MGKmSRdV63d7unzd.jpg)|![1001445243.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23w2qZLAt87FJxtg12CZw3pkgUbgT4W9EcobGTMAfb6nyJTrMcKPbGUBRYpSfxAy1Cj4b.jpg)|![1001445302.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23uQvjbDDeBTkbn8VLZ5npdxCB4wZZ6tunSR8EXbwVrdopsdgqyt5tAD1ChWKgiyydYE8.jpg)|
|-|-|-|




Ahora vamos a realizar las patitas realizamos dos círculos y pegamos para cada patita, para la carita realizamos los ojitos en color negro y en el centro un punto blanco.


>Now we're going to make the little legs. We make two circles and glue one for each leg. For the face, we make the eyes in black and a white dot in the center.


|![1001445310.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23xAXVoCuWW1uDNs5Fd47fGRG4XQGZuzsRvcfFS9rPVk517y4XqKJX2zUzZyr1cvsLgpW.jpg)|![1001445313.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23vsSgx3FySYkdjvX49w2TjWq8dUcARxGT7UdYvySpEcvmBNiqi9QqGnJytq8VBxkUVC2.jpg)|
|-|-|


|![1001445334.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23wX1YUZa5PMdXCYqtT3JNbZmkdPZeBVe7NXKqtbAAYT4tUDEZthQCuXQEvV4iSStsdSU.jpg)|![1001445348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23wCEJTcUS2bfVrjpG8VGvaEYa9miG3QxNP7Qkvc5n2kUdFysP9R2Cj3mZ3ziS5zeBjQS.jpg)|
|-|-|





También realicé la nariz en color blanco y negro, y listo, de esta forma terminé este panda inspirado en Lily Shieldpaw, espero les haya gustado el resultado, muchas gracias por el apoyo y por visitar mi publicación, nos vemos en una próxima oportunidad con más ideas creativas.



>I also made the nose in black and white, and that's it! This is how I finished this panda inspired by Lily Shieldpaw. I hope you liked the result. Thank you so much for your support and for visiting my post. See you next time with more creative ideas!


|![1001445358.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23w2qUu5Wqnqv5k25Kuv4d2eNRUGxn1NyqkWqGuxfwcYRTmwMGiAAd1sYprkUCW5DjPtk.jpg)|![1001445364.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23wqnKs2ab2AcT1VDD5rrrHQ2CT9tU3uGHcFw67kpanjwVh3644x2ihCoMoJjbSBSJHsP.jpg)|![1001445369.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23wMaSnDocCuPaneAufx5dGhRf3ptLGD8LqGY41FF5gfCz7aXMCx2GfwxXUhSArSx1BE8.jpg)|
|-|-|-|





Más del resultado final:
>More on the final result:


![1001449135.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/Eo4D3WcFYBcoQqbVpahMTFexdWpe4tZSmHvtjiCoETXBfVirtN4YCMFHXgeq5pB8fWw.jpg)

![1001449146.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23tmKwBZTg3MTL1istvwfK2L4zCbyumRbdspAndZxo3oLVCLna9ADVGN8zdJhdZ5tc8qo.jpg)



![1000100308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQX1QCU8EKjdgAjeZpBNuDdZqxkg2pWGQEVHPRjdtuyPX/1000100308.png)




![1000095868.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWG8Jt6SU3neCCGF5ZCDw8KzpFGS63KR5cYgcCEoKEYgi/1000095868.png)

I mean, I hate the market position we are in more than anything you could ever imagine. Its one of the top 3 things I hate most in life. In no particular order.
 
1. Americans calling football soccer
2. Kurtzman Star Trek
3. Hive at 6 cents

But I see more people having an opinion on whats funded at these low prices and even if its coming from an unwillingness to make an investment I want to hear why that is. For better or worse, I have never been one at a loss of words when it comes to a discussion. 😅
I could do corpo-talk easily here. Its easy but dishonest. People know me too well here already. 
 
There is a saying in Croatia paraphrasing: \

Not calling anyone a donkey but the point is, if theres even remote value in a criticism, in any feedback, it is valuable to listen. So for those that are reluctant, tell me why...   

Ultimately, proposal or no proposal, Im just a die hard Hiver that will do his absolute best to make this chain a success and if anyone sees where we might fail, although I have utter confidence we will not, anything that would help us succeed, help Hive succeed, I am all ears for. Its not just funding, its about where we want to end up as a chain tomorrow. Thats what Magi is. Its a chance, a good one at that.

title.title: I Am #AliveAndThriving Today! || #IAmAliveChallenge || Daily Off-Grid Jungle Journal Entry: Day #1376 - A Deeper Dive into the Hermes AI Agent - GaiaYoga Gardens, Lower Puna, Far East Big Island, Hawai'i - Monday, May 4, 2026
title.body: ![Hive-Banner-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tGM7REKBsvoBhPiEV5Fvb8tb333qQ8N9x2YfxaF9vWohE9Qf39RUEAn3LfysdgfbYpZ.png) ![1000027360.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wWs6baE264yxQptqjHvpRCd4k8WAEfn9GTMReFHE6GGtcRUQNAaugexVnydimtVpf2f.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) >I live naked and barefooted, very close to Earth and Nature, in an 18-acre, off-grid, clothing-optional, food-forest intentional community ([GaiaYoga Gardens](https://gaiayoga.org)), way out in the jungles of Lower Puna, far East Big Island, Hawai'i, and I have for more than 7 years now. Although there are many challenges, I love my life, and I'm immensely grateful to live where and how I do, on my own terms! I would not want to live any other way! 😁🙏💚⚡💥🔥✴️✳️❇️👣🌱✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ``` Hive Debt: 23.48% HIVE Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.075 USD HBD/HIVE-Backed Dollar Fiat-Dollar Price: 1.023 USD ALIVE SWAP.HIVE Price: 0.02845686 SWAP.HIVE HEARTBEAT ALIVE Price: 0.1068501 ALIVE BLURT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.00121553 USD QORT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.158999 USD VOI Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.0001703 USD BTC/Bitcoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 81,503.95 USD BCH/Bitcoin Cash Fiat-Dollar Price: 454.57 USD LTC/Litecoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 55.715 USD Gold Fiat-Dollar Price: 4,580.10 USD Silver Fiat-Dollar Price: 73.74 USD Ranking for Our @aliveandmmb Witness Node: #130 (among all witnesses, including inactive)/#101 (among active witnesses only)/471.3k HP in votes/49 votes in total ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) Warm greetings all! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 Today I wanted to go a bit more deeply into the still-very-new Hermes (*AI*) Agent, which was only released on February 26,2026, and which in that time has been developed, and garnered attention, extremely quickly, with over 132,000 stars, and rising, on Github. It's free, and open source under the MIT license, with a very-easy installation and setup on Linux, MacOS, Windows, and even in Android, as well as a huge degree of configuration flexibility. It learns, remembers, and self-improves over time, as it accomplishes tasks, creating new skills on the fly as the situation requires. It's like OpenClaw, but far simpler and easier to set up, and from my personal perspective, far better. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![1000027362.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wC5hXZQbbc96566CGd5uakxFjquGEdmMykZ1GddnGaY3Neev4avTjcL2gysdike57RA.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![1000027363.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23u67UuHtEhKKAMT834k3vsipLFkse8Jh6Ryz6e2yGS2k5jdz9aC6XbXK98e7Awv43BYk.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Given how new Hermes is, I was shocked too see the large number of videos and articles about it already. I've only been working with it for about 4 days now, and it's one of the most incredible software implementations that I've ever seen, and with its very-rapid development cycle, it's getting better with every new iteration. When I said that the pace of development in AI-tech is faster than in any other tech domain in which I've had experience, I mean it. We're talking days or weeks, not months or years. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![1000027364.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23u6584YP6XUUvka7uTdCNEHvbWn9iZtnU367MWEzsANszcXNRmYq3F2Q35aUMjuRRydU.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![1000027365.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tSNDy7WuKyKzxzvAmJ77JxPrDYhjUPWuMrmM46ekzLa1h6Tiw55rQq6bjunYC2K3vLX.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Hermes can be used with both assorted paid cloud-based AI models, or those running from local machines, and it works with a great number of model inference engines, both cloud-based and locally-installed, so it's an exceedingly flexible framework, while at the same time being amazingly simple and easy to use. It's truly an extraordinary piece of software, and it's very much got my rapt attention. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![1000027366.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23u5bTvCoKAFLnzQg6tFkYegroBeFMCcKoXAC1rqYXHLZhxn4SPUWH5WDb2D3eDtGA7fB.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![1000027367.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wCE28SXXkCyweYe11W3jEAeRy5taQTzoCZzrbUp1a7nz1dp6vCTDEjpvyL3uFiJ3rEF.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Hermes can work as one individual agent, that handles all tasks, or it can be set up with an orchestraror-workers topology, where one top-level supervisor agent interacts with the user, and delegates tasks to different specialized agents, to collaborate and accomplish a particular goal. The orchestraror-workers dynamic is what I want to build, though I'm still assertaining whether that is practically feasible on my laptop. One AI model operating at a time is fine on my system, running more than one simulataneously gets a bit more challenging, however, due to hardware-resource constraints. I do pretty well, though, even with my modest setup. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![1000027368.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wMWS2QECmEwj4uHsqoXobmpVDdjMyhPhV2ZMF3PWrJqhBVGD63WwMKUSrDyX8Kr2P9K.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![1000027369.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tmL5Nr9tMUfiAQG2UZGipxERidELRoe2AKY8QqbqBksj9R4DDsYYoFa8wo13rDbZX5s.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) I've begun to read every bit of the official documentation on Hermes, and to assess everything that I can find that describes people's experiences using and setting it up. I want to learn how to use it well, and to its full potential, on my laptop, and although I do have hardware constraints, what is possible is still quite mind blowing indeed. If you're interested in exploring Hermes, and would like to give it a try, I suggest heading over to their [***Github page***](https://github.com/nousresearch/hermes-agent), to their [***main website***](https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com), and if you want to get an idea of the sorts of skills that are available to Hermes, go take a peek at their [***SkillHub Wiki***](https://deepwiki.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/8.2-skills-hub). This is the kind of technology that changes everything. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![1000027370.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tSWksU82Efef58iZKvLVapEzCYveDknu1QG3dPte1gKWMocAErfubRzXUYstptfvGQV.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![1000027371.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23w2mSDnsJnXUHZtksmQX8Qbt7aGcZrP2LmPkpiRWteQ78ghPf8jrtN29qwZEKesPfwyX.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Yesterday, Monday, I left the Flow House, after finishing up my Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, and working a bit more with Hermes, very late again, by around 3:45PM, giving my attention first to some photography for my posts, and to a few small jungle-community tasks. Once those were completed, I took a quick break up at the Flow House, before heading across the property, to assist Melekai and Østein to move and position lava rocks, some of them huge, around Melekai's new pond. Ano helped in moving and positioning a particularly massive lava boulder. After wrapping that up, I traversed the property again to take a shower, make myself some food in Wabisabi, collect my jar of leftover superfood fire coffee, and finally to head back to the Flow House, to work a little more with Hermes, and to begin my evening Hive tasks. I got through all of my notifications by about 11:30PM, and for the first time in ages, I skipped asset management, worked with Hermes a bit more, then I went to bed super late, by around 1AM. I woke up by about 6:15AM, having slept reasonably well, working with Hermes, doing more AI research, going to make my superfood fire coffee in Wabisabi, then returning to the Flow House to watch a few YouTube videos on Hermes, and to write this post. It's now just after 1:45PM, so it's a great time to wrap this up, so that I may attend to my few other important Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, before leaving the Flow House a little later in the afternoon, to focus first on some photography for my posts, and then on jungle-community/land work and tasks. I deeply appreciate y'all so very much! Until my very-late goals-and-progress update later this evening, and the next manifestation of these posts tomorrow! ***Always forward, onward, upward, and whaleward, ho, together we go!*** 😁🙏💚✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![1000027375.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uFTybJFvVDPQqf2LQk7jBhPrK9YJ7eNaJk7gaSyA7GHdGfY231sV83FPfw3dRtghxue.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![1000027377.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wX5QzS8ZBuzAZRsNUUsgbUpc3yofjs7JhxN3c8HpZ4TBcsfWNtVq9j41mrNes2C2RwZ.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ### 2026 Life Goals ``` 1.) Do regular integral practices again, alone or with others. 2.) Prepare regular batches of my medicinal teas collected from the land again. 3.) Make my plant nursery, and the gardens, beautiful again. 4.) Begin learning relevant coding/programming languages to more fully contribute to the sovereignty-driven technologies where I am active, like Arch Linux, Hive, Qortal, DeSo, and Bastyon. ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) *All photos were taken with my **Motorola G Play 2024 Android Phone**.* ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1RxBbudG9rt2dp1cGCcDqm1HJsmhBZUTJ8yUepXHTDRdUuVF5MhuePSiKAaiqqoQ.png) Thank you all so much who have helped me get to where I am today, and allowing me to share more of the beauty and magic from my life and my world with you, and for your continuous appreciation and support! I am truly deeply grateful! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1RxBbudG9rt2dp1cGCcDqm1HJsmhBZUTJ8yUepXHTDRdUuVF5MhuePSiKAaiqqoQ.png) If you'd like to find me on other alternative platforms where I have accounts (I spend most of my time here on ***Hive***), click on this signature image below to go to my *LinkTree* page. title.title: Wtorek skręcania półek
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTXpbmffGhxW6WJQnALpUHxWbtvgLoyKydA8gJEdEmAQL/dfuns_2026_05_06_012109eadac2777493.jpg)

Pod koniec kwietnia zrealizowałem pomysł, który chodził mi po głowie od jakiegoś czasu. A mianowicie, aby zrobić półki z kartonowych pudeł (zostaje ich bardzo dużo po napojach), postawić je na szafie i powkładać do nich książki. Jak pomyślałem, tak zrobiłem. No i z pewnością było to lepsze rozwiązanie niż sterty książek stojące ot tak, ale jednak dalekie od optimum. Przede wszystkim kartony pod ciężarem książek się uginały trochę. Nie stały też wystarczająco stabilnie i miałem obawy, że kiedyś przy jakimś uderzeniu w szafę mogę runąć. Niestety nie mam żadnego zdjęcia. Konstrukcję widać trochę na powyższym zdjęciu. Tak czy owak zacząłem szukać alternatyw. Najpierw jakiś skrzynek drewnianych. Ostatecznie jednak trafiłem na regały. Rozmiar idealny. Zamówiłem 8. Wczoraj przyszły.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRsR2Kr6PVCzFATjkUcNB4ASPWnbWsVHQjLxsuSKRJEdM/dfuns_2026_05_05_233523584a7e466668.jpg)

No i chyba kolejnym zakupem będzie wózek, bo trochę mam już dość noszenia ciężkich paczek z Żabki. Zwłaszcza, gdy przychodzi ich kilka w jeden dzień.

Same regały sprawdziły się całkiem dobrze. 4 wylądowały już na szafie. 4 zamierzam powiesić gdzieś na ścianach. Przydadzą się, bo \

książek po ostatnim przemeblowaniu wciąż jest sporo... 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc7dXXyca8RqVYnRdJvqtScfSWPuyDdWgj6v1jEUZ4QWU/dfuns_2026_05_06_014125c570feffa74c.jpg)

Co ciekawe wczoraj nie było żadnego otwartego wydarzenia a frekwencja i tak była wysoka. Powoli dochodzimy do stanu, w którym ludzie przychodzą do KBK niezależnie czy coś się dzieje. Czasem przychodzą specjalnie, czasem wpadają bo akurat byli w pobliżu. Bardzo cieszy mnie ta tendencja...

title.title: 开工啦
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![ljGqtA1JLvqhLgHR_bxt9.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/alpha-omega/images/ljGqtA1JLvqhLgHR_bxt9/ljGqtA1JLvqhLgHR_bxt9.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

今天是五月五号，全国人民都在假期最后一天往回赶路的时候，我已经复工了。早上起床后准备了一顿简单的早饭，然后慢悠悠的来到公司，不出所料公司几乎没人，一直到9点以后才陆陆续续来了几个同事。上午处理了一些工作上的事情，很快就到了午饭时间。今天园区只有我们一家公司上班，其它公司都休息，食堂肯定不开放，去哪里吃饭好呢。我原本想着骑电动车去稍微远点地方，后来看到马路前面有移动小贩们，就走过去瞧瞧。

来到移动小贩处转了一圈，没有特别想吃的，于是拐个弯继续往前走，来到公司楼背面的饮食一条街。转了一圈决定吃羊肉泡馍，一碗要25块钱有点小贵。今天特别晒，打开手机一看最高温度飙到了30度，而且今天是立夏，也该热起来了。吃完午饭回到公司还是很热，貌似没开空调，一问才知道今天就连物业都没上班，空调归物业管，所以肯定没开放。没办法，热就热点吧。

下午摸了一会鱼，然后又开始干活，但是太热了干活效率不高。好不容易挨到下班，外面刮起了风，看天气预报显示明天下雨。孩子妈和孩子坐晚上高铁返程，10点半到站。我在家洗了个澡，把孩子书包收拾好。等到晚上9点下楼开车去车站，趁着五一假期期间还能免费跑高速。接到孩子妈和孩子已经快11点了，一脚油门上高速，赶在凌晨12点之前下了高速。回到家已经很晚了，赶紧睡觉，明天就恢复到正常生活节奏啦。

---

For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@alpha-omega/5mfu8d)

title.title: An Update of My Life: The Reasons of My Inactivity in the Past Few Weeks! God Bless Everyone! 😇🙌🤗
title.body: **Have a Blessed Day to all ASEAN Hivers and all my Fellow Hivers all over the World!** It has been more than two weeks the last blog post that I've shared here in the community. For today, I will be sharing the reasons why I wasn't active this past weeks. I have two main reasons to share with all of you but the second one which I will discuss here will be the main reason of my inactive status for the past few weeks. Before I get started sharing the reasons, let me give thanks and appreciate first above all, my ever supportive supporters here in the community, and I just hope this will continue more and more. Note: In my blog post today, you may see pictures of my which needs guidance especially to minors. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUSeNbpvYgxT6PKd3AgChSfrcd8QfbSh3YxGi7CS4eWRh/1778022292222.png) It is my happiness in every time I came here in the community to share my daily life events, as it is my way to express and to give thanks to God for such an opportunity to attend an events or activities. I am also happy to share those events and activities in my life, as I do believe that it will give encouragement and inspiration to everyone who will come to support me and especially to those who will read my content. But unfortunately, this past few days, more than two weeks to be exact, I am inactive and today, I will be sharing here the reasons why I am inactive. The first reason why, is due to a 4 days Summer Youth Camp from April 21-24, 2026, in which I am too busy from this days and not be able to share the happenings during the events here in the community. I have too many pictures captured during the event, and I will be going to share it still here but not now, in the coming days. I just hope, everyone will still support my blog posts featuring the 4 days Summer Youth Camp events. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmURtRaqZ7N2NqdvhNDV2xbExYmcCwTHLcGA1YB7ieE4iq/1778022837938.jpg) Now, here is the main reason why I am inactive for more than two weeks. It is because of the unexpected Motorcycle Accident that happened to me just after the Summer Youth Camp. No one ever asked this accident may happen in our life, even to me, but I do believe that everything that happens in our life, God has a reason and I am still thankful to God for He never leave me in this unforgettable happening in my life. A short story about the accident, it happens last April 25, 2026 when I attended an overnight prayer. It was around 2:00 AM when it happened when we going back home. I am not the driver, I am just a back rider. Unfortunately the Motorcycle of my friend's break was gone and we don't know the reason. The road we drove is a high hill which makes us very fast going down and we don't have control in the motorcycle anymore. Then the accident happened, and when I woke up, I was in the hospital as shown in the picture captured by my cousin who rescued us. This is the first time it happened to me and I just hope and pray that this will not happen to me anymore and also to anyone for it is not easy that an accident may happen to us. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPZCffe8QztQwTTKzmYZZ6J2RyjMXs4ddYEYRwJ84mPdF/1778023515037.jpg) When I was in the hospital, I am already awake and I already know what happened surround me. I was then undergo with different Laboratory procedures in order to know what may happen or effects to my body. The Laboratory Procedures are X-ray and thank God everything is clear and no fractures happened to me. Next one is the Ultrasound to checked my internal organs and again thank God everything is good. Another Laboratory Procedure is an Eye Checkup by the Opthalmologist. They said that their is no blood inside my eyes but needs full check up as an eye root is growing unusual as to the normal. Last Laboratory Procedure that happened to me is the CT Scan to check my head knowing that I have a head injury. The results was out and found out that it is still good even though their is a small blood clot in my head but can be treated by medicine and rest. I was now then admitted in the hospital for three days for observation and when I was in the hospital. I am thankful to God for the miracle and blessings He give to me. Also thankful to all who helped when I was still in the hospital. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRdPCgngdAXLfrmQMmt4W6vQ31JBGr3Bpp1sE2fMAK8TZ/1778024147958.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfBjrogJcj7TnZMgN87pjHZC5neTqrVVcf1NA5rfs5V1Q/1778024148025.jpg) It has been more than a week since the motorcycle accident happened to me. I am still in the process of healing and recovering but thank God I am now much better than before. I can now walked and do other house chores and I am very much thankful to God. I can now write a blog post but I must say that it may not be always but make sure I'll be dropping here from time to time. Above all, even this happened in my life. God is still so good all the time in my life. He give me an extension of life to enjoy and to give glory to Him. I will always give praise and honor to God alone. This would be all for today's post, and until next time again, I just want to thank everyone in advance who will drop by on my blog post. **To God be all the Glory!** 😇🙌☝️ **Your Friend** **_@godlovermel25_**

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cinco_de_Mayo

>Cinco de Mayo has its roots in the second French intervention in Mexico, which took place in the aftermath of the 1846–48 Mexican–American War and the 1858–61 Reform War. The Reform War was a civil war that pitted Liberals (who believed in separation of church and state and freedom of religion) against Conservatives (who favored a tight bond between the Catholic Church and the Mexican state).

I don't label myself as Liberal nor Conservative but I am in favor of separation of church and state.

Especially when the church in question was forced on the people.

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_the_Catholic_Church_in_Mexico

So I thought about it, researched it, and this is what I found out.

Let's all try to respect each other and not force things on each other.

\

- The Beatles.

Happy day and week to all!

title.title: Encuentro de Talentos // Ser libre// (Esp/Eng)
title.body:
---
_Feliz y bendecido día_ >_Happy and blessed day_

![El texto del párrafo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wWyGo3pWL4tDb5FQVmekGauV7jZWgcFCk3bwSTT63NK3wUf6Aab8q4Wb86koct4i7cs.jpg)

>


¡Hola, amigos! Como todos los martes, estoy aquí en **Encuentro de Talentos** por invitación de nuestra querida amiga @angelica7, esta vez con un tema que nos invita a reflexionar. Se trata de **ser libre**. Sinceramente, cuando leo o escucho la palabra \

, levanto los brazos como si estuviera a punto de volar como una gaviota o un pájaro que extiende sus alas para ser libre en esta vida y ser feliz. Este tema abarca realmente muchas cosas, ya que ser libre significa no estar atado, amar libremente, vivir como uno desea, sin miedo ni prejuicios, sin tanta vanidad. Ya que ser libre significa dejar atrás lo malo y vivir el momento, ser libre es desprenderse de lo que más nos atormenta y liberarnos de todas esas cadenas que nos atan al pasado y nos impiden vivir. Ser libre es un espacio que los seres humanos necesitamos para estar en paz y a gusto con nosotros mismos. Muchas personas no se sienten libres porque se sienten atadas y atormentadas; otras temen a su pasado, o tal vez se encuentran prisioneras de sí mismas o encerradas en una celda por haber cometido un delito. Estas personas anhelan ser libres, al igual que los animales necesitan la libertad; las aves, también, necesitan ser libres. Si se las mantiene en una jaula, todos deseamos esa libertad para alzar el vuelo y sentirnos a salvo; por eso doy gracias cada día por ser libre. Soy libre porque decido mi propio destino, porque no vivo para complacer a los demás y porque encuentro mi paz conectando con las puestas de sol y los elementos naturales. Me siento agradecida por vivir en libertad, sabiendo que viviré libremente, sin miedo, en armonía y amor. Soy libre porque vivo según mis propios términos y no según los de los demás. Gracias por la alegría de poder vivir en libertad. Por eso valoro mi libertad porque decido lo que quiero y no espero nada de nadie por mis creencias, mis valores y mis pensamientos que me hacen vibrar positivamente. Así pues, amigos míos, es importante que disfrutemos de nuestra libertad, porque cuando empecemos a envejecer, cuando el cansancio nos venza y cuando nuestros pies ya no puedan llevarnos y tengamos que depender de los demás, serán el tiempo y otras personas quienes tomen las decisiones por nosotros. Será entonces cuando realmente hayamos perdido nuestra libertad. Por eso, debemos disfrutar de ella en este instante, sin prejuicios, ni miedos. Ser libre es lo mejor.
![1000424720.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23u67Bepzqe39A9sdnzsERZokjrs61zBnoPvgnD7bQSEkFgKUrr92JLUH3SBJ9pehqm67.jpg) ![1000439494.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vsSMcMbenQXBqJGEijozQbYZ6rnNmQ1PsNmn6igG9jkHK58KX1ro2Eu1qsHyCCLQTnd.jpg)
--- # English --- Hello, friends! Just like every Tuesday, I’m here on **Encuentro de Talentos** at the invitation of our dear friend @angelica7, this time with a topic that invites us to reflect. It’s about **being free**. Honestly, when I read or hear the word “free,” I raise my arms as if I were about to fly like a seagull or a bird spreading its wings to be free in this life and be happy. This topic really covers a lot of ground, since being free means not being tied down, loving freely, living as one wishes, without fear or prejudice, without so much vanity. Since being free means leaving the bad behind and living in the moment, being free is letting go of what torments us most and freeing ourselves from all those chains that bind us to the past and prevent us from living. Being free is a space that we humans need to be at peace and at ease with ourselves. Many people do not feel free because they feel bound and tormented; others fear their past, or perhaps find themselves prisoners of their own minds or locked in a cell for having committed a crime. These people long to be free, just as animals need freedom; birds, too, need to be free. If kept in a cage, we all long for that freedom to take flight and feel safe; that is why I give thanks every day for being free. I am free because I decide my own destiny, because I do not live to please others, and because I find my peace by connecting with sunsets and the natural elements. I am grateful to live in freedom, knowing that I will live freely, without fear, in harmony and love. I am free because I live on my own terms and not on those of others. Thank you for the joy of being able to live in freedom. That is why I value my freedom—because I decide what I want and expect nothing from anyone regarding my beliefs, my values, and my thoughts that make me vibrate positively. So, my friends, it is important that we enjoy our freedom, because when we begin to grow old, when fatigue gets the better of us, and when our feet can no longer carry us and we have to depend on others, it will be time and other people who make decisions for us. That is when we will have truly lost our freedom. That is why we must enjoy it right now, without prejudice or fear. Being free is the best thing.

title.title: And More Windows – May 3, 2026@goldenoakfarm
title.body:
![Windows - living room trashed crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/Ep3eFzRVExNG6KLjfuSS9mNtzcSeiudFvfWa1sZh4gSra7joFGCbPMpaZALWzuiZZXT.jpg)

On Sunday morning I got up at 5AM and got a load in the dishwasher then worked on editing photos until 6AM. I started moving stuff in the living room because my brother was going to help me do the outside windows and the roundtop was first.

I moved all the plants to the dining room table then dismantled the shelves and lights. 

The window after that was the awning in the kitchen and that just took a couple minutes.

![Robin and eggs in azalea collage text crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/241tbC2R3NbDCxCUSqApHFKDGHx4cU4uPzWJm8o31XaaWe67ae2vj53QgkbUK7nYeypbt.jpg)

But when I went to pull up shades at 7AM, I discovered a robin on a nest in the azalea. She had 3 eggs. The photos were taken at a sharp angle through the dirty window, so that’s as good as it got.

I got the screens from the bedroom and pantry as they are never taken out and vacuumed them really well.  Next I took out all the rest of the screens I’d put in during April and got all the grills off the windows.

I had started washing the grills when my brother came down, so we got started.  Because the momma robin was next to one of the windows, I decided to not wash it this time around. So we only had 5 to do and finished in about an hour.

I sat down for a while then got up and started putting things back together. Once all the plants and lights were back, I had to water all the seedlings. That finished me off.

![Last of load of kindling crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23x16sAKahX7KxJFcndPs5TcTZwwyst9H36BNhjwuuHjNDENLBLs4hfM4CuCFeypJnt1J.jpg)

Later in the afternoon, my son and his friend finished unloading the truck of kindling and got the bagged kindling down in the freezer room. There weren’t as many bags as I thought there would be.

I spent the evening watching ‘My Favorite Martian’ until bedtime at 8PM.

On Monday my window guy is supposed to come for 9AM. I plan to get as many of f the office windows done as I can, and maybe a few of the living room too. That will definitely finish me off. It’s to be a beautiful day, in the 70’s, but I will be inside.

![Mini bio framed Jan 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyn876JURgHHjsp757ZTvXeEEBjdDeLXWynRcLCeuqwPPsqtEtXTosSPyKZdAgWivJB.jpg)

title.title: Como preparo mis comidas para la semana [ESP-ENG]
title.body: >Hola querida comunidad de Hive Food, espero que estén muy bien. Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes una forma práctica de organizar nuestras comidas para toda la semana, ideal cuando no tenemos mucho tiempo para cocinar cada día. En esta ocasión preparé varias recetas sencillas y rendidoras: una carne molida con papas y zanahoria, una mortadela guisada perfecta para rellenar arepas, panes o hacer pastelitos, y arroz suficiente para acompañar durante toda la semana. Es una manera de ahorrar tiempo, dinero y esfuerzo, sin dejar de comer rico y casero en el día a día.\n\n

>Hello, dear Hive Food community! I hope you’re all doing well. Today I want to share with you a practical way to plan your meals for the whole week—perfect for when you don’t have much time to cook every day. This time, I prepared several simple, hearty recipes: ground beef with potatoes and carrots, a stewed meatloaf perfect for filling arepas, bread, or making pastries, and enough rice to serve as a side dish all week long. It’s a way to save time, money, and effort, while still enjoying delicious, homemade meals every day.
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
![5s4dzRwnVbzGY5ssnCE4wXzkeAEXyVtgk1ApQTwHMTp6y5PvEo1yennAPsP4d1LBcvF2DN3NXZV48rEfAv7dqbHwZ9WVDFeovGGCFS3NFrLH323BeNdzWpmKmaSHcNPhF6CspuXXhxaiNef2NqqCST3NFz7tDvYs9x8GsYq.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/23tcNngg6kuZLr17voRDC8Nooj7bozWrLKoEWH9DLG2ogVpYdA2m37W8SwsE5b3RM1rRc.gif)
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
#### INGREDIENTES: > INGREDIENTS:

>500 gr de carne molida, 1/2 mortadela de pollo, 2 tazas de arroz, 1 kg de papas, 1 kg de zanahorias, 2 cebollas grandes, 8 dientes de ajo, condimentos (orégano, sal, pimienta, comino al gusto), aceite, 200 gr de pasta de tomate.\n\n

>500 g ground beef, 1/2 pound chicken mortadella, 2 cups rice, 1 kg potatoes, 1 kg carrots, 2 large onions, 8 cloves garlic, seasonings (oregano, salt, pepper, cumin to taste), oil, 200 g tomato paste. *** #### PASO A PASO: > STEP BY STEP:

>Inicié por la carne, hice carne molida porque rinde mucho y me alcanza para casi toda la semana, corté todos los vegetales que separé a la mitad, para usar en ambas preparaciones, en un sartén caliente, añadí un poco de aceite y comencé a sofreír la mitad de la cebolla junto a la carne y la mitad de los dientes de ajo.\n\n

>I started with the meat; I made ground beef because it goes a long way and lasts me almost the whole week. I chopped all the vegetables and set half of them aside to use in both dishes. In a hot skillet, I added a little oil and began sautéing half the onion along with the meat and half the garlic cloves. ***

>Incorporé los condimentos y la mitad de la pasta de tomate junto a 1/2 taza de agua, coloquen una tapa y dejen cocinar unos 10 minutos a fuego bajo, luego rectifiquen los sabores, dejen cocinar hasta que la salsa espese.\n\n

>Add the seasonings and half the tomato paste along with 1/2 cup of water, cover, and simmer for about 10 minutes over low heat. Then adjust the seasoning and continue cooking until the sauce thickens. ***

>Seguiremos los mismos pasos para preparar la mortadela, pero primero la vamos a freír hasta dorar, en ese punto incorporamos los vegetales, condimentos y la pasta de tomate sin agua, cocinamos hasta que la salsas espese. Está preparación es ideal para rellenar panes, arepas o armar pastelitos.\n\n

>We’ll follow the same steps to prepare the mortadella, but first we’ll fry it until golden brown. At that point, we’ll add the vegetables, seasonings, and tomato paste (without the liquid), and cook until the sauce thickens. This mixture is perfect for filling bread, arepas, or making pastries. ***
>Finalmente hice arroz suficiente para toda la semana, no como mucho arroz así que dos tazas es la cantidad ideal para mi semana. Hagan el arroz como suelen hacerlo.\n\n
>I finally made enough rice to last the whole week. I don't eat a lot of rice, so two cups is the perfect amount for me for the week. Cook the rice the way you usually do. ***

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/Eo8TMj2dTHv5sufAh5sxRU7SNF4LmS7YCXPk9aTkWQCLcVm6L38VHMkqYLsocw4XH8m.jpg

![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
![5s4dzRwnVbzGY5ssnCE4wXzkeAEXyVtgk1ApQTwHMTp6y5PvEo1yennAPsP4d1LBcvF2DN3NXZV48rEfAv7dqbHwZ9WVDFeovGGCFS3NFrLH323BeNdzWpmKmaSHcNPhF6CspuXXhxaiNef2NqqCST3NFz7tDvYs9x8GsYq.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/23tcNngg6kuZLr17voRDC8Nooj7bozWrLKoEWH9DLG2ogVpYdA2m37W8SwsE5b3RM1rRc.gif)
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
##### Como pueden ver, con un poco de organización es posible resolver las comidas de toda la semana de forma fácil y práctica. Estas recetas son sencillas, económicas y muy versátiles, ya que se pueden combinar de diferentes maneras según el gusto o lo que tengamos a la mano. Es una excelente opción para quienes trabajan o tienen poco tiempo para cocinar a diario. Espero que esta idea les sea útil y los motive a planificar sus comidas. Gracias por llegar hasta aquí, por leer y acompañarme. Los invito a comentar cómo organizan sus comidas durante la semana. > As you can see, with a little organization, it’s easy and convenient to plan meals for the whole week. These recipes are simple, affordable, and very versatile, since they can be combined in different ways depending on your taste or what you have on hand. It’s an excellent option for those who work or have little time to cook every day. I hope this idea is helpful and inspires you to plan your meals. Thank you for reading this far and for joining me. I invite you to share how you organize your meals during the week.

title.body:
>  

## Spanish

Hola a todos. Pensar en libertad casi siempre lo asociamos con acciones o conducta, con el querer ser o el querer hacer sin limitarnos a algo que no somos, y justamente en ese proceso y visión llegamos a dejar de lado la libertad de nuestro corazón y sentir, de esas emociones autónomas y propias que tenemos y que no dejamos salir por algún tema externo o de nosotros mismos, y es que buscando una libertad, encerramos parte de nuestra esencia real por adecuar y reiniciar más allá de adaptar.





Y esto no lo digo por querer generalizar, sino también porque personalmente lo he hecho. Como muchos saben, siempre una de las cosas que quiero es el tema de sentir una paz conmigo misma y, en ocasiones, en ese camino me he planteado mucho lo que es esa pregunta si debo de moderar hasta incluso quitar de raíz algunas cosas propias de mi por ese pensar de quizás no sea agradable o me cause limitantes , ojo no me refiero a auto ponernos límites o saber los momentos donde hay que simplemente  estar allí sino a ese pensamiento de dejar de lado algo que nos gusta mucho y que es propio por generar una imagen \

y más que todo hablo de el como nos proyectamos de corazón .

Y ojo obviamente escribo esto desde un punto autocrítico porque incluso es un mensaje para mí misma de que mi sentimientos y mi corazón se deben de expresar libremente no solo lo que piense y haga porque al final puedo ser libre en mis avances pero sentir que hay un faltante si no tengo un corazón libre para emocionarme sin miedo y pensamientos de más porque si no solo sobre pienso con mis acciones sino con mis emociones y auto cuestiono si mi corazón está bien con algunas cosas más allá de dejarlo fluir y avanzar como debe de ser .

## English
 
 
Hello everyone. We almost always associate freedom with actions or behavior, with wanting to be or want to do without limiting ourselves to something we're not. And it's precisely in that process and vision that we end up neglecting the freedom of our hearts and feelings, those autonomous and personal emotions we have and don't let out because of some external issue or something within ourselves. In seeking freedom, we imprison part of our true essence, trying to adapt and restart rather than simply adapt.

And I don't say this to generalize, but also because I've done it myself. As many of you know, one of my greatest desires is to find inner peace. And sometimes, along this path, I've pondered whether I should moderate, or even eliminate, certain aspects of myself because I think they might not be pleasant or limiting. Mind you, I'm not referring to setting limits for ourselves or knowing when to simply be present, but rather to the thought of abandoning something we truly enjoy and that is inherent to our nature in order to project a \

image. And above all, I'm talking about how we project ourselves from the heart.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmQNgQprw16AaB1BgSGZmkrNLaTHVodxtTvnT2VFQrZxm1/1778024270434.jpg
[link](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/mujer-emoci%c3%b3n-depresi%c3%b3n-ni%c3%b1a-8186391/)
To be more specific, I'll tell you something. On a few occasions, I've also mentioned that I'm sentimental, or even affectionate—you know, that feeling of being a softie when it comes to many things. Because of this, I sometimes hide it from certain people, perhaps mistakenly thinking they'll see me differently. We forget something very important: we're constantly evolving, and whether we like it or not, our emotions become stronger. Being able to express them freely from the heart is what allows us to mature in a healthy and beautiful way. And mind you, I'm writing this from a self-critical perspective because it's also a message to myself: my feelings and my heart should be expressed freely, not just what I think and do. Because ultimately, I can be free in my progress, but feel something is missing if I don't have a free heart to feel emotions without fear or overthinking. Otherwise, I overthink not only my actions but also my emotions, and I question whether my heart is okay with certain things, instead of just letting it flow and move forward as it should.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmc4yqsi58JhUprDGWxQTdSzdCfmGYyDvAYsfuAJttLwij/1778024320652.jpg
So, sometimes it's important to listen not only to the mind but also to the heart, especially in moments like these as I write, watching the sunset without light. It's precisely when we should take advantage of this time to connect with ourselves. This is how I connected with the topic proposed by @talento for this week, and I hope you enjoy it. Thank you so much for reading.

title.title: The Narrow Gate of Concentration
title.body:
![1000141833.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/EopspmwZf4jFkZxfdqejj8GcXHsGrmp2eKh94cnRdfMW6VJWVjE7JRoy8GgK7imFRyJ.jpg)






![topfeather.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/jVIY8Tx5-top-feather.png)




<center>I notice first how a slight shift in focus leads to three more losses before I even realize I’ve wandered off again into my mind,
I notice first how easy it is to call distraction harmless while it quietly rearranges the whole day against me again and again,
I first notice how the broken thread of attention costs more than the minute that stole it from my own hands,
I notice first, am I truly resting right now or just escaping the weight of what matters most to me right this very moment,
I notice it first, and when I finally confess it, the hour has already gone ahead without me…





<center>I have learned that scattered habits do not stay small because they teach my mind to keep abandoning itself,
I have learned that every needless interruption leaves a residue of restlessness I carry into the next task,
I have learned that returning to depth gets harder each time I reward my own wandering with relief,
I have learned, am I feeding the pattern I claim I want to break by touching it all over again,
I have learned, how repetition can build chains as easily as it builds my needed strength…





<center>I protect now, that narrow doorway where concentration enters before noise can overwhelm the frame and seize the room,
I protect now, by refusing invitations that look tiny but know exactly how to once again once welcomed,
I protect now, because unfinished things keep speaking in my chest long after I close the screen that don’t want to face,
I protect now, can I disappoint a momentary urge instead of disappointing myself again for the nth time,
I protect now, though part of me still craves the easier ruin of delay, because waiting has always disguised itself as mercy while stealing from me in silence…





<center>I approach slowly, for a more stable focus acknowledging that perfection is unattainable and that slips still occur unexpectedly,
I approach slowly, not seeking perfection, but rather honesty when my mind begins to negotiate to what I wanted to imagine
I approach slowly, accepting that discipline often looks plainly boring while chaos arrives dressed as relieved comfort,
I approach slowly, can I begin again this minute instead of mourning the last wasted one, because regret cannot return it, but attention can still redeem what remains,
I approach slowly, because saving pieces of a day can still become a life, and lives are rebuilt the same way they were lost, one hour, one day, one month, at a time…





<center>Watchwords:
The hour moved on
Repetition can build chains
Narrow doorway where concentration enters
Easier ruin of dela
Saving pieces of a day








![bottomfeather.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/bYIitQga-bottom-feather.png)

<center>Here is Tikatarot, who dares you to answer the question, *“Who am I?”..*</center>

<center>As and will always be reminding you to dream:</center> 
<center>*“As you are still the Master of your destiny and the maker of your dreams…”*</center>

title.title: 不是我不想理你
title.body:
那天有個人，是朋友的朋友，我們一同坐下聊天時認識的。拉叔我自從得了這個病後，尤其是帶著拐杖走路，總會被問為什麼“腳痛”。每當我解釋說是因為中風，得到的回复大部份都是安慰的話🤣 放心，我的誰那時也中了，現在完全好了。去做針灸了沒？我的誰去那一家師傅，扎了幾針後，奇蹟般的能走了……有時我真的很想懟回去，你有中過嗎？😂不過很可能就掀桌子翻臉了。

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaHJd8drupMwpU5ZRXDLhESxPNSXcNEV4tRM1aARGSFAG/1778021270643.jpg)

老實說，我都不是很想搭理。我都明白這些是好心的話，完全理解，我也不想開罪人，所以也完全沒有反駁，只是靜靜的聽，偶爾點頭好像是說知道了，必要時還得裝著好像恍然大悟，真的嗎？那倒可以試試。😬說到底，還不是得給些情緒價值你？

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT8Rj9gTpVxYftb54NRzRcso1AtdaZRgWLPvqr122rVTs/1778021270758.jpg)

我也不是擺爛，我在這裡只是想分享一哈心情。其實，你們拉叔我在政府醫療中心已經學會了，大家都是平等的心態。在政府醫院，不管你是有錢沒錢，政府醫師會盡可能用最簡單直接的方法，去拯救最多、最大範圍的人群。就算是在物理治療，我還是第一次上物理治療“班”。原來物理治療也有同學🤣這是這一班級的同學，幾乎都是爺爺奶奶級別的老同學了。

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdvWjfsJoZPqzXAg3sr7J2p2QVPzoANsUUSCAJP7ia6ac/1778021270830.jpg)

你知道這一些物理治療的同學們的聊天話題是什麼嗎？是中了幾久？出血範圍多少公分？左邊還是右邊？現在吃幾度血清？有沒用抗凝血藥？在家練習哪個到工作？到外面散步有沒用拐杖？還有試過，有個叔叔還帶著他女朋友（應該是嬸嬸吧）陪讀的，趁女朋友走開了，還會嬉皮笑臉的問男同學你們“那個”有影響嗎？用什麼招比較適合？😂 雖然大家年齡相若，你們拉叔我看起來還是長得比較（不敢說年輕）幼稚的，馬上交槍，說今年還沒有女朋友🤣自己解決是沒問題的。

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmThjCkFaAtdykiQu1dRVDoyw9JFacAzqXVA3Q7kx5K2og/1778021270907.jpg)

你的誰好起來了，我都能理解。但是我覺得，中過風的人想要的，並不是安慰或醫學常識，而是簡單的鼓勵就可以了。因為，只有中過風的人才知道身體失去控制，要找回來是什麼感受。如果我的情況很糟，我聽到你的誰活得很好，我可能會埋怨為什麼別人就能好我不能？你的誰針灸後竟然能走動了，可是我一直在針一直在走了，難道還有什麼地方我還沒扎針？還是扎錯了穴位？最近怎麼覺得自己特別色？🤣

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaBTcrXNvbA3zDVQrAYmrnmKaijfGK1MAHrvP8v5K1VKZ/1778021270968.jpg)

不是每個人中風的案例都可以用“輕微”和嚴重來衡量。同樣的腦栓，一個腦細胞壞死導致死亡，另一個栓了一哈死不去，但腦神經受損。同樣的腦溢血，一個可能做手術將血塊移除時傷害了神經，身體某技能將會永久失去控制，另一個可能溢血範圍完全不影響身體機能（這個更危險，可能腦殼疼得炸裂然後就暴斃了）。所以嘛，我覺得能鼓勵一下正在學走路的“老朋友”就很好了🤣

title.title: I forgave to be free : Loh 287
title.body:
What was it that you clung to tightly (an ideal, a person, a stage of life) that life forced you to let go of? What was the emotional process of accepting that it was no longer part of your present?

​

Love can be a beautiful sweet sour experience. Sometimes, love is the lesson that sets you free. It started as childhood friendship. Our parents shared a close relationship, and what began as play-study grew into something more. He was “prince charming” in my eyes. I was head over heels feeling lucky and excited for a future that felt safe and familiar with great family goals.

The red flags were there. I just didn’t care because love can beclouding. I was in year two at the university while he had already finished and secured a good job. His family was supportively capable and they promised that I will be fine and still complete my education. He proposed three times. And the three times, I said no not because I didn't love him. I was not considering or ready for marriage and also I was not to ready to let him go. I felt so uneasy about the marriage proposal. I told him to hold on until I was done with my study. He did not object and he quietly agreed to wait.

_Two weeks later, I woke up to a pre-wedding pictures. I called to ask about it and he said it was a prank. He sent me gifts, something he rarely did except compelled. The same secretary I had suspected he was becoming too close with. When I confronted him, he said I was just being jealous._

_Guess who was standing beside him in the photos, the secretary._

_I felt betrayed. I felt played. I cried so much then. It happened during my semester examinations, and I barely could read properly . I was lucky enough not to fail any course. The heartache and betrayal were real and deep._

_My mum noticed I had not been eating and asked why. I told her I had \
_\n\n_Few days later, he sent me a message: \

He added that his mother didn’t really like the woman he married the way she liked me. That she often called her my name. That she took seriously ill when she learnt it wasn’t me._

_Still date, I don't know if the message was to ridicule or engage me in a chat. I simply ignored his message, blocked his contact. I avoided everything that had to do with him.

**The process of acceptance and recovery**

I thought silence and avoidance were healing. I was so wrong._

Years later, I realized I was still hurting. I avoided every person who approached me. It got so bad that my dad said, \

.

Yes, I was punishing myself for his choice while he was living free.

I started healing when I understood something:

- I deserved better than someone who had to be compelled to choose me, give or do something.
- Someone who wanted marriage just to secure a contract. The only thing he needed was to be married. That was the reason for the sudden proposal.

Then one day in church, someone said, \
you are still tied to your past and living with the hurt and hatred.\n\nThose words made me self reflect, I prayed under my breath and said, \

And I felt great peace and joy in my soul.

I also read books that aided my recovery. I loved myself again. I took it as a lesson learned.

You don’t heal in silence. You heal with confidence in self and worth. Letting go, acceptance and recovery wasn’t instant, It was gradual and long for me with prayer, books and daily smart choices at a time.

It took me about four years to love again But when I did, it was different. It was peaceful. It was genuine. Love is a person and also a feeling. Both did i find and it was worth the wait. Within those years, he called my number and wanted to reconnect. I told him I wish him well but I don’t want to be in touch.

Today, I’m happy it didn’t work out because now I now know what genuine love looks like. And I found someone who values it. Someone I could trust enough to say Yes to forever. Talking about it today with ease and clarity is a clear evidence that I'm not bound by the experience.

 I have learned that some people are like John the Baptist; they prepare the way so the saviour will or can come. He wasn’t my forever. He was preparation. 
​

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 5 2026 - Another day of walking ✨
title.body:
#
ENGLISH CONTENT

Hello everyone in this community! Today I had planned to go out with my boyfriend, since it was his day off. My eyes were still tired, so I thought it would be a good idea to follow a plan that didn't require using laptop or phone screens. Since my boyfriend had a doctor's appointment first, I left after his house. I took the \

walking the 15 minutes to the transportation hub, and once I got downtown, instead of taking another ride, I decided to walk to the mall. As long as the weather is cool and I'm in a good mood, I don't mind walking. In fact, I really enjoy it because I can organize my thoughts while I'm out.
![1000411133.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wqgVtbNg6BtMzemuAys2MskRuGonMZnP7zgWF6t6XjGStVm4htHt2udi3osATQ8qWTS.jpg)
**✨ At the mall ✨**

When we met up, it was already lunchtime, so we went to eat. After lunch, we went to the cinema to see *Mario Galaxy*. Despite my tired eyes, I didn't feel like it bothered me during the movie, so I was able to enjoy it without any problems. By the time we left, it was getting late, so we went for coffee and headed back. It wasn't the best day ever, but at least it was different. Anyway, I hope to get enough rest tonight because I want to sew a few things tomorrow for an upcoming bazaar 😊
![1000411287.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xefJW7u2ns7VCMYjooYLm5WPRJQsjoaD5oLZA4tiNRfFkLhdyK2JcrRBhBtB2AaZum2.jpg)
**☕️ I'd been craving a good coffee for days ☕️**

### ✨ Thank you so much for visiting my post. I hope you found it interesting ✨
![sticker-hive-good-luck_eng.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/AJmmUV1yayiznHFJfUGf3NNWfH9ifhsnVHdRXhexXndn8Ky6G7nHMgfMBVmfQdV.gif)

#
💚 Until next time! 💚

![SEPARADOR.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23ydCF6RtBK44fyUqZnnPGvJWAgep2EUuKVgg1fmuih7CXvQzHPWpAqG5Q2SEJmUAZxCx.jpeg)
#
CONTENIDO EN ESPAÑOL

¡Hola a todos los integrantes de esta comunidad! Hoy tenía planeado salir con mi novio, aprovechando que era su día libre. Estaba aún cansada de la visión, por lo que me parecía buena idea seguir un plan que no necesitase usar la pantalla de la laptop o de los teléfonos. Como mi novio iba a ir primero a una cita médica, yo salí después de su casa. Aproveché entonces de tomar el \

, teniendo que caminar los 15 minutos hasta la zona de transporte y una vez que llegué al centro de la ciudad, en lugar de tomar un segundo transporte, decidí caminar hasta el centro comercial. Mientras el clima esté fresco y ande animada, no tengo problema en caminar. Es más, me gusta mucho porque en el proceso, puedo poner orden a mis ideas.
![1000411133.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wqgVtbNg6BtMzemuAys2MskRuGonMZnP7zgWF6t6XjGStVm4htHt2udi3osATQ8qWTS.jpg)
**✨ En el centro comercial ✨**

Cuando nos encontramos, ya era hora de almorzar, así que fuimos a ello. Una vez que comimos, fuimos al cine a ver la película *Mario Galaxy*. A pesar de mi cansancio ocular, no siento que me molestase durante la proyección, así que pude disfrutar de la película sin problemas. Al salir, ya se había hecho tarde, por lo que fuimos por un café y volvimos. No fue el mejor día de todos, pero al menos fue diferente. Por lo demás, espero descansar lo suficiente esta noche, porque quiero coser algunas cositas mañana para un bazar que está próximo 😊

body.title: ​El valor de lo sencillo el niño de la casa cumple 17 años en familia 🎂✨|The value of simplicity our youngest turns 17 with the family 🎂✨
body.body:
> A menudo, la vida nos empuja a creer que las grandes celebraciones requieren de despliegues monumentales o lugares ostentosos. Sin embargo, cuando nos detenemos a observar lo que realmente nos hace sonreír, descubrimos que la felicidad reside en los detalles más cotidianos. Ayer, celebrando los 17 años del niño de la casa, volvimos a confirmar que el mejor regalo siempre será el tiempo compartido.
Life often leads us to believe that big celebrations require grand displays or lavish venues. However, when we stop to consider what truly makes us smile, we discover that happiness lies in the simplest, most everyday details. Yesterday, as we celebrated our son’s 17th birthday, we were reminded once again that the best gift will always be the time we spend together.
​No hubo música a todo volumen ni protocolos rígidos. Lo que hubo fue algo mucho más valioso: una torta casera con ese sabor inconfundible que solo un tío puede lograr cuando cocina con afecto, un brindis sencillo con refrescos y, sobre todo, el abrigo de la casa de la abuela. Ese lugar que, sin importar cuánto crezcamos, siempre se siente como el centro del mundo.
There was no loud music or rigid formalities. What there was, however, was something far more precious: a homemade cake with that unmistakable flavor that only an uncle can achieve when he bakes with love, a simple toast with soft drinks, and, above all, the warmth of Grandma’s house. That place that, no matter how much we grow up, always feels like the center of the world.
​Llegar a los 17 es una etapa de transición fascinante. Es ese puente entre la niñez que se despide y la adultez que empieza a asomarse. En momentos así, sentarse a charlar, reírse de anécdotas viejas y simplemente \

es lo que les da a nuestros jóvenes la seguridad de que, sin importar cuán lejos lleguen, siempre tendrán un puerto seguro al cual volver.
Turning 17 is a fascinating transitional phase. It’s that bridge between childhood, which is coming to an end, and adulthood, which is just beginning to peek through. At times like these, sitting down to chat, laughing at old stories, and simply “being there” is what gives our young people the assurance that, no matter how far they go, they will always have a safe haven to return to.
​Estar en familia es mucho más que coincidir en un espacio; es construir un lenguaje común, es el apoyo silencioso en una mirada y la alegría genuina por el crecimiento del otro. Estos encuentros en casa de la abuela son los que tejen los recuerdos que atesoraremos por décadas. Al final del día, lo que queda no es el tamaño del pastel, sino la calidez de las manos que lo prepararon y la sinceridad de los abrazos recibidos.
Being with family is much more than just gathering in one place; it’s about building a shared language, the silent support conveyed in a glance, and the genuine joy we feel at seeing each other grow. These gatherings at Grandma’s house are what weave the memories we’ll treasure for decades to come. At the end of the day, what remains isn’t the size of the cake, but the warmth of the hands that made it and the sincerity of the hugs we received.
​Que nunca nos falte la excusa de un cumpleaños para recordar que, si tenemos a la familia cerca, lo tenemos todo.
May we never lack the excuse of a birthday to remind us that, if we have our family close by, we have everything.

body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbo7Bk6cGjFoiwzQgwr5nFfifyoBgYzBkje6m7zvy9R9M/igorshubin_bitcoin_4912863.jpg)


[source](https://pixabay.com/ko/photos/%eb%b9%84%ed%8a%b8-%ec%bd%94%ec%9d%b8-blockchain-4912863/)

암호화폐 시장에 꽤 의미 있는 뉴스가 나왔다. 미국 상원에서 디지털 자산 시장의 규제 명확성을 높이기 위한 ‘클래리티 법’ 관련 수정안에 합의했다는 소식이다. 특히 스테이블코인의 운영 방식이 핵심이었는데, 단순히 보유만으로 이자를 주는 방식은 금지하고 실제 거래나 활동을 기반으로 한 보상은 허용하기로 했다고 한다.

이게 꽤 중요한 변화처럼 느껴진다. 단순 투자 수익이 아니라 ‘사용 기반 보상’만 인정한다는 건, 암호화폐를 하나의 금융 인프라로 보겠다는 방향성으로 보이기 때문이다. 그래서인지 업계 반응도 상당히 긍정적이다.

시장도 바로 반응했다. USDC 발행사인 서클은 거의 20% 가까이 급등했고, 코인베이스도 6% 넘게 올랐다. 규제 리스크가 줄어들었다는 기대 때문인지 투자심리가 확 살아난 느낌이다. 이런 흐름이 이어지면서 비트코인도 강하게 상승해서 장중 8만 달러를 돌파했다는 점이 인상적이다.

특히 ETF 자금 유입이 다시 늘어나고 있다는 점도 눈에 띈다. 하루에 6억 달러 이상 들어왔다니, 기관 자금이 다시 본격적으로 들어오는 분위기 같다.

전체적으로 보면, 이번 합의는 단순한 정책 변화가 아니라 암호화폐가 제도권 안으로 들어가는 신호처럼 느껴진다. 아직 최종 통과는 남아 있지만, 만약 그대로 진행된다면 시장 구조 자체가 한 단계 더 성숙해질 가능성이 크다.

요즘 중동 리스크 때문에 전통 시장은 다소 흔들리는 모습인데, 암호화폐 쪽은 오히려 독자적인 상승 흐름을 만들고 있는 점도 흥미롭다. 앞으로 21일 상원 본회의 결과가 중요한 분기점이 될 것 같다.


1. ‘단순 이자 지급’ 금지
스테이블코인을 그냥 들고만 있어도 이자를 주는 방식(예금처럼 운용)은 허용하지 않음.
→ 즉, 은행 예금처럼 쓰는 구조는 막겠다는 것.

2. ‘사용 기반 보상’은 허용
거래, 결제, 디파이 활동 등 실제 네트워크 사용에 따른 인센티브는 가능.
→ 코인베이스·서클이 하던 리워드 모델은 합법적 근거 확보.

3. 규제 방향성 명확화
스테이블코인을 투자상품이 아니라 ‘결제/인프라 수단’ 중심으로 규정하려는 의도.

오늘 결론: 규제가 명확해질수록 시장은 더 강해질 수 있다. 그리고 지금은 그 변화의 초입일지도 모른다.
