body.title: 5 de mayo 2026: Cada cosa en su lugar | Everything in its place
body.body: > Hoy ha sido un día interesante... de varias maneras me ha dado luces en cuanto a algunas decisiones pendientes en el ámbito profesional. Había estado considerando algunos escenarios posibles y llegué a sentirme algo aturdida últimanante. No tener opciones es exasperante, pero tener varias, que parecen atractivas es, al menos, inquietante. Me siento agradecida por todo lo que esta vida me ofrece.

> Today has been an interesting day... in many ways, it has shed some light on some pending decisions in my professional life. I had been considering a few possible scenarios and had started to feel a bit overwhelmed lately. Having no options is frustrating, but having several that all seem appealing is, at the very least, unsettling. I feel grateful for everything this life has to offer. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmQeUVtZFPvQSNYNdEuZ2Lz2wCEHNB5uKheWFDX56tRP5A/20260505_143516.jpg
***

> Ya yo tenía un plan trazado, que inicia con una maestría y llegué a considerar dejarlo a un lado, por la tentación de un empleo con algunas mejoras. Es fácil dejarnos llevar por la retribución inmediata, ante el esfuerzo que al final se traduce en algo mucho mejor, pero que requiere paciencia. Son dos años de por medio entre mi meta y la posibilidad de mejorar mi ingreso. Más de una vez coloqué en una balanza: Dinero o preparación para un upgrade de mi perfil. Hoy elegí preparación, no porque no me tentara el dinero, sino porque la oferta no fue lo suficientemente buena para abandonar mi plan.

> I already had a plan laid out, starting with a master’s degree, and I even considered setting it aside because of the temptation of a job with better pay. It's easy to get carried away by the immediate reward, even though the effort ultimately leads to something much better—but it requires patience. There are two years standing between my goal and the chance to increase my income. More than once, I’ve weighed the options: money or investing in an upgrade for my profile. Today I chose education, not because the money didn’t tempt me, but because the offer wasn’t good enough to make me abandon my plan. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmaYUW7JM3GfHbXASdmJ7v2ybyMGbEH2GASb9k3xePXfaP/20260430_215233.jpg
***

> Entre otras novedades, esta mañana mi jefe me comunicó que mi gerencia había aprobado mi ingreso a un postgrado al que me postulé. Les confieso que llegué a pensar que no sería así, porque son varias las personas que quieren entrar y los cupos por gerencia son limitados. En muchas ocasiones las cosas no salen tal como las pensamos, sobre todo cuando se trata de lo que tememos, que por fortuna, muy poco sucede. Sentí alegría por la buena noticia y entonces, sentí la certeza de que debía seguir por ese camino. Por cierto, hoy ha sido un día de mucho trabajo, hasta me traje un poco a casa para terminar una presentación técnica para mañana, lo que haré después de escribir esta publicación 😆.

> Among other news, my boss told me this morning that my department had approved my admission to the graduate program I applied for. I’ll admit that I actually thought it wouldn’t happen, because there are a lot of people who want to get in and the spots per department are limited. Things often don’t turn out the way we expect, especially when it comes to what we fear—which, fortunately, rarely happens. I was happy about the good news, and then I felt certain that I should continue down that path. By the way, today has been a very busy day; I even brought some work home to finish a technical presentation for tomorrow, which I’ll do after writing this post 😆. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmY7YFtL7Z4wwSqN7nunioscUb5CWf9UGw6kCY2C4nrwr9/20260505.gif
***

> Un momento curioso de este día que les quiero compartir, fue que cuando mis colegas y yo salimos de la sala de trabajo, porque llegó el personal de limpieza, esta linda gatita se me subió a las piernas de manera sorpresiva y amasando mis piernas por un buen rato... Es la segunda vez que lo hace. Todos en el lugar estaban cautivados con esto. Luego, le pregunté a Gemini qué significaba este comportamiento en los gatos y en resumen, me respondió que era un cumplido enorme, que es una forma de decirme que me percibe como su lugar seguro. Lo más épico es que ni siquiera me gustan los gatos😬, bueno, ninguna mascota. Pero siento que esta gata me está ganando.

> One funny moment from today that I want to share with you was when my colleagues and I left the office because the cleaning staff had arrived, and this cute little cat suddenly jumped onto my legs and started kneading them for quite a while... It’s the second time she’s done this. Everyone in the room was captivated by this. Later, I asked Gemini what this behavior meant in cats, and in short, she told me it was a huge compliment—a way of telling me she sees me as her safe place. The most epic part is that I don’t even like cats😬—well, any pets, really. But I feel like this cat is winning me over. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmcwB2jhVMsppPJe86AGbYYkouBQHtzgUgbZzsqDsNQRKL/20260505_100942.jpg
***

> Antes de regresar a casa me hice algo que tenía meses queriendo hacer, pero que siempre dejaba para después: Ir al quiropedista. No fue algo planificado, fue un: ¡Ya basta! Haz lo que tienes que hacer. Mis pies necesitaban un cariñito, además fue un momento de relax. También fui a secarme el cabello, para estar linda para mañana en la presentación técnica de la que les hablé, algo que tampoco hago con frecuencia. Me sentí bien de haber avanzado tanto en mis tareas.

> Before heading home, I did something I’d been wanting to do for months but always put off: I went to the podiatrist. It wasn’t something I planned; it was more like, “Enough is enough! Just do what you have to do.” My feet needed some TLC, and it was also a chance to relax. I also went to get my hair blow-dried, so I’d look nice for tomorrow’s technical presentation I told you about—something I don’t do very often either. I felt good about having made so much progress on my tasks. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmVBZpxFfRUzZS7gCHiUzHdWKWJ4EkM9SVV3zurgzrTtVm/20260505_164358.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCVkiZrRxXwagi66h8U8HT3PQgpx2dZx7ZTs8ZKtUYu1/mi_sep.png

> Bueno, como mencioné antes, mi día no ha terminado, aún tengo trabajo por hacer, así que dejo hasta aquí mis pensamientos para compartir con ustedes hoy amigos, deseándoles que sus vidas estén colmadas de bendiciones y que sean capaces de apreciarlas. Gracias por haberme acompañado a través de estas letras.

> Well, as I mentioned earlier, my day isn’t over yet—I still have work to do—so I’ll leave it there for today, friends. I hope your lives are filled with blessings and that you’re able to appreciate them. Thank you for joining me on this journey through these words. ***
https://images.hive.blog/350x350/https://images.ecency.com/DQmYmNTSoQ7tHfuKVDmksrsS9RzBg8HAqYnXghQXaHbi7Yt/image.png Thank you very much

body.title: Too fraudulent an advert
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmX24QVGypRh9Bip5ZDRcq2mfpYJxzYvxuQZScz2Jw2SEw/1000179751.jpg 
[source](https://www.magnific.com/free-photo/magnifier-with-fraud-message_8218600.htm#fromView=search&page=2&position=15&uuid=20429c8d-d973-42e1-876e-ba7fcae83398&query=Fraudulent+adsAI+generated+)  
What you ordered versus what you got has been that challenge in online businessing. This is why I most [times](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-time) have to head to the [market](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-market) to source for the right product myself. Phone [cameras](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-camera) can be deceptive; everything gets well polished but the reality may be a product regret.   

I have heard and adding to that, read to confirm a news about a [customer](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-customer) that charged redbull (energy drink company) to [court](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-court-legal) for not giving him [Wings](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-wings-1927-film) after several [years](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-year) of using the product. Funny right, but he became a millionaire in the process as the [company](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-company-business) has to compensate him.   

I just kept this [article](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-article) in my archives waiting for the appointed moment. I guess today is that [day](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-day). [ALL](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-all-currency) these pop up ads can be annoying yet you have to understand that they are trying to do [business](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-business) and make [sales](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-sales).   

One can't ignore the impact of [advertising](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-advertising) to business. In fact, as an [entrepreneur](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-entrepreneur) you will understand more. Advertising is one of the [TOP](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-top-currency) sectors I am planning to [leverage](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-leverage) and improve our business sales. I have met with several marketers to find out just the right strategy plus an affordable one.   

Nevertheless, some businesses have made advertising boring or maybe I should say, ridiculous. The unprofessionality in it can be irritating. I just saw one of such pop up ads and although not the first time I have seen that particular company running that advert, I had to take much time to look at it this time around.  

It is a [loan](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-loans) app company advertisement. We all know the whooping charges this people charge on monthly loans and the amount gets even higher if it will last for three to night [months](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-month). You can pay up to 40% in the process depending and what was their advertising talking of?  

Before getting there let's do some calculations. N250K for let's say six months plus charge can be  N350K (installment [payments](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-payment) for six months). The longer the months, the higher the [interest rate](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-interest-rate). A month month loan can accrue 20% [interest](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-interest) rate. You can see how alarming the rates are.   

And yet, such a company can boldly stand out on a [video](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-video) advert to say N100K loan to pay interest rate of N1500 (totalling N101,500). I mean, where doe this company get this fraudulent advertising mindset from? It seems a beyond the roof [fraud](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-fraud) just to get customer attention. Maybe the best advice can be, do well to avoid the entire loaning system.  

I know it can seem painful after going through the entire loan process to discover you were lied to and that it is even no where near any other assumptions you can imagine. Yes, be ready to pay around N60K extra as interest from what was first assumed to be just N1500. Did you even see that coming?  

To conclude, let me add, others may see it as an eye-catching advert. A click bait and whatever, bit if you are to ask me, THIS IS FRAUD and very irritating to see [professionals](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-professional) deploying it. It is something that I the right measures are taken, they could be sued to pay damaged. I feel the need for ads monitoring department in the country to help curb this kind of widespread heavy lies. customers are not meant to be taken for granted. This is really what we call ‘false hope and a bad marketing strategy’.   

>This is an [article](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-article) covered by dani-EL; a broad niche [writer](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-writer). I write on faith, [life](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-life) facts and daily living, business and [economics](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-economics-social-science), small scale and daily businessing, [cryptocurrency](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/cryptocurrency) and [technology](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-technology). And yes, I do cover articles on financial [education](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-education) and [investment](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-investment) updates. And [note](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-note), if I happen to be a financial adviser to you, the [TOP](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-top-currency) financial advice should be ‘DYOR’ (Do Your Own Research), I can't afford to break your heart

body.title: Mensaje diario de 5  minutos: paralizado / 5 Minute Freewrite: paralyzed
body.body:
>

​
# Momento



#

En un estado de mucha conmoción estaba ese día cuando escuchaba cada palabra mientras le explicaban que aprobaron su crédito y el proceso de compra de su primera casa estaba listo; siendo un momento muy importante porque todo el empeño que puso tanto físico como mental estaba dando resultados además por la inversión de los ahorros de mucho tiempo que había destinado con tanto deseo para tener su casa propia lo que es un paso significativo en su vida donde inevitablemente quedo **paralizado** ante tanta información.

Así son las reacciones humanas frente a este tipo de noticias que en este caso es positiva, es buena y reconfortante porque es como cosechar los frutos de la siembra que cuidaste tanto paso a paso cada día; ya que necesito de trabajo y paciencia. Quedarse paralizado es porque forma parte de la emoción por lo que escucha porque es evidente que se trata de una noticia impresionante; luego de superar ese estado que normalmente es momentáneo pueden expresar otras emociones como llorar, gritar, pero mostrando alegría y euforia porque está muy feliz.

También por escuchar otro tipo de noticias te puedes paralizar y son aquellas que suelen causar dolor, angustia, tristeza y hasta molestia de manera que caso contrario a una alegría aquí te sorprendes porque nadie quiere recibir una noticia que desestabilice tu vida, tu tranquilidad así de repente y lógicamente las personas sienten y son afectadas por muchas razones. Existen las noticias malas y te puedes enterar de algo porque lo escuchas o ves, entras en un estado de shock quedándote congelado sin palabras y luego reaccionar molesta, sea en caso negativo o positivo es prioridad no quedarse estancando en ese estado emocional.
​

​<center>![WhatsApp Image 2022-05-12 at 3.28.50 PM.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeucn6MeLy6DkeFM7A2nU8vB9xADUBt8Yr6bzbsja2DRK/WhatsApp%20Image%202022-05-12%20at%203.28.50%20PM.jpeg)</center>



# Moment

​

#
She was in a state of great excitement that day as she listened intently to every word while they explained that her loan had been approved and the process of buying her first home was all set; It was a very important moment because all the effort he had put in, both physically and mentally, was paying off, thanks also to the investment of the savings he had set aside over a long period of time with such a strong desire to own his own home—a significant step in his life—and he inevitably found himself **paralyzed** by so much information.

 That’s how people react to this kind of news—which, in this case, is positive, good, and heartening—because it’s like reaping the fruits of the seeds you tended so carefully, step by step, every day; after all, it takes hard work and patience. Feeling paralyzed is part of the emotional response to what they hear, because it’s clearly stunning news; after getting past that state—which is usually momentary—they may express other emotions like crying or shouting, but with joy and euphoria because they’re so happy.

​Hearing other kinds of news can also leave you paralyzed—the kind that tends to cause pain, distress, sadness, and even discomfort. Unlike joyful news, this kind of news takes you by surprise because no one wants to receive news that suddenly disrupts their life and peace of mind. Naturally, people feel and are affected by it for many reasons. There is bad news, and you might learn about something because you hear or see it; you go into a state of shock, freezing up and left speechless, and then react with anger. Whether the news is negative or positive, the priority is not to get stuck in that emotional state.

#

>Data from U.S. Census Bureau IPUMS microdata (as analyzed/reported by [wealthvieu](https://wealthvieu.com/homeownership-rate-by-demographics/) . 
Visual chart created with Datawrapper

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXw9m7WU6dbHNVb3zwpAfKTecFuGz3TraCfH9omH8o3s6/image.png)


Based on U.S. Census Bureau IPUMS Census microdata, the percentage of U.S. citizens who were both married and homeowners prior to reaching age 30 dropped dramatically over the course of the last 65 years, from roughly 52% in 1960 to 12% in 2025 (as per the 2010-2011 American Community Survey). 

During the 1960s, early marriage was common and housing was fairly affordable compared to incomes; As a result, households could often be supported with one person working full-time. However, since then, this trend has changed dramatically. By 1980, 45% of people had reached the combined goal of homeownership and being married, this number decreased to 35% by 2000, continued its downward trend to 25% by 2010 and further to just 12% by 2025.

This trend occurred due to many factors including the rapid increase in home values relative to wage growth makes it more difficult for younger people to purchase homes early in life; people now marry later and spend more time in school and initial career paths; in addition student loans; living costs in cities; and the change of social norms have all resulted in these changing marriage and home ownership patterns.

Simply put: the data is clear with respect to measuring how much less common finding yourself married and a homeowner by age 30 has become compared with the mid-20th century.

*References*
[Weathvieu](https://wealthvieu.com/homeownership-rate-by-demographics/)Homeownership Rate by Demographics 
U.S. Census Bureau [IPUMS](https://usa.ipums.org/usa/) Census microdata & American Community Survey

body.title: The decision i have left to midnight instead of drowning emotionally #25
body.body:
**Greetings my lovely friends and lovers of #midnightowl**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNbgd2tsutMsgD5LcrdYvxoQLsWoaccwzxPxsm9P4EJQm/1778021721872.jpg)

For years now I have been living alone, bored and drained, Am seen as a strong woman. Sometimes no calls from family or no one cares to know how am fairing. Except when I call that's when they will seize that opportunity and ask about me. To me I will say am okay, while I fully know am not. But am all alone and sometimess drained emotionally, i need more than just money. People taught when one is married you are  living good. Nothing dey bite where she dey. 

I don't want to border or discuss it with anyone, not even to my parent, to share my emotions or problems because they have their own burdens that they are carrying and don't want to be worried, to them I can handle anything, worst come to worse i should pray over it and push through it alone.

There are some nights i will stay awake, lost in taughts,  reflecting on how long this will continue, the loneliness and boredom. There are times i feel tired even after having a quality sleep at night. I smile publicly but in the close door I feel lost.

But lately I think am willing to talk to someone maybe to my elder sister, she is good at listening and givie attention. I have to be honest with her that am not strong, that I need help and I want to share my worry with her. Am drowning silently i think i need help even though am afraid to admit it.

I can't will keep postponing each day or midnight because at midnight postponing seize, Midnight is not only the time I have to break down alone, it's a time i share my emotions with someone instead of keeping it to myself. Avoiding to speak out has not done me good or made me to be a strong woman rather it has left me in the dark and lonely. Its best i speak out than being alone in my midnight decision. 

Thanks for visiting my blog @amara24. Loads of love 💕❤️🥰

body.title: A new day!
body.body:
Today was a better day!
I had a descent rest last night.
Still a little tired, hopefully it will pass before the weekend!

What is this weekend?
It's the first weekend of camping up at our trailer, for the season.
I am super excited!
Last year was @bradleyarrow's first time camping with me.
We will be going on atv rides, having camp fires, making s'mores! Yummy😋
Most importantly, making memories!

My son Ryan got to experience something awesome today!
It is on my bucket list to do, little bugger got to experience first.
He went on a helicopter ride!
He was going to Glovers Island, an island in Grand Lake, to bid on a job!
As I said before, he is a carpenter by trade, a good one at that.
A company is putting a goldmine there, lots of money to be made.

I wish him the best of luck!
He was excited about the whole thing.
When they got close to the island, they could not land, the wind was too high coming off Grand Lake.
Here a couple of pictures.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cathyarrow/242NTxWVBenU1b9gG8SCtARUAQQWM8x7EEgc6fww8pN23xY6xFuDYSDgCp5W3Y3nzhZ8p.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cathyarrow/23xKvHKkpHEm3j8iQJUFq57BcrESkDxhGYNyDmLrLFasfWuVKkLKM5VMkZGFXhefbnbUi.png)

Riding in style!


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cathyarrow/243q29ysKFNDy4vQ7HdJDrLQr1JhqmSX3FYp5XZGEKjyiXk4f155Td1j3Xr2LAGA6pND1.png)

A picture of the town of Deer Lake, where he was raised.

They will give it another try soon, to get on the island.

I am so proud of all that he accomplished in the past 3 1/2 years.
He is a recovering drug addict, crack cocaine was his choice of drugs.
He lost everything he owned.
His children, truck, job, house and me.

It was a awful time in our lives.
He ended up in jail for 8 months, where he decided to change his life around.

I ended up with his boys, his wife at the time was gone off her rocker also.
She currently is still living her life as an addict.
She hasn't seen her boys for 3 years now.

Ryan got rid of her while they were doing drugs.
Ryan is engaged to marry again, she also was an addict.
Together they changed their lives around.
She also has 2 children.

Ryan got out of jail November, 2023, it wasn't an easy road let me tell you.
So much hurt, pain, healing, forgiveness, was felt by all of us.
Slowly but surely he picked up the pieces and rebuilt his life.
From the ground up.

He obeyed every rule he had to follow, curfew, home by 8pm, he lived with my Aunt.
Someone knew what he was like before he was an addict, and gave him a job.
He always said that Ryan is a good person/worker, he just went down the wrong path.

Fast forward to today, he got his own company, he is hiring workers for the up coming work season.
That my friends is a big accomplishment. 

I left a lot of details out, way too much for me to type, and I like to leave it where it is, in the past!
It just goes to show, that anyone can change and deserves a second chance!
I love my son with all of my heart, I am so grateful for prayers and to him to be the son, dad and soon to be husband that he is.

Good night, God Bless🙏
Life is good💞

body.body:
Good morning all, doing my 5 minutes free writing with prompt - Convince Me. Hope you enjoy the story.


![images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQp1wdc6I3x2rE_cfYLz7CPtsfcIj5eyoY9ESIBBoMmog&s=10](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQp1wdc6I3x2rE_cfYLz7CPtsfcIj5eyoY9ESIBBoMmog&s=10)

[Source](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQp1wdc6I3x2rE_cfYLz7CPtsfcIj5eyoY9ESIBBoMmog&s=10)


In life, I think a lot of argument can be avoided. But at the same time, a lot of argument started because both parties or more are unwilling to convince one another of their views and standpoint. 

In a logical society which we are, we should be talking about logic and reason rationally. Everything works in a certain manner because it follows a set of discovery or a set of define rule that is universal.

For example, what are we rooted to the ground on Earth, we all agreed or in most cases, born and taught to accept there's gravity on Earth. Where else astronauts floats on Moon for the lack of gravitational pull. 

For newer ideas, where it's not widely proven or in the initial stage of proofing. The originator would have to convince me of the truth behind, no argument is needed, facts can speak for itself. That's why reading published paper in established journal is a good way of gathering facts as these authors would have spent months or years researching and proving their theory. 

Therefore, next time when someone said to us \
we should be happy that he or she is likely to be reasonable.

body.body:
This has a lot to do with the way we think and, in some cases, even with our experiences. Sometimes, I used to get on my mom’s case for keeping so many things at home, things that didn’t even make sense, at least not to me. I thought that way my whole life and even started to wonder if my mom had some kind of compulsive hoarding disorder.

You know, as the years went by, I realized it wasn’t exactly about possession in the material sense, or about the feeling of having a lot of things, but rather about the mindset of saving things to use later. Like you said, some things are kept for a special occasion that may never come, but watching what my mom did, after so much time, I realized she did it out of fear, fear of needing something and not having it.

We come from a humble family, and she learned from my grandfather to save things because, in times of scarcity, stored items can be useful. For a long time, I heard a phrase my mom used to say, and when I was little, my grandfather used to say it too: “whoever saves, has.”

It sounds like a silly phrase, but it makes sense. Today I understand it, even though I don’t feel the need to keep things, especially with how much life has improved in many ways and how easy it is to get things if necessary.

So I don’t know, maybe because I’ve always lived around that mindset, today I try to live as minimally as possible. It feels like the more things I have, the more tied down I become, and I like having freedom. It’s as if material accumulation becomes a weight that holds us back, or maybe that’s just a crazy idea of mine haha Anyway, I like the things you say, and it really does make a lot of sense

body.title: My Midnight Decision
body.body:
I have developed the habit of leaving important  decisions I have to make till midnight. Midnight for me is a time of peace and clarity when everywhere is quiet, no distractions, at that moment my thoughts can flow well. I can think deeply, pray, and carefully evaluate my options without pressure. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUeyFVXeniXkj9ry1JNABWdHyKCZsQmx8uBsDXQXs5nxo/1778014181933.jpg)

There was a particular experience I had that made me believe so much in  midnight decision making. A friend of mine once introduced me to a business opportunity she was very exited about. She kept pressuring me to join, insisting that it was a great deal. At first, everything about the offer sounded too good to be true, and her confidence and achievements in the business almost convinced me. 

I refused to rush into a decision, I told her that I needed time to think about it. That night,  at midnight, when everyone was fast asleep and the environment was calm and peaceful. I pick up my phone after saying a prayer, I began to research the business thoroughly.

To my greatest surprise, I discovered that the so-called opportunity was actually a Ponzi scheme. It became clear that it was not a legitimate business, but one that would eventually collapse and cause financial loss to those involved.

The next morning, I called my friend and shared my findings with her. I explained my decision not to join and warned her about the risks. Unfortunately, she refused to listen and remained convinced that the business was genuine.

Just a week later, the business collapsed exactly as I had feared. Many people lost their money, and my friend ended up in serious debt.

Through that experience, I learnt that taking time to reflect expecially in quiet moments like midnight can save one from costly mistakes.

This is @midnightletters Prompt #25  and I am @sarahbaby sending lots of love ♥️♥️♥️♥️

Although I have taken so many decisions in my entire life, there's one decision that used to get settled by me in the middle of the night and this one decision is using the network to do transactions in the middle of the night, most especially bank transactions.

My decision has been made at night due to over-crowded use of the network in my area during the day.  So, for this, I have always made it a point of duty to carry out any of my network related transactions in the middle of the night so as not to be hindered by the over-crowded use of the network in the day.

Doing it at midnight as a result of my midnight decision has made it now easier for me from unwanted and unnecessary explanations.

In conclusion, this and many more had been taken by me in the middle of the night and I can tell you that these my decisions have  proved worthy of it the end.

body.title: Let's Keep Living Real, Predicting Death Would Destroy Originality
body.body:
A DEVICE THAT CAN TELL DEATH TIME
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQpPJcvFE1kkU3ZMe5KRXcZfdZL8c8T84ta11YS4W3qzg/image.png) [Geralt](https://pixabay.com/images/download/geralt-time-1739629_1920.jpg) Hello #Scifimultiverse, happy new week. I welcome you to my blog. Death is inevitable and a debt we owe to the creator. Some people are mindful of the way they would die. I have worked with a boss who once told us a story about a man who had an accident on the road, and while people rushed to the scene for rescue services, an attempt to carry him from the scene revealed he was wearing torn pants. Immediately, he decided to always dress well from head to toe to avoid such embarrassment in his last moments. He went further to reiterate that ever since that incident, when going to bed, he dresses properly in case Mr. Death knocks at his door, he will exit without leaving his family embarrassed. Imagine if that kind of person had access to a device that could tell the time of death, maybe he would dress in his best outfit and prepare his exit mightily, since he already has the resources. I would like to weigh the pros and cons of buying this device. The things I will consider include: --------------------------------------------------------------- 1.The authenticity of the device, whether the device can predict death, and the level of accuracy. Has anybody used and attested to this device's capability to predict death time? 2.Is the device mobile or stationary? This will enable me to make a better decision regarding carrying it about, especially when I travel. Carrying it about will mean serious inconvenience to my person. I wouldn’t want such a load. 3.The size and access: Can my whole family access one device, or is it an individual device? 4.What is the durability of the device? Is it digital or some analogue device? -------------------------------------------------------------- However, this device will cause individuals to start living a fake life, because in the pursuit of eternity, many people will want to adjust their lifestyle immediately upon notification of their death timeline. Again, the rich may make life miserable for the poor by causing artificial scarcity of the device to deal with those who cannot afford it. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT9YzL3sgFfBtYFx6VbHDwYMySRxukf8L1JanMnrWBoXP/image.png) [Jon Tyson](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1631474034318-8e1195d1a0b8?q=80&w=735&auto=format&fit=crop&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&ixid=M3wxMjA3fDB8MHxwaG90by1wYWdlfHx8fGVufDB8fHx8fA%3D%3D) I would not like to buy such a device because the scripture revealed that no one knows the date or time of their death. Some have been given the grace to set their families in order before their death. This is the kind of grace I want to attain, direct from the throne of mercy and not from a mere device that can develop fault and fail. Feel free to join the contest [here](https://ecency.com/hive-111030/@scifimultiverse/scifi-multiverse-prompt-week-66-edition-1-or-a-device-that-can-tell-death-timeor) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT66pGVYf4ZESvQddY2iD13s38hzQrtvM9JussceRXdAC/image.png)

body.title: LATEST TRIO VIBES... #TTT
body.body:
>*Music is life itself!*


A good music(s) is literally all it takes to make for a good day.
While I might be exaggerating, I'm quite certain that I'm not. If that makes any sense.


In a literal sense,  I won't say I begin my day by playing out the songs I have sitting pretty on my not-so-many playlists. But I love to think my day begins the very moment I tap the play button on the first song that calls out to me.

So what am I saying?... The power of music and my undiluted love for it cannot be underestimated and diluted. And I'm pretty sure my fellow music lovers can relate 💯.


*****



![IMG_20260505_222716.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soma18/23tv2Le8XEPsNRErXpdZ47ZUXPayUDr5Z9jZZcKzYBhoLNBS5JKke3bCZ5MXeEM7uzRVK.jpg)


It's been a while I joined the #ttt contest though,  just as it's been an even longer while since I participated in any other contest by communities in the blockchain or worst still, written a personal blog.  
But I'm so much glad to be doing that now... And even better, centred on something I cherish - which I almost missed by the way. Sighs.


For my entry today, I simply chose to share the latest trio (songs ) I added to my playlists - dance pops and hip hop.               

Adopting their reverse order, I present an Ariana Grande's melodious tune 'BYE' though Altare 's remix version of it which I got to know about thanks to a friend of mine who used it as a background sound to a cute video she made of herself, otherwise I'm sure I wouldn't have known about it. Atleast not any time soon... Probably.


*****


https://youtu.be/agneRtEe-t8?si=9xVEN2nPqsYJKhL4


Ariana, with her dulcet voice has always been a great singer and she didn't disappoint with this song.
Before I could say 'A', I had swiftly switched from simply nodding my head and attempting to lip sync the beat to actually listening in! 


Next up.... \

ft. NLE Choppa.
Or more like, listen to me now... Lol.  Yet another vibe that got royally posited on my playlist. A pretty cool beat that makes anyone wanna shake their heads and sway their bodies to it.  Emphasis on anyone 🙃.


*****

https://youtu.be/deHxoVnBjlM?si=lLtFrW-ZaeTdpt2t


Anddddd, last but surely not the least, I have paparazzi by Lady Gaga .... Oh myyyyy.  This one just had me smiling on listening in.


*****

https://youtu.be/d2smz_1L2_0?si=IN0z46W-KGgbWosZ


Being my first time listening to her song despite how prominent her name is in the music industry, I just didn't know what to expect so yeah, I wasn't prepared to be blown off my feet with the banger 😉.

So peeps, I bet these are enough vibes for the day... Do well to listen in and rock your worries far awayyyy!


*****

Till the next contest... Hopefully 🤞.

Ciao!

🌟

body.body:
> Debo confesar que para mí todos los días son musicales, literalmente como una película ja ja ja… Y es que cuando algo me sale mal, o no logro concretar algo, o quizás un mal día de trabajo, suelo cantar, es mi manera de calmarme y no hacerle honor a mi signo que cuando se enfada suele más bien meter más los pies en el fango así que si me ponemos a pensar definitivamente mi vida es un musical ja ja ja… No es para llorar es para seguir sonriendo pues debemos entender que todo lo que nos ocurre tiene un porqué y de seguro que algún aprendizaje lograremos obtener. >_I have to admit that, for me, every day is like a musical literally, just like a movie, ha ha ha… You see, when something goes wrong, or I can’t get something done, or maybe I’m having a bad day at work, I usually sing. It’s my way of calming down and not living up to my zodiac sign, which, when it gets angry, tends to just dig itself deeper into the mud. So if we really think about it, my life is definitely a musical, ha ha ha… It’s not a reason to cry it’s a reason to keep smiling because we have to understand that everything that happens to us happens for a reason, and we’re sure to learn something from it._
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQff3hEbikki1Za9EhL8onoJ1vXJyYoXqq5Ci45351E1r3xx4PB8vHKDm5SeVVPRYua.png)
Como saben suele usar TTT para hablar de mí, de la música que me ha rodeado en mi vida y hoy no es la excepción pero no hablaremos del pasado, todo lo contrario, estaremos en presente porque definitivamente hay quienes siguen luchando por ese sonido que en el 2000 revoluciono la industria y la vida del rock. Es cierto que por algunos motivos hoy es más reflejada otro tipo de genero del que por cierto, ya hemos conversado, ya que he dado a demostrar en estos TTT que existen nuevas bandas de rock con mucho carácter, fuerza y un excelente sonido. >_As you know, I usually use TTT to talk about myself and the music that has surrounded me throughout my life, and today is no exception. But we won’t be talking about the past quite the opposite. We’ll be focusing on the present, because there are definitely those who continue to fight for that sound that revolutionized the industry and the world of rock in 2000. It’s true that, for some reasons, another genre is more prominent today one we’ve actually already discussed since I’ve shown in these TTTs that there are new rock bands with a lot of character, energy, and an excellent sound._
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQff3hEbikki1Za9EhL8onoJ1vXJyYoXqq5Ci45351E1r3xx4PB8vHKDm5SeVVPRYua.png)
Algunos pensarán que habrá bandas que deberían de haber muerto hace dos décadas y sin embargo, hay muchas que siguen más vigentes que nunca como lo es el caso de las bandas que hoy les presentaré. Por ejemplo, Korn es una de ellas. Mientras muchos daban por muerto el nu-metal después de los 2000, Jonathan Davis y los suyos continúan encontrando formas de resonar y literalmente gritarle al mundo que siguen más vivos que nunca. Aunque bueno, es entendible que la edad no pasa en vano, el mismo Jonathan ya no tiene la misma resistencia pero aún así ese hombre sigue con su respectivo paral realizando conciertos y el más reciente ha sido en Colombia. > _Some might think there are bands that should have faded away two decades ago, yet there are many that remain as relevant as ever as is the case with the bands I’m going to introduce to you today. For example, Korn is one of them. While many wrote off nu-metal after the 2000s, Jonathan Davis and his band continue to find ways to resonate and literally shout to the world that they’re more alive than ever. Of course, it’s understandable that age takes its toll Jonathan himself doesn’t have the same stamina anymore but even so, he continues to perform with his band, and their most recent concert was in Colombia._ La banda ha revivido su sonido en un estudio de grabación grabando \

, un tema creado como banda sonora de Diablo IV. No es cualquier trabajo es una canción que habla de cargar con las cicatrices como trofeos, no como debilidades y eso sin duda suena por todos lados al Korn clásico: guitarras bajadas, ese sonido característico y la voz de Davis alternando entre el lamento y el rugido. Esuchemos!

>_The band has revived its signature sound in the recording studio with “Reward The Scars,” a track created as the soundtrack for Diablo IV. This isn't just any song it's a track that speaks to carrying scars as trophies, not as weaknesses, and it certainly echoes classic Korn in every way: distorted guitars, that signature sound, and Davis's vocals alternating between a wail and a roar. Let’s give it a listen!_

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sHmnnNxu6Ww

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQff3hEbikki1Za9EhL8onoJ1vXJyYoXqq5Ci45351E1r3xx4PB8vHKDm5SeVVPRYua.png)

<div class=\

> Otra banda que de seguro creía que estaba extinta fue Foo Fighters y fíjense que no, tengo un par de meses escuchando la propuesta y lo que puedo decir es ¡Sí que están de vuelta! No cabe duda que con esta canción la banda marca un regreso al sonido grunge y crudo de los primeros trabajos, con esas guitarras pesadas y esa peculiar energía agresiva que contrasta con el sonido más pulido. Esta Banda ha estado pasando por muchísimo estrés personal desde la muerte Taylor Hawkins la banda tuvo que tomarse un tiempo de luto pero como lo hubiera querido Taylor, la música debe seguir sonando. Esta canción fue lanzada hace muy poco y los invito a escuchar esta nueva mejorada propuesta donde el Punk y Post-Grunge dicen presente. >_Another band I was sure had called it quits was Foo Fighters, but guess what? This band has been going through a lot of personal stress since Taylor Hawkins’ death; the band had to take some time to mourn, but just as Taylor would have wanted, the music must keep playing. This song was released very recently, and I invite you to listen to this new, improved track where punk and post-grunge make their presence felt._ https://youtu.be/Lgy4a0tXz7M?si=lQbzp0jD5bt9k1vA

body.title: The Regret I’ve Carried for Years - LOH #287
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>


For the past six years, I have been carrying a heavy feeling that has prevented me from my reality. Sometimes the resentment that comes from the situation is extreme, and sometimes it's regret; maybe I would have done it this way or that way, and I wouldn't be carrying this heavy weight that weighs me down over the years, so I thought...



![1778021638029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nkemakonam89/23zGifL1CnDfDQo3MQXh6Wt9stjiCBVfEpSCjBDaWWCqVu9cNGoydL89ZPnj7rdcxxH3V.jpg)


I know there were days when everything looked fine on the outside, but deep down inside of me, I felt the weight, the silent kind of weight that stole my joy even when I should have been happy. This weight mostly comes in the form of regret, but it is what it is. 





Regret over a condition I wish I could have approached differently; the word \

I voiced out without thinking outside the box. I stayed silent, thinking that the whole situation was under control since I was in a good hospital, but I was wrong. I should have known better; I should have thought deeper; I should have made a smart decision, as Mum, who is also in a medical field, even though I am not a medical doctor. There are lots of, had I known, lots of regrets. I kept going hard on myself, wishing for the hand of the clock to be reset so I could make a smart decision or opinion, but if only wishes were horses. After the MRI brain scan my son had, the neurologist handling his case told me clearly that his issue is a developmental defect, and even surgery cannot correct it!.. He said a lot that I didn't know when tears rolled down my cheeks because upon hearing such a statement, I quickly recalled the time I gave birth to my son prematurely. And the hospital told us to buy all materials needed for the incubator, as my child will complete the gestational period over there. We didn't hesitate at all but bought all the needed materials requested. Only for the same doctor to come back after 24 hours and say they have checked my son and seen that everything is okay, so no need for an incubator. I was overly excited and gifted all the incubator materials we bought to other moms who needed it. Only for me to later notice the congestion at the neonatal unit and the death of a baby over there. I began to wonder, could it be that there is no space for them to admit my newborn over there that made them discharge him, or were they saying the truth that, indeed, my child is okay and doesn't need to enter the incubator? To be sincere, I didn't deliberate on this thought for a long time but rather told myself that I can't question a doctor but believe his diagnosis; after all, I am not a doctor. The excitement that I was going home was heavenly after a long time I stayed in the hospital over the pregnancy complications. If only I knew what was coming; I would have been patient to really verify that truly, my child is fit to go home. Four years after the birth, my son suddenly went unconscious—no fall, no fever, no nothing—and seizures started to this date. He is already 11 years old, and since he was four, I have been suffering over his health challenge; it's been terrible dealing with a brain condition. I can't count the number of hospitals I have visited so far, and I'm still counting. The resources are going out day by day to date. The emotional torture on my end, the pain my son has gone through, and more...it's a whole lot of regret!. Honestly, I am finding it hard to forgive myself, and nothing that I know I am doing is helping the situation as it is now, but I wish to, just not yet, but I keep striving; it's not easy, though, watching my first son live on drugs to control the brain condition. ***** This post is in response to the ladies of Hive prompt #287. Interesting in participating ? Click [here](https://peakd.com/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-287) ## Image is mine !

No grass cutting today, instead im sowing some seeds; courgette and peas. For the peas, I’m trying something new: a ‘seed snail’ ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5DB2355D-E4C4-43EF-83C3-9D1A3B31A8681778021637.768491) This is where you lay out a piece of plastic (or bubblewrap in this case) and put a layer of potting compost on it. body.title: HIVE IS PUMPING The Web3 Social Blockchain You're Already Using Just Exploded!
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWFbYW6TMTJANts1G3nWuPzw1T6p5psDa4UdjTUCfvVwR/1778021405461.jpg)


Hive (HIVE) just posted one of the most impressive moves of the week  +26.17% on Binance, spiking from a low of $0.0589 all the way to a 24 hour high of $0.0988 on massive volume of 246 million HIVE. The chart is explosive weeks of complete flatline near $0.0589, then one vertical green candle that changed everything. And the irony? You're probably already using this blockchain right now.

What Is Hive  And Why Is It Special?

Hive is a blockchain running on a delegated proof of stake consensus mechanism, launched in March 2020 as a hard fork of the Steem blockchain  born as a community rebellion against centralization when Justin Sun of Tron attempted to take over Steem. The community forked the chain, took their data and content, and built something entirely independent.  
The Hive ecosystem runs on two cryptocurrencies HIVE, the native governance token, and HBD, the USD-pegged stablecoin. The blockchain is designed for Web3 social media applications with an emphasis on speed, scalability, and fee-less transactions.   That means zero gas fees every time you post, comment, or vote  something no other major blockchain can offer at this scale.

The Platform Is Thriving

Hive's ecosystem includes numerous second-layer projects utilizing its fast, free transactions to build web apps, spanning DeFi, gaming, fitness, blogging, and video with applications like Splinterlands, PeakD, and HiveBlog already live and active.   Splinterlands alone has processed hundreds of millions of transactions  more than most DeFi chains combined.
All posted original content is permanently stored on the Hive blockchain, and creators earn rewards in HIVE and HBD through the Proof of Brain protocol  which maintains content quality by leveraging human curation to distribute rewards to the most valuable posts.   Writers, photographers, crypto analysts all getting paid directly on-chain, no middleman, no platform cut.

The Altcoin Season Narrative

With a 7 day gain of 25.30%, HIVE is massively outperforming the global crypto market which is up just 5.30% in the same period.   Capital is rotating hard into undervalued social and Web3 infrastructure tokens  and HIVE, with a market cap of just $41 million, is perfectly positioned as one of the most undervalued Layer 1 blockchains in the space.

The Technical Picture Is Explosive

The Binance 1H chart tells the full story. After weeks of complete consolidation at $0.0589, a single candle ripped through all three EMAs simultaneously  EMA 25 at 0.0743, EMA 50 at 0.0702, EMA 100 at 0.0662  all cleared in one move. Volume at the spike hit nearly 51 million HIVE in a single candle  that is institutional level buying, not retail FOMO.
HIVE hit its all time low of just $0.05536 on March 31, 2026  anyone who bought that bottom is already sitting on +77% gains in just five weeks. The recovery from absolute capitulation lows with genuine platform utility behind it is one of the strongest setups in all of crypto. 
HIVE's all time high was $3.42 in November 2021  currently trading 97.81% below that peak.  With a live, active ecosystem, zero fee transactions, and a growing Web3 social media narrative, the recovery runway for HIVE in 2026 is enormous.

---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

body.title: 5th Seed Starting – May 2, 2026@goldenoakfarm
body.body:
![Backyard - rainy day crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xATu4h4NzGmcoNyucpuwE6szRp6p5bEmVDZr2h6aCnNzcjqw1bo7yZ78EDK5bVDjGN9.jpg)

*Rainy spring morning*

Saturday morning I was up just after 6AM and got a load in the dishwasher. I got my post up and then started setting up for seed starting. My #1 intern came down around 8:30AM and brought the materials upstairs then left to do a painting job. It was to rain all day and be in the 50’s.

Later I got the kitchen cleaned up and got started.

![Setting up for seed starting collage text crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/241tdRiGtJJEknGFm8S1XRkpMfCyxEFs32EZMmmeR2fZUsG6zmzuKR6pDg47vydQVNdHa.jpg)

I got the trays laid out and then decided to sit down and do the notes and seeds. I discovered I’d made the same mistake for the 3rd time: writing in small pots where large ones were needed. I’d also written down I needed 15 tomatoes when I really only needed 9. Sigh… So in the end we used the same number of trays.

![5th seed starting chart May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23tmjWH7oczfhgES14p6iKdUQ6Uu52r2sTGgstUukodmrpdeTm5PN7kkoVr2Vy2KZwkdE.jpg)

I got all the markers written, even though I’d lost the bag full of the ones I’d wanted to use. Everything was done, so I set about filling pots and soaking the soil. When I’d filled all the trays on the counter, I went and sat down to wait for my #1 intern to return at noon to do the seed starting.

![Windows fill again collage text crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23yTmiEwAyJ1YC11TC4N3vNBX4VqoMLLwzPo3S2RTWxnbtrY6K9fJ2gZP1t6iCb3aNi1B.jpg)

We finished about 2PM and got the kitchen wiped down and cleaned up. I sat down and watched ‘My Favorite Martian’ until bedtime.

On Sunday, my brother said he’d help me get 6 more windows done in the morning. That ought to do me in.

![Mini bio framed Jan 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyn876JURgHHjsp757ZTvXeEEBjdDeLXWynRcLCeuqwPPsqtEtXTosSPyKZdAgWivJB.jpg)

![GridArt_20260504_210900117.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EouBB9XiYWC1erfXPQHttTJKcDSr8KE7X1SiVzMtDxpfSG7KcuUZGd7ixbPH4vYkusE.jpg)

![IMG_20260425_130644.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EpnFdi1SUuh9JcFdbqB7f1GyKpZ3683Km3T3Nmy7bSUJFTwpda4rjwzPgNBkD9vPFAb.jpg)

> Recuerdo un tiempo en que me sentí presa en pensamientos de enfermedad, pues vivía con miedos, esos que te bloquean y te hacen sentir inseguro, en donde los nervios se apoderaron de mí. Pasé años tomando pastillas, me volví adicta y me sentí atrapada; no sabía cómo dejarlas. Algunas personas me decían que era algo mental; más bien creo que era algo que uno mismo lo sana, teniendo pensamientos positivos, creyendo en ti mismo, sintiéndote libre. Así empecé a controlarlo, sin pastillas, hasta que sané. >I remember a time when I felt trapped by thoughts of illness, because I was living with fears—the kind that paralyze you and make you feel insecure—and my nerves took over. I spent years taking pills, became addicted, and felt trapped; I didn’t know how to stop. Some people told me it was a mental issue; I think it was something you heal yourself, by having positive thoughts, believing in yourself, and feeling free. That’s how I started to get it under control, without pills, until I was healed.

> Otra de mis opiniones es que aquí en esta plataforma somos libres de escribir nuestras experiencias, conocimientos, sentimientos de manera libre; no tenemos un horario, tampoco una comunidad específica, pues escogemos las favoritas, claro está que siempre respetando las reglas de cada comunidad. Por esa razón me gusta estar aquí, y los hechos lo revelan, pues ya 8 años navegando en este ecosistema. >Another view I hold is that here on this platform, we’re free to share our experiences, knowledge, and feelings openly; we don’t have a set schedule or a specific community to follow, since we choose the ones we like best—though, of course, we always respect each community’s rules. body.title: Is being a single mother acceptable in the eyes of God? || MCGI topic review
body.body:
Greetings!

https://youtu.be/l13EhMBseRY?si=M_DrbOluY6DIApyF

I’m glad to have you here once again. Today, I’d like us to reflect on a powerful message from the word of God, shared through His servant, Bro. Eli Soriano.
One truth the Bible makes very clear is that God is not partial. In Romans 2:11, we are reminded that He does not show favoritism. God doesn’t treat one person as more important than another. The same message is echoed in James 2:1, where believers are warned not to let favoritism influence their faith in our Lord Jesus Christ.

When you really think about it, this makes perfect sense. Every human being was created by God, and in His eyes, everyone has value. No one is insignificant. That is why the Bible teaches that God desires all people to be saved. In 1 Timothy 2:4, we are told that He wants everyone to come to the knowledge of the truth.

This tells us something very important about God’s heart—His love is for everyone. 

As 2 Peter 3:9 explains, God is patient with us. He is not quick to condemn but gives people time to turn away from sin and find their way back to Him.

If this is how God sees us, then it challenges how we should see others. There is no room for rejection or discrimination, whether it is based on someone’s past, their status, or their personal struggles.

For example, being a single mother or having a difficult background should never be a reason for exclusion. In the true church of God, we are called to reflect His love by accepting and caring for one another.

1 Corinthians 12:25 reminds us that there should be no division among believers. Instead, we are to look out for each other and treat one another with genuine concern.

We can also learn from the early church. Take Mary Magdalene, for instance. She had a troubled past and was once under the influence of evil spirits. Yet, she was delivered, accepted, and transformed. She became a faithful follower of Jesus and played a role in supporting His ministry, as seen in Luke 8:2.
Her story is a beautiful reminder that no one is beyond God’s reach. No matter where a person is coming from, they can be changed, accepted, and used for a greater purpose.

So, as we go about our daily lives, let’s remember to see people the way God sees them—with compassion, fairness, and love.

Thanks for reading.

body.title: Schlafmangel am Stück
body.body:
Hallo Freunde,

wisst ihr wie sehr ich diesen Schlafmangel inzwischen fast schon liebe, der einen die ganze Zeit begeleitet. Langsam sammeln sich die Krankmeldungen immer mehr und so bleibt auch immer mehr arbeit an denen hängen, die sich nicht krank melden und damit man irgendwie sein Leben noch am laufen halten kann, muss man Zeit aufbringen, den Alltag in die Stunden reinzubringen, die übrig bleibt. Ich meine wenn man mehr oder weniger die ganze Zeit nur auf der Arbeit ist, kann man schlecht den Haushalt mit einbinden, sonst kann man ganzschöne Probleme bekommen.

Aber mal schauen wo sich das alles noch hinentwickelt, ich weiß nur das ich inzwischen jeden Tag langsam ein Level an Schlafmangel habe, bei dem ich nicht weiß wohin es dann wieder geht. Mal schauen wie schlimm das noch alles wird, aktuell weiß ich schon nicht mehr welcher Tag ist, im Monat bin ich mir aber noch fast sicher. Aber hey, irgendwie muss das Gesundheitswesen ja am laufen gehalten werden.

In dem Sinne, gehabt euch wohl und immer dran denken, schlaft ausreichend, es ist gut für die Gesundheit. Und in dem SInne, gehabt euch wohl.

body.title: No borro nada - Mensaje diarii de 5 minutos
body.body:
No soy de las que borran el pasado, ni las fotos, ni los recuerdos, ni las experiencias, porque cada una de ellas, las que me hicieron reír y las que me hicieron llorar, me fue construyendo. 

Las cosas buenas me enseñaron a disfrutar la vida, a valorar los momentos hermosos. 

Las malas me enseñaron a ser fuerte, a no rendirme, a saber que después de la tormenta siempre sale el sol.

Por eso, no borro nada, porque todo lo vivido es parte de mí.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmayqhBP3PK1p1v9nqQS9UaHiM58EycCscvr82rNYqRgUh/1778020809668.jpg)

ENGLISH
I'm not one to erase the past, not photos, not memories, not experiences, because each one of them—those that made me laugh and those that made me cry—has shaped me.

The good things taught me to enjoy life, to value beautiful moments.

The bad things taught me to be strong, to never give up, to know that after the storm, the sun always comes out.

That's why I don't erase anything, because everything I've lived through is a part of me.

Al leer tu publicación y lo que ha vivido el familiar de tu amiga, me trasladé a los días en que llegó mi hermano Enrique a mi casa en Maracay. El hombre había sufrido una caída y se había fracturado la cadera, el hombro y un brazo. El impacto nos hizo descubrir que padecía una enfermedad que le consumía los huesos. No podía levantarse; no podía bañarse ni asearse por sí mismo. Allí estuve yo, al pie del cañón.

Pero lo terrible fue cuando me tocó llevarlo al Ambulatorio del Norte para un chequeo con una traumatóloga de apellido García. Lo trasladamos en un vehículo particular que costó conseguir; en esos momentos de angustia los amigos desaparecen y, en aquellos días, ningún familiar estaba cerca. Llevarlo sentado le producía un dolor intenso. En el ambulatorio, pasaron horas antes de que llegara la doctora.

Lo positivo fue que los vigilantes se mostraron receptivos y ayudaron a bajarlo del carro y movilizarlo en silla de ruedas. Sin embargo, el trato de las enfermeras mientras esperábamos fue horrible, y no solo con mi hermano, sino con varios pacientes. Eso fue en un turno de la mañana. No entiendo por qué algunos empleados públicos desatan tal furia contra el ciudadano; si no les gusta su trabajo, deberían renunciar.

En otra oportunidad fui a CORPOSALUD, en Las Delicias, a solicitar una ambulancia para trasladarlo al Hospital Central, pues había contactado a un médico que nos ayudaría con todos los exámenes. La respuesta fue lapidaria: \

. Un servicio que se supone gratuito. Tuve que ingeniármelas y pagar una ambulancia privada; no iba a pagarle al gobierno por un servicio que es un derecho.

En el Hospital Central nos atendieron bien; desde el camillero hasta los médicos fueron excelentes. Pero la falta de insumos y de personal convertía la espera en un infierno, y lo peor era tener que volver varios días seguidos.

Lamentablemente, mi hermano falleció el 6 de junio de 2020. Me queda el mal sabor de los espacios de salud pública. Tiempo después, una amiga médico especialista en salud pública me confesó que, en su gran mayoría, quienes están en los centros no están aptos; que los buenos se fueron del país y que el personal administrativo y de enfermería suele ser colocado por compadrazgo, con un conocimiento escaso sobre medicina y atención al paciente. No son todos, pero estoy seguro de que abundan porque lo viví.

Leer tu texto me revolvió la rabia; no por ti, hermano querido, sino por lo que nos ha tocado resistir en estos más de 20 años de maldad.

Un fuerte abrazo desde este lado del planeta.

!ALIVE

body.title: The Company of the Right People
body.body: > Since I began writing on my blog for Hive, many people have passed through my life—and, in fact, I encouraged many of them to start writing or recording themselves singing—yet as time went by, only a few of us remained: those who truly fell in love with the platform. The women accompanying me in these photos—my now-wife and her best friend—are among those who, at one point, lived out their blogging lives on Hive to the fullest. That is what makes them stand out amidst the many people who surround me today: they know that every adventure and every photograph eventually finds its way here—captured in a moment of inspiration and memories. I believe they can no longer imagine a life shared with me that lacks the magic of celebrating life itself.

> ![IMG_20240324_144555.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xyTNdEztf2ggWKBF2JsohJVvPjuLxmgwrjzoKuCyX2uH2YLiFMMew18pABSXf7kx9tm.jpg) ![IMG_20240324_144638.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xpKN51gAQb559B4emm8Ezbfdi1C6T3VR62WSontVeuAb4h48z5rruR8n6wWRS2nmamw.jpg)
Jhoxiris and Kimberly make for the perfect company when exploring new places—a fact beautifully captured that afternoon in Santiago de Compostela, Spain. It wasn't a Wednesday; in fact, it was Palm Sunday, which meant the streets were empty and the city was remarkably quiet. We had a concert scheduled for that evening, but since our plane had landed that morning, we had plenty of time to get to know the city—and I certainly walked them until they were ready to drop. That said, I didn't get off scot-free; Kimberly herself demanded at least three photos a minute. Yet the walk was so delightful that I didn't mind in the slightest; life made me fall in love with Santiago de Compostela from the very moment we stepped off the plane.
![IMG_20240324_145240.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23yTdGSKExqEE4cKSPrqE9jNXZFubb6PAnhAjayM3NddXzHeRgZMTtEpJuU1MYoowFEAv.jpg)
This was one of the best walks of my entire life. If you read my posts regularly on Hive, you’ll know that I’ve written a lot about Santiago de Compostela in Spain—and that’s despite the fact that I was there for exactly just 24 hours! But boy, did I make the most of that city, both day and night; I think sleeping was the last thing I did while I was there—there would be plenty of time for that later, on the buses, once we left the city. The weather was perfect; it was cold, but manageable—our jackets were all we needed to enjoy a wonderful day walking the streets, though I must confess that things got a bit more extreme once night fell! 🤣 The city revealed to us a blend of nature, modernity, and a profound sense of peace, thanks to the sparse crowds wandering about during *siesta* hours. I remember walking for kilometers—and I’ve been sharing all those photos right here on Hive (though I still have a few left to post)—but I hadn’t yet shared the photos showing our joyful faces. And that is exactly what I intend to do today: share a little bit of the joy we felt, simply for the sake of stepping out for a walk 🙏

> ![IMG_20240324_144827.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xVLynLum9PJEi3jRa4biHALe51oF4PQoc3gdgcNw4NfdwMaFWwdtaKsJnimGF4MHr9F.jpg) ![IMG_20240324_135114.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23zkkZTfybQMobdhRqL737wjqHGBH7VKNdBDiCUjSBsG9AQBnV5xSHaeMoNQN45qiHG4C.jpg)
A few days ago, I mentioned to Kimberly during choir rehearsals that I still had about 1,400 photos left from the trip we took to Spain two years ago—and, utterly astonished, she could do nothing but laugh. Although I was already active on Hive, it was in this city—after we’d spent a week roaming around Spain—that we sat down to eat some pizza, and I told her that I had bought my new phone specifically with the intention of filming and photographing absolutely everything, even our simple walks around the neighborhood. She didn't quite get it at the time, but—being the good friend she is—she simply supported me and took the opportunity to have me snap plenty of pictures of her, too. The three of us agreed that this city was our absolute favorite; and despite arriving at the concert utterly exhausted from all the walking we’d done that afternoon, our energy levels were still at 1,000%—so much so that we even went for our customary evening stroll later that night! 🤣
![IMG_20240324_144405.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23vi3xCu11A5vSp4oRFgYCdLDZbkcXSgQ1NhC8aDQbxqDkHJ1DCbV6KHT1u9vBxBLuZaU.jpg)
Since that day, the three of us have gone on many outings together; Kimberly is that indispensable friend when it comes to exploring new places. I remember that, after Spain, we discovered many spots right here in Caracas with her as our guide—and we even explored Medellín, Colombia, entirely on foot in just a few days. The only time this trio of friends was ever separated was when she had to go sing in Mexico while we headed to Rome. It felt sad at the time, but we all thoroughly enjoyed where destiny had taken us; in fact, I was delighted to see that she walked and walked through various Mexican cities, snapping plenty of photos—exactly as I (her Master) had taught her! 🤣

> ![IMG_20240324_145530.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23s9RY1zrYy91khKp5tzNMZoXeQVStDHgNo8YbYdx2ykTmtNFNT6Mv6JttEcJHyHiNTkf.jpg) ![IMG_20240324_144523.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/EowHX4F72hFAdBUxPUWjLMhHdx9CJJGhT7CqTHE2moLn3EAVm7JdrE3yUqLGXkkvu6Q.jpg)
I embarked on this journey with all my energy focused on leaving the pain of grief behind—or rather, on transforming it. Things went well right from day one; and although my final epiphany was still two days away, the streets and the Cathedral of Santiago de Compostela—on that particular Palm Sunday—became my new connection to the spiritual realm and the true beginning of that transformation. Despite everything, I did have a minor disagreement with my wife that afternoon—thanks to Google Maps! 🤣 But even so, the presence of our friend—serving as a welcome third party—ensured that our walk continued to unfold in peace. This walk had all the ingredients for success—so much so that it has remained etched in my mind all these years, and I am still able to write about it and share photographs today. I thought these images would be destined solely for our personal album, but no: I took another look at them just a few days ago, and simply seeing them brought me joy all over again. The beauty of the setting, the weather, and—above all—the company of the right people made this day truly perfect. Thank you so much for stopping by and reading my blog; I truly appreciate it. In this post, I haven't focused on the city's landscapes per se, but rather on the emotion of the experience we shared that afternoon—an experience now preserved for posterity through these photographs. The perfect walk—which began right after some delicious pizzas! 🤭
![IMG_20240324_141216.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/EpA4rP28aXsj7Ge7kVDXLYgUJbneSD5wUaHgpbUTrrEzA13ym98A7goiS7bimnm9933.jpg)
