body.title: EASY doesn't mean Better!
body.body: ? This is usually a saying used in the context of getting rich quick, which came easily. In this case, when something like this happens, not long after, people end up losing everything they achieved quickly.\n\nA well-known example of the effectiveness of this saying is in relation to lottery winners and players who win a lot of money in big leagues such as major basketball. I remember seeing a documentary once, or a video, I don't remember exactly, but it was mentioned that most winners of giant lottery prizes and players with huge salaries end up losing everything they won shortly afterwards. It's surreal for any \

person to think about how someone can lose millions and millions and have nothing left after years.\n\nThe reason is simple, what comes easy, goes easy. People who win the lottery and expensive players in the biggest football and basketball leagues, by receiving a large amount of money, end up raising their standard of living to a level \

with the money they received all at once in the case of lottery winners or for the salaries in the case of players. But they forget that if good planning is not done, if there is an unforeseen event with the player such as the end of a contract or an injury, that salary ends, but the costs continue. And in the case of the lottery winner, every time he spends it is as if he adds a hole in his financial account which, because he does not have a source of income, reduces the amount to a point where the high costs of living become greater than he takes into account. This is a very simple example of how ease is not always the best possible path. I'll be much appreaciated if you **Votes**, **Reblogs** or give any **Tips**. Thanks and have good reading! 🍀 ---

>

## EASY doesn't mean Better!

Taking this concept of ease to today and technology, we arrive at AI. Several experts are selling it as if it were the new great revolution in terms of the advancement of humanity, often betting all their chips on this point, as we see with large investments being made in this area.

As much as AI can help in different areas, such as helping with ideas, creating images, suggestions, creating code, shouldn't we ask ourselves if this is really good? As I mentioned, we are in a period where investments in AI are at the highest level, and as a result, companies are offering these services at less than their cost. A lot was invested in the purchase of video cards that will soon become obsolete, in the construction of large warehouses and energy systems, at one point investors will demand a return on the investment made.

At this point, you could end up being the person who built a great business, which could become unviable if the costs of AI are greater than your gains. If the service provided gets worse and there are more errors, those who have not dedicated themselves to learning and improving in creative and technical areas will become dependent on a tool that will no longer provide answers. Furthermore, we have people increasingly depending on AI for inspiration and to answer questions, if one day this is not available, what will become of these people? It's always interesting to do a \

exercise, and think about how the easiest doesn't always mean the best. You can use technology but not be dependent on it. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeCJZEK6UG5Tc3avBibmLNHkgkN9PXcmVN1jYhHR6aHGG/image.png ---

>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdgemWk9bwe7JDScSmAAon8g2JggDWr77X2QrU4aaV6Vb/easy_doesn_t_mean_better.jpg)

Já ouviu aquele ditado que diz o seguinte: \

? Geralmente esse é um ditado usado no contexto de um enriquecimento rápido, que veio de forma fácil. Nesse caso, quando algo nesse sentido acontece, em não muito tempo depois, as pessoas acabam perdendo tudo que conquistaram de maneira rápida.\n\nUm exemplo bem conhecido da eficácia desse ditado é com relação à ganhadores de loteria e jogadores que ganham muito dinheiro em grandes ligas como as principais do basquete. Me lembro de ter visto uma vez um documentário, ou um vídeo, não me recordo exatamente, mas nele foi comentado que a maioria dos ganhadores de prêmios gigantes de loteria e jogadores com salários altíssimos, acabam perdendo tudo que ganharam pouco tempo depois. É algo surreal para qualquer pessoa \

, pensar em como alguém consegue perder milhões e milhões e não sobrar nada depois de anos.\n\nO motivo é simples, o que vem fácil, vai fácil. As pessoas que ganham na loteria e jogadores caros das maiores ligas do futebol e do basket, ao receber um grande montante de dinheiro, acaba subindo o seu padrão de vida para um nível \

com o dinheiro que receberam de uma vez só no caso dos ganhadores de loteria ou para os salários no caso dos jogadores. Só que eles se esquecem que se não for feito um bom planejamento, se houver um imprevisto com o jogador como um fim de contrato ou uma lesão, aquele salário acaba, mas os custos continuam. E no caso do ganhador de loteria, toda vez que ele gasta é como se ele adicionasse um buraco na sua conta financeira que por ele não ter uma fonte de receita, vai diminuindo o montante até um ponto que os custos alto de vida ficam maiores do que ele tem em conta. Esse é um exemplo bem simples de como a facilidade nem sempre é o melhor caminho possível. Fico agradecido se você puder dar um **Voto**, **Reblogs** ou algum **Tips**. Obrigado e boa leitura! 🍀 ---

>

## EASY doesn't mean Better!

Levando esse conceito de facilidade para os dias de hoje e para a tecnologia, chegamos na IA. Diversos especialistas estão vendendo ela como se fosse à nova grande revolução em termos de avanço da humanidade, apostando muitas vezes todas as fichas nesse ponto, como vemos com grandes investimentos sendo feitos nessa área.

Por mais que a IA consiga ajudar em diversas áreas, como no auxílio de ideias, criação de imagens, sugestões, criação de código, será que não devemos nos perguntar se isso é realmente bom? Como eu mencionei, estamos em um período que os investimentos em IA estão no mais alto nível, e com isso as empresas estão oferecendo esses serviços de forma menor do que o custo. Foram investidos muito na compra de placas de vídeo que logo vão ficar obsoletas, na construção de grandes galpões e sistemas de energia, uma hora os investidores vão requisitar o retorno do investimento feito.

Nesse momento, você pode acabar sendo a pessoa que construiu um grande negócio, que pode ficar inviável se os custos da IA forem maiores do que os seus ganhos. Se o serviço fornecidos ficar pior e ela tiver mais erros, aqueles que não se dedicaram à aprender e melhorar nas áreas criativas e técnicas vão ficar dependentes de uma ferramenta que não vai fornecer mais as respostas. Além disso, temos as pessoas dependendo cada vez mais das IA para inspirações e para responder dúvidas, se um dia isso não estiver disponível, o que será dessas pessoas? É sempre interessante fazer um exercício do \

, e pensar com isso que nem sempre o mais fácil significa o melhor. Você pode usar a tecnologia, mas não ser dependente dela. ---

***

天空总是让我感到宁静与宽广。无论是晴空万里，还是阴云密布，它都展现着不同的情绪。看着白云漂浮，仿佛时间也在慢下来；而夕阳西下时，那绚烂的色彩更是让我感受到生命的美好。天空是无限的希望和梦想的象征，让我在忙碌的生活中找到了片刻的平静与思考。

body.title: The Power of Failure: What One Woman’s Six Business Failures Can Teach Us
body.body:
<center> https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSxPYJx8Stn9wZ9Js5feQVnarDXbaTMzmFTxQiWBEbR1V/17780184942635765594159789117974.jpg 
[Source](https://www.taketheleadwomen.com/blog/starting-again-key-strategies-women-leaders-rebound-failure)</center>

I read in the news where someone actually said that she failed in six businesses For so many people that alone would have been a story failure is actually a Good thing if you understand it perfectly well, and it carries certain shame in our culture Especially when it happened publicly or repeatedly we often treat it like a final verdict as if when someone failed The person is left behind, but that's not even true Since this story has been shared it has pushed back against what we actually thought of before And failure was not the end of the story. It became the beginning of a clearer one. What stood out most in The latest story who has failed in six businesses But still thriving to now is that she failed but what she did after the failure she paused Reflected and did a personal check of all what she was doing That step matters a lot. 

It's not for you to just feel then go into depression. You should be able to Reflect and know what you did wrong, what you did right. Would it be environment, is it funds, is it finance, are Capitals in right check, are friends that are supposed to pull you out of any bad situation that you are in, are they Actually around. 

If that is so, trust me Failure becomes something that can be worked on. Sometimes failure is also a signal It is a nice way of asking the other question Are you building in the public lane? Because if you are building in secret, you can't fail But if you are building in the public, failure becomes your next companion The answer was honest. Selling physical products was not her strength Which she has actually found out. 

That kind of clarity is powerful It takes humility to admit that you are wrong and this thing cannot even work for you because some people Immediately they see something they want to be part of it not knowing if it will work for them or not Many people spend years forcing themselves into business model careers and paths that look attractive from the outside But they are not natural when it comes to practicing. They try as much as possible to follow trend and they copy what is popular They chase what others are making to look easy. Then when it becomes difficult, they blame themselves without ever questioning whether This fits or it does not fit them There are people that actually recognizes their real strength. 

This lady has recognized her real strength To be coaching, mentoring and consulting and those are very different from running a physical product business. One requires a different kind of energy, skills, patience and way of thinking Once she has understood this, she changed direction totally and that changed the way She came out powerful at the end of the day What someone can learn from this story is many The first is that not every failure means that you should quit If you fail, it takes time to learn from this lady's story, reflect and checkmate everything that you are doing There's also a difference between persistence and misalignment You can be doing the wrong thing over and over again and think that you are persistent Whereas it's still going to lead to the same failure There is also a place of misalignment when you are not doing the right thing at the right time in the right place A fish that is trying to swim on land will surely get himself killed So those are the things that you need to work on If these things are not well taken care of, it can make or mar you as a person But persistence can actually become self-sabotaging When you are stubbornly holding on to something that was never a good fit for you Growth does not always come from pushing harder Sometimes it comes from becoming more honest with yourself



Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@timscreative/the-power-of-failure-what-one-womans-six-business-failures-can-teach-us-8xu)

body.title: Ser libre – Que mi mente no sea una jaula, sino una herramienta que ordena  la luz de mi conciencia| To be free – May my mind not be a cage, but a tool that channels the light of my consciousness
body.body: ![Ser libre – Que mi mente no sea una jaula, sino una herramienta que ordena la luz de mi conciencia.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23vi3sNzSWZp5ZAfRz6dYK62CLfd7UK835Q9r6NoGaN3jD1X1MNPPvjTAMbupiykCtQTA.jpg)\n\n<div class=\

>

En Español

Saludos a todos, amigos de la comunidad de #EmpowerTalent , con el tema que nos traen cada semana, especialmente con nuestra querida @angelica7 , para invitarnos a escribir sobre: \

, como entender que todos y cada una de las personas manejan diferentes conceptos, y esto deriva de las creencias, valores, costumbres de cada uno. Se puede ser libre incluso encerrado en 4 paredes; ¿Han pensado alguna vez sobre esta situación? Alguna vez han imaginado que se han sentido presos en algún lugar, o de ideas y pensamientos? ¿Qué harían o harían para sentirse en libertad?, a continuación mi participación: A veces, cuando me detengo a reflexionar, necesito creer que el trabajo que estoy haciendo tiene un significado más allá del cansancio de cada día, incluso si no puedo ver una conexión más grande en lo que estoy haciendo, me genera hasta un sentimiento de vacío.

Una persona con voluntad propia

Pienso que una persona libre al asumir la responsabilidad y las consecuencias de sus propias acciones, puede tomar decisiones que le permiten descubrir su vocación y creatividad, como una suma de muchas cosas no materiales, de sensaciones, dones, talentos, negocios, trabajos y razones, que le llevan hacia adelante. Como un poder de vivir con autenticidad, superando los miedos para seguir su intuición o valores personales. Por ejemplo, puedo ser mejor y hay cosas a las que debo decir “ya basta” y que también debo hacer para lograrlo, porque ya basta de no expresar lo que siento por miedo, basta de poner primero a los demás, es tiempo de pensar en mí misma, basta de esperar el momento perfecto por dudar de lo que puedo hacer, hoy es el momento para decir “no” sin sentir culpa, puedo sonreír por las cosas malas y buenas, por esas que duran sólo un momento. ![Ser libre – Que mi mente no sea una jaula, sino una herramienta que ordena la luz de mi conciencia (3).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23wMf8jHsDX9ME4mZB5YouSXEy12E2TFGPWBB1ahxrd72bARAdvK5BUCQfFTeBuKzoy7i.jpg)

Una actividad ordinaria en un **trabajo sagrado**

En particular, cuando dejo de ver cualquier tarea como una obligación y comienzo a verla como un acto de servicio o una expresión de mí misma, la verdad es que tengo la oportunidad de transformarla por completo, más que un deber, al mirarla como un gesto de bienestar del otro, convertir esas acciones cotidianas como cocinar, limpiar o hacer recados, en expresiones de cuidado y afecto. Entonces si me permito convertir una actividad ordinaria en un **trabajo sagrado**, que no depende sólo de lo que realizo, sino de la intención y la presencia con la que lo hago, siempre tendré la libertad de aprovechar los buenos momentos y convertirlos en mi vocación, sea cual sea mi actividad, más aun cuando me da esa sensación de que me gusta cada vez más.

No es solo un trabajo, es una combinación con mi mundo interior

Un ejemplo de ello es escribir, porque es una de las perspectivas más poderosas que puedo adoptar ante la vida, para expresar mi creatividad, aunado a mi ritual del espacio, así como el simple hecho de preparar mi café, sentarme frente a la hoja en blanco y encender una luz para percibir que no es solo un trabajo, es una combinación con mi mundo interior. Cuando esa \

se manifiesta en el acto de escribir, como el proceso de tomar alguna emoción, un sentimiento, un dolor y darle una forma real en el mundo, pues al hacerlo, estoy materializando mis propias ideas o pensamientos. Cuando me pierdo en el proceso de escribir, el tiempo desaparece y el ego se silencia para convertirse en el instrumento a través del cual fluye una idea, pues la intención es que puedo escribir para ofertar, o puedo escribir para sanar, iluminar o conectar. ![Ser libre – Que mi mente no sea una jaula, sino una herramienta que ordena la luz de mi conciencia (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23wgRvYFdw7JdejVpR1z4XWznVmpqbAYHA7jJVEzCgXW6hmizV7BLjnUUzNQuW7upVibV.jpg)

Una herramienta que ordena la luz de mi conciencia

Me encanta la frase ** \

** del poeta Kahlil Gibran, donde nos resalta que el trabajo realizado con pasión y amor, señala que la verdadera labor es una expresión física de nuestra alma y afecto, convirtiendo la tarea diaria en una forma de arte y devoción, en lugar de una simple necesidad. Porque al final del día, lo que hace que algo sea \
es el respeto que le otorgas. Si tratas tu escritura con devoción, paciencia y coraje, deja de ser una \

y se convierte en una **misión**.\n\nCuando las palabras salen de mis pensamientos, estoy participando en un proceso de **traducción**: estoy tomando mis ideas, mi lógica y  memoria para construir un puente hacia los demás, así que al sentir que esa conexión ocurre, la \

deja de ser una amenaza para convertirse en un **altar** o un espacio de descubrimiento. Ya no escribo porque tengo que hacerlo, sino porque hay una verdad que necesita ser testificada a través de mí. Esa sensación de que las palabras tienen un peso propio y que el tiempo se suspende es, en esencia, una experiencia para ver la rutina no como una cárcel, sino como la estructura que permite que la inspiración tenga un lugar donde aterrizar, y eso es una distinción al reconocer que las palabras brotan de mis pensamientos, ya que le da a mi trabajo sagrado una cualidad de artesanía consciente. Muchas veces se idealiza la inspiración como un rayo que cae del cielo, pero hay algo profundamente sagrado en el uso de la mente. El trabajo sagrado a través del pensamiento ocurre cuando logro que la mente no sea una jaula, sino una herramienta que ordena la luz de mi conciencia. Creo firmemente que el recurso de la oración es muy valioso para pedir a nuestro creador que esa conexión sea una guía para mis manos y que cada cosa o palabra que elija, sea una piedra firme en la construcción de mi camino creativo. Si desean unirse a la iniciativa y al encuentro de Talentos, deben hacer [Click aquí](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-ser-libres). ![HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23uFeZeEupfP2Ys5Yin2yB3q4qodjysvQmFQzzqVuENLu9c4LfDp9pEG4suGmVQVhofzs.jpg) Los diseños y las imágenes en Canva. Las fotografías en mi galería tomadas de mi teléfono Honor Magic6 y editadas en canva Traducido con www.DeepL.com/Translator (versión gratuita) ![Ser libre – Que mi mente no sea una jaula, sino una herramienta que ordena la luz de mi conciencia (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23vi3x77hBViCsieduidqG7snykipro8DGTzqjUEMDUsaGuZa3HjAuvf9KbTatU3Ykb6e.jpg)

In English

Greetings to everyone, friends of the #EmpowerTalent community. With the topic you bring us each week—especially our dear @angelica7—inviting us to write about: “Being free”, and how we should understand that each and every person has different ideas about this, stemming from their own beliefs, values and customs. You can be free even when confined within four walls; have you ever thought about this situation? Have you ever imagined feeling trapped somewhere, or by ideas and thoughts? What would you do to feel free? Here is my contribution: Sometimes, when I stop to reflect, I need to believe that the work I am doing has a meaning beyond the daily grind; even if I cannot see a greater connection in what I am doing, it leaves me feeling empty.

A person with a mind of their own

I believe that a free person, by taking responsibility for and accepting the consequences of their own actions, can make decisions that allow them to discover their calling and creativity – a combination of many non-material things, such as feelings, gifts, talents, business ventures, jobs and reasons – which propel them forward. It is a power to live authentically, overcoming fears to follow one’s intuition or personal values. For example, I can be better, and there are things to which I must say ‘enough is enough’ and which I must also do to achieve this, because enough is enough of not expressing what I feel out of fear; enough of putting others first; it is time to think of myself; enough of waiting for the perfect moment because I doubt what I can do; today is the time to say “no” without feeling guilty; I can smile at the bad and the good, at those moments that last just a moment. ![Ser libre – Que mi mente no sea una jaula, sino una herramienta que ordena la luz de mi conciencia (3).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23wMf8jHsDX9ME4mZB5YouSXEy12E2TFGPWBB1ahxrd72bARAdvK5BUCQfFTeBuKzoy7i.jpg)

An ordinary activity in a **sacred task**

In particular, when I stop seeing any task as an obligation and start seeing it as an act of service or an expression of myself, the truth is that I have the opportunity to transform it completely; rather than a duty, by viewing it as a gesture of kindness towards others, I can turn those everyday actions—such as cooking, cleaning or running errands—into expressions of care and affection. So if I allow myself to turn an ordinary activity into **sacred work**—which depends not only on what I do, but on the intention and presence with which I do it—I will always have the freedom to make the most of the good moments and turn them into my vocation, whatever my activity may be, all the more so when I get that feeling that I am enjoying it more and more.

It’s not just a job; it’s an extension of my inner world

An example of this is writing, because it is one of the most powerful perspectives I can adopt in life to express my creativity, combined with my ritual of space, as well as the simple act of making my coffee, sitting down in front of the blank page and switching on a light to realise that it is not just a job, it is a fusion with my inner world. When that ‘sacred opportunity’ manifests itself in the act of writing—as the process of taking an emotion, a feeling, a pain, and giving it a real form in the world—then, in doing so, I am bringing my own ideas or thoughts to life. When I lose myself in the process of writing, time disappears and the ego falls silent, becoming the instrument through which an idea flows, for the intention is that I can write to offer, or I can write to heal, enlighten or connect. ![Ser libre – Que mi mente no sea una jaula, sino una herramienta que ordena la luz de mi conciencia (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23wgRvYFdw7JdejVpR1z4XWznVmpqbAYHA7jJVEzCgXW6hmizV7BLjnUUzNQuW7upVibV.jpg)

A tool that organises the light of my consciousness

I love the phrase **“Work is love made visible.”** by the poet Kahlil Gibran, which highlights that work done with passion and love shows that true labour is a physical expression of our soul and affection, transforming daily tasks into a form of art and devotion, rather than a mere necessity. Because at the end of the day, what makes something ‘sacred’ is the respect you give it. If you treat your writing with devotion, patience and courage, it ceases to be an ‘activity’ and becomes a **mission**. When words flow from my thoughts, I am engaged in a process of **translation**: I am using my ideas, my logic and my memory to build a bridge to others, so that when I feel that connection happening, the ‘blank page’ ceases to be a threat and becomes an **altar** or a space for discovery. I no longer write because I have to, but because there is a truth that needs to be borne witness to through me. That sensation that words have a weight of their own and that time stands still is, in essence, an experience of seeing routine not as a prison, but as the structure that allows inspiration a place to land, and that is a distinction in recognising that words spring from my thoughts, as it gives my sacred work a quality of conscious craftsmanship. Inspiration is often idealised as a bolt of lightning falling from the sky, but there is something deeply sacred in the use of the mind. Sacred work through thought occurs when I manage to ensure that the mind is not a cage, but a tool that channels the light of my consciousness. I firmly believe that prayer is a valuable resource for asking our Creator that this connection may guide my hands, and that every object or word I choose may be a firm foundation in the building of my creative path. Este domingo, al concluir la Súper Final de la Copa del Mundo de Clavados 2026 celebrada en el \

de China demostró una vez más su dominio absoluto, ganando sin discusión las 9 medallas de oro. Esta actuación no solo continuó su legado dorado, sino que mostró un nivel excepcionalmente alto de técnica y fortaleza mental.

En esta publicación quiero dejar constancia de lo anterior y exponer los elementos esenciales de la actuación de los deportistas del gigante asiático.

Mientras tanto, Chen Yuxi y su compañera temporal Lu Wei ganaron la plataforma 10 m sincronizada femenina con más de 366 puntos, una puntuación que supera la propia actuación olímpica de  Tokio y París, demostrando una adaptabilidad notable.

Un comentario final 

La fortaleza de los clavadistas chinos  es producto de un entrenamiento en el que aplican los adelantos  de la ciencia, herencia técnica, fuerte psicología y un sistema sólido de talentos que obliga a todos los atletas a dar el máximo de su rendimiento.

body.title: One of the Most Effective Reward Cards in Modern!
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcuLysoheGUsmz1ryYmGVmHZDkAuXPoycBDzDFSNKniXg/image.png)

## Introduction

Today I would like to talk about one of the most effective modern reward cards: Commander Slade. This card has always been a fun card to play but after Chaos Legion left Modern League this card became one of the most effective cards in the game. 

## Commander Slade
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmez8j7o7qugJN7jZ4qbCYZf1s1BoB3ssVk71FQWY5Sva2/image.png)

Commander Slade is a Rebellion Reward card that for ten mana comes with the following base specifications: five melee damage, seven shield, six speed and ten health points. 

It also comes with the following abilities:  
**Enfeeble** - reduces opponent's melee power by one after each successful attack
**Dodge** - has a 25% chance of avoiding physical attacks
**Deflect** - Doesn't take damage from thorns, return fire, blast splash, magic reflect or corrosive ward.
**Backfire** - When enemy unit misses this ability deals 2 physical damage to the enemy

This is an impressive set of base specs as well as great abilities. In the next section I would like to explore what cards pair really well with Commander Slade and why.

## Best Cards to Pair with Commander Slade
When it comes to cards that pair best with Commander Slade I believe that two summoners really stand out: Cryptic and Elias Max Pruitt.

Each of the summoners determines the best complimentary cards that you can play with Commander Slade to achieve the most effective use of this card. When you play Commander Slade you play it for his ability to avoid hits or for his ability to deliver major damage or for both.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdTVx5us9Uj9Zx9RuGPWwpKZay1VPsiiS9muFdrFD91hF/image.png)

If you are playing the un-hittable tank strategy you are more likely to go with the Cryptic summoner as this summoner reduces the speed of all opponents by one and also makes them blind. 

I don't have a maxed out Cryptic, so I rarely play this strategy.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaujw7F7GNuW4cpBpgUaDAJkk3NbobyownQ6zJvAAmnhD/image.png)

And if you are playing the maximum damage dealer strategy you should be picking Elias Max Pruitt as he add one melee damage to Commander Slade and more importantly gives Commander Slade Armored Strike and one extra armor that is good for an extra eight damage per turn.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSXtjrkmSW3PfHusADHygghme86z5888489cqU9oc91y7/image.png)

Another key card that I like to play with Commander Slade is Daarg Deadblast this card has two very important abilities one is swiftness and the other one is weapons training that enables me to bring in a couple more speed control cards into the mix and weapons train them: Daigendark Surveyor and Yaba's Pickle. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme2qh1KfGHyaZeKixnNEN74iThynHGUmjMeruPTQJ237z/image.png)

Surveyor is a great small mana card which has stun, magic reflect and slow abilities which really help speed up Commander Slade relative to his opponents.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdL7zeJ2kbRZWysXDcZ1wiewiFQxiECcrpyqGFc1gGpog/image.png)

Yaba's Pickle is another great support card that slows the opponent as well as is a very resilient card as it has self heal, shield and evasiveness. 

I was also lucky to get a black foil version of this card, so I get a very nice black foil and promo card bonus that is good for a 30% boost in SPS and Glint earnings.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVX6v8y2V7sWGWpPbLZY7frQPUu17r9rJ2NVdZhn97Tmb/image.png)

And finally in battles where we can expect magic damage dealers on the other side Jicarilla the Rime is a great companion card to Commander Slade as it gives Commander Slade a Phase ability or ability to avoid magic attack as well as it has a tank heal ability so when Commander is hit she can heal him. This card is even more effective when played with the Cryptic summoner.

## The Battle

[Link to the Battle Featuring Commander Slade](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_9e6d9ab7b4b7b41aee1046cc14a19cf0?ref=seattlea)
The one card I have not mentioned above that I frequently play with Commander Slade is Coralforged. This card gives Commander Slade the ability to strike from the second position so it keeps this high damage monster in game longer and it definitely best used with the maximum damage strategy than with the un-hittable strategy.  
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTvFqkXce14Sz4GjphH7KUdecWaEVP6QxiDfrZXuxrqS7/image.png)

Here in this battle against JunJun01 Scholar I am using a high damage strategy with Commander Slade.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY8weD5YLVG5wUwRAFrRoZVomvnxJoEWoWDUG4oBpRn7c/image.png)

In the first round our team did a lot of damage to their tank, but Doldrus and Grimbardun Smith are definitely keeping this tank in the game by healing it and repairing the armor.

At the same time their Grove Doomblade is doing a lot of damage to my backline taking out one of the blackline monsters already.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXrN6MsidesSmVMBxxmYzQ9Vt7Xug4RrmPdMdpTGdjg9y/image.png)

In the second round we finally get rid of their tank but lost another backline monster.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWBHfTbZQSxnV843iEq13czfcTrno8raYLdpfkPbNgFyN/image.png)

Third Round definitely showed the power of Commander Slade as we were able to get rid of Doldrus and another monster from their team.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQq8eYEMW9so18N5n1rKG4pCEKkz4N4tubdFAkXpU3Wv4/image.png)

In the third round we finally eliminated the last damage dealer on their team and now our victory is only a matter of time.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaTRNwu5AAasF63tGLEj9w4pfnDTAcX9vTkQsSd5rYbAj/image.png)

It was a nice win against a significantly higher ranked scholar that brought us almost twenty six SPS tokens!

body.title: Efootball gameplay
body.body: Good day, everyone. I'm really guilty, but you don't know how to go into posting a single video. I said i would find a clip on efootball. i couldn't find a good clip.\

I’m glad this post was helpful to you.
As for our present day… I understand you; I know what it’s like when a country goes through such a crisis.
Thank you for your understanding and support.

For me, the war in Ukraine has been going on for 11 years now, since 2014, followed by its full-scale phase starting in 2022. Honestly, it’s very hard to cope with. So much has been lost—land, our homes, our relatives and loved ones. They cannot be brought back… War is terrifying. A great evil has come to our land.

But we are Ukrainians. Those of us who love our country continue our work. We do everything we can to stand against this aggression. That is the only thing keeping us from complete despair. People have united… We are doing everything for the sake of Victory.

However, the war is not over. The main task is to close the sky. Enemy drones hunt civilians, and even children do not stop them (attacks on buses, maternity hospitals, kindergartens, hospitals, trains—they strike everything they can)… Sadly, every day could be the last…

Paradoxically, all of this pushes us to live each day fully and to appreciate it.

So, we must keep going… As long as we are alive, we will endure.

body.title: Romerías de Mayo 33 edición
body.body: /> Tal vez el evento que tira con más fuerza del arte joven es este tipo en toda Cuba y este año casi no se hace. Si incluso el arte en ocaciones le toca darse de bruces contra la realidad y eso fue lo que casi sucede en esta ocasión. Para nadie es un secreto la situación actual del país y como está afectado a la soledad en todos los niveles así como su repercusión de en la vida cotidiana.

/> Por eso este año la idea de aglutinar artistas de todo el país y de distintas manifestaciones artista con sus obras y espectáculos a cuesta parecía una locura. No hablamos solo del costo materia sino también del logístico en estos tiempos de crisis normalmente apostar por el arte es un reto, imaginen la contingencia en apostar por todas las artes, echa por jóvenes, que a fin de cuentas son los más desmotivados por las situaciones de la cotidianidad del país.

/> Muchos dieron a las romerías por pérdidas, pero no el arte joven como siempre se impuso. Algunos opinan qué tal vez es una maniobra desde algún círculo del poder para mostrar una salud que el sistema cultural ciertamente no tiene, otros podrán opinar que es una locura sin más, pero cuando se está en las Romerías uno es capaz de percibir esa fuerza más que tiene el arte y que los jóvenes producen y por el que apuestan al punto de autogestionarse la estancia, la alimentación y sin saber del todo los si tendrán un espacio en los eventos.

/> Eso sí, quien llega a algún espacio de las romerías tiene las puertas abiertas, porque este es lo los pocos evento que permiten a quien tenga la voluntad mostrar lo que hace. Porque si es arte en tiempos de contingencia, donde hay otras prioridades. Y si puedes que no sea imprescindible, pero el arte sana y estás romerías han sido la prueba de cuando hay voluntad el arte joven se da aún el la crisis más extridentes.

body.title: Tangential and Normal Components of Acceleration
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1778017327497-f2cc0661a9aa8686.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=mes/5ce9a8c6)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=mes/5ce9a8c6)


---

In this video, I write the vector equation of acceleration in terms of its unit tangent and unit normal vector components, which is useful when analyzing the motion of a particle along a curve. The unit normal vector is defined as the ratio of the tangent vector (derivative of the position vector) with its magnitude; hence, the length will be 1. Likewise, the unit normal vector is the derivative of the unit tangent vector divided by its magnitude. I use the equation for the curvature and derivative of velocity to obtain the acceleration in terms of the unit tangent and unit normal vectors. These components outline how much acceleration an object experiences in the direction of its current motion (tangent) and how much in the direction perpendicular to its motion (normal). This is useful in calculating the forces associated with such accelerations.

#math #vectors #calculus #physics #education

body.body:
>

‎Technology comes in phases, in every phase, the objective remain the same. The primary purpose of technological advancement is to make living a lot easier. Communicating with our loved ones that were out of reach used to be a problem, we created devices to help eradicate the issue. Traveling on feet and animals could barely serve as a means of transportation, we built cars, bikes, planes, trains to make transportation more comfortable.
‎
‎Technology has always served as a solution to our immediate problems. Is the evolution of technology making us less creative? when I saw this question, I laughed. You know the funny thing about we humans is that, we are not used to not having problems and the moment something threatens our need for chaos, we start pointing fingers. Being at ease is not the natural nature of we humans, we get bored of it. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUPFtDSVDFfo5xup3zC1rtH1EkfKeeSLREZntkoLzqs6c/1778017972552.jpg)

‎This present era is definitely considered technological era but we shouldn't be mistaken about one fact; the evolution should not be about technology alone. We humans are species that needs to evolve to survive. At every point in human evolution, it is a race of survival but the moment we realized technology could substitute we humans in many areas, we became less focused on our own evolution. We started looking for ways to make technology more effective, instead of building our mind or finding ways to enhance ourselves.
‎
‎To an extent, technology is expected to enhance human productivity. So it is safe to say, technology still serve we humans as far as technology is concerned. Here is the issue, what if tomorrow, all technology stops working, what can we humans do without technology? Every knowledge have been stored on computers, we trust these devices to do the reading and information analysis for us, without the need to train ourselves to do it.
‎
‎Slowly, we humans that grow in chaos, we are finally getting comfortable with being at ease; enjoying the beauty of technology. What effect does this have on our creativity? Well, I wouldn't say we are less creative, after all, we are the one building these devices. It is a case of creative misdirection, it is okay to be creative with technology and build beautiful tools but we shouldn't neglect ourselves in the process.
‎
‎Technology is slowly becoming an extension of mankind but it is not. It is a tool built to serve a purpose, it is not a part of us. With AI, most people have lost the ability to think for themselves. People can no longer formulate letters, memo; Ai does the job. AI has become relationship counselors for some couples, it thinks for them and analyze their lives and dictate next steps. Thinking used to be what we are good at, this is what made us Superior species. It is okay to consult AI, in order to gain better understanding but it final result shouldn't be our final conclusion.
‎
‎Most of us forget, even AI get it wrong most times and yet, that is your own adviser. You don't give time to consider the possibility of the result being wrong, AI has become \

for some people. Our capacity of creative thinking as a human is not being used on humans but used for technology, so that they can do the thinking for us. ‎ ‎How can we remedy this? We need to remember which evolution brought us this far, it wasn't technological evolution but human evolution. The fact that technology keeps evolving, does not mean we have to stop. ‎ ***** **** ‎_***This write-up was inspired by weekly featured content titled ***The cost of ease*** in hive learners community.***_ ‎ ****** ***** ‎ ‎_***[Cover image](https://unsplash.com/photos/people-sitting-down-near-table-with-assorted-laptop-computers-SYTO3xs06fU)***_ ‎ **** ***** ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVNhTyUg4Aq2RTHWnTXsaS4758biE3M9xtHurNqYAe8XT/img_0.8353900969042101.jpg) ‎

body.title: Better days in Silver League: Won 5 games after 7 entries - Splinterlands Modern Format
body.body: > How are you doing? The game entries in this second day of the week provided a better outcome compared to the situation on Monday. I knew that it was better to slow down a day to benefit from the vacuum created by the skilled warriors who ranked up in Gold league. It was a pleasure to secure more points after seven battles.

> ## A:/ Testing the water I only played two battles over the past twenty hours. It was two direct losses in the silver league. My plan on the following day was not to rush and deep further away of the Gold league gate. I was not stress about the defeat. Plan was to get out after two losses. I finished the section in the evening with numerous victories.
![](https://images.hive.blog/500x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmdRB7ozZaU62NSZWe4VBZ28Yfo6MCryi3197uPL37kyk9/backgroundspl.png)
## B:/ 7 battles and 5 victories As a player in Splinterlands Modern Format it is impossible to predict the outcome of a battle. If you are lucky your opponent can make a mistake and the ruleset will play in your favor. Otherwise, you just hit the ground with no point. It was the situation in my first battle of the day when I lost the game and I figured my next game will surely be the same.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPEVKTaEdy4QCjq5pK2D6PqD2Ku7WasTtUS28zpd7XNXX/bat1.png)
The magic factor in the arena played in favor of the opponent. I could not bring enough defense against this army. [Bat1](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_e51dc671db90a1dd331be34057d65b8f) -- ---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcG1wT4TQhuoBb28u9SU7ikNpZYNgcvEETbrDe764XLMe/bat2.png)
How can return from a first day losses in Splinterlands. I took a five minutes pause. It was a perfect moment to make a tea and drink a sip before launching the second game. Luck shined on my team as I took out the magic team with a solid combo of melee and magic warriors. [Bat2](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_866db9a8d02d90f1fd0ee6268709dc48) -- --- After the last victory I was confident about my progression during the next challenge I played safe and calm with Lorkus and Oridum plus Venka. Victory again for my team
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVe5EebhCADTsmLnkzAvcSQvdB7qbLjzhZkWHagD2GZTA/bat_3.png)
[Bat3](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_2a4705f5c2626fc23633bdc620638072) -- --- It was beautiful to see my team flying in this fourth game. The warriors were ready with Rage and his super ability to stop magic attacks.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbufsZcv8J3V3ay76njAdVYHwrRQDFk24oFiYyAoftFz5/bat_4.png)
Impossible to beat this combo at this stage of the game. Won this battle. [Bat4](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_67406fa4c6a2a7b5a5c683df019894c7) -- --- Tofu was on the other side to the ring it means problem for all the warriors in the game opposing this well protected army.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcdnk32NR1xXf1NQBy7xpKaGgP59kyAh1bfYfj3k7JWUg/bat5.png)
Akane performance in this battle was magnificent. My selection came out victorious after tough battle against the light fighters. [Bat5](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_9611a4a3a90134dfd641bbdb414323b5) -- ---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbXtANZk1SYpb5a4fAvNgDwcqThXdoPTV2ZfkgVoqFMeZ/bat_6.png)
In this sixth battle, I was not interesting to bring the level of combat too high because I worried about the energy point burnt since the start of this series. I won the game despite my lowest game plan in action on the battlefield. [Bat6](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_83facfadb73d5a27ffa9ae15078d7cd4) -- ---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT774YU47S7hveuqTUYanNTXvJh2zkUeC4ZAZiqhDt72j/bat7.png)
I got kicked out of the battlefield on this seventh battle. It was a nice game I was ready to give the touch to the next players and save the rest of my energy point for tomorrow. Beautiful battle [Bat 7](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_83facfadb73d5a27ffa9ae15078d7cd4) -- --- Is your progress in Splinterlands after five day in the current season in good stand?
![](https://images.hive.blog/500x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmdRB7ozZaU62NSZWe4VBZ28Yfo6MCryi3197uPL37kyk9/backgroundspl.png)

> ## C:/ Combination of all new assets added to the collection I was lucky to save enough Glint point in my wallet to help collect more regular cards from the Lots and Chest. The opening was not great, but It is part of the game. I am preparing the coming of the Brawl with powerful and experience Gladiators. Opening Gladius packs are in my task list before the Brawl return in the next twelve hours. Wish you all the best in your season.

### Welcome to my #TTT #ThreeTuneTuesday entry! Hello, good evening, and welcome to another edition of “Birthday Boy of the Day”! And for today, the fifth day of the fifth month of the year, I’d like to introduce you to Roddy Radiation! Born on May 5, 1955, the English singer and guitarist, who turns 71 today, made his name primarily in a ska band called “The Specials.” Formed in Coventry in 1977, the band’s original lineup included Terry Hall, Neville Staple, Jerry Dammers, Lynval Golding, Roddy Radiation, Horace Panter, John Bradbury, Dick Cuthell, and Rico Rodriguez. Their lively music combined rhythms drawn from punk and rocksteady, two styles that were very popular in the late 1970s. Social and political criticism were central themes in the lyrics this band presented, with a large part of their repertoire consisting of these two topics. I must admit that I wasn’t familiar with either the singer or the band, so I did a quick search on YouTube for some of their songs. I chose three that seemed most appropriate for this post. body.title: Dziennik #75/2026 - coraz gorzej
body.body: > Dobry wieczór. Źle spałam. Dalej towarzyszy mi bunt ciała, ale no biorę to na klatę. Nie mam zresztą innego wyjścia. Tzn. mam, ale przyjmijmy, że nie mam. Śniadania nie udało mi się zjeść, płyny wchodzą trochę lepiej, ale nadal kiepsko. Poza tym wstałam z tak ciężką depresją, że miałam ochotę się pochlastać. Pojechałam na terapię i wczoraj wierzyłam, że da mi ona trochę oddechu, ale niestety było odwrotnie. Nieopacznie wyrzuciłam z siebie to, co dokucza mi ostatnio najbardziej i mówię nieopacznie, bo wcale nie chciałam z nikim na ten temat rozmawiać. Wiedziałam, że się rozpadnę już do końca i w istocie tak było. Ciężka to była sesja, po której wyszłam w tak złym stanie, że ciężko mi to w ogóle ubrać w słowa. Nie dość, że rozmawiałam o czymś, o czym rozmawiać nie chcę, bo boli najbardziej na świecie to jeszcze przez mój ogólny stan psychofizyczny odbierałam słowa psycholog jako przytyki w moją stronę choć wcale tak nie było. W pracy kierownicy wzięli mnie na rozmowę co się ze mną dzieje, bo mam depresję wymalowaną na twarzy. Nic nie powiedziałam. Starałam się ze wszystkich sił zamaskować mój stan, ale mi się to nie udało, bo asystentka również wzięła mnie na rozmowę i pytała co się dzieje i jak ma mi pomóc. I co jej miałam powiedzieć? Że mi się życie wali na głowę? Że w ogóle żyć to mi się nawet nie chce zaczynając od początku? Nic nie powiedziałam. Próbowałam się nie rozpaść choć gula w gardle jest dość mocno wyczuwalna. Kilku magazynierów też mnie zaczepiło z pytaniem czy wszystko w porządku, bo jestem małomówna i wyglądam jakby mnie z krzyża zdjęli, więc tak, można oficjalnie powiedzieć, że jest źle. Wróciłam do domu, poszłam z psem i ot, jestem. Czuję rozpacz i nic więcej. Chociaż nie. Jest jeszcze dużo lęku. Bardzo dużo. Kolacji nie udało mi się zjeść, ale już machnęłam na to ręką, nie będę się zmuszać. Trochę tylko spróbuję się nawodnić, bo to też leży. Kolejny bezsensowny dzień za mną.. Do jutra.

body.title: My two favorite MLB teams are set to compete! A's at Phillies tonight! | Cristopher Sánchez (PHI) and Luis Severino (ATH) on the mound
body.body:
I know it may be odd to some, but I like both the Phillies and A's. Becoming a fan of two MLB teams is a somewhat long story that I've written on a few times and I've just accepted it. I thought it was as odd as anyone to have two teams, I've always believed you should stick with one team. But meh, it's just sports at the end of the day, all for fun. What's fun for me is liking both of these franchises!

The Phillies and A's are on opposite coasts of the US, and play in different leagues. So it's really interesting following both teams. They don't face each other much and slowly but surely I'm learning more about the rosters across the MLB. 

Basically the results of this game are a win-win for me really. I'm ultimately neutral when it comes to the results of this series. But its still good to follow the rosters and results of course.

It will be interesting watching these teams compete as a fan of both teams and knowing the rosters fairly well in general. I am embracing it and looking forward to it! It's a really unique feeling being a genuine fan of both teams.

![5526 - 5726_20260505_163616_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/AJiyGBs92jX4kzgSVFiVf5kPDh2x7WdZ8F7KYH1ygSWXUewiyW4ueF137XqZDoA.png)
Logo sources: [Src](https://www.stickpng.com/img/sports/baseball/major-league-baseball-mlb/oakland-athletics/oakland-athletics-a-logo), [Src](https://loodibee.com/mlb/philadelphia-phillies/) 

The last time I wrote on the A's before their off day, they were struggling with the Guardians and were looking to not get swept. Well, they accomplished exactly that with a pretty [dominant win Sunday](https://youtu.be/iNRVpYaHjUA?si=Q4rKyKF10pDzW-WM). Aaron Civale looked great on the mound, going six innings and allowing just a single run. He's now 3-1 with a strong 2.94 ERA. I hope he stays consistent! Three A's homered as well. Colby Thomas hit his first, Zack Gelof hit his second, and Tyler Sodestrom hit his fourth. Those were all solo shots. Jeff McNeil joined the offensive action with a massive double with the bases loaded that cleared the bases! 3 RBI for Mr. McNeil there.

Yesterday, the Phillies [won their game](https://youtu.be/xMsSw2KBbgY?si=LQnp0UFjHnxeQogv) and their series against the Marlins. Aaron Nola had a great quality outing! He pitched six scoreless innings. Now that was great to see, can't recall the last time he pitched that well. Nola was really the MVP of that game because the Phillies only managed to win 1-0! Let's see if Nola can sustain this a bit more. The sole run by the Phillies came off of Bryce Harper's bat as he hit his 7th homer of the season. Nola and Harper coming up big when you need them. Good on the vets, the long-time Phillies!

Tonight these two teams meet and man, it will be intriguing to see how Cristopher Sánchez handles this explosive A's offense. Luis Severino has been steady lately, lets see if he can handle this Phillies team that needs every win they can get.

I just hope it's a good game really! I hope there isn't a sweep.

# #GOPHILLIES!!!
# #GOATHLETICS!!!

body.title: Desconectar para reconectar, volver a simples hábitos que devuelven la calma a nuestra vida. / Disconnect to reconnect, return to simple habits that return calm to our life. ESP./EN.
body.body: >Image created by the Ecency AI for this post. / Image created by the Ecency AI for this post.
>Invisible en la pantalla esencial en la vida
>Invisible on the essential screen in life

>En un primer momento, pensé en escribir otro contenido, pero recientemente le acabo de responder un comentario al compañero @psicologopoeta y cuando terminé de hacerlo me puse a escribir este post ya que me acordé de una situación bien interesante que se dio en estos días, y decidí cambiar el tema y escribir un poco sobre esa experiencia.

>Hace unos meses, mi madre sufrió un accidente y quedó inhabilitada por un tiempo; de hecho, yo pasé un par de meses donde tuve que alejarme de mis actividades cotidianas y de Hive para poder atender a mis viejos, ya que ambos estaban en cama.
>En esos momentos, una amiga venía a visitarme e intentaba apoyarme en lo que podía, y en realidad pasamos bastante tiempo juntos y de hecho conversamos bastante.

>En varias de esas conversaciones, ella me comentó su preocupación, ya que se le estaban olvidando las cosas, estaba perdiendo mucho tiempo haciendo trabajos en la oficina que antes dominaba muy rápidamente; ahora perdía constantemente objetos como las llaves, el celular y hasta se le olvidó comprar en el mercado, algo que ella había salido a comprar expresamente; simplemente se le olvidó cuando fue a realizar las compras y, además de eso, se estaba sintiendo muy cansada y desanimada.
>De hecho, me comentó que sentía temor de estar perdiendo la cordura. Ahora bien, mientras ella me contaba esto, se tomó dos tazas de café y no dejó de revisar el celular.

>Cuando ella me preguntó qué pensaba, yo le pedí que comentara su día y, por lo que me dijo, deduje que lo primero que ella hace al levantarse es revisar el celular y tomar café; después desayuna viendo el noticiero, después sale al trabajo y pasa horas sentada; de ahí sale, regresa a casa, revisa y pasa horas dentro de las redes, después ve televisión, habla con alguna persona por teléfono y vuelve a la rutina al día siguiente.

>Ella me preguntó si estaba seguro de lo que le decía, y le dije que sí; después ella me dijo: “Convénceme de eso”. Y ahí le expliqué mi teoría, le dije que ella estaba presa y en manos del Gran Hermano, que las redes y la pantalla del teléfono dominaban su vida; además, a ella le encanta seguir canales políticos, eso la llena de estrés y expectativas, pasa muchas horas sentada, toma demasiado café, inclusive en las tardes, respira por la boca y no soporta estar sola ni en silencio.

>No revises el teléfono de manera constante y, en la medida de lo posible, no sigas los canales políticos; pasa más tiempo con familiares y amigos, haz ejercicios de respiración para dominar la ansiedad, haz ejercicio por lo menos tres veces por semana y trata de caminar por lo menos 10 minutos al día cuando haya sol. Y finalmente, en las noches, no uses el teléfono después de las 9 de la noche, a menos que te llamen, y trata de leer de 15 a 20 minutos antes de dormir, y haz ejercicios de respiración controlada al acostarte.

>Y efectivamente, con estos consejos, ella mejoró mucho, pero como le faltaba constancia, le recomendé que fuese a un terapeuta, que reforzó mucho de lo que yo le había dicho y la ayudó a construir una rutina, que le ayudó a retomar su vida y ahora se siente más cómoda y feliz.

>En fin, muchas veces asumimos hábitos que son nocivos para nuestra salud, aun sin darnos cuenta, o por dejarnos llevar por lo mismo que hacen los demás, y eso es algo de lo que siempre debemos estar pendientes.

>At first, I thought about writing another content, but recently I just answered a comment to the colleague @psicologopoeta and when I finished doing it I started writing this post because I remembered a very interesting situation that happened these days, and I decided to change the topic and write a little about that experience.

>A few months ago, my mother suffered an accident and was disabled for a while; in fact, I spent a couple of months where I had to get away from my daily activities and Hive to be able to take care of my old people, since they were both in bed.
>At those times, a friend would come to visit me and try to support me in any way she could, and we actually spent quite a bit of time together and actually talked quite a lot.

>In several of those conversations, she told me about her concern, since she was forgetting things, she was wasting a lot of time doing work in the office that she used to master very quickly; now she was constantly losing objects such as keys, cell phone and even forgot to buy at the market, something that she had gone out to buy expressly; she simply forgot when she went to make purchases and, besides that, she was feeling very tired and discouraged.
>In fact, he told me that he was afraid that he was losing his sanity. Now, while she was telling me this, she drank two cups of coffee and didn't stop checking her cell phone.

>When she asked me what I thought, I asked her to comment on her day and, from what she told me, I deduced that the first thing she does when she gets up is check her cell phone and drink coffee; then she has breakfast watching the news, then she goes out to work and spends hours sitting; from there she goes out, returns home, reviews and spends hours online, then watches television, talks to someone on the phone and returns to the routine the next day.
>After listening to her, I told her: \

>She asked me if I was sure of what I was saying, and I said yes; then she said, “Convince me of that.” And there I explained my theory to her, I told her that she was imprisoned and in the hands of Big Brother, that the networks and the phone screen dominated her life; besides, she loves following political channels, it fills her with stress and expectations, she spends many hours sitting, drinks too much coffee, even in the afternoons, she breathes through her mouth and she can't stand being alone or in silence.
>When he looked at me, I said, \

>Do not constantly check the phone and, as far as possible, do not follow political channels; spend more time with family and friends, do breathing exercises to master anxiety, exercise at least three times a week and try to walk at least 10 minutes a day when it is sunny. And finally, in the evenings, do not use the phone after 9 pm, unless you are called, and try to read 15-20 minutes before bedtime, and do controlled breathing exercises at bedtime.

>And indeed, with these tips, she improved a lot, but since she lacked perseverance, I recommended that she go to a therapist, who reinforced much of what I had told her and helped her build a routine, which helped her get back to her life and now she feels more comfortable and happy.

>In short, many times we assume habits that are harmful to our health, even without realizing it, or by letting ourselves be carried away by the same thing that others do, and that is something that we should always be aware of.

>Thank you very much for reading me.

Let me start by saying this is going to be a positive post but first let me get a couple things out of the way.

I know there is a lot of negativity on Hive but you know what that is in offline life as well. Everyone has opinions and everyone deserves there own.

The goal of The BBH Foundation is to help people in need and at the same time on board them to Hive, make them productive members of Hive so that in the long term they can supplement their income as needed as well as grow their Hive account so that at some point they don't need help and in turn will help onboard others and teach them to same.

On the positive side this is happening. The family Cathy and I are helping basically out of our own pockets are doing well. I just have to say we are doing this because they are awesome people, they need help at the moment, and they were will to learn about Hive and become active.

My hat goes off to @valderalazaro, it was a steep learning curve for him. As we all know Hive can be. Then he onboard his wife @diazktty. Then today I found out Lazaro onboard his cousin @marian.liz. 

To me this is exciting stuff. What the OG's on Hive have been talking about for years. Getting people on HIve, getting them active and showing them what Hive can do for them and what they can do for Hive.

Cathy and I are slowly starting a movement here. We are helping others that want to help themselves. That is the key.

If you want to help us help please consider donating Hive or HBD to @thebbhfoundation or adding @thebbhfoundation as a benificery  to your long form posts.

Thanks for reading and please support the three people above.

Bradley & Cathy

Feliz y bendecida tarde amigos de esta maravillosa Comunidad de Gems, hoy una vez más vengo a compartirles un increíble paseo en que hice con mi hijo y su novia para conocer el Templo de Bahá’í, el único en Sudamérica y que forma parte del selecto grupo de casas de oración continentales como las de la India, Australia, Uganda o Estados Unidos, elegidos estratégicamente para representar la presencia de esta fe en cada Rincón del mundo. # Comienzo por contarles que esta es una religión independiente y moderna, se basa en la unidad sus tres pilares fundamentales: 1.- Creen que existe un sólo creador para toda la humanidad. 2.- Ven a los grandes profetas como Jesús, Moisés, Buda o Mahoma como mensajeros de un plan divino. 3.- Su lema principal es la unidad en la diversidad, promoviendo la igualdad entre hombres y mujeres y eliminando todo tipo de perjuicios.

Happy and blessed afternoon, friends of this wonderful Gems Community. On the ceiling, a calligraphic design is visible in the very center of the temple, featuring the Arabic phrase: \

For the Bahá’í Faith, this symbol represents the connection between God, His messengers, and humanity.

body.title: A Space For Reflection
body.body:
Steveston used to be a small fishing village that was highly active in the early days of the region. Many people of Japanese descent settled here in the 1800s to work in the fishing industry and grow into a thriving community. Now, this sleepy village has become a tourist attraction for its quaint good looks.

I was passing by the Steveston museum and post office when I noticed that there was a garden right beside it, designed in the style of classic Japanese gardens. As it turned out, the Steveston Japanese Canadian museum is located there as well. The building used to house offices for the Japanese school and hospital.

<center>![japanese garden.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/Eoprx7W5YVnghk8Lv6tp7hBjGbRiiboc5bdwStphZtv9i2CDcVCcw85mMMtsP8UPqRs.jpg)</center>

The garden is a peaceful and highly aesthetic oasis in the middle of the village. It reflects the spirit of the city's early history and the rich tapestry that is culture.

|[![X logo_2_xsm.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/AJecgMmDUgF93E2AYfZhSuEV18YwrJ7AmNXzAomRqzbwzXLVuT7ddPwJjH5Jnvf.png)](https://x.com/litguru23)|[![InLeo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/AKxnKQnZb5pt8W8wS7ibusYdJHHMVUt2zjZE9HQ7EfxcfWfdZAPYYdhjtbX5mMi.png)](https://inleo.io/profile/litguru)|[![Psychedelic Instagram logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/AJoHtwg5jNLCE9bmNpaXFo7YdyUxN32Jn8PA9HsS1qsR6dH8RC66WCv337ZB6Me.png)](https://www.instagram.com/litguru23/)|[![girl with pearl earring.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/AJkR7G8QAKHYw87UqCH9jHbgZyfiT97yHJPsupJDHcG7dcianiT2pXs2PSbx6LD.png)](https://nftshowroom.com/litguru/gallery)

body.title: We celebrated the birthday of Miriam, my coworker | Celebramos el cumpleaños de Miriam, mi compañera de trabajo 🎂
body.body:
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!) Hello, friends and family of Hive. How are you all doing? I’m doing great, since Mother’s Day and my youngest daughter’s birthday are coming up this weekend, which has me feeling very excited. ![InShot_20260504_080340114.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme16UrfqU7bWznnx1UZFonJpxRnFD4JrsXo7UKuWPRC5K/InShot_20260504_080340114.jpg) On another note, a week ago we celebrated the birthday of my dental hygienist, Miriam, at work. I like to let the people I care about know how important they are to me with a small gift, so I got her a present with perfume and a bracelet, since she loves jewelry and smelling great. My coworker and my boss also gave her a special gift on her special day. ![20260428_125434.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV18x2EmxMxUFVN6i2it2gyreevtULouirPur8RPvkst2/20260428_125434.jpg) ![20260428_130756.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmemCJC4k8WicFt2328eW45hYqfvapo44375RZEFs9bsGS/20260428_130756.jpg) We all chipped in to buy a small slice of cold cake, covered and filled with caramel and topped with peanuts and chocolate chips, though in the end my colleague ended up getting another slice of cake this time chocolate so she had two slices. We sang “Happy Birthday” to her after lunch; at that moment, our coworker Juan also joined us, and we hold him in high regard for his camaraderie. ![20260428_125448.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZTF9oEXaFGPyHFErTbbZE4yuQEBdsezowLrmNwgAvFc2/20260428_125448.jpg) ![20260428_125757.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb7Ctco28RXQzwPmCDACdufoPXoxoGUCyqJm7eqoyNVD9/20260428_125757.jpg) Finally, we each enjoyed a slice of cake. It didn’t look like much, but it was just enough for our small group. The dessert was very fluffy and sweet, with plenty of caramel sauce just the way I like it and they didn’t skimp on the filling at all. ![20260428_130221.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma6Ur5odLbZK9SAQGqeychp7uNLvZuQgqXNxkDiEwFD8X/20260428_130221.jpg) Miriam was very happy with our gifts and the cake. She let me know that she is a very grateful person. Ever since I started in the medical field, it has been a blessing for me to have her at work not only as a colleague but as a friend since she is one of the most loyal people I have around me. We may have differences, but we resolve them immediately by communicating how we feel; we don’t let pride damage our friendship. ![20260428_125841.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPLBjpejFy3ExLz7xmbqrWLwXnzgitF2QpeisYdgfLnrL/20260428_125841.jpg) It was a wonderful afternoon, one we’ll surely repeat to celebrate life.

--- Photos taken with a Samsung Galaxy A35. Collage created in [Inshot](https://v.inshot.com/invite) Content owned by me. Translation by: [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com/es/translator)

>

Hola amigos y familia de Hive. ¿Como se encuentran? Yo muy bien, ya que al final de está semana se celebrará el Día de las Madres y el cumpleaños de mi hija menor, lo cuál me llena de mucha emoción. 

![InShot_20260504_080340114.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme16UrfqU7bWznnx1UZFonJpxRnFD4JrsXo7UKuWPRC5K/InShot_20260504_080340114.jpg)

Por otra parte, hace una semana celebramos en mi trabajo el cumpleaños de mi higienista dental Miriam, me gusta hacerle saber a las personas que aprecio lo importante que son con algún detalle, por esa razón le preparé un regalo con un perfume y una pulsera, ya que a ella le encanta la bisutería y oler muy rico, mi colega y mi jefa también le hicieron un detalle especial en su día. 

![20260428_125434.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV18x2EmxMxUFVN6i2it2gyreevtULouirPur8RPvkst2/20260428_125434.jpg)

![20260428_130756.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmemCJC4k8WicFt2328eW45hYqfvapo44375RZEFs9bsGS/20260428_130756.jpg)

body.title: Back to work, a short run, and floating [#poprzeczka May 2026 #04]
body.body:
## Back to reality First day at work after the May 1st vacation. The kind of morning where the holiday feels better in hindsight than the desk feels in the present. Still — back at it. A couple of doggy walks throughout the day kept the step count ticking and provided the necessary breaks from the screen. ## Short run after 4 pm Once the workday was done, laced up for a short run to shake off the stiffness. Nothing long, nothing structured — just enough to get the blood moving and clear the head before the main event of the evening. ## Float Center Ljubljana The highlight of the day: a session at [Float Center Ljubljana](https://floatcenterljubljana.si/en/) — the favourite spot for sensory deprivation and deep rest. Into the tank, lights out, silence. Just you and the water and the salt. After the float, an interview — they are preparing promotional material and wanted a regular floater's perspective. Happy to oblige. Not a hard conversation to have when you genuinely believe in it. The result: deeply relaxed, at peace, reset. The body and mind both grateful. ## The #poprzeczka Day **4** of May. The bar is at **4,000 steps**. With **7,800 steps** logged — just enough, and then some. body.title: Big-Mouthed Dystopia
body.body:
>


> I had plans.

Nothing big. Just sit in a café after lunch with a cheap cup of coffee and write. I got the coffee and began to write, when I got a call from Smallsteps, about twenty minutes later than normal. There were issues. Her friend had lost her bus card, so Smallsteps and another friend had stayed back looking for it. When it didn't show up, she called me to see if her friend could come to our place, using Smallsteps' card. No worries. But since I wasn't *that far* away from them, I skulled my coffee and picked all three of them up and was going to drop each home. Except, silly me said, if you check with your parents, you can all come to our place and play together. 

> That was the end of quiet time.

---


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/23z7NCoUhjb1ARQhrdjAZswm7Rxb6HmXtGdsdbFoPJWUPJMK5LgWyTNZ4VndD7EShoJ6a.png)


---

> I should learn to keep my mouth shut.

However, these girls are a nice group and not only that, all of them speak English as natives, which is a rarity for me. They normally play in Finnish, but we can have proper conversations together and make jokes and stuff, which I can't do with Smallsteps' other friends. This is both a good thing and a bad thing for Smallsteps, because well... *dad jokes.*

While I didn't get to do what I was planning, there was an unexpected upside, because I spent about an hour talking with father of bus card girl when he came to pick her up, and he is a Brit who has been here for well over a decade already. He is working in an IT consulting company and we have a lot we can talk about and some overlapping insights. And while he is currently employed, he can see where it is heading and *it scares him.* 

While he framed it as a mid-life crisis, he was asking what we should do once these last few jobs disappear. Is retraining really a viable solution when whatever one learns is going to be replaced by automation also? What happens to society when there is 20-30-50% unemployment? What do his kids need to learn now?

I think many people have these kinds of questions and many more, but don't have the time or will to really think through the answers for them. As you know from my writing, I see a pretty dystopian world ahead, but the optimist and idealist in me wishes that wasn't the case. If I had my way, the world would use the advantages of not having to do the busy work that automation can take care of, to spend time solving the real problems we face, like climate change, clean energy supply, cleaning up pollution - all with the underlying goal of continually improving human wellbeing. 

As a species today, we are *incredibly wasteful* with our resources. You might be thinking I am talking about throwing a way food and the pollution clogging skies and waterways, but I am mostly talking about our human capital - our bodies and brains. They are both incredible evolutionary machines, yet we don't apply their capabilities well. We don't use our brains to solve the real problems we face, we use them to find new and innovative ways to be entertained. We don't use our bodies to make real changes in the world like cleaning up the environment we live in and rely on for life, we just sit around on the couch, watching something that doesn't grow us at all.

> The only thing growing in the society we have created, are waist lines, mental problems, emotional instability, and unemployment queues. 

We often think of employment as a way to make money so we can live, but I think that we should have 100% employment all of the time. People should be constantly employed on improvement projects across the board, not for the money, but for the purpose. Money muddies the waters of purpose, because it becomes the meaning of work itself, so people will willingly do what they don't want to do or what doesn't add any human value to the world, for money. If there was no money involved and the only reward was the feeling that you we are working on the right things in life, 99% of the jobs would disappear and nearly all current companies collapse.

That is because the 99% are working for the benefit of the 1% in exchange for a salary. If that salary would disappear, the jobs don't provide enough real-world meaning to attract people, and what they make wouldn't sell anyway, because people will have *more important things to do* with their time and personal resources.

People would be healthier, fitter, and their eyes brighter, because their daily life would be something rewarding at the core human level, and that is always a compelling prize, and an addictive feeling. We want to feel good, which is why so many poor substitutes are successful, because they make us feel good for a moment, but it fades quickly. So we buy more feel good product, and then try another, and another, and the supply chain fills up with demand. Even though so little of what we do each day, really makes a positive difference for society. 

Even doctors who are \

are usually saving them from issues that are almost completely preventable, and are only issues because of lifestyle and behaviour. If all of that saving from nonsense resource could be put into generating improved health, what a difference it would make. > We have used all we have available to us, to get to where we are today. Walk and take a look around. Breathe the air. Take a drink from the nearest stream. Is it clean? Turn on the news and see what is happening in the world, talk to your friends and family about their current feelings, experiences, and where they see the future. Watch kids interact with each other, and parents interact with their children. Look at the stock markets hitting new highs, while average people burn out and break down, and the bottom 20% are getting so disillusioned they are resorting to extreme violence. We waste the resources of us, the resources of the world, and the potential we have to make a great world. >The future? There is always one, whether we are here to be a part of it or not. Of course, I didn't bombard this poor guy with all of this. Instead, I suggested he start an OnlyFans account and create a niche for himself. body.title: Callistemon citrinus [Spn/Eng]
body.body:
>Expansiva semana llena de salud, energía, ideas maravillosas, magia. Encuentros con tu propio ser y mucho entusiasmo en cada actividad que realicen.

\n\n

>Al leer el nombre en la investigación realizada sobre esta planta como escobillón rojo o limpia tubos, pensé : hasta en el mundo de la vegetación están los apodos, la verdad es que este parque donde camino la mayor parte de las mañanas se trae excelentes arboles de los cuales algunos he compartido por aquí, son hermosos, cada uno con sus características embelleciendo los espacios, como refiero en otros post, damos todo por hecho y quizás la mayoría no los aprecia como he aprendido en este recorrido de salir y observar como debe ser el entorno natural que nos rodea.

>Su nombre científico es Callistemon citrinus, conocido comúnmente como escobillón rojo o limpia tubos, es un arbusto perennifolio resistente, originario de Australia. Debido a su belleza y resistencia ha sido introducida como planta ornamental en regiones de clima templado y tropical de todo el mundo. Es muy común en Venezuela, ahora quiero tenerla en casa, por las características que presenta y cada día nuestro amado Sol está más incandescente, este tipo de plantas son los que debemos plantar, porque nuestro planeta requiere de su presencia, resistente, ornamental para diferentes espacios.

\n\n

> Es muy valorado en jardinería por sus flores rojas brillantes en forma de cepillo, que aparecen en primavera y verano. Requiere pleno sol, riego moderado y es tolerante a heladas. La verdad esta planta está a pleno sol, la tierra donde se encuentra se nota que no es regada con frecuencia y así mismo nos presenta su belleza, hojas verdes y flores rojas. Bueno, la lluvia cuando llega se encarga de dar sus nutrientes, bañarla y refrescarla.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/23uFVgsWJB5r8ueaqJvuLgWARd23nvk6kDRGMMjE2rN1uxwvhW12CeShHKha5MvweA93S.png

>Su nombre proviene del griego Kallos que significa hermoso y Stemon significa estambre, este nombre hace referencia a sus vistosas flores.

Presento a continuación detalles sobre esta planta:

>Características: Arbusto perennifolio que puede alcanzar entre 2 y 4 metros de altura. Sus hojas son lanceoladas, coriáceas y de color verde grisáceo.

\n\n
>Hojas: estas al estrujarlas desprenden un ligero aroma a limón o eucalipto. Comprobado por mí. Si, presenta ese olor, mi esposo y yo asemejamos a eucalipto.

>Floración: Las inflorescencias son densas espigas cilíndricas de color rojo vibrante, similares a los cepillos para limpiar biberones, que atraen a abejas y abejorros.

Cuidados:
Luz: Necesita pleno sol para una floración abundante. Riego: Moderado, adaptándose bien a la sequía una vez establecido. Suelo: Prefiere suelos bien drenados. Poda: Se recomienda la poda de formación tras la floración. Usos: Ideal para jardines de bajo mantenimiento, barreras visuales, macetas, o como planta ornamental de acento por su color. Resistencia: Es una planta sumamente resistente. Soporta bien la sequía una vez establecida, igual que diferentes tipos de suelo.

>Algo muy importante es como propagarla, las semillas germinan sin dificultad pero la descendencia es muy dispar y muchas plantas no ofrecerán flores ornamentales. El método de propagación adecuado es el de estacas con hojas de madera parcialmente madura, las cuales enraízan con bastante facilidad en invernadero. Bueno, no tengo invernadero, puedo probar una estaca con hojas en un envase, mi patio no tiene mucha tierra. En envases puede ser una experiencia agradable, a ver si funciona. Aquí tengo razón para hacerlo porque está demostrado que no solo puede ser plantado directamente en el suelo, vive perfectamente, también, en macetas de buen tamaño.

\n\n

>También dice la investigación que es una especie medicinal y antibacterial, ahora es cuestión de hacer esta indagación de acuerdo a su utilidad y como es el proceso para ello.

\n\n

>Así como es utilizada desde la medicina las flores de Callistemon son una planta de Australia, tienen su propio significado espiritual como abundancia, risa y alegría. Las flores se utilizan para celebrar el nacimiento, el nuevo y el sustento.
