links.title: How does less choice bring more peace?
links.body:
>

![PXL_20260222_130736361.PORTRAIT.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaRjQk72LgmGJzxCthDBB4fyR7v4CxjKXZfRwYb6LimL1/PXL_20260222_130736361.PORTRAIT.jpg)


There's this quiet kind of exhaustion that comes from having or doing too much. Having too many options, too many tools, too many decisions waiting for you before the day even starts properly. 
I barely even noticed it. It just creeped in. 

## When I Started Outsourcing My Thinking
Somewhere along the line I started letting AI do lots of my thinking for me. Questions, Stuck on idea? Need to make a decision? I ask AI. It was fast, made things easier, it was convenient, but then it was making me less sharp. 

<div class=\

> ![PXL_20260115_175632115.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeqEHC6PMtb8TnaqDeEZQto3mjNuqmZzJJjkqYUopoHpu/PXL_20260115_175632115.jpg) I saw it as a problem. So I made a quiet decision to...I pulled back. Started trying to figure out things for myself again. Trying to work things out in my own head again before reaching for a shortcut. It felt uncomfortable attack first, honestly. Like using a awakening a muscle that has gone soft from underuse. But slowly I began noticing changes, my thinking got clearer. I started feeling more confident, and my mind felt more at peace. In a good way. That's when I began to see the bigger picture. The Real Cost of Too Many Choices Every unnecessary decision costs you something. Not really money but attention. And attention is one thing you can't get back. To think about it. The time spent scrolling through options before settling on something else simple. The mental back and forth of trying to achieve five goals instead of two or one at a time. The low-level stress of a cluttered workspace, or phone full of apps you barely even open . None of these feel heavy in it's own, but it stacks up. Psychologists call it decision fatigue ; the idea that every choice you make, no matter how little, draws from the same mental energy reserve. By the time you made a thousand tiny decisions before noon, the important ones start to suffer. ## What Simplifying Actually Looks Like Simplifying doesn't have to be dramatic. Nobody's asking you to sell or dispose your belongings and move off the grid. ![PXL_20251228_101028278.PORTRAIT.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRnqdzAENBDY9aDu3wC1rPCovsm8m88TE2QyXVYfYMQ4F/PXL_20251228_101028278.PORTRAIT.jpg) It is simply: * Wearing simple outfits so mornings stop feeling like negotiations * Dropping a few unnecessary goals * Eating simpler meals so as not to overthink nutrition every day * Choosing to think something through yourself before instantly delegating it to a tool Small things. But they compound. ***Peace Is What's Left When You Stop Overloading Yourself*** The calmest people do not have fewer problems, they have fewer unnecessary decisions that require their attention everyday. They simplify their inputs so they can focus on what truly matters. So it's not about living with small means, it's about being intentional with where your energy goes.
Images belong to me
https://images.hive.blog/DQmPT77rYbQCTcr2kAfDq6bv15zmMy2uDR5QtpmmcimXXBd/image.png

body.title: The Emotional Process I Cut Off #287
body.body:
Greetings, beautiful ladiesofhive!


I am so excited to participate in this week's edition and I want to share the emotional journey that I stripped off that wasn't part of my future. And it was about a relationship I wanted to build. I didn't know this guy wasn't meant for me. He had broken my heart not with other ladies, but with his attitude towards the things of God. He wasn't committed and sacrificial at all. 


![IMG-20251123-WA0012.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/peckypeace/23w2oGkpRHcCtWxUgqkhzpAfnzVyXDexCojr647d1FmaGg9ccHQ553mV9XJS6D5j23rXN.jpg)



I love young men who are committed to the things of God but he wasn't at all. He was in and out of it. I didn't notice that, he also cheated with many girls. In my mind, this guy isn't for me. And one of my friends told me I should cut ties with him immediately, and I did with pain in my heart. I loved him at that time. And truly this love was a blind one 🤣. 

There wasn't something beneficial about the relationship then and in the future, I had to let go because it wasn't important for me. 

I withdrew myself from him and I decided to look into myself, develop, and build myself to become a better version of myself now and in the future.

Some relationships or people don't need to follow you to your present; otherwise, it will break or mar your destiny. 

We need vision to marry, the one that comes from God. Every good gift comes from the Lord. A man or woman who is godly, who doesn't follow the standard or pattern of the world but God's pattern. The vision will direct you to the right person who will be needful and useful in your present.

In all, I cut it off, to pursue my ambition that aligns with the vision placed in my heart. Any relationship that will drain me emotionally, I cut it off, preferring a healthy relationship with a vision for the future. I guard my heart diligently.

_**This is my response to the ladiesofhive contest #287**_

_**I love, I care, and I forgive**_

Hello,here is my story-comment:

The most suspicious mountain menu I ever survived

After a long walk up the hill, my wife and I reached that level of hunger where you stop being a human and become a food-hunting animal.

There was only one restaurant within 5 km. No options. No escape. Just destiny.

We sat down. I opened the menu.

And my eyes went wide.

This wasn’t a menu… this was a psychological test.

First thing they brought was the soup.
“Grandma’s Secret Soup.”

Alright, sounds safe. Classic. Comfort food. No risk.

Then I looked closer.

The “secret” turned out to be tomato soup… with some weird floating leaves that looked like oregano — which I absolutely don’t like — and random peppercorns casually swimming around like they pay rent there.

I realized that secret means: “you’re not supposed to ask questions.”

Then came the main course options.

And that’s when things escalated quickly.
I saw something called:

“Maiden’s Joy Sausage.”

Now… I didn’t know if I should order it or apologize to it.

Curiosity won.

When they brought it… I understood the name.

Long. Slightly spicy. Suspiciously confident on the plate.

I just nodded like, “okay… I see what’s going on here.”

But the real surprise?

“Maiden’s Tears Meatballs.”
I tried them.

Big mistake.

So spicy, full of onions… I started crying immediately. Not emotional crying — survival crying.

At one point I wasn’t even eating anymore, I was negotiating with the plate.

Meanwhile my wife played it safe… or so she thought.

She ordered something called:

“Đorđe’s Stuffed Schnitzel.”
Or maybe it was a typo. Maybe it wasn’t.

Because on the menu there was also something like “Fish-Đorđe” version… which made even less sense.

Anyway, it turned out to be stuffed, rolled, fried meat… with fish involved somehow. Vegetarian logic left the chat.

At this point I needed something to reset my entire existence.

So I ordered a Lav beer.

And I swear, as I was opening it, I expected to hear a lion roar somewhere in the distance.

Luckily… no lion. Just trauma and silence.
In the end, we were full.

Not just from the food — but from the whole experience.

The restaurant clearly had a very… specific sense of humor.

But hey… at least the walk on the mountain stayed a beautiful memory.

The menu?

That’s a story I’ll never forget.

Hello Motherhood community, I have a little secret ***I Just had a baby*** 🫢🫢.
So far so good it has been an interesting journey, my baby is 10 weeks today, I'll talk about what I have learn observed a been advised in this new journey of mine.

Motherhood has been a rollercoaster of events, as I type this I have my baby here on my chest, so no breaks whatsoever. But it's all good in the end.

I have watch relative and others have a baby , but I haven't had the experience of motherhood journey on a personal level. And so I finally get to be on the pedestal and it's really awesome to , even though it can be annoying and very tiring.
Sometimes The baby is hungry and wants to be fed, other times he just wants to be cuddled and kissed, then diaper change or he needs a bath.

Speaking of food , my baby has a big appetite and he really wants to have something in his tummy once he's hungry, and his lips are so firm as it suckles to either the feeding bottle or breast milk. This is what the bottle looks like after he is done feeding all squeezed and pressed, it's really amazing to see how he feeds and is enthusiastic about food. 
But I am been careful at how much I feed him so , he doesn't end up with a big fat tummy , I really don't want a plus size baby.
And besides a fat baby doesn't mean his healthy though.

body.title: Secret Sharer (2014)
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>



![IMG_5345.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23tGXmkdK6MS3wAp7zrzhGS5ks1jXBvcioPamFcy8bijofXSdqV2qcfAJebE7Som3oNwr.jpeg)

I hope nobody’s judging me for seeing old films when there are newly released ones? It just happened that I want these old films. The old ones are raw and unfiltered with less theatrics and exaggerated soundtracks. Also, I was drawn to this one because it is set out at sea and films like that instantly pull me in. I like the isolation and the feeling that something is bound to go wrong. 

**Synopsis(possible spoilers)**

![IMG_5335.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/242DZQhNE974uoVg9rRsA3KVmQFubi6BufgA1TUnvAGyUZd9ecwSgTEJEc4dNr2CXn93V.jpeg)

The film follows Conrad (Jack Laskey), a young British sea captain on his very first command. Already struggling with insecurity and the pressure to prove himself, his situation becomes even more complicated when he discovers a mysterious naked woman hiding close to his ship.

She introduces herself as Li (Zhu Zhu), and claims to be fleeing after causing the death of a man. Instead of turning her in, Conrad makes a risky decision to hide her, setting off a chain of tension, secrecy, and growing intimacy between the two.

As the ship moves through dangerous waters and suspicions begin to rise among the crew, Conrad is forced to confront not just the danger Li brings, but his own fears, desires, and moral boundaries.

**My Thoughts** 

![IMG_5351.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23tGvsQs3DReqGU2ZxRd8Z7qhwP8rHZZSBoLkornYAdWhwbGE3WuVugu2fmE8nQBVmaii.jpeg)

This film felt like I was watching something unfold behind a layer of fog. At first, I wasn’t sure if I was fully into it but then something about the stillness and atmosphere started to pull me in.

![IMG_5352.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23t75BVg4aeiqLPppcevVJHJSzRwdFSKmsustLAM17rKXbUwKJ5GWNPafXAtEfbpnyhZM.jpeg)

This film doesn’t rely on big action or dramatic twists. Instead, it builds its story through intimate moments and tension that feels more internal than external. The ocean setting plays a huge role here as well because it adds to that sense of isolation, like Conrad is completely cut off from the world, making decisions that no one else can really guide him through.

![IMG_5349.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/Eo8L7p31wPQ7EweZNi1YmVxrtqXRWAL9cDoeAMcer9Q8RhxoeoJUw1fMTV6SVnmQN35.jpeg)

About Conrad and Li’s connection, it actually develops fast. Under normal circumstances, I might have rolled my eyes at that. But here it feels less like a traditional romance and more like two people clinging to each other in a moment of uncertainty. Li is mysterious, almost unreadable at times while Conrad is inexperienced, unsure, but drawn to her in a way he doesn’t fully understand.

![IMG_5350.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23tvD6JFQMcWcVQCJF9acgH1fJtiVctXFVzN7hyXx7GoxUjX8i6arEJydwzdqYcNJzpUZ.jpeg)

Their relationship isn’t built on long conversations or deep backstories; rather, it’s built on circumstance and that’s what makes it interesting, even if it’s not entirely convincing.

![IMG_5342.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23vsLK8xyN8ovmNM9fremrFpv21cEAAcAx3U5Q41EVsi3qpkH8FPsbD41WWLCuQWnKmWc.jpeg)

What stood out to me is how the film explores stepping into responsibility for the first time, making choices without knowing if they’re right and the blurred line between duty and desire.

![IMG_5336.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/EpJY76hMmAKwiyxtrkhhxQqZfV9CwsrorPuUajR1fYwpXPDjpcwCUaE2v4pyeBetDqD.jpeg)

Conrad’s decision to protect Li isn’t just about her, but him trying to define the kind of man he wants to be. And that internal conflict carries the film more than the actual plot does.

The story itself isn’t very complex. So if you’re looking for strong twists or a clear, gripping narrative, this might not satisfy you. Also, Li’s character, while intriguing, remains a bit too distant. I wanted to understand her more, but the film keeps her just out of reach.

![IMG_5340.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23swbr8TZ8KuJTh2Gazozx3xr5WkhX3ssKuEB547a2xDPCgABgQrGzofe9r8XLx3gXT1S.jpeg)

All in all, this is one of those films that feels more like a mood than a story. It’s restrained and leaves a lot unsaid. For me? I didn’t love it completely, but I appreciated what it was trying to do.

Rating: 6.8/10



</diva>

body.title: Solar Report: April 2026
body.body:
Here is my monthly report on how our solar panel system did in March 2026. We have: * 20x400W panels = 8kW, facing west * 5kW [GivEnergy](https://givenergy.co.uk/) inverter * 9.5kWh GivEnergy battery The house is in the UK at about 52° north. The system was installed in February 2024. The system was installed by [Octopus](https://share.octopus.energy/tan-grove-963) who also supply our power and gas. This is the year so far, all in kWh: |Month|Generated|Used|Exported|Imported|Cost import|Paid export| |-|-|-|-|-|-|-| |[January](/hive-127466/@steevc/solar-report-january-2026)|110|518|106|522|£88.53|£14.91| |[February](/hive-127466/@steevc/solar-report-february-2026)|237|592|226|580|£79.08|£33.97| |[March](/hive-127466/@steevc/solar-report-march-2026)|590|484|599|507|£74.47|£68.30| |[April](/hive-127466/@steevc/solar-report-april-2026)|937|283|927|326|£37.71|£112.71| April has been pretty sunny so we have been able to generate and export a lot of power. In March the peak for a day was 35kWh and last month it was almost 45kWh so we were earning something almost every day that was generally enough to cover the gas cost too, so our debt to [Octopus](https://share.octopus.energy/tan-grove-963) (referral link) will decrease as I expected. I had an email recently to say they will increase our monthly payments a little as they want me to be in credit again. I will let that happen and see where we are in a year. I just have to get it right so that we cover the winter costs with what we make in the sunnier months. ![Solar generation](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steevc/23zmE1BUhohFkmK7xNEfoyojxj6VepJvezybqKbfo6oRdK3BLEnh7eZJAShQ29zcVkpvk.png) We imported a lot less as the leased EV has been in for repairs for a while. They seem to have issues getting the parts. The issue is with the key. A lot of cars just require the key to be near the car, but I really have no issue with having to insert it to start the car. I think cars are getting too complicated and that means more to go wrong. Our consumption from the grid has been pretty constant as we just charge the battery up each morning after discharging what we have the previous evening. The import rate went up a little, but for those few early hours it costs less than a pound to charge the battery and we make back more whilst the sun shines. They dropped the cheap rate in April, but had to put it back up this month due to the current issues that affect fuel prices. Having solar is cushioning us from the impact. I think a lot of people and countries are looking to get more into renewables to break away from fossil fuel dependency. Another issue that will affect us is that GivEnergy who made our battery and inverter are in financial difficulties. I think we will still have a warranty from Octopus who installed the system, but we may [need to pay](https://givenergy.com/paid-givenergy-tier-announced/) to get the same access and control of the system. There may be workarounds for this that I will look into, but having to pay a few pounds per month for that access is not a huge deal. I do not anticipate that my system will stop working. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p9IrDFLXUY0 Shine on!

body.title: The End of What I Knew
body.body: > One thing I’ve always been grateful for is the life that I have and live because it can always be worse. Someone somewhere probably wishes to have the life I’m currently living but they don’t ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf7qAyyqHCVjppC4KwhytXx9MZkhWfEd5h8syKVCzC9HH/img_0746.jpg) I wouldn’t say I’ve had the best of lives, but I’m happy for the life I get to live and the opportunity to always make it better. Life is full of ups and downs and I got one have had to experience and go through some moments of friction with people really cared about. It all started as something minor and within a twinkle of an eye, things had escalated to the peak. It wasn’t a good time for as I was the victim in all of this. But everyone involved was probably being selfish as it’s a normal part of human nature. All I could do was as pray over everything after bawling my eyes out. And just like that,God came through for me and just like it all happened, it all disappeared like it never happened. The issue was never spoken or even heard of even though I wish to get it off my chest. For years, I carried the pain of the entire situation in my heart. I couldn’t let go and that hurt me a lot because I wanted to let go for my own sanity but my body wouldn’t let me. I was always on high alert- everyday was a new to day wonder when the worst was going to happen. Eventually, I told myself I didn’t deserve to punish myself like this for others actions. So, I forgave, I moved on and I am living in one of the happiest phases of my life. I look back today and realize that even though I haven’t entirely forgotten about everything, I am not letting it define me and the life I’m living because what is life if I always have to carry the weight of what ifs? - - - image belongs to me. - - - ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuSJ2V9NneWQW9Jxgobw7BtKvMb3UBPdxv3jaAhx5vpA/f40b32ec_5287_4867_ae7e_9fa77d7f679b.png)

body.title: ‎The Day I Knew My Deadline
body.body:
Hi Hive,
‎
‎With this week prompt, I’d just imagine waking up one morning and the world has forever changed. Scientists have created a device that tells you the exact moment you will die, down to the second. No guessing. No uncertainty. Just a fixed deadline on my life.
‎
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNsLoLQFox6md7AZe7EdjaU5PeHtE22uWtTgodJt9GzaE/mohssinechnaf77-clock-3317291_1920.jpg 

‎[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/images/download/x-3317291_1920.jpg)
‎
‎It sounds like something out of a movie at first. But then reality sets in that the device is real and expensive as well. And only few people can afford it. Then the question is simple but heavy, would I really buy it?
‎
‎I’m torn, honestly.
‎
‎Part of me is curious. I have always wondered how much time I truly have. Because knowing my exact death date could really bring a strange kind of clarity. No more procrastination. No more “I’ll do it tomorrow or later.” Because later would suddenly have a limit. If I knew I had 50 more years left, I would definitely plan differently. And if it was 5 years, I would move with urgency. And if it was just a month, then everything about my life would change overnight.
‎
‎But another part of me is really scared. Because knowing might take away something crucial such as hope. Currently, life feels open-ended. I can dream, plan, and believe there is time to fix things. But if a device tells me my clock is not up to what I expected, that weight might actually crush me. Because at that moment, every decision might feel like a countdown, and not a choice anymore.
‎
‎If I had that kind of device, I don’t think I would use it just  on anyone. I would not want to know the actual time my loved ones will die. Because that kind of knowledge will definitely feels like a burden no one should ever, ever carry. And instead, I might use it for myself only and even that would also take courage to do.
‎
‎What would I do if I knew my exact death date?
‎
‎It's simple, but not something that easy. I would stop delaying my life. I would focus more on what truly matters, which isbmy family, peace of mind, and meaningful work. I would want to take more risks, speak more honestly, forgive faster, and love without ever holding back. I would stop chasing things that don’t really matter and start investing in moments that really count.
‎
‎But here is the deeper truth, and maybe we don’t really need such a device.
‎
‎Because either we know the exact time or not, the reality still unfold because we are all on a countdown irregardless. The difference is, we don’t see the clock currently.
‎
‎And maybe not knowing our exact death date is actually a gift.
‎
‎Because it push us to live by faith, to value time more even without totally understanding it, and to wake up each day with possibility instead of certainty.
‎
‎So would I really buy the device?
‎
‎Maybe not.
‎
‎But instead, I would choose to live like I already know time is limited because it definitely is.
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)
‎

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@twicejoy/the-day-i-knew-my-deadline-2kv)

body.title: AFERIY P210 Portable Power Station. Unboxing and First Impressions. [ENG+ESP]
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeC5xwDsGjUUVnGDhR6BhqMpS9ueJmj2JN3CE4hTuhik9/miniatura_de_youtube_minimalista_oscuro_amarillo.png)
I’d love to start this post by saying I’m back, but the truth is, I never really left. The truth is, I’ve always tried to stay as active as possible, but with only 4 hours—not even consecutive—of electricity, it’s been impossible. But this post isn’t the place to complain about my country’s electricity situation; rather, it’s a space where I like to share reviews of the things I manage to get through a lot of effort and dedication. That's why today I'm pleased to show you my new portable power station from AFERIY, specifically the AFERIY P210. This power station cost me around $522 USD, which I consider a very good deal, given that other stations with similar features are around $700 USD. The AFERIY P210 has a power output of 2400 W and a 2048 Wh battery. >Me encantaría comenzar este post diciendo que he vuelto nuevamente, pero en realidad nunca me fui. >La verdad es que siempre he tratado de mantenerme lo más activo posible, pero con solo 4 horas, no consecutivas, de fluido eléctrico, me ha sido imposible. Pero esta publicación no es el lugar indicado para quejarme respecto a la situación electroenergética de mi país, sino más bien un espacio donde me gusta compartir reseñas sobre las cosas que logro obtener con muchísimo esfuerzo y dedicación. >Es por ello que el día de hoy me complace mostrarles mi nueva estación de energía portátil de la marca AFERIY, concretamente la AFERIY P210. Esta estación de energía me costó alrededor de 522 USD, lo cual considero que fue una muy buena compra, teniendo en cuenta que otras estaciones con sus mismas características rondan los 700 USD. La AFERIY P210 cuenta con una potencia de salida de 2400 W y una batería de 2048 Wh de almacenamiento.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmWHgy52C3eh2YL5e4u8JCdKmN2147j1qtsiStM9V7cSdG/copilot_20260502_131150.png https://images.ecency.com/DQmPsSZCgBnnj6b2SEUhQnpFLGHiEkGMJJTMbPwCgqFAGHU/copilot_20260502_131333.png
[Source](https://uk.aferiy.com/products/aferiy-af-p210-portable-power-station-2400w-2048wh)
I haven't had a chance to test it thoroughly yet, since as of this writing, it's only been fully operational for three days. In about a month, I'll post a more in-depth review covering its pros and cons. For now, I'll just show you a quick unboxing and share my first impressions of this power station, which, as I mentioned, will allow me to start sharing my content with the HIVE community again. >Aún no he podido probarla bien, ya que al momento de redactar esta publicación solo lleva 3 días en pleno funcionamiento. Más adelante, un mes más o menos, traeré una reseña más especializada respecto a sus pros y contras. Por ahora me limitaré a mostrarles un intento de unboxing y mis primeras impresiones sobre esta estación de energía, la cual, como ya les comenté, me permitirá volver a compartir mi contenido con la familia de HIVE.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmXKBrZDamGNJj9sSf7N4Hpg4GGFKqGXfzhUva3VLLteus/20260429_101530.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQmWMkMsBCPMj5EAePGNHAfbHkuLbcyisnSEUwZKmDwPJdA/20260429_101603.jpg
At first glance, the packaging doesn't look like anything special, and although the box looks a little worn, it shows no signs of serious damage. When I open it, I find protective foam covering everything, giving no hint of what's inside. Normally I'd be super excited, but I've seen so many reviews and videos of this power station that I already feel like I've unboxed several of them. >A simple vista, el embalaje no parece nada del otro mundo y, aunque la caja se ve un poco maltratada, no muestra signos de algún daño severo. Al abrirla, me encuentro con una espuma protectora que lo cubre todo y no deja entrever nada de su contenido. Normalmente sentiría un hype enorme, pero he visto tantas reseñas y videos de esta estación de energía que ya siento como si hubiese desempaquetado varias.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ4VguDu2Cc6R7C3a9gmUEUiJQtCaaAmb2b8b5Z5ZRW2N/20260429_101611.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQmRTzQitPdHdDKkeCLo7FdfuX2rKWkGBi7BcEekpWGLj2x/20260429_101625.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmPsk4dD2dXQZeoKqLryUKJdxuFhFXZHddLctDBM6VGg7S/20260429_101645.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQmd1cGtrBf7wiSksxDr47BJJxAUw3JETFemp9Tp3bBxkj9/20260429_101657.jpg
When I remove the cover, the first things I see are two bags: a clear nylon one and a gray one that looks like a coin purse or clutch. We’ll talk about the nylon bag later; for now, let’s focus on the other one. Inside the gray pouch are two cables, which I can easily identify by their connectors. One of the cables is for AC charging or direct current charging. The other consists of MC4 connectors and an XT90 connector, making this the DC charging cable or solar charging cable. >Al retirar la cubierta, lo primero que encuentro son dos bolsas: una de nylon transparente y otra de color gris con un aspecto de monedero o cartera de mano. De la bolsa de nylon hablaremos más adelante; ahora centrémonos en la otra. Dentro del monedero gris hay dos cables, los cuales identifico fácilmente por sus conectores. Uno de los cables es para la carga CA o carga directa de la corriente. El otro está compuesto por conectores MC4 y un conector XT90, lo cual convierte a este cable en el cable de carga DC o carga solar.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmbYZkd3hGkhHiwyhX9bTkpkWLgpdS7MQsJ2sc4GzWZZMr/20260429_101748.jpg
Inside the packaging, I find the user manual, a brand brochure, and a warranty card. The thing is, when you buy this power station, the manufacturer offers a 2-year warranty, but with this card, you can get an additional 5 years, for a total of 7 years of coverage. As for the manual, I was surprised by how well-made it is and how clearly it explains how the power station works and how to connect it to the app. Because yes, you can control and configure the power station from an app on your phone. >Debajo de las bolsas encuentro el manual de usuario, una tarjeta de presentación de la marca y una tarjeta de garantía. La cuestión es que al comprar esta estación de energía, el fabricante te da 2 años de autonomía, pero con esta tarjeta se pueden obtener 5 años adicionales para un total de 7 años de garantía. Del manual, por su parte, me sorprendió lo bien hecho que está y lo fácil que explica cómo funciona la estación y cómo vincularla con la aplicación. Porque sí, se puede controlar y configurar la estación desde una app en el teléfono.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmaXYhAih4TddLtSAsgtvUhwa9YuYPQ5JAfhbetVHHefEY/20260429_120816.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQmUz9dLZ3nqrKVLmMt9aubj9ySj8pS1RBd7LLR3Vj7mX9j/20260429_120831.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmPon2CRwpE3sz6ybzBPgLeHNYSgcpkWWF7n5yu5RmLWUJ/20260429_120904.jpg
I continued rummaging through the box, and when I removed the top protective covers, I found the AFERIY P210 wrapped in thin nylon. Imagine my surprise when I tried to take it out of the box and realized it was incredibly heavy (about 51 lbs). Luckily, it comes with side handles to make it easier to carry. >Continúo indagando en el interior de la caja y, al retirar los protectores superiores, me encuentro a la AFERIY P210 envuelta en un nylon fino. Cuál sería mi sorpresa al intentar sacarla de la caja y darme cuenta de que pesa un montón (51 lbs aprox). Por suerte, trae unas agarraderas laterales para facilitar su transporte.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmR5Kaerc1JJ4YdswZ9fqjwMGNw1ffhKT3z5aLxjTWd6DW/20260429_120928.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQmXZTAdeF9jfeq6uSmqrTrbqTTeRxjYdQa8FeSQvyr3dKi/20260429_121130.jpg
At first glance, I can confirm what I already knew: IT'S BEAUTIFUL. That gray finish with black accents gives it a very modern look. On the back, there's a large label listing its complete technical specifications and other important details. >Tras un primer vistazo, confirmo algo que ya sabía: ES HERMOSA. Ese acabado en gris con detalles en negro le da un toque muy moderno. En la parte trasera posee una enorme etiqueta en la cual viene plasmada su ficha técnica completa y otros datos importantes.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmXS8DjzAFyno17rR2v6CvgWCfBa9sG3BzesRjdxqpYDsL/20260429_120946.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQmZijmbZLKcHgnoCXdSG1NyhkW8bUQrGXRYXm3jo4MiXy2/20260429_120956.jpg
On the left side, there are two ventilation grilles, and below them are the AC and DC charging ports I mentioned earlier. As for AC charging, this station supports up to 1100 W, though it can be set to lower values for sensitive electrical grids and to prevent overheating. On the other hand, the XT90 connector for DC charging or solar charging is rated for a maximum of 50 V and 20 A, supporting a maximum solar charge of 500 W. Panels rated for more than 500 W can be connected without issue, but the station’s internal MPPT would limit the charge to 500 W. >En el lateral izquierdo se encuentran dos rejillas de ventilación y debajo los puertos de carga AC y DC que mencioné anteriormente. En cuanto a la carga AC, esta estación soporta una carga de hasta 1100 W, pudiéndose configurar a valores inferiores para redes eléctricas sensibles y para evitar sobrecalentamiento. Por otra parte, el conector XT90 de la carga DC o carga solar viene marcado como que soporta máximo 50 V y 20 A, admitiendo como máximo una carga solar de 500 W. Se pueden conectar paneles de más de 500 W perfectamente, pero el MPPT interno de la estación limitaría la carga a 500 W.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmaPnQpw4PCDqneiwa7Gi6xbvmxfZnBMjEAVSQtyrWmxRb/20260429_121015.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQmcacPnuuUmceRGTj6p3NXfcyqFjixQCF7WucJY97qvkFD/20260429_121030.jpg
On the other hand, on the right side, the station has two more ventilation grilles; I assume two are intake and two are exhaust. Below, a cover protects the output of the voltage inverter, which has six 110-volt power outlets. A great feature of this station is that the AC outlet connectors are 20-amp, and they’re easy to identify because one of their holes is T-shaped. >Por otro lado, en el lateral derecho, la estación cuenta con dos rejillas más de ventilación; supongo que son dos de entrada y dos de salida. Debajo, una compuerta resguarda la salida del inversor de voltaje, el cual cuenta con 6 conexiones o salidas de corriente de 110 V. Algo muy bueno que tiene esta estación es que los conectores de la salida AC son de 20 A y eso es fácil de identificar, ya que poseen uno de sus orificios en forma de T.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmfMAkmUuQzFAK6VCzYG4J1Uxncuf4zSWRu9geVJThBZLj/20260429_121153.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQmTieQRGEvLbeeEuk3kNd6wj4weZquQSJqzhdjv2H6MYFh/20260429_121210.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmXKPmXRzY1qg5XqxUX5cZrPREXDXAAh156hrTueKfLDKx/20260429_121338.jpg
On the front panel, the AFERIY P210 features: - 1x USB-C port – 100 W - 3x USB-C ports – 20W - 2x USB-A ports – 18W Fast Charging - 1x 12V / 10A cigarette lighter port - 2x DC5521 12V / 3A ports - 1x XT60 12V / 25A port It also features a flashlight with a warm light and 3 different modes (Steady, SOS, Strobe). Something that caught my attention is its huge display, where you can easily view important data such as: - Battery level in % - Active connections - Input power in watts - Output power in watts - Remaining charge time/usage time >En la parte frontal, el AFERIY P210 cuenta con: >- Salida USB-C – de 100 W de 1x >- 3x Salida USB-C – 20W >- 2x Salida USB-A – 18W Carga Rápida >- 1 encendedor de cigarrillos 12 V / 10 A >- 2x DC5521 12V / 3A >- 1x XT60 Salida 12 V / 25 A >También posee una linterna con una luz cálida y 3 modos distintos (Fijo, SOS, Parpadeo). Algo que me llamó la atención es su enorme pantalla, en la cual se pueden ver con facilidad datos importantes como: >- Nivel de batería en % >- Conexiones activas >- Potencia de entrada en vatios >- Potencia de salida en vatios >- Tiempo restante de carga/tiempo de uso
https://images.ecency.com/DQmUJqwVeV8pnN96ykYF6nNKDLWxHwvCEb9MNkihk4FdMnr/20260429_121440.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQmVMWWUi4yoKW3HxHVrM9pXgtmLniA9n8b15fDA4tM81AL/20260429_121454.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmfZop1tkQXoJWMa1g9KofoEQghSioqjJ7RdHe7g9iCzrg/20260429_121520.jpg
There is a compartment in the top section, which I assume is meant for storing charging cables and other accessories, such as a USB-C cable or even a 12-volt cable with a cigarette lighter plug. For now, I’ll keep the DC solar charging cable, since I haven’t yet purchased the solar panel I want to add to the station to increase its runtime during peak sunlight hours. >En la sección superior hay un compartimento, el cual supongo que será para almacenar los cables de carga y algún que otro accesorio, como puede llegar a ser un cable USB-C o incluso un cable 12 V con conector de encendedor de cigarrillos. Por ahora guardaré el cable DC de carga solar, pues aún no he adquirido el panel solar que quiero ponerle a la estación y así aumentar su autonomía durante las horas pico de irradiación solar.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmcAApnkAQVRTjZPiGJ7TAiS9To32yNAnRZjZh6sJvdZiz/20260429_121609.jpg https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ6egYLX3gVJcCYKwQxUanaMtD8TTv9h4ZgFMr7qpCknW/20260429_121619.jpg
Last but not least is the clear nylon bag, which I said I’d save for last. Well, inside it I found a canvas cover for the docking station. And yes, it’s a nice touch on the manufacturer’s part to include a cover to protect against dust and possible splashes. In my case, the station will be stationary, so I don’t think it will ever come into contact with water, but for someone who takes it camping, this cover is undoubtedly very useful. >Por último, pero no menos importante, queda la bolsa de nylon transparente, la cual dije que dejaría para el final. Pues bien, dentro de ella encontré una cubierta de lona para la estación. Y sí, menudo detalle del fabricante de añadir un protector para el polvo y posibles salpicaduras. En mi caso, la estación estará fija, así que no creo que interactúe alguna vez con el agua, pero para alguien que se la lleve de camping, sin duda este cobertor es algo muy útil.
Well, dear reader, that’s all for today. I hope you enjoyed this rough attempt at an unboxing. I hope you found my words helpful. And a promise is a promise. I’ll be back soon with another review of this portable power station, but this time focusing on its pros and cons. >Y bueno, querido/a lector/a, esto ha sido todo por hoy. Espero que hayas disfrutado de este burdo intento de unboxing. Espero que mis palabras te sean útiles. Y lo prometido es deuda. Pronto traeré otra reseña de esta estación de energía portátil, pero enfocándome en sus pros y contras.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edeyglezsosa/23tRrCsM8uF676cQdqTbrS852E58grkkwobSLvMV8UmdqmnfpWAdw8W5FyUCZhjvEzPts.png) ######

body.title: Chalan Beel Water and Riya Rupan Children's Park Afternoon
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbmn4H8QEyPtwnozBr175YQ7LphFkuCu9HZ3hukDqanEB/20260506_011315_collage.jpg)


Not all trips in life are planned, some trips are done in a hurry and those are the best. Last September 13th was one such day. I set off towards Sirajganj with my elder brother and the best friends of the area. The purpose was to float on a boat in Chalan Beel and hang out at Riya Rupan Park.

Boat trip:
When we entered Chalan Beel in the morning, it felt like today was ours. When we rented a huge boat and went to the middle of the beel, there was only water and water all around. Sitting on the roof of the boat, the stories, songs and funny jokes of the elder brothers were filling my mind. Sometimes stopping the boat and dipping my feet in the water of the beel, and that gust of wind, honestly, my mind was completely frozen. The satisfaction of eating muri makhana together sitting on a boat, cannot be found even in the food of a five-star hotel. The excitement of standing in the middle of the beel and taking a 'group selfie', even when I think about it, I remember it. The beel is the largest in South Asia.

A colorful afternoon at Riya Rupan Park:
We went down the river from the beel to Riya Rupan Children's Park in Ullapara, Sirajganj. It was 3 pm. It was a district next to us, not far away. As soon as I entered the park, I felt like I had returned to my childhood. Although it is a children's park, the crazy things we did with our friends made me feel like I was still young. When we were swinging on the Nagardola, the view of the entire area from above was amazing. The ropeway or cable car ride was one of the best moments of the day. The older brothers were standing below, encouraging us and laughing.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNoASiXFFuBHHMcDLgzceJZ8A5JbWGNs93Eszgjn9nCDf/mix_20260505_234501.jpg)

Photography and what's inside the park:
I took a lot of pictures but deleted them as my phone's storage was full. If I had a Hive account then, I would have uploaded all the pictures. But then I had no idea about Hive, or I didn't even know its name.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRH2agmRJTiazvCW1BRG6NDUjhscWS8bxAFq8t9WX71da/mix_20260505_234058.jpg)

What is there,
There is a mini train inside the park, which usually takes children, like the National Parliament of Bangladesh, they have built a small parliament, like the National Memorial of Bangladesh, they have built a small memorial. The most interesting thing is, like the Taj Mahal built by the Indian Emperor Shah Jahan, they have built a small Taj Mahal here too. There are giraffe statues, bird statues, dinosaur statues. There is a merry-go-round. There is a ropeway or cable car. There are many boats to ride around in the pond. There are many shops selling toys and cosmetics inside the park. There are different species of plants and they are given different shapes. There are also statues of different animals. There are different species of flowers. There are many more but I don't remember because it has been a long time.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVXrMLVVH5ScKJZfMWb6YCDYjPJiBWMjmbaufMTcnhPfX/mix_20260505_234550.jpg)

I took a lot of pictures there because I love photography, but because my phone's storage is full every day, I almost have to empty it, but I still kept some pictures as a memory and shared them with you today.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRxDBczZPffgtDxxufMsY9PpPzBcx2oCYZohEHNhkH8F8/mix_20260505_234139.jpg)

When I finished cooking and eating there before sunset and headed home, I felt a different sense of well-being. That guidance from my elder brothers and this bond with friends, these days, are the ingredients for survival. The vastness of Chalan Beel and that afternoon at Riya Rupan Park will remain very bright in the pages of memory. Those who are looking for a little freedom, should go on such a trip with their friends, their minds will be completely refreshed.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV19NFqcUZgtaup5cAC4AHN3wnGQRaTk7GYnCMi4ChVdY/mix_20260505_234400.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYJAYKtMJTD6R3MXSUqVFbX6oJJvkDU1RNHSSPGdPjLg/mix_20260505_235354.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXxixVT7gAH2nRGNuBZQEybvt1ckYd2Q9ZUbrnavCKA3X/mix_20260505_235252.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbxLZWRWpFZ5bLRd5g8fdo9ip7LCEFpBjioSrR6spK8i2/mix_20260505_234643.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ59xMMdCC11NKnQqQfUUbctRTxxWoRxKDZARnfJCTQFu/mix_20260505_235214.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXtzkH9yHzkXBGtgRenGB4Xti8sgyqTYmCXvdzfz5vS8w/20250913_153232.jpg)

Hi Sketch and Threespeak community.

Today we are here with a new post of ours, we hope you will like our hard work. Here you can see that we have selected a beautiful sketch of a peacock sitting on a branch of a tree. Here you can also see that time is passing quickly. It took us four hours to make this post and as I said that in the future we will buy colors and then what will we do with the colors in our sketch,

First we made the whole sketch and then after that you can see that by working hard we started making the lower part of it which has its wings which is quite difficult to make and then after that you can see on its sides here that we have made some tree leaves and some branches on which it was sitting so we have made it by doing a complete procedure so here after that we have given an outline inside it with black marker on all the sides.

And then after that everything has become clear so making the upper part of the peacock which is its mouth part was quite difficult it has been designed with a lot of hard work. Then after that you can see here that we have also filled it with colors here, we tried to paint it with different types of colors because not everything is available with us yet. Slowly we are also completing all our materials.

And slowly with practice things will also get better. You can see that after giving the outline black color, it became much more beautiful. It is not possible to make it in one go. We had erased it many times and then made it again. So here, when we came to the leafy part below it and the peacock's feathers, they were being made with a lot of effort because here it can be seen that we have used different types of colors in them,

body.title: Starting my journey on Hive
body.body:
#### Helen here Hello everyone, My name is Helen. I’m truly excited to officially be present and start my journey on Hive, though I can be a little shy when it comes to putting myself out there. I have never written before now, I have received offers to write but never got around it. I hope this space helps me grow, become more confident, and express myself better. I don’t know much about crypto and I hope to learn as I go. It would be fascinating to find out how a crypto based social media works. ![38750A35-2E10-4B22-B775-D1635BE71E50.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/helenxxo/23vhuA9BdLLEvWiMqtgp9PkYDaLciq4cLmiabbtTYqswpHzK4cuE3ypHLsCXJukpm6ybf.png) ![IMG_8422.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/helenxxo/23y8qrRwyGSdDZbxDfm2Mk6sAQJuZpvh9dhFYthfZArbvU6wHHu7iR5jVNG94oYjZbHyf.jpeg) Big thanks to @samostically for encouraging me to join. I’ve known him for more than 2 years and he has told me about hive a couple of times, again, I never made progress in that conversation until now.
### About me I studied Chemistry Education in school, completed my NYSC, and I currently run a business selling home and kitchen essentials. I enjoy creating video content for my brand, trying new things, and finding simple ways to make my everyday life easier. I basically do this on my instagram and TikTok page. It would be nice to maybe put some of those content here and make new ones that fit any community I find here. ![IMG_0638.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/helenxxo/242ryBSNhUSWvQd7vm36kiegKKFsC81TrLSxafSTR5PMDu67TGBaZP2QuwHdqTrK3WU23.jpeg) I also enjoy exploring ideas, learning from people, and seeing things from different perspectives. I’ll be sharing my journey, especially around my business, lifestyle, and what I learn along the way. I’m really looking forward to connecting with amazing people here and growing together. P.S.: I’m an introvert, and my life revolves around me and my environment. Not much happens daily, so I find it difficult to write a lengthy introduction, as I really don’t have much else to say about myself. I hope this explains me, and I’m open to questions and opinions. ![IMG_9336.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/helenxxo/23uFXzoQeXXDYFBP92zdpm3WGMA6baKDkhtcK3ikjcfXZWUFgEjF2PD1wERWEYpeRdD1w.jpeg)

body.body: If you have read my posts lately, you probably know I'm ind of [obsessed with this new OmenX project.](https://hive.blog/hivegaming/@hanshotfirst/a-geeky-guy-s-guide-to-omenx-wars) With alt season being so... non existent and there being a bit of negativity on Hive, it is nice to have something to purely dream and hope about. I'm sure things will get more positive around Hive when the price bounces back, but there is something about a new project that makes you think, \

. I have no idea if OmenX will be that unicorn, but it is fun to dream. 

![file_000000000e5071f8a613d43606f37efa.PNG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc5saPQSQkZRrfm9nfxpfTRzt8eqfP8c9nY4Y4oTkWrMV/file_000000000e5071f8a613d43606f37efa.PNG)

But luckily, it is not just a vaporware dream. OmenX is actually creating things. It already has a proof of concept probability based game that is actually pretty strategic and fun, but you really need tokens to play that. Well a few days ago, the platform released its first purely for fun game... well not purely as you can win OmenX tokens. The game is legit fun and is 100% free to play. You can improve your experience and move up the leader board faster if you spend a little OmenX but it is nothing outrageous and it is 100% optional. I have only spent a little bit and am relying on grinding out gold in missions to improve my Sloths' stats. Most importantly, I am having a tn of fun while playing. Although I play on my laptop, it can be played on mobile and seems a lot like the mobile games I constantly have to tell my students to stop playing. A full round can take as little as three minutes (which means a kid would try and play twice during the 5 minute passing period). Rounds can be longer if you want, but you can choose the faster games or longer games depending on time and preference. So it is super faced paced and gives you a quick dopamine boost.

I don't know if anyone realizes this... but I am very old. I saw the original Star wars in the theater. That type of old. So I remember the first video game arcades. Cosmic Sloths kind of reminds me a little of the original Asteroids with far better graphics, better controls and way more variety... with a little bit of Smash TV mixed in for good measure. Instead of a triangle ship, you are a Sloth-Human mix in a very cool battle-suit. Your Sloth starts in the middle of the screen and enemies come from all directions. Each enemy has different traits, speeds and abilities so it adds to the challenge, novelty and fun. Every time you destroy an enemy, it leaves behind a XP gem. Stronger enemies leave behind more valuable gems. Sometimes the enemy also leaves behind gold. You need your maneuver your Sloth to pick up these gems and gold as you fight off more and more enemies. The Smash TV aspect comes in with the fact that your weapons fire automatically and you are able to upgrade them as you collect enough XP to move up experience levels. Sadly there is none telling you \

But we can overlook that. 


![cosmic.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ9AvQnb9U6UgCAUhatitKJJwViUUzvnBAZy1kGFDmtQm/cosmic.png)


Of course as the round goes on, the enemies get stronger, faster and more plentiful. This means you have to be wise in the upgrades you choose on each level. Although the upgrades are randomized, you always get three upgrades to choose one from. Because of this randomization, no two rounds can ever be exactly alike. To further add to the fun, different combinations of upgrades provide different specialized weapons or effects. It's actually quite amazing. 

After a round, you are taken back to the Sloth Lounge where you can spend your gold. There are so many things to spend your gold on. You can upgrade, Plasma Output (gun), Hull Integrity (HP), Thruster Speed, Tractor Range (for collecting gems and gold), Nano Repair (HP Regen), System Cooling (Cool-down between special abilities) and Cosmic Fortune (luck at finding cool things like nukes that destroy everything on the screen). There are also weekly and daily upgrades of all of those. And that is not even counting the Armory and Talent improvements you can buy with gold. There is honestly so much to upgrade that it is incredible! I won't even get into using things called \

to further upgrade and improve weapons. Just trust me, there are plenty of things to keep chasing. 

The game also features bonuses just for logging in each day. You can get gold or relics just for keeping your login streak alive. Of course all of this can be sped up by spending OmenX... but it is not essential. If you do spend OmenX on these upgrades or to re-roll your random upgrades during the game, those tokens go into a prize pool that is distributed to the highest scores for the week in the leader board. It is honestly a great system.


![9AD99B7F-B202-431B-9A98-7C619001FA94.PNG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQTGncBfqrW9NM1zY8qdw6qpV7vn9mhhFnds55dSYdM6z/9AD99B7F-B202-431B-9A98-7C619001FA94.PNG)


Although I love the game, the most impressive thing is that the OmenX game developer platform is so user friendly that this game was created by a community member with no previous developer experience. And he did it in about one month. I actually started testing the game after he worked on it for a week and it was already incredibly. The developer continues to listen to player feedback and is constantly making improvements. I can't believe how fast he is push out these improvements! 

Seeing how incredible a game made by a novice is has my mouth watering at the idea of what a professional developer can do. I can't wait!

So if you were waiting to sign up for OmenX, now is the time. Get in early! And if you do want to spend money (not financial advice) the VIP program is still live for about 12 weeks.

Hola @psicologopoeta, feliz tarde.
Sabes, una de las situaciones mas graves que vivimos en la actualidad, es que las sociedades occidentales, y sobre todo las latinoamericanas, estamos perdiendo los valores familiares, culturales, religiosos y sociales de una manera muy rápida, y eso se debe según los estudios que leído por un proceso de neocolonización, mediante el cual asumimos los valores estadounidenses que son muy diferentes a los nuestros.
Ojo, eso no pasa solo en nuestra región, también esta pasando en Europa y otras regiones, de Bauman, Borurdieu y Zizek, hablan mucho sobre esto, también hay algunos textos de Pascuali, que asoman esta realidad.
Lo cierto, es que debido a las realidades económicas, políticas, culturales y los procesos de competencia, que hoy en día convierten el trabajo y la vida cotidiana en una competencia de supervivencia, muchos de los adultos terminan alejados de su familia y de hecho, muchas veces están ausentes aunque estén presentes físicamente.
Por eso vemos a los niños refugiarse en los video juegos, las series de Tv y si nos sentamos a verlos, observaremos como muchos se aíslan, no juegan juegos grupales, sino que hacen de una pantalla su mundo.
Ahora, con la pandemia del COVID, con la IA y las presentes y futuras crisis económicas, veremos como crece el teletrabajo, y lo triste es ver en situaciones reales de niños en familias que viven del teletrabajo y cómo sienten que sus padres se alejan de ellos a causa de una pantalla.
Eso ha provocado, que haya casa, donde una madre que está en la cocina de la casa, le escriba un mensaje de texto, a su hijo para que salga a comer, eliminándose así cada vez más el contacto humano.
En fin son temas muy largos y algo complejos, pero lo cierto, es que estamos creando una sociedad cada vez más aislada y solitaria, en un mundo donde la tecnología nos mantiene comunicados y lleno de informaciones.
Para terminar, yo lo que estoy haciendo con mis vecinitas y en mi casa, es hacer algo obligatorio a nivel familiar, que se llama la hora comunitaria, ese es un momento sagrado, don todos estamos juntos, sin teléfonos, sin PC, haciendo juegos de mesa juntos, viendo una película y después discutiéndola, hay nos contamos el día, jugamos el juego del abrazo y el de la consciencia, y compartimos como familia.
En un principio, a las niñas, le parecía un fastidio, ahora exigen el tiempo comunitario, ahora, ellas saludan en el ascensor, ayudan a los ancianos con las bolsas, y escuchan a la gente cuando hablan, y ahora esta la propuesta de hacer un par de actividades comunitarias.
Al final, me di cuenta, que la única forma de combatir esas situaciones que nos rodean, es enseñando lo que aprendimos, conviviendo, dando y practicando valores, y humanizando el ambiente que nos rodea.
Disculpa la epístola, pero me pareció interesante hacer el comentario.
Feliz tarde.

!HUESO

body.title: Nobody Gets a Medal for Suffering
body.body:
>Dear Gentle Readers, ✒️

One thing I have come to understand and make peace with is that you can't stop growth. Technology is dynamic. It would always change, improve, evolve and you can't do a goddam thing about it(Lol, forgive my language). AI is here to stay and the best you can do is to adopt it early enough and see how it can improve your workflow.

I have an Argument:

For the millennials and early Genz's, you might be familiar with this contraption.

/>

The grinding stone was used especially in Africa as a continent and Nigeria. It was a common kitchen tool used to grind pepper, fruits and other food items. Even today, some people still argue that pepper ground with a grinding stone gives the best taste and texture to food.

And they might be right cos I remember as a child, my Mum used this to prepare our meals and it tasted quite good. I was pretty young so who knows, the fragments I remember might not just be entirely accurate.

Imagine in the age as a food seller, you still use this, a grinding stone to blend your pepper. You would get it done but you won't be able to match your competitors that use an electric powered blender to blend pepper, fruits and other items in split seconds.

You would get the work done, yes

But would you be able to keep up?

I doubt

Can you feel my drift!

That is exactly how I see technology and AI today.

There were a lot of people that chose not to adopt this early enough because it felt like it was unnatural or cheating. Trust me, they paid the price. The truth is people who don't adopt technology often get left behind.

Don't get me wrong, that does not mean the old ways were bad. It simply means the world moved forward.

In essence, what I was trying to prove is that you might not like that a new technology has come because it makes you feel lazy or less creative but I implore people to understand that technology(AI in this case) is here to stay and the best you can do for yourself is to adopt it early in your life.

There is a misconception that AI stuns your creativity and makes you lazy. I beg to differ.

Let's understand that every innovation has its good and bad sides. it just depends on how you use it. As sweet as sugar is, too much of it could be very harmful to the body and too little of it lowers your blood sugar level which is also bad for the health.

Balance is key. 🗝️

AI should be treated the same way.

It should not replace the human mind, it should support it.

For instance, writers can you AI to organize thoughts, Engineers can use it run confirm calculations or predict outcomes, content creators can use it for brainstorming. However the original thought, emotion and feeling should come from the human mind and not a machine.

Words and creativity without feeling lacks this dept. I don't know how to explain it but it lacks this human touch.

Feeling in your craft is what keeps Art alive.

Ethical considerations should be put in place when making use of AI.

AI should be used as an assistant and not a ship to sail on its own. It needs a captain that always understands the fundamentals to be able to enhance his already creative side and use AI mainly for automating mundane tasks.

body.title: Recordando de dónde venimos
body.body:
**¡Hola, amigos de Hive!**

Casi 25 días desde mi último post. Han pasado muchas cosas en lo personal y lo profesional, pero hoy no quiero hablar de eso. Hoy quiero hablar de algo más grande, porque creo que es momento de mirar hacia atrás y recordar por qué seguimos aquí.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eddiespino/23twA2Y16XUmDvVgUP9Nr6noFN13stHrxvMbd4zusFjf5vtR4oNYrGzDpJ5vk9tbAq9cL.png)

Como siempre, quisiera iniciar con una canción. Conozco \

de [Kodaline](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kodaline) desde hace unos 10 años, fue una de las primeras que escuché de la banda. Su música ha tenido un gran impacto en mi vida, y aunque hoy no me extenderé sobre eso, sí quiero detenerme en el video.

El video lo protagoniza el actor que se hizo famoso por interpretar a McLovin. Es la historia de un jockey que, tras un accidente, queda en silla de ruedas. Es claramente un evento traumático. Pero al final del video, logra subirse de nuevo al caballo. Esa imagen, simbólica como es, la relaciono con mi viaje aquí en Hive.

https://youtu.be/-gj4_qp4a28?si=viIL4QWPcLFbO7Jm

---

### Seis años después

Hace algunas semanas empecé a platicarle sobre Hive a una amiga. Y al hacerlo, me di cuenta de algo: tuve que regresar a las raíces para poder explicarle por qué este lugar importa. Volví a leer uno de los artículos de Decrypt sobre la historia de cómo nació Hive, y me hizo reflexionar.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eddiespino/244UzK68GBFCK9DrUNTfcajN9tYmV1wwLhgPymfmMQdAMYz3APf8fBYZvwyGDrXXGU8iB.png)

https://decrypt.co/38050/steem-steemit-tron-justin-sun-cryptocurrency-war

Llegué a Steem en enero de 2018. Pasé de creador de contenido a community manager, después a self-taught, a asistente y Project Manager con muchos sombreros, y, eventualmente, a cofundador de Mantequilla-Soft. En el camino, fundé Aliento, colaboré en proyectos grandes como 3Speak, denuncié abusos y ayudé a organizar eventos importantes para Hive, tanto virtuales como presenciales.

Han pasado tantas cosas en estos años. Cosas buenas, cosas malas. Sé que muchos han llegado y muchos se han ido. Sé que muchos de nosotros ya no tenemos la misma energía, la misma fe, ni la misma motivación que teníamos al inicio. Y está bien reconocerlo.

Pero recordar de dónde venimos también significa recordar que lo que se construyó, se construyó por algo, y por alguien.

---

### Lo que Aliento ha hecho, en datos

Hace unos días leí un análisis publicado por @demotruk sobre la retención de cuentas nuevas en Hive. Lo que encontró merece su propio post (y de hecho, eso es lo que voy a hacer la próxima semana en desde @Aliento), pero les adelanto lo principal:

**Aliento es la comunidad de bienvenida con mayor retención en Hive.** Y es la única cuya tasa de retención no se cayó entre 2022 y 2023, mientras otros proyectos de bienvenida vieron caídas de hasta 13 puntos porcentuales.

No lo digo yo. Lo dice una investigación independiente, basada en datos on-chain, mirando cohortes de cuentas nuevas durante dos años completos.

Esto importa porque, cuando uno atraviesa momentos de poca motivación, es fácil olvidar que el trabajo que hacemos sí deja huella. Aliento la deja. Y los datos de @demotruk lo confirman. Pueden leer el post [aquí](https://peakd.com/hive-107705/@demotruk/the-rise-abuse-and-quiet-migration-of-introduceyourself).

Esta o la próxima semana vamos a publicar un análisis detallado en Aliento, con los números completos, los matices honestos, y lo que esto significa para la comunidad hispana de Hive. Si les interesa el tema, estén pendientes.

---

### Recordar para construir

No se trata de hacer un *double down* ni de arriesgarse aún más. No se trata de pretender que todo está bien cuando no lo está. Se trata de algo más simple: recordar por qué estamos aquí, y dejar que ese recuerdo informe lo que hacemos a partir de hoy.

El jockey del video de Kodaline no se subió al caballo porque todo se hubiera resuelto. Se subió porque entendió que volver a empezar era posible.

Hive ya pasó por su propio momento de \

. Lo hicimos en 2020. Lo hemos hecho cada vez que algo se cayó y tocó levantarlo. Y lo seguiremos haciendo, porque eso es lo que distingue a quienes se quedan: la capacidad de recordar de dónde vienen para saber hacia dónde van.\n\n*¿Y ustedes? ¿Qué los trajo a Hive originalmente? ¿Qué los mantiene aquí hoy? Me encantaría leerlos en los comentarios.*

body.title: A Skylit Drive || TTT
body.body: > Hello music lovers. It's me, @saydie, with some Three Tune Tuesday post after a while, although I've been sharing other music content like the past concerts that I have been to. Well, I just came home after watching **A Skylit Drive** concert today and still feel the dopamine rush, which is maybe preventing me from putting my eyes to rest. So instead of staring at the ceiling, I decided to make a short post, but I still need time to process everything that happened today, so it might take a while before I can make a detailed post about my experience, not to mention, I will also watch **Saosin** next this coming Thursday. So, for now, I just wanna share about my top 3 picks among their setlist. ___ ***All It Takes For Your Dreams To Come True - A Skylit Drive*** https://youtu.be/BrMLAB-ipuw?si=iU3djcwojk7oNw8Q

> This is the first song that the band sings. Can't believe that this song is already 17 years old, because they sing it with the same energy from those early years, especially Michael Jagmin for his distinct high-pitched vocal style. Of course, live performances sound different from studio recordings that we hear in music videos, but the way they sing it, I really feel that I return to my teenage years. ___ ***Wires...And The Concept Of Breathing - A Skylit Drive*** https://youtu.be/KiBI6lHshzc?si=ugrZFbi9rRONKqPo

>

Comes from their second album with the same title, this song is just one of my all-time favorites from all their songs, and why I fell in love with the band, so I was really glad when it turned out that it was included in their setlist. Those raw and energetic characteristics of the song were still there, just blended well with the melodic hooks of the song, and the aggressive screaming by Joey Galligan really helps to convey the deep emotional turmoil of the song.

<div>

___

***Separate Ways (Worlds Apart) [Journey Cover] - A Skylit Drive***

<div class=\

> https://youtu.be/udy3bMkdwNk?si=UzCnfs_Xg7E_LyRJ And for my third pick, I go for their encore song, Separate Ways (Worlds Apart), which is a Journey cover song, part of the Punk Goes Classic Rock album. I'm not really fond of listening to cover songs, because most of the time, I prefer to listen to the original. But in their cover, they did not just copy the song, but also brought their own identity to it, and that identity is still felt very distinctively throughout the song. ___ And that was it for now. Overall, I really do enjoy the concert, and as I check on their setlist, I learned that they actually play 15 songs in total, which is just insane, since they only played 10 songs when they played in Hammersonic Festival in Indonesia, which is a far bigger music event than what we had here in PH, but they still played it very energetically, and full of showmanship. As my friend says, the best concerts does not always need big arenas. See you until next time! ___
> The linked videos are not owned by me, I am just sharing the link to the copyright owner's video. No copyright infringement is intended.\n\n

body.title: Weekly ish Running Update...
body.body:
I've just realised I've missed out one random inteerval session I did about 10 days ago, but the last three runs as follows:

### Hereford easyish 6K 

I wasn't in the mood for really slow running so I opted for slightly faster...


![Screenshot_20260503_211722_Garmin Connect.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/23vYctYouQsQHwPU1C5fpgnDx21MNiUNDeKLE9ZgvnA6KDtT67PUE5SoRrgYHstUytidq.jpg)

5.47 pace and 151BPM average is OK - low HRZ 4. 

### Hereford easy 7K 

Out around Breinton, loverly morning! 


![Screenshot_20260503_211657_Garmin Connect.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/23ujfuxiGYDZDaJFVZqPANES21Wwuro7cxWWsKmwiSw1ttXtssBACs9BAqok1mg8B4cQD.jpg)

Slightly slower pace and lower HR, I am gonna experiment with this going forwards! 

### London Intervals...

I headed to the track and bashed out 4.2Ks worth of intervals at a decent pace, as below...

![Screenshot_20260505_210836_Garmin Connect.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/23xV6PqQDC6M1LCE28qH65y1vkyzA1dBSYdJXP9Nxp7zQUoh8GV21uD1SE59u6qowHV1b.jpg)


Interesting that the first long interval I felt fine and sped up to a decent final 0.6K pace, I could have pushed for a 2K total, but that was enough, the next two 800s felt hard as did the 400s, this was enough! 

Paces..


![Screenshot_20260505_210856_Garmin Connect.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/23swgX6maCEN2HYEfkCvDucPGtVyJcvFwjCnsf8iPh6VignQ1WaasW2PPPbw12vcFaes3.jpg)


![Screenshot_20260505_210904_Garmin Connect.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/23swgMvaSb5yR2bao5PFLYScQbKLXZnu2snGcx2wu7hfsPR7mS91Z434NHnjrruGqjcNR.jpg)


You know what, I will take the above! 

### Final thoughts...

I am quite happy with this routine - alternating slow runs which I am really enjoying with tempo and track sessions, the later I do enjoy but today's not so much, this was just plane hard work.....





It'll be interesting to see if I do get any faster....

오늘의 산책은 정말 즐거웠어요. 공원에 도착했을 때, 우연히 오랜 친구를 만났습니다. 우리는 서로의 근황을 나누고, 함께 잠시 앉아 커피를 마시며 이야기를 나누었어요. 그 친구는 최근에 새로 시작한 취미에 대해 이야기해 주었고, 나도 흥미로운 이야기들을 나눴답니다. 또한, 산책하는 길에 작은 플리마켓이 열리고 있더군요. 다양한 핸드메이드 제품과 빈티지 소품들을 구경하면서 소소한 즐거움을 느꼈습니다. 특히, 예쁜 도자기 컵 하나를 사게 되었는데, 조그마한 가게 안에서 만든 것이라고 하더군요. 이렇게 하루 동안의 산책은 친구와의 재회와 새로운 발견으로 가득 찬 시간이었습니다! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). body.title: The Hibiscus Secret.
body.body: > While I was investigating a well near Sobek's pool, I found a bloody priest's robe and a note revealing a plot to poison the crocodiles. I tracked the commands to Melina the Hibiscus at the Neorion Naval Arsenal. After a failed assassination attempt on the sleeping target, I was forced to flee the heavily guarded site. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQNSfyYFWcpjjPabquo2W3g7h6MXLpX7jKE9XRVDW6KAm/screenshot_1_.jpg) When I was investigating the second pool in the temple of Sobek, I noticed blood stains trailing toward a dark corner. I had to use this narrow well to get to the stained dark place beneath the temple structure. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNw4q2MqRG28dthFYsVmb17ujX3gj21me9zi2k7qGexQP/screenshot_2_.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVhz2yQMn4sa4d83auDVjYtfYb1dBoxEtNaNRFDkuDbrV/screenshot_3_.jpg) I noticed I was on the other side of the pool where Sobek was resting, safely tucked away from the public eye. Then I found a discarded priest's robe which was covered in fresh blood, which said whoever was wearing this was badly injured or worse. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPX8MZ5pys1d4qA4ZcDUdc2BuQQymcmJijZMdF7gTtDmM/screenshot_4_.jpg) The blood trail led outside to the east of the temple. I called Senu and located the injured person from high above, and then I went outside. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbFv6HMnB8AFaRWgKK3iYtpJ28m5vUJiqt3qgwfMAEdzj/screenshot_5_.jpg) I ran to the spot and found a dead body of a soldier who was mauled by crocodiles. The soldier had a note that had commands about how to poison the crocodile to manipulate the village's faith. And this was the man who poisoned the crocodiles, who was taking orders from Melina the Hibiscus, a name that carried a weight of corruption. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPPswU23DojGR8u9xFPLQnfrgCRMNKwTbEYxen4xFe2cT/screenshot_6_.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQEGFwMnJDPTvXy6uH8TYpWHRLwULMweHi3ojx4vAhyD1/screenshot_7_.jpg) Now I had to assassinate Melina the Hibiscus, who was hiding at Neorion Naval Arsenal, which is south of Krokodilopolis. I rode there and once close, I flew Senu to locate her among the soldiers. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcCDVAFEmExBEkFfQZkWhocnH4pHz7VwhAqE8iVJBAGAV/screenshot_8_.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY66XxJyTkjVBQHEKU4fkoreDG3eKSPnXvFAVfoDD9MKe/screenshot_9_.jpg) The arsenal was heavily guarded with strong patrols of elite soldiers. body.title: The Act of Friendship
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWdWY8JiG5pTwd4pcLscZ8eUnq12zW9JwSbzzRTcPhmka/1778012138084.jpg)

People are too quick to discard friendships these days and, almost always, discard them for reasons that should not be substantial enough to even weaken true friendships. Reasons like change in status, moving to another country or even just an argument that doesn't need be any more than a few seconds of being upset has resulted in people letting go of who they called friends. Furthermore, most people are not patient enough to see past a persons’ imperfections or just the fact that their friend may now have a weakness; they simply decide they have fallen out of love with that person.

For me it has never been like that. The chances of me letting a friend go are very low, unless that person was not truly my friend from the start. I am not quick to make friends, but once I have decide to let someone in my heart and called them my friend, it is not just for a limited period. It is not dependent on situations, once I call you friend, you're a friend forever.

Moving places or livy in a different country does not change anything. It does not matter how far you move away; growth and transitions cannot change our friendship. Those are only experiences that come with life.

I have noticed something, and it is that most people are not willing to sacrifice their own comfort and peace of mind for others and that is why most friendships do not last. Friendship should not be only about good times and pleasant conversations or just showing up only when you want to. Friendship requires effort, sacrifice. It requires the willingness to let it cost you your comfort, your money and even your time.

Friendship is a giving.

Yes, you give your time when it's not convenient. Giving your attention when you are too tired. Showing up for someone when it is not in your plan. That is where most people back away from making true friends and so true friends become very scarce.

In my life I have only had a few people I truly called friends and these people have been in my life for over three decades. Beyond childhood friendship that naturally fades away as people grows up and move in different directions in life, the friendship I chose from my teenage years has remained strong till today.

The fact that we don't see each other on a regular basis doesn't change a thing. The fact that we do not live in the same region doesn't change a thing. The bond is still there, the connection is still in tact.

I have grew up with friends from teenage years up till now we all men with families. But there is one friend I have had for the better part of my life, for more than three decades, nearly over half of my whole life. We went to school together as teenagers, grew up together, and today we are still together as men with families and that friendship is as strong, stronger even, now. And it has extended to include our wives and children.

The one thing that kept us together as friends is sacrifice and forbearance; the willingness to overlook a flaw, to stay committed to the person and stand by them even when you don't feel like it. That is what makes true friendship.

This is the kind of friend you can call upon any time and they will show up without asking too many questions, not because he's obligated to you but because of the bond you share.

That is what I called the act of friendship.

body.title: Spring Is Coming and Nature Is Waking Up 🌿
body.body: Today I want to share some photos of trees I've taken. I took these photos in different locations, five or six different spots. But they all made me feel the same thing: spring is coming. Lately, I've been looking at trees more while walking. I've seen them before, but I didn't pay this much attention. Now I look at the branches, the leaves, and the sky. It makes me feel good. Sometimes I just stop and watch.\n\n

/> The trees aren't fully green yet. But there's a movement within them. The branches are slowly coming to life. It's like winter is ending. It's like nature is waking up. It's beautiful to see this change. I love looking up from under a tree. The moment it merges with the sky is very impressive. Especially in the evenings, it's beautiful. The light is softer as the sun sets. I usually took my photos at those times.

/> Sometimes, when I'm walking, a tree catches my attention. I immediately stop and take a picture. People pass by, but I want to capture that moment. Because that moment gives me peace. Trees remind me of patience. They wait throughout the winter. Then they slowly come to life. They don't rush. Everything happens in its time. This is a good lesson for me too.

/> These photos aren't just images. Each one holds a memory. A short walk, a brief stop, or a beautiful feeling… That's why they're precious to me. Seeing the arrival of spring like this makes me happy. You don't need grand things. A tree, some sky, and a peaceful moment are enough.
/>\n\nI hope you feel peace while looking at these photos. Perhaps you'll pay a little more attention to the trees today. Because sometimes the most beautiful things are very close to us.

body.title: Encuentro de Talentos: Vivir en libertad
body.body:
<center>**Vivir en libertad** 
**To live in freedom**</center>





<div class=\

> Es un concepto difícil el decir que vivimos en libertad, porque desde que nacemos dependemos de otras personas, como seres humanos la libertad y ser libre se van forjando. La libertad como la entendemos es decidir por voluntad propia. Tenemos la capacidad para tener opciones a elegir, también para asumir las responsabilidades de nuestros actos. Particularmente ese vivir en libertad esta muy adentro de nosotros mismos. Podemos estar dentro de un espacio limitado y sentirnos libres.
> It's a difficult concept to say that we live in freedom, because from birth we depend on others. As human beings, freedom and being free are things we forge. Freedom, as we understand it, is deciding of our own free will. We have the capacity to choose and to take responsibility for our actions. This sense of living in freedom is deeply ingrained within ourselves. We can be confined within a limited space and still feel free.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZdF1LNGVva8gHsGkMJnoADR8PqK2zcezE77qPZizTPKT/imagen.png)

En esta semana en la que estoy planeando un viaje, mi hijo me pregunta que voy a sentir al estar en libertad, sin fallas de luz, de agua y donde se cumplen las leyes. Yo le digo que esa libertad es relativa y aunque cuento con servicios afuera, el tener que salir de mi país para poder abrazar a mis hijos no es nada fácil, me causa estrés y preparativos.
> This week, as I'm planning a trip, my son asks me how I'll feel being free, without power outages or water shortages, and where the laws are enforced. I tell him that freedom is relative, and even though I have services abroad, having to leave my country to hug my children isn't easy; it causes me stress and requires preparation.
Definitivamente ser libre o sentirse libre esta muy adentro en nuestro pensamiento. A veces es un trabajo el que nos aprisiona o simplemente nos cargamos con el trabajo u obligaciones de otras personas. Y definitivamente es nuestra culpa cuando esto ocurre, simplemente no hemos delegado labores para los miembros del hogar.
> Being free, or feeling free, is definitely something deeply ingrained in our thinking. Sometimes it's work that imprisons us, or we simply burden ourselves with the work or obligations of others. And it's definitely our fault when this happens; we simply haven't delegated tasks to the members of our household.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPqnkGuL6LqCnfsgM9HeC9SQbhDB3a264os76kM7GYzAh/imagen.png)

Recuerdo que hace muchos años atrás una persona amiga cayo preso. Con animo de ayudarlo, al ir a visitarlo le preguntaba que necesitaba y se nos ocurrió la idea de enlazar la universidad con las clases de primaria que los presos estaban solicitando.Recogimos entre los amigos y parientes libros, cuadernos y mucho material escolar para llevárselo a la cárcel. Y tuve que presenciar como los guardias destruyeron la mayoría a pesar de nuestras protestas. La verdad al equipo educativo no le quedo muchas ganas de volver ayudar después de presenciar ese atropello. No resulta fácil mantener una buena actitud al ver estos episodios.
> I remember many years ago a friend of mine was imprisoned. Wanting to help him, I visited him and asked what he needed. That's when we came up with the idea of ​​connecting the university with the elementary school classes the prisoners were requesting. We collected books, notebooks, and lots of school supplies from friends and relatives to take to the prison. And I had to witness the guards destroy most of them despite our protests. The truth is, the teaching staff didn't feel very inclined to help again after witnessing that outrage. It's not easy to maintain a positive attitude when you see things like this.
Todos los venezolanos sabemos de esta lucha constante por la libertad. Pero no podemos depender solamente de ella, debemos continuar, seguir apoyando, creando y deseando esa libertad.
> All Venezuelans are aware of this constant struggle for freedom. But we cannot rely solely on it; we must continue, keep supporting, creating, and striving for that freedom.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfJECo5bQRXUorCPaJt1SKLkE5B4CQxyVJd8B9JocBujS/imagen.png)
