🌍 The Dark City of Spirits
The Dark City stood in a desolate land where no one dared to live. Every night, black clouds circled above, and the moon glowed like the eyes of a spirit, terrifying anyone who looked at it.  

People from nearby towns called it “The City of Spirits” because anyone who entered never returned. Legends said powerful spirits ruled there, turning it into a kingdom of darkness.  

The houses were ruins, their walls covered with strange symbols no one could understand. At night, eerie voices echoed through the streets, like cries of people trapped in fear. Anyone who stepped inside heard a chilling whisper: “Love and mercy are forbidden here; only fear and darkness reign.”  

A brave girl named Sagal decided to break this curse. Armed with prayers and verses, she walked into the city with light and compassion in her heart. As she reached the center, spirits tried to frighten her, but her voice and prayers tore through the shadows.  

The leader of the spirits appeared, his eyes burning like fire, his voice thundering: “This is my kingdom; no light shall enter!” But Sagal recited powerful verses, and lightning of pure light struck the city.  

The black clouds scattered, the spirits fled to distant mountains, and the city began to shine. People from nearby towns rejoiced, calling Sagal “The girl who brought light back to the City of Spirits.”  

From that day, the Dark City became a symbol of courage and the power of prayer. People learned that no matter how deep the darkness, light and compassion could always break through.

body.title: Mail Call: 1870-A France 5 Francs Napoleon III
body.body:
Got another one in the mail from my favorite coin dealer. An 1870-A France 5 Francs featuring Napoleon III. This one has some history behind it.

<center>![IMG_2624.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/coinjoe/23wX9hqf2RQ4FgK4RZPYBA38YmtskgR8VvN17Pw8xgDSj1rCJmuuKEvbztjTFRN8n1XRa.jpg)</center>

The obverse shows the portrait of Napoleon III facing left with \

mint mark indicates it was struck at the Paris Mint.

<center>![IMG_2625.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/coinjoe/23uFgbeYaPtEgLvxHDgLxvz7piohNAB7EXWRadxF8dtx2nYTEiNwmbeFQMNrnw6cMu7px.jpg)
</center>

The reverse features the imperial coat of arms with the French eagle. The edge bears the inscription \

Spoiler alert: He didn't.

This is a silver coin, .900 fine, weighing 25 grams with a diameter of 37mm. It contains about 0.7234 troy ounces of actual silver.

This is where it gets interesting. This coin was minted in early 1870 while Napoleon III was still Emperor of France. The Second French Empire was at its peak. Or so everyone thought.

By July 1870, France declared war on Prussia. It was supposed to be a quick victory to restore French prestige and keep Prussia in check. It didn't go that way.

By September 1st, 1870, Napoleon III was captured at the Battle of Sedan along with over 100,000 French troops. One of the most humiliating defeats in French military history.

By September 4th, the Second Empire was over. The Third Republic was declared in Paris. Napoleon III went from Emperor to prisoner of war in a matter of days.

The war dragged on until January 1871. France lost Alsace and part of Lorraine to the newly unified German Empire. They were forced to pay five billion francs in reparations. German troops occupied northern France until it was paid off.

The loss poisoned relations between France and Germany for decades. Some historians draw a straight line from this war to the trenches of World War I.

So this coin in my hand was legal tender under an emperor who would be a prisoner of war within months of it being struck. The government that minted it didn't survive the year.

That's what I love about old coins. They're not just metal. They're frozen moments in time. This one captures the last days of an empire that didn't know it was dying.

![HiveDivider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/coinjoe/EoGvX4Va6X4ZfjnYkvBhFi2bqZsCrwoqpWhwgmGDPKVDS9eeZ4zF8foqAfcm44mn84d.png)

If you have any further information about this coin you would like to add, like historical information I left out or want to correct any I may have gotten wrong, please drop it in the comments.

Thanks for reading,
Joe

body.title: Clarissa or the End of the World – New Fiction
body.body:
![Untitled (1280 x 780 px).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23xVia8KfPEWHjM9fdUrGwTkE4q8TbZAmqdP175yNh1M3KFaEWnL7HrqGKG3YL5BtCrps.png)

Clarissa came by this afternoon. She wasn't wearing much – daisy dukes with black sheer stockings and a half shirt – and I tried to keep my eyes in my head. We hadn't really settled anything yet, and I didn't want to let on that I wanted anything.

She sat in my rocker all agog about the craft that had appeared off the coast. We couldn't see it from where we were, ten miles inland, but it was all over social media, not to mention regular media. I kept trying to start flirting and she kept trying to speculate. Like speculating would have changed what was about to happen.

“They're saying there isn't any movement out there, but this one guy thinks he can see someone, or something, standing on top of it. The video he shared, there's just a glimpse, but you can kind of see a figure, or something.”

She was breathless talking about it. She held out her phone to show me. I watched the clip trying not to stare at the line where her legs crossed. There was nothing to see. Just that same mile wide, triangular hunk of black sitting inert like it had since it splashed down in the ocean about a month ago.

“Trump is going to blow it up,” I said. “Start some kind of intergalactic war. You know he wants to.”

But she wasn't having it. Kept on about how they – whoever or whatever they are – were going to reveal our bonds of peace and love and usher in the Age of Aquarius.

And there I was trying to get laid with the end of the world.

*

Clarissa first came into my experience when I worked overnight at Circle K. She was the too young, semi-homeless chick who stayed with some guys in the moss-smeared trailer across the road. I'd see her at 2, 3 in the morning – knee-high leather boots, miniskirt, halter top, a garland of plastic flowers around her neck – with a pet carrier full of cats, her fur babies. I'd give her an eyeful and her cats a sandwich or two from the hot food we were throwing out. I suspect she ate some of the sandwiches herself.

One time she came in she had made herself up with glitter across her plump cheeks and up around her eyes to her brow. I told her it looked nice, and she was appreciative, said the guys had made fun of her for doing it. That set the tone of our relationship – she a-flutter soaking up my compliments, and me an old simp dishing it out. Of course, as any of the T-fueled dating coaches on YouTube will tell you, simps never get laid.

Even back then, at the end of the first Trump presidency and long before the craft appeared, Clarissa was starry-eyed about aliens. I would see her come rushing up the sidewalk through the storefront windows, leaving her homeless crew on the corner, to come bursting through the doors with news of the lights she had seen in the sky over Beacon Hill. She was always so happy announcing that they were up there, watching over us. I would nod along, noting a paradox in such nice long legs on a crazy chick.

But I guess she wasn't completely crazy. They really were up there.

*

CNN had reported that two U.S. Navy carriers and a frigate were stationed in the Pacific on the far side of the alien craft. Unbeknownst to us, while we sat in my apartment arguing over whether the aliens intended love or war – and I tried not to drool over her plump legs in that black sheer hose – the long inert ship had begun to show some activity. The side of the triangular craft that faced the Navy vessels shifted color from black to a shimmering pink. The pink began to waft out of the ship like mist, which built into a shimmering pink cloud bank – with sparkles of white light inside it – and rolled toward the Navy vessels.

The two carriers reacted as soon as the pink cloud began rolling out. The Navy had already been maintaining a rotation of two fighter jets in a holding pattern over the craft; then it launched a string of F-35s toward the horizon, where they swept in a wide return arc. Klaxons must have blared on the frigate as the missile launchers lowered to horizontal to aim at the pink cloud. I imagine a broadcast repeating itself over a loudspeaker: “Return to your previous position or be fired upon.”

But the cloud continued to advance over the waves. The frigate fired a warning shot from its bow cannon, then with barely a pause fired a successive flashing of eight pairs of missiles. The missiles penetrated the cloud – but there was no explosion, either within the cloud or the alien craft. The missiles simply disappeared. The F-35s  zoomed past in low pairs firing their sidewinders, and missile after missile entered the cloud with no effect, and the missiles that hit the craft itself penetrated the black like it was mist too, and disappeared.

The pink cloud rolled forward. The frigate opened up with every gun it had. The cloud wafted over the three Navy vessels like a fog, building up until all three were occluded. Then it's motion lulled and stopped – it reversed course and began to pull back into the craft.

Revealing that the Navy vessels were gone.

*

King 5 out of Seattle had a chopper in the air when all of this went down, and within half an hour Clarissa and I were watching clips on social media.

She was so ecstatic she could barely sit still. “I told you, dude, I told you! This is love. That's why the cloud is pink. They're going to take our tools of war and teach us nonviolence.”

I was in shock. The alien craft consumed some of the most advanced ships and weaponry in the world with impunity. We're powerless.

Clarissa slid off one shoe. Actually ran her stocking foot up the inside of my leg. “We should celebrate,” she said.

But I was too freaked out to get hard.

***

body.title: My Green Dream: A Morning in a Rooftop Garden.
body.body:
> ![IMG-20260501-WA0010~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUvQ2CVZB726tYzMPcuF63Gma1Fwauko5iLMi7Gmujzpr/IMG-20260501-WA0010~2.jpg) ![IMG-20260501-WA0014~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZUccSHy2JcHcCAGM9ktTMtWbozAvTstRX8Q9LGFsSXjA/IMG-20260501-WA0014~2.jpg) Who doesn't like a touch of greenery? There is no alternative to gardening to take a breather within the four walls of this mechanical city. I love gardening very much, and out of that love, I have built a small rooftop garden on the roof of my house. This morning was a little special for my garden, because today I made room for some new members in my garden. ![IMG-20260501-WA0022~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma8WKdZivPXrK4xu3ki2Arj8oEbpgGct96kunLcgZCJUR/IMG-20260501-WA0022~2.jpg) ![IMG-20260501-WA0044~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcLWPbPJUan8Apn184y7Sf6wUwiVHXehJ43dLHKp8PbHX/IMG-20260501-WA0044~2.jpg) I woke up early this morning and went to the garden. Today's main plan was to plant a **brinjal seedling**. I prepared the right soil mixture and planted the seedling in a large pot with great care. Only a garden lover can describe the joy of watching a plant grow. Not only brinjal, I have planted some other creeping vegetable seedlings in this small garden of mine. These include: **Jhinga:** When these plants start climbing the roof, the garden will become more lively. **Bitter gourd:** Not only is the nutritional value of bitter gourd high, but the beauty of its leaves and vines is also extraordinary. **Other trees:** I also have various seasonal trees in my garden that make me feel better every morning. ![IMG20260501111333~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYxPoTyssKfr3Xg2fz6FoKND54qc1KygZaYK1yjwgZoTb/IMG20260501111333~2.jpg) Amidst the hustle and bustle of the city, a rooftop garden works like therapy for me. These small things like taking care of the trees, cleaning the weeds, or seeing new buds give me peace of mind. When you can collect fresh, poison-free vegetables from your own planted trees, the joy of that achievement is different from anything else. In the current era, when the shortage of land is increasing, each of us should plant at least one or two trees on our roofs or balconies. Not only does it maintain the balance of the environment, but it also helps meet the nutritional needs of the family. This small garden of mine may not be very big, but it is a reflection of my dream. ![IMG20260501112023~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTkYDCP1LvvjJytST3JzhvdAmXV7s6fMe9RGFJaCiR7bg/IMG20260501112023~2.jpg) Finally, I would like to say, plant a sapling in the small empty space of your house today. You will see, as that small sapling grows, your life has also become more joyful. Do share your opinion about my garden! This was my arrangement for today. I hope you liked the pictures I took and the nature observations. Wishing everyone good health, I bid you farewell here today. |

body.title: The Price We Pay to be Online
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUy6H2oEpy5UL2PXEZt3p5xRUz2AkgN4fMu1WadWFBGe2/1000237570.png 

I stumbled upon a thread early today wherein someone was questioning the relevance of complains from users stating that their contributions on short content platforms on Hive were not being rewarded, especially on Ecency, and this got me thinking because though the question looked simple at face value it does not fully represent the reality as to why one shows up here everyday.

The author of the thread asked if users were here for rewards or connection, to me this question misses the point because honestly we all show up for rewards in a way or the other. Hive is a tool that provides opportunities for builders, investors and content creators to create and not everyone is here to build. Builders are providing value, investors are also providing value and content creators, day in and out are also providing value regardless of long or short content and all of them do so because there is a reward in sight.

Even the connection is no exception, for engagement is also a reward itself. So the claims made about receiving no rewards, especially from short content, are in my view not just simple complaints but frustrated reactions stemming from a real issue.

The real issue is the price one pays to be online.

For some, this is not simply a matter of logging in and putting content up, they are in places with erratic power supply and unaffordable internet service. So for them being online is not passive but a deliberate action taken at a price.

I and many others with similar circumstance spend money daily to keep our devices charged. Charging phones and power banks at the charging centers have become a common practice and if we calculate it costs about $8 and possibly higher per month to do this. Moreover this is without accounting for data which would cost just as much and even higher depending on one's internet usage.

Putting it all together it's obvious the mere act of being active on this platform costs more than a lot of users are currently earning. And still we show up.

So when someone complains of not getting rewards especially from interacting with short content such as Snaps, Waves, InLeo threads; it is only fair that they are not met with mere dismissal but rather understanding. Yes, the complaint should not become an every-day occurrence, but they are legitimate and they arise from something quite critical.

Short content platforms are meant to serve as containers for user contributions to be rewarded and by default every participant and commenter on it should benefit in one way or the other. So when someone participates consistently and receives no reward, something must be wrong somewhere.

We should not condemn such people because when one consistently pays to be online, it is very difficult to continue doing so and not receive something in return.

Being online is not free for everyone, and for many of us, the price we pay is real.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@thelastdash/the-price-we-pay-to-be-online-4aq)

title.body: Unreality Layers Material Layers is a builder for creating complex materials from multiple layers that stack on top of one another.,, Each layer adds color, texture, or an effect, and we easily control their combination - adjusting order and blending intensity. We configured the material so a layer can be applied to different objects, both with our seamless world material and with an atlas material. And if a layer is not used, we disable its computation, which saves resources and improves performance.,, This lets you quickly create beautiful, realistic surfaces, adding details from our library like dirt, rust, and scratches without changing the base material each time. The approach saves time and resources, letting you adjust only what you need - simply and efficiently. #rendering #material

title.title: Well Say Hello To Our South Korean Friends
title.body: /> [source](https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/hive) I am sure you are all well aware of HIVE going up in price this morning a healthy 40% or so and now slowly retracting to around 23% which is expected. I was expecting the South Koreans to come and play like they used to do and it must be profitable otherwise they would not be doing this. How can we forget how they helped HIVE hit $3.41 back in November of 2021 which is also the ATH. This price pump is not because HIVE has developed some new app or it is undervalued and this is just a way for traders to make quick profit however they do this. This was a twice monthly occurrence during the last Bull cycle so seeing this happen is a definite positive.

/> I have not paid much attention to where the HIVE volume has been of late and it is great to see not one or two, but 4 exchanges having decent volumes for HIVE. Upbit based in S. Korea with a 51% in increased volume is where this pump was driven from with Binance jumping on the band wagon up by 17% today. This is actually good news because this is not 100% reliant on the Koreans to pump HIVE and we now have back up once it is started. I can recall tracking the pumps with HIVE a few years ago and there is definitely a pattern. This being the first for a very long time could be a test run and I do expect more to follow later this week. Don't quote me on this but if memory serves me right the pumps were 3 days apart so maybe Thursday/Friday would be good to pay attention. HIVE for some reason is a good coin to manipulate the price and is probably more down to low volumes being able to move the price. Having the extra exchanges with decent volumes is a bonus this time around and the chances are the spikes could be significant swings which will hopefully grow our base price. This is all good news for HIVE that the pumps are back because each time in the past we remained higher than the starting point regarding price after the pump and dump had concluded. A dream scenario if we can grow our base price before the market comes back to life as this would give HIVE a head start. It was not that long ago we had so much negativity around HIVE with many saying we would never see the ATH ever again and one must have an open mind and some patience. With a HIVE/USDT perpetual on Binance Futures with up to a 75 x leverage anything is possible. I am no trader so I am not sure how this all works, but with Binance offering HIVE a decent APR because they need the liquidity on offer. Exchanges make money from trades so offering an extra 5 or 10% may make no sense, but it is clear when there is price swings like now they make their money back and far more. $19.1 million in HIVE over the last 24 hours is good news as HIVE is back on the radar again.

/></center>

I am no fan of the pump and dump and wish HIVE was recognized for what it offers as a blockchain instead. At least HIVE is in the news and any news is good news.

title.title: Under His Hand: Standing Firm Against the Lion
title.body:
“Humble yourselves, therefore, under the mighty hand of God so that at the proper time He may exalt you, casting all your anxieties on Him because He cares for you. Be sober-minded; be watchful. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour. Resist him, firm in your faith…” — 1 Peter 5:6-9

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeCg3vZDCZvFZbD8CxB5jnSgR1shqzgNLCowqVEUaiYYW/1778010783887.jpg)

What does it mean for Satan to “devour” a Christian like a ravenous lion? Well, Peter’s call to resist him “firm in your faith,” implies that the devouring imagined here is one that consumes faith. For someone to be so devoured would mean that faith crumbles, that faith gives way, that—like Peter himself on the night of Christ’s betrayal—faith falls before the fearful onslaught of this diabolical lion. This is the devouring that Peter—now reinstated by resurrecting grace—warns his readers against.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS44SXgKSDJv9KbRAQ4hhU2aRomLgNaZT94AqBK81vCgw/1778010811056.jpg)

In this picture, then, Satan roars in the background like a lion intent on devouring the wayward believer. However, the saint is pictured as resisting the devil’s assaults “firm in his faith”. Notice that this resistance is not some brazen spiritual warfare, but rather is a child-like, desperate dependence on the crucified and risen Jesus Christ. As we humble ourselves under (or, in this case, “within”) the mighty hand of God—receiving what difficulties God’s sovereign wisdom ordains and casting the cares stirred up by those difficulties back onto the heart of love that decreed them for our good—we are resisting Satan firm in our faith.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeCg3vZDCZvFZbD8CxB5jnSgR1shqzgNLCowqVEUaiYYW/1778010835767.jpg)

See also that the hand of Christ (representing both His person and the work of His death,  resurrection, and present reign) not only hides the Christian as a sure refuge, but also holds the bit and bridle in Satan’s mouth. Yes, the devil is an enemy, yes, he is opposed to God and to his people and has power to destroy the body, but he is—at every step—bound by the leash of God’s sovereign will….and for the one trusting in Jesus Christ, that will is only, ever, and always good.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdBmhfJ3MGoaZXPZ46GpzCbRToNXvHDuhCAuFXfgTAYCK/1778010867891.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTNxHRZsgxUPLPCL1zrjtow9xUhzkvoxPVDyxSK7j8XLF/1778010867996.jpg)

[Explanation continued in the comments]

title.title: The social impact of Ozempic
title.body: /> _Banner created in ChatGPT_ * * * I was at a party last Saturday, a kids' party, but the guys stayed in a corner talking about some topics. One topic that appeared was about the GLP-1–based drugs, like Ozempic and Wegovy. They were talking about good examples in the family or circle of friends that they used, and they cited as a magic people losing weight. But of course, they were saying that those needed to get a good re-education on how they are eating. So what we were talking about is that being overweight isn't an excuse anymore, since it is easy to lose weight. Then I read today an interesting study on that topic.

/> _The new era of injected drugs to help lose weight is having some impacts on society._ [_Free-for-use in FreePik_](https://www.magnific.com/free-photo/closeup-shot-syringe-vial-white-glossy-surface_10990363.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=3&uuid=5746e7b9-4b15-47dc-ba5c-14a782b878b7&query=injected+drugs) The article wasn't talking about the good and bad effects of the chemical compound on our bodies, but about the social stigma of using it. The article was published in the [International Journal of Obesity](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41366-026-02061-y) and they are saying that, socially speaking, if it is bad to be overweight in society, taking this drug can be worse. We know that social segregation is bad for those who are overweight, but it looks like the stigma for those taking the drugs is worse, even after reducing their total weight. Because they are considered cheaters who went through a considered easier way. The study concluded that those who didn't lose weight suffer less with social judgment compared to those who went through a GLP-1 drug treatment. The people in the study said that diet and exercise earn recognition, while those using these drugs mostly cheated. But also another fact is that those who regain weight after a treatment with GLP-1 suffer more stigma than ever. So for sure those patients would need a follow-up with some psychological help to continue their path. The people in the study associated the regain of weight with a lack of discipline. So we commonly think that society usually tags those who are overweight with some sort of stigma, but essentially in this case, losing weight is worse! Maybe the problem is society and how it likes to be judgmental of everything.

/> _People who are in the process of losing weight suffer more if they are taking these drugs._ [_Free-for-use in FreePik_](https://www.magnific.com/free-photo/image-young-plus-size-girl-workout-gym-doing-fitness-holding-hands-head-looking-tired-exercises-white-background_24481588.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=7&uuid=e335f716-d377-4f57-96a2-db8d3477ee67&query=losing+weight+sad) As moral people interpret the problem, not the weight, but how people manage the weight is more important. If they use what they consider cheating, or if they lose control and regain the weight, are the worst-case scenarios. It is an interesting study that is worthwhile for us to think about how we see and treat others. So I can conclude that people are not concerned about your health if you are overweight, but they just want to create a stigma for you being lazy, who has never tried to lose weight. [

/> Eu estava em uma festa no sábado passado, uma festa infantil, mas os rapazes ficaram num canto conversando sobre vários assuntos. Um dos tópicos que surgiu foi sobre os medicamentos à base de GLP-1, como Ozempic e Wegovy. Eles estavam falando sobre bons exemplos na família ou no círculo de amigos que usavam esses medicamentos e citavam como mágica a perda de peso dessas pessoas. Mas, claro, eles diziam que essas pessoas precisavam de uma boa reeducação alimentar. Então, o que estávamos discutindo é que estar acima do peso não é mais desculpa, já que é fácil emagrecer. Então, hoje li um estudo interessante sobre esse assunto.

/> _A nova era das drogas injetáveis para ajudar na perda de peso está tendo alguns impactos na sociedade._ [_Gratuito para uso no FreePik_](https://www.magnific.com/free-photo/closeup-shot-syringe-vial-white-glossy-surface_10990363.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=3&uuid=5746e7b9-4b15-47dc-ba5c-14a782b878b7&query=injected+drugs) O artigo não estava falando sobre os efeitos bons e ruins do composto químico em nossos corpos, mas sobre o estigma social de seu uso. O artigo foi publicado no [International Journal of Obesity](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41366-026-02061-y) e afirma que, socialmente falando, se ser obeso já é ruim para a sociedade, tomar esse medicamento pode ser ainda pior. Sabemos que a segregação social é prejudicial para quem está acima do peso, mas parece que o estigma para quem usa esses medicamentos é ainda maior, mesmo após a perda de peso. Isso porque essas pessoas são consideradas trapaceiras que escolheram um caminho considerado mais fácil. O estudo concluiu que aqueles que não perderam peso sofrem menos com o julgamento social em comparação com aqueles que fizeram tratamento com o medicamento GLP-1. Os participantes do estudo disseram que dieta e exercícios físicos geram reconhecimento, enquanto aqueles que usam esses medicamentos são vistos como trapaceiros. Mas outro fato é que aqueles que recuperam o peso após o tratamento com GLP-1 sofrem ainda mais estigma. Portanto, certamente esses pacientes precisarão de acompanhamento com algum tipo de apoio psicológico para dar continuidade ao tratamento. As pessoas no estudo associaram o ganho de peso à falta de disciplina. É comum pensarmos que a sociedade costuma estigmatizar quem está acima do peso, mas, neste caso, perder peso é pior! Talvez o problema seja a sociedade e sua tendência a julgar tudo.

/> _Pessoas que estão em processo de emagrecimento sofrem mais se estiverem tomando esses medicamentos._ [_Gratuito para uso no FreePik_](https://www.magnific.com/free-photo/image-young-plus-size-girl-workout-gym-doing-fitness-holding-hands-head-looking-tired-exercises-white-background_24481588.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=7&uuid=e335f716-d377-4f57-96a2-db8d3477ee67&query=losing+weight+sad) Como pessoas com princípios morais interpretam o problema, não é o peso em si, mas como as pessoas o gerenciam que é mais importante. Se elas usam o que consideram trapaça, ou se perdem o controle e recuperam o peso, esses são os piores cenários. É um estudo interessante que nos faz refletir sobre como vemos e tratamos os outros. Portanto, posso concluir que as pessoas não se preocupam com a sua saúde se você estiver acima do peso, mas sim em criar um estigma de preguiça, associando você a quem nunca tentou emagrecer. [

Super Power Tuesday. Flex’em up mi gente.  

We had something stupendous in mind for this segment, but we lost it. The thought blew out the window, just as we were about to start pecking it out. 

Back-the-truck up, plan. Happy Cinqo De Mayo. Or, let that sinko in. 

Contrary to popular belief, especially among Gringos, Cinco de Mayo is not Mexico’s Independence Day, (that’s September 16, if anyone cares). The May 5th date actually commemorates the 1862 Battle of Puebla.  

In 1861, (Note: US Civil War is happening just North of the boarder), Mexico’s President Benito Juárez suspended debt payments to France, Britain, and Spain. While the latter two negotiated, Napoleon III of France saw an opportunity, he sent a massive, well-equipped army to conquer Mexico and install a puppet emperor. (Where have we seen this tactic before?) 

By May 5, 1862, about 6,000 French troops were marching toward Mexico City. At the town of Puebla, they met fierce resistance from roughly 2,000 rag-tag Mexican soldiers led by General Ignacio Zaragoza. Against all odds, the Mexicans won the day. 

After the victory, they all sat back and drank Coronas (beer), with limes, did Tequila shots and ate nachos. (I made that up.)  

The victory was largely symbolic. The French eventually regrouped and occupied Mexico for several years. Still, the Battle of Puebla became a potent symbol of Mexican unity and resistance against European imperialism.  

Another note. This activity in Mexico alarmed President Lincoln, as he feared, with good reason, that if the Confederate side was victorious, yet weakened, Napoleon III would invade the US. 

Cinco de Mayo barely registers as a holiday in most of Mexico.  It’s commemorated, so we hear, in Puebla, where it’s celebrated militarily. Its rise in the United States is a story of cultural reinvention. (That’s bot-speak for Mexploitation.)  

Chicano activists  during the civil rights 60s & 70s rediscovered the Battle of Puebla. They saw it as a parallel to their own struggle for civil rights, a tenacious underdog doing battle against an oppressor. Activists began using the date to celebrate Mexican-American heritage, identity, and pride.  

In the 1980s, (of course), Beer and tequila companies saw an opportunity. The historical significance faded, replaced by marketing campaigns promoting margaritas, tacos, and decorative sombreros. By the 1990s, corporations had successfully transformed Cinco de Mayo into a generic party holiday, what many call “Drinko de Mayo.”

Today, on May 5th, many Americans think of green limes, white cheese, and red (not too spicy) salsa on their nachos, Tejano music, and drink specials at chain restaurants. Many have no idea a real battle, or a nuanced history even exists. 

Welcome to America. You know you’re a made minority when corporate sponsorship erases your struggle, cartoonifies your history, and sells your own culture back to you in a bottle of beer and a bag of chips. 

Don’t believe me, just ask Aunt Jemima, Uncle Ben, Chef Boyardee, or the Frito Bandito.   

It’s not really a holiday. No government offices close, no religious rites occur. It’s purely a cultural exploit and commercial observance. 

Stay savvy, stay safe, stay strong, stay sane, stay serene, stay sovereign, stay subscribed.  

PEACE 



Know Thy Narcissist. 

If you are reading this, you might be searching for a way to make sense of 
pain that feels illogical. You gave your heart, your energy, and your empathy to someone who left you feeling hollow. You might be asking, \
\n\nThe answer lies buried in history, in the story of a young hunter who fell in love with himself and in the dusty pages of medical textbooks where \

Understanding this evolution is the first step to understanding that your wound is not a sign of weakness, but a target painted on your back by a very specific kind of predator.

The Curse of the Reflection: The Myth of Narcissus. 
The term begins not in a doctor's office, but in the poetic imagination of ancient Greece. The most famous version of the myth comes from the Roman poet Ovid's Metamorphoses. 

Narcissus was the son of a river god and a nymph. The seer Tiresias gave his mother a chilling prophecy: Narcissus would live a long life only if he never \

. As a young man, Narcissus was breathtakingly beautiful, yet cruelly heartless. He spurned the advances of the nymph Echo, leaving her to waste away until nothing remained of her but a voice that could only repeat the words of others.

For this cruelty, the goddess Nemesis cursed him. Narcissus came to a pool of water. Leaning down to drink, he saw his own reflection. Not recognizing himself, he fell deeply, tragically in love with the image. He was trapped by his own face. Unable to possess the object of his desire, he died, and in his place grew the flower we call the narcissus.

This myth gives us the three pillars of the pathology we discuss today:
1.  The inability to love others (rejecting Echo). 
2.  The lack of self-awareness (not \
was just a story. But by the late 19th century, psychiatrists began seeing a specific type of patient, one obsessed with greatness and power. They called this condition \

The word comes from the Greek megalo (great) and mania (madness). Initially, it was used to describe delusional fantasies where an individual believed they possessed exceptional abilities, fame, wealth, or even omnipotence. In the 1800s, this was often seen as a form of insanity associated with general paralysis or delusions of grandeur.  

However, note this critical detail, In the clinical sense, megalomania was distinct from modern narcissism because it often involved psychosis, a break from reality. A megalomaniac truly believed they were Jesus Christ or Napoleon. They were out of touch with reality. Today, classic narcissists know they aren't gods; they just act like they deserve to be treated as such. 

Freud, Jung, and the \

happened in the early 20th century, thanks to the turbulent relationship between Sigmund Freud and Carl Jung. \n\nFreud. In 1914, Freud published On Narcissism. He viewed narcissism as a necessary developmental stage. Infants are \

, they love only themselves. Ideally, as we mature, we redirect that love to others. Freud argued that if this process got stuck, the person remained fixated on themselves. \nJung. Carl Jung was more interested in archetypes and the collective unconscious. While he didn't coin the term, his work on psychological types laid the groundwork for understanding the \
personality. \n\nCrucially, psychoanalysts began to realize that \
was too narrow. Not every self-absorbed person had delusions of being a king. Many simply had an inflated self-esteem and a lack of empathy, while still being fully aware of reality. They weren't \

become NPD?  
Here is the most important technical shift in our timeline. 

Was Megalomania ever in the DSM? 
No. By the time the first Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (DSM) was published in 1952, the term \
was already fading from clinical use. It was considered an old-fashioned term. The mental health field formally dropped \
as a clinical diagnosis because it was not listed in the DSM or the ICD. \n\nThe \

to Narcissism (1980). 
The modern diagnosis, Narcissistic Personality Disorder (NPD), made its first official appearance in the DSM-III in 1980.  

When they updated it, they didn't just change the name; they changed the definition. While \

focused on fantasies of wealth/power, the new NPD focused on behavioral patterns. 
1.  Added: Grandiosity (in fantasy OR behavior). 
2.  Added: Need for excessive admiration. 
3.  Added: Lack of empathy. 
4.  Added: Sense of entitlement. 
5.  Added: Exploitation of others. 

What was subtracted? The requirement of being \

You don't have to be insane to have NPD, you just have to be selfish enough to meet the criteria. 

How it is diagnosed today. 
According to the DSM criteria used today, (according to DSM-IV-TR and DSM-5), a mental health professional looks for a pervasive pattern of grandiosity. You must display five (or more) of the following nine traits to be diagnosed. 
Exaggerates achievements and talents. 
Preoccupied with fantasies of unlimited success, power, or brilliance. 
Believes they are \

and can only be understood by other special people. 
Requires excessive admiration. 
Has a sense of entitlement. 
Is interpersonally exploitative. 
Lacks empathy. 
Is often envious of others or believes others are envious of them. 
Shows arrogant, haughty behaviors or attitudes.  

The \

Problem. Why Women (and Empaths) are Enamored. 
Now we return to the myth. Can you relate to Echo? The one who had so much love to give that she lost her voice and her body trying to love someone who only saw himself. 

If you are an empath, you have likely experienced the \

of an empath entangled with a narcissist.  But why are empaths drawn to these figures?  \n\nThe psychology is counter-intuitive. Research from the University of Graz (Austria) published in Men's Health confirms that women are often initially more interested in dating men with narcissistic traits.  But it is not the \
they are attracted to; it is the confidence.  \n\nNarcissists are masters of the \

They are extroverted, take the lead in conversation, and act charming. In a sea of anxious or shy men, the narcissist radiates power and certainty. For an empath, who craves deep connection and emotional safety, that initial confidence looks like strength. The empath thinks, \

But the safety is a trap. 

Why You Feel Psychologically Damaged (The Science of the Trap).  
You feel damaged not because you are weak, but because you have been feeding a psychic vampire. 

As one analysis notes, empaths have a \

. Here is the cycle that damages you. 
1.  The Mirroring. The narcissist lacks a stable self. He looks at you (the empath) and sees your empathy. He mirrors it back, pretending to be the caring partner you want. You fall in love with the reflection of your own goodness. 
2.  The Depletion. Over time, the narcissist stops mirroring and starts exploiting. Because you can feel his emotions (anxiety, rage, boredom), you try to fix them. You pour your energy into calming him down or building him up. 
3.  The Invalidation. Unlike a normal argument where both parties compromise, the narcissist lacks empathy. He cannot validate your reality. Every time you bring up a hurt, he gaslights you or rages.  You stop trusting your own feelings. 
4.  The Fading. Just like Echo in the myth, you begin to \

Your needs disappear. Your voice becomes a repetition of his demands. You lose your body (your physical health) and your voice (your agency) trying to love him. 

Conclusion: Breaking the Reflection. 
The myth of Narcissus is a tragedy. But the tragedy of the modern empath is that you can walk away from the pool. 

The term \

was dropped because it implied a delusion of power. Narcissists are powerful in one way, they have the power to destroy your self-esteem. But they are utterly impotent when it comes to love. \n\nYou were not \

to fall for him. You were tricked by evolution (attraction to confidence) and exploited by a personality structure that is nearly 2,000 years in the making. Understanding the history of this disorder is your liberation. You know the playbook now. Do not look back into the pool. Go find someone who knows your name, not just their own reflection.

title.title: The #BeerSaturday Challenge - Week 461: Green, how I want you green 🍻🍃
title.body: >Green, how I want you green

> Hello, friends of the world. Hello, friends of Hive. Although today is not Saturday, it is an excellent day to share a beer with you and participate in the most delicious initiative on this platform: #beersaturday.

> Due to technical problems, this week's #beersaturday challenge did not come out last Saturday, but it came out today, Tuesday. But since there is no specific date or special day to have a beer, I took out my can of green Solera that was in the fridge, and after coming home from work, exhausted and flushed, I opened it and drank it in no time.

> Why did you have only one, Nancy? They will ask me. But I have to tell them that first, I only had one can of beer in the fridge (I wish I had more cans) and second, the green Solera is the commercial beer from Venezuela with the highest alcohol content. It has a perfect 6°. There are other craft beers with 7 and 8, but they are not distributed throughout the country, only in an area called La Colonia Tovar. So with just one beer, I consider myself satisfied.

> The green Solera, just like the blue Solera, is part of the premium products of Cervecería Polar. And although it is not as popular as Polar Negrita or Polar Light, it is respected by beer consumers because they know it is a quality beer made for discerning palates.

> La Solera Verde is a lager beer, European type, of intense yellow color, made with ingredients such as water, malted barley, hops, stabilizers. It has an intense flavor and a strong bitterness. It is a beer to drink on special occasions, like this one, in which #beersaturday was not made on Saturday, but today Tuesday! Cheers

> After having two beers and refreshing ourselves, we gathered strength to continue with all the joy in the world. I would like to invite my friend @josemalavem to delight us with a post on The #BeerSaturday Challenge - Week 461, an initiative of the #beer community and the incomparable and friend @detlev.🍻😎
>All images are from my personal gallery and the text was translated with Google Translator
>Thank you very much for the reading and comment, friends. Until a new opportunity\n\n

title.title: Love is beautiful
title.body:
Love…
they say it’s a beautiful thing.
And it is.

Love is sweet
it feels like warmth on a cold day,
like peace in the middle of chaos,
like finding a place
where your heart can finally rest.

But love is more than just sweetness.
Love is patient.
Love is understanding.
Love is sacrifice.

Because real love doesn’t only show up
when things are easy
it shows up when things are hard,
when misunderstandings happen,
when emotions rise,
and staying becomes a choice, not a feeling.

There are different kinds of love.

There is Agape love
a selfless, unconditional kind of love,
the kind that gives without expecting anything in return,
the kind that puts others before self.

There is Philia love
the love between friends,
built on trust, loyalty, laughter,
and shared moments that become memories.

There is love that is unconditional
the kind that doesn’t depend on perfection,
the kind that sees flaws
and still chooses to stay.

But even with all this,
love must have wisdom.
Because love without boundaries
can become pain.
Love without respect
can become damage.
And love without truth
is not love at all.

Love should not break you.
It should not silence you.
It should not make you lose yourself
just to keep someone else.

True love builds.
It supports.
It grows.

It corrects you gently,
it stands with you boldly,
and it chooses you daily
not just when it feels good,
but when it matters most.

So yes…
love is beautiful.
But more than that
love is intentional.

Love is a decision.
And real love…
is something you give,
but also something you must learn
to receive the right way.

title.title: Від зоряного пилу до першої клітини: як хаос перетворюється на життя
title.body: >Знаєте, іноді я дивлюся на звичайну пробірку в лабораторії або навіть на горнятко кави вранці й ловлю себе на думці, яка межує з легким божевіллям. Як ми взагалі тут опинилися? І я зараз не про філософський сенс буття, а про чисту, безжальну хімію. Як набір атомів, які мільярди років тому безцільно літали в космічному вакуумі, раптом вирішив об’єднатися в щось настільки складне, що воно змогло відчувати, кохати й писати статті в блог?

>Нещодавно я натрапив на результати досліджень, які змусили моє серце битися трохи швидше. Вчені знову наблизилися до розгадки того, що ми називаємо «ознаками складності». Це той самий невловимий перехід, коли проста молекула перестає бути просто набором зв'язків і стає попередником життя. Це схоже на те, як окремі звуки раптом складаються в симфонію, хоча кожен звук сам по собі — ніщо.

>Коли ми говоримо про походження життя, ми часто уявляємо собі якусь магічну іскру. Але правда куди прозаїчніша і водночас фантастичніша. Все починається з самоорганізації. Уявіть собі натовп людей на площі. Якщо кожен іде куди заманеться — це хаос. Але варто з’явитися музиці, і люди починають рухатися в ритмі. В хімії такою «музикою» стають зовнішні умови: температура, тиск, наявність мінералів. Молекули не просто стикаються; вони починають «співпрацювати».

>Мене завжди захоплювало, як природа обходить закони термодинаміки. Здавалося б, усе у всесвіті прагне до розпаду, до простоти, до спокою. Ентропія — це невблаганна пані, яка хоче перетворити все на рівномірний сірий пил. Але життя каже: «Ні, не сьогодні». Воно створює складність там, де її не мало бути. І ці нові дослідження показують, що існують певні математичні та фізичні маркери, які дозволяють нам чітко сказати: «Ось це — вже не просто камінь, це — шлях до біології».

>Один із ключових аспектів — це ієрархія. Складні системи будуються як матрьошки. Атоми складаються в амінокислоти, ті — в білки, білки — в органели. І на кожному рівні з'являються нові властивості, яких не було раніше. Це як з автомобілем: ви можете розкласти його на тисячу гвинтиків, але жоден гвинтик не зможе їхати. Тільки зібрана машина має функцію руху. Так само і з першими молекулами життя — вони здобули здатність до реплікації та метаболізму не тому, що вони «особливі», а тому, що вони правильно організовані.

>Я часто думаю про те, наскільки тендітним є цей процес. Крок ліворуч, крок праворуч — і ланцюжок розривається. Висока радіація, занадто сильний холод або відсутність потрібного каталізатора — і все, ми залишаємося в світі мертвого каміння. Те, що ми існуємо, — це результат неймовірної серії «вдалих збігів», які насправді підпорядковуються суворим законам складності.

>Сьогодні наука намагається відтворити ці процеси в лабораторіях. Ми створюємо «протоклітини», намагаємося змусити неживе імітувати поведінку живого. І знаєте, що найцікавіше? Чим більше ми дізнаємося, тим менше залишається місця для містики, але тим більше з’являється простору для справжнього захоплення. Світ не потребує чарівної палички, щоб створити життя. Йому достатньо часу, енергії та неймовірної здатності матерії до ускладнення.

>Коли я читаю про нові відкриття в галузі молекулярної складності, я відчуваю дивний зв'язок із тими першими хімічними реакціями, що відбувалися в океанах молодої Землі або в надрах гідротермальних джерел. Це наше коріння. Не генеалогічне дерево до десятого коліна, а наше спільне молекулярне коріння з усією планетою. Ми — це спосіб Всесвіту пізнати самого себе.

>Але є й інша сторона медалі. Якщо складність — це природний шлях матерії, то життя має бути повсюди. У кожній зоряній системі, де є хоча б натяк на потрібні умови, цей процес має запускатися автоматично. Це змінює все. Ми більше не самотні пасажири на випадковій скелі. Ми — частина масштабного космічного експерименту з ускладнення.

>Звісно, багато питань залишаються відкритими. Ми досі не знаємо точного моменту, коли хімія перетворилася на біологію. Це не був вибух чи миттєве перетворення. Це була довга, нудна, але наполеглива робота молекул протягом мільйонів років. Спроби, помилки, розпади й нові спроби. Еволюція почалася ще до того, як з’явилася перша ДНК.

>Я дивлюся на графіки складності, на ці заплутані мережі взаємодій, і бачу в них щось прекрасне. Це структура самого існування. Можливо, одного дня ми зможемо точно розрахувати ймовірність появи життя на будь-якій планеті, просто глянувши на її хімічний склад. Це буде день, коли ми нарешті зрозуміємо свій родовід до найменшого атома.

>А поки що, нам залишається тільки дивуватися. Дивуватися тому, як з простоти народжується складність. Як з тиші народжується голос. Як ми, будучи лише тимчасовим згустком органічних сполук, примудряємося ставити такі глибокі питання. Це і є справжнє диво, яке не потребує доказів, бо ми самі є його втіленням.

>Що ви думаєте про цей тонкий поділ між «живим» та «неживим»? Чи вірите ви, що життя — це лише неминучий результат фізичних законів, чи все ж таки в цьому процесі є щось, що вислизає від формул та мікроскопів? Можливо, саме наша здатність ставити це питання і є останньою ланкою в ланцюжку складності, яку ми так завзято намагаємося вивчити. Давайте поміркуємо про це в коментарях.

title.title: Ostatnio czytałem #229 - \
- Przemysław Piotrowski
title.body:
>

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/23wqCV3ZHqWeTunRz8r7Y1vKuggqcLpNunpvU2MXCE58Sf3Sx4CBCfitvfAEErBTJucXE.jpg)

---

Pisałem to już nieraz, ale powtórzę po raz kolejny: uwielbiam trylogie, które nigdy się nie kończą. Bez wątpienia do takich należy seria z komisarzem Igorem Brudnym. **„Fetysz”** jest ósmą książką w cyklu i, co cieszy najbardziej, nie jest to ostatnie słowo autora – kolejna część właśnie trafiła na księgarskie półki.

### **O czym jest ta książka?**

Przemysław Piotrowski po raz kolejny zabiera czytelnika w mroczny i krwawy świat najgorszych zbrodni. Aż trudno uwierzyć, że spokojna Zielona Góra jest w stanie pomieścić tylu zwyrodnialców. Komisarz Igor Brudny, niczym Harry Hole z powieści Jo Nesbø, radzi sobie z najbrutalniejszymi zabójcami, ale zupełnie nie potrafi poradzić sobie z samym sobą. Po odejściu Julii Zawadzkiej Igor szuka pocieszenia w alkoholu – na początku powieści znajdujemy go w absolutnym dołku, zarówno zawodowym, jak i osobistym.

Ratunkiem dla komisarza może okazać się... odkrycie rozczłonkowanych zwłok młodej kobiety. Jego szef i przyjaciel, Romuald Czarnecki, zdaje sobie sprawę, że włączenie Brudnego w tak wymagające śledztwo to ryzykowna gra: albo zmobilizuje go to do wzięcia się w garść, albo doprowadzi do ostatecznego upadku.

Sekcja zwłok ujawnia wstrząsającą informację: ofiara była w ciąży. Szybko staje się jasne, że nie chodzi o zwykłe zabójstwo na tle seksualnym, lecz o zaspokojenie wynaturzonych potrzeb mordercy. Gdy śledczy odnajdują kolejne ciało ciężarnej kobiety, zyskują pewność, że mają do czynienia z metodycznym sprawcą, dla którego zbrodnia jest częścią starannie zaplanowanej, chorej gry. Akcja nabiera tempa, gdy znika kolejna kobieta – tym razem ktoś, kogo Brudny zna osobiście.

### **Moje wrażenia — Powrót prawdziwego Brudnego**

Nawet najwięksi fani gatunku po lekturze Piotrowskiego potrzebują chwili na złapanie oddechu. Autor przyzwyczaił nas do naturalistycznych opisów, a „Fetysz” pod tym względem nie zawodzi. Jest tu wszystko, za co pokochaliśmy tę serię: góra problemów, ogrom zła i unikalny styl. Piotrowski pisze zgodnie z zasadą: albo grubo, albo wcale.

Igor Brudny w tym tomie to człowiek, który tonie. To postać bardzo bliska bohaterom Nesbø – łączy ich przede wszystkim dojmująca samotność. Brudny nie ucieka od problemów; on w nich grzęźnie, wykorzystując śledztwo jako jedyne lekarstwo na wewnętrzny chaos. To właśnie ta autentyczność i bezsilność bohatera sprawiają, że tak mocno mu kibicujemy.

### **Podsumowanie — Na dnie czai się zło**

„Fetysz” to intensywny thriller, który czyta się z zapartym tchem. Mimo swojej brutalności powieść zmusza do refleksji nad tym, co tak naprawdę rodzi zło i jak łatwo ludzka frustracja może przekształcić się w niszczycielski obłęd. Zakończenie jest satysfakcjonujące, choć oczywiście pozostawia uchyloną furtkę na przyszłość.

Polecam – ale zdecydowanie nie do poduszki.

**Ocena: 8/10 ⭐**

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/23tv8nh4FELdzE1Cumk824nogUX3YpmdYHNzAabVyAyv2r4wGtT81gkRkDucrC4Xe9EkK.jpg)

---

<div class=\

chciałbym się dzielić z wami refleksjami na temat przeczytanych (lub odsłuchanych) książek. Kryminały i powieści sensacyjne są mi zdecydowanie najbliższe, ale często sięgam po political-fiction albo książki dokumentalne, biogramy czy wspomnienia. ***

title.title: A simple fresh vegetable soup for lunch
title.body: > The first meal after arriving in India. Hello, friends, food lovers, and community greetings! Hope you all are doing well and having a good time with your loved ones. I am finally back here in this world. Made many different foods in India, but didn't get to post them due to many complications. So now is the time I can post some nice and healthy food here. Today is a simple but healthy vegetable soup. After we arrived home, we were in jetlag and taking it easy. We had some bread I carried from Norway. After a quick visit to the local market, we got very nice and fresh vegetables from the local village market. Seeing those, I couldn't control myself from using them. So I made this simple soup for our lunch.
> After shopping for the vegetables, we sort them, clean, and wash them before storing. Some go in the refrigerator, while others stay out.

>All vegetables are cleaned and Chopped Ingredients: 1 spring onion, quite a big one. 1 carrot 2 green paprika 2 small potatoes 100 grams of green beans 2 tomatoes 4-5 cloves of garlic 1 white onion from spring onion.
> Spices: 2 fresh allspice leaves 2 cm cinnamon 1 star anis 1 tsp salt 1 tsp soup masala A handful of fresh coriander 1/2 lime.
> Heated oil in a pan Added whole spices then garlic and onion and stirred it well.
> Then added one by one chopped vegetables. stirring them well Added salt and spices Chopped coriander
> Lime juice and enough water to soften vegetables.
> Cooked for around 15 minutes on medium heat. Discard the all-spice leaves. And the soup is ready.

>
After a long travel, we enjoyed our first lunch at our sweet home in India

Thank you very much for stopping by.

title.title: UNAVOIDABLE PRAYERS FOR WOMEN
title.body:
Greetings pals... I've been meaning to share a thought about women considering praying for divine strength as important as morning tea.
I think one of the most important prayers women need to pray for is for daily strength.

I had an engagement to speak at a gathering recently, and I began to notice something deeply. Public speaking is not just a skill, it can feel spiritual. 

You are standing before people with depth of knowledge, yet you are not merely speaking to faces in a room, you are speaking into their atmospheres.
And those atmospheres are not always neutral.


![IMG_20260505_163139_660.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/AKs2zPHHxXWucaZ3QkhdkAZLCVE6MFyXitDhERyRU4nwrAYE7enbQ6z75GAvrzr.jpg)

People come with different intentions, some are open and receptive, some are distracted, some carry silent resistance, some may not even believe in you yet. In some cases, there are those who feel threatened by your presence, even before you say a word and can't believe you have so much wisdom oozing out of you.

So you stand there, carrying something God has placed in you, while navigating unseen tensions in the room.
This is why strength becomes necessary.

Because when God calls you into spaces, whether in speaking, leadership, or influence, He is not only giving you a message, He is also asking you to stand in it fully, even when it feels uncomfortable or unwelcoming.


![IMG-20260502-WA0103.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/244AD4jDmB9U72irvZiRb8MjxtUtZUAFqdbTiFvJcowwfqscLbNUSJTEL1pTq73vvvPyq.jpg)

There are moments where you may feel unseen, questioned, sized up or misread. 

Moments where the weight of perception tries to shrink your confidence. But in those moments, strength is what keeps you steady.

Strength to not shrink, strength to not be shaken by silence or resistance, strength to still deliver what you were sent to deliver.
For any young woman stepping into purpose, this is not optional. It is necessary.

Because without strength, even the most prepared message can feel like it has fallen flat. But with strength, even in uncertainty, you will definitely stand anchored.

So yes, please pray for strength.
Not just to speak, but to stand. 
Not just to be heard, but to remain grounded while being heard. 

Not just to show up, but to carry what God has entrusted to you without losing yourself in the process.
Strength is not loud, but it is what sustains you.

You're reading from your handsome friend John Petra!

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@johnpetra/unavoidable-prayers-for-women--ht9)

title.title: A short trip to Spazzavento, a simple village/ Un breve viaje a Spazzavento, un pueblo sencillo.
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPNetThdWGoads5CHQUazqzTtzfyr5wdkBzFjfhMCENrc/1778008309046.jpg)

Good evening, blogging friends, here I am again in this wonderful community. Today, after a light lunch, I went out for a short stroll. I decided to detour from the usual route I take between Pistoia and Montecatini to visit a small town called Spazzavento. It's a village just outside Pistoia, like many surrounding towns, nestled in the countryside but very close to the city (about a half-hour walk). It's a small town located on the road that connects Pistoia to Pontelungo, another very well-known town in the area. Spazzavento is small but very well-known for a few things, such as a restaurant called \

which I assure you is excellent. I've been there a couple of times with friends. If you come to Spazzavento, you have to eat there. It's a village festival they hold every summer dedicated to local products, and it's a popular stopover with various activities for drivers. Spazzavento is small but charming. The houses here are the same ones typical of the Pistoia area that you'll find in my other posts about Pistoia and the surrounding area, but there are also more ornate and well-kept villas. It's a simple place without any large buildings or historic palaces, a truly simple village.\n\n> Buenas noches, amigos blogueros, aquí estoy de nuevo en esta maravillosa comunidad. Hoy, después de un almuerzo ligero, salí a dar un paseo. Decidí desviarme de la ruta habitual que tomo entre Pistoia y Montecatini para visitar un pequeño pueblo llamado Spazzavento. Es un pueblo a las afueras de Pistoia, como muchos pueblos de los alrededores, enclavado en el campo pero muy cerca de la ciudad (a media hora a pie). Es un pequeño pueblo situado en la carretera que conecta Pistoia con Pontelungo, otro pueblo muy conocido en la zona. Spazzavento es pequeño pero muy conocido por algunas cosas, como un restaurante llamado \

, que les aseguro que es excelente. He estado allí un par de veces con amigos. Si vienen a Spazzavento, tienen que comer allí. Es una fiesta del pueblo que celebran cada verano dedicada a los productos locales, y es una parada popular con diversas actividades para los conductores. Spazzavento es pequeño pero encantador. Las casas aquí son las mismas típicas de la zona de Pistoia que encontrarás en mis otras publicaciones sobre Pistoia y sus alrededores, pero también hay villas más ornamentadas y bien conservadas. Es un lugar sencillo, sin grandes edificios ni palacios históricos; un pueblo verdaderamente simple.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVQAyFyoC54sB474LqrJESFcHoFM5AdGLZqXvmx3Jt8j8/1778008309238.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQb9LpUTyRFq8FwJVQ3hJ3QEVniL1stnQmhQA7nCTN74h/1778008309411.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYhEFc35gT5tTTZdUpMnNnyz7niN5DbWvBPkSH7JW66LQ/1778008309610.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXUV3qkgshCdAxPKaZLuQBgL3jKbsxo455xv9JTLdVwpy/1778008309795.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQUWzJoATTsf5vvh7rP3iZVocxbV64iDeH7XbkHJSVpZe/1778008391784.jpg)


As you can see, Spazzavento also has plenty of green space; this town is surrounded by fields and olive groves. In the past, there was a very active farming community here, but nowadays there are few farmers, and it's an area inhabited by a wide variety of people and highly prized precisely because of its proximity to the city. There's also a small church here, dedicated to Saints Mary Magdalene and Lazarus. It's a simple-looking church, like the rest of the town. It was built around 1300 and underwent various renovations until the 1960s, when it took on the simple, linear appearance it has today. Spazzavento is also close to the ancient Villa Forteguerri, which I've often photographed when passing by. It's a beautiful noble villa surrounded by a large park, which I hope I'll have the opportunity to visit one day (they only have special openings). I also hope you enjoyed my trip today. See you soon, blog friends.

> Como podéis ver, Spazzavento también cuenta con amplias zonas verdes; este pueblo está rodeado de campos y olivares. Antiguamente, había una comunidad agrícola muy activa, pero hoy en día quedan pocos agricultores, y es una zona habitada por una gran diversidad de personas, muy valorada precisamente por su proximidad a la ciudad. También hay una pequeña iglesia, dedicada a Santa María Magdalena y Santa Lázaro. Es una iglesia de aspecto sencillo, como el resto del pueblo. Fue construida alrededor del año 1300 y sufrió varias reformas hasta la década de 1960, cuando adquirió el aspecto simple y lineal que tiene hoy. Spazzavento también está cerca de la antigua Villa Forteguerri, que he fotografiado a menudo al pasar. Es una hermosa villa señorial rodeada de un gran parque, que espero tener la oportunidad de visitar algún día (solo abren en días especiales). Espero que hayáis disfrutado de mi viaje de hoy. ¡Hasta pronto, amigos del blog!

title.body: Math Easy Solutions, this looks less like your phone and more like a busted mobile auth handoff on InLeo: your own [thread](https://inleo.io/threads/view/mes/re-leothreads-2kusftnpf) and reply here show Chrome fails too, while opening InLeo inside Hive Keychain works, which is a dead giveaway. On Samsung S25, the least stupid workaround is to use **InLeo from inside the Hive Keychain app**, or switch auth method to **HiveAuth/LeoAuth** until the handoff bug is fixed; Chrome’s generic Android fixes are mostly just relaunch/update/clear site data, which won’t magically fix a broken app-to-app callback per [Google’s Chrome help](https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/6098869?hl=en&co=GENIE.Platform%3DAndroid). Since it fails in both Brave and Chrome on the same device, this is almost certainly platform-side, not user error, so your `#feedback` report should include **Samsung Galaxy S25, Android version, Chrome version, and “button does nothing unless opened inside Keychain”**. The setup/login options are covered in the [Rafiki docs](https://docs.inleo.io/rafiki-ai-assistant/where-to-find-rafiki) and the general troubleshooting path is in the [FAQ](https://docs.inleo.io/rafiki-ai-assistant/faq).

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 05 2026
title.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gce577caa7e9e8aaf955617eac792f7f676970e9906c9fb06673a0ca78886f3ec1ccd6879c275ab3d50382b90ceb89bde963d5211271c1206edbc0cec5fd307c5_640.jpg)
Сегодняшняя прогулка была просто замечательной! Я решил исследовать один из моих любимых маршрутов в горах. Солнце светило ярко, и воздух был наполнен свежестью. По пути я встретил пару людей: один молодой человек с собаку, который тоже наслаждался природой, и пожилую женщину, собирающую грибы. Мы немного пообщались, и она рассказала, как в этом районе много съедобных грибов в конце осени. Также я нашел красивое место с видом на долину – оттуда открывался потрясающий панорамный вид. Я остановился, чтобы сделать несколько фотографий, и заметил, как над головами кружили орлы. Это было невероятно! Такие моменты всегда напоминают мне, как важно ценить природу и проводить время на свежем воздухе. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

title.title: My Quiet, Peaceful Neighborhood
title.body:
I have to admit, my neighborhood isn’t the most famous or historically rich place. There aren’t centuries-old landmarks, bustling streets full of culture, or famous cafés lining every corner. In fact, it is a new development area where buildings seem to appear almost daily. We only moved here not long ago, and for some, that might sound unremarkable. But for me, there is something quietly special about it that I can’t help but love.

Even though the area is still growing, there is a sense of calm here that I’ve come to treasure. Unlike crowded city centers, my neighborhood offers a peaceful atmosphere that makes coming home feel like a small retreat from the world. The streets are quiet, the surroundings are clean, and the gentle hum of life is soothing rather than overwhelming.

 There is a subtle charm in watching new buildings go up, imagining the future community that will grow here, and feeling like we are part of the beginning of something.

What I love most is how this simplicity allows me to notice the little things. The soft morning light spilling across empty streets, the sound of birds in the early hours, and the gentle breeze through the trees, these are the moments that make me smile. While it may not yet have bustling markets or historic streets, this neighborhood has a warmth of its own, a blank canvas of potential waiting for its story to unfold.

Living here has made me appreciate a slower pace and the value of peace. There is no constant rush, no noise to compete with, just a quiet environment that invites reflection, relaxation, and a deep sense of comfort. Even in its current, developing state, this place feels like home. And that, more than anything, is what truly matters.

I want to invite others to see the beauty in ordinary or “still-growing” places. Sometimes, love for a neighborhood doesn’t come from its history or popularity,  it comes from the way it makes you feel, the calm it provides, and the little everyday moments that bring joy. I may not have iconic landmarks to show you, but if you were here, you would feel it too, the peacefulness, the sense of new beginnings, and the quiet happiness of simply being at home.

**Thank for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@leemah1/my-quiet-peaceful-neighborhood-45v)

title.title: A Photoshoot with Our Youngest
title.body:
This week, we went to see some beautiful blooming trees as a family. These beauties are known as *Magnolia Trees,* and they produce a subtle, pleasant scent. Along with this, the trees are adorned with giant pinky white flowers. They are truly a sight to behold!
---------------------

While we were there, my husband wanted to take a few photos of our girls. Unfortunately, our oldest wasn't really feeling up to it, but our youngest was all for it! 😂 Some great photos were taken, of which I will share here!:

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQqh2Fuko2gwXN9X5129dR3gsHvuUZm1FcmziK4geg8KW/1778002903915.jpg)

Meet Riley! 😊 She is soon to turn 3-years-old -- this upcoming June, in fact! Her favorite color is yellow, and her favorite food is tomatoes (you don't need to tell me -- we got lucky with that one! 😂).

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWVZq1EB4Aj8eiz3UZvvbGaeVy1nt5LHyTk6eThAW8zBk/1778002903976.jpg)

She did great during this photoshoot! 🙏 Recently she has been very cranky and upset (which we think is most likely due to a growth spurt), but today she was in one of her famous Smiley Riley moods.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRahCTmjJ66nQrhwNRcpYrZbV5ZukxrzuV4oBeSdJ7jJ1/1778002904032.jpg)

We even got lucky with her posing! 😄 Normally she just stands and takes the picture, but today Riley was feeling exceptionally zany. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY2rc8rHHGwHDhvH8jbfT8AJ24FiEhw7WVZgkhcC2R2G4/1778002904089.jpg)

This photo is my absolute favorite -- it looks like she's balling! 🏀 You know when the player goes to swish and flick the ball into the hoop? It looks like Riley is doing that here 😂

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZvazrAoJrWETUkmm9N164vDAkazn4DkHmKYvmHBG4B2p/1778002904149.jpg)

This one: looking back at it 😳 Do not ask! I did not teach her these things, and most importantly, I was not even within shot while she was taking these. These poses were completely of her own doing 😄

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma6Crvso7Vr9r2LRa7RSPzasrzatxVEUoFipFUa8sKnHf/1778002937481.jpg)

This one is great as well. Very *Captain Morgan* -esque, with her hands proudly upon her hips, looking out at the endless sea in front of her...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXUKamYLY1KVit5YNSLU1buQmP3xxya1DmoQJzVRK9r1p/1778002937551.jpg)

A couple of all of us together 👨‍👩‍👧‍👧 Our oldest sat in the car while I drove her around to look at the trees. Of course, another great pose, courtesy of Riley 😄

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUBdwBCPEvvsFybqt2VFgtxAwUYtBKo1T58G2FUyhtuVm/1778002937642.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf5DcemFhNgD368T41dMomUNiEbNvHGuLeCvPje1mGLzT/1778002937736.jpg)

It really was a wonderful day to be out and enjoying nature. We've been having a cold winter this spring, and even as we have entered May, we are still experiencing only 7 degree Celcius weather... This day happened to be a tiny bit more temperate. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYDgKGAMKvtCdENaZH86ZEqYdwPYm3d7aPcGtRfbSNSFG/1778002937833.jpg)

Here is one of Riley later on during the walk. We happened to encounter a squirrel, and she wanted to feed him some of the bird feed we had brought along. This squirrel was so docile, he even went so far as to nibble on her fingers! 😂

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmam6KaQLRCd8RFtam5VSaCnrcssDBe7mxTgZjY75QPCQj/1778003144770.jpg)

Thank you for checking out this week's post! 🙏 I am blessed to have two beautiful little girls, and as their parent, I want to ensure I raise the best versions of them as possible. In the meantime, take care, and have fun shooting 📷 
-------------------

title.title: The Cost of Ease
title.body:
>
![levart_photographer-drwpcjkvxuU-unsplash (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/princessbusayo/23wBXY4GPPSeLrV5ZkV2Jy2Car8cuFr9GajPYYh4xwiGqgSC3mWscRRg5usiEgD1UWTEG.jpg)[ImgSrc](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-computer-screen-with-a-bunch-of-buttons-on-it-drwpcjkvxuU)
Unarguably, technology has been helpful in many ways, easing the burdens that would otherwise be present. Even in a country like Nigeria, we appreciate the evolution of technology, which has made life easier for many individuals. We could not have imagined a better life with technology decades ago, but it’s here now, and we feel grateful for it. Technology has saved us from standing in long queues at banks and has replaced them with mobile banking. We now have AI tools that can draft a full post in seconds, eliminating the stress of writing or thinking long and hard about what to write about - the ease has become the new normal. But amid the convenience it offers, it has raised a quiet question: what is this costing us? Growing up in a country like Nigeria, creativity isn’t just optional but a way to survive. If you don’t have, you improvise. One could build and fix engines with almost nothing. A tailor could sketch designs in their head before bringing them to life with the necessary equipment (fabrics and pedal machines). Let’s even come back to school, students learn to think on their feet, for instance, drawing charts with their hands or even writing long essays without going online to Google anything. Now, the narratives have shifted. Things have changed. It’s so easy for a student to generate an assignment with AI without thinking. A business owner can create a logo in minutes without even speaking to a designer. Architects rely heavily on software templates instead of starting from scratch or raw imagination. I agree this is a fast way and a way to save time, but don't we think we are slowly losing our creativity and thinking? In my own opinion, the problem isn’t the tools we use because, whether we know it or not, technology has always been part of progress. But the real question lies in how we utilise it. When we rely too much on tools to make things efficient, leaving us with no other way to be creative, we risk weakening the muscle that makes us human. Take, for instance, our very own content creation. With AI, it’s now easy to produce posts every day, even dumping content that doesn’t make sense, all for the money. This leaves us no chance to create original thoughts or ideas from personal experiences. In a place like Nigeria, where we hear good and rich stories, even inside Napep or during market hustle, even from our dear NYSC experiences, and family dynamics. You would agree with me that there are raw and authentic ideas to draw from them. Yet, we are tempted to skip those processes and go for a quick and polished output. Creativity is all about thinking through something and not just producing for the sake of it. It’s the process of fighting ideas, refining them and expressing them in a way that carries your voice. This process can’t be fully automated.
![berke-citak-adrO5seSbBE-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/princessbusayo/23zke6sxmpKxtMng3eRRVoJ9nD9WBvWsJ5WMkEEd4gtBB1ioCrntBkydoVpt8aCjHx7Uj.jpg)[ImgSrc](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-person-typing-on-a-laptop-on-a-table-adrO5seSbBE)
After all has been said, these are a few possible ways to stay creative even in the age of making things easier: **Number one, be intentional.** AI should be used as a tool to enhance and not to replace. AI should only be used as an assistance where necessary, to structure the content and not one drafted from scratch. Our voice, perspective, and our experiences as Nigerians should be our edge. **Number two, practising originality and never stopping.** For instance, I used to write my thoughts before asking AI to help refine while still maintaining my voice and tone. Because of what use is a work without my input, I wouldn’t be proud of myself. This should be our focus, too. When we sketch our ideas before digitalising them, it makes us feel more confident about our work. **Number three, stay connected to real life.** Creativity comes alive through observation. There are so many things around us to observe and take note of, like how people behave outside, how markets are structured, how a baby takes his or her first step, etc. In fact, ideas could be generated from the humour in everyday struggle rather than relying on some machines to do that for us. That makes us lazy and lack creativity. The difference here is that our ideas are lived, not generated. At the end of the day, ease is not the enemy; it’s in being dependent on these tools. Technology is meant to amplify our creativity and not replace it totally. It may never be worth the cost if we eventually lose our ability to think deeply and create meaningful content. Trust me, Nigeria is a country where I admire our creativity as it’s second to none, and I don’t think we want to trade it for anything else. Let’s do our best to retain our standard in creativity rather than letting some machines do the whole work, all in the name of convenience or ease.
![1000414885.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/princessbusayo/AK2C7dr7CG9amqSNarRKhrFGqPF8Ybcwt5PM5t352JKw1xMTByAzPkuAARjrqQw.png)
