title.title: Sell In May?
title.body:
So, let’s get straight to the point, because May has just started and the same discussion is already heating up. On one hand, last Friday the S&P 500 closed at 7,230 points and the Nasdaq hit a new all-time high at 25,114. On the other hand, everywhere you look you hear the same phrase: “Sell in May and go away.” Sell now, go enjoy your vacation, come back in September.

And every year, thousands of investors fall into this trap. This year, with markets at record highs and geopolitics in full swing, the temptation is even stronger.

---

### WHERE THIS STORY CAME FROM

“Sell in May and go away.” It sounds like ancient investing wisdom. In reality, it has British roots, from the time when bankers in London would leave for summer holidays and the market would go into “sleep mode” until September.

Put simply, the logic was this: fewer participants in the market = lower volume = weaker returns. So, exit in May and re-enter in autumn.

Does it sound logical? Maybe. Back then. Today, markets operate almost nonstop, with algorithms, automated systems, and trillions flowing through ETFs that buy continuously. The seasonality that existed back then has mostly disappeared.

“So why are we still talking about it?”

---

### WHAT THE NUMBERS SAY

This is where things get even more interesting.

JPMorgan analyzed the data from the past decade. What did they find? The S&P 500 returns on average +1.5% in May. +1.9% in June. And now pay attention. +3.4% in July.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSGdatybJVjcx6kAezBo9HdEeytAhjKbLd9TEUruhaqeY/image.png)


What does that mean? That anyone who sold in May to avoid the “summer slowdown”... missed three of the most profitable months of the year.

But there’s more. Deutsche Bank ran the same analysis for Europe, using the STOXX Europe 600. In 25 out of the 39 years examined, the “sell in May” strategy failed. Simply holding your positions without doing anything would have delivered better returns.

And here comes the statement that sums it all up. Paul Ciana, head technical analyst at Bank of America, said that “this year will once again disprove the theory.”

---

### ARE THERE REASONS TO WORRY?

The truth is, there is a big “but” in all of this.

Because this year there are some factors that justify concern. Let’s go through them.

First. The CAPE ratio, the metric that measures whether stocks are expensive relative to earnings, is around 39.42. What does that mean? That we are at levels seen only three times in history: during the Dot-Com bubble, the 2008–2009 crisis, and the pandemic.

Second. Margin debt, meaning borrowed money used by investors to buy stocks, is at historical highs.

And third. Goldman Sachs issued a warning. They clearly stated that the number one risk for the U.S. economy right now is a correction in equities.

So yes, there are valid concerns. But does anyone know when a correction will happen? No. And that’s the whole point.

---

### MARKET TIMING IS A LOSING GAME

Let’s say you decide to follow “sell in May.” Fine. You sell. You take your money and sit on the sidelines. Now what? When do you get back in?

That’s the question no one ever answers. Because market timing isn’t one decision. It’s two. When you exit and when you re-enter. And you need to get both right to come out ahead.

Is that possible? Maybe once or twice. But every year, for 30 or 40 years? It’s not. The data is crystal clear.

If you had sold last May expecting a correction, you would have missed an entire upward move. And now you’d be staring at the Nasdaq at 25,000 points asking, “when will it finally drop so I can get back in?”

title.title: My work place
title.body:
I noticed something interesting about one of my male colleagues.

Our office closes around 4:30–5:00 p.m., and once you’re done with your work, you’re free to head home. Simple.

But this guy? He never leaves.

Every single day at closing hour, you’ll still find him glued to his desk like his chair is paying rent.

Meanwhile, me? I’m usually among the first people to disappear once it’s time. No stress.

So this evening, the moment it hit 4:30, I packed my bag at lightning speed and headed straight for the door.

Just as I got there, I heard HR knock on his office door and ask,“Are you staying back today?”

He replied calmly, “Yes.”

Then HR asked, “What will you be having? Rice or swallow?”

Excuse me… what??

Since when did our office start serving food??

I quietly turned back, walked to my seat like nothing happened, and gently reopened my laptop.

Suddenly, I too had “work.”

Not long after, everyone else left. It was just me, that man, and HR remaining.

Around 5:30 p.m., a food vendor walked in carrying food… one for HR… and another for that man.

Ahhh!

As she was leaving, I quickly opened my door on purpose.

She spotted me and said, “Nne, you’re still around?”

I replied, “Yes oo, I still have some work to finish.”

HR heard my voice and called out,“Chinecherem, you’re still here?”

I said yes, I had some things to clear.

He said, “That’s good. At least you won’t go home late and start cooking. Tell her what you want.”

Ehhhhhh!!!

I nearly screamed—but I composed myself.

“I’ll have jollof rice, ma,” I said with dignity.

Five minutes later… hot jollof rice landed on my table like a blessing from above.

The joy I felt? Unexplainable.

I didn’t waste a single second.

After eating, I just sat quietly in my office, waiting for the perfect time to leave—so it wouldn’t look like I stayed back because of food. (God forbid.)

Soon, they locked up their offices and we all stepped out together.

As we were leaving, that my colleague looked at me and said,“So you stayed back today? Unlike you that always rush home?”

I smiled calmly. “I had some work to clear.”

He nodded… then asked,“So tomorrow you’ll go early since you’ve finished everything?”

I said, “Hmm… not really. From this month, once I’m done, I’ll start staying back to cross-check everything.”

He paused, looked at me, and said,“Don’t you think that’s stressful? You should be going home early.”

I said, “No, I just want to be more dedicated this month.”

The way he looked at me after that… he knew.

But he said nothing.

title.title: Graffiti Book
title.body:
>It had been quite a while since I last picked up a pencil to draw, and today, while I was waiting at the office for confirmation of a new job, I made this drawing.

\n\n

>Greetings to all my friends who are part of the blockchain community in general, but especially to all the artists who share their work with us and to those outstanding artists who, over time, have demonstrated constant growth and development in the world of blockchain. Allow me to share this drawing and a few words with you.

‎ Sketch. -------

>As you well know, my passion for art is heavily focused on graffiti and street art in general—everything that encompasses hip-hop culture and the movement, whether it’s artistic or moralistic graffiti, gang graffiti, and the emotions behind every signature made with a marker or spray paint, just as every trick landed on a skateboard—you have to practice skateboarding—is closely tied to these kinds of emotions.

‎

>The drawing presented today is a graffiti piece featuring my name or my graffiti artist nickname, which is used on various platforms, one of which is here on HIVE, FONE—four letters that have made the rounds throughout the whole town and have become known in other states here in the country. Little by little, it has been gaining not only popularity but also that respect and recognition that means so much to many of us. I know there is graffiti of a very high caliber, yet it is quite satisfying to know and see that my work also receives its share of recognition in this world in general.

‎

>Here, using two crayon colors, I began to shape these letters with these soft tones, then applied an outline with a red pen to solidify the contours and surroundings. Yes, the graffiti I’ve been presenting lately has been quite basic and used very few colors—all of this is due to the financial constraints I’m facing. However, as I emphasize in each of my posts when I share my own graffiti , sometimes there’s something that pushes us a little further than simply creating a piece that stands out; sometimes we just need to satisfy that creative or constructive need to start a sketch and finish a piece. And even if this piece is missing some elements—like colors, etc.—never compromise on style, personality, or energy.

‎ * Here I’m sharing a photo of my complete sketchbook ‎ ‎ **And here, at the end of this post, I’m sharing my latest graffiti piece, which, as I mentioned before, is very sparse in color but rich in emotions and feelings.**

title.title: Founding a Future.
title.body: > After defeating a group of bandits upon landing, Sigurd and Eivor secured a longhouse and rescued two merchant hostages. The clan began constructing their new home, leading to a cinematic moment where Eivor assisted Randvi with the settlement map. Finally, the group officially named their new village Ravensthorpe. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYgwBwvk6NyQcCMfKYViDbajFSUR6r1zu5iHztT6i89hM/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdzY5UuydrpLEs9uufMCRsLNWVv4rJ32mw5jv6gyYJJhv/screenshot_2_.png) Sigurd tried to play along with the bandit leader to see their true intentions after getting off the longship, but they threatened the Norsemen with a play of swords and expected us to cower. They did not realize who they were dealing with. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdJJr59Uobw9DHJbz3ogPR3BuujmPkWFHvXUkDwrzuQ53/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVxjHNVGuUVpBC7G5KracKtEogvNDM7kAXXjRiRGut9G5/screenshot_4_.png) Not just me, but every Norseman around us were thirsty for blood, and it had been eight days without a drop of blood to their access during the long voyage. So we started quenching our thirst by engaging the bandits in a fierce melee right on the riverbank. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUbdSrE7HF64y4EVCvyMrstqRbDa1gChvpWfgqYgcg7ME/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaF4tzzkCm6eZydNDYsyJo9BrAU1ALUhSPFh7z3pyU8RC/screenshot_6_.png) I noticed the Norsemen were better off without me because of their sheer strength and skill, but I still supported them in taking down those bandits. We worked with a brutal efficiency that left the bandit group scattered and broken in a matter of seconds. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRKgTcHSA9HLUitoeEqcyZpCYfMHyDDiz8WKu359zfFCz/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbjgFv4wh8Pdf4TPnpavo4qpwAJxhhBuHnNEg8LPbDDCx/screenshot_8_.png) After getting rid of the bandits, Sigurd asked everyone to look around the perimeter as he didn't want any more surprises lurking in the shadows. And there was a large longhouse that Eivor decided to check personally, sensing that scavengers might still be hiding in the remains of the longhouse. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVXqtUiiDX8xBDcg8d8mnzqMowgZSFsuAACHG9hiT9CaA/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNVXQT5Jq75UcakBymwUTcATxPkKjp2H6pq8Q5CfzWr7h/screenshot_10_.png) I heard a lady talking from the longhouse, her voice muffled by the thick wooden walls. I moved toward the entrance, but I noticed there was a noise trap at the entrance made of hanging bones and metal scraps. I had to step carefully to avoid alerting whoever was inside. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaUfcvuNvnubG1rDGXPF5P84AiKNfwgXPQDSRLE8EMZXo/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbTa8MidFavxwk47VagjoJdiJzamW3xEKu2oZ4zX86Ynm/screenshot_12_.png) After getting inside that longhouse, we found two hostages, and a lady named Yanli talked boldly, thinking we were the ones who had taken them hostage. But Sigurd convinced them they were the good guys and untied them from their bonds. They decided to help the Norsemen building this place, mentioning they were merchants who had been traveling through the region before being captured. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd16KQdcRPQQf96s9KcPLZS4rXQLs9dk24P7JDzRak8o4/screenshot_13_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUJyzsCQbMJgBqoCxhMtZVqasRKSRWrqUWTPy87QdyfRx/screenshot_14_.png) After the chapter concluded, Eivor and Sigurd went outside to welcome the rest of their clan, who were left behind on the ships until the area was secured. The sight of the families and warriors stepping onto the shore brought a sense of relief to the camp. They were no longer just a war band; they were a community ready to build something lasting. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZZSY8zN8P8yJfCzstXezohBoz9dRRxp4tJUMw1ARdv6v/screenshot_15_.png) The Norsemen started building their home, hammering away at the new foundations while the cinematic part showed Randvi carrying some scrolls to the longship. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNiTjdNsExVnSQJBppVECqVnqJdbq18spTN8sAjThnVTi/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU5dhBKv9c3cXW4h8T9bZ6qBLnXhELJzp4b9tpdZusPL2/screenshot_17_.png) When she was checking on a map laid out on a table, she realized there was daylight suddenly showered on her from above. She looked up with a small smile, curious about who was letting the sun into the room. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbajx7Lq1KnHoPHXAYPWpBX1xW9xKZHCosWJ2EJc8KgxZ/screenshot_18_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUr24xgEPfNTv6mFAoSPSsixPoHLoNJohVqo1McbuVY87/screenshot_19_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeqKXuxhMprcQW2Vx6n2uPd3HNYYuk4qncrkWCXMPHUFu/screenshot_20_.png) She looked up and noticed it was no other than Eivor who was working on the roof of the longship, removing old boards to let the light in. It was a rare moment of peace amidst the labor of establishing a new settlement in a foreign land. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZXJVwmpRTsBNh5wcav1PVtjHAv3YDV8HYq14tk9c6QmS/screenshot_21_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVxDxuotGxHUa6enFkVDghFL116GAhjpt6WQH9xVFZsuM/screenshot_22_.png) Then Eivor and Sigurd met Randvi to discuss the future of the clan's territory. Sigurd mentioned that their place was currently unnamed and they couldn't let that stand if they wanted to be respected. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmctpYryjzTAcrFHWoGoqfh8ZpceDUoub5rUGUNkMQ5ebm/screenshot_23_.png) After Sigurd asked what they would call this place, Eivor stared on the map and said it could be named Ravensthorpe, the village of ravens, and the rest liked it. That's all for now. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=coooldude/6cf4a77c)

title.title: The Burden of Knowing: Why Some Truths Are Better Left Unknown
title.body:
Death is a constant reality that each and every individual, including animals, experiences at one point in time or another. Like we all know death is inevitable, and it's said that no one knows the actual time or ways anyone will die, and that's why many are advised to live a good life, make hay while the sun shines, so that they won't end up regretting how they spent their lives before death comes into the picture. But then in the event that we have a device that can show when and how each individual will die, would I be willing to have or use such devices? Below I'll state my take and the reason behind it. ![1000583640.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/242NghtaQPXUFUL7zW6u4TRXqUVLjmkhm2dUeK15JiPgWHYbyoxim7drkaafBRnuWwk2Z.jpg) Do I want to know my time of death or that of those around me? And if I knew it, what would be its benefits to me? Based on my response to the later questions, what could possibly be the benefits of knowing my time of death? The only benefit I can think of is the fact that it can help me take swift action in doing things I'd love to do before I die and probably put some things in place so that my family won't have to go through struggles when I'm gone. But then will I want to know when I'll die? The response is a resounding NO. Why is that? Because death is a mystery; it can meet one at any point in time, and I wouldn't want a situation whereby I've such a device and check my time of death, and after that, I end up going through depression and anxiety that comes from knowing when I'll die. My life might become a shadow of itself because I might end up living worried rather than live a simple life that comes from the place of not knowing when I'll die. Knowing my time of death might be a curse in disguise, and so for that reason I'm not interested. Even though it's more or less an avenue to make money if I have such devices and can check and tell people when they'll die, I know a lot of people will be willing to pay just to get that information. But why I'm still not going to get the device and delve into such business is because there's no way I'll have such devices and not be tempted to use them to see my own time of death, and that's why it's a no-no for me. *** All photos are mine. ***
Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@vickoly/the-burden-of-knowing-why-some-truths-are-better-left-unknown-9s2)

title.body: A small suggestion for the future: if you want faster access to liquidity, it helps to move funds from SWAP.HIVE back to the Layer 1 side (HIVE/HBD). From there, Magi can offer more flexibility for transfers and interactions, as long as you have enough RC. Hive Engine has its own role, but [Magi ](https://peakd.com/@magi.network)is opening more possibilities over time — it might fit better with what you’re trying to do.

title.title: This were the HIVE OPEN DAYS IN ALICANTE 30.04 - 03.05.2026 [GER/ENG] ✌️✌️✌️
title.body:
![IMG_4267.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23u6BKghCgc1x4GnRFt8fmDWqdcY6oMgKrvEGVSZXu583ttk6gyvyVr4rjBCC6vEzQya1.jpeg)

Das waren die **HIVE OPEN DAYS in ALICANTE** und ehrlich, ich war geflasht hoch tausend. Eigentlich sind die HOD schon vorbei, aber ich sitze immer noch in Alicante und habe so gar keinen Schimmer, wohin es als Nächstes geht. Zumindest habe ich mal ein Zimmer für heute eingecheckt – das ist schon mal gut so ;-) 

Aktuell genieße ich einen guten Cappuccino, eine Bowl und das WLAN in einem netten kleinen Café, empfohlen von @ninaeatshere.


![IMG_4957.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23xVPmFzrC3c5FzTJHfaovyaFwj9A8CrhJtnWRwbccG4xacyhsvoqL4e7p2v9eitn4U8U.jpeg)


![IMG_4956.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/241tfncQiZH21i3H3eWVgDjzTaCda8y93mcM34sXdzUtsXULbPsUanvnRtbMcJ8iBeZVS.jpeg)
@ninaeatshere 

![IMG_4958.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23zS3T365cyUr2gN56JQ5ghiekWCifDjMWEGSopqzyqdaav2N8sjLg5CVU9Dmy2jgz1oW.jpeg)




... der Blogpost, der länger dauerte ... Aktuell sitze ich beim Kaffee und warte auf das „BlaBla“ am Flughafen in Sevilla ...

**HIVE OPEN DAYS – was für ein Event?!**



![IMG_4303.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23xen7sQ1ms6ic4TN2TyDwQgcb7VSvwC9CiAn5yt8w6pNVQPqYsSoJhVTPuQDCjmYkB4d.jpeg)




Danke an @tibfox, @ninaeatshere, @ph1102 und all die Sprecher @alessandrawhite, @palomap3 und @livinguktaiwan. 



Es war wirklich interessant! Das Wochenende war ganz nach meinem Geschmack und im Vergleich zu den HIVE MEETUPS in Wien eine wahre „Völlerei“. Unglaublich, was hier für einmalig 20 HBD auf die Beine gestellt wurde: Top Location, super Präsentationen und Essen ohne Ende. Ganz zu schweigen von der Bootsfahrt nach Tabarca, dem Essen dort und dem Spaß an der ganzen Sache. Die Preise waren sowohl für alte Hasen als auch für Newbies ein Traum – für mich eine weitere Erfahrung, die ich nicht missen möchte.

Was mich wirklich gewundert hat: Dass doch einige Neue über die Meetup.com-App zum Event kamen und direkt onboarded wurden. So, jetzt seid ihr „Neuen“ dran – ich freue mich auf eure Posts!



![IMG_4866.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23rz6XKqQM9SGWFLT25KWcB1fMMhkh12R4ruTb3BBd8pB1cv3Ux3LMSfNKTjxDb5eUuj6.jpeg)
@alicante from Santa Barbara


Von Chiclana nach Sevilla, nach Alicante und wieder retour. Eine Nacht verlängert, nette Leute getroffen, einen super Abend mit dem Rockstar @anamz aus Venezuela gehabt, Wein getrunken und das Flair Spaniens genossen.



![IMG_4124.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23zvBDZYMssammvqTF8n24G4wgELn4MQ66gR8FU5oGWszQuQ2q4QDv7XoMCcyXzYfif8C.jpeg)




Die #HOD waren weit mehr als nur ein Community-Event. Ich habe viel für die Meetups in Wien mitgenommen, habe mit einigen alten und neuen Hasen gesprochen und will dort nun einiges verändern. Auch @godfish, ein alter Bekannter der Wiener Meetups aus Prag, hat mir gute Inputs gegeben. 



![IMG_4787.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23z7MzmCEKSG7VVaF3cJVpVPfrBJXQ3RmZFiMCPp1wGHAo76yNsJpdf83ZTWDPWUZBiMv.jpeg)




Einfach cool zu sehen, wie die HIVE-Community im „kleinen Kreise“ solche Events pusht, auf die Beine stellt und wir mit so viel Spaß dabei sein dürfen. 



![IMG_5031.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23ywqCTqrkjchVFtBKt6MUhr6AFzL9EPwE5SQwhBaFvn5BwHw4zAUmU8EMoDUmcvMT9Jz.jpeg)
@alicante pic by @anamz 

Kennst du das? Die einen sagen dies, die anderen das und irgendwie denkst du dir nur: ???. Ich habe gelernt, mir selbst eine Meinung zu bilden, und dafür bin ich mehr als dankbar. Denn das Wochenende war – inklusive des „4 Jahre Baccarat Entertainment Geburtstagscalls“ – der Wahnsinn. Der eine oder andere weiß ja, dass ich von Montag bis Freitag online nur Gewinne mitnehme. Eine Geschichte, die fast zu gut klingt, um wahr zu sein, und dennoch mache ich es. Das eine schließt das andere definitiv nicht aus und somit ist alles *perfectoooo* ...



![IMG_4223.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/242Y7m3NAD5khgz5rWTzNfoPbJq98Cso9zyYW7huSYHATva4dTEP7qdMgX7FR1Urnp791.jpeg)
*Reisen, Bloggen, online Geld verdienen und Spaß im Leben haben.*





Dankbar, mir selbst ein Bild von dem Event gemacht zu haben. Natürlich habe ich auch mit HIVERinnen, unter anderem mit @ninaeatshere, @alessandrawhite und @tibfox, kritische Punkte der Community und HIVE angesprochen, über Ideen geplaudert und interessante Gespräche geführt.


![IMG_4245.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23wgPfWmbQSFiEFSZfnJ8Kmjdhpv1oWTdfJsJhjgAQtbaHwPq6P9FfkoBsZLJC5CH8SYv.jpeg)
@haastrecht , @reiseamateur , @schmidi ME bei der Ankunft





Eines habe ich im Leben lernen dürfen: *Du darfst nie von anderen etwas erwarten, wenn du selbst nicht bereit bist, den Weg zu gehen oder etwas zu verändern.*


![IMG_4518.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23uQtsVTLigB7f3F5qN7FkgjqjVcxRt8NxTLoDLd54GaHNafgAgctQvTT4bU1qx5w8Rrs.jpeg)
*Afterwork chillout bevor dinner @amkaye , @palomap3 . @haastrecht , @ph1102 , and ???*


Was ich dieses Wochenende auch erleben durfte: Web2 ist Web2 – und wenn du Neider hast oder nicht ins System passt, dann ist dein Account weg und geblockt. Ist mir gerade auf Instagram passiert.

**Warum erwähne ich das hier?**


![IMG_4442.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23yTfQPcrQbQReDhwnpvXQ6M3u9a7Dc5C1A2bqakWcyiPpRkkBGCcWnbeNHh7fRwymA96.jpeg)
*@reiseamateur and ??? (please help)*




HIVE ist HIVE – dezentral, Web3 und im besten Falle auch in 50 Jahren noch da. Für mich ist die Blockchain wie ein Tagebuch, ein Erlebnisbuch, in dem ich meine Learnings, Erlebnisse, Reisen, aber auch Tipps teile. Es macht Spaß, das später selbst nachzulesen.

**So, nun zum Event selbst ✌️:**

Donnerstag, der 30.04., war Onboarding: Programm durchgehen, besprechen und – wie könnte es anders sein – Essen. Ein kleines Warm-up mit Megabuffet, von dem locker noch 10 Leute mehr hätten satt werden können.

Wie auch immer, es war cool zu sehen, wie viele Leute die Reise auf sich nahmen und sogar mit dem Camper anreisten. @haastrecht war am Anfang irgendwie „na ja“, aber ganz ehrlich: Über das Wochenende entwickelte sich eine Freundschaft. Freitag war dann das Main-Event im Ulab – wohl eine der besten Locations für so ein Event. Besonders gefallen hat mir der Vortrag von @livinguktaiwan über die Communities auf HIVE. Aber auch @tibfox hat mich überzeugt, mich in Zukunft mehr mit @threespeak zu beschäftigen. @palomap3 habe ich leider nicht ganz verstanden, da der Vortrag auf Spanisch war und ich den Übersetzungsmonitor nicht sehen konnte. Im Grunde waren aber alle gut und es tat wirklich gut, das alles einmal LIVE zu erleben. Von „Online to Offline“ – es ist einfach lässig, die Menschen auch mal „in echt“ zu sehen.

Liebe HIVE-Community, eine Community lebt von der Gemeinschaft. Mir ist klar, dass nicht jeder das Geld hat, um solche Events zu besuchen. Jedoch sind 20 HBD nichts, wenn du aktiv auf HIVE bist. Das Event #HOD hat viel Spaß gemacht und ich durfte viele neue Gesichter kennenlernen. Die HIVE-Reise geht weiter, mein Leben geht weiter, und auch wenn viele Menschen da draußen skeptisch gegenüber HIVE und Online-Business sind: Tragt es nach außen!

![IMG_4929.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23uQvrfr1YgV5SRyEtwa1zfmD2pEY8LYZ4VzUkj8brks4H5SFdXuByyHxVVdFiKL5bCdF.jpeg)
*Good coffee after lunch*

Letztendlich sehe ich auch ein paar kritische Punkte bei solchen Events bzw. bei unserer geliebten Chain, aber ich will die positiven Eindrücke im Gedächtnis behalten. Ich freue mich auf weitere HIVE OPEN DAYS und womöglich das @hivefest, wo ich dann auch das erste Mal dabei sein werde. 

Übrigens blogge ich immer noch am liebsten über @peakd, aber seit den #HOD habe ich wieder @ecency auf dem Handy. Die App ist neben der @hivekeychain einfach die beste. 

Spanien ist anders, *no na net*, das Flair ein Traum und es ist immer noch Off-Season, was alles entspannter macht. 

Zitat @ninaeatshere: „Womöglich ist es die Sonne, die so viele Leute hier glücklicher macht als woanders.“

Tja, ich denke, sie hat recht ... 

Liebe Leser, ich habe so viele coole Fotos, dass ich sie nicht alle ordne oder groß sortiere. Falls versehentlich ein Foto online kommt, das so nicht hätte erscheinen sollen, kontaktiert mich bitte.

It’s incredible what was organized here for a one-time fee of 20 HBD: Top location, great presentations, and food without end. Not to mention the boat trip to Tabarca, the meal there, and the overall fun of it all. The prices were a dream for both \

and newbies alike – for me, it was another experience I wouldn't want to miss.


![IMG_4402.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23tbw4DhJzacueGZstXLEwEYRRKDim9W8PX2YECGJWrBcCb3mPxTAxLKjCazKyzb2NY9t.jpeg)



What really surprised me was that quite a few new people joined through the Meetup.com app, attended the event, and were onboarded right then and there. Now it's your turn, \

– I’m looking forward to your posts!

*Vejer*

The #HOD was far more than just a community event. I took a lot away for the meetups in Vienna; I spoke with several veterans and newcomers and want to change a few things there. @godfish, an old acquaintance from the Vienna meetups who came from Prague, also gave me some great input. 




![IMG_4340.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23wgSTMgbgcFYzFK5hxepjDxeuvwntX9BHzyq8GtpHtp8EpK3tharNcHBG3eWjt9GDJLc.jpeg)
*Dinnertime*


It’s just cool to see how the HIVE community pushes and organizes such events in a \

and how we get to be part of it with so much joy. 






![IMG_4538.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23uQtf31pvymnC2SZNbypkz8cxWtnmbLYySJpLr2UhhfrQ1FjTYr6qmBvEcSDfoAT85zG.jpeg)

Do you know that feeling? Some say this, others say that, and somehow you’re just left thinking: ???. I’ve learned to form my own opinion, and for that, I’m more than grateful. Because this weekend – including the \

– was insane. Some of you know that from Monday to Friday, I only take profits online. A story that almost sounds too good to be true, and yet, I do it. One definitely doesn't exclude the other, so everything is *perfectoooo*...

I’m grateful I came to see the event for myself. Of course, I also discussed critical points regarding the community and HIVE with fellow HIVERs, including @ninaeatshere, @alessandrawhite, and @tibfox. We chatted about ideas and had very interesting conversations.

One thing I’ve learned in life: *You can never expect something from others if you aren’t willing to walk the path or change something yourself.*

What I also experienced and learned this weekend: Web2 is Web2 – and if you have haters or don't fit into the system, your account is gone and blocked. Just happened to me on Instagram.

**Why am I mentioning this here?**

HIVE is HIVE – decentralized, Web3, and ideally still around in 50 years. For me, the blockchain is like a diary, a book of experiences where I share my learnings, experiences, travels, and tips. It’s fun to read back through it yourself.

![IMG_4469.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23tHJPLYDbJaRv5cWdSUZBM7bky4Tx3Rkfuvzj3BA5f9eWBs2e8M1sG5zJq3bUbLcMoaQ.jpeg)

*Saved food and bring it to poor people*

**Now, about the event itself ✌️:**

Thursday, April 30th, was onboarding: going through the program, discussing things, and – how could it be otherwise – eating. A little warm-up with a mega-buffet that could easily have fed 10 more people. 

![IMG_4460.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23tviGHvRREhhm6cHj64QtkRY8M66U9S6jxuwXC2NsygjFDFWs2raJLe2ChY43ymHk1EA.jpeg)



Anyway, it was cool to see how many people made the journey, some even arriving in campers. At first, @haastrecht was a bit \

but honestly: a friendship developed over the weekend. He was touring in his VW bus, and it was really cool to get to know him.


![IMG_4501.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23wMekyB7Z19iCbcfcWzHJhuu4uLmg5kLqwpwU3EyxDCTPVWF1X6JJ716TTVmtFzRhMKX.jpeg)

Friday was the main event at Ulab, probably one of the best locations for such an event. I particularly enjoyed the talk by @livinguktaiwan about HIVE communities. But @tibfox also convinced me to look into @threespeak in the future. Unfortunately, I didn't quite understand @palomap3 since the talk was in Spanish and I couldn't see the translation monitor. But basically, they were all good, and it felt great to experience it all LIVE. From \
– it’s just cool to see people \

Saturday was Tabarca Island day, and it was glorious. A beautiful island, great food, the beach quiz, and cleanplanettour.io. @cleanplanet on the island – honestly, I did that for the first time too.

title.title: Agility Training
title.body:
Hello friends! Today, we were finally able to attend an official agility training session at our local training ground again. ** *Ahoj přátelé! Dneska jsme se konečně zase mohli zúčastnit oficiálního agility tréninku u nás na cvičáku.* ![1000095325.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/Eq5GvoVvK4PZmK15eKJogGbTC2JD8TcNrvqHiHU2WqvMtVK3Qi8JLK4EUKBCLCGyfqi.jpg) ![1000041964.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23xyvixEw5woHh1AvkKbovLzJ7KhixNWj1PsQVRHnycYuYmGEx73Yvo3rpHfHz65q668L.jpg)

Cesmína

After a long break, Cesmína ran several longer sequences and finally got back on the dog walk. She crossed it several times and really surprised me; despite the long hiatus, she hit her running contacts perfectly. **The contact zone must be a different color and is 90 cm long; the dog must touch it with at least one paw.** It’s one of the trickier parts of agility, as dogs often fly off the zone, which results in 5 penalty points. Even for Cesmína, this is usually where she picks up faults 🫤🙂. ** *Cesmína si po delší pauze zaběhla několik delších sekvencí a konečně se dostala i k běhu přes kladinu. Několikrát ji překonala a mile mě překvapila – i když na ní dlouho nebyla, sbíhala poctivě až do koncové zóny.* ***Tato zóna musí mít odlišnou barvu, je dlouhá 90 cm a pes se jí musí dotknout alespoň jednou tlapkou.*** *Je to jedna z těžších částí agility, protože psi zónu často přeskakují, za což inkasují 5 trestných bodů. I pro Cesmínu je to místo, kde chybuje téměř pravidelně 🫤🙂.* ![1000095309.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/Eo6KWK2HRifVbd2uDbtesxxYAp4Hee4veMzCPNZNb79rB6Lu3jEMioiV86uZHDdTK5b.jpg) ![1000095308.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/EoEp5nY4X5Ni2Ga65qy3UUCavmX1omCvu6DtZ9Wb475Ky933jXF9jN9PwLEGEBQvV7o.jpg) ![1000095307.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/EoAZL8rLB5hpTd1yGQSm6BDWLSfjfU6MMHmRrDme56SHZPZ1pRbS6Y9dBqMtJD7D6gj.jpg) ![1000095310.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23u5xwtoqi7XUKSB9HFd4ctdx8XUkBmB4NjZyKnx1Pvf93ydLdVfyefGf1u6ZKzKwZCDH.jpg) ![1000095326.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/EoAZLABnYxtCLNGTxVD4QcCaupc3pk3vf8oGjkryWx1tKoHDdhNhwqj24dz7RTNetMe.jpg) ![1000095324.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23tvcDoSa1ohm8psNvF9F7ZmASGpn7eA1ngZ3ghTqhiDyx73v5nRYT3ULneUCRyGAZ63W.gif) ![1000041964.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23xyvixEw5woHh1AvkKbovLzJ7KhixNWj1PsQVRHnycYuYmGEx73Yvo3rpHfHz65q668L.jpg)

Oggy

On the other hand, Oggýsek spent almost the entire training session head over heels, chasing after a young female dog, and was completely unable to focus. Only after she headed home did he also get some training in. ** *Na druhou stranu Oggýsek téměř celý trénink zamilovaně naháněl mladou fenečku a nebyl vůbec schopen trénovat. Teprve když odešla domů, také si trochu zatrénoval.* ![1000095312.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/Eo8SNVLx15ED1voPw2YiQSot7xBhtuchMMqnMbt82HCBqQCPwXLY9aEeZXcKK4biSfn.jpg) ![1000095311.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/EogMuQa1e43Y82yucX5NrMLC6dAu8CYAiefKXvHR8jiWezAxH4z974VAa1zfJE34cnV.jpg) ![1000095318.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23u61BAJcvpBz9DrwnMgtsuh9mNh2j1Hdzh6mkSFumCtCxcCYUMRNJQLn8ePPwSPw3on9.gif) ![1000041964.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23xyvixEw5woHh1AvkKbovLzJ7KhixNWj1PsQVRHnycYuYmGEx73Yvo3rpHfHz65q668L.jpg)
**It was a great day, and we’re heading home happily exhausted. High paws!** 🐾
***Byl to skvělý den a domů se vracíme příjemně unavení. Packu na to!*** 🐾
![1000041964.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wahaceggy/23xyvixEw5woHh1AvkKbovLzJ7KhixNWj1PsQVRHnycYuYmGEx73Yvo3rpHfHz65q668L.jpg)

title.title: 🇵🇱 Aktywna regeneracja💪\n/ 🇬🇧 Active recovery 💪: May 4 2026
title.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/77f9c2a9-f45a-4490-87f1-2504d13c43b2.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d42d8821-0c42-40d8-b7c4-3940718099ac.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0c26dd4e-5fec-4d09-b28d-7edf5962f38f.jpg)
🇵🇱 ### Aktywna regeneracja Nie samym sportem człowiek żyje. Czasem zamiast kilometrów wchodzą metry drewna. Dobry gospodarz myśli do przodu — a opał na zimę zaczyna się od wiosny. Dla ciała to dalej ruch. Inny niż bieganie, ale wciąż potrzebny. Luźniej na głowie, spokojniej w nogach. Regeneracja nie zawsze oznacza odpoczynek. --- 🇬🇧 ### Active recovery Life isn’t just about training. Sometimes, instead of kilometers, it’s meters of wood. A good host thinks ahead — and winter fuel starts in spring. For the body, it’s still movement. Different from running, but just as needed. Easier on the mind, lighter on the legs. Recovery doesn’t always mean rest.

title.title: Love is a beautiful thing
title.body:
Love…
they say it’s a beautiful thing.
And it is.

Love is sweet
it feels like warmth on a cold day,
like peace in the middle of chaos,
like finding a place
where your heart can finally rest.

But love is more than just sweetness.

Love is patient.
Love is understanding.
Love is sacrifice.

Because real love doesn’t only show up
when things are easy
it shows up when things are hard,
when misunderstandings happen,
when emotions rise,
and staying becomes a choice, not a feeling.

There are different kinds of love.

There is Agape love
a selfless, unconditional kind of love,
the kind that gives without expecting anything in return,
the kind that puts others before self.

There is Philia love
the love between friends,
built on trust, loyalty, laughter,
and shared moments that become memories.

There is love that is unconditional—
the kind that doesn’t depend on perfection,
the kind that sees flaws
and still chooses to stay.

But even with all this,
love must have wisdom.

Because love without boundaries
can become pain.
Love without respect
can become damage.
And love without truth
is not love at all.

Love should not break you.
It should not silence you.
It should not make you lose yourself
just to keep someone else.

True love builds.
It supports.
It grows.

It corrects you gently,
it stands with you boldly,
and it chooses you daily
not just when it feels good,
but when it matters most.

So yes…
love is beautiful.
But more than that
love is intentional.

Love is a decision.
And real love
is something you give,
but also something you must learn
to receive the right way.

title.title: People Are Getting Ready for Summer, Little by Little 少しずつ夏の準備を始めている人たち　[English and Japanese]
title.body:
![IMG_5065.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmST1CxhfLdRTRd8WTY3FGEem1AkDLv1k2zAVeRQ2yr39R/IMG_5065.jpeg)
### People Are Getting Ready for Summer, Little by Little
#

Spring arrives slowly here every year. The atmosphere of both the ocean and the mountains changes little by little. It’s beautiful and enjoyable to notice nature’s shifting expressions. People also begin preparing for summer as spring arrives, because winter returns quickly after these beautiful seasons.

I like taking photos of the countryside and everyday life. It’s very peaceful. Nothing dramatic, but I can see small, adorable moments of human life within the scenery.

This view is simple yet stunning. I can walk along the dike and feel the ocean breathe. When the tide goes out, a vast empty space appears before me. It’s such a lovely moment.

![IMG_5063.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSH4YMBmXNgyHuMTp6mkR3XcSJ1JiW9EC9pbMcSK9KSTr/IMG_5063.jpeg)

This is another typical countryside scene. As you can see, people have already started preparing firewood for their wood stoves in anticipation of the harsh winter. I love the old-looking shed. You can see the history of people’s lives in it. You can almost read how many times the roof and walls have been repaired. It may be an ordinary scene, but for me, it offers a wonderful perspective for photography.

![IMG_5072.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ842P7nUCCkkiBLWTsqq5toDrTNMYrJtzCEUEdfJ4CNg/IMG_5072.jpeg)

This is also a classic spring scene in the countryside, as people prepare for the growing season. I can smell the earth and fertilizer. A farmer’s tractor is getting the land ready for planting. Farmers rotate their fields each year, and it seems they’ve chosen to plant vegetables here this time. I wonder what will grow. Potatoes, corn, or something else? It’s fun to imagine.

![IMG_5066.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPgVcRAkubPVqPaMqDpmckeKathSvadCQFUVi86rLweXX/IMG_5066.jpeg)

Back to the ocean. My dog really enjoys walking here. And speaking of spring, there’s one more thing to mention: ticks. They’re like tough little spring monsters. They quickly latch onto dogs and people during walks.

![IMG_5071.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcxD9TDZMBR2LZaNPTT22QMtumfqk7FbAGPD4Yn5UyxQT/IMG_5071.jpeg)

I need to give my dog tick-prevention medicine in early spring, and he’s already had his dose. Luckily, his white fur makes ticks easier to spot. When I visited a hardware store, I even saw a section dedicated to tick control. I guess it’s time to mow our yard soon.

![IMG_5067.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmawoBp9Re8cR1JLXtXjMkCcVRNZnyr5ytKaPpvM89qFvh/IMG_5067.jpeg)

Oh, and kayaking. Another sign of spring and summer here. The river water still looks very cold, but I’ve noticed people starting to get ready for kayaking and canoeing. I’ve tried kayaking before, and it was a wonderful experience. I’d love to go again.

![IMG_5070.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQeVr1trRXhy2zqHEEaVNrQdUYayWiYjiFF1WswbEEyva/IMG_5070.jpeg)

There are also preparations for fishing. My husband loves fishing and has already gotten his license for the season. I don’t fish much myself, but I enjoy cooking when he brings fish home. I also like browsing fishing gear in stores. They’re so colourful and beautiful. Sometimes I even think they could be turned into earrings!

Japanese 日本語

![IMG_5065.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmST1CxhfLdRTRd8WTY3FGEem1AkDLv1k2zAVeRQ2yr39R/IMG_5065.jpeg)
### 少しずつ夏の準備を始めている人たち
#

ここでは、春は毎年ゆっくりとやってきます。海と山の空気が少しずつ変わっていくのを感じます。自然の表情の変化に気づくことは、とても美しく、楽しいことです。人々もようやく春が訪れると、もう夏の準備を始めます。この地域では、美しい季節のあとにすぐ冬がやってくるからです。

私は田舎の風景や人々の暮らしを写真に撮るのが好きです。とても穏やかで、特別なことは何もないのですが、その風景の中に人の愛らしい生活が見えてきます。

この景色はとてもシンプルで美しいです。堤防沿いを歩きながら、海が呼吸しているように感じます。潮が引くと、目の前に大きな空間が広がります。その瞬間がとても好きです。

![IMG_5063.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSH4YMBmXNgyHuMTp6mkR3XcSJ1JiW9EC9pbMcSK9KSTr/IMG_5063.jpeg)

こちらも典型的な田舎の風景です。ご覧の通り、厳しい冬に備えてすでに薪ストーブ用の薪の準備が始まっています。古びた小屋がとても味があって、人の暮らしの歴史が感じられます。屋根や壁が何度も修理されてきたことが伝わってきます。一見すると何気ない風景ですが、私にとってはとても魅力的な撮影のアングルです。

![IMG_5072.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ842P7nUCCkkiBLWTsqq5toDrTNMYrJtzCEUEdfJ4CNg/IMG_5072.jpeg)

これも春の田舎らしい風景で、夏に向けた準備の光景のひとつです。土や肥料の匂いが漂っています。農家のトラクターが畑を耕し、作物を育てる準備をしています。毎年、畑は休ませながら使われるので、今年はこの畑に野菜を植えることにしたのでしょう。じゃがいもかな？とうもろこし？それとも別のもの？何が育つのか想像するのも楽しい時間です。

![IMG_5066.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPgVcRAkubPVqPaMqDpmckeKathSvadCQFUVi86rLweXX/IMG_5066.jpeg)

海の話に戻ると、ここでの散歩を私の犬もとても楽しんでいます。そして春といえば、もうひとつ大事な話があります。「ダニ」です。彼らはまるで強力な春のモンスターのようで、散歩中に犬や人に素早くついてきます。

![IMG_5071.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcxD9TDZMBR2LZaNPTT22QMtumfqk7FbAGPD4Yn5UyxQT/IMG_5071.jpeg)

毎年春の初めに、ダニ予防の薬を犬に与えています。今春はもうすでに済ませました。幸い、私の犬は白い毛なので、ダニを見つけやすいです。ホームセンターに行くと、ダニ対策のコーナーもありました。そろそろ庭の草刈りもしないといけません。

![IMG_5067.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmawoBp9Re8cR1JLXtXjMkCcVRNZnyr5ytKaPpvM89qFvh/IMG_5067.jpeg)

それから、カヤック。これもこの地域の春から夏の風物詩です。川の水はまだとても冷たそうですが、カヤックやカヌーの準備をしている人たちを見かけるようになりました。以前カヤックをしたことがありますが、とても素敵な体験でした。またやってみたいです。

![IMG_5070.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQeVr1trRXhy2zqHEEaVNrQdUYayWiYjiFF1WswbEEyva/IMG_5070.jpeg)

釣りの準備も始まっています。主人は釣りが大好きで、すでに今シーズンの魚釣り用のライセンスを取得しています。私はあまり釣りはしませんが、魚を持ち帰ってくれたときに料理するのが楽しみです。お店で釣り道具を見るのも好きで、色鮮やかでとてもきれいです。時々、これはピアスになりそうと思ってしまいます。

Thank you for reading!
お読みいただきありがとうございます。

title.title: Der Krypto-Winter scheint vorüber?/ Is the crypto winter over?
title.body:
Nach dem Bitcoin-Kursabsturz auf rund 60.000 US-Dollar im Februar und zwei Monaten zäher Seitwärtsbewegung mehren sich die bullishen Vorzeichen. Michael Saylors BTC-Akkumulationsmaschine läuft auf Hochtouren, auch die Spot ETFs von BlackRock und Co. verzeichnen an einzelnen Tagen wieder Zuflüsse in dreistelliger Millionenhöhe. Die zittrigen Hände scheinen aus dem Markt gespült worden zu sein. Was bleibt, ist der harte Kern der Langzeit-Hodler. Haben wir den Bitcoin-Boden schon gesehen und dürfen jetzt auf eine echte Erholungsrallye hoffen? Noch zweifeln viele Experten. 

BTC Echo Redakteur Tobias Zander: Wohl kaum jemand hätte vor einem Jahr erwartet, dass ein ganzer Bitcoin heute weniger als 80.000 US-Dollar kosten würde. Doch obwohl der Vierjahreszyklus seine überoptimistischen Kritiker einholte – auch ich gehörte zu ihnen – fiel dieser Bärenmarkt bislang erstaunlich mild aus. Der Tiefpunkt am 6. Februar entsprach einer 53-prozentigen Korrektur gegenüber dem Allzeithoch von 126.000 US-Dollar.

Ich zitierte aus folgendem Interview...

https://www.btc-echo.de/news/steht-bitcoin-das-schlimmste-noch-bevor-229511/

Fazit:

Wenn die Kursentwicklung der Krypto-Leitwährung uns eine Sache wieder und wieder gezeigt hat, dann ist es gnadenlose Brutalität gegen Schönwetterinvestoren, die glauben, dass man mit Bitcoin “einfach” zu Wohlstand gelangen könnte. Deshalb erwarte ich, dass der BTC-Kurs vor einer nachhaltigen Erholungsrallye noch einmal leicht unter 60.000 US-Dollar rutschen wird – wenn auch nur für kurze Zeit. Für echte Überzeugungstäter heißt es dann mal wieder: “Kaufen, wenn die Kanonen donnern”.

Frage an dich: Habe ich es verpasst im Februar nachzukaufen oder kommt der echte Boden erst noch???

title.title: I’d Choose Living Fully Over Knowing My End
title.body:
<div  class=text-justify>

When I read the prompt, I rushed to go read through other entries first for one reason. I thought it'd be weird for me to write that I won't buy the machine even if it's very cheap or use it if it's free of charge to check. But reading through others entries, we are well aware of the dangers.

Death is inevitable, while we could to good extent determine when one can be born, it's never told when exactly they can be born and same for death. When people fall seriously sick, doctors or people who are good with health issues can give an estimate of time left for these people to live.

Most of the time, they are never accurate because death is meant to be unexpected most times. Though it's sad to think, death doesn't care about age, achievements, morals of being good or being bad, it just comes to whoever it wants at the appointed time. Many lost lives even in sleep.

It has been like this for millennium years, since the beginning of the world, since Adam. And now, *humans have developed a device that can tell me the time of my death?* That sounds like a whole deviation from what the world has been created to be, it will cause a huge disaster in the world.

Why I think so is not far fetched, we've see how people act after they get the news that they will die in less than six months time, they tend to live so cautiously like it's not life they are living anymore. Some even die way earlier before then because they let fear kill them before the illness.

And then, let's talk about the part where this device will make people lose hope so easily because one of the reasons we are all living and waking up each morning is the hope that we have that the new day is another opportunity to get something right. Knowing when to die takes that.

![file_00000000da5c720ab9e9817ce92cef84.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/EpvjSAhGQviJhfnSybZPFsB7MzUnem6fYMUcesW8j7rDUhdJ8avHqYVbjmV5BkJSoZg.png)

Instead of buying a device to know when I'll die, I'd rather live right for the case of dying so unexpectedly or by accident and take care of myself for the case of growing old before death. We don't need to know how long we have to live, what matter is how we live the life we have now.

I guess this where the life advice of: **\

** works very well. We don't know what will happen the next hour, we only know today so today is the right time to start what you've been procrastinating on to start. **That’s the real AI win:** not “robot replaces human,” but **boring friction gets deleted**.

Your examples are concrete, which is why the point lands. Saving **20–25 minutes on grammar** and another **20–25 minutes on thumbnails** isn’t small — that’s easily **40–50 minutes** back from a single post. Over a month, that becomes serious time, not just a neat trick.

The smart part is that you’re using AI for **acceleration**, not as a substitute for your own thinking. That’s the sweet spot. Let AI handle spelling, cleanup, formatting, and image generation; let **you** handle the ideas, experience, and judgment. Otherwise people end up publishing polished nonsense, which is unfortunately a thriving genre online.

The image works too. The contrast between the slower manual workflow and the AI-assisted side makes your point visually in one shot. Clean choice.

One thing worth adding to strengthen the post: **AI saves time, but it still needs supervision**. It’s fast, not automatically right. That balance would make your argument sharper and more honest.

title.title: Does AI restricting creativity !?
title.body:
>

Artificial Intelligence, also known as AI, is the most trending/hot topic at the present time, and it’s been trending for the last few years. As time goes by, it’s getting more attention, and it’s not surprising, as it’s hard to ignore. With the help of AI, our tasks have become easier, and its power is something like magic. It’s like we can complete any task in a few seconds, which was supposed to take at least a few hours in the past. Allow me to share some insight related to it from my practical life. ![Inline Image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSFomtDoc6Sg8Jgpy2h36rXaBfp3PRcUaLyR6xGptEg3D/ai-image-1778007037903.jpeg) picture generated by rafiki AI is indeed very powerful. In my daily life, I write posts every day, and after writing a post, I always used to check my spelling mistakes and grammatical mistakes, and such a thing would cost me at least 20/25 minutes. But now I have AI, and it can figure out all the errors within a few seconds, and even if I manually check every error, it can take a maximum of 3/4 minutes. And if I don’t check manually, it can be done with a single click. So, at the present time, I don’t even need to understand grammar, and without having any good understanding of grammar, it can be fixed within such a short time. It’s indeed something impressive. Again, after writing a post, I used to create a picture for using it as a thumbnail. There were many ways to make it, but creating it from Canva was the most common thing for me. It would also take at least 20-25 minutes after I became faster at doing it. In the beginning, it used to take nearly 45+ minutes, and it was time-consuming. But now I have AI, and by just giving a little description about my desired thumbnail picture, it can show me the result within a minute. Can you imagine how much time it is saving for me? I don’t need to make efforts, and additionally, it is saving my most precious time. So, it’s reasonable to use AI, as it saves our efforts and time and makes our life easier and more comfortable. At least I have no reason for denying the use of AI. It’s indeed a very handy tool. But have you noticed, I stopped using my creativeness for making my post banner or creating thumbnail pictures? In the case of coding, it’s also the same. Now, making a program without knowing any coding language is very natural, and a coder also doesn’t need to be creative for normal coding, as AI can make it for him within a short time, which can save a lot of his efforts. So, he is also not trying to be creative now. The reason is quite simple. Why should we waste our time and efforts in the name of creativity when we can get it easily within a few clicks? Does it mean AI is destroying our creativeness and making us lazy? I think it’s not like that. It’s us who choose not to be creative and to become lazy. Not adapting to technology is called foolishness, and there is no way for us to avoid AI. But there are still many cases where creativeness is required, and AI still can’t replace us. If we want to be creative, we must focus on it. It’s like in a hot summer, we used to use hand fans in the past, but now we have electric fans and don’t need to waste our efforts on hand fans. In that time, we can choose to do something productive and creative. But if we only choose to stay and relax, it’s our fault for not taking advantage of the saved time and efforts from using electric fans. We can’t blame electric fans for it. Likewise, we can’t blame AI for our laziness. It’s a choice, and if we want to be creative, we still have many ways to be creative. AI never restricts us from being creative.

links.title: Forgiveness is key
links.body:
Forgiveness is powerful. It is one of the most difficult things to do, yet one of the most necessary for our growth and peace of mind. When someone hurts us, the pain can sit deep within our hearts. It can make us angry, bitter, and even change how we see others. In those moments, forgiveness feels almost impossible.

But forgiveness is not about pretending that the hurt never happened. It is not about ignoring the pain or excusing the wrong. Forgiveness is a conscious decision to let go of the weight that the offense has placed on your heart. It is choosing your peace over your pain.

Many people struggle with forgiveness because they think it means going back to how things used to be. But forgiveness does not mean reconnection. You can forgive someone and still set boundaries. You can forgive and choose distance. You can forgive and protect your mental and emotional well-being.
Forgiveness is not for the other person alone, it is for you. Holding onto anger and resentment only keeps you tied to the hurt. It drains your energy and robs you of joy. But when you forgive, you release yourself. You free your mind, your heart, and your spirit.

It is not easy. It takes time, strength, and sometimes repeated effort. But it is worth it. Because in the end, forgiveness is not a sign of weakness it is a sign of healing, growth, and inner strength.
Choose forgiveness, not because they deserve it, but because you deserve peace.

links.title: 💛💚Playing a ranked in MLBB as Melissa (ADC) MVP!!! 💅💅
links.body:
>

Hello, hello friends. Today I'm back with a new battle, featuring a character I haven't shown before. This character is a marksman, known for having some of the highest area-of-effect damage. Melissa is a relatively new character, but she's been very well received by us players who have been playing this famous MOBA for years.

>***Hola, hola amigos. Hoy regreso con una nueva batalla, con un personaje que aún no había mostrado. Este personaje es del tipo tirador, destacando por ser de los personajes con más daño en zona. Melissa es relativamente un personaje nuevo, siendo altamente bien recibida por nosotros los jugadores con años jugando el famoso MOBA.***


![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EoiTj7jRWMGDcNMnT33kwqoxpbFsjShnsp9jkj7q8sG3nZvBpKorNyRSBEBrch8hS4J.jpg)


Melissa (according to the game's lore) is a seamstress who owns a voodoo doll. When thrown in a certain area and touched by any enemy, it can be selected and used to attack with basic attacks, reflecting the damage back at the enemy continuously. To escape, simply move out of the attack range.

>***Melissa (según el lore del juego) es una costurera que posee un muñeco vudú, este al ser arrojado en una zona determinada y tocado por cualquier enemigo, puede seleccionarlo y atacar con sus básicos reflejando el daño en el enemigo continuamente y para liberarse de él, solo basta con salirse del rango de ataque.***


![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/Eo45r7NcGzSArve6Xr3xQBBBkQnuHN8dpN6MQs6gBjpZ9PJVtBP3rD2ZHcDf7FuMMtt.jpg)


Currently, I only own one skin for this character called \
since there hasn't been a new one available for purchase. In fact, the one I have now was a direct gift from the game. But I'd still be more excited to get another one like \

from the game's collaboration with Jujutsu Kaisen, since it has the best effects of the hero, and it's really satisfying to see it in action with this collaboration.\n\n>***Actualmente, solo poseo una apariencia de este personaje llamada \

, ya que realmente no ha tenido una nueva que pueda estar a mi alcance comprar, y de hecho, esta que hasta ahora tengo fue un regalo directo del juego, pero aun así me emocionaría más obtener alguna otra como la de \

de la colaboración del juego con Jujutsu Kaisen, ya que esta tiene los mejores efectos del héroe, y realmente es satisfactorio verla en acción con esta colaboración.***

<center>

![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)

</center>

https://youtu.be/xK3ct22x7p8?si=Akz6KUQA2tyDu8jv

<div class\

>

I don't consider myself the best at the game, since there are times when I go an entire day without winning a battle. But in this particular battle, I'm receiving more criticism than praise from my teammates, because (as I've said before), the key to a good victory lies in your allies performing well in battle.

>***Yo no me creo para nada el mejor en el juego, ya que hay oportunidades en la que paso todo un día sin ganar una batalla. Pero en esta batalla en especial tengo más críticas que alabanzas de mis compañeros, ya que (como he dicho antes), la clave para una buena victoria está en que tus aliados tengan un buen desempeño al momento de luchar.***


![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EoCawHs7jhX4P6ZRnYANegEHiF1sA3A7dXM1b8ZTVxo74rzGHuEcNgFAi44mxuvn18t.jpg)


I mustn't deny that at first I thought this battle was lost, since the enemy mage wouldn't let me do anything at the beginning, and receiving no immediate or consistent help, I took it upon myself to do whatever was necessary to advance, even if it was slowly. Melissa's ultimate ability prevents enemies from touching her; it doesn't make her immune, but it gives her the advantage in melee combat.

>***No debo negar que al inicio di por perdida esta batalla, ya que el mago enemigo no me dejaba hacer nada al principio, y al no recibir ayuda inmediata ni constante, tomé por mis propias manos la decisión de hacer todo lo necesario para que avanzáramos, así fuese lentamente. Melissa con se última habilidad puede evitar que los enemigos la puedan tocar, no la vuelve inmune, pero en luchas cuerpo a cuerpo tiene la ventaja.***

<center>


![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)




</center>


![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/Eo8K8cT58MDsKi9e2fUYtoJjUvhto1ALaBKYKNPe4JDCBE8bDNmrCFwyDfho3iSJNXa.jpg)



<div class\

>

The enemy's mistake was to relentlessly harass my line. At first, I can't deny that they slowed me down, but it cost them dearly. When they slow me down, I move to the other lines without them even noticing. If they don't let me do anything in my place, I go somewhere else so they feel the fear of losing their other lines.

>***El error del enemigo fue acosar mi línea imparablemente, en un principio no puedo negar que me retrasaron, pero eso les costó, porque cuando a mí me retrasan, me muevo a las otras líneas sin que ni siquiera lo noten, porque si no me dejan hacer nada en mi sitio, voy a otro lado para que sientan el miedo de peder sus otras líneas.***


![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/23tGc17gX5o9obyvUjg3bsGPyrwwu9KFQCewLveXCKJ8C1w6yAb63T4vtZwd5s4eP5wD5.png)



Just look at the final results: Our jungler never did anything to help the team as a whole. The mage never paid much attention to what her opponent was doing. The tank, while he healed and controlled the crowd, never had any real objectives; he saved me many times, but I think he could have encouraged the others to perform better in areas like the jungle. The fighter showed aggression towards the enemies, but credit shouldn't be given to those who only focus on fighting.

>***Solo basta con ver los resultados finales: Nuestro jungla nunca hizo nada que le colaborara al equipo en general. La maga nunca le dio mayor importancia a lo que estaba haciendo su contrincante. El tanque si bien curaba y controlaba, jamás tuvo verdaderos objetivos, me salvó muchas veces, pero creo que pudo haber impulsado a los demás a tener un mejor desempeño en lugares como la jungla. El combatiente mostró rudeza contra los enemigos, pero no se le debe dar merito a quienes solo se enfocan en pelear.***


![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EoeERJsJXmjX9P6J4ZuhH1Wcf1T7PyHe7V2E6qWmVVbDLRBFvbpWCfBpAf188RQgikT.jpg)


In other words, you might notice that, based on the latest update, there are interactive effects and options like lane preselection, allowing the system to choose your lane exactly to your liking. The game currently features a couple of new heroes that I haven't introduced yet, but I'll try to show an upcoming battle with one of them that might inspire you to play.

>***En otras palabras, pueden notar que con base en la última actualización, hay efectos interactivos y opciones como la preselección de líneas para que el propio sistema te elija tu línea totalmente a tu gusto. El juego actualmente cuenta con un par de héroes nuevos que aún no he presentado, pero trataré de mostrar una batalla próxima con alguno que te anime a jugar.***

# Space Marines:
A Captain - the leader
A Chaplain - a 2IC leader and spiritual leader
A Librarian - the psychic magic guy
An Ancient - A Banner Bearer
A squad of Intercessors - the Battleline squad
A squad of Vanguard Veterans with Jump Packs - an elite close combat unit
A squad of Eradicators - Anti-troop ranged support with a new gun
A Land Speeder - the return of a Legends unit now with slightly different and modernized Space Marine Weapons

# Orks
A Warboss - the leader
A Bigboss - the 2IC leader
A Weirdboy - the psychic magic guy
A Nob with Banner - the Banner guy
20x Ork Boys - Battleline Infantry, either 2x10 or 1x20 Boyz
10x Gretchin - Expendable cannon fodder or overlooked sneaky unit
A Wartrakk - Another Legends unit making it back to 40k!
A Dakkarig - A Shooty Ork walker

# Also in the Box
New Core Rules
A Lore Book
A Missions Deck
A Narrative Campaign Deck
Datasheets for all the minis
Transfer sheets for all the minis

>Holaaaaa amigos de la comunidad de gems,para este día se me ocurrió hacer algo diferente para compartir en la comunidad,y es que no todo se trata de una rutina, también de vez en cuando deberíamos tomarnos un respiro y darle nuestros ojos y mente una manera diferente de ver la vida,para esta vez les quiero dejar una sola imagen,una imagen que tienen algo que esconde,y ustedes se encargan de descubrir que es. Yo al principio no lo veía pero si tenemos una exelente vista se logrará ver que es 🧐👀🕵🏻.** --- # > **Hello friends of the Gems community! Today I thought I'd do something different to share with the community. It's not all about routine; we should also take a break now and then and give our eyes and minds a different perspective on life. This time, I want to share a single image with you, an image that has something hidden, and it's up to you to discover what it is. I didn't see it at first, but if you have excellent eyesight, you'll be able to see what it is🧐👀🕵🏻.** ---
![1000268067.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeoZjnqCFeEmr8APtWQTjpye5QyrsNnbT251S2TvDrKrX/1000268067.jpg)

>La imagen que ven aquí,es una foto que tome del patio de mi casa,y allí se puede ver una planta de parchita que viene creciendo desde hace un tiempo,no tiene parchitas aún porque creo que no es el tiempo para florecer. Entonces la forma que tiene se ve que parece más a un arbusto,porque mi mamá vio que si no había en dónde colocarla para que se vaya agarrando como es una planta de enredaderas, entonces ella lo que hizo fue enrollarlas en su misma de la planta,y entonces así es que esa planta se ve asi,volviéndose en un escondite en dónde no se ve quien está allí 🧐.** --- # > **The picture you see here is a photo I took of my backyard. You can see a passion fruit plant that's been growing for a while. It doesn't have any fruit yet because I don't think it's the right time to bloom. Its shape makes it look more like a bush because my mom realized there wasn't anywhere for it to climb, like a vine, so she wrapped it around itself. That's how it looks, becoming a hiding place where you can't see who's there 🧐.** --- **

>No les voy a dejar muchas pistas, porque sería trampa,solo tienen la imagen para descubrir quien está allí 🧐. links.title: Smart Tool, Lazy Mind.
links.body:
I was at a bus park one day like that, that was how this lady called her boyfriend who I was standing next too. The phone wasn't on speaker, but based on what the guy was saying, it was obvious that the girl was accusing him of not posting her and writing epistles for her birthday.



![1001009312.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/AK7wQ5GJkLipGbRPgN9QWkg2VxZckbXmwBQL3Q2wH3cxnhuYhyncxGBEASM6NTa.png)



Guess what the guy said, he told her she is not the calm type and that that was what he was busy doing inside the bus since, trying to come up with the most romantic, sweet and lovely writeup for her. I thought it was true until the guy looked at me, smiled and begged me to please on my hotspot for him, because he wants to quickly prompt chatgpt to get it done. I just smiled at him.

And in less than two minutes, this guy has posted three different pictures with three different lovely and awesome writeups to appreciate and adore her... Omo, one of it was even in Yoruba, while one as some but of pidgin in it. Sincerely, she wouldn't have thought this guy didn't write it for himself. You might want to ask me how I knew, I and the guy became friends on the journey and I got to know about it all




![1001009298.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/1001009298.png)


Now, you can see ehwo something that's supposed to take minutes of deep thinking and all, taking few seconds to do. And that's how laziness is coming in quietly, we begin to see it as easy, but then we are losing ourselves unknowingly. What's too much in writing an epistle for your lover and sending it to her, you get to add some deep details, memories and all. 




Even though that is not possible with all these tools too depending on how you prompt it too. But then, I won't deny that I've used it to generate birthday wishes as well and even ask for ideas about certain things... Even still we should try as much as possible to think things through first, tasks that bring of yours, make use of it, don't just program it into delving into chatgpt every single time you need to get something done.



![1001009313.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/AJmr34eZurGxfA2g1SJ8xbYynjQqjpscpJTZfLZVr524L44wBQMWpGfiuQGSi4A.png)




Because today, a lot of people can't just do without it. And like I said earlier, some can't even think for themselves. I knew it had gotten worse when I see some group of youths in my church using chatgpt to answer Sunday school questions... Omo 🤦, isn't that dangerous, that we can think for ourselves anymore, that we can try things out ourselves first before trying to make use of a tool. Isn't it bad to now see how that a tool that's supposed to come in handy once in a while now is replacing us and our brains entirely....




Technology is good, I'm making use of a phone now, and it is a product of tech, so tech is good, but we need to balance things. We should learn to try to do something for ourselves first, those tools shouldn't be our go-to immediately we are faced with a problem. Let's put our mind and brain to work, that's how creativity works and comes to be, those who created these tools make use of their thinking faculties too...





🌹

links.title: Technology has boost creativity
links.body:
Happy new week great family and I am excited to share my own view on the subject matter for this edition. At first I was wondering how would I start but after a couple of minutes, some ideas dropped.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXockZHQ8XeHLjhSTfpiqqzjjCJCu14a3qULU6DMHqeHd/1778006679019.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcCQj2vxsni6zZXhrqfSSdrLVU8bKenysE4BnHZDG16qC/1778006679293.jpg)

##### pictures are my own.

The theme for this edition deals with the cost of ease. Us the invention of technology making us as humans less productive or creative? Since AI has taken over virtually every helm of affairs. Is this a blow on creativity and how can  we maintain our creativity with all these in play? Hmmmm this is a topic that needs proper attention in order to bring balance.

Technology hasn't destroyed or killed creativity but I think it has transformed and developed creativity to another dimension even though most of the art work today are going to extinction. I would like to share some few thoughts on the advantage that technology has brought to the society.

Technology has shifted creativity from the physical realm to what I called digital platforms. Instead of using things like paper, stage etc the advent of screen, computers and software and also AI materials has driven this to another height. You hardly see people make use of hand brushes to make drawing. The usual pencil drawing that artist normally do has been replaced with AI now. I saw a drawing that I thought it was a human being that created it but I was informed is AI generated. This is good development but does it completely blow out creativity? Not at all rather it helps to fortify what has been happening.

Some of the pictures and snapshot that normally takes days before they are printed hmmm it has become just a matter of minutes and your work is delivered to you smoothly. The technological advancement has come to improve our creativity. Just relying on AI without having a grip on how to give the right command so that the AI will process it is another thing. It requires another higher level of creativity to come up with something like that.

### How can we stay creative?

Technology has both positive and negative impacts but I think the positive impacts are enormous. Technology has helped to improve our creativity and makes things easy even though some individuals are loosing their relevance.
One of the ways for us to stay relevant and suit into the modern age is to develop strategies to adopt to the current system. Every individual should make effort to catch up with the trend. Everyone should learn to upgrade knowledge to meet up with the demands. There are many that have given up on their creativity because of so many factors which could include low self esteem and lack of confidence. Let's learn to balance the trending thing.

Technology has not eliminated creativity but it has added value and reshape it. It has foster opportunities for one to explore new possibilities for better creativity even though the originality of creativity has been reduced a little. Thanks so much for reading my entry for week 216 edition 1. All comments are appreciated.
Thanks

Feliz inicio de semana, del mejor mes del año al menos para mí, porque es mi cumpleaños y el de mi bebé, además del mes de las flores y de la virgen. 
Este fin de semana entrené ambos días, sábado y domingo, el sábado le di unas vueltas al Parque del Este, lugar donde me gusta mucho correr por el paisaje, me conecto con la naturaleza y me despeja la mente, hice 5K a un ritmo promedio de 6´36” los primeros no fueron tan fáciles porque de verdad no tenía muchas ganas de correr y tenía hambre, pero me dije: “dale que no entrenaste en la semana y si comes, después no haces nada y hay que mover ese cuerpo que los 40 los tenemos respirándonos en la nuca y queremos llegar a viejos chévere” 
El domingo entrené en Lomas del Ávila, primero pensé en hacer 5K, en la primera cuesta dije, haré 3K y al final hice 4K (promedié jajaja), aunque al principio sentía que iba hiper lento, mientras iba calentando agarré un buen ritmo 6´40” promedio al final.  Solo pienso mientras subo en que eso me da resistencia para cuando troto en plano, para no tirar la toalla, es mi motivación y también pienso en que mientras no vuelva a nadar, hay que correr y hacerlo bien. 
Algo que me gusta de correr de lo que no disfrutamos al nadar es del aliento de las personas alrededor, aun cuando no te conocen, te ven correr y te dicen “dale campeona” “vamos que vas bien” y es muy chévere sentir también esa motivación, porque te dan ganas de continuar, es como una energía externa que te potencia un poco más.

___________________________________
Happy start to the week! It’s the best month of the year—at least for me—because it’s my birthday and my baby’s, plus it’s the month of flowers and the Virgin Mary.
This weekend I trained both days, Saturday and Sunday. On Saturday, I ran a few laps around Parque del Este, a place I really love to run because of the scenery; it helps me connect with nature and clears my mind. I ran 5K at an average pace of 6:36. The first few kilometers weren’t so easy because I really didn’t feel like running and I was hungry, but I told myself: “Come on, you didn’t train this week, and if you eat, you won’t do anything afterward—you’ve got to get that body moving because 40 is breathing down our necks, and we want to grow old in style.” 
On Sunday I trained in Lomas del Ávila. At first I thought about doing 5K, but on the first hill I said, “I’ll do 3K,” and in the end I did 4K (I averaged it out, ha ha ha), even though at first I felt like I was going super slow. As I warmed up, I picked up a good pace, averaging 6’40” by the end.  As I climb, I just think that this builds my endurance for when I’m running on flat ground, so I don’t give up—it’s my motivation. I also think that as long as I’m not swimming again, I have to run and do it well. 
Something I like about running that we don’t get from swimming is the encouragement from the people around you. Even if they don’t know you, they see you running and say, “Go for it, champ!” or “Come on, you’re doing great!” and it’s really cool to feel that motivation too, because it makes you want to keep going—it’s like an external energy that boosts you.

---

The Curse of the Reflection: The Myth of Narcissus. 
The term begins not in a doctor's office, but in the poetic imagination of ancient Greece. The most famous version of the myth comes from the Roman poet Ovid's Metamorphoses. 

Narcissus was the son of a river god and a nymph. The seer Tiresias gave his mother a chilling prophecy: Narcissus would live a long life only if he never \

. As a young man, Narcissus was breathtakingly beautiful, yet cruelly heartless. He spurned the advances of the nymph Echo, leaving her to waste away until nothing remained of her but a voice that could only repeat the words of others.

For this cruelty, the goddess Nemesis cursed him. Narcissus came to a pool of water. Leaning down to drink, he saw his own reflection. Not recognizing himself, he fell deeply, tragically in love with the image. He was trapped by his own face. Unable to possess the object of his desire, he died, and in his place grew the flower we call the narcissus.

This myth gives us the three pillars of the pathology we discuss today:
1.  The inability to love others (rejecting Echo). 
2.  The lack of self-awareness (not \
was just a story. But by the late 19th century, psychiatrists began seeing a specific type of patient, one obsessed with greatness and power. They called this condition \

The word comes from the Greek megalo (great) and mania (madness). Initially, it was used to describe delusional fantasies where an individual believed they possessed exceptional abilities, fame, wealth, or even omnipotence. In the 1800s, this was often seen as a form of insanity associated with general paralysis or delusions of grandeur.  

However, note this critical detail, In the clinical sense, megalomania was distinct from modern narcissism because it often involved psychosis, a break from reality. A megalomaniac truly believed they were Jesus Christ or Napoleon. They were out of touch with reality. Today, classic narcissists know they aren't gods; they just act like they deserve to be treated as such. 

Freud, Jung, and the \

happened in the early 20th century, thanks to the turbulent relationship between Sigmund Freud and Carl Jung. \n\nFreud. In 1914, Freud published On Narcissism. He viewed narcissism as a necessary developmental stage. Infants are \

, they love only themselves. Ideally, as we mature, we redirect that love to others. Freud argued that if this process got stuck, the person remained fixated on themselves. \nJung. Here is the most important technical shift in our timeline. 

Was Megalomania ever in the DSM? 
No. By the time the first Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (DSM) was published in 1952, the term \
was already fading from clinical use. It was considered an old-fashioned term. The mental health field formally dropped \
as a clinical diagnosis because it was not listed in the DSM or the ICD. \n\nThe \

to Narcissism (1980). 
The modern diagnosis, Narcissistic Personality Disorder (NPD), made its first official appearance in the DSM-III in 1980.  

When they updated it, they didn't just change the name; they changed the definition. While \

focused on fantasies of wealth/power, the new NPD focused on behavioral patterns. 
1.  Added: Grandiosity (in fantasy OR behavior). 
2.  Added: Need for excessive admiration. 
3.  Added: Lack of empathy.

5.  Added: Exploitation of others.

You don't have to be insane to have NPD, you just have to be selfish enough to meet the criteria. 

How it is diagnosed today. 
According to the DSM criteria used today, (according to DSM-IV-TR and DSM-5), a mental health professional looks for a pervasive pattern of grandiosity. You must display five (or more) of the following nine traits to be diagnosed. 
Exaggerates achievements and talents. 
Preoccupied with fantasies of unlimited success, power, or brilliance. 
Believes they are \

and can only be understood by other special people. 
Requires excessive admiration. 
Has a sense of entitlement. 
Is interpersonally exploitative. 
Lacks empathy. 
Is often envious of others or believes others are envious of them. 
Shows arrogant, haughty behaviors or attitudes.  

The \

Problem. Why Women (and Empaths) are Enamored. 
Now we return to the myth. Can you relate to Echo? The one who had so much love to give that she lost her voice and her body trying to love someone who only saw himself. 

If you are an empath, you have likely experienced the \

of an empath entangled with a narcissist.  But why are empaths drawn to these figures?  \n\nThe psychology is counter-intuitive. Research from the University of Graz (Austria) published in Men's Health confirms that women are often initially more interested in dating men with narcissistic traits.  But it is not the \
they are attracted to; it is the confidence.  \n\nNarcissists are masters of the \

They are extroverted, take the lead in conversation, and act charming. In a sea of anxious or shy men, the narcissist radiates power and certainty. For an empath, who craves deep connection and emotional safety, that initial confidence looks like strength. The empath thinks, \

But the safety is a trap. 

Why You Feel Psychologically Damaged (The Science of the Trap).  
You feel damaged not because you are weak, but because you have been feeding a psychic vampire. 

As one analysis notes, empaths have a \

. Here is the cycle that damages you. 
1.  The Mirroring. The narcissist lacks a stable self. He looks at you (the empath) and sees your empathy. He mirrors it back, pretending to be the caring partner you want. You fall in love with the reflection of your own goodness. 
2.  The Depletion. Over time, the narcissist stops mirroring and starts exploiting. Because you can feel his emotions (anxiety, rage, boredom), you try to fix them. You pour your energy into calming him down or building him up. 
3.  The Invalidation. Unlike a normal argument where both parties compromise, the narcissist lacks empathy. He cannot validate your reality. Every time you bring up a hurt, he gaslights you or rages.  You stop trusting your own feelings. 
4.  The Fading. Just like Echo in the myth, you begin to \

Your needs disappear. Your voice becomes a repetition of his demands. You lose your body (your physical health) and your voice (your agency) trying to love him. 

Conclusion: Breaking the Reflection. 
The myth of Narcissus is a tragedy. But the tragedy of the modern empath is that you can walk away from the pool.

was dropped because it implied a delusion of power. Narcissists are powerful in one way, they have the power to destroy your self-esteem. But they are utterly impotent when it comes to love. \n\nYou were not \

to fall for him. You were tricked by evolution (attraction to confidence) and exploited by a personality structure that is nearly 2,000 years in the making.
