body.title: The myth of perfect pricing.
body.body:
<center>[Accurate](https://blog.accurate.com.br/confiabilidade-de-software/)</center>
Among the numerous challenges in the world of entrepreneurship, I believe that one of the most complicated steps for entrepreneurs is setting a **price** (preferably a fair one, obviously) for their own service or product. Mathematically speaking, the calculations exist, and they are made according to some very specific points (involving raw materials and transportation, just to mention a few examples), varying from person to person in relation to what they can deliver with skill to their clients, within the segment in which they have chosen to venture.
In theory, the pricing numbers for a service or product are commonly defined according to the distinct aspects that are inherent to them. However, in the real world (that is, in day-to-day practice), these numbers end up not being supported by the purchase demand imposed by customers. No, this is not a rule, but when meticulously calculated prices do not meet the expectations of others... It is necessary to recalculate the route in the sea of pricing; Ultimately, without customers willing to pay for a service or product, there's no way to generate cash flow.
<center>[GoCardless](https://gocardless.com/en-au/guides/posts/factors-to-consider-when-pricing-your-products-or-services/)</center>
Even the most daring entrepreneurs (that is, those with more money to play this game of imposition) often have difficulties in the pricing phase because they need to know how the public will react to what they will have to pay to access. The exact numbers of the calculations will always be available, but I think it is the end customer who really dictates the rules of the game, because it is the money in the other person's pocket that will \
into each company's cash register. Without \

of ideas, the numbers can become a headache.\nAll this made me think about how different theory is from practice, because in the real world, personal connections weigh much more than mathematical calculations within this context of entrepreneurship. Numbers matter (at a \

level), because they translate into profits and are the basis of capitalism; on the other hand, the good old relationship involving emotional articulations combined with traditional common sense is a combination that never goes out of style, and that is still as relevant as it was decades ago. Entrepreneurs and customers need to maintain stable relationships at all times.
---
<center>**El mito de la fijación de precios perfecta.**</center>
Entre los numerosos desafíos del mundo del emprendimiento, considero que uno de los pasos más complejos para los emprendedores es fijar un **precio** (preferiblemente justo, por supuesto) para su servicio o producto. Matemáticamente hablando, los cálculos existen y se realizan en función de puntos muy específicos (como materias primas y transporte, por mencionar algunos ejemplos), que varían de una persona a otra según la calidad del servicio que pueden ofrecer a sus clientes, dentro del segmento en el que han decidido incursionar.
En teoría, los precios de un servicio o producto se definen comúnmente según sus características intrínsecas. Sin embargo, en la práctica, estos precios no siempre se corresponden con la demanda de los clientes. No, no es una regla, pero cuando los precios calculados meticulosamente no satisfacen las expectativas de los demás, es necesario replantear la estrategia de precios. En definitiva, sin clientes dispuestos a pagar por un servicio o producto, es imposible generar flujo de caja.
Incluso los emprendedores más audaces (es decir, aquellos con más capital para participar en este juego de imposición) suelen tener dificultades en la fase de fijación de precios, ya que necesitan saber cómo reaccionará el público ante el precio de acceso. Si bien las cifras exactas de los cálculos siempre estarán disponibles, creo que es el cliente final quien realmente dicta las reglas del juego, porque es el dinero en el bolsillo del otro el que \
a la caja registradora de cada empresa. Sin una \

de ideas, los números pueden convertirse en un verdadero quebradero de cabeza.\nTodo esto me hizo reflexionar sobre la gran diferencia entre la teoría y la práctica, porque en el mundo real, las conexiones personales pesan mucho más que los cálculos matemáticos en el contexto del emprendimiento. Los números importan (a un nivel \

), porque se traducen en ganancias y son la base del capitalismo; por otro lado, la buena y vieja relación que combina la expresión emocional con el sentido común tradicional es una combinación que nunca pasa de moda y que sigue siendo tan relevante como hace décadas. Emprendedores y clientes necesitan mantener relaciones estables en todo momento. ---
**O mito da precificação perfeita.**
Dentre os inúmeros desafios no mundo do empreendedorismo, eu penso que uma das etapas mais complicadas para os empreendedores seja colocar um **preço** (preferencialmente justo, obviamente) no seu próprio serviço ou produto. Matematicamente falando os cálculos existem, e são feitos de acordo com alguns pontos bem específicos (envolvendo matéria-prima e deslocamento, apenas para mencionar alguns exemplos), variando de pessoa para pessoa em relação ao que elas podem entregar com aptidão aos seus clientes, dentro do segmento no qual elas optaram por empreender. Em tese, os números da precificação de um serviço ou produto são comumente definidos de acordo com os aspectos distintos que são inerentes a eles. No entanto, no mundo real (ou seja, na prática do dia-a-dia), esses números acabam não sendo sustentados pela demanda de compra imposta pelos clientes. Não, isso não é uma regra, mas quando preços milimetricamente calculados não atendem as expectativas alheias... É preciso recalcular a rota no mar da precificação; afinal de contas, sem clientes dispostos a pagar por um serviço ou produto, não há como fazer o capital girar em caixa. Até mesmo para os empreendedores mais arrojados (ou seja, que tem mais dinheiro para jogar esse jogo de imposição) costumam ter suas dificuldades na fase que envolve a precificação porque é preciso saber como o público irá reagir ao que eles terão que pagar para acessar. Os números exatos dos cálculos sempre vão estar disponíveis, mas eu acho que é o cliente final quem realmente dita as regras do jogo, porque é o dinheiro que está no bolso da outra pessoa que vai “pular” no caixa de cada empresa. Sem haver “conciliação” de ideias, os números podem se tornar uma dor de cabeça. Tudo isso me fez pensar no quanto a teoria é diferente da prática, porque no mundo real, as conexões pessoais pesam muito mais do que os cálculos matemáticos dentro desse contexto de empreendedorismo. Os números importam (em um nível “assustador”), porque eles traduzem lucros e são à base do capitalismo; por outro lado, a boa e velha relação envolvendo articulações emocionais aliada ao tradicional bom senso é uma combinação que nunca sai de moda, e que ainda se mostra tão atual quanto há décadas atrás. Empreendedores e clientes precisam ter relações sempre estáveis. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@wiseagent/the-myth-of-perfect-pricing-rc)

body.title: My Eldest Son's 21st Simple  Birthday Celebration
body.body:
Have a great day all hivers here @bayanihive ! 
Just sharing our simple birthday celebration of my eldest son Vench. 
Wow! Years are running so fast . This son of mine is now already 21 years old. It signifies that I am already getting old now. Thanks  to Almighty God for giving my son a healthy life now at 21. 

![1000089983.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/48UmTwsyEwK8BqCU4PHyNWd3TxRd5anQmcyeSM747aipYYU4RV2z63RqbqSf5fjY2s.png)

On May 4, 2026 we had a simple birthday  celebration for my eldest son Vench . It was just a simple celebration but for sure it made my son felt that I always give him the importance of offerings as thanks giving to God for the gift of life . It doesn't matter how big or small the offering is. What matters  most is to give thanks to God for all the blessings especially the good health and longevity of life . 

This son of mine is a handsome one . He is my first blessing from above . When he was a child , he use to cry  most of the time without a cause. I dont know why . Now, he is still making noise but in the microphone because he really love music. He used to sing in a karaoke during his free time . This boy is a talented one . 

![1000089982.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/AK54EirAuDVQ6r3BxGULw3U8WY1ztyvvAoP6955S4UY3faPyGJbM9imu8EEuRTa.jpg)

![1000089941.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EoyPzdHd6FpgmhW6Bdd9Rt5KyzU1NtLg7Hvbnef22vCEYB4QxjNKxCiTXp8UB6VKybW.jpg)

I keep saving money for my childrens' birthday . Even in the midst of crisis now , I find it hard to save money just to make them happy on their special day. 

On May 3, 2026 a day before son's birthday , my wife asking me If I have money . I gave her the budget that I have saved and we went to the market to buy some  kilos of meat , fish ,and fruits. Everytime there is occasion , my wife's brothers and sisters, nieces and nephews were came to join us and helped us in preparing the foods . 

![1000089897.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EowJTgXLQYW8Hs8gjDGSErxQK2RPaV1gzffAZdtNnQ7GQYcab7PBjP3mcSAbgWcyggN.jpg)

![1000089901.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/23tvgoR4FgfrbWfKzX9m9QU6zJLfiwXnFELA5VNWCGqPxonRseTRLrZMdsAhC2dQpQS36.jpg)

![1000089912.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/23tveVy1PexBYxZQSoT6E6Dc1j4CZ3fLwwCUn5Fngd5dtqKJyB5Qqvqk3EkrY1cz8Jf3W.jpg)

![1000089913.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/Eos1qmD7NnpSBZd5Mk3YJz3CiYbBeraCnqsjQr5oEBuiwZDcod2FuT2pAmPJ5RybiUt.jpg)

Cooking dishes and preparing it needs multiple efforts to do . Thanks to my wife's family  for their cooperation. Celebration is not complete without visitors like friends and relatives . Occasion is somewhat stressful at the same time enjoyable. 
Visitors of my son  were coming and drinking beer with him . I always reminded him to drink wine moderately. I will not deprive him of what he want to do as long as he will not exploit it and put limit to everything . Health is our priority and we need to love ourself to live longer. 

![1000089916.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EpnDDMTZkEGARpe6gveWiXQuMXmNHmMerAPS6Xxn3wJ5tEDC7wesjTyAoUrtJRUGifJ.jpg)

![1000089921.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/245TC7WCJwhRKgPvo6XEM29hV4DmizSMyUkdPNsznekRz1uCztZHkrfK6Y78R3GmJMENq.jpg)

It was ended a simple celebration of my son's birthday but it was  memorable and enjoyable . 

Thanks to all who read my blog .
Till my next blog friends . 

The lead pictures in scrapbook are edited in canva and all are mine . 

God bless everyone .

body.body: Interesting point. Hive does move independently at times. BTC can influence the overall mood, but it doesn’t explain Hive’s spikes — those come from its own liquidity quirks. The way I see it: BTC goes up → people get more active → some buy Hive → small spikes appear. But that’s not the same as BTC +5% = Hive +50%. If the correlation were direct, LTC wouldn’t be sitting still right now.

body.body:
Swaps are large portion of our features and revenue model but they are not our only offering. Our main competitors are focused solely on this functionality, mainnet to mainnet swaps across major chains. 
Magi is fundamentally built differently, allowing for custody of all of our supported tokens in any of our supported wallets (such as holding BTC on Magi in an EVM wallet), allowing for feeless (RC based) transfers of these assets on Magi. 

We in many ways evolved whats possible with trustless crosschain tech far beyond what other crosschain protocols considered doing. 

Our goal is not only to provide a convenient swap interface, but also to simplify onboarding by allowing users to interact with our full feature set easily from any wallet.
We used Thorchain code heavily as reference but did not fork it, that would have created a multitude of integration issues. 

They did a lot of heavy lifting and made mistakes, basically for us to learn from and not repeat.

body.title: Hive Music Festival Week #186 - Round 3 || Deeper in love by Sir Jude Nnam
body.body:
>Hello everyone! I am @ernesto6402, and it is beautiful to be here; I am happy to be a part of this week's hive musical festival. It has been a while I participated in this beautiful musical event. Due to how busy I have become, I have not been active here on hive for sometime now. That notwithstanding, I have made some adjustment that will put right back on track, and it feels good to be back. 

>¡Hola a todos! Soy @ernesto6402, y es un placer estar aquí; me alegra formar parte del festival musical de Hive de esta semana. Hacía tiempo que no participaba en este maravilloso evento musical. Debido a lo ocupado que he estado, llevaba un tiempo sin estar activo aquí en Hive. A pesar de ello, he hecho algunos ajustes que me permitirán volver a la normalidad, y me alegro de estar de vuelta. 


For this week's festival, I have chosen a gospel song by a popular Nigerian Catholic liturgical composer. I will be performing the song deeper in love by Sir Jude Nnam. I have been a catholic chorister here in Nigerian for years now, and this song is no doubt one of my favorite Nigerian Catholic hymn. There are so many things to be loved about the song, but the lyrics is what I love the most. For me, it is simply a song with deep message, and I guess it will be same for every Christian who comes across it.
>Para el festival de esta semana, he elegido una canción de gospel de un popular compositor litúrgico católico nigeriano. Interpretaré la canción «Deeper in Love», de Sir Jude Nnam. Llevo años cantando en un coro católico aquí en Nigeria, y esta canción es sin duda uno de mis himnos católicos nigerianos favoritos. Hay muchas cosas que me encantan de esta canción, pero lo que más me gusta es la letra. Para mí, es simplemente una canción con un mensaje profundo, y supongo que será lo mismo para cualquier cristiano que la escuche. 
 

In summary, the song simply emphasized the need to draw closer to God. The need to love God, and the need to constantly make effort towards that. The song is actually a beautiful prayer, and  the prayers of this song is one that should be said by all Christians. That God who is love may continuously hold us closer to himself; Amen🙏.  
>En resumen, la canción simplemente hacía hincapié en la necesidad de acercarnos más a Dios. La necesidad de amar a Dios y la necesidad de esforzarnos constantemente por lograrlo. La canción es, en realidad, una hermosa oración, y  las palabras de esta canción son unas que todos los cristianos deberían rezar. Que Dios, que es amor, nos mantenga siempre cerca de Él; Amén🙏.  

For the purpose of my performance today, I will be doing a freestyle of the song \

. The original song is an easy going Nigerian Catholic hymn with a little bit of Afro vibes, but I will be doing a completely different thing with the song. I will be using just the grand piano from my keyboard while I solo the song in my own unique way. >Para mi actuación de hoy, voy a interpretar una versión libre de la canción «Deeper in Love». La canción original es un himno católico nigeriano de estilo relajado con un ligero toque afro, pero yo le daré un giro completamente diferente. Utilizaré únicamente el sonido de piano de cola de mi teclado mientras toco la canción a mi manera, con un estilo propio y único.
**LYRICS / LETRA**
+ **Chorus** Take me deeper in love with you Jesus, o deeper in love Hold me closer in love with you Jesus o closer in love with you >Haz que mi amor por ti sea más profundo Jesús, oh, más profundo en el amor Acércame más a ti en el amor Jesús, oh, más cerca de ti en el amor + **Verse 1** Lord there is a longing only you can fill A ranging tempest only you can still My soul is thirsting for you, o my God Lord quench my thirst Lord feed my soul >Señor, hay un anhelo que solo tú puedes colmar Una tormenta embravecida que solo tú puedes calmar Mi alma te anhela, oh Dios mío Señor, sacia mi sed Señor, alimenta mi alma + **Verse 2** Yes from sunrise to sunrise i seek your face From day to day i long for your touch To hold my hand Lord lest i fall To draw me nearer closer to thee >Sí, desde el amanecer hasta el amanecer busco tu rostro Día tras día anhelo tu contacto Para que me tomes de la mano, Señor, no sea que caiga Para acercarme más y más a ti [Source](https://www.musixmatch.com/lyrics/Sir-Jude-Nnam-2/In-Love-With-Jesus) https://youtu.be/-HRDit6YefA?si=qeIAs8zqJttIr7Ph
**The Original Song**
--- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=ernesto6402/385896fb)

body.title: Baked fish [ENG/ESP]
body.body:
> Wanting to eat something different, out of the ordinary, today we felt like eating a delicious baked fish. Well, my mother wanted to eat it, and I, as her faithful companion, was there to prepare this delicious menu for our lunch. Do you want to see how we did it? I tell you, super easy and simple to prepare, with few ingredients and it cooks in a short time.
![post hive (52).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23zGpyDXVQndUVfv3v4n6hCFfR7J5zGs4NUTPgbS2yJGBxTvtgveghVi8JmmCpusrLjVi.png)
--- ## Ingredients: - 1 kilo of golden fish - 1 onion - 2 small potatoes - Chili and paprika - Seasonings ## Preparation: Well, for the preparation, as I said, it is simple and easy, we place our fish on the tray and there we are going to add the seasonings, the onion, the paprika cut into strips or small pieces, as you like.
![post hive (53).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23xVTtr6qaugwWzEHuygxHUXWH5pjNvhaSKk71MViatxkpnNowMef66L6XR1aYC1taUzN.png)
![post hive (54).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23u673V4y8yPzUar2FfqLhtQTU1gFYAEef9cLcxZBjFbDujEHgeWkDhRvo2wjWV2pbQRh.png)
We also add the potato, chopped into small pieces, a little bit of parsley or cilantro, whichever you have. We season it with a bit of oil, and with this ready, all that remains is to put our fish in the oven.
![post hive (55).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23vhyb3nqefhQhgkwHNQRSzBPkAkRXBgK3pyUf54QbeRoTW9XftgTPe32HUBpfPYg22u1.png)
Important, cover it with aluminum foil, for better cooking, for a time of 30 minutes.
![post hive (56).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23yTje9cLFskqHEpJSFp3xVWQWLVggVq8L4nzxRpze6AQBob7sYifzWqZV8pRv4jXyvRo.png)
And this is how our fish turns out, very tasty, really, I hadn't eaten fish like this in a long time, I recommend it to you, healthier, without frying, and as you can see, I repeat, easy to prepare.
![post hive (58).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23y8x7My3awdja5DZszfGoL5LfnWAogGmxh99x9dxsAt8gGQDYc1jHPZqsmfuTSP9vLz7.png)
How are you, have you prepared the fish this way? In my hometown it is usually eaten fried, just as tasty, but it never hurts to vary it a bit, looking to eat healthier, that is what is important. Well friends, I hope you liked my menu today, let's see what we prepare tomorrow, something sweet and tasty, maybe, we keep creating, trying new recipes. 😋
SPANISH VERSION

Con ganas de comer algo diferente, fuera de lo normal, hoy nos antojamos de comer un rico pescado al horno, bueno mi madre quería comerlo, y yo como su fiel compañera, estuve allí para preparar este rico menú para nuestro almuerzo. Quieren ver como lo hicimos, les cuento super fácil y sencillo de preparar, con pocos ingredientes y se cocina en poco tiempo.

![post hive (52).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23zGpyDXVQndUVfv3v4n6hCFfR7J5zGs4NUTPgbS2yJGBxTvtgveghVi8JmmCpusrLjVi.png)
--- ## Ingredients: - 1 kilo pescado dorado - 1 cebolla - 2 papas pequeñas - Ají y pimentón - condimentos ## Preparation: Pues bien para la preparación, como dije es sencillo y fácil, colocamos nuestro pescado en la bandeja y allí le vamos a ir agregando los aliños, la cebolla, el pimentón cortados en tiras o trocitos pequeños, como gusten.

body.title: Replace the batteries - Batterien ersetzen
body.body:
## EN (DE unten) 
  
  Hello, everyone,

I'm wondering what this is supposed to measure? I still have an old Tangen generator—yeah, totally old-school, no app. Okay, it's for my wife's account; I have a different account for myself, where I do everything through the app.

The Tangenerator is probably about 15 years old and still works, but what really gets on my nerves is that it’s been showing me “Replace batteries” for what feels like two years now.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJMww3jm6nUMUuKKhHuFhQ51sN84abnWR8D4jQkrRgvs/grafik.png)

But if I take the card out and put it back in, it says “Battery almost empty” or something like that, and then I can use the generator normally. But not when the “Replace Batteries” message appears.

Yeah, now I have to take the card out and put it back in more often, and then it works. It annoys me that this message pops up and won’t let me continue. It would be fine if it just said “almost empty” and eventually ran out completely. I’m out of luck if I don’t have a battery on hand—the warning came early enough.

Of course, I don’t use it that often—otherwise, it wouldn’t have lasted a good two years. But when I think about how often that useless message popped up, I could probably use the batteries in there (is it just one?? hmmm) for another 2–3 years.



Imagine you start your car, and then a message pops up saying, “Please refuel,” and the car shuts off again—even though you could easily drive another 100 km. You have to do this five times before you can finally get going.



Translated with DeepL.com (free version)
  
 ## DE 
  Hallo liebe Community,

ich frage mich, was der misst soll? Ich habe noch einen alten Tangenerator, ja voll Oldschool, keine App. Ok ist für das Konto meiner Frau, ich habe für mich ein anderes Konto, da mache ich alles nur in der App.

Der Tangenerator ist vermutlich schon an die 15 Jahre alt und funktioniert noch immer, aber was mir tierisch auf den Keks geht ist das der mir schon seit gefühlt 2 Jahren anzeigt \

.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJMww3jm6nUMUuKKhHuFhQ51sN84abnWR8D4jQkrRgvs/grafik.png)

Aber wenn ich die Karte herausnehme und wieder hereinstecke, dann kommt Batterie fast leer oder so ähnlich und dann kann ich normal den Generator verwenden. Aber nicht bei der anzeige \

.

Ja inzwischen muss ich die Karte öfter herausnehmen und wieder hereinstecken und dann geht es. Mich nervt, dass es diese Anzeige gibt und mich nicht weiter machen lässt. Es würde langen, wenn angezeigt wird, fast leer und irgendwann ist es ganz leer. Habe ich Pech, wenn ich dann keine Batterie zur Hand habe, die Anzeige kam ja früh genug.

Klar so oft benutze ich es gar nicht, sonst wären es nicht wohl schon gut 2 Jahre. Wenn ich aber überlege, wie oft diese unnütze Anzeige kam, da könnte ich die Batterien die drin sind (ist es nicht nur eine?? hmmm), wohl noch 2-3 Jahre nutzen.

Stellt euch vor, ihr würdet euer Auto zünden und dann kommt eine Anzeige, bitte tanken und das Auto geht wieder aus, obwohl ihr noch locker 100 km fahren könnt. Ihr müsst das dann 5-mal machen, bis ihr dann doch losfahren könnt.

body.title: La Periquera [ESP-ENG]
body.body: /> Coronando al parque Calixto García, en la Ciudad de Holguín, tanto viajeros como nativos observan con atención una construcción monumental que corona al parque. En unos de sus laterales se encuentra La Periquera - La Casa Consistorial - Ayuntamiento - Museo Municipal de la Ciudad de los Parques. Un lugar cargado de historias, misterios, cultura, anécdotas y leyendas. Desde el misterioso amor vivido por una damisela hasta las acciones mambisas por aquellas guerras de independencias libradas por los cubanos contra el ejército español. > Crowning Calixto García Park in the city of Holguín, both travelers and locals carefully observe a monumental structure that dominates the square. On one of its sides stands La Periquera — the Town Hall — City Council — and Municipal Museum of the City of Parks. A place filled with stories, mysteries, culture, anecdotes, and legends. From the mysterious love experienced by a young lady to the mambí actions during those wars of independence fought by Cubans against the Spanish army.

/> Entre líneas pronunciadas, texturas increibles, el gran ritmo de sus columnas, balcones, ventanas y puertas, le otorgan al lugar una distinción increíble resaltada por los colores contrastantes y vibrantes, bañado con los colores de nuestra bandera, la bandera cubana. Allí en ese maravilloso lugar se preserva parte de nuestra identidad, de nuestra historia y es epicentro de lo que ocurre en la ciudad de Holguín. Contemplarlo desde el parque, desde ese enorme parque, da a la vista un espectáculo que comenzó a construirse hace ya 300 años. > Between pronounced lines, incredible textures, and the strong rhythm of its columns, balconies, windows, and doors, the place is granted an extraordinary distinction, highlighted by contrasting and vibrant colors, bathed in the shades of our flag — the Cuban flag. There, in that marvelous place, a part of our identity and our history is preserved, and it serves as the epicenter of what happens in the city of Holguín. Gazing at it from the park, from that vast park, offers a spectacle that began to take shape 300 years ago.

/> Ah!!!!! pero visitarlo, entrar a su patio, a su interior, es evidenciar aún más la grandeza del lugar: su pozo central, las columnas con sus arcos, las barandas, el paisaje urbano que nos muestra es espléndido. Es un mundo increíblemente diferente, es casi un viaje en el tiempo, al pasado donde adquirimos como nuestra esa arquitectura. Comprendes entonces el por qué de que se hayan resguardado aquí, en este lugar, las tropas españolas, y a base de fuego y gritos fueron sacados (aquí nace el nombre de la Periquera), en sus uniformes verdes y rojos que parecían pericos en su jaula. > Ah! But visiting it—stepping into its courtyard, into its interior—reveals even more of the place’s grandeur: its central well, the columns with their arches, the railings, and the splendid urban landscape it offers. It feels like an entirely different world, almost like a journey back in time, to the past where we embraced this architecture as our own. You then understand why the Spanish troops took shelter here, in this very place, and how, through fire and shouts, they were driven out (this is where the name La Periquera originates), dressed in their green and red uniforms that made them look like parrots in a cage.

/> También, el silencio del lugar, te hacía recordar esa leyenda de amor que se vivió entre los túneles subterráneos que conectaban a la Periquera - La Iglesia de San José - y la Loma de Cruz y que usaban los enamorados para verse. Recuerdas esa historia de amor con desenlace fatal pero que aún retumba en silencio en sus paredes y que según las personas se logra escuchar de vez en vez el lamento de una joven. > Also, the silence of the place made you recall that love legend lived within the underground tunnels that connected La Periquera, the Church of San José, and Loma de la Cruz—tunnels lovers used to meet in secret. You remember that love story with its tragic ending, a story that still echoes silently through its walls, and according to some people, the lament of a young woman can still be heard from time to time.

/> Todo estaba allí, a cada paso se enriquecía nuestra presencia entre esos muros, en cada momento nos enamorábamos más de la Periquera, entonces se desato la cámara para poder recoger cada elemento que nos permitiera recordar o, simplemente, cerrar los ojos y re-visitar ese lugar tan encantador. > Everything was there; with every step, our presence among those walls felt richer. With each moment, we fell more in love with La Periquera, and then the camera came alive so we could capture every element that would allow us to remember—or simply close our eyes and revisit—that enchanting place.

/>

body.title: MONEY OR SKILLS
body.body:
![images (2) (20).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/henrietta27/23tmUbP1CKP7EGvsxvDbxBEE966uqNQkTT7gECPVDnKeYsTLp6CfkwA3TrXboAGtwVS4c.jpeg)
[source](https://www.pexels.com/search/counting%20money/) 

I would always advocate for skills over charity because by enabling a person with a particular kind of skill it goes to show that you are teaching them how to fish and not just feeding them with the fish as the popular saying goes. Most people often confused charity with giving of monetary gifts to people who are in need but reverse is the case because even in the Bible, alms giving is not limited to money but it cuts across every aspect which includes food items, teaching, cleaning, helping the poor, granting AIDS scholarships and so many more.

Recently, I watched a story on social media where a philanthropist came out to accuse a lady of disguising as been poor when at one point in time this person has helped her to establish herself so that she can be financially stable. 

Apparently, when this woman was given the large sum of money to take care of herself and her children she spent it recklessly and within three months she was back on the streets again. In turn, people were accusing this philanthropist that you do not give people money especially when you know that what they really need is to learn a skill that would help them function in life.

Often times when you give people money they do not appreciate it and it is hurtful because your effort and hard work put in making that money is regarded as useless and ungrateful by another person. In other words, this is why I subscribe to using my money to buy food items or household things to gift out to people who needs them and who would appreciate them with all their hearts.

This is my participation in the @hive-reachout community weekly contest, to join in check through this [link] (https://peakd.com/hive-178437/@hive-reachout/hivereachout-weekly-prompt-98charity-money-or-skill-lus)

body.title: Moody but beautiful #monomad
body.body: Greetings lovely members of the community. I hope you all are doing great and enjoying quality time with your loved ones. > समुदाय के प्यारे सदस्यों को नमस्कार। मुझे आशा है कि आप सभी अच्छे होंगे और अपने प्रियजनों के साथ गुणवत्तापूर्ण समय का आनंद ले रहे है। ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeAproJ2QTcTNEqMhu9ejWMPv5LQaccnFgDToHrcqdjZz/img_3212.heic) The weather flipped so fast. Just a few days ago it was hot, and now it’s cold enough to grab a jacket before stepping out. Rain, thunder, even a bit of hail here and there… it all feels sudden, but also kind of nice in its own way. >मौसम अचानक कितना बदल गया है। कुछ दिन पहले तक गर्मी थी, और अब बाहर निकलने से पहले जैकेट चाहिए। बारिश, गरज, कभी-कभी ओले… सब कुछ एकदम से बदल गया, लेकिन फिर भी अच्छा लग रहा है अपने तरीके से। ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS5K3yV8UCyDpyMfTPYTBArSDUhF3cVG8qza5sjyYJwin/img_3214.heic) Thick, heavy clouds stacked over the hills, like they were moving slowly but carrying a lot. The light kept breaking through in patches, falling on the mountains and making some parts glow while others stayed dark. It felt very cinematic, like a quiet storm building up. >कल का आसमान अलग ही लग रहा था। भारी-भारी बादल पहाड़ों के ऊपर छाए हुए थे, जैसे धीरे-धीरे चल रहे हों लेकिन अंदर बहुत कुछ लिए हुए। बीच-बीच में रोशनी बादलों से निकलकर पहाड़ों पर पड़ रही थी कहीं उजाला, कहीं अंधेरा… पूरा सीन बहुत cinematic लग रहा था। ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNQWuuf3BEqjg4XVGxGKScDNaM5e7BjcZmYdYS2rHuLtf/img_3215.heic) From the viewpoint, the layers of hills just kept fading into each other. The closer ones were sharp, full of houses and trees, and the ones far away looked soft and misty. It almost didn’t feel real for a second. >ऊपर से देखो तो पहाड़ों की परतें बस खत्म ही नहीं हो रही थीं। पास वाले साफ दिख रहे थे, घर और पेड़ों के साथ, और दूर वाले हल्के-हल्के धुंध में गायब हो रहे थे। एक पल के लिए सब कुछ थोड़ा unreal सा लगा। ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQgDrM1FBXpHYcUHdx5FSWvFgRS7S8oeVgcsByei2jzHp/img_3216.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY1f27BRx2tQ95YsYEDBa5cKRkmrTpPcHcFSyh8fWHoAu/img_3217.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUsEsdhjsNqrynyFm6ycPT5GmiD9rEgSDxKXFnWaqBBAd/img_3218.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY33AqPkE9zrpeEDrwwVmFv8bAHTXxmLz5Hb9AHRC1HT3/img_3219.heic) There was a couple there taking pictures, and when I looked up at the view behind them, I just stopped. It was one of those “wait a second” moments. >वहाँ एक जोड़ा भी फोटो ले रहा था, और जब मैंने उनके पीछे का view देखा तो बस रुक गई। ऐसा लगा जैसे “एक सेकंड, ये कैप्चर करना पड़ेगा।” बिना सोचे बस फोटो ले ली। ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVVAd8LPbqu2iNEvbVaR9ZyDEqZSyRgue7aUFFpXakedz/img_3220.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbauPZkjuUAEYsTTV7z9RCevDciZSdJuoP9BzH75BuHVB/img_3221.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQufK1Un3vpiUvHi6Q99Py93kPJ7BuJrv1xG82y6J6GYf/img_3222.heic) I don’t know why, but I actually like this kind of weather sometimes. It’s not bright or cheerful, but it makes you feel something. >पता नहीं क्यों, पर ऐसा मौसम कभी-कभी अच्छा लगता है। खुश वाला नहीं होता, पर कुछ feel जरूर कराता है। That’s all for today folks. Happy snapping. 💜💙 Thankyou for visiting 🌸 >आज के लिए बस इतना ही दोस्तों। तस्वीरें लेने का आनंद लें। 💜💙 आने के लिए धन्यवाद 🌸

This made the battle even more interesting.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23tRzkK9NCE6at8dYb1ifSUjduNkRqCZbNBeSq9oei77wAQWjZivPUgtssgw7bHYy6UD5.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23tRxSKKS3rnjTRf7j79AWnaD1cRs2XSjyZctasLNxRTNyrDGLbxS7Sn97Z6ojST82drZ.png)

body.title: Una historia real que no me deja dormir | A true story that won't let me sleep
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdZtN3V4wbxKcdQK5XR5obSyLoWVaHFrk3gUPqusbEb1x/1778004005905.jpg)

Esto me pasó hace como un año, y todavía no encuentro una explicación que me deje tranquilo.
Yo vivía solo en un apartamento pequeño, en un tercer piso. Nada lujoso, pero cómodo. Era un lugar bastante tranquilo, casi siempre en silencio, de esos donde cualquier ruido se nota.
​Todo empezó con algo simple: golpes.
No eran constantes ni fuertes. Más bien eran golpes secos, como si alguien tocara una pared con los nudillos. A veces venían del lado de la cocina, otras veces del baño. Nunca le di mucha importancia, pensé que era algún vecino.
Pero un detalle empezó a molestarme.
Los golpes casi siempre pasaban en la madrugada, entre las 2 y las 4.
​Una noche, ya cansado, decidí quedarme despierto para ver si podía identificar de dónde venían exactamente. Apagué todo y me senté en la sala en silencio.
A las 3:12 a.m. escuché el primer golpe.
Seco. Claro.
Venía de la pared que da al baño.
Me acerqué despacio, tratando de no hacer ruido. Me quedé ahí, pegado a la pared.
Pasaron unos segundos… y entonces volvieron a sonar.
But esta vez no fue un solo golpe.
Fueron tres, seguidos.
Y justo después… escuché algo que no era un golpe.
Era como si alguien pasara la mano por la pared, raspando lentamente.
Te juro que en ese momento se me erizó todo el cuerpo.
Me alejé y no volví a acercarme esa noche.
​Al día siguiente hablé con el vecino del otro lado. Le pregunté si él escuchaba ruidos en la madrugada.
Me dijo que no. Que él casi ni estaba en casa por trabajo.
Ahí fue cuando me empezó a dar mala espina.
​Esa misma noche, los ruidos volvieron.
Pero esta vez no venían del baño.
Venían del pasillo.
Salí del cuarto y me quedé mirando hacia la oscuridad. No encendí la luz.
Escuché los pasos.
Lentos. Arrastrados.
Venían hacia mí.
No eran como los pasos normales de alguien caminando. Era más como si alguien estuviera caminando descalzo, muy despacio, arrastrando los pies.
Y se detenerieron justo frente a mí.
Yo no veía a nadie.
Pero estaba seguro de que había algo ahí.
No me moví. No respiré fuerte. Nada.
Y entonces… sentí algo.
Una presión leve en el hombro.
Como una mano.
Salí corriendo sin mirar atrás. Dormí esa noche en casa de un amigo.
​A los pocos días me mudé.
Tiempo después, por curiosidad, hablé con el antiguo dueño del apartamento. Le pregunté si alguien había tenido problemas ahí.
Al principio dudó, pero luego me dijo algo que todavía me pone la piel de gallina.
La persona que vivía antes que yo… se quejaba exactamente de lo mismo.
Golpes en las paredes.
Pasos en la madrugada.
Y la sensación de que alguien estaba dentro del apartamento… aunque viviera solo.
Pero eso no fue lo peor.
Lo peor fue lo último que me dijo:
“Él también decía que lo tocaban.”

This happened to me about a year ago, and I still can't find an explanation that leaves me at peace.
I lived alone in a small apartment on the third floor. Nothing fancy, but comfortable. It was a fairly quiet place, almost always silent, one of those places where any noise stands out.
​It all started with something simple: knocking.
They weren't constant or loud. Rather, they were dry thuds, as if someone were tapping a wall with their knuckles. Sometimes they came from the kitchen side, other times from the bathroom. I never paid much attention to it, thinking it was just a neighbor.
But one detail began to bother me.
The noises almost always happened in the early morning, between 2 and 4 a.m.
​One night, exhausted, I decided to stay awake to see if I could figure out exactly where they were coming from. I turned everything off and sat in the living room in silence.
At 3:12 a.m. I heard the first knock.
Dry. Clear.
It came from the wall facing the bathroom.
I approached slowly, trying not to make any noise. I stood there, pressed against the wall.
A few seconds passed... and then they knocked again.
But this time it wasn't just a single knock.
There were three, one after another.
And right after that... I heard something that wasn't a knock.
It was as if someone were dragging a hand across the wall, scraping slowly.
I swear to you, every hair on my body stood up at that moment.
I moved away and didn't go near it again that night.
​The next day, I spoke to the neighbor next door. I asked him if he heard noises in the early morning.
He said no. He was hardly ever home because of work.
That's when things started to feel really wrong.
​That same night, the noises returned.
But this time they didn't come from the bathroom.
They came from the hallway.
I came out of the bedroom and stared into the darkness. I didn't turn on the light.
I heard the footsteps.
Slow. Shuffling.
They were coming toward me.
They weren't like normal footsteps. It sounded more like someone walking barefoot, very slowly, dragging their feet.
And they stopped right in front of me.
I didn't see anyone.
But I was sure there was something there.
I didn't move. I didn't breathe hard. Nothing.
And then... I felt something.
A slight pressure on my shoulder.
Like a hand.
I ran out without looking back. I spent that night at a friend's house.
​A few days later, I moved out.
Sometime later, out of curiosity, I spoke to the former owner of the apartment. I asked him if anyone had ever had any problems there.
At first, he hesitated, but then he told me something that still gives me goosebumps.
The person who lived there before me... complained about exactly the same thing.
Knocking on the walls.
Footsteps in the early morning.
And the feeling that someone was inside the apartment... even though they lived alone.
But that wasn't the worst part.
The worst part was the last thing he told me:

body.title: Keeping liquidity in SWAP.HIVE is a big problem
body.body:
Today Hive had a nice pump. After a very long time, there is a price movement for Hive. This has not been the case for the last few months, I should say. It was very good to see a positive price improvement. I had bought a few Hive when the price was around 6 cents. Now for the 2-cent pump, I thought of selling Hive and booking a profit back. Unfortunately, I don't have the Hive in the main balance, but instead I had them as SWAP.HIVE. Now I have to convert them from Hive Engine to the native Hive Wallet and then sell them in the market. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTJhMzpePBRqSQjvAYEihvtcpySZTuqcoK72MSQtXV4bZ/image.png)

Source - Gemini

This is a good opportunity because getting a 2-cent difference itself is a great thing. I would like to make use of this opportunity and sell some Hive to probably buy back later. But unfortunately, I do not have liquidity in the form of Hive. Instead, I have all my holdings as SWAP.HIVE. The main reason why I held some Hive in the first place instead of selling them was to book profits whenever I could and then buy back again. More like a small trade. But my funds are locked in as SWAP.HIVE. Now I cannot rely on the liquidity of SWAP.USDT or SWAP.HBD because they fluctuate, and their liquidity will also be very low right now. 

If I have to use the native Hive Engine withdrawal option, I might lose a lot of money in the swapping part. Sometimes there can be offers like these where there will be a temporary pump and the price goes back to the same. In such cases, a small profit can be seen if played right. I think there should be more swap options available in the future that can take care of the automated trading.

body.title: Bitcoin is starting to move higher again — and it’s not just a fluctuating price
body.body:
Bitcoin is starting to move higher again — and it’s not just a fluctuating price
Bitcoin has started to move higher in earnest, and all major sources show the same price action. In my active tab, the price is listed at $81,260 (updated May 5), and the other platforms reflect the same value. This consistency across sources confirms that the upward movement is real, not noise.

>

This is not a “pump” out of the blue. This is a move that comes after a long period of consolidation. Bitcoin has a clear pattern: it sits still, then suddenly starts. That’s exactly what we’re seeing now.

The area where the price is playing is critical:

- 78,000 – 82,000 USD → test zone

- Above 82–83k USD → confirmation of momentum

- Below 78k USD → return to consolidation, no panic

The current movement looks more like the beginning of momentum than a random fluctuation.

For me, this Bitcoin increase is not just “another spike”. It is that moment when the market shows you that it has not fallen asleep, even if many have the impression that everything is stagnant. I have been watching BTC and LTC for some time and recognize the pattern: long silence, low volume, bored people… and then, suddenly, it starts to breathe differently.

If it passes cleanly above 82–83k USD. That is where you can see if it is just a test or a real momentum. The market reaction to rejections. If it rejects and does not fall below 78k, it means that the trend is still healthy.

Generally, when everyone is bored, BTC has a habit of surprising, and when everyone becomes euphoric, it is usually too late. For me, this movement is not hype. It is just the beginning of a change of pace.

When Bitcoin starts to rise, the temptation is great. I know how it is: you see the green candles, you see the momentum, you see the differences between the sources and you have the impression that \
.\n\nBut this is where people often make mistakes....If you jump into the market just because \

, you have already lost your good position.

BTC is not going anywhere. If it is a real trend, it still gives you chances. If it is just a test, you have jumped right at the top.

For me, there are three clear zones now:

- 78–82k → test

- 82–83k → confirmation

- below 78k → consolidation

It is important not to confuse momentum with the trend. A big candle does not mean a trend. A momentum does not mean a bull run. I'm looking at continuity, not a single move

It remains to be seen if Bitcoin confirms above 82–83k — the question is: will it manage to maintain momentum or are we entering consolidation again?

body.title: Apex (2026) - ADRENALINE ADDICTS AND PIRANHA TEETH - REVIEW
body.body:
https://i.postimg.cc/J0NKmH6L/Apex-(2026)-REVIEW-000.gif
[Source](https://www.netflix.com/title/81763251/)

https://i.imgur.com/PGNq5Ek.png
During the weekend there were two Netflix movies I was very skeptical to watch but I said F it, I havent watch a movie in a few weeks and wanted to start somehow, it packs a ton of action, there is constant action and almost no drama, after the first 20min, pure chasing through the Australian wilderness although there is not much context but imo it was not needed. The story follows Sasha, an adrenaline junkie who is out climbing the Troll Wall in Norway with her partner Tommy, played by Eric Bana, when a storm hits and everything goes to shit, there were some cool shots during that part of the movie, an avalanche knocks Tommy off the wall and Sasha is forced to let him go because she couldnt hold and it got me thinking how there is no moment for drama or shock under that situation and just like that the guy is gone in the first few minutes, which is a heavy way to open a movie and does all the work of telling you exactly who Sasha is before the movie really stat spreading its wings. Five months later she is deep in the Australian wilderness at Wandarra National Park, solo kayaking through these insane canyons called the Grand Isle Narrows, which is basically the same as putting up a neon sign that says please send a psycho killer my way, well Im probably exagerating but you get the idea. The ranger station is covered in missing persons posters, a local literally warns her that people go into those woods and never come out again, and the second she stops at a gas station to fuel up her van, a group of local hunters are already circling her like she is something to be bagged and tagged. She is there to spread Tommy's ashes and find some peace in the country where he grew up, which is a very emotional anchor for the whole thing, and you feel the grief on Charlize Theron is face even when she is just standing at a map trying to ignore the gross flirting from these guys.

- IMDB: https://www.imdb.com/title/tt16431404/
- Platform: [NETFLIX](https://www.netflix.com/title/81763251/)

https://bo.skiptvads.blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-1777932018-overlay.png
<div style=\

> https://bo.skiptvads.blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/scrn_1777932593_4-1777932793-overlay.jpg [Source](https://www.netflix.com/title/81763251/) Taron Egerton showing up as the villain Ben is the best thing about this movie by a wide margin, and the dude goes absolutely full send into this role in a way you would never expect from the guy who played Eggsy in Kingsman. He is wearing these fake veneers that he actually rips out to reveal a set of jagged teeth underneath, which is such a weird and specific visual choice that you cannot stop staring at his mouth every time he is on screen, and that kind of committed weirdness is exactly what a movie like this needs to stay interesting past the setup. Ben plays the charming local at first, giving Sasha directions to a camping spot at Blackstone Bay while the whole time he is already planning the hunt, stealing her gear overnight, and letting her get a head start while a pop song blares on a speaker as his personal pump up routine. He tracks her down using a phone playing family videos as audio bait, and when she hears the voices and goes to investigate on foot, he pops out of nowhere and the game is officially on. The bird screeching noise he makes when he gets close to his prey is the kind of unhinged character detail that the movie needed more of, and word is that Egerton invented it himself on set, which makes it even better. Charlize Theron for her part is doing heavy lifting with barely any dialogue once the chase starts, she communicates the whole weight of Sasha through body language and her eyes alone, and there are stretches where she is just running and reacting and you are completely with her anyway because she is that locked in. https://bo.skiptvads.blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/scrn_1777932593_24-1777932793-overlay.jpg [Source](https://www.netflix.com/title/81763251/) https://bo.skiptvads.blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/scrn_1777932593_25-1777932793-overlay.jpg [Source](https://www.netflix.com/title/81763251/) The problem is that the logic in the second half of this movie is a mess that kept pulling me out of it. She takes a head slam off an underwater rock that would put any normal person out cold for a week, and she just shakes it off and keeps moving like it never happened, then later she steps into a massive metal leg clamp trap that should have snapped her shin in half, but somehow she is still sprinting through the forest two scenes later with no visible issue. Ben chasing her through the canyon while somehow keeping pace on foot while she is in a kayak is the kind of thing you just have to choose to accept or you are going to spend the whole movie arguing with the screen, and I kept arguing with the screen. The secondary hunters that harass her at the van early on are a complete waste of time because they show up making a racket, act creepy, and then vanish from the movie entirely without a single payoff, like they were cut from a different version of the script and nobody caught it in the edit. The cave hideout where Ben keeps his operation has that classic slasher villain aesthetic with bodies stored in the dark, and he gives this rambling speech about rituals and consuming the spirit of his prey, which is supposed to make him feel like a deeper character but just lands flat because nothing in the script earns that kind of weight for him. You could tell from pretty early on where things were heading because the movie sets up its circular structure too obviously, telegraphing that the ending is going to mirror the opening in a very deliberate way that removes most of the surprise. https://bo.skiptvads.blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/scrn_1777932593_31-1777932794-overlay.jpg [Source](https://www.netflix.com/title/81763251/) https://bo.skiptvads.blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/scrn_1777932593_8-1777932794-overlay.jpg [Source](https://www.netflix.com/title/81763251/) The closest comparison for Apex is somewhere between the dread of Fall, that 2022 movie with the two women trapped on top of a five hundred foot tower, and a throwback 90s slasher where the villain has a gimmick and the survivor just has to outlast him. Fall had better tension because the danger felt physically real and the stakes were simple, while Apex is trying to layer a survival thriller over a slasher vibe at the same time, and the two things keep bumping into each other in ways that hurt the pacing. The canyon cinematography is solid at times, those claustrophobic angles that make you feel like the rock walls are closing in, but then the movie cuts to wide shots that lean too hard on budget CGI and the illusion falls apart. The opening scene on the Troll Wall in Norway is the most visually striking thing in the entire movie, and it is also the part with the least amount of action, which tells you something about where the attention went. That sequence has a weight and stillness that the rest of the movie never really gets back, and every time Apex tries to build real tension in the second half you keep measuring it against that opener and finding it a little short. https://i.imgur.com/uwwnjtd.png

> https://i.imgur.com/r0yj9oi.png The finale involves a tandem climb up a canyon wall that mirrors the Norway prologue in both setup and outcome, and Sasha is the one who actually proposes the arrangement to Ben after pointing out that his busted leg makes a long overland walk impossible for him. He agrees while making it very clear he will kill her if she tries anything, which is about as much trust as you can expect from a man who makes jerky out of people. She eventually rigs Ben is rope to a branch and manipulates the setup so he takes the fall, which lands with a very deliberate thematic echo to the opening, and the movie wants you to feel something profound about that full circle moment. The problem is the green screen work on that cliff face is painfully obvious, to the point where the tension the movie has been building just dissolves right when it needs to peak, and you go from invested to distracted in about thirty seconds. After making it to the top, Sasha is found by a passing camper, makes it back to the ranger station, and points at that board of missing people to tell them she knows exactly where every single one of them ended up. It is a decent enough close but the emotional gut punch the movie is reaching for does not quite connect because the journey there had too many logic gaps along the way. Apex gets a 5.5 out of 10. Theron and Egerton are both great here and deserve a tighter script than this one gave them, but it is a solid enough Saturday afternoon watch if you do not mind occasionally yelling at your TV. https://i.imgur.com/uwwnjtd.png https://i.imgur.com/AbuDA6i.png

body.title: I was very wrong about Kemi Badenoch.
body.body:
![Kemi takes down heckler.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mrfahrenheit211/AJkRB2eFDpdDyr3DZxTYZq6Lv83vMannRW3muyChAayccBu5Z9bhJuG3UKeanQu.jpg)
Picture Shows: Tory Leader Kemi Badenoch faces down 'Palestine' nutjob heckler.


When Kemi Badenoch became Conservative Party leader to say that I was unimpressed with her early performance would be somewhat of an understatement.  I was impressed by her when she was part of the last Tory government because she seemed to be one of the few people in the Tories who were willing to take aim at the DEI shitshow that all the main parties, including the Tories, had played a part in embedding in the British state and British society.

However I’m now going to have to admit that I was wrong in my initial assessment and for that I apologise both to Ms Badenoch for misjudging her and to the readers of this blog.

Her initial Commons performances might have lacked fire and it’s clear that she stumbled a few times during her time bedding in as leader, such as falling for the willy waving business with Reform over membership numbers.  Back then with her gaffes and her less than confident looking Commons performances and the rumours of a lack of hard work on her part might not have put out the best image of being a suitable Prime Minister, but time has proven me wrong.   Ms Badenoch has been putting in better and better Commons performances and is regularly besting the Prime Minister in Commons debates.  She’s got a handle on her party’s media machine and her social media videos and appearances along with her appearances on mainstream media political shows are giving a very good impression indeed.

Contrary to her hesitant early start Ms Badenoch has become more and more confident in the House, in the media, on the socials and in personal appearances.  She handles questions well and you get the impression that she’s now very much up on her brief.  She’s showing passion and is not ashamed of placing herself on the Right of British politics.

But it’s not just scripted or formal occasions when Ms Badenoch is showing her steel, she’s recently proved she can do this off the cuff.  Here she is dealing very effectively with some ‘Palestine’ supporting tosser who was heckling her.

https://x.com/CrewkerneMan/status/2051351421015015885

I’m quite embarrassed at getting Ms Badenoch wrong.  She’s grown into a very effective, very personable Tory leader.  I got Boris Johnson wrong as well, I thought that he would govern much further to the Right than he actually did, I judged him via what he had written and that misled me.  The early stages of Ms Badenoch’s reign as Tory leader I also have got wrong.  Her missteps and initially poor performance in my view coloured my early view of her but she’s learned on the job in what is a very difficult job.  Despite my initial dismissal of her she’s done a great job of turning the public image of the Tories around somewhat, she’s also talking much more to the Right which could go down well.  Theresa May and Boris Johnson let Britons down very badly. It was on their watch that migration exploded and we got even more deeply mired into Net Zero. It was also a time when the Tories quite readily surrendered to the cultural Left. Because of that record the Tories have lost a lot of the public’s trust and it is Kemi Badenoch’s job to rebuild that trust but most importantly earn that trust by acting on the public’s concerns.  Let’s hope she manages to achieve that. So far so good. She’s been direct with the public and moral when she needs to be and seems to be refreshingly free of bullshit waffle.  I was wrong about Kemi Badenoch and I hope I keep getting proven wrong about her.

body.title: Mini bow keychain 🎀
body.body:
Hello, Hi, Namaste to all Hive users reaching this post, hope you all are doing great. So today I am sharing a mini bow keychain. This is the mini version of the bow I shared earlier.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPdeAL3HabSGA1EJCwYWxSWfaZhxDUDF1AKF6Qg43hHzq/1778002726708.jpg)

So here is the process of this keychain - 

Mostly all the steps are the same for this bow, just we have to decrease the chains to make it smaller.
You can choose any colour for the bow, I chose orange because I haven't used orange for any crochet item yet. 

First, fall made 32 chains, then took a loop and inserted it into the 3rd chain from the end. After this started making double crochet (a total of 30 double crochet).

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTRfkzLxbXvm7d65ze1Gh7ESX9TjbpKPBX3mNrqX7w6uL/1778002843047.jpg)

Then made 2 chains, again took a loop and inserted it into the 3rd chain and started making 30 double crochet.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeURoQTJs2EW3nHCFBPGHYjRrcmP5a4gSpVZsW1rs9P9N/1778002843225.jpg)

Repeat this process one more time ( In total a row of single crochet, then 3 rows of double crochet). At the end make a slip knot.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSDnBkozQTMb6FMZxsQ9TKmnxTo9pziLx8Mx3F5sjNHkG/1778002843373.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYpEZESqVvcSpgdFyR3e1z1LSdg7yczET8ZqFW3Kw6mwQ/1778002897003.jpg)

Now stitch both ends together and then push it backwards so that the stitch comes in the middle (as shown in the image).
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcuRUB4xPdMN1h9AFo3wCZr4WEdAxKLhnoq8Ss31SSTYD/1778002843466.jpg)
Here the upper part of the bow was ready.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU1NEJihxoXuUi2rWSCePzf1N8WGCAiUwHs1zyGTuSShB/1778002843619.jpg)
Now for the bottom part, I made 17 chains and then took a loop and inserted the needle in the 3rd chain and started making 15 double crochet. Repeated it one more time. 
In total - made a row of chains and 2 rows of double crochet.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPkGAtHEiw11oatEonkxfGxKcGoYzyUrUNFSvDkggsL3y/1778002868877.jpg)

After this attachment both the upper and bottom parts by rolling the same wool in the middle portion of the bow and finally I made a knot.
Then attached the keyring And here the mini bow was ready.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPdeAL3HabSGA1EJCwYWxSWfaZhxDUDF1AKF6Qg43hHzq/1778003809026.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSCq2cznDnMjLg8mRkKgFofv72wT7wi391M2q4ozqjzVp/1778003809168.jpg)

Hope you all liked it, do share your opinions with me 🤗.
Thank you for visiting my post.

body.title: The Aftermath of Sickness.
body.body:
> > The contest themes of @gamingphoto helps us seeing things in a video game that we normally ignore. After assisting the healer with a poisoned well crisis, I reflected on the necessity of violence for protection. Following the somber night in the village, I discovered a grim Mongol execution site before engaging a patrol in a high-stakes standoff. I successfully defeated the group and rescued a peasant who provided vital intelligence.
[Gaming Photography Weekly Contest.](https://peakd.com/hive-185676/@gamingphoto/gaming-photography-weekly-contest-3dd8d88e14c67)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmShVRpzKKm9JoyTC4EfuoUMjQVC88vznPbezKGkfsxCm7/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWpVPN9KfhVVzmKV2sKgbYYN87SU4asmBQSPnsAbikYwG/screenshot_2_.png) I found the healer harvesting some tubers from around that lake. When he said he could help but wondered if Jin enjoyed the violence, Jin replied he kill only to protect their people from the invaders. It was a heavy conversation that highlighted the moral weight Jin carries. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVUXutbeTB8nuocNRLBTmajymEQ6UDrhJbYuxZqsH3itL/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdm6i3dFHBm6S6hm7s8vtUcbuYCyQqqStvoVNU7TjScKn/screenshot_4_.png) Then I continued following the healer towards the camp to heal those who need it most after the recent attacks. And after getting there, we found a lady really sick and struggling to breathe while her family looked on in despair. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSPNAhgr87rGpxAC9UNUa55eHAgE2KkTVfb9msp6Q6NMy/screenshot_5_.png) A peasant said they didn't have any food left, just water from the well that they had been drinking for several days. So both Jin and the healer understood the Mongols poisoned the well water, which was killing the villagers slowly. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPaCcAkYxXpkVXudNHi5gYF6FxgjrWQpJEFgMTfiPSFqr/screenshot_6_.png) The mission came to an end after the healer suggested the best care he could provide with the limited resources he had available. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNNESKjFhA1nFBVQyK97FiG2oPzbPMxSLsZagX3QmbnYo/screenshot_7_.png) The healer disappeared after the quest came to an end, and it became nighttime across the island. It was a haunting sight as some of them had died already from the contamination. The silence of the camp was heavy. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdpMcx8cA2DtemJYGCE6h5CUi2yKJ87Up5dMXVYXzp5Ri/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaDCJz5aHFiZU4S5zgRRqMuFEA9Wx9Gijmm4eZW33NKmB/screenshot_9_.png) I was riding around and I found this grim site where the Mongols hanged two dead bodies to a tree. I wish I could give them a proper burial, but the game doesn't allow me do such action. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmShqoJHRWazdTeK7hkC4MQ5F13XQy4dXRDy7qyFn79mXq/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNPTRd7uVSC1mH4AHMS2yn5mLGP1rk4NfiX54QyL7HNUu/screenshot_11_.png) I was wandering around the open fields under the moonlight and suddenly I noticed a Mongol group patrolling the tall grass. So I challenged their leader for a standoff. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQAe3KUWN72vKpCMGMrozLn8jkwNrS5kD6brFwqqSMTQk/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYNc1kMigXnpUDr8UzMDWQwDb2LpCapYVKKowPpMVQcPt/screenshot_13_.png) The Mongol leader had a cunning eagle that tried to distract me by diving low as I waited for the perfect moment to strike. But I really did it perfectly, took down both the Mongol leader and the eagle in one fluid motion. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaGD8V9p6cL9tRb3896WqRkyaG3mPjtwLxB2jwZeNLreE/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWAzMtsw8W3WcUKxAv1YWFqkNg5Tmk6V5sf1oapA7RRte/screenshot_15_.png) After taking down the Mongol leader, I noticed his soldiers were running towards me with their weapons drawn and fury in their eyes. So I also started running towards them to bring the fight to them, refusing to stay on the defensive. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaqLUoaTxcKcv8QHfEQLbL35iZdrvKMchpLa7gkDBXSYt/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmawmm1GByiiEQrymfW27Vjxt2oTugaoQn3GgpxW3wVM2M/screenshot_17_.png) The first thing I did was a jump kick on one of the Mongols, knocking him back and breaking his guard instantly. Then I started slaying them down one by one, moving through my stances to counter their different weapon types. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeHM5VFV5v69d5Rpk6AqwQXAAEUZnWRfnpdSbFf5kKQDh/screenshot_18_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV8fQeB9UfB14G1ENrRtPUsTT3UNAYfWVA8pt1BABNqbC/screenshot_19_.png) After attacking this Mongol for a moment and breaking his stance, I slit his throat when there was the last one of them running towards me. I didn't hesitate, letting the body fall as I turned to face the final threat. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc4QMCY8z3nbqKqwK45paARXUjvpf1W7ZvFdNLdpoECQu/screenshot_20_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYbvX8JuGEAbdJUeCJczmJXJiLkUHzQfg7T8rFG1oU8V2/screenshot_21_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcFELKu1as5T3UMPsNXxrcCnu1f7TQDVoWhrdmmxShHpD/screenshot_22_.png) I didn't give the last one a chance to attack me as I struck fast with a combination of high and low slashes. I pierced my katana through his chest as the ending blow, keeping the beautiful moon witness of my brutality against the invaders. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTNdMT1acgmt1PRQq2ZNqgJ7Z2jM2tB1oaqdWSn7g5GqU/screenshot_23_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdDennYR8ZNDZnciyi6NirWuHLSUxCLqxbnFJo9u79vki/screenshot_24_.png) Then I found this peasant whom the Mongols had been guarding during the fight. He gave me information about the Mongols' invasion at Azamo's eastern coast, at the crossroads where the fishermen used to sell the day's catch. --- If you like the post, feel free to like, comment & share. I will soon come with another post. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=naeemulnepun/c11b3f7a)

body.title: The countdown clock
body.body:
Having a device that can tell death time is actually tempting. Because of the desire to live with intention
But I would rather wake up everyday hoping, than buy a device that can tell me the exact time of my death.
 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP8G13qkzG5YLrs6rgjVhWYQqsLyMcKUnaTT6zJ5DiiJQ/1778003074503.jpg)
[Image source](https://unsplash.com/photos/clear-glass-hour-glass-on-red-and-yellow-leaves-XYXZy6HSI5A)

A lot of people are already battling with depression and anxiety. Now imagine giving them this device, it only causes more harm to them.

What about our society, the government or the employers? People with shorter life spans might lose opportunities there will be discrimination and injustice.
 And people who have longer life spans might feel empowered and start making unnecessary decisions.

Presently we are living our lives with doubt, and somehow that doubt makes life meaningful. 
We plan with no Idea if it works out or fails, we learn to forgive, we have big dreams, we hope for something better and that's because we believe time is on our side. That's how life has been designed to protect us from ourselves.

But with a device like that everything changes. What happens when a young boy discovers he has just 3 weeks left to live. He can't live fully, the lack of peace, the pressure and fear.

So for me, I will prefer my illusion of “hope.” it might be uncertain but it's better I don't know what might hurt me. It will give me peace to enjoy moments naturally. I won't have to live in fear 
I can freely laugh with my friends, love deeply without the fear of leaving someone behind.

I don't want a mechanical life that, instead of living, we will be calculating. I want to live freely, not in fear.
The fact that we don't know when life will end makes it valuable. Some mystery is just meant to stay mysterious. Because once you know you've known.

body.body: Yes — but they’re niche and usually privacy-preserving wrappers or shielded transfers around stablecoins, not magic “invisible dollars.” Projects and approaches people point to include [Railgun-shielded stablecoins](https://www.stablecoininsider.com/privacy-stablecoins-top-projects/), while broader privacy discussions are already treating “private stablecoins” as an emerging category in [CoinDesk’s 2025 piece on 2026 privacy trends](https://www.coindesk.com/opinion/2025/12/31/4-predictions-for-privacy-in-2026).  \n\nThe catch is the boring but important part: regulators hate fully anonymous money, so truly private stablecoins struggle with compliance, listings, and scale; that’s why most real-world versions focus on optional privacy rather than total secrecy. On InLeo, the closest recent discussion I found was broader stablecoin talk like [@dashnode’s thread on stablecoin regulation](https://inleo.io/threads/view/dashnode/re-leothreads-2tvke1rzj) and [@rimurutempest’s post on banks and stablecoins](https://inleo.io/@rimurutempest/banks-x-stablecoins-the-future-of-money-fka), but not a major thread specifically centered on private stablecoins.

body.title: Mi experiencia exponiendo Rockin' Hell en la Feria Internacional del Cine en Guadalajara
body.body:
Como les platiqué en mi último post, he estado bastante saturado de trabajo por distintas razones, pero para nada es queja :D

Una de esas razones es que, mi proyecto Rockin' Hell fue seleccionado para ser expuesto en el PlayTest de la FICG 2026.

Fue un evento muy bien organizado, nos trataron de lujo, y tuvimos un excelente recibimiento. Lastimosamente, no hubo tantas personas como imaginábamos, pero igual le sacamos bastante provecho.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marisky/23wfojpSpHUYhV9aP9q16E7kJX2HUhkninohXKybEKxfT8kdw4LZRNehWDekKvo74ha3V.png)

Teníamos que atender 3 puntos en concreto para que el evento fuera exitoso para nosotros:

1. Como en cualquier otro evento de este tipo, el darnos a conocer y hacer que las personas completen nuestros CTA es clave. Así que preparamos nuestros códigos QR para ejercer muy poca fricción con las personas.

2. Al haber solo una computadora designada para nuestra demo de aproximadamente 30 minutos, sabíamos que no sería suficiente para alcanzar el número de personas que buscábamos. 

3. Por otra parte, en la universidad me pedían una validación de una idea que planteé en mi proyecto de modelo de negocios, que funciona bajo la teoría, pero no hay validación de campo, que tiene que ver con Realidad Virtual y juegos en tercera persona.

Así que tomamos acción y porteamos una fracción del videojuego a Oculus Quest, porque la indicación era \

pero nada me impedía llevar lentesitos con pantalla (JAJAJA soy un puto genio 🧐).

Así, pudimos tener a más personas jugando a la vez; nuestro stand llamaba muchísimo más la atención al ver un wey atrás todo disosiado con unos lentesotes y Heavy Metal de fondo; y más importante, hicimos nuestra investigación de campo 🧐 que me arrojaron datos MUY interesantes. Puedo decir que mi hipótesis es correcta, pero encontré variables que no había considerado y le darán un giro muy interesante a mi proyecto.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marisky/23vhuGVeXVTBvfQ8JXfYNRs9WmakCU3UdEbWd13Z7P7wzcsidADodJaogUCzV6iSzfdnG.png)

En cuanto a las personas que alcanzamos, no fueron enormes números, pero tuvimos el cuádruple de eficacia en redes sociales en relación a los proyectos vecinos, lo que es bastante bueno para nosotros.

De hecho, las redes sociales no son nuestro único ni principal CTA, lo que creo que suma mérito, porque teníamos dos CTAs más que nuestros vecinos, e igualmente llegamos a ser más efectivos :D

En cuanto a anécdotas divertidas, 5 niños probaron nuestro demo. Eso es el terror de los desarrolladores de videojuegos... Los niños son tan impredecibles, y sin querer ser despectivo, su desarrollo cognitivo aún no está tan desarrollado, así que es todo un reto desarrollar para ellos.

Estaba nervioso a tope, pero WOW, me sorprendí a mí mismo jajajaja. 4 de 5 niños pasaron el primer nivel completo, y 3 de ellos derrotaron al primer jefe.

Me llevé anécdotas muy interesantes con ellos... Un chico pasó el juego 2 veces completas, y en su tercer vuelta su mamá le tuvo que arrancar el control de las manos mientras discutían por irse JAJAJ... Y pensarán \

... Pero no, se tardó más de una hora en lograr matar al primer jefe XD

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marisky/EopmeMLkhpeBREmihwa1RLBnEQiQrGvDvHVgEHWTLZaa8cxk59yxdeaek3PhJ4J6kPq.png)

Y también, me llevé dos de las mejores anécdotas que he tenido en mi carrera como desarrollador :')

Una niña de 8 años estaba súper enfrascada con el juego a pesar de que sus habilidades no eran las mejores como para enfrentar al jefe. La ayudé a matar a Crybone, y en cuanto terminó el demo, eligió uno de nuestros stickers de Vic y me dijo súper feliz \

y se fue re-emocionada con su maestra como si hubiera probado el mismísmo GOTY de My Little Pony x Bluey jsajja, nunca se me va a olvidar 🥹

Otro chico, tiene problemas severos problemas de vértigo. Su mamá me platicó su caso mientras su hijo probaba el juego, y me platicó que a él le encanta la realidad virtual, pero que nunca ha podido disfrutarla del todo, porque no puede estar de pie sin perder el equilibrio, y la Realidad Virtual hace este síntoma aún más agresivo. Me preguntó acerca del port de Meta Quest, y le expliqué los detalles de cómo era la experiencia.

El niño estaba emocionado por probarlo, su mamá nos dio luz verde y, con bastante cuidado, le coloqué los visores...
No saben lo nervioso que estaba en ese momento 💀, después de verlo estable durante 15 segundos y escuchar el gritote de Crybone a través de los visores, me tranquilicé bastante jajaj.
Él jugó toda la experiencia completa por alrededor de 20 minutos y ver su cara de felicidad lo fue todo 😭
Su mamá estuvo muy agradecida conmigo y mi compañera por la atención que le dimos y me dio las gracias por hacer posible que su hijo pudiera disfrutar de una experiencia así 🥹

Fue raro, como si nos hubieran puesto en el camino... Yo estaba realizando la prueba de un producto diseñado específicamente para poder disfrutar esta tecnología sin la necesidad de estar de pie y capturar movimiento para evitar mareos y malestar físico... Y llegó un chico que le encanta el VR, pero que no puede estar de pie y se marea fácilmente... ¿Cuál era la probabilidad? no sé, seguramente bajas, pero nos la pasamos de lujo jajaja

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marisky/23xVCSny77CVqjuU3RXLGojADY7xmiG6MgSa71KgTSZ8eBHkeqD25R7iyioEBV2HPC9b8.png)

Y bueno, pasaron muchas cositas, pude ver a mi mejor amigo después de meses sin coincidir por nuestros horarios, conocí personas muy cool con las que podrían surgir colaboraciones en el futuro, incluso vi dos-tres tik tokers famosos que sigo JAJAJ, fue muy random.

Me encanta sentarme en una esquina de la plaza y desde allí observar el comportamiento de las personas que visualizan sus teléfonos móviles, o aquellas que comparten una conversación con el acompañante del momento, o aquellos que viven en situación de calles y en medio de su soledad mantienen una conversación con alguien que solo ellos ven. ¿Quién podría afirmar con quiénes hablan, y de qué tema se trata la discusión? Vaya uno a saber qué pensamientos pasan por la mente de estas personas. \n


\n

: . I love sitting on a corner of the plaza and observing the behavior of people looking at their mobile phones, or those having a conversation with their current companion, or those living on the streets who, in their solitude, are talking to someone only they can see. body.title: Embracing Ease Without Laziness
body.body:
Evolution of technology has made so many things easy for us. Right from getting answers to what seems to take like forever to get answers to in the past years. Projects are done easily and efficiently even more than how human efforts could have manually done it. 

![1000669790.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/23xyLgZvDoPoECLDNeZ4KFqpAcjVcEk643RQqMPs2ABveJHDfywhmyVemieHPajy6Z38B.jpg)<sub>[Image is Mine]()</sub>

We now have so many innovations, AI models, tools and many others that technology has brought to make our lives easier. Unfortunately we have come to be fully dependent on the assistance which technology brings to us and this may in one way or the other wanna make those rumors true indirectly. Although, It is not like AI would chase people off their work but then the ability to brainstorm on ideas and be creative may not be like before.

Sincerely, no one would want a hard or difficult life and I feel like as long as you are not solely dependent on something, it could still be fair enough to call it an aid. Take for instance, as a graphic designer who would always brainstorm on what design to give a client or make for a product, with a good creative prompt (as long as you have that original idea of what you want to create in your head) to the AI model, you would get a ready-made design of which you might now need to adjust till it meets your taste as a designer. You're still creative cos without your creative prompt of what you want, the AI won't give it to you but the opposite.

An HR firm posted something on LinkedIn about an HR manager's email to an applicant with a paragraph showing **\

** Like you prompted chatgpt for something that you can't sit to create yourself and you still feel lazy to read through the answers to proofread for you to see that you had copied your own prompt alongside the body of the email.

That is how less or no creative the evolution of technology has made us to become BUT just like I do say that for the fact that someone innovated something for the use of people doesn't mean they have to carry the burden of the misuse by users.

![1000670848.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/242DXCcT6Srx6Lqi2cGhNBwpCpqT8rem1ctg3hsSMPvzPzmY8d2qrTPhebsF9264g4jk8.jpg)<sub>[Image generated by AI]()</sub>

That we are less creative, the blame lies on us cos it has only come to ease our burden not shouldering the burden of our faults.
At the beginning of this month I thought about creating a flyer for my brand and wishing my followers a happy new month and I did that with the help of the AI tool which seems very impossible before unless you reach out to a graphic designer.

It is of a fact that it may be affecting some professions but we can't stop the evolution just like we can't stop the usage of cars and stay to donkey rides because we don't want to be lazy and that is why we must blend with these changes in a way that we neither feel left out nor become useless when the tool is no longer available.

**NOTE:** No matter how effective these AI tools may be interfering with these creativities, at the end it still needs a human touch and that is why every creative worker will always remain relevant no matter what.

I'll be dropping my 🖊️ here on the Hive Learners community prompt 

Thanks for reading through 🤗 

All images are cited
