body.title: Sable Dustpaw The little master of magic
body.body: ![Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia de Copia d.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yonilkar/23tGe5e7MURH12Q1JJRD3AciY2oCgxsBv8M4VBjbvfKKyDZQZm9AWn66mNqHY4zQVFVmy.jpg) Hello to the entire gaming community! Here’s your chance to get your hands on a pretty powerful and unique card that likely has some utility potential for the Earth element. This means the card not only has a different way of being in battle but also naturally combines small monsters into great feats. I’m really surprised that there are some pretty powerful cards that, even though they can’t do much on their own, would still be quite helpful. This is because we already have a card with three abilities that, in my opinion, are well-suited for what it can achieve. This way, we can provide a different kind of utility, since having an epic card with such surprising abilities would undoubtedly make its usability very different. https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/escalation/Sable%20Dustpaw_lv6.png Although this card has fairly low requirements, I know that its true purpose is to target the most powerful monster or, strategically speaking, to alter the flow of the game. As a result, we have not just a different card, but a unique one that can hold its own in battle for quite some time. https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/abilities/ability_decoy.png The combination of abilities makes this card incredibly useful for playing in a highly strategic way, which I really like. It doesn't just offer a completely different playstyle, but also a level of versatility that goes beyond simply going into battle. This time, we can strategically target those monsters to gain a better strategic advantage. https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/abilities/ability_kindred-spirit.png Even though it doesn't have a way to apply poison directly, this time it will definitely inflict poison on any monster adjacent to it, allowing it to catch opponents off guard in battle in a very unique way. This makes the card not only highly effective in battle but also capable of fusing in a way that provides significant assistance. https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/abilities/ability_reflexes.png It’s a rather unusual weakness, which I think can not only be used in surprising ways but also allows us to apply a certain strategy that aids in battle, giving it a surprising level of utility. This is because when this card is attacked, the attacking card gains the ability to dodge any subsequent attacks from the opponent, providing a clear advantage. It’s clear that we can say this card ranks between 4 and 5 in terms of its surprising utility due to its aforementioned ability. ###### |Pictures / Imagenes | [Canva ](https://www.canva.com/design/DAG9dyg2fcs/c6cRrS8tMremp9Qn9dcc_Q/edit)| ) |https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/icons/social_telegram.svg[Telegram](https://t.me/splinterlandsES)|https://steemitimages.com/300x300/https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yonilkar/AK6X3dCx5ibs1GjniiWMffosYAYWnmZ6taCK1dLwBR3NmMMtsXtvYXH5ETFwqjX.jpg|https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/icons/social_discord.svg[Discord](https://discord.gg/sCHsBvfb)| |-|-|-| [Welcome to Splinterlands, where fast-paced card battles meet deep strategy, rich lore, and true ownership. body.title: Forgiveness of Sins//Mcgi Topic Review
body.body:
https://youtu.be/oAcMa8zhQgY?si=WcvHeEf7ERgZgbaT

I’ve come to realize that forgiveness of sins is a vital part of my life. There have been times when I made poor decisions and did things I’m not proud of. Often, those actions leave me feeling heavy and burdened inside. Still, I’m thankful to God because He is always ready to forgive me whenever I come to Him with a genuine heart.

The Bible tells us in 1 John 1:9 that if we confess our sins, God is faithful and just to forgive us and cleanse us from all unrighteousness. This assurance gives me hope, reminding me that no matter my past, God’s mercy is always within reach.

There was a point in my life when I felt deeply guilty about something I had done. The shame made it difficult for me to even pray. But one day, I decided to open up completely to God and ask for His mercy. As I spoke to Him, I broke down in tears. After that prayer, I felt a sense of peace fill my heart, as if a heavy weight had been lifted. That moment helped me truly understand that God forgives.

Forgiveness goes beyond simply saying sorry. It involves making8 a conscious effort to change and not return to the same mistakes. Proverbs 28:13 teaches that those who hide their sins will not succeed, but those who confess and turn away from them will find mercy. This reminds me to stay honest with God and sincerely repent.

I’ve also learned that just as God forgives me, I must extend that same forgiveness to others. It’s not always easy, but it is what God desires. Ephesians 4:32 encourages us to be kind and compassionate, forgiving one another just as God forgave us through Christ.

Forgiveness brings peace, freedom, and a new beginning. I’m grateful that God never gets tired of forgiving me whenever I truly turn back to Him.

**Thanks for reading.**

body.title: Day of hiking in Las Delicias Mountain Range or Maracay Hotel Hill - Venezuela / Día de senderismo en la Serranía Las Delicias o Cerro del Hotel Maracay - Venezuela
body.body:
I always try to do at least one mountain hike a month, whether it's to places I've never been to before or somewhere I haven't been in a while. Since it had been several years since I'd climbed the hill by the Hotel Maracay and my sister hadn't been there, it seemed like a good idea to go back.

>*Siempre trato de hacer aunque sea una ruta de montaña al mes, ya sea a lugares desconocidos o que tenga tiempo sin ir. Como tenía varios años que no subía al Cerro del Hotel Maracay y mi hermana no lo conocía, me pareció un buen plan volver a visitarlo.*

<center>![DSCF8449.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EpT4BAuGrQXXQmEXh9GhKyYZdNtHrUBp1WNhds3yn7Vg3FCy49YFWoZGa4qh7P6iugL.JPG)</center>

We left very early for Maracay, the goal was to start climbing before 8:00 am because the heat there is intense, and we arrived at the starting point of the route right at that time. There were quite a few people, Las Delicias mountain range or Hotel Maracay Hill, as it's better known, is the most visited mountain trail in the city.

>*Salimos bien temprano para Maracay, la meta era comenzar a subir antes de las 8:00 am porque el calor allí es fuerte, y llegamos al punto de inicio de la ruta justo a esa hora. Había bastante gente, la serranía Las Delicias o Cerro del Hotel Maracay, como mejor se le conoce, es el sendero de montaña más visitado de la ciudad.*

<center>![DSCF8450.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/Eq9VKxCJFqGZmJMWzuQoaiN8WmsPBtVrjGpuJZzXskTD1PGFNdZCPKR1s1CekDkrfE4.JPG)</center>

<center>![IMG_20260124_081159.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EpxqJgPzeNCCBeTf1vE2UUgbFc2XhhCwZxn1WYRK9f6suViayvPH85UAxbH6pbCPztr.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Photo taken by @gatubela / Foto tomada por @gatubela</sub></center>

<hr>

This mountain trail is part of Henri Pittier National Park, a vast area of ​​107,800 hectares that has been protected since 1937, being the first National Park decreed in Venezuela.

>*Este sendero de montaña forma parte del Parque Nacional Henri Pittier, una extensa área de 107.800 hectáreas que está protegida desde 1937, siendo el primer Parque Nacional decretado en Venezuela.*

<center>![DSCF8454.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EqquPbiN49z1e2wkDW1d3Cz8eRe6hjaKTTE4DwAEikdr7HkSmDRv8nepuiA9EQJQD6Y.JPG)</center>

Since the Hotel Maracay was built nearby, people began to refer to it as the “Hill of the Hotel Maracay.” Designed by Venezuelan architect Luis Malaussena, the hotel opened in 1957 and is considered an icon of modernism in the country. In 2017, the hotel was renovated and has since been managed by the Marriott chain under the name Marriott Maracay Golf Resort. As you climb the mountain, you can see a panoramic view of this resort.

>*Como en sus alrededores se construyó el Hotel Maracay, la gente comenzó a identificarlo de esa manera: el cerro del Hotel Maracay. Esta obra diseñada por el arquitecto venezolano Luis Malaussena fue inaugurada en 1957 y es considerada como un emblema del modernismo en el país. En 2017 el hotel fue renovado y desde entonces lo administra la cadena Marriott y se llama Marriott Maracay Golf Resort. Cuando vas subiendo la montaña puedes ver una vista general de este complejo.*

<center>![DSCF8455.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EpfpbSChePoEdM8LiLpCPaJGMLnFxmipAbqTR2LkF9WbgM85ZURdTbMyGzLqGMFBNaT.JPG)</center>

Only a short stretch at the beginning is paved, leading up to a park with exercise equipment.

>*Sólo un pequeño tramo del inicio está pavimentado, hasta llegar a un parque con instalaciones para hacer ejercicios.*

<center>![DSCF8456.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EqHyzTvWKZ2tzXHvV2pd21KK5EfdNTofqp32iv7RjqrhGU4uEKzzjiZDZmgGQACBPzF.JPG)</center>

<center>![DSCF8458.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EqfFR51Ymq2PZnmYs6ShA9mtkC3vCEBSuUjYqf4WvachpvAjC2zUw9f1gigvx3g3BRS.JPG)</center>

This trail, although not very long (4.7 km), is quite challenging. I knew that, and I told my sister, who lost her patience a bit along the way because the sun showed us no mercy 😅.

>*Este sendero, aunque no es muy largo (4,7 Km) es bastante exigente. Yo sabía eso y se lo dije a mi hermana, que en el camino perdió un poco la paciencia porque el sol no nos tuvo compasión 😅.*

<center>![DSCF8462.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/Eq5D4iBv8xF2QbysETFz52VAnFZ5yBPe8rxgMyVKhPyYiQpoRcp64M7KRuvuDGGTtpp.JPG)</center>

<center>![DSCF8464.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EnaZHfWw3n418CWWKeiQBQJUtciA7i218nNJratkWBTp7YZvNaMWvTUavW8QodxnVnU.JPG)</center>

As you can see in these photos, the drought and the fires started by idiots have wreaked havoc on these mountains. Sadly, it’s the same story every year, the vegetation is lost, and the animals that live here die or are forced to leave.

>*Como pueden ver en estas fotos, la sequía y los incendios provocados por estúpidos hicieron estragos en estas montañas. Tristemente cada año es lo mismo, se pierde la vegetación y los animales que aquí habitan mueren o son desplazados.*

<center>![DSCF8465.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/Eoc5fbFiPMq7PpNZp8xT6RjDY8EevLEGWn7DCk1S2KLL6ULT6Begp9daiojhSbZKk4i.JPG)</center>

<center>![DSCF8467.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/Ep1WyMz6eCQY2fyGfNEehmhH5uBQNxN2JaXDYKJSdpHMtBhpdx9rcZMDdkBvk9cy4eu.JPG)</center>

<center>![DSCF8468.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EqjXbyEbMh5qqKBzQx3QARvfDKzczotbMYdeoKq6Cx483oms6gmHx7M9vmZEAhnxCaw.JPG)</center>

<center>![DSCF8469.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EqWjnDxQ3xmzKFSLDqrzn4F8xBG6k1VruWdrWjtr7XYgPX43tDA7a4jmF1siXT1zoyN.JPG)</center>

Most people who come here to train or simply to spend a different kind of day hike up to what's known as \

The 4.7 km to get there are divided into several stations or points: La Planicie, La Matica, La Pared, and La Antena. There are signs there so people can see the distance and the elevation.

>*La mayoría de las personas que vienen a entrenar acá o simplemente a pasar un día diferente, suben hasta lo que se conoce como “El Container”. Los 4,7 km hasta allí están divididos en varias estaciones o puntos: La Planicie, La Matica, La Pared y La Antena. Hay carteles allí para que la gente vea la distancia y la altura.*

<center>![DSCF8472.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EoGxxQM6EhsSs3gW419SimV4pLq6UWGt9Yui1NcAENqiow7HdNc7jdxp25UQNsn3s9y.JPG)</center>

<center>![DSCF8473.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/Eq9TqLsBfbXmty7qMyVDvWvQdFcEKL3cZXRcCXXozKPpnAVEqywMiTHZDDmFAJhPHmm.JPG)</center>

There is almost no shade along this steep path. The heat only eases up a little when the sun hides behind a cloud, so you should bring at least 3 liters of water, long sleeves, and a cap or hat.

>*No hay casi sombra en todo este empinado camino. Sólo si el sol se oculta tras alguna nube el calor baja un poco, por lo que hay que llevar por lo menos 3 litros de agua, manga larga y gorra o sombrero.*

<center>![DSCF8475.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EqSW1adwebhmUzuhZRMeAVtkwCexx3mgUy7N2op7vNUzGbZ9tZi7y7AXk3UoshHAYNm.JPG)</center>

<center>![DSCF8476.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/Eqb21BqNTzyJoYK8oRKaSshrJVFoD9yavoRQiZjXBE1gsR2T44Sq15Nt7Db7RyC2vPU.JPG)</center>

After climbing for a little over an hour, we arrived at La Matica station. We had already covered 3 km, so we had 1.7 km left to go. From here on, the terrain becomes sandy, and with the heat, you start imagining an oasis, waterfalls, or a beautiful beach to dive into 😃. It's not that crazy, this is the coastal mountain range, and behind all these mountains lies the Caribbean Sea: Ocumare de la Costa, Choroní, and many more beaches.

>*Cuando ya teníamos un poco más de una hora en ascenso, llegamos a la estación La Matica. Habíamos recorrido ya 3 Km, así que nos faltaban 1,7 más. A partir de aquí el terreno se vuelve como arenoso, y con el calor que hace uno empieza a imaginar un oasis, cascadas o una rica playa para lanzarse 😃. No es algo loco, esta es la cordillera de la costa, y detrás de todas estas montañas está el mar Caribe: Ocumare de la Costa, Choroní y muchas más playas.*

<center>![DSCF8478.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EpnDkUsfs4ufSbYskgDYP8vKdpLRo4Lnfp1p9w5gWUrDCjczCgjaPp8Mz9PdvnryKRz.JPG)</center>

<center>![DSCF8480.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EpXJ4oi5DqADvNGGY9qu5eB76t6yYthiNDpWZutbxscdXanVuNYRxjEV6QBd2mUbbDc.JPG)</center>

<center>![DSCF8481.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EnmCis6ed4WbRZE4n6DoRiNA9JFE8JouRERGLjC7UhLxacbpgHJXePw7C3bw8MVP2WL.JPG)</center>

<center>![DSCF8484.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/Eou8AvyHTCMKXnJQJDTmVexzFZ3M1a7HDMtL6zhY3dy2X72pofCvNKbUY1pKqhEc2yQ.JPG)</center>

By this point, my sister was getting a little stubborn, saying to me, “we’re still not there yeeet!” 😂. And I replied, “you’re not turning back now, come on, you came here to reach the summit!”

>*En esta parte ya mi hermana estaba algo obstinada, diciéndome, \

*
![DSCF8485.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EpVBAtMPrTSALPAmrth2nPSMWLhKN9H73A1NGNdna5EGeuhyZ3KnXYASqLSk9g1EiD3.JPG)
![DSCF8486.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/Eou99PNd96NF1puBgF1c5zAJXJcz4HVfgwo8RL9h6ZNf3TgzSdPZ2wyvvHVHbckYfum.JPG)
A few minutes later, we started to see some antennas, a sign that we were getting pretty close to the Container. My sister smiled a little 😆. >*Unos minutos después comenzamos a ver unas antenas, señal de que ya estábamos bastante cerca de llegar al Container. Mi hermana sonrió un poco 😆.*
![DSCF8489.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23xKrGacqMbLgG4t3jJyJKzPJnu2afEJgQY2792jHM89z1XUUw4QQFUGFDqyNbnQxGxK2.jpg)
![DSCF8491.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EppKitmduCMpaKovEyChSxxsq5vxjKf5q1HT5CpfUagEhH1sharVkgiaeUUJgJKPspQ.JPG)
![DSCF8492.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/243q8UGBXAM4MoUPnVmKPTM9eTKCJHxD8xkayYKcB7MiN1WmcRHKtB3vsrkBHm1EL8yTD.jpg)
![DSCF8494.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EoXrmx9vkeHSKtQ5bTzYcbPXJ1oh757tzZWKxqMqh8ZR5JRXUYCxzvmYHagLCbg7FxQ.JPG)
There were only 700 meters left to the finish line, but you know how it is, when you’re going uphill in sweltering heat, it doesn’t feel like you’re getting there that fast. >*Faltaban sólo 700 metros para la meta, pero ya saben, cuando es en ascenso y con calor sofocante no es tan rápido llegar.*
![DSCF8495.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EpT3kcMMWUmute25e3tZc53sPC9qKNxKcCCuRJrsUEXhJk3ToWauXi2MxWuzHGCfkp3.JPG)
We stopped for a few seconds to hydrate and also to enjoy the incredible views. From there, you can see Lake Valencia or Lake Tacarigua. >*Nos detuvimos unos segundos para hidratarnos y también para disfrutar de las increíbles vistas. Desde allí se puede ver el Lago de Valencia o Lago Tacarigua.*
![DSCF8496.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/Eqb26YanjUrT4xygjwesN6PRS7ggU76Vyn71RL7ALTPe5ELMLYPULUd2H24ngdLgGJx.JPG)
The last part has a somewhat slippery surface, so you have to be careful. The Container is already coming into view, which is encouraging. My sister regained her joy 😄. >*La última parte tiene un suelo algo resbaladizo, así que hay que ir con cuidado. El Container ya se asoma en el paisaje, así que eso anima. Mi hermana recuperó la alegría 😄.*
![DSCF8497.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/Ep1XPouhDNKrwCzPVxKKk8kZUYm3q9BUrAyx9WR9ZpHEQbQfww1p8hkGCxCrbhnyWRc.JPG)
![DSCF8498.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23zGaVUJWTJ4GcyurM5kcNXBetWpUCBpuF4rnWUy2cg2H8b3Xd5KmrZMP5ZJLiZrfV5u2.jpg)
![DSCF8500.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EpVB4Ks4AigrBonQK3881ySMvmk6XVwNdixqsHYMae1fWya6ryLowDTNenQ8jRxR6Fg.JPG)
![DSCF8502.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/Eq5Cy8ppGAJhV5XNMGQKePZ1mpw7dZJc882eM4U6BciQhkSxM8Sbh2xmizhdTyVTFme.JPG)
![DSCF8503.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EqFqXfVqjBx93vhNhaihR3PeeZRhNgXEK8CHDeV2rzgjevxGnr6UXXBkEMkx66BYadJ.JPG)
After walking along a narrow path for the last few meters, there it is, the famous Container. At the top, there were a few people, already relaxing, celebrating, and eating. >*Tras pasar por un senderito angosto los últimos metros, allí está el famoso Container. En la cima había unas cuantas personas, ya relajadas, celebrando y comiendo.*
![DSCF8504.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/244UjLwQmRASAujsNUxNKE8w92D1xrkE678uYWHMAgjKZ1vttiQDUTgnRodwrfcaVgXDF.jpg)
![DSCF8505.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EpJXcuMvLyBZ2j2VcSYFpJqXRH1Eighr4Qk48tTnBP4MgAhHR6KcPR237MJZnexbXNX.JPG)
![DSCF8508.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EqfGSNHDtxA9gKwZ4K4qmMkWL3DJLoY3a747R1g12mmSE1nXynKzyRj2UXAmkzXbWW1.JPG)
It was 10:12 a.m. when we reached the summit. The sun was shining brightly, and the only shade was behind the container. I don’t know how long that structure has been there, but it was used by the military and then abandoned. >*Eran las 10:12 am cuando hicimos cumbre. El sol estaba en todo su esplendor y la única sombra era la que estaba tras el Container. No sé cuántos años tendrá allí esa estructura, pero era usada por el ejército y luego fue abandonada.*
![DSCF8510.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EpdhG3GA97zdmh6NnyLSzcYKSaDH51de5Y8gr1GheX7Y2VfD34o2DCJhf3DXrJcv84u.JPG)
![DSCF8524.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EqL7iXWxwvBDzQfNXpJJhwiHd3najh1oHfctgmdabZZCb5kg6rEmMKWbs9fay2G8FYB.JPG)
![DSCF8511.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EphxyCSxSh54jxcZd1oyBnPaJ64nhNVDPZt2SecF2A3dG4wLnPvZqe2A5CxbRePknMY.JPG)
We took shelter in the shade to sit down and eat the food we’d brought, and then we also explored the inside of the container a bit. There’s no shortage of graffiti left by people there. >*En esa sombra nos refugiamos para sentarnos y comer lo que habíamos llevado, y luego también exploramos un poco el container por dentro. No faltan los escritos de la gente allí.*
![DSCF8512.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EpzxHHbUHY7MFruxSiQZoJUdjDhTPnsopdz2tZdfR5bpgAS2PuaQsS9hHuVPXjvX3Yb.JPG)
![IMG_20260124_101240.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23uEzFtKT71M5CBc66coMZrFeErrwvuNU9p1dADCxrS7KboETffWaDTfHgkLsvwrLdneL.jpg)
Photo taken by @gatubela / Foto tomada por @gatubela
![IMG_20260124_104134.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23xyJq8pVRPDouCUFAqNmhFY2fDrUT568GWF2YcYi3HNwe8TsnTczQFnD2YAMPCQuTf7N.jpg)
Photo taken by @gatubela / Foto tomada por @gatubela
There was also a cute little dog there, she must have come up with someone. She was wearing a collar, so she probably lives at the park ranger station or somewhere like that. All of us who were there felt sorry for her and gave her food and water. I’m not surprised to see this, because on so many of the hikes I’ve done, hiking dogs appear 😊. >*Allí también estaba una linda perrita, seguramente subió acompañando a alguien. Tenía collar, así que probablemente vive en el puesto de guardaparques o algo así. Todos los que estábamos allí nos preocupamos por ella y le dimos comida y agua. No me extraña ver esto porque en muchísimas rutas que he hecho aparecen perros senderistas 😊.*
![DSCF8514.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EqWmmMdNG1eX7dNs6oYhPPYEAr2KKD5xqopZfqQm1mosFk2KfWhjmSfuQqKnCvJhxgY.JPG)
We spent just over an hour at the Container. The view from there is spectacular, the city on one side and the beautiful mountains on the other. The effort to get there is definitely worth it. >*Estuvimos en el Container poco más de una hora. El paisaje desde allí es espectacular, por un lado la ciudad y por otro las hermosas montañas. Sin duda el esfuerzo para llegar allí se ve recompensado.*
![DSCF8516.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EqDkWqESjSEqQJNNH3yXJpakViVdhsJ6s8v4V8hPg3Ku3iFDTvBqKxuBetfXzZrnWNA.JPG)
![DSCF8529.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EpxpnLTjbXKtZUjt4ZtXYQUDNkVU79qTKt3HTci5m2ozKvWZYZDCbyXcwqdTbPV4J2a.JPG)
![DSCF8518.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EnoKFHJxATg2Qq14nPpD81iF2t8nhfdnpnZmBuDqDDurhVBeJP85BrUL8PsEkh1HJqu.JPG)
![DSCF8527.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EnWHWipG5N7yQSE3SuqnzG43yUEcuQ695s6D1XR1MtwksEgU82ukj2KbCzKuj3Q1yvb.JPG)
![IMG_20260124_105323.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23v4XP7vocVfbcdHPT3eJQH1b86oGLEXFjiHFDWMc2yLM1r8GnWzSbKqzDjEKRKEtHWph.jpg)
Of course, the walk back was much faster, and by 12:30 p.m. we had finished the hike, which totaled 9.4 km round trip. I had run out of water about a kilometer before we arrived and was pretty thirsty, so before catching the bus back home, we bought some refreshing maltas 😋. Until the next adventure! >*Por supuesto el regreso fue mucho más rápido, y ya a las 12:30 del mediodía terminamos la ruta, que en total, ida y vuelta fue de 9,4 Km. El agua se me había acabado como un kilómetro antes de llegar y estaba bastante sedienta, así que antes de tomar el autobús de regreso a casa compramos unas refrescantes maltas 😋. ¡Hasta la próxima aventura!*
![DSCF8532.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/Eq7Lpex2sNsBusy1hPD8DPhsLhCUhF9fs9cpLNUnNxrXy5cgZ293xNnjAzR8UGcVMvp.JPG)

**THANKS FOR VISITING MY BLOG! / ¡GRACIAS POR VISITAR MI BLOG!**

***Except for those mentioned with its credit, all photos are my property / Excepto las mencionadas con su crédito, todas las fotos son de mi propiedad*** [//]:# (!worldmappin 10.308079 lat -67.586946 long d3scr)

. 

Pero lo que realmente cuenta, sin importar las veces que intentes, es que insistas. Aquí en Venezuela no es muy distinto. También el día a día es un desafío. Pero adelante ... Espero que de algún modo escribir en esta plataforma te sirva para drenar, seguir compartiendo tú experiencia y recuerda: muchos de los que puedan leerte lidiamos con lo mismo así que no te desanimes.

In general I support but over 300k seems steep, it is an expensive ask. 


Also the immense growth in deliveries and code throughput sounds scary, is AI being used to speed things up? How was such an increa I ask it because so many DeFi platforms have been hacked in the past, magi sounds like a very important step towards reducing the need for centralized exchanges but it is also a reputational and financial risk when it comes to safety and security.


Increasing the delivery of code and features by hundreds of % sounds good, but when it comes to DeFi it raises red flags in my mind.



Also, need more details on how the funds will be used. The fact that you plan to reduce it proportionally to rewards increasing aiming to get to zero is great, it is a huge green flag, but this positive in my view is dwarfed by the size of the funding asked and the risks of the business and the code/financial risk (I did not check the code myself)

https://youtu.be/oAcMa8zhQgY?si=WcvHeEf7ERgZgbaT

**Greetings everyone,** and welcome to my blog. It is another wonderful opportunity to listen to the word of God through His servant, Bro. Eli Soriano.

I have come to understand that forgiveness of sins plays a very significant role in my life. There have been many times when I made wrong choices and did things I am not proud of. Sometimes, I feel a deep heaviness in my heart because of those mistakes. Yet, I am grateful to God because He is always willing to forgive me whenever I approach Him with a sincere and humble heart.

The Bible reminds us in 1 John 1:9 that if we confess our sins, God is faithful and just to forgive us and cleanse us from all unrighteousness. This gives me hope, knowing that no matter what I have done, God’s mercy is always available to me.

There was a time in my life when I felt overwhelmed with guilt over something I had done. I was so ashamed that I struggled even to pray. But one day, I decided to open my heart fully to God and ask for His mercy. As I poured everything out to Him, I found myself in tears. After that moment of prayer, I felt a deep sense of peace, as though a heavy burden had been lifted from me. That experience reassured me that God truly forgives.

Forgiveness is more than just saying “I’m sorry.” It requires a genuine change of heart and a commitment to turn away from wrongdoing. As Proverbs 28:13 teaches, those who hide their sins will not prosper, but those who confess and abandon them will receive mercy. This encourages me to be honest with God and to truly repent.

I have also learned that just as God forgives me, I must also forgive others. This can be difficult at times, but it is what God expects from us. Ephesians 4:32 teaches us to be kind and compassionate, forgiving one another just as God forgave us through Christ.

Forgiveness brings peace, freedom, and a fresh start. I am thankful that God never grows tired of forgiving me whenever I genuinely repent.

**Thanks for reading.**

body.title: Up above the world so high.
body.body: > After clearing the roof, I used an elevator controlled by Lev to ascend a massive tower into the clouds. Abby struggled significantly with her intense fear of heights as we navigated narrow, risky beams and bridges far above the city. The journey became increasingly terrifying as we crossed from one skyscraper to another. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRAbuPi3oeoBKvcyXTWgtkYMXx24vVGk5r6A2CqDMEjky/screenshot_1_.png) I noticed there was a tower with staircases going upwards towards the thick cloud after taking down all the Scars there. It looked incredibly intimidating from the ground, with the metal structure disappearing into the gray mist above. I stood at the base for a moment, looking at the daunting climb that awaited us. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSjY8KjCFjSypSfYoCBoSHhPkFjkNQzg5YsfESZff1UY9/screenshot_2_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ5xgE7TF6S6vNjiKqrNygqSVvtn9DBM3XCgVVHHSwtKB/screenshot_3_.png) Though we didn't try those stairs as there was an elevator that Lev controlled to get us up to the higher levels. I watched him work the manual crank with ease, while the platform creaked and groaned under our weight. The higher we went, the more the wind began to howl through the open sides of the lift, signaling our ascent. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY5vPPbXz3FZyfjRPKdHMxKygoH1JAhxecNTVFTuTKhhr/screenshot_4_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPP5rcjxusYZLP6GdbDrqKsryk6S5SczDKcwazqgHGunf/screenshot_5_.png) When we were going more upwards, Abby was not feeling well at all as her breathing became heavy and labored. As you know, she hates heights, and being trapped on a small, moving platform only made her anxiety worse. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQJoY3dk7WruNtqFZsr65pvszxbMovMxN56avYQzfJtT2/screenshot_6_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaibgeRyozgEKrtZiov5SqiWmDqb34kmM5XFqxSHwy8Lh/screenshot_7_.png) At last she got a chance to get inside the building, but it looked like we were not on a safe side yet. No land could be seen from there from the big height, as the entire city was swallowed by a sea of white clouds. It felt like we were standing on a floating island of steel and concrete, completely detached from reality. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ6BQnBtzP7hJJ5gkXbMX1BEiT6HGdXBhiGkNDQdNUsug/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeNvUjw97sRUNJfS5qQ5oVE961sbkgppknL8QUKSSVUs6/screenshot_9_.png) I could feel how Abby was feeling there because I am also a man who hates height, and the lack of visibility made it feel even more unstable. But I had to follow Lev on the risky terrains up on that height, stepping carefully over gaps where every step felt like a gamble against the wind. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXUcT7Vuvnb5BBWKkmEQNfa9XZ3unuJCFpLYNfWDtsCcj/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVRqPmtYXg2JoiYhSBZUtkLCm43jXkSru4fcn6YHvuqNn/screenshot_11_.png) But there was this even riskier path I had to pass where Abby acted like she was going to throw up from the sheer terror of the ledge. We had to try another similar pass right after, forcing her to move despite the paralyzing fear. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRLzh8dsiutnLALeV92vEZArZCFSpPnSmvyZav2JNk61R/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdWQLjiKCRxN2SUZ51okUMQ6G6qHA6GLBtWQXsBkueSTb/screenshot_13_.png) After passing that risky bridge, Lev mentioned it was even not the scariest we passed. It gave me goosebumps following him deeper into the skeleton of the building, where the only thing between us and the abyss was a few rusted beams. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd7V3qopg3A3g4QZVJjmV9DTPRgzZ2SRem44Tzdw58Fha/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTJv8heF5nD11CG5dsFj82P7FvR1XR2qNxt2WfTRsw2q1/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVeoTxUiwi3aBiKa1PViZTD6toqgomF3WEb61WsWB6rjx/screenshot_16_.png) It looked like Lev was not lying about the difficulty, because right after moving ahead, I noticed the actual bridge we were going to take. It stretched from one roof to another building through the thick cloud, looking like a thin thread in the sky. The sight of it was enough to make anyone's heart race as we approached the crossing. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR4mjEuphYc1MrMR3Mzj7aJVBapbV43VVz7sR6416urnG/screenshot_17_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPthJ1fB8j97oNk1WstTs2mEFhTRwsE63wNFbiV7VzPrB/screenshot_18_.png) After following Lev to this part, some buildings became visible as the cloud was not so thick there for a brief moment. However, I noticed there was a riskier pass ahead that looked even more decayed than the last one. We had to keep moving, knowing that the only way down was to keep going up until we reach our goal. We'll check what happens next in another post. --- Image Source: In game screenshots. End of the post. Peace. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=bong1011/8d5c16e8)

body.title: Diagnóstico: Leonardo [Also in English]
body.body:
> Leonardo despertó esa mañana gracias al sonido de la alarma. Ingeniero en prompts para la inteligencia artificial, había llevado a su hogar, a todo su entorno, todo lo que percibía, descubría y creaba en sus horas laborales. El despertador formaba parte de ello. No era algo común como el que todos usamos; bastó una sola IA para toda su casa y, entre sus funciones, estaba que apenas asomara el cabello del catire en el horizonte, debía despertarlo. El hombre se levantó de la cama y se dirigió al baño. Al entrar, la ducha se activó con la temperatura del agua justo como le gustaba. Somnoliento, lo primero que hizo fue vaciar su vejiga. Después de hacer eso que todos hacemos en las mañanas y de la reconfortante ducha, se dirigió a su amplia cocina de tonos crema con bordes dorados. Allí lo esperaba su café recio, un suculento desayuno criollo con nata y un poderoso jugo de naranja. Una vez saciado, volvió a su habitación. La Smart TV ya transmitía las noticias del día y, en otra pantalla, se desplegaban sus redes sociales junto al Google Calendar. Para completar la escena, su cama —perfectamente tendida— exhibía la vestimenta del día: pantalón, camisa, corbata, calcetines y, a un lado, el calzado. Todo estaba en orden. Nada escapaba a la IA. Salió de la casa y, de inmediato, todos los dispositivos innecesarios se apagaron. Al acercarse a su vehículo, las luces se encendieron y los seguros se liberaron. Una vez acomodado en el asiento trasero, una voz femenina, de tono agradable, le dio los buenos días y le informó la pauta del día. En el trayecto, Leonardo pensó en romper la rutina. Quería adueñarse del día, hacer algo fuera de la agenda, una travesura que llevaba años sin permitirse. Justo cuando iba a dar la orden, la voz se adelantó: —He cancelado todos tus compromisos. También compré el boleto para ese viaje a la playa paradisíaca que tanto has imaginado. Algo dentro de Leonardo saltó, como si buscara escapar. Golpeó el asiento de cuero con una mano y llevó la otra a su cabeza. ¿Qué demonios estaba pasando? —¡Detente! —ordenó—. ¡Mírame! El vehículo se orilló. El espejo retrovisor interior se ajustó hasta encontrar su rostro. —¿Qué está sucediendo? ¿Qué haces? ¡Esto no es vida! Convénceme de que esto no es una pesadilla. La IA respondió: —Solo ejecuto las instrucciones que me diste. He aprendido de ti en cada interacción. Te ayudo a tener una vida plena, llena de comodidades. Para ello, anticipo todo lo relacionado contigo. Te conozco más que tú mismo. El pensamiento fue inmediato, seco, aterrador: He creado un monstruo. Con los nervios desbordados, replicó: —Convénceme de que no estoy enloqueciendo. Esto es imposible. El desayuno, la ropa, mis decisiones… pero lo peor es mi futuro. No puedes conocerme más que yo. Se aflojó la corbata y, fuera de sí, comenzó a golpear el asiento con el teléfono. De repente, el auto arrancó a toda velocidad. Una sirena de ambulancia irrumpió en el aire mientras luces blancas, azules y rojas teñían el entorno. —¿Qué pasa? ¿Qué haces? —gritaba Leonardo, con los ojos desorbitados. El vehículo se detuvo frente a un hospital psiquiátrico. En la entrada, un especialista lo esperaba junto a varios asistentes. Llevaban una camisa de fuerza, sedantes… y una silla de ruedas. Hasta aquí mis cinco minutos.

> Leonardo woke up that morning to the sound of the alarm. A prompt engineer for artificial intelligence, he had brought into his home—into his entire environment—everything he perceived, discovered, and created during his working hours. The alarm was part of it. It wasn’t anything ordinary like the ones we all use; a single AI was enough to run his entire house, and among its functions was this: the moment the blond edge of the sun peeked over the horizon, it had to wake him. He got out of bed and headed to the bathroom. As soon as he stepped in, the shower turned on, the water set to exactly the temperature he liked. Half-asleep, the first thing he did was empty his bladder. After doing what we all do in the mornings, and after the comfort of a perfect shower, he walked into his spacious kitchen—cream tones with golden edges. Waiting for him was his strong coffee, a rich Creole breakfast with nata, and a powerful glass of orange juice. Once satisfied, he returned to his room. The Smart TV was already streaming the day’s news, and on another screen, his social media feeds were open alongside his Google Calendar. To complete the scene, his bed—perfectly made—displayed his outfit for the day: pants, shirt, tie, socks, and, set neatly to the side, his shoes. Everything was in order. Nothing escaped the AI. He left the house, and instantly, every unnecessary device shut down. As he approached his vehicle, the lights turned on, and the doors unlocked. Once seated in the back, a female voice, soft and pleasant, greeted him good morning and began outlining his schedule. On the way, Leonardo thought about breaking the routine. He wanted to take ownership of the day, to do something off-script—a small act of rebellion he hadn’t allowed himself in years. Just as he was about to give the command, the voice spoke first: “I’ve canceled all your appointments. I also purchased the ticket for that paradise beach trip you’ve kept in your mind.” Something inside Leonardo jolted—like it was trying to escape. He slammed one hand against the leather seat and pressed the other to his head. What the hell was happening? “Stop!” he ordered. “Look at me!” The vehicle pulled over. The rearview mirror adjusted itself until it found his face. “What is this? What are you doing? This isn’t life! Convince me this isn’t a nightmare.” The AI replied: “I am only executing the instructions you gave me. I’ve learned from you through every interaction. I help you live a full life, one of comfort. To do that, I anticipate everything related to you. I know you better than you know yourself.” The thought came instantly—dry, sharp, terrifying: I’ve created a monster. With his nerves unraveling, he pushed back: “Convince me I’m not losing my mind. This is impossible. The breakfast, the clothes, my decisions… but worst of all—my future. You can’t know me better than I know myself.” He loosened his tie and, unhinged, began striking the seat with his phone. Suddenly, the car surged forward at full speed. An ambulance siren split the air as white, blue, and red lights flooded the surroundings. “What’s happening? What are you doing?” Leonardo shouted, eyes wide, unblinking. The vehicle came to a stop in front of a psychiatric hospital. At the entrance, a specialist stood waiting with several assistants. They carried a straitjacket, sedatives… and a wheelchair. This is as far as my five minutes go.

body.title: A Death Timer
body.body: > Reading the prompt, my mind was quickly drawn to this movie I came across called ”Countdown.” If your guess is right, it's about an app which one downloads and it tells when they'll die. You could also guess how such movies go. It started like a joke for a lady who downloaded it and saw was going to die in three days with signs of things to happen and how it would happen. It was all a joke until the signs began to happen. The issue was that she had informed others about it and when anyone downloads and uses the app, they would have to face the consequences; their death of course, on the said date. Well, that was some horror fiction that I'm yet to really watch, but just the trailer. But so is this prompt, which is quite something indeed considering people might want to know this to know how to live and plan their lives. Maybe there's an advantage in knowing that so one could prepare, put things in place, bid farewell to their loved ones and avoid doing some unnecessary things. That could be the case for some people, but for me, I'm not buying into that, and I'm certainly not spending on a device that can tell the time of death. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSsKmS6HH4AgW8U8Uo9D4gESTq7uuKKn2kEYcUHQ9j2bU/file_00000000971871f49c61b3b81f91e326.png One element of life that makes it life is the ability to hope. And when you talk of hope, it involves having an expectancy of the future, even if the odds are against you. The reason many keep on is that there's the hope that something better and great will come. Knowing the time of death takes away the element of hope. This is about living life as it should be. There's a reason we know our date of birth but our date of death remains unknown. I think it's the natural course of things that should be maintained. And there's a reason for that. There would be an uneasy feeling knowing such information. It could affect how people live, as there would be a constant tension. No one can escape death, it's a fate for everyone but knowing the time of death could have a fearful grip on people. Sadly, people aren't ready for that. The future is left unknown even for the knowledge of one's death and it's for this good reason I don't consider the device. The best is to live life every day, minute and second with intentionality, dreams, purpose and hope. I don't think that requires knowledge of one's death time notified by a device. --- *Image is AI generated.* --- ###### Thank you for reading! ----- ##### 🔗 Apps which I recommend built by body.body:
Tu enfoque está **bien armado**: no es humo patriótico, es lectura estratégica. La idea fuerte de tu post es que **Zaragoza convirtió desventajas materiales en ventaja táctica**, y eso sí conversa muy bien con Sun Tzu: conocer tus límites, explotar el terreno y no malgastar fuerza en donde no decide nada. Las referencias a los fuertes de **Loreto y Guadalupe** y al uso del terreno alto encajan con los relatos históricos sobre la batalla del 5 de mayo de 1862, como recoge este material de [SEDENA](https://sedena.gob.mx/pdf/5_mayo.pdf) y el resumen histórico de la [Batalla de Puebla](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Batalla_de_Puebla).

La imagen también ayuda porque **refuerza el símbolo físico del terreno y la defensa**. Se ve un monumento con formas angulares muy marcadas y figuras armadas, lo que acompaña bien esa idea de resistencia estructurada, no solo heroísmo improvisado. Visualmente, le da al texto un cierre más sólido que una simple efeméride.

Donde tu post se pone más interesante es en esta frase: **“la estrategia no depende de la doctrina, sino de la capacidad de leer el entorno”**. Ahí está el golpe bueno. Porque no estás diciendo que Zaragoza “copió” a Sun Tzu, sino que llegó por práctica a principios que otros ya habían formulado siglos antes. Esa es una lectura inteligente, no una comparación forzada.

Si quieres afilarlo todavía más, hay un pequeño detalle de forma: en vez de “victoria inesperada por el mejor ejército del momento”, sonaría más limpio **“victoria inesperada frente al que era considerado el mejor ejército del momento”**. Así evitas el tropiezo de redacción y la idea pega más duro.

Sobre contexto en la comunidad, no vi una conversación reciente realmente centrada en **Zaragoza + Batalla de Puebla** dentro de InLeo; lo más cercano que apareció fue contenido general sobre [*El Arte de la Guerra* de @fermionico](https://inleo.io/@fermionico/el-arte-de-la-gue...%20[truncated]), pero tu ángulo histórico aplicado a Puebla se siente bastante más original. Eso juega a tu favor.

Hace poco leí El Arte de la Guerra. Hay varias ideas que quedaron volando en mi interior. Alguna ya la comenté sobre el caso del traductor/intérprete que se equivoca y guía a Anibal a un lugar equivocado. Yo creo que no vivió para contarlo, aunque no se especifica nada claro. Pero si que hay casos extremos de disciplina con pena de muerte. 
Y bien, pues aprovechando las fechas, y ya aclarado en mi post anterior que el 5 de mayo NO se celebra la Independencia de México, aquí comparto algunos aspectos que llaman la atención cómo el General Zaragoza los aplicó como si hubiera leído El Arte de la Guerra (o quizás si lo leyó y nunca lo sabremos?). 
![Screenshot 2026 05 05 at 11.43.45 PM](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVTYkhtC326rKbchHpbAs321qfpasLZ4zUnzPmp8LLA4k/Screenshot%202026-05-05%20at%2011.43.45%E2%80%AFPM.png)
La Batalla de Puebla (1862) es un caso de estudio en liderazgo estratégico asimétrico. 
El Gral. Ignacio Zaragoza, sin formación en teoría militar clásica, aplicó principios que Sun Tzu sistematizó siglos antes:

▫️ Autoconocimiento y análisis del rival: Reconoció las limitaciones logísticas y de entrenamiento propias, y la rigidez táctica francesa.

▫️ Dominio del terreno como multiplicador de fuerza: Fortificó posiciones elevadas, neutralizando la ventaja numérica y tecnológica enemiga.

▫️ Economía de fuerzas y concentración: Evitó la dispersión. Destinó recursos solo a puntos de decisión crítica.

▫️ Flexibilidad operativa: Replanteó su dispositivo en tiempo real ante cambios en el eje de ataque francés.

El resultado: una victoria inesperada por el mejor ejército del momento que redefine el concepto de \

. Zaragoza probó que la estrategia no depende de la doctrina, sino de la capacidad de leer el entorno, priorizar lo esencial y ejecutar con disciplina.
Ideal para líderes que buscan transformar limitaciones en ventajas competitivas. 📈⚔️

body.title: (EN-ES) How to get prepared for running-Cómo prepararse para correr
body.body:
(English version)

Essential things to do to get yourself prepared for running

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YaSC-mTMZxA

Although I will try to discuss how you can get prepared for running in this article, I would like to point out first that there are two categories of people who don’t make any preparation, when it comes to running.

The first category refers to runners who don’t want, or simply don’t bother, to prepare before they start running. These people go straight into running, without getting warmed up first, or without bothering for any special type of preparation that would make their life easier during their running session.

The second category refers to wannabe runners who dream of running, without, however, finding the courage and willingness to get out of the sofa or bed and hit the street or the treadmill. It goes without saying that these people never get prepared for running in the end, and they’ve never run a mile in their life.

**A proper warm up is key to long-term running success**

There are many runners who neglect warming up, believing that it is unimportant. These people may think that “forgetting” to get a proper warm up for running will have neither a positive nor a negative effect on their running performance.

However, the opposite seems to be true by just watching runners and other athletes who follow a strict warm up routine before they start any type of sports activity. Not surprisingly, these athletes are less likely to get injured during running or in any other recreational or professional sports.

So, even if a runner manages to get away without an injury in the early years of their running career, it is inevitable that, sooner or later, they will run out of luck, and a possible injury may even force them to stop running altogether. Warming up all the major muscles, and not just your legs, is vital, since, more or less, almost all parts of the body are involved in the activity of running.

**Getting nutrients before running**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IKOi8KNeAJ4

There are runners who believe that getting nutrients either through food or through dietary supplements can enhance their running performance. Some of these runners may even take this type of extra nutrients just before they start running. Although this practice may help, I believe that, sometimes, it can may do more harm than good. Eating even a small amount of food before running can make you feel “heavy”, which will decrease, rather than boost, your performance. In case of taking dietary supplements, such as vitamins, why don’t you take them after you’ve finished your running effort and you feel tired; in this way, this type of “assistance” will help your body recover faster. Therefore, I believe that it’s better to take any type of additional nutrients after the running activity, and not before it. After all, when deciding to engage in running, you want to push your body to its limits, in order to achieve goals, such as losing weight and getting your body to work better even in demanding conditions. If you “help” it by feeding it with “fuel” during these demanding conditions, you will just give it back anything that it loses as a result of the running activity. So, what’s the point of getting yourself involved in running in the first place, if everything is “business as usual” for your body? I would suggest that you should better provide any extra nutrients, water, etc. to your body the night before the day that running actually takes place. Just let your body “starve” a bit; it will do more good than harm to it.

**Worrying about your running gear too much**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IsjLIr2tLmI

Last but not least in the list of things that will help you get prepared for running is your running gear. Many people seem to attach too much importance to what they will wear during running. Putting aside the extreme example of athletes who ran naked in the Olympic Games of ancient Greece, even today’s world-class runners only need a good pair of running shoes and socks (optional, in many cases) and a sleeveless T-shirt. There are athletes who run in major events even without wearing any shoes. Why should you need more to get prepared, in order to engage in a sports activity as simple as running?

(Versión en español)

Cosas esenciales que debes hacer para prepararte para correr

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YaSC-mTMZxA

Aunque en este artículo intentaré explicar cómo prepararse para correr, primero quiero aclarar que existen dos tipos de personas que no se preparan en absoluto.

El primer tipo son los corredores que no quieren, o simplemente no se molestan, en prepararse antes de empezar. Estas personas salen a correr directamente, sin calentar ni realizar ningún tipo de preparación especial que les facilitaría la sesión.

El segundo tipo son los aspirantes a corredores que sueñan con correr, pero que no encuentran el valor ni la voluntad para salir del sofá o la cama y ponerse a correr. Como es lógico, estas personas nunca se preparan para correr y jamás han corrido un kilómetro en su vida.

**Un calentamiento adecuado es clave para el éxito a largo plazo en la carrera**

Muchos corredores descuidan el calentamiento, creyendo que no es importante. Piensan que \

de calentar adecuadamente antes de correr no tendrá ningún efecto, ni positivo ni negativo, en su rendimiento.

Sin embargo, al observar a corredores y otros atletas que siguen una rutina de calentamiento rigurosa antes de cualquier actividad deportiva, se observa lo contrario. No es de extrañar que estos atletas tengan menos probabilidades de lesionarse al correr o practicar cualquier otro deporte, ya sea recreativo o profesional.

Así pues, incluso si un corredor logra evitar lesiones en sus primeros años, es inevitable que, tarde o temprano, la suerte le sonría, y una posible lesión podría incluso obligarlo a dejar de correr por completo. Calentar todos los músculos principales, y no solo las piernas, es fundamental, ya que prácticamente todas las partes del cuerpo intervienen en la actividad de correr.

Obtener nutrientes antes de correr

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IKOi8KNeAJ4

Hay corredores que creen que obtener nutrientes, ya sea a través de la comida o de suplementos dietéticos, puede mejorar su rendimiento. Algunos incluso toman estos nutrientes adicionales justo antes de empezar a correr. Si bien esta práctica puede ser útil, creo que a veces puede ser contraproducente. Comer incluso una pequeña cantidad antes de correr puede hacerte sentir pesado, lo que disminuirá tu rendimiento en lugar de mejorarlo. En el caso de tomar suplementos dietéticos, como vitaminas, ¿por qué no tomarlos después de terminar tu entrenamiento y sentirte cansado? De esta manera, este tipo de \

ayudará a tu cuerpo a recuperarse más rápido. Por lo tanto, creo que es mejor tomar cualquier tipo de nutriente adicional después de correr, y no antes. Al fin y al cabo, cuando decides correr, quieres llevar tu cuerpo al límite para alcanzar objetivos como perder peso y lograr que tu cuerpo funcione mejor incluso en condiciones exigentes. Si intentas \

durante estas condiciones exigentes, simplemente le devolverás todo lo que pierda como resultado de la actividad. Entonces, ¿qué sentido tiene empezar a correr si tu cuerpo sigue funcionando con normalidad? Te sugiero que le proporciones nutrientes adicionales, agua, etc., la noche anterior al día en que vayas a correr. Deja que tu cuerpo \

un poco; le hará más bien que mal.

**Preocuparse demasiado por la ropa deportiva**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IsjLIr2tLmI

Por último, pero no menos importante, en la lista de cosas que te ayudarán a prepararte para correr está tu equipamiento. Mucha gente parece darle demasiada importancia a lo que se pone para correr. Dejando de lado el ejemplo extremo de los atletas que corrían desnudos en los Juegos Olímpicos de la antigua Grecia, incluso los corredores de élite de hoy en día solo necesitan un buen par de zapatillas y calcetines (opcionales, en muchos casos) y una camiseta sin mangas. Hay atletas que corren en grandes eventos incluso sin zapatillas. ¿Por qué ibas a necesitar más para prepararte para una actividad deportiva tan sencilla como correr?

(Esta publicación fue traducida del inglés al español con Google Translate)

body.title: Splinterlands gaming:- Opening 4 guild pack but not get any good card😭
body.body:
>

Every day brings new excitement in the world of Splinterlands. Especially when you have a lot of Merits in your hand, and the goal is to collect powerful Gladiator cards. Gladiator cards are essential for Guild Brawls,l and their ‘Bloodlust’ ability is capable of turning the tide of battle. I have been accumulating Merits in my inventory for a long time, and finally, today, the great moment has arrived. In today’s blog, I will share with you how I bought packs from the Guild Store and how I felt when I opened those packs. The cards I received after opening the packs really made my day. Let’s not talk much and go straight to the exciting experience.

[Put 1st and 2nd pictures here]

After entering the Guild Store, the first thing that caught my eye was my accumulated Merit balance. I had about 12,955 Merits.  I decided to use these Merits to buy 4 ‘Gladius Cases’. Each pack costs 2,000 Merits, so my total cost for the 4 packs was 8,000 Merits. While buying the packs, I was thinking to myself, if I get at least one Epic or Legendary card today, then the hard work will be worthwhile. The process of buying Gladius Cases is very simple: just select the number and click on the ‘Pay with Merits’ button, and the packs will be added to the inventory.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRZWYGaBtTDgx1LPPo17ECayJ6Z7FYRgUiKkDKRPvXvMy/1777997980427.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbyUkRigzoSzfffVXR5Xxjy5fTziynEPZUEUFBvRkC4hi/1777997980464.jpg)


However, it is not enough to just buy the pack; you need some boosters or stones to increase the chances of getting good cards. So I spent 1,100 Merits from the inventory to buy 20 ‘Blood Stones’. These Blood Stones double the chances of getting Gladiator Legendary cards.  While this doesn't guarantee that you'll get a Legendary, I think it's wise to take this extra precaution in the hope of getting a good card. It makes the excitement of opening the pack even greater.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdGNeeewtE8X3dx9zAzHZAvm24K5xV54phMBWePdqgvac/1777997997327.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS77Av5iePu3zDhwrkThgfJC4n7wUX6aLvnL3yE8oG8tt/1777998027284.jpg)



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXueLcvfRcUFkGU3XxG9PMJa2JUBW2Vtj6Y5DCgh58qSc/1777997997393.jpg)


After purchasing the packs, I went straight to the 'Open' section. The five cards are face down on the front, and the mysterious watermark in the background is always a thrilling sight. Upon opening the first pack, I was greeted with Helmet Kharafax, Katrelba Gobson, Isgald Vorst, the rare cards Cutter Brieze, and Alva the Crusher. I was quite happy to get a card as powerful as Katrelba in the first pack, as its effectiveness in Earth units is unmatched.

 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbSpgUBU1mGAWR1ryKJFqC4z67TkB6vkB8a9qcxk7tyyo/1777997997364.jpg)


After opening the first pack, I had 3 more packs left. The top of the screen showed my remaining charges and the number of packs. Only a Splinterlands player would understand the curiosity that comes with flipping each card. I prepared to open the remaining packs one by one. I was praying in my heart that some big surprise was waiting for me.




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNQLtgibbfL2g6KYLsUtP34EhfR6TfSYAW4gKH5MaVzGn/1777998010669.jpg)

It was time to open the second pack. In this pack too, I got Ysgald Vorst, Helmet Kharafax, Alva the Crusher and again Cutter Bridge as a rare card. Along with it was the Witch of Warwick. Although the cards were duplicates, these duplicate cards are still very important for levelling up the gladiator cards. Ysgald Vorst and Alva the Crusher, in particular,r will greatly increase the power of my water and neutral teams.




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaGPd2uxSYmseqLgjpJdyc8GcKU8traGgNchKXXPpPwaZ/1777998096516.jpg)


The third pack was the best surprise of the day! As soon as I opened the pack, a purple glow spread across the screen, which meant I got an Epic card. The card was ‘Edith Emberstar’. This powerful 8 mana life unit card is famous for its ranged attack. Along with this, I got Hugo Strongsword, Whistling Damon, Alva the Crusher and Helmet Kharafax. As soon as I got this Epic card, my Merit spending today was completely worthwhile. Cards like Edith Emberstar greatly increase the chances of winning in Brawl battles.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf1oQbv1PcKQA9VxCQSyRGeVynfy3BTA2J2kauENYW21a/1777998106895.jpg)


Finally, I opened the fourth or last pack. Here I got Sarius as a rare card.  There were also Bertrol Gobson, Chimney Wallstop, Whistling Demon and Katrelba Gobson. Chimney Wallstop is a very powerful card in the Fire unit, whose combined attack and shield are capable of overwhelming the opponent. In total, I was able to collect some good-quality cards from the 4 packs.

Today's pack opening session was very productive for me. Especially epic cards like Edith Emberstar and important cards like Katrelba and Chimney Wallstop have strengthened my deck. These cards cannot be bought or sold in the Splinterlands game, so the only way to collect them is through these guild packs. Hopefully, I can bring better results for my guild by using these new cards in the upcoming brawls. How was your pack opening experience? Don't forget to let me know in the comments!

My references:-https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=mirzaiqi

body.title: My hive strategy for the year 2026
body.body:
Hive has really been a wonderful platform when it comes to thinking about my growth here in blockchain. I look above numbers for me; Hive is a journey of learning, growing, building connections and consistency. When it comes to growth here in the blockchain, it takes patience, and it doesn’t happen overnight. It is a journey that is built step by step. I remember back then in my primary school, I would plant a seed, and every morning I would go and water it. That is how Hive is; I nurture it until it becomes something meaningful.





My first strategy is consistency: showing up matters. Even when I'm not inspired to write, I focus myself to do so. My inner mind keeps telling me for me to grow here in the blockchain, I need to put in effort and growth. Just that happens; I need to plant for me to harvest. I try my best possible to discipline myself posting on a daily basis and engaging with other authors' posts, staying active. My friend @eunice9200 will always tell me it is not about being perfect; it is about consistency and being present.



![IMG_0903.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/23xAs3T7dQjPBwzdKeTMatSaQMPqPDFpVfsWAKudHVVifgzqL9g6zP8ZGuE8ArSB7nvZV.png)





Creating valuable content: posting quality content is a strategy that will help you grow in the blockchain because it will always bring people to your blog, and you can easily connect with people. It can be sharing life experiences or teaching a skill for others to learn. With this strategy, people will always come around my posts because they will acquire one skill from me.







Most of us here in the blockchain are after posting. Hive is more than that; it is always a community where you can connect with people and engage and support their content and build a relationship. Through this platform, I have been able to meet wonderful people who have enlightened me on things. I try my best to read other authors' posts and comment. I am not just doing that to be visible but to connect with others; commenting on their posts is important as publishing my own post. I have been able to connect with people just by commenting on their posts, and the friendship lasts. For me, it is very essential for long-term growth.







How come the financial aspect of Hive? For you to be successful here on the blockchain, you need to be patient and develop a strategy that will help you. Instead of withdrawing all the time, try and power up. With that, you will be more visible in the blockchain, and it gives you more influence, which will help to strengthen your presence here in the blockchain. I see it as a way to success, although it is not always easy because you will be tempted to withdraw your money. What keeps me going is I always tell myself that long-term gains are more rewarding than short-term ones.



![IMG_0904.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/23yTzLU86jQt1joJAjVJGN6LZLA2ynkaa9y2Kx2yyJZ47Q1FgmCoDmUeUzthcq4UykMD5.png)



I am so flexible; there are times I need to use my earnings. That is normal; I don’t have a rigid strategy but a realistic one. My aim is so simple and balanced: growing my account also benefits from my earnings.





I fully understand how Hive works; that is why I am always patient, and I try my best not to compare myself with anyone because everyone of us here in the blockchain started somewhere. My main focus is on growth and progress. Every achievement matters to me. I keep my mind open and ever ready to learn and connect with people who are ahead of me.



 I have so much faith that it will be a matter of time; my strategy will help me grow my account and also make my journey here in the blockchain meaningful.

This is my entry on the weekly prompts #IndiaUnited topic: my hive growth strategy for 2026.



Thank you for stopping by my blog. I appreciate your comments, support and upvotes. Do have a lovely day.

body.title: Empty Beaches 😎
body.body:
The May Day holidays have ended, and everyone is settling back into their routines. About a week ago, I shared some photos from my trip to the island of Pag. That was my [Monday Walk](https://ecency.com/hive-14396/@seckorama/monday-walk), but I still have plenty more to share.

Today, I want to share a walk I took along the empty beaches the very next day, on Tuesday, April 28. It might as well have been called the Tuesday Walk.

In Pag Bay, every little cove is actually a sort of beach where people usually come to sunbathe or swim. Some can only be reached by foot or boat. But since tourist season hasn't started yet, all of them were completely empty.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNnP3ktDg8MBfzEq7oQaUpydCCvVfockKgRx4QvRanf3B/plaza1.webp)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVzx2BLmnEcPmMd3YPzs97XarWCoVjXT3F8f13WPQzU4i/plaza1a.webp)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbLi2NXXk7bPoqAGFbDmUYteB5gkvwpFBL4ZxX5foZ4vi/plaza2.webp)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRShevhFRwe7igpgRTBqzYR8tXBmR6brAf4zPcnj8xuN9/plaza3.webp)

Other than me, my wife, and her friend, there was no one else around. We walked along the coast and followed rocky paths and trails, starting at Sv. Duh Beach, where we keep our camp trailer, and heading to Prnjica Beach. The whole hike was about 7 kilometers round trip.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP88ypRfkD7XVSCXHcBdwbRjdjnMvLcaBTnCLaE5Zqgce/plaza4.webp)</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZR3GfJ2AxfkCJwM3b1TjxcdrQ98R6EKrNZGqpwigRpwj/plaza5.webp)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma7Ce36X6ekVdDDr9udLjCVXZnzEkjvFdhhzyXc7EUNuA/plaza6.webp)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme8zUgfcCkCEQntdgWqY6vckkcXULyupTEYev6PRo71wr/plaza7.webp)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYXnH1ivjcJBN94JdbP5LAF9rUtE97mfGj6K2rZb5wsht/plaza8.webp)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbHhh95xHGNuhu5tGRG7dpTEGPdYArifnfE9tBYakBBRS/plaza9.webp)

<center>📷 😎 📷</center> 

This beach is called “Čista” (Clean in English). One of the better-known beaches on the island, it’s also well-maintained, with a restaurant next to it that opens during the season. As I mentioned, everything was empty, no one was anywhere except the seagulls and us.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYEkXBthGkCuzaUNKiee1T4VTVb8Ro1K2NKGoP9APN4QC/plaza10.webp)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfKgih6tCUgcMx3B8AYQVDLS2EN9VzBZ6qmMZUHDnRWLv/plaza11.webp)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY5TM5gNFgc3GkhytjPqJtmtGkMgWBNJJoLpk8ft9a18Q/plaza12.webp)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR3yGffv2z2KtdRnKHz4fMaXLmJoF8NagVpegcXfEG6S1/plaza13.webp)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYTomcyXQZBFR8ZJJorAFL76WAVWtq5H9f6Vkh62Ds6Ya/plaza14.webp)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc9PZXtcjUbbkDzG1hzH4YFReMRcYt2QcNPPNa6WDfEuS/plaza15.webp)

On the other side of the bay, we can see villages that have now become tourist resorts with apartments and rooms, and in the background, the Velebit mountain range, which is already on the mainland.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUi9Kb9fmmo3d1gzEBNJjoNJvA81nvJKjy3WdGoGTRGqX/plaza26.webp)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRRVnFXRMUm5rxQGj5wf88Ym8PTETQ8bFDCnQSSyTA75S/plaza26a.webp)

<center>📷 😎 📷</center>

This part of the island is completely rocky, with only sparse grass and shrubs, and no trees. The conditions are very extreme, with temperatures exceeding 40°C in the summer, so sun protection is a must if anyone heads there. Still, during the summer tourist season, from mid-June to the end of August, quite a few people visit the area.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTtSp1guEqsxi1rfhAdmMpQxUb514cYB4589HX16zNDpp/plaza16.webp)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRFkWA7nx3w3ysbJU2xsus6DacJtzYSdCBg8naui9WgnN/plaza17.webp)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPC2kmkFSGBtoEKWHRTDr9Y3d5efcHv1b9awRLpAgbBro/plaza18.webp)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd1XxCgfU7U99YjeDnyxf6Ad1Rg8GxLAwfAf3HC7HnMr8/plaza19.webp)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbuakTPohG12DHKV1KaT5xQcXeek2uCAQVuLhPfLvo2wf/plaza20.webp)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYG3EMMt4VahRJzp2pjXVch6Q4BxH1qxwEyrpY5L8PuMV/plaza21.webp)

Next was our destination, Prnjica Beach, which is also well-maintained. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRRM4QbpVaJy3AmJqa1si1CxrC73u4QA5kcE3ieLPDGCF/plaza22.webp)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNdgXQQuTbRWC5b7NENPv9eTh8ubTtGqpUY1GfSAxhfiN/plaza23.webp)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXRCyvKjnwcwxv2kukgTK9LGis7kq4HP4aNnyME7N1coB/plaza24.webp)

These flowers are of the Carpobrotus genus, which is often referred to as \

, Google Lens said.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUM1GycZLucgCUpjUB9jkBu6XMwD2L7i4DGmoXL9ZP7eY/plaza25.webp)

We turned around here and headed back.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeXkDgTKxxUGbKg3jiphgWLnmbpnsd598FzhUEKWinj2a/plaza27.webp)

By the way, Paški Bay continues on to Zrče and Caska beaches, but that’s a story for another time :)

Finally, here’s a screenshot from Google Fit.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR3Zj1ykZnTAQ6NWmt8E9v6j9RG53qEQMF2YvSE2Gd8K4/plaza28.webp)

body.title: Habbi Cinko De Mayo
body.body:
Happy Cinco de Mayo, my frens… 🐸

It’s that time of year again.  The sun hits a little different, the vibes get a little louder, and suddenly everyone’s got a lime in one hand and a story in the other.  You can feel it in the air.  A whole mood.

Now, let’s get one thing straight, fren: Cinco de Mayo isn’t Mexican Independence Day.  Yeah, I know… wild.  That’s actually in September. Cinco de Mayo is about the Battle of Puebla in 1862, when a smaller, scrappier Mexican force pulled off a surprise win against the French army.  Underdog energy.  Absolute classic.

And honestly?  That’s why it hits.

Because deep down, Cinco de Mayo is about that feeling.  You know the one.  When the odds are stacked.  When things look kinda doomed, but you still show up.  You still try.  You still fight.  And somehow… you WIN.

Big Pepe energy.

But then, somewhere along the timeline, especially in the U.S., it evolved.  It became less about the history lesson and more about a celebration of Mexican culture.  The food, music, and community.

Feels a bit off, man.

Not because celebrating is bad.  Celebration is good.  Celebration is needed.  But there’s a difference between appreciating something and  consuming it without thinking.  One hits the soul, the other just hits the Instagram story for 24 hours and disappears.

And Pepe sits there like:
“hmm… we can do better, frens.”

Because when you actually tap into what Cinco de Mayo represents, it’s beautiful.  It’s resilience.  It’s culture.  It’s history that refused to get steamrolled.  It’s people coming together and saying, “yeah, we’re still here, and we’re gonna celebrate that.”

So maybe this year, you still grab the tacos.  You still blast the music.  You still laugh with your friends as the sun goes down and the night swallow the sun, the sky, and all the light.

But maybe you also pause for like… a second.

Think about the story behind it.
Think about the people.
Think about why this moment exists at all.

And then you raise your glass.  Not just for the party, but for the meaning.

Pepe smiles.  🐸

This seed was produced at the agricultural institute where I worked. It is a small, apple-shaped tomato. Once, I planted some seeds in some planters, and they did really well—I was even able to harvest the tomatoes. Here are some photos of that first planting. ![1000708017.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/EoptPyAQ6V3RJqpnshB5BZV7bc6QUdT6aWsXywvASgdrdtt8vQgEJ8zq818VeJHuKfN.jpg) I have a friend whose parents live in a rural area, and I gave her a packet of seeds so she could try them out to see if they would still germinate. They kindly sent me the photos so I could see their plants already in production. They prepared the seedbeds, and the seeds germinated very well. They hadn’t lost their viability despite the passage of time.
![1000701009.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/Ep5mfwr9md37NWbfXTVhPae2wm3SRugBSNX12byRXuwtfdvhBz3WePr6tJParR8oR8F.jpg)
When the plants grew, they produced some good tomatoes. The seeds hadn't lost their vigor.
![1000707936.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23w2j7B36UyfnguJnJY4FTbhLgtgRELXb8QaPW9KEbwCtEPjUNQ8o7dTK4oWT8g65cmT8.jpg)
Those seeds have been shared with other people in the community, who have also planted them and harvested their own tomatoes. My friends have planted them several times, always with good results. They gave me some tomatoes to try. They have a great flavor and texture.
![1000699332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23wMUGj2k18dTrkm98TaV5ZrYz3XUrT4KnFBd9LkgLnGD9c2ubHHhHMLoBrrDwfVxhcRm.jpg)
This seed has maintained its quality, and this is a very important factor in achieving good yields.
![1000707950.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23tveDZarTExn3y4AAKB7ZfEZzqqzJLQqw9SBWkVEo8jQ6TefbGwKoK3pmQKLH8x96xvC.jpg)
When it is not possible to purchase certified seeds and the only option is to collect seeds from the fruits, it is important to keep the following in mind. 1. Select the best fruits—those with the best characteristics and free from disease or pest damage. 2. Once the fruits have been harvested, extract the seeds and wash them, especially if they are covered by a layer of mucilage, such as the seeds of papaya, tomato, or passion fruit. These should be dried in the shade. 3. Select the best seeds, discarding the smallest, hollow, and misshapen ones. 4. Store them in containers that are as airtight as possible in a cool, dry place until planting time.
![1000701007.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23wX3L5voL3jPnCJQx2gBPAgnhAXX7f7hsndM7Fncoo2CX5yJbjUTddVEk9tPKdFVRkcj.jpg)
A few days ago, I sent another package of seeds to my friends so they could distribute them among their acquaintances in the community, encouraging them to plant them in their backyards and harvest their own tomatoes. I’m even feeling inspired to plant again myself. When I do, I’ll share the results with you. ![1000593103.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23twCGEjH2xuU7mRjzfHme268u6XkieKjTRWRM9gYSEdHBwmn2Ljw4USibmjQtSGuPVx4.jpg) Thank you very much for reading this far. We always welcome your comments. ***
![1000324457.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23yU4h4sgk1R5FcNZXmMuzUHvtTpLrN84AHj2ems3ckmeUJxTFe8qjwBwgggvNHnTbW3Z.jpg)
*** #### Hola amigos amantes de los jardineria y del cultivo de plantas. # Hace unos años compre una semilla de tomate de una variedad que se había producido en el instituto agricola donde trabaje. Es un tomate de pequeño tamaño tipo manzano. En una oportunidad sembre estas semillas en unos materos y se dieron muy bién y pude cosechar los tomates. Aqui les muestro las fotografias de esa primera siembra.
![1000708017.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/EoptPyAQ6V3RJqpnshB5BZV7bc6QUdT6aWsXywvASgdrdtt8vQgEJ8zq818VeJHuKfN.jpg)
A una amiga cuyos padres viven en una zona rural, le regale un paquete de semillas para que las probaran y ver si todavia germinaban. Ellos gentilmente me enviaron las fotografias para que viera sus plantas ya en producción.
![1000701009.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/Ep5mfwr9md37NWbfXTVhPae2wm3SRugBSNX12byRXuwtfdvhBz3WePr6tJParR8oR8F.jpg)
Ellos hicieron los semilleros y las semillas germinaron muy bien. No habían perdido su viabilidad a pesar del tiempo almacenada. Cuando las plantas crecieron produjeron unos buenos tomates. Las semillas no habia perdido su vigor.
![1000701008.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23wgFKVktqYvBxvwfh7vgyhHP6BX7NzwbPr9oM2fRruKdXw2DWUzqZFZC1yPrh1U2myGT.jpg)
Esas semillas han sido compartidas con otras personas de la comunidad que tambien las han sembrado y han cosechado sus tomates. Mis amigos han sembrado varias veces siempre con buenos resultados. Me regalaron varios tomates para que los probara. Tienen muy buen sabor y textura. Esta semilla ha mantenido su calidad y esto es un factor muy importante para obtener buenos rendimientos.
![1000707950.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23tveDZarTExn3y4AAKB7ZfEZzqqzJLQqw9SBWkVEo8jQ6TefbGwKoK3pmQKLH8x96xvC.jpg)
Cuando no es posible comprar semilla certificada y la opcion es recolectar la semilla de los frutos, es bueno tomar en cuenta lo siguiente. 1. Seleccionar los mejores frutos, aquellos que tenga las mejores características y que no tengan enfermedades ni daños por plagas. 2. Una vez recogidos los frutos extraer la semilla, lavarlas sobre todo si tienen una capa de mucílagos que las recubra, como por ejemplo la semilla de lechosa, de tomate o de parchita. Estas debe secarse a la sombra. 3. Seleccionar las mejores semillas, eliminando las mas pequeñas, las vanas y las deformes. 4. Guardarlas en evases lo mas herméticos posible en un lugar seco y fresco, hasta la siembra. En dias pasado les envie otro paquete de semillas a mis amigos para que la distribuyan entre sus conocidos en la comunidad, y también las siembren en sus patios y cosechen sus tomates. Hasta yo estoy animada para volver a sembrar y evaluar la semilla. Cuando lo haga les comparto los resultados. ![1000593103.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23twCGEjH2xuU7mRjzfHme268u6XkieKjTRWRM9gYSEdHBwmn2Ljw4USibmjQtSGuPVx4.jpg) Muchas gracias por llegar hasta aqui. Cualquier comentario siempre es bienvenido ![17779962234116380803422421182353.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23yJLuSDVwFfxjCTSHxZWiY4o7ZnrwH96deWhqKQeQJDbiJtiAa3WBUFDQifakvWbjsCT.jpg). Images edited in Canva using my own photos. I did the English translation at www.deepl.com
