body.title: AI IS MAKING HUMANS LOSE THEIR CREATIVITY
body.body:
Hello, you're welcome to my blog today.

Every day, A.I. is growing, but I think it is killing human creativity. We all know that the human mind is made in such a way that there are no limits, and they can do anything and achieve it. But nowadays, we are all dependent on A.I. Every one of us is using it in some way or another. I am accepting this; I am very dependent on A.I. I am using it in my e-commerce business. It helps me to make pictures, keywords, descriptions, and many more things. 



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcouEvt1EPAnp2A6nkhqrnS9VcCeDTzXuMUaPyGyed1L9/183036.png 




That A.I. is making the human mind very limited. When things get easier and more direct to the people, they stop thinking outside the box, and they create a cave in their mind. Now, even I am using A.I. I have stopped thinking outside the box to the extent that I have become so dependent on it that I have stopped thinking creatively. Of course, A.I. is useful and very important, but all I want to say is that it limits the human creative mind. Let me give you the best example of how it works. Here is where I am getting at with this. Humans, with the technology of today (A.I. and the rest), will create even bigger things using their brains and the ease of these technologies to make lives even much easier than we can imagine now. We should not forget that A.I. and every other technology we see today are all human creations.

With machines, with A.I., and with every cool and amazing technology made by humans, humans will create even cooler things with them. It's only a matter of time, and yes, the aim still remains to make life easier for everyone. The major downside to this is that we cannot go back to living as we did in some aspects of our lives anymore, and that is mainly for people who wish to go back.

It is a contrast to realize that we needed so many years to evolve intellectually to the point of, at our peak, building something so powerful that it may create an intellectual regression. Of course, I may be wrong about this, but logically speaking, perhaps we have already passed our peak and have been regressing for some years now. The previous generation was much stronger intellectually, and the one after ours may be even worse, all of this thanks to technology and the ease it brings, a flood of distractions and such easy ways to store knowledge in artificial memories that our brains are losing their function in many aspects. Maybe I am wrong to think this way. Maybe it is just the impression of a man who has lived through this transition between the pre- and post-technology eras.

Human beings themselves are lazy, perhaps as a primitive mechanism to conserve energy. And who doesn’t feel lazy about thinking when we have a base of ideas ready to be used as a spark for generating something greater through artificial intelligence? We can use a brain far more powerful than our own to generate thousands of alternatives and build so many other things. And then, what will we do with our own brains? They will no longer be stimulated. Too much effort is being handed over to A.I. What will happen, if not human intellectual degradation over the years? What will become of future generations?

Technology is evolving too much. Too much convenience, too little effort, and thousands of tools to put many ideas into practice, ideas that often did not even come from human brains. Yeah, we’ve reached a point where something can be built entirely without human intervention, with planning, ideas, and even the operational side carried out by robots. Technology has evolved enough for our creativity to also be pushed aside. Why think of something different if we can have hundreds of ideas generated with just a few clicks? We are on the path to intellectually withering away.

My personal opinion is that whatever technology is around you, we should take full advantage of all these things and do our work with more accuracy and creativity. If we are able to do this, then in this way we do not lose our creativity; in this way, people can become more creative. You too must be following many such channels on Instagram that upload photos through this generator, and their engagement levels are quite good. Similarly, on YouTube, many channels are generating substantial revenue by creating A.I. videos using this same mechanism.

As technology advances, things are becoming easier for us. Tasks that used to take a lot of time earlier can now be done in a jiffy. Whether you have to write a big code or generate an image, any task that used to take hours can now be done very easily with the help of A.I. tools. And this has become much more popular than hair salons, and gradually every single company is introducing A.I. tools into their products. See, these are making it easier for us to get things done quickly.

Thank you for stopping by my blog.

>In low-Mana battles, this Life card—with its melee attack power—consistently ranks high on my list of favorites. This is because, for a mere 3 Mana cost, this card comes equipped with a comprehensive set of stats. Indeed, I am referring specifically to its Level 1 version, which offers 1 melee attack power, 1 armor, 2 health, and 2 speed. Furthermore, it boasts two excellent abilities: the first is Flying, which helps protect the card from melee attacks up to 25% of the time; the second is the Charge ability, which—despite being a melee attacker—grants this card the freedom to launch attacks from any position in the lineup without restriction. To find so much utility packed into a single card for a mere 3 Mana cost—and right from Level 1, no less—is clearly a significant advantage. In fact, until today, I had already upgraded this card to Level 2; this meant that, while all other stats remained constant, my card at Level 2 was equipped with 2 armor—signifying even greater protection.

\n\n

loot; this allowed me to level it up once again. Naturally, in my excitement, the very first thing I did was take a look at the benefits offered at this third level. Since I was currently in the process of upgrading it to Level 3—and the journey from there to Level 4 would require another 15 copies—I decided to focus my attention on the other stats instead. Upon upgrading to this level, the card's Speed ​​is set to increase—a stat that is, technically speaking, even more critical than Attack Power. body.title: The Song of Mary: He has performed mighty deeds with his arm; he has scattered those who are proud in their inmost thoughts. Luke 1:51
body.body: In the Bible, it is usual that after an extraordinary event, a hymn or a song to celebrate it takes place. This is why, in the Gospel of Luke, after the angel Gabriel announces the conception and birth of Jesus to Mary, a song called the Magnificat, or Song of Mary, is sung. This song bears a strong resemblance to Hannah's Song (1 Samuel 2:1-10), a song attributed to the mother of the prophet Samuel in gratitude to God for the conception and birth of the miraculous child. With this extraordinary event, related in the gospel of Luke, the covenant made between God and David (2 Samuel 7) was fulfilled in Mary, as the angel promised the birth of a savior for Israel.\nMary is considered a God-fearing woman in the gospels, and in this song, the glory, wisdom, and mercy of God over all things are expressed. In this song, Maria begins by expressing her happiness and joy for the grace received: \

Luke 1:46-48.\nThen the song continues, expressing how God provides for the needy and how the children of Israel are always before His eyes; and how God in His wisdom accomplishes great things and rejects the proud of heart, that is why the song also expresses: \

Luke 1:51.
This song of Mary is a song that essentially expresses something that in Christianity is known as poverty of spirit. As Jesus taught in the Sermon on the Mount with the Beatitudes, Mary is poor in spirit in the sense that she considered herself a humble servant of the Lord, and did not pretend, as Job in the Old Testament did, to set herself up as judge of the Lord for the event that occurred. In this sense, Mary, the mother of the Lord, with her singing, is an example to follow for all who want to enter the Kingdom of God, the empire or government of the divine perfections.
![The Song of Mary. He has performed mighty deeds with his arm; he has scattered those who are proud in their inmost thoughts. Luke 1,51.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPaZHeph6CphJZRC3MNep8eTmi8xBgHpdNdZjV4r2H3g4/The%20Song%20of%20Mary.%20He%20has%20performed%20mighty%20deeds%20with%20his%20arm;%20he%20has%20scattered%20those%20who%20are%20proud%20in%20their%20inmost%20thoughts.%20Luke%201,51.jpg)

body.body: Aquí tienes el montaje bilingüe completo de **Guaco**, extendido y actualizado con sus hitos más recientes y reconocimientos internacionales, manteniendo el rigor factual y el formato de negritas solicitado.\n\n<div class=\

> Presentamos la trayectoria de **Guaco**, la agrupación que transformó la tradición zuliana en un lenguaje universal, consolidándose como la **Súper Banda de Venezuela** a través de la experimentación y el éxito global.

> We present the trajectory of **Guaco**, the group that transformed Zulia's tradition into a universal language, establishing themselves as the **Súper Banda de Venezuela** through experimentation and global success. -----
[English version below!](#contenido-english)
----- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/musicavenezuela/ALD7eeXy8FsXwPMtniyZeEXZZbei8gLJYFqoQWMQPurf2j9bqk7hEzsXNy72dV4.png) # Guaco: La metamorfosis eterna de la Súper Banda de Venezuela

>\n\nEl fenómeno musical conocido como **Guaco** tuvo su origen en 1960 en la ciudad de Maracaibo, estado Zulia. Lo que inicialmente surgió como una agrupación estudiantil dedicada a la interpretación de la **Gaita**, el género tradicional por excelencia de la región zuliana, pronto se transformó en un laboratorio de experimentación sin precedentes. A comienzos de la década de los 70, bajo el liderazgo de **Gustavo Aguado**, la banda comenzó a introducir innovaciones que rompieron con los esquemas del purismo gaitero. La incorporación de instrumentos como la guitarra eléctrica, el bajo, las congas y el cencerro, junto a armonías complejas inspiradas en el jazz, generó una profunda división en la opinión pública, marcando un \

en la historia de la música popular venezolana.\n\nA pesar de la resistencia inicial de los sectores más tradicionales, el impacto de **Guaco** fue tan masivo que logró trascender las fronteras regionales para conquistar el mercado nacional e internacional. Este proceso de evolución constante derivó en la creación de una sonoridad propia e inclasificable denominada el **\

**. Este estilo es una amalgama sofisticada donde convergen la síncopa de la **Salsa**, la libertad del **Jazz**, la energía del **Funk** y la estructura del **Pop**, todo sobre una base rítmica que jamás olvida su raíz marabina. Éxitos históricos como **\

** no solo dominaron las carteleras radiales, sino que definieron la identidad sonora de varias generaciones.\n\nEn las últimas décadas, la agrupación ha consolidado su estatus de **Súper Banda de Venezuela** mediante una profesionalización técnica de primer nivel. Su discografía reciente ha sido ampliamente reconocida por la industria global, logrando múltiples nominaciones y triunfos en los premios **Latin Grammy**. Destacan producciones como **Escultura**, **Guaco Histórico 2** y el ambicioso proyecto **Bidimensional**, el cual fue grabado en colaboración con la **Orquesta Sinfónica Simón Bolívar** bajo la dirección del maestro **Gustavo Dudamel**. Esta etapa ha dejado para el cancionero contemporáneo temas de gran calado como **\

**, demostrando una capacidad de renovación asombrosa que los mantiene en los primeros lugares de popularidad y ventas digitales. Hoy en día, **Guaco** es mucho más que una banda; es una institución que ha servido como plataforma para el lanzamiento de solistas y músicos de élite. Su legado se ha documentado en piezas cinematográficas como **Guaco: Semblanza**, donde se explora la rigurosidad de su propuesta estética y su visión de vanguardia. Con giras que recorren los escenarios más exigentes de América y Europa, la agrupación continúa demostrando que la clave de su permanencia es la mutación constante. Al no permitirse estancarse en fórmulas pasadas, **Guaco** se erige como el ejemplo máximo de cómo una tradición local puede evolucionar hasta convertirse en un lenguaje musical universal y eterno. -----

>

### Guaco: The Eternal Metamorphosis of Venezuela's Superband

The musical phenomenon known as **Guaco** originated in 1960 in the city of Maracaibo, Zulia state. What initially began as a student group dedicated to performing **Gaita**, the traditional genre par excellence of the Zulian region, soon transformed into an unprecedented laboratory for experimentation. At the beginning of the 70s, under the leadership of **Gustavo Aguado**, the band began introducing innovations that broke the patterns of gaitero purism. The incorporation of instruments such as the electric guitar, bass, congas, and cowbell, along with complex jazz-inspired harmonies, generated a profound division in public opinion, marking a \

in the history of Venezuelan popular music.\n\nDespite the initial resistance from more traditional sectors, **Guaco**'s impact was so massive that it managed to transcend regional borders to conquer national and international markets. This process of constant evolution led to the creation of a unique and unclassifiable sound called the **\

**. This style is a sophisticated amalgam where the syncopation of **Salsa**, the freedom of **Jazz**, the energy of **Funk**, and the structure of **Pop** converge, all over a rhythmic base that never forgets its Maracaibo roots. Historical hits like **\

** not only dominated the radio charts but also defined the sound identity of several generations.\n\nIn recent decades, the group has consolidated its status as the **Súper Banda de Venezuela** through top-level technical professionalization. Their recent discography has been widely recognized by the global industry, achieving multiple nominations and wins at the **Latin Grammy** awards. Notable productions include **Escultura**, **Guaco Histórico 2**, and the ambitious **Bidimensional** project, which was recorded in collaboration with the **Orquesta Sinfónica Simón Bolívar** under the direction of master **Gustavo Dudamel**. This era has contributed contemporary songs such as **\

**, demonstrating an amazing capacity for renewal that keeps them at the top of popularity and digital sales. Today, **Guaco** is much more than a band; it is an institution that has served as a platform for the launch of soloists and elite musicians. Their legacy has been documented in cinematic pieces like **Guaco: Semblanza**, where the rigor of their aesthetic proposal and avant-garde vision are explored. With tours spanning the most demanding stages in America and Europe, the group continues to prove that the key to its permanence is constant mutation. By not allowing themselves to stagnate in past formulas, **Guaco** stands as the ultimate example of how a local tradition can evolve into a universal and eternal musical language. #

body.title: Bouquet y Centros de mesas para los 15 de mi hija, hecho con amor /  Bouquets and centrepieces for my daughter’s 15th birthday, made with love.
body.body:
**Las Manualidades son espectaculares.**

**Crafts are brilliant**



<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmcjHQ4cc9zvbGWuYuWf8x99cyDWbRj5w6jjKpLH3nnWEY/1777992386021.jpg</center>


<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmXMMuAkcuRLYdA2QYEJy2R16VqoPZ6ZAFRsafDdHM5UZ4/1777989229057.jpg</center>



https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=motica129/x8dkj61o




https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=motica129/k7jdo752


Saludos queridos amigos de Hive, hoy no es lunes Pero si es día de contar historias ,  me pareció oportuno traer mi experiencia en la realización de los centros de mesa y el bouquet  para  los 15 años  de mi hija ,  aún cuando no los cee totalmente yo sola fue una experiencia muy bonita y significativa para mí, dicen que cuando las cosas las hace uno mismo el gasto es menor y la satisfacción mayor.

‎Así que, les cuento como fue para mí este tema,  cuando comenzamos a organizar los 15 , vinieron muchas cosas a la mente , entre ellas que podíamos colocar de centro de mesa que sirviera como  recuerdo de una vez, así que buscando en las plataformas digitales conseguí un modelo que me gustó ,  un aro montado en un pedazo de madera y decorado con flores y mariposas, que alumbrará con luces de adas .

‎Partiendo de están idea , comenzamos a comprar los materiales para hacerlos, fue un gran reto conseguir los aros , ya que en un principio lo queríamos con  aros de ratan , en fin tuvimos buscándolos por todos lados y nunca lo conseguimos , empezamos a tener otras opciones en cuenta, por internet vimos unos aros que venian ya listos para montar Pero al buscarlos en las tiendas no lo conseguí, así que toque otras opciones, los tíos herreros y los amigos herreros , y bueno no hubo mucho éxito tampoco ya que el material era costoso y el deseo de colaborar era mínimo , entonces  le dije a mi esposo necesito que me compres tirro yo haré los aros con alambre dulce y los forrare con tirro y mi esposo me sugirió colocarle cinta de razo para forrarlos.

‎Así comenzó todo el proceso de los centros de mesa, me fui con mi Prima @GenesisSanchez a buscar los detalles, las cintas de razo de 4cm y las de 2cm ,  las mariposas y luces adas en las tiendas para decoraciones y los silicón para ir pegando las cintas.
‎
‎Mi esposo corto la madera y le hizo la abertura para meter el alambre y cuando yo comencé a hacer los aros él terminó ayudándome a hacerlos.


>Greetings, dear friends at Hive. Today isn’t Monday, but it is a day for telling stories, so I thought it would be a good idea to share my experience of making the centrepieces and bouquet for my daughter’s 15th birthday party. Although I didn’t make them entirely on my own, it was a lovely and meaningful experience for me; they say that when you do things yourself, it costs less and brings greater satisfaction.

>So, let me tell you how it all went for me:  when we started organising the 15th birthday party, lots of things came to mind, including what we could use as a centrepiece that would also serve as a keepsake. So, whilst searching online, I found a design I liked: a hoop mounted on a piece of wood and decorated with flowers and butterflies, which would be lit up with fairy lights.

>With that in mind, we started buying the materials to make them. It was a real challenge to find the hoops, as we’d originally wanted rattan ones. We searched high and low but never managed to find any, so we started considering other options. We’d seen some hoops online that were ready to assemble, but when I looked for them in shops, I couldn’t find them, so I turned to other options: blacksmith uncles and blacksmith friends. Well, that wasn’t very successful either, as the materials were expensive and there was little willingness to help. So I told my husband, ‘I need you to buy me some tulle; I’ll make the hoops out of soft wire and cover them with tulle.’ My husband suggested using satin ribbon to cover them.

>That’s how the whole process of making the centrepieces began. I went with my cousin @GenesisSanchez to look for the finishing touches: the 4cm and 2cm satin ribbons, the butterflies and fairy lights in the decoration shops, and the silicone to stick the ribbons down.

>My husband cut the wood and made a hole in it for the wire, and when I started making the hoops, he finished them off by helping me.


<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmYxsECU1SVqETLiiYLgCbcjrBAL9FGtGRHKCbzJLuEtBy/1777986909867.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmVw6x5avpx2HyG21bzNd6jCuHEjuhvjw5YeKm7PY3cdyN/1777986910047.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmSYxWqDostTBvfV1QSFtD1Hkv6hr4teVjBXR4ZCWpnsdR/1777986910153.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmb3iPpaypErxepT9N4QF28Gzpcp7bFhAXsoXqC8AAuED9/1777986910286.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmaJDSN3vu5A8T4ewnvJbdxpEskat8sHrxsJDXcHYnVYhu/1777986910368.jpg</center>

‎
‎Listos los aros forrados con tirro procedo a pegar la cinta de razo alrededor del aro para posteriormente colocarlo en la tablita y pegarlo.

>Once the hoops have been lined with fabric, I proceed to stick the satin ribbon around the hoop so that I can then place it on the board and stick it down.
‎

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmYmTER9PufFNVZZnG6gnxD8AZ5LyXiHwLVx8qrrs8f1QN/1777987253378.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmd75XBdQLzDFLVGTTeu2CUMJEWSR4KqDSrbHhCcqkyLFE/1777987253583.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmSujJNZYkmqZ7Cc4iHEuvDUeDaw9rDgniKdA6nR24VrEt/1777987253682.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmbL8XKBM5qf4r5uvk3d8K9u4hKQdEQKmUre8JwtFntPZk/1777987253814.jpg</center>



‎Una vez terminado este paso fui a llevarlo a casa de mi tía , quien terminaría el proceso , colocando las flores eternas hechas por ellas y decorando el aro con las mariposas y las luces adas, Aún faltaba un detalle del Topper que hiciera alusión al evento . Queríamos hacer muchas cosas Pero el tiempo se fue volando, así que terminamos imprimiendo el Topper y pegandolo al centro de mesa

>Once this step was finished, I took it to my aunt’s house, where she would complete the process by adding the preserved flowers they had made and decorating the ring with butterflies and fairy lights. There was still one detail missing from the topper that would reflect the occasion. We wanted to do so many things, but time flew by, so we ended up printing the topper and sticking it to the centrepiece..

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmSyUrUQgusDiCTio4YDJnXApCoubqWHFeBxS62GBL9iw6/1777988011417.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmcwFprYPSCkArk5f7A5ChyBzQ3FHFPUNrxAfopqnKfWAL/1777988011472.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmXDh2jwGpe9xjr312siWWKSiZHmULyenHsbUqTUEeJNDZ/1777988011522.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmVFmA1AcoPdLWuAs7onPxqTpuNZvktvhRahpoDe8FQYqb/1777988011568.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmX5JDm6V6k4p1EgQEKReCW6gku8CEo3d264y3ieDZQr7T/1777988011614.jpg</center>

‎
‎fue un trabajo en conjunto , hecho con amor para un mismo fin, decorar las mesas y dejar un recuerdo a todas aquellas personas que estuvieron y participaron de este día especial para mí hija.

>It was a joint effort, done with love and with a shared goal: to decorate the tables and leave a lasting memory for everyone who was there and took part in this special day for my daughter.


<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmXpYASE2nSgaF1SFrmLi2H8z3YJUuToxNF8uFJHLnhX7B/1777988247177.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmcqup1QUE5Sd2VecSiSJSYHwbjz84WJMANZCA36wbZVzk/1777988247233.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmT84iR83wYbZyMpjfmypzCvYke84x34o7537zHgUMAoCN/1777988247282.jpg</center>


‎No se puede negar que quedaron muy lindos .

>There’s no denying that they turned out really lovely.



<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmXMMuAkcuRLYdA2QYEJy2R16VqoPZ6ZAFRsafDdHM5UZ4/1777988323624.jpg</center>


https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=motica129/k7jdo752



‎gracias a mi esposo @leanpoqui y a mi tía @MariaCastro y a mi prima @GenesisSanchez  por ayudarme en este proceso

>Thanks to my husband @leanpoqui, my aunt @MariaCastro and my cousin @GenesisSanchez for helping me through this process

------

<center>**@motica129</center>**

------


Está publicación es un contenido original, experiencias en los 15 de mi hija.

Las fotografías y videos están en mi galería familiar, fueron captados con diferentes dispositivos de la familia y no autorizo a nadie a usarlas sin mi consentimiento.

El texto fue traducido al idioma ingles con el traductor Deepl, versión gratuita.

Me encantaría leer tus comentarios en cuanto a qué te pareció como quedaron el bouquet y los centros de mesa .


>This post features original content: my daughter’s 15th birthday celebrations.

>The photos and videos are in my family gallery; they were taken using various devices belonging to the family, and I do not authorise anyone to use them without my consent.

>The text was translated into English using the free version of the Deepl translator.

>I’d love to hear your thoughts on how you liked the bouquet and the centrepieces.

body.title: Splinterlands | The MALTHRAKSIS is a Dual Attack Fearless Beast
body.body:
![Kaylia Silverleaf.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23uEz7haSkjWzYQWMTUC7ZimJZSzwbxeasufyHndBL5Dg9QzxfmDbaNNPx5hF8dhZ7QM1.jpg)

 --- 


### Hello Splinterlands Warriors,

Welcome back to another fresh and awesome Splinterlands post guys, and I hope all of you are doing well in life and enjoying a great day with your family and friends. Now, if you are one of those who are actively playing this card-based strategy game without any distractions and tirelessly building your NFT card and other asset collection, I think all of you are currently fighting through the ongoing ranked season and trying to push your trophy count higher to reach your goal. If we take a quick look at the ongoing ranked season timer, there are still around 9 days and 23 hours left before the reset happens. So there is still plenty of time in hand to climb higher on the trophy, secure better league tier rewards, and maybe even prepare for a leaderboard push later on if you have enough battle energy and confidence.

 --- 


![Screenshot 2026-05-05 at 8.15.34 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wBdkECxEEfGL2oQSHo3DK2aFJGMSQQeesm2CRK6htfY3XKfBUyvkv2cY6TirKGXxi4Q.png)

 --- 


Now, talking about my own progress in the frontier section of this game, I am currently playing in the highest Gold I league tier with a trophy count of around 3,720. My goal this season remains the same, which is to reach the 4,200 trophy mark first and then try for the leaderboard if everything goes well. With enough time left, I will try my level best to stay consistent and keep pushing forward and let's see how it goes.


 --- 



![Screenshot 2026-05-05 at 6.59.31 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wg8m9yDtW31jRG5cL7aEw1ZNuPGg6BXb7fTo3hf3QomK2gwDhGLSBp4rR8bEQTEYq36.png)

![Screenshot 2026-05-05 at 6.59.45 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wByPh7nSAZUW14uKJXJybQSpWgr4s7Ajj2qdgnAPVtzEikY8bTHxSeGeQxPvKAiLHcH.png)

![Screenshot 2026-05-05 at 8.10.26 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/Eo6BhLdMyHWBs8yRcvgQjb5SGCc8DUr4dPeZAN16gH4hYqtu6oHapM1DyVa8vrz2pRG.png)

 --- 



On the other hand, if we take a look at the weekly Frontier raffle, I have currently collected a total of 15 entries. With around 5 days and 22 hours left before the raffle draw, I will try to increase this number to somewhere between 54 and 57 entries as usual. Let’s see how things turn out this time. Also, I have opened 6 foundation packs today that I won from the last 2 days' daily missions. As for the outcome, I received 4 epics, 4 rares, a gold foil common and all the rest common cards, and not to mention I am very happy with this pull.

 --- 


![image-removebg-preview.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/AJhU8uFpwY6ZbrQ9uKZtiTk9s13pyMak9k4oadfhh8kHPMgrNdpC31VPbZmTLQ6.png)


 --- 



### Malthraksis

Now moving forward, let us come to the main topic of this post, as today I will be discussing another powerful monster from the newest Escalation edition. As you have already seen in the title and thumbnail above, today I will be talking about the Malthraksis. So if you are interested in learning more about this monster card, let us take a deeper dive without any further delay.

The Malthraksis is a monster type card that was introduced in the game with the newest Escalation mini cardset edition. This monster belongs to the Water element and comes from the Undead bloodline. By rarity, this card is a Legendary monster, so you will require a total of 11 CC cards in order to upgrade it to its maximum level. Now, if you want to use this monster in battles, you need to spend 7 mana, which makes it suitable for medium to high mana limit matches. The attack type of this monster is a combination of both Melee and Ranged, which already makes it quite special. Along with that, it comes with a decent balance of speed, armor, and health, making it reliable both offensively and defensively. At its maximum level, this monster gains a total of four abilities, which I will explain below. Let us now take a closer look at its league-wise stats and abilities.

 --- 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wWLwMbqJ6CqYiuwjXP9xtibyxpfSgVrzPHrVe3WKLoeCnBebVCZ2esSoCB2pebM1BMr.png)


 --- 



#### BRONZE

At level 1, this monster starts with 1 ranged and 2 melee attack power at 3 speed with 1 armor and 6 health. Even at its initial level, it gains the Opportunity ability. This makes it very effective at finishing off weaker enemy units quickly.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23vsC5TfvsBEFvxcUnJAtkJJXZD6n6WFVEi6tPsg654UkhMZVakdmQNfXonzo1X6gu16K.png)


`OPPORTUNITY` – Targets the enemy unit with the least health.



#### SILVER

When you upgrade this monster further, its stats remain similar, but it unlocks another ability called Kindred Will: Deflection Shroud. This ability becomes very useful when combined with other Kindred-based monsters.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/AKKRsDiQnSnJiyGdr9uKws1fTYwUopNocRzyFhB6qbCw69r4qJutyWsbCkxut4h.png)


`KINDRED WILL: DEFLECTION SHROUD` – At the start of battle, adjacent units with Kindred Spirit gain Deflection Shroud.



#### GOLD

As this monster gets upgraded further, its stats improve and it now holds 2 ranged and 2 melee attack power at 3 speed with 1 armour and 7 health. At this level, it also gains the Painforge ability. This allows the monster to grow stronger under certain conditions.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/AK55DatreJnpofdFGL6WL7wqPRMxJgSUpXb5R8njj698mg62j3uRXPChSPysH8J.png)


`PAINFORGE` – +1 power when damaged by Poisoned or Burning or hit by an ally.



#### DIAMOND / CHAMPION

Finally, when you upgrade this monster to its maximum level, its stats improve further and it now carries 2 ranged and 2 melee attack power at 3 speed with 1 armor and 8 health. At this level, it also gains another powerful ability called Protect. This adds a strong defensive boost to your entire lineup.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23vhqVBXezyY19CEZw1SCodtBhZniD9dAJjzkPRJjVuxW3QjAs5nLXQjYbdbGsWQ5WzSY.png)


`PROTECT` – Gives +2 armor to all allied units.



Last but not least, I think this monster is a very powerful and versatile card. First of all, it comes with dual attack types, both melee and ranged, which is quite rare and very useful, especially for a 7 mana monster. This makes it a great option for high mana or aggressive battle setups. Another strong advantage is its Opportunity ability, which allows it to target the weakest enemy unit and quickly eliminate it using its dual attack power. This can help you gain an early advantage in battles. On top of that, the Protect ability gives +2 armor to all allied units, making your entire team more durable against melee and ranged attacks. The Kindred Will ability also opens up synergy opportunities if you place compatible monsters next to it. Lastly, the Painforge ability gives it additional power when affected by certain conditions, making it even more dangerous in the right scenarios. Overall, I think the Malthraksis is a fearless dual-attack beast that offers both offensive strength and defensive support, making it a great addition to any competitive lineup. What do you think?

#### I hope you enjoyed reading my post about MALTHRAKSIS. Let me know your thoughts about today's post in the comments section below, and I look forward to seeing you all in my next post.

<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVjRvqqj6rjKZp9xk5H54AZMoSXGU8oqRBJVvWjmVq53f/image.png)</center>

body.title: Did you know that Square Enix once released a demake of one of its own games?
body.body:
>

Hello, Hive friends! It’s been a while since we’ve seen each other here—I haven’t posted a single thing since January. But you know how life goes: work piles up and you don’t have time for anything else. Let’s see if we can be a little more active on this beloved social network, which I really appreciate because of the friends I’ve made here. In this post, I want to talk about something I consider more of a curiosity—a game I had the pleasure of playing after taking a quick look at it. We all know the classic Final Fantasy 15, which amazed many and others didn’t like at all because of the loss of the franchise’s “essence,” but we can’t deny that it was a revolutionary game for its time because of the open world and its massive 100GB file size—all of which Square Enix claimed was necessary to depict our hero’s journey. But you’d be surprised if I told you that there’s a much more condensed version of this entire story, created and directed by Square Enix itself, which we could perfectly describe as a “demake.” This version is known as Final Fantasy 15 Pocket Edition, which was first released for mobile devices and later for consoles.

https://gh.cdn.sewest.net/assets/ident/galleries/final-fantasy-hd-pocket-edition/en_GB/FINAL%20FANTASY%20XV%20POCKET%20EDITION%20HD_20180730163927.jpg?quality=65
As for the game's story, everything remains exactly the same, but Noctis and his friends' journey is much more linear; there isn't as much exploration, and the car rides won't be as long (which was one of the things that made the original stand out)—they'll only take a few seconds. Many might see this as a flaw, but for others who can’t afford the original experience, this could be perfect since the entire main story is still there, complete with the voice acting and soundtrack from the original version. What changes drastically is the appearance of all the characters, shifting from absolute realism to a chibi style reminiscent of those classic Final Fantasy games that were released for the Nintendo DS. In my case, I have absolutely no complaints; I even find it nostalgic. However, the downside of this visual style is the cutscenes: in dramatic scenes, since the characters can’t express emotions due to their design, the result ends up being somewhat comical. I think this whole product, as a demake, is an interesting concept, especially since not many companies make them. ||| |-|-| https://gh.cdn.sewest.net/assets/ident/galleries/ffxv-pocket-edition-uk/en_GB/pocket-edition-screenshot-5.jpg?quality=65|https://gh.cdn.sewest.net/assets/ident/galleries/final-fantasy-hd-pocket-edition/en_GB/FINAL%20FANTASY%20XV%20POCKET%20EDITION%20HD_20180730184819.jpg?quality=65 I’d say the end result is magnificent. Condensing a game of this magnitude into a mobile format could have been a Herculean task, but they pulled it off—especially since they’ve included the additional story content from *Final Fantasy XV*, so we’re already getting the extended version of the story, which is told here in an episodic format. As for combat, it’s a faithful representation of the original, with options to attack, take cover, and quick-time events; even the dungeon mapping is quite similar to the original game. The only major issue here is that there are no side quests, so in terms of replayability, there isn’t much to do—you complete the 10 hours of gameplay, and that’s it. I’ve come to think that this product turned out so well that they even released console versions called Pocket Edition HD. I’d say this video game is perfect for those who just want to enjoy the story of Final Fantasy XV, regardless of the visuals or whether they can’t afford to run the original version; after all, it’s a fairly faithful version created by Square Enix. -------------------
![mg1 gif.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mig1/23ydTE7KBDPXbs6M6cpiwKB1CFTmB5utWUiXj4peUHBj5xUReooi8Ycb5t5XTGUgt4Zib.gif) *Thanks for reading my post and see you next time <3*
##
ESPAÑOL
https://gh.cdn.sewest.net/assets/ident/games/final-fantasy-xv-pocket-edition-hd/en_GB/GamesIndex_GameListing_Artwork.jpg?quality=65

>

¡Hola amigos de Hive! Tanto tiempo sin vernos por acá, desde Enero sin hacer ni una sola publicación pero es que ya saben cómo es la vida, te sale trabajo y no te da tiempo para nada pero veamos si estamos un poco más activos por esta querida red social la cual aprecio mucho debido a los amigos que hice acá. En este caso les quiero hablar de algo que considero más una curiosidad la cual tuve el placer de jugar después de echarle una miradita. Todos conocemos el clásico Final Fantasy 15, el cual maravilló a muchos y a otros no les gustó para nada por la pérdida de la \

de la franquicia, pero no podemos negar que fue un juego revolucionario para la época por el mundo abierto y el gran peso que tenía de 100GB, todo esto necesario según Square Enix para representar el viaje de nuestro héroe. Pero te sorprenderías si te dijera que existe una versión mucho más condensada de toda esta historia, incluso hecha, creada y dirigida por la misma Square Enix, en lo que podríamos describir de forma perfecta en el término de demake. Esta versión es la que se conoce como Final Fantasy 15 Pocket Edition, la cual salió primero para celulares y luego para consolas.
https://gh.cdn.sewest.net/assets/ident/galleries/final-fantasy-hd-pocket-edition/en_GB/FINAL%20FANTASY%20XV%20POCKET%20EDITION%20HD_20180730163927.jpg?quality=65
En cuanto a la historia del juego, se mantiene todo totalmente igual pero haciendo todo el viaje de Noctis y sus amigos mucho más lineal, no hay tanta exploración y los viajes no serán tan largos en automóvil (que era una de las cosas por las que destaca el original), solo una cosa de segundos. Muchos podrán considerar esto como un defecto pero para otros que no se puedan permitir la experiencia original, esto podría ser perfecto ya que en cuanto a toda la historia principal, la tenemos presente, inclusive con el doblaje y banda sonora de la versión original. Lo que cambia drásticamente es el aspecto de todos los personajes, pasando del realismo absoluto a una versión chibi, que recuerda a esos clásicos Final Fantasy que llegaron a salir para la Nintendo DS, en mi caso no tengo quejas en absoluto, me parece hasta nostálgico pero lo que puede ser malo de ese estilo visual son las cinemáticas, donde puede haber escenas dramáticas, como los personajes no pueden expresar emociones debido al diseño, resulta siendo algo incluso cómico. Pienso que todo este producto como demake es una propuesta interesante y más por el hecho de que no muchas compañías los hacen. ||| |-|-| https://gh.cdn.sewest.net/assets/ident/galleries/ffxv-pocket-edition-uk/en_GB/pocket-edition-screenshot-5.jpg?quality=65|https://gh.cdn.sewest.net/assets/ident/galleries/final-fantasy-hd-pocket-edition/en_GB/FINAL%20FANTASY%20XV%20POCKET%20EDITION%20HD_20180730184819.jpg?quality=65 El resultado final yo diría que es magnífico, reducir un juego de tal magnitud a un formato para celular podría ser una tarea titánica pero lo lograron, contando además con las historias adicionales que se añadieron para el Final Fantasy XV por lo que ya de por sí tendremos la versión extendida de la historia, la cual es contada en este caso en un formato episódico. Respecto al combate, es una fiel representación del original, con opciones para atacar, cubrirte y los quick time events, incluso el mapeado de las mazmorras es bastante parecido al juego original. El único gran problema acá es que no hay misiones secundarias, por lo que en tema rejugabilidad no hay mucho que hacer, completas las 10 horas de juego y no se ofrece más. He llegado a pensar que este producto salió tan bien que incluso sacaron versiones para consolas nombradas como Pocket Edition HD. Diría que este videojuego es perfecto para aquellos que solamente quieran disfrutar la historia de Final Fantasy XV, sin importar las apariencias o si no se pueden permitir correr la versión original, al fin y al cabo, es una versión bastante fiel creada por Square Enix. -------------------
![mg1 gif.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mig1/23ydTE7KBDPXbs6M6cpiwKB1CFTmB5utWUiXj4peUHBj5xUReooi8Ycb5t5XTGUgt4Zib.gif) *Gracias por leer mi post y nos vemos en la próxima <3*
####

body.title: Keeping the mind busy, fuelling the brain
body.body:
> Image made using ChatGPT
I have had a busy day so far. Work followed by the gym and a lot of cycling in between destinations. The body has been worked hard, and I am now resting. I could write off the day here and relax for the rest of the late afternoon and evening, but with this free time, why not keep the brain going and be productive?. Plus, having relaxing time, although good for you, maybe too much can allow bad habits and negative thoughts to creep in.
Today has been going very well in terms of keeping productive and not wasting the day. At work, whilst working, I was able to keep my headphones on and smash through an entire Audiobook. On top of that, I smashed 50% through another whilst cycling around. Getting exercise and knowledge together is a big win. I don't do audiobooks too much, I prefer to read, but with A free month of BookBeat (that's right, no payment from me, so saving money there), I may as well take advantage whilst I can. This will also be a big help towards my book-reading goal of 30 books in 2026. It is currently 15:00pm whilst I write up this post, it will probably be around 17:00 pm UK time by the time I reread and hit publish (if it does get published at all that is). Regardless, it is safe to say today and the week so far has been very positive. Long may it continue.
If you read yesterday's post from me in a way, this may feel like a continuation of that, and to be fair, it is. What I like about this type of post is that I don't overthink it and put too much planning into it. Of course, planning is important, but for this, I think letting the mind flow brings out a more authentic me.
Networking. Connect with others, build relationships, and maintain relationships. For me, I am somewhat still new to networking. It was only last year that I made a LinkedIn account and also pushed myself to get involved in communities and engage more. That doesn't stop at LinkedIn, I have also pushed myself to be more active, more creative and more engaging on Hive Blockchain, as well as some smaller platforms, with the goal being to better myself, expand my knowledge and build interesting relationships, even friendships with great people. At first, I thought networking was exclusive to someone professional, someone who knows what they want, and well, it isn't. I don't consider myself someone people should seek to connect with, and I do not know what I want. I have ideas but no clear and obvious answer, and that is OK. Instead, I see networking as an endless opportunity with no limits, so far it is working wonders for me. I have been the most active I have ever been on Hive, I have secured A job that I hope will help me progress, and I have opened my mind.

>
Image made using ChatGPT
Learning. Learning is important. I didn't know this during school, and I actually struggled in school. Mostly my fault, I focused purely on sports and nothing else, and I just didn't enjoy school. Fast-forward to today, and I realise learning is very important and even vital for everyday life and even survival. I was tutored to play and improve at sports, and I taught myself basic cooking. Whether tutored or self-taught, learning is learning.
Blogging. Blogging is something I enjoy. I don't consider myself an influencer or a great blogger. I just love to blog, and I love to engage with bloggers too, especially on Hive, where fame means nothing; anyone can create, comment and be unique, and you have the same opportunity as everyone else. No censorship, no nonsense rules like mainstream platforms and most of all a lovely community full of people that actually want to engage, help and grow together. Since Hive blogging has easily become one of my favourite hobbies.
Reading. Reading is again something I did not really do much of growing up. I enjoyed it when I did read the old Simpsons comics and occasional graphic novels, but with my time being taken up with sports and general things kids and teens do, it was a rarity for me to read, and yet today, reading is again something I really enjoy doing. Whether it is an entire audiobook during my work shift or just a page or two before bedtime, I enjoy it, and I gain knowledge from it that I didn't have previously. One thing I have personally noticed about my reading habits is that I am reading books from people regardless of their situations, controversies and status. I am reading books from names like Ant Middleton, Alice Cooper, Piers Morgan, and Jordan Peterson. Regardless of the headlines they make, good or bad, if any at all, I judge them purely on the book they write. I had a friend recently tell me their disgust after I shared that I read a book by Piers Morgan and that I, for the most part, enjoyed it. To which I shrug off and say I enjoy it for me. For me, that is how a book should be viewed when it is written by someone considered controversial.
I use a couple of book tracking apps, Goodreads, Bookwyrm, and Fable. Fable being my favourite as it is more socialable and just a nice UI. I love the tracking on it, too and the brief AI insights it gives you based on reading habits.

>


<center>
9 of 30 books read and 5 of 12 months into the year gone by. It isn't bad going considering this will be my first year of actually committing to a goal. The daily streak needs some work, I could cheat as it does that you edit ;) But I will keep it legit, haha. My reviews for books, honestly, take them with a grain of salt. I naturally give super high ratings if I slightly enjoy the read. I am happy that I am reading a variety of things. Furthermore, I still need to tackle more, including true crime, sci-fi, and fantasy genres, but I am enjoying it, and with my Kindle, I can save money and access more books.
</center>


<center>
Overall, I’m happy with how things are progressing. Days like this remind me that small, consistent actions, whether it’s learning, moving, or connecting, add up over time. I know I’m heading in the right direction with myself, and doing all of these helps me take my mind off of the things that aren't so great for me right now. With that, I conclude today's post. Thanks for reading.
</center>

body.title: Television Review: Fear City: New York vs the Mafia (2020)
body.body:
![(source: tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/eAHQ2RZQs6zc4OCNmMYr9OfJeq9.jpg)


New York, a metropolis that—whether justifiably or not—is regarded as the most important city in the world today, was at the start of this decade going what were probably the worst moments in its history, thanks to the global pandemic and its economic effects. Until 2020, however, the worst period for the citizens of the Big Apple was considered to be the 1970s, a decade in which the city with the highest concentration of financial capital and power was burdened by a politically inert administration, incompetent municipal services, an economic crisis, and social problems that—among other things—triggered an explosion of crime on a previously unimaginable scale, so that the average New Yorker had more reason to fear being killed on the street than a citizen of conflict-ridden Belfast or Beirut. *Fear City: New York vs Mafia*, a three-part mini-series directed by Sam Hobkinson, attempts to show how the unquestioned hegemony of the Italian-American mafia contributed to all of this in no small measure, and how putting that organisation in its rightful place was the beginning of the journey towards a calmer, more decent, better-ordered and happier New York—the New York that would exist until the spring of 2020.

The opening of *Fear City* shows that the New York mafia based its hegemony over the streets of the world's most important metropolis not so much on the sheer number of its members, its penchant for extreme violence, its superb organisation, strict discipline, or brilliant strategy, as on the skilful exploitation of one prosaic fact. Individual mobsters could \

and end up in prison for extortion, robbery, drug-dealing and similar crimes, but the organisation itself remained untouchable, because the bosses could not be proven to have directly participated in those illegal activities. At the beginning of the 1970s, the famous law known by the acronym RICO was passed, introducing new concept to American criminal law, and making it possible for mafia leaders to be held accountable for crimes to which they had given their direct or indirect blessing. Admittedly, it took several years for a group of FBI agents and the federal prosecutors working with them to remember to use RICO as a tool to attack the previously untouchable leaders of the five New York \
. In this, they were greatly aided by the development of modern technology, which made it possible to bypass \

through intensive wiretapping and thus uncover the most closely guarded secrets of the world's most famous criminal organisation. As the years go by, the data thus collected allows federal prosecutors finally to launch proceedings that, in the mid-1980s, lead to spectacular trials and the imprisonment of mafia bosses.\n\n*Fear City* is quite cleverly conceived, the most important creative decision being to make only three episodes, so that viewers can watch the whole story in a single evening's binge. The second thing that makes *Fear City* different from most series and films on a similar subject is that it hardly ever shows the mafia from the perspective of the mobsters themselves, but almost exclusively from the perspective of the federal agents and prosecutors who fought against them. This is both a strength and a weakness of the series, given that viewers already know or have reason to guess the outcome of the conflict, so there is no particular tension, and the only thing that could be called \

is the occasionally ingenious but mostly prosaic placement of hidden listening devices in the cars and homes of mobsters. That does not mean *Fear City* lacks moments of interesting content, but it all largely boils down to dry testimony from retired civil servants in their seventies or eighties, who only here and there try to \

with an amusing anecdote. The authors themselves are sometimes aware of this, and allow themselves the occasional digression, such as mentioning Trump in the context of the 1980s construction boom in New York, when the future president, as an entrepreneur in an industry riddled with organised crime, had to be careful about how he positioned himself vis-à-vis the mafia. By an ironic twist of fate, one of the main protagonists of this series is former federal prosecutor Rudy Giuliani, who brought indictments against mobsters and thereby laid the foundations for his mayoral career, and who later made headlines as Trump's controversial lawyer in lawsuits over alleged election fraud. When it is necessary to show how all these events looked from the mafia's perspective, the authors use interviews with mobsters who did not end up serving multi-decade prison sentences and who, by nature, were \

.\n\nThe most important shortcoming of *Fear City*, however, is content that is actually inadequate for this story. The series simply ends too quickly; it does not show the events that took place after the trials and that should have given context to the federal operation to remove the untouchable mafia bosses. It completely ignores the generation of new, young mobsters who replaced the imprisoned ageing \

, among them John Gotti, the head of the Gambino family, who in just a few years became a media star and the subject of countless biopics, TV series and even a reality show devoted to his descendants. Compared to other works that have dealt with the mafia—whether fiction like *[The Godfather](https://peakd.com/film/@drax/retro-film-review-the-godfather-1972)*, or even 1980s documentaries like *Mob Inc.*—*Fear City* comes across as disappointingly like reheated cabbage.

RATING: 4/10 (+)

body.title: 当然可以！以下是一个旅游博客的主题建议：\n\n**“隐秘的旅行：探索
body.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g23a6de11001df4dac320917c4bf08e07e6b7d714dd069770f473eed313d5e5a8f2ffdce52bb9f7353c3cb23ad0a55780e0f229724d4f9d44e1905139a46e737f_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 隐秘的旅行：探索那些不为人知的目的地

在这个信息爆炸的时代，许多旅行者都倾向于选择热门的旅游景点，如巴黎的埃菲尔铁塔、纽约的时代广场或东京的涩谷十字路口。然而，世界上还有许多隐秘的角落，等待着我们去发现。在这篇文章中，我将带你探索一些不为人知的目的地，让你的旅行更加独特而难忘。

## 1. 斯洛文尼亚：布莱德湖

布莱德湖位于斯洛文尼亚的阿尔卑斯山脚下，以其迷人的湖泊和小岛而闻名。这里的湖水清澈见底，四周被郁郁葱葱的森林环绕。你可以租一只小船，划向湖中的小岛，参观岛上的教堂，或者在湖边的步道上漫步，享受宁静的自然风光。

## 2. 乔治亚：乌兹鲁基村

乌兹鲁基村是乔治亚一个鲜为人知的村庄，位于大高加索山脉的怀抱中。这里的建筑风格独特，拥有许多保存完好的中世纪塔楼。游客可以在这里体验当地的传统生活方式，品尝地道的乔治亚美食，甚至参与到当地的节庆活动中。

## 3. 日本：高野山

虽然日本有许多著名的城市和景点，但高野山却是一个隐藏的宝藏。这个佛教圣地坐落在山中，拥有众多寺庙和宁静的环境。游客可以在这里参与禅修，体验僧侣的生活，感受内心的平和与宁静。

## 4. 葡萄牙：阿尔加维的海滩

阿尔加维是葡萄牙南部的一个地区，以其美丽的海滩而闻名。然而，许多游客只知道主要的海滩，而忽视了那些不为人知的小海湾。例如，Praia da Marinha和Praia da Rocha都是隐藏的瑰宝，拥有壮观的岩石景观和清澈的海水，是放松和游泳的理想之地。

## 5. 冰岛：西峡湾

冰岛的西峡湾是一个远离人群的地方，拥有壮丽的自然风光。这里的峡湾、瀑布和野生动物让人赞叹不已。游客可以在这里进行徒步旅行、观鸟，甚至在某些季节观看到北极光。西峡湾的宁静与美丽，绝对是冰岛旅行中不可错过的体验。

## 结束语

旅行不仅仅是去名胜古迹打卡，更是探索未知、体验不同文化的过程。希望这篇文章能够激发你去寻找那些隐秘的旅行目的地，让你的下一次旅行充满惊喜与发现。无论你选择哪个地方，记得放慢脚步，细细品味每一个瞬间。安全旅行，期待你的美好故事！

- 1 cup of green or red seedless grapes 8 oz or 150g
- 1 cup of sweetened coconut flakes 95g
- 1 1/2 cups of fruity mini marshmallows 90g
- 1 1/2 cups of pineapple tidbits 20 oz or 567g
- 3/4 cup of maraschino cherries 10 oz

body.title: Reel Mix
body.body:
by Siberiann on Paul Lindstrom 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/paulindstrom [![Reel Mix](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/609d48a8-a298-436b-821c-e585f401d9e8.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/qgk1nH5sedYuir45Gz8sQv) 
 
 El reel escocés no nació en un conservatorio ni fue diseñado por teóricos distantes. Surgió del suelo, de los pies golpeando la madera de las tabernas y de la necesidad visceral de moverse al compás de la vida comunitaria. Es curioso pensar cómo algo tan aparentemente simple, esa estructura binaria de cuatro tiempos que corre como agua rápida, pueda contener tanta historia y emoción.

En sus orígenes, mucho antes de que se estandarizara la notación musical, el reel era una criatura oral. Pasaba de maestro a alumno, de padre a hijo, en sesiones donde la memoria era el único archivo disponible. Los músicos de los siglos XVII y XVIII no buscaban la perfección técnica tal como la entendemos hoy, sino el \

, ese impulso rítmico que hace imposible quedarse quieto. Era la banda sonora de los bailes country, de las bodas rurales y de las reuniones clandestinas donde la cultura escocesa resistía la asimilación. Cada nota doble, cada arco rápido, llevaba consigo el peso de una identidad que se negaba a desaparecer.

Con el tiempo, la figura del compositor comenzó a tomar forma, aunque siempre manteniendo un pie firmemente plantado en la tradición. Nombres como Niel Gow, el legendario violinista del siglo XVIII, transformaron el reel de una mera danza funcional a una forma de arte expresiva. Gow entendía que el reel podía cantar, llorar y reír. Sus composiciones no eran solo ejercicios de velocidad; tenían alma. Introdujo matices, dinámicas y una sensibilidad melódica que elevó el género. La gente no solo bailaba sus tunes; los escuchaba, los sentía en el pecho. Esta evolución marcó un punto de inflexión: el reel dejó de ser solo acompañamiento para convertirse en protagonista.

La diáspora escocesa jugó un papel crucial en la dispersión y transformación de este estilo. Cuando los escoceses emigraron a América, Canadá y Australia, llevaron sus violines y sus gaitas en los barcos. En las nuevas tierras, el reel se mezcló con otras influencias, dando lugar a variantes regionales, pero la esencia rítmica permaneció intacta. En Cape Breton, por ejemplo, el estilo se conservó con una pureza arqueológica, mientras que en otras partes se fusionó con el folk local. 

Hoy en día, escuchar un reel bien ejecutado sigue siendo una experiencia electrizante. Hay una tensión deliciosa entre la precisión técnica requerida para mantener el tempo implacable y la libertad expresiva necesaria para darle carácter. Los músicos contemporáneos, desde los tradicionales más puristas hasta los fusores experimentales, siguen buscando ese equilibrio. No se trata solo de tocar rápido; se trata de contar una historia en pocos compases. La repetición de las frases melódicas, lejos de ser monótona, crea un estado hipnótico, una especie de trance colectivo que une a intérpretes y oyentes.

Lo fascinante del reel escocés es su humildad aparente. No necesita grandes orquestas ni producciones complejas. A menudo, basta con un solo instrumento y un buen sentido del ritmo para despertar ecos de siglos pasados. Es una música democrática, accesible pero profunda, que invita a participar ya sea bailando, aplaudiendo o simplemente cerrando los ojos y dejando que la melodía haga su trabajo. En un mundo digital y acelerado, el reel ofrece una conexión tangible con lo humano, con lo físico, con el placer inmediato de compartir un momento a través del sonido. 

La resonancia del reel escocés trasciende las partituras y se filtra en los intersticios de otras artes, actuando como un hilo conductor invisible que conecta disciplinas aparentemente distantes. En la literatura, especialmente en la narrativa romántica y costumbrista de los siglos XIX y XX, el ritmo del reel aparece a menudo como metáfora de la vitalidad desbordante o del caos controlado. Autores como Walter Scott no solo describían los bailes, sino que estructuraban ciertas escenas de acción con la misma urgencia rítmica: frases cortas, aceleradas, que imitan el arco del violín corriendo sobre las cuerdas. La prosa adquiere una cadencia binaria, un galope literario que empuja al lector hacia adelante, reflejando esa energía inagotable característica de las Highlands. 

En el cine, la influencia es más auditiva que textual, pero no por ello menos profunda. Los compositores de bandas sonoras han utilizado durante décadas los patrones del reel para evocar inmediatamente un sentido de lugar y pertenencia, o para subrayar escenas de persecución y huida. La estructura implacable del 4/4 rápido proporciona una columna vertebral perfecta para el montaje cinematográfico. Cuando las imágenes cortan al ritmo de los golpes de arco, se crea una sincronía visceral que el espectador siente en el cuerpo antes de procesarla intelectualmente. Películas épicas o dramas familiares ambientados en Escocia dependen de esta estética sonora para establecer la atmósfera; el reel no es solo fondo, es un personaje más que dicta el tempo emocional de la escena, aportando una capa de autenticidad cruda que los instrumentos sinfónicos tradicionales a menudo no pueden lograr por sí solos.

Curiosamente, la moda también ha bebido de esta fuente, aunque de manera más sutil y simbólica. El resurgimiento del interés por la cultura celta y escocesa en las pasarelas contemporáneas va de la mano con una reivindicación de la artesanía y la tradición, valores intrínsecos a la música folk. Los tejidos de tartán, con sus cruces geométricas y repetitivas, encuentran un eco visual en la estructura matemática y recurrente del reel. Diseñadores modernos a menudo citan la \

de la música tradicional como inspiración para colecciones que buscan moverse, fluir y romper con la estática. La ropa deja de ser un traje de museo para convertirse en indumentaria dinámica, pensada para el movimiento, igual que el reel está pensado para el baile. Hay una estética de la funcionalidad elegante que une la prenda bien confeccionada con la melodía bien ejecutada: ambas requieren precisión, historia y un respeto profundo por la materia prima.

Quizás donde la huella es más evidente y transformadora es en otros estilos musicales. El reel escocés es uno de los ancestros directos del bluegrass y el old-time americano. Cuando los inmigrantes escoceses e irlandeses llegaron a Appalachia, sus reels se encontraron con las baladas africanas y los ritmos locales, creando una fusión explosiva. La técnica de bowing (uso del arco) desarrollada para los reels escoceses se adaptó al banjo y al violín country, dando forma a la velocidad vertiginosa que caracteriza a géneros como el bluegrass. Sin esa base rítmica escocesa, el sonido de Bill Monroe o Doc Watson sería inconcebible. Incluso en el rock y el folk eléctrico moderno, bandas como Fairport Convention o Runrig integraron la estructura del reel en formatos de banda de rock, demostrando que la progresión armónica simple y el impulso rítmico pueden soportar amplificación eléctrica y baterías pesadas sin perder su esencia.

Esta permeabilidad cultural demuestra que el reel no es una reliquia aislada, sino un lenguaje universal de energía y comunidad. Su capacidad para migrar de la literatura al cine, de la tela a la electricidad, habla de una flexibilidad sorprendente. No se trata de una imposición cultural, sino de una adopción natural por parte de otras artes que reconocen en el reel una verdad fundamental: la necesidad humana de ritmo, de conexión y de celebración. 

En momentos históricos donde la expresión de la escocidad fue suprimida, especialmente tras el levantamiento jacobita de 1745, la música se convirtió en un refugio seguro. Mientras las leyes prohibían el uso de la gaita o el tartán, el violín, instrumento menos asociado políticamente con la rebelión armada pero igualmente capaz de transmitir el alma de las Highlands, mantuvo viva la llama. El reel, por tanto, no es solo entretenimiento; es un archivo histórico codificado en notas, una forma de recordar quiénes eran cuando todo lo demás les era arrebatado.

La universalidad del reel también lo convierte en un embajador cultural de primer orden. A diferencia de formas musicales más herméticas o complejas teóricamente, el reel es accesible. Su alegría es contagiosa y su estructura lógica permite que músicos de cualquier origen se aproximen a él con relativa facilidad. Esto ha facilitado que la cultura escocesa se proyecte al mundo no desde una posición de exotismo lejano, sino desde la cercanía de una fiesta compartida. 

Además, el reel representa un triunfo de la tradición oral sobre la escritura. En una era obsesionada con la documentación escrita y digital, el reel sigue dependiendo fundamentalmente de la transmisión directa, del oído al oído, de la mano a la mano. Esta dependencia de la presencia física asegura que la cultura no se convierta en algo estático o muerto en un libro. Cada vez que se enseña un reel, se transmite no solo la melodía, sino la postura, el fraseo, la respiración y la actitud vital del maestro. Es un conocimiento encarnado. Esto convierte al reel en un hito pedagógico único, demostrando que ciertas formas de saber requieren contacto humano directo para sobrevivir con autenticidad. La tecnología puede grabar el sonido, pero no puede transmitir la intención cultural sin la intermediación humana.

El reel nos recuerda que la cultura no es solo lo que protegemos, sino lo que compartimos con entusiasmo. Es un legado que no se guarda en vitrinas, sino que se baila, se toca y se vive, renovándose con cada pie que golpea el suelo y cada arco que corta el aire, asegurando que este hito cultural siga siendo tan relevante hoy como lo fue hace tres siglos.

Es todo por hoy.

Disfruten del mix que les comparto, esta vez, sin voz, solo instrumental.

body.title: Thank You For That.
body.body:
So I will put that in the comments and pin it to the top here in a moment. Lady Rocket, are you there? Yes. Yes, I am here. 

Fantastic to hear you. Love to little astronauts that are making a wonderful... I am coming to you actually from the Griffith Park Observatory area. I wanted to be in a very special place. 

As some of you might know, this is the most magical dedicated to space object park that we have here in Los Angeles. I will post some incredible videos, but also, Brent, it's terrific to have you here. And tokenized the Moon Mission. 

What a spectacular opportunity. I just spent a week in Munich on behalf of Copernicus Space, on behalf of our community, on behalf of our investments, and something so important, being able to deliver our message to important audiences. Tokenization of space, I don't have to tell you. 

So many of you are already with us for quite some time, but after the Munich Security Conference, tokenization of space is truly strategic, significant, and tough opportunity. And I'm so happy that Brent will be addressing it today with us. So looking forward to your participation and thank you, Brent, for hosting us on a beautiful Monday morning in Los Angeles.

Awesome. Yeah, so what I'm going to start, I'll pin... Is Twitter doing its weird stuff again? Looking to put in the comments the actual link for you guys to fill in. Yeah, while you are doing it, I want to welcome Mark, who is in the audience. 

He represents, he's the CEO of GoQLabs and Crown Network. So if you would like to join us to speak, we would love to hear from you. Otherwise, please connect afterwards. 

Also, David Burt, welcome, you're a senior software developer. Send the Doge meme to the Moon, literally. So you are part of our family. 

It's wonderful to have you and your art continues to be beautifully out there. And the time is to make something happen with it. Esther, Artemis, Quasar, Dolores, Binx. 

Binx, if you'd love to share about your initiative that you just announced. I read about it 4 a.m. Los Angeles time about your absolutely fantastic initiative at the Copernicus Space Passport to bring new visibility to Copernicus. So thank you for that.

body.body: Oof, how's your wrist today? Did you hit feet first and then flop/roll onto your back or was it flat on your back from the block?! I think you need to practice safety rolls XD \n\n<sub>I think \
needs to practice safety rolls but it's one of those things \

ever thinks about til you break your wrist!</sub>

> they don't want to look silly trying to work out how to fill the car

Now they look even sillier coz they ran out of fuel :D

> I think most of us \

have become accustomed to avoiding this kind of physical discomfort, especially as we age

I guess that makes sense.  I am in an industry where it seems the opposite is true though XD the oldest coaches are in their 60s.  And I'm around your age and I'm still demonstrating a lot of the nonsense (which I learned how to do in the last three years along with the groups I've been coaching XD) and very often having to roll out of saving a child from falling on their heads (because the way I either have to or end up catching one of us is going to get twisted if I don't roll with them).  It's good fun.

> Have you ever experienced that much pain you have been unable to think, unable to move, that you are just frozen, that all your systems were overwhelmed and your body started to shut down to protect itself?

I've had some kids react similar to this (sometimes with tears involved on their part but not mine) when confronted with my atomic drill progressions because they are terrified of either the drill itself or the skill for whatever reason.  They get very gently and persistently cajoled through and the ones that are still in the gym program have come a fair way.

Sports (and music and whatever other activities one can think of) are useful for getting people accustomed to struggling.

body.title: Cactus Gloom In Acrylic Paint
body.body:
>
Hello, how are you? Months ago, I started painting the Gloom characters I drew. It was supposed to be made using clay, but that time I didn’t feel like doing clay, so I decided to make a series of acrylic paintings of the Gloom characters I drew. -----
Materials I Used:

> ![3.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep3ffpTz2wUwZ4iYFe1nCnKpKDesxiyY6f66smYtVKmgxxjfpEMLcjM6DVNTFWUyPdK.JPG) I drew a cactus bloom in colored pencil, then toned the canvas with burnt sienna. ----

> ![5.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoK7iZHtyZQxSMeALbPnrL6CeRgPJDrQ1zAhrCdxtLVGPHZR7Wt5zUAdYWNnpknirE8.JPG) After that, I outline the drawing with a darker shade of color because it is pretty much gone after I tone up the canvas, LOL. -----

> ![7.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoc8xC7cqC1dq5TQEg83r4qyXUFynXxNCVKRgfiUNzbmE5f9NDUDTwR8VufLh4ahhyu.JPG) I start by layering the skin in the color of my choice, applying it until the color below is completely covered. ----

> ![9.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoeFpGA8s5RowaDeATjkCMRvR4CeuZAqHZau9GHTmHV97jb6bfvTPSj6BAaawJdWKih.JPG) Then I painted the body with the darkest green I have. ----

> ![11.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoc7vLEt9YGi3227eHsZyvx9FF5sLQcmmh7fA115kHTRoAQ2dXYbm64bFHWifRPcZER.JPG) Then I decided to paint the background, a purple or violet shade, in order to make the character pop out more. ----

> ![13.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoeFNuDk4E8m994W1ars683Q3GkXUEYcLKft7bL4yWX5vtbBkqhTi75BGieYJYyaoAT.JPG) When I am satisfied and up with the shade of the skin, I painted the eyes, nose, and eyebrows. ----

> ![15.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep1YnmYSdyCYHMR9xm1hdXXPMLySWwSjH4RuzTPBcm6YFn1csYaT4w8gHBsodwdJ9Gx.JPG) Of course, a cactus groom is not a cactus if it doesn’t have the thorn, so I painted it lighter than the body color in order to make it more visible. ----

> ![17.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EonnRTBioWyjmRuxXBD9vsbYU9VE5UXfHoefX5Dx9LRNPyvaArshynpSxSGKeRrh2jk.JPG) For this part, I added the highlights and finished up some parts that I didn’t add enough shade to. ---- ![18.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoCj4rVLQKn2cDz8ASvUc6mbZuVERScF47K9GnYsj9UXv2BVKTU9PMJMm7wzSjafMiP.JPG) I wanted to add background design, but I think I like the focus on the character more. ____ ![19.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoeFwzVui6Y6i2APSXJuXySkrhn2eULXHq98KRbw8wJLfc9BJmTa9sTHYJqkL922XHK.JPG) I hope you like it! :-)… ----
Thank you for visiting, see you on my next blog. :D Please take care of your mental health as well. I hope you are okay today :))
---
