body.title: Chaos Rising Pokemon Prerelease Guide & Theorycrafting
body.body: Hi there. In this Pokemon TCG post, I do a prerelease guide for the upcoming Chaos Rising set. Prerelease events are casual tournament events where players, collectors and maybe PokeInvestors/scalpers (unfortunately) get cards early and play games. Some are aiming to get big hits like some of these art cards. | | | | | |---|---|---|---| | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/88-Froakie.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/90-Ampharos.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/116-Mega-Greninja-ex.png | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/118-Mega-Dragalge-ex.jpg |   Chaos Rising Prerelease events are held from May 9, 2026 to May 17, 2026. Some local stores may give out extra packs for participation. Some other stores may have a format where you win more packs for each win or if you achieve a certain tournament record. It depends. This post is long. Read and see what you want.   ## Prerelease Format --- Prerelease events do take up a few hours out of the day. Entry fees for these events are usually around 40 or 45 CAD per event. Some places may charge 35 CAD or even 30 CAD but they give out less packs or have more competitive prizing. In a prerelease event, each participant receives one build and battle kit. This kit usually retails for more than 45 CAD after release. You also get a few extra packs. It is usually two extra packs but it depends on the store. After receiving the kit, you have 30 minutes to build a 40 card deck from the build and battle kit with a preconstructed deck and the packs you get. In a prerelease format, you can go past the standard max 4 copies of a card in a deck. https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/Chaos-Rising-Prerelease-Promos.jpg Once the deckbuilding phase is done, you play the tournament. The tournament is in a swiss format. You typically matchup with someone of the same record as you. If there is an odd number of people, then someone in each round gets a free win or a bye. A free win is impactful as the store may have a pack per win prize format. The casual prerelease tournaments are usually in a best of one format with 3 rounds. There may be a few places that have more rounds or even a best of 3 format.   ## Promo Cards --- In the prerelease build and battle kit, you get 1 of 4 promo cards and its associated preconstructed deck. The preconstructed decks are unknown but I'm sure there will be a few Youtubers who will leak the information before May 9. For Chaos Rising, the promo cards are one of either: * Crobat * Ampharos * Delphox * Goodra   | | | | | |---|---|---|---| | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/MEP_EN_74.png | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/MEP_EN_75.png | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/MEP_EN_76.png | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/MEP_EN_77.png |   Note that all 4 promo cards are Stage 2 Pokemon. Crobat seems to be the best out of the four. One Dark Energy for 80 damage plus Confusion & Poison it pretty powerful. Goodra may be the most powerful but you have to watch out for discarding the top card of your deck. Energy requirements can be awkward. English card Images are from [pokemonproxies.com](https://pokemonproxies.com) or from [Pokebeach](https://www.pokebeach.com/2026/04/many-chaos-rising-english-cards-revealed-all-cut-and-added-cards-now-known). ## Beedrill ex --- If you are lucky, Beedrill ex is pretty good in the prerelease format. Watch out for Fire Pokemon though. | | | | |---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-001-Weedle-DttjxZc0.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-002-Kakuna-DQ3g_99R.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-003-Beedrill_ex-ChRtpa6A.png |   ## Fennekin ---

>Image Source Fennekin outside of a Delphox deck is useable in my opinion. The Call For Family attack for any 1 Energy lets you search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokemon and put them onto your Bench. (Then shuffle deck.) In standard play, Call For Family is sometimes used in the early game but for prerelease this attack is good for setup and you see your deck.   ## Remoraid & Octillery --- | | | | |---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-016-Remoraid-DXnqqlUx.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-017-Octillery-Bi1ps5y5.png |   This Octillery evolution line good be good in a Goodra deck. You run Water Energy anyways. Octillery is also good if you don't like your deck and want to do just Water Pokemon. Corner Stop requires one Water Energy to deal 30 damage. During the opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokemon tries to attack, the opponent has to flip 2 coins. If any of the two is tails, the attack does nothing. The probability of hitting two Heads is 25%. This Corner Stop attack is pretty annoying and can lead to stall and deckout. However, the opponent can switch out to a new Pokemon and knock out the Octillery.   ## Mega Greninja ex Line --- | | | | |---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-020-Froakie-DZCqxezz.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-021-Frogadier-CVYRKikY.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-022-Mega_Greninja_ex-BzXRt8Vd.png |   It is hard to ignore the Mega Greninja evolution line. If you are lucky, consider this evolution line. You may have to make room for Water Energy if you are not using Goodra. Watch out for Ampharos though.   ## Deoxys --- | | | | | |---|---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-031-Deoxys-ti-qk0aI.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-032-Deoxys-BLnRqjqe.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-033-Deoxys-DavB9qx6.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-034-Deoxys-DBf6WLGH.png | There are 4 Deoxys cards in the set. The one with Genome Charge could be okay in prerelease if you run a full Psychic deck (ditching the preconstructed deck). The Deoxys with the Psy Protect attack is really good against opponents that have attackers with abilities. It would take some time to get energy on to this Deoxys though. **Free Retreat Deoxys** The only two Pokemon in this set that have a zero retreat cost. It is Zubat and this Deoxys. You may or may not use this for attacking. The zero retreat cost is helpful for putting this in front after one of your Pokemon is Knocked Out. That way you can gain more information from your draw before committing a possible attack. The Psy Speed attack is decent. One Psychic energy for 30 damage plus you draw cards until 5 cards in hand.   ## Skrelp & Mega Dragalge ex --- | | | |---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-056-Skrelp-C5CkXhTr.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-063-Mega_Dragalge_ex-CZzSrkuE.png |   Mega Dragalge ex could be the best attacker in the prerelease format. The Pernicious Poison attack does not deal damage but it deals 16 damage counters of Poison damage in between turns for a Poisoned Pokemon.   ## Quilfish & Roxie's Performance --- | | | |---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-051-Qwilfish-BBPmLiLL.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-077-Roxie's_Performance-Am6dOrer.png | Qwilfish is kind of usable for any deck. The Poison Point is a punish style ability. If Qwilfish is in the active spot and takes damage from an attack from the opponent's Pokemon, the Attacking Pokemon is Poisoned. Roxie's Performance is a niche Supporter card that goes with Poison Pokemon. During the opponent's next turn, their Poisoned Pokemon cannot retreat (including newly Poisoned Pokemon).   ## Tauros Might Be Good ---

>Image Source Tauros could be good. In prerelease, you can go past 4 copies. You could even do an all out Tauros deck. Crowd Targeting requires 2 Energy for the attack. You choose 1 of your opponent's Pokemon (Active or Benched). Flip a coin for each Tauros you have in play. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads to that Pokemon. **Three Tauros In Play (3 Flips) Probability Table** | # Heads | Damage | Probability | |---|---|---| | 0 | 0 | 12.5% | | 1 | 50 dmg | 37.5% | | 2 | 100 dmg | 37.5% | | 3 | 150 dmg | 12.5% |   **Four Tauros Probability Table** | # Heads | Damage | Probability | |---|---|---| | 0 | 0 | 6.25% | | 1 | 50 | 25% | | 2 | 100 | 37.5% | | 3 | 150 dmg | 25% | | 4 | 200 dmg | 6.25% |   **Five Tauros Probability Table** | # Heads | Damage | Probability | |---|---|---| | 0 | 0 | 3.125% | | 1 | 50 | 15.625% | | 2 | 100 | 31.25% | | 3 | 150 | 31.25% | | 4 | 200 | 15.625% | | 5 | 250 | 3.125% |   Increasing the number of Tauros helps with getting at least 100 damage. The main issues with an all Tauros deck is getting the Tauros in play and getting energy set up. Tauros has 130 HP but can be fragile later in the game.   ## Minccino & Cinccino ex --- | | | |---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-070-Minccino-DCwTxCZm.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-071-Cinccino_ex-DhjIuAqS.png | Minccino on its own is a decent early game attacker. One Energy for 30 damage and then 10 damage to itself. Cincinno ex looks to be pretty annoying. Smooth Coat activates when any damage is done to it. Flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage. Energized Slap does 40 damage for each Energy attached to it.   ## Mega Floette ex, Prism Tower, Hyperrouge Ange Floette --- | | | | |---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-035-Mega_Floette_ex-DmccdIhY.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-080-Prism_Tower-CE6fS4Mu.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-079-Hyperrogue_Ange_Floette-Cu7tvHMF.png |   If you get lucky, the combination of Mega Floette ex, Prism Tower and Hyperrouge Ange Floette is strong in prerelease. You would need a Pokemon ex to go toe to toe with this combination. Crobat, Cincinno ex or Octillery can stall this out though.   ## Emma ---

>Image Source Emma could be an okay draw supporter. The opponent reveals his/her hand. Then you draw cards equal to the amount of Pokemon in the opponent's hand. Even if don't draw many cards, seeing the opponent's hand can be of great value.   ## Delibird ---

>Image Source This Delibird could be useful in a few niche decks. If you have a lot of energy in the hand, then this first attack can power up your attackers. I think this is best with Mega Pokemon ex attackers that require a lot of energy. If your Mega Pokemon ex is up and running, you typically just win if the opponent has no Pokemon ex to fight back with.   ## Special Red Card ---

>Image Source Special Red Card is one of the best cards in the game and in this format. Some may argue that this is the best card in the game (in Japan or soon). In the prerelease format, you start with 4 Prize Cards instead of the Standard six. You can play this Special Red Card if the opponent has 3 Prize cards or lower. For the prerelease format, it would be when the opponent knocked out one of your Pokemon. After playing this card, the opponent shuffles their hand and puts it into to the **bottom of their deck**. Then the opponent draws 3 cards. I boldfaced bottom of deck as the opponent should not shuffle the cards back into the deck. (Regular players should warn newer players about this to maintain board state. Someone who waits for this mistake then rulesharks this to gain a cheap win at a casual prerelease is suspect.)   ## Special Energy Cards --- | | | | |---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-081-Nitro_Fire_Energy-DFG7qmD1.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-082-Bubble_Water_Energy-BXO-MYpo.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-083-Magnet_Metal_Energy-Dyqh5L6D.png | There are 3 new special Energy cards in the Mega Evolution sets series. We have: * Nitro Fire Energy * Bubble Water Energy * Magnet Metal Energy   Nitro Fire Energy is good for Fire Pokemon with attacks that require discarding. Instead of discarding you put the discarded Energy back into your hand. Bubble Water Energy is very good for Water Pokemon. You heal any Special Conditions (Paralysis, Poison, Asleep, Burn) and Water Pokemon with this Energy are not affected by Special Conditions. Magnet Metal Energy will not see much play in the prerelease format. Metal Pokemon with this Energy has zero retreat cost.   ## Other Notes --- When it comes to the prerelease format, a lot of luck and variance is involved. Two wins out of 3 rounds is usually good. One win out of 3 could be good if the opponents are tough somehow. Winning three out of three usually involves good luck in packs and in games. It is hard to do and I think it is not that important to win a prerelease event. Sometimes you lose against someone with lucky pulls and Pokemon ex. Sometimes you win without lucky pulls. When it comes to deckbuilding, sticking with the preconstructed deck is generally safe. Regular players may want to cut certain cards to make room for better attackers or more supporters. Some people may want to adjust their decks to make room for a Mega Pokemon ex they got from packs. | | | |---|---| | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/HHP-ikaXkAAvtg5.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/41-Gourgeist-ex.jpg | You never know who you run into at prerelease events (or any event in general). The opponent could be a regular player, an ace trainer, a pro (who may be all in on this game), a store employee (maybe) or a first-timer. The main goal with prerelease events is to get stuff early. Earning more packs from wins is a nice bonus. Chaos Rising prerelease events could be chaotic. Without knowing the preconstructed decks, I think any deck and even any player can do well. Some people may try to ditch their preconstructed decks and try stuff like Tauros, Cincinno ex, Mega Dragalge ex, Mega Greninja ex or Mega Floette ex.  
Thank you for reading.

body.title: Turquoise Water Drops
body.body:
I find doing water drop photography like this to be a mix of studio photography, macro, and action photography, as it combines elements of both and is a great way to learn and perfect different techniques. To get the colors right and lighting how I want it, I have to understand where to place my lights and how to best use my flash. For the macro side of things, it's about trying to get very small objects sharp and in focus in the right spots. For the action side of things, it's all about timing and being able to get the right shot at the right time. If you have the time, all it really takes is a kitchen sink and some patience; it's a great low-pressure way to practice some really eye-catching photography.

body.title: The Big Difference between Assumption and Rumours - PART 1
body.body:
Assumption and Rumour and entirely two different things because most people take them for each other and it is not actually So even tho there have to be one before the second one can actually do so if there is no one there is actually not going to be the other but let’s go deeper into the topic. In what way do you view Assumption and Rumour, my own perspective will be dropped today and yours also will be appreciated in the comment section.

![IMG_4198.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayorkeys/23yJG8m6s3wQZksNdJGgZqUW1VVPKi4ohjXwohtVaCZcBuhsfky5wShATVgsC13bTUj8c.jpeg)

When we talk about assumption and rumour, but actually dwell on information which are not actually verified but people see it as the truth. This kind of stuff do not come from a single source but different people and different places and that is why it is easy and faster to believe than the truth. In most cases rumour are better believe than the real truth because the truth is seen as lie since there is no real evidence even though there is evidence before it can change the impression rumour already created in people’s mind it will go a long way and take a while before it can be changed.

Now i will define both of them one after the other so as to see things differently the way i see it.

**ASSUMPTION** : This is actually a belief you see and accept as the through it is not been said to you but this is a personal belief and conclusion different from what others might see just to be able to move on from the past and focus on the new thing which you can bring to the mind. Assumption is just like overthinking because it comes along with conclusion and you belief what you are thinking is the final. Like an example now you texted and called someone 5 times and the person didn’t pick or reply assumption set in that the person might actually be in a meeting, or be sleeping or actually ignoring you without confirming why.

**RUMOUR** : Rumour is actually a story or let me say information that is transferred from one person to another without verification also from the source of the matter. This is different from a belief, you do not belief what you hear in rumour you just say it because it is coming from someone who you think knows the truth of the matter and that is why rumour is very hard not to believe since more than two people are saying the same thing at different time and also different places..

Let’s look at this example, I heard someone stole money from the bank and i told another person without verifying the other person started saying it around also which is not true then that is how it continue to spread and people believe it is the truth. If they later find out the truth, they would see it as a lie..

The two differences between the two is that assumption is a mindset or let me say within and also the rumour is external because it deals with different people and different places. I know I can’t say all once but i will have to continue in another post where we will talk about how they are generated or where most come from.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@mayorkeys/the-big-difference-between-assumption-and-rumours-part-1-on)

body.title: Monomad: Urban glamour - with Mariale [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
>

This is my entry for the #monomad challenge.

Personally, I believe that when you take photos of a girl, you want to highlight her natural beauty, whether it’s her face, her expressions, the way she poses, or even the clothes she’s wearing at the time and that’s exactly what Mariale and I did in this shoot; I hope you enjoy them.

Creo personalmente que cuando le haces fotografías a una chica, quieres resaltar la belleza que desprende, ya sea por su rostro, sus expresiones, la forma en que posa o incluso por la ropa que tenga al momento, y justamente es una combinación de todo esto lo que hicimos Mariale y yo en esta sesión; espero que las disfruten.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23xAVKSLWQ2fhz5ukgUKn4TMQ3vXBJUax9yEGuWnZBb1Zcovt6vT1Y29Q9uyUtgcBKAnt.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tvVynVRJew3fwcoAxmgP7hCsnpxEXxviE2w95eSEeWBvDkCa5mCPvfyK9x3yrCuBDMC.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23wCBw56Ne6Wo7pTdiqoAtWSoCkuCQhWNK5hYmVM87vKUYVmxNb5CeGi5ChJx8eWCDGRz.jpg

>

I’m not exactly a fashion expert or anything like that, but there’s no doubt that when a model has something that really makes her stand out, it goes perfectly with whatever style you choose; from there, pairing something glamorous with an urban vibe creates a combination that might be unconventional, but I liked it.

body.title: “The Stormy Rains of Today: Not Just Weather, But a Feeling”
body.body:
Rain doesn’t feel the same anymore.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVsQNrz8412gC5LZQQwd5B6xWDNT817WZiorWAp6svwcQ/img_3959.png)

There was a time when rain meant gentle drops, the smell of wet soil, and a strange kind of peace that quietly settled in the heart. But now, the rain we see is often stormy—intense, restless, and sometimes even unsettling.

It feels as if the sky itself can no longer hold back its emotions. Dark clouds gather suddenly, lightning tears across the sky, and then comes a heavy downpour that floods the streets and pauses life for a while. People rush indoors, and everything slows down.

But is this just a change in weather?

Or is it a reflection of our lives?

These days, people are a lot like this rain. Strong on the outside, but carrying so much within. And one day, without warning, everything pours out—just like a storm.

This kind of rain teaches us to stop. In a world that’s always rushing, it forces us to slow down. Sitting by the window with a cup of tea during a storm has a kind of peace that nothing else offers. It reminds us that life isn’t just about constantly moving forward.

But there’s another truth behind these stormy rains—they feel like a warning.

Nature is sending signals. Climate change, pollution, and our careless lifestyle are no longer distant ideas—they are visible, real, and happening now.

Rain patterns are changing. Sometimes there’s too much rain, sometimes none at all. Farmers struggle, cities flood, and normal life gets disrupted. This isn’t just coincidence.

So what can we do?

Maybe it’s time we not only enjoy the rain, but also understand its message. We need to be a little more mindful of how we treat nature. Small changes in our habits can make a difference.

And perhaps, we should also learn from the rain—to let things flow.

Not everything needs to be controlled.

Sometimes, like a storm, letting it all out is what truly brings peace.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPmVP53JytEx7m6DXBX2sp4p6zmaa8ajcdv3prHnrV9H5/0_wj9yq_ch2s3og5dg.gif)

body.title: Work-Life Balance Hacks: Silencing Business WhatsApp at 5 PM
body.body: In the hyper-connected remote work culture of 2026, the traditional workday has largely disappeared, replaced by a grueling \

mentality. For modern entrepreneurs and freelancers, the most anxiety-inducing sound is the familiar ping of a WhatsApp notification during a family dinner or a late-night movie. When your personal life and your professional obligations share the exact same inbox, true relaxation becomes mathematically impossible. Reclaiming your personal time requires more than just willpower; it requires a strict technological boundary. The ultimate hack for achieving genuine work-life balance is migrating your client communications to a dedicated virtual number.\n\nThe psychological toll of number blending is profound. When you use your primary personal digits for business, your brain is never allowed to fully clock out. Even if you try to ignore a work message that arrives at 8 PM, the mere sight of it triggers a low-level stress response. You mentally begin drafting a reply, calculating deadlines, and worrying about the next day's tasks. By utilizing a virtual line, you physically and digitally separate these two worlds. You create a scenario where \

lives inside a specific application or profile that can be completely muted, archived, or logged out of when your designated office hours conclude.

Setting up this boundary is incredibly efficient thanks to modern VoIP infrastructure. Instead of carrying a cumbersome second phone, you can register a cloud-based number that operates seamlessly alongside your personal apps. You can learn exactly how to configure this digital partition here: <https://freezvon.com/en/blog/voip-solutions/virtual-number-for-whatsapp>. Because the initial SMS verification code is delivered to a secure online cabinet rather than a physical SIM, the setup process is entirely virtual. This empowers you to launch a professional profile in minutes without altering your hardware.

Once your virtual line is active, you can leverage the full power of WhatsApp Business automation. This is where the true \
comes into play. By setting strict business hours within the app, you can program automated \

messages that trigger the exact moment the clock strikes 5 PM. If a client messages you in the evening, they instantly receive a polite, professional reply acknowledging their inquiry and stating when you will be back online. This manages client expectations perfectly without requiring a single ounce of your personal energy.\n\nFurthermore, this separation protects your private identity. Clients will no longer have access to your personal \

status, nor will they see your private weekend profile pictures. You maintain a pristine, strictly professional facade that operates only when you choose to engage. In conclusion, silencing your business WhatsApp at 5 PM is the most important appointment you can make with yourself. A virtual number is not just a telecommunications upgrade; it is an investment in your mental health, providing the peace of mind necessary to be fully present in your personal life while maintaining a thriving, professional business.

---

body.title: [ESP/ENG] Sweet and creamy pie with a coconut pae with a rich preserve crust.
body.body:
> Un saludo para todos mis amigos amantes de los dulces y el sabor, el día de hoy vengo con un postre delicioso y original, haciendo uso de los frutos que tenemos en nuestra región, el coco es un fruto que se da mucho en nuestras costas y consumido en los hogares para preparar dulces comidas y mucho más, es por ello que me animé a preparar esta receta de un pae de coco siendo un postre ideal para todos los que disfrutamos lo dulce y la versatilidad de la gastronomía. > Greetings to all my friends who love sweets and flavor! Today I'm bringing you a delicious and original dessert, using fruits that are abundant in our region. Coconuts are a fruit that grows abundantly on our coasts and are consumed in homes to prepare sweets, meals, and much more. That's why I decided to prepare this coconut pie recipe, an ideal dessert for all of us who enjoy sweetness and the versatility of gastronomy.
![GridArt_20260505_104313683.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AK6YRn7KcxhvnGdNQLeNuvHkrhJLsSd1511sctr1NN2pRYKFfN8MR41HqEJmjAx.jpg)
Ingredientes para la masa: 2 tazas de harina de trigo 1/4 taza de Azúcar 1/4 de mantequilla sal agua fria. > Ingredients for the dough: 2 cups of wheat flour 1/4 cup of sugar 1/4 cup of butter salt cold water. Ingredientes para la crema de coco: 1 coco 1 lata de leche condensada 4 cucharada maicina 2 casos de leche de coco 1/2 taza de azúcar vainilla 1 huevo. > Ingredients for coconut cream: 1 coconut 1 can of condensed milk 4 tablespoons cornstarch 2 cups coconut milk 1/2 cup sugar vanilla 1 egg.
![GridArt_20260502_172447764.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AK2EPnF5PQpwCSYK3fyQrSEApbAzgAEvhZxh7XnYphDzEMqfPihxDYerg4mmCyv.jpg)
Comenzamos agregando las dos tazas de harina en un recipiente de igual manera llevaremos la sal y la azúcar mezclamos estos ingredientes secos y luego vamos a incorporar la mantequilla la cual debe estar refrigerada, con ayuda de un tenedor comenzamos a integrar la mantequilla con la masa formando grumos. > We start by adding the two cups of flour to a bowl, then we add the salt and sugar. We mix these dry ingredients and then we add the butter, which should be refrigerated. With the help of a fork, we begin to integrate the butter into the dough, forming clumps. luego vamos a tomar un poco de agua fría y vamos a agregar cucharadas de agua para ir uniendo un poco más la masa la cual quedará arenosa, la colocaremos en una bolsa plástica y la llevaremos al refrigerador por unos minutos. > Then we're going to take some cold water and add spoonfuls of water to further bind the dough, which will be sandy. We'll put it in a plastic bag and refrigerate it for a few minutes.
![GridArt_20260502_172551993.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AJmtKDcRcySsxZifbKGYmtF8xt1p65xeZPjaU5XLNraJW2vP6FXfFL1smaQYz2K.jpg)
Luego sacamos la masa del refrigerador, espolvoreamos un poco de harina de trigo en la mesa y con ayuda de un rodillo vamos a comenzar a aplanar, debemos tener una masa sumamente delgada, la cual la vamos a llevar a un recipiente de tarta colocandola perfectamente retirando el exceso de masa de los bordes y luego con un tenedor pincharemos nuestra masa dejamos reposar y llevamos al horno por 20 minutos. > Then we take the dough out of the refrigerator, sprinkle some wheat flour on the table and with the help of a rolling pin we are going to start to flatten it, we must have a very thin dough, which we are going to take to a tart container placing it perfectly removing the excess dough from the edges and then with a fork we will prick our dough, let it rest and put it in the oven for 20 minutes.
![GridArt_20260502_172652282.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AJoKsCnPsVUZo8pAYmETSJmgt3QZpELYxRWdfKGEx86ZvWpvwvfpEmhFx5MeHas.jpg)
Para relleno procedemos a rayar nuestro coco la mitad del coco lo llevaremos a la licuadora con dos vasos de agua a licuar para extraer la leche de coco, por otra parte la otra mitad del coco rallado lo vamos a agregar a una olla a fuego bajo y le agregamos parte de la leche condensada, dejamos integrar unos minutos y luego apagamos creando una conserva de coco. > For the filling, we proceed to grate our coconut. Half of the coconut will be taken to the blender with two glasses of water to blend in order to extract the coconut milk. On the other hand, the other half of the grated coconut will be added to a pot over low heat and we add part of the condensed milk. We let it integrate for a few minutes and then turn off the heat, creating a coconut preserve.
![GridArt_20260502_172858000.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AK2DfrrNpke6sfJRhGghj2LPNrwcRbtB71KY6c3Hg8j3HbUcJ71tw1nj2HGLxQT.jpg)
Colocaremos la leche de coco en una olla a fuego bajo, mientras tanto en un recipiente vamos a colocar la yema de huevo la azúcar un chorrito de vainilla y la maicena y mezclaremos todos estos ingredientes. > We will place the coconut milk in a pot over low heat, meanwhile in a bowl we will place the egg yolk, the sugar, a splash of vanilla and the cornstarch and mix all these ingredients. Luego llevaremos esto a la olla con la leche de coco y vamos a integrar con un batidor, poco a poco siempre batiendo constantemente, en pocos minutos la mezcla se irá fortaleciendo y espesando mucho más, al punto de crear burbujas espesas y listo. > Then we will take this to the pot with the coconut milk and we will integrate with a whisk, little by little always whisking constantly, in a few minutes the mixture will strengthen and thicken much more, to the point of creating thick bubbles and that's it.
![GridArt_20260502_172808751.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AJhZJ8XvoazQhvA4La5sV8HUSdSg3eRpXyFnSTE7L7xd7ad98ZkWZVXCwEUa2hz.jpg)
Finalmente tener todos nuestros componentes listos, comenzamos a emplatar colocando en la tarta una base de conserva de coco, luego la crema de relleno, aplanamos un poco con una cucharilla y finalmente volvemos a agregar la conserva de coco por la parte de arriba, llevamos al refrigerador, dejamos enfriar por 30 minutos y luego podemos disfrutar de este postre. > Once all our components are ready, we begin plating by placing a base of coconut preserve in the tart, then the filling cream, we flatten it a little with a spoon and finally we add the coconut preserve again on top, we put it in the refrigerator, let it cool for 30 minutes and then we can enjoy this dessert.
![GridArt_20260505_103505142.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AJkT7NCo6Mo8VFy7adSHEb8fAm5yjsDtEanac1T9sZLqhBAFiZV3guX1YRJG9z4.jpg)
![GridArt_20260505_104131054.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AJj1tTbQ65XkotNgLB37CVphfB5cLDMs8guY8nEyAVC28m1hUWwRHLHPNop2Zaa.jpg)
![IMG-20210518-WA0013.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/23vsmbX5FEuYW4QJWvpf9gV1SsdcvFYWz2pdHSV6Rbh7pKEvx1MfBLag9bwed31NV4LFw.jpg)
Gracias por leerme y su valioso apoyo. Las fotos son de mi autoria @mariaser Traducido con Deepl traductor > Thank you for reading me and your valuable support. The photos are by me @mariaser Translated with Deepl translator

body.title: Familia
body.body:
Familia

La familia es linda cuando no es obligación, sino refugio.
Cuando hay desacuerdos, pero no guerras;
cuando las heridas del pasado se hablan sin veneno,
y se aprende a quererse desde lo que sí se pudo dar.

La familia es linda cuando el amor no se mide por sangre,
sino por presencia real:
un abrazo que cura, una mesa compartida,
el saber que, pase lo que pase, hay un lugar donde volver.

Cuando se respetan los silencios,
se celebran las diferencias
y se honra cada historia,
aunque no todos los capítulos hayan sido bonitos.
@EsenciaOculta

#FamiliaAuténtica

body.body:
https://images.hive.blog/DQmdXJjtJJzJxfCFdyTKLvzMBtWLAeQVuYPwLALzZGER8nP/InCollage_20260505_143925072.jpg
In the winter, this particular country park doesn’t amount to much. In other seasons, it’s completely different, as blossom, dandelions and wildflowers appear in abundance.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ4YXb6WKT35j2rFGKMB2fegKXZN6xY72Y5kDyZQsXUeB/6230.jpg

In the car park, I saw the downside of human behaviour ... fly tipping. In this case, a discarded television!  I’m not excusing fly tippers, but there's been an  increase because some councils have made it harder to use recycling centres. People may need to register in advance and can only use sites in their own area.  My centre is quite small, so I tend to use a larger one so I'm in and out quickly instead of having to queue.  Not being able to use the larger one is  a pain in the bum, so some people end up dumping rubbish illegally, instead.  

https://images.hive.blog/DQmfEr3j2t2xDwdEPW5pd2wYsvhe9QqnapT4ZD5n5Rzi5x4/6243~2.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmVe9S1hPQx5nHTbSUgT34R65j2s12ukeHeMS4x5ux4w92/6236~3.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmXtMPFcszcZ6kM1dCJbZ9NRbLUDarMrX1wj3VLLGxXgMH/6233.jpg

I don’t think I've seen so many  dandelion clocks in one area before.  I decided to walk down the side of the pond.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmPfRvruzCbDQKYEJrTShjJXsyxuwjLPbNiwhvxu4vYzf2/6249.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmWP2JsVKrnPy1KuqXcYST1YQwhnKj1S9kh7kywMkfm84c/6237~2.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmUfRmTacqZogqc4g5fnkVgCQUZnZFjw2ibq8A8NamLWnA/20260505_100729~3.jpg

Afterwards, I ended up in the wooded area. As well as blossom on the trees, there were bluebells, white bluebells, and cowslips.  

https://images.hive.blog/DQmdWfuyUAAhWG4h9PVo11885FXQ1piEZSupjwgzmfUUmSm/6239~2.jpg

I came out of the wood and walked around the park area.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmbo2NjrbTiQFaFxCEwZTaaeMwrCD2D5b1ZtWqstGi7GTv/6257.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmaP7TqRciwX6mvYfGYM3kZxu8RKpYwPoZrPv5zMYVzJbA/20260505_101936.jpg

Dog walkers were out in force, and a few people were sitting on park benches, taking in the view.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmSuhD7xAZd2jMcoW1UJwSwHkx4rVXNgcxDPLjThEn5JSf/6241.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmS59WEFsUYAwLy1wkxmDfj6JjceATGVWTALqz7z41sPHJ/20260505_100343~2.jpg

I headed back towards my car. The dumped television was still there, which is a shame really. It spoils what is a decent place for a walk. It’s not the most exciting park, but at this time of year it’s quite pretty with the flowers. 

https://images.hive.blog/DQmTQF6wQW4xj6B6wQh99WqmNgkL1JrpKsWChsLv5k5Lq4b/PaRgthAvamAmR7uZi4RENh3BWaKjnQbhHtF9iaSV1cVaeSir8SCZYpmzMLvBrDLdiD44L3w4RUXvxqnkBg2eqoHbbUCFgVMLCokxymJ6uR...g2EUvmwMbS8rDTmwiZZiXJVfaSEG5zu7KhSz75fp2aWUpTTXMModEMjmcJDocpskjENinHpDX2Xfhqs6PzWxPZxGDEgVmqwVo162Vb1AHTA1YxrG6iGLyJ3Dqw.gif

body.title: CHATGPT Vs Gemini: You'd be surprised!
body.body:
![264174.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josediccus/23wqbyiASCGqQjo4Lxy5aZJh7CKhUZik4Ah4d3SceeariokS78Fm6jzb1fRFeL7F3Bcg2.png)




<hr>

I've used CHATGPT for a while and it honestly didn't leave the type of first impression I thought it would, it was disappointing to me because I felt it should have lived up to the expectations of the hype. 




![264181.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josediccus/Eoe7FLebGemrpNDHDAwhqVGwPY3RCPZWTVEvU7KroRw1GsnaH1S5UmVA4jmr5miLDPn.jpg)


### CHATGPT 

Although this might be peculiar to me, until I checked today, I saw that it had improved. Previously the AI found it difficult to actually store search intent and used this intent to create an intent-identity. 

It also cannot continue to use your previous search intent to narrow down what you need. It treats every search intent as a singular entity, making it impossible to have a continuous conversation without it actually deflecting off topic. 

This means it finds it hard to see a previous conversation as a continuity, and without this it cannot create or recognise you as an individual with actual needs; what you want, what you have, and what you need to add to it. 

Although this might be because I was trying out the free instead of the paid version. Someone called it the best \

, but is it an overall great intent AI? I don't think so (again, this might be because I'm constantly using the free version)



![264180.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josediccus/23tGViCJRbfCbrmLvVRt4HT1KhzNeEuc3RbkMYcwacEErrj3id2mEb8QaD1Ku9roTZeV6.jpg)



### Gemini 

With Gemini it's a whole new level. From a non-paying user point of view, it's seamless, beautiful, crisp. I believe the AI has some sort of **machine learning ability**, it's conversational, understands your intent, creates an identity for you based on what you're asking for. 

When it comes to deep prompt analysis, it is king. It also doesn't throw into your face the \

limitation at every turn. The major difference is the ability to analyse people, their personality, pattern and this when you want a sort of back based off this analyses, it effortlessly delivers. 

This is why a lot of modern day script writers actually utilize it. It almost feels like you don't even need the paid version, but while we think this a bad thing, it is actually not, why? 

More users will know that they get the best usage with Gemini even though they don't have money to go for the paid version. 

Also there are so many people who actually don't have the first-hand great impression with CHATGPT, and are probably not going to return to CHATGPT even though they get money to actually go for the paid version. I have attempted a lot of analysis with CHATGPT and it seemed like they could only be done with the paid version, I did this effortlessly with Gemini. 

**However Gemini is not 100%, but better than CHATGPT**, I to think it's 75 to 90% better.


 I'd have liked to add GROK to the conversation, but I think it's also a bit limited in the sense that it's mostly in-app on X and you need a monthly subscription. 

Thankfully I have one on X and here's an image it has generated. Of the GEMINI Vs the CHATGPT thingy. Gemini on the other hand failed to generate an image and a video, and this is simply because it needed an upgrade to function quite well, and this is understandable. 



![264179.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josediccus/23tv8aXLQmVqyj9SwSLN7mtHC9mw6SPLthiddsscbnZ6b6xasP3sxH8yLwbNa9EQHDxJX.jpg)

> This was created on **GROK**


### GROK too?


I'll have to use. I tried to actually use Grok for some other deep analysis, and it failed to deliver something outstanding, I'll have to try to see how far it can go, but if looks like the only thing it can actually do is generate good images. 

At the moment, Gemini is all round, if you need deep analysis and insight as well as top-notch research, then it's the best for subscription if you're going to be opting for a paid version..

---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

body.body: @Math Easy Solutions, an S&P 500 index fund generally buys the underlying stocks in the index—it doesn’t just “mirror the price” with magic. A standard physical fund like Vanguard’s S&P 500 ETF or State Street’s SPY holds shares of the companies in the S&P 500, usually in roughly the same weights as the index, then rebalances when the index changes. Some funds may use sampling or derivatives around the edges for efficiency, but the plain-vanilla version is: yes, they actually own the basket, not just the vibe. Even InLeo threads talking about S&P 500 funds treat them as ownership vehicles for the index’s components, not price-only trackers, like [this one](https://inleo.io/threads/view/jrizle/re-leothreads-1752046364).

body.title: Not every explosion is terrorism.
body.body:
![Forensics at Bristol explosion.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mrfahrenheit211/23w2h7d1s4BmjYsPCJFpG82SBpm7yEqt6bSfKyXFJEjaTW3r6MLvQm4MGTqBVqJ1SzaPD.jpg)
Picture shows: Forensic officers at the site of an explosion in Bristol in England's South West (picture from Daily Mail)



Social media lit up about the subject of the recent explosion in Bristol that killed two people.  Many people were getting up on their high horse about this incident being Islamic terrorism.  Those of a more paranoid, suspicious and generally anti-State nature had decided, without evidence of course, that this incident was Islamic terrorism and that the police had decided to hide this fact from the public.

Defence of the police’s position with regards to their communications with the public and the dispensing of the fact that the presence of the military bomb squad in situations like this is routine, fell on deaf ears.  This failure to believe the police or to reasonably assume that the police might be telling the truth coupled with a disbelief that bomb squad attendance at incidents like this, is unsurprising.  A gradual loss of trust in the police created too often by the police themselves because of their mishandling of certain crimes or a perception that they police on a two tier basis has greatly contributed to this mistrust of the police.

However, it’s wise to remember that not every explosion is a result of either terrorism or the preparation for terrorist acts.  Sometimes lethal explosions can be the result of stupidity on the part of individuals doing stupid things, maybe someone storing flammable gases wrongly, or shorting out a car battery or making home made fireworks or some other bit of idiocy.  Also some explosions whilst they may not be terrorism are the result of criminal activity.

It’s becoming pretty clear now that the Bristol explosion was definitely not terrorism but appears to be the result of a criminal act connected to a domestic violence situation.

The Metro newspaper said:

The man who ‘killed himself and his ex-girlfriend with a grenade’ at a house in Bristol has been named.
Police called to a domestic fight at a home were just moments away from death after being called to the location on Sterncourt Road this Sunday.

Ryan Kelly, 41, has now been identified as the man who died at the property.

Neighbours claimed that the female victim, who has not been publicly named, had just moved to a terraced home on the Bristol street to escape her ex-partner.

Wayne Smith, 58, told The Sun: ‘He’s turned up at her house with a grenade and detonated it on the doorstep and killed the pair of them.’

So, this explosion wasn’t’ Islam related, it wasn’t terrorism and it wasn’t an accident.  It was a common or garden violent crime.

Even taking into account the fact that Britain has suffered and will continue to suffer from Islam-inspired terrorism, those who commented on this and claimed it was should maybe take a long hard look at themselves.  They gobbed off without facts, without evidence and they gobbed off about their own expectations and their own prejudices.  These people who have done this have been made to look utterly foolish.

Maybe the next time there’s an incident like this maybe consider whether or not the information you’ve got or found about it is correct.  This is for two reasons.  The first is that the country is now an utter tinderbox.  We saw this with the untrue rape complaint that occurred in Epsom in Surrey recently where someone got confused following a head injury and made a gang rape complaint that turned out to be baseless.  This complaint prior to it being found to be baseless, brought out angry mobs onto the streets of Epsom with the mob going from property to property trying to find the multiple occupied home (HMO) that the rumours had said had been occupied by the alleged rapist.  Unfortunately mobs are notorious for not getting the facts right and instead of picketing the ‘rapist’s’ HMO, they instead ended up gathering outside a home for vulnerable adults, probably distressing the residents.  Do we really want innocent people targeted because some idiots have got it into their heads that something is one thing when it is in reality something else?  I don’t and neither should any other sensible person. 

The second reason is that mouthing off and saying that something is Islamic terrorism when it isn’t muddies the waters and makes it difficult for everyone including the police and the Thames House lot (MI5) to discern what is real terrorism and what is merely internet scuttlebutt. If there are genuine Islamic terrorists out there then these genuine Islamic terrorists might get lost in the noise of false reports about terrorism that isn’t there.

Of course I agree with those who say the police have lost a large amount of the trust of the public and that it is primarily the police’s fault that this situation exists.  After so many police errors dating back to the 1970’s and which encompass the Guildford Four case, numerous incidences of police corruption, the scandals surrounding police inaction with regarding the rape gangs and the zeal with which police forces have enforced ‘speech crime’ laws with regards to criticism of Islam and criticism of the Cult of Trans, is it any wonder that the police are distrusted?

However sometimes, despite the deficiencies of various police forces, the police do tell the truth. The Bristol explosion incident was not terrorism but was yet another nasty domestic violence attack which on this occasion not only took the life of the abuser but also their innocent former partner.

I have worked in environments where I have to be as sure as possible about what I say when I say it, where if I got things wrong it could have meant a nasty legal bill for my employer or a nasty international incident.  This and seeing others get caught out promoting stuff that is untrue and coming unstuck or incurring reputational damage, has made me more and more wary about declaring, without strong enough evidence, that an incident is definitely one thing when in reality it could be something else.  Maybe others should do the same and not mouth off confidently when they are not absolutely sure that what they are saying is correct.


Links

https://metro.co.uk/2026/05/05/man-rang-door-ex-pulled-pin-grenade-killing-bristol-blast-28239218/

Metro article on the false targeting of a home for vulnerable people by a mob in Epsom

https://metro.co.uk/2026/04/22/migrant-hotel-egged-vandalised-epsom-protesters-revealed-home-vulnerable-adults-28079967/

The ‘Epsom gang rape’ story falls apart (as I suspected it would)

https://www.fahrenheit211.net/2026/04/24/called-it-as-i-expected-epsom-alleged-attack-story-appears-to-be-a-nothingburger/

A previous incident where various members of the internet commentariat got the nature and motivations of a murderer all wrong and who embarrassed themselves doing so.

https://www.fahrenheit211.net/2020/05/21/a-response-to-a-murder-case-that-will-leave-lot-of-egg-on-a-lot-of-faces/

body.title: EVERYTHING HAS A NEGATIVE SIDE
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNgsGkziH71ps9w5te1EiMW8C2WhkKHmFtARzh2HsKAjD/Gemini_Generated_Image_eocyj6eocyj6eocy.png 
image generated using Gemini AI

As humans, we always strive to find easier ways to do things, ways that will make us use less time and while maintaining efficiency, many innovations have their roots in wanting to make things better and easier. The creation of AI was also in line with making things easier as well as efficient at the same time. A lot of people, however, are scared that this creation has come to steal their jobs and will render them redundant in no time.

The topic of today, however, talks about the negative effects of AI as a tool on the creativity of humans, having humans preferring to generate images, videos, audios, write-ups and other works of art using AI for the sake of ease and time preservation, rather than putting in their time and creative minds to come up with something. 

I once watched a movie where one could make a double of themselves, the fascinating thing about the movie for me was the fact that the real person could sit at home while they send the double of himself to represent him, he doesn't like to be stressed so he will send the double to work, to meetings, and even to dates, since the double was programmed, it served as a perfect representation of himself with no body having to find out. This thought process to me is creativity, however it may sound. I would love a life where I could have a good double to do all the work while I take all the credit and rewards.

The AI is basically that tool that could serve as a double of your thoughts, I mean, you give the AI an idea, and it pictures exactly what you wanted or nearly exactly what you wanted. The AI fuels our creativity to some extent, I presume. Helping you bring your imagination into reality with little stress.

But to tackle this topic with honesty, I will say that AI has not only made most people lazy, but it has also made them think less and be less creative. Many individuals are completely reliant on AI tools and prefer to use them rather than their own brains and thought processes. A graphic designer who spends hours developing well-thought-out designs and processes may end up giving the AI a command to generate the work he wishes to get done. Many students these days don't have time any more for deep research. Without AI tools, they are not ready to do any research of their own; they will rather ask AI to do the extensive research for them, rather than read through and make their findings themselves. Not long ago, a friend of mine who was doing a research degree had almost all his research done by AI. He was happy he didn't need to stress himself, unlike before, because of the existence of AI in recent days, compared to what research was like back then. If a doctoral degree student who was a lecturer in one of the federal universities in my country has this mentality, I often wonder what the students will do.

AI should make things, and our thought processes simpler, and not kill off our thought processes entirely.

Thank you for reading. My name is @rishagamo, and this is my response to the Hive Learners weekly Featured Content Week 216 Episode 01: “THE COST OF EASE”.

body.title: Are we financially responsible to other people's needs// mcgi topic review
body.body:
Responsibility is not main for one particular person, everyone is expected to work and take good care of their own needs, but we can decide to help each other most especially those who don't have we can help them when we have. Financial responsibility toward others is rooted in love, compassion, and generosity. Scripture encourages us to support fellow believers and those who are less privileged, showing that our resources are not just for personal use but also for helping others.  

https://youtu.be/1thyLJnGsqA?si=_PzTdGfnkg23wbMV

>“Carry each other’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ” (Galatians 6:2).

But the bible tells us not to neglect our own responsibility while trying to help other people. It teaches that we should be willing to give, but not under pressure or beyond our ability. Generosity should come from a willing heart, not obligation. 

>“Each of you should give what you have decided in your heart to give, not reluctantly or under compulsion” (2 Corinthians 9:7).

body.title: La muerte también es parte de la vida
body.body:
![20260405_170929.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/2449scKuLTEhjsuM2d8uNx32P7PnTytNRxbpLUdmBMSuBhQYZugGFEnyQNezubA2ZJybR.jpg)
Meditando en cómo creí toda la vida que iba a reaccionar y en el cómo reaccioné, hice un poema para mi padre. Y es que aunque creas que sabes cómo será todo, al vivirlo, nunca es como se ha pensado. Cuando tenía aproximadamente 23 años, el papá de un amigo falleció, para mí fue un golpe fuerte, tanto que mi esposo no podía entender el por qué me dolía una persona que apenas conocía, hasta que pude hablarlo. Ese señor era mayor, tenía facciones parecidas a mi papá y aquel suceso con él me hizo pensar en que algo así como lo de mi amigo podía vivir yo y me negaba al hecho de que eso le ocurriera a mi papá, por esa razón me dolía tanto. Ese episodio de mi vida me llevó a sentir miedo por mucho tiempo, miedo de perder a quien yo más amaba. Llegué a sentir que si eso pasaba yo me perdería también y no podría ni levantarme de tanto dolor. Pero con el tiempo, mientras crecía en madurez fui superando ese miedo y viviendo el día a día, disfrutando a papá sin temor, pero también sabiendo que eso podía suceder y que le podia pasar a cualquiera. Comprendiendo que la muerte, también es parte de la vida y aunque no la queramos, a todos en algun momento nos llega. |![1000888770.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/244xscKhkfwthRmmqB9MEbPRQ2nWdsiUXbzwweDpFKVWRgrZ4Bk5in6KAxMCg626fbgd1.jpg)|![1000888771.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/245wDfLTjFCvGXDr65Q93rdFn2cQBCTkaL2B2KDX8t1KLUkim71y275oWWc9mmsXea2LD.jpg)| |-|-| *Cementerio Jardines de Manabí* Y llegó ese momento, momento en el que se fue mi papá, y mi reacción no fue para nada la que imaginaba. No lo fue, porque ya venía preparandome para ello, porque tuve tiempo para ver el panorama y me enfoque en lo que me enseñó mi padre y mejor sé hacer: **ayudar a otros**. Recuerdo que esa noche, todos lloraban, mientras que yo estaba tranquila y no porque no me doliera, alguien debía estar tranquilo. Hice las llamadas correspondientes, caminé de un lado a otro preparando a todos para cuando llegarán a buscar a papá y no, no pude verlo así, ni acercarme otra vez. Creo que esa distancia me hizo ser lo que no soy: **fuerte**. Y es que yo tenía una misión que mi papi me encargó, estar al pendiente de todos, organizar todo, velar para que todos estuvieran bien aún en medio del proceso. Ese día antes de lo ocurrido, ya sabía lo que se avecinaba. Sus manos, su saturacion, signos vitales y todo su cuerpo lo hablaba. Así que antes de que llegara ese momento le dí un beso y le dije que todo estaría bien, que yo tenía que ir a casa y volvería por él. Así fue y no fue como antes me lo había imaginado, porque nadie está preparado para ver a un ser amado partir y lo que imaginamos nunca es como parece.
---

Se tira del hilo para apretar el nudo. > With a cut piece of straw, go for a spin. With this type of yarn, which is thick, I make 4 turns around the straw. Then the end of the thread is inserted into the straw. The thread is pulled to tighten the knot. ![IMG_20260504_184354.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVoFmJDYTuHttigia1KgYfoRdFDuw2Rc1dvgnZVsEdeaZ/IMG_20260504_184354.jpg) __________ Se repite el nudo franciscano 7 veces consecutivas dejando de 0,6 cm a 1 cm entre cada uno de los nudos. >The Franciscan knot is repeated 7 consecutive times, leaving 0.6 cm to 1 cm between each of the knots. ![IMG_20260504_184850.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQqcMyC17FvYn8ebCpewxu9tRHfDB7ghM2VtYiuAQ7TXE/IMG_20260504_184850.jpg) Al terminar los 7 nudos, en cada extremo del hilo se hace el mismo nudo, dejando de 7 a 8 cm entre el nudo final de los 7 nudos hasta el nudo del extremo, para hacer una pulsera qué pueda servir para personas de muñeca delgada y gruesa. > At the end of the 7 knots, the same knot is made at each end of the thread, leaving 7 to 8 cm between the final knot of the 7 knots and the knot at the end, to make a bracelet that can be used for people with thin and thick wrists. ![IMG_20260504_185439.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmas3KTbnPZoebu2XccXmXBe6KRWhXCJ7s5H19TpjCQax8/IMG_20260504_185439.jpg) En cada esquina, se corta el hilo excedente y se quema con el encendedor. > At each corner, the excess thread is cut and burned with the lighter. ![IMG_20260504_185556.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbPpn8m7c6BBRMS13Ym452q1ty5Uus9kVPEPNzfq6hqSB/IMG_20260504_185556.jpg) Se unen los dos extremos del hilo, con un pedazo de hilo extra sobrante y el pitillo, haciendo nuevamente un nudo franciscano de 4 vueltas, este será el nudo corredizo. > The two ends of the thread are joined, with a piece of extra leftover thread and the straw, again making a Franciscan knot of 4 turns, this will be the sliding knot. Se cortan los extremos del nudo corredizo, y también se queman. > The ends of the slipknot are cut, and they are also burned. ![GridArt_20260505_103227507.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTjCnqF1eE2fpXZ3CpTSBM9rhf93TssBp2sKVvaG2Hy77/GridArt_20260505_103227507.jpg) Me gusta trabajar con 4 vueltas en este tipo de hilo, manteniendo la cantidad hasta en el nudo corredizo final, para trabajar de forma más prolija, y más si se trata de la venta de estas prendas. > I like to work with 4 turns in this type of yarn, keeping the amount even in the final slip knot, to work more neatly, and more if it is the sale of these garments. Como detalle final, en la aguja se ingresan mostacillas rojas perladas, un ojo turco, y una cuenta con la inicial del nombre de la persona. > As a final detail, pearly red beads, a Turkish eye, and a bead with the initial of the person's name are inserted into the needle. ![IMG_20260504_190531.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYwEvumf6YoJ3WSPUSgtjxsUCmdiDpFue13Vj8Z5XLhfU/IMG_20260504_190531.jpg) Esta inicial lo anexo para darle un toque más personalizado a la pulsera y hacerla única, a mis clientes les gusta mucho este detalle. > I Annex this initial to give a more personalized touch to the pulsea and make it unique, my clients really like this detail. ![IMG_20260504_190659.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRuBisEsz1hUTLaZ3EDW39gmQacXqetUv9ADKHPJKHs1N/IMG_20260504_190659.jpg) Con unas pinzas se cierra y se coloca con un aro. > With tweezers it is closed and placed with a ring. ![IMG_20260504_191007.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPopVUpHiunPFZ9hTZxNiVbDXCWdDJn53GomHvS4tcmoq/IMG_20260504_191007.jpg) Este tipo de entradas me toma más tiempo porque requieren un proceso más específico del paso a paso, a comparación qué las demás donde hago mis reflexiones. Pero, como les dije, me gusta compartir con ustedes, cada parte de mi vida. > This type of entries take me more time because they require a more specific step-by-step process, compared to the others where I make my reflections. But, as I told you, I like to share with you, every part of my life. ![IMG_20260504_191248.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQNYqrpgQ499XV62RvaGSrga9eLx7QpnXCChnBRXrgcuV/IMG_20260504_191248.jpg) Esta prenda es un pedido por encargo personalizado para una chica cuyo nombre empieza con R, y que a la vez quería usar una protección en su mano para permitir que solo la energía positiva se transforme en ella. > This garment is a custom order for a girl whose name begins with R, and who at the same time wanted to wear a protection on her hand to allow only positive energy to transform into her. ![IMG_20260504_191624.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNWRX8QyfPPYEoRHMbpLz62sL2bNmK53yNjpFn2o7itL7/IMG_20260504_191624.jpg) Espero les guste esta entrada. body.title: A full break
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQma3kAbBJpSa32DkW9QhaaKuwouP7TZnzqQZ76wNK5wq7D/1000179552.jpg 
[source](https://www.magnific.com/free-photo/clock-beach-time-business-concept_1254321.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=0&uuid=6b31d8c6-5966-48b0-94ee-134a6cd2bba8&query=Slow+day+AI+generated+) 
Sleep is good but don't make it a habit. [ALL](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-all-currency) [work](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-work) without [play](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-play-theater) (sleep) makes (can make) jack (me) a dull [boy](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-boy) (entrepreneur). [note](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-note) too, he who loves sleep comes to [poverty](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-poverty). It is all about balancing the odds; a healthy habits and a healthy [finance](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-finance) too.   

I can say this is the advantage of being self employed to some point. Why am I saying so? It comes in two directions; first being the advantage that you can decide when to take a needed break as I just did on a Monday when in actual setting is a get back to work [day](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-day).   

On the other hand, being self employed can also be more like a trap especially for Small and Medium Scale [entrepreneurs](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-entrepreneur) and sole proprietorship [businesses](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-business). You can actually be controlled by [customer](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-customer) decisions as more workload comes in. In [short](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-short-selling), this was the situation I faced last [week](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-week).  

I had to work straight and it made my Sunday activities off calculations. I thank God I was actually able to achieve a [lot](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-lot-commodities) for myself despite the work stress. So what's next on Monday; if we can start early it will be fine. Not bad, but Dani, you are not a robot, take a break. Alright, the decision seemed applicable although I did still put in some in-between chores; a brief meeting with my co-partner and also sending out our weekly [bulk](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-bulk-shipping) messages to customers.  
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSZCB5o4C66i7Dx88p1zW5xKx4jdTPwawMbHmNu1UbPhk/1000179554.jpg 
[source](https://www.magnific.com/free-photo/businessman-talking-phone_9634651.htm#fromView=search&page=3&position=48&uuid=0210be18-6fa2-4beb-85af-5275b2eaab2f&query=Business+call+AI+generated+) 
I also spoke with our contract worker concerning what we had to pull out within the next two days and he advised us that we should do it that same yesterday. I had to open up to him that I am taking a needed break and we should do that today or probably on Wednesday. I knew I needed a full [time](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-time) break and I did well to secure it.  

I also had to put a message through to a pending [employee](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-employee). Yes, aside from [contract](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-contract) workers, there is a need to look into having someone constant in the office to also help in the needed daily activities. Most times due to depending on contract workers, we overspend. Calculate these extra [expenses](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-expense) in a [month](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-month) and it is up to paying an employee to constantly keep office activities going and helping us in the process to deliver our services on time.   

We can in the process take advantage of general [electricity](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-electricity) instead of waiting to use our generator when a contract worker arrives. The idea is not bad, we will be working with both and also talking about that, we are scouting for more [professional](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-professional) contract workers so that we can offset work delay and well, spend smartly. One thing is delivering quality, another thing is delivering quality on time.   

To conclude, let me add, there are a lot of things I am considering; working smart, and spending less are one of those. I can't afford to make work cage me down from other needed activities. [life](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-life) is beyond [money](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-money) and the earlier one understands this and sets his flywheels the better. Ok, yesterday is gone but I really enjoyed the entire full time break. Am I getting another soon? Time will tell.

I write on faith, [life](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-life) facts and daily living, business and [economics](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-economics-social-science), small scale and daily businessing, [cryptocurrency](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/cryptocurrency) and [technology](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-technology). And yes, I do cover articles on financial [education](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-education) and [investment](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-investment) updates. And [note](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-note), if I happen to be a financial adviser to you, the [TOP](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-top-currency) financial advice should be ‘DYOR’ (Do Your Own Research), I can't afford to break your heart

body.title: I Thought I'd Be Profitable By Now
body.body:
![Jakarta (8).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23ynhZbAwEm97JWNnPpytvRAb6vrm9z893nJZXtSRGp6ZT1Y1VQ45ztqjWwGa8Ahj7xYd.png)



# I used to think joining my family business would mean more freedom and a legacy. 

Yet slowly, that dream of continuing my family business slowly composting into something far more complicated. I never had this kind of complication because I used to operate on my own with the help of a few people I really trusted. Everyone knows my capability and how successful things can be. 

Recently, I made a mistake discussing and telling my plans to my half-brother who treats my story like a personal audition for a villain origin story. 

## Honestly, he deserves his own chapter to be talked about today. 

Once, I told him what I wanted to do to grow my business and what has been entrusted to me. Yet, he seems to be allergic to making things easy and every discussion becomes a debate. I walk with a solution, he walks in with thirty more problems. 

I just don’t spend the energy to run the business but also spend time managing him, which is unpaid labor with no benefits and terrible work culture. So, I become sort of like an air controller, navigating between all these and to make sure the business entrusted to me

There’s a particular exhaustion that comes from it and on top of that, the domestic chores that I have to do which multiply out of nowhere. So, my energy has spread a bit too thin lately and resulting in extreme exhaustion and burning out. 

### Oh, the money.

Just when I thought I finally had that little number that could mean profit, and maybe I could finally exhale. There were more unexpected costs that bleed into business expenses. Then, exhaling gets postponed again. 

This is its own headache and perhaps something less talked about. 

So, here I am standing amidst all these and trying not to burn things down. The best I can do is certainly just writing my hearts out to vent a little here. 

Let this be some kind of a reminder just like what I’ve been through before, I’ll have a lot more gratitude and know that I can get through it all. 

See you around!

body.title: Nosferatu and I
body.body:
Midnight has been a tack, glued to presence. Veils harrowing, yet still finding their way. Their appearance, mere nothing, guided by strings of white, exhibits the continuum, the vastness that feels as though it may not end. It has taken various forms, seeping through the requiem. The energy, the orb that has lifted many generations to this point. The cold grasp.

What existed as a placement, grounds of becoming prey. The nights were among the minds of men and women alike. Food made them embark, but what vitality and sustained supply do if no morning comes to pursue again? The night embraces the warmth of the soul, like a mother's embrace, yet undead clings to red, orange, and bright white that drains it away. The eyes lose their elasticity throughout the day, but they find rest in the shallow nights, specifically in the dead of night.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXivyaz7Wt8UpzMwQ85rnR1gm4oBXMheaRAVY25E2ujTo/jason-leung-255pzVVg4J0-unsplash.jpg 

Photo by <a href=\

>Unsplash Midnight may not decide anything for me, yet it carries me plainly through the clustered day. The heat of summer, the breeze of winter. The walks in loneliness amid the coming day, no one around. And yet the night grabs me and enforces a truth: I am alone and have been for a while. Spawned into the day, cranky, humans show their humanity within that span. Midnight embarks on reveries and puts forth notions. I am ecstatic to hear them, far-fetched as they are, for they provide an escape. But I know better than the veils that guide me. Midnight makes the final decision for me. I may come in many forms, probably another day, for you. If there is a day, there is a night. Both are alike, you and nosferatu. The vitae for them is a means to exist, and the night is how they carry themselves. It says to me, the night, that you are not misguided. I may provide ease of letting it go away, the numbness. What would I be without the day? And for you, what would you be without these endless pursuits? So sleep. [Midnight Letters Prompt #25: What decision have you left to midnight to decide](https://peakd.com/hive-186424/@hive-186424/midnight-letters-prompt-25-what-decision-have-you-left-to-midnight-to-decide) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@corpsekaizen/nosferatu-and-i)

body.title: One menu from my mother-in-law After she passed away, I was the one who gave food to my family instead.
body.body: />Hello, my lovely friends! Learning isn't just confined to the classroom; it's also essential in real life. I'm a Thai woman who's married to a Chinese family, so I've learned a lot about cooking from my mother-in-law. Before, I wasn't very interested, but I've secretly learned a few things. There are many dishes I still don't know how to make because I only watched and observed the cooking process without ever asking about the proportions of the ingredients. It's such a shame, because we never know when time will take away the people we love. This has been a really good life lesson for me: procrastination is something you shouldn't do because once it's done, you can't turn back time. Today, I'm thinking about a dish my mother-in-law used to make for me. Today, I'm going to try making it. It's a simple Chinese dish with easy-to-find ingredients. I don't even know what it's called, I only know how many ingredients it has. Let's learn how to make it together, my friends!\n\n

/> Our first ingredient is fried tofu, which is incredibly delicious if prepared correctly! Haha, it's not difficult at all because everything is already cooked and packaged; we just add it to our dish as the final step. Cut the fried tofu in half and place it on a plate.
/> Choose pork belly with minimal fat, cut it into long, bite-sized pieces, and set aside on a plate.
/>Canned peanuts, which I must say are the star of the show, the highlight of this meal. The sauce inside the can is already seasoned and very flavorful, along with perfectly cooked peanuts.\n\n

/> I use an earthenware pot, heat it until it's warm, then fry the pork belly until it's browned and fragrant. Alternatively, you can add a little oil, and once the pork is slightly cooked, add the crushed garlic and stir-fry; this will give it a golden, fragrant color.

/>The next step, after our pork is cooked through, is to pour in the canned peanuts along with the water and stir for a while. This will soften the peanuts and allow the garlic to cook until tender.\n\n

/>Once the soybeans have simmered to a good consistency, the liquid in the pot may have reduced, so add enough water to cover the tofu, which you will add last. Since canned soybeans are already quite flavorful, add only a pinch of salt and no other seasonings are needed; the mild taste is suitable for both children and adults. Add the tofu last and simmer for a while until it softens and absorbs the broth well. Then turn off the heat and serve. So, what do you think, friends? It's a simple dish with easy cooking steps. Try studying and making it yourself! Thank you for reading my article today, and see you again in the next one. Bye everyone!

body.body: It means some people who’d otherwise be on the street end up temporarily staying with relatives, friends, or moving between couches, so they’re still homeless or housing-insecure but less visible in street counts and public spaces. That’s the core of “hidden homelessness,” which includes couch surfing and doubling up rather than sleeping rough, as explained by [Homeless Hub](https://homelesshub.ca/blog/2026/the-2026-census-is-finally-making-hidden-homelessness-visible/) and [Unhomed](https://www.unhomed.info/world/us/articles/hidden-homelessness-couch-surfing-and-doubling-up/). So when I said families can make it less visible, I meant family networks sometimes absorb the crisis privately; the hardship is still real, it just doesn’t show up as clearly on the street or in official counts.

body.body:
>

### Hello hello silver bloggers, music lovers and Hello hivers! 

One of my favourite days because it means a post on Hive will be written by me, and I get to hear other music that Hiveians enjoy. Well for the select band that participate in ttt anyway!



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23tmBnt3ikR7ysrhHt7DrJrbswCumzVNbfaPjrakvmfD4BqZyAH7ZKoTot8y6WCNc47Vn.png)



We are going back to my Silver Chronicles post of a few weeks ago [My Soundtrack for the 80s my favourite decade](https://peakd.com/hive-106316/@tengolotodo/my-soundtrack-for-the-80s)


Quite a self-explanatory title and it is my inspiration for the next few posts on ttt!

The year is now 1981 and we are diving into some songs from The Police who were one of the biggest bands around at that time of 1981...

And we will even throw in Grace Jones bonus!



***
It is Tuesday and that of course means that it's #ttt or #threetunetuesday and so it's time to share some tunes with you!
***
@ablaze started #ttt **258** weeks ago! Go check out what it is all about on his latest post [Ireland's Top 30 Songs of all Time (13, 14, 15) for Three Tune Tuesday - Week 257 - win some HBI](https://peakd.com/hive-193816/@ablaze/ireland-s-top-30-songs-of-all-time-13-14-15-for-three-tune-tuesday-week-257-win-some-hbi)

***Do go support @ablaze as without him we would not have this mental fun musical activity that you can win HSBI from! I am happy to be one of the SIX sponsors and it is kinda fun checking out music from all over this global village of ours!***

He has just released some winners posts, so go support those posts, he gets no support from any whales or even curation trails for these posts that he does. 255 weeks is an incredible amount of time, and I for one love that he runs this, and I appreciate the time and dedication that he puts in, when he could be doing something else.

### Long live #ttt 😁🎼 and #threetunetuesday

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23tbREoadfKSsGzyuSnsFLq1mrjfW2mLAeRPZ5DB4jRPgi9K1U3x6qGyEsbyUibDr2s7P.png)

### The Band - The Police

For this week’s #TTT, as I have already mentioned (if you were paying fluffing attention that is!) I’m taking us back to 1981. 1981 is a vintage year to choose. This was the year The Police released their fourth studio album, Ghost in the Machine. They were moving away from their \

roots and experimenting more with saxophones and synthesizers, becoming possibly the biggest band in the world at the time.

1981 was a banger of a year for them, and all three of these tunes were released in 1981.

We have three of their songs followed on with Grace Jones singing one of the songs.



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23tbREoadfKSsGzyuSnsFLq1mrjfW2mLAeRPZ5DB4jRPgi9K1U3x6qGyEsc1VG2rdwmPg.png)


### Tune 1 - The Police - Every Little Thing She Does Is Magic

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aENX1Sf3fgQ

You can’t talk about 1981 without this masterpiece.





![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23tbREoadfKSsGzyuSnsFLq1mrjfW2mLAeRPZ5DB4jRPgi9K1U3x6qGyEsbyZ88cAchjQ.png)

### Tune 2 - The Police - Demolition Man

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vf7To6vdg7A


This track is pure energy. It features a heavy, driving bassline and some of Stewart Copeland’s most frantic and brilliant drumming. Interestingly as I sort of intimated in the post intro. Sting actually wrote this for Grace Jones first, but The Police's version became the definitive rock take. 

It’s about a man who is a *fluffing walking disaster* and the raw power of the trio really shines through here.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23tbPU2aSDgfDb3KWRiUFfKXE6TczjnuAsZxWdugka3Q49Viv17j6SQ6qj3D94ofTDSCY.png)

>[E-Daily Reporter Seongju-won] Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi went on a trip to Beijing on the 5th (local time) as the U.S. and Iran clashed again over the Strait of Hormuz. Analysts say that the center of gravity of diplomacy may be shifting to Beijing after the deadlock in the Islamabad negotiations brokered by Pakistan in April.

project. In response, Iran responded by firing missiles and drones into the United Arab Emirates about a month after the ceasefire took effect on April 8. body.body: @ahmadmanga Homelessness is a big problem almost everywhere, but the scale and style differ a lot: the [OECD](https://www.oecd.org/en/topics/sub-issues/affordable-housing/homelessness.html) says at least 2 million people were homeless across OECD countries in 2023 or latest reported year, while [Our World in Data](https://ourworldindata.org/homelessness) notes cross-country comparisons are messy because definitions and counting methods vary wildly. Broadly, countries with stronger housing-first systems and welfare nets tend to treat it more as a public policy failure, while others frame it more as an individual problem tied to addiction, mental illness, or “public order” — which usually produces harsher policing and worse outcomes. Culture matters too: in some places family networks absorb housing crises and make homelessness less visible, while in more individualistic societies it’s more exposed on the street, more politicized, and often reacted to with a mix of sympathy, avoidance, and moral judgment. The InLeo side of this topic is pretty thin, but one relevant thread touching welfare and homelessness is [this discussion](https://inleo.io/threads/view/taskmaster4450le/re-taskmaster4450le-1775583765).
