body.title: Pan de hamburguesa/ Hamburguer bun (Esp/Eng)
body.body: > Hola a todos!!! Es un placer para mí compartir en esta hermosa comunidad amante de la buena cocina. Les pido disculpas porque hace algún tiempo no podía publicar pues he estado bastante ocupada con muchos cambios que he tenido que hacer en mi vida, gracias a Dios todos han sido para bien. Uno de esos cambios me ha dado mucha alegría y me ha llenado de ilusión. Tengo el enorme privilegio de estar pasando un curso de Panadería Dulcería. Para mí es un privilegio porque siempre ha sido mi sueño dedicarme a hacer panes y dulces. Por tanto, me siento muy afortunada de poder estar dando mis primeros pasos para ver mi sueño cumplido.

> > *Hello everyone! It's a pleasure to share with this wonderful community of food lovers. I apologize for not posting lately, as I've been quite busy with many changes in my life, thank God they've all been for the best. One of these changes has brought me great joy and filled me with excitement. I have the enormous privilege of taking a baking and pastry course. It's a privilege for me because it's always been my dream to dedicate myself to making bread and sweets.*
![IMG_20260414_133656.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/23tmNDhKgLh472wcnR4rJrAJiJ38fkJ5qhwzSpAZwPbkCtNg4JGNRKmGfLA5ZGe5f1tnv.jpg) ![IMG_20260414_133209.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/23y8xQiDuhpCg66hBTyQSTD4JrcWqsKGdD3gkiEdaAqenS5AyXEDUzH5TXNqUVyLxAD9o.jpg)

> En este curso he podido conocer a muchas personas maravillosas que comparten mi misma pasión. Juntos pasamos momentos muy amenos, a la vez que poco a poco vamos aprendiendo y ayudándonos a crecer. En el día de hoy les traigo la receta del pan de hamburguesa. A continuación les comparto los ingredientes:

> > *Therefore, I feel very fortunate to be taking my first steps toward fulfilling my dream. In this course, I've met many wonderful people who share my passion. We spend very enjoyable times together, while gradually learning and helping each other grow. Today I'm sharing my hamburger bun recipe. Here are the ingredients:*
![IMG-20260414-WA0032.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/EogPiVv6gdfngN4xm85iywhiqPraqMoVpVnhKibr1jEbPr34Yzr48jQPxiXAwYrYQxz.jpg) ![IMG-20260414-WA0009.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/EowG4KTiCnbRmmSud5PqiF6Uc84QPgwAqhxVB7DEcSjCgdSqZCoGLweewwKML4VvexH.jpg)

> # Ingredientes 1. Harina 500 gramos 2. Agua 250 mililitros 3. Levadura 10 gramos 4. Sal 10 gramos 5. Azúcar 60 gramos 6. Leche en polvo 25 gramos 7. Grasa 30 gramos 8. Mejorador 5 gramos 9. Harina para espolvoreo= 100 gramos 10. Grasa para engrasar= 10 gramos 11. Semillas de Sésamo= 100 gramos

> # Ingredients 1. Flour 500 grams 2. Water 250 milliliters 3. Yeast 10 grams 4. Salt 10 grams 5. Sugar 60 grams 6. Powdered milk 25 grams 7. Fat 30 grams 8. Improver 5 grams 9. Flour for dusting = 100 grams 10. Fat for greasing = 10 grams 11. Sesame seeds = 100 grams
![IMG_20260414_130159.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/EpXJUJQE6YTxE7Ju7C63MRRQvtx13kzgeW97g2jkVMnPDjrZw9v8buXrGpsB4RMDBEm.jpg)

> # Procedimiento ## Paso 1 Primero se deben pesar bien los ingredientes. Una vez hecho esto, se hace un volcán con la harina, el mejorador y la leche en polvo. (Estos ingredientes se deben haber mezclado bien previamente). ## Paso 2 Hacer un hueco grande en el centro del volcán y añadir el agua, la sal, el azúcar y el aceite. Mezclar bien estos ingredientes. ## Paso 3 Poco a poco ir uniendo los ingredientes secos con el centro que contiene una mezcla líquida.

> # Procedure ## Step 1 > *First, weigh the ingredients carefully. Once this is done, create a well in the center of the flour, improver, and powdered milk. (These ingredients should have been thoroughly mixed beforehand.)* ## Step 2 > *Make a large well in the center of the well and add the water, salt, sugar, and oil. Mix these ingredients well.* ## Step 3 > *Gradually incorporate the dry ingredients into the center of the liquid mixture.*
![IMG-20260414-WA0006.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/23tbtuPwEizaYBLMUdQwBVaRytThVUvEg2n1xEPJ9qSdgLTXkENbSZzeCYYbvxkXBGjC6.jpg)

> ## Paso 4 El amasado puede ser manual o con una máquina amasadora. El amasado en la primera velocidad se realiza hasta que la masa sea homogénea y se despegue de las paredes del equipo. Luego se realiza el amasado en segunda velocidad hasta que la masa se torne elástica y cambie de color. ## Paso 5 Se pone a reposar la masa por 40 minutos, hasta que aumente su volumen. ## Paso 6 Se divide, pesa y bolea la masa. Cada bola de masa en nuestro caso, pesó 60 gramos. Realmente un pan de hamburguesa debe tener un peso en crudo de entre 80 a 100 gramos. Pero los hicimos más pequeños para que salieran más unidades.

> ## Step 4 > *Kneading can be done by hand or with a stand mixer. Knead at the lowest speed until the dough is smooth and pulls away from the sides of the mixer. Then, knead at the second speed until the dough becomes elastic and changes color.* ## Step 5 > *Let the dough rest for 40 minutes, until it has doubled in volume.* ## Step 6 > *Divide, weigh, and shape the dough into balls. Each ball of dough in our case weighed 60 grams. Ideally, a hamburger bun should weigh between 80 and 100 grams raw. But we made them smaller to get more buns.*
![IMG_20260414_125741.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/23wCBnQeDZgifR7tnnRM3KFSCfAT8mfvsFJUpm8PeWniJgKXTbmsuK81cg2AYxGQTK2Xr.jpg)

> ## Paso 7 Se ponen a fermentar los panes en la estufa a 35 grados Celsius y 75 % de humedad relativa. ## Paso 8 Una vez que aumentaron el doble de su volumen se sacan de la estufa se brillan con huevo batido y se le colocan las semillas de sésamo. ## Paso 9 Se hornean los panes hasta que se observe que tienen un color dorado y que ya están cocinados. Una vez cocinados, se sacan del horno para que se enfríen.

> ## Step 7 > *Proof the buns in the oven at 35 degrees Celsius and 75% relative humidity.* ## Step 8 > *Once they have doubled in volume, remove them from the oven, brush them with beaten egg, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.* ## Step 9 > *Bake the buns until they are golden brown and cooked through. Once baked, remove them from the oven to cool.*
![IMG_20260504_195310.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/23zSBmgnZMFVqy9mrSrswYyHreyxKwvMJ93mqYMFx6dgR4bVvmpxKB1PtVwBzNCeBf91d.jpg)

body.title: Is Being a single mother acceptable in the eyes of God?//Mcgi Topic Review
body.body:
https://youtu.be/l13EhMBseRY?si=M_DrbOluY6DIApyF

**Greetings everyone,** and welcome to my blog. It is another wonderful opportunity to listen to the word of God through His servant, Bro. Eli Soriano.

According to Romans 2:11, God shows no partiality; He does not favor one person over another. When we speak of God—the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ—it means there is no discrimination with Him. In the same way, James 2:1 reminds believers not to practice favoritism in their faith in Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory.

We are not meant to treat people differently because everyone was created by God. In His sight, every individual matters. This is why the Bible teaches that it is God’s desire for all people to be saved. As stated in 1 Timothy 2:4, God wants everyone to come to the knowledge of the truth and receive salvation.

If God desires all people to be saved, then it clearly shows that He loves everyone. Also, 2 Peter 3:9 explains that God is patient with us. He does not want anyone to perish but wants everyone to turn away from sin and repent.

God’s will is that no one should be lost—not even a single person. His love extends to all. So the question should not be whether we accept someone based on their situation, such as being a single mother. There is no valid reason to reject anyone. While some people may have faced discrimination, such behavior is not expected in the true church of God. In the body of Christ, we are called to treat one another equally and show genuine care for each other.

1 Corinthians 12:25 teaches that there should be no division among believers, but that everyone should care for one another equally.

Looking at the early church, we see an example in Mary Magdalene. She had a troubled past and was once oppressed by evil spirits, yet she was delivered and accepted into the church. She became an important part of spreading the gospel and even supported the ministry of Jesus Christ. As recorded in Luke 8:2, she was among those who were healed and transformed.

This shows that no matter a person’s past or condition, they can be accepted, valued, and used for God’s purpose.

**Thanks for reading.**

body.title: WHEN IS GOD'S PERFECT TIME/ THE OLD PATH
body.body: The perfect time for God is not checked by human time, but is checked with a unique time which is God's time. The time which God does his own thing is beyond human understanding. What may seem like delay to us is not delay in God’s eyes, but preparation. This reminds us that God’s timing is always intentional and never late.\nhttps://youtu.be/TIAgZr_oErQ?si=vvWabwoa_fbnUlWw\nChristian find it hard to wait for God time, because they believe on their own time instead of God own. However, Scripture encourages patience and trust in God’s process. Even when things seem slow or uncertain, there is an assurance that what God has planned will come to pass at the right moment. This shows that God’s perfect timing involves faith, endurance, and trusting that He knows what is best for us.

body.title: A city within a city - Alba Iulia - Romania
body.body:
After visiting the salt mines, I headed towards Alba Iulia, the city where my daughter and friends from all over the world had gathered for a joint project. Now it was clear to me why there is no bus service here. I turned off the highway and drove some 11km to the city.Alba Iulia is divided into the Upper and Lower Towns. I decided to focus my tour on the Upper Town, which is located in the fortress.This was a real surprise for me and I have never seen anything like this. In our Belgrade there is a huge fortress, but inside it there are only historical sights and parks, here the entire city is located in the 12km long fortress Alba Karolina.The fortress has 6 entrances and it is very important to enter at the right entrance then you will find your way around very easily. Entrance is free and I immediately bought a map at the entrance.My entrance is the beginning of the Coronation Cathedral. Kings were crowned here.

![679401473_4220722308178430_1454961464723114640_n (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dragan1957/23ywmC6Ykn3LZNrF1EHqwfwSar3YK6Cj1pjozMP5Wq3xa4uABqrr1UTSeX3gSQBRyBrVT.jpg)

What I read in the map, I will write what is there of the sights. First, the fortress was built in the shape of a star, and the landmarks I saw were the coronation cathedral of the Romanian royal couple, the Roman Catholic cathedral with the tomb of Janos Hunjadi, and the National Unification Museum.

The fortress functions as an urban district of the city, which particularly fascinated me. There are several streets with houses from the 18th and 19th centuries that are still used as private homes or have been converted into some catering facility that is particularly interesting for tourists. I would love to stay in one of these houses. Maybe there are ghosts haha. In addition to the house, inside the fortress there are also important buildings such as a university, a military hospital and the headquarters of the Romanian army.While I was walking around the fortress, I only saw locals going to work or school, shopping. It's really easy to live here, and I couldn't believe it. You know, I would love to live here too. I saw several parks, a fountain, cafes, restaurants. And all that in a 4-hour tour. Of course, that's only part of it, because it would take me at least 4 days to tour this city.

body.title: The Mirage of Connection
body.body: We have never been more connected, yet we are completely alone. The screens promise community, but they deliver isolation. We trade intimacy for attention. We judge people by their avatars. It is a hollow experience. We feel a phantom vibration in our pockets. We think it is a message. It is just a glitch in our nerves. We are starving for real touch. The digital interface is cold glass. It reflects our own face back at us. We are falling in love with our own reflections. It is narcissism disguised as networking. The algorithm creates a bubble. It protects us from dissent. It protects us from reality. We live in a hall of mirrors. We need to smash the glass. We need to breathe the air outside. It is toxic out there, but it is real.
body.author: ideology-glitch

body.title: Journeys to Peace /   Huzura Açılan Yolculuklar   ( EN-TR)
body.body:
Every time I set out on a journey, I find myself facing stories that are completely different from what I had planned. While this brings me deep joy, I sometimes find myself in situations that are difficult to handle.  On these journeys toward freedom, where I often let the route unfold naturally, the feelings I experience fill me with a sense of peace, yet some of the scenes I encounter leave an indescribable sadness within me. Perhaps that is why every journey becomes an adventure that allows one to rediscover not only the places visited but also one’s own inner self. 


>Her yolculuğa çıkarken planladıklarından öte her zaman farklı bambaşka hikayelerle karşı karşıya kalıyorum. Bu durum beni içten içe mutlu etsede bazen baş edilmesi zor durumlara maruz kalabiliyorum.  Özgürlüğe doğru çıktığım, rotasını çoğu zaman akışına bıraktığım bu yollarda hissettiklerim bir yandan içimi  huzurla doldururken, karşıma çıkan bazı manzaralar da içimde tarifsiz bir hüzün bırakıyor. Belki bu yüzden her yolculuk, sadece gidilen yerleri değil, insanın kendi içini de yeniden keşfettiği bir serüvene dönüşüyor. 

![IMG20260325115255.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeHpWDqroZ85PhAHNw9LQyzftEYEzwPWKi7x5R972nq8R/IMG20260325115255.jpg)

Although I had marked certain points on maps during my trips, especially along the Aegean and Mediterranean coasts, the real discovery was always taking place within me.  It was mid-July. I had begun my journey during the hottest time of the year in the Mediterranean... When I arrived in Kaş from Antalya, the landscape resembled a horizon line between the color of the sea and the sky.  As the turbulent waves crashed against the rugged cliffs, they did more than just make a sound. As I looked, I saw the resilience of the stones bearing the traces of the civilizations that once lived here, despite all these years.  Especially as I walked through those narrow streets, the scent of the past, trapped between the stone walls, was immediately palpable. 


>Özellikle Ege ve Akdeniz kıyılarına yaptığım yolculuklarım da haritalarda işaretlediğim bazı noktalar vardı belki ama asıl keşfi hep içimde yaşıyordum.  Temmuz ayı ortalarıydı. Akdeniz'in en sıcak zamanlarında başlamıştım yolculuğuma... Antalya'dan Kaş'a vardığımda denizin rengiyle gökyüzü arasında ufuk çizgisi anımsatan bir manzara vardı.  Hırçın dalgalar sert kayalıklara vururken sadece ses çıkarmıyordu. Baktığımda geçmişte burada yaşayan medeniyetlerin izlerini taşıyan taşların bunca yıla rağmen direnişini görüyordum.  Hele o dar sokaklarında yürüken taş duvarlarının arasında sıkışmış olan geçmişin kokusu hemen hissediliyordu. 

![IMG20260325115036.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaRa5o1Hx5KLhxBtVesc474V1UANwWiVPb6AQAPyshxC3/IMG20260325115036.jpg)

![IMG20260324125102.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQQhPuTDfpADafVGZbB9AuUnJH4fcwt1LSM61MyXXGzKg/IMG20260324125102.jpg)

After leaving Kaş, the road took me to Kalkan. I arrived in Kalkan just in time for sunset... I made my way to a high cliff.  This was exactly what I was looking for when I set out to watch the sunset. The colors and scenery as the sun slowly sank into the sea were indescribable. In that moment, I felt a sense of peace being reborn within me.  It was as if I had been here before and had never experienced this feeling.  Who knows, perhaps some places are already written into a person’s soul. 

>Kaş'tan çıktıktan sonra yol beni Kalkan'a götürdü.  Gün batımından varmıştım Kalkan'a... Yüksek bir kıyıya geçtim.  Gün batımını izlemek için aradığımda tam buydu. Güneş ağır ağır denizin içine gömülürken oluşan renk ve manzara tarifsizdi. O an içimde huzurun yeniden doğduğunu hissettim.  Sanki daha önce burada bulunmuşum ve bu hissi yamamış gibiydim.  Kimbilir belki de bazı yerler insanın ruhuna önceden yazılmıştır. 


![IMG20260424143755.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVcSY6VMWxjP1Gcjeq3j3wssspjMxrZEp2SrsaEun4UEm/IMG20260424143755.jpg)


![IMG20260324122059.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX678EiNcjYHpvNm8E2vrHcdz43Y57S582XCTQu4MpFkf/IMG20260324122059.jpg)


We had watched the sun set. Our next stop was Patara. This place felt like a step back in time compared to Kalkan. It was quiet. It had a long stretch of beach. The waves in this area were rougher and more powerful. Occasionally, warnings were posted advising against entering the water. The area that made Patara most famous was Kum Tepesi. The fine grains of sand covering a vast expanse of land evoked the image of a vast desert. As you walk across the sand, you suddenly feel as though you’ve stepped back in time. Patara is a small coastal town steeped in history, once a popular city of ancient civilizations. The ancient city of Patara is more magnificent and better organized than one might expect. The fact that the ruins have stood firm to this day and that this is one of the best-preserved historical sites makes this coastal town even more appealing. 

>Güneşi batırmıştık. Sıradaki yolumuz Pataraydı. Burası Kalkan'a göre daha geçmiş bir zamandı. Sessizdi. Uzun bir sahili vardı. Dalgalar bu bölgede daha hırçın ve etkiliydi. Zaman zaman denize girilmez uyarısı yapılırdı. Patara'yı en meşhur yapan bölgesi Kum Tepesiydi. Geniş bir arazinin üzerini kaplayan ince kum taneleri büyük sahra çölünü anımsatıyordu.  Kumların üzerinde yürürken kendinizi bir anda geçmiş zamanda hissediyorsunuz. Patara tarih kokan, eski medeniyetlerin popüler şehirlerinden biri olarak geçen küçük bir sahil kenarıdır. Patara Antik Kent alışılmışın ötesinde daha görkemli ve daha düzenli yapılan bir kenttir. Kalıntıların günümüze kadar sağlam duruşları ve buranın en korunaklı tarihi yer olması bu sahil kenarını daha da cazip hale getirmiş. 


![IMG20250728190551.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVv1EgWDF1ZLtib7taoca7EC7reo9z41qVBKJWxuDCRBr/IMG20250728190551.jpg)

![IMG20250728185021.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmddEPjV7zJBuwWK6TzYURdQmxVMT1enyANWH4o32CQvtp/IMG20250728185021.jpg)


![IMG20260501162017.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbzCX7zwiaAN2CkUM5CDXPDVned62JGofFBE5TwMmTchf/IMG20260501162017.jpg)


![IMG20260424163301 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVdodZ4Kee3UX8Pj12pe8drtWM8uBhh6R5uZv3MjAkqwu/IMG20260424163301%20(1).jpg)

My journeys in the Aegean began with Ölüdeniz. When I arrived in Fethiye from Antalya, the atmosphere and scent of the town had completely changed. The nature and the sea were quieter and more serene. Everything was just as it should be. Even the waves lapped against the shore, they did so gently. The color of the sea at Ölüdeniz had turned turquoise, reflecting a peace that seeped into one’s soul. The only issue was the beaches being far apart from one another. But as I wandered among the coves, I saw just how generous nature could be. Every corner held a different view and beauty. Far from the noise, I was left alone with only the sounds of nature. 

>Ege'deki yolculuklarım Ölüdeniz ile başlamıştı. Antalya'dan Fethiye'ye geldiğimde şehrin havası ve kokusu tamamen değişmişti. Daha sessiz ve daha sakin bir doğa ve deniz vardı. Her şey olması gerektiği gibiydi. Dalgalar bile kıyıya vurdukça, nazik davranıyordu. Ölüdeniz'deki denizin rengi turkuaz rengine dönüşmüş, insanın içine işleyen bir huzur yansıtıyordu. Tek sorun birbirinden uzak olan sahil kenarlarıydı.  Ama koyların arasında dolanırken doğanın ne kadar cömert olabileceğini gördüm. Her köşede ayrı bir manzara ve güzellik yatıyordu. Gürültüden uzak sadece doğanın sesiyle başbaşa kalmıştım. 

​
![IMG20260501162006.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc35yrtgxgVoFqEfTtAAz5wFUHAuSeEdJArQHk2xia1S7/IMG20260501162006.jpg)

![IMG20260424163630 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVtuvH2qpV4aLcDSHJMr4qyRPu6H6A9EtHTed242pcH9M/IMG20260424163630%20(1).jpg)

At the end of my journeys, I always realize that what people truly need isn’t anything particularly grand. When we use our time wisely, even small moments can leave a lasting impression. A cup of tea shared with a stranger, a brief conversation that follows, or a simple greeting—these are all like little pieces that complete the heart.  The strength that comes from helping others and the peace of being content with what we have will lead us to victory. May your path be clear and your joy abundant. 


>Yolculuklarımın sonunda hep, insanın ihtiyacı olan şey aslında çok da büyülütelecek şeyler değil.  Zamanı doğru kullandığımızda küçük anıların bile anısı büyük oluyor. Hiç tanımadığım biriyle aynı ortamda birlikte içilen bir bardak çay, ardından edinilen kısa bir  sohbet, paylaşılan bir selam hepsi insanın içini tamamlayan küçük parçacıklar gibidir.  Yardımlaşmanın verdiği güç ve elindekilerle yetinmenin huzuru bizi zaferlere götürecektir. Yolunuz açık, keyfiniz bol olsun. 

​

​

body.title: Morning Sweats: Warming Myself Up while the Sun Rises
body.body: /> It's Sunday morning again so that I will be running early. I am always looking forward to sweating up while the sun rises. Aside from feeling good all day, I feel like I have all the energy I need. I set my alarm for 5:30 in the morning. When I woke up, I just started preparing everything, from my shoes, water bottle, and more. I got myself a cup of tea and a cracker to boost my energy. After all the preparations, I had to do warm-up exercises for about 5 minutes before I started running. When I got to the streets, there were only a few people and cars around, as it was still early.

/> After walking and running for a few minutes, I slowed down a bit and let the sweat roll down my face. As I looked around, I was already kilometers away from home. I needed to lie low since I got a very high heart rate while running. Also, it made me sweaty and tired. My legs could feel slight cramping, but I must get going.

/> The sun started to show up little by little. It's getting warmer, too. My sweats started coming through my face, and it felt good. I think I was already on my 5th kilometer when I passed through the rice field and a beautiful river near our home. I am almost at our house, too.

/> I slowed down a bit again and took a quick photo of myself, all sweaty and tired. I've already done 8 kilometres, and I'm starting to feel tired in my body, yet it feels so good to feel so weary in the morning. I got home and had some cool-down exercises for about 8 minutes. It's for the muscles and to make sure I don't feel sore all day. After the cool-down, it was time for me to drink some water and recharge by eating breakfast. It was another good run for me!

y piensas que es por verte,
pero es mi mala suerte
no puedas olvidarme,
trabajo es lo que busco
y no enamorarte...

Poesía y dibujo 
@ saulos

body.title: Título: Cuando la amígdala nos secuestra: solo queda la memoria implícita
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTU7KXtGmzjvnhJVW6CzKFwzToDw3rK65eVVNJrvyXcxs/1777985089388.jpg)

¿Te ha pasado que después de una discusión fuerte o un susto enorme no recuerdas bien lo que dijiste ni lo que hizo el otro? Solo te queda una sensación en el cuerpo: tensión en el pecho, un nudo en la garganta o ganas de huir.

Eso es un secuestro amigdalar. Como psicólogo, lo veo a menudo en consulta. La amígdala, esa pequeña estructura dentro del sistema límbico, se activa antes que cualquier pensamiento racional. No espera al córtex prefrontal. Detecta una amenaza —real o interpretada— y dispara la alarma. En milisegundos, el cuerpo se prepara para luchar o escapar.

Lo que ocurre después es fascinante y a la vez complicado: durante ese secuestro, la memoria explícita —la que nos permite narrar lo sucedido con orden cronológico, detalles y palabras— se apaga parcialmente. Por eso tantas personas dicen “no sé qué pasó, solo reaccioné”.

En cambio, la memoria implícita queda grabada a fuego. Son registros sensoriales y emocionales: una voz que sonó igual a la de aquella persona que nos lastimó, una música que apareció antes del golpe, el olor de un lugar. Estas memorias no vienen con etiquetas ni fechas. Solo son. Y el cuerpo las recuerda aunque la mente consciente haya “olvidado” el episodio.

El trabajo terapéutico no es eliminar la amígdala —sería un error— sino ayudar a que el córtex prefrontal vuelva a la reunión cuando ya pasó el peligro. Reconocer el secuestro, nombrarlo, y poco a poco integrar lo implícito con lo explícito.

Title: When the amygdala hijacks us: only implicit memory remains

Have you ever been in a heated argument or a sudden scare, and afterward you couldn’t clearly remember what you said or what the other person did? All that stayed with you was a bodily sensation: chest tightness, a lump in your throat, or an urge to run.

That’s an amygdala hijack, a term I often use in my psychology practice. The amygdala — that small, almond-shaped structure inside the limbic system — activates before any rational thought can kick in. It doesn’t wait for the prefrontal cortex. It detects a threat (real or perceived) and sounds the alarm. Within milliseconds, your body prepares to fight or flee.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc66Po48g9X4sHo2Y2jSguTntTNFrjjAWwmmvUBZ4vQcd/1777985089104.jpg)

What happens next is both fascinating and challenging: during that hijack, explicit memory — the one that lets us recall events in order, with details and narrative — partially shuts down. That’s why so many people say, “I don’t know what happened, I just reacted.”

Implicit memory, however, gets burned in. These are sensory and emotional records: a voice that sounded just like someone who once hurt you, a song that played right before a blow, the smell of a certain place. These memories don’t come with labels or timestamps. They just are. And the body remembers them even when the conscious mind has “forgotten” the episode.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYrV1pR7p5XU5YTUmc82jEDBGFz9xFM8QcfrGCc4zm1tS/1777985089007.jpg)

Therapeutic work is not about removing the amygdala — that would be a mistake — but about helping the prefrontal cortex rejoin the meeting after the danger has passed. Recognizing the hijack, naming it, and slowly integrating implicit with explicit memory.

body.title: Technology Vs Creativity... What Are We Losing.
body.body:
Hello Community, 

I don’t think technology is making us less creative… but I do think it is making us a bit lazy with our creativity sometimes, and there is a difference.

See, creativity has never really been about the tools, it is about the person using them, back then, people used paint, pen, or even just their hands to create crazy beautiful things, now we have AI, software, and all these tools that can do things faster, that does not kill creativity, it just changes how we express it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTNbZcAew6V4ztVBhRNn6YAJxw5yAYeNCHcr9B6PMtrPH/1777985741909.jpg)

But here is where the problem comes in… convenience.

When something becomes too easy, people stop trying as hard, Instead of thinking deeply or pushing ideas, it is tempting to just type a prompt and accept whatever comes out, No stress, no struggle, no real effort, and sometimes, that struggle is actually where the best ideas come from.

Like imagine someone designing a building years ago, They had to sketch, calculate, adjust, start again… there was a whole process, that process forced them to think, to be intentional, now, with technology, you can generate multiple designs in minutes. It’s impressive, but it can also remove that creative muscle workout.

So yeah, in that sense, technology can weaken creativity if we rely on it too much.

But at the same time, it can also make creativity even bigger.

Think about it,  so someone with ideas but no drawing skills can now bring their vision to life, a small creator can edit videos, design graphics. Reach people all over the world without needing a whole team, That’s actually powerful.technology is opening doors that used to be locked.

So instead of killing creativity, I think it is just exposing how we choose to use it.

There are people who use AI and tools to enhance their ideas, like they already have something in their head and they use technology to bring it out better, then there are people who depend on it completely, like the tool is doing all the thinking for them, that is where creativity starts to drop.

For me, I think the real question is not is technology ruining creativity? but are we still thinking for ourselves?

Because if you are still thinking, still questioning, still adding your own touch, then your creativity is intact, the tool is just helping you move faster.

Now, how do we stay creative with all this around?

First thing, don’t lose your own voice, it is easy to start sounding like everything else when you rely too much on generated stuff, take time to think things through yourself before using any tool.

Second, create without shortcuts sometimes, like write without AI, design without templates, just struggle through it, It might not be perfect, but it keeps your creative muscles active.

Third, be intentional, don’t just create because you can, create because you actually have something to say or express, that alone makes a huge difference.

And lastly, use technology as a partner,and  not a replacement, let it assist you, and not define you.

At the end of the day creativity is still much alive, It hasn’t gone anywhere, It’s just being tested in a way.

No I don’t think technology is killing our creativity, I just think it is revealing who is willing to stay creative and who is okay, with letting the machine do all the work.

[Image Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/turned-on-gray-laptop-computer-XJXWbfSo2f0)

# The SB-Chronicle Prompt #45
With #sb-chronicles... we are posting a question on Mondays, prompting anyone who wants to join in to write their own \
Chronicle for future generations to read! *If you feel like suggesting a next prompt yourself... please feel welcome to contact one of the \

!*

### > Memorable Meals You’ve Ever Had


**Tell us what Are the Most Memorable Meals You’ve Ever Had?** What did you eat, and where? Who were you with? Share some pictures of that meals if you have them.


***
![silver_divider_black.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-106316/23tm7UaLc76pYmSHzjvoxFkPkfZzAiHisjLZwAUTQxGnKDSXL96oVGDuZfXYU9Rdd7YwX.png)

# The How-2 join the Silverbloggers Chronicles

- Just take the prompt question and answer it in your own Hive post. 
- **Post in our Silver Bloggers Community**.
- Be sure to **use [#sb-chronicles](https://peakd.com/created/sb-chronicles) as your first tag**, to get them all listed at the same place. 
- Write 100% original content of **around 300 words in English**.
- **Put the link to your post into the comment section of your chosen prompt.**
- Have fun.
- 

And soon enough, we’ll have a \

for future generations. **There is no time limit for all this...** Write whenever you like and whatever prompt suits you. Just make sure you use the proper tag and put a link to your post in the comment section of the chosen prompt, so we can curate your story.

[You can check here on all our prompts - always updated with what's to come!](https://peakd.com/hive-106316/@hive-106316/the-silverbloggers-writers-block-terminator)

![sbChroniclesEmblem_512_2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mondoshawan/23tvXkzvtgxkFPNzgun7ViKutnfGv5hkLFKTxGm6X7qKLVG7scHA7cunPuvJ6rCcYdiXc.png)
***

# The Idea of the Chronicles
...kinda started when our community advisor [SilverScribe](https://peakd.com/@ericvancewalton) came up with the Memoir Mondays. A new topic/question every Monday for a whole year, and we all loved it so much that we've fallen into a kind of writer's block since the \

of it.  <sup><sup> *Not really, but still...* </sup></sup>

So what could be more obvious than to continue somehow? Something has to be done to tackle writer's block, or even the ‘all-time low’ at Hive...
***
The Silverators started brainstorming the hows and the whens to get an idea of what we could all share for the best of our community. To have a sort of \

that never gets old.

In the synonyms for the word memoir, we can find - chronicle. Now, that was it.... our own chronicles!  **The Silverbloggers Chronicles**! The place where we all keep our memories to share with the future. The library of a silly, wild bunch of Silvers. **The Silvery Book of the Wise**! Hehehe


***
![silver_divider_black.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-106316/23tm7UaLc76pYmSHzjvoxFkPkfZzAiHisjLZwAUTQxGnKDSXL96oVGDuZfXYU9Rdd7YwX.png)
***
### On Winning the Prize ?!
We are all winners in this by supporting each other in the community, be it with an upvote, a tip, and/or a kind comment... 

> Since we \
know that many are just chasing big votes, with not doing much at all, running behind the whales to get them to pay attention, craving for a vote of lots of dollar$. Or the ones being \

and trying to benefit from the Vitamin R<sup>elation</sup> until there's a Lambo in sight...!

We feel this is the wrong way. A community should be there for each other, even if many humans are conditioned differently. It's more about putting the ego-selfish-ego aside, because life is not about money, it's about joy/happiness. That everyone gets support for their best they give to the community. 

> You may say it's good to have dreams? Yes, we live these dreams to achieve the best for everyone. Remember - joy/happiness?!

Why are we even writing about this while promoting the Chronicles for our community? It's to make us all realise that many members don't get high-profile support, but we can \

ourselves. Also, to understand that the idea of a memoir library for future generations is probably not the way to get rich, to finally get that Lambo. It's about sharing viewpoints, knowledge, and the occasional good laugh. It's about individuals, nature, and happiness. And be sure, we continue to curate the pearls in our midst!
***
![silver_divider_black.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-106316/23tm7UaLc76pYmSHzjvoxFkPkfZzAiHisjLZwAUTQxGnKDSXL96oVGDuZfXYU9Rdd7YwX.png)
***

## Last words...

We would love to get more eyes on this post *and* all community posts from - [@hive-106316](https://peakd.com/c/hive-106316) - our Silver Bloggers Mother Account.  This is why we make a point of reblogging your posts.  Please do the same?!

body.title: Mi libertad Está en mi Interior (Esp/ Eng)
body.body:
, eso depende de los ojos que lo miren y para ello intervienen factores, desde el lugar donde nacemos, las costumbres y la cultura en la que crecemos. Desde allí, cada uno de nosotros tiene una visión de lo que es para cada quien sentirse libre. Eso implica que lo que podría ser, en mi caso, ser libre, para otra persona puede ser otras cosas totalmente diferentes. Me explico con este ejemplo: para una persona nacida en un medio lleno de naturaleza, animales, ríos, montañas, para él sentirse libre es estar en medio de su medio ambiente; estar en su suelo, su tierra, lo hace sentirse como a los pajarillos que admira. Ahora, una persona que está acostumbrada a estar en ciudades, en un ambiente urbano, tal vez lleno de arte, libros, de bullicio, para estar libre, para el sentirse libre en su ambiente, podría ser asistir a cualquier evento social, viajar, en fin.

Entonces, basándome en esto, ya centrándome en lo que para mí significa sentirme libre, empiezo por el inicio. Fui criada como hija única durante un buen tiempo, pasé mucho tiempo en soledad, solo con mis familiares más cercanos; para ese tiempo tomé el hábito de la lectura y luego el de la escritura, porque descubrí que mediante ellos podía andar por lugares donde no había andado. Al leer un libro, me traslado a mundos donde puedo andar por donde quiera, experimentar incluso lo desconocido; lo mismo sucede cuando escribo, porque por medio de la escritura, libero todo lo que pienso y siento, mis emociones y sentimientos consiguen expresar mi mundo interior y eso es liberador.


<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/242Nd6j5JVaCGeHg1k7n163t4XHWbH13iTiNkmr4JK6SRJ6WLMQkHyYn39FrjeqQfdeAN.png)
</center>


Por otro lado, otras formas de ser libre son hacer otras cosas que me dan bienestar, como caminar entre la naturaleza, visitarla en sus diversas manifestaciones: ríos, playas, montañas, llanos. Me encanta sentirme parte de ella, aunque soy de las que prefiere su hermosa ciudad para vivir, pero afortunadamente es una ciudad llena de muchos espacios donde puedo conectar con ella y eso es maravilloso; eso me hace sentir en completa libertad, me complementa y cada vez que necesito esa conexión tengo muchas opciones a la mano y, a mi entender, eso es parte de sentirse libre.

Quizás para otros, la libertad esté en otras cosas: viajar, conocer otros países, sumergirse en otras culturas, aprender nuevos bailes, disfrutar de la vida al aire libre, recorrer el mundo en bicicleta y paremos de contar, pero personalmente el ser libre está en las cosas sencillas y que me llenan de satisfacción y que, sobre todo, me conectan con mi creador, con mi bienestar físico, emocional y espiritual; en todas estas cosas radica mi sentimiento de libertad. También el poder compartir con los míos sin mayores preocupaciones, eso me libera enormemente y debo decir que es una de mis principales motivaciones para estar completamente en tranquilidad y en completo bienestar.



Estoy segura de que, al empezar a leer las diferentes participaciones de mis amigos hivers, muchos tendrán diferentes formas de expresar lo que para ellos significa ser libre, pero de lo que sí estoy segura es de que cada quien hablará desde sus propias experiencias, culturas, tradiciones y gustos, porque eso es lo que somos y de eso se compone la libertad personal.

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/23ujXbrYSn8rtQ7Gb31MupqPHNdqAMKucQZW2iVhrvXMj3jtcRTmY5s2mgH7vy2Tjnr6A.png)
</center>



Esta es mi participación en [Encuentro de Talentos: \

that depends on the eyes that look at it, and for that, factors come into play, from the place where we are born, the customs, and the culture in which we grow up. From there, each of us has a vision of what it means for each person to feel free. That implies that what might be, in my case, being free, for another person could be something completely different. Let me explain with this example: for a person born in an environment full of nature, animals, rivers, and mountains, feeling free means being in the midst of their environment; being on their soil, their land, makes them feel like the little birds they admire. Now, a person who is used to being in cities, in an urban environment, perhaps full of art, books, and hustle and bustle, to feel free, to feel free in their environment, could be attending any social event, traveling, in short.

So, based on this, focusing on what feeling free means to me, I start from the beginning. I was raised as an only child for a long time, spending a lot of time in solitude, only with my closest relatives; during that time, I took up the habit of reading and then writing, because I discovered that thru them I could go to places I had never been. When I read a book, I transport myself to worlds where I can wander wherever I want, even experiencing the unknown; the same happens when I write, because thru writing, I release everything I think and feel, my emotions and feelings manage to express my inner world, and that is liberating.

On the other hand, other ways to be free are doing things that give me well-being, such as walking in nature, visiting it in its various forms: rivers, beaches, mountains, plains. I love feeling like a part of it, even tho I am one of those who prefers its beautiful city to live in, but fortunately, it is a city full of many spaces where I can connect with it, and that is wonderful; it makes me feel completely free, it complements me, and whenever I need that connection, I have many options at hand, and, in my understanding, that is part of feeling free.

Perhaps for others, freedom lies in different things: traveling, getting to know other countries, immersing themselves in other cultures, learning new dances, enjoying life outdoors, cycling around the world, and so on. But personally, being free is found in simple things that fill me with satisfaction and, above all, connect me with my creator, with my physical, emotional, and spiritual well-being; in all these things lies my feeling of freedom. Also, being able to share with my loved ones without major worries, that frees me enormously and I must say it is one of my main motivations to be completely at peace and in complete well-being.



I am sure that, as I start reading the different contributions from my hivers friends, many will have different ways of expressing what being free means to them, but what I am sure of is that each person will speak from their own experiences, cultures, traditions, and tastes, because that is who we are and that is what personal freedom is made of.

body.title: Life’s Unexpected Turns: My Chow Chow Cardo’s Sprain and the Lessons of Everyday Care
body.body:
**Hello Hive Fam! 💕** Most especially to my Hive Friends who never fail to support me, I’m so grateful for your constant encouragement. Sharing my little life stories with you always feels like catching up with family.

![1000015654.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/Eopsps3E4wfgjWYp93ubNqYsbv4attzDbRShjhFx8ch1CmX6XTvbbLAZ1TmpM7HmHXB.jpg)

Today brought me a surprise I wasn’t prepared for. Just a few hours ago, I noticed my fur baby, **Cardo**, my fluffy Chow Chow, had a leg sprain. I was shocked because I didn’t see how it happened. One moment he was fine, and the next, he was limping.

![1000015655.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/EonkwpJ5p9rg77QRpggYqjPfoaoai1csLHWsVxv38Uc6hg7pzkfCDr6AB4dE1sLj2CF.jpg)

![1000015656.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/Eos1rtRhJkZHu8aRGT5T5mMxm3nLc8t4PhkE896i8eRhx2KVXs7mbydyVuuhExvkT9J.jpg)

This isn’t the first time. Cardo experienced the same thing before, and back then, I didn’t bring him to the vet. After a few days, he healed naturally. I’m hoping the same will happen now. I believe in his strength and resilience, and I trust that he’ll bounce back soon.

![1000015657.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/Ep5nkLMUJyVZ6iimXkzSVuvkttyXCFjYnBpFJcJonF5RN9ypmN4kR5gaW4HqPgKN9Hn.jpg)

Moments like these remind me that life is full of unexpected turns. As a fur parent, I’ve learned that caring for pets is not just about feeding them or playing with them; it’s also about being emotionally present when they’re vulnerable. Cardo teaches me patience, empathy, and the importance of hope.

![1000015658.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/EoptPxFMyZLmiX75min2TVbE2EWM5EUxshYii7dBx3naDgrGLEb7UzfoAoKNvQAoELu.jpg)

**Thank you, Hive Fam, for taking the time to read my little lifestyle update today.** Your support means the world to me, and I’m sending love to all of you and to your fur babies, too! 🐾💖
https://youtube.com/shorts/SDtKsxhy7ZA?si=p0BHwHEkLeeMWweb

[Record-breaking charity fundraiser]
I'll start today's news roundup with very positive news from Poland. An unknown streamer nicknamed \

raised around $70 million to fight cancer. Various celebrities, talking heads, and authorities have joined the cause – both members of our Deep State and those independent of the government. And above all, the mass uprising of many people. Some Poles are criticizing this action, and although I understand their frustration, I'm still angry at their nonsense.

I personally can't stand celebrities, especially those who brainwash ordinary people, contributing to social polarization. I know that charities are (unfortunately) often a front for various shady businesses or outright frauds, but... Here we're dealing with a random person, who could have been me, you, your friend, my friend, your ex's cousin, or his friend, who just a few years ago was swearing at another player on some server. However, celebrities' actions, although solely for self-promotion (somewhere in the back of their minds, some feel a microscopic desire to help), primarily help the sick and poor. And that's incredibly important; there's never enough money for those in need.

Generally, everyone talks a lot about health, leaving money aside. A topic that shouldn't be ignored, because while it won't solve all problems, it will help many. Or at least provide a relatively comfortable life. I hope there will be more initiatives like this!

Sam nie cierpię celebrytów, zwłaszcza takich którzy robią wodę z mózgu zwykłym ludziom, dokładając się do społecznej polaryzacji. Wiem że organizacje dobroczynne to (niestety) często przykrywka na różne szemrane biznesy lub bezdyskusyjne oszustwa, ale... Tu mamy do czynienia z randomem, którym mogłem być ja, Ty, twój kolega, mój kolega, kuzyn twojej byłej lub jego kolega, który jeszcze kilka lat temu bluzgał się z innym graczem na jakimś serwerze. Natomiast działania celebrytów choć służą włącznie autopromocji (gdzieś tam z tyłu głowy, niektórzy odczuwają mikroskopijną chęć pomocy), to przede wszystkim pomagają chorym i biednym ludziom. A to jest cholernie ważne, pieniędzy dla potrzebujących nigdy mało.  

Generalnie wszyscy dużo mówią o zdrowiu pomijając temat pieniędzy. Temat, którego pomijać się nie powinno bo choć problemy nie rozwiążą wszystkich problemów, to pomogą w wielu. A przynajmniej zapewnią w miarę komfortowe życie. Mam nadzieję, że będzie więcej takich akcji!
https://gamerant.com/mrbeast-charity-record-stream/

[Sony zaprzecza]
W ostatnim przeglądzie newsów zastanawiałem się jak część graczy, czy nowa praktyka Sony zaszkodzi nam. Przewidywania choć były logiczne, okazały się być nieprawdziwe. Nie polecam wierzyć Grifterom, którzy kompletnie manipulowali treścią tej wiadomości.
https://gamerant.com/sony-playstation-drm-statement/

[Project Helix]
Już 7 maja dowiemy się nowych rzeczy na temat kolejnej konsoli Microsoft. 
https://gamerant.com/xbox-game-dev-helix-console-event-when-may-7/

[Zysk Koei-Tecmo] 
Spółka Koei-Tecmo opublikowała raport za ostatni rok fiskalny. Odnotowali wzrost wartości swojej firmy o kilka %. 
https://gamerant.com/koei-tecmo-reports-record-profits/

[Darmowa gra od Housemarque]
Macie kody w linku.
https://gamerant.com/saros-free-download-may-2026/

[GTA 6]
Jeden z ważniejszych ludzi w Take Two, Strauss Zelnick, powiedział że niedługo rozpocznie się kampania promocyjna GTA 6. Wypowiedział się również na temat ceny i kosztów produkcji, oczywiście bez detali.
https://gamerant.com/grand-theft-auto-6-gta6-news-coming-soon/

Jak myślicie? Rockstar zmieni datę premiery? Wg mnie nie ma na to szans. 
https://gamerant.com/grand-theft-auto-6-gta-6-release-date-delay-polymarket/

Panie CEO, nie ma co się czego bać. Gra na pewno zarobi, tryb online również (musieliście być geniuszami, by zepsuć coś tak łatwego w Waszej sytuacji) tym bardziej. A że ludzie będą skomleć? No cóż, czasem bywa.  
https://gamerant.com/grand-theft-auto-6-release-when-ceo-terrified/

https://gamerant.com/gta-6-price-update/

https://gamerant.com/gta-6-pre-orders-when-update-may-2026/

Co innego w przypadku, gdyby wszyscy gracze masowo rzucili się do trybu multiplayer... Tutaj może być już problem, dlatego Rockstar aktywuje ten tryb w grudniu lub nawet na początku 2027... Stawiam, że docisną grę kolanem jeszcze w grudniu. Dzieci i nastolatki kochają GTA Online, więc lepiej nie tracić darmowych pieniędzy. 

Dostaliśmy informacje o lokowanych produktach. 
https://gamerant.com/gta-6-online-multiplayer-launch-day-problems/

https://gamerant.com/gta-6-release-date-expected-pre-order-period-rdr2-comparison/

https://gamerant.com/gta-6-product-placement/

Poza tym, tak jak mówiłem w ostatnim przeglądzie newsów, zakończyła się ostatnia edycja znanego eventu w świecie GTA. 
https://gamerant.com/gta-online-last-april-420-event/

Jeden z rzekomych pracowników Rockstar mówi, że trwa crunchowanie. Poczekam na więcej informacji zanim dodam swój komentarz. 
https://gamerant.com/rockstar-accused-crunch-gta-6/

[RDR 2]
A skoro mowa o GTA... Od wczoraj możecie kupić pudełkową wersję jednej z najważniejszych gier RockStar na konsolę PS5. Cena to 30$.
https://gamerant.com/red-dead-redemption-ps5-physical-edition-release-date-price/

https://gamerant.com/red-dead-redemption-ps5-physical-discounted-price/

[PS+]
Poznaliśmy pierwszą paczkę gier, która trafi do usługi PS+. Póki co nic ciekawego dla mnie -  EA Sports FC26, Wuchang: Fallen Feathers, Nine Sols. 
https://gamerant.com/ps-plus-games-may-2026-list-monthly-free-essential/

[First Light] 
Gra trafi do sprzedaży już 27 maja. Dostaliśmy informacje na jej temat.
https://gamerant.com/007-first-light-james-bond-games-change-forever/

https://gamerant.com/007-first-light-feature-list/

Podobno przejście gry ma zająć około 20 godzin. 
https://gamerant.com/007-first-light-how-long-to-beat/

[Helldivers 2]
Gra dostałą podobno potężny patch.
https://gamerant.com/helldivers-2-update-content-balance-changes-patch-notes/

[Wolverine]
Jeśli czekacie na nową grę, to wg studia Insomniac, dostaniemy je do końca wiosny... Czyli został im jeszcze maj. 
https://gamerant.com/insomniac-wolverine-game-news-update-2026/

[Injustice 3]
Przez wpadkę Warner Brothers, dostaliśmy informację na temat sequela popularnej bijatyki. Pracownik którego dane wyciekły, współtworzył również sequel gry z Hogwartem (Harry Potter) oraz 2 niezapowiedziane jeszcze tytuły.
https://gamerant.com/injustice-3-news-leaks-2026/

[Cars 3] 
Warner Brothers skasowało grę od studia Avalanche. Nie sądzę by ktokolwiek płakał za 3 część Cars (tej bajki Disneya lub Pixara).
https://gamerant.com/cars-driven-win-shut-down-nintendo-playstation-xbox-2026/

[Cronos]
Posiadacze Macintoshów i innych maszyn Apple'a będą mogli w końcu zagrać w Polską grę.
https://gamerant.com/cronos-the-new-dawn-official-mac-release-trailer/

[GreedFall: The Dying World]
Z kolei twórcy powyższej gry (oraz Steelrising), czyli studio Spiders, znika z planszy po 2 dekadach tworzenia gier. 
https://gamerant.com/greedfall-steelrising-spiders-dev-shutting-down-2026/

[FF]
Naoki Hamaguchi udzielił wywiadu serwisowi Comicbook. Podobno nie powiedział nic ważnego, jedynie potwierdzając że zespół ciągle pracuje. Zakładam że są na tym etapie, gdy jeszcze nie mają co pokazać (bo jest niedokończone lub za szybko). I bardzo dobrze, takie ogłoszenia powinny być jak najpóźniej.
https://gamerant.com/final-fantasy-7-remake-part-3-progress/

Dostaliśmy wersję demo gry, która już 3 czerwca trafi na Switcha 2 i Xboxa. 
https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2026-04-28/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth-switch-2-xbox-series-x-s-game-trailer-reveals-demo/.236898

https://gamerant.com/video/final-fantasy-7-rebirth-official-nintendo-switch-2-and-xbox-demo-trailer/

[Invincible VS]
Gra w końcu zadebiutowała. Powiem tak, pewnie zagram, ale tylko na dobrej promocji. Gra wygląda na dość sztywną, a brutalne sceny są dla mnie, jak Mortal Kombat z Temu. Poznaliśmy listę zawodników z nadchodzących DLC... Powiem tak, poza Olivierem nie mam nikogo, kim bym chciał zagrać. No może Dinozaury :D. 
https://gamerant.com/video/invincible-vs-official-launch-trailer/

https://gamerant.com/invincible-vs-dlc-characters-leak/

Dzięki Bogu, że rolę Cecile'a przejął Ghoul z Fallout - doskonale pasuje do nihilistycznego, złego skurwiela, który musi taki być. Z drugiej strony, nie wyobrażam sobie by Omnimanem mógł być ktoś inny. 
https://www.comingsoon.net/tv/news/2127627-invincible-jk-simmons-omni-man-cecil-cast

[Wuchang: Fallen Feathers]
Włoska firma, Digital Bros, zapłaciła 4.7 miliona dolarów za kupno tego tytułu. 
https://gamerant.com/wuchang-fallen-feathers-sold-digital-bros/

[Silent Whispers]
Niedługo zadebiutuje darmowa gra napędzana UE5 poświęcona romansom. Gameplay ma bardzo dużo wyświetleń, demo też cieszy się pewną popularnością. 
https://gamerant.com/new-romance-games-silent-whispers/

[Star Wars: Galactic Racer]
Gra zadebiutuje 6 października na PS5, Xbox i PC. 
https://www.comingsoon.net/games/news/2127131-star-wars-galactic-racer-trailer-sets-release-date-for-video-game

https://gamerant.com/video/star-wars-galactic-racer-official-release-date-reveal-and-pre-order-announcement-trailer/

[Undisputed 2]
Steel City Interactive pracuje nad sequelem swojej pierwszej gry. Nie znam jej, z tego co widziałem zebrała mieszane opinie. Podobno daje dużo frajdy, ale sprawiała też dużo problemów, miała wiele bugów.
https://gamerant.com/undisputed-2-in-development/

[TLoU]
Podobno moduł Multiplayer do TLoU był tak zajebisty, że całe studio w niego grało. Być może reszta również się o tym przekona. Tak, wiem jak działa 98% petycji internetowych, ale czasem się udaje. Sony mogłoby podnieść ten pomysł z podłogi - ostatnio dostali trochę słusznej krytyki, a takie ruchy zawsze dobrze wyglądają. Tym bardziej, że podobno gra jest w znacznej mierze gotowa. 
https://gamerant.com/the-last-of-us-online-best-multiplayer-game-naughty-dog/

https://gamerant.com/the-last-of-us-multiplayer-factions-revive-petition/

[Resident Evil Requiem] 
Reżyser gry podzielił się z nami danymi dotyczącymi preferencji graczy (RE pozwala na wybór perspektywy). Wg Koshi Nakanishi 90% graczy wybiera tryb trzecioosobowy grając Leonem, natomiast 50% pierwszoosobowy grając Grace.
https://gamerant.com/resident-evil-requiem-first-or-third-person-mode/

Także skoro mamy już potwierdzenie DLC, możemy się rozsiąść i czekać. 
https://gamerant.com/resident-evil-requiem-story-dlc-update/

[Blood of Dawnwalker]
Podobno Polska gra ma takie wymagania sprzętowe, że kod gry wbija się w nią swoimi zębami i doi ile wlezie. Nie wiem, czy żart mi wyszedł, ale podobno gra jest naprawdę ładna i wymagająca - NVIDIA podzieliła się danymi. Twórcy mówią też, że ma wystarczyć graczom na dłużej niż Witcher i CP2077. Trzymam za słowo! 

Poza tym, z racji że premiera już niedługo, dostaliśmy trailer, zobaczyliśmy Edycję Kolekcjonerską oraz dostaliśmy opis mechanik romantycznych. Premiera 3 września na Xbox, PC i PS5. 
https://gamerant.com/blood-dawnwalker-max-settings-specs-pc/

https://gamerant.com/the-blood-of-dawnwalker-official-collectors-edition-overview-trailer/

https://gamerant.com/video/the-blood-of-dawnwalker-official-story-trailer/

https://gamerant.com/blood-dawnwalker-time-calendar-romance-how-works/

[The Blair Witch Project] 
Poznaliśmy nazwisko reżysera, który przygotuje również scenariusz. Choć nazwisko nie jest zbyt znane, przynajmniej dla mnie, to jego inny projekt daje pewne nadzieje, co do jakości filmu (doświadczeni twórcy / producenci finansują jego projekt).
https://www.comingsoon.net/movies/news/2127126-the-blair-witch-project-reboot-update-excite-fans-of-original

[Resident Evil]
Choć rozumiem narzekania fanów i miłośników horrorów, to rozumiem też filmowców. Czasem trudno jest zrobić adaptację jakieś historii, widząc jej gigantyczne dziedzictwo. Nie mówię, że tak jest w przypadku RE, aczkolwiek nie jestem jej fanem, więc nie mogę się wypowiedzieć. Tak czy siak, byłoby fajnie gdyby miłośnicy gier dostali również film w 100% dla siebie. Premiera 18 września tego roku.
https://www.comingsoon.net/movies/features/2127108-resident-evil-trailer-shows-controversial-choice-is-paying-off

https://www.comingsoon.net/movies/trailers/2127037-resident-evil-teaser-trailer-zach-cregger-intense-horror-movie

Reżyser wypowiedział się również na temat tego, dlaczego w jego filmie nie będzie Leona. Była bardzo szczera - chciał stworzyć film, w którym będzie idiota jak on. 
https://www.comingsoon.net/movies/news/2127327-resident-evil-director-reveals-why-leon-kennedy-isnt-in-movie

[Mortal Kombat 2]
Z reguły ignoruje takie predykcje, ale tym razem mam trochę informacji. Były pokazy testowe i fani są generalnie niezadowoleni. Podobno film ma podobny poziom co poprzedni, czyli niski, ale... Za to jest trochę więcej komedii. Oh wow, jest tyle fajnych elementów, które mogliby zmienić, a skupili się na tych mniej istotnych. Obejrzę ten film, ale jak trafi na streaming. Mam nadzieję, że to będzie przynajmniej dobry, śmieciowy film. Jak Venom 2 albo nadchodzący Street Fighter. 
https://www.comingsoon.net/movies/features/2127175-mortal-kombat-2-rotten-tomatoes-rating-prediction-rt-score

Panie reżyserze, ja nie chcę fanserwisu. To znaczy chcę, ale nie kosztem filmu. Napisz dobry scenariusz, przemyśl go i popraw, potem zrób film i w trakcie dodaj jakieś bzdury dla fanów. Tak, bzdury, jeśli podstawy nie działają, to te \

body.body:
No más leer la pregunta del título, me enganché 🤭

Quienes tenemos arraigo a la lectura entendemos lo que implica y la influencia pasiva o activa que ejerce. Digo pasiva porque puede que haya alguien que lea por gusto y hasta allí, sin preocuparse por enriquecer el vocabulario o por aprovechar lo que lee para mejorar su cosmovisión. Pero hay otros que si nos tomemos la lectura más en serio y encontremos sabores y aromas que enriquezcan y nutran el intelecto y el verbo. Quizás sea un manera abstracta de expresarlo pero eso pienso. 

Para mí leer ha Sido justamente una manera de mantenerme al día con los giros de la sociedad, el intelecto, los altibajos de la historia, lecciones del pasado, experiencias que marcan... El primer libro que leí fue La Biblia. Mi mamá supo cómo enamorarme de las letras. Desde entonces es un placer tener un libro a la mano y así no me enganche, al menos saber de que se trata porque un libro no tiene por qué ser bueno para mí para ser bueno. 

Perdí la cuenta de los libros y novelas que he leído. Es algo que me gusta tanto que por poner un ejemplo, \
me lo devoré en tres días. Otros títulos realmente buenos que me dejaron huella fueron \

.... Y un laaaaargo excetera.\n\nY no, en mi caso no leo para creerme mejor que otros, leo primero porque soy adicto a esa vaina 😅, y segundo porque me gusta refinar mi vocabulario. Después de todo, no es malo. El secreto esta en mantener una actitud equilibrada y saber expresarse sin ser creído ni patán.

body.title: A welcome rain shower for the garden and some nice growth #gardenjournal
body.body: It has been two weeks ago since I have posted my last #hivegarden #gardenjournal. I use these update posts to see how much things have grown over the weeks between the posts. And things are growing quite fast here in spring. We've had quite some sunny days in the past two weeks and the rain showers we had today and yesterday in the evening were quite welcome for my garden. The lovely pink blossom of the crabapple that started two weeks ago has almost disappeared. The tree was visited by hundreds of bees. When I was standing under the tree it was almost like the sound of a drone. Now, after two weeks and some heavy rainfall in the weekend, it lost a lot of its blossoms. It was good for the rest of the garden though. And the purple ceanothus took over. ![ceaothus.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/242hL3TLbrx1kA6hA8oU41JTUjP1nBXNXftgN35vVCmcfShYtVVvdjUUmFTKUVHN3vMJt.png) ![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png) As I already said in the introduction; a lot can happen in just two weeks. Here are my Oxeye plants from two weeks ago and last weekend. They grow so quickly. It won't be long until they will start to grow their lovely yellow flowers. | Two weeks ago| Last weekend| |------|--------| |![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23xVKF6Dtjd5UYLXajYHEjH6Ypaw9TqXE1RQsKA1b5iKpVWPASYH9sZ6PC45XU7LZaBgW.png)|

>|
 
I am trying to grow more Oxeye plants from the seed I collected last year. Quite a lot of them have germinated, but they grow slowly. I also put a lot of seeds together in one space, so it might be a bit hard so separate them. I don't dare to yet since they still look so fragile.
I wonder if I have to keep the lid on the greenhouse or not. Anyone tips?

![oxeye.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/EonkzmQyYjXG46ThDQ2dLACLrcF2Cm9ivf4ZyDmVvPu4bxLpXkFsKnxJTAGe5r32A3P.png)

![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png)

The other seedlings are doing quite well. The cucumbers have been standing behind glass in the blazing sun for a while. You can tell they really took a hit judging by the yellow leaves. But I watered them quite a bit and they do seem to grow bigger now. I see secondary leaves already.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23x16t2SQSUVtcUHNJcEeyVhnK3bnrgaaGSQswEdzDywuMxDbn8d9KQxZ3m3cQTKeY7Dy.png)

The peppers are growing slowly, but they are growing.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23xKraQRUrux2PmhjczMvpA1jG9J3n1UCAUsNWU4DaC7qWG7LSJpSZgDyN9btyP7X8Gbo.png)

Same goes for the tomatoes.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23yTf8Qse2qbF8xVgXJbKvHGwmQDRgifMgRE4XH7v8o8zGmcYxXwjbK59LgLgztX8xGzk.png)

![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png)

Maybe you remember I seeded wildflower mix in my backyard last time. These have germinated quite well as you can see in the photo below. I'm really curious what this will look like in a few weeks.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/EogMsN6tERYwX6cVWV7KB7gmZXYDWTZjV1aMvtfbL4j5HQnsgxu9t3HJbWtekBV3g1g.png)

![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png)

# Nephentes Monkey Jars
Another nice comparison to make is from my Nephentes Monkey Jars pitcher plant. Although my two plants only have one pitcher that is actually growing, it is growing quite rapidly. It's almost the size of my pink (and I have quite big hands 😂).

| Two weeks ago| Last weekend|
|------|--------|
|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23uFXnFqXnSvrnfBYw9v9eJuJmRxVAH6KM7QZLd7s3zTGVngMVmsr6UMnq1t4jrWt12p8.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23vi6UfaEGTLcgSC52jQHE3cfTEcWjthyenVZvUhnEWosAFpX7Qp5uPMfzxAKt1RpwFQe.png)|

![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png)

# Propagation
I'm also trying to propagate some indoor plants. [Last time](https://peakd.com/hive-140635/@friendlymoose/my-garden-in-spring-fresh-growth-and-blooming-trees) I've removed two shoots from a succulent. I left them to dry in for a couple of days and planted them in propagation soil. 
They seem to be doing quite well, aren't they?

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23ywuFgGX4GHR3Jxj9L2kmbgwrPVVGWzrUrSfNnocMR6jLFgzvCnUQBCdeZBsuJEfUGhN.png)

One of the other projects is another succulent. It is really growing slowly, but it's just cool to see it forms a new plant just from a leaf I cut off from the mother plant. I held the tip of a ballpoint next to it so you can get a reference of its size.  

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23vsG6JFxWEuUjGh8SGmUGzpNaeXWoDQjJbSA47DrzdHR3kH6fpAmfbn4Y5XYKjYUg2Qq.png)

Finally I've cut off a long stem of my Scindapsus Pictus Trebie, cut it into small parts and put it in water. These plants have so-called air roots. Little brown nodes near the leaves. When you put that into the water it starts to grow new roots by itself. As you can see, the cuttings are growing new roots already.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23yJNy6VmpjxTD9F2KG8yjwSDaWzywHmT31Tkxd6vSCBWGGVPmeoHdhHcXyKtbKYZBFu8.png)

![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png)

So this was it for now. I’d love to hear your thoughts on my update in the comments.

![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png)

body.title: Fins on Pot Arribar en Doge?
body.body:
Era una vegada un gos Shiba Inu anomenat Doge que no es conformava amb bordar als carters. Un dia, mirant les estrelles des del seu sofà de memecoins, va dir: «Wow, such universe, very far». I va decidir que ell, el rei dels doges, aniria fins al límit de tot el que existeix.

Primer va creuar el barri saltant sobre piles de bitcoins abandonats. Després va travessar Europa amb un coet fet de tendències de Twitter i cafè de Reddit. «To the moon!», cridava la gent, però en Doge va respondre: «Moon? Too close, much boring». I va seguir cap a Mart, on va plantar una bandera amb la cara de Elon Musk i va canviar els marcians a Dogecoin.

Però no es va aturar. Va travessar forats negres jugant a fetch amb asteroides, va negociar amb aliens que volien comprar la seva cara per fer NFTs intergalàctics i va arribar al límit de l’univers observable. Allà, un científic molt seriós li va dir: «Aquí s’acaba tot, gos». En Doge va inclinar el cap, va fer el seu somriure etern i va contestar: «Such limit? Very temporary».

Llavors va fer un salt quàntic, va trencar les regles de la física i va arribar al multivers. En un univers era president, en un altre era déu dels gossos, i en un tercer venia pizzes a preus de 2017. Quan li van preguntar fins on pensava arribar, en Doge va remenar la cua i va bordar: «To infinity and beyond… and then a little further, because wow».

I així, mentre els humans discutíem si pujaria o baixaria, en Doge ja era a llocs on ni la llum havia arribat, cobrant impostos en memecoins i fent que tot l’univers digués «much respect». Perquè si hi ha una cosa clara, és que amb en Doge… els límits sempre fan «very sad face».

There’s also a policy tailwind in the background from the [Clarity Act progress / crypto regulation narrative](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/05/04/circle-coinbase-lead-crypto-stock-rally-amid-clarity-act-progress-bitcoin-above-usd80-000), which is helping the whole sector bid up.\n\nOn InLeo, people are reading it the same way: [@rajitfi](https://inleo.io/threads/view/rajitfi/re-raxhi-1777985492) called it “classic momentum,” and [@guruzg](https://inleo.io/threads/view/guruzg/re-raxhi-1777984548) tied it to broader BTC-led market stress and liquidity. So yeah, scary pump — but not random. It’s mostly HIVE catching a very fast-moving crypto tailwind, which is great on the way up and rude as hell on the way back down.

body.title: The Days That Changed Me: My Work Immersion Story (Day 3-6)
body.body: > **The Days That Changed Me: My Work Immersion Story (Day 3-6)** ![THE DAYS THAT CHANGED ME MY WORK IMMERSION STORY (DAY 3-6).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23yx8JRAT9Pwaghtn1bYcvNC4FP8NjxopEaLNMiw76tuW6f7NLw6thwck5zYEvPAEcbWZ.png) Good day, my dearest Hive friends! I would like to share with you the rest of my immersion journey (Day 3-6). If you haven't read the first two parts yet, please read them first before continuing with this one. **Day 3** ![THE DAYS THAT CHANGED ME MY WORK IMMERSION STORY (DAY 3-6) (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23xLDm464Dos82DbYEyQ5wHhiQymv15DtgrgEGFQQwi2nte7h1JjAMprdn7qDXKVv3KdP.png) On the third day, we started learning more about electrical topics and had a short quiz about the history of CEBECO II and some electrical stuffs. We were asked to draw a one-way switch diagram, and although we didn't know how to make it at first, we searched for references and asked help from our EIM classmate. ![Screenshot 2026-05-05 201327.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23tbvx49xGH83cfvVJQwKCSNtf7jYDBkkxFEYYavZQaZUNFqQHC6jqfQiCZSaXUSjiizZ.png) In the afternoon, we discussed basic electricity, which felt like a physics class. After the discussion, we took another test that felt like a board exam. I actually thought that the exam was a prank, huhu. Thankfully, I passed even though it was challenging. **CLASS SUSPENDED** ![THE DAYS THAT CHANGED ME MY WORK IMMERSION STORY (DAY 3-6) (3).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23x1SX9NNtLokfx2DHCSn8mH7vHTqxXC58qW7VTSQ4iHDArqiUUvaaxjAbysabmiVeqi2.png) The supposed Day 4 and Day 5 of our immersion didn't continue because there was a typhoon. On Day 4, we were supposed to visit CEBECO, but one school wasn’t allowed to attend because their principal said it wasn’t safe due to the weather. So in the end, all of us were told to just go home. At that time, it honestly didn't even feel like there was a typhoon, it was actually really hot. Because of that, my friends and I decided to go out instead. We went to Bogo Plaza and ate at Mang Inasal. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23vsNbCYFkw9asyvTohpEyfwfEU9t7DCTF7bRszWspetLydf7xYmh4bCizG3z3vazcap1.png) The funny part is, since most of our money was already spent at Mang Inasal, we decided to save money afterward. So we looked for a free ride. My friends even told me a “tip”—just give a thumbs-upp to passing vehicles, and if someone stops, it means they’re willing to let you ride for free. **Day 4** ![THE DAYS THAT CHANGED ME MY WORK IMMERSION STORY (DAY 3-6) (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23xLDm464Dos82DbYEyQ5wHhiQymv15DtgrgEGFMeCrGvgsnQpmCEffNbcmNGYNNkwnJC.png) On Day 4, we began actual wiring activities, which made the experience more exciting. One of our instructors taught us how to create single pole and three-way diagrams and apply them to real wiring. ![5b510c93-cdc6-4eff-9ddc-fad5f2821584.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/EoEqXZ8bPVj5V2cHZ4qWntY4kt9LnupgvzYUh3Hu6L9GaSyMBfo3MBEux58hXDCi7Zs.jpg) I was paired with Shray, and we worked together to connect the wires properly. I felt nervous because I was scared of getting electrocuted and worried that we might not light the bulb. Fortunately, we successfully lit the bulb, and I felt proudd of our teamwork. **Day 5** ![THE DAYS THAT CHANGED ME MY WORK IMMERSION STORY (DAY 3-6) (4).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23xLDm464Dos82DbYEyQ5wHhiQymv15DtgrgDqCEvb3Zn4Wp3NgAj4ZHyfJZAxrLR4C1F.png) Day 5 was more relaxed because only a few students attended due to heavy rain. Sir Rowell was busy, but he still took time to teach us whenever he was available. ![3a72e37d-ffe9-4530-a17c-5ea848284647.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23wC9vU3Gu9tMgjJnCm53FvAoXJYvUF7zagctneNpuNH1K3zuNhn5k44HDDXnWFrpLi1P.jpg) He asked us to draw diagrams individually to test our understanding. I was able to draw mine without looking at references. After finishing, I asked my friends to check if my workk was correct. **Day 6** ![THE DAYS THAT CHANGED ME MY WORK IMMERSION STORY (DAY 3-6) (5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23xLDm464Dos82DbYEyQ5wHhiQymv15DtgrgDqCEvb3Zn4Wp3NgAj4ZHyfJXWGHS2DcdK.png) Day 6 was our final exam day, and the testt focused on electrical diagrams. We were unsure if our answers were correct, but we did our best. After the exam, we relaxed while there was a meeting in the venue hall. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23xAXuGuo3fxtvLMXgA85hc4oH4RkGCD9SZUf1Wyjp9Ch2iqxxmv9L48Y6g2CSnQJdGi4.png) In the afternoon, we continued our wiring activity with our partners. It was also Sir Rowell's last day teaching us, which made the day a little memorable. **THANK YOU FOR READING!**

body.title: Navigating in a digital-era ecosystem and leading global changes
body.body:
Whether your brand is looking to capitalize on how people are engaging with their audiences, digital platforms within China delineate a pathway. This transformation revolves around the [social media Chinese platforms](https://eastwardmedia.com/chinese-social-media-marketing/), which are an ecosystem that unites entertainment, commerce, and communication, thus enriching our propensities of economic behavior.

Western platforms tend to separate social networking from e-commerce, but Chinese environments are designed for immediate and transactional engagement. According to users, it allows them to find everything from product discovery and live demonstrations to reviews and then complete the purchase seamlessly from within an app. Such integration spotlights not only a user bean change, but one toward an ease-of-use way of living that organizations in North America are beginning to get behind.



![AdobeStock_432765619-768x512.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/6b5630c4194f4a3b42f593ccdee9e31414f462343cc0a0ea03a2eef260ee780f)



An essential strength of social media Chinese tactics is their use of immersive content. Users are then busier paying attention to short-form videos, live shows, and interactive posts. Gone are the days when brands posted only static visuals or queued up thousands of posts; today, they create engaging stories that change dynamically in real-time. Such a format encourages more involvement, with the audience becoming active rather than passive consumers of information.

One additional standout element is the impact of digital characters. Content creators OR streamers ➔ Influencers because they allow clients to play. This is important because their recommendations are more impactful since they create continuous interaction with their audiences. For businesses dipping their toes in the water of social media Chinese tactics, it highlights the need to earn trust, rather than relying on one-off promotion campaigns.

Community interaction is equally critical. Interactive comment sections, group chats with Wild West-style conversations, and user-generated content all foster a collective digital culture that allows opinions to spread quickly. The brands that prosper in social media spaces in China are those that take part in a conversation with consumers, responding to feedback and facilitating dialogue. This is a two-way communication model that is far contrasted from the older broadcast style of marketing.

Data is continuously impacting strategies as well. The platform makes use of data training and analyzes user behavior, in turn serving highly personalized content. Different regions have different expectations when it comes to privacy, but at the core of this belief is a solid truth: by really knowing what your audience wants, and responding quickly, you can boost engagement and conversion rates.

On top of that, this ecosystem is very fast; it is one of the fastest. Trends live and die in days, so brands need to keep up. Campaigns are regularly iterated on and re-launched in quick succession. Businesses that apply the lessons learned in Chinese environments tend to be more experimental, moving from rigid planning to prioritizing flexibility.

As for organizations in the US and Canada, these systems are not to be fully copied but rather followed for their highest-performing components. Digital presence can be improved by combining shopping with content, creating real influencer partnerships, and assisting in real-time interaction.

Social media Chinese innovation influence expands as global audiences are growing accustomed to interactivity and personalization. Brands are expected to take note of this development since it is essential for them to retain relevance, competitiveness, and connectivity in the growing digital world.

Steve Haynes is the author of this article. To know more details about [Chinese programmatic display in Canada](https://eastwardmedia.com/programmatic-display/), please visit our website: eastwardmedia.com.

body.body:
<center>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/23y8gxjhirXCjfeZ7mzXwqHAuviYGtY8g7Npghywut5XZYkDfRheEtUcDaz6n3Wkb69Y5.png</center>
<sbr>

<div class ='text-justify'>

Aha, it's Tuesday. That means Three Tunes by Ablaze, and today's spotlight goes to Sia, an acclaimed Australian singer, songwriter, and music video director with powerful vocals and massive pop hits. She is also known for wearing large wigs to obscure her face during the peak of her career. 

She started as a singer in the band \

in the 90's, then went on as a solo artist when the group disbanded, releasing 5 studio albums, then shifting to writing songs for other artists (i.e., Beyoncé, Rihanna, Flo Rida). The first tune below was released in 2014 as the lead single for her album 1000 Forms of Fear. ### Chandelier
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2vjPBrBU-TM
Accordingly, the electropop ballad was initially written for Rihanna or Beyoncé, but she decided to record the song herself. I'd say it was a good decision as it became her first single to appear on the US Billboard Hot 100, peaking at #8. It also reached 5th on the record charts in 20 countries, and received 4 nominations in the Grammy Awards. It went viral and became the 7th most viewed (watched) video on YouTube in 2014.[*(¹)*](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chandelier_(song)) I suppose most people have heard of this song. The next tune is also a popular dance-pop, written by Sia herself. ### Titanium
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JRfuAukYTKg
Accordingly, Sia recorded a demo and sent it to other artists. It was offered to Katy Perry, but the artist turned it down, then a twist happened. Unbeknownst to the singer, Guetta released her demo vocals for his album Nothing but the Beat.[*(²)*](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Titanium_(David_Guetta_song)) Anyway, I love Sia's soaring vocals, the pulsating beat that gives the song that \

feeling, which makes one wanna get up and dance. And last but certainly not least is a song that topped the US Billboard Hot 100, becoming the singer's first number one single and Sean Paul's. ### Cheap Thrills (ft. Sean Paul)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nYh-n7EOtMA
It won the APRA Music Awards of 2019 and 2020, and the Most Played Australian Work Overseas in the APRA Music Awards of 2018. It topped other charts and reached Platinum and Diamond status in various countries. It was Italy's best-selling and highest-certified single by a female artist, receiving Diamond certification, making Sia the first female artist to achieve such a status. [*(³)*](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cheap_Thrills_(song)) Anyhow, I like the vibrant, more upbeat, and \

of this dance-hall pop track. And with that, let me end this week's participation in the TTT edition. --- ---
*Lead photo is a screenshot of her [YT Channel](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCN9HPn2fq-NL8M5_kp4RWZQ) profile pic. No copyright infringement intended. 05052026/20:50ph*
