title.title: Painting in freedom (oil on cardboard)
title.body:
Hello hivers, an happy Tuesday to you all! Today here it's raining since soon in the morning and all the leaves in my backyard are full of little raindrops. It's good because we had a lot of sunny days and so the Nature needs a little water from the sky. 😊 My furry friends Nanny and Bimba are not happy about the weather and they are sleeping hard on theyr warm blankets on my sofa for the most part of the day. This morning, as usual, I woke up soon and, after I gave food to my cats and after my first cup of coffee of the day, I placed myself in front of my working table. I have no new ideas for my artworks and, mayve cause the bad weather, I felt myself at a low level of energy so I decided to painting something in freedom. I took some scraps of cardboard from an old box I have inside my lab room and my hands were free to run on them. In the following pic you can see the result: ![DSCN0119.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EowJXau9yZBiHUXdC877gnivZ5L5sDrbVyuvRHXpRgU1sFyXPpAkAdi3bKEx39yyXD2.JPG) Maybe when I will be painted some other ones I'll make a sort of book with them or maybe I'll use them for an artwork, but now I'm having fun and relax working on them They are oil colors paintings and I took some pics while I was working on them so you can see the process too: ![DSCN0115.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EowH1u7T8iz2k4LKMMRC55885v1kJpEWE4gV8K29SAmDKUaJyiYR43w4DAtfdtzSzuL.JPG) ![DSCN0116.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EoAbE84wq35fEtmpgTS8DyRufnVt3pUdo116i2kXFAoSh518fKBXF4iQLSQxp6U8B8E.JPG) ![DSCN0117.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/Eoke1vmv3w97UNm8vpueEotpC7wiB8rk9mDBDNHbWYu8c4WjEFYmJYrWZabzQ1se58Q.JPG) I hope you like it! See ya soon and stay safe, Silvia

title.title: Cinnamon Cheese Toast
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaA1vH4dRxGUZgwsDGdhgLBjeQUn4yPUnqk7zx4RWj2xJ/1777984624029.png)

Hi bloggers and food lovers! Have a great day, everyone. Today I’m sharing a delicious breakfast recipe to kickstart your day, it’s simple and uses easily accessible ingredients. I absolutely love the rich aroma of cinnamon, so this time I’m making cinnamon toast that’s perfect to enjoy with coffee in the morning. Let’s get started!

**Ingredients:**

- 6 slices of white bread
- 1 tbsp margarine
- 2 tbsp ground cinnamon
- Mozzarella cheese
- 1 egg
- 70 ml milk
- a pinch of salt
- 1/2 tsp vanilla extract 
- a mixture of sugar and ground cinnamon

**Instructions:**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmagTwtvkuPgoHMYU1DeQQJkZBaUWFCfQqFZKmcSvW2yBM/1777984664656.jpg)

- Trim the crusts off the white bread, leaving only the white part

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaMbagb8PvshMaR2i84ApmcEceJGfHW4sQTujReu7rBNp/1777984685812.jpg)

- Roll out the white bread with a rolling pin or whatever you have on hand

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWVDJkHPzxd6p62HnYE8WW2sRjKEc9THmyhfEUuccntBR/1777984703719.jpg)

- Prepare the margarine and ground cinnamon

- Mix until well combined

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNyCkfZbEzcUFV6ZM9JRdr1AV7VFqj8THrTsmwTSkFfbo/1777984721555.jpg)

- Spread the mixture over the flattened white bread slices

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmePB8XK9cEVZjKy1r6NedvGVm9ReXcHq6gNxTfQtsHSfo/1777984735500.jpg)

- Add slices of mozzarella cheese on top

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQxn774UxtHBEwqvoQcAEAb1AkBvPkDj4h2wS3Hw9dx23/1777984761857.jpg)

- Roll up the bread

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRtx98kBUa15RrjdJXHN65QTiuyYsCcKC7LnX6m1RqoMN/1777984779984.jpg)

- Repeat the same process for the remaining five slices of bread

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdJa9z68WvitaYbhWsz9J5dSYPVEXNdfD4EWiYuLki1Nb/1777984791917.jpg)

- Crack the egg into a bowl

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVwipuZNzgPrnN4o66WQEUnM6TRh9DNGgVPUQTUVuUjki/1777984811970.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTZcxQiBERHJg4ruYPW1DoKmP4eyRRH5UxfWykRRU6TWW/1777984812176.jpg)

- Add the milk and vanilla extract

- Add a pinch of salt

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPKfDrYzGhmh4AzyREVdJuzcGxjyUJoZ6FPtjubFSZqcv/1777984828718.jpg)

- Whisk the egg and milk mixture until well combined

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeaXZenojdw2tdjo6rZi6g7BJMRxshuf8YBorewu76hsC/1777984853880.jpg)

- Dip the bread rolls into the egg and milk mixture

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYBnKeVHApe8BMkYpEzoGWjaMm7zf4hfZ8EqXKk7aCq8G/1777984867721.jpg)

- Heat a pan greased with margarine

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQUQixTWEVjLq5iPcopHDChiZvvvLqkzpvL6AHhwt1k7j/1777984887745.jpg)

- Fry the dipped bread rolls

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXbQ2mJqT919jt1xGPc2JXrucBzgmzuXpwEUbiQVfuS2H/1777984902314.jpg)

- Fry until cooked through and golden brown

- Repeat until all the bread rolls are cooked

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcQKK8HKHGdG5ANfnMFyfxh46YsPiiqw26B5dow1MeW3h/1777984923516.jpg)

- Sprinkle the fried bread rolls with a mixture of sugar and ground cinnamon

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX1DYtFaKjFzNZdmcH52ouoyJdU1GZJsn6rCx1hx3nDzZ/1777984945796.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWW9X1zBKAaA3ajPWx8yeC5NZfHagQvNZQMjwFRdnERNP/1777984946222.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQFZTXBx2g1BkDVoYpkyBnAUDrL1rXLdvU64K2mXT2u37/1777985006433.jpg)

- Serve while warm and enjoy with a hot cup of coffee

Exceptional Vertical Real Estate – USA • Monaco • Dubai • Morocco • Israel

## Why Luxury Residential Towers Have Become the Ultimate Choice for High-Net-Worth Individuals in 2026

In 2026, luxury residential towers stand as the pinnacle of modern high-end living. These iconic skyscrapers go far beyond impressive height and striking architecture — they deliver a complete, seamless vertical lifestyle that combines breathtaking panoramic views, uncompromising security, world-class 5-star services, and the latest smart-home technology all under one exclusive roof.

Ultra-high-net-worth buyers from around the globe are increasingly turning to these towers instead of traditional villas or estates. The reasons are compelling: effortless access to sky-high wellness facilities such as infinity pools, private spas and yoga studios, 24/7 concierge teams that anticipate every need, and a highly curated community of like-minded residents. Living in a luxury residential tower means enjoying privacy and convenience without any of the maintenance burdens that come with large standalone properties.

This ultimate guide provides the most comprehensive and up-to-date exploration of the five leading global destinations for luxury residential towers. We examine the United States with its record-breaking New York supertalls, Monaco and the legendary Tour Odéon, Dubai’s futuristic skyline, Morocco’s booming Casablanca market, and Israel where Tel Aviv has rapidly become the Mediterranean’s most exciting luxury tower destination. Each section offers deep project analysis, unique features, strong investment rationale, 2026 market trends, and practical advice for serious buyers.

### The Key Advantages That Make Luxury Residential Towers Irresistible in 2026

*   24/7 concierge and full 5-star hotel-style services including private chefs, chauffeurs, yacht charters and personal assistants

*   Advanced biometric security systems combined with round-the-clock professional surveillance teams

*   Altitude wellness amenities: infinity pools, private spas, hammams, yoga studios, sky gardens and state-of-the-art fitness centers

*   Cutting-edge smart-home technology featuring voice control, automated lighting, independent climate systems and full home automation

*   Unobstructed 360° panoramic views over sea, parks, rivers or legendary city skylines

*   Strong and consistent annual appreciation ranging from +8% to +15% on the most premium markets worldwide

*   Internationally recognized environmental certifications including LEED Platinum, HQE and BREEAM Excellent

*   Highly profitable short-term and seasonal rental opportunities supported by dedicated on-site management teams

*   Exclusive resident communities that offer networking opportunities, privacy and a shared luxury lifestyle

Investing in a luxury residential tower is far more than acquiring real estate — it is about securing a rare lifestyle asset that delivers daily enjoyment, peace of mind and excellent long-term value. With limited inventory and steadily growing global demand, these properties continue to offer outstanding liquidity and strong resale potential in 2026.

![Luxury apartment interior renovation in Tel Aviv tower - modern white design, open plan living room and kitchen with contemporary furniture and large windows](https://readdy.ai/api/search-image?query=luxury%20apartment%20interior%20renovation%20in%20Tel%20Aviv%20tower%20modern%20white%20design%20open%20plan%20living%20room%20kitchen%20contemporary%20furniture%20large%20windows&width=800&height=500&seq=blog2a&orientation=landscape)

**Stunning modern interior of a luxury apartment inside a Tel Aviv residential tower** – Bright open-plan living room and kitchen with contemporary design, expansive windows, and breathtaking city views, typical of the exclusive high-end residences featured throughout this guide.

## United States: New York and the Supertalls of Billionaires’ Row

The United States, and Manhattan in particular, remains the undisputed global leader in luxury residential towers. Billionaires’ Row has become the most prestigious address on earth, home to the tallest and most exclusive supertalls that attract ultra-wealthy buyers from every continent who seek the ultimate combination of prestige, views and services.

Central Park Tower, standing at 472 meters, is currently the tallest residential tower in the world. Its carefully limited collection of only 179 apartments offers direct, unobstructed views of Central Park, the Hudson River and the iconic Empire State Building. Each residence features ceilings higher than 4 meters, Bulthaup kitchens, Carrara marble bathrooms and private access to an extraordinary sky club on the 100th floor that includes an indoor pool, a sprawling 10,000 m² spa, a private cinema and a temperature-controlled wine cellar.

432 Park Avenue continues to set the standard for refined minimalism with residences ranging from 300 to over 1,000 m² and dramatic floor-to-ceiling glass walls that flood the spaces with natural light. Residents enjoy full hotel service, an ultra-modern fitness center and a concierge team capable of arranging anything from private jet charters to personal shopping experiences. The ultra-slim Steinway Tower at 111 West 57th Street completes this elite trio with its handcrafted finishes and exceptional architectural elegance.

Beyond these headline projects, New York’s luxury tower market continues to deliver outstanding performance. These properties have achieved an average value increase of 48% over the past five years. In 2026, demand remains exceptionally strong, driven by international buyers seeking economic stability, high liquidity and the unmatched prestige of a New York address. The combination of resilient economic fundamentals and favorable tax structures for foreign investors makes American luxury residential towers one of the safest and most rewarding long-term choices available today.

**Investment Outlook 2026:** With limited new supply and sustained international interest, prices in Billionaires’ Row are expected to continue their upward trajectory, making now an excellent time to secure one of these rare vertical residences.

## Monaco: Tour Odéon, the Timeless Icon of the Principality

In the heart of Monaco, Tour Odéon continues to reign as the most prestigious and desirable luxury residential tower in Europe. Rising 170 meters, this striking double-tower development contains just 259 ultra-exclusive residences. The crown jewel is the spectacular Sky Penthouse spanning 3,500 m² across five levels, complete with its own private swimming pool, water slide and a panoramic terrace offering 360° views of the Mediterranean Sea and the historic Rock of Monaco.

Every apartment is finished to the absolute highest standards with 5-star hotel service, 24-hour concierge support, private spas, personal cinemas and interiors created by the world’s leading designers. Tour Odéon masterfully blends classic Monegasque elegance with bold modern architecture. Its prime location — only minutes from the Casino, Port Hercules and the finest luxury boutiques — makes it the perfect address for those who want to be at the very center of Monaco’s refined lifestyle.

Investors are strongly attracted to Monaco’s legendary tax advantages, including zero income tax for residents, together with unparalleled security and consistent year-after-year property appreciation. In 2026 the demand for residences in Tour Odéon remains exceptionally high among royal families, successful entrepreneurs and dedicated connoisseurs of the Principality who fully understand the unique and enduring value of owning a piece of Monaco’s vertical skyline.

**Investment Outlook 2026:** With extremely limited inventory and steady international demand, Tour Odéon residences continue to be among the most sought-after and stable luxury real estate assets in Europe.

## Dubai: The Global Capital of Futuristic Luxury Residential Towers

Dubai stands unchallenged as the world capital of futuristic luxury residential towers. From the world-famous Burj Khalifa to the groundbreaking developments along Dubai Marina, each tower represents a true masterpiece of architecture, engineering and innovation. The Burj Khalifa residences, located from the 19th to the 108th floor, deliver the ultimate prestige with jaw-dropping views and exclusive Armani Casa service.

Other landmark towers such as the Princess Tower and Marina 101 offer spacious layouts finished with premium marble, 24-carat gold accents and the latest smart-home technology. Exciting new 2026 projects include the Pininfarina-designed Iconic Tower, branded residences from Bugatti and Elie Saab, and innovative sky-bridges featuring suspended infinity pools. These developments consistently attract an international clientele that appreciates modernity, security and impressive rental yields that often reach 8 to 10% per year.

Dubai’s zero income tax policy, exceptional quality of life and sustained population growth further strengthen the investment case. A luxury residential tower in Dubai continues to be one of the most dynamic and rewarding opportunities in the global real estate market for 2026 and beyond.

**Investment Outlook 2026:** With strong rental demand and continuous new branded projects, Dubai luxury towers remain a top performer for both capital appreciation and income generation.

## Morocco: The Remarkable Rise of Luxury Residential Towers in Casablanca

Morocco is currently experiencing one of the most dynamic booms in vertical luxury real estate across North Africa and the Mediterranean region. In Casablanca, flagship projects such as the Marine Towers, the developments within Casa Finance City and branded residences from Elie Saab and other leading international names are rapidly transforming the city skyline. These towers deliver spacious apartments with sweeping Atlantic Ocean terraces, infinity pools, beautifully landscaped parks and full five-star services.

Buyers are drawn by Morocco’s strong and sustained economic growth, highly favorable taxation for foreign investors, Mediterranean lifestyle, environmentally certified buildings and convenient geographic proximity to Europe. Luxury residential towers in Casablanca offer an ideal solution for both second homes and high-yield rental investments, providing the perfect balance of modern comfort and rich cultural heritage.

**Investment Outlook 2026:** With increasing international interest and limited high-end supply, Casablanca’s luxury tower segment is positioned for continued strong growth and attractive returns.

## Israel: Tel Aviv, the Rising Mediterranean Jewel of Luxury Residential Towers

Tel Aviv, proudly known as the White City and listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site, has quickly established itself as one of the world’s most desirable new destinations for luxury residential towers. Its powerful combination of economic dynamism, vibrant cultural scene, innovative tech ecosystem and stunning Mediterranean coastline creates an irresistible appeal for discerning international buyers seeking both lifestyle and investment value.

Signature luxury towers include Meier on Rothschild designed by Richard Meier, the Yoo Towers by Philippe Starck, the W Tower, Sarona Tower and the prestigious Kempinski Residences. All of these developments offer exceptional sea views, ultra-luxurious finishes, advanced smart-home technology and a sophisticated cosmopolitan lifestyle that perfectly blends modern Israeli innovation with timeless Mediterranean charm.

For the most complete, up-to-date and detailed selection of luxury residential towers in Tel Aviv — including current availability, pricing, sea views, floor plans and full service information — visit the official specialist platform:

[Discover all luxury residential towers in Tel Aviv → TLV Towers](https://tlv-towers.com/)

These properties represent a unique and timely investment opportunity in a fast-growing, forward-thinking city that successfully combines cutting-edge innovation, world-class security and an enviable Mediterranean quality of life.

**Investment Outlook 2026:** Tel Aviv’s luxury tower market continues to benefit from strong local and international demand, making it one of the most promising emerging luxury real estate destinations in the Mediterranean region.

## Ready to Live at the Pinnacle of Luxury in 2026?

Luxury residential towers in the USA, Monaco, Dubai, Morocco, and Israel are far more than extraordinary homes. They represent a complete and exclusive way of life, a superior long-term patrimonial investment, and a truly unique vertical lifestyle that is unmatched anywhere else in the world.

Whether you are searching for your primary residence, a luxurious second home, a high-performing investment asset or simply the ultimate lifestyle upgrade, these iconic towers deliver the absolute best in premium real estate. With limited supply, growing global demand and consistently strong appreciation, 2026 is the perfect time to explore and secure one of the world’s finest luxury residential towers.

title.title: Travala April 2026 Report: Growth, Friction, and the Real Question for Investors
title.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/no-advice/23viJwKfFYvWGZeNb3CwJasXR91EyZVZYu8zLWbtZtB6nHE5Cq2QYVrkyPEXsnAUuB7qC.png)


The latest data from Travala gives us a clear snapshot of where crypto-native travel stands today—and more importantly, where it’s heading.

At first glance, the April 2026 report continues a broader trend: **steady recovery, but not explosive growth**. That’s exactly what you would expect from a platform transitioning from early adoption into a more mature phase.

---

## **📊 The Numbers: MoM vs YoY Reality Check**

Let’s break this down with a rational, investor-grade lens.

### **Month-over-Month (MoM)**

* March 2026 revenue: **~$7.92M**
* April 2026 revenue: **~$7.61M**
* April 2025 revenue: **~$9.10M**

This suggests **a fairly stable revenue**, no growth. That’s important.

Travala is no longer a narrative-only play—it’s becoming an **operational business with seasonality**, similar to traditional travel platforms.

### **Year-over-Year (YoY)**

* April 2026: 1.5M lower compared to peak 2025 levels

This implies a **YoY contraction or stagnation**, which might look bearish at first glance.

But context matters:

* 2024–2025 was a **post-COVID travel rebound peak**
* 2026 reflects **normalization of demand**

From a macro perspective, this is not failure—it’s **mean reversion**.

---

## **🧠 Investor Perspective: Is the Business Model Still Sound?**

Short answer: **Yes—but with caveats.**

### **Strengths**

* Asset-light OTA model (similar to Booking.com)
* Massive inventory: millions of properties, flights, activities 
* Multi-payment rails (crypto + fiat)
* Tokenized loyalty system (AVA)

This combination is powerful. Travala is not trying to replace the travel industry—it’s **plugging crypto into it**.

### **Weaknesses**

* Thin margins (typical for travel aggregators)
* Heavy dependence on external suppliers
* Limited pricing advantage vs Web2 competitors

This is the key insight:

> Travala is not a monopoly protocol like Bitcoin—it is a **competitive marketplace business**.

That means valuation must be grounded in **cash flow potential**, not ideology.

---

## **🪙 AVA Token: Undervalued or Dead Weight?**

Let’s look at the facts.

* Market cap: ~**$20M**
* Utility:

  * Discounts
  * Loyalty rewards
  * staking (Smart Program)
  * governance elements ([Coinbase][5])

### **Bull Case**

* Increasing token lock-up (Smart Program growth)
* Buybacks reduce circulating supply
* Direct link to platform usage

This creates a **closed-loop economy**, which is rare and valuable.

### **Bear Case**

* Demand is **incentive-driven**, not necessity-driven
* Token velocity remains high
* Revenue does not directly accrue to token holders

From a strict financial perspective:

> AVA behaves more like a **loyalty point with market liquidity** than an equity asset.

That’s not bad—but it limits upside unless:

* user growth accelerates significantly, or
* token sinks (staking/locking) become dominant

---

## **🧳 User Perspective: Does Travala Actually Deliver?**

Here’s where things get interesting.

User feedback is generally strong:

* Smooth booking experience
* Wide payment options
* Responsive support

From a user standpoint, Travala solves a real problem:

> **Spending crypto in the real world without friction.**

And that’s where ideology meets utility.

In a world increasingly hostile to financial sovereignty, platforms like Travala provide:

* censorship-resistant payments
* global access
* optionality between fiat and crypto

That’s not just convenience—that’s **freedom infrastructure**.

---

## **🐯 Travel Tiger NFTs: Worth the Investment?**

This is where enthusiasm needs to meet discipline.

### **What you get**

* Enhanced rewards (Diamond tier perks)
* access to bonuses and travel drops
* status within the ecosystem

### **Investment View**

A Travel Tiger NFT is not a speculative JPEG.

It’s a **yield-enhancing membership instrument**.

So the key question becomes:

> *Do you travel enough to justify the capital lock?*

If:

* You travel frequently
* You already use Travala
* You value AVA rewards

→ It can outperform traditional loyalty programs.

If not:

→ It’s capital inefficiency.

---

## **⚖️ Final Verdict: A Rational Bull Case**

Travala is not a moonshot anymore.

It is something far more interesting:

> A **working crypto business with real users, real revenue, and real constraints.**

### **As an investor**

* Moderate growth
* undervalued relative to niche dominance
* but not a hyper-growth rocket

### **As a user**

* Strong product-market fit
* real utility for crypto holders

### **AVA token**

* fairly priced given current adoption
* upside depends entirely on **network growth**, not speculation

---

## **🚀 Closing Thought**

We often look for the next 100x token.

But the real opportunity might be quieter:

Platforms like Travala are building the **economic layer of crypto adoption**—not through hype, but through usage.

And history shows:

> The companies that survive normalization are the ones that define the next cycle.

---

</liketuimages>

给欢欢过完生日，我也感觉累了，不想到处跑了，不约而同的跟老公在家呆着，没有什么事，就看起电视剧来，欢欢倒是很忙，就连今天的补课都不想上了，跑同学一起去商场了。

问他做什么，他说去商场吃火锅，我说你有钱吗？他说小姑给他过生日的钱，我也是服了他们小姑，每次过生日时，都给钱，让小孩子乱发，这些不良好的习惯，很多原因都是因为家庭原因而造成的

欢欢说上次同学过生日时，请了他，这次他请，我想骂他，可是回请别人也是对的呀，我只是再三嘱付他用钱，该用的可以用，该省的则省，我说钱不能乱发，挣钱难，发钱易，也不知这孩子听进去没有，做妈的真的让人超心。现在的娃娃在教育好，也是很难的。

虽然没有出门，但是我们还是去小区走了走，有只小白猫，很是可爱，我们一出来，他也跟着来了，在下面跟他逗了下，摸摸他的毛，喂点吃的给他，我也是很开心的。

五一的假也就这么快过完了，感觉太快了，到了下午，我还带欢欢去看了眼睛，眼睛的视力不好了，医生给他开了眼药水，本想可以报社保，那仁康医院的医生都说可以报，可是社区医院却不同意转诊，真的给气死了，这家都说可以报，很多人都报了，他都不同意，只是签个转诊。

没有办法情况下，我只自费了，用了四百多，然后把欢欢的定点医院转到仁康了，下次不要弄那个转诊了，真的烦死了，直接过来看就好，医生说6月份生效，意思下个月开药时，可以便宜一半，想到那个医院不同意转诊，就来气，真的是一点医德都没有，现在好医生真的太难找了。

继续分享美食，这家干锅鸭头在秦皇岛排名第一，友哥一直没有去体验，今天还在假期内呢，孩子也没有辅导课，就去体验了一把。

友哥的前同事曾经和友哥分享过，这家干锅鸭头店的老板，当初在刚干这一行的时候，秦皇岛人对这个还不太追崇的时候，老板曾经赔进去两套房。但是老板坚持住了，也去某地学来了秘方，口碑打开了，红火起来了。

现在这家干锅鸭头这么火爆，他家美团里没有套餐可以团，只能到店里点餐。美团上有外卖，但是友哥怕外卖口味不正宗，或者份量少。所以来店里吃。

店里大厅吃，不支持电话预订位置，只能到店现场排队，想不排队就要在饭点前早到。友哥就是大聪明，在十一点前到的，到了之后大厅已经有很多人在用餐了，但是还有余位，友哥可以不用排队就能用餐了。

友哥吃完的时候，店外排队的有好多人了。

体验之后，干锅鸭头味道确实挺好的，可以去第二次的那种。体验不太好的就是价格偏贵，不亲民。米饭是4元一碗，也比普通饭点贵。

各位小伙伴们如果来秦皇岛，可以去品尝一下哦。

好了，各位小伙伴们，友哥今天就分享到这里吧！明天见！祝各位小伙伴们天天快乐，天天好心情！

title.title: There's a reason...
title.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQVKdXsw48DQeQQPMuJywSwmvj2z2Gp7VXRHJicjtDkF9/20251017_183442.webp)

-----------------------------

There's a reason they are the number 4 team in the nation.   There's also a reason their ace pitcher was paid $1 million dollars to leave Stanford and come play with the Red Raiders.  I was sitting in a hotel room across the state the other day when I watched NiJaree Canady pitch the first perfect game of her career.  Which honestly is no small thing.  You might think if she was as good as you say, it shouldn't have taken her until her senior year to make this accomplishment.  

Which might be true, but if you know the game, you know just how hard it is to pitch a perfect game. In fact, it is so hard to do that in professional baseball there is a lot of stigma around even talking about it.  Think about it.  It's not easy to do.  

We are talking no walks, no runners, nothing but outs and strike outs.  Of course, it can't all be attributed to Canady.  In this case a bit of the credit goes to the field for not making any mistakes, but it can be argued that the pitcher is the one who sets them up to achieve that greatness.  

Yes, the game only went five inning instead of the traditional seven due to Texas Tech putting up eight runs to Baylor's zero which implemented the run rule and ended the game early. 

Let's break that down though.  A perfect game means Canady faced 15 total batters.  Nine of those batters she struck out, so that just leaves six where she had to rely on her teammates to get the job done for her.  Those aren't too bad odds if you ask me.  

Thanks to the run rule, perfect games probably aren't as rare in softball as they are in baseball, but the fact that it took one of the best pitchers in the country this long to get her first one should still tell you something.  

There's a reason she was the number 2 draft pick in the new AUSL that was recently implemented.  If you ask me, it's about time we had a professional softball league.  Plus, we get to see softball in the Summer Olympic games soon, so that is pretty cool too!  

There's a reason softball is so awesome.  If you haven't figured it out yet, you really need to take a second look.  Division I schools start their conference tournaments this week.  Maybe this is the time you finally give softball a chance.  There's a reason you are reading this post after all....

title.title: Simple rice with leeks and courgette/ Arroz sencillo con puerros y calabacines.
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVVnrmoD47h8vJdayTCbQDxDim1gXPV4WnvQ2akXL1Zx3/1777983638379.jpg)

Good afternoon, blogging friends, how are you? Today I'm with you with another recipe: simple, delicious, and healthy. I picked up various vegetables at the supermarket—leeks, zucchini, eggplant, and potatoes—and since I was craving rice today (like a good Italian, I love pasta, but every now and then I crave rice, noodles, or other grains I adore!), I decided to make a simple rice dish with leeks and zucchini. 

For this recipe, you'll need: 

* 100 grams of rice 
* 80 grams of leek 
* 1 medium zucchini
 * 3 cloves of garlic
 * 3 tablespoons of fine salt 
* 3 tablespoons of oil 

First, prepare the seasoning for the rice. Peel the garlic, cut it into medium-sized pieces, and then sauté it in a pan with three tablespoons of oil for three minutes. Then let's take care of the courgette, wash it, cut it lengthwise and then in half and then cut it into slices of similar size, add it to the pan with the garlic and mix and cook for about fifteen minutes, stirring occasionally.

🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡

Buenas tardes, amigos blogueros, ¿cómo están? Hoy les traigo otra receta: sencilla, deliciosa y saludable. Compré varias verduras en el supermercado: puerros, calabacines, berenjenas y papas. Como hoy tenía antojo de arroz (como buena italiana, me encanta la pasta, ¡pero de vez en cuando me apetece arroz, fideos u otros cereales que adoro!), decidí preparar un sencillo plato de arroz con puerros y calabacines. 

Para esta receta necesitarán:

 * 100 gramos de arroz
 * 80 gramos de puerro
 * 1 calabacín mediano 
* 3 dientes de ajo 
* 3 cucharadas de sal fina
 * 3 cucharadas de aceite

 Primero, preparen el aderezo para el arroz. Pelen el ajo, córtelo en trozos medianos y sofríanlo en una sartén con tres cucharadas de aceite durante tres minutos. A continuación, preparemos el calabacín: lavémoslo, córtelo longitudinalmente, luego por la mitad y finalmente en rodajas de tamaño similar. Añádalo a la sartén con el ajo, mezcle y cocine durante unos quince minutos, removiendo de vez en cuando.




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPe6bxRTNa61NJmTFKEZHSNEQVvQD5ksS1gwarkFuqgP6/1777983638541.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY2jVsfuCS1rCiZMjj8XsCzUHcLh2vwTxmwtXWKezQ2fS/1777983638731.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQofvcS3sAwqk1Po8g4LHK8ocRFhkmRSU87Cpw3V8mfya/1777983638919.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmewtaxiyvWcb1kjK9mLxKX5R6g6GiUrTfvRLqjumbowjy/1777983639107.jpg)




Next, prepare the leek: wash it, remove the outer leaves, and slice the required amount into thin rounds. Add them to the pan with the zucchini, stir, and cook for another ten minutes.

 Meanwhile, prepare the rice: bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Once the water boils, add the rice and cook for fifteen minutes. Drain, reserving a little of the cooking water to soften the rice. Add the contents of the pan to the rice and stir vigorously. Voilà, your simple leek and zucchini rice is ready.

🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡

A continuación, prepara el puerro: lávalo, retira las hojas exteriores y corta la cantidad necesaria en rodajas finas. Añádelas a la sartén con el calabacín, remueve y cocina durante diez minutos más. Mientras tanto, prepara el arroz: pon a hervir una olla con agua salada. 

Una vez que hierva, añade el arroz y cocina durante quince minutos. Escurre el arroz, reservando un poco del agua de cocción para que quede más blando. Añade el contenido de la sartén al arroz y remueve enérgicamente. ¡Listo! Tu sencillo arroz con puerro y calabacín está preparado.

title.title: [Eng./Esp.]   The Art of Not Being Convinced.   ||   El Arte de No Ser Convencido.
title.body:
*** *** #
Si eres de habla hispana, la versión en español es mejor para ti; debes hacer clic 👉 [**AQUÍ**](#english)
*** ***
# ***
***

> Today’s phrase is thrown down like a gauntlet in an ancient duel: **“Convince me!”**. Those who utter it usually believe they are opening the doors of their intellect, offering virgin soil for the seeds of truth to germinate. But, if we look closely, the stance is often quite different. It is not an opening; it is a trench. Let me explain.
# ***
The Art of Not Being Convinced
*** The irony of persuasion is that success often depends not on the strength of the argument, but on the receptiveness of the listener. Etymologically, ‘persuade’ comes from the Latin *vincere*: ***to defeat the other with reason***, but in practice, *no one wants to be defeated*. No one wants their *‘inner self’* to lose a battle. That is why we have transformed the act of convincing into the art of confirmation.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23zGeHroPbBs9SqSJnz2SNBpybZyD6mvG4jikgdixoWTrAyEa8UJNLxZZAPpyDxMtL8NJ.png) [Thanks to the Qwen3.6-Plus AI for this image.](https://chat.qwen.ai/)
If you put forward an idea to a group of ten people, it is likely that three will embrace it, three will ignore it and four will declare war on you. Is it because the first three are more intelligent? Not necessarily. It is because you have told them what they already knew, but in better words. You have given them permission to continue believing what they already believed. You have given them the comfort of being right. In the post-truth era, persuasion has become the echo of our own biases. ## **The man who held the truth, but nobody wanted it** To understand this human resistance to being convinced by the facts, we must travel back to the corridors of a Vienna hospital in 1847. There, a Hungarian doctor named Ignaz Semmelweis discovered an irrefutable scientific truth: ***if doctors washed their hands with a chlorinated lime solution before attending births, the mortality rate among mothers fell from 18% to 1%***. It was a fact; there was data; lives were saved. But when Semmelweis tried to ‘convince’ the medical community, he came up against a granite wall. Why? Simple: because his truth implied something doctors did not want to hear – that it was they, with their dirty hands, who were killing their patients. This is not a story; it is a real historical fact. The information did not convince them because it was not what they wanted to hear. It didn’t fit with their identity as “knightly saviours”. Semmelweis failed to convince his colleagues; he died in an asylum, humiliated and rejected, whilst doctors continued to operate with hands stained with death, simply because “washing one’s hands” wasn’t the narrative that flattered their status. ## **The Echo Chronicle** This real-life experience teaches us that the human brain has a very strict gatekeeper called **confirmation bias**. This gatekeeper only lets in guests it already knows. If you bring a new but uncomfortable truth, the door is slammed in your face. But if you bring a lie that sounds like what I want to hear, I’ll roll out the red carpet for you. Convincing has, tragically, become the act of feeding a hunger for pre-existing certainties. It is the irony of modern communication: we seek dialogue, but only to find a mirror. The next time someone says to us, ***“Convince me!”**, perhaps we should respond with another question: *“Are you looking for a new truth, or do you just want me to put music to what you’re already thinking?”*. The fact that information convinces some people and not others says nothing about the quality of the information, but rather about the shape of the walls each person has built around their own mind. To convince is not to win an argument; it is to find someone willing to set aside their pride in exchange for a little light. And that, my dear readers, is the rarest of occurrences in human nature. *** ***

>\n\nLa frase de hoy se lanza como un guante en un duelo antiguo: **\

**. Quien la pronuncia suele creer que está abriendo las puertas de su intelecto, ofreciendo un campo virgen para que las semillas de la verdad germinen. Pero, si observamos con cuidado, la postura suele ser distinta. No es una apertura; es una trinchera. Les explico.
# ***
El Arte de No Ser Convencido
*** Lo irónico de convencer, es que a menudo el éxito no depende de la fuerza del argumento, sino de la hospitalidad del que escucha. Etimológicamente, convencer viene del latín vincere: ***vencer al otro con razones***, pero en la práctica, *nadie quiere ser derrotado*. Nadie quiere que su *\

* pierda una batalla. Por eso, hemos transformado el acto de convencer en el arte de confirmar.

<center>
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23tRzsaMprQdGr5yv5Wtz5WdjsGZLhot5hxBmUumcoLbUDaVekYPzDhupsp874BMhf2Fc.png)
<sup>[Gracias a la app Banana 2.0 por esta imagen.](https://gemini.google.com/app)</sup>
</center>

Si en un grupo de diez personas lanzas una idea, es probable que tres te abracen, tres te ignoren y cuatro te declaren la guerra. ¿Es porque los primeros son más inteligentes?, no necesariamente. Es porque les has dicho lo que ya sabían, pero con mejores palabras. Les has dado permiso para seguir creyendo lo que ya creían. Les has regalado la comodidad de tener razón. Convencer, en el siglo de la posverdad, se ha vuelto el rumor de nuestros propios sesgos.

## **El hombre que tenía la verdad, pero nadie la quería**

Para entender esta resistencia humana a ser convencidos por lo real, hay que viajar a los pasillos de un hospital de Viena en 1847. Allí, un médico húngaro llamado Ignaz Semmelweis descubrió una verdad científica irrefutable: ***si los médicos se lavaban las manos con una solución de cal clorada antes de atender partos, la mortalidad de las madres caía del 18% al 1%***.

Era un hecho, había datos, había vidas salvadas. Pero cuando Semmelweis intentó \

a la comunidad médica, se encontró con un muro de granito. ¿Por qué?, sencillo, porque su verdad implicaba algo que los médicos no querían escuchar: que eran ellos, con sus manos sucias, quienes estaban matando a sus pacientes. Esto no es un cuento, es un hecho real de la historia.\n\nLa información no los convenció porque no era lo que querían oír. No encajaba con su identidad de \
. Semmelweis no logró convencer a sus colegas; murió en un asilo, humillado y rechazado, mientras los médicos seguían operando con las manos manchadas de muerte, simplemente porque \

no era la narrativa que halagaba su estatus.

## **La Crónica del Eco**

Esta experiencia real nos enseña que el cerebro humano tiene un portero muy estricto llamado **sesgo de confirmación**. Este portero solo deja pasar a los invitados que ya conoce. Si traes una verdad nueva, pero incómoda, se le cierra la puerta en la cara. Pero si traes una mentira que suena a lo que yo deseo, te pongo alfombra roja.

Convencer se ha vuelto, trágicamente, el acto de alimentar el hambre de certezas previas. Es la ironía de la comunicación moderna: buscamos diálogo, pero solo para encontrar un espejo.

La próxima vez que alguien nos diga ***\
**, quizá deberíamos responder con otra pregunta: *\

*. La información que convence a unos y a otros no, no habla de la calidad de la información, sino de la forma de los muros que cada uno ha construido alrededor de su propia mente. Convencer no es ganar una discusión; es encontrar a alguien que esté dispuesto a perder su orgullo a cambio de un poco de luz. Y eso, mis queridos lectores, es el evento más escaso de la naturaleza humana.

title.title: A Clean Sweep.
title.body: > After a soldier discovered a body, I eliminated him from above and continued my infiltration using sleep darts and hidden blade. I cleared a shed and handled a suspicious guard before securing more intel. Finally, I removed the remaining perimeter guards, including two heavy soldiers, to ensure the area was completely clear. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUCdYEVC8rf1eXNNhhUUjhHZ6ZeiFwjhdGhXdwWRfwGCb/screenshot_1_.png) I noticed a soldier somehow found the dead body I left in the grass earlier after getting the intel from that house. I leaned forward and I assassinated him from the air, dropping onto his shoulders and silencing him before he could shout out to other guards. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV1RLLb7hAwKPUsnLNpMT5aTjzoUujWeV8RKiBmR7zsRz/screenshot_2_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVjHfxEosZBemyRyESXmoQM2rTrX3CvVh1bJDGtQTXLMy/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdcYFz5UYEVpjzxHx4Ap1nXCg1wMzPTyeX8gBHgJS2354/screenshot_4_.png) Then I went ahead and found this soldier relaxing there, leaning against some sacks. I didn't find an opening for a direct assassination from my current angle without being spotted, so I shot him with a sleeping dart, and then I assassinated him. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZUBb2LGnYfeo1JLz6JsNgddCTn8E7Tdi4VuAcsAZqvub/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSjSrESPpUkkANCiZEJHDyxAwvbd6QViH3f1Xg9F4ssPQ/screenshot_6_.png) There were two more soldiers right beside me in a shed, surrounded by old crates. Well, after taking them both down, I tried to hide the bodies in the corner of the shed. I worked quickly, knowing that a patrol was scheduled to pass close-by. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWanA3Qo7d4nXy8d6gson3LnVu6TFwMKW2h4zwRGL3JRK/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNiXhK2xYK7CSRtRLdiQXT6C2gGdBQzeTnYsMQ8ptGCPk/screenshot_8_.png) But another soldier from the outside noticed something was unusual as he glanced through the open doorway. He came inside to check and found a dead body that I hadn't managed to pull into the shadows yet. So I had to be quick in assassinating him as well. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcDcB35TX53ikphsBoZrUBgadx1hiSxkCgi9GMVUHMt8B/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUcCAkYLfVmyXUv9n2iUftrmxwiU4D8Yg4XSZC9cufXKY/screenshot_10_.png) Then I found this man guarding another document on a desk near the back of the camp. I assassinated him and grabbed the information real quick. The scrolls contained valuable details, which would be useful for my next mission. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW7yUhrz8zdhXPn3dETaL1Xbw5D7i1KxsB6bFBHE674DJ/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbrzUCJdqZMkwGiHE8sUoLgKCJXQTE7hoCLTnhsUrV2Sh/screenshot_12_.png) I went outside and noticed a guard whom I distracted to come to the side by whistling from behind a stone wall. When the soldier was going back after not finding me, I assassinated him from the behind, ensuring he fell quietly into the water. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXCrVyixzYf8WMFNMhYUm1jdztmFND6Vr8RfsGBLSPXKz/screenshot_13_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcG9RytQVcGsgYRJCDBJ8UmJSf4AYFiaQGz95reHRcgjW/screenshot_14_.png) Then this soldier suddenly came out of nowhere and started looking for me around as he found a dead body I left behind. He was alert and moving with his spear drawn. So I ran to him and I assassinated him real fast, catching him in a sprint. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSJxR4rhU5bAqwgYDTD8gvbdYCHPCzriENgoSUqAgGpv8/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZMk5w56uqJCvDZ29ggkBihBuMb8DoarQhTjx82dAvaDa/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmccQf1d1xNExiyX2mLoMi6far3bEMgU8ARVqyqZjb2ePC/screenshot_17_.png) That heavy soldier became my next target who was wearing thick armor, so a direct fight would have been loud and dangerous for my current position. After following him to a safe side, I assassinated him with a precise strike to his back, with my hidden blade. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdQp2Bu64pgz7yGgK4tsd8SqUsdG7TrpY8U3gWxQasY1/screenshot_18_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ3uBDWfSqtGbqPwMBaN4ZxC1H6Pi4imSz3bPPk6EqwpV/screenshot_19_.png) There were two more guards at the entrance area, standing watch by the gates. I first took down a regular soldier with a swift hidden blade strike, and then I went for the heavy soldier at the entrance, taking him down as well to ensure that the path was completely clear for my escape. Until next time, happy gaming. *Note: The icon for the thumbnail is collected from steamgriddb.com* --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=paarvez/ddf71160)

title.title: Point Coffee: Kopi Susu Gula Aren
title.body:
Hello guys....

How are you all? I hope you are all well and always happy. Nice to meet you all again. I'm back with my story about trying new coffee.

The coffee that I tried this time was Point Coffee, Point Coffee has several variations of coffee, such as coffee made directly by the barista, there is bottled coffee and pocket coffee, and currently they also release bottled instant coffee.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRxQqXUKwFhqy7rbFZ69MrP82Z4Y7vtUT4Gmhi7EWyNe5/1777973339320.jpg)

Bottled coffee and bottled instant coffee from Point Coffee are different. Bottled coffee can be found at Point Coffee, while bottled instant coffee can be found at convenience stores. They are the same brand, but the packaging and location of sale are different.

For this coffee, they have several flavors, such as palm sugar milk coffee, macchiato, and others. And of course, I will try the palm sugar milk coffee, because I really like the palm sugar milk coffee that is usually available at Point Coffee.

*Composition :*

* Water
* Milk (20%)
* Palm Sugar (5%)
* Sugar, Powdered Milk,
* Vegetable Creamer
* Coffee Powder (1%)
* And others


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWMHJdg8wsQxwzzemMYE3xniSwxQc9okgJVxrPWYEu6Z2/1777983540586.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmck3QWzuEXP7KpBzHfH8b3yF57PMmTiZnb7KnxFYDpvk5/1777983540630.jpg)

As for the taste of this coffee, it's quite good, but very sweet with a faint coffee flavor. But it's very fragrant, the aroma of the coffee is very fragrant.

Because I think it's too sweet, that's why I added ice cubes. Adding ice cubes makes this coffee fresher, with just the right amount of sweetness.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPeT5feqmsdonNhy2ypAacXYMTBGNkPXjWUd9PQcg6SVu/1777983987700.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYnUiuH6JQxDtp8Q9ZauuwGqc3PBiEAGqNo49sHyoJ4mh/1777983987739.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcVsNudzmAxqKZL13rAfvmRMYuAUUGjVaHUdZLQGtevrP/1777983987775.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYvP4KhyCjybJRZ4ygSMq6jnA4hkNSYs3p7VqiWRmtPXU/1777983987816.jpg)

Overall this coffee is quite good, but if you want a drink with a strong coffee taste then you won't like this, but if you want a sweet drink then this will suit you.

Okay, that's my story for now. I'll be back to tell you my next story. Thank you for reading my story, bye~

title.title: Georgia Cities /Gürcistan Şehirleri
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX6onPDMW1RRFmR4niFcJnZGJ2bUXYBvq2M2WFTyzQrYB/img_8067.jpg)

Hello everyone! Today I will be sharing my trip abroad where I had a mini-vacation. I chose Georgia as my destination because it is both close to our country and offers tour opportunities. So, my friends and I decided on Batumi and Tbilisi as our destination.

*Herkese selamlar 
Bugün sizlere mini tatil yaptığım yurt dışı gezimi paylaşacağım. Ülke olarak Gürcistan’ı seçtim. Çünkü ülkemize hem yakın hem de tur imkanı olduğu için arkadaşlarımızla beraber rotamız Gürcistan Batum, Tiflis oldu.*


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf9J4DdFUVE28msrpV1F8E1sK9iZEthuW6xw3bAJ2BHWP/img_5993.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUr472n6gQ6N3e2zWLwdKy233XQvk88uNd2Gdv2CUYEXG/img_6004.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP3QcQ5ZRjZhHztByrEmv9DLQuNFRDL2xG6yrP7UhU7N4/img_6001.jpg)


Our initial plan was a 2-day, 1-night trip. We planned to spend the first day in Tbilisi and the second day in Batumi. Before leaving, we planned our trip and gathered information to avoid any difficulties during our journey. The day before, we packed our bags and went straight to the bus terminal after school. We joined a tour company called Karadeniz Tur. The bus we boarded had about 35 people. It was quite crowded, which made things a bit difficult during the trip because managing large groups is challenging.


*İlk önce olanımız 2 gün 1 gece olarak planladık. Burada ilk günü Tifliste diğer günü Batum olmak üzere plan yaptık. Gitmeden önce gideceğimiz yerleri planı yapıp gittiğimizde zorda kalmamak için bilgi sahibi olduk. Biz arkadaşlarla birgün öncesinden bavulları ayarlayıp okul çıkışı direk otobüs terminaline geçtik. Tura Karadeniz tur adı altında bi firmanın adı ile katıldık. Bindiğimiz otobüs yaklaşık 35 kişi idi. Biraz kalabalıktı. Bu biraz gezi esnasında zor oldu çünkü kalabalık grupları idare etmek zordu.*


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT9p85tdfyuSRJpFTKnomzyekmudosfEKJXDWmi9tHHFt/img_4129.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTEZCWkkuLvK2QLwhsJyn6ppFbYQWGx5AhGjGF3AAUrtc/img_6013.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmai4AQ14Mm2Rap6tFC4rxwSc2nM6xuQJAAk7NkBtfruuV/img_6016.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdHmEb1vqKM1XCgnFFyCvLKvVDhe2q37eMKEW5UuXMtHE/img_7480.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUWKQxcRRvtqxSMoXiPyup8L6groLHi8fEJtMynh7YLdy/img_7476.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRo835ViuW7TdHVVn33hSiyWsAZoHohdqADjL6LZdKzJZ/img_7479.jpg)

We boarded the bus after school around 5 PM. We arrived at the border crossing at 2 AM. We needed ID and a stamp to cross. After completing the checks, we exchanged Turkish lira for lari. 1 lari was equivalent to 17 TL. I exchanged 2000 TL worth of lari. Then we passed through Batumi and first arrived in Tbilisi. The journey between Tbilisi and Batumi took 5 hours. We arrived in Tbilisi around 9 AM. We had breakfast there. We didn't really like the breakfast because there wasn't much variety. After breakfast, we went to the restaurant to change and then back to our room.

*Bizi okul çıkışı otobüse bindik akşam 17.00 gibi bindik. Burada saat 02:00 de sınır kapısına geldik. Burada geçişler için kimlik ve kaşe gerekti. Kontrolleri sağladıktan sonra Türk parasını lariye çevirdik. 1 lari 17 tl ye denk geliyordu. Ben 2000 tlik lari bozdurdum. Ve artık Batum’dan geçip ilk olarak Tiflise geldik. Tiflis ile Batum arası 5 saat sürdü. Sabah saat 09:00 gibi tifliste olduk. Tiflise gelince burada kahvaltımızı yaptık. Kahvaltıyı çok beğenmedi. Çünkü çok çeşit yoktu. Burada kahvaltıyı yapıp üzerimizi değiştirmek için restoranta odaya geçtik.*
 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXyuwzAwSrScPuyxK236jnG31KHrbubhb3WnHGMujHjwR/img_7562.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZNXHDyhcTRpddvSmwwbLDj1BtiMo76cRvTo7g34fToHc/img_7563.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb68W6mkRoaEMBRUgc3Utsmxd1QL65fvjeJdAC5od6Nq4/img_7908.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaSZHt2dH7qkw7Ue4Mxi2jKoJwh64VdACwAA7M2dmLy5g/img_7909.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmawbG9LqSoa1xQp3fhXZs3fexb4gDss3wbAEFoM5NAVV6/img_7910.jpg)

After changing my clothes, we started our tour of the Tbilisi bazaar. Here we saw the Heydar Aliyev monument. Our guide shared information about it with us. We wandered through the shops in the bazaar. The most important fruits here are grapes and anchovies. Alcohol is made here and sold everywhere. The whole country offers a wide variety of alcoholic beverages for sale. The different bottles caught our attention. I bought magnets for myself and my siblings to take as gifts when we leave. We visited the Cathedral of Sion, one of the important landmarks in the bazaar, and took photos. We also walked around the Bridge of Peace, another significant place. The bazaars had both an old and a brand-new atmosphere.

*Üzerimi değiştirdikten sonra Tiflisi çarşı gezisine başladık. Burada Haydar Aliyev anıtını gördük. Rehber onunla ilgili bilgileri bize paylaştı. Burada çarşılarda alışveriş yerlerini dolandık. Burada en önemli meyve üzüm be ant. Buradan alkol yapıp her yer alkol satılıyor. Ülkenin her yeri çeşit çeşit alkolli  içekcek ile satışa sunulmuş. Çeşit çeşit şişeleri dikaktleri çekiyordu. Burada magnet aldım kendime ve kardeşlerime. Giderken hediye götürmek için. Çarşıda önemli noktalardan biri olan sioni kadetraliyi ziyaret ettik fotolar aldık. Burada önemli yerlerden biri olan barış köpsünün etrafında dolandık. Çarşılar hem eski hem yepyeni bi hava vardı.*


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVchD5eZ75Z3cQeXxX3SCwEMbJ56YJYqdHGQVm8iw8hXp/img_6262.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaJT2tsDtxoMqXV1Wkm95pZqcxpnZfXkSYHxrVdPp2Dz2/img_6273.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeDq3A8qRmHRgVdbqr6tGRsi5xEGbcQ7ZQCdx9ostziWL/img_6281.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRztNk7m8tdZYeWD7HsAUhYbvQhh2AdfgD17V3Qi3e51G/img_6282.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZcj7ZPWz6awF8o5PozDfc2E3VNWF31Yrad4eTpbypdRK/img_7584.jpg)

In Tbilisi, cars were eye-catching; because parts were very expensive here, cars were restored and repainted. Buying a new car was cheaper than buying parts. The cars here are a bit more minimalist and older in style.

*Tifliste arabalar dikkat çekiyordu burada parça çok pahalı olduğu için arabalar renklerle restore edilip kullanıyordu. Çünkü yemi bi araba almak parça almaktan daha uyguna geliyordu. Burada arabalar biraz daha minimal tarzda ve eski.*


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNiLVUMyfbU1sHTeqSgHNJfyE9RcuHFc4zEhuiPJCvQWZ/img_8061.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeFHisb6gPSuBQUesygYfcf8m6twKcnJ6zxXA1jzNwHye/img_8060.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWArp6ud3292LmvbuvDdmhdwveEpqRouYnxTbGdspLi9S/img_8062.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfGJbsypeDppU5s3crMHj1SrEoRUtBLuD26jnw6mrZJ3Q/img_8063.jpg)

We had lunch here after exploring the market. My friends and I tried Khinkali and Khachapuri, famous Georgian dishes. My friend also ordered wine. We tasted these delicious dishes here. Although I didn't get to try as much, my friend certainly enjoyed them. ☺️😂

*Burayı çarşıyı gezdikten sonra öğle arası yemeği verdik. Biz arkadaşlarımız Gürcistan’ın meşhur yemeği olan Hinkali, Haçapuriyi denedik. Arkadaşım yanında şarap da istedi. Burada bu lezzeteleir tattık. Ben çok tatamasamda arkadaşım yemeklerin hakkını verdi.☺️😂*


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ44E4Ez72Ym9gjMJYxPaQ34S7CUV5Ko7CJKFei1sDXWS/img_6744.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY1K4PW6RxfRs13Kj1RZ8619r4vcWryeECpZH4abtopM9/img_6743.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmewvz8TA58yRqWLjaDDQNzu4y9zFz39nR17nxQnUCSXoZ/img_6874.jpg)

title.title: Only Tulips
title.body:
![Yellow w/ red](https://images.ecency.com/DQme5TorEME2H1gJ8KCTGfj7mNxpehXTFcd9yLxEA7yYhp9/img_0841.jpeg)

Only Tulips.  This post is only tulips.  Only tulips in my beds.  Only one shot per tulip.

![Fringed Yellow](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWaWnnVpo1RxsBeJrmEcm3n4PWnbP34uvGayGyqNSHJxM/img_0859.jpeg)

We are delighted with our tulips this year.  We have been planting blubs for three years and starting to get a nice critical mass of established tulips.

![Double](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcCx74NsrhvkFRSNLZhpwvs3Ke3PrnhdCHW3CWuaX61sV/img_0858.jpeg)

We also have daffodils and hyacinths.  Plus some crocus and a few allium.  Those are the spring bulbs.  But this is only about the tulips.

![Yellow w/ black](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdpyyvxWhEKihVy1bvvo3Q26zv4k17xcTjcnvvVdbfGvi/img_0854.jpeg)

We buy our bulbs mail order in the fall from Holland Bulbs.

![Reds](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUxuKLdUxGedXWWvsRr4F9YzJuoUxdtnMAnCKcuRtW5Pw/img_0853.jpeg)

We are rehabilitating some old beds that had been neglected and graveled over for a wider drive way at some point then haphazardly covered with mulch probably right before we bought the house.  So typically I get a little mulch then gravel then maybe a little soil then clay when digging out the beds.

![Orange](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcAsUjL3iEsvtUCJjYBXAvxzZd7YCBzFLx7iL1JWvdwdj/img_0852.jpeg)

We have a system going where we dig out some new area in the beds around now (May/June).  Then we have some red Dahlias that we got from a neighbor we put in for the summer.  We dig and add soil and compost when putting in the Dahlias so its easier when we do the bulbs in the fall.  I usually have to cart off the gravel I dig up and we replace it with better soil components.

![Red w/ Yellow](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYuHUGjjiG9DVe5MgUL1gUEKsSkn9MwMfE4PyRLsDatbE/img_0851.jpeg)

When we do plant the bulbs we add in some bulb fertilizer (Bulb-tone).  Then the following spring we have some more tulips.  And we repeat each year.

![Pink](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQpeiKRSkVhkrHqSpfxfkZU34Z3PRRTnshWberh729yFn/img_0850.jpeg)

The Dahlias are getting out of hand 🙄 more tubers each year that we split up and store in the basement all winter.  I am about ready to pass that curse along to someone else 😅 too much work.

![Red](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcap6msmjfhrQ5p6y6WWAbauy5GnnSMGK1NxLBRUzM86S/img_0849.jpeg)

Back to the tulips.  We buy an assortment.

![Yellow Double](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd9b2yBhDW61DEbCCwEpCf6KfypqvZYsGzMYeapiyesi6/img_0848.jpeg)

Lots of different colors plus a few fringed varieties and double tulips.

![Rescue](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWvU6BMG7hzeLQBRbLrsWouBSFkbbdb8LrhDhLjgy97WK/img_0861.jpeg)

My wife claims they are all the same when we plant them and you never know what you get until they come up.  I mostly run the shovel, wheel barrow, and water so I'm not sure if that is true or she just loses track of what she puts where...

![Red](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV9smHHGNaH1qzdaEwTMWMTZTcYbqcVJszWRWmZPwPU25/img_0839.jpeg)

Fortunately she doesn't read my Hive posts so I can ponder this question out loud 🤔

![Yellow w/ Red black core](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPcVBQKTQsvnCKM7BwozNhCEiZR6wPBueMpo4tTdz9wkb/img_0818.jpeg)

Well that the end of the photos so that means the end of my rambling.  Thanks for checking out my post

title.title: WHEN EVERYTHING BECOMES EASY, WHAT HAPPENS TO CREATIVITY
title.body: > We are living in an era when virtually anything can be done quicker, easier and with less effort. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRg132EMRY9k3Dkq5vSRWNLAdSd4n2oY8BtiaJahdCAvY/1777984088901.jpg) You want to write? There exists a tool to that. You want to design? There is even a tool to do it. You desire ideas, structure, even fined content? One can do it all with a few clicks. And to be quite frank, it is impressive. But on the other hand... it brings up a question I cannot but ask: Are we more productive or is it that we are simply becoming a little less creative? I have thought about this a lot particularly in the recent past. It was a time when it was necessary to be patient when creating anything. Writing was sitting and thinking, and grappling at words, and deleting and rewriting, and at times just staring at a blank page, longer than one wanted to admit. The creation of something entailed experimentation. Learning. Failing. Trying again. It did not come easy... but that was one of the things that made it yours. Things are now different. A significant amount of friction is eliminated by technology. And though that might sound like a good thing, because everybody likes to have it easy, I believe that there must be a cost involved in it. Once things become too easy, then we cease to stretch ourselves. Use an example such as writing. Having made possible that all ideas, all structures, all forms of expression can be produced in an instant, then where do we go with the personal struggle? It is that struggle, the thinking, the refining, the emotional input, that is normally where creativity is created. Without it all begins to seem like... well, like that. Clear, well-organized, yet not necessarily insightful. However, I do not believe that technology is the issue. The actual challenge is the way we decide to utilize it. Since there are always tools. The distinction at this point is that the tools are robust enough that they end up doing much of the work on our behalf. And that’s where discipline comes in. In my case, I do not consider technology as something which should overrule creativity. I consider it something that must favor it. There’s a difference. When you give up to the fullest extent of tools to think, create, and express, then over time you notice that your own creative capacity is beginning to weaken. You are more of a consumer rather than a producer. However, when you apply the same tools to hone the ideas, broaden your thinking, or expedite the performance, then you still are in charge of the creative process. The other thing I have been able to discover is this: Creativity does not only concern output. It’s about effort. The process matters. The thinking matters. The points at which you hesitate, in which things are not running smoothly, these are not the challenges, they are the elements of the creation itself. By taking that process out of the picture, we may gain velocity... but lose density. What then can we do to be creative in a world where everything is turning into an automation? To me it all boils down to a few basic things: Remain engaged in the process. Don’t outsource your thinking completely. Work with tools, but nonetheless, use your brain. You should permit yourself to wrestle a bit. Not all things need to be immediate. When things are not easy, some of the best ideas are realized. Create intentionally. Question yourself: Is this my own? Or have I simply prepared a sort of thing? At the end of the day, technology isn’t going anywhere. It will just become better, quicker and more competent. The actual question is not whether it is killing creativity. The actual question is: Or are we still making the choice to be creative... or is it the choice of convenience instead? Effort is mighty. However, when we are not too keen it may gradually strip us off the same thing that makes our work feel human. [Image Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/gray-and-black-laptop-computer-on-surface-Im7lZjxeLhg) ![1000573341.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/treasuree/23s9c1MqSx1HhT1yGGJrzoEBDBcyBewncBKsKPuN1kVPXLcoQ7uNM77SbgWqKK6ErUSTg.png)

title.title: Skincare Is Not About Expensive Products (It’s About What You Do Daily)
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmck7DaowAsJqCP4p1EfBqBrhAvfU1RqfokQYeCuNuPKSV/1777983972584.jpg)




I used to believe one simple thing…
“Expensive products = better skin.”
Honestly, I was completely wrong.
At one point, I even thought if I could just afford brands like Neutrogena or Garnier, my skin problems would disappear. But nothing really changed. Same dull skin, same small breakouts, same frustration.
Then slowly… I realized something.
It’s not about what you buy.
It’s about what you do every single day.
Most people ignore the basics. Like seriously ignore them.
Washing face properly?
Drinking enough water?
Sleeping on time?
These things sound boring. No one talks about them because they don’t look “fancy.” But these are the real game.
I remember a time when I was using a decent face wash, nothing expensive, but I started being consistent. Twice a day. No skipping. And slowly, my skin started looking… calmer. Not perfect, but better.
That’s when it hit me.
Consistency beats cost.
Also, people don’t realize how much diet matters. You can apply the best cream in the world, but if you’re eating oily junk daily, your skin will show it. Skin doesn’t lie. It reflects what’s happening inside.
And sleep… honestly, this is something I still struggle with.
Late night scrolling, random videos, wasting time… then waking up tired. And yeah, your face shows that tiredness too. Dark circles don’t come from nowhere.
Another mistake people make is touching their face again and again. I used to do that a lot without even noticing. Dirty hands, constant touching… and then wondering why pimples appear.
Funny thing.
We blame products… but ignore our habits.
I’m not saying expensive skincare is useless. Some products actually help. But thinking they are the “main solution”? That’s the wrong mindset.
Good skin is actually simple. Not easy… but simple.
Basic routine. Clean habits. Patience.
That’s it.
No overnight magic. No miracle cream.
Just small daily actions that slowly build results.
And yeah… it takes time. That’s the part people hate.
But trust me, it works.

title.title: Drawing A Portrait [7]
title.body: Hello everyone Today I will present the portrait of one of the first Black slaves to have survived slavery and managed to escape it.

/> He was born in 1745 in West Africa, in the former Kingdom of Benin in southeastern Nigeria, and died in the Westminster district of London. This is actually a portrait of Olaudah Equiano, better known as Gustave Vassa.
/> I created this portrait in 2023 as an exercise. Below, you will find a more detailed explanation and the different stages of its creation.
/> This is a graphite pencil portrait on A2-sized Bristol paper depicting an 18th-century man. It is a bust portrait (head and shoulders).

/> The man is shown in three-quarter view, looking slightly to the right. He is wearing a powdered wig typical of the era of the buttoned coat. The smile is subtle and slightly mischievous, with a lively gaze.
/> The face is well-proportioned and perfectly captures the spirit of youth, vivacity, and intelligence.

/>

  
The slight smile brings the portrait to life.  
Thank you for this brief read while observing the different stages of the portrait's creation. Have a pleasant day.

title.body:
A different day lining up. It is raining to start. My wife is housebound after breaking her foot yesterday. Need to be close at hand if she needs help. Did walk up to shops to get the one key ingredient for dinner - coriander. Rain had stopped. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e580bbca-8584-47e9-a879-6e8499cdbb6e.jpg) Did go for a short walk to get the steps in - up past the pink hibiscus and then along the highway past the church ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3b5e231c-0ff5-460d-95a2-408089f469f0.jpg) There are signs of spring - warm days and nights not cool has the flowers confused ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/87c7c217-ffc6-4fa8-84cf-eb7f6213660f.jpg) Jonquils flowering in the rectory garden - autumn? ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e8918523-4179-4848-b25e-6bdc4a4ddfba.jpg) Summer lily - not often see a double header ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/061f8ab3-5557-4a9a-83b7-4f3f439509c4.jpg) House sold in St Johns Avenue ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2dfdcb15-1554-47f9-96ab-9e9ef04be760.jpg) Cute little cottage. Does not look like anything social worth heritage protection - likely to be a knockdown. Big plot behind is a good chance there will be an up and behind extension ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c8720130-cce9-4c68-8011-ed796de3d41c.jpg) Clouds broke for a clear blue sky behind. Garden liked the rain - walker liked the sun ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9d2bf6ad-0696-48b2-9c32-e643deb41531.jpg) Was not going to take photos of camellias but this one is perfect ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8ceab3bc-ac6e-47df-bf67-08f5d49df607.jpg) Some creature ate holes in this mushroom. Not much left for Beef Wellington and a long way from Leongatha. I was there a few weeks ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/03d7f40d-8de1-47d3-942d-4e4cc74624ce.jpg) Bromeliads are in season - was good to get steps in dry Did cook dinner - a spicy Thai chicken mince dish with coriander. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/53ecbc8c-11a4-48bf-bae7-8770f74626d1.jpg) Onion and garlic sauteed. Add in some chilli and spring onions. Then add the chicken mince - stir it over till it all goes from pink to white Sauce goes in next - light soy, dark soy, fish sauce, oyster sauce, a touch of sugar. I prefer to use sweet soy - ketjap manis. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/bf8321f2-623b-422b-aec6-c3cfda6c330f.jpg) When all said and done add in a cup of chopped coriander # yep a whole cup. Serve with rice - was yum and done in 35 minutes while we watched 36 minute Masterchef challenge ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2c7fad05-443c-4663-8b98-9af7223544b8.jpg) 19 year old Hunter Valley semillon cooed with the spicy

title.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fjworld/AK296kCRD2bFMcyum92v1jEugUpE7ZPBzWVVvKiLBcbjz9QYJXKA7CEXRa7WkX7.png)

The last FJWorld update was on the Ides of March
https://peakd.com/hive-102963/@fjworld/fjworld-update-the-ides-of-march-2026

First, The USA/Israel war against Iran is still happening. The West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price is up over 18% and likely to go higher.

It has been 11 days since my last blog and that is because I have been super busy with offline responsibilities. In this blog I will give a high level update. Additional blogs will be created to update on the progress to various aspects of The PEPT Game platform, goals and objectives. 

## Problem Solving Game Piece

First, let me say we had a significant price increase in Hive in the last 24 hours. This has boosted the US$ valuation of many PEPT related accounts and tokens.

The Tribaldex Market Capitalization of our problem solving token has surpassed the 13 Trillion dollar level.

![toofuckeh_mcap0.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fjworld/23uRLPL6N6MvJYNJf4CssNL3bet4PxewQoJuZYyRWFDYAJDcyesPSbRKGQcTHFCxxB3TP.png)

![toofuckeh_adj_mcap.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fjworld/23xyriAus1aWYvV6LuNTwDRi4jbCgaftrjt81rkdHJmNaPRtK8peWFcUe7rVsyu6SwrrT.png)

In the above Bar Chart, I excluded the tokens in the fjworld.pept locked token account. You can see the significant valuation change from the current price increase of Hive.

## TooFuckeh Liquidity Pools 

![toofuckeh_lp.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fjworld/23tmmJoNsmd3fvSWKxA4rKfcQXWWrs2aWMm6JRQiwx7GAya8jcFRCiYUihbyFMnjrjfXX.png)

The value of our Liquidity Pool holdings has increased significantly and sooner than expected.

**In the March report I said...**
> I expect that our problem solving account will have accumulated over $600 in liquidity by the end of 2026.

Well, our liquidity valuation has increased by over 163% so we blew pass our 2026 target. This shows that strategies that focus on process and not just target can produce returns beyond expectations.

The next 2 images are included to show the change since the last FJWorld update.

![lps.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fjworld/23xAyLpLnFj4hQ7fKjibXhRp6TfCcdsRN1gg3tAx4g7x4D5mWw5tGx5ihjyUkia7Qo62i.png)

![toofuckeh_lps.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fjworld/23w3EvJ7g1AepdPrRPETUHMbQSjjZGuHJuXZYZ6PCYn7je2KPvKp7ZAaG8ZEzjHy3AWSV.png)

This week I will be making changes to several Liquidity Pools across several accounts and not just our problem solving account.

## Important
Our problem solving game pieces is most important and every effort is make to achieve steady capital appreciation.

![toofuckeh_chart.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fjworld/23w3AcWHspqW2nqoDjj3yiYp2F4zsqEgsvzEfXN8M2ohkeLvnKmhLyzJasdHQkKHgcMa4.png)

We achieved a strong foundation above 0.010 Hive and with the increase in the price of Hive, staking TooFuckeh tokens and adding liquidity to TOOFUCKEH:SWAP.HIVE is a most rewarding way to grow digital wealth on Hive. 

**Make your problem solving tokens work for you**. That is, don't leave it liquid unless you are planning on selling.

Now we look at some other project activities.

## ePayTraffic

![epaytraffic.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fjworld/EogT5kbi7pbLoBY7kdHCwzzDKvMCSjc9M9k395cR8a1qK1i4WR9QPSChmKezBzoaJ66.png)
https://epaytraffic.com/rewards/

Migration of ePayTraffic Manual Traffic Exchange site with The PEPT Game continues. There was a setback because of poor surfing performance. This has been remedied by switching to a faster server. There was also a setback related to a cPanel vulnerability concern. This has been remedied as well.

I will publish a blog to update you on the current migration progress.

## SWF, TooFuckeh Stakers, pepEntropy, QuBit and more...

In the next few days I will review the recent changes with Sovereign Wealth Fund, Gift distribution for TooFuckeh Stakers and our PEPENTROPY:SWAP.HIVE Liquidity Pool.

## Offline Work
I have been very busy with landscaping on our home property and that has taken me away from online work. I also had to complete a couple of personal income tax returns and currently working on a corporate tax return. In addition, I am making long term plans related to transfer of assets to family members. This includes a cottage property, an income property and a couple of vacant lots.

Accept my apology for the delay in blogging about the many changes made and preparing you for changes coming. Thank you for your understanding.

Time for another task.

May  Positive [pepEntropy](https://tribaldex.com/trade/PEPENTROPY) be with all Hivers.

title.title: Swing Between Shadows: The Ultimate Power of Two Spider Men
title.body:
https://youtu.be/vNyiTmtJqL4?si=YCgJV2QzQlMKtFyi
Watch on YouTube 

Marvel's Spider Man 2 is an incredible video game that perfectly combines action, adventure and an emotional story. In this game players get the chance to control not one but two superheroes Peter Parker and Miles Morales who put in all their strength to save New York City from dangerous enemies.

The most special feature of this game is its amazing graphics and near realistic environment. New York City has been designed so beautifully that it feels like you are actually swinging through the city. Spider Man’s fast paced movement and web swinging between buildings transport the player into an entirely different world.

In terms of story this game is also quite strong. It includes new and old villains like Venom and Kraven the Hunter who make the story even more thrilling. Every mission brings a new challenge and every twist keeps the player constantly engaged. The bond between Peter and Miles and the weight of their responsibilities also add emotional depth to the story.


If we talk about gameplay the fighting system has been made even better and more exciting than before. New gadgets special moves and the unique abilities of both characters make the game even more fun. Overall this game is an excellent choice for anyone who loves action games and superheroes.

title.title: Nueva revelación en el estudio | Historia [ESP-ENG]
title.body:
> ![aaaa.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPSTUpLD3YKw7LamPgWRitc8vmY6ZJLYezkLfv6C5QWzf/aaaa.jpg) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/foto-de-enfoque-selectivo-de-mujer-tocando-la-guitarra-2223848/) Una semana después, el estudio de Holozing seguía muy emocionado con todo le trabajo intenso que se hizo, los pasillos habían sido cambiados por una energía más intensa, más ambiciosa, además nadie hablaba de la batalla perdida, ni de la repetición. Ahora todos hablaban de lo que venía por el mismo hecho de que las cuatro pruebas habían terminado con éxito comenzando comenzado desde el desierto hasta el océano. Claudio regresó al estudio y se sentó frente a la pantalla principal, observando las grabaciones una y otra vez, cualquier error mínimo para mejorar y cada vez más pelean entre criaturas son diferentes — comentó. El empresario, también están listo y respondió sin dudar —Porque ya no son pruebas de batallas, ahora están evolucionando y aprovechando sus habilidades al máximo. Todo cambio cuando se escuchó la puerta del estudio abrirse, fue un sonido fuerte y resultó ser un nuevo guitarrista. Nadie sabía su nombre aún, pero cuando sus dedos tocaron las cuerdas, el ambiente cambió por completo, ya que tenía talento y seguro que era capaz de crear cualquier sonido. Claudio sonrió levemente —Esto era lo que faltaba. >A week later, the Holozing studio was still buzzing with excitement over all the hard work that had been done; the hallways were filled with a more intense, more ambitious energy, and no one was talking about the lost battle or the setback. Now everyone was talking about what was to come, simply because the four tests had been successfully completed, starting from the desert and ending at the ocean. # >Claudio returned to the studio and sat in front of the main screen, watching the recordings over and over again. “Any minor mistake to improve on, and each time the battles between the creatures are different,” he remarked. The manager, also ready, replied without hesitation, “Because they’re no longer battle trials; now they’re evolving and making the most of their abilities.” # >Everything changed when the studio door opened; it was a loud sound, and it turned out to be a new guitarist. No one knew his name yet, but when his fingers touched the strings, the atmosphere changed completely, as he was talented and surely capable of creating any sound. Claudio smiled slightly. “This was what was missing.” ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRxkrALthkCpbLnbjQBGi5SAz22KZyfkviNHH5YippLsB/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/hombre-persona-sentado-musico-7715396/) El equipo de músicos crecía y eso mismo día, el equipo de diseño se duplicó también con pantallas nuevas, ideas de mejor calidad que aparecían sin descanso. Todos comenzaron a trabajar y el estudio comenzó a llenarse de bocetos: formas desconocidas, siluetas incompletas, estructuras que no parecían pertenecer ni al agua, ni a la tierra, ni al cielo. Esto era algo totalmente nuevo. Esa noche, todo el equipo fue convocado al salón central y luces se apagaron, solo quedó encendida la pantalla central. El empresario dio un paso al frente — este es el comienzo de algo grande —dijo con firmeza—. Mientras que en el fondo se escuchó un sonido que venía de la guitarra marcando el ritmo de algo, ya que no era una melodía completa era una advertencia. Segundos después en la pantalla, una figura comenzó a formarse. Primero era una sombra, luego una silueta y después movimientos dejando a todos si palabras.—Esta… —susurró Claudio. Hasta que finalmente se mostró una nueva criatura en pantalla y abrió los ojos, mientras que el guitarrista nuevo tocaba con fuerza, pero todo se quedó en silencio y la criatura se fue. Allí todos entendieron, que estaba naciendo una nueva criatura y nueva canción que la acompañara. >The team of musicians was growing, and that very day, the design team doubled in size as well, with new screens and higher-quality ideas emerging nonstop. Everyone got to work, and the studio began to fill with sketches: unfamiliar shapes, incomplete silhouettes, structures that seemed to belong neither to the water, nor to the land, nor to the sky. This was something entirely new. # >That night, the entire team was summoned to the central hall, and the lights went out; only the central screen remained lit. The entrepreneur stepped forward—“This is the beginning of something big,” he said firmly. Meanwhile, in the background, a sound could be heard coming from the guitar, marking the rhythm of something; since it wasn’t a complete melody, it was a warning. # >Seconds later, a figure began to take shape on the screen. First it was a shadow, then a silhouette, and then movements that left everyone speechless. “This…” whispered Claudio. Until finally, a new creature appeared on the screen and opened its eyes, while the new guitarist played forcefully, but everything fell silent and the creature was gone. Then everyone understood that a new creature was being born, along with a new song to accompany it. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeQm8gUhfXBMZsz4aVooxnKW6qNt6AqVfiCpazcAY7L9X/image.png) [Source](https://peakd.com/hive-131131/@holozing/first-bug-and-poison-type-creature-reveal-and-some-updates)
