body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hatdogsensei/23tvAaMV6zwpFnWckPt3FfuwKCaZmwub3CqNWFLgsKrUL55T5muBkfHJi7P9N2EHm9D8o.png)

Hello Splinterlands Community, The community challenge for this week is to fully utilize the AI available to make Splinterlands look cooler and better to the public. I think this is a great initiative since the different AI tools is very accessible and available which can help the game in the future. My goal for this challenge is to create a modern design for the OG cards in the game. These are the cards from the Alpha and Beta sets which are the first cards that were introduced in the game many years ago. I personally love to use these cards on my battles before and I believe they can still be a gamechanger on Wild format battles since they have these powerful stats and abilities.

![ \

](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYBaGeXbVWaEiG1jni6u7XS8WVUTkBCaKSPkBgUA9i4oq/image.png) # **Divine Healer**

Divine Healer is a life alpha unit that has the tank heal ability and it has the design of an elder with the healing ability which I use as inspiration in creating the new look for this card which emphasizes on updating the looks of the Divine Healer and showcasing its healing capability.

## 🖌️ Original Design: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hatdogsensei/23xVRCbxCdB7u6o4bnnpzU2HyVfWjh2ctawTsmrFfkbXndM3t7TqUBKMKzYREgw9VqnbT.png) ## 🎨 Reimagine Design: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hatdogsensei/23vi47GyVmxx5NtfoUX7Ms5xuTtAutreHR14hspEnk6U9hknMxayqRNAzajctdwS2ERon.png) ![ \

](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYBaGeXbVWaEiG1jni6u7XS8WVUTkBCaKSPkBgUA9i4oq/image.png) # **Prince Rennyn**

Prince Rennyn is a legendary earth beta summoner that provides bonus health, armor and ranged damage to all units at the start of the match and it is personally one of my favorite summoners in the game and my goal for this summoner is to make the Prince to look more fierce and elegant as well as to utilize the earth element with its archery skills.

## 🖌️ Original Design: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hatdogsensei/23uQnCz1aJEF3WwkvV1snGpZFbK5kpPy1bHZkz9hVuCyzfWhGJkPBQqXUE7Ed5PgNqWf2.png) ## 🎨 Reimagine Design: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hatdogsensei/23wgKytKhEMBtcovtnQ6GgzYu4cC7uH7KTC6ijs48gUsdrL39fWpQkTizLuGJNBNHFaFS.png) ![ \

](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYBaGeXbVWaEiG1jni6u7XS8WVUTkBCaKSPkBgUA9i4oq/image.png) # **Undead Priest**

Undead Priest is a death alpha unit that has the weaken ability which reduces the health of the enemy units. It has the design of a mummy that is capable of casting curses to the enemy which I use as idea in creating the new look for this card which focuses on the dark look of the card considering that is from death element as well as showcasing its curses capability with its debuffing abilities.

## 🖌️ Original Design: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hatdogsensei/23vsL1sdwPa8Htkg9t6zVN6Zz7h5ikc2M9ccgkHiVPv9VkFboeqgKWmVHyMqxoodaSXqe.png) ## 🎨 Reimagine Design: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hatdogsensei/23uFM2bAHTRaVP2tzkuB5XdsNhL8NmJgcU1hmyDBZon4q9joKh6kgDo72FgWZZayjfq4h.png) ![ \

](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYBaGeXbVWaEiG1jni6u7XS8WVUTkBCaKSPkBgUA9i4oq/image.png) # **Alric Stormbringer**

Alric Stormbringer is a water alpha summoner that provides additional magic damage to all your units at the start of the match. The card has the design of an elder wizard that is casting a magic ability which I use as inspiration in creating the new look for Alric Stormbringer where I emphasize on its strengths which is the magic damage also I make the stormbringer theme for the card more showcased on to its reimagined design

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 05 2026
body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g4434b07901bda5ddf39753db96f603977dd6a8435914ae039b108a5644367524cda35a3b58c66f4f47bddcbee62070db7708a897f6d287a893510c4d31feabbe_640.jpg)
Hoy mi caminata fue realmente revitalizante. Comencé mi ruta en el parque central, donde el aire fresco y los árboles frondosos me dieron la bienvenida. Mientras paseaba, me encontré con una mujer mayor que estaba alimentando a las palomas. Su sonrisa era contagiosa, y me contó historias sobre cómo solía venir aquí con sus hijos cuando eran pequeños. Fue un hermoso recordatorio de cómo las pequeñas cosas pueden crear grandes recuerdos. Más adelante, pasé por una galería de arte al aire libre y me detuve a admirar una impresionante pintura mural que representaba la diversidad de nuestra ciudad. Hablé con un artista local que estaba pintando en vivo. Me explicó su proceso creativo y cómo se inspira en las diferentes culturas que coexisten en nuestra comunidad. Fue inspirador escuchar su pasión por el arte y su deseo de transmitir un mensaje de unidad a través de su trabajo. La caminata no solo me permitió disfrutar de la belleza del paisaje urbano, sino que también me brindó la oportunidad de conectar con personas y aprender de sus historias. Sin duda, cada paseo tiene su propia magia. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). body.title: [테이스팀#652]용리단길 파스타전문 오네스토(onesto)
body.body:
어린이날~!!
용산공원을 거쳐 처음으로 용리단길에 다녀왔다. ~단길이 많은 건 알았지만, 용히단길은 또 처음 들어봤다.
날씨도 맑고 화창하고, 감기가 몸을 좀 괴롭혔지만, 특별한 일정도 없어서 가볍게 나선 길이었다. 결론부터 말하면 기대를 많이 하고 가면 살짝 심심할 수 있는데, 그냥 동네 산책하듯이 보면 나름 괜찮은 곳이었다.

지하철에서 내려서 신용산역 쪽으로 나오자마자 분위기가 조금 달라지는 게 느껴졌다. 높은 빌딩들이 있는 지역인데도 조금만 걸어 들어가면 바로 골목으로 분위기가 바뀌고, 그 사이사이에 카페랑 식당들이 늘어선 골목. 조금 더 걸어가면 삼각지역 방향으로 이어지는데, 그쪽이 흔히 말하는 용리단길 느낌이 더 강하게 나는 구간이었다.

전체적인 인상은 생각보다 화려한 “핫플 거리” 느낌은 아니었다. 성수처럼 넓고 북적이는 상권도 아니고, 가로수길처럼 길 하나를 중심으로 쭉 이어지는 구조도 아니었다. 대신 작은 골목 안에 가게들이 흩어져 있는 형태라서, 걸어 다니면서 하나씩 발견하는 재미가 있는 동네였다. 오래된 건물을 리모델링해서 만든 가게들도 많아서 그런지, 일부러 꾸며놓은 느낌보다는 자연스럽게 형성된 분위기가 더 크게 느껴졌다.

![BFF853ED-4C04-4675-8E1D-DEAE920337B3.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQTFYwSCgTRwtaweFaVpaQro792qX6kSJXbtJ1pT9yt9D/BFF853ED-4C04-4675-8E1D-DEAE920337B3.jpeg)

식사는 고민하다가 피자랑 파스타를 먹을 수 있는 Onesto에 들어갔다. 웨이팅이 없는 게 제일 큰 이유였고, 분위기도 괜찮아보여서였다.
오히려 조용히 식사하는 분위기의 레스토랑이었다. 그래선지 주변에 소개팅 분위기를 풍기거나 데이트 하는 커플이 많아보였다. 
피자와 파스타를 주문했는데 전체적으로 맛은 무난하게 괜찮았다. 특별히 튀는 맛이라기보다는 안정적인 이탈리안 레스토랑 느낌이라 부담 없이 먹기 좋았다.
다만, 330미리 정도의 맥쥬가 만원이라닛! 요즘 시세를 내가 모르는 것인가?
(이러니 다들 그냥 집에서 한 술~ 그러니 가격은 더 상승? 악순환인가?)

식사 후에는 주변을 조금 더 걸어봤는데, 확실히 용리단길은 뭔가를 보러 오는 곳이라기보다는 그냥 천천히 걷는 동네에 가까웠다. 카페도 많고 술집도 많아서 저녁 시간에는 분위기가 또 다를 것 같다는 생각이 들었다. 낮에는 비교적 조용하고, 골목 사이로 햇빛이 들어오는 느낌이 괜찮았다.

전체적으로 정리하면 용리단길은 엄청난 볼거리나 대표 맛집이 있는 곳이라기보다는, “적당히 걷고, 적당히 먹고, 적당히 쉬기 좋은 골목”에 가까웠다. 기대를 너무 크게 하고 가면 아쉬울 수 있지만, 가볍게 산책 겸 다녀오기에는 나쁘지 않은 곳이었다. 다음에는 저녁 시간대에 와서 분위기가 어떻게 달라지는지도 한 번 보고 싶다.
너무 ‘핫‘하지 않아 마음에 들었던 용리단길!

El sábado descubrí uno de esos rincones especiales que, aunque siempre han estado ahí, logran sorprenderte como si fueran un pequeño secreto bien guardado en mi querida ciudad de . Durante nuestra visita al Hotel El Bosque, buscando disfrutar de la piscina y escapar un poco del intenso calor, mi amiga Yessica y yo nos encontramos con una grata sorpresa: el Bar Azul.


Desde que entramos, el lugar nos conquistó por completo. Su ambiente acogedor, fresco y elegante fue como un oasis en medio de las altas temperaturas de afuera. Lo mejor de todo fue descubrir que no es necesario hospedarse en el hotel para disfrutar de este espacio, algo que lo convierte en una excelente opción para quienes desean regalarse un momento diferente sin grandes complicaciones.


Como buenas cubanas amantes del café, fuimos directas a explorar las opciones. Aunque nos sorprendió saber que en moneda nacional solo podíamos acceder a expreso, cortadito, piña colada, jugo de tomate y cerveza importada, mientras muchas otras ofertas eran exclusivamente en tarjeta de dólares, eso no logró empañar nuestra experiencia.


Probamos el café expreso y el cortadito, y honestamente, ambos fueron una delicia. Aromáticos, intensos y perfectamente preparados, de esos cafés que se disfrutan despacio, conversación tras conversación. También pedimos piñas coladas para consentir a nuestras madres, porque si algo tengo claro, es que ellas merecen siempre cada detalle bonito, cada pequeño gesto de amor y cada experiencia especial que podamos compartirles.


Verlas disfrutar su café en aquel ambiente tan agradable hizo el momento aún más especial. Entre risas, buena compañía, bebidas deliciosas y el aire acondicionado que nos abrazaba mientras afuera el calor seguía haciendo de las suyas, por momentos olvidamos completamente que nuestra idea inicial era pasar el día en la piscina.


El Bar Azul terminó robándose una parte importante de nuestra visita, regalándonos mucho más que café: nos ofreció pausa, confort y recuerdos hermosos. A veces, los mejores momentos no son los que planeamos, sino esos que aparecen de forma inesperada y convierten un día común en una experiencia memorable. Sin duda, este rincón del Hotel El Bosque se ganó un lugar especial en mi lista de sitios favoritos para volver, disfrutar y seguir creando recuerdos llenos de sabor, cariño y pequeños lujos que alegran el alma.




# English Version 




Last Saturday, I discovered one of those special places that, even though it has always been there, manages to surprise you like a well-kept little secret in my beloved city of . During our visit to Hotel El Bosque, while planning to enjoy the pool and escape the intense heat for a while, my friend Yessica and I came across a wonderful surprise: the famous Blue Bar.


From the moment we walked in, the place completely won us over. Its cozy, fresh, and elegant atmosphere felt like an oasis in the middle of the unbearable outdoor temperatures. The best part was discovering that you do not need to stay at the hotel to enjoy this space, which makes it an excellent option for anyone wanting to treat themselves to a different experience without too much hassle.


Like true Cubans who deeply love coffee, we immediately explored the menu options. Although we were surprised to learn that in national currency we could only purchase espresso, cortadito, piña colada, tomato juice, and imported beer, while many other choices required a dollar card, this did not ruin our experience at all.


We tried both the espresso and the cortadito, and honestly, they were absolutely delicious. Aromatic, intense, and perfectly prepared, the kind of coffee you enjoy slowly while sharing meaningful conversations. We also ordered piña coladas to treat our mothers, because if there is one thing I truly believe, it is that mothers deserve every beautiful detail, every small gesture of love, and every special experience we can offer them.


Watching them enjoy their coffee in such a pleasant setting made the moment even more meaningful. Between laughter, wonderful company, delicious drinks, and the refreshing air conditioning embracing us while the heat raged outside, we almost forgot that our original plan had been to spend the day at the pool.


The Blue Bar ended up stealing an important part of our visit, giving us much more than coffee. It offered us comfort, relaxation, and beautiful memories. Sometimes, the best moments are not the ones we carefully plan, but the unexpected ones that transform an ordinary day into something unforgettable. Without a doubt, this charming corner of Hotel El Bosque has earned a special place on my list of favorite spots to return to, enjoy, and continue creating memories filled with flavor, love, and those small luxuries that brighten the soul.

title.title: Addressing Crisis 2026
title.body:
/>

The world in 2026 faces multiple simultaneous problems which connect to each other like threads in a single fabric. The primary element that controls everything in the system is change. The system experiences rapid and permanent alterations which frequently produce excessive changes to its existing state.  
The world faces its most critical challenge through increasing expenses for daily living. The costs for food and rent and transportation and essential items keep rising across various cities and countries. The actual wage increases for workers do not match the rising cost of living expenses.

Families of millions experience daily hardships because they need to select between essential items and their financial capabilities. People now treat basic food items as essential expenses they must track and evaluate before purchasing.  
The world currently faces its second important challenge through growing economic inequality. The world experiences technological and economic development but the advantages of this progress do not reach every individual.

People who possess unlimited access to educational tools and career chances and comfortable living conditions, while others remain trapped in informal work and unstable housing. The divide between rich people and those who face economic difficulties keeps growing, which leads to social unrest and community unrest in various regions.  
The effects of climate change now appear in people's daily existence. The occurrence of extreme weather events, which include floods and heatwaves and storms, has transformed into a regular part of life. The current state of the world exists. Farmers face unpredictable seasonal challenges, cities experience flooding problems, and communities must complete their rebuilding process repeatedly. Environmental issues now function as primary elements that determine human existence.  
The world faces a rising challenge from mental health issues. Young people experience mental health problems through their development of stress and anxiety and loneliness. The combination of social media comparison with financial uncertainty, creates emotional exhaustion through the success pressure. Mental health support services remain either restricted or hard to obtain in numerous locations around the world.

People experience technological changes which transform their daily activities and their work environments. The combination of artificial intelligence with automated systems leads to job elimination but results in job creation.

The transformation creates new possibilities which “bring both” present opportunities and present challenges which make people fear the upcoming changes. People who possess adaptation skills “will make progress” while others who lack this ability “will face” the risk of becoming obsolete. Education systems find themselves under pressure to establish their system because of rapid educational changes which are currently occurring.  
Urban areas face a severe problem because their residents require adequate housing solutions. Urban areas experience population growth while the supply of affordable housing fails to match this increased demand. Most workers and their families now face two major challenges which include overcrowding and subsequent development of informal settlements and extended time required for commuting.  
Trust has developed into a major challenge which requires solution. The world today contains excessive information which makes it difficult to separate true information from false information. Misinformation spreads rapidly through social platforms which leads to changes in public views and results in different groups developing fenced-off relationships.  
The combined analysis of all existing problems leads to the discovery that our world continues to progress without any possibility of stopping. The world exists in a state of speed which exceeds the capacity of various systems including governments and schools and economies and individuals to adapt completely.  
The main obstacle which 2026 presents to us extends beyond any particular crisis. Humanity must develop its capacity to adapt social links and personal equilibrium which enables them to navigate an environment that undergoes continual modifications.

title.title: El Principito Café [A good place in Valencia] ESP/ENG
title.body:
![Pink Yellow Aesthetic Collage Travel Diaries Vlog YouTube Thumbnail (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wqq23MdCWhvg3qJDwAVE9RoiMdfpnfQZQr1YmCnkeCq3g3BzPxCNy51ncdXZ2ZJZGfm.jpg)
(Cover designed by me in canva editor)
>Portada diseñada por mi en el editor de Canva

Hello everyone! The place I want to show you today is a real gem in my city, Valencia, Venezuela. Valencia has gradually become a small gastronomic powerhouse in the country, with more and more cafes and restaurants. However, what makes this place different is evident from its very name, \

(The Prince), as it's one hundred percent inspired by Antoine de Saint-Exupéry's famous book. From the outside, you can tell it's a special and very welcoming place. It has many iconic elements that you'll recognize whether you're a fan of the novel like me, or if you've simply read the book once, like this one here. Do you remember that drawing the aviator made as a child that everyone interpreted as a hat, but it was actually a boa constrictor that had swallowed an elephant? >¡Hola que tal El lugar que pretendo mostrarles ek día de hoy es una senscion de mi ciudad, Valencia, en Venezuela, ya que poco a poco Valencia se ha ido convirtiendo en una pequeña potencia gastronóica en el país, con cada vez más cafés y restaurantes, sin embargo lo que hace diferente a este lugar está presente desde su nombre mismo “El Príncipito” ya que está inspirado cien por ciento en el famoso libro de Antoine de Saint-Exupér. Desde afuera puedes percibir que es un lugar especial y muy acogedor, cuenta con muchos elementos icónicos que tanto si ustedes son fans de la novela como yo, o si simplemente han leído el libro una vez, podrán reconocerlo, como esto de aquí. ¿Recuerdan ese dibujo que el aviador hizo en su niñez y que todos interpretaban como un sombrero pero en realidad era una boa que había devorado un elefante?

![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.05 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EoeFM4wtEEWQotYCp6gwumCaHAZvxR2DcStD2KvLtBvBH3SP5Ds5uNNmHfmQGrX9iLb.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.05 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/Epta5iYQT4MASL3qXtV8Ap77zpvBXN8XyfkE3ri6WFFjrT4E5EzgoF7jKo66njC9fr4.jpeg)

Inside, the place is quite small and doesn't even have public restrooms due to its size (a major drawback). The small size and the number of people who sometimes enter can be overwhelming for you as a customer, but it's not too bad. The service is top-notch, with very friendly and well-trained staff. The background music is at a good volume, and I feel this creates a cozy atmosphere that compensates for the lack of space. It's also full of iconic elements, like the famous quote from the fox who wanted to be \

>Por dentro el lugar es bastante pequeñito y ni siquiera cuenta con baños para el público debido a lo pequeño que es (un gran punto en contra) el reducido tamaño y la cantidad de gente que a veces entra puede resultar agobiante en tu experiencia como cliente, pero tampoco es algo tan grave, la atención es de primera calidad, con un personal muy amable y bien preparado para la atención al publico, la música de fondo está a un buen volumen y siento que esto genera un ambiente acogedor que compensa la falta de espacio, además está lleno de elementos icónicos como esta célebre frase del zorro que quería se “domesticado” por el Principito “Lo esencial es invisible a los ojos”.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.13 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EoAYo8Qxuf9EFa9sEb85J25XG1pnv8jp4HLFypo9v1q74Gx5KBpnt2FxG1mDbHiutXJ.jpeg)

The menu is quite simple, with no complicated recipes since it's a Coffee shop, not a restaurant, so they only serve breakfast and afternoon tea. I ordered a cappuccino and a puff pastry chicken pie, which was absolutely delicious.

>El menú es bastante sencillo, sin recetas muy complicadas ya que se trata de un café, no de un restaurante, así que solo sirven desayunos y meriendas. Yo ordené un capuchino y un pastel de pollo de hojaldre que estaba absolutamente delicioso.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.25 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wCJAARzNvgEz5cUNCxvoLuY1YZg4vzoCMumxCedPRbrViSUoaQXZ737mWW41YNpu7Bd.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.25 PM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EopuQAsEEXLiK77B4ZZxqr4FLMV9hV38CSVuAanjYvE6VR9fEEBRZGh8Nc3ANtnod8Z.jpeg)

Everywhere I looked, something caught my eye. Roses predominated, representing the vain rose in the story who demanded all the little prince's attention. He cared for her diligently, watering her and protecting her with a glass dome at night. There are also stars and planets everywhere, representing the galaxy through which the main character travels in his quest for knowledge..

>Por donde quiera que yo mirara algo llamaba mi atención, las rosas predominaban como representación de la rosa vanidosa que en el cuento demandaba toda la atención del principito, él la cuidaba con esmero, regándola y protegiéndola con una cúpula de cristal por las noches. También hay estrellas y planetas por todos lados que representan la galaxia por la que el personaje principal viaja en su búsqueda de conocimiento.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.16 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23z7FuossAhtsBhxx9QWQjZXDzk4R7bkvgRujNi4cEFbYZvgT3E5o8Rv3KYijrs1x1uxp.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.09 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EoGxSUJjriZnA2C5zcg6yNJsU2kSfwTtmp8ByDdQT2tFJSc6X1CbimqfgwSK89vCG6q.jpeg)

They also sell some interesting souvenirs; they don't have a huge selection, but there are some things you can choose from to give a special gift to someone who appreciates such things.

>También venden algunos souveniers interesantes, no es mucha la mercannciía que tienen allí pero si hay cosas que se pueden elegir para darle un regalo esecial a alguien que sepa apreciar esas cosas.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.07 PM (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23x1B9mCajqe5vwd3FGp2tu7MVi5KD2Mip5uHkSybGFSTRie45MYJenABQiDCdjnafChj.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.08 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/Ep1XoivBS97EzKazGyXxnhboTX2yhCgD9kkNkvcuxtfA8VbhF6Bv38BWEdYwNDPBVDC.jpeg)

The truth is that I am delighted to have gone to that place, except for the negative points I found I can say in general terms that it was a very pleasant gastronomic experience but also a sensory one because seeing each element there was as if in some way I had been absorbed by the book.

>La verdad es que estoy encantada de haber ido a ese lugar, salvo por los puntos negativos que encontré puedo decir en términos generales que fue una gratísima experiencia gastronómica pero también sensorial porque de verdad que ver cada elemento allí fue como si de alguna manera yo hubiese sido absorbida por el libro.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.08 PM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wgFTcgmxcq2EnEo4Y561oGxcnzoxtpvipvzZ7ET1wCdo5SvvBxmD5JKuk8ShHW1haZa.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.26 PM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23vhsCqTthA1Tf4VXEifyoZWDJob88MvM2zEsBmic35v83EHYYHwMKCVdm6NqyKFHvNNc.jpeg)

I hope you enjoyed this place as much as I did; it's a perfect spot for introspection and relaxation, where you can eat well and dream big.

>Espero que les haya gustado tanto este lugar como me gustó a mi, es un lugar perfecto para la introspección y la relajación donde se come rico y se sueña en grande.
![Presentación Propuesta de Proyecto Portfolio Scrapbook Marrón y Negro.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wqwC8G3pmfAmUg1E61Zg3gUWbUypQbajqdteMGTFid9mWcYbLuHqe1kY7FxJ8zAiMM5.jpg)
(Image designed by me in canva editor)

title.title: Family Reunion [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
![Pink Cream and Brown Aesthetic Collage Vlog Lifestyle YouTube Thumbnail.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/242hf3FSM37jBy2RFnRc2EFCZx9PH3nnbdK3Ce9rP7ku7fipxj4bxJvRKDohz2FrP2kJf.jpg)
Made with Canva Editor >Imagen editada en Canva

On Sunday I had a wonderful family meeting and reunion that I enjoyed like never before, and I say \

because I almost always see my family (my sisters and nephews) but on Sunday I had the opportunity to meet again with one of my nieces who has lived for some years in Barcelona, Spain, and is now visiting her own country, reuniting with all her loved ones. >El domingo tuve un precioso encuentro y reencuentro familiar que disfruté como nunca, y digo “encuentro” y “reencuentro” porque yo casi siempre veo a mi familia (mis hermanas y sobrinos) pero es que el domingo fue que tuve la oportunidad de reencontrarme con una de mis sobrinas que vive desde hace unos años en Barcelona, España, y ahora está de visita en su propio país, reencontrándose con todos sus seres queridos.

She has always been a practicing Catholic, having studied at Don Bosco School. So, as a way of thanking God for being back in her country and among her family, she organized a thanksgiving mass at the sanctuary of Don Bosco School, where she and my youngest daughter also studied. Almost all the family members attended the gathering, and it was also the first time we saw a mass celebrated by William, or rather, Father William, a great friend of my niece and therefore of the whole family.

>Ella siempre ha sido católica practicante ya que estudió en el colegio Don Bosco, así que como una forma de agradecer a Dios por estar nuevamente en su país y entre los suyos, ella organizó una misa de acción de gracias en el santuario del mismo colegio Don Bosco donde ella estudió y mi hija menor también. Casi todos los miembros de la famlia aistimos a la reunion, pero además fue la priera vez que vimos una misa oficiada por William, o bueno, más bien el padre William un gran amigo de mi sobrina y por ende de toda la familia.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.03 PM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/Eq5DvBXVRipP3M7Pyp6dcX7XxusW8zRUkzrNpGBsWoVepK3L8RFp8ucJH8BkCU6RfMi.jpeg)

After Mass, the school library was lent to us so the whole family could spend time together peacefully, and that's exactly what we did: we ate, drank, and chatted at length, reminiscing about old times. My niece shared her experiences not only as an immigrant in Spain but also as a doctor and through her service to the church and the nursing home where she volunteers. We also filled her in on all the family news. We truly had a wonderful time, laughing and enjoying ourselves like we hadn't in a long time.

>Luego de la misa nos prestaron la biblioteca del colegio para que pudiesemos convivir tranquilamente toda la familia y así lo hicimos: comimos, bebimos y nos dedicamos a conversar largo y tendido, recordando anecdotas y mi sobrina compartiendo sus experiencias no solo como migrante en España sino como médico y también con sus servicios a la iglesia y al ancianato en el que trabaja como voluntaria, nosotros también la pusimos al día con todos los pormenores de la familia. Realmente pasamos un momento agradable en el cual nos reímos y disfrutamos como no lo habíamos hecho en mucho tiempo.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.01 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/EqhQkKcp22qNETBP7dsFT6trd2KhKJPuzJYLQFQ6BqHWovs1U7fH1iqdLBfX1Wu8h1U.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.06.56 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/EprVVMnSiVnhYBVrFbhoHvUFjzVtoWVDwBN3UbVHAiEUTzsix5PEErMpz3LJbGaNDN8.jpeg)

Then it was time to take family photos, first with my sisters (one was away on a trip at the time) and also with my nephews and nieces. All of this brought back many memories of the times we were there for a \

(an activity held to celebrate the anniversary week of Saint John Bosco). I also remember the school band activities I attended to support my daughter.

>Luego llegó el momento de hacer las fotos familiares, en primer lugar con mis hermanas (faltaba una que estaba de viaje en ese momento) y también con los sobrinos. Todo esto me trajo muchos recuerdos de las veces que estuvimos allí en un “Domingo Familiar” (una actividad que se hacía a propósito de la semana de aniversario de San Juan Bosco), también recuerdo las actividades de la banda escolar a la que yo asistía para apoyar a mi hija.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.06.38 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/EqdAvW4apQ8bTPEUyprrNiE5JtpWvHc4cyq6ZKLtFwmYFbR5MkZTwptJUspHXadJGJy.jpeg)

I was also surprised to find different places or areas, like a chapel that wasn't there before, but we kept taking pictures to immortalize the beautiful moment, and we were dying of laughter at the faces my brother was making, since he is the funny one in the family.

>También me sorprendió encontrar lugares o zonas diferentes, como una capilla que antes no estaba allí, pero nosotros seguíamos tomando fotos para inmortalizar el hermoso momento, y nos moríamos de risa con las caras que hacía mi hermano, ya que él es el gracioso de la familia.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.01 PM (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/EoPQQPBNHorviiycS4czF5nrugte6REaQjsSe4UeRcFf3XngyTD9ByjBt8zKWX4XuzX.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.06.09 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23z7FctjriHgBuZsdBPfW4WyWy6Pw7qxjkEKeNFCPbCNoyyQzPnoYiBpZNr4ef94CzoR3.jpeg)

I am truly grateful to God for this wonderful opportunity to be together, which offers us moments of happiness that somehow alleviate and compensate for the difficult times we have faced on several occasions. This shows us that life is a constant flow of changes, and that we must therefore make the most of it, learn from our mistakes, grow through adversity, and enjoy the happy moments because life is the here and now. Thank you all for letting me share this overwhelming happiness with you. I send you virtual kisses and hugs.

>De verdad que estoy muy agradecida con Dios por esta maravillosa oportunidad de estar juntos que nos ofrece momentos de felicidad que sirven de alivio y compensación de alguna manera por los momentos duros que tuvimos que enfrentar en varias ocasiones, lo cual nos demuestra que la vida es un flujo constante de cambios y que por eso hay que aprovecharla al máximo, aprender de los errores, crecer en la adversidad y disfrutar los momentos felices porque la vida es el aquí y el ahora. Gracias también a ustedes por dejarme compartir esta felicidad que me embarga, les envío besos y abrazos virtuales.
![_Miniatura de Youtube Procrastinación Simple Dorado y Crema.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/245n5WzTfDjt8QuC1CfX1iGPu5crq9bsYhnHjwPHUAnBL93vKUMEPGEND9gUCyLLvHj4k.jpg)

title.title: Michael Jackson [The Movie Reveiew]
title.body:
![Grey Illustration Movie Making Presentation (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23vsDrfNVCTvWPX8b846q2pDshemBV2PyjdRXCT581bj6j6RtdLSjgvzaHNFwcPG8pbQB.jpg)

Hey internet people. How's it going? Today I'm here to tell you that on Saturday I finally went to see the Michael Jackson movie 🤗 😃 and honestly, it not only met my expectations, but it far exceeded them. >Hola, gente de internet. ¿Todo bien? Hoy vengo a contarles que el sábado fui a ver la película de Michael Jackson POR FIN 🤗 😃 y la verdad es que no solo estuvo a la alturas de mis expectativas, sino que las superó con creces.

First of all, it was complete chaos because I booked the tickets through the cinema's app and had to pay with mobile payment (an electronic payment method in Venezuela), but when I tried to register the payment in the app, it wouldn't register. So I was stressed out, writing on all the cinema company's platforms until I had a lightbulb moment and registered the payment through the website instead of the app, and then I was able to do it (just a tip in case this happens to you).

>En primero lugar fue todo un caos porque reservé las entradas por la aplicación del cine y debía hacer el pago con pago móvil (un método de pago electrónico en Venezuela) pero al momento de registrar el pago en la app, no lo quería registrar, así que ya estaba estresada escribiendo en todas las plataformas de la compañía de cine hasta que se me prendió el foco de las ideas y registré el pago por la pág y no por la app, y entonces pude hacerlo (un dato por si les llegase a pasar esto)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.23 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23z7Hdf4puJLTEKdXLLvcqoHZ79LWXsZfb5kvoUzDs1zJjsgdq9d4XfSyFNWp2FjYfi6s.jpeg)

I think that rather than talking about photography or aesthetics, characteristics that define audiovisuals, on this occasion I prefer to focus on the story and the characterization and acting work, which for me was truly remarkable and impressive 🤗

>Creo que más que hablar de fotografía o estética, características que definen los audiovisuales, en esta ocasión prefiero irme por la historia y el trabajo de caracterización y actuaciones que fue lo que para mí fue realmente destacable e impresionante 🤗

I'll start by talking about the performances: everyone did an excellent job, however, I must highlight three actors in particular: Colman Domingo, who played Joseph Jackson; Juliano Krue Valdi, who played young Michael; and finally, Jaafar Jackson, who played his uncle as an adult. I think Jaafar (once in character) not only resembled him physically, but also in his demeanor. The camera angles in the scenes with Michael were very well placed, as they helped frame the panic and claustrophobia Michael felt towards his father, how he would back away when his father approached him, or how he would seek refuge in something to gain strength and not be so obvious when showing his fear.

>Empezaré hablando de las actuaciones: todos hicieron un excelente trabajo sin embargo debo destacar a tres actores en especial: el caso del actor Colman Domingo, quien interpretó a Joseph Jackson, a Juliano Krue Valdi, quien interpretó a Michael niño, y por último a Jaafar Jackson, quien interpretó a su tío de adulto. Creo que Jaafar (una vez caracterizado) no solo se parecía físicamente, sino que también en la actitud, los ángulos de cámara en las escenas que tenía el film con Michael estaban muy bien puestas ya que ayudaban a enmarcar esa relación de pánico y claustrofobia que sentía Michael referente a su padre, como se echaba atrás cuando esté se le acercaba, o buscaba reafirmarse a algo para obtener fuerza y no ser tan evidente a la hora de mostrar miedo.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.15 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/Enyn3yp2jUJPfqMXD45U64RpqZ4uji14Xfso7ptoVd7UcN3nyK5chQdMSEc7BdiRr5V.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.20 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/Eo1uVFqoaDoK5PS25wby9eMDpnxt4CufvFH1DgmwQf7oBTSbAo5XXQkS6f4ZgFi6MbB.jpeg)

The actor was imposing; his stage presence was truly unsettling, generating that sense of danger or constant alertness that Michael most likely felt in front of his father, which is admirable in the actor since he managed to convey everything he needed to.

>El actor imponía, realmente su puesta en escena daba incomodidad generaba esa sensación de peligro o de alerta permanente que muy probablemente sentía Michael frente a su padre lo que es digno de admiración en el actor ya que logró transmitir todo lo que debía
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.24 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/Eo1uVG9F5jGxTFqgkpwhiYSKAdfFv6AKzarwKs5YQEyBeSZmfGJMKaeZBgFBBvHNTWQ.jpeg)

Juliano Krue Valdi is definitely a mini-Michael, and what's most surprising about the original Michael is that he was explosive on stage from a young age. For a small child to captivate even adults is an admirable feat, so in my opinion, the fact that a child actor can replicate exactly what characterized that young Michael is astonishing. The boy expresses himself just as Michael did back then: explosive on stage but withdrawn and fearful offstage.

>Juliano Krue Valdi es definitivamente un mini Michael, y es que lo que más sorprende del Michael original, es que desde pequeño era explosivo en el escenario, y para un niño pequeño lograr cautivar incluso a adultos es una hazaña admirable, así que en mi opinión, el que un niño actor pueda replicar exactamente eso que caracterizaba a ese pequeño Michael es sorprendente. El niño se expresa tal cual lo hacia Michael en esa época, una explosión en el escenario pero retraído y temeroso fuera de él
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.16 PM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/EnymeUpos1V9N8CoWENCwXk6GpmQvkVAeWArjKvyeb5Qe1rtQwCWYwKeNppWXfK735t.jpeg)

It also has some pretty intense scenes, like those depicting abuse, and I think it does an excellent job of conveying everything a child in those circumstances can feel.

>Además tiene escenas bastante fuertes como las de maltrato, y creo que hace un excelente trabajo transmitiendo todo lo que un niño en esas condiciones puede sentir

Jaafar Jackson, wow! What can I say? He's truly an excellent actor, and I think growing up watching his uncle's work his whole life must have helped him a lot in refining the character. There was a lot of debate about whether he resembled him or not, but regardless... Watching him in the film was like seeing Michael: the tone of his voice when speaking or singing a cappella, his gaze, his expressions, not only when singing and dancing but in his everyday life, his submissive and shy way of moving, and his explosive power on stage... I think he gathered, developed, and ultimately projected all of that perfectly.

>Jaafar Jackson ¡Wow! ¿Qué puedo decir? La verdad es que es un excelente actor y creo que haber crecido mirando el trabajo de su tío toda su vida tiene que haberle ayudado mucho a pulir el personaje. Hubo mucho debate si se parecía o no pero independientemente... Verlo en la película era ver a Michael, el tono de su voz al hablar o cantar a capella, su mirada, sus expresiones, no solo al cantar y bailar sino en su día a día, su forma sumisa y tímida de moverse, y la fuerza explosiva en el escenario... Creo que recopiló, desarrollo y finalmente proyectó todo eso a la perfección.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.26 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23ynb45D4pzPEpuPfvV8P5fazzDJgKMxSSB9vAE6Ah52bBb913ojuCuFtTKqt61wADzVg.jpeg)

The repertoire of songs they used for the film is wonderful; my sister and I couldn't stop singing along, especially to \
by the Jackson Five, but also Michael's \

I also appreciated that the film didn't dwell on all the controversy surrounding Michael after 1993, but instead focused directly on showing who he was and how he reached the pinnacle of success, as well as revealing his more human side as a philanthropist, his need for affection as a person, and his longing for his lost childhood, beyond the pop superstar persona. The film shows us the excellent human being he was: resilient, empathetic, noble, and loving.

>El repertorio de canciones que utilizaron para el film es maravilloso, mi hermana y yo no dejábamos de cantar, en especial I'll be There y ABC de los Jackson's Five, pero también Thriller, Billie Jean y Bad de Michael. También me gustó que no se ahondara en todo ese tema de la polémica que el pobre Michael vivió después de 1993, sino que el film se enfocó directamente en mostrar quién era él y como llegó a la cúspide del éxito, además de mostrar su lado más humano como filántropo, sus necesidades de afecto como persona y su añoranza por la niñez perdida, más allá de la super estrella de pop. La película nos muestra el excelente ser humano que era: resiliente, empático, noble y amoroso.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.20 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23t752GskTyp8uvnfWzbPcGzcvuPWrYLwLYzRjeweKkyGmWb6JUZm1ETmL2VXZLfQ5vUJ.jpeg)

And well, people, that's all for today's post, I hope you liked it. Thank you very much as always for supporting my work, I welcome new readers, I love you all very much, I send you a hug and I'll see you in another post.

>Y bueno, gente, esto ha sido todo por el post de hoy, espero que les haya gustado. Muchas gracias como siempre por apoyar mi trabajo, le doy la bienvenida a los nuevos lectores, les quiero mucho a todos, les envío un abrazo y ya nos encontraremos en otro post
![Miniatura de YouTube Ilustrativo Niños Naranja Amarillo Blanco.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23wggpJxc7pQATGzLcLTp9GjDNd3VfauwAPHDRxoZ8EmXsU7zoEGH9nhDKFtEYUji1Fvf.jpg)

title.body: Greetings Hive family and food lovers everywhere! Food's got that epic power to link us all, crossing borders like Hive links creators worldwide. That's the spark behind my first Worldwide Cooking Contest on YouTube. Check my previous posts here if you missed the intro or the killer _ginisang upo_! As promised, Hive foodies, here's Entry #3 from Mharchie Vlog: Buttered Crabs that scream indulgence! Out of 10 stellar submissions packed with creativity, sweat, and mouthwatering flavor, I'm unveiling them one by one. Get ready to dive into this seafood stunner, comment to vote (most comments wins by May 9!), and let's see it shine.
/>\n\nWelcome back to another delicious food adventure! Today, we are bringing the \

to the kitchen with a seafood favorite that is guaranteed to be a crowd-pleaser. If you are a fan of rich, savory, and garlicky goodness, you are going to love this recipe for Buttered Crab with Garlic Flavor. The best part? There is a secret ingredient that gives the sauce a uniquely delicious twist! Let’s dive right into how you can cook this up at home. **What You’ll Need:** *

>The Secret Twist: Coke! (While many seafood recipes call for Sprite or 7-Up, using Coke brings out a surprisingly rich, caramelized flavor profile that takes this dish to the next level).

**Step-by-Step Instructions:** 1. Sauté the Aromatics Start by heating your pan and melting a generous block of butter. Once the butter is fully melted and bubbling, toss in your garlic. You want to cook this down until the garlic turns a beautifully fragrant golden brown. 2. Add the Crabs As soon as your garlic is perfectly toasted, it’s time to add the star of the show. Drop your fresh crabs into the pan, letting them coat in that rich garlic-butter base. 3. Season and Pour the Magic Ingredient Sprinkle a good amount of black pepper over the crabs to give it a nice kick of spice. Then, pour in the Coke! It might sound unconventional if you are used to clear sodas, but trust the process—the cola will reduce into a sticky, sweet, and savory glaze that pairs perfectly with the crab meat. 4. Cover, Simmer, and Flip Cover your pan and let the mixture come to a boil. The goal is to let the crabs cook thoroughly while the liquid slowly reduces. After a few minutes, remove the lid and flip the crabs over. This ensures that the heat is distributed evenly and that every part of the crab absorbs the flavorful sauce. 5. Reduce the Sauce (But Don't Let It Dry!) Keep simmering the crabs until the sauce thickens up. You have to keep a close eye on the pan during this final stretch. You want the sauce to reduce significantly so it clings to the shells, but do not let it dry out completely. Leaving a little bit of that thick, buttery, cola-infused sauce at the bottom of the pan is essential for serving (and for pouring over your rice!). **Ready to Serve!** Once the sauce reaches the perfect consistency, pull it off the heat. Grab a plate, serve it up hot, and get ready to get your hands messy. There you have it guys, a scrumptious, finger-licking Buttered Crab in Garlic Flavor. Happy cooking, and enjoy! **Watch the full video here:** https://youtu.be/2126s\_\_334k?t=13

title.title: Helpmeet by Naben Ruthnum
title.body:
### <center>Preamable</center>

<hr>

![20260501_170941~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EoAZgFW2NbRVzw34dviNEXuk6hdeAV8pCKVix17oUbgroTDtF1dg52zf6CURMR8zJeS.jpg)

This week I finished reading a book called Helpmeet by Naben Ruthnum. It was another very short novella of only 85 pages. This one could easily be read in a day or over a weekend, which makes it perfect for padding your book reading numbers. 

![20260430_193217~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EpT5ax1sg7CQhvoqx53CFVc5cbijaeVLGBpQQtR1DbvrhZGckgzn3rT1HnchCTRm79n.jpg)

The author is Canadian and the genre for this book is \

which isn't a genre that I am overly familiar with and not one I read normally. That being said, I don't have a good reference base to compare it. I personally didn't find this one to be scary or disturbing in any way though. I would probably describe it more as supernatural than horror myself. I found it more interesting and entertaining than anything. 

There is a good description listed on the back cover that I like. 

>##### a uniquely unsettling Gothic love story.

I think that is a pretty fitting description myself. 

### <center>Brief Synopsis</center>

<hr>

The book is short so I'll keep the synopsis brief. It is essentially about a woman who cares for her dying husband who is suffering from a strange and gruesome illness. I don't want to give away too much if anyone actually wants to read it. The book explores themes of infidelity, marriage and partner devotion, the caregiver relationship and disease with body horror.    

### <center>Synopsis with Spoilers</center>

<hr>

I'm going to include a section with a more detailed description now, for those that do not plan on reading it. I will be including spoilers in this section so **Skip the small print if you don't want the ending to be spoiled.** 

<sub>The husband contracts a strange disease from a woman that he is having an affair with. The wife knows of the affair and has accepted it and takes care of her husband as his body goes through a gruesome transformation process. The wife is a nurse by profession so she is at ease with the mans care. She can remove herself emotionally from the situation and act as his nurse I mean. She also still deeply cares for him. The mans nose turns color and falls off, his eyes fall out, as do his teeth. Eventually his tongue falls out as well and it ends up just being tossed in the fire. The mans skin changes, he experiences intense pain and then comes the climax. The mans back rips open and a strange parasitic supernatural organism that resembles a flower emerges from the mans body. It walks around on hard tipped petals. We find out that the woman who the husband had an affair with had been instructed by the parasite on how to resurrect it. She comes to collect the parasite at the end and she unexpectedly also gets taken over by it. The husband and wife actually live on, but in the most bizarre way imaginable. The parasite shows the wife how to climb into her husbands skin and become one with him. She effectively wears him like a body suit which molds to her form. The two continue to live out their days in the country home where all this takes place.</sub>

### <center>Conclusion</center>

<hr>

![20260430_193032~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23wWrj2mzvynYvVNBRJEXS1sXNKUuX9GxLxWJ7EsRQajjDEdYA8pRiXSWFK6gCj3ikoZe.jpg)

If you read the spoiler section then you might think that this book is a little over the top and maybe kind of stupid sounding, but its really not. Its strange for sure, but it was well written and the story progresses in a way that makes sense to the reader. I found it novel and entertaining and would recommend it if it sounds appealing to you. I would give it 4 out of 5 stars. 

### Enjoy and thanks for reading. Let me know your thoughts in the comments.

title.title: Evergreen album | Aki Special by Prince Nico Mbarga
title.body: In today’s #ttt, I decided to go deep into one of the evergreen albums in highlife that was released before I was born. This album, **Aki Special** by Prince Nico Mbarga, was released in 1987 and, till today, it is still being played. I often wonder how such music is made and how it manages to last forever.\n\n

/>

I first got to know this song from hearing it played often on the radio and by my dad as well. Honestly, I was more familiar with the cover version done by Tilda, and I initially thought she owned the song. It was only one day, when I heard the original version with a male voice being played on the radio, that I decided to check. That was when I found out that Prince Nico Mbarga actually owns the song.

**AKI SPECIAL**

https://youtu.be/duPxbZVeuMQ?si=y8qDomJs19VO6VRL

This is one of the biggest songs on the album, and it is the one I like the most, even though Sweet Mother appears to be the worldwide number one. This song is pure magic. The beats are soothing, they tingle the ears and make one want to dance in a calm, effortless way. The lyrics are just as impressive. I often wonder how these musicians came up with ideas to put together such lines.

https://youtu.be/KAHD8f23AuQ?si=NgldHMYUrLOTVwEj

Tilda and the Rogers crew did a cover of the song and even made a video for it. I remember watching that video on VCD back then because my dad liked the song so much.

**Sweet Mother**

https://youtu.be/HaMVWxT7vsw?si=cMFz4cKEtKo-HhxQ

This appears to be the most globally recognized song. You really cannot talk about celebrating mothers without mentioning this song. Just last week, a relative approached me to ask for a favor. He wanted me to create a photo reel video of his late mother and specifically requested that I use the Sweet Mother song. You see, many years have passed, yet the song is still highly valued.

https://youtu.be/mkp3WnUu\_WQ?si=Czr-nomlQ6DKU9na

**Christiana**

https://youtu.be/7Fkxb3uluWo?si=hgd\_FTHO11tHRIlT

This song… the intro alone still gives me nostalgia anytime it comes on.

Oh my goodness! How did people from the olden days come up with such masterpieces???

https://youtu.be/6G0wrhQj9J8?si=rj6MnDHnnMhCllOg

Thanks for reading.

title.title: Lightpainting as medication (part 7) - Lightpainting on Hive
title.body:
Hi,

I'm struggling into life atm, facing injuries, unemployment without any income and depression.

Photography has always been the beacon in the dark so I began doing lightpainting again starting from last week. I'll try to do it as often as possible during the following weeks as I'm convinced it will help me to recover and smile again.

For my 3rd session, I've been there with my girlfriend. She's not really aware about lightpainting so she was curious about how I do it. I was a bit tired during that session but I took a lot of pleasure at it and we had great time together.

Lightpainting is a photographic technique in which exposures are made by moving a hand-held light source while taking a long exposure photograph, either to illuminate a subject or to shine a point of light directly at the camera, or by moving the camera itself during exposure. Nothing is added or removed in post processing.

title.body:
I was listening to music with a friend while we played video games and shot the breeze the other evening. Our playlist is eclectic. One of the songs that cycled through was *Feel Good, Inc.* by the Gorillaz.

https://youtu.be/BRyviMSO9c0

That was released over 20 years ago already. *oof.* If that embedded video doesn't play where you are, I'm sure you can find it elsewhere. It broke out of obscurity to hit the charts.

Anyway, the main thing I wanted to note was the structure of the song. It has distinct movements in its short 3-1/2 minutes. The band is \

in the sense the members are all fictional animated characters, but real human beings wrote and performed the music. For the video, 2D and 3D animation were designed and drawn, not generated by an algorithm. This song was, and remains, *special.* The lyrical obscurity and allusions still *mean* something.

As it stands now, pop music has trended more and more toward formulaic nothingness, or else we remember what broke out of that background blandness that may have always been there. In any case, A.I. slop can only manage to swim in that soup of mediocrity from which it is drawn, but it can hide there too well if we continue to tolerate boring nothingness from corporate studios.

I also listen to a lot of folk music, and you can go see local bands play real instruments in person for any genre, but I especially like the folk music scene because you simply can't fake authenticity like that. I picked this one from a channel I found with loads of folk music festival videos from around the Pacific Northwest.

https://youtu.be/4XSNjzhpvPQ

I am also tangentially a metalhead - not obsessed with the genre, but I have more in my rotation than one might expect, too. Some think of metal as just a wall of noise, but many bands are proficient musicians with a deep understanding of music theory. They play intricate and complex music with extra volume and distortion. That takes real talent, especially live.

https://youtu.be/hCmTgVQsxRI

Is it cheating to link prog metal? I say not for my illustrative purposes.

Anyway, authenticity will soon have its own value in the market, whether measured in money or attention. We will see a divide far more heated than the electric vs, acoustic or guitars vs. synthesizers feuds of the past.

I probably should have made this into a post of my own, but it is the wee hours of Wednesday even here on the west coast.

title.title: 러브 스토리의 주제는 다양
title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g410c1fe9f8b6de97e7d1df6488115109aa88440653525ea1a223febde35db3cad5cf259101804484d444b25b592fc2a9d5d52c36ceea9efbeee42617a862d5f0_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 러브 스토리: 다양한 주제

## 1. 첫사랑의 기억
어린 시절, 같은 동네에서 자란 두 소년과 소녀. 그들은 매일 함께 놀며 서로에게 특별한 감정을 느끼기 시작한다. 하지만 소녀의 가족이 이사를 가게 되면서 그들은 헤어지게 되고, 세월이 흐른 후 우연히 다시 만난다. 과연 그들의 첫사랑은 다시 시작될 수 있을까?

## 2. 시간 여행자의 사랑
미래에서 온 시간 여행자와 현재에 사는 평범한 청년의 이야기. 시간 여행자는 자신의 임무를 수행하기 위해 과거로 돌아오지만, 그곳에서 청년을 만나 사랑에 빠진다. 하지만 시간의 제약으로 인해 그들의 사랑은 계속해서 위협받는다. 과연 그들은 서로를 지킬 수 있을까?

## 3. 문화의 경계를 넘다
한국에서 유학 중인 외국인 학생과 그를 도와주는 한국인 학생의 이야기. 서로 다른 문화와 언어의 장벽을 극복하며 가까워지는 두 사람. 그들은 서로의 문화를 이해하고 존중하며 진정한 사랑을 찾는다. 하지만 가족과 사회의 반대에 부딪히게 된다. 그들은 사랑을 지킬 수 있을까?

## 4. 잃어버린 기억
교통사고로 기억을 잃은 남자와 그의 옛 사랑을 찾으려는 여자의 이야기. 여자는 남자의 과거를 찾아 그를 돕기 위해 노력하지만, 남자는 점점 그녀에게 끌리게 된다. 과연 잃어버린 기억 속에 숨겨진 사랑의 진실은 무엇일까?

## 5. 비 오는 날의 우연
비 오는 날 우산을 나누어 쓰게 된 두 사람. 처음에는 어색한 만남이지만, 시간이 지나면서 서로의 마음을 열게 된다. 비 오는 날의 소소한 일상 속에서 사랑이 싹트게 되는 이야기를 담고 있다. 그들의 사랑은 비와 함께 더욱 깊어질까?

## 6. 직장 내 연애
같은 회사에서 일하는 두 사람의 로맨스. 처음에는 경쟁 관계였지만, 프로젝트를 함께 진행하면서 서로의 매력을 발견하게 된다. 하지만 직장 내 연애의 복잡한 상황과 동료들의 시선이 그들의 사랑을 위협한다. 그들은 이 어려움을 극복할 수 있을까?

## 7. 재회와 새로운 시작
오랜 친구였던 두 사람이 성인이 되어 재회하게 된다. 서로의 삶이 달라졌지만, 과거의 감정이 다시 되살아난다. 그들은 서로의 상처를 이해하고 치유하며 새로운 시작을 할 수 있을까?

---

이와 같은 다양한 주제를 통해 러브 스토리를 만들어 볼 수 있습니다. 각 주제는 사랑의 다양한 측면과 복잡함을 탐구하며, 독자에게 감정적인 여운을 남길 수 있습니다.

title.title: Kunsthal Rotterdam
title.body: > Today I want to meet you with my work visit in Rotterdam. My visit was filled with several professional engagements, but I also found time for cultural and art experiences that fascinated me. After loading my day, I decided to visit one of the local exhibition halls for artistic works. ![Ro (1).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeYz1RaKqAp7cbd325hZAgkYHdBiidp4FUPWgghw8HZJj/Ro%20(1).jfif) The first piece I looked at was this red and blue cubist dancing mask, made of wood, stainless steel, and mirrored holographic vinyl. The mask seemed to really dance before my eyes. Every movement of the light changed its appearance and created different colors. A combination of materials and techniques gave the mask dynamism and depth. ![Ro (11).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUpht6njhLscfg12AdSYWFApBRPbxjJibkpdXSQiZRetM/Ro%20(11).jfif) ![Ro (10).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSD48fYZH4xVzEPFtTErAHWAu7vah4u5HhnzYaSTzNnxH/Ro%20(10).jfif) ![Ro (9).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdLKtqWUQwiGqQQnWQ4MMCgPRqkrhf3ef3HymxJ6485t9/Ro%20(9).jfif) ![Ro (8).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmde1aeDw8r3gvswfPHvELxUPNXoryC7bRj6siZ3UjhdqG/Ro%20(8).jfif) The next exhibit was an art installation made up of blinds, drying racks, and other elements arranged in an abstract manner. These objects were transformed into something new and unexpected, which challenged my imagination and perception of everyday objects. The installation made me think about the potential of ordinary things that can be transformed into art through creativity and innovation. ![Rot (5).jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmWdN2qzPQcZza48zv3cwb8cqSgdCrxknTXXaP3MDbbnmn/Rot%20(5).jpg) Next, I saw several art panels in traditional Chinese style. These works transported me to a world full of detail and symbolism. Chinese motifs and techniques were presented in a modern way that emphasized the beauty and complexity of Chinese art. ![Ro (6).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXvLZDRHHLoUuRNYAGa3XqGqXU4oMLNp8xL5PU5n42rs1/Ro%20(6).jfif) ![Ro (7).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbrdG9gkRRPNdGnskkkLg532tzbEZarQvyjg2HRd2GyG4/Ro%20(7).jfif) In the next hall, I saw sculptures made of ropes. These works show how even the most ordinary material can be used to create interesting figures. The sculptures looked both delicate and sturdy. ![Ro (3).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdunoDaWGA5VxkPPnXeobKykogntEj69suDF7sVUrowKx/Ro%20(3).jfif) ![Ro (4).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdnX5jhJxdJnhtnbvCg1gTTKnVTLwA5VfoWpjssgdrtg4/Ro%20(4).jfif) ![Ro (5).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaJ2KuYwQzeiJuRVJZni7sXxg6xFXDCEGd7F7gegCjgV8/Ro%20(5).jfif) In the end, I was impressed by the improvised work, which actually turned out to be a lamp, combining functionality and aesthetics in a beautiful way. ![Ro (2).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyWNsCwTCMYE8aR17Hb8EewmXyd8VBNU2XF13JwQoY3T/Ro%20(2).jfif) This exhibition was a real inspiration for me, giving me various ideas that I would like to implement in the future :) [//]:# (!worldmappin 51.91075 lat 4.47375 long d3scr)

title.title: Warum eine Zuckersteuer dumm und schädlich ist!
title.body:
*english summary:
Germany plans a sugar tax on beverages similar to the UK model, to reduce obesity and ease health insurance costs. However, experience from the UK shows manufacturers switch to erythritol (E968), a sweetener recently associated with higher risks of heart disease, thrombosis, and mortality. Critics call the policy paternalistic, socially unfair, and counterproductive.*



Liebe Leser und Zucker-Konsumenten,

ab 2028 soll in Deutschland eine Steuer auf Zucker in Getränken eingeführt werden<sup>1</sup>, nach englischem Vorbild. 5-8g Zucker pro Liter Getränk kosten 26 Cent, ab 8 Gramm pro Liter werden 32 Cent fällig. In Österreich wird sie wohl eher nicht kommen, @vikisecrets hat darüber auch schon [berichtet](https://peakd.com/hive-121566/@vikisecrets/german-gov-considering-introducing-new-sugar-tax-like-in-the-uk-only-on-soda-not-fast-food-or-chocolate). Ziel ist es nach Angaben der ReGIERung, das zunehmende Auftreten von Adipositas bei Kindern und JUgendlichen zu bekämpfen, dadurch die Krankenkassen zu entlasten und gleichzeitig Steuereinnahmen zu lukrieren. Win-win-win für alle? Klingt fast zu schön, um wahr zu sein!

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23zknd61FKyfh1tJU2xf37kvnG7bp11mW1De9mssnUEMANdSRcGCUj9CqgZULGxngMs22.png)


Die geschätzten Einnahmen von 450 Mio.€ sollen angeblich direkt in Präventionsprogramme münden (haha, wers glaubt).

Doch die Regelung wird scheitern, das ist jetzt schon klar, wenn man in die UK schaut, wo sie schon seit 8 Jahren in Kraft ist. Was ist dort passiert? Die Hersteller haben die Zuckermenge in den Getränken reduziert (um Umsatzverluste durch den Preisanstieg zu vermeiden) und durch Zuckerersatzstoffe wie E968 ersetzt. Nicht nur ist die Fettleibigkeit in den UK nicht verschwunden, eher im Gegenteil, sie wächst jährlich (UK hat nach wie vor eine der höchsten Adipositas-Raten in Westeuropa), und der Ersatzstoff, der nun die Süße liefert, bringt zusätzliche Gesundheitsrisken!

E968 oder Erythritol/Erythrit (meso-1,2,3,4-Butantetrol)<sup>2</sup> ist ein nicht nahrhafter Zuckerersatzstoff, der in vielen „zero-calory“ Soft-Drinks, z.B. Red Bull Zero enthalten ist. In der EU wurde Erythrit 2003 vom damaligen Scientific Committee on Food (SCF) als sicherer Nahrungsmittelzusatz eingestuft (ohne Langzeitdaten zu haben!), 2006 wurde Erythritol als „neues Nahrungsmittel“ zum generellen Einsatz freigegeben und 2015 wurde die erlaubte Menge von Erythrit erhöht auf 1,6% des jeweiligen Getränks<sup>3</sup>. Erst 2023 wurde die „empfohlene Menge“ des Konsums von Erythrit verringert, denn es wirkt abführend, wenn zuviel davon konsumiert wird.

Aber bei Durchfall bleibt es leider nicht. Die Studienlage hat sich seither geändert. In einer 2023 in *nature* publizierten Metaanalyse<sup>4</sup> wird aufgezeigt, dass Erythrit das Risiko kardiovaskulärer Ereignisse und Thrombosen erhöht.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/Eo6SAAFNmQuEMWogQ9TZX3MQ1i6qt1eNmSSYL8gaoD5Ls2PKP3P6nhaZRNVNzjgYVTU.png)

Der Verdacht, dass Erythrit tatsächlich mehr Schaden als Nutzen anrichtet und nicht „sicher und effektiv“ ist bzw. \

(wie Karl Kautabak sagen würde), wurde auch in einer langjährigen Kohortenstudie<sup>5</sup> von Lim et al. aus 2024 bestätigt, in der sich ein erhöhten Risiko für die Gesamtsterblichkeit und die kardiovaskulären Mortalität gezeigt hatte. Auch das Krebsmortalitätsrisiko war positiv mit Erythrit assoziiert.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23swpTv13GW4wPKMvfvPH65Nyri7dueLrRJkAZv3cg7V21PmehuNXCpxBeXoJPYLRUtfQ.png)

In einer neuen in-vitro Studie<sup>6</sup> von Berry et al. zeigte sich, dass Erythrit oxidativen Streß in Gehirnzellen verursacht, eine mögliche Ursache für das beobachtete erhöhte Schlaganfallrisiko!

Ein Gesetz einzuführen mit dem Anspruch, die Krankenkassen zu entlasten und dass Herstellern Anreize setzt, anstatt Zucker einen Stoff zu verwenden, der das Risiko für Herz-Kreislauferkrankungen erhöht, ist ein Meisterstück an Unfähigkeit und das in gleich mehrerer Hinsicht.
Eine Zucker-Steuer ist auch sozial ungerecht, da sie Arme mehr trifft als Reiche. Gerade Arme bzw. intellektuell Herausgeforderte (es gibt eine Korrelation zwischen beiden) sind im Schnitt dicker und haben einen höheren Zuckerkonsum (weil Impulskontrolle und IQ zusammenhängen). Und die, die es sich leisten können, werden ihr Verhalten wegen der Zuckersteuer nicht ändern. Wobei die Inflation ohnehin so hoch ist, dass für Viele die 26-32c nicht ins Gewicht fallen würden (wie gesagt, die Hersteller könnten auch ausweichen auf Ersatzstoffe, sodass gar kein Lenkungseffekt da wäre).

Zudem ist sie paternalistisch und ein Eingriff in die Selbstbestimmung (aber das hat die linke Regierung noch nie von einem Gesetz abgehalten, siehe den Zwang zu Wärmepumpen oder Dieselfahrverbote). Solche Steuern (im engl. auch \

, wo für die notorisch geldknappen Regierungen kein Halt abzusehen ist - alles unter dem Feigenblatt der Gesundheit. Erst Zuckersteuer, als nächstes Fleisch-Steuer? Oder Schilift-Steuer (um die Unfallkrankenhäuser zu finanzieren)?\n\nDie Sorge um die Gesundheitskosten scheint auch deswegen geheuchelt, weil Studien belegen, dass ohnehin Raucher früher sterben als Nicht-Raucher und Adipöse früher als Normalgewichtige und entsprechend die Rentenkassen weit weniger belasten. OK, vor ihrem vorzeitigen Ableben haben Raucher/Fette vermutlich höhere Gesundheitskosten als \

, aber jeder stirbt an irgendetwas und auch Krebs ist teuer in der Behandlung - Fette erleben altersbedingten Krebs gar nicht mehr und so spart der Staat doppelt! Um Gesundheitskosten einzusparen, müsste man eine Steuer auf Obst, Gemüse und Fitness-Studios einführen!

Wenn es der Regierung tatsächlich darum ginge, die Ursachen des Übergewichts zu bekämpfen, dann müsste sie zusätzlich bedenkliche Zuckerersatzstoffe verbieten und vor allem gegen hochprozessierte Nahrungsmittel vorgehen, die voll mit [Pflanzensamenölen](https://peakd.com/hive-196387/@stayoutoftherz/die-unruhmliche-geschichte-der-pflanzensamenole-the-history-of-seed-oils) (seed oils) sind und die wenig Nährstoffe, aber dafür umso mehr Chemie enthalten. Eine Steuer auf Raps-, Soja-, Maiskeim- und Sonnenblumenöl - das wäre ein Riesenschritt für die Gesundheit! Das wäre aber ein ganz anderer Kampf, und den scheuen die Politiker zugunsten von billigem und nachweislich schwachsinnigem Aktionismus.

**Quellen:**
(1) https://www.swr.de/leben/gesundheit/aerzte-fordern-zuckersteuer-um-die-krankenkassen-zu-entlasten-100.html
(2) https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Erythrit
(3) https://sciencefiles.org/2026/04/30/ersetze-fettleibigkeit-durch-schlaganfall-warum-die-zuckersteuer-vorhersehbar-keine-entlastung-der-gesetzlichen-krankenkassen-bringen-wird/
(4) https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-023-02223-9
(5) https://www.mdpi.com/2072-6643/16/18/3099
(6) https://journals.physiology.org/doi/full/10.1152/japplphysiol.00276.2025

title.title: We are still there =/= Wir sind noch hier 👹🍣🎎 Wonderful Japan ENG-GER
title.body: ![IMG_8817.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUaPSqYq7UnMovRnhPyzdkRZv8X2VRJQkcopB5wqqgNyG/IMG_8817.jpeg) We still have a little time left, even though the end of our trip is now very close. Ultimately, it is still just a short trip, even though this time we are travelling longer than usual. But maybe there’s never enough time for Kyoto. I could probably spend a few weeks here without ever getting bored of the city and its surroundings. After all, it’s always a question of time and, above all, money. And we’re always a bit short on both. But we’re still happy to be here and to be able to explore this amazing city. For those who don’t know, Kyoto is the cultural and traditional heart of Japan and was the country’s imperial capital for over a thousand years. To this day, this is reflected in the extraordinary density of temples, shrines, and traditional neighborhoods. There’s something to see everywhere, though you’re rarely alone while doing so. As usual, I’ve taken a whole bunch of photos, though I’ll have to back them up and sort through them once we get back. But I’ve brought a few pictures along to give you a little preview today. The rest will come later, once I’ve cleared my head and have a little time to spare. In any case, I’ve got plenty to tell you... ![IMG_8849.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNUanVrJPafNQ6BPhV9NWSFPQBNNY194PkFeiLjNirBao/IMG_8849.jpeg) DEUTSCH Ein wenig haben wir noch, auch wenn das Ende unserer Reise nun schon ganz nah gerückt ist. Letztendlich ist es dann eben doch eine Kurzreise, auch wenn wir diesmal länger unterwegs sind als üblich. Aber vielleicht reicht es für Kyoto auch nie. Wahrscheinlich könnte ich hier einige Wochen verbringen, ohne dass es mir hier in der Stadt und seiner Umgebung langweilig werden würde. Letztendlich ist alles eben eine Frage der Zeit und vor allem auch des Geldes. Und bei Beidem wird es eben immer doch recht knapp bei uns. Aber wir freuen uns trotzdem hier zu sein und diese großartige Stadt entdecken zu können. Wer es nicht weiß, Kyoto ist das kulturelle und traditionelle Herz Japans und war über tausend Jahre lang die kaiserliche Hauptstadt des Landes. Bis heute zeigt sich das in der außergewöhnlichen Dichte an Tempeln, Schreinen und traditionellen Vierteln widerspiegelt. Es gibt überall etwas zu sehen, wobei man dabei selten alleine ist. Wie üblich habe ich wieder eine ganze Menge an Fotos gemacht, wobei ich diese dan erst einmal nach unserer Rückkehr sichern und sichten muss. Aber auch heute gibt es wieder einen kleinen Vorgeschmack und ich habe ein Bilder mitgebracht. Alles andere gibt es dann später, wenn ich meinen Kopf wieder frei und ein wenig Muse habe. Ich habe euch auf jeden Fall eine ganze Menge zu berichten... ![IMG_8868.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWcbD9YxBk5t1PD9phpgkT6deMCtawLzmj7tHnzKSv4Lf/IMG_8868.jpeg) ![blog-ende.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23tv6H18WKn98nBVkn2MwVhwWsuFRFgjBGwxLEMVhRZD7zRRbFokaNiAn39fUaB3TxVX6.png)

title.title: Matchday Matrix Round 5
title.body:
These matches will see us reach the half way point of the inaugural Matchday Matrix. 


![Designer (10).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/talesfrmthecrypt/23vsBTnoUTVuv87yXUe3pVa1gRHzQkmazSFhcQHP5a24ymnk2aurtPqdBJWQGddQMEgzc.png)


Yesterday's fixtures were tough and unlike the 3 that came before, didn't provide an opportunity for a perfect score. We did however have our first match (Everton v Man City) that guaranteed a win on any of the 5 outcomes you happened to choose! 

I don't think we'll be able to give such a match this evening...

![Screenshot 2026-05-05 at 06.11.25.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/talesfrmthecrypt/23swdsE7WGBD7LFTxLUqczrAR8VficWX2PdM6pQKgXfLKpL7F9YEm8CdgYybLvEtSahBi.png)


We've got some real challenges for you in round 5 with matches from leagues I'm pretty sure many of you will never have watched! 

### Arsenal v Atletico 

The first of the Champions League semi finals and some might say simply an appetizer for the fixture to come tomorrow night... 

1-1 from the first leg puts the Gunners in a strong position. They've already beaten this Atletico side 4-0 here earlier in the season while Simeone's team more generally doesn't have a great record on English soil with 6 losses from their last 7 visits. 

I'd expect it to be a bit tighter than their previous encounter in North London. BTTS and over 2.5 odds are both hovering around the 1.85 mark but odds on the draw are still out at 4.00. 

There were only 7 corners in the fist leg and just 1 of those Arsenal. I'd expect them to generate more this time around but over 10.5 corners is still out at odds of 2.1.

Surprisingly in a game where 2 penalties were conceded and 18 fouls total committed we had just 1 yellow card. Over 3.5 in this match might be one to look at though with odds of 1.44

### Dunfermline Athletic v Arbroath

We're back to Scotland this time for 2 sides battling for the opportunity to join the SPL via the Championship playoffs. 

I have a friend who is an Arbroath supporter. Did you know that their home ground, Gayfield Park, is closer to the sea than any other professional football stadium in Europe. On a particularly rough day, the waves come over the wall at one end of the ground! 

These 2 sides will meet each other 3 times in the space of a week having played out a 0-0 draw in their final league match against each other on Friday just gone before the first leg of the playoffs tonight. 

Historically, those kind of runs against the same team don't tend to produce lots of goals particularly when you add knockout football into the equation too. Odds of another draw are 3.10

That being said there were 14 goals in the 3 matches prior to last Friday's nil nil that these 2 have played against each other this season. Suffice to say they know each other well! Odds on it being an open game are BTTS 1.73 and over 2.5 goals 1.91.

The game on Friday produced a whopping 16 corners. Can MM players get a repeat of that outcome? 

3 of last 8 games featuring these 2 sides have produced 3.5 yellow cards or more. Might we get a bit more needle in this one given what's at stake? 


### Al Khaleej vs Al Hilal

I'll be honest, I find it very difficult to remember which club is which in the Saudi Pro League given that 16 out of 18 the clubs start with 'Al'. 

What's easier to remember is the players who jumped ship from European football to chase their millions in the SPL. 

This then in the AL Hilal of  Karim Benzema, Darwin Núñez, João Cancelo, Rúben Neves, Theo Hernández, Kalidou Koulibaly and many more familiar names. Up against Al Khaleej whose star overseas import is former United and Bournemouth forward Josh King. 

One of these teams is 2nd in the league, one is 11th. I'll let you guess which... 

For Al Hilal though it is a crunch match and an opporunity to take advantage of top placed Al-Nassr's (that's CR7's team) slip-up on Sunday and cut the gap to them to just 2 points with 3 games to play. Those 2 powerhouses of the Saudi Pro League actually play each other next Tuesday in what might be a championship decider. 

This is a game between 2 sides who know how to find the back of the net. Al Hilal have done so 79 times in their 30 games to date while Al Khaleej are no slouches either, 51 goals in their 30 this season. BTTS is 1.65 but over 2.5 goals is a very appealing 1.30!

I'm afraid that I don't have season long stats on the likes of corners and cards at my finger tips for this league so you might just have to take a punt. Looking at Al Hilal's most recent matches there have been plenty of corners, not so many yellow cards. 


### Gnistan v Inter Turku

From Saudi Arabia to Finland! 

Inter Turku, unbeaten in their first 5 matches of the Finnish season, have the opportunity to go top against a Gnistan side who are winless to date and sit bottom with just a solitary point. 

The mismatch opens up the possibility of Inter Turku racking up a few goals but it's also worth noting that in 9 matches total this season, these 2 have produced just 8 goals. The bookies seem to understand this too with odds of 1.67 on BTTS and 1.70 on over 2.5 goals. 

However, it's not for lack of trying, at least as far as generating set pieces opportunities. Inter Turku are generating 7.6 corners for per game for an average total of 11.20. Gnistan matches average bang on 10.5 corners per game. 

Gnistan picked up 6 yellows themselves last time out (9 match total) but Inter Turku's games have been far calmer. None of their 5 matches to date have exceeded the 3.5 yellow mark. 


### Magesi v Orbit College

We're clocking up some serious air miles today. From Finland to South Africa and a relegation battle to stay in the top flight. 

Orbit College are bottom of the league 20 points. Magesi are 3rd bottom on 21 points and until recently looked dead and buried. However, 2 wins in their last 5 have pulled them out of the relegation zone. 

If you were hoping for high scoring exciting football then you should probably look elsewhere. These 2 sides have generated 22 and 19 goals respectively from 26 games this season. 

Given all that, we are presented with that rare opportunity to go for a draw at odds of under 2/1. This game to finish in a stalemate is 2.75


# Matchday Matrix Standings 

As noted above, everyone was guaranteed a point yesterday by the Everton v City match, even me who otherwise had an absolute disaster of a round! 

The highest score in the round was a 5 but I'd see that as a major win - the equivalent of grinding out a result on a wet and windy night at Stoke (does that analogy still hold value?). I think this afternoon will be similar and these next couple of rounds will separate the men from the boys.

title.body:
>

![1000035649.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/Eokg4Y6v8P3qfxyRun3xUo3nUNnAUrf6SGXF5w3tGjdFFNgu8aKpbyyPziwNXxjdu6c.png)

I promised last night that I will make Mommy F fish soup with veggies. She complained while we're having dinner that the fried fish is really hard to eat. It was fried during lunch so it is really become like of a jerky and I fried it really crispy. When I ate it, it really hard to chew so I understand MOm.

<div class=\

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EorzHT2j5RHn4jUd3JmbEdMPhaU1WoHipAoo8eChnDMxx8Ww6hzNXuvkFKXht2GURx5.jpg And so this morning, I visit the yard and checked the sweet potato leaves on the ground. I ready a small stainless bowl to put my veggies and had my quick quest on the yard. The two cuties decides to accompany me -wait, its more like, to interrupt me, lol. Luckily, there's a lot of sweet potato leaves on different sides if our yard. All I have to do is just pick

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoEqXgZENtYoWb2z6YXZj3pfXiy7kb3VnUgPMdZAxaeH1YppfQnTWxN99J9Yf84HSfr.jpg And so, here's our first ingredient for our fish soup, a sweet potato leaves. I actually picked just the young ones so that it is easier to cook

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoAaBqCRF2YjkqVj2Cmp4SEgypC6cXxBZGLLNBXz8oVp5re1bQh5JMmDsGyt6bSpw4x.jpg I spotted some Alugbati next to the sweet potato leaves and I really want to pick some as well, but I already planned to harvest Malunggay so I pick it, the dish may become too greeny and make my moms blood surge up, so I decided not to. But seriously, i not much of a fan of Alugbati as Ingredients, but I love it as a plant coz of its pretty color.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EpzxmhyH6qExjuvSGNJi49LGJMHDxagvBWy89UhDo7nrYCQ2NSgxvh2iUo7oR3Mtg7L.jpg So next stop is here, in the Malunggay tree. We have two three of it by the way. This one is still very young. Mama planted it and it is a branch from the old Malunggay we have. We didn't wait long for it to give us leaves like this.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoK5oaFS54t8mSguRXTSVaWandWh8eFUkwZvi3z9XBPQRMiK2VKkTZ89gBGmZECXw1Y.jpg And of course I also pick a few from the old Malunggay. I noticed that it is flowering now. Its fruits is actually so good in a fish soup. I'm already looking forward for it.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/Eokc5tCXmtT5AFEu6wc6nMTwa8oUF8V6z5JpifPfpeXHmwnNmLxhc9ewEVkYjUCr2ye.jpg And so, here our fresh ingredients. We have here ***sweet potato leaves, malunggay, three small onions, and the fish***

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoAbE8gdyiSy167S2KMMS6sgRrV6fCL24GZ9YtnZgcQjyXmidi3ef5eSxAKoN9yDsfW.jpg And yes, the white water there is rice water. I'll use that for our fish and vegetable soup today.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoCfmrnNyrRdLuagKWyeXrEAYZPPAU9eQRusn672onGhhWnsxNaG9Krm5qwPVz2Q8U3.jpg I just put ***salt, msg, onions, fish and the rice water*** altogether in a pan. We'll just simmer them for a few minutes before putting the veggies

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoAYjCkeXVfNmTe7CyGSntz23k73pUEZ3be427SDKZFXXnxdsQGNsMqwunvBR1THuyQ.jpg Before putting the veggies, I removed all the fish first because we don't want it to become a ground fish, lol. Also, I put first the Malunggay in there and let it cook for one minute before putting the sweet potato leaves

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/Eo8QufYMuFff5GDhxqaJjKLUp4gTfHNstA7K5m5EQWvF4rWuNPqnvCLEBA6Hep92i2V.jpg And it'a done! The veggies doesn't really take more time to be cooked. It is done after just a few minutes. And there we have it, a healy fish and vegetable soup using rice water. A healthy one that will surely warm anyone's stomach and heart.
