title.title: Tuesday Some nice colors in Buttonwood Park
title.body:
# Some nice colors in Buttonwood Park Good mo0rning and I hope your week is going well The other day I got a call from a friend/Facebook contact who leads a group called the Friends of Buttonwood Park, they do regular cleanups around the park and maintain some of the gardens and trees, and I think its awesome, they help to keep the park so beautiful and as many call it the Jewel or crown Jewel of the city Buttonwood Park is a 97-acre municipal park designed in the 1890s by the renowned Olmsted firm. It features walking paths, a pond, and is famously home to the accredited Buttonwood Park Zoo. It is a premier community hub offering recreation, a historic district, and a renowned zoo Anyway,s back to him messaging me, We have interacted quite a lot on Farcebook and also meet in the park for walks a couple of times, he is so proud of the park and a fountain of information on it. Walking with him was so cool, I learnt so much about the park. HIw message the other day was that many of the trees were blossoming nicely and probably wouldn't last to long and I many want to check it out. I initially thought to stay in as I had only been out of the hospital for a couple of days and my energy levels were still low, but then I thought a nice easy walk in the park with some fresh air and of course my camera, would be good for my mental well-being, so that afternoon I headed there Here is one of the trees near the kids playground, when I walk by playgrounds, especially when theres lots of families nd kids playing, I keep my camera down at my side, I know some people think the worse if they see an older gentleman with a camera around kids outdoors, but i popped it up to my eye for this shot.
![nice colors in BP-4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/Eq7K3EGoSdico8WV4QzPFrKN1tar4An1WeSnWeM4oYFVwTwN1nHvwE9BeSv2ZZtsvsX.jpg) **Sony A7iv 28mm F9 1/200 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/Eq7K3EGoSdico8WV4QzPFrKN1tar4An1WeSnWeM4oYFVwTwN1nHvwE9BeSv2ZZtsvsX.jpg)**

Now i should say that, afternoon it was cloudy and gloomy for the most part when I was there so getting good shots of the blossoms was a challenge, especially without blowing out the skies or needed a lot of tweaking in Photoshop to recover the skies as much as I could, and in this first shot the sky looked bad so I did something I seldom do and replaced the sky Some more blossoms in the park

title.title: Which Route is perfect for Himalayan Motorbike Tour?
title.body:
![choosing the right tour for your skill level.png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/fa33b59a03588c9ce24ca36363757489b97275497236193759b92793b037dbef)

Among the most recommended Best Routes for Motorcycle Tours Himalaya, seasoned riders often choose circuits that combine altitude, terrain diversity, and cultural exposure.

A commonly followed high altitude circuit includes:

*   \- Leh

*   \- Khardung La

*   \- Nubra Valley

*   \- Pangong Lake

*   \- Chang La

*   \- Tso Moriri

*   \- Hanle

*   \- Return to Leh

These [Himalayan Motorbike Tour routes](https://brahmandtours.wordpress.com/2026/03/05/motorcycle-touring-in-himalayas-what-only-experienced-riders-know/) are known for dramatic mountain passes, remote villages, and pristine lakes. Khardung La and Chang La test both machine and rider, while stretches toward Hanle demand confidence on isolated roads. 

Experienced riders do not just complete the route. They pace themselves, schedule acclimatization days in Leh, and avoid rushing through high passes.

title.title: 栽下了小苗，种下了希望
title.body:
妈妈着急回农村老家是因为她要种玉米还要栽一些秧苗，说时间不能等，不能太晚了，所以2号的早上，早早就起来去很远的市场，骑着自行车买了秧苗。 我当时看了下时间大概不到5点就去市场了， 这可真是太早了， 对于我这个不能起早的人来说，简直是受不了，我这个人有个习惯就是熬夜还可以，要是让我起早，这一天都会昏昏沉沉的。 

妈妈买回来很多的小苗，用一个框装着，里面有西红柿苗，冬瓜，苦瓜，丝瓜，还有芹菜苗。 我说自己买种子种不是更好吗？她说自己种的赶不上人家培育这个，买的这小小苗很快就会长大的。 
![xiaomiaozhang.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfDnhxCxBTXavLyXdb1GVnViBjMB7EbxiZZrB6fWdJfMe/xiaomiaozhang.jpg)

![liangtang.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcNiFw35HFgrcjdWFkvawUvkGfoR8X4dQkQVLptywuvPh/liangtang.jpg)

我和她拿着这些小苗准备坐车回农村，但当时因为错过了一班车，结果下一趟就的等好久，我决定打车回去。 妈妈说这样不值得，毕竟打车回去种地，代价太高了，哎， 老人的观点就是能省就省。 我说总也不打车，偶尔一次吧， 否则还的等那么长时间也耽误不起。 就这样，她同意了，我们俩打车很快就到了农村老家。 

院子里的因为好久没下雨了， 非常的干燥，感觉土都是酥的，踩上一脚，要冒烟的感觉！这农活我还真不会干，甚至傻傻的连这些秧苗也分不清，苦瓜和丝瓜冬瓜的，真是弄不清楚，哈哈，真是四体不勤五谷不分啊！

***这个小苗大家知道是什么吗？***

![miao.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPLqyvpkjRhE3R678koezWTJwZStUniAd1JC7nqxW8iYT/miao.jpg)


70多岁的老人干起活来，比我这个年富力强的要强多了。 妈妈指挥我先栽西红柿，她先刨坑，我放小苗，小苗上有个蓝色的塑料要拿下去，然后培土，结果我培成平的了， 妈妈一看，又让我形成圆形坑，这样浇水的时候不至于水流出去。 看来微小的细节也很关键啊！

![xihong.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbev2HEmL9EE3suFVUM2WmQJR1ZfhHVaRauKsAQFVTGJC/xihong.jpg)

栽完小苗，培完土，我开始每个浇水，全部浇透，然后走的时候再不补浇一次。怕这两天温度太高，地太干，小苗会晒干。 其实就是栽小苗也不是那么简单的， 要先刨坑，让后还要施底肥，有机肥最好，然后栽苗，培土，最后浇水。 将西红柿栽完， 我感觉到自己的腿疼，屁股也疼😂😅

不过看着栽完的小苗，心情还是非常愉悦的，很有成就感呢！然后又种了玉米，将玉米粒放到泥土里， 放了3个玉米粒，为的是将来出芽了，保留一颗最好的。种完玉米又去栽了冬瓜苗，苦瓜和丝瓜，不能大家能分清楚哪个都是什么瓜吗？

![kugua.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNgLe8cTxVmwG7LgmcUG8rWg8icAZ79JN5wgTQWkmEFrm/kugua.jpg)

![si.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTZmFuutNQMtjUAThhVbbHeRkM6hHWFGTD17zzL4okT6v/si.jpg)

最后干的就是芹菜苗，在大门口，妈妈找了一小块地，然后翻地，将土块打碎，再将坑挖好，一边挖一边放芹菜苗，也是一样形成一个个小土坑，好留存水的，不过这芹菜苗太细弱了，栽上就趴下了， 我怀疑能长好吗？会不会蔫吧就死了？

![qian1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcAgza217subJcEP3fdE52KHnYwBMsd53xZAcTKmHs6q8/qian1.jpg)

妈妈说不会的， 只要栽上，浇上水，大部分都会活的，这也就是“有苗不愁长”，原来这句话是这么来的呀！语言真是实践的结晶！看着这小小苗都栽上了，我就非常期待秋天收获的结果。 看看秋天能得到多少冬瓜，丝瓜啥的，夏天能有多少西红柿，哈哈，真是有所期待啊！

对于多年不干农活的我来说， 栽小苗种地还是挺新鲜的，也深刻体会到了农民的不容易，以后还有除草施肥，可不是栽完了就不管了的！爱心的呵护下，这些小苗一定会结出硕果吧！😊😍

title.title: The Universe Chose Violence Before 8 AM
title.body:
/>

You know those highly specific mornings. The ones where nothing goes fundamentally, catastrophically wrong, but the universe decides to issue a relentless, highly coordinated series of micro-aggressions just to test the limits of your psychological endurance. You look back at it later, once the dust has settled, and you logically know that none of it was a big deal. But in the moment? In the moment, it feels like a targeted cosmic conspiracy.

<h3 style=\
>Today was definitively one of those mornings.\n\nThe very first sign of impending doom was the physical act of getting out of bed. \

is perhaps too generous a term; it was more of a desperate, undignified roll over the mattress edge until gravity did the rest of the work. The physical labor from the weekend is still very much residing in my muscles, currently staging a vocal protest rally. Add to that yesterday's visit to the physiotherapist—who apparently moonlights as an enthusiastic chiropractor and managed to crack joints I was previously unaware I possessed—and I woke up feeling entirely chronologically displaced. My birth certificate claims I am a modern adult, but my spine was aggressively screaming that I am, in fact, an 85-year-old Victorian ghost. But whatever. I rolled, I landed, I was upright. Shockingly, I was even on time.

I shuffled to the kitchen to initiate the sacred morning ritual: turn on the coffee machine, then pack the laptop into the bag. And right there, waiting for me, was the second red flag of the day. Literally red. The LED lights on my plugin battery were flashing an angry, menacing crimson.

A minor setback, I told myself. I grabbed my freshly brewed coffee, feeling somewhat resilient, and went to investigate why the digital world was forsaking me.

The modem was offline. Dead. Bereft of life.

I did what any desperate modern human does: I performed the sacred, panic-induced rite of unplugging it and plugging it back in. Nothing. I stared at it. I threatened it. Still nothing. Luckily, the kids are off to school, and both my partner and I are working from the office today, so the immediate crisis of a disconnected household was temporarily averted. But I know exactly what this means. The modem has given up the ghost and needs a full replacement. Since I am commuting to Brussels for work today, coordinating a new box by tomorrow is going to be a logistical side-quest of epic proportions. I’ll have to spend my lunch break on the phone with my provider, begging them to either teleport a new one to my doorstep or finding a local shop where I can scavenge one tonight.

If I thought leaving the house would improve the situation, the Belgian railway system quickly disabused me of that foolish notion.

Upon stepping onto the train, I was immediately assaulted by a solid wall of scent. Someone in my immediate vicinity had not just applied perfume; they had seemingly slipped, fallen, and nearly drowned in a vat of industrial-grade synthetic musk. I simply do not understand the thought process here. Why do some people feel the overwhelming need to broadcast their olfactory presence from three time zones away? Take a shower, and if you really must, apply a subtle, fleeting hint of fragrance. Are their own nasal passages entirely burned out? Are they immune to their own chemical warfare? Because of this walking perfumery, the humble slices of bread I brought for my breakfast absorbed the ambient air. I ended up chewing on a sandwich that tasted distinctively like cheap lavender, sandalwood, and regret.

Naturally, the train was packed to the gills, meaning I couldn't escape the miasma, and inevitably, someone sat right next to me.

<h3 style=\

>Enter: The Slurper. Of all the things my new seatmate could have brought for breakfast, they chose a banana shake. Now, for crucial context, I absolutely despise bananas. I hate the taste, I hate the texture, and I intensely loathe the smell. Combine that fruity stench with my hyper-sensitivity to the toxic perfume cloud we were currently trapped in, and my stomach began doing Olympic-level acrobatics. But the smell wasn't even the worst part. It was the sound. This person wasn't just drinking a beverage; they were aggressively extracting a thick sludge through a plastic straw with a wet, resonant slurping sound that echoed in the deepest recesses of my soul. Schluuuuurp. Smack. Schluuuuurp. It was like sitting next to a thirsty, uncoordinated walrus. And just to ensure my comfort levels remained at absolute zero, I realized I had somehow chosen the one seat on the entire train positioned directly beneath a rogue air-conditioning vent. Outside, it is a mild, completely harmless 14 degrees. There is absolutely no need for artificial cooling. Yet, this vent was blasting a steady, relentless stream of arctic, gale-force wind directly onto the back of my neck. I can already feel the stiff neck developing, settling in right next to the aches the physiotherapist so generously left me with yesterday. There is a slight comedic silver lining to the commute, however. The banana-slurping walrus next to me has diligently opened his laptop. He spent a solid five minutes booting it up, adjusting the screen angle, and adopting a posture of intense corporate concentration. But I can see his screen. He is doing absolutely nothing. He has merely opened his email client to ensure his status icon turns green. He is putting on a magnificent, Oscar-worthy theatrical performance of \

for the benefit of absolutely no one on this train. You just have to respect the sheer commitment to the grift.

So, here I sit. Freezing, aching, tasting perfume, smelling bananas, and listening to a symphony of slurps. I am incredibly curious to see if the trajectory of this Tuesday improves, or if this is simply the recurring theme for the next twelve hours.

Upon finally stepping off the train, escaping my frozen, banana-scented perfume chamber, I immediately called my internet provider. Plot twist: it turns out my modem hasn't actually given up the ghost after all. The helpdesk cheerfully informed me that it’s simply an unreported network outage in our area. Logically, this means there is a glimmer of hope that the connection will magically be restored by the time I get back. But given the sheer, unadulterated string of bad luck that has dictated my morning so far? My optimism is currently hovering somewhere around absolute zero.

Actually, I already know exactly how the day ends. When I finally make it home tonight, exhausted from my battle with the elements, the telecom providers, and public transport, I will open the front door not to a warm, loving welcome, but to a chorus of sheer despair from my family.

*   \

Eighty-five-year-old Victorian ghost or not, it’s going to be a very long Tuesday.

Cheers,  
Peter

title.title: Why Nigerian Market Traders Choose Small Shops Over Big Profits: The Trust Problem
title.body:
I do not know how a regular market is in your country, but in Nigeria, where I live, we have a regular market, and traders line themselves up in different batches to sell their goods and get money in return.

Walk into any Nigerian market, and you'll find dozens of traders selling identical products along the same stretch. Looking for rice or yams? You might see a hundred-meter line of competing vendors. Each trader fights fiercely for customers, sometimes literally competing for the same buyer's attention.


<div align=\

> https://live.staticflickr.com/4094/4798715747_8657fd2a67_b.jpg >https://www.flickr.com/photos/iita-media-library/4798715747 Fighting to get customers is one of the reasons enmity brews among these traders, and then you wonder why they do not come together to form a large business instead of staying separate, owning small shops and kiosks, and making little or no sales. If they come together to form a bigger business, they would make more sales, sell at a lower price, and divide profits after the sale. Nigerians prefer to own 100% of a small business rather than to own a small percentage of a big one that would pay better. A lot of people have faced issues of fraudulent activities in their previous partnership, so it is very difficult for them to trust another partnership. This is why we have so many people starting small ventures, even when it can be difficult to make sales. https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/d/db/Eastern_Boki_Market%2C_Wula%2C_Cross_River_State.jpg [https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Eastern_Boki_Market,_Wula,_Cross_River_State](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Eastern_Boki_Market,_Wula,_Cross_River_State.jpg) Another reason why these people do not partner to form a bigger business is that they believe they are better at closing deals than the other person, and they do not want to be the one making the sales while the other person doesn't. Instead of working together, they feel they are being cheated and decide to manage their small venture alone. Another reason why partnership is difficult with these sellers is deciding who calls the shots. They do not want to be inferior in their business; they want call the shots and so they do not want to partner with someone. So which would you choose: full ownership of a small business with limited income, or a minority stake in a venture worth 100 times more? title.body: Well, Linux is open source, meaning that the code is publicly available to people to review.  That's how this exploit was found before hackers began using it.  Windows code is closed source.  No one can review it, so exploits are found only by people that reverse engineer the code, without the permission of the publisher.  When exploits are found in Windows code, those that find them have only liability to the publisher when they publish them, because they violated the copyright of the publisher when they reverse engineered it.  People have different motivation to look for exploits in Windows code than Linux code because of that, and such exploits in closed source code are sold to hackers rather than revealed to the public.\n\nThanks!

title.title: Mensaje diario de 5 minutos-¡Convénceme!/ Daily 5 minute message- Convince me!
title.body:
> Convénceme que la vida es pana y que vale la pena cada día en esa lucha constante. Convénceme que salir de la cama cada día es un esfuerzo constante que siempre resulta bien. Convénceme que todo va a salir bien. Convénceme que tengo que convencerte a seguir adelante. Parece un trabalenguas de convencimientos, cuando la vida no requiere tanta exhibición solo más esfuerzo. A veces nos golpea duro, a veces nos mece suavemente. Solamente con mirar a nuestro alrededor podemos encontrar detalles que no necesitan ser explicados, simplemente nos hacen esforzarnos por salir de la cama. Me encanta esta mirada a nuestro alrededor, no hace falta ir más allá o viajar para sentir motivos para vivir nuestra vida. Fíjate que no hace falta convencer a un bebé para que respire y viva. Pero parece que hay personas que el peso de la vida se les vuelve cuesta arriba y eso se entiende. A veces se vuelve muy duro el vivir. Creo que el truco esta en encontrar detalles a nuestro alrededor y esforzarnos en ayudar a otros. ¡Convénceme! que al abrir los ojos pueda seguir viendo tu mirada, que tus ojos estarán allí presentes mirándome, aunque sea en recuerdos. Nos llenamos de recuerdos y mientras estén presentes en nuestra mente seguiremos esforzándonos en seguir adelante. Este ejercicio de cada mañana que me levanto muy temprano para realizar es simplemente maravilloso, es como encontrar una lista de cosas buenas para seguir adelante. Me preocupa una interrupción a mi ritmo, pero veré como lo resuelvo. No me preocupare por cosas que no puedo evitar que sucedan, pero me esforzaré por seguir escuchando mis palabras y leyendo a mis amigos.
***
Este texto corresponde a mi participación en el reto diario del amigo @latino.romano y @mariannewest [post](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/5-may-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3094-convince-me) **ENGLISH VERSION**
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTG3R1tKbMsRS3LgeJXea5FGcPxt3ft1GsfJKuGkWzCA3/imagen.png)
Convince me that life is great and that every day is worth it in this constant struggle. Convince me that getting out of bed each day is a constant effort that always turns out well. Convince me that everything will be alright. Convince me that I have to convince you to keep going. It sounds like a tongue twister of persuasions, when life doesn't require so much showmanship, just more effort. Sometimes it hits us hard, sometimes it rocks us gently. Just by looking around us, we can find details that don't need to be explained; they simply make us strive to get out of bed. I love this way of looking around us; we don't need to go far or travel to find reasons to live our lives. Notice that you don't need to convince a baby to breathe and live. But it seems that for some people, the weight of life becomes an uphill battle, and that's understandable. Sometimes living becomes very hard. I think the trick is to find details around us and strive to help others. Convince me! That when I open my eyes I can still see your gaze, that your eyes will be there, looking at me, even if only in memories. We fill ourselves with memories, and as long as they are present in our minds, we will continue striving to move forward. This exercise I do every morning, which I do very early, is simply wonderful; it's like finding a list of good things to keep me going. I worry about being interrupted, but I'll see how I deal with it. I won't worry about things I can't prevent from happening, but I will strive to keep listening to my own thoughts and reading what my friends are saying.
***
This text corresponds to my participation in the daily challenge of my friend @improv, @felt.buzz, @latino.romano and @mariannewest [post](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/5-may-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3094-convince-me)

title.title: 🌍 Me fui buscando libertad y encontré algo más grande 🌍 Iniciativa [Esp - Eng ] 🌍 I left searching for freedom and found something greater 🌍 Initiative
title.body:
>

Feliz martes para toda esta hermosa comunidad de #EmpowerTalent. Un abrazo para cada uno, y un agradecimiento especial a @angelica7 por su constancia y por mantener este espacio lleno de motivación semana tras semana.

Esta semana, cuando leí el tema *“Ser Libre”*, me quedé pensando un buen rato, porque es una palabra que todos usamos, pero no siempre entendemos de la misma manera. A veces creemos que ser libre es hacer lo que queremos, irnos, cambiar de lugar o tomar decisiones grandes, pero con el tiempo uno va entendiendo que la libertad también pasa por lo que llevamos por dentro.
_________

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRN4mcdxkNkUdjwhhn6anx9R1ZkNz76AD7TFMfesKrXJc/image.png)</center>

<center>*\

*</center>
_________

Ser libre, para mí no siempre fue algo que entendí desde el principio. Cuando era niño, en Puerto Cabello, vivía sin pensar mucho en eso. Tenía el mar cerca, jugaba, estudiaba, compartía, y todo fluía. En ese momento uno cree que eso es lo normal, que la vida es así de sencilla. Pero con el tiempo te das cuenta de que muchas veces ya eras libre y no lo sabías. Porque no tenías tantas preocupaciones, no estabas cargado de responsabilidades, no vivías pensando en el mañana. Era una libertad natural, sin análisis, sin cuestionamientos. Hoy lo miro y digo que sí, en ese momento era libre, pero no tenía la conciencia para valorarlo.
__________

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTaFfVq5biGu9ToXF94US9vLo6tax3Xavg4gXEz4yF8So/image.png)</center>

<center>*\

*</center>
__________

Luego viene la vida, la realidad, las decisiones, y ahí empiezas a entender que la libertad no siempre es hacer lo que quieres. En Venezuela viví muchas etapas, algunas buenas, otras no tanto. Llegó un momento donde te sientes limitado, no solo por lo que pasa alrededor, sino por lo que empieza a pasar dentro de ti. Pensamientos, preocupaciones, incertidumbre. Y ahí es donde te haces esa pregunta que plantea el tema: ¿puede uno sentirse preso sin estar encerrado? Y la respuesta es sí. Porque a veces uno mismo se encierra en sus miedos, en sus dudas, en lo que cree que no puede cambiar. Yo lo viví, y no es fácil reconocerlo.
____________

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmduUaiSzSapxzwk51ZLyuLtwCQYY6tKrSX6z7KxtuBNXA/image.png)</center>

<center>*\

*</center>
___________

Tomar la decisión de emigrar fue una de las cosas más fuertes que me tocó vivir. Dejar tu país, tu gente, tu historia, no es fácil. Yo me fui buscando una mejor vida, buscando tranquilidad, buscando estabilidad. Pensé que eso era libertad. Pero cuando llegas a otro país, en mi caso Argentina, te das cuenta de que la libertad también viene con responsabilidades más grandes. Trabajos duros, empezar desde cero, demostrar quién eres sin que nadie conozca tu historia. Y ahí entiendes algo importante: ser libre no es que todo sea fácil, es tener la capacidad de seguir adelante a pesar de lo difícil.
___________

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmabQ54dvmCGgABa2YycdwrMNAfmMhAQFXJnMsUFtxoeey/image.png)</center>

<center>*\

*</center>
___________

Hoy, con todo lo vivido, puedo decir que ser libre para mí tiene otro significado. No se trata de dónde estás, sino de cómo estás por dentro. He pasado momentos duros, pérdidas que no se superan, situaciones que te marcan, pero también he aprendido a seguir, a adaptarme, a no quedarme estancado en lo que duele. Encontré en la escritura una forma de soltar, de expresarme, de conectar con otros. Y eso también es libertad. Poder decir lo que sientes, poder transformar lo vivido en algo que ayude a otros. Para mí, ser libre es eso, seguir adelante, cuidar de mi familia, tener paz en medio del proceso y no dejar que nada me detenga por dentro.

<center>![SeparadorHive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mballesteros/23t7YWoN53XUARh93PVvS9mqaVjjjMGSNi6uJUMjKptGwBVoiTyadsRVjRPAE27xgxsc7.png)</center>

Y si, uno entiende que ser libre no es que todo esté perfecto, ni que la vida sea fácil. Es aprender a vivir con lo que toca, sin dejar que eso te detenga por dentro. Es seguir, adaptarse y no perder la paz, incluso cuando las cosas no salen como uno espera.

Ahora te pregunto: *¿qué significa para ti ser libre? ¿Sientes que hay algo que hoy te está limitando o ya lograste encontrar esa libertad dentro de ti?*

***Gracias por llegar hasta aquí. Te leo en la caja de comentarios. Un abrazo grande para todos.***

body.title: Viaje al origen del sonido (cuento)
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP84zH4AJBui2viLsC1YnYSnMaK98RXYE5i71V1d2BYPT/1777976976667.jpg)
[fuente](https://pixabay.com/photos/hummingbird-bird-animal-feathers-9100457/)

Casi podía jurar ver cómo sus plantas crecían sanas, vigorosas con los colores más hermosos de todos. Pero no solo las plantas, vió que la música, al igual que a sus plantas, lo hacía mejor, más completo, feliz, perfecto. Le dijeron que les pusiera música clásica y lo hizo. No obstante, los cactus y los árboles frutales no disfrutaban tanto de Mozart, Bach o Vivali. Ah, ellos preferían del buen rock and roll. Algunos del power metal, otros del heavy, grunge o alternativo (sobre todo los mangos), pero siempre el rock. 
Por esa razón en su casa podías disfrutar de la mejor ópera, música de concierto o rock que pudieras pedir. También encontrar las calabazas de un metro de largo, jugosos mangos durante todo el año y al alcance de la mano, piñas, manzanas, uvas, fresas, cítricos y cualquier planta por más exótica que la busques. Todo, en su casa, y floreciendo al ritmo de la música y una eterna coreografía de colibríes.
Pero nunca fue suficiente. 
Al menos, no desde que le hablaron del sonido de la naturaleza. Ese sonido primigenio que causó que brotara la primera semilla en el mundo. Algunos cuentan que es la voz de la madre Gaia, su risa, su llanto o quizás su llamado, pero es ella la emisora de aquel milagroso sonido. Le contaron que nunca hubo un Dios, ni un Big Bang, sino Gaia y el su voz lo que originó la vida en el universo. 
Algunos aseguran que es ella la responsable de que aún estemos vivo. 
Por eso él dejó instrucciones para el cuidado de sus plantas y salió en busca de Gaia. El sueño de lo que pudiera realizar, todo lo que podría crear de conseguir aquel sonido, ese, era el impulso necesario para que se adentrara al corazón de la selva amazónica. 
Durante meses anduvo, grabadora en mano, por cada tramo de la selva. Gastó fortunas en traductores, guías, pistas y cualquier otra cosa que lo llevara un poco más cerca de su objetivo. Prestaba atención a cada sonido, ruido que revelara el hogar de la madre tierra. Varios fueron sus puntos de referencia: las estrellas, los ríos, el tono de la vegetación, incluso, contrató a lectores de las entrañas de los peces. 
Y nada. Gaia no estaba en en Amazonas.
Tomó un avión hacia a Japón, de ahí a cada una de las islas de Oceanía, a la selva de la India, anduvo por cada tramo de la muralla china y su inmenso imperio asiático. Nada. Años vagó por cada continente, cada selva, pradera, zoológico, incluso los desiertos más remotos y estériles fueron revisados palmo a palmo. 
Tuvo un atisbo de esperanza mientras exploraba las pirámides egipcias y vio que unos jeroglíficos aún sin traducir, pero todo quedó en eso, esperanzas.
Sobrevoló cada una de las figuras del mono, pelícano, araña, ballena, el colibrí y cuanta figura había en el valle de Nazca. Todas se le aparecieron una noche retozando en sus sueños, cantándole una nana. Al amanecer sobre un cesped imposible en aquella zona, indicó a su guía que lo llevara hasta la Tierra del Fuego. De ahí se unió a una expedición que se dirigía al polo sur. Nadie entendió cómo ni por qué aquel capricho de viajar hasta el sitio más inhabitable del planeta, más solo quiso que lo dejaran ser. No decía más nada.
 Se limitaba a tararear aquella nana. 
Tres meses después, el barco ancló cerca de un campamento científico, desde donde lo vieron perderse entre la nieve. Iba casi sin abrigarse, pero no quiso ayuda. Alegaba que Gaia lo protegería. Tomó su mochila,q equipos y partió hasta el interior del continente con la mera protección de aquella idea y la nana. No dejó de tararearla durante los quince días de camino hasta llegar a una enorme montaña. Estaba cansado, así que se acostó a dormir sobre la nieve. Al amanecer supo dónde comenzar a cavar gracias a la misma nana, quizás también guiado por las estrellas. Quizás fue pura suerte, pero bajo capas de nieve, se encontraba la entrada a una cueva.
A pesar del gélido exterior, adentro estaba cálido. Encendió unas luces y anduvo por entre los túneles hasta llegar a una habitación inmensa tapizada con plantas y frutas nunca antes vista. En el centro, halló una esfera enorme, congelada. Se acercó y miró al interior. Allí estaba ella, lo supo en lo más hondo de su ser. Pero estaba atrapada en el hielo. Tomó un pico y comenzó a golpear la esfera. Esquirlas tras esquirlas fue abriéndose paso. Casi no le quedaban fuerzas. El impulso de la nana iba perdiendo su efecto. Mientras más se adentraba en la esfera, más se notaron los efectos de los días sin alimento, sueño y calor. Cada golpe era un tormento, pero no cesó ni un instante. De pronto, supo que con el siguiente, llegaría a ella. Podría verla con toda claridad. Ella también. Sin embargo, solo entonces, ya con el brazo en alto, se cuestionó ¿cómo ella había terminado ahí? ¿Qué iba a suceder si la liberaba? 
La nana volvió a zumbar en su cabeza, en sus oídos, con más fuerza, con promesas de vida, verde, alimentos, paraíso. Todo era bueno. Todo era perfecto. 
Quizás, demasiado bueno y perfecto. 
Así que temió que con el próximo golpe, la vida en la tierra, tal y como la conocía, llegara a su fin. Incluso la suya. 
Mas él golpeó e hizo un pequeño agujero por el que un zumbido, un rápido aleteo se dejó escuchar. Extrañado, ansioso, continuó abriendo el orificio hasta ver el interior de aquella esfera. 
Justo entonces la reconoció. La descubrió en el vuelo de aquel colibrí, así reconoció a Gaia, sus líneas en el valle de Nazca, su voz en la sala de su casa, bailando al ritmo de su música para sus plantas.
El colibrí voló hasta detenerse al frente de su rostro y lo besó. Luego, partió hacia el exterior, dejando un manto verde y creciente tras de sí.
Él no hizo nada más que sentarse dentro de la esfera y esperar.
No estaba seguro de cuando, pero ella, si regresaba lo encontraría allí en la esfera, sentado.

body.body:
![寿.jpg](https://img.ilark.io/img/202601/1777976384651-t11v4.jpg)

七秩华年，鬓染霜花。 
忆从戎岁月，风霜作伴；
军号声里，满腔热血。
归来田亩， 一担辛劳夜不休。
看庭前，正橘林滴翠，香满枝头。

更换猪舍晨稠， 把岁月熬成好丰收。
粗茶淡饭，一生俭朴为根；
肩挑日月，手种温柔。 
为子女，倾囊供读， 托举为其青云路。
今寿宴，愿福如东海，寿比南山。

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 05 2026
body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g448ea2db3a3025efaa34dfbbb8984970316ef2c3231673a85057637c8efeab2b878967834f12fd23f8ed6fa2eb8cdf99_640.jpg)
Hoy mi caminata por la ciudad fue realmente revitalizante. Comencé en el parque central, donde pude ver a un grupo de personas practicando yoga al aire libre. La energía era contagiosa, y me hizo sentir inspirado a unirme en algún momento futuro. Mientras caminaba, conocí a una mujer mayor que estaba alimentando a las palomas. Me contó que cada mañana viene al parque para disfrutar de la tranquilidad antes de que la ciudad despierte completamente. Me impresionó su conocimiento sobre las diferentes especies de aves que visitan el lugar; parecía una verdadera experta. Además, pasé por un colorido mercado callejero donde vendían frutas y verduras frescas. Me detuve a comprar unas deliciosas fresas que estaban en su punto. La variedad de aromas y colores me hizo sentir agradecido por la vida urbana y todas las pequeñas sorpresas que ofrece cada día. Sin duda, mi caminata fue un recordatorio de la belleza de la comunidad que nos rodea. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

body.title: 河流总是给人一种宁静而悠然的感觉。水面在阳光
body.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/ga371a31b227f864c6a78c833641e9f8522dbf3b5464b0b1af493916ea186044634432c5b75c2dedb53cdc1406c37f6195247504990c9c2a7df56cef1ab6c55ed_640.jpg)</center>

***

河流是大自然的脉络，它静静流淌，承载着无数故事与回忆。站在河边，听着水声潺潺，仿佛时间都慢了下来，心灵得到了片刻的宁静。河水在阳光下闪烁，映照出生活的美好与希望，让人感受到生命的流动与变化。每一条河流都有它的独特魅力，连接着山川大地，滋养着生灵，让我在喧嚣中找到了内心的平和。

body.title: En busca de la luz / Poema
body.body:
<center>Salir del fondo es muy complicado,
muchos se fijan solo en el pasado,
pero pocos se fijan en el esfuerzo
que realizó desde que despierto.</center>

<center>Me siento sumergido en oscuridad,
algo diferente a la más pura maldad,
se percibe como un fría indiferencia,
como si no tuvieran de ti conciencia.</center>

<center>Relegado al olvido por la sociedad,
visto como si vistiera solo suciedad,
pocas veces conocí la empatia ajena,
aún así crecí como una persona buena.</center>

<center>Mi única esperanza es hallar la luz,
mi persistencia se mantiene aún,
quiero ver el mundo como los demás
y que no me sigan juzgando sin más.</center>

<center>A muchos los consideran basura,
a nadie le importaría si murieran,
eso es algo que debemos cambiar,
educar a los jóvenes para no odiar.</center>

<center>Esa luz debe ser nuestro objetivo,
un derecho esencial para todo ser vivo,
donde la igualdad sea nuestra bandera,
donde trabajemos de forma sincera.</center>

body.title: European Green Lizard
body.body:
Yesterday when I visited my Cousin in Krems after work, I found this beautiful European Green Lizard lying in the sun directly in front of her appartement. I waited some minutes in front of her appartment and there I found this beautiful green lizard enjoying the sun. I had my smartphone with me and snapped a few pictures. When she arrived it was still there and I showed it to her, she had never seen it before in front of her house and was amazed on its beauty. Unfortunately I only had my smartphone with me and no better Camere. 

But since I know that they can be found in front of my cousins flat I might take my camera with me the next time I visit here. But I have to admit this visit was not planned since I only visited her because I had to work nearby her home place and I drove by my cousins home on my way back.

My mother-in-law was seated and waiting for me when I initially arrived at my husband's house. I looked lost as I entered the house. We had just gotten back from our honeymoon when she appeared with her legs folded, her eyes fixated on me, and a smile on her lips, seemingly conveying that she knew precisely what she was doing. 

I tried to mask my horror by smiling and saying, \

and got up to give me a hug. Reluctantly, I gave her a hug. My spouse turned to face me after I turned to face him. Our home? Did I hear correctly? He never informed me that she would be staying at our house. This was truly the first time I was moving into my future home as a bride; I had only been there once to see it. \
I nearly screamed out, but I refrained. \n\nShe went from the kitchen to the bedroom. \

God, where was I supposed to start? What kind of circumstance was this? Should I tell my mother-in-law or my spouse how I felt? What kind of temptation was this? A large bowl of water and a towel were ready for me as I walked into the bedroom. She grinned and said, \

Was this a custom? Was this an initiation of any sort? I was completely startled that this was happening, even though I had only had two in-person interactions with his mother because I lived overseas. I married a Christian. \n\nMy husband stayed silent and composed, almost like a fool, for want of better words. He appeared to have gone insane. He dipped his leg into the basin after following. I didn't. I pretended to have a stomach ache and entered the loo. I called my mother right then. What kind of absurdity is this? Does she wish to replace you in her son's life? My mother yelled in a terrified tone, \
\n\nMy mother-in-law was waiting at the door with a bathing bag, a robe, and a towel when I emerged. \
With all due respect, ma, please let me talk to my husband.\

Oh, I apologise; I'm not stopping you from talking to him in any way, am I?” I didn't even respond. \n\nI entered the room and started talking loudly and angrily at him. He didn't react and maintained his composure. It made me appear stupid, and as I was still yelling, I heard loud voices and the main entrance open. \

I wasn't allowed to spoil the surprise.\

body.title: A Peaceful First Evening at Wat Phra That Si Chom Thong
body.body:
My trip to Thailand officially began with a meaningful first stop in Ban Luang, where we visited **Wat Phra That Si Chom Thong Worawihan**. Since this was my first time in Chiang Mai, I felt that visiting a temple was one of the best ways to begin the journey. Temples are not only places of worship, but they also reveal so much about the local culture, architecture, and way of life. This particular place is known as one of the high-ranking temples in the region, and after seeing it for myself, I could understand why.


![1000140786.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eoc58oosrcWdcfMZw16G1ub2w9jzezHRfEViQdrDwaerA2GLtuTMP4xRA6591evASDc.jpg)


We arrived at Chiang Mai Airport at around 5 PM, and from there, everything moved quite fast. After clearing arrival procedures, buying a SIM card, and booking a Grab car, it was already close to 6 PM. The ride to Ban Luang took around an hour, so by the time we reached the temple area, it was already around 7 PM. Even so, I was still excited because there was enough time to explore a little before calling it a night.


![1000140723.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpEGGr5YuD4uYMCJX7u4LjukgvbWhU4rtW1UL2HkqcMwYioa4fY59eRMdQp1SgtDb8g.jpg)

![1000140751.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpC8YKbZ9AGqGD9Mh3NHWQuWuwva21JogoTAU9NyyuUGp3aGujWg32paEkJMWc8zXjr.jpg)


At first, it seemed like we would not be able to enter. The front gate was already closed, and I honestly thought we had missed our chance. We decided to simply walk around the area and admire the place from outside. Luckily, one of the side entrances was still open. We took a peek, and that was when a security guard greeted us and kindly told us that we were still allowed to go inside. That small moment already made the experience memorable for me. It was such a warm welcome to Thailand.


![1000140769.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpJYX13FdVHu9Km6RyzvN7Zr9jtVwL3fLiaKWZU5WKYymMSbkrPQ8iVn4YyUhPv9UtC.jpg)

![1000140775.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoiVArwQ8kYJ7BqoyWM4t6SRXcGky3RThKuoYoafFoVXvSkC5ypti3ZyDU6fi9FkPZu.jpg)

![1000140774.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoeEV2NznxGbCqjJ8bdea2CHWhkiEssy4e25Kmd8SN9bQmd9eDE8pArvgkdb3vaQ5V7.jpg)

![1000140773.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoCi4RpMzgtC7AgBQipPqTpVHFS1LBziRT1PSiLrAeXRJuwTsMvbe4S6BDBnkGARV6v.jpg)

![1000140776.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoChdxnerMKE1i4DkM6PwQ18FZaXyLBWARNL2mbv8qXiFscefN9frRK7NUKXrWzCCEH.jpg)


As a first-time visitor to a temple complex like this, I was immediately amazed by the incredible architecture. The place feels grand, but at the same time very peaceful. I realized quickly that this was more than just a beautiful temple. It is a whole complex that serves different purposes for the community, including spaces for meditation and other activities. That gave the place more depth for me because it showed how deeply connected religion and daily life are here.


![1000140786.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eoc58oosrcWdcfMZw16G1ub2w9jzezHRfEViQdrDwaerA2GLtuTMP4xRA6591evASDc.jpg)

![1000140777.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eoc52nYFjt6cP9a8htUpSV8uJZrnAeLMBfkhbrGnHoxFg6KDJNKWQpGnEaXGStfc8qG.jpg)


What fascinated me the most was how everything seemed to be built around the golden stupa, which instantly became the centerpiece of the whole complex. There is a kind of visual rhythm in the way the buildings, walkways, and sacred spaces are arranged around it. Another thing that really caught my attention was the sacred tree supported by huge wooden bracings. I found that feature incredibly unique. It felt like nature, faith, and craftsmanship were all meeting in one place.


![1000140790.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoAZpLXkxHmhoEAodMiZBqdKpKucUssQdKoiZ1qYHJfepEPtwNzkxx2qKHKSJnoGo3r.jpg)

![1000140785.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EorzJSfNrGB12tmvNVsCSZiuS2HARpYDuhK9hmBqPP1d6KHBYFEbgZMtFkzKHfbcoiQ.jpg)

![1000140788.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoEpbihPesW5dWu3fXkq2aAUTLU4fHydzWdwQxC3vgUTGtYSochVJYNLpK1b7jP6EeN.jpg)

![1000140791.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoChaAg6oWJPWVJeBi6PkqMRmBpqGydTp7dThZeYnJMymLvkNDf8k2jsyKGNeAj77WA.jpg)

![1000140787.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoAYqkkgN2NFLtCGcCQPmgajBaCJ5sZrN3uucwAuwRxBn94rx9dRgEfcqRa1GB8eSfD.jpg)


The details of the temple were also stunning. The gold ornaments, intricate patterns, and decorative elements made every corner worth photographing. Even though it was already night, the warm lights made the temple glow beautifully. In fact, I think the night atmosphere added more drama and mystery to the photos. Every detail looked more striking against the dark sky, and that made the whole complex feel even more magical.


![1000140795.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoAZpLP4dj9sgNG4vJJ7NtUBoynGVS5GE4j7iweaVVt1vJRwZrMM4ySaeuz79xLA1sQ.jpg)

![1000140793.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23tmFur29n6GQbK4V8N3S6jgHg9xBHNVdoXynZtqAkGREvAimdUG1EtQfFjXXc7f8znu5.jpg)


But beyond the architecture and photography, what stayed with me the most was the feeling of serenity in the place. As I got closer to the golden stupa, everything felt quieter, calmer, and more surreal. There was a sense of awe that is difficult to explain, like the place naturally invites you to slow down and be present. It was such a beautiful way to begin this Thailand trip.


![1000140797.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EogNDzpNfTM76vMt4eq5eJD1SRL69bKYupz66F9S8VFipj6w89JawfY4ZvUT1afDEGR.jpg)


***This first stop in Chiang Mai already gave me a memorable experience, and it made me even more excited to explore more of the region. If this is how the trip begins, then I can only imagine how many more incredible places and moments are waiting ahead.***

## I will definitely be revisiting Chiang Mai soon.

body.title: Eliminando cargas / Removing loads
body.body:
En muchas ocasiones somos tan despistados que no nos damos cuenta de cuánto pasa a nuestro alrededor realmente. A veces sin darnos cuenta cosas extraordinarias se nos escapan de las manos y ni siquiera nos damos cuenta de cómo ni cuándo. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaKjBcZ5QUJjvAn6Vv6ucGrEstqtLpfX2w3DMUj7XDAwe/img_1257.jpg)
<center>[Fuente ](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/smiley-icono-gestual-queja-822361/)</center>

Suena loco, pero así es. Hace rato mientras conversaba con una amiga sobre lo concurrida que tenía mi semana y que a veces no encontraba tiempo ”para mi”; ella me abrió los ojos y me dijo parafraseando: *No te quejes tanto, porque sin darte cuenta estás viviendo las cosas por las que habías orado*

Y yo tipo: Literal 🥹

(Gracias a Dios por mi amiga @leibys012)

La cuestión es que le pedimos a Dios por x cosas y seguimos en nuestro vaivén y lo curioso es que cuando llegan las respuestas comenzamos a quejarnos y en eso se nos va la vida. Quejas que en realidad no van para ningún lado y son la excusa perfecta para no decir de forma clara que no sabemos administrar nuestro tiempo, o muchas veces limitarnos…

La queja no tiene pros, al contrario, está cargada de contras.
-No te deja ver todo lo maravilloso que se te presenta. Con tanto por delante y con un hábito espantoso sin querer soltarlo, sólo nublándote el lente para no ver más allá.
-No te deja disfrutar de nada, sólo estamos enfocados en dormir quejándonos, para levantarnos igual. Un bucle que nos encanta porque es el camino más fácil.
-Oscurece nuestra alma, con el tiempo lo volvemos un estilo de vida y para volver atrás cuesta. Ya llevamos mucho tiempo ensimismado y la costumbre es de las cosas más fuertes.
-Nos aleja de personas bonitas. Nadie está dispuesto a pasarse la vida al lado de alguien que se queja de día y de noche. Eso sería involucrar a más personas en algo que nada que ver.

<center>…</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVwyUiMxinmdNrxueMXtT2CoGvZ6D3ajpXuR55MAzH2sb/img_1258.webp)
<center>[Fuente ](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/margarita-leucanthemum-composicion-74886/)</center>

Dejar las quejas atrás hace que automáticamente miremos de forma amplia todo lo que está transcurriendo en nuestra vida. Mantiene nuestra mente enfocada en el presente - futuro y no en lo que se nos escapó y ya no hay remedio. 

Me niego a cargar con ese peso enorme, prefiero deleitarme en todas las cosas buenas y bonitas que tiene Dios preparadas para mi.
¿Qué tal cambiar las quejas por las gracias? Definitivamente cambiar ese hábito fue de las mejores decisiones, lo dejé atrás y no lo extraño para nada.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUU2gvcaDcywn9xonuixyGBEyx7ERoM4LXFT3s3n9Lnxx/img_1259.webp)
<center>[Fuente ](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/smiley-travieso-lengua-680220/)</center>

Agradecer siempre es el antídoto perfecto para contrarrestar las constantes quejas. Desde que abrimos los ojos…
Por una mañana llena de matices 
Por un Sol radiante acompañado de nubes 
Por un día más de vida 
Por nuestra familia 
Por el aire que respiramos 
Por nuevas oportunidades 
Por TODO.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfR2bsi1pkSWV9JyMELc8qrCpakvEm9tUY7oMJLTuvLqU/img_1260.webp)
<center>[Fuente ](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/firmar-gracias-personaje-figura-1715890/)</center>


Debemos ser más agradecidos. Apartar un minuto de cada día y ver cuan grandes cosas nos rodean y sobre todo, recordar que nunca estamos solos; Dios sobre está ahí y su silencio no es ausencia; él obra. ¡Qué motivo más grande y fuerte para no quejarnos por nada!

Menos quejas y más sonrisas, más gratitud. ¡Comencemos hoy!


Bonito día.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYMbB7dyG4aZvodEevQiEnScK6HnK1Yt9knsYvSYUF5se/img_1390.png)

Many times we are so clueless that we don't realize how much is really happening around us. Sometimes without realizing it extraordinary things slip out of our hands and we don't even realize how or when. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaKjBcZ5QUJjvAn6Vv6ucGrEstqtLpfX2w3DMUj7XDAwe/img_1257.jpg )
</center>[Source](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/smiley-icono-gestual-queja-822361/)</center>

It sounds crazy, but that's the way it is. A while ago while I was talking with a friend about how busy my week was and that sometimes I didn't find time ”for me\

The Valley of Five Polish Lakes in the Tatra Mountains is definitely worth a visit. It can be reached via various routes, which can be seen in the photos. The following shots were taken at several points along the trail starting from Morskie Oko (blue hiking trail). Two ponds stand out in the photos: Przedni Staw and Wielki Staw.

> <sub>**[ PL ]**</sub>
> Dolina Pięciu Stawów Polskich w Tatrach to miejsce zdecydowanie warte odwiedzenia. Można do niej dotrzeć różnymi trasami, które można dostrzec na zdjęciach. Poniższe uęcia wykonałem w kilku miejscach na szlaku zaczynającym się od Morskiego Oka (szlak pieszy niebieski). Na zdjęciach wyróżniają się dwa stawy: Przedni Staw oraz Wielki Staw.

body.title: Cover song - Music folk of Venezuela by @yoxibeth
body.body:
/>
Hola a todos los amigos de la comunidad de Music Hoy me siento muy emocionada de compartir con ustedes una pieza que corre por las venas de nuestra tradición llanera \

, una composición del recordado Ramón Castillo. En esta ocasión, he querido interpretar este hermoso tema en el tono de Re Mayor, una tonalidad que le brinda un brillo especial. Para que la experiencia sea verdaderamente auténtica, cuento con el honor de tener en el acompañamiento de fondo al Maestro Ramón Páez, quien con su maestría en el arpa logra dibujar ese paisaje sonoro tan característico de nuestras tierras. Grabar este video ha sido un proceso lleno de respeto por nuestras raíces, buscando transmitir esa fuerza y a la vez la melancolía que solo la música folclórica sabe expresar cuando se hace con el corazón. Espero que disfruten de esta entrega tanto como yo disfruté preparándola para todos ustedes, pues cada nota es un abrazo extendido hacia quienes valoran nuestro arte. Agradezco enormemente el apoyo constante que le brindan a mi contenido y los comentarios que siempre me motivan a seguir mejorando y difundiendo nuestra cultura en Hive. Sin más que agregar, los invito a ponerse cómodos y dejarse llevar por el sonido del cuatro y el arpa . Les mando un cordial saludo y un gran abrazo llanero, se despide como siempre su amiga @Yoxibeth.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yoxibeth/23xydoCJwfgSFMF5etRQgzu4JXpY2qJKi5jLt7XZgLRSKf7oohgGX8sP1GwV13hJkSGXJ.PNG

/> >Hello to all my friends in the Music community! Today I’m thrilled to share with you a piece that runs deep in the veins of our Llanera tradition: “Las tres llanuras hermanas,” a composition by the late Ramón Castillo. For this performance, I’ve chosen to play this beautiful piece in the key of D major, a key that lends it a special brilliance. >To make the experience truly authentic, I have the honor of being accompanied by Maestro Ramón Páez, who, with his mastery of the harp, manages to paint that soundscape so characteristic of our lands. Recording this video has been a process filled with respect for our roots, seeking to convey that strength and, at the same time, the melancholy that only folk music knows how to express when it is made with the heart. >I hope you enjoy this release as much as I enjoyed preparing it for all of you, for every note is a warm embrace extended to those who value our art. I am deeply grateful for the constant support you give my content and for the comments that always motivate me to keep improving and spreading our culture on Hive. >Without further ado, I invite you to get comfortable and let yourselves be carried away by the sound of the cuatro and the harp. I send you warm regards and a big embrace from the plains; as always, your friend @Yoxibeth bids you farewell.

body.title: One Regret I Carry
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXZVXWNua9BsgkVqezgHUkgaydgN37pkmjuKhERfZxj9n/1777974491948.jpg)


One regret I find myself carrying is not taking advantage of the opportunities I had earlier in life to build myself financially. There was a time when I had fewer responsiblities in my life, instead of me taking advantage of that period, no, I was deeply focused on my personal challenge at that time that I completely forgot that I have a life after that phase.

 Looking back now, I realised that the challenge that I was facing then, that's to have a child of my own was  important to me then, but I allowed it to consumed all my time, energy and attention, making me to missed chances to explore business ideas, invest in opportunities around me, and grow financially.

I will say that I'm not that business inclined of a person. I will  tell you why. Then the environment I was in did not seem fully developed, so business opportunities were there, clear and within my reach. So if I were business inclined, I would have grabbed those opportunities then and make something good out of it. Instead of me allowing the weight of my situation then and the pressure from my in-laws to prevent me from thinking beyond my immediate struggle. 

Now, when I look back and see others who took those same opportunities and how their businesses has grown and expanded,  😥😥😥 it stirs pain and regret in my heart. It makes me wonder how my life would have been financially if I had made different choices.

The truth is that, no matter how much I revisit the past in my mind, I can not change it. Yes, regret is natural, but I'm learning not to be imprisoned by my past. I have forgiven my self for not knowing and i have choosen not to be bitter or hard on myself when ever I look at others. 

I have been willing to rebuild myself and to grow financially. I avail myself to exploring new opportunities around me, learning new skills and not allowing fear, doubt or even obstacles to hold me back again.

Thanks for stopping by @sarahbaby blog. This is Ladies of Hive contest #287 and I am delighted to participate.

body.title: Duck Egg Soup in Thick Coconut Milk
body.body:
> ![20260501_123518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/Ep5od6iAyW1j5SfE6k9zpcaX9ECA4QMeZrSGwYzMsZPBDamc9bFWCzXVzprNvVrU5zu.jpg) Today I’m going to cook a very simple home-style dish—this is my go-to when the ducks start laying eggs at home. Yep, this duck egg dish is our lunch side dish, enjoyed with warm white rice. Usually, the combination of mashed boiled sweet potatoes and salted fish makes for a truly appetizing plate.
Rich Duck Eggs
![20260501_124010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xL2VqfFWh1b36Cv5D1uDWu4xPjXqggkrM2AJfGojvSr6rn373Ndd4JgejWeZQUHaT4K.jpg) The name of this dish alone is sure to tempt anyone wondering how to turn duck eggs into a simple, easy, and affordable meal. The blend of spices, combined with coconut milk and scrambled eggs, creates an extraordinary dish. The natural savory-sweet flavor of the spices, with a hint of heat, is just perfect on the palate. For those of you wondering what to make with duck eggs, I think this will be a fantastic alternative. Plus, it’s one of my husband’s favorites; he says this dish is irreplaceable—it’s that delicious, even though it’s made with just duck eggs. Curious about the step-by-step preparation? Let’s check out the recipe below.
Ingredients
![20260501_114348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EpT57moFur4DWoFzyu9Wavxxj2DjDRH5FZ3vm57YagzbXTPw9qzAQGrDhCRuLHoSB2C.jpg)

>
**Main Ingredients**
4 eggs 500 ml coconut milk 1 sprig of curry leaves 5 green chilies 1 stalk of lemongrass

>
**Spice Paste**
6 dried shrimp 20 small hot chilies 3 cm turmeric 1 teaspoon coriander 1 dried chili 2 cloves garlic 2 shallots
Preparation Procedure
Sauté the shallots, curry leaves, and lemongrass, then blend the spice paste until smooth with a little water and add it to the pan, stirring until fragrant.

> ![20260501_114918.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xL6sSrNGb212BeQgpL15Za2fRZ8eDhwEuaCw3PpXcB3hs3seZHysyGP8ZDyq3DvqCNT.jpg) ![20260501_114954.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wMY14hnjRi2hZsTkdfReKetvZ4r7V8HLdnP2CTsCQMLfJ5X9kERBEFwayhSitRCJ4iR.jpg)
Slowly pour the coconut milk into the pan while stirring and wait until it comes to a boil.

> ![20260501_115603.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xAVgELA5fKc2XzdvHyrjnXaL34uvSzorUa8YuiBRZCxD5EM1FpeHcpyLcMys6zQiH2s.jpg) ![20260501_115440.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wgFgJ6gex5AWv9NguTWSC6HnJdPHwLvuFvDrbE3igAngnvAz87N8QXi9kPsWFoTsD6p.jpg)
Crack the eggs one by one into a bowl, then add them to the coconut milk. For this step, do not stir so the eggs don't break apart.Then add the green chili and cook again until it boils

> ![20260501_115648.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23yTd3tyxJgtYCcbFkiWr5m5NnEMG5xK7Tvuigof6V8YR3poG9SJifkPnWFc8cQ64ByZd.jpg) ![20260501_120223.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23tc1LUiNfweecaD1ZAiyeX79xenxWS36kkK4YyRKCRGJWxKUt5D5RBAQjyfifUURRDbb.jpg)
Then continue until all the eggs are in. Let the eggs cook. Don't forget to season with salt. I used ¼ teaspoon of salt. Adjust to taste if needed.

> ![20260501_120244.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wqieGEnDUqidq11DSfCyw8HavsLr98p9dU7gnG8nVvoPhtoXJXvwbM8CvHd66RXMhSf.jpg)
Result
![20260501_123945.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EpQxJZWZedQYiUC4M2TkaSWHkBYun9HU1DH6jxbeAbj1pLgLscAWV8CHtdy3LMUGH4n.jpg) The coconut milk-simmered duck eggs are ready to serve. Serve them with warm white rice, add a little fish sauce, and enjoy. This is the heavenly taste of a traditional dish; the duck eggs are tender and cooked evenly. None of them cracked at all—all four are perfectly smooth—and I absolutely love how they turned out, round and uniform. Now, never substitute chicken eggs because the result will definitely be different, and the eggs will surely crack in the sauce.
| ![20260501_124059.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23y94mxzfhSLz3bYjdMnDLh81Eygr3RJsJKJ3QCdav3n8ho1SMx2ba61wWxfBvn7zCTE4.jpg) | ![20260501_124032.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wquKGHp1winXgTdL4djMfH2A6gs3dRoep9X1q8tzjxpnFZ2y2M7tBZWJmLXnAJJf3RT.jpg) | ![20260501_124038.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23w32263VTS9jddKb4EK55HBF6o5RFypRyVgk6n7t8rwV4Zrt8FgQkQSjyTJD6rvJNyQL.jpg) | |-|-|-|
The flavor is just right on the palate—savory, sweet, and spicy all blend into a truly umami experience, even without any bouillon. This is already incredibly delicious; today’s lunch is very simple, yet it’s so tasty it surpasses enjoying a fancy meal at a restaurant.
![20230506_212938_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23yTv75jgyP5CSod1jCZoAPbPAnA7mSYtNJUa33KmuA4GgtmxGNNUyyxR9bq8gsiGS8qF.png)

About The Author
Welcome to this blog, I have a real name \

, who comes from Indonesia. I have several hobbies, reading, writing, gardening, I also love food and cooking, even art related.  And the most interesting one is spending the whole day traveling. From those hobbies, I will  some inspiring content for all of you, I hope you like my blog, please and reblog this post if you like it!.</sub>

Hey All,



![1000145965.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gungunkrishu/23tvnfD19XhxD9dFQfC2tJoJdVUbkARh4mWNYcEDvLxLTc3LWZBS5AaHwU1T2tMyAnNhN.png)


I made a post on UberOne Membership programme around March,2026 – [UberOne Membership - Everything You Need to Know About UberOne Membership - Lets Explore...]( https://peakd.com/hive-146620/@gungunkrishu/uberone-membership-everything-you-need-to-know-about-uberone-membership-lets-explore) and reported that I had subscribed to the membership by just paying INR 190/- [which is like almost $2.5+ dollars] for entire one year subscription plan. The best part was that in the same plan I was able to get my family members added to the plan in the same amount. Which means at $2.5 three members of my family is taking advantage of UberOne membership programme.


![1000145950.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gungunkrishu/23tHbfzgyoD8Z763BVG7r9YgQeEnffd71rqdT9pBzhqFSdSVxkbQt2xTUthiA7cYcasuV.jpg)


### UberOne Membership – My Experience So FAR – is Membership Worth OR Not?
Have a look at the above image and it will give you a sense that I have already recovered my money and still have like 10 months to leverage up the membership benefits. Just as a reminder here are the main benefits of the UberOne programme. And they are as follows::
•	Earn up to 15% Uber One credits on rides like Go, Go Sedan, Premier, XL, Reserve, Black, Auto and Parcel. Uber one credits are redeemable on your next trip.
•	Priority support: 24 X 7 Support for members
There are many other benefits but these two are my mains ones that inclined me to buy the membership. Moving forward to answering the question of is membership worth or not? Then I think that if you are a frequent user who prefers taking a cab as opposed to driving yourself then there is no harm being a UberOne member. In my example I have already recovered what I invested and considering the time I have till the membership ends I would even benefit more and it would surpass at least giving me a profit of INR 1K+ so not a bad deal at all. The best part is that the UberOne credits are applied automatically so you need not worry about how to take advantage of the UberOne credits. I had some questions around the credits but then when I understood how it works it made things more simpler. Maybe in my next follow-up post I would describe how UberOne credits works with the help of an example. Also I did like to echo on the cabs that we are assigned here – they are all well maintained cabs and at times cabs are upgraded at FREE of cost. So I guess this is additional benefit which we cannot ignore. Well this should be it for todays post on - \

Happy and safe riding and leverage UberOne benefit to its fullest... cheers

body.title: Adapt the Plan,  Never the Goal
body.body:
>

Growth is rarely linear, and obstacles should be viewed as navigable staircases rather than impenetrable walls. >El crecimiento rara vez es lineal, y los obstáculos deben verse como escaleras navegables en lugar de muros infranqueables.

When life forces you to stop a routine, the key to maintaining momentum is flexibility, swapping the activity while keeping the goal. >Cuando la vida te obliga a detener una rutina, la clave para mantener el impulso es la flexibilidad, cambiar la actividad sin perder el objetivo.

Adapting to challenges is the most effective strategy to ensure that success becomes the result of consistent, compounded actions. >Adaptarse a los desafíos es la estrategia más efectiva para garantizar que el éxito sea el resultado de acciones consistentes y acumuladas.

For example, if a knee injury stops a runner, the smart move is switching to another activity such as swimming to stay fit while healing. Same goal, different path, zero lost momentum. >Por ejemplo, si una lesión en la rodilla detiene a un corredor, lo más inteligente es cambiarse a otra actividad como la natación para mantenerse en forma mientras sana. Mismo objetivo, camino diferente, sin perder el ritmo.

When a recent obstacle blocked your path, did you throw in the towel or did you find a way to pivot?

>Cuando un obstáculo reciente bloqueó tu camino, ¿tiraste la toalla o encontraste la manera de reinventarte?

body.title: Hive Music Festival Week 186, round 3. // Forever Yours // covered by @sampraise77
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1777973668517-e2ea5354040dcd9d.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=sampraise77/c2c5cf84)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=sampraise77/c2c5cf84)


---

Hey everyone, it's @sampraise77 here for Hive Music Festival Week 186, round 3. I'm going to be singing a song titled 'Forever Yours' by Kaestrings for you today.

This song is all about someone's deep personal devotion to God, really focusing on His unconditional love and giving yourself completely to Him. At its heart, it shows how a believer understands that God's love is truly unique, incomparable, and just beyond what we can fully get. This kind of love isn't something you earn; it's a free gift, and it really changes a person from the inside.

One of the main ideas in this song is about understanding who you are through God's eyes. The singer really wants to see themselves just as God sees them—as someone valuable, accepted, and truly loved. This really highlights a spiritual battle many believers face: learning to get over insecurity, guilt, or self-doubt by trusting God's truth instead of how others might see them. It's saying that true confidence and figuring out your purpose comes from matching how you see yourself with how God sees you.

There's also a really powerful message about being saved and getting a new life. The song tells us that God has given us life for free, which really suggests that salvation comes from His grace, not from anything we do. This goes along with Christian beliefs about getting a spiritual refresh and being set free from sin. And when it mentions getting something so valuable without paying anything, it really stresses the idea of sacrifice—pointing to how God gave something incredibly precious so that all people could experience a full life.

Giving yourself over and feeling like you truly belong are also big parts of the song. The singer states that everything they are and everything they own belongs to God, and not just for a short time, but forever. This speaks to a complete dedication—where a person happily places their life, their purpose, and their future in God's hands. It's not about being forced to submit, but rather a joyful way to respond to love.

The fact that it uses both English and Hausa really broadens what the song can express, making it culturally rich and welcoming to many. It also helps drive home the same message across both languages: that God's love is truly special and worth committing your whole life to.

Finally, the song has a really grateful and worshipful feeling. It's not just something to reflect on; it also clearly states a firm decision to keep following God, all the time. The way it keeps repeating phrases about 'forever' really emphasizes how permanent this is, showing that this relationship isn't just a brief moment, but something that lasts eternally.

So, all in all, this song is a truly heartfelt piece of worship that beautifully blends themes like love, gratitude, identity, sacrifice, and an eternal commitment, all wrapped up into one powerful spiritual message.

Lyrics Source
https://youtu.be/7wxtbVGLhJY?si=BmIfgO3QhheX0lcy

---

Es genial que cuentes con tu mapa para descubrir bellezas como estas. Qué bueno que en esta oportunidad contará con la compañía de tu madre. Has hecho un gran trabajo apoyándola para que pudiera llegar a la cima.

Muchas gracias por compartir estas bellas fotografías y toda esta experiencia.

Que disfrutes de un día hermoso.

body.title: “When Cold Hearts Burn — The Fire Hidden Inside Silence”
body.body:
https://shorturl.at/ZHfF4

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPVV1FimCCB4aUgUoNvnTEGkLH5W9eU9hgg6j2ZGFTxZ1/1777973927747.jpg)



Sometimes, pain doesn’t come from loud arguments or harsh words.
Sometimes, it comes quietly… through distance, silence, and cold behavior.
“My heart slowly burns because of your cold attitude,
Look how even ice has managed to set a fire inside me.”
Strange, right?
How can ice create fire?
But if you’ve ever felt this… you already understand.
I’ve noticed something in life.
People can survive anger. They can even survive fights.
But what breaks them… is indifference.
That moment when someone who used to care… suddenly changes.
They still talk, but not the same way.
They still reply, but without warmth.
They’re there… but not really there.
And that’s where the burning begins.
The word “slowly burns” matters here.
This isn’t loud pain.
It’s quiet… steady… and deep.
Like something inside you is turning into ash, but no one can see it.
I’ve been there too.
Everything feels normal one day, and then suddenly something shifts.
No explanation. No clear reason.
Just a cold tone… and a strange distance.
And the worst part?
You start questioning yourself.
“Did I do something wrong?”
“Why are they acting like this?”
“Do I even matter anymore?”
These questions don’t just stay in your mind…
They slowly eat you from the inside.
But here’s the uncomfortable truth.
Not every cold behavior comes from cruelty.
Sometimes people are just tired.
Sometimes they’re lost in their own problems.
Sometimes they don’t even realize how much they’ve changed.
Still… silence hurts.
Because what isn’t said, often hurts more than what is said.
In my opinion, the strongest relationships are not the ones without problems…
They are the ones where people notice the distance before it becomes permanent.
Where silence is questioned.
Where coldness is addressed.
Where someone actually says,
“Something feels off… are you okay?”
Because honestly…
A small change in your behavior might be nothing to you…
But for someone else, it can shake their whole world.
In the end, love doesn’t need perfect words.
It doesn’t need constant talking.
But it does need warmth.
Because once warmth disappears…
Even ice can set everything on fire.

听说用红葱头做黑葱油 比洋葱做出来的味更香！到底是真是假，用了才有评判权。就在拼夕夕上下单5斤（后来发现这个量有点太多了，这个季节不易存放，很快就会长出新芽了）我还特意搜了一下哪个产地的红葱头比较正（好像是广东）结果遇到一个挂羊头卖狗肉的店铺，写着广东红葱头，收到了才发现 发货地是云南。。算了，就这样吧，懒得退了！

这个季节的大葱也不太好买，逛了两天菜场才买到满意的，用料都备齐就可以开工啦~看着视频做黑葱油的短短几分钟，好简单快手似的。事实是 操作好简单，但可一点都不快手哦！从备料到熬成 全程手工的话至少需要一个半小时。

每次做我都觉得油倒挺多了，结果都是熬成后油多不了一点，反而还有点少！油少了炸料时就不好操作。料越来越多，油少 后面倒入的蒜泥和姜末就极容易粘锅底，一旦粘锅底就不容易炸透，就像今天我做的，油少没炸透就还要补救一下！不然会缩短存放时间，还会影响口感。后面就用烤箱低温补救了一下，反而是第一次做的最满意！做越多越不放心上了哈哈😃

做一次要那么久时间，估计下一次做又不知在何年何月咯😂

body.title: When God is In The Family
body.body:
Greetings, everyone!


![1777970729138.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/peckypeace/EqBdaxVEUA2PV3KGPNk7eP2zBhjmdTo2oYREy4fBceXPnbpetd7pPKo5mhXCgWAcwvq.jpg)


[Source](https://www.facebook.com/100003935576067/posts/3545289815612169/?app=fbl)

I want to share a story of this beautiful family with you. I met this man in Eket when I went to visit his mother and helped her with house chores and farm work. I used to call him brother Victor. He was a young lecturer in polytechnic. By then, he was living a horrible lifestyle that I didn't like, and the mother didn't like either.

He was a deep womanizer, I mean. He will never bypass a beautiful lady, whether you are big or small, he will get what he wants and go his way. In my mind, I had already seen him as a young man who had no future and was releasing sperm all the time,, and how he would build his own family. Would the remaining sperm be enough to reproduce? If I were a fully grown woman to the age of marriage and he came to me to ask my hand in marriage, I wouldn't have let my hand, because I had seen the type of life he lived and I was afraid that he had a disease or infection. Not knowing I was thinking as a human but God was in a whole situation waiting for the appointed time to come for change to emerge. When a man is in Christ, old things have passed away; now he has become a new creature in the hands of God.

One fateful day, I was scrolling on Facebook, and I saw his picture with a young lady and a baby boy. I stopped. I opened his profile, went through it, to know if he got married legally to the lady. 

Behold, I saw a wedding card, pre-wedding photos with this lady. I was shocked. I knelt down and thanked God for changing this man into a married man with a child.

Another year goes by. Still on Facebook, I saw another photo with his wife and two male children. I was like God! I dropped him a text. Congratulating him and his new family on building.

Early this morning, after I had finished reading my Bible, sleep took me off. I woke up again to Facebook, and I saw this morning on his profile with his wife and three children, two grown-up boys and a newborn baby girl. 

I chatted him up and thanked God for his family. When you have God, you will have life in abundant and it will be seen in reality.

I still thank God for him and God is merciful and kind to His children. 

I read this morning how God told the Pharisees that he came for the sinners, not for the good people. He showed compassion and mercy to those. Reading down, I saw he doesn't judge people the way the world judges. This is so amazing for who God is to men.

We might be thinking that the person doesn't deserve the mercy of God, but in the agenda of God, He showed mercy to whom He wanted to show mercy. 

Kai, this God is too good. He doesn't act the way the world wants him to act. He does His thing at His own time, not the timing of men but His.

I remember, when we used to sing: \

. So sweet to know Jesus Christ.

Be a different species from the Lord.

God is so faithful and kind.

Thank you for reading through.

body.title: Pakistan Super Leaugue #PSL 2026 Final: Peshawar Zalmi Are Champions!
body.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPoxi68fbajpE9c525ZvH2E1aiWcc8NwMh2aDKsy126EL/PSL.PNG)

## **Peace be upon you all ✨🌟**

**Warm greetings to everyone.🤍🌸**

I hope you are all doing well, staying healthy, motivated, and full of positive energy, and your days are full of joy, peace, and little moments that make you smile. 🌟✨🌟

Pakistan Super League (PSL) 11 final played on 3 May 2026, at Gaddafi Stadium, Lahore, between Peshawar Zalmi and Hyderabad Kingsmen. In my last post, I broke down the details and discussed the journey of both teams in the tournament. 
Both teams played excellent cricket throughout the PSL, and they deserve to be in the final. Peshawar was the most consistent team in this PSL edition with their performance, and Hyderabad Kingsmen emerged as the most resilient team of this edition, even though they were participating in the PSL for the very first time. 
The final was not short of thrills and exciting moments. At some stages, the match can be turned on either way, but once again, Peshawar Zalmi proved that they were better prepared, handled the pressure situations calmly, and won the Champions Title in PSL 11. 

**Peshawar Zalmi beat Hyderabad Kingsmen by 5 wickets.**

Kingsmen batted first and only managed 129 runs. Zalmi chased it down in 15.2 overs. Simple result, but the match itself was full of drama, collapses, and extraordinary performances by the players.

---

## First Innings: Hyderabad Kingsmen Bat

The Gaddafi Stadium was packed with **32,461 fans**. Supporters of both teams were there. Peshawar Zalmi won the toss and chose to bowl first.

Kingsmen started really well. In the first 6 overs (called the powerplay), they scored 69 runs with only 2 wickets down. Labuschagne and Maaz Sadaqat were hitting freely. It looked like a big total was coming.

Then everything fell apart.

Spinner **Sufiyan Muqeem** got the first breakthrough, and after that, the wickets came in a rush. Kingsmen lost **4 wickets for just 2 runs** at one stage. Glenn Maxwell, Kusal Perera, and Irfan Khan — three experienced match-winners, all got out for zero.

Only **Saim Ayub** fought back. He scored 54 off 50 balls, almost on his own, while wickets kept falling at the other end. It was a brilliant knock under pressure, but when you are the only batter scoring, it is never going to be enough.

**Final score: 129 all out in 18 overs.**

On a ground where scores of 180+ are normal, 129 was not enough. Peshawar Zalmi was already in a strong position to win the title.

**Peshawar Zalmi Bowling** was extraordinary, Aaron Hardie's spell of 4/27 was the standout performance with the ball. He got Labuschagne when he was looking dangerous, and then came back to clean up the tail.
Nahid Rana was very impressive as well. In his 4 overs, he took 2 wickets for just 22 Runs. Sufiyan Muqeem and Muhammad Basit took one wicket each. 

---
## Second Innings: Peshawar Zalmi Chase 130

Chasing 130 should have been comfortable. It was not, at least not at the start.

**Mohammad Ali** bowled one of the most dramatic first overs you will ever see in a T20 final. He got out both openers, Mohammad Haris AND Babar Azam, in the very same over. Babar, the top run scorer of the whole tournament, was out for a golden duck on the first ball. Zalmi were 7/2 after just one over.

Then Kusal Mendis (9) and Michael Bracewell (4) also failed. Zalmi were **40 for 4**, still needing 90 more runs, with most of their best batters already gone.

That is when **Aaron Hardie and Abdul Samad** walked to the crease and simply refused to panic. Hardie anchored the innings with calm and class. Samad played the aggressive role, smashing sixes and boundaries. Together they added **85 runs** and completely took the match away from the Kingsmen. When Samad was finally out for 48, Zalmi needed just 5 more runs. Farhan Yousaf hit a boundary to finish it.

**Peshawar Zalmi: 130/5 in 15.2 overs,  on by 5 wickets**

**Hyderabad Kingsmen Bowlers** started aggressively and pushed Peshawar Zalmi into a difficult situation, but Peshawar's Batsmen stayed calm in a difficult situation. Low total on the board was another reason. 
Muhammad Ali took 3 wickets for 38 runs. Akif Javed and Hunain Shah took one wicket each for 29 and 26 runs respectively. 

---

## Player of the Match

Aaron Hardie was the player of the match. He displayed one of the greatest individual performances in PSL final history.

- **With the ball:** 4 wickets for 27 runs, dismantled the Kingsmen's middle order
- **With the bat:** 56 not out off 39 balls and rescued Zalmi from 40/4

He became the **first player in PSL history** to take 4 wickets AND score a half-century in the same final.

When his team needed him to bowl, he delivered. When his team needed him to bat, he delivered again. That is what a true all-rounder does on the biggest stage.

---

## Three Moments That Decided the Match

**1. The middle-order collapse**
When Maxwell, Perera, and Irfan Khan all got out for zero in quick succession, Kingsmen's score went from promising to helpless. 129 was the result of those three balls.

**2. Hardie's bowling spell**
He broke the back of the Kingsmen innings by removing Labuschagne just when he was looking dangerous, then finished off the tail. 4/27 in a final is exceptional.

**3. Hardie and Samad's partnership**
Zalmi were 40/4 and in serious trouble. Most teams would have crumbled. Instead, these two put on 85 runs calmly and won the match with nearly 5 overs to spare.

---

## What I Thought of This Final

I will be honest, 129 vs 130 is not the kind of scoreline you expect in a PSL final. On most nights at Gaddafi Stadium, both teams would have scored 170+.

But finals are not about big scores. They are about handling pressure. And on that front, Peshawar Zalmi were clearly the better team on the night.

Babar Azam got a golden duck and still lifted the trophy. That tells you everything about how well-balanced this squad was. No single player was carrying the team; they had depth, and it showed when it mattered most.

For Hyderabad Kingsmen, reaching the final in your debut season is already an achievement worth celebrating. Their middle order letting them down will hurt, but there is no shame in losing a final. They will be back.

And for Babar Azam personally, this was a long time coming. Nine years of PSL without a title as a player, multiple finals lost. He finally has one as captain. That is a special feeling.

---

## Quick Stats & Records

- **Attendance:** 32,461, highest in PSL history
- **Zalmi's last PSL title:** 2017 (9 years ago)
- **Player of the Tournament:** Sufyan Moqeem, excellent young talent. 
- **Top run scorer of PSL 2026:** Babar Azam, 588 runs (tied PSL record, two 100's)
- **Hardie's record:** First player to take 4 wickets + score 50+ in a PSL final

---

## Final Thoughts

PSL 2026 gave us upsets, comeback stories, individual brilliance across the whole season, and a final that had genuine drama even if the score looks one-sided on paper.

The right team won. Peshawar Zalmi were the best side in the tournament from start to finish, and they proved it when it counted most.
