body.title: Pigeon 🕊️
body.body:
Pigeon 🕊️
I went for a walk today. We worked this morning—not just on drawing, but also in our backyard. At lunchtime, we decided to take a break because we were tired and it was too hot to do anything. I decided not to lie in bed, but to go for a walk with my friends. 
We went to the lake. But on the way, I saw this beautiful pigeon in a tree. It had such an unusual color. 
I managed to take a photo of the pigeon. I’m not a professional photographer. It’s hard for me to photograph a bird. It’s much easier to take a photo of a building or flowers. They’re always in one place. But birds don’t exactly sit still in one place. They often fly from branch to branch or fly away altogether. But I still managed to take a photo of the pigeon. I also managed to take a photo of another animal, but I’ll tell you about that in another post. 
Pigeons are very cute and smart birds. They don’t fly away to warmer places during the winter, when it’s cold. They stay home for the winter. It’s very good to feed them. There isn’t much food for birds in the winter. That’s why you can feed them. You can feed pigeons different kinds of grains. 
Pigeons are very beautiful and intelligent birds. They come in different colors. There are also wild pigeons; they look a little different. 
Pigeons are intelligent birds; there are even carrier pigeons. In the past, since ancient times, letters were delivered by carrier pigeons.

body.title: The Cost of Ignorance
body.body:
We live in a world where short-form social media content has taken over, and it is so bad that people no longer cultivate the habit of reading as they used to in the past. There was a time when students and people flooded libraries to access materials for writing and learning. If someone had told me that the number of people who read daily would decrease in this internet age, I would have said it was a lie.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRRHBDQsytec9r5K6Hm7KhdQwQEMMnyb2pMS1rmnmiESP/img_0034.jpg)


The truth is that people no longer need to visit a physical library before accessing books. There are many PDFs and online materials available for anyone who wishes to learn. However, the reverse is now the case, as people have become increasingly lazy about reading. You will see students and even adults scrolling through the internet, searching for what is not lost, and becoming engrossed in comedy content created online.

There is a saying that if you want information to become inaccessible, simply put it in writing, and you would be surprised how many people will fail to find it. It is even worse in Africa. A lot of people do not read unless it is for examinations. You will hear people say, “Ah, you are reading?” It seems that many people here do not believe reading is necessary for accessing information. Some even say, “I don’t have an examination now, so why should I read?”

Would it not be a tragedy if all these classical works of art were left on shelves to gather dust while our skills and knowledge die with us? Even now, most books are available in audio formats that we can listen to online without needing physical copies. Knowledge is wealth, and reading is one of the primary ways we acquire it. If you do not read, you are gradually losing knowledge, and you may not remain relevant for long.

All this time, we have sat on the fence, complaining and feeding off the struggles of our ancestors. What have we put in place for future generations? When I was young, I remember listening to my grandmother share witty sayings, up-to-date information about the past, lessons learned, and what we should and should not do. One would realize that this present generation often does not value such wisdom. Many believe they know it all and are unwilling to learn from elders, often saying times have changed and that we no longer do things that way. They claim we are now in a digital and technological era, forgetting that much of what they call “outdated knowledge” is the foundation upon which modern progress is built.

All developments in the world today are the result of the work of those who came before us. Scholars made it possible. That is why in academics, we reference past scholars, build on their contributions, and continue from where they stopped.

Is it our debt? Is it our indifference toward acquiring knowledge and skills? Is it our low drive for purpose and creativity? Whatever the answers may be, we must reflect on ourselves. We have to think about future generations. We cannot live here forever, and we must be mindful of what we do now, because younger generations are watching us.

If we do not cultivate the habit of reading, the coming generation will not see any reason to do so.

Education is power. And if you think education is expensive, then try ignorance.

body.title: Dialectical behaviour therapy as a pathway to resilience
body.body:
The field of mental health care is always growing, which leads to better psychological and evidence-based solution paths for people when their feelings or behaviors become more intense. Dialectical behaviour therapy (DBT) is one well-respected method that has been developed specifically to help clients better regulate emotional responses, develop relationships, and coping strategies. [Dialectical behaviour therapy in London](https://www.vitalminds.ca/london/dialectical-behaviour-therapy/) has become an expanding form of treatment that helps a great many people obtain emotional stability and develop their sense of self.[#heallth](https://www.waivio.com/object/heallth) 

![464783335_122191955882204851_1589762593859953167_n.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/35c4642084ae3d317cd06d498ff4ed545464e7b11c059b33ff8f4a0f1f35aedb)

**Understanding the core of DBT**

Dialectical behaviour therapy originated to help people with borderline personality disorder, but is widely used for all types of mental health issues. Among them are anxiety, depression, post-traumatic stress, and self-destructive behaviors. In London, dialectical behaviour therapy teaches clients is all about a dialectic of acceptance and change, concurrently teaching clients that it is okay to feel whatever they are feeling, ng whilst also trying to work towards healthier reactions.

**Essential skill areas that power forward movement**

There are four skill sets that DBT emphasizes as the cornerstones of the therapy. Mindfulness encourages staying in the moment and being aware of your thoughts without judgment. Distress tolerance helps them to navigate a crisis without turning to self-destructive behaviours. One aspect of emotional regulation is to reduce sensation as well as improve the ability to expect feelings that arise, and the second aspect of interpersonal effectiveness is utilizing verbal communication and relations. Clients can also access dialectical behaviour therapy in London to develop these skills, often in a methodical manner throughout the course of treatment.

**Who can benefit from DBT?**

DBT is a therapy that people think of with complex emotional disorders, but the application extends far beyond this. Especially those who face chronic levels of stress, swings in mood, or just being impulsive. Not only are adolescents and adults, but also those in high -pressure professional environments that relate to the DBT structured techniques. Dialectical behaviour therapy in London is versatile and therefore would be targeted to meet the needs of all age groups as well as personally intended scenarios.

**The role of structured sessions**

DBT usually consists of individual therapy and group skills training. One-on-one appointments target specific challenges and goal setting, whereas group sessions foster a community-like environment for practicing learned skill sets. This dual strategy creates accountability and aids in consistent progress. Therapists also frequently offer between-session support to reinforce the successful application of techniques in real-life settings.

**Breaking down emotional barriers**

Decreasing emotional vulnerability is one of the most significant ways in which DBT assists. Recognizing triggers and noting emotional reactions is teaching us to control how we react. This helps not only our mental health but also the quality of life in general. As you know, clients get better with self-awareness and confidence in dealing with tough situations.

**Long-Term Benefits of DBT**

These are not tools you learn and promptly forget—they are lifelong skills taught in DBT. Those who complete therapy tend to feel more emotionally resilient within relationships and have a more reasonable grasp of the good and bad aspects of life. DBT is very structured, so this means it gives a roadmap for progress going forward to follow. Such an investment in one's wellbeing goes a long way, as mental wellbeing is just like physical, but much harder to track or measure.

Structured therapeutic methods like DBT allow people to work through, beyond the panic-driven rhythms of impulsive spiral behavior. This approach provides a well-trodden trail to emotional clarity, equipping individuals with the ability to travel through life more reliably and purposefully.

To know more about, [Autism therapy Oakville](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MAcoidqLLnViHuNL7), please visit our website: **vitalminds.ca.**

body.title: When Life feels like the same day on repeat
body.body:
There are some people I see around me for whom life has been the same throughout. And I wonder: don’t they get exhausted?

In my society itself, there are so many people I’ve been watching live the same life for as long as I’ve known them.

There’s one lady. She isn’t financially very stable, and she works at a small institute nearby. Every morning I see her leaving with heavy bags on her shoulder. Every evening she returns, looking like the burden has only grown. Over the years, the only change I’ve noticed in her is physical — her shoulders have started to droop. The weight she carries is no longer just in the bags. It’s in her posture, her pace, her silence.

The lady who stays in the apartment above mine has a somewhat similar story. Different job, different details, but the same rhythm. Wake up, work, come home, sleep, repeat. No vacations. No “extra” days. Just survival, stitched into a routine so tight there’s no room for a pause.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXDdt9ckjzm7tbHNuHCpujF6K2Do3vreFYrDRTMxcSA2t/image.png)
[Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/sad-sadness-woman-lonely-9077558/)

When I look at them, I feel sad. Not pity, something heavier. A kind of quiet grief for life that seems to have no end to it. We talk a lot about burnout from overworking, from chasing dreams too hard. But we do not talk about the exhaustion that comes from nothing. I feel there is a lot of exhaustion that life can give on waking up to the exact same struggle, knowing it's going to be same day after day and year after year, eating up full life. 

For them, there’s no slow day or high energy day. Every day is the same day and heavy day. I sometimes have conversation with one of these ladies who is now around 75 years old, and she tells, she has no choice but to do it because she has to survive. I wonder what they dream about. Do they still dream? Or has routines wiped away everything. At her age she should go easy on life but she still shows up every single day. This is a different kind of strength living repetitive days all through the life.  What I have seen with these ladies is that their lives may look the same from the outside. But inside, there’s a quiet war being fought against giving up. And they are e winning it, daily.

Seeing them makes my own complaints feel smaller. It reminds me to be grateful for the liberty I have to choose what I want to do and not get burdened up. It also reminds me to be kinder to people around me who have been so caught up in carrying their own weight. Some people do not have the luxury to go easy on life or put up their legs and say, finally I am done, their whole life keeps going on with just enough.

***Thank you for visiting my blog.*** 👼🏻👼🏻💖💖🌹🌺🌸

body.title: What is the 3/4 Rule for Elevators?
body.body:
The [3/4 rule for elevators](https://atticoelevators.weebly.com/blog/what-is-the-34-rule-for-elevators-the-secret-to-safer-faster-more-efficient-rides) is a practical guideline followed by every Best Lift Company in Delhi to ensure safety, smooth performance, and long-term efficiency. Here’s a simple, point-to-point explanation:

*   Capacity Limit: Elevators should ideally operate at no more than 75% (3/4) of their total capacity for better performance.

*   Passenger Comfort: Avoiding full load helps reduce overcrowding and ensures a smooth, comfortable ride.

*   Efficient Operation: Lifts run faster and more efficiently when they are not overloaded, reducing waiting time.

*   Safety Factor: This rule adds a safety buffer, minimizing the risk of breakdowns or mechanical stress.

*   Energy Saving: Using elevators below full capacity helps reduce electricity consumption.

*   Longer Lifespan: It improves the durability of components like motors, cables, and control systems.

In simple terms, the 3/4 rule means don’t overload the lift-leave space for safety and efficiency, a practice followed by every reliable [elevator company in Delhi NCR](https://atticoelevators.com/) and elevator manufacturers in Delhi.

body.body:
![robert-woeger-MDiwNU1pIdo-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/internutter/23uQiHzHY8HFGcZjH99awtih5PvAjWnmdm1UM22CajTSwi4sSB9DoHZkYs9YC41dBeqYx.jpg)

> The Swan Prince Odilio Magustine Jestarion Francas has learned from Trudy that there is no easy way out of his curse. His only hope would be to earn the love of a lady. But what can a swan offer a damsel or maiden fair? Perhaps something to do with flight could open the door he’s looking for…
> [https://peakd.com/fiction/@internutter/challenge-04851-m102-with-adequate-reason](https://peakd.com/fiction/@internutter/challenge-04851-m102-with-adequate-reason) -- [Deathshead419](https://internutter.org/bb/user/deathshead419)

The kiss of a virgin wasn't hard to obtain if you didn't mind the slobbery attempts of toddlers. Which the Prince Odilio Magustine Jestarion Francas _did_ object to.

\
\n\nTrudy grumbled about it for an hour, part of which was spent arguing with a tree. \
She added a meaningful glare.\n\nPrince Odilio blinked back at her in confusion before saying, \
Another minute dragged by in silence. \

Trudy folded her arms and raised one eyebrow.

Odilio honked at the sky in frustration and sighed, \
He nibbled some of the food that Trudy and Wraithvine provided. \
\n\nWraithvine emerged from hir tower with a large, thick book. The spine declared it to be _The Complete Guide to Gentlemanly Behaviour, Virtues, and Manners._ Ze sat down and opened it. \

Odilio grumbled a groan as he listened to Wraithvine reading. He had never bothered with any of this before, but now he finally realised that that was why he was in this fix to begin with. He clearly had a lot to learn.

body.title: Hacienda Clavero Viewpoint – Contemplation and natural wonder 📷 Málaga – Spain
body.body:
> --- >It is in the silence and energy of nature that I find a unique space in which to admire the wonders of the world, and when I discover a new viewpoint, those wonders unfold before my eyes. --- ![20260505_001130.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wqia16fi3MmXeXhuahfWympNYgtPD4vdEhJCBJEAJjLnhQtkPK6kzxXXkt8XcwDBMMB.jpg) --- A while ago, whilst exploring the map, which is my great friend for discovering new places full of nature and peace, I found a new forest park called Hacienda Clavero. I remember it took me quite a while to find the entrance, because the map, for example, told me I was in the right place, but there were no paths there, so I had to walk quite a distance to find the spot. --- ![20260305_155817.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243fjx6DGLbBSyDFHZmBpjQSRrfoLhjzPzqBditzgBaBw5TykrMQPYMqSVTHt2azB65gt.jpg) ![20260305_155856.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245cTuHD4FcXsayWYkosYfjW65Bo3DEEj2Ly9wnPzpZDjd4ecrrWA73p1VEcPr4WQoVUj.jpg) --- But that whole journey helped me learn more about the area, get to know the neighbourhood where this 11-hectare forest park is located, and visit new places. I have a very good visual memory, so when I walk a path and pay attention, I hardly ever forget it. It’s like a huge map forming in my head that grows day by day. --- ![20260305_161548.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243WEqBKsi1gnQX19teJ8bRmcLKrNaxNNdnRkdpWLBDijb8nqHLPbP2nz1AzqernJXKUV.jpg) ![20260305_161601.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243LvLFKueDxkRWF5BWb9wMBVm3RkPS9DFCofMVwQpVWMmJp7YQNeLggA3iLgfiCKUXWa.jpg) --- Upon entering the park and seeing the map there, which contained quite a lot of information, on my first visit, I realised there were too many paths and that it would be impossible to cover the entire park in a single day. Above all, because I wanted to explore it at a leisurely pace, paying attention to my surroundings and connecting with nature. Sometimes, and this is one of those times, my mum comes along on these sorts of visits, mainly because I need to get some exercise and I like her to see new places. For many people, including my friend Loli, I’ve been like a guide around the city, which I love, because I come to love the places I visit and I love it when more people get to know them. On this trip I went with my mum; she was excited to reach the viewpoint, as it’s quite a steep climb, but with my help she managed it, though I don’t want to get ahead of myself. --- ![20260305_162053.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23sJfTnAMqeDZCu2g5H2iBgbAnpM2s6CdPRUDTcWXc5fxw1qvUb9p2UK9Qs2xDJAacsE4.jpg) ![20260305_161727.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vsJNqo72aRMs2nKC4iv1Ch7uR4FUHvo1Z4MpP1qRuwj5sa5CZwuPw2r41XGRtrsyox8.jpg) ![20260305_161631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMU59qaX3cxudCdE25dqsWs9hwo3gDQe9Cmpeo1aCESVUpZPEjbTFLeNmfcQq7fAEUz.jpg) ![20260305_161947.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zbCsAr2Nbc2Pzo2Ht1nsWyPRZtLKXqqPBXDmGksTJ2xUKusF988xggh4ywdcZcRfvr5.jpg) ![20260305_162321.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243zQyXWykkKRPBrYt7QFcKot5qcSMNYFfqgVUz2KaRiAMx47WmEtf1J8tM6NAv8T4h6z.jpg) ![20260305_162255.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245w6qdCufqZJHpJ9sKvZnpqKthYWd3mWdD2qKfcYNfUWTQ81pHgt1bpgVaW3aHuPVwqm.jpg) --- When I visit a new place, I always take photos of the maps because, although I can then use Google Maps to find my way, I find it more important to follow the signposted map of the park itself; it has important details, paths that aren’t shown everywhere, and interesting signposts. Almost all the city’s forest parks are set in hilly terrain, quite high up, and reforestation has been carried out, mainly with pine trees, to protect the city from potential rainfall, rain that, in the past, when there wasn’t enough vegetation, caused problems for the buildings. I really like the fact that the city always maintains these parks and keeps them in such good condition, protecting the local flora and fauna. --- ![20260305_162057.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xeZ5SkQaMW6FRUf9dg5qvG2w8JijrfqppHkb9D53FsvCbXjkBChMh8EnELNnb9duuVq.jpg) ![20260305_162246.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgHkhjSaHPBKV3tENijCknKoMyfamXbM9Qo73dZkAgVCc2fpP7JvVcpecZrQ2us6sPC.jpg) ![20260305_162313.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vhuWMtRRvsj1x5srt7vCt6FWsJdT8AxN15PwkDpQEbHgsjEnqeeVwS8NMmAwSfQT6zU.jpg) ![20260305_162822.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgFBLDLrsnkSeZbrDC8F8Qm2nE3znLvA5LhhnVqSXKRDDMupWUkaDhBmeq7wic6sPza.jpg) ![20260305_162825.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wzzvrUdz3EGUcdbeJmo2keN5AqfVc272mpDCreapRhQXkMFtph5YpUZwx1raBxZ45Jd.jpg) ![20260305_163010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/2458BPnZzBg4wwdmNiohEtmWo2w4A9vto2yhSefS6KbhxMaPn3US5LEayFdPRdQno3weo.jpg) ![20260305_163014.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23y8jVEz524C3QmwG4cg1drJFvZGQdPJSkA7wFtCRaDTfvhP2cGapGe47UZG64Ph8vgEB.jpg) ![20260305_162834.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tvcMceaSGYqX3XuPVZgzxnBtVMprFWJBoUDL6bvxvsxMjzGyAqQoZE66zyryBnBbf2Q.jpg) --- Above all, I saw the Aleppo pine, but also carob trees and a few others. What I couldn’t see were animals like chameleons, though I did spot some birds and could hear them too. I was telling you about that connection with nature, and the fact that there was no one else there made it easier to enjoy it; at least when I’m on my own, I enjoy natural spaces so much more, the sounds of nature, the way every step sounds different, every bird’s song, every breeze rustling through the leaves. It’s wonderful. --- ![20260305_162404.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xeb9XdHT7SQDoJNZXbpcY916MwoVRAroRmUr2Zcv9avLiRgCgEJ6TfAw1hdss93ezyU.jpg) ![20260305_162418.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ycu82V4FZ8gSryvVTEZu1RHH9iVTgezpiwry4ME3UEFBUzoaAtT6yhi9U2oCWYA72xh.jpg) ![20260305_162516.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vhuD5LWw55qQaDdVJTcjTbgqesz75MJ5r8Dg95xKGTftYWoDBzVUvFQynPArSkuTGZR.jpg) ![20260305_162820.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wzxsvYFDp9Gh7MKVG2PQ6x9kMYP6RsgFbirg6roLCL5M8tUCbuxBnMSAvDLEBd1pkUr.jpg) ![20260305_162520.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uFPYg3HgFcXZSPrC8pSX7KMrgmXWBtBwnr1CDpjaCDGhJHSNMmSDvXde3rupBGtzaKr.jpg) --- I followed the path marked on the map to reach the viewpoint located in the centre of the forest park, right at the heart and highest point of the park. Every step taken, every zigzagging path I walked was worth it; I can assure you of that. --- ![20260305_163036.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tvYD6AzBGWSRBm1fUQ7SAtLvuV9bxyJGDELPFVjbJyLuv2GPgbcHAFRkb4f68oVMC8x.jpg) ![20260305_163225.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23y8mZJ235KW6JLGFKsx21trBWtPvFdjBpeittP25gK9AnXYWxPhSeqwvdFcGFfNdaPA9.jpg) ![20260305_163308.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242DBvHrnrGfeUSpi4kEeRFUjpfyg4cGAjWFpg1Kyc2QMFMz5EbX7kacpu51WPzZAcC3S.jpg) --- I couldn’t see the viewpoint from a distance, because the paths kept winding; this is so you can climb the slope without it feeling too steep. I think that’s why the paths wind their way around the area until you reach it. And on my walk I spotted many other paths that crossed the main one; I think they also lead to wonderful places and views. But on this occasion I had a goal, and I was happy that my mum was climbing with me, very carefully, because the small stones are slippery, but we had good footwear. --- ![20260305_163312.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xKrC9tJMLJ5hnK7r1wsyTm6Hb9Rqy9UymtfsYpHFiJw7x1y6ezv8wLbEeKzExaMWoZ5.jpg) ![20260305_163310.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wWxxtzueEfYfzhGD4ifdVUkcrXEpN877jZHfj1ATDEWXSjQTzhkntTUVa5zQCiiYTnK.jpg) ![20260305_163527.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xeWvjKcpUT5v3xcBJCKR4arekCmH5f69dX5qzQFmygLdwhjDBabVSpDDP2yMnDPQpXS.jpg) ![20260305_163524.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23u63KuvbCAqxwoVnkdmFTz8iCvbwsSYL2aXj4TzeAuByweyUVozBXzq3U1WDiwte4Uto.jpg) --- As we reached the viewpoint area, although there was still quite a way to go, I could see some benches with picnic tables in the distance. And when I saw this, I still didn’t realise that the viewpoint was very, very close by. I made my way there, constantly looking around me, something I do all the time, because there was so much greenery and such beauty that I wanted to take it all in, not just with my eyes or my phone, but especially with my heart. Now I have this wonderful opportunity to be in a place full of greenery and natural spaces, and I’m so grateful to life for it; I want to enjoy it to the full. That’s why I walk slowly, step by step, feeling the emotions that arise in every moment. --- ![20260305_163406.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tmHnQYoTHi67gUUuxrjpTwBBLemHBGuKDq6CSE1RvETSree1my1eNWw3ejGw8uEK5SR.jpg) ![20260305_165800.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242D9dhw2SBpp1987zrdGLem6umLsZcH5owhKcQogyXHL6TbRzSP8ozgKcLSrQQ75gkyW.jpg) ![20260305_165000.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgDcFxc7JsRw1iBH2gMe7pnFqSKXqYGU87Bqx7aGgCkDTHttDfsKxAnAuzWKSbZLghq.jpg) ![20260305_165134.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zGW4aTHV2UJAgpGxHbWwMJcPWyRLth3k8AfNYu5skUbYUfgHiN9Q77nToUmgPt3ZgD3.jpg) --- I reached the area with the benches; there were plenty of them, here and there, some in the shade and others in the sun. There was something for everyone, and there wasn’t even anyone there. Perfect. body.title: A Delayed Responce 1
body.body:
A Delayed Response 1

Humans are “meaners”. It is part of human nature to look for meaning in everything. The need to find meaning in life comes from within us and defines our worldview and even gives us a way of coping with the chaos around us. We begin our journey by finding meaning in a simple gesture such as when our mother smiles at us or with our favorite toys as a child. This is how our meaning-making process is developed and it continues until we are able to assign different meanings to different things, activities, events, and relationships.

The process of looking for meaning in one’s life becomes a more and more complicated matter as time goes by and we mature. In times when we face any difficulties and in times when we lack challenges in daily activities, we tend to look for meaning in order to understand what we are doing and have something to believe in for the future. While some find meaning in achievements, there are other people who see the meaning of life in social interactions and spirituality. It is amazing that humans find reasons even for pointless matters in their lives.

It is vital for people to find the meaning in their lives, especially in terms of relationships. The importance lies in the connection that people find within their relationships, in the understanding between people, and in the sense of common goal and mission that people possess. No matter what kind of relationships are being spoken about – be they romantic, familial or even platonic – such relationships will always represent a reflection of the person's own beliefs and aspirations. Many times, we try to evaluate the importance of relationships for our own lives. Looking after other people can be considered an important task which makes our lives meaningful and fulfilling.

All events, happy or sad, come with the opportunity to gain significance from them. Reflecting on what I have lived through in life, I came to the conclusion that I have always tried to find the purpose or some kind of lesson from a difficult situation or a positive one. It all may be considered both an advantage and disadvantage, since, on one hand, we learn how to find strength and inspiration in such circumstances, but, on the other hand, it may cause a person to make life more complicated than it is. Our unpredictable nature forces us to do that continually.

The experience which profoundly affected me in this way is illustrated by the following incident from my life. As a fairly decent model, caretaker, and guardian for my 1-year-old niece named Alveiah, every effort made by me in this direction has proved extremely rewarding. Being with her, watching her develop as she interacts with the world around her and trying to imbibe some values and love in her every step has helped provide my life with a purpose other than my own. Any activity with her assumes significance, be it when I comfort her when she cries, teach her new words or even sit with her when she laughs.



The experience that I went through in looking after my niece also provides yet another example of meaning making in interactions. In doing this, I not only impact her positively, but at the same time I gain knowledge about the meaning of being responsible and what compassion is all about. It’s a reciprocal relationship, as much as she gains from watching me, I also learn from her innocence the art of being compassionate and joyful. It’s such examples of interactions that prove how meaningful our existence can be judged by its impact on others.

In addition to this, having such responsibility of taking care of this innocent soul has instilled within me a deeper sense of appreciation for those little incidents of life which hold great significance in our lives. These little acts of sharing a smile, embracing each other or uttering loving words take on a great significance in terms of making her understand about the world around us and how we interact. Such incidents hold significance as they help create a sense of security and love within her heart. For me, these incidents help realize that the significance of life lies in those small acts of kindness rather than big accomplishments in life.

Upon further consideration, it becomes evident to me that the instinctive tendency of the human being to seek meaning is a strength and a limitation. Firstly, this is because our quest for understanding helps us find meaning even where it does not immediately exist, which enables us to survive in such situations. On the other hand, however, it can sometimes make us overanalyze and weave narratives in relation to what transpired due to the fact that we cannot make sense of something. The process of seeking meaning is essentially who we are and how we perceive things.

In summary, the assertion “Human beings are ‘meaning makers’. We seek the meaning and significance of each event, activity, and relationship in our lives” represents a crucial element in human existence. The quest for meaning compels us to develop, associate, and persevere. From my personal experiences, particularly when taking care of my niece, it becomes evident that our instinctual drive to seek meaning in our actions may elevate the mundane to significant sources of fulfillment. It is these moments of meaning in our lives that form the essence of our lives as we create them through our deeds, interactions, and thoughts.
![765dc7fc7f5836656ce7e4d519012034.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ivan51204/23tbRUnpkAn6CPkGJ12Pyvc44QjvpjzPNixexNNTrHg9iqn1jH3tYBda6HKp6amQiL1yY.jpg)

body.title: Libre de ataduras, miedos y amargura|Free from attachments, fears, and bitterness
body.body:
>




<center>![IMG-20260429-WA0194.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXqBxvTKsxnJQqEJ8zMptSxkXdido7H9xTd289tcMAqTq/IMG-20260429-WA0194.jpeg)</center>



¡Hola queridos usuarios! En mi infancia me aburría muy rápido, siempre andaba aburrida, hasta que llegó el día que pude unir algunas palabras y completar una frase, claro luego que me dictaban algunas letras del abecedario junto a las vocales. Entender la unión de una consonante con una vocal era algo grandioso. 

Leer me hizo sentir libre, poder realizar la carta a los Reyes Magos fue algo maravilloso, recibir la recompensa de todo mi esfuerzo al obtener lo que había pedido con tanta ilusión: un bulto y unos colores prisma color. Mi primer contacto en el mundo de la docencia fue enseñar a escribir y, leer a una compañera de clases.

En otra etapa de mi vida poder plasmar mi imaginación realizando cuentos que en mi mente se formaban y terminaban unas historias hermosas, mi tiempo era bien organizado, escribía cartas para mí, me encantaba leerlas luego. Luego escribía cartas a mis amigos del salón, ver sus caras de asombro me llenaban de mucha alegría. Mis padres al recibir mis cartas gozaban mucho, sus ojos brillaban, sus abrazos eran mi gran recompensa. Así iban pasando los años, me inscribí en una escuela poética, poder compartir con estos seres me hizo aumentar mis ilusiones, pude desahogar toda mi parte de poeta.


La lectura siempre nos ayudará a crecer, poder investigar, poder adquirir conocimiento no se compara con nada. En esta dinámica semanal donde nuestra comunidad #empowertalent con su motivadora @angelica7 nos llevan a otro mundo, esta semana con su tema \

, lo más que se asemeja es este don de escribir. Leyendo un poco la publicación que nos invita a desbordarnos a escribir sobre este tema, me hizo sentir algo nostálgica por esas personas que pierden su libertad por algún ser humano, también por alguna mala jugada de las emociones las cuales nos pueden llevar a perder nuestra libertad.




<center>![IMG_20260418_093904.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ9kvoaAibnrYjMmF7NFUmrhQCEUWzsYbqLXsQKpdhown/IMG_20260418_093904.jpg)</center>




Hoy puedo decir que soy libre, sin ataduras de ningún tipo, libre sin sentirme atada a nada, sin complejos, libre de adicciones, libre de temores, feliz de estar conmigo, feliz de ver a las personas cara a cara, con algunas deudas que se van a ir solventando paso a paso. Poder dormir a la hora que quiero dormir, no esperar aprobación de nada ni de nadie eso para mí es ser libre. Sentirme en paz es sentir ser libre.

Hoy sigo escribiendo por esta plataforma que nos une, esta plataforma que nos ayuda a seguir adelante, nos distrae con estas iniciativas tan motivadoras.



<center>![IMG-20230314-WA0078.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXuiFB8GzU79dFjnoXfGM3zyVb8YyZznGCkLwbU3GAk7Z/IMG-20230314-WA0078.jpg)</center>


Hello dear users! As a child, I got bored very easily; I was always bored. Then one day, I was able to put words together and complete sentences, after having some letters of the alphabet dictated to me along with the vowels. Understanding the combination of a consonant and a vowel was amazing.

Reading made me feel free. Writing my letter to the Three Wise Men was wonderful, and receiving the reward for all my effort—what I had asked for with such excitement—was a school pencil case and some Prismacolor pencils. My first experience in the world of teaching was helping a classmate to read and write.

In another stage of my life, I was able to express my imagination by creating stories that formed in my mind and culminated in beautiful narratives. My time was well-organized; I wrote letters to myself, and I loved reading them afterward. Then I wrote letters to my classmates, and seeing their amazed faces filled me with joy. My parents were overjoyed when they received my letters; their eyes lit up, and their hugs were my greatest reward. As the years passed, I enrolled in a poetry school. Being able to share with these people fueled my dreams, and I was able to unleash my inner poet



<center>![IMG_20260502_162509.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQy88dEHGQMhizCpPmebotWoihLQSHD1JDnqadsB9oiAD/IMG_20260502_162509.jpg)</center>




Reading will always help us grow; being able to research and acquire knowledge is incomparable. In this weekly activity, our #empowertalent community, with its motivator @angelica7, takes us to another world. This week's theme is \

and the closest thing to it is this gift of writing. Reading a bit of the publication that invites us to write about this topic made me feel somewhat nostalgic for those people who lose their freedom because of some human being, also because of some bad trick of the emotions which can lead us to lose our freedom. Today I can say that I am free, without any kind of ties, free without feeling bound to anything, without hang-ups, free from addictions, free from fears, happy to be with myself, happy to see people face to face, with a few debts that will be paid off step by step. Being able to sleep when I want to sleep, not needing approval from anything or anyone—that, for me, is being free. Feeling at peace is feeling free. Today I continue writing on this platform that unites us, this platform that helps us move forward, distracts us with these motivating initiatives. Todas las imágenes son de mi propiedad. body.title: Why do childhood memories feel more special than present life?
body.body:
Hello, Ram Ram, Namaste, Sastriyakal to all Hive users. Today I'll tell you why do childhood memories feel more special than present life. We all would love our childhood memories that we have remembered till now because the children have more sharp memory than the adult ones, so the children remember and don't forget the things easily but, we easily forget because our mind is not sharp as sharp mind the children is. All the time we feel that our present is not good and our past felt good and we expect that our future would be good and this may be true and may not be so, if a person's present is not going good so, he remembers his childhood days or past days when he was happy and he thinks that but, now the life is not going good and he expects that his future would be going good and like this only a person lives his life.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQj4SZspKU7LhF2WXnWv8uDm8hWAScpbqsxYoZuZ7JE8v/aa.png)



[img src](chatgpt.com)



 It doesn't matters that how many obstacles and difficulties are there in your life but, a person should always be happy about thinking about his past happenings that always makes him happy and motivated and then the person believes that his future would also go nice like his past. So, I don't know why but, I also feel haooy about listening talks about my childhood- the things I did, the mischief I did and all the things I did. I can tell you many incidents of my childhood but, I'll tell you only some of them that around 11 or 12 years ago, when I was 5-4 years old, there was a television in my house which was like a squared T.V. and I watched cartoons on it and one day, I was watching cartoon on it and suddenly I don't know why I thought that I should try to lift this T.V. but, at that time I don't had enough thinking because obviously I was a kid. So, when I tried to lift the television so, the T.V. fell on me I stucked under it and I shouted and all of my family members came and I fainted and I was also not inhaling and exhaling air so, my grandmother sprinkled some water on my face and I woke up and one day, I fell from a bed and then my head was scratched with a pointed tile peice and I got bleeding from my head that day also I had gone to docter for medicine at late night, so, this was my childhood's mischiveous stories that I can never forget in my life and I remembered these stories till now even after 11-12 years. 




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQQXzQuTjVe36nedn1QhR6qj7LJfs4H8JfEo2Pbi9vCM6/hhy.jpg)

In dem Fall passt mir sowieso die RBar Meldung nicht, hat mich vorher auch nicht interessiert dafuer habe ich das nicht gebaut, ist ja gut wenn es mit schneller laeuft, ich baue aber, das es Ok laeuft, wenns Ok laufen soll und net Schnell oder sonstwas.

Ich trenne mich dann auch von dem OneAPI Zeug und baue das selber nach wie ich es brauche. Habe sowieso schon damit angefangen aufzusaugen was ich da drueber bekommen kann. Ich hab das Zeug also schonmal das ich zum Bauen brauche.

Die gehen mir auf den Sack, wollte ich einfach zum Spaß meine KI Fragen auf dem Laptop, geht die nicht an...

Hin und Her... Das faellt mir viel zu Schwer.

Also mache ich es mir Richtig. :-) Dauert laenger, wirkt aber auch Dauerhafter.

# Markdown 簡介

Markdown 是一種輕量級的標記語言，主要用於格式化文本。它的設計目的是讓人們能夠以易讀和易寫的方式編寫文檔，並且可以輕鬆轉換為 HTML 等格式。

## 基本語法

### 標題

使用 `#` 來創建標題，`#` 的數量表示標題的層級。例如：

```markdown
# 這是 H1 標題
## 這是 H2 標題
### 這是 H3 標題
```

### 粗體和斜體

- 使用 `**` 或 `__` 來表示粗體文本。
- 使用 `*` 或 `_` 來表示斜體文本。

```markdown
**這是粗體文本**
*這是斜體文本*
```

### 列表

- 無序列表使用 `-`、`*` 或 `+` 開頭。
- 有序列表使用數字加點號。

```markdown
- 項目一
- 項目二
  - 子項目

1. 第一項
2. 第二項
```

### 超鏈接和圖片

- 超鏈接的格式為 `[顯示文本](URL)`
- 圖片的格式為 `![替代文本](圖片URL)`

```markdown
[訪問 Google](https://www.google.com)
![示例圖片](https://via.placeholder.com/150)
```

### 程式碼區塊

使用反引號 `` ` `` 來標記行內程式碼，使用三個反引號來標記多行程式碼區塊。

```markdown
這是一段 `行內程式碼`。
```

## 結論

Markdown 是一種簡單而強大的工具，適合用於各種文檔的編寫，如 README 文件、博客文章等。希望這個簡介能幫助你快速上手 Markdown！

```
body.title: School side hustle
body.body:
---


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYrsV23kAqdi6T1fT4bieSTZpzLF1FwuY29CbxtxhCtkC/img_20260503_143446_0.jpg)



---


Being a student is financially demanding, wether you are sponsored by someone or self sponsored, you will realise that the money you have is not enough and that you must keep spending on daily basis and at times you spend on things you didn't really budget for. This is why having a  side hustle as a student is not just good, but it's necessary especially in countries like Nigeria were the cost of living is fighting with the living on daily basis.
‎
‎You buy something at a certain price today, going back to get it the next morning, you will hear a different story, the price has doubled if not even tripled. And you realize that your initial plans had been shattered. If the commodity was important to you, you have no choice than to look for a way and get it. And you can only get it when you have the money. So having a side hustle helps you beat some kind inflation and reduces the level of dependency. Therefore, as a student , non-student you need it, because it has been helpful.
‎
‎Back then in my higher institution days, I never really had any serious side hustle apart from the music skill I developed from home, even when I was not too good with some of the musical instruments that I played back then, I still needed to use the little knowledge that I had to help myself. I can remember always going to programs with one of my guy to play and at the end of the event we will be paid, even when sometimes the pay was not much but it was still very helpful because it will solve one or two problems. Those days we mostly play in churches, tarry nights and other church activities, we play in traditional marriages and funerals too. That particular side hustle was helpful on till I noticed that it has started affecting my academic activities, I now had to put a stop to it and then face my studies and other minor side hustling like assisting some people do their research work and also doing MC jobs for friends during their birthday.
‎
>‎To this end, side hustle is necessary and should be a key part of every students life.

The reason why this lotus pond is popular is that the pink lotus flowers reflecting off the water give off a \
feeling which offers a natural feel in the middle of Bangkok city. It perfectly matches the urban nature-themed content which is ideal for taking photos and videos.\n\n

If you visit this lotus pond in the afternoon (5:00 pm - 7:00 pm), it is beautiful in a different way, with the golden evening light illuminating the lotus flowers, creating warm-toned photos. body.title: Sadaw.   A stinky bean that you should definitely try at least once
body.body: I'm not really sure if this bean even exists in my home country or if it does it is some sort of specialty thing that would only appear at Asian markets and are probably shipped there frozen.  \n\nI was walking along once with a group of people that had some Thai people in it and noticed a rather powerful aroma coming from one of the street-food vendors and then one of the Thai women in our group started saying \

in such an excited way that it was like a child getting excited for Christmas or something.

<center>  
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jack.russelle/23xpAzHoywED8j4Ju9RvBp2YujLjvmkP8WSeJpr41mmNGcQbJjBKgbjsYSg5x82enVfNG.png)
[src](https://migrationology.smugmug.com/Thai-Recipes/i-tBQcZJq/0/X2/stink-beans-recipes-13-X2.jpg)</center>

I had heard of these beans before and even though I have been here for many years at this point, I had never tried them and wasn’t even aware that they were around, if they were.   According to my Thai friends this is a southern Thailand delicacy of sorts and for the most part the veggie doesn’t make it all the way up here in the north and for whatever reasons, the farmers here in the north don’t really cultivate them either.   They grow high up in really tall trees and are quite difficult to obtain.  They have trained monkeys that will go an get them for the farmers in the south but they don’t make it to the markets up in the north because the farmers in the south can sell them all there and have no reason to take a chance on them spoiling in transit to sell in other markets.  

<center> https://healthytraditionalfood.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/img_1317.jpg?w=616
[src](https://healthytraditionalfood.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/img_1317.jpg?w=616)</center> 

Normally a shrimp curry rice plate on the streets would cost around $2 or so but with the “imported” Sadaw beans this doubled the price and well, they were quite stingy with how many they gave us.  I am willing to try almost anything once but I was actually a bit afraid of this because while it is being cooked it gives off an almost horrible aroma / stench.   

But when I bit into them I was kind of delighted.  It doesn’t taste at all like it smells and it has a nice crispy snap to it as well.   I was told after I had already eaten about half of them that the beans “stick with you” for a while afterwards meaning that when you use the toilet, it is going to be evident that you had Sadaw.  That’s all I have to say about that and all I can say is that in this regard the vegetable is a lot like asparagus.  

<center> https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/7a/Parkia_speciosa.JPG
[src](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/7a/Parkia_speciosa.JPG)</center>

I can't imagine what the first couple of people were like when they first discovered this bean.  I can imagine the conversation

* that smells awful

* yeah, we should eat it

Then when it is cooked it ends up somehow smelling even worse. 

These beans are called Petai beans apparently, but I have never heard anyone in Thailand refer to them as such.  They are \

or just stinky beans.   While it is really unlikely that you are going to encounter them in Chiang Mai because they are both seasonal and normally from quite far away, places like Krabi, Phutet, Phang-Nga, Hat Yai and other places in the south have them in great supply although they can be quite expensive (relative to the region, of course) depending on what time of year it is.   

I highly recommend that you try them if you encounter them, but just be aware of the side effects that I mentioned earlier that I do not care to discuss in greater detail  :P

body.title: i192 TP 17Q, Drawing step by step /Rising Star
body.body: > Good morning everyone, I'm happy to welcome you back to one of my drawings. Today I've drawn one of the spectacular cards from the game. It's a new microphone, the i192 TP 17Q. As you can see, it's a beautiful blue microphone. In fact, blue tones will be the predominant colors throughout the drawing; they're present in various shades. So, if you're a fan of those colors, you'll surely like the drawing. On the cover, you already saw a preview of how it turned out, but now I'm going to show you the whole process step by step from the beginning so you can see how I did it. To start, I drew what would be the inner frame. ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JkCmxfZTBich6x3QcYruMbLZy1Yjj6KRHh3gkgsbNGeRWT6c3qBrDssgtYiB2Eyx.jpg) After drawing the structure, I drew the handle and the top part, which includes the ball that protects the internal components of the device in real life. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JhGpWhq8meW6CssThZJQr2FbvztHZtkAKHn4oxrYjHmr5YhvaJWkc9NzGPYMCii1.jpg) ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JhGpWi9G1QoiHGhHSYk3TnV54dGgdB4zAuCMZFExUvXVo6ExevUVuUGh9csMuefw.jpg) Next, I drew several internal lines inside the microphone to divide it into sections, which made it look better and easier to paint. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo6S6U3zkTDdsviyrmZgdm7CQVMMEqYtBZFzymJP9HgREwxR2GFQ588jNQAdX6GQ3N1.jpg) Now comes the painting. As I mentioned, the predominant colors are blue in various shades, so you'll see them a lot. I started with the outer background, for which I chose a light blue, reminiscent of playing cards. For the frame, I used a slightly darker blue. For the inner background, which I painted later, I used various shades of blue. And the microphone itself is light blue, gray, and black. You can see it now in the photos. ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EocAue5fz91jgMbSVWtwsUMNc4WJ9t5CFdczfNQPq66n1RpSJDXZvdfm5R7XYoii8bE.jpg) ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoPL82o85ZM6wDw1AL2D53drLizCxeUYvEHFEwB7XcU23WbmESrfepn5NHGDYG1q3wE.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EpdfDYAqbesgHg9Exy5YbAsDzzCki7H9Vq9RB4K6mAFVnTSFfvwKdKCdpE934qycCct.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EqmcBDGbEEdrCZXQBAyQQEhTLGGXGj8Zu7Qftuxu7xtBZmXaMeChc6ubR9GRLHeD5S8.jpg) And to finish, here's the final result. See you in the next drawing. Blessings to all. ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/243LvfBtEXEbn2ydtB4PQoLvyuoua5ivZ5tJDxKjA8xfhS73wM8vM73X5z1fEkJVWD3us.jpg)

body.title: Eine Lichtung, die immer wieder auftaucht
body.body: Der 1. Mai begann für mich lange mit dem Geruch von Rauch und feuchter Erde. Ein Bollerwagen, der über einen Waldweg holpert. Irgendwo eine Lichtung, die man nicht suchen musste, weil man wusste, dass sie da ist. Der Rest hat sich erst später dazugesetzt. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/23xejfYD3DjKmRA4HEBgAh7cC1av7AE41k5R2Uyhv8iwFjHmmQFE1gchAZZ79cx9xjC2k.png) Als Kind war es einfach. Eine Wiese irgendwo im Wald, eine Lichtung, die sich jedes Jahr ein bisschen anders anfühlte. Ein kleines Feuer, nichts Großes. Hackfleisch, irgendwie gerollt, Kartoffeln in der Glut. Mehr brauchte es nicht. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/Eqb1AoPxMeszA5SWuHo7Jq17ez1sZbQWSD4jBN27jC9AEb9cZiG5HjCS5hwgBSfMd1v.png) Später wurden die Wege länger. Fahrradtouren, 20 oder 30 Kilometer, jemand hatte einen Anhänger für die Verpflegung und einfach los. Nicht geplant, eher dieses Gefühl, dass man an so einem Tag draußen sein muss. Dann kamen Mofa, Moped, Motorrad. Der Radius wurde größer, die Ziele konkreter. Tanz in den Mai, Bierzeltfeste, andere Orte, andere Menschen. Und doch immer dieses Unterwegssein. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/23uQfxTfEzmhc9jVacERaMFKWpkRLRgZCQxwGHVU2S1i2bJNDz3xwoQ9kC6PZco1xMr9Z.png) Und in genau diese Zeit fiel ein Moment, der leiser war, als er im Rückblick wirkt. Vor 40 Jahren hörten wir vom Reaktorunfall in Tschernobyl. Es war kein Einschnitt, der sofort alles verändert hat. Eher ein langsames Verschieben im Kopf. Zum ersten Mal wurde mir bewusst, dass das, was weit weg passiert, trotzdem etwas mit uns zu tun hat. Und dass das eigene Verhalten vielleicht doch nicht ganz so bedeutungslos ist, wie es sich bis dahin angefühlt hatte. Ich erinnere mich an diesen 1. Mai. Wir standen mit den Motorrädern auf einer Wiese, hatten einen klappbaren Holzgrill dabei, ein paar Sachen zum Essen, viel Zeit, als uns die Nachricht erreichte. Es war eine Phase, in der sich Dinge gefestigt haben. Freundschaften. Beziehungen. Vielleicht auch ein Stück Identität. Dann wurde es ruhiger. Familie. Wieder Fahrräder. Wieder raus, aber anders. Vertrauter, strukturierter. Vieles wiederholte sich, aber es fühlte sich nicht wie eine Wiederholung an. Und gleichzeitig hat sich die Umgebung verändert. Grillen hier verboten, Lagerfeuer dort nicht mehr erlaubt. Wege gesperrt, Zufahrten dicht gemacht. Plätze, die früher selbstverständlich waren, sind verschwunden oder unerreichbar geworden. Vielleicht ist das auch ein Echo von damals. Dieses vorsichtiger Gewordensein. Dieses Abwägen. Vor etwa 20 Jahren habe ich angefangen, mir meinen eigenen Ort zu schaffen. Ein kleines Freizeitdomizil, nicht weit weg. Direkt an einem See, eingebettet in mehrere Gewässer und ein angrenzendes Naturschutzgebiet. Nichts Spektakuläres, aber genau richtig, um den Alltag beiseite zu schieben. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/243zbaUsYx8vLxSDABBKQMQb7JUvQfmGZrbZH89TfS2n4zAupgt6eGixbn2B22F2fh7Kz.png) Inzwischen sind es rund 100 Plätze dort. Kleine Parzellen, auf denen zwischen zwei und sechs Menschen ihr eigenes Stück Rückzug gefunden haben. Dieses Jahr besteht die Gemeinschaft seit 20 Jahren. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/2423smeP4bawXCbLLUS5N42gjpo6JXwLNb84yqiFM3X5daUirWVb3VZc1SQSJLL983kBL.png) Ab etwa 2006 bis zur Corona-Zeit war der 1. Mai für uns fest mit diesem Ort verbunden. Am See, mit Familie und Freunden. Zusammensitzen, grillen, gemeinsam etwas unternehmen und irgendwann einfach dort bleiben und einschlafen. Es hatte etwas Selbstverständliches bekommen. Dann kam eine Pause. Keine eigene Entscheidung, eher ein Bruch, der von außen kam. Und vielleicht ist genau das der Grund, warum wir dieses Jahr wieder etwas aufgegriffen haben. Ein Stück von dem, was lange selbstverständlich war. Ohne großen Plan, eher aus dem Gefühl heraus. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/244oZFcr3H94B1AuKF48wCT5aCcNSznG9eg1PEUpCfnocWb46rMZUBpsCkAVAYaQTVJ4s.png) Wenn ich heute am 1. Mai dort sitze, ist vieles anders als früher. Und gleichzeitig erstaunlich ähnlich. Einige der Kinder von damals – auch meine eigenen – haben die Plätze übernommen. Und manchmal merke ich, wie sich die Perspektive verändert hat. Vielleicht geht es gar nicht nur um den Ort oder das, was man macht. Sondern darum, sich immer wieder einen Raum zu schaffen, in dem das möglich ist. Und sich zu erinnern, wann man damit begonnen hat.

body.title: German gov considering introducing new sugar tax like in the UK 🙈 only on soda, not (fast) food or chocolate.
body.body:
Die deutsche Regierung möchte eine Zuckersteuer (Zuckerabgabe) auf gesüßte Getränke einführen, ähnlich wie in UK. Auch in Österreich wird die Idee jetzt aufgegriffen, vorerst in den Mainstream-Medien.

Geplant ist eine Abgabe ausschließlich auf gesüßte Getränke, nicht auf Schokolade, Fast Food oder andere Lebensmittel. Zumindest vorerst.

Dabei orientiert sich die Steuer am Zuckergehalt, unter 5g pro 100 ml fällt keine Zuckerstreuer an, ab 5g wären 26 Cent pro Liter angedacht, und ab 8g 32 Cent. 

Das würde eine 0.5 Cola-Flasche mit etwa 10g Zucker pro 100ml um 16 Cent verteuern.

In UK beträgt die Steuer übrigens 18 Pence ab 5g und 24 Pence ab 8g Zucker.

Denke nicht, dass wegen ein paar Cent Abgabe die Leute weniger Zucker trinken oder essen werden, sondern es ist eher eine kreative Geldbeschaffungsaktion.

Andererseits könnte die Steuer manche Getränkehersteller dazu bewegen, den Zucker unter die 8 bzw. 5 Gramm-Grenze zu reduzieren, um die Steuer zu senken. Das hätte einen positiven Effekt.

Alternative wäre der Umstieg auf künstliche Süßungsmittel ohne natürlichen Zucker, was allerdings gesundheitlich ebenfalls bedenklich wäre, vor allem wenn man diese Süßungsmittel in hohen Dosen konsumiert.

Kritiker der Zuckersteuer sehen darin auch eine übergriffigen Staat, der zu viele persönliche Bereiche regulieren und besteuern möchte.

Was haltet ihr von der Zuckersteuer? Wie hat diese in UK funktioniert? Trinken die Leute jetzt weniger Zucker oder ist es nur eine neue Steuer, um den Staatshaushalt auszuweiten?

## Deutschland plant neue Zuckerabgabe nach dem Vorbild von UK

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vikisecrets/23wWtdL6PcMTQ39YGRgWjmVPQGhnoSHSvsAN8SrCbbVCp1CKGEHLANZv82nwNtexHvYH1.png)

https://x.com/VDemokratie/status/2049417319412064705

https://x.com/RolandTichy/status/2051551800793186429

## ZDF: Bundesregierung will Zuckerabgabe einführen

https://www.zdfheute.de/politik/krankenkassen-reform-finanzreform-warken-eckpunkte-zuckersteuer-100.html?utm_source=copilot.com

## Welt: „Wo fängt staatliche Erziehung an?“ – Connemann warnt vor „Nanny-Staat“

https://www.msn.com/de-de/finanzen/top-stories/wo-f%C3%A4ngt-staatliche-erziehung-an-connemann-warnt-vor-nanny-staat/ar-AA223SZf?ocid=BingNewsSerp

## Braucht Österreich eine Zuckersteuer?

https://www.diepresse.com/21344941/braucht-oesterreich-eine-zuckersteuer

## English

The German government wants to introduce a sugar tax on sweetened beverages, similar to the one in the UK. The idea is now gaining traction in Austria as well, at least in the mainstream media.

The plan is to impose a tax exclusively on sweetened beverages, not on chocolate, fast food, or other foods. At least for now.

The tax is based on sugar content: no sugar tax applies for less than 5g per 100 ml, for 5g or more, 26 cents per liter is proposed, and for 8g or more, 32 cents. 

This would add 16 cents to the price of a 0.5-liter bottle of Coke, which contains about 10g of sugar per 100 ml.

In the UK, by the way, the tax is 18 pence for 5g or more and 24 pence for 8g or more of sugar.

I don’t think people will drink or eat less sugar just because of a few cents in tax, in my opinion it’s more of a creative money-raising scheme.

On the other hand, the tax could encourage some beverage manufacturers to reduce the sugar content below the 8 or 5 gram threshold to lower the tax. That would have a positive effect.

An alternative would be switching to artificial sweeteners without natural sugar, though this would also raise health concerns, especially if these sweeteners are consumed in high doses daily.

Critics of the sugar tax also see it as an overbearing government that wants to regulate and tax too many areas of personal life.

What do you think of the proposed sugar tax in Germany? How has it worked out in the UK? Are people drinking less sugar now, or is it just a new tax to boost the national budget?

body.title: Flesh Fly (Sarcophagidae)
body.body:
| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ***Sarcophagidae*** | April 28, 2026 | Purulia, Natore, Bangladesh |

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYMAcD9FgGnY9De5kn4DE4LLcxDe4edkcBS37kqyVnbUE/20260505_130703.jpg)

We see flies buzzing around our house or in different places all day long. Normally, we don't have much interest in flies. But when I saw this fly sitting on a leaf, it caught my eye.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXUxj2B3b7vD5mCHGgUrS5VjLCyDaUuoWCAWP29ZcPwm4/20260505_125930.jpg)

 It is slightly larger than a normal fly and its eyes are very bright red.
I couldn't help but take pictures of insects. I turned on my mobile camera and took several pictures. After taking the pictures, I was surprised to see that what looked like a normal fly to the naked eye looked completely different.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ9SGNmsrwXaefEAV86QWxiLQdzLGWhJfDRPgn3m1qddB/20260505_130301.jpg)

It has three distinct black stripes along its neck or back. And on the side of its abdomen, there is a nice checkerboard or chessboard pattern of a mixture of gray and black.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTjNDBKihVDCTB8Ju8yQkAKs8C6GnCXZKizVjxM973SKU/20260505_130113.jpg)

I searched iNaturalist and Google Lens to find the name of the insect. Both apps gave me the same result—it is a *flesh fly*, whose scientific family is ***Sarcophagidae***.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmczruyacb4uVL5LWwEX1opsvvDmq6p9RwKD3tkech1jCB/20260505_125531.jpg)

While reading about them, I came across a very strange fact. Unlike other common flies that lay eggs, they do not lay eggs, but give birth to live larvae. Although they are called 'flesh flies', they mainly help keep our environment clean by eating rotten food.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYge47bytuJcD9HkjPH76FWLJeqjqZ6ZGkjfGWX6WP3WZ/mix_20260505_125031.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdrcZaN8aPHKixmKy7S9NevGMKhcVB6akn4Q8GdPZxs9D/20260505_125424.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT5g4wWS6szfS7DuBwZum7rWhSf6erDpwu5kqLqf5rm1d/20260505_125343.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQfuvHQKWbH8WT5DSYhLDCBZRK5vKJCXGGDwZQxd6JKMe/20260505_125704.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmav6aE6dj2mn2ZvtBsSnrWwcoZMCEifamfTUa1fviuCcy/20260428_140615.jpg)

I hope you enjoy these pictures of these red-eyed flies.

body.title: Running summary of the week // Résumé running de la semaine [EN/FR]
body.body:
<center>![running semaine 27 avril.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EpGRBBdG9SABTr8oC62cdUPL6h9uaSy1tfi75Rbn8TMcsQpCoXbaNj2WoMFfwBs8yBW.jpg)</center>

Hey everyone! I hope you're all doing great 😁

Yesterday was Monday, and like every Monday for the past few weeks, it's time for my weekly running recap!

This week, I did two runs and two walks.

First, on Monday at lunchtime, @genesisledger and I went for a walk in our village. A short 3.69km loop, for a total of 45 minutes. It's a great way to stay active, even on rest days, and clear my head!

<center>![marche lundi.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23xV6hEPWeewvMdT7gJ4Q8p4RMK9k42EjoampbVwvcq73QEJ8EmC1QZqsxUC191Zx7819.png)</center>

Then, on Tuesday, I did a run. The plan was: 3 x [10 minutes of easy running / 1 minute of walking].

The first two cycles were pretty easy. The last one required a bit more effort, but I managed! This kind of interval training, if you can call it that, is quite important for building endurance. The goal is to run in blocks to break up long runs.

<center>![séance running 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23tvcJiiZLLP9miPDYwLYn1p1wo5k4MFwZRR3NNRy7xxG2mM6vYdhVkDSNPYohrhrZFhE.png)</center>

So, here I ran 4.38km. With an average pace of 7:23/km, which is still faster than my easy pace. Or maybe my easy pace is actually faster than I thought! 😁

Then, on Wednesday, we went for a short walk: 3.37km for a total of 38 minutes.

<center>![marche mercredi.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23wMS5QERsLYnz4bv76YJm6LdUKP35CqjTEyRnyh55Eu6G7DVurCpsz8Fc35pCXMUFrqH.png)</center>

On Thursday, April 30th, we did the second running session of the week. A real interval session this time. It's the second time we've done this session: about 9-10 minutes of running, then 5 x [30 seconds of sprinting, 30 seconds of easy running], then 8 minutes of easy running.

<center>![séance 2 running.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23wgBFEJnMd4usZFtzgpUipKEgS39St7n5rM6LooffLYaUTK2XhTDDV8x7GFJWL8Ygzsr.png)</center>

This session is for cardio training. It's quite effective! For the moment, I'm only doing 5 repetitions, but the goal is to move up to 6 repetitions soon.

My average pace was 7:40/km, which is pretty good considering I walked for a minute each time.

And that's how the running week ended, because on Thursday evening, we went to a techno party in Paris with friends. Then we spent Friday and Saturday relaxing.

And on Sunday, my parents arrived to stay with us for a few days.

Anyway, I think the coming week will be pretty much the same… we'll see!

Have a great week! ☀️

See you soon, Johanna

PS: I'm using Google Translate for the English part.

__________________

<center>*Version en français*</center>
__________________

<center>![running semaine 27 avril.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EpGRBBdG9SABTr8oC62cdUPL6h9uaSy1tfi75Rbn8TMcsQpCoXbaNj2WoMFfwBs8yBW.jpg)</center>

Hello les amis ! J’espère que vous allez tous très bien 😁 

Hier, c’était lundi et comme tous les lundis depuis plusieurs semaines, c’est le jour du bilan running de la semaine ! 

Cette semaine, j’ai fait 2 séances de running et 2 séances de marche.

Tout d’abord, le lundi midi, avec @genesisledger, nous sommes partis marcher dans notre village. Une petite boucle de 3,69km, pour un total de 45 minutes de marche. Cela permet de rester actif, même les jours off et de se vider un peu la tête ! 

<center>![marche lundi.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23xV6hEPWeewvMdT7gJ4Q8p4RMK9k42EjoampbVwvcq73QEJ8EmC1QZqsxUC191Zx7819.png)</center>

Ensuite, mardi, j’ai fait une séance de running. Au programme : 3 x [10 minutes de course à allure EF / 1 minute de marche].

Les deux premiers cycles étaient assez simples. Le dernier m’a demandé un peu plus d’efforts, mais j’ai réussi ! Ce genre de séance de fractionnés, si on peut appeler ça des fractionnés, est assez importante pour travailler l’endurance. Le but est de courir par blocs pour découper les sorties longues. 

<center>![séance running 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23tvcJiiZLLP9miPDYwLYn1p1wo5k4MFwZRR3NNRy7xxG2mM6vYdhVkDSNPYohrhrZFhE.png)</center>

Ici, j’ai donc couru 4,38km. Avec une allure moyenne de 7:23/km, ce qui est toujours plus rapide que mon EF. Ou alors, peut-être que mon allure EF est finalement plus rapide que ce que je pensais ! 😁

Ensuite, mercredi, nous avons fait une petite balade : 3,37km pour un total de 38 minutes.

<center>![marche mercredi.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23wMS5QERsLYnz4bv76YJm6LdUKP35CqjTEyRnyh55Eu6G7DVurCpsz8Fc35pCXMUFrqH.png)</center>

Le jeudi 30 avril, nous avons fait la deuxième séance running de la semaine. Une vraie séance de fractionné cette fois-ci. C’est la deuxième fois qu’on fait cette séance : environ 9-10 minutes de course, puis 5 x [30 secondes de sprint, 30 secondes de course lente], puis 8 minutes de course allure EF. 

<center>![séance 2 running.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23wgBFEJnMd4usZFtzgpUipKEgS39St7n5rM6LooffLYaUTK2XhTDDV8x7GFJWL8Ygzsr.png)</center>

Cette séance sert à travailler le cardio. C’est assez efficace ! Pour le moment, je ne fais que 5 répétitions, mais le but est de passer bientôt à 6 répétitions. 

Mon allure moyenne est de 7:40/km, ce qui est assez correct pour avoir marché une minute à chaque fois. 

Et c’est ainsi que la semaine de running s’est terminée, car jeudi soir, nous avons été à une soirée techno sur Paris, avec des amis. Et, nous avons ensuite passé le vendredi et samedi à nous reposer. 

Et le dimanche, mes parents sont arrivés chez nous pour quelques jours. 

Bref, je pense que la semaine qui arrive sera à peu près identique… à voir ! 

Je vous souhaite une belle semaine ☀️

À bientôt, 
Johanna 

PS : J’utilise Google Traduction pour traduire la partie en anglais.

body.title: Does God wants all things happening including evil
body.body:
God is never happy with how this world have turned upside down and alot of evil everywhere and every corner. In the book of genesis we can see how created everything for us to be beautiful and for man to enjoy them but sin entered the world through the first two humans on earth since then evil and sorrow entered the world. 
https://youtu.be/qUluFZhUsL0?si=ufRjPrKQqR0Nu7H0
Rather than being the author of evil, God is portrayed as holy and righteous, grieved by wrongdoing and suffering. He permits certain things, not because He delights in them, but because He has given humans the freedom to choose between good and evil.

>“The Lord is not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance” (2 Peter 3:9).

At the same time, Scripture teaches that God can bring good out of bad situations and use even painful experiences for a greater purpose. He remains in control and promises justice in the end, assuring believers that evil will not prevail forever.

body.title: Dawns, Thoughts and A Constant Struggle Against Melancholy...
body.body: >A few weeks ago, during one of those late night conversations with my boyfriend, we somehow drifted into talking about melancholy. You know that weird spell the early hours seem to cast, how they quietly push you into thinking about everything and nothing at the same time. I am not really as nocturnal as he is, but for a couple of days I leaned into it and started taking some photos at that hour. Nothing fancy, no breathtaking locations. Just what I had around me. The street where I live, the sky at that time, even a window catching the first hint of morning light.

>While we were talking, I could not stop thinking about how obsessed we are with this idea of status, like there is some invisible checklist we are all supposed to complete. At a certain age, after certain steps, everything should fall into place. And if it does not, well, something must be wrong with you. If I am being honest, a lot of frustration comes from exactly that. From not matching those expectations, from wanting to have things before even understanding who we are. That thought became the backbone of the photos I am sharing. There is something about the emptiness of those hours that feels strangely beautiful, even if we usually overlook it. It also makes you question things. Are we really defined by how much we have? By numbers in a bank account? By what we can buy or show? I would love to give clear answers to those questions, but I do not think I can. And maybe that is not even the point.

>What I can say is that there is a connection between that quiet dissatisfaction and the need to create something. I am not calling myself an artist or anything like that, but I do believe beauty is there, right in front of us. It just requires a pause. Two simple things I have noticed. Early mornings tend to feel more intense, more visually striking than other times of the day. And reflecting, really reflecting, is another way of feeling things more deeply. I have spent years wondering if it is worth stressing so much about what I have or do not have. Being a mother makes that question even heavier. It is not just about me anymore. The way I act, what I value, it all shapes my daughter in some way. And the last thing I would want is for her to grow up feeling like she is never enough or that her life is defined by lack.

>That is why these photos try to hold some sense of balance. Nothing too overwhelming, nothing out of place. At least that was the intention. I have been rethinking what really matters in my life, and balance keeps coming back as the answer. Not perfection, not excess, just knowing where things belong. Even when life feels messy or unresolved, it does not mean it always will be. At some point, I realized something almost by accident. Most of my photos are pointed toward the horizon. I did not plan it, but there it is. Maybe I am looking for something, or maybe just trying to remind myself that there is always something beyond what feels heavy right now. Our minds tend to exaggerate things, make them feel bigger, more dramatic than they actually are.

>Sometimes all it takes is slowing down a little. Letting the anxiety settle. Looking at things more carefully before reacting to them. I am not here to give advice like I have everything figured out. I do not. I am just trying to make sense of things in my own way, to make life feel a bit lighter, a bit more manageable. Is that enough? I honestly do not know. I just hope that, in some way, these photos connect with whoever sees them. And if you ever feel like you are not enough, like you are somehow incomplete, trust me, you are not. Most of the time, it is just your perspective getting in the way. And yeah, I really hope I do not sound like some self help author right now. If I do, my bad. Thanks for reading, seriously.

body.title: !DIY The Charismatic Mario Bros: His Power-Up and the Shining Star Made with Foam Clay. (Tutorial) [ENG] [ESP]
body.body:
> Hello!! Good evening to the @diyhub family and all craft lovers. Today I’m going to show you how to make, with moldable foam clay, the charismatic animated character Mario Bros and the classic objects from his adventures. I hope you all like the creation — the entire community — and I’m super happy to share my experience with this flexible material. Join me!
Hola!! Buenas Noches familia Diyhub, amantes de los trabajos manuales y artesanías, el día de hoy les enseñaré a realizar con foami moldeable (foam clay) al carismático animado de Mario Bros y los objetos clásicos de sus aventuras. Espero les guste la creación, a toda la comunidad en general y yo súper contento en presentarles mi experiencia con este material flexible. ¡Acompáñame!

> These images are taken from Pinterest as a representation of Mario Bros, a platform video game series created by Nintendo in 1985, which involved the adventures of the plumber character and fun missions to capture the flag. Inside, you’ll find surprise boxes, various enemies and magic stars. To remember them, I developed these animated figures using foam clay. I know it’s not much, but it’s my way of expressing myself through art.
Estas imágenes son tomadas de Pinterest en representación de Mario Bros una serie de videojuegos de plataformas creadas por Nintendo en 1985, que consistía en aventuras del fontanero animado y maravillosas misiones por coger la bandera; dentro encontrarás cajas sorpresas, varios enemigos y estrellas mágicas. Para recordarlos pues desarrolle estos animados en foami clay. Sé que no es mucho, pero es mi manera de expresarme mediante el arte.

>
In the following I will show you step by step the realization of my work. To begin with, I will mention all the materials used:
A continuación les mostraré paso a paso la realización de mi trabajo. Para empezar, mencionaré todos los materiales utilizados:

>

Materiales / Materials

  • Foami moldeable Blanco / White foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Negro / Black foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Amarillo / Yellow foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Rojo / Red foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Azul / Blue foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Carmelita / Carmelite foam clay
  • Herramientas para pasta foami / Kit of foami

>

STEP / PASO 1

In the initial stage, I start by taking a piece of beige clay to make Mario's body. Then, I shape it into a ball with my hands, giving it a curious finish.
En la fase inicial, comienzo tomando una porción de arcilla en color beige para realizar el cuerpo de Mario. Luego, con las manos moldeó en forma de bola, dándoles una terminación curiosa.

>

STEP / PASO 2

Next, I develop the character's body parts: his head, eyes, overalls, cap, legs, and arms. Then, for the objects, I create the surprise box and the magic star, always giving my best.
Seguidamente, desarrollo las piezas del cuerpo en el personaje, su cabeza, sus ojos, su overol, su boina, sus patas y los brazos. Además en los objetos se crea la caja sorpresa y la estrella mágica, siempre dando lo mejor de mi.

>

STEP / PASO 3

Finally, we make the final touches on the face, eyes, and classics accessories. This design is a bit more complex, as the parts are smaller when it comes to molding.
Ya por último, realizamos los retoques finales en el rostro, los ojos y los accesorios clásicos. Este diseño es un poco más complejo, pues son más pequeñas las partes a la hora de moldear.

>

Final result / Resultado final

It should be noted that this design was searched on Pinterest; but the realization of the animations are made by me, with dedication to make them look more beautiful in your home or bedroom.
Cabe destacar que este diseño fue buscado en Pinterest; pero la realización de los animados son hechos por mí, con dedicación para que luzcan mas bonitos en tu hogar o dormitorio.

>
If you liked it, don't forget to leave a comment and follow me for future posts. I'd love to know your opinion and ideas for the next one. Regards
Si te ha gustado, no olvides dejar tu comentario y seguirme para próximas publicaciones. Me encantaría saber tu opinión e ideas para el siguiente. Saludos

></center>

#MarioBros #Stars #art #diy #tutorial @bdvoter @sanjeevm

With a story that is way too early to figure out where it will lead, it's time to move forward with the 3rd part of my **Life is Strange: Reunion** playtrough, where Max finally meets Moses to experience more with her rewinding powers, see what risks she has to assume and if it's actually worth all the effort to change the future where Chloe and Moses might die in a fire at the school where Max is a Photography Teacher.

Despite being a part of the game that only takes place in Moses' office for around 30 minutes, it turned out to be a very engaging moment with a lot of secrets to uncover and details that will decide how the future will look for your path if you don't find all the clues.

As I mentioned previously, this game depends on whatever each person who plays finds as clues, as well as making decisions based on the available conversations in-game, so if you are not a fan of a lot of drama or endings that will leave you in tears, this episode is very important.

I am still not sure whether I managed to find all clues *(although I believe I did)*, but 99% of them are surely in my gameplay, even if I ended up exploring a lot before finding some of them.

https://youtu.be/QPTGAqSNfS8?si=bSe4F9okHpzfuWhs

Still within this part of the game, Max will meet Owen for the first time and have a quick confrontation. I won't reveal any spoilers here, but I will mention that this is the least favourite person of the game for me, and it actually turns out to be a pain for a lot more people who played the LIS series of games, no matter the twists of the game, each player will get.

But if you played the game, don't forget to let me know what dialogue options you picked, as well as how many clues you found in this part of the story. I am still not very happy with some of the conversation choices I made, but I am sure things could have gone worse, right?

没想到一转眼就到了5天假期的最后一天，明天又要上班上学，回归日常正轨了。总觉得假期过得格外快，明明感觉才刚放假，转眼就要结束，实在让人感慨。
 
我的感冒已经接近尾声，今天算不上满血复活，但状态已经好了很多，血槽大概恢复了百分之八九十。趁着身体舒服些，我便带着孩子出门游玩，好好享受假期的最后时光。
 
今天武汉的阳光格外强烈，室外气温很高，长时间在户外活动很容易中暑，并不适合久待。斟酌之后，我们决定全程选择室内场所，最后敲定了湖北省博物馆和湖北省美术馆这两个地方。
 
其实今年1月份我就独自来过这两处场馆，而且之前也去过很多次。但孩子不一样，他总共只去过两三次：幼儿园去过一次，小学一二年级去过一次，之后三四年都没再去过，估计早就忘得差不多了，所以才想着带他重新参观一遍。
 
逛博物馆大多是走马观花，能记住的东西并不算多，不过每一次到访，总能发现一些之前没留意的新展品。我们提前料到五一期间人流量会比平时大，到现场后果然印证了这个猜想。
 
大部分展厅的人流还算正常，唯独越王勾践剑的展厅，场面格外夸张，排队队伍足足延伸了七八十米，甚至接近一百米，拥挤程度实在吓人。一楼的曾侯乙编钟展区也围了好几层游客，好在比越王勾践剑那边要宽松不少。
 
这次参观还有个意外收获，馆内新增了一处展馆，专门展示缅甸、越南、老挝等东南亚国家的文化与文物。这个展馆位置相对偏僻，虽然同属湖北省博物馆，但参观的人特别少，加上我们，整个展厅里也就五六个人，体验感格外舒适，我们也趁机尽情参观、拍照留念。
 
只是不知为何，如今一看到越南、老挝、缅甸这些地名，脑海里总会不自觉联想到电信诈骗、噶腰子这类负面新闻，心里难免生出几分忌惮，我想自己这辈子大概都不会前往这几个国家了。
 
中午从博物馆出来简单吃过午饭，我们便来到了一街之隔的湖北省美术馆，结果却格外失望。

相比我1月份看过的展览，这次的展览水准大打折扣，内容敷衍潦草，严重拉低了省美术馆的水准，全程我几乎没怎么拍照。一楼大片区域被圈起来做了付费展，查了之后才知道是国外抽象艺术家的作品，风格类似表情包，性价比极低，我们便直接略过；二楼、三楼的展品也寥寥无几，毫无看点。

翻看小红书，发现不少人都在吐槽这次美术展览，看来大家的失望都不是没有原因。希望湖北省美术馆能尽快提升审美标准与展品质量，别再让大家失望，毕竟这也是武汉的文化名片，不该这样拉低城市格调。
```
