body.title: Reírnos nos ayuda a tomarnos la vida con más ligereza | Laughing helps us take life less seriously 😜 [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
#### Reírnos nos ayuda a tomarnos la vida con más ligereza.  

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmf324StYr8d26pJoBJsQ2vGntTSAxPNXfEo6RdndWeZJW/1000009869.png 


Hola querida comunidad de Holos & Lotus. Estuve leyendo las últimas publicaciones de nuestros amigos en la comunidad y vi la de @dumbelth17 sobre [**la risa como un acto de libertad y de escudo ante las adversidades**.](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@dumbelth17/reir-para-no-llorar-el-arte-de-usar-la-risa-como-un-escudo-de-libertad) Dicen que la risa tiene el poder de curar el alma, también que es la mejor forma de enfrentar la vida que puede llegar a ser bastante agridulce y con momentos donde sentimos que no podremos más, pero seguimos y las fuerzas se renuevan cada día. 

Yo soy una persona de risa algo escandalosa cuando estoy en confianza, siento que hay momentos en los que reír me ha permitido sentirme mejor, sobre todo ahora que existen plataformas como TikTok donde se encuentran miles de videos de humor y también de entretenimiento. Hace poco descubrí a Soy Klei un joven venezolano que se ha vuelto viral por interpretar diferentes mujeres venezolanas y me ha atrapado lo original y lo bien que actúa en cada uno de sus videos, además de generarme una gran alegría y muchas risas por sus ocurrencias que son tantas que cada vez que veo un vídeo creo haberlo visto todo por parte de sus personajes, pero no, siempre hay más 🤭

En momentos donde siento que estoy en un estado de ansiedad o quiero despejar la mente busco sus videos y me encanta verlo, porque algo que tiene es que en ningún momento sus personajes denigran a nadie, todo es tan humorístico pero sin caer en el humor negro que no es de mi preferencia ver. Tal vez porque no me gusta demasiado que se usen situaciones delicadas para caer en la burla. Pero si que disfruto de ver que hay personas que sin dejar que la fama o el éxito se les suba a la cabeza, crean contenido que entretiene y que a la vez te hace sentir en casa, te lleva a recordar a personas incluso de tu propia familia, así me siento con Soy Klei. 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbfJcFwn9zsD6juAF9v9nNFyj2bVmj9Z3HTHaYNTzE4Ww/1000009871.jpg 


<center><sub>[fuente](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/mujer-retrato-sonriente-sonriendo-7244736/)</sub></center>

Me cuesta un poco tomar las cosas con humor debo de admitir, aunque antes era mucho más drástica. Siento que puedo disfrutar del humor mientras sea algo sano y que no caiga en dejar a otros mal. Disfruto también de poder compartir con mi mamá momentos de risas, con ella siempre me siento en confianza y ambas somos de signo tierra por lo que tenemos cosas similares en cuanto a personalidad. Estar con ella en esos momentos que han sido difíciles y luego sacarle el lado bueno o gracioso hace que las situaciones sean más llevaderas y permiten que el cuerpo se relaje y por supuesto, me sienta mejor. 

Compartir humor con alguien es de las cosas más especiales que puede existir, pienso que cuando tenemos amistades que van en la misma sintonía que nosotros, que pueden darnos cosas positivas y no solo una compañía superflua, entonces hemos encontrado el tesoro más grande del mundo, un amigo que puede vernos como familia o como alguien que es importante en su vida es algo muy valioso. No soy de tener muchos amigos, siento que tengo que conocer a las personas por mucho tiempo para realmente poder sentir que puede existir esa confianza de decir que es una verdadera amistad. Pero encontrar a alguien que pueda no solo reír contigo sino también comprenderte en los momentos difíciles, es algo que no sucede a menudo. 

En la vida hay que saber reír, ya que existen tantos momentos difíciles y oscuros que es necesario encontrar la forma de drenar desde el humor, es bueno poder hacerlo solos y si es en compañia mucho mejor. Me recuerdo siempre que la vida no es una cosa tan seria y que hay que también verle el lado divertido a las cosas. Por ejemplo, me causa mucha risa ver cuando me equivoco en algo y cuando me vuelvo demasiado sincera, siento que es ese lado más infantil que sale de mi, y no piensa demasiado las cosas, simplemente quiere poder divertirse y ser feliz. Reír es darnos la oportunidad de dejar de lado la seriedad de lo cotidiano y aprender a vivir con más ligereza. 😁

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbjaGuGqnxVsGyGiNyfeFk3kd4KMNQq986hdvtJqQnzrP/1000009870.png

#### Laughing helps us take life less seriously. 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbcaaUwHmBFTfKf6C6SL5no2NdFNUcxe6UwsLcRinQ4u5/1000009868.png 



Hello, dear Holos & Lotus community. I was reading the latest posts from our friends in the community and saw the one by @dumbelth17 about [**laughter as an act of freedom and a shield against adversity.**](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@dumbelth17/reir-para-no-llorar-el-arte-de-usar-la-risa-como-un-escudo-de-libertad) They say laughter has the power to heal the soul, and that it is the best way to face a life that can become quite bittersweet—filled with moments where we feel we can't go on, yet we keep moving and our strength is renewed every day.

I am a person with a somewhat loud laugh when I’m among people I trust. I feel there are moments when laughing has allowed me to feel better, especially now that platforms like TikTok exist, where you can find thousands of humorous and entertaining videos. I recently discovered \

a young Venezuelan man who has gone viral for portraying different Venezuelan women. I’ve been captivated by how original he is and how well he acts in each of his videos. He brings me great joy and many laughs with his antics; they are so creative that every time I watch a video, I think I’ve seen it all from his characters—but no, there’s always more! 🤭\n\nIn moments when I feel anxious or want to clear my mind, I look for his videos. I love watching him because one thing he does is ensure his characters never denigrate anyone. Everything is humorous without falling into \

which I personally don't care for. Perhaps it’s because I don’t like it when delicate situations are used for mockery. However, I truly enjoy seeing people who, without letting fame or success go to their heads, create content that entertains and makes you feel at home at the same time. It reminds you of people in your own family; that’s how I feel with Soy Klei.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbfJcFwn9zsD6juAF9v9nNFyj2bVmj9Z3HTHaYNTzE4Ww/1000009871.jpg

<center><sub>[source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/mujer-retrato-sonriente-sonriendo-7244736/)</sub></center>

I must admit it’s a bit hard for me to take things with humor, though I used to be much more drastic. I feel I can enjoy humor as long as it’s healthy and doesn't involve making others look bad. I also enjoy sharing moments of laughter with my mom. I always feel comfortable with her; we are both Earth signs, so we have similar personalities. Being with her during difficult times and eventually finding the good or funny side makes those situations more bearable. it allows the body to relax and, of course, makes me feel better.

Sharing humor with someone is one of the most special things that can exist. I think that when we have friendships that are on the same wavelength as us—people who can give us positive things and not just superficial company—then we have found the greatest treasure in the world. A friend who can see us as family or as someone important in their life is something very valuable. I’m not someone who has many friends; I feel I have to know people for a long time to truly feel that the trust exists to call it a true friendship. But finding someone who can not only laugh with you but also understand you in difficult moments is something that doesn't happen often.

In life, you have to know how to laugh. Since there are so many difficult and dark moments, it is necessary to find a way to vent through humor. It’s good to be able to do it alone, and if it’s in company, even better. I always remind myself that life isn't such a serious thing and that you also have to see the funny side of things. For example, it makes me laugh a lot when I make a mistake or when I become \

I feel that’s my more childish side coming out—the side that doesn't overthink things and simply wants to have fun and be happy. Laughing is giving ourselves the opportunity to set aside the seriousness of daily life and learn to live with more lightness. 😁

body.body: One of my favorite things to do in spring is to explore even the most remote corners of the city. I climb to the hills where I can get a clear view of the city and then watch it unfold. It's a pleasure to see those places after the long winter. _İlkbahar mevsiminde sevdiğim şeylerden biri şehrin en ücra köşelerine kadar yürümek. Şehri net şekilde görebileceğim tepelere kadar tırmanmak ardından şehri izlemek. Uzun kış mevsiminden sonra o yerleri görmek keyif veriyor._

/> I honestly don't remember the last time I was in this area. It's been more than two years. Not much has changed :) After the heavy rains, the grass looks more vibrant and greener. Some of the trees are sprouting leaves and flowers, while others are waiting for the temperature to rise a little more. _En son bu bölgeye ne zaman geldim doğrusu hatırlamıyorum. Aradan iki yıldan daha uzun zaman geçmiştir. Değişen pek bir şey yok :) Yoğun yağışlardan sonra otlar daha diri ve daha yeşil görünüyor. Ağaçların bir kısmı yaprak, çiçek açarken bazı ağaçlar hava sıcaklığının biraz daha artmasını bekliyor._

/> There's plenty of greenery around me. The trees are a little lighter in color. The houses are clearly visible because the trees haven't fully opened their leaves yet. Once the trees fully awaken from winter, it will become impossible to see the houses. They will look as if they are trapped in a forest. It truly saddens me to see the mountains devoid of trees. A long time ago, about 100 years ago, the mountains were covered in trees. Uncontrolled logging and grazing have depleted the number of trees on the mountains. Planting trees on the mountains will revitalize nature and prevent erosion and landslides. _Yanı başımda yeşiklikler fazla. Ağaçlarda yeşilin tonu biraz daha açık. Henüz ağaçlar yapraklarını tam açmadığı için evler net şekilde görünüyor. Ağaçlar kış mevsiminden iyice uyandıktan sonra evleri görmek imkansız hale gelecek. Evler adeta bir orman içine hapsolmuş gibi gözükecek. Dağların ağaçlardan yoksun olması doğrusu üzüyor beni. Çok önceleri, yaklaşık 100 yıl önce dağlar ağaçlar ile kaplıymış. Bilinçsiz ağaç kesimleri, bilinçsiz otlatmalar nedeniyle dağda ağaç sayısı tükenmiş. Dağlara ağaç ekmek doğayı canlandıracak, erezyonu, heyelanı engelleyecek._

/>

The road in the first photo winds through the mountains and high-altitude plateaus, while the second photo shows a road leading towards the city. The first photo shows a rocky area. Towards the end of spring and autumn, a waterfall cascades down from these rocks. The waterfall is quite long, entirely fed by snowmelt and rainwater. If it could flow with the same vigor during the summer months, it would maintain its magnificent appearance and attract many more visitors.

_İlk fotoğraftaki yol dağlara, yüksek rakımlı yaylalara dolu ilerlerken ikinci fotoğraf şehre doğru ilerliyor. İlk fotoğrafta kayalık bir alan gözüküyor. İlkbahar ve sonbahar mevsiminin sonlarına doğru o kayalıklardan aşağıya kadar akan bir şelale var. Şelale oldukça uzun, tamamen kar suları ve yağmur sularından kaynağını alıyor. Yaz aylalarında da çoşkulu şekilde akabilseydi harika görüntüsünü devam ettiriyor olacaktı. Bununla birlikte çok sayıda ziyaretçiyi ağırlamış olacaktı._

body.title: Softness of neglected wild flowers: A unique gift of nature.
body.body:
> ![2N61tyyncFaFVtpM8rCsJzDgecVMtkz4jpzBsszXjhqan9p2ZBsV174TPYFXg495F91v6EFyUptkPU2DUwppVHcYeHn3WcEqTJ68LGNfoQ1xKeQtMDm2D2ft5ufMNK3nEdin5xrrLskz~2.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWdSSSJiD7VgENNLChcMbf3hvA7ixpTUhgeXKw23Qeahf/2N61tyyncFaFVtpM8rCsJzDgecVMtkz4jpzBsszXjhqan9p2ZBsV174TPYFXg495F91v6EFyUptkPU2DUwppVHcYeHn3WcEqTJ68LGNfoQ1xKeQtMDm2D2ft5ufMNK3nEdin5xrrLskz~2.jpeg) Nature loves to decorate it to its own accord. We often bring expensive flowering plants from nurseries and plant them in the garden, take care of them. But behind our eyes, some wild flowers bloom in the corner of the garden or on the side of the road, whose beauty is not less than the precious flower in any part. Today I am sharing the story of such a wild flower with you. A piece of carelessness that grew carelessly this morning while walking by the garden, I suddenly caught my eye on these beautiful flowers. They bloom without any gardener, without any additional fertilizer or water. We usually know these flowers as **Sialmuti** or **Bon Tulsi**. Many people think of it as just a wild weed, but its small petals and white-purple color bring a kind of calmness to the mind. The biggest feature of these wild flowers is their **tolerance**. They do not forget to make their existence known even in the sun, rain or extreme neglect. When these light pink and white flowers bloom together in the bushes, it seems that nature has touched its own canvas with watercolor. Its delicate texture and well-arranged petals are truly amazing. These wild flowers play a major role in not only beauty, but also in protecting the environment and biodiversity. Butterflies, bees and small insects are the main food source or honey collected from these neglected flowers. ![2N61tyyncFaFVtpM8rCsJzDgecVMtkz4jpzBsszXjhqan9p5aDkae16BhXm1bhSzVWeyf3po1tWADMNrN1nnUdRm8KSFuqDm82d9d68Ls9R1FgRGKfWNCdYw28HVwvX9eQvVaPeGHbPL~3.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeXChkD8qkn2QsU9GTt4UM65sq25wqHxWvZijoTywQckd/2N61tyyncFaFVtpM8rCsJzDgecVMtkz4jpzBsszXjhqan9p5aDkae16BhXm1bhSzVWeyf3po1tWADMNrN1nnUdRm8KSFuqDm82d9d68Ls9R1FgRGKfWNCdYw28HVwvX9eQvVaPeGHbPL~3.jpeg) Their contribution to keeping the nature of rural Bengal alive is undeniable. We often go somewhere far away in search of beauty, but we don't notice that there are so many wonderful works of art hidden next to the house. If we take some time to look at these small wild flowers around us in mechanical life, the complications in life may be somewhat lighter. Nature gives us all of it unscathed, all we need is a beautiful vision to see. This was my arrangement for today. I hope you liked the pictures I took and the nature observations. Wishing everyone good health, I bid you farewell here today. |

body.title: [EN/PT] It Was Another Day
body.body: > It has been over two weeks now. He lost count of time, as days seem to be just a repetition of same events. He prepared his breakfast and put everything on that white kitchen table, with the grey cover. His usual morning coffee along with four slices of bread with jam in all of them. He felt tired to just think that, it is going to be few hours at work. Then, he will go directly to the gym and come back home. Maybe, watch a movie. Or, just try to find something to watch on live TV. He was having different conversations, different tasks and sometimes meeting new people. But, since his wife travelled for work. He felt as if everything is tasteless now. He did not know how to find joy within himself. He used to share everything with her. Maybe it is something with his nature that, he can experience so many things on his own. But, those times of laughter and struggle during the day, seemed dull and almost the same, when he kept going back to empty walls. # PT

>

Já se passaram mais de duas semanas. Ele perdeu a noção do tempo, pois os dias pareciam apenas uma repetição dos mesmos eventos. Preparou o café da manhã e colocou tudo sobre a mesa branca da cozinha, coberta com uma toalha cinza. Seu café matinal de sempre, acompanhado de quatro fatias de pão com geleia.

Sentiu-se cansado só de pensar que seriam apenas algumas horas de trabalho. Depois, iria direto para a academia e voltaria para casa. Talvez assistisse a um filme. Ou, quem sabe, tentasse encontrar algo interessante na TV. Tinha conversas diversas, realizava tarefas diferentes e, às vezes, conhecia pessoas novas. Mas, desde que sua esposa viajou a trabalho, tudo parecia sem graça. Não sabia como encontrar alegria dentro de si. Costumava compartilhar tudo com ela. Talvez fosse algo da sua natureza, essa capacidade de vivenciar tantas coisas sozinho. Mas aqueles momentos de riso e luta durante o dia pareciam monótonos e repetitivos, agora que ele voltava sempre para as paredes vazias.

五一劳动节最后一天是放假了。之前1号2号还有4号都是在上班，到5号以后休息的。
所以早上起来就想画点啥。就拿着铅笔在外面比划比划。原本想画对面的房子。
我拍了张照片下来。准备把对面的房子给画出来，可能这样会很好看。

等到拿起铅笔削好之后准备画的时候。画着画着就把手给画出来了。
结果想画后面的房子一下子就偷懒的坏习惯又犯了。结果房子没有画。
我同事在旁边，还在笑话我比划了半天，怎么房子没画出来，只画了你自己这双大手。

其实我很想跟他说，我不想画了，挺懒的。因为把手画出来已经是很费劲了。
画完手之后就去工地走一圈。看看工地的电有没有断干净？
因为今天看起来天气不太好。如果店没有关的话，会比较危险。

因为放假之后，工地里面是没有人上班的。所以就去巡视了一下。
打开门之后就把电箱绕了一圈，都已经把电都关好了。才放心的想回来。
结果在电箱旁边看到一只知了。这玩意在好多年前看过，但是近十几年都没有见到了。


![IMG20260430100716.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aellly/Ep1bj74hp8LhR3SyN5JFeN7nPQRPqV8QnzFnzHjvyt6oz8z8Du6k3mT5k1h3XEaevro.jpg)
在以前看到这玩意的时候，我肯定会把它抓起来。因为它会叫。
在小时候我还用蜘蛛网盘一个大网，然后去粘这种东物。只要粘到了它就跑不了。
到现在应该有30年没有去抓这种东西了。那时候年纪小，我特别喜欢抓这玩意来玩。

不过当时抓的全部都是黑色的。而且还是会叫的。个头也比这种要大一些。
但是今天看到的这一只个头明显没有那么大。而且身上也不是黑色的。
总体上看，像是一种枯绿色。如果不仔细看，他站在草里面是没办法发现它。

body.title: 写日记
body.body:
一大早，孩子妈妈带老大去看牙医，家里只剩下我跟二宝俩人。

起床后，我忙自己的事情，二宝在桌子那写作业。过了一会，我通过摄像头看了下，发现虽然在写作业，但隔一会头似乎会向左侧看一下，好像在看什么。

我走出房间，来到桌子前，二宝表现的很淡定。我左右瞅了瞅，虽然没看出什么问题，但总觉得哪里怪怪的。

二宝这小子，很会耍花招，我猜测他一定在掩盖着什么。都说“捉贼捉脏”，我苦于没有抓住这家伙的证据，不好说什么，便假装回去了。

一回到房间，我就重新打开摄像头，仔细盯着看。



![IMG20260421172250.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmak5ojeFT1x99miVaX9gbmChepuBnjRCVsPVjWWVXy7W5/IMG20260421172250.jpg)


果不其然，开始二宝还假模假式装了一会。隔了几分钟后，他估摸我暂时不会过来，就开始了“故伎重演”，不知道从哪里变戏法拿出本书，放到左边。。。然后抄写了起来。

这次抓到现行，我打开一看，原来是范文作文，问他怎么回事？

原来老师布置了日记，这小子不想写，想走捷径，直接找了一篇范文，打算抄写上去。。。囧

我问他，

“怎么不写自己发生过的有趣事情？”

二宝沮丧着脸，

“感觉没什么好写的。。。”

好嘛！平时叫你们多看书，多看书，现在要写作文了，肚子空空没墨水，才知道没什么可写，早干嘛去了？


![IMG20260421172246.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaE8zhYtBxh4iz4p5zwML5zijspeWiBJChW7GFiWQkzh7/IMG20260421172246.jpg)


我提示他，

“可以写些这几天发生的一些有趣好玩的事情嘛？”

二宝想了想，

“昨天出去玩滑梯了，这个可以吗？”

“那个太幼稚了！你现在都四年级了，再写那个显得太。。。”

“那前天去吃烤肉那次呢？” 二宝问我。

我见他这样说，只好苦笑了下，

“行吧，你觉得有意思，那你就写吃烤肉吧！”

“我觉得那个靠肥牛挺好吃，还有那个冷面也不错。。。”

“如果直接这样写，显得太流水了。。。”，我提示他，

“你可以写些心里活动，比如吃冷面的时候，对照下跟平时爸爸给你做的面有什么不同？”

二宝点了点头，

“后边去玩那个电子游戏，抓娃娃也挺有意思的。。。我打算把这个也写上去。。。”

“你抓到娃娃了没？” 我问他。

二宝尴尬地笑了笑，

“没抓到！”

听他这么说，我提示他，

“可以来句幽默的，比如说，虽然抓娃娃很有意思，但是唯一遗憾的，就是我一个娃娃也没抓到。。。”

“哈哈哈”，没等我说完，二宝乐了。

“题目你打算写什么呢？” 我问他。

“去XX商场玩？”二宝试探问我。

我想了下，

“不如改成《愉快的一天》吧”

“这个题目不错！” 二宝说。

“作文最后一段，你可以这么写：真是愉快的一天啊！这样刚好呼应主题《愉快的一天》”

“好好，我知道怎么写了！”二宝听我说完，马上转身回去写他的日记去了。

body.title: It’s Only a Matter of Time
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>



![IMG_5328.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/Ep1Vsg3XG9TXkeErWBF5S2FEsWVo9mqjWge82GCSTwwQBiHsujqjc8iRin8pvsJrCPa.webp)

Whether we like it or not, the truth never stays hidden forever no matter how carefully it’s tucked away or how convincingly we tell ourselves it isn’t there, it still finds a way to surface.

My sister is pregnant and has made her decision to keep the baby. In her own way, she seems at peace with that. Her boyfriend is also willing to take responsibility, but not marriage, but in my family, that giving birth out of wedlock is a big deal. Marriage before pregnancy is not just expected, it’s almost sacred to my parents. So for now, she’s chosen to be silent about it. I am the only one who knows but I’ve taken on the role to keep my mouth shut as it is not in my place to tell. 

What actually puzzles me is how she thinks this can remain hidden. Every time she’s about to leave the house, she reassures herself out loud that it’s not visible yet. For a while, I let her believe it until one day, I decided to just be an arse. So I told her firmly that *it is visible*.

Because how could it not be? Something is growing steadily, day by day. These days, it just seems like time knows she’s trying to outrun it and has been moving faster. Plus each day adds a change and an announcement her body is already making, even if her words are not.

In all of this, she goes over to see our parents once in a while but they haven’t noticed or maybe they have, and they’re choosing silence too. Who knows? 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYppJwdxdFnZA1Li2ZHD2otHyqUUNjbc3iVChsTXo3o9E/IMG_5329.jpeg 

She says she’ll stop going entirely soon and I keep wondering why? I mean why avoid the inevitable? Why carry the weight of secrecy when the truth is already beginning to show itself? I told her, to just tell them. Let them react however they will. Let them be upset if they need to be. They’ll come around eventually because parents often do.

But I guess fear is a powerful thing. She’s afraid of the disappointment, the questions, the anger that might come before understanding. And yet, she’s equally certain about the fact that she’s keeping her baby. So here we are, in this strange in-between space where something so real is being treated like it can still be hidden, where truth is growing quietly, but undeniably.

It’s almost ironic because of all the things in life that can be concealed, delayed, or denied, this isn’t one of them.

My response to the Freewriters [daily prompt](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/4-may-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3093-it-is-visible)

body.title: Never bet against Men and Power Tools!
body.body:
Ok… spring is here… and honestly? Maybe already a bit too hot. But hey, that also means one very important thing! I can finally sit outside with my laptop, pretend I’m super productive, watch the beautiful nature around me, listen to birds singing, and admire the cats who are suddenly brave enough to visit again… *(yeah… funny how they disappeared when my dog was around 😉)* 

But wait… something was missing. 
Right. A place to actually sit. 

I mean… sure, I had chairs and a table… but not the kind where you can sit like a proper princess and work without your back screaming after 10 minutes. And **YES**...princess is the correct word here. 

Of course, instead of doing something normal like… I don’t know… going to a store and buying new patio furniture… I just complained. A lot. Like, why do that when you can complain and hope the universe sends you a magical gift? *“Hey girl, we heard you suffer...here’s a free chair!”* 
Yeah… turns out life doesn’t work like that. 

**Or… does it?** 

Because one day, after listening to me complain for the 100th time, my husband snapped: 
*“WHAT THE HELL?! Come on, let’s go to the store...you’re driving me crazy!”* 

So… the universe did hear me. Just… through my husband 😄 

Now, shopping with him? Chaos. I want one thing, he wants another… we debate like it’s a life-or-death decision. But after a solid 30 minutes, we actually agreed on something. Or better said...we make the deal! 

 
If I choose the set, I build it myself. BUT if I need his help...I cook for him for a whole week. Whatever he wants. 

I was like: *“Easy. It’s basically Lego.”* 
 

We got home. I was excited. Ready. Confident. 
**“LET’S BUILD THIS!”** 


![IMG_9380.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbVFjXXWeryutfuyYyWABfjM24sA5Td1zwhmzbNiUJCow/IMG_9380.jpeg)



First chair… hmm… weird. 
Second chair… still weird. 
Third chair… **WHAT THE HELL IS THIS?!** 


![IMG_9399.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdHJDDYyVFWRpXnxTsxxj7ziQF1UUsoEVvXQTVLTjiiDP/IMG_9399.jpeg)



Nothing fit together. **NOTHING.** But did I ask for help? Of course not. I’m stubborn. 


![IMG_9382.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQcRnfsChLY3AehBXtAN6yNrYGdrJ9yP4dVMHs1cfxzRj/IMG_9382.jpeg)



I tried everything. Even YouTube *(which, for once, failed me)*. 
Meanwhile, my husband is just standing there laughing like this is the best show he’s ever seen. 

Then he says: *“Remember last year when you built the closet?”* 



![IMG_9397.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma9md5WbQvAfDPDqeGeVsfqv36b9S7zZpgj3P1TNfHQfp/IMG_9397.jpeg)

![IMG_9393.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSENFMZHT5eYfUdiNoSLQdLeBCYUZdgvhof95CDgDrUXA/IMG_9393.jpeg)



And BOOM. Flashback. Trauma. Regret. Why do I always forget that I am terrible at building furniture?! 

**But NO. I refused to give up.** 

Two hours later… I had ONE chair. **ONE.** 
I was mentally crying, physically sweating, and emotionally using very creative bad words. Loud ones. Very loud ones. Honestly, I’m just grateful the neighbors don’t understand me. 


![IMG_9384.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf2TgUQioDtpcXDBKwe77xxj3H8fwNHihffKpanNBcPeq/IMG_9384.jpeg)


![IMG_9389.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS2yg7AKbE7ehko87xFBRKJEE65nLbVzhBXuFe132Vsxu/IMG_9389.jpeg)


Finally… I gave up. *“Baby… please help…”* 

Which means: I lost the bet. Great. 

My husband walks in like a superhero: *“This is easy. I’ll do it in an hour.”* 

I smiled. Because I knew something he didn’t. 


![IMG_9388.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV9DEKH6e7BRFkhmfpkc4gkVzg89jZswddzamXwW4NJzx/IMG_9388.jpeg)

![IMG_9385.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfQ3pMQg4xP5zWTKfcsfbw2889SeK2Kgv3kVMC2oethRb/IMG_9385.jpeg)



So I made a second bet: *“If you finish everything without problems, I’ll add desserts to your week of cooking. BUT if you fail...I do nothing.”* 

He said: *“Deal.”* 

He builds the table. Easy. Two chairs? Done. No instructions. Showing off. 

And then… the fourth chair. 

Pause. 
Head scratching. 
Instructions in hand. 

**Ohhh yes. My moment** 😄 

I casually asked: *“Something wrong?”* 
He starts complaining: *“These parts don’t match!”* 


![IMG_9396.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT7wYdNiQuNXkPagYmocdERjqKFsne4TwgpgMm9Ctq1QK/IMG_9396.jpeg)

![IMG_9391.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb5fsFLL8LYyyvsNKFqgmJTLSiwNxfFCAKvXA3Y44QXxg/IMG_9391.jpeg)



Me: *“So… you admit defeat?”* 
Him: *“Yes.”* 


![IMG_9400.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXmP5hu5eb8HnG8NrXv9MAHUPgvh4ubuyy6ytjJQEB79G/IMG_9400.jpeg)



**I WON!!!** 
*(Okay, still missing a chair, but that’s not important right now 😄)* 

Later, I told my brother about the *“impossible chair.”* 
Big mistake. 

He goes: *“You just don’t know how to do it. I can fix it.”* 

So of course… another bet. 
If he fails → he pays me €50. 
If he succeeds → I pay him. 

Guess what happened? 

Yeah… I lost. He literally drilled a hole and fixed it in minutes. 

**FANTASTIC.** 

So now I have: 
✔ A full patio set 
✔ A working chair 
✖ €50 
✖ My dignity 

But hey… I can finally sit outside, work on my laptop, and feel like a proper princess again 😄 


![IMG_9546.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbjf6osLnqvGU649Sur47ZFrAUnzGqGqZysHanPUM4nBZ/IMG_9546.jpeg)



And maybe… just maybe… it’s time for me to stop making bets. 

Because at this rate, I’m going to be broke very soon 😉 


![IMG_9544.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbyKpxdVFnhP7VhRvRHbKGLckqadYr13CDZzmz8yebSRM/IMG_9544.jpeg)



 With love, @tinabrezpike ❤️

body.title: Why Do We Pay More for Experience Than Products?
body.body:
![ChatGPT Image Apr 27, 2026, 11_40_06 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sumant/23wMcNfheapWdRSPbU6nWzP5YcK536oqUhAt4KQwwW2tcuKbnMZuhgTfA2mCbKkrkmPwa.png)



In a world saturated with mass-produced goods, the global economy has shifted from a focus on tangible ownership to intangible engagement. We are increasingly willing to pay a premium for experiences, travel, dining, or live events over physical products. This shift is driven by the psychological depth of memory, the social nature of humans, and the diminishing returns of material possessions.

### The Psychology of Lasting Value

While a new smartphone loses its luster as soon as a newer model is released, an experience gains value over time. Psychologically, humans adapt to physical objects quickly, a phenomenon that is known as hedonic adaptation. In contrast, experiences become part of our identity. A week spent trekking through the Himalayas doesn't just provide a view, it shapes our resilience and narrative.

### Social Connection and Story Capital

Products are often solitary, but experiences are inherently social. We pay more for a concert or a shared meal because it fosters connection. Furthermore, in the digital age, experiences provide **\

** We are defined more by what we have done than by what we own. Sharing a unique experience creates a social bond that a luxury watch simply cannot replicate.

### The Search for Authenticity

In an era of automation, we crave the \

We pay for the expertise of a chef or the atmosphere of a curated boutique because these elements feel authentic. We aren't just buying a service; we are investing in a moment that feels unrepeatable.\n\nUltimately, we pay more for experiences because they are the only \

that don't depreciate. They reside in our memories, influencing our happiness long after the physical product would have ended up in a landfill.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sumant/23ynNSKsaBMS8q1y16rfSBSChwi6xc8MDnKA42tf2Lzj84VzNDypf5EGvyxXiKKszjDfA.png)

When we approach our parents with respect, patience, and a willingness to change, we create room for healing and restoration.

Show love to your parents, care for them because they are the people who brought you to this world, while doing all these things nothing will separate you from your parents. By making efforts to listen, support, and care for your parents, you gradually rebuild trust.

body.title: ShardWorks — Early Access: We're Looking for Our First Players
body.body:
If you're playing Splinterlands with more than one or two accounts, you already                                                                                                                                                           
  know the drill. Log in, claim rewards, collect SPS, stake, check the season                                                                                                                                                               
  pass, do it again tomorrow. It's not gameplay — it's maintenance. And the more                                                                                                                                                            
  accounts you run, the more of your day it eats.                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  **ShardWorks** automates all of that. We're looking for a handful of early                                                                                                                                                                
  players to try it, tell us what works, and help us shape what comes next.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  ---                                                       

  ## What it does

  ShardWorks handles the repetitive account maintenance that has nothing to do
  with actually playing the game:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  - **Claim daily rewards** across all your accounts
  - **Collect SPS** from regular accounts into a central bank account                                                                                                                                                                       
  - **Stake SPS** on the bank                               
  - **Swap SPS to DEC** when you need it
  - **Distribute DEC** to accounts that need it for season passes — smartly,
    prioritising accounts that need it most                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  - **Buy season passes** automatically when they run out
  - **Claim staking rewards** and **frontier draws**                                                                                                                                                                                        
  - **Harvest land** and **add liquidity to pools**         

  You set it up once through a browser UI. The system runs the jobs on schedule                                                                                                                                                             
  while you focus on the actual game.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  ---                                                       

  ## How much access does it need? You decide.

  This is the question everyone rightly asks first, and the honest answer is:
  **it depends on which features you want to use.**
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  ShardWorks respects Hive's key hierarchy. Different operations need different


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sc000/23tbGjgLGKTRJYavLo8bAyyb9kvvFgJquHbLTCsP1TzFFdCpfaBkPkPznFvYzNP7J66YG.png)

  keys, and we enforce that boundary strictly.                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                            
  **Posting key is enough for:**

  - Claiming daily rewards
  - Buying season passes
  - Claiming frontier draws
  - Staking SPS                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  - Delegating SPS
  - Land harvesting and liquidity                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  - VOUCHER pool management                                 

  **Active key is only needed if you want:**

  - SPS transfers from accounts to your bank
  - SPS → DEC swaps on Hive Engine
  - DEC distribution from bank to accounts                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  - Rental bid placement
  - Staking rewards claiming                                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                            
  That means you can run a fully useful setup — claims, season passes, staking,
  land — with **nothing but posting keys**. The active key unlocks the token-flow
  features. You choose how far you go. Nothing in the system forces you to add an                                                                                                                                                           
  active key, and the UI makes the distinction visible before you submit anything.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  ---                                                       

  ## How keys are protected                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
   
  We understand that handing private keys to any system is a real trust decision.                                                                                                                                                           
  Here is exactly what we do with them.                     

  **Keys never leave your server in plaintext.** When you submit a key through the
  browser, it travels over HTTPS to the API, is validated, immediately encrypted,
  and stored. The plaintext is gone from memory at the end of that request. It is                                                                                                                                                           
  never returned to the browser — not on key list pages, not anywhere.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  **Encryption uses HashiCorp Vault with envelope encryption.** Each key is                                                                                                                                                                 
  encrypted with a unique data key. That data key is itself wrapped by Vault's
  Transit engine. The database only ever stores encrypted payloads. Even someone                                                                                                                                                            
  with a full database backup cannot read a stored private key without also having
  access to a running, unsealed Vault instance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  **Active keys require explicit confirmation.** The API requires a separate
  confirmation flag when submitting an active key. You cannot accidentally store                                                                                                                                                            
  one while intending to store a posting key.               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  **The browser is deliberately kept out of the secret loop.** The UI collects the
  key once and submits it. It receives back only a status (stored / revoked). Key                                                                                                                                                           
  material never lives in browser storage, cookies, or local state.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  **Login uses Hive Keychain.** You never type a password into ShardWorks. Login
  is a Keychain-signed challenge — the same pattern a hardware wallet would use.                                                                                                                                                            
  No password, no master credential, no account takeover from a leaked session.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  **The worker decrypts only what it needs, only when it needs it.** When a
  scheduled job runs, the worker fetches and decrypts the specific key for that                                                                                                                                                             
  specific operation at that moment. It does not hold decrypted keys in a cache
  between runs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
   
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                            
  ## You can audit the code

  We are asking for your trust, and we think that trust should be earnable rather
  than assumed. If you want to read the code before deciding, we welcome that.
  Early adopters who reach out will be given access to review the source directly.
  You can verify how keys are stored, how the worker handles them, and how the                                                                                                                                                              
  Vault integration works — end to end.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  This offer is genuine. If something in the code makes you uncomfortable, we want
  to hear it.

  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
   
  ## Who this is for right now                                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                            
  ShardWorks is early. It works, and we run it ourselves, but it is not yet a
  polished product with a support desk. We are looking for players who:

  - Run multiple Splinterlands accounts and feel the maintenance burden
  - Are comfortable with self-hosted tools (a Linux server, Python, basic
    configuration)                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  - Are willing to share feedback when something is confusing or broken
  - Understand this is a work in progress                                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                            
  If that sounds like you, get in touch. Early users get direct access to the
  developer, input on what gets built next, and the knowledge that the tooling
  they are shaping will be used by real players.                                                                                                                                                                                            
   
  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                            
  *ShardWorks — less time on maintenance, more time on the game.*

body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXxmkAG7gDyw15ethL1WvgyRXdBoMuKFfPnJR4FpLypEM/1777969171243.jpg)


​Rotawirus. Straszne dziadostwo. Nigdy bym nie przypuszczała, że ta infekcja potrafi tak zdemolować organizm dziecka, mimo kompletu szczepień. Wylądowaliśmy w szpitalu z kwasicą metaboliczną, co brzmi groźnie i tak też wygląda – wyniki gazometrii poleciały w dół, a my od kilku dni walczymy o każdy procent nawodnienia. Widok malucha podpiętego do kroplówek, które muszą powoli i precyzyjnie „odkwaszać” krew, łamie serce, ale na szczęście powoli wracamy na prostą. Pierwszy solidnie \

nocnik był u nas świętem narodowym, bo to znak, że nerki w końcu ruszyły do pracy i wypłukują to świństwo.
​Żeby jednak nie było zbyt kolorowo, właśnie dostałam raport z domu – Bombel zaczął gorączkować i ma już pierwsze objawy jelitówki. Serce mi pęka, bo siedzę uwięziona na oddziale niemowlęcym, a tam zaczyna się powtórka z rozrywki. Mam tylko nadzieję, że u starszego skończy się na strachu i piciu elektrolitów w domu, a limit nieszczęść na ten tydzień już wyczerpaliśmy. 

> Rotavirus. Terrible crap. I never would have imagined this infection could wreak such havoc on a child's body, despite a full set of vaccinations. We ended up in the hospital with metabolic acidosis, which sounds serious and feels like it – blood gas results have plummeted, and for the past few days we've been fighting for every ounce of hydration. The sight of our little one hooked up to IVs, which must slowly and precisely \
her blood, is heartbreaking, but thankfully, we're slowly getting back on track. The first solidly \

potty was a national holiday in our room, as it signified that the kidneys were finally starting to work and flush out the filth. But to make things less rosy, I just got a report from home –  Bombel has started running a fever and is already showing the first symptoms of intestinal infections. My heart is breaking because I'm trapped in the infant ward, and there, the fun begins all over again. I just hope that my older one will end up scared and drinking electrolytes at home. We've already exhausted our quota of misfortunes for this week.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb9TzCtPJuGrDux65YGk4YbhsmZtZxCZX8RCWeCoU8QG6/1777969181321.jpg)

\
\nMoże Loczek już pomału wraca do zdrowia, na pewno wraca jej apetyt, skoro widzi ser żółty na obrazku bajki Odlot ☺️\n>\
Maybe Curly is slowly recovering, and her appetite is definitely coming back, since she sees yellow cheese in the  Up story☺️

body.title: Lodisucio: Radical Foundational Black American Supremacism Simplified
body.body:
A Lodisucio is a term used to label individuals—typically from the Foundational Black American community—who promote inflammatory, exclusionary, and racially charged views that frame Latino immigrants as direct threats to Black economic opportunities, cultural space, and social advancement, often advocating aggressive measures like mass deportations or violence.

The label criticizes a zero-sum mindset and supremacist-style activism that portrays Latinos, Indigenous peoples, and recent African migrants as competitors for jobs, resources, and recognition while rejecting alliances with other communities of color and dismissing Latino contributions.

In online discourse and identity politics spaces, Lodisucios are described as amplifying emotionally charged propaganda on platforms like TikTok and YouTube, pressuring mixed-race individuals to abandon hybrid heritages in favor of singular Black lineage, and blending legitimate economic anxieties with exaggerated claims of cultural erasure or resource theft.

Ultimately, the term serves as a diagnostic tool to identify patterns of racial manipulation and divisive grievance politics that fracture multi-ethnic solidarity, underscoring the need to root out such adversarial elements for a pluralistic society to thrive.

Read more about [Lodisucio Movements](https://thefreevoluntarist.blogspot.com/2026/04/lodisucio-exposed-anti-latino-rhetoric.html) in the United States.

body.title: Late night, semi-drunk, guilt run
body.body: There was a couple of old friends visiting over the weekend and while I had already warned them before they arrived that I am not like I was back when we used to hang in college, I ended up succombing to peer pressure and the fact that I was genuinely having a great time catching up with some people that I used to be regularly *very irresponsible with* on a regular basis in my 20's.   \n\nBy the time they said \

for the 4th time I had to put a stop to that nonsense.   When I input my information in the MyFitnessPal app that I use for calorie tracking, I saw that I was 500 calories OVER my daily limit of 2050 calories and was sitting in my house thinking \

It might not have been the best choice, but it was a choice that I made and gosh darnit, I can be very stubborn when I decide that I am going to do something.

<center> https://www.dexerto.com/cdn-image/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/07/Drunk-man-runs-8km-race.jpg?width=1200&quality=60&format=auto
[src](https://www.dexerto.com/entertainment/drunk-man-in-flip-flops-joins-8km-race-wins-a-medal-3235126/)</center>

That image is taken from [a really entertaining article that I read](https://www.dexerto.com/entertainment/drunk-man-in-flip-flops-joins-8km-race-wins-a-medal-3235126/) about a drunk guy who joined a running race in flip flops and managed to keep up with the people who were in the race all the way to the end.  He didn't win, but people noticed him and congratulated him with a medal for making it all the way.  The cool side of this story was that being recognized for his achievement encouraged the man to change his life and now he runs regularly.  

Well nobody was going to give me a medal last night that's for sure but since I started running so late I didn't actually encounter many other people on the trail and that's probably why I decided to take my shirt off... which is something I almost never do when running.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/normie.fitness/23tGZrNPhqH2rZfQ2ouMARLUmujUfzGukc3SvKkPSPd7eyxSGZoctVTAHh7DHTRgp2rpv.png)
</center>

The pace I started out at felt a bit rushed and I was kind of impressed when my watch told me the stats on the first km and found out that I was only moving a tiny bit slower than I normally would do and this was with a belly full of beer.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/normie.fitness/23tRr5AgZEsymfcsiUiA3d9VS436R6do9YdKuReGPuWNrKN8jnQmQydie2XYhZSgbgHFZ.png)
</center>

I have this thing that I do lately where no matter what I am feeling like, I strive to mentally get past the barricade of stopping before hitting 5km.   I really feel like a lot of running is psychological.  You aren't really as tired as your brain is telling you nor are you gassed out or experiencing muscle fatigue, you are just trying to quit because you are being lazy... or at least that is the way I look at it.  

Semi-drunk me is actually pretty motivated to not give up though especially when I would encounter someone else on the trail that probably didn't have 8 lagers that night.  

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/normie.fitness/23tGVQVe9TkVBAVmcEQAcwcdcmr8mBrwjXC5B463woEaBNH9uEn47f4boVMSj77sKwqcu.png)
</center>

I did manage to keep a reasonable tab on my heart rate as well, which is something I always do when I am sober but I wasn't actively monitoring it the other night.  It's kind of good to know that I can just \

my way to the type of heart rate that I am looking for.  I may have stepped a bit far into anaerobic but I know why this is:  It was because other people were around and I was trying to not look drunk

<center>  
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/normie.fitness/23tkfuTmcSEF9YW9WXeggZsz6i6usj5hmEZqUSjRe5Lfgnn4UaK7fSk1itEZT3ZpWFR33.png)
</center>

By the time I was done my app was kind of proud of me and also when I dug a bit deeper it was stating that at least for the past week, my overall training load is really high,perhaps even a little bit too high.  

I don't know who comes up with these things though, I don't feel like it is possible to overtrain when you are only doing around an hour of cardio a day.  I guess I'll find out when I hurt myself.  

I am not encouraging anyone to go drunk running.  Obviously there are more bad things that can happen than good but when I saw that i was 500 calories over on the day I was not going to allow that to stand.  But the time I was done I had managed to be in a 100 calorie deficit and while I do aim for 300-500 deficit per day to get my weight down to get more speed, I think I did pretty well considering that the rest of my day was rather irresponsible.   

The run had another effect though and that was that I probably sweat out or had my body consume all the alcohol becuase the following morning I felt just fine!

body.title: Fluir sobre la nieve  o el agua | Poesía [ES/EN]
body.body: > Una chica vestida de negro me sirve un café, hace un gesto con sus labios y lo ignoro sin darme cuenta. Luego supe algo sobre su mirada y pensé en los pingüinos de Madagascar. Los pingüinos no beben café, ni les importa que Madagascar sea el nombre de una isla que trasciende las olas y los arrecifes, solo les importa ser fieles a su pareja y fluir sobre la nieve o el agua. Este café tiene demasiada agua, y para colmos lo ha servido una chica vestida de negro.

body.title: UN PLATO DE MAZAMORRA CON CARNE-----A plate of masamorra with meat
body.body:
Buenos dias a todos los que componen esta maravillosa plataforma social de HIVE, siempre existen opciones en preparar la comida para el almuerzo como en este caso, en donde la misma se trata de mazamorra, la cual es una comida tradicional de sudamerica, la misma es a base de maiz blanco o amarillo, bien cocinado, el mismo se lo deja remojado en agua desde el dia anterior, luego para cocinarlo se asemeja a la misma manera de cocinar un guisado, quedando el mismo como se ve en esta foto.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/23wCE8tAqLXoaxGfgB6mafYD58tj1MH7Cb77VhywWjNYdSMiv9vp8WuXwbBJPTFQx8uVb.png)

Asi que teniendo el maiz del dia anterior en remojo, agregamos una olla en la hornalla de la cocina, le vertemos un poco de aceite, luego cebolla, ajo a gusto, despues la carne, cuando la misma esta casi cocinada, le agregamos un poco de agua, el maiz antes mencionado y asi dejamos que se termine de cocinar todo, para luego degustarlo y saborearlo.

MUCHAS GRACIAS POR LEERME Y SEGUIRME.

TRADUCIDO ALINGLES

Good morning to everyone who makes up this wonderful social platform of HIVE. There are always options for preparing lunch, like in this case, where it is about mazamorra, a traditional South American dish. It is made with white or yellow corn, well-cooked. The corn is soaked in water the day before, and then it is cooked in a manner similar to making a stew, resulting in what you see in this photo.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/23wCE8tAqLXoaxGfgB6mafYD58tj1MH7Cb77VhywWjNYdSMiv9vp8WuXwbBJPTF

So, having the corn from the previous day soaking, we place a pot on the stove, pour in a bit of oil, then add onion, garlic to taste, then the meat. When the meat is almost cooked, we add a bit of water, the aforementioned corn, and let everything finish cooking, so we can then taste and savor it.

Thank you very much for reading and following me.

body.title: A simple life with my family today, Clean and bring separated recyclables to a local recycling shop to sell them, Our lunch, Walk and shop at two wet markets.
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSbXduFitdwadj1SouWgmWEqZrJ1vy449PC7VT7JogTdP/1777965583785.jpg)

Hello everyone. How are you today? I hope all is well with you and your family. My autistic son is starting his new semester today. It is a school for special needs children. Which focuses on occupational therapy for special needs children. But after we took our autistic son to school, we didn't go anywhere and go home. My wife and I now have free time again,  So we're planning to give the home a thorough cleaning. We plan to take my unused recyclables to a recycling shop to sell them too. Such as cardboard box and  plastic bottle. This time, our granddaughter cleaned with us. After the house cleaning is finished, So we are sorting cardboard boxs and  plastic bottles. 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeLteG9MKKQBzvqCXPGGWRVNn7ViCN16y3hcmBzb5sJSj/1777965583963.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQdBuAdbfWvYzvAFvbSczNwMx29KY4wnBzwruvnKFiPAU/1777965583841.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWEJmpoSShC4VhGwXsQQDkQYp5T8JLD5bX6VJA5Trcey8/1777965584069.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc4Tcuu878cp84D8Kh74UbyYUgMwkw5n8VXXaWvfYARuX/1777965584153.jpg)

There's a local recycling shop near my home, just one village over. So we bring my separated recyclables to this  recycling shop to sell them. We traveled to this recycling shop from our village, passing by farms outside our village community.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdSuZX37DnsPFd8HXaBdEqcxMsuZec73WFvB5oCtdAG8d/1777965881306.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQTaxyfNT1WazCTCYmUxtpov1k9tVAvYuFyGrCo1UTx8T/1777965881692.jpg)

Then we passed the next village and through that village's farm to get to the recycling shop.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX56UFLVNzWfA7hxfSBKdMQXe2rLuJ5yazDqE9N8fYXAq/1777965881573.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTJ69b5uWDeqZsp6m1aMrRo6ybQMzBe1z2voWF6mExGq3/1777965881427.jpg)

This recycling shop is a large one. People from many nearby villages bring their separated recyclables to this recycling shop. We spent about 20 minutes selling our recyclables here.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSKQZcgfo4tc6RByVXs6pr2CtaxLkTkgFCEZ9wkMobfP3/1777966335949.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR9DexaPPfFRcq7pcRDeSr3SUYFTCcHm3F1oRvaL9se7e/1777966336477.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRmnEbGmQRdvERwLpmaQkrxdotfL2JynTmpVWQXXxAsD8/1777966336253.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdKgLx3Ns4zWoQV9SxEZftbpq7Ag4m2CAsoGKvNtYnqNg/1777966336644.jpg)

It was almost noon and we were feeling hungry, so we went to another nearby village. 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdsxp4C3VEbXv9juoTrjfeNK9yD5QiKXPipMdH98wHQR4/1777966604218.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNVquDx5SGSyHN6B3h9B92v38J7QEv6Zy7bYEZona8EBH/1777966604410.jpg)

This village has a delicious noodle shop. And we used to eat noodles here. This time we ordered thin rice noodles with pork meatballs and pork.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdX9cK9xrioVrea7qK7UW69kwDRuzdh1TWDksRDT1iWmR/1777966604642.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQjpv4Ack5u928Hj5FfRtHBs386t7jiHtovrS6LszGscj/1777966604546.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTE9cQBQ9sfUxk8zSWq5o8KUPXSB4LveJXkNPaoFbAmPE/1777966604811.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVt7ZUuq1NiDZ1QPoptpuQpxTn2ytZ2UbqFXamhrTikmG/1777966698009.jpg)

Finally we go to two wet markets in two sub-districts. The first wet market was in our subdistrict. We walked around this market but didn't buy anything. Because they don't have the things we need here. So we went to the second wet market in the next subdistrict. After walking around the market, we bought some ingredients, seasonings, and snacks here.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmatWiFyEjxtrTfEah9XS7Hy7RHUWLmtacU9w65Lw4Tu1t/1777967291115.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcV2ZdtvdjS3h5jCWUnKeTDq8jG6M5mM7AV775Ej45Ked/1777967291224.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWNP7HZssVj1YF3yQTbakfHBMnfVUJFC2HCmV1LzfMPrS/1777967291344.jpg)

Then we picked up our autistic son from school in the afternoon. And we took our son to the doctor at the health center and then returned home. These are the stories and photos I want to share for this post. Invite everyone to see and enjoy my stories and photos. Please forgive any errors/mistakes. Have a great day. See you next time. Thank you for your support and visiting my post. Bye 🤗

📷 Take photo By Smartphone Vivo V30.

body.title: Thoughts and available keys from Humble Drop: July 2025
body.body:
>

<center>![Thoughts and available keys from Humble Drop: July 2025.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bengy/23uQkM1tTy6UheA65KNgzgRkAMmjdfDVbSUpKaB2frWhgsMxrAH9kNgv4H5hteL2BSvZT.png)</center>

[Rogue Trader](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186680/Warhammer_40000_Rogue_Trader/)
[Cat Quest 3](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2305840/Cat_Quest_III/)
[Death's Door](https://store.steampowered.com/app/894020/Deaths_Door/)
[Daemon X Machina](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1167450/DAEMON_X_MACHINA/)
[Wizard with a Gun](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150530/Wizard_with_a_Gun/)
[Neo Cab](https://store.steampowered.com/app/794540/Neo_Cab/)
[Everafter Falls](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1416960/Everafter_Falls/)
[Blanc](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1982340/Blanc/)

I've claimed some of the games from this drop, but please leave a comment with an offer in HBD/HIVE if you are interested in picking up a Steam key for any of the games that I don't claim myself!

Well... this was a mixed bag as far as [Humble Bundle](https://www.humblebundle.com/monthly?refc=Zio8ho) drops go... it would have been a pretty awesome month for drops... except that I had already bought some of the games on Steam sales in the past (will I never learn...)... and that made it a personally ordinary month drop. 

That said, there are some really awesome games if you are interested in putting in an offer for something in there!

So, leading this month's drop is Warhammer 40k: Rogue Trader... this is an awesome old school style CRPG. Sort of in the old Baldur's Gate style, and set in the really quite amazing 40k universe. You play as one of the Imperial Rogue Traders... basically, a space law unto itself... this is a great must-have game for anyone who is interested in real RPGs (not that action poop...)... sadly, I already bought it on launch... because I'm an old-school gamer who LOVES these games! So, this is a very enticing game for anyone who might be wanting to claim it!

Next up... Cat Quest 3. Okay, this is a bit of a cutesy take on the ARPG thing (you know... the poop type of RPGs?)... but my youngest daughter loves the Cat Quest series... and so, this is a claim... but for her. 

Death's Door is a bit of an unusual game... the art style grabbed me though. And this is the real reason that I love the Humble Bundle drops so much... the odd little games that you wouldn't ordinarily think about purchasing... but just because they are in the bundle, you end up claiming them just to see what they are about. A 3d platformer? A souls-like? A narrative game? Strange... but intriguing.

Daemon X Machina seems to be a bit of a retro styled Japanese Mecha game. There was perhaps a time when this would excite me... but these days, the mecha games that I prefer are things like BattleTech where you are running merc company in turn based tactical battles. I just can't really summon up the desire to play an action orientated mecha game anymore...  even the newer Mechwarrior games are a bit of a stretch for me. So, a pass for me!

Wizard with a Gun... online co-op game... insta-NO! Couch-co-op... maybe... but random strangers on the internet. NOPE! Maybe in the future, I would do this with my daughters on separate Steam accounts... but playing board games together sounds like more fun. Pass on this one!

NeoCab is a visual novel about being the last human cab driver on the planet... it has a really nice dark art style... and I'm crazily curious about story based games like this! Insta-YES!

Everafter Falls... another farming life sim. No thanks... I'll stick to my RimWorld thanks! 

Blanc seems like a great game for a young family. Cute art style, and a nice wholesome story... and seemingly not too complicated from a gaming point of view. But I think that my daughter's are a bit too old for this. I might end up seeing if one of the other extended family memebrs with younger kids might be interested... or perhaps some reader might like it?

artist\\.title: Camote Tops Salad & Juice + Free Viands Blessings 😊❤🙏
artist\\.body:
Hello everyone!

Hope all are safe and well! 😊❤🙏

Today, I just want to share a simple yet meaningful part of my day. It is something that reminded me again how blessed we are, even in the smallest things. 😊

I went to our backyard to pick some camote tops. It’s such a simple routine, but there’s something peaceful about harvesting your own food. The fresh green leaves, still a bit wet from nature, made me smile. I picked enough for a meal, feeling thankful already even before cooking. 😊❤

After that, I washed them properly and prepared a small pot with a cup of water. Once it started to boil, I added the camote tops and let it cook for just about a minute. I didn’t want to overcook it so it would stay fresh and nutritious. Then I separated the leaves into a bowl and poured the remaining soup into a glass and it became my camote tops juice. 😊❤

Simple, right? But very healthy. 😊

Then I prepared the ingredients for the salad. I sliced some onion, garlic, ginger, and tomato. Added a pinch if salt and  I mixed everything with the camote tops and squeezed some fresh calamansi juice. The aroma alone was already appetizing because it's fresh, a bit tangy, and very natural. 😊❤

And just like that, I had my own homemade camote tops salad and juice. 😊😋

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY9UqrtxMBDa6ELGitkqhsDd2UzNPieTS6knobtJJvZu3/20260504_145229.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYgjzE5KBaFKDebZ5fuQNU7PZXTGwHCkVmN6dVqwH7NMM/20260504_145832.jpg)

When I am about to eat my simple meal, another blessing came unexpectedly. My mother arrived home from a fiesta celebration and brought some viands with her. I couldn’t help but smile because it's a perfect timing! 😊❤

Free food again! 😅

She brought home some meat dishes, and it felt like a feast added to my already healthy meal. Truly, God provides in ways we don’t expect. ❤🙏

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYvKyKeXvEap3ymZ83GJ13ZiBqLQyhHfojEHdXGUS59kr/20260504_145819.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZn2FoWY6XBsFwubL7LmtP5hUCqFGM3rwbUu1ns4dssSA/20260504_144558.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbzi8zn4dhMtDYziqj5782zWLMMAVYbYjJieqhSfH5JVp/20260504_144535.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYdttaFv6JRSqC3tk4HevuDCizDvWSFjWrgajac1G5NN1/20260504_144527.jpg)

After eating, I still had energy and decided to make ice candy. I will share the recipe on my next blog. 😊

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma6VLK2PaMzLQHAxX4hRuhmJZSGCAxvPY6nxbD2T7vjGZ/20260504_140202.jpg)

What I really love about today is that we didn’t spend anything for our meals. Everything came from what we already have or what was given to us. From the backyard harvest to the unexpected blessings from my mother where everything felt like a gentle reminder of God’s provision. 😊🙏❤

Sometimes, we think we need so much to be happy. But days like this remind me that even the simplest meals, when shared with gratitude, can bring so much joy. 😊🙏❤


Have a Blessed Tuesday everyone! 😀😀😀💖💖💖

Thank You Lord for the blessings and love!

Be grateful in every little/simple things and you’ll find happiness you ever wanted! 😀😀😀

Everyday is worth to be grateful of!

Praying for the safety and wellness of all.

Heal Our Land Oh God!

Lovelots,
@shikika

artist\\.title: The Cost of Ease: Are We Losing Our Creativity?
artist\\.body: <div align=\
>\n<div class=\

>
![IMG-20260505-WA0002.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oluwa-tosin/23xVKAA6MCLAgawu3nofpmLH3Ez1hkTh5thm2nQuiKzgLRCQwSCdnn7TYhLpWbpxdzK2m.jpg)
Good day, people of Hive! Welcome to my blog. Today's topic is from Hive-Learners, which says:**The Cost of Ease**. So let’s dive in. Honestly, the world today is moving faster than ever and feels so easy. We don’t really have to stress ourselves too much before getting things done. With just our phones alone, we can write, create, and design. Truth is, it’s convenient and even enjoyable sometimes, and that’s why we use it. But deep down, the question is: Are we becoming too comfortable? And if the answer is yes, is that comfort quietly taking away our creativity?
Honestly, technology is not the problem. If anything, it shows how creative we humans can be. But the way we now depend on it is where the issue comes in. Truth is, it has become a normal thing for us to look for shortcuts. We like things that will be easy for us, not difficult. Instead of sitting down to think things through, we just love looking for the fastest way to get results. And when we keep doing that, we don’t really give our minds the chance to work the way they should. Before the existence of technology, creating something meaningful took time and effort. People had to sit with their ideas, struggle with whether those ideas were good or not, and sometimes even start over if they weren’t. Writers had to rewrite things multiple times to get them right, and many other things like that. Yes, the process may have been tiring, and people would have been fed up doing things again and again, but it helped them grow and think more deeply. But now, most of that process can be skipped. It may sound like a good thing, but it also takes away that part where creativity is built.
![IMG-20260505-WA0005.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oluwa-tosin/23wqgVu1KRyedHkbM4R8dX9mwYKNHK1kNsfSUdK82rDzpJzyXuQMX4GmHG9NH2tp888mV.jpg)
To me, I don’t believe that creativity has disappeared. It’s still there; it just depends on how we choose to use what we have. We still have people who put in the effort to think for themselves and only use technology as support. They already have their ideas; they just use tools to make things easier or better. That happens to me most times, I already have the idea, I just use tools to help improve it. That alone shows that creativity is still alive. Truth is, to me, I see nothing wrong with using technology, but we shouldn’t let it take over our thinking. Sometimes, it’s important to try and make sure we do our best. Even if what we come up with is not perfect, at least it came from us, and that effort matters. In conclusion, ease is not bad. In fact, it has made life better in many ways. But too much of it can make us lazy without even realizing it. So to me, I think it’s about being mindful. We should use what is available, but we should not forget to use our own minds too. Our thoughts and our ideas are still what make everything we create truly ours. **This is my entry for the Hive Learners Weekly Featured Content Week 216 Episode 01.** **Thanks for reading💞💞💞💞💞.** **Images generated from Meta Al.**

artist\\.title: New Day - New House!
artist\\.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQapwArUduHP6dey8DGPST6Sx4tLyk4UsHCEwq6Eb7dkP/1777965599282.jpg)

#### How our world has changed in one day!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcpaRmeuR2f6DwSq7ZNGAJSkBe7B4Xv3mzF3UV965eXQW/1777965599756.jpg)

**Last week we began looking more earnestly at our 'financial situation' and to consider asking for help. A couple of days later we spoke to Vincent's dearest mamma, about a possible loan of funds pending the Arthouse selling. The next day we spoke to our neighbour down the track, Antonio, about the wee house and land joined onto ours, went to visit Corado soon after - and today are waiting for the Gift of the property costs to be wired to us... We are ecstatic, champing at the bit to get started, and going for a shower at the hotel to celebrate!!**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVNNuBHfX8oCuVR8PSvKB47DRisJhtWqpBfPWKFfcgKsj/1777965600254.jpg)

The tensions leading up to this happy resolution of our crisis was immense. Vincent and I have both lived 'under the breadline' most of our adult lives, but this has been scraping the crumbs up much more than usual: he convinced me that *if we are truly in hardship, his family would help us*, but I was not so certain, nor so comfortable with asking for help. I've always somehow managed to make do and mend, forage and find solutions, but these days getting started on our homestead have been extremely trying.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUNFnS5jC7CzFTneN9y1vbuSomAvPe3Bj9r5ZFMjHUKe4/1777965600767.jpg)

The worst of our situation - for me - has been the lack of comfort, order, cleanliness; men often have a higher tolerance for disharmony in the home, and I am also a good few years older than my partner, and have a far stronger basic need for calm, tidyness, *beauty* in my home! Living between a brick shed and a tent this past 10 months has been ***excruciating*** at times (as I've mentioned in my Hive posts!) - but yes, the next phase is all the more like True Luxury, when stability finally presents itself.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNg6Aa2QnQPw5XqzFcP9qHGuS8HdUwergA1f2jXiqUfQJ/1777965601218.jpg)

I feel too, that having such a precarious entry into our adventures in sovereignty has brought up a lot of my earlier life 'traumas': times of genuine fear for my life, and very early life experiences of danger and vulnerability. Without conscious attention to suporting oneself and each other to allow primal feelings to rise up and dissipate, a relationship could quite easily crumble. .

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSy5f3LmkW57kRZ4EoZcE4xViD37d1m4gew46PRemArnW/1777965705158.jpg)

We are blessed to be confident in our processes, and (mostly!) able to relatively-effortlessly hold space for the other to 'freak out' about the big situations we're faced with. Recently we were tested to the max though, with dwindling reserves, little to no income on the horizon, and dramatic weather patterns making life in our brick house quite unbearable in specific moments.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmerNhUyiKSXtkAe38UwH8Pn1LNSFGCNEWCTuZB6tGLzb6/1777965705637.jpg)

Having been through multiple situations in which I might actually not have made it, this 'perfect storm' really brought a lot to the surface. However, it also forced us to speak our needs out more; to be clearer about them, and to speak to the right people about them - and generally to those around us. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP3XxsFDfCMqQGyMaWFJdRVzFuyhdhDVsfmNvKWXvZkUA/1777965706123.jpg)

When I've been verging on disaster in the past, this has always brought solution: speaking about our needs - not our wants or demands, but our core survival necessities - both in our prayers with the Universe, and with the right, trustworthy folk, has a way of releasing the emotional/ energetic charge on any predicament, thus ultimately freeing up the (way towards the) solution.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVShgofgB1t6PonDPWiMZek7cY2Nqj5J1M8rj4PJM2YG9/1777965706643.jpg)

God doesn't grant a solution to us like a bancomat: we still have to do the big work - in fact we have to work even harder than before, and to discern better and be more wise and conscious than before! There is no space for slacking or overt passivity, in manifesting a big project like we are doing, in the context of a New Earth being cocreated!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaJgqoJnyPcch6t71Fb9TraYrBRuc6L9ohyP2SWFTjpse/1777965707199.jpg)

### So we imminently have a new, ***proper*** house to feel into, to clear out and fix up and fill!!! We cannot hold back, and have begun weeding, sowing seeds, mulching, cutting back the brambles on the huge fruit trees.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdfNUSoYPMuwDqPnZosSELD8odLQoa8PsPhpM61u1EgD3/1777965745098.jpg)

We are adding another ⅓ or so of our current acreage, including a nice-sized 'orto', multiple cherry trees (one possibly as old as 500 yrs!), more mature fig, walnut and an apple tree, a load of wild greens, and some glorious woodland extended from our own.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVuc5thjUBbZcirJacdqn2v74oYaTn23LdqW3LBr5kzQp/1777965745551.jpg)
 
Plus the house!! Oooh, it is D I V I N E !! A perfect blend of old and not-as-old, solid but botched-together, cosy and traditional, practicality!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV5XB2GshS3FB2JyTECMKoSpKDyiu3vTiJY2BYbo5PauS/1777965745865.jpg)

We are talking non-stop about what to put where, how to make it function autonomously, when to plant what... It is a LOT to take in, holistically - symbiotic with all the rest of what is unfolding within and around us. We are spinning with new inspiration and enthusiasm and vitality - still effectively with almost-no-financial-resources, BUT with absolutely everything that we need to get started For Real for real! 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQSvAuyKEyiYh3Nuesj4No7mEur68zZKupEM46i8Bzk64/1777965746494.jpg)

Cannot wait to share more!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQZkyqBkhmMsUaB3Rm2J2T3oRMwqaMzqLYvzm8mA85Vp3/1777965747071.jpg)

But now is the time for our hotel appointment with the much-needed shower!!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNcnmmBjkQy3Fff9nRFa16NxTtr7vd8JQ4DDEmh3pEQCM/1777965802797.jpg)

### With Love to you all in your work with the earth and the cosmos!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPNBCoL2kPM2gMDgGg42b7yTPQqYyEhVzW8xn7uV7d3cq/1777269272977.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYDD8qEjo1Jxcpc1AUX6MVNaWCYaN6HrDu6pGeAUm9qz7/1777425073984.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPtdkS4UKREF3zvNLugENEXPt76ETXkoZXtqahwHysPSR/1777269308888.jpg)

树是大自然的奇迹，它们用挺拔的姿态和繁茂的枝叶装点着我们的生活。每当我走在林间小道上，呼吸着清新的空气，心中总会涌起一种宁静与放松的感觉。树木不仅是生命的象征，还承载着无数的回忆与故事。它们默默地见证着时间的流逝，教会我们耐心与坚持。无论是春日的嫩芽，还是秋天的落叶，树木都以不同的面貌展现着生命的轮回。
