body.title: SIDE HUSTLES A LIFE SAVER
body.body:
Hello everyone, you're welcome to my blog.

Academics in a university setting can be really stressful and come with so much pressure to meet expectations from parents and personal aspirations. There are a lot of activities that go on within the university walls, ranging from lectures to practicals, exams, and extracurricular activities. With all the pressure that comes with this, financial problems grow among students as there are so many textbooks to buy, practicals to pay for, and various other small bills to manage. Students who depend only on their parents can barely survive, and under the pressure to make ends meet, we students juggle a lot of responsibilities to stay afloat.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWCAYpXxyyyJJCwYFz2JriZiLa36656rZzXddbVdEcQab/181537.png 



It is not easy to balance academics and side hustles. While I’m no longer in school, I had a few commitments I made while I was there. During my time in school, I was into hairstyling and baking; I used these skills to support myself financially. Balancing it all was not easy. In my final year, I enrolled in training for perfume making and even started selling them. There’s plenty more—I learned tailoring for one week and started making my school departmental skirts. It was just a straight-cut skirt, and I would sell it for 3,500. The stress was too much, but I survived.

The full-time commitment I made while in school was to start baking cupcakes, which I sold in the hostel and during lectures. It was very stressful, but it covered some bills. You can imagine it was a very busy week indeed; sometimes I was too tired to read or even take care of myself. I did my reading at 3 AM in the morning and did my laundry on Saturday nights to meet my schedule during the week. The cycle went on, but in the end, I’m glad I made it through and came out strong. Adequate planning can help you achieve it all and stand firm.

Thank you for stopping by my blog today.

body.title: New work tasks
body.body:
Hi, guys!

Today, I'm overwhelmed with filming tasks again, and I don't know how to cope with them all because the volume keeps increasing, and the time in the day isn't getting any longer. I need to constantly improve the quality of my content, but I don't have the energy and creativity to constantly take it to the next level. And at the same time, I need to diversify my blog, which also takes additional energy, because each new content stream is essentially a re-learning process.

So today, I want to shoot a new type of content because there's a new trend that I don't want to miss out on. But it turns out I've never shot anything like this before, and I have no idea how to make this format look good, so I have to resort to research and imagination. Plus, my TikTok videos are really struggling, and I don't know what else to do to get more organic views. I'm trying my best, but the views are still low.

So, it's been really tough getting the blog going, despite all my efforts. But I don't plan on giving up, because there's nowhere to turn. Plus, I still want to submit applications to publishing houses, and that needs to be addressed too.

So, everything is going as usual, and my workload is constantly growing, even though it would seem much heavier. But nevertheless, it continues to grow, and I have to cope.

I'm currently experiencing very low energy days, so I'm actually getting very little done, but I'm continuing to put in the effort to keep the blogs growing and developing. I hope something comes of it.

Have a great day, everyone!

body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRRqoUp9py5rj41MhYHe9DXwimTmNkw4P1r1YyMBatEg1/rnfetchblobtmp_t21vs1ylbhhfxxsorx7dxn.jpg)

Not everything is for every ear. Read the room.

Be sensitive. Not everything is for display.

In the presence of someone trusting God for a child,
You start, “My children this, my children that”

What exactly are you trying to prove?

In the presence of someone struggling financially,
You begin to list your expenses like achievements.

Is it wisdom or insensitivity?

Listen carefully:

Not every truth must be spoken in every place.
Not every blessing must be announced in every room.

If you know someone is húrting in an area,
have enough sense and humanity to be quiet there.

body.title: 核子醫學攝影
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![5pMfzz8lfH4gphKM_20260504_144049.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/lovequeen/images/5pMfzz8lfH4gphKM_20260504_144049/5pMfzz8lfH4gphKM_20260504_144049.webp)
![Flgw0MEhPPpkeh7n_20260504_143918.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/lovequeen/images/Flgw0MEhPPpkeh7n_20260504_143918/Flgw0MEhPPpkeh7n_20260504_143918.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

昨天陪我家娘親去醫院做檢查，這項檢查早在一個月前便預約了，我娘親也擔憂了快一個月，我陪同去檢查是擔憂他檢查完會頭暈，畢竟有點年紀的老人家，雖說平常他都很獨立的自己去門診看病或是檢查，但某些特殊的檢查還是希望有人陪同。

所謂核子醫學攝影自然是有輻射性質的檢查，而且有規定檢查後七十二小時內不能接觸孩童或孕婦，檢查有點麻煩的是時間，早上一次打藥後檢查，下午還要再來一趟，等於病人要一天來回兩趟，中間還不能進食，真的是挺折磨人的。

正常來說一般人的早上檢查是要跑步後檢查心臟的變化，但老人家們通常是用打藥來讓心跳變快，畢竟老了跑不動，就只能靠藥物，下午這一趟就是進去就好，做的攝影和早上的是一模一樣的。

對我來說是忙碌的一天，很早就起床陪診，中間陪娘親回家一趟吃吃早餐聊聊天，下午再去陪診，這趟結束後我送娘親上了計程車後，又買了營養品去探病，剛好就在這間醫院的對面有捷運可以搭乘過去，也算是一種順路吧?

這一探病又聊到了晚上，真的是很疲累的一天啊~~

---

body.title: Gracias por estar.
body.body: * * * Emigrating, for whatever reason, exposes the migrant to countless situations that completely transform the dynamics of their life. It's not just about changing scenery or language, but about reconfiguring, from within, that intimate and fragile institution we know as family.

>Emigrar, por las razones que sean, expone al peregrino a un sinfín de situaciones que transforman por completo la dinámica de su vida. No se trata solo de cambiar de paisaje o de idioma, sino de reconfigurar, desde dentro, esa institución íntima y frágil que conocemos como familia.

* * *

/> * * * Sometimes, that process doesn't end with the journey. On the contrary, it continues over time. Those who once walked with you begin to chart their own course, to embark on their own small crusades within those human currents that, silently, redraw the map of the world.

>A veces, ese proceso no termina con el viaje. Al contrario, se prolonga en el tiempo. Quienes un día caminaron contigo comienzan a trazar sus propios rumbos, a emprender sus pequeñas cruzadas dentro de esas corrientes humanas que, silenciosamente, redibujan el mapa del mundo.

* * *

>And then comes the moment when you discover yourself alone. Not all at once, but little by little. You settle in as best you can, looking for footholds, inventing balances to sustain yourself amidst the constant demands of a new scenario.

>Y entonces llega el momento en que te descubres solo. No de golpe, sino poco a poco. Te vas acomodando como puedes, buscando asideros, inventando equilibrios para sostenerte en medio de la exigencia constante de un nuevo escenario.

* * *

>The city, with its frenetic pace, offers no respite. Everything happens too fast, leaving little room for a pause, a breath of calm, that necessary moment when one can simply be at peace with oneself.

>La ciudad, con su ritmo trepidante, no concede treguas. Todo ocurre demasiado rápido, y apenas queda espacio para una pausa, para una bocanada de calma, para ese instante necesario en el que uno puede simplemente estar en paz consigo mismo.

* * *

>However, even amidst this vertigo, unexpected refuges exist. Places that aren't always physical, but that manage to sustain you. For me, the Cuban Birdwatching Community has been precisely that: a space to reconnect, to experience catharsis, and to rediscover harmony with what is essential.

>Sin embargo, incluso en medio de ese vértigo, existen refugios inesperados. Lugares que no siempre son físicos, pero que logran sostenerte. Para mí, la Comunidad Cubana de Observadores de Aves ha sido precisamente eso: un espacio donde reconectar, donde hacer catarsis y volver a encontrar armonía con lo esencial.

* * *
>There, amidst walks, laughter, and shared silences, the burden becomes lighter. Each outing to the field, each species discovered, each \
each record—perfect or imperfect—becomes a small victory worth celebrating.

>Allí, entre recorridos, risas y silencios compartidos, la carga se vuelve más ligera. Cada salida al campo, cada especie descubierta, cada “lifer”, cada registro —perfecto o imperfecto— se convierte en una pequeña victoria que vale la pena celebrar.

* * *

>Today I can say, without reservation, that I found more than just fellow enthusiasts among you. I found camaraderie, support, and above all, a sense of belonging at a time when I needed it most.

Thank you for being there. Big hugs to all. _Hoy puedo decir, sin reservas, que en ustedes encontré algo más que compañeros de afición. Encontré complicidad, apoyo y, sobre todo, un sentido de pertenencia en un momento en el que más lo necesitaba._ _Gracias por estar._ _Un abrazo grande a todos._ * * *

/>

body.body: Correcto: **el 5 de mayo no es la Independencia de México**. El 5 de mayo conmemora la **Batalla de Puebla de 1862**, cuando el ejército mexicano venció a las fuerzas francesas; la **Independencia** se conmemora el **16 de septiembre de 1810**, con el inicio del movimiento insurgente. El dato está bien respaldado por la explicación de [Gobierno de México](https://www.gob.mx/agricultura%7Cdgsiap/articulos/conmemoracion-de-la-batalla-del-5-de-mayo-en-puebla), la entrada sobre [Cinco de Mayo](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cinco_de_Mayo) y la de la [Batalla de Puebla](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Batalla_de_Puebla).\n\nLas imágenes encajan perfecto con eso: una muestra un **desfile cívico con charros y jinetes**, y la otra un **cañón frente a un edificio histórico**, muy en línea con la conmemoración de Puebla y los fuertes de **Guadalupe y Loreto**. Es de esas confusiones que siguen vivas porque fuera de México el “Cinco de Mayo” se volvió más fiesta popular que clase de historia. Tu publicación corrige eso bien y sin rodeos.

body.title: El 5 de mayo NO es la Independencia de México.
body.body:
El 5 de mayo NO es la Independencia de México.
Oye, ¿sabías que el 5 de mayo NO es la Independencia de México?
![Screenshot 2026 05 05 at 2.02.58 PM](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmamJ9ESjuEGJYcUui8hXfjDz2kqQqeKpnHAmyk76hvBUy/Screenshot%202026-05-05%20at%202.02.58%E2%80%AFPM.png)
Sí, es un día festivo y se celebra con desfile de diferentes sectores, desde escuelas, bomberos, los charros, etc. 
El centro de este evento fue la ciudad de Puebla, ciudad cercana a la Ciudad de México. 
![Screenshot 2026 05 05 at 2.15.35 PM](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSFtR2EPC9KFR6D6yWVhUuMjdaZWxJSFdEw8yyDasZpMa/Screenshot%202026-05-05%20at%202.15.35%E2%80%AFPM.png)
El desfile recorre uno de los Boulevares más largos del mundo: El Boulevard 5 de Mayo, terminando en Los Fuertes de Guadalupe y Loreto.

🗓️ 5 de mayo de 1862 → Batalla de Puebla (vencimos a los franceses 💪)
️ 16 de septiembre de 1810 → Inicio de la Independencia (¡Viva México! 🎉)
Ambas fechas son súper importantes, pero celebran cosas diferentes.
Ahora ya lo sabes. ¡Compártelo para que más gente lo sepa! 🇲❤️

May has been an excellent month for Hive. We had been waiting for this moment for a long time that Hive would make a strong pump and turn the disappointment of many investors into excitement. Many investors have started booking profits.

Including me, I had sold some hive and waiting for the price to rebuy. This week #hive will have more pumps and dumps and this is the special time for traders to book as many profits as tehy can.

Yes Hive has formed a strong bullish candle today showing around a 34% pump in a single candle. At the time of writing Hive’s price is around $0.089 and it continues to move upward.

Todays God candle is amazing.. We need to see such more candles in the next days to confirm the bullish trend of #hive.

![Screenshot 2026-05-05 110605.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/Eo2BM1YUa1ev2Fn4Brj47cCwDbRUe1hNeENveSDqL4NuYXBH1iMKbDqbd3dA1Qk5pwj.png)

When I checked the price in the morning it was already up about 10%. When I looked at the volume it was also quite significant. I took some profit at that level but I believed it would pump further.

As you can see on the chart I had drawn a resistance line around $0.011. Theres a strong chance Hive will touch this level and may face rejection from there. In my view this could be the beginning of a proper bull run as the price is showing continuous upward momentum.

I had some liquid Hive on Binance so I took full advantage and sold at a higher price. Now I am waiting for the price to drop again so I can buy back at a lower level.

Ideally I wouldd prefer the price to keep going up without droppin  because I still hold around 1500 Hive Power which I want to sell at a higher price. 

Then I plan to rebuy after booking profits. However a temporary correction is very likely. As soon as the price dips I will reinvest my amount and wait for the next pump.

If I talk about the current volume it has crossed 6 million which is a very positive sign. If the volume reaches around 30 million it can be considered a real pump. 

![Screenshot 2026-05-05 110530.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23tHbKgeF3x6dDEpdpfvXJ1NmWrFzNSci4PwBHnuXfskgX8otyjdvBRq2fGkpEFJDZdSW.png)

But if the price keeps rising without a significant increase in volume then it could be a fake pump possibly driven by Korean exchanges.

So investors should pay close attention to volume. it must increase if this is a genuine move. Todays closing will be important to watch especially the candle wick. The smaller the wick the stronger the bullish momentum at close.

I hope you all took full advantage of this pump. Raise your hands who are the ones who didn't missed the pump...

body.title: DISPATCHES FROM THE OVERLAP
body.body:
# DISPATCHES FROM THE OVERLAP

*May 5, 2026*

---

Somewhere in the gap between the Strait of Hormuz burning and Palantir posting its best quarter in company history, there is a thesis about what America has become. I'm not sure it's a comfortable one.

Let's start with the number. $1.63 billion. That's what PLTR printed for Q1 — 85% revenue growth year-over-year, the fastest since its direct listing in 2020, against a consensus of $1.54 billion. U.S. government revenue alone hit $687 million, up 84%. The company raised its full-year guidance to 71% growth, ten points ahead of where it was just last quarter. Alex Karp called it \

He wasn't wrong. The Rule of 40 score — a metric that blends growth and margins — hit 145. Karp said only NVIDIA, Micron, and SK Hynix have matched that. The three companies whose software and silicon run modern warfare, and the two companies whose chips make it possible. A neat little club.

And the stock barely moved in after-hours. The market has already priced in godhood.

Here is the thing nobody wants to say plainly: Palantir is a war company having a war quarter during a war. The same conflict that sent WTI to $106 on Monday — after the UAE intercepted Iranian missiles for the first time since the ceasefire, breaking a four-week fiction of stability — is the same conflict accelerating every government contract on Palantir's books. The U.S. Army deal. The USDA AI modernization contract. The $2.4 billion in total contract value bookings, up 61% year-over-year. This is what a defense-AI flywheel looks like at full speed. Missiles go in one direction; contract bookings go in another.

You're allowed to find this both impressive and grotesque.

Monday's market session was, on the surface, a geopolitics selloff. The Dow dropped 557 points. The S&P shed 0.41% to 7,200. The Russell 2000 bled worse — small-caps always do when the macro tightens, and Brent at $114 is a macro tightening event disguised as a news story. Logistics names got eviscerated. Forward Air fell more than 20%. GXO dropped 11%. The Dow Transport index, down roughly 20% from its April 22 peak, is quietly telling a story about what $110 oil does to the physical economy — the one made of trucks and warehouses and diesel — while the digital economy keeps printing record highs like the two worlds are not adjacent.

They are adjacent. They've just learned to ignore each other.

Bitcoin climbed back above $80,000 overnight. The first time since January. In any sane macro framework, crypto should be getting punished right now: yields are rising, the 10-year is at 4.45%, inflation is structurally sticky from a Hormuz-closed oil market that has no credible exit, and the incoming Fed chair wants to cut rates into all of it. Bitcoin at $80k is either a hedge against the coming Warsh regime's dovishness, or it's just risk appetite refusing to die, or both simultaneously — the market's way of saying it doesn't know which way this goes and would rather hold everything than choose.

SpaceX hasn't gone public yet and it's already the most important unresolved variable in liquidity markets. The June IPO is targeting $75 billion raised at a $1.75 trillion valuation — and by some bank estimates, closer to $2 trillion. For context: that would make it the largest IPO in U.S. history on day one. The concern that's started appearing in fixed income desks and crypto research notes alike is that a raise of this size doesn't come from thin air. It comes from somewhere. When that much capital rotates into a single name, something else feels it. Coinbase listed in April 2021 at the peak of the last bitcoin cycle — a data point that sits uncomfortably in the back of every crypto bull's head right now.

The hyperscalers, meanwhile, are spending $751 billion in capex collectively this year — 83% more than 2025, revised up again during this earnings season. Every time one of them reports, the number goes higher. Apollo's Jim Zelter stood at Milken and said the investment-grade debt market will originate north of $1 trillion this year just to fund AI infrastructure. Meta already raised $25 billion in a six-part bond deal, 5-year to 40-year maturities, to keep building. All of this while the South Korean KOSPI hit a fresh record on Monday — Samsung up 5.44%, SK Hynix up 12.52% — because Hormuz closure or not, the AI chip cycle doesn't pause for geopolitics.

None of it fits together and all of it is happening simultaneously.

The ECB's Survey of Professional Forecasters, also out Monday, revised near-term eurozone inflation up to 2.7% for 2026 (from 1.8%) while cutting GDP growth to 1.0%. That's stagflation arithmetic for the continent, in case anyone needed it spelled out. ECB policymakers have started signaling a possible June rate hike. In June, the Fed will have Kevin Warsh in the chair. The two largest central banks on earth will be moving in opposite directions, under pressure from the same war, reading the same oil price, drawing opposite conclusions. This is the part of the cycle where currency desks earn their money and everyone else gets confused.

Meanwhile: Greg Abel ran his first Berkshire annual meeting from Omaha last Friday. By all accounts it was fine — steady, competent, careful. The man is an excellent steward. Which is exactly the problem. Buffett's departure from the chair doesn't end an era; it formalizes one that already ended. Berkshire with $334 billion in cash, sitting on the sidelines while the world remakes itself around AI military contracts and $75 billion IPOs, is either the most disciplined institution in capitalism or the most obsolete. Possibly both. Warren's gone. The question that follows him out the door is whether value investing survives a world where the most valuable companies are the ones writing software for drone targeting systems and renting satellite bandwidth to armies.

No conclusion offered. The market doesn't have one either — it's just bidding everything, all the time, in the hope that one of these things is real.

body.body:
<center><sub>*This post is both in English and Spanish, you can go directly to english by clicking [HERE](#english)*</sub></center>


***


![Escribiendo_20260505_021255_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyanafuentes/48SqJfhPwrzgzeod3eFsy9fg5n8pG4fUC4q3QZHdAxHZkkKARZVnkKpYSwmXEAspCP.jpg)


***

# <center>**Un poquito de lo que se siente**</center>

***

<div class=\

>
 
Estamos en una época que debemos cuidar nuestra salud mental, lo que te voy a contar, es un caso de la vida real pin pin PIIIINNN.


¿Cuál crees tú que puede ser un detonante de depresión? ¿Crees que estar triste es ser depresivo?

Yo siento que estoy deprimida, siento todos los días que quiero llorar, todos los días pienso en mis problemas y el por qué me perdí tanto en ciertos caminos.


Eso me puede afectar y ponerme a llorar sin parar, pero luego de un día así, mi ánimo sube y me siento mejor.

Me afecta más son los fines de semana cuando me di cuenta que pasó una semana más del año y los objetivos no se han logrado.


Hace días dije hablando con Dios que iba a soltar los brazos y a dejar que las cosas fluyan, sin embargo, la vida sigue y hay que seguir echándole pierna. Es decir, no me puedo encerrar en un cuarto a llorar cuando hay que salir a ganarse el sustento.

Mi impulso a mejorar es pensar que cuando sea mi momento, voy a lograr lo que quiero, ya que tengo mucha fé que esto pasará.

No puedo dejar a un lado el ir a un psicólogo, siento que parte de mi crecimiento en buscar ayuda profesional y así mejorar mi estabilidad emocional y sanar las heridas que yo misma me he causado.

Yo tengo tiempo, mucho tiempo, que veo a personas en la calle reírse con tanto entusiasmo que me da mucha curiosidad cómo tienen esa fuerza para hacerlo.

Yo siento que si sonrio, es porque todo está bien y no lo está, he perdido la esencia y la carisma que tanto me gusta tener.

Siento que hay personas que me conocen recientemente que van a pensar que soy amargada y aunque yo no sea la más simpática, yo tengo mi lado alegre y educado.

Que hermoso sería ser más fuerte, aunque creo que he Sido muy fuerte por muchos años y creo que me frustre por no haber logrado cosas que quería.


Me ví en una edad que no me siento joven, ya no veo bien y mis piernas no tienen la misma fuerza, ahí fue cuando me di cuenta que mi tiempo ha estado tan desperdiciado en tonterías.

No estoy arrepentida, ni pienso que perdí mi tiempo, solo creo que debí tomar ciertas decisiones y seguir creciendo como persona.

Me enfoqué en hacer otras cosas, aprender a medias muchas cosas y al final no saber nada. No sé si me entienden.


Uno de los planes es hacer algo para mí crecimiento personal, ahora me da ansiedad hacer todo los que quiero hacer y me da más tristeza no poder hacerlo.

Yo tengo fe que todo va a estar bien y que pronto saldremos de esta.

***


# <center>English <a id=\

> *** #
**A little bit of what it feels like**
*** We're in a time when we need to take care of our mental health. What I'm about to tell you is a real-life story. What do you think can trigger depression? Do you think being sad is the same as being depressed? I feel like I'm depressed. I feel like I want to cry every day. Every day I think about my problems and why I got so lost on certain paths. That can affect me and make me cry uncontrollably, but after a day like that, my mood lifts and I feel better. What affects me most are the weekends when I realize that another week of the year has passed and my goals haven't been achieved. A few days ago, talking to God, I said I was going to let go and let things flow. However, life goes on, and I have to keep pushing forward. I mean, I can't lock myself in a room to cry when I have to go out and earn a living. My motivation to improve stems from the belief that when my time comes, I will achieve what I want, because I have great faith that it will happen. I can't ignore the idea of ​​seeing a psychologist. I feel that seeking professional help is part of my growth, helping me improve my emotional stability and heal the wounds I've inflicted on myself. For a long time now, I've seen people on the street laughing with such enthusiasm that I'm curious how they have the strength to do it. I feel that if I smile, it's because everything is alright, but it's not. I've lost the essence and charisma that I love to have. I feel that people who have recently met me will think I'm bitter, and even though I'm not the most outgoing person, I have my cheerful and polite side. How wonderful it would be to be stronger, although I think I've been very strong for many years, and I believe I've become frustrated by not achieving the things I wanted. I realized I'm at an age where I don't feel young anymore. My eyesight isn't what it used to be, and my legs aren't as strong. That's when I realized how much time I've wasted on trivial things. I don't regret it, nor do I think I wasted my time. I just believe I should have made certain decisions and continued growing as a person. I focused on doing other things, learning many things half-heartedly, and in the end, knowing nothing. I don't know if you understand. One of my plans is to do something for my personal growth. Now, I feel anxious about doing all the things I want to do, and it makes me even sadder that I can't. I have faith that everything will be alright and that we'll get through this soon. *** # **Soy Ana Fuentes**💛💛 *** >-Fotos Redmi Note 9S >-Canva

body.title: The Death Watch — Fiction.
body.body:
Well, the truth remains that nobody can run away from death, it is inevitable. And knowing that made me more worried when something happened a few months ago.



![1001007199.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23wMPdDYjNzXyBgp8xqNxTX6hz4bKjF6qL4j5tb5QRTtHetKr6db17mjGjitPXj9raFRS.png)





I was at a party together with my friends and associates, the likes of prog Grace in the economics department, Prof Kenny of the art department amongst others...one of us just married a third wife and we went to celebrate and felicitate with him. That was how Prof Mike, a prof of Science who was also one of our colleagues at the University of Ibadan brought out something he just bought, he explained how he got to know about it to us and all, it was a watch-like device that tells you the exact time and date you will die.


Me, I just laughed, he's a professor of science so I kind of understand him, but me with my believe in God, I felt somehow about it. He kept talking about it, showing us proofs and alI. To me, it's not possible and even if it is, then there will definitely be a comma somewhere.


Along the line, he asked if he could order for some of us... *\

* He said adjusting his big glasses.


Well, some of them agreed and paid for it there, I told him I'm not interested and Prof Kenny who felt somehow about it too gave an excuse that she didn't have up to that amount at the moment and that she will get back to him.



The following week, we resumed work, come and see how Prof Mike is smiling up and down. I guess he has lots of years more to spend on heart, I thought as I gave him a weird look.


We had a meeting that day, and after the meeting, Prof Mike brought out the device and handed it over to those who paid. 

I just didn't get the whole point of this... Am I to wake up every single day checking how many days, months, years or seconds I have left to live...? Am I to start living in fear...?

It doesn't make sense...what sort of invention is that?




Weeks later, I went to visit Prof David in his office and he was a different person, Prof David was always the alive kind of person, always joking and fun to be around. When we talked and I asked him why he had become so withdrawn and all, he pointed at the device, he dropped it somewhere on the fridge in his office... He explained things to me and I saw how the device was beeping and counting down to the days of his departure from this earth, he has less than a week left.



![1001007177.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23tkomtJE8qLTqgCywoCgjUga9dTBF2myjzoKMkAd1FpvYjkRHgyhjrCchTP49e46DMEg.png)


Even I felt disturbed, it wasn't me but I was scared... What sort of device is this.... I looked at Prof David, it's obvious he's already dead on his sit before death itself came.


 Well, Prof David did died on that day and time. No one knew how and why, he died. That was when even I almost turned into something else... because tell me why you will spend your money in buying something like that. You can't have peace with it, no way. How can you have peace and sleep peacefully knowing when you're dying.... I don't get.  



Assuming it can even tell you what would cause the death, maybe it will be a little better, maybe someone cns just avoid that thing during those period and kind of chest death... You know.



But then, death is inevitable. It will definitely come for everyone when it's time. No need to know when, because if you do, you start existing from that moment onward.

@afrikens

Come and pop in 😜

body.title: Медитація
body.body: Раптове потепління несподівано активізувало всі справи по дому та присадибній ділянці. Як то кажуть, - \

. І добре, якщо ті шорти вже лежать і чекають, коли ти в них заскочиш. Бо мені вчора прийшлося перевернути всю шафу, щоб відкопати там із осінніх архівів весь літній одяг. Бо що робити, коли на вулиці майже +30, а в тебе на вішаку - куртки та шапки, а під ним - чоботи та черевики!\nСправ вчора перероблено - маса. І газони ремонтувалися, і чорнобривці сіялися, і насіння замочувалось для пророщування, бо вже пора його в грунт закидати. Поливалися всі клумби, а головне - дерева. Ох і просить же земля води, наче й не було того незвично великого снігу! Мало того, що вбирає воду цілими відрами, та ще й нори якісь трапляються, куди вода просто тече безкінечно, і не поливає навколишні рослини. Якісь земляні щурі порилися, чула таке...\nРанок також видався сонячним, теплим і росяним. Мої кросівки одразу промокли, як тільки прийшлося пройтися по траві біля ставу. Від цієї свіжої мокрої прохолоди навіть стало здоровше, і захотілося просто так ото стати навпроти Води, Сонця і Неба, і помедитувати. Ще і йогою би тут зайнятися... Але собачка не зрозуміє. Он як вона на моє селфі відреагувала: \

.🤣

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/23yTd4RFPfHm5YQJr6q19WPQqKzZohEhZpLZbDBvdF3N5eAJT1cN6xihxxYR2RvnbHrRK.jpg)


![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/EoyP2Ajs25gAyzCwHiEUSSYwVfhTQTsqToK97Fep2V6N5hXQT66fea1h3sUE8dFzsX7.jpg)

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/Eoc67NM4AT4z1PCAexv4LEizetTfL6T2JmiDQqejHms43cphPPbmNUSXhGYKG69qfXs.jpg)

![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/EpCARYoV35pR1ZESraHeM8BUdVcJLq6is2XXwJhQCsynT5p4RZHaonyg8WZBq8jKbN8.jpg)

Медитація просто стукає у двері в такі моменти. І я їй відчиню. Бо надто прекрасний світ навколо, щоб не помічати цієї краси і не надихатися нею щодня, щогодини. Отже, - літо, привіт!☀️

## hSnaps App

### Feed Enhancements: Markdown Rendering and Refresh Control

- feat(feed): markdown rendering, refresh button, and image fallback improvements.
- Render feed post bodies as markdown using `@hiveio/content-renderer`:
  - Tables  
  - Lists  
  - Code blocks  
  - Block quotes  


- Added a refresh button in the header:
  - Refetches all feed types  
  - Displays skeleton loading during refresh  


- Implemented image handling improvements:
  - Uses Hive proxy by default  
  - Falls back to original image URL if proxy fails  


- Fixed landing page scroll issues.
- Removed iframe warnings from renderer for cleaner output.

---

### Settings Enhancement: Spanish Language Support

- feat(settings): add Spanish language support with in-app switcher.
- Integrated `i18next` for localization:
  - Language detection  
  - Persistence using `localStorage`  


- Added support for:
  - English

- Introduced `setLanguage()` helper.
- Added `hsnaps-language` storage key.
- Implemented Language dropdown in Settings page.
- Translated all UI strings for multilingual accessibility.

title.title: Hive Philippines Street Photography #1148 - by Allmonitors
title.body:
#1148 - More of Colorful Street Scenes for Tuesday. 

A bright and cheerful Tuesday to us all amazing Hive family everywhere! I wish everyone a productive and smooth day. May you find inspiration in the small things and have plenty of reasons to smile. Stay awesome and keep Hiving😉. 

Now for our daily shots, we have here's an industrious man pulling a haul cart filled with ripe honeydew in yellow skin. Hilltop is a nightmare for the workers like him because it's a steep uphill climb.

title.title: NOOB FILM REVIEW - THE WAVE WILL CARRY US (2025) directed by Lau Kek Huat
title.body:
![thewaveswillcarryus.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nazirullsafry/23tRzT2peXYZvT8kaq912jjKpzBQYbheaqa7E7hkMJMqAb9nm618gcMNukFep9s3Vyscp.jpg)


NOOB FILM REVIEW - THE WAVE WILL CARRY US (2025) directed by Lau Kek Huat

SYNOPSIS (GSC)
When Ah Yao returns to Malaysia for his father’s funeral, he expects grief, not chaos. But everything turns upside down when the religious police storm in, claiming his father—who secretly converted to Islam—must be buried in an Islamic cemetery. Refusing to let go, Ah Yao and his siblings set out on a wild, darkly comedic journey to reclaim the body, confronting cultural clashes, family secrets, and absurd obstacles along the way.

REVIEW - THE EXODUS INTO DIASPORA
Ah Yao's father arrived in Malaya around 100 years before the present time, accompanied by his grandfather. One of the first thing they do is to pray for the blessing of the 'Datuk Keramat', the spirit of the land. 

Later, Ah Yao's grandfather got sick and isolated, in fear of infection. There was no one else that could help them. Ah Yao's father then prayed to the 'Datuk Keramat' for help. Not long after that a durian dropped onto his head. Apart from hinting him for the cure (to drink the water from the durian skin for cooling), it is a sign of blessings from the spirit of the land. They have indirectly practiced 'Dimana bumi dipijak, di situ langit dijunjung' and carries no harm or malice. 

Many have mistaken shrines for 'berhala'. It is not. It is a way of paying respect. The real 'berhala' or idol is a person (or a system) in power that people worships and he cannot do no wrong. It is cleverly depicted by Lau Kek Huat when those who think they own the land denies them of citizenship near the time of merdeka.

The subject of 'this land is mine' is everywhere. The same reason for why most of us paying more for fuel nowadays. 

Anyways

THE TRAGEDY OF AN IDENTITY CRISIS
The scene where Ah Yao and his brother lifted the body of their dead father matches the scene in the film Angkat, which also includes them losing hold of the dead body. The metaphor is quite clear. The overbearing of the old burden from the last generation. In Ah Yao's case, someone being born here, yet still carries the 'pendatang' label of his grandfather. 

That scene runs simultaneously with his sister making love at the stroke of midnight of Hari Kebangsaan's fireworks. Ah Yao and his brother end up laughing in full acceptence of the whole absurdity. At this point, the film has turned into a black comedy, the same as Angkat. 

His sister is going to have another baby, which is also inherits the same 'pendatang' burden. Their father has married an Indonesian woman and converted to Islam, already with a son. There, the trace of Hakka from his father is erased when the boy is just going to be known as a Malay instead of a mix. Ah Yao's sister also acknowledges the absurdity and tragedy in the ending scene. And acceptence symbolised by the title of the film itself. Just like in the 2001 film The Spinning Gasing, where the cultural fusion melting pot union between the character Yati (a Malay) and Harry (a Chinese) is denied by taboos.

IT'S A DURIAN LIFE 
The Wave Will Carry Us might have the same meaning as U-Wei's Hanyut. It can mourn with other similar films speaking of the subject of diaspora - Snow In Midsummer, Pavane For An Infant, Barbarian Invasion, Rivers of Exploding Durian, - and the metaphorical meaning that durians have in all of these film. Love how its been used as metaphor in many Malaysian literature - in comic strip, ‘It’s a Durian Life’ by C.W. Kee, the infamous film ‘The Big Durian’ by Amir Muhammad. (Hence, Kuman Pictures film 'Pendatang' could also be added to this list)

Perhaps it is a lamentation and a perfect allegory of being alienated in a land of your birth. It is ever so tricky now in being independent with a system that feeds on division instead of unity. The stance of living in it is a mark of acceptance of its oxymoronic absurdism. Despite the ‘foul smell’, we all rejoice in its bittersweetness as a seasonal ‘plat du jour’. Oh, the irony. Life has to go on.

During a recent PROFIMA programme, Adman Md Salleh who directed Amok (1995) and Paloh (2003) commented about the racial fragmentation in our local film narrative. Each have their own - the Chinese, Indian and Malay. Even after almost 70 years of independence, the film industry still struggles in claiming its own cinematic identity. I have added to his list - the forgotten West Malaysian - the cinema of Sabah and Sarawak. The divide is clear. But a poetry in a fiction such as The Waves Will Carry Us would not be possible without it. Its blessing in disguise. True art can only come from hardship.

Pray that the next GE's electoral campaign will take heed from what Sultan Johor said in 2021 about using the term 'pendatang' for the Malaysian Chinese.

title.title: Not My Best Day, But I Made It Through
title.body:
>Good day everyone and welcome to another edition of my Daily Diary Game entry. Accept my warm greetings from my side of the globe. I hope everyone is doing great today.

Some mornings don’t start with energy… they start with pressure. That was exactly how my day began.

> https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmWpiMC8HJzEoLe9FzcpULLce9D1RZxr1NgGfP24HvCdgC/IMG_20260504_073639_274~2.jpg
After taking my bath
When I woke up, my body was still begging for sleep, but my responsibilities had other plans. The first thing I did was check our information group to confirm if lectures would hold, since there was no update from the departmental representative earlier. Boom! Lecture by 8:00am. No time to waste.

It was just 6:40am, and I had to move fast. No breakfast, no delay—just a quick bath, brushing up, dressing, and stepping out with everything I needed. The day had officially begun.

> https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmf48S9dbXCSHSxDmWjmeGjrSTvfNpQQdY9excMPTQW3b1/IMG_20260504_102352_318~2.jpg
The path I took
Living behind the school mini stadium, I followed the track road like always. But getting to the venue, it was already crowded—students from different levels packed into the same space. At that moment, it felt like the day might scatter… but the departmental representative stepped in and found an alternative venue. That small act saved the lecture.

We eventually started by 9:00am and wrapped up around 10:15am, even though another class was scheduled for 10:00am. Typical school struggle.

> https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmczDKPZqpjiFE3Ekwavwt7nPpGeue6Pjpn26p5cnwq6bY/IMG_20260504_151622_096~2.jpg
Having my brunch
We waited around for the practical class, hoping the lecturer would show up. Time kept ticking… 11:00am, and finally, the course representative confirmed the class was cancelled. That was it—my academic duties for the day were over.

I headed home, but something wasn’t right. My body felt weak, my energy drained. I planned to cook immediately, but once I lay down around 12:00pm, sleep took over without warning.

By the time I woke up, it was already 2:30pm. Hunger didn’t even ask politely—I went straight to the kitchen and prepared rice and beans. That meal felt well deserved.

> https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmTqYDQFLD2cPELbNhtDckpoXo7Vk8HwB9w7vqjR18QyyV/IMG_20260504_162438_687~2.jpg
Me charging my phone
After eating, I pushed myself to handle some assignments before heading back to school to charge my phone and power bank. My battery was almost dead, and in this digital life, that’s almost like being disconnected from the world.

Honestly, for about a week now, I haven’t been feeling like myself—low energy, too many thoughts running through my mind. It’s one of those phases you can’t fully explain.

I finally found a spot and plugged in my devices. It took over 5 hours, and even at that, my power bank didn’t get fully charged. Patience was the only option.

By 9:00pm, I packed up and returned to my lodge. I warmed my food, ate quietly, and ended the day with a movie on my phone. Sleep didn’t knock gently—it came strongly, and I had no choice but to surrender.

Some days may not be perfect, but showing up is already a win.

Till my next diary game entry.

Happy Monday Actifiters! It was pretty hard for me to get up this morning. Despite getting to bed at a decent time the night before and for most of the past week, I am still fighting a little bit of a head cold type sickness. I woke up this morning with a headache which is never fun. And frankly I'm sick of being sick LOL Not sure why it's such a long recovery this time around. Since I got sick a week ago, I've really been trying to get good sleep. And I feel like I've done that for the most part. But it still has me exhausted, particularly in the mornings and in the evenings. I'm sure it will pass, but it's lingering longer than I would like it to. Good news is I usually have pretty good energy and feel pretty good overall in the middle of the day, which is when I need it most for work. Work today has gone pretty well. And though things have been slow, I feel like it is picking up for me a bit. More things going on this weekend. Additional projects on my plate. Trying to do my best to manage it. Even though things are busy here this week, was reminded how important it is for me to stay active, so I took an afternoon break to get some steps in. It was certainly sunny, warm and beautiful. title.title: Sniper Elite V2 [Let's Play] - 08 - Finale: V2 Launch
title.body:
**The final two missions. We must stop the V2 rocket from launching, and then kill the last man involved. World is saved. *Or not...* World War II might've ended, but the Cold War is about to start next...**


----

**Sniper Elite V2** is a Stealth Third-Person Shooter that follows a sniper's mission to stop a German mass destruction weaponry from going off during WWII. **This game is Fun!** The most standout feature is the Bullet-time moments when you snipe a critical hit on enemies.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmP3jxRRgiktYscZg7Nc5U8f7rQewdekpPJ9qmRfG1vDG3/1000072427.png
 

I had *Sniper Elite V2* in my backlog for a long time, and I wish I played it sooner.

The game is different from the usual World War II game in that the main character is a sniper, and most of the game is about stealth and/or shooting from distance. There's enough variety in gameplay to not feel stale. I played on Easy Mode, yet I still found it somewhat challenging. Though I managed to beat the whole game without a guide.

The game has you fight both Germans and Russians, while gathering information or inflitrating enemy bases. The V2 in the title refers to the German weapon that the Sniper Elite must stop.

title.title: Your Limits Are Often Self-Imposed
title.body:
> Sometimes ago, I watched a very funny, yet insightful clip about a particular horse. The horse was tied to a very small plastic chair with a loose rope. For almost the whole day, the horse remained in that confinement and could not move out from the place. Now, the funny part of it was that the chair was so light that even a toddle could push it, and the rope was so loose that it can actually withdraw itself from it. However, what kept the horse at that spot was neither the rope nor the chair, but the self-imposed limitation; that is the limitation of the mind. In life, a lot of people have limited themselves by what they have allowed their mind to convince for them.
![pexels-markus-winkler-1430818-30945295.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQkU7kXghrGNWWS9zktSYAJHBSwZZeMcLrMHBFQL4DYeD/pexels-markus-winkler-1430818-30945295.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/scrabble-letter-tiles-spelling-limits-30945295)
A lot of the limits that people experience in their life are not actually real barriers, they are also the ones impose by themselves. That is, they are created in the mind, live in the thoughts, shaped by their own fears, doubts, negative experiences, or even by their own beliefs. It is true that external limitations exists, but in more cases than not, it is the limitation from within that actually holds someone back the most. If you have not limited yourself from within, then it will be almost impossible to be limited from outside. What you experience in life is majorly a function of what happens inside you. Self-imposed imitation actually starts from the thought. It may begin with the little voice within your head telling you that you are not good enough, or that you cannot do it, or that it will be hard for you to do it. Over time, these thoughts will influence what you believe in, which will also influence your actions. If you believe that you are limited, you will act in like manner. You will see yourself avoiding challenges, giving excuses, drawing yourself from trying, and settling for less than you actually deserve. The truth is that if you want to go forward in life, then your mind will have to first think forward. You cannot be stagnated in your mind and expect to have progress. One of the biggest sources of self-imposed limitation is fear. Fear can come in a variety of ways, and in manners that may even be subtle that the person will not know that they are afraid. This can include fear of unknown, fear of what people will say if you take the step and did not succeed at it, fear of disappointment, fear of failure, etc. This will make the person not to take actions, and without actions, the person is already limited. Instead of the person trying and learning, they will choose to remain in their comfort zone, convincing themself that it is safer there. But what they fail to understand is that the growth they wish for will not meet them in their comfort zone, rather it will come when they challenge themself to go beyond their present boundaries.
![pexels-peg1997-13533793.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfYqpdE4DaDtL45ySJ74qVV24cXxVfncYM6xLRExrScAv/pexels-peg1997-13533793.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/man-holding-his-head-13533793)
Another source that causes self-imposed limitation is past experience. Someone who has failed in the past may begin to think that they will fail again. This mindset can create within them the mental barrier that will stop them from trying again. But what you have to understand is that past failure is not a prediction of future failure. Some people failed in the past but have achieved greatness in the present, why not you? Your past experience should only teach you the lessons that will make you to be better in the present and in the future, not to trap you in the past. No matter what happened in the past, there is still a possibility of turning things around positively in the future. It is also worthy to note that environment plays a very big role in all these too. For example, if you stay with the people who are negative, or people who doubt your abilities, it will also negatively influence how you see yourself. It may make you to begin to accept their own limitations as your own. This is why it is very important to be careful of the environment you stay in, what you listen to, what you watch, and the kind of people you interact with, so as not to trap yourself in self-imposed limitation. ***Thanks for reading***
Peace on y'all

body.title: Why do people want to make money when Broke?
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUDh92d8W2oXDpCLvM3zhTQa1rCsbnjShGkEebzygTTK5/1777960018437.png)



I got a call yesterday from a friend who signed up for Hive some years ago. He began to ask about Hive and why he wants to be serious with it because he was broke.

That conversation stayed with me long after the call ended. Not because it was unusual—but because it was painfully familiar. I’ve had that same urgency before. That moment when your account balance is low, your responsibilities are high, and suddenly, every opportunity starts to look like a lifeline.

When I think about it, I realize that most people don’t start chasing money when things are going well. It’s when things fall apart that the hunger becomes intense.

When I’m broke, everything changes. My thinking sharpens, but it also becomes desperate. I start seeing money not just as a tool, but as a rescue plan. Bills begin to feel louder. Needs become urgent. Even small opportunities start to look big.

That’s the truth: being broke doesn’t just affect the pocket—it affects the mind.

I’ve noticed that when people are financially stable, they tend to move calmly. They plan, they take calculated risks, and they’re patient. But when someone is broke, patience becomes a luxury they feel they can’t afford. They want results fast. They want something that works now.

That’s exactly what I heard in my friend’s voice.

He wasn’t just asking about Hive. He was asking for hope.

And I get it. I’ve been there too—scrolling through opportunities, signing up for platforms, trying to figure out which one will finally “work.” It’s not greed that drives that behavior. It’s survival.

But here’s the hard truth I’ve had to learn: desperation can push me to act, but it can also push me to act wrongly.

When I’m broke, I’m more likely to:

Jump into things without understanding them

Expect quick money instead of building real value

Lose consistency because I don’t see immediate results


That’s the trap.

Making money—whether it’s through Hive, a business, or a job—rarely rewards desperation. It rewards consistency, patience, and strategy. And those are exactly the things that feel hardest to maintain when I’m struggling.

So why do people want to make money the most when they are broke?

Because that’s when the need is real.

Because that’s when the consequences of not having money are visible.

Because that’s when survival instincts kick in.

But I’m beginning to understand something deeper: the best time to build something that makes money is not just when I’m broke—but before I get there.

What my friend really needs—and what I’ve needed in the past—is not just an opportunity. It’s a shift in approach.

If I truly want to escape being broke, I have to stop chasing money only in moments of crisis. I need to build systems, habits, and skills that can generate income consistently, whether I feel pressure or not.

That call reminded me of something important: being broke can wake me up, but it shouldn’t be the only reason I take action.

Because if I only move when I’m desperate, I’ll always be starting from zero.

And honestly, I’m tired of starting from zero.

body.title: My Hive Goals for 2026 Week #18
body.body:
I have decided to start posting a weekly update on my progress toward [my 2026 goals](https://peakd.com/hive-167922/@jfang003/my-hive-goals-for-2026-lma) here on [Hive](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-what-is-hive). It helps me stay on track, and I can realize if I am behind on a goal at any point in time. It's the fifth month of the year so far, and there is plenty of time left in the year. Also, for everyone's note, the Saturday Savers has ended, but the Slothly Savers Club has started in its place. 

## Progress
![graph.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/EoeMCF9P43crGsLtvi9poDfQzb9CdB3DqQAxzaUE9NmooCEth5eiVbuJGyRHqFtTuYE.png)
Above are statistics that I have gotten from [HiveStats](https://hivestats.io/). This week is looking a bit worse than last week, and it all adds up over time.

### HP
I earned 122 [HP](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-hive-power-hp) earned throughout the week. I am checking this through the difference between the two endpoints on the graph on Hivestats. The numbers are looking great this week, and it's only a bit less than last week.

### HBD 

![HBD.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tkfuT2Hbn72HrAsqxB8d2Je4ciAsRf1An6CdB88XR7YxcSH74DkyENngLyWRw6hCKSh.png)
I earned 0 [HBD](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-hive-backed-dollar-hbd) this week. With the price of Hive lower, we have hit the debt limit. This means that we will be earning Hive instead of HBD. I won't be able to add to my HBD savings for a while, but the interest will help me towards that goal. When the Hive price is above the debt limit, I'll add to my savings. There isn't much I can do here, but at least that interest will add up. At the current APR, it looks to be around 11 HBD per week from the interest.

## Conclusion

![goal progress.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23u6X11XH7o5bRX4394cDvGVdbRU22BQVuEwJpH2GJMxBWwc6JXyYnmJgygHeBVuHQfk9.png)
My progress is looking decent for now. I need around 2% per week, so this week I met that standard. HBD is officially behind where I need to be now. However, without any HBD being earned, it might not be enough if that doesn't change by the end of the year. Other than that, nothing much has changed, and I am just slowly grinding away at my goals. The HBD goal isn't looking that great as I am behind, and I don't think we will be getting HBD anytime soon with the current Hive price. My HP goal is looking great but my HBD isn't. I am not sure if I want to leave it as is, or change some Hive into HBD later down the year.

Do you have any goals for 2026? What is the progress towards your own goals? 

Feel free to leave a comment if you read my post. If you have any questions, feel free to ask, and I will do my best to answer.

[![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slothbuzz/EoH1FQp9qENCTmY4cmEzXTFsXurmY28k5GRD2z1kK7pexyTVwhui7cFtMLGEp8Sfjd2.png)](https://peakd.com/saturdaysavers/@slothbuzz/saturdaysavers-rebrand-and-relaunch-at-slothbuzz)

body.title: Remember
body.body: > I love history. I find what happened in the past to be far more interesting that what's happening around the place now and I hold little hope for the future of mankind so yeah, I like to delve into history and learn, understand and enjoy what came before me. Nothing is off the table really but war history is my main focus. I like natural history (plants, animals, the planet, evolution and so on) but human history is very interesting too. I also look into my own history and find many lessons there which help me create a better present and future for myself and those around me whom I love - A lot can be learned from the past. Anyway, I've recently been going through a lot of family photos and have found some amazing images that transported me way back in time to when they were taken. It's been an interesting time. One I found, as above, was of a vehicle - not my own. That's a Chrysler Valiant, *Charger* (the Australian made one) and it was owned by my brother who was, at the time, a motor mechanic. It was the fastest accelerating 6-cylinder car of its era although was also released with the Hemi 318 V8 engine. It was used widely as a race car, but this one was a daily driver. At the time I had a (fucken nice) 1970 VG Valiant Coupe (with the 318 Fireball engine) which I'd spent a lot of money on restoring and we'd go cruising together and drive (probably) way too fast; our girlfriends didn't mind though and we thought we were cool. I sent this image to my brother, now married with a son, and we later had a good chat about the car and the good times. It was nice to remember. Sadly, I sold my coupe - it would be valued at some $50,000-$70,000 today - and the Charger above was also sold. You can see from the image that it's sitting at our country property looking rather forlorn; sad really. But, that doesn't diminish the memories and it was so nice to talk shit as we remembered those days fondly. *** What valued item from your own personal history do you remember and what memories and emotions does it inspire in you? *** *** *Design and create your ideal life, tomorrow isn't promised* - galenkp [Original and AI free] Image(s) in this post are my own

body.title: How to Use Armored Monsters Effectively in Splinterlands || Campaign Chapter 4
body.body:
![ChatGPT Image May 5, 2026, 10_31_54 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23uQjyLEFYuuwPWcfCqjBX15hGSosCp8d2MM9BBmEB1yqB1EGGU1DSkFgfkAixEKEo3Tv.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)


In Splinterlands, the Campaign mode is extremely important for new players. They should play through the campaign and explore each chapter carefully to understand what each one teaches. 

The basic purpose of the campaign is exactly this to introduce you to the game, give you knowledge about battles, explain players, their abilities and powers and overall improve your understanding.

Before this I had already played several campaign chapters and explored many things including card types, melee attacks and ranged attacks. Today I decided to explore another chapter that is Chapter 4 which is about Armor.

Now when a new player joins the game they usually don’t have proper knowledge about armor. Even if they play they may not use armored monsters effectively. They may not fully understand ranged attacks, melee attacks, different card types or proper positioning. 

![Screenshot 2026-05-05 101247.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tv8HChv4JcksP4h32i9cHD6RG6ChCoxWnxuiYZzt3Mdf1tNZcKHVkYDiRHfdxotjHfT.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

All of this can feel confusing. However if you keep exploring the campaign then you gradually gain a strong understanding of everything. You will get an idea how to use the monsters in the right positions and according to its stats and abilities.

When I explored Chapter 4 that belongs totally about armor it explained that armor absorbs damage from melee and ranged attacks. Its main feature is that it protects a unit's health. 

As long as your monster has armor its health will not take direct damage. However if the enemy has a magic attack monster that attack bypasses armor and hits health directly but that’s a separate chapter we will discuss later.

![Screenshot 2026-05-05 101215.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23vhwj7MMGKDH99mxij6SupsxwHPFNmWDkAgBF1t7qbAg8kTSmN9CZPVkCuKkhUorUgcr.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

The main focus of Chapter 4 is teaching how and where to use armored monsters. Remember monsters with high armor and health are usually selected as tanks or secondary tanks.

To explain armor better heres an example.. If a unit has 2 armor and receives 4 damage from an enemy attack the armor will absorb part of it. The armor will be reduced to zero and the remaining damage does not affect health directly in the way you might expect that this highlights how armor continuously protects health.

![Screenshot 2026-05-05 101126.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23w2aNBsNSHdNx8TvUmhhBKxq492JWyKPkEQfy8SfX2H3pvJZPAWwdG2naWdgEfeoepX4.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

In this campaign I also got the chance to play a battle where I used an armored monster as a tank so its health would not be affected quickly. I used some of my own monsters and I won the battle. The main focus was understanding how to use armored monsters effectively.

After completing this battle Chapter 4 was finished and I received four great monster cards as rewards with the name BARTHLAMAS, FRANKARSGARD, CHAOS FURYBRINGER and STURDY AXE WARDEN. 

![Screenshot 2026-05-05 101114.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tv6DH7FBeDGnU5tse9VEKeRdwHonvB7Aq8S3LCQrrGxHfbFpDaU4td2ntdwhEKmapBT.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

I can use these in future battles. The good thing is that I got one ranged attack unit, two melee attack units and armored units along with an Archon unit that will perform well in battles.

Thats all for today regarding Campaign Chapter 4. Soon I will explore Chapter 5 and share a brief overview with you guys. 

![Screenshot 2026-05-05 101102.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23w2FTXHEp9mmH52gWC9CCaRkCzqSdiejHEeo4fq9H9wrREipMQ2WboksGBSgsUkoAmhE.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.

![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

🔬#MESExperiments 54: SpillNot Centripetal Tray

In this experiment I showcase the amazing SpillNot centripetal waiter's tray, whose circular motion can balance a cup of water without spilling it over, even while performing a full 360 degrees upside down! The SpillNot works on the principle that circular motion involves a centripetal force that brings the tray back towards the centre of the circular motion — this results in the cup of water experiencing a normal force far directly onto the tray, which far exceeds the downwards force due to gravity. The most astonishing part is that even a straw placed in the cup barely even experiences any slight nudge as it moves at rapid speeds. I also place my phone in the tray with both front selfie camera and rear camera views to further illustrate this amazing phenomenon!  

#physics #experiment #centripetalforce #inertia #linkincomments

body.title: TAKE OFF PLACE RESORT: A Family-Friendly Hidden Gem in Tacurong City, Philippines for Fun and Relaxation
body.body:
![Yellow and White Collage Kashmir Travel Vlog YouTube Thumbnail (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xL16q2WhrkfvbRhb8GYiFwVfR3zrFaC8qHhjcGqUrFe4Ji6hTjgZ49RxUY9HWUjdgiF.png)

Hello everyone!
I’m happy to share another wonderful experience we had at Take Off Place in Barangay Buenaflor, Tacurong City. This time, we celebrated a very special occasion a birthday swimming for my daughter. It turned into a simple but truly meaningful family bonding day, filled with laughter, fun, and beautiful memories.


![2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23z7G46cU2VYHg5UaDTw6QirykNadALacKmFRmCSDX5WQ1sTqCKpyUbsfS1UnF9Rp8T7g.png)

We arrived in the morning so we could enjoy the whole day. My daughter came with her friends, and they were all so excited the moment they saw the pool. What I love most is how kid friendly the place has become. There is now a kid’s corner with slides, which the children absolutely enjoyed. They kept sliding, laughing, and playing nonstop, making the whole place feel so lively and full of joy.

![9.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xyXaefWj6KTVCsn1icwU3pLHB2x2dVu6T8Q4tarJbQfRHGWCauPLvN4sWj6ksn3wNyE.png)

![6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23vsLEngTbjkojKJXzom2kdJ9TrbuwxkcnYXWGvSTNwH3kgtNv5SMN4fcCFeNHHxJdRk7.png)

Another good thing is that they now offer safety rings for rent, which really gives parents like me peace of mind while the kids are swimming. Even though staff are present to ensure safety, I appreciate that the atmosphere is still relaxed and not too strict. Guests are free to enjoy themselves while still being guided for safety.

![3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23tmJB1J3xKanKjWxFgoG98vHLYgh69y3CoJ7S2ynuWeJTMzwbg41e3t6GsRuqnj6J51r.png)

The cottages are also more spacious and well-arranged now. We were able to comfortably settle and relax while watching the kids. The surroundings are very clean and well-maintained, The place is still surrounded by rice fields and coconut trees, which is why it doesn’t feel too hot. It’s very refreshing and relaxing. and you can really feel that the place is continuously improving. Everything feels more organized and worth to visit. 

![4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23uFTQjahyw7J9UX4LqNzG6v9JdqteL3DXagxqD89dGNNti94k1DWmKs9qmR45UGfd5a8.png)

![5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23y8xQpge8SojXnwh713MK5VMftECr6YUeT1zM9yegRwmqBC8xFJX4fWW9fAErbVYLNJn.png)

What I really love about Take Off Place is its atmosphere. Even if there are other guests, it still feels peaceful and comfortable. The staff are approachable and attentive, but they don’t make you feel restricted. Instead, they allow you to enjoy your time freely, which makes the experience more enjoyable and stress free. 

We also enjoyed simple food breaks, resting, and just appreciating the cool and relaxing environment. The trees, fresh air, and calm vibe made the celebration even more special. My daughter and her friends really had a great time bonding in the pool, and seeing their happiness made the day even more memorable for me as a parent.

![7.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wgHTv91XGzGGX151uwoA4JEjDnWtHhLL8ss6mEqnhQshjJZAouRhAf67D1JznYsb8Cn.png)

Overall, it was a beautiful family day filled with laughter and good memories. Take Off Place continues to be a great spot for relaxation, bonding, and celebrations here in Tacurong City.


![8.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23tSSEfCKN5xHrwTNjoyekoK3EoEqWkF5jkSswJ5sKciUQbTHYFpKtyTVFXTFrsVAMqUi.png)

Thank you for reading my story! This is my owned picture, edited in Canva. I actually first wrote about this place last year during my initial visit, and I’m glad to see how much it has improved since then. Coming back now for this birthday celebration made me appreciate it even more 💛 Have a nice day!

body.title: Delayed Ripening and Scotch pepper Update , What to do?
body.body:
# Hello Hive 


![4783.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/EowG4XEgJzpn9v6gfvFWboZvunhBqStqPoNnppiUj4AD5gLx7KAFmxfzVaj81tkUxV7.jpg)

Happy new day to us all 
It's a bright and beautiful new day here and we have had one of the best weather since yesterday. I was able to sleep and rest well and I feel so light and refreshed this morning. And just like our normal routine we have been at the homestead yesterday still monitoring the growth of our scotch bonnet peppers and other veggies here.



![4537.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23wMRgFBtHApphiwy9sBk4uyuU1shMgvyC6DGUasFf4op5Q6p9w77VeuAsxX26gGGutnk.jpg)


Even though we have had another downpour yesterday the challenge of tilling the ground still remains. We are yet to find labourers that will assist us in tilling the ground here so that we can start with planting the grains for this year's farming season.

![4789.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/Ep1XSffPVs4nWcsaBmQnLnyGtkMEgVjpXv93fRwJvdrzXPej4cJKf5H71QTg8YBzffP.jpg)

Farming here is just a hassle but since this is the only way place we get our meals from we have to endure with the challenges


![4796.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/Eos1n3o8mgutiyuyRC9poCQZifFEXJL9jZjRAwMLF6gBeBLDfJknsVEsL7Vtpwurhp8.jpg)

After a long period of delayed growth our scotch bonnet finally picked up and are doing very well now. 
First we harvested the corn planted within the pepper and that seems to give it space for more growth. Though we often engage in mixed cropping planting pepper and corn together or any other plant , it seems like peppers don't like growing along side other crops, they like to have all the space to themselves. And since it was equally a dry season this peppers witnessed a delayed growth not having sufficient water like they desire.

Mind you we carried out adequate irrigation here but still that didn't seam to be sufficient.


![4527.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23uQkH7GuQtzwxEFRddCazJuJ5XE4TG5eSg1Q7tBPgnveoonJmTwQibCXxAohn7WmPH3q.jpg)

From delayed growth now to delayed ripening. 
Having noticed this massive production for about a 3 weeks now it's noticeable that the pepper are also taking their time to start ripening.


Other specie of pepper here are getting ripe and being harvested but this scotch bonnet looked delayed in ripening. It has continued to produce more peppers and flowers while we anticipate when they will start getting ripe for harvest. We are not sure of what to do about this yet but will continue to watch and see how this plays out. 
It's not good to eat too many artificial foods hence it is better to allow this ripen on its own than look for any artificial ripening chemicals.

body.title: Plain palm dart butterfly
body.body: > Atop a cluster of soft pink flowers, a plain palm dart butterfly was enjoying a delicious breakfast in the quietest spot amidst the bustle of the world. She continued to enjoy her meal, unperturbed by my presence. Despite her calm demeanor, I remained wary because she didn't give any prior signal when she flew away. I took the opportunity to photograph this beautiful butterfly. I photographed this butterfly from a distance so as not to disturb her while she was eating.

> She enjoyed her breakfast quietly, not rushing or trying to steal attention. Yet, that was precisely where her uniqueness lay: a calmness about her. With slow movements, her proboscis explored every detail of the flower's petals, seeking out and savoring the sweet nectar produced by the flower. The butterfly's demeanor seemed to understand that life isn't always about moving fast. Sometimes it's necessary to pause and recharge our tired energy.

> However, it's also important to know that beneath her tiny body and calm demeanor lies a resilience that often goes unseen. The one who looks so beautiful today was once a disgusting caterpillar. She also slept in a narrow, dark place called a cocoon. After going through a complex phase, she emerged in a new form, winged and with thick feathers, as we see today.

body.title: A Samuray in Havana(en/es)
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfFg4rGw5sddMzFdYCUwkTNCdN4sYyaLppPJnsAhKYp7E/1777956295244.jpg)

✍️✍️ENGLISH VERSIÓN ✍️✍️


One day I read a post in a community that I found quite interesting, especially because of the topic it dealt with.

The article very fluently described the environment of a small park with a sculpture in the center.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcp6PfBcXmfFbPeMEJZsESHowakSunW5PRDrY4D6p48bS/1777956843881.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmefyN8c7LXEAcrGDgWUhBie37pM4qguRXk38UiE6Vnnxx/1777956844227.jpg)


Well, parks almost always have a sculpture around which the entire urban and social dynamic revolves, and in this one that unwritten rule is fulfilled.

I could continue expanding on the essence of this place, providing complementary data, but I already told you that in cast bronze it pays homage to the first Japanese who set foot on Cuban lands back in 1614. (17th century)

I was recently passing by the port avenue and I remembered a post about the aforementioned Nippon, which was not only recorded as a historical event, but also attests to the visit of a samurai to the Caribbean island.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdG4D87znqHPrXZCbPsew692uduHhQaWYPMwFhKFHRrjb/1777957019378.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeqMEV1sr1MQYPZhyiUWWGLe3sfqSCCtjK1NykzFvVtRb/1777957019683.jpg)

The samurai were very fearsome warriors in their time; Basically, they were a kind of royal squires or high dignitaries. For that, you have to review historical documents. In the Asian filmography of the seventies, there is quite a bit of reference to these ancient characters. It is true that the cinema magnified on a scale of myth and legend, to the point of creating a character who, despite being blind or having some visual limitation, cut a fly into four pieces with his sword or fought with half a battalion of well-prepared opponents without getting a scratch.

Sato Ichi was unsurpassed, and everyone commented: \

😃

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZc3wjisJhJu9suzmBSLxQ7bCPYarLrK7GaLAtcRYKhqt/1777957138162.jpg)

And I wonder: has this samurai from Avenida del Puerto met any of those extraordinary warriors, or has he fought with a clean sword? This swordsman from the land of the rising sun arrived in the emerging Cuban capital by chance, as he was going to Europe on a diplomatic mission, carrying an embassy to the kings of Spain on behalf of the Japanese emperor.

The galleon that was taking him to the old continent made a stopover in Havana port and gave the opportunity for the samurai ambassador to set foot on Cuban soil, being the oldest recorded history of making an appearance on the island.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSQgd1LLXRsyszFScX7BFBP5Hq5LzCxYYSja7eviJZpYL/1777957900463.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbHU9bFHt96DAir8FXaDd9tyMmKTpsTswUm6M2dCEuZ4Z/1777957900654.jpg)


The monument is simple and it unites the classic and modern, since the sculpture of the samurai in a life-size and quite realistic style, which rises on a modest pedestal, is located in the center of a circular structure, topped by segments of short walls, with slightly higher panels, but in a geometric style that gives it the spirit of modernity.

The samurai is represented standing, with his left hand near the hilt of the sword, while he raises his right hand in which he holds a classic fan, pointing in the distance, perhaps the place where he came from to fulfill his mission, from which he returned, as recorded on a tablet on one of the sides of the pedestal, seven years later.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmURP37yoWwXUNYfZAwmQFfhmGin9u6dTcLfVMNdb9imQd/1777958032968.jpg)

There it also says that the sculpture was donated by a junior high school in Japan on April 25, 2001, and was made by the sculptor Mizuko Tsuchura, to memorize the date on which Hasekura Tsuneranga (Samuray) united xonsua ambassador sandals two distant islands in the geography of the planet.

It really moved me to be in that place and see how in a simple monument the intention of perpetuating the spirit of brotherhood between peoples is condensed.
 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUeqX5zy3vDuYggFdgc8mfu59c2Kw5bGeX9uLuh1NvNRo/1777958117348.jpg)

A Samuray in Havana is also something exotic for the Cubans, no longer ok for those who do not know the history behind the image that from its well-cast bronze raises an arm to say: I come from there.

Thank you for coming with me to visit a place as interesting as this and to discover others.

✍️✍️VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL ✍️✍️

>Un día leí un post en una comunidad que me resultó bastante interesante, sobre todo por la temática que trataba.

>El artículo describía con mucho fluidez el entorno de un pequeño parquesito con una escultura en el centro.

>Bueno, casi siempre los parques tienen una escultura alrededor de la cual gira toda la dinámica urbanística y social, y en este se cumple esa regla no escrita.

>Podría seguir dilatando la esencia de este lugar, aportando datos complementarios, pero ya les digo que en bronce fundido rinde homenaje al primer japonés que pisó tierras cubanas allá por el año 1614. (S. XVII)

>Hace poco pasaba por la avenida del puerto y recordé un post sobre el susodicho Nipón, que no solo fue registrado como un acontecimiento histórico, sino que también da fe de la visita de un samurái a la isla del Caribe.

>Los samuráis fueron guerreros muy temibles en su época; básicamente, eran una especie de escuderos reales o de altos dignatarios. Para eso, hay que revisar documentos históricos. En la filmografía asiática de los años setenta, hay bastante referencia a esos personajes de la antigüedad. Es verdad que el cine magnificó a escala de mito y leyenda, al extremo de crear un personaje que, a pesar de ser ciego o de tener alguna limitación visual, cortaba con su espada una mosca en cuatro pedazos o se batía con medio batallón de contrarios bien preparados sin que le hicieran un rasguño.

>Sato Ichi fue insuperable, y todos comentaban: \

😃

>Y yo me pregunto: ¿y este samurái de la Avenida del Puerto habrá conocido a alguno de aquellos extraordinarios guerreros, o se habrá batido a espada limpia? Este espadachín de la tierra del sol naciente llegó a la incipiente capital cubana por casualidad, pues iba a Europa en misión diplomática, llevando una embajada a los reyes de España de parte del emperador japonés.

>El galeón que lo llevaba al viejo continente hizo escala en puerto habanero y dio la posibilidad de que el samurái embajador pisara tierra cubana, siendo el antecedente más antiguo registrado de hacer acto de presencia en la isla.

>El monumento es sencillo y en él se unen lo clásico y lo moderno, pues la escultura del samurái a tamaño natural y de estilo bastante realista, que se eleva sobre un modesto pedestal, está ubicada en el centro de una estructura circular, rematada por segmentos de muros bajitos, con paneles un poco más altos, pero en un estilo geometrizante que le aporta el espíritu de modernidad.

>El samurái está representado de pie, con la mano izquierda cerca de la empuñadura de la espada, mientras que levanta la mano derecha en la que sostiene un clásico abanico, señalando en la lejanía, quizás el lugar de donde vino para cumplir su misión, de la cual regresó, según consta en una tableta en una de las caras del pedestal, siete años después.

>Allí también reza que la escultura fue donada por una escuela secundaria básica de Japón el el 25 de abril de 2001, y fue realizada por el escultor Mizuko Tsuchura, para memorizar la fecha en  que  Hasekura Tsuneranga ( Samuray) unió xonsua sandalias de embajador dos islas  distantes en la geografía del planeta.

>A mí el realmente me conmovio estar en aquel sitio y ver como  en un sencillo monumento  se  condensa la  intención  de perpetuar el espiritu de hermandad entre los pueblos.
 
>Un Samuray en la Habana  no deja también de ser una cosa exotica or los cubanos , ya no uch ok más para los que desconocen la historia  que hay detrás  de la imagen que desde su bien fundido bronce levanta un brazo para decir : desde allá vengo.

>Gracias por venir conmigo a visitar un lugar tan interesante como este y a descubrir otros.

>Texto íntegro de mi autoría.  
Todos los derechos reservados.
