body.title: Los ojos y su hogar / Your Eyes and Your Home
body.body:
<center>

Dos ojos sin hogar,
entran dónde una pelota está,
se acercan con serenidad 
y se suben en ella para un rostro crear. 

La pelota se mueve contenta
y voltea un frasco que está cerca,
es de pintura fresca
y con ella una boca naranja crea. 

>Two homeless eyes,
find their way to where a ball lies,
approach calmly
and climb onto it to form a face.

>The ball moves happily
and knocks over a nearby jar,
filled with fresh paint,
and uses it to create an orange mouth.

![42166.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23tvuamb8GXYKH2Ph2b7xqrE9VqsH2FrM6sNTT2gyy5nzYQ47Ek8LKiXQYc9VpuyrBrvn.gif)

La pelota con ojos y boca se va,
llega donde unas plantas hay,
una flor se acerca para hablar
y le explica que aquí para ella no hay lugar. 

La pelota es insistente 
y la flor es de las que ayuda siempre 
la arrastra suavemente 
intenta subirla a una matera, pero no puede. 

>The ball with eyes and a mouth rolls away,
it comes to a spot where there are some plants,
a flower comes over to talk
and explains that there’s no room for it here.

>The ball is persistent,
and the flower is the kind that always helps,
it gently pulls it along,
trying to lift it into a planter, but it can’t.

![42167.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23u6G12dju2MWosm5EJi8czw9ckZANm7Sj3MipzyWit9nja4oioUYqdwy7mhJhHG9JxzC.gif)
 
Pasa un ciempiés por el lugar
y se acerca para ayudar,
entre los dos la pelota logran cargar
y la dejan sobre la matera de gris tonalidad. 

A los ojos no le gustan las alturas
y se lanzan al suelo con premura,
un nuevo lugar buscan,
en la misma maceta, pero a una baja altura.

>A centipede wanders by
and comes over to help,
together, they manage to carry the ball
and set it down on the gray flowerpot.

>They don’t like heights,
so they hurry down to the ground,
looking for a new spot
in the same pot, but lower down.

![42169.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23yToVTcs9czG9LY5ma8qCqkng6vxFqhv3M2vHkGxFUbaRJYwc7XMzotNzV74kx2VvGwb.gif)

Desde ahí todo observan
la mirada se ve muy bella,
encontraron una casa nueva
y a la altura perfecta. 

>From there, they can see everything;
the view is absolutely beautiful.
They found a new home
at just the right height. 

</center>

<center>
![InShot_20230630_124621147.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/EoAfYKqkd84fmD8iEEbc9Es3YuzFg1JTfQ4Hw7VLmJMMx3Db3HdE4WL8Y1yyd2Ms4vL.gif)

What's up, everyone!

I just want to share our simple bonding moment last night.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSyZvmjtaFo7xeK5FjzhWmsCuJ6jgw17pmy9duA9u7dPy/1777902277878.jpg)

Actually, we planned to go out last Sunday, but we decided to change the schedule.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZJGKikSZna4VZAqNvLwExhsmAybvf4eis4qX9NTpmDHU/1777902305293.jpg)

One of our friends, Nanaw, just got home from his trip. Or should I say, he just came back from visiting his girlfriend! Haha. 

Of course, he shared a lot of stories with us about how it went and what they did. 

It was nice to hear his updates and see him happy. 😆

And as usual, we couldn't stop teasing Kuya Danny! 

He is still looking for the love of his life. 😂

There is someone we know who is also looking for a future husband, but I think Kuya Danny is not interested. Haha.

He just said, \

But come on bro, nothing is impossible when it comes to love, right? Hahaha! 

We just kept on laughing and joking around the whole time. 🤣

We just bought some Red Horse beer and prepared some good \

. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdWqSPmNNahYZJDysGPtASVFzBCLQgpMhmT3xRMDDJyyK/1777902329531.jpg)

body.title: Unplanned Food Trip with Friends after a Successful Community Visit
body.body:
Greetings everyone. I hope you are having a wonderful day and always safe wherever you may be.

![Cold escape with friends_20260505_100519_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23xehjpZ73U1zBgZoQyDrqFfYYqDarpgkHYP9TkfTx6vxRANm19djZt22jy1SWE4vP8Tf.jpg)

As for me, I would say, I had a great day together with my friends. Like what others say, It would always be great when you are with the right people. The weather is so hot today but we always bring umbrellas to keep us protected and water to keep us hydrated. After our successful community visit, a couple invited us for some snacks because their house is just nearby. Since we are available, most of us agreed to go. I also love to visit their place because it feels cool and peaceful there.

![1777946436518_100132.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23wWxrkDg1mXCoNYxAK6rpTr1R6f4iHeU7dRLsyfK3KSfWv7sDR4PwctS72VAnWWAG74L.jpg)

I felt so excited to learn that they were making banana turon, it is a popular Filipino street food and dessert with saba bananas and brown sugar wrapped in spring roll wrappers. It is deep-fried until golden and usually caramelized with brown sugar. But as for our version, we no longer caramelized it from the outside.

![1777859060250_104729.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23ywqKamomyKqyNYxZ6gyXhXxTvNrL84Mb5iSEgNz9TLkdgcuS7dBgvdqmnAjZoequni4.jpg)

![1777859060284_104850.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23zGYWr2p7LhFdVJDaEHVvrvjZqjUpzxAbsct6prmWrQrxH6EQyC9Wz8mrYuYSZB2DY6C.jpg)

When I came, they were almost done wrapping everything and gonna start frying. 

While frying outside, we also took time chatting and telling funny stories. But my eyes are set at the banana turon, I am truly craving to eat some. I guess, I am not the only who is excited to eat as all of us gathered outside cheering up the other girls who are frying.

![1777859060114_104220.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23wgPvLabXECxPi2ExhWJB7Q1Ke8pcUqi6G6mzE2yfMNBdYWiVGvCjZV5skyJLB2ujPxu.jpg)

As soon as we were done frying, we started to dig in after saying a prayer of thanks. Oh as expected it was truly yummy. The banana is already ripe which totatally matched the saltiness of the wrapper. Plus, I just learned that it would taste more delicious if you put some margarine and sprinkle white sugar. Oh, I would say, it was not enough. The plate was emptied in just few minutes.

But I am grateful that I got to eat my cravings and we just agreed that we will make banana turon again in another time.
It is also funny because we just planned to stay for some snacks but the invitation was extended. We were offered to stay for lunch so we stayed. We agreed to have pancit and stewed beans for lunch. 

![1777859059856_094517.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23tbu3go1DRgV9nqUYdEMUTvPrVKNjKqeUwHfyY8Pkkxy8cLn94U8xuX5vfqSm95phpuY.jpg)

It was kind of nice though. Well I guess, nobody wants to go home yet, we all wanted to stay and enjoy more the company. Regardless how simple the meal may be, what we appreciate is the great company. We love being together. As we helped with the preparations we also laughed at each other stories. It was also time for us to encourage one another during this difficult times and I considered it a rest from my routine activities at home. This are the kind of people I want to be always with and being with them makes me feel relaxed, comforting and fun. I hope we always get to meet such kind of friends

Thanks for reading. Until next time. Love, Nes

Photos are mine and edited with Canva.

body.title: A Stunning Encounter with my Tiny Yellow Visitor
body.body: >A Golden Moment in the Garden

>💛 🦋 💛 🦋 💛 🦋 💛 🦋 💛 🦋 💛 🦋 💛 🦋 💛 🦋 💛 🦋 💛 🦋 💛 🦋 💛

Today was a very quiet and beautiful day. I was relaxing in my backyard, swinging slowly on my hammock. The large avocado tree above me provided a nice, cool shade. As I swayed, I spotted something bright on the ground. I have a tiny yellow visitor today. A tiny yellow butterfly was hovering over the concrete path. It looked like a small piece of floating sunshine against the gray ground. It would land for a second and then flap its wings again. I really wanted to capture its beauty, so I grabbed my camera. I tried to move closer to get a good photo. But every time I took a single step, the little butterfly would get scared and fly away. It was like a game of tag that I could not win 😁 I eventually stayed very still and used my zoom lens to see it better. Here is what I noticed about my small friend, First is its bright color. Its wings are very vibrant, sunny yellow. It's so noticeable against the dull gray path. There were tiny patterns. When it sits still, you can see tiny, faint brown spots on the underside of its wings. It has dark edges. When it opens its wings to fly, there is a thin black border along the very top edges. It has very long, delicate antennae and tiny legs that help it balance on the rough rocks. Even though it was hard to get close, watching the butterfly was the best part of my afternoon. It reminded me to slow down and notice the small things. Sometimes, you just have to sit still and let nature come to you. 🦋

Sucks that it also happend to you! 

My guess was that I was flagged because I was transfering in a pattern and being not smart enough to hold the balance for a while so that labelled it suspicious of money laundry. 

Unfortunately life demands me to rebalance all my investments (including some of my Hive) - therefore I was simply using this pattern: 
- Hive wallet => deposit into Mexc => sell for usdc => transfer into CB => sell for Euro => withdraw Euro. 
- Funds were less than 2 min on Mexc after funds being tradable (that is my mistake I guess). 

Customer support asked me to provide info on source of the deposit and purpose of the deposit, aswell as info on the receipient. Because my KYC info on CB and Mexc was the same - that got cleared. But I was not able to convince them that this hive account is the same owner as the Mexc account (while they use facial recognition and my recent photos are all over my running blog - but it is not kyc-ed). I tried with countless different attempts to provide them the info they wanted but each time 6-8h wait and “please resummit” with stated issue “cannot verify source and purpose of deposits”. 

As there are 0 dodgy transactions on my MEXC account. I just used it as an exit route and had less than $100 on futures to play around. This feels random and risky for hive as why/how should we proof where the funds is coming from (on an exchange that doesn’t even need kyc itself) and when you provide real info and you still get frozen - what can you do with a company that has been officially been desolved in 2024 in amd from the Seychellen. 

My loss here is a route and <100$ so it sucks as now my total fees are +/- 4% higher. But my risk is somewhat lower.

body.title: [ENG/ESP] A holiday filled with breathtaking scenery and solutions that arrive just in time
body.body: > **Today I’m back to work, because my days off have come to an end and the routine is calling me back with a vengeance. I wish you all a great day and a prosperous week; mine, I assure you, will be packed with activity from early on. That’s just the nature of this job we carry out with responsibility and care, always attentive to any detail that might arise in the hotels and in the services we provide. I want to tell you that yesterday, Monday, taking advantage of the fact that it was a holiday here in Margarita, we decided to visit a friend who recently had knee surgery. We wanted to see her, find out how she was doing, and spend some time with her. She is one of those people who, even when in pain, remains in good spirits and keeps the conversation pleasant. Being at her house was comforting, as always. As we were talking, he mentioned something that caught our attention: at a shop called Autorepuesto JJ 2013 C.A., located in Juangriego, in the municipality of Marcano, they had some parts we needed for our car. His car is similar to ours, so he was familiar with the type of parts and knew they might have them there. That information was just what we needed, because we’d been wondering for days where to get those parts without having to order them from the mainland. When our visit ended, we headed to Juangriego, wondering if the shop would be open. Even though it was a holiday, some locally owned businesses often open for half a day, so it was worth a try. We took the Portachuelo road, which is always a pleasant and quick route to get to that area.**

> *Ya hoy sí me toca volver a trabajar, porque los días de descanso llegaron a su fin y la rutina vuelve a llamar con fuerza. Les deseo un día genial y una semana próspera; la mía, se los aseguro, estará llena de actividad desde temprano. Así es este oficio que llevamos con responsabilidad y cariño, siempre atentos a cualquier detalle que pueda surgir en los hoteles y en los servicios que prestamos. Quiero contarles que ayer lunes, aprovechando que era feriado aquí en Margarita, decidimos visitar a una amiga que hace poco fue operada de una rodilla. Queríamos verla, saber cómo seguía y acompañarla un rato. Ella es de esas personas que, aun con molestias, conserva el buen ánimo y la conversación agradable. Estar en su casa fue reconfortante, como siempre. Mientras hablábamos, nos comentó algo que nos llamó la atención; en un local llamado Autorepuesto JJ 2013 C.A, ubicado en Juangriego, municipio Marcano, había unos repuestos que nosotros necesitábamos para nuestro auto. Su carro es parecido al nuestro, así que conocía bien el tipo de piezas y sabía que allí podían tenerlas. Esa información nos cayó como anillo al dedo, porque llevábamos días pensando en dónde conseguir esos repuestos sin tener que pedirlos a tierra firme. Al terminar la visita, salimos rumbo a Juangriego con la duda de si el local estaría abierto. Aunque era feriado, algunos negocios propios suelen abrir media jornada, así que valía la pena intentarlo. Tomamos la vía Portachuelo, que siempre es un camino agradable y rápido para llegar a esa zona.*
![z.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23xVM9TF3ZYTHj5GaBZAS5sG4KJqJZYxG4P3b4YDr1kPqZsDkpmHKeCZYo2PbNweiFScL.jpg) ![y (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep7seUEBMLWp5SPLviAVRBCJijQxhvyMDfuABMEZy598QQpY7XdRqBXnHJTQuvGCpeW.jpg) ![y (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep3dGztxCEXzdXEFPRsq8ARx5z2Us4xbmodbyUVmzhU4kT37nSeg9RSpwznsHJBYD3j.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-04_22-25-32.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EnoJgR6NDj4ej4NQutwzBpApBHYEFcUQCx1CLE7vcSSd8iW4fxjQdFnnvNDASsqYcwx.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-04_22-25-31.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqWjuDNEMxqVQAgejcV8ttgN9mBqP6hnGnbnq2Fiv4uAkqrVhhPCCjGGqnLaVNP6zwo.jpg)

> **The sky was clear, with bright sunshine illuminating the hills in the distance. The natural and urban landscapes looked radiant, as if they, too, were enjoying the day off. Driving through Santana and Tacarigua always feels special to me; their streets, their people, their colors—everything has a unique charm. I, of course, didn’t miss the chance to capture a few moments with my camera, because every corner of Margarita has a story to tell.**

> *El clima estaba despejado, con un sol brillante que iluminaba los cerros a lo lejos. Los paisajes naturales y urbanos se veían radiantes, como si también estuvieran disfrutando del día libre. Atravesar Santana y Tacarigua siempre me resulta especial; sus calles, su gente, sus colores, todo tiene un encanto particular. Yo, por supuesto, no perdí la oportunidad de capturar algunos momentos con mi lente, porque cada rincón de Margarita tiene algo que contar.*
![photo_2026-05-04_22-57-23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep3duNNzoqVeHdpAHByUuXzLCRnXqcrGzZBwXwSU4KNsjteUFqMXywpgKePGz8Y8ZaF.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-04_22-25-37.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EprS9dBMzXVRmpdSbAYxHuznNYwPsQ2Dn2JWbrkkEKW5vRZuKXWsvaXhEbjk2VkW5AX.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-04_22-25-36 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq3666BQu7odG7P4ykm2pLbJ6FiCA3CnxmdrrSwpQ7TCoaFbfTwVCJF9cau1M3Zvg6K.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-04_22-25-29 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpGPnGByFEf9kai46zTsq3DoGJcCvpUSmGUbnQXZsmP9Bsdzov398LC1uptj4QxwyZL.jpg)
> **Amid the breeze, sunshine, and scenic views, we arrived at the shop our friend had recommended. To our surprise and relief, it was open. We felt the trip had been worth it.**

> *Entre brisa, sol y paisajes llegamos al negocio que nos había recomendado nuestra amiga. Para nuestra sorpresa y alivio estaba abierto. Sentimos que el viaje había valido la pena.*
![photo_2026-05-04_22-25-29.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EogNkLjAvcNwYfEWwUB5Ui48hZBypy9arUnPrzHR3pT7f9qVi3tGTLFa3vPuKTrUYzP.jpg)

> **The man who helped us, Oscar, welcomed us very warmly. Best of all, he actually had the part we were looking for—and in several different brands, too. He patiently explained the differences between each one and suggested which one would be best for us. Interestingly, it matched the recommendation another mechanic had given us a few days earlier, so that gave us even more confidence. My husband, satisfied with the explanation, paid for the parts, and we set off to return home. Having those parts is essential for building the other engine, and that made him very happy. He had thought he would have to order them from off the island, so finding them here was a huge relief.**

> *El señor que atendía, Oscar, nos recibió con mucha amabilidad. Lo mejor de todo es que sí tenía el repuesto que buscábamos, y además de varias marcas. Nos explicó con paciencia las diferencias entre cada una y nos sugirió cuál era la más conveniente. Curiosamente, coincidía con la recomendación que otro mecánico nos había dado días atrás, así que eso nos dio aún más seguridad. Mi esposo, satisfecho con la explicación, pagó los repuestos y nos dispusimos a regresar. Tener esas piezas es fundamental para armar el otro motor, y eso lo puso muy contento. Él pensaba que tendría que mandarlas a pedir fuera de la isla, así que encontrarlas aquí fue un alivio enorme.*
![z.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoyQ1c9WiWEVnnnLD7XBKf9a3L7S5WmEApymGnBsrWpLeenkw8eaccnqJW4dNz9iDfW.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-04_22-25-27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23vsLA1BC6B5FU1GBc9sPhMC3E8rN1gJXYJWM7eTiGkX8sqWxkyMqXLiKYqSNr5xBFGtC.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-04_22-25-26.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoiUoDviPprZaM5qNnzhHZQHdHECPxFivxEYQLAoqxaLbAqh72XgSyc9p7ZSpewZaNB.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-04_22-25-25 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoGxWJ8UANrYkQhc2UT5cjGYLvXy4v5ksVQQKt5aSefMZPGP9xoYJePst9zvdXPKBwa.jpg)

> **We left Juangriego, bidding farewell to its majestic hills, which seemed to escort us on our way back. We took the Portachuelo road again and continued on until we reached home, where a well-deserved rest awaited us before returning to work.**

> *Salimos de Juangriego despidiéndonos de sus cerros imponentes, que parecían escoltarnos en el camino de vuelta.  Retomamos la vía Portachuelo y seguimos hasta llegar a casa, donde nos esperaba el merecido descanso antes de retomar la jornada laboral.*
![photo_2026-05-04_22-57-27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq7LuZcQJEbEMd73JYrdycvMJCMbRCe6uF7x6mfAC7Xp76D6ztuT7qfEG6yHoBc8zhQ.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-04_22-57-26.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqFr6t2nt6eoQ1kNURzs4qC3DxWRkYiAQXWrC4VZpvnYGLPEPAZGXiHyPoEqy4ZET93.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-04_22-57-25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq36ZNxFG6kcCvxWMziEpPEdqsGdrqV6abZh7hYfWLowbhn5XTz13CC6Q1mMwpoKMNJ.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-04_22-25-23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpT48Rhjea1VxCVWaAP9UDaz3vhS7V1MhnY3cqL9kBBQ4vp7bpBWBE7Lus6SdBS9GVs.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-04_22-25-22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq5BbK1ZmqnEceSh7csSRzvQR6EWXDrGykmW1cSSrnm7mhQfvwEJe7hs7cXFKS9FZEc.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-04_22-25-21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EprRdUqrvga7gi5S8nRVGe1YVxJvRsmfhxfz5pQfctYBRPerqKrjLTraSjhDYRgXYzJ.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-04_22-25-20 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqQN71Z9uKXfBiEcrfzJxzbEKZDCKvaFi5GomCYU7YWvoZG9imbUMyzyVcQkkZwRXfr.jpg)

body.title: May Day Y'all
body.body: /> Here in the US, we have us a Labor Day in September because the federal government was afraid that if we celebrated May Day here, it wouldn't be good for them or their fat cat patrons.
/> The fat cats have had a stranglehold on politicians and working people for far too long here, which might have something to do with the record levels of inequality.
/> _The worker bees might have something to say about that. . ._
/> Despite the well-to-do and the well intoxicated folks fixation on horses running in ovals, hundreds turned out for multiple events marking May Day here in Louisville on Friday.

/> The unions and our local Democratic Socialists of American chapter put one on at Injustice Square Park downtown, followed shortly after by one at the Louisville Tool Library put together by the Party for Socialism & Liberation and an assortment of other groups.
/> There was also a 'Bread and Roses Gala' that yours truly skipped out on, the two were more than enough food, fun, music and speeches for one day.
/> Especially with the street photography extravaganza that is the Kentucky Derby the very next day.
/> As much as anything, the day's festivities were about building community, solidarity. _Same thing really._

/> Was by far the most people that'd partook in May Day here in many years, seems the community building efforts are starting to bear fruit. _The regime's sundry transgressions may have thrown napalm on the fire as well._
/> It's curious how people's participation ebbs and flows. Not just with politics either, the same plays out here on HIVE.
/> _Well, except it's the good times that greens this place up, whereas it's the lean times that turns May Day into a riot._
/> Friday wasn't anything like a riot, closer to a block party.
/> Solidarity, and happy May Day y'all!

body.title: No Mood, But Still Showing Up 💪✨ / Sin Ganas, Pero Aquí Estamos 💪✨
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVd1Pd7G9yotcJkzLgvNvcWorSKy3hmAEZAfJepPnq1mz/IMG_7598.jpg 

Honestly, today I didn’t feel like going to the gym at all. I was tired, low on energy, and my mind kept looking for excuses to just stay home. But deep down, I knew that showing up was the best decision I could make for myself. Because it’s not always about feeling motivated… it’s about doing what you know is right, even when you don’t feel like it.

Once I got there and started moving, everything slowly changed. The tiredness didn’t completely disappear, but my mindset did. I felt stronger for not giving up, for choosing discipline over comfort. These are the days that really count — the ones where you show up even when it’s hard.

I may have arrived without ganas, but I’m leaving proud of myself. Because even when we feel tired, taking care of ourselves is always worth it. And today was one of those quiet victories that mean so much. 💖✨

>La verdad hoy no tenía ganas de iniciar en el gym. Estaba cansada, sin tanta energía, y mi mente buscaba cualquier excusa para quedarme en casa. Pero en el fondo sabía que venir era lo mejor para mí. Porque no siempre se trata de tener motivación… se trata de hacer lo que sabes que te hace bien, incluso cuando no tienes ganas.

>Ya estando aquí y empezando a moverme, poco a poco todo cambió. El cansancio no desapareció por completo, pero mi actitud sí. Me sentí más fuerte por no rendirme, por elegir la disciplina en lugar de la comodidad. Estos son los días que más cuentan — cuando vienes incluso cuando cuesta.

>Tal vez llegué sin ganas, pero me voy orgullosa de mí. Porque aunque estemos cansadas, cuidarnos siempre vale la pena. Y hoy fue una de esas pequeñas victorias que significan mucho. 💖✨

body.title: 😝National Weather Observers Day! / ¡Día Nacional de los Observadores Meteorológicos! 😎
body.body: > A weather observer is a person authorized by a meteorological authority to record weather observations. Weather stations and local broadcasters around the world use them to provide the public with the latest and most accurate weather information. Their work in the field of meteorology is of utmost importance, which is why ***National Weather Observer Day*** was created. > Un observador meteorológico es una persona autorizada por una autoridad meteorológica para registrar observaciones meteorológicas . Las estaciones meteorológicas y las emisoras locales de todo el mundo los utilizan para brindar a la población la información meteorológica más reciente y precisa. Su labor en el campo de la meteorología es de suma importancia, razón por la cual se creó el ***Día Nacional del Observador Meteorológico.*** This holiday is celebrated on May 4th each year and pays tribute to those who look after everyone's well-being. National Weather Observers Day was created by Alan Brue in 1989 to honor weather observers, both amateur and professional, and to celebrate the weather. > Esta festividad se celebra el 4 de mayo de cada año y rinde homenaje a quienes velan por el bienestar de todos. El Día Nacional de los Observadores Meteorológicos fue creado por Alan Brue en 1989 para honrar a los observadores meteorológicos, tanto aficionados como profesionales, y para celebrar el clima. ***Some facts***: - If the autumn weather is mild, then the spiders in your house will be larger. - Every minute, 2,000 thunderstorms form on Earth. - In July 2001, the rain in Kerala, India, was red. - A thunderstorm can produce winds exceeding 160 kilometers per hour. - Forest fires can create a phenomenon known as fire whirls. These are essentially fire tornadoes. Some frogs begin croaking loudly before it starts to rain. - In 1684, the River Thames froze for two consecutive months. - Blackouts are dust storms that have become mixed with soil. - Worms can often sense when a flood is approaching. > *Algunos datos*: Si el clima otoñal es templado, entonces las arañas en casa serán más grandes. -Cada minuto, se forman 2.000 tormentas eléctricas en la Tierra . En julio de 2001, la lluvia en Kerala, India , era roja. -Una tormenta eléctrica puede producir vientos superiores a los 160 kilómetros por hora. -Los incendios forestales pueden crear un fenómeno conocido como remolinos de fuego. Estos son, esencialmente, tornados de fuego. Algunas ranas comienzan a croar ruidosamente antes de que empiece a llover. -En 1684, el río Támesis se congeló durante dos meses seguidos. Las ventiscas negras son tormentas de polvo que se han mezclado con tierra. -Los gusanos a menudo pueden presentir cuándo se acerca una inundación. https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thealliance/SszMQ6lq-thealliance20new20pagebreak.png ## Family Time!

> ![theallianceaddamsamily.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thealliance/Eo1xNsyU9Q6SticGggzUC7xpkcWk5kDPPA4jxXtRSJGrwXNYeTqbZEsruByRn4MkSey.gif) Well hey there, did ya miss us? We missed you! So much, in fact, that we have rescheduled our 'Family Time' to Fridays and we hope to see you there! Join our lovely band of outcasts, normies, goofballs, pimps, degenerates, professionals and all things within and without and betwixt and between starting **6 pm CST/ 7 pm EST**. We always try to have a little fun and and if you're paying attention, a few smiles might just be shared. We like to smile. We like to laugh. We realize that life isn't all about the important things like #politics, #religion and #sex, no, it's about the time spent, the experiences had and memories made. Memories get passed on, experiences are shared and time - time is the currency we spend to acquire them. > Bueno, hola, ¿nos extrañaste? ¡Te extrañamos! De hecho, tanto, que hemos reprogramado nuestro 'Tiempo en familia' para los viernes ¡y esperamos verte allí! Únase a nuestra encantadora banda de marginados, normativos, tontos, proxenetas, degenerados, profesionales y todo lo relacionado con dentro y fuera y entre y a partir de **6 p.m. CST/ 7 p.m. EST**. Siempre tratamos de divertirnos un poco y, si estás prestando atención, es posible que compartamos algunas sonrisas. Nos gusta sonreír. Nos gusta reír. Nos damos cuenta de que la vida no se trata solo de cosas importantes como la #política, la #religión y el #sexo, no, se trata del tiempo invertido, las experiencias vividas y los recuerdos creados. Los recuerdos se transmiten, las experiencias se comparten y el tiempo... el tiempo es la moneda que gastamos para adquirirlos. It just may be worth your time to [visit the Castle](https://discord.gg/EpyXNyh) and come check us out. Unlike the 'Addams Family' shows, all of this is live, unrehearsed and not recorded before any audience. Funny things happen. Sad things happen. Smiles and tears get shared. Worries and hopes are passed around. Sometimes, we even eat #pizza, cake and ice cream. Sometimes, we watch movies. Sometimes, giant insects attack the microphones and we have to get out our silly swatters and smack 'em up so we have something to snack on because the popcorn got eaten already by little slugs that left slimy trails everywhere and made the sidewalks slippery so that the pancakes didn't get enough traction on our canoes to steer the spaceships. Exactly. > Puede que valga la pena dedicar tiempo a [visitar el castillo](https://discord.gg/EpyXNyh) y venir a vernos. A diferencia de los shows de 'La Familia Addams', todo esto es en vivo, sin ensayar y no grabado ante ninguna audiencia. Suceden cosas divertidas. Suceden cosas tristes. Se comparten sonrisas y lágrimas. Se transmiten preocupaciones y esperanzas. A veces, incluso comemos #pizza, tarta y helado. A veces vemos películas. body.title: Pink Flowers on the Road [ENG|ESP]
body.body: > Hello everyone. Today I want to share some photos of flowers I found this morning. I had just finished training at one of the parks in my area and was walking back home. It was still early when I noticed some vines growing near the street. # The pink color of the flowers stood out clearly against the gray of the asphalt and the rusty metal nearby. It is an interesting contrast that you don't always see in the middle of the city. I decided to stop for a moment and take several shots to document what I saw. # I think that in the daily rush we usually ignore these things. The texture of the petals looks different next to the hard surfaces of the street, and that caught my attention from a photographic point of view. I used my phone to capture the images, as the morning light was clear enough to show the colors as they were. # I share these photos here because they were the highlight of my walk back. Sometimes a simple detail like this changes the environment of a regular route. I hope you find the images interesting. # Without anything more to add, I bid farewell. Stay tuned for future posts! Until next time!

> Hola a Todos. Hoy quiero compartir unas fotos de unas flores que encontré esta mañana. Acababa de terminar de entrenar en uno de los parques de mi zona y caminaba de regreso a casa. Aún era temprano cuando noté unas enredaderas que crecían cerca de la calle. # El color rosado de las flores resaltaba claramente sobre el gris del asfalto y el metal oxidado que había cerca. Es un contraste interesante que no siempre se ve en medio de la ciudad. Decidí detenerme un momento y hacer varias tomas para documentar lo que vi. # Creo que con el ajetreo diario solemos ignorar estas cosas. La textura de los pétalos se ve distinta junto a las superficies duras de la calle, y eso me llamó la atención desde el punto de vista fotográfico. Usé mi celular para capturar las imágenes, ya que la luz de la mañana era lo suficientemente clara para mostrar los colores tal como eran. # Comparto estas fotos por aquí porque fueron lo más destacado de mi caminata de regreso. A veces un detalle simple como este cambia el entorno de una ruta común. Espero que las imágenes les resulten interesantes. # Sin más que agregar me despido, estén atentos a los próximos post. ¡Hasta la Próxima! ------ ---- |

body.title: Drawing Sukuna, the strongest Sorcerer, and Satoru Gojo, characters from the anime Jujutsu Kaisen(eng-spn)
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1777957192578-c8685d1c2ef816d0.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=dominic1/921defb6)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=dominic1/921defb6)


---

Hello Hive friends! We're back again to draw **Sukuna**, the strongest Sorcerer and King of Curses, a human or demon leader with two faces and four arms, considered a walking disaster. But this time we won't just be drawing him; we'll also be drawing **Satoru Gojo**.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23tmL4uCzCYikNsHsN6JhfNc7Ywr9MF7ttJArFqbuByN4N41APxzLgrvx4L9PJYr5gC2z.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23tSckuWMa6ZDAFU8WWnFNNWweQkXipC98VXwH2z7oHn3w5SYveUZQc4FeJRU4DorowYL.png)

In the drawing, I'll depict them both in a battle where **Sukuna** faces **Satoru Gojo** and cuts him in half in a brutal fight. Sukuna is in the body of one of Satoru Gojo's students. Satoru Gojo then confronts Sukuna to free his student and remove him from Sukuna's body, but Satoru Gojo is unsuccessful because Sukuna defeats him in hand-to-hand combat that lasts eight hours.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23tmN64UvWUkXmyKMK8pTyj9vimmqokSn8KH3boPwaUcqR5kcow7hz95ZtoUojLNmRXkG.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23tSYuNX3rV8LqauRBSoQQUCXwSoRAAD7xaLgzfYKBqonH338VzeNwbTLHqPYKTfo2n8t.png)

In this fight, Sukuna takes over the student's body, and this student has the ability to summon Mahoraga. In other words, it's three fighters against one. That's why Satoru Gojo, despite having a lot of power and territory, lost and was cut down. Half because **Sukuna** died on December 24th, her birthday.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23tSYcUGY2VYo2T7i5jJndzcv813srWYxQ1UohiFhZ9yuK7YpN73af8oJV6hBToAZLYbH.png)

Watch the video and I'll show you how I made this drawing, using a step-by-step tutorial I saw on TikTok as a reference.

https://vt.tiktok.com/ZS9XT2wq1/

___

*Photos taken with a Redmi 13 phone
Video recorded with a Redmi 13 phone and edited with Capcut
Free music from Capcut
Used Google Translate*

____

### ESPAÑOL

Hola amiguitos de Hive nuevamente vamos a dibujar a **Sukuna**, el Hechicero mas fuerte y Rey de las maldiciones un líder humano o demonio con dos caras y cuatro brazos, considerado un desastre andante pero esta vez no lo dibujaremos solo a él, también dibujaremos a **Satoru Gojo** .


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23tmL4uCzCYikNsHsN6JhfNc7Ywr9MF7ttJArFqbuByN4N41APxzLgrvx4L9PJYr5gC2z.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23tSckuWMa6ZDAFU8WWnFNNWweQkXipC98VXwH2z7oHn3w5SYveUZQc4FeJRU4DorowYL.png)

En el dibujo los presentaré a ambos en una batalla donde **Sukuna** se enfrenta a **Satoru Gojo** y lo corta a la mitad en una cruel pelea. Sukuna está en el cuerpo de uno de los estudiantes de **Satoru Gojo** .y entonces **Satoru Gojo** se enfretan a **Sukuna** para lograr liberar a su estudiante y sacarlo del cuerpo de **Sukuna** pero **Satoru Gojo** no pudo hacerlo porque **Sukuna** lo derrotó en el combate cuerpo a cuerpo que duró ocho horas.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23tmN64UvWUkXmyKMK8pTyj9vimmqokSn8KH3boPwaUcqR5kcow7hz95ZtoUojLNmRXkG.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23tSYuNX3rV8LqauRBSoQQUCXwSoRAAD7xaLgzfYKBqonH338VzeNwbTLHqPYKTfo2n8t.png)

En esta pelea **Sukuna** se apodera del cuerpo del estudiante y este estudiante tiene la habilidad de invocar a **Mahoraga** es decir son tres luchadores contra uno, por eso **Satoru Gojo** a pesar de tener mucho y poder y territorio perdió y fue cortado a la mitad por **Sukuna** muriendo el 24 de diciembre, el día de su cumpleaños.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23tSYcUGY2VYo2T7i5jJndzcv813srWYxQ1UohiFhZ9yuK7YpN73af8oJV6hBToAZLYbH.png)


Vean el video y les mostraré cómo hice este dibujo tomando como referencia un paso a paso que vi en tik tok

Satoru Gojo then confronts Sukuna to free his student and remove him from Sukuna's body, but Satoru Gojo is unsuccessful because Sukuna defeats him in hand-to-hand combat that lasts eight hours.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23tmN64UvWUkXmyKMK8pTyj9vimmqokSn8KH3boPwaUcqR5kcow7hz95ZtoUojLNmRXkG.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23tSYuNX3rV8LqauRBSoQQUCXwSoRAAD7xaLgzfYKBqonH338VzeNwbTLHqPYKTfo2n8t.png)

In this fight, Sukuna takes over the student's body, and this student has the ability to summon Mahoraga. In other words, it's three fighters against one. That's why Satoru Gojo, despite having a lot of power and territory, lost and was cut down. Half because **Sukuna** died on December 24th, her birthday.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23tSYcUGY2VYo2T7i5jJndzcv813srWYxQ1UohiFhZ9yuK7YpN73af8oJV6hBToAZLYbH.png)

Hola amiguitos de Hive nuevamente vamos a dibujar a **Sukuna**, el Hechicero mas fuerte y Rey de las maldiciones un líder humano o demonio con dos caras y cuatro brazos, considerado un desastre andante pero esta vez no lo dibujaremos solo a él, también dibujaremos a **Satoru Gojo** .


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23tmL4uCzCYikNsHsN6JhfNc7Ywr9MF7ttJArFqbuByN4N41APxzLgrvx4L9PJYr5gC2z.png)

title.body: Felicitaciones mi estimada amiga por este excelente texto. Son muchos los intentos que a lo largo de la historia de la Literatura y el Arte se han hecho de definir la Poesía, tan inefable ella y tan grandiosa. No obstante entre las ideas más profundas que yo he leído acerca de la praxis poética se encuenta la expresada por Eliseo Diego cuando hablando de su función y la de los poetas es \

y de una manera trascendente porque persigue precisamente la utopía de intentar decir con palabras lo que las palabras (yo diría que excepto las poéticas) no alcanzan a decir en todo su esplendor o en todo su horror o angustia. Por eso cada vez que tengo la dicha de leerme un poema que diga tanto incluso sin recurrir al hermetismo o a la sobrecarga de metáforas sino con imágenes profundas, elocuentes y coloquiales, quedo mudo de admiración y reconocimiento. Gracias por iluminarnos con la brillantez de la Poesía.

title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1777956708406-f511d9e9af35d00a.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=mes/863a9706)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=mes/863a9706)


---

In #MESExperiments 54, I showcase the amazing SpillNot centripetal waiter's tray, whose circular motion can balance a cup of water without spilling it over, even while performing a full 360 degrees upside down! The SpillNot works on the principle that circular motion involves a centripetal force that brings the tray back towards the centre of the circular motion — this results in the cup of water experiencing a normal force far directly onto the tray, which far exceeds the downwards force due to gravity. The most astonishing part is that even a straw placed in the cup barely even experiences any slight nudge as it moves at rapid speeds. I also place my phone in the tray with both front selfie camera and rear camera views to further illustrate this amazing phenomenon!  

#physics #experiment #centripetalforce #inertia 

Stay tuned for #MESExperiments 55...

Wheels and Sea Salt: Sundays of Freedom at Playa El Agua
There’s no better way to wrap up the week than by swapping routine for the constant motion of skating along the seashore. What started as a simple curiosity has turned into my new favorite hobby: exploring Margarita Island on roller skates. This activity not only allows me to rediscover the landscapes of my home from a different perspective, but it has also become the perfect excuse to strengthen bonds with incredible friends.

Our tours have already taken us through different parts of the island, from the streets of Pampatar to the main avenues, but there’s something magnetic about Sundays on skates. It’s the day when the pace slows down, the traffic clears, and the sea breeze accompanies us with every push.

The Review: Gliding Among Palm Trees
This Sunday’s plan had an unbeatable setting: El Agua Beach. Meeting up there with the group of friends, adjusting our skates, and feeling that first glide across the pavement while listening to the waves in the background is a revitalizing experience.

The most fun part of skating in a group around the island is the shared energy. It’s not just about speed or technique, but about the laughter, the music playing in the background, and the strategic stops to hydrate and enjoy the scenery. At Playa El Agua, the route feels cinematic; the palm trees seem to fly by in fast motion, and the Sunday atmosphere provides that touch of relaxation we all need before the week begins.



---

title.title: My additional source of income came from tutoring.
title.body: > https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRnyAPCuRsYXyZBvgd762v2TbCU7B1kH1sVRSnpCH5tV9/1000068661.png Hello friends, I hope you are doing well. Welcome to my new post. In our country, I am a child of a middle-class family. It becomes quite difficult for boys like us to meet the education expenses when we live in the city. I went to the city to study. I still remember when I was studying in the first year of my honors, my family gave me money. As a result, I was able to study that year. I had a pretty good time but sometimes there were many family problems. When I was in the second year of my honors, my parents could not give me much money due to my family. Due to which it turned out that the cost of living in my hostel in the second year of my honors increased quite a lot. I was in a lot of debt at that time. Sometimes I felt very sad. I felt like my studies might stop here. However, I used to see some older brothers in my hostel who did a lot of things besides studying. I learned a lot from them. I used to see that they used to tutor small children in the morning. They used to go to the homes of those small children and teach them. As a result, they would get money. Then I called a friend of mine and asked him to find some tuition for me. After a month, he found a tuition for me which was the first tuition of my life. I started teaching a small child there for 3000 taka per month. That child was a student of class five. Thus I started my first tuition. After which I got another tuition and along with my studies, I started earning good money from there. From then on, I reduced the amount of money I took from my home quite a lot. Sometimes I did not take money, but when it was time for my semester fee, I would take a little money from my home. This pressure on me at home had reduced a lot. But it was very good for me. But now I have got quite a bit more tuition due to which now I have stopped taking money from my home completely. I run quite a lot of my hostel expenses with this money. Actually life takes us to a stage where we have to suffer a lot and work hard through which we achieve success. There was a lot like this in my life. Where I was unsure whether I would be able to move forward with my studies. I hope you like our post, thank you all. ![1000019308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRW9rHroSFBSAKdERxzaNWNAnWKCXRUdrHF4LbDABXrT6/1000019308.png) --- Divce | realmi c67 -|-| Image source| Gemini genared image ### Kind Regards @nahid43 ![1000019308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRW9rHroSFBSAKdERxzaNWNAnWKCXRUdrHF4LbDABXrT6/1000019308.png) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@nahid43/my-additional-source-of-income-came-from-tutoring-5qe)

title.title: Last breakfast | A Picture is Worth a Thousand Words
title.body:
<center>
![242hivrdjiyH2M5HtG8kXeFNUADSx3rDc7VeYJ4N5p69ojqu8DdppCorRN1cHEdkPX1DA.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/242hjYd5xBwRUUrFfptYZRwEknb19dp5e8bSRGwpeBLSNhEaHg6gQ3r6CVbHeH7XT9h2z.jpg)
 [Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/sandwich-bread-strawberry-jam-7854483/)</center>

<hr>

The tragedy occurred between seven and eight in the morning. The sun barely filtered through the slats of the blinds. Helena was more anxious than usual as she prepared breakfast.

She had endured too many years of shouting, belittlement, and bruises hidden beneath makeup. All she wanted was for this nightmare of a marriage to end.

In front of her was a plate with a perfectly toasted piece of bread, covered with a thick layer of strawberry jam, and a steaming cup of black coffee. In that dark beverage, Helena had dissolved the contents of a small vial: a deadly poison.

The heavy footsteps of her husband, Ricardo, echoed down the hallway until he reached the dining room. He entered the kitchen with his usual scowl. Without greeting his wife, he sat down abruptly at the head of the table.

She brought the plate to him as if she were a restaurant waitress, and he took the cup of coffee with his hands.

Helena held her breath. Ricardo lightly blew on the steam and took a long, deep sip of his coffee. His eyes flew open. The effect was almost instantaneous; the cup slipped from his fingers, smashing on the floor, and his body collapsed onto the table, Ricardo’s face covered in jam.

After watching him die, Helena ran out of the kitchen: she grabbed her leather purse and the car keys. As she left, she felt that she could finally breathe again. And once free, she would drive without looking back toward her true home.





<hr>

title.title: El crecimiento personal en el arte 🐤🎨 [ENG/ESP]
title.body:
>Greetings to everyone in the Lifestyle community! Today I’m stopping by to share with you another day in the classroom. I’m really happy because we’ve gotten off to a great start this week in the drawing workshop. Over the last few days, since the kids have been taking exams and have also been a bit distracted (I mean, even though they’re good students, they have moments when they lose focus and get a little disorganized—I think that’s normal), I decided we should stop moving forward with the material and focus on what had happened with their previous assignments. That way, I was able to review, student by student, what they had done. There, i focused on the works that were half-finished. For those who were up to date, we did a drawing exercise with a still life of some roses.

\n\n

>As I mentioned in the previous post, sometimes I feel like I might be failing as a teacher when I notice that some of the work is technically sound (and by this I mean literally the execution of the technique or use of materials, not their artistic intentions)... or rather, the instructions aren’t fully understood (among other things), but then I start looking closely at the photos (which, by the way, are also part of my own class follow-up) and I notice that they’ve actually made quite a bit of progress and are getting closer every day to becoming the artists they so desperately want to be. I believe they actually already are; this is simply one of their many stages.

\n\n>

>¡Saludos a todos en la comunidad de Lifestyle! El día de hoy me uno por acá para compartir con ustedes un nuevo día en el aula de clases. Estoy muy feliz porque esta semana empezamos con buen pie en el taller de dibujo. En estos últimos días debido a que los niños han estado en exámenes y también han estado un poco distraídos (es decir, me refiero a que a pesar de que son buenos estudiantes tienen sus momentos dónde pierden un poco la atención y el orden, creo que es algo normal), decidí que debíamos dejar de avanzar en el contenido y concentrarnos en lo que había sucedido con los trabajos anteriores. De esa forma pude revisar, estudiante por estudiante, lo que llevaban hecho. Allí me enfoque en los trabajos que estaban a medio terminar. Para quienes si estaban en regla, pues hicimos un ejercicio de dibujo con un bodegón de unas rosas.

\n\n>

>Como comenté en la anterior publicación a veces siento que quizás puedo estar fallando como profesora cuando noto que hay algunas ejecuciones regulares en los trabajos (y con esto me refiero a literalmente la acción de la técnica o materiales, no a sus intenciones artísticas)... o más bien no se entiende del todo la instrucción (entre otras cosas), pero luego me pongo a detallar las fotografías (que por cierto, también forman parte de mi propio seguimiento de las clased) y noto que en realidad han avanzado bastante y que están cada día más cerca de ser esos artistas que tanto desean ser. Yo creo que en realidad ya lo son, simplemente esta será una de sus muchas etapas.

![IMG_20260504_190056_177.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Eq9WCj9krJv4HBomZzndFzZEfoRZtFfY3jvMbjrYWz2zKJjQ45EWFoV65ho1GYEndiL.jpg) ![IMG_20260504_190056_112.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Eq7Mu2FvasPNwScwVssYe3pCR3F5yVzMPjvDiAaoDipANAqcBG4JPgzToMwCtt2TrA3.jpg) ![IMG_20260504_190056_225.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Eqb34gMEerdmzoAz98RJiC8kQJ8bGpuuLwgmVTascHf6JxsCjv6kdsxTYxGakcrwcbd.jpg) ![IMG_20260504_190055_841.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EouAgqTvqQYTRommeGxVMJsitdRh4H66jLBo7QFH6sK4mA96JasXEHmcwepdpujTm5i.jpg) ![IMG_20260504_190055_646.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpT5e1cz1BnUhQZRYD8nKqRz8g9rYJWKU5NkyuEiKjAC1R1UztWSXoyWEDWR6QLnbHd.jpg) ![IMG_20260504_190056_433.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EqFtPSUC5znSzADuWuck2Bzzyh4T9myeF9mbSkB1q9R9dicHzTdqW3VZ4ra4R6zNRV9.jpg) ![IMG_20260504_190056_126.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpNpsHmwjytnNFXrsHXTcNgAtUcnzYWe7LACNqDPSaXhbbvzGLUgaJjtKW1PjP3Tw1p.jpg)

>Today the kids were especially excited because they hadn’t seen each other since last Thursday, so they were sharing their experiences. Like the Michael Jackson movie they went to see. They’ve been asking to listen to Michael Jackson for several weeks now, so I let them listen to that while they work, and I think that’s inspired some of my students to join in the dancing. Which I think is wonderful. I’m so happy with them, i really am. They bring me so many laughs and heartwarming moments. For example, one of them came in with his Big Ben collage (Elizabeth Tower), another painted a cute little yellow bird (here in Puerto Ordaz there are lots of birds like that—they’re so beautiful), another made a collage of a pear (she has drawings, paintings, and other works featuring that pear), another made a Golden Retriever puppy, another girl drew Cristiano Ronaldo (hahaha, she’s so authentic), and a few others drew roses. We’ll have our closing activity soon, and I feel a little sad because I won’t see them for a long time, but at the same time so happy because they’re moving on to the next stage and will have reached another milestone. Without further ado, thank you so much for stopping by.

\n\n>

>Hoy los niños estaban especialmente emocionados porque no se habían visto desde el jueves pasado, así que compartían sus experiencias. Cómo la película de Michael Jackson que fueron a ver. Ellos tienen varias semanas pidiendo escuchar Michael Jackson, así que los dejo oir eso mientras trabajan y yo creo que eso ha inspirado a algunas de mis estudiantes a unirse a la danza. Lo cual me parece maravilloso. Yo soy muy feliz con ellos, de verdad que si. Me sacan muchas risas y momentos de corazón. Por ejemplo, uno de ellos llegó con su collage del Big Ben (Torre de Isabel), otra de ellas pinto un lindo pajarito amarillo (aquí en Puerto Ordaz hay muchos pajaritos así, son muy bellos), otra hizo su pera en collage (ella tiene dibujos, pinturas y demás con esa pera, otro hizo un perrito Golden Retriever, otra de las niñas con Cristiano Ronaldo (jajaja ella es muy auténtica) y algunos más con sus rosas. Ya pronto tendremos nuestra actividad de cierre y me siento un poco triste porque no los veré en mucho tiempo, pero a la vez tan feliz porque ellos pasan a otra etapa y habrán alcanzado una meta más. Sin más que decir, muchísimas gracias por pasar por aquí.

title.title: Beach Bliss Reset 🌊
title.body:
Our recent trip to the beach was seriously a dream come true exactly what we needed to get away from all the city craziness. The moment we got there it was like all the stress just melted away with the sound of waves hitting the shore playing like the best chillout music ever.
 

![1000033036.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/piyaanggtiu/23sddkqLLpPdcgA3sHNx11uzquxgBffQpS6QNWKpqVniJzjzygJ4T9iJNkfa5iWRFz2Vv.jpg)

And that air? So fresh with that awesome salty smell that just wakes you right up. It felt like a total reset. The beach itself was just stunning that really fine almost powdery white sand just stretched on forever.
 

![1000033037.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/piyaanggtiu/23uFW8NynXtm6HgMW6WnmFNHBqDi4HZboVWiQFMLoc4415MSSadbqiABd1soVEY11zsKW.jpg)

 
![1000033032.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/piyaanggtiu/23xVGvzr6jApa2cGgHGwsYnag8KnWzRztpGswwZiAUCLWmMER99Xjm3WLU43D2taUxajM.jpg)

And the sun oh my god it just sparkled on the water turning the whole ocean into this amazing show of blues and greens you just could not stop staring.
 
![1000033033.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/piyaanggtiu/23rz2oHUqyExyJP8HzQSvZmjsWN9n7zYpQ3HJRzZ6EthVvKXq5PCZnXVzJd8mCh7zEGrj.jpg)

Remember when we were at Borlongan Beach? That place had its own vibe too with all those cool smooth pebbles and stones along the shore that made it feel so unique and just as beautiful in its own way.
 

![1000033035.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/piyaanggtiu/245cTuGCyxqHxsRngLimLu12ZsfqhnnkZe7QvCwGLUPamg88GctuWG9BjAej2jMqg1a5y.jpg)

 

![1000033031.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/piyaanggtiu/23ujfzm6HEcDS1rmLPevBvREqpTT9xHmsqwtbGe4PL2dSvnGyRejbMQqNKm6HXNUg2Y6m.jpg)

You could barely make out these tiny fishing boats far away just slowly cruising adding this sweet rustic touch to the whole perfect scene. And the kids!
 

![1000033027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/piyaanggtiu/245T7pLdKKmTiWFAVGsWq5kNtb5kaPh52TpFzxbFdVeu92eReb3yPkQediNZRbHHsypjt.jpg)

 

![1000033030.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/piyaanggtiu/23vhyWmNa7DD3qun8yxnw9VA1ewGDAx5qxMec2cB6ezNu9hec2xmES2ie8H5hM7CbLMXW.jpg)

Explosions of orange, soft pinks deep purples it all just blended together painting the sky like nothing ive ever seen. It was such a beautiful reminder of how incredible nature is and how it can just blow your mind.
 
![1000033030.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/piyaanggtiu/23vhyWmNa7DD3qun8yxnw9VA1ewGDAx5qxMec2cB6ezNu9hec2xmES2ie8H5hM7CbLMXW.jpg)

 
![1000033028.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/piyaanggtiu/23vPH25usSySVb9kHSbiU3y7vKZ9Cm1Mge8gRz6tW8nnJp3WfhXoptEdvz3M2DZuciJyB.jpg)

A chance to reconnect with natures chill vibes and just appreciate the simple deep beauty around us. Seriously it made us want to go back ASAP already counting down the days until we can dive back into that peaceful coastal charm.

title.title: STEAMED FLUFFY BANANA MUFFINS
title.body: Hello 👋@foodiesbeehive Turning ripe bananas into a sweet and delicious muffins always made my kiddos full of energy and happy.. Today's kitchen adventure I'd loved to share to you is how I turned these ripe bananas into a sweet treats for my kids..Here's my STEAMED BANANA MUFFINS

> When making banana muffins it's very important to prepare it ahead of time.Make it sure to measure the ingredients accurately to achieve a fluffy and delicious muffins.. You will need the following 2 cups all purpose flour 3/4 cup white sugar 1 tablespoon baking powder ½ teaspoon baking soda 1 cup fresh milk 1 tablespoon white vinegar ½ cup melted butter (salted) 1 pc whole egg 4-5 pcs chopped bananas 1 cup dark chocolate chips(optional)

> Organized everything before making the muffins..Accuracy and consistency is very important to achieve the desired taste.. Here are the procedures in making the banana muffins Measure all dry ingredients and place it in a mixing bowl..Add the all purpose flour,sugar,baking powder and baking soda and a pinch of salt together and mix it.
> Next is combined all the wet ingredients in a mixing bowl like milk,butter,and egg.Stir it well..
> Finally slowly add the mashed bananas and gently combined it together with the other ingredients.
> Do not over mix it.Just until it becomes smooth and there's no more lumps. Finally,though it's optional you can always add some fun add ins like chocolate chips or raisins or even nuts..
> Prepare to fill in the muffin cups Line the muffin tray with paper cups,spoon the batter and fill the cups for about 3/4 full..
> Steamed for 10-15 minutes or you can also baked for 18-20 minutes or until golden brown.

>
Enjoy and serve this to kids with a refreshing juice or drinks..

🌱 Backyard Sugarcane Journey – From Simple Cuttings to Sweet Success 🍃
title.body:
There’s something incredibly rewarding about stepping into your backyard and seeing real growth happening right in front of you. Today, I paused for a moment to appreciate my sugarcane plants—and honestly, the progress feels amazing.
What started as a few simple cuttings has now turned into strong, upright stalks reaching confidently toward the sun. Watching this transformation reminds me that farming, even on a small scale, is a journey of patience and consistency.
From the photos, you can clearly see how the canes are developing. The stalks are getting thicker, and the leaves are stretching out beautifully. Some of the lower leaves are drying out, and that’s actually a good sign. It shows the plant is maturing and directing its energy into building strong stems and storing sugar.
One thing I’ve learned from this process is that sugarcane doesn’t demand perfection—it responds to care. Regular watering has been key, especially during the hotter days. I’ve been making sure the soil stays moist without becoming waterlogged, and that balance is really helping the plants thrive.
Spacing has also made a big difference. Even in a backyard setup, giving each plant enough room allows for better growth. Where the plants are less crowded, the stalks are noticeably healthier and stronger. Good airflow also helps keep pests and diseases under control.
So far, I haven’t faced any major pest issues. I check the leaves regularly, and everything looks fairly clean. I prefer to observe first before taking any action—sometimes nature balances itself if you give it time.
What excites me most is what’s coming next. These canes are slowly getting closer to harvest, and that means fresh, natural sugarcane straight from my backyard. There’s nothing quite like enjoying something you’ve grown yourself—pure, organic, and full of life.
This experience keeps reminding me that you don’t need a large farm to grow something meaningful. Even a small space can produce something valuable if you stay consistent and patient.
I’ll definitely keep sharing updates as the sugarcane matures.

title.title: No Man Should Lord Over Another
title.body:
I got no trust in anything that supports hierarchy amongst men when it means to control how everyone is supposed to live in according to Man's made up laws. Not in any institutions as it will  inevitably be evident to eventually turn against its members. But it is mostly visible to those who are not in them. 

However, a few black sheep manages to evade the sheepdogs and the wolves outside their fences and morph into Shepards of the sheep they had to leave behind beforehand. Not physically leave them but leave their shared beliefs that causes them to be submissive to a ruling class that is only interested in using them as batteries to the same system that protects them from being free. 


![1000029554.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhshrooms/23tbibi8ybbGw1CdmigpckT7upaFxnmvHm1f8nMT1Zdzcd5grPHUxAGoRXbSwbMTcXmuR.png)


***

From an early age I came into being within strict Catholic upbringings and customs. The tyrants of my age that bullied me everyday in school and attended church are the same types that most likely join the \

that condones the same behavior payed by extortion fees. It's just business. Nothing personal. It's only the people's stick whipping your back for all that you have to serve controller's will. 

***

It was through the wise written in the bible that the deceptive interpretations made by the religious institutions that gave me the sight to see through the veils of control. For you see, like what you resist persists, they who persist to control give birth to those who will disobey. 

One showed me through scripture and the other was the live example hidden in plain sight. One using the other. Of course one needs to be open minded enough to perceive what is hidden from them and it is no easy  way. 

A wise book composed of many wise books, carefully selected and interpreted that \

also served to give the illusion of justification for having a master and slave class.

I got no trust in government authority always lying and deceiving raping and raiding our world wide neighborhoods and consciousness. But they are also just a proud useful tool to the hidden evil hands that works to keep them and us all sick and obedient for a currentsea that is only burying us all under the weight of the oceans tears.

***

Obviously my recognizing of these systems didn't form overnight. Many events and experiences and along with questioning my relationship to these, gave birth to further understanding of what sovereignty actually means for Man.

So what is sovereignty?

If you read selectively and ignore the parts that contradict it, you can even find within the current Abrahamic religious bibles, speak about sovereignty in a way that supports the no rulers over Man argument.

In the first book of Samuel  chapter 8, verses 10 through 18, Samuel warns that kings WILL take your sons, daughters, land, and wealth. Basically a direct critique of centralized authority, and reads like a prediction of taxation, conscription, and state control.

In Luke 22:25–26 it reads

> “The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship… but you shall not be so.”

A clear rejection of hierarchical domination among people.


> “Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free…” -Galatians 5:1 

Emphasizes personal freedom over bondage and can be interpreted as spiritual and social.

And lastly but not least of all, Matthew 23:8–10:

> “Do not be called Rabbi… do not call anyone on earth your father… nor be called instructors…”

This is completely undermining titles of authority structures among men.

The Bible however is not purely anti-authority. As there are many verses that are contradict and proclaim to the masses to be obedient to a ruling class. 

To name only one off the top of my head I can think of no better example than the book of Romans 13:1–2, 
> “Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers…” given the context after it, it points to submission to government systems rather than to God. In some parts it even goes as far as to claim that their authority to rule comes from God which is an outward lie. The very type of thing to say such a thing can only come from someone who wants control over others. It's important to never take the bible seriously word for word for it is pack filled with parables and other hidden coded messages. A skeptical mind is required.

As you can see we have two very contradictory sides. One is anti-domination and the other demands order and submission. I don't know about you but I for one am far more inclined to not being ruled over by mere Men who were born into existence the same way as any other Man on Earth.

***

No man should “lord over” another. Yet even today we have a vast majority amount of people that proclaim the world needs to be under rulers based purely on faith alone to be legitimate, if they call themselves govern|ment.

The Bible rejects illegitimate human domination morally, but acknowledges its existence pragmatically. Meaning, just because it's wrong and unjustified, doesn't mean \
won't be existing and attempting to reap your hard earned fruits from the labor you have sowed upon the earth. In other words it describes \

as both corrupt and temporarily tolerated. Yet it is this tolerance that must be kept in check, by every individual, in a matter of understanding and faith in themselves and with God within us all, or else we get more tyranny if we don't for our tolerance levels measures the amount of tyranny we all get as a whole. 

So the question dear reader lies within you all, what are we to do today to lower our tolerance against control systems? Or more precisely, what are you still tolerating that you know you shouldn’t?

title.title: ‎LOH #287 || When Love Is Not Enough: Learning to Let Go After Six Years ‎
title.body:
‎Hi Hive,
‎
‎
‎There was a time that I believed love could actually fix anything. That if you held on tightly enough, gave enough, sacrificed enough, things would somehow fall back into place. 
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPMEPNmCRGftS2r9XA62UpAKZw1Pp7REWJMAKdjoGHNvJ/watcharaph-love-700771_1920.jpg 

‎[pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/love-admire-fall-in-love-crush-700771/)
‎
‎Ad for six years, I built my world around a relationship I thought would last forever. It was not just love but it was routine, friendship, shared dreams, and a future I had already imagined in full detail.
‎
‎So I refused to see it clearly when things started falling apart.
‎
‎I continue to clung to her not just because about the love I only have for her, but because I had invested so much of myself into what we had. Six years is not something you walk away from easily. 
‎
‎I kept telling myself that we have come too far to end like this. I tried to neglect the cracks, hoping they would somehow seal themselves. I tried harder, gave more, and held on tighter.
‎
‎But the truth is, no matter how much you resist, life has a way of forcing the truth on you.
‎
‎And the harder I held on, the more I began to feel the weight of something that was no longer meant for me. But still , I don't want to give up easily.
‎
‎Conversations became forced and effort became one-sided. What once felt natural started feeling like work. And deep down, I knew something was wrong. I knew things had changed but the hardest part was accepting the reality.
‎
‎Letting go was a gradual process and wasn't  a single moment.
‎
‎From first came denial to frustration. Then that silent sadness that keeps lingering when you realize something tangible is slipping away and there is nothing you can do to stop it. I questioned everything, what really went wrong, what I could have done better, whether love alone was ever enough.
‎
‎And then, slowly, acceptance crept in.
‎
‎I started to accept the reality. And not the kind that comes with relief, but the kind that comes with pain and understanding. I started to understand that holding on was hurting me more than letting go ever could, so I made my choice. 
‎
‎I question myself, that why clinging to someone that has already given her heart to some else. So I chose letting go. That sometimes, love is not about fighting to stay but it’s about having the strength to walk away when staying no longer brings peace and that's what I did.
‎
‎Even though, accepting the end of that chapter did not erase the memories or the love I once felt. But it taught me something deeper that not everything we hold onto is meant to stay. Some things come into our lives to shape us, teach us, and prepare us for what’s next to come.
‎
‎Six years taught me how to deeply love. And letting go taught me how to love myself.
‎
‎And sometimes, that’s the lesson life was trying to teach all along.
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)
‎

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@twicejoy/loh-287-when-love-is-not-enough-learning-to-let-go-after-six-years--cuv)

Que las bendiciones de Dios inunden sus vidas. Es un placer compartir una nueva aventura en el sector San Luis de Cumaná, ubicado en la Avenida Universidad, en la carretera que conecta con Puerto La Cruz. Este sector es conocido por sus hermosas playas, alrededor de las cuales se han construido clubes, hoteles, residencias, oficinas gubernamentales, instalaciones turísticas y otros negocios. El Club San Luis se encuentra cerca del sector Los Uveros, y su nombre proviene de la abundancia de uva de playa que se encuentra en esta zona. Como la mayoría de las playas de esta zona, cuenta con malecones y una cancha deportiva, y como se puede apreciar en las fotografías, una hermosa vista al mar. También se pueden observar los diversos edificios ubicados a lo largo de esta franja costera. Visité la zona por la tarde, y aunque sabía que había uva de playa en esta área, me sorprendió la cantidad. Son de diferentes tamaños y sus ramas se inclinan hacia los lados, formando cómodos asientos para quienes visitan estas playas. Desde allí, pueden observar el paisaje o simplemente disfrutar de la brisa marina.

> **
ENGLISH
** Abundant and eternal blessings to all members of this @worldmappin community. It's a pleasure to greet you and wish you a happy and blessed day. May God's blessings overflow into your lives. It's a pleasure to share a new adventure in the San Luis sector of Cumaná, located on Avenida Universidad, on the highway that connects to Puerto La Cruz. This sector is known for its beautiful beaches, around which clubs, hotels, residences, government offices, tourist facilities, and other businesses have been built. The San Luis Club is located near the Los Uveros sector, and its name comes from the abundance of sea grape trees (Uvero de Playa) found in this area. Like most beaches in this zone, it has walkways and a sports field, and as you can see in the photographs, a beautiful view of the sea. You can also appreciate the various buildings located along this coastal strip. I visited in the afternoon, and although I knew that sea grape trees existed in this area, I was surprised by the number of them. They are of various sizes, and their branches bend to the sides, forming comfortable seats for those who visit these beaches. From there, they can observe the landscape or simply enjoy the beach breeze. ![SL (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23ywoAP3hdJLDJsW9PcF6uD7KyutY3ZvJwvbJbfGVydHxT5Lr78VVqu1BjvnGY85kYSQx.jpeg) ![SL (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpxrGAsuim8Vtg45fzxsnprjWsSEYM2nLvPMgKXgE4AhoGveFnztB6pVwi9MrX5H7ab.jpeg) ![SL (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqDk8EkMxhgpFA9znYVDd7CtbttDTHwS6TtsGDSK98VMuX953EvkyvNXmW1uUnG4UhG.jpeg) ![SL (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Ep7vYyuAT31UpNGzEMUBeHNi7HY6rVkLdNNqw7rBAaGpjrmW8zYD3usSLW6szBumPir.jpeg) ![SL (6).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoptKUr6qb4LVfcMZTYb7FxQpGynLKYzHp5KD1azwwS8JVX2FVy1AjR4DoCUitx3mkM.jpeg) ![SL (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EokcgjRabWKw8Wp5jeJtY4fjRXgamBpx8fDX3yHAfimHpo8hEj1EUFwUESFCmmJFmDB.jpeg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

> Cerca del club San Luis y su playa, ubicada detrás, hay varios bancos a lo largo del paseo marítimo donde se pueden alquilar sillas y sombrillas. También se ofrecen paseos en barco. Estos centros recreativos son conocidos por brindar servicios ideales para disfrutar de la playa, como alquiler de sombrillas, mesas y sillas, además de lugares para comprar comida deliciosa. Algo que me llamó la atención y que nunca antes había visto en esta playa fueron los paseos a caballo. Me impresionó ver dos caballos en la playa, y una amable señora me explicó que es una de las atracciones que ofrecen: paseos a caballo guiados por expertos equinos. La idea de ofrecer paseos a caballo me pareció muy interesante, ya que en esta zona suelen ofrecer paseos en bananas, botes , actividades deportivas como fútbol, voleibol, tenis y, a veces, fútbol playa, pero nunca paseos a caballo ni caminatas. Debe ser divertido recorrer la playa en estos simpáticos animales. Para realizar el paseo, hay que reservar el servicio con antelación, y se realiza a la hora acordada. Detrás del club, en el paseo marítimo, hay una valla publicitaria decorada con animales marinos como caballitos de mar, cangrejos y peces, adornada con algas, y con letras azules y blancas. Las sillas y los toldos se encuentran en distintas zonas cerca de la playa y bajo las plantas de overo. Las sillas son amarillas y verdes, y las cabañas son rectangulares, hechas de madera y ramas de palma.

> Near the San Luis club and its beach located behind it, there are several benches along the boardwalk offering chair and umbrella rentals for visitors. Boat tours are also available. These recreational centers are known for providing services suitable for enjoying the beach, including umbrella, table, and chair rentals, as well as places to buy delicious food. Something that caught my attention and that I had never seen on this beach before were the horseback rides. I was impressed to see two horses on the beach, and a kind lady explained that it's one of the attractions they offer: horseback riding guided by equine experts. The idea of offering horseback rides seemed very interesting to me because in this area they usually offer banana boat rides and sports activities like soccer, volleyball, tennis, and sometimes beach soccer, but never horseback riding and walks. It must be fun to travel along the beach on these friendly animals. To take the ride, you have to request the service in advance, and the ride takes place at the corresponding time. Behind the club, there's a billboard located on the walkway, which is decorated with marine animals like seahorses, crabs, and fish, adorned with seaweed, and the letters are blue and white. The chairs and awnings are located in different areas near the beach and under the overo plants. The chairs are yellow and green, and the huts are rectangular, made of wood and palm branches. ![SL (10).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EokdYeDjcrX3U684EMrSK9ujin2RQrHiiqvDLSjr774pbYLkF3EY2yRQRi9QFX3BXpM.jpeg) ![SL (11).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EopsuaWBJC7eU41XcQdCZXzL95zG1wL53onJcJhUoiQV3DDhEgvFmLcZCZtd4ZxUMm4.jpeg) ![SL (12).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpXKXXvEMGYZPSiF3tktiJSFgZZ7XvhABRnrVsaDfWrNze4iK1PkFhrn1ZySRAHPQeB.jpeg) ![SL (9).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23u657AsmPte6KqU8VWhPZu1WFHqeiPmGucM47YDNhv2qoqKjsAon4uVTJqziGdPwwPcW.jpeg) ![SL (8).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eptb1Sb1vL38DTrQRKtbi9qB6tNddVW7bd33hTZdRfhtABgZnSQsdmy7cVFeppPUNcV.jpeg)

> Siguiendo este sendero, verán un gran barco en el mar, algo común en esta zona. También podemos apreciar la playa, los senderos y las mesas, sillas y demás servicios que ofrece este club. Los árboles de uva de mar abundan en esta área y sirven de aparcamiento y sombra para algunas motocicletas. Los senderos cuentan con bancos típicos de piedra y hormigón. Los árboles de uva de mar, los más abundantes en esta zona, se encuentran a lo largo de los bordes de los senderos, en la orilla del agua y a lo largo de una extensa franja de la propiedad. Visitar esta zona fue una experiencia maravillosa, una aventura encantadora, y también aprendí sobre los servicios de equitación. Gracias por acompañarme en esta fascinante aventura.

> Continuing along this path, you'll see a large boat in the sea, a common sight in this area. We also have a view of the beach, the walkways, and the tables, chairs, and other amenities offered by this club. The sea grape trees are present in this area and serve as parking and shade for some motorcycles. The walkways feature typical benches made of stone and concrete. The sea grape trees, which are the most abundant in this area, are located along the edges of the walkways, at the water's edge, and across a large and long stretch of the property. Visiting this area was a wonderful experience, a lovely adventure, and I also learned about the horseback riding services. Thank you for joining me on this fascinating adventure. ![SL (16).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23yTgytorXgTXxe3aA4udjgGTMJAu4AbJWTcTjn6zRhutuuVtwQCVCqLv9sT3ncUDreRC.jpeg) ![SL (17).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpVCdxZdFidza63rjXCJZqvTQcTosbUaLD6MEq8o8TLBtVxsjS5RwdnDTbd6iiW6W1e.jpeg) ![SL (13).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EokdCKKqT2Q73ZiBq8cBMS6svEPrTPDWefi1ThXRXjy5EtNhaoqLs1AoMYAnfGeEEoy.jpeg) ![SL (15).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EptcRGADJ1EU4DFxJYwtPYZGjkTibsH5aS2HCCJD9giaGRrh2fdVQzEwiP5TKGcgoyN.jpeg) ![SL (18).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpXKYeEAM9ksTZxCrYKysJ9T8opmKQ8Jmvi3pu9X3fP3qjMZhZ4ymPekuhiaTkdVuMD.jpeg) ![SL (14).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23wMYDf24PraNZkq2r6kihgYSmULvv3XcEd1v7kdXCfVqLeLUfWuXwsmcAwcfhd1EmZ5S.jpeg) ![separador virgilio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48KdAZ2oktyDRja9ez5m3v1qBY6PZfFU8sSGEE17ey9FUfktwmCJiLv2c2YiZggq73.png)
