title.title: Cumpleaños Spa & Arte (Parte III) || Spa & Art Birthday (Part III)
title.body:
![1001029207.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23tvm3GXC3LNPTAzsP466zEBLNkDQrVN4Ys9xrijDtzgzwzb7hhnGDZ8NbisymP9dhQ5K.jpg) ![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)

¡Hola Chicos!

Por fin llegamos al final de esta historia donde acompañamos a la pequeña Marcela y sus amigos a celebrar sus 7 años. Una celebración de arte y Spa que tuvo lugar en el salón de Tefy, una emprendedora de la ciudad de Cabimas. El cabo de unos cuántos minutos las niñas comenzaron a terminar con sus obras y lo fueron notificando. Esto significaba que ya mi jornada estaba por terminar pues ya cuando terminan todas yo me retiro.

Hi everyone!

We've finally reached the end of this story where we accompanied little Marcela and her friends to celebrate her 7th birthday. It was an art and spa celebration held at the salon of Tefy, an entrepreneur from the city of Cabimas. After a few minutes, the girls began to finish their artwork and let everyone know. This meant that my day was almost over, as I usually leave once everyone is finished.
![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)
![1001029200.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23uFRQAQfqjBVpGzDvY7PaQrfxaH2ANXyiWTYkRCfXPshMQCbsYaUJcRKNSnABFtq1rum.jpg) ![1001029205.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wC9VJtmuDxFkgCPRwitE335GqjmqAPfua6BXuK6zDNX1bXFrYuDGXGiKxgJ69G4CWGY.jpg) ![1001029194.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wgMX2y7mQH1uLp5aJ75aPvZCqCffzZmFQG3wk8ET4J7n1PQfsdMo4EDdZQvvA8Te7XD.jpg) Todas hicieron un trabajo genial con sus cuadros y además lucían súper lindas con sus peinados y maquillaje. Ellas quedaron bastantes contentas con el resultado y les emocionaba el hecho de que podían llevarse su cuadro a casa. Yo fui diciéndole una por una que se acercaran al área donde estaba la torta para tomarles la foto del resultado final.
![1001029192.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wgMybx6M4p6XrNGWjPX3yf2XTSqp9eos3yDAiTtnpFAeVzpBZ5yM2CEudtTGWE8cDSN.jpg) ![1001029197.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wWyPVjPWRg3jLHdwReRq9PawJQ72qSSAJB8qmMNPfy5F5ZxJGuMuxGDZxm893Ek9qT1.jpg) ![1001029202.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wC9degZE1Z4exKeiCvkR7zNMJtT7Uf5kP1USnjsJvzhTMHan4KYDqxVhvKNF8iWW4Ub.jpg) They all did a fantastic job with their paintings and looked absolutely gorgeous with their hairstyles and makeup. They were very happy with the result and excited about taking their paintings home. I asked each of them individually to come over to the cake area so I could take a picture of the final result.
![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png) ![1001029196.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wCJAA6qLfhLdnYkXNqBAvgAT4Ge17PiKAQs4gwC2NDb5MaR5haHjsmGCguVbMDhBU99.jpg)
![1001029199.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23ydCScaktCy7h8ecbQmVvSukoFLdQvV9PfhCzJHYondA1tvj1afMyHq3j45ptDgWRPCp.jpg) Cuando comenzamos a recoger todo mi hijo y yo, la mamá de la cumpleañera me dijo que todavía no me retirara porque ya estaban por llegar unas pizzas que ella había encargado. Por supuesto quién le dice que no una pizza 🤭. Cuando por fin llegaron me pareció súper chistoso y tuve que tomarle foto porque todas tenían forma de corazón. Estaban demasiado sabrosas la verdad y tuvimos la oportunidad de comernos unos buenos trozos. Luego de eso se cantó el cumpleaños y también estuvimos presentes en ese momento además que nos quedamos igualmente para cuando partir una piñata. Terminamos disfrutando de toda la fiesta sin querer jajaja
![1001029204.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23ynbBkuttikXTyagf25riHn2RVG1os6oqqFpJrHc4wt33cEbJVbbn2P6P2x8Luc7xnMr.jpg) As my son and I started cleaning up, the birthday girl's mom told me not to leave yet because some pizzas she had ordered were about to arrive. Of course, who can say no to pizza? 🤭 When they finally arrived, I thought it was hilarious and had to take a picture because they were all heart-shaped. They were so delicious, and we had the chance to eat some good slices. After that, they sang \

and we were there for that too. We also stayed for when they broke the piñata. We ended up enjoying the whole party without even meaning to! haha ![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)
![1001029193.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/2432J7tQ41r8bHZYe4yBLdJTxk7huMywDq2juLWpagqn6b6FSceWStsRxwi1U5sah73Fv.jpg) ![1001029195.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23zGcZW2cfyLmmSHdUZUT7S4ogGp2T49LZvP5tMJ5Abp4Q2Z7gWds2i71SErY9sCbSiJp.jpg) Después de eso nos dieron unos trozos de torta, una caja con dulce y ya de ahí nos retiramos. Fue una buena jornada en la que por supuesto ganamos experiencia por lo vivido, la pasamos genial celebrando el cumpleaños de esa pequeña que recién conocíamos y pudimos ofrecer nuevamente nuestras sesiones de arte que tanto disfrutamos. Muchas gracias por acompañarme hasta aquí espero se hayan disfrutado esta historia tanto como nosotros lo hicimos viviéndola..
![1001029201.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23zGVivWdbeX2bvaM5PpxVTURZvn4bX9jQ1LmGP9k7btJ1WwrBhDTQgsHBgTqghrhMbfE.jpg) ![1001029198.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/242NmLTDdsrT5JVi3C2AKjdzp8kP8XjfadugAMxT5BRD8DygkpmGBbqqhKJZxwZCemmXe.jpg) After that, they gave us some pieces of cake and a box of candy, and then we left. It was a great day, and of course, we gained valuable experience. We had a wonderful time celebrating the birthday of this little girl we had just met, and we were able to offer our art sessions again, which we enjoy so much. Thank you so much for joining me this far. I hope you enjoyed this story as much as we enjoyed experiencing it.

title.title: Forgive And Forget. MCGI TOPIC REVIEW
title.body:
https://youtu.be/jDq9V5vcv90?si=rh9pDF0cV5Xraq48
Forgiveness was taught to us by our Lord Jesus Christ. The human's mind is not possessing the ability to forgive. It possesses a revenge mind. It is the mind that is always wroth with the other person because of what has been done unto him or her. We always want to pay back. We want to give eye for eye and evil for evil. But that is not the doctrines of the New testament in Jesus Christ. In Jesus Christ, we are taught to forgive those who offend us. We are to forget and not remember again.

In the law of Moses, everyone received recompense equally for whatsoever offense he has committed. There was no room for forgiveness. Forgiveness never existed in their dairy. That is where they learnt the law of eye for eye and tooth for tooth. We are not going to practice that again. In the New Testament, we express love towards others. It is a true love that does not put in minds what wrong his or her neighbor has done to him.

Why we find it difficult to forgive others is because we are not walking in love. If we walk in love towards our fellow humans, we will not remember the wrong things that such people do to us.

title.title: Movie Review: Devil May Cry
title.body:
![117.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/EoGwR5YY45HEtrd64v1f5eRFSwDri8orAFNYKAaPNxQDxNgbGuqoVDj1F8oTrbb6k8h.jpg)
Hi there, Welcome to a new movie review article from my blog. I decided it was time to sit back and relax, but this could not be completely achieved with the presence of something to watch. For me, and I think many others out there, movies are a way to relax from all the hustle and bustle of life. So it was a no-brainer when I decided to watch a movie, but this time it was anime, ***Devil May Cry.*** At first, I had a conflicting idea about the difference between an anime and a cartoon. It all boiled down to the geographical location of its creation. If it was created in Japan or by Japanese, then it is anime. Since Devil May Cry was created by the Japanese Madhouse, it is anime.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23wC7cygyQpteadqBXkXCjXi37fgL9WMgq1NvrgccxLKFqZcF9jseDLJC2kJ3iXcGN6VG.png)
The anime came to Netflix on the 3rd of April 2025, and there were major concerns about how well it would perform. In the mixed world of both video games and anime adaptations of the video game, there have been concerns about how well these movie adaptations of video games will fare. Will they be good? Or will it just be another try-and-error method like some in the past? Well, here is one deciding factor that many fail to consider when putting these adaptations into consideration. There will be instances where certain storylines have to be cut off, especially when it is a full movie adaptation of bringing these game characters to life. Like for One Piece, there were certain episodes from the manga that were cut out or, in better words, summed up.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/EoK4uwMzDARSVm28itsLKBzZGHCTso8iiX9fnuSbmRUWDgQn7j7UUuwzsqQvVjfm1UN.png)
In my case, I did not play much of the game Devil May Cry when I was much younger; I only came across it a few times to remember that it was a good game. So, going into the series on Netflix, I did not place all my hopes in the field of high expectations. I sincerely recommend that movie lovers do the same. Do not place so many high expectations on the movie before watching. Just keep an open mind, so that way you get amazed when you get to watch things that are super interesting. The anime, Devil May Cry, is based on the demon hunter character Dante, one of the sons of Spada. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23y8qZ4Zpwq5iyxndAQ4CHYRA5u1pNCywCt4jEoMZmWepajzenqFdUQhAcv2yBan2dCW6.png) Dante has a living of killing demons without knowing he was one of them, a hybrid, both demon and human, but in this sense, he is one of the good ones. He is the second twin son of Spada, the demon who created the barrier between the demon world and Earth. He was strongly regarded as the defender of humans for the heroic act he did when he realised the demon king Mundus had a growing quest to conquer the world, starting with Earth next. After setting up the barrier, Spada moved to Earth, where he met Dante's mother. It is quite an amazing story that keeps one on their toes while we edge closer to the unveiling of each plot, one episode at a time. A good factor that made me realise this was going to be a good anime to watch was the action mixed with good cliffhangers at the end of each episode. It was amazing as it kept me wanting more each time. You do not know how good a series can get until it gets to the end of each episode. Do not sleep on Devil May Cry, go and watch it.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23uQEYunkQhn7wKaxv244iGkr1jVWy8RyMFu3nrgiLY2kQ1tPrdrKW2rDEkFjCAmUKERm.png)
# My Rating: 9/10

![Samostically Banner.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/Eo6Cie7XPvRCoFSbPcHCY2WLfe8w5upAP4o2FvnNPV8d52md62bx9Gg7vhkcHNi1hnr.png)
I am @samostically, a chess player and writer. I love to share the experience I have gained from different battles over the 64 squares and the knowledgeable insights from books I have read. title.title: Colores por aquí, colores por allá
title.body:
![1000533976.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23tSQAf6gpJMBM8E9VhxAjYEAp2r2UkaPKeLepa5TcBdWvppG13HG3v4RgL4deSpv1k4A.jpg)
Queridas personas que pasan por mi blog, hoy quiero reflexionar sobre los colores de la vida y cómo se hace imperante pintar nuestra vida con ellos. Desde que levanta el día y vemos el azul del cielo, podemos tomarlo como la esperanza de paz. El azul de una amistad que perdura en el tiempo y hace que tengamos con quien reír en los buenos tiempos y un hombro en el cual reposar en los momentos duros. Dos profesores de canto me han dicho que debo imaginar mi voz con un color, y que puedo imaginar que este color baña la sala. Es un ejercicio de imaginación que bien resulta para el canto. Imaginen entonces cuánto nos puede ayudar coleccionar nuestros colores favoritos y dejarlos salir y volar por nuestros espacios. En mis paseos tengo la suerte de coincidir con la belleza natural que en todo su esplendor me muestra colores que puedo atesorar en mi memoria. El amarillo de una flor de cactus, esas flores tan peculiares que tardan años en florecer entregando sus colores. Tono optimista, abundante y enérgico. >Dear readers of my blog, today I want to reflect on the colors of life and how important it is to paint our lives with them. >From the moment the day dawns and we see the blue of the sky, we can take it as a symbol of hope for peace. The blue of a friendship that endures over time, giving us someone to laugh with in good times and a shoulder to lean on in hard times. >Two singing teachers have told me that I should imagine my voice as a color, and that I can imagine this color filling the room. It’s an exercise in imagination that works well for singing. Imagine, then, how much it can help us to collect our favorite colors and let them flow and fly through our spaces. >On my walks, I’m lucky enough to encounter natural beauty that, in all its splendor, shows me colors I can treasure in my memory. >The yellow of a cactus flower—those peculiar blooms that take years to blossom, finally revealing their colors. An optimistic, abundant, and energetic hue. ![1000533974.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23vsN2T2qTGXJnuaXYJERNWYj9Saz3ouAj2gQVxvvuHrKMpxamuKjx21mgpF8budXt7gq.jpg) Colores por aquí y por allá, contrastando el potente cactus con los tonos rosa que a veces aparecen en el cielo cuando el día se levanta o cuando va a descansar. > Colors here and there, contrasting the striking cactus with the shades of pink that sometimes appear in the sky as the day breaks or as it draws to a close. ![1000533977.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23zkrvj16E1GxHQx3wRkoNCfgTGJhAiDPxRhZxaJg2GW28DhDgWJwKignAgnNWctSftny.jpg) Me guardo el rosa intenso de esta flor y su blanco que rodea el centro. Dos colores tan diferentes unidos que pueden hablarnos de cómo la vida nos lleva de la pureza a la pasión. *¿Qué colores guardas de tus días?* *¿Qué colores te regala la naturaleza?* *¿Qué color baña tu espacio ahora mismo?* ***Colores, vida, sensaciones...*** > I’ll hold onto the deep pink of this flower and the white that surrounds its center. Two such different colors, united in a way that speaks to how life takes us from purity to passion. >*What colors do you hold onto from your days?* >*What colors does nature give you?* >*What color fills your space right now?* ![1000533973.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23tvcWiTrA5qHiKWe3XFgVwpHT9HAWNw97DtXbW1fj27UhQMp9KEp3mpnCdkkqRwYwNmn.jpg)

*Gracias por pasar por aquí, por detenerte a leer o a escuchar, por comentar, por votar.*
**¡Gracias por todo tu apoyo!**

title.title: Beef with chili peppers 🫑, served with rice and a salad of eggs, tomatoes 🍅, and cucumbers 🥒
title.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Feliz inicio de semana para todos mis amigos amantes de la buena comida, quiero compartirles la #receta de el almuerzo familiar que prepare el día de hoy, se trata de una carne de res sazonada con ají y la serví con arroz blanco y una ensalada de huevo, tomate y pepino

> **
ENGLISH
** Happy start to the week to all my food-loving friends! I want to share the #recipe for the family lunch I made today: beef seasoned with chili peppers, served with white rice and an egg, tomato, and cucumber salad. ![IMG_20260504_130057_528.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/EpCAQnZKsuRPbTVDpEq2nTsD5mkBRJ4aGQed7VvPra6za92n7eAWGTsDUTavFVwtZqo.jpg)

> **
INGREDIENTES
** carne de res en bistec, arroz, tomate, pepino, huevo, ají

> **
INGREDIENTS
** beef steak, rice, tomato, cucumber, egg, chili pepper ![IMG_20260504_121436_445.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/EpLhWAcvxGNZNZtZxb6HMVaZfYnSAeBcjeLwm8inyuWrzGcwvU8C2BHxMJEoacsYrQ6.jpg)

> **
PROCEDIMIENTO
** Coloqué la carne en una paila junto con el ají y la pisé muy bien hasta que estuvo completamente triturado el ají; agregué adobo, sal, un poco de aceite, llevé a cocinar. Por otro lado lavé muy bien el arroz , agregué sal al gusto, agua, un poco de aceite y llevé a cocinar, hasta que hubo secado.

> **
PROCEDURE
** I placed the meat in a pan along with the chili pepper and pounded it thoroughly until the chili pepper was completely crushed; I added the marinade, salt, and a little oil, then set it to cook. Meanwhile, I rinsed the rice thoroughly, added salt to taste, water, and a little oil, then set it to cook until the liquid had evaporated. ![Collage_2026-05-04_23_37_35.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/Eq7QGHAftQHkXTTGqzs7w3tDBueKa8L68KPCFjrY68SguY47fvAVny9oE3n4WdFUfRN.jpg) ![Collage_2026-05-04_23_36_52.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23uQpUx6qQWJFJ5qqpAuMU1kGkqzgNZ7Pt7j8H3KADpjHF1Gyp9v5U9A7prtdEbQWK6jj.jpg)
> Finalmente serví acompañado con una ensalada de huevo cocido, tomate y pepino . Espero haya sido de tu agrado. Gracias por visitarme! Dios te bendiga🙏

> Finally, I served it with a salad made with hard-boiled eggs, tomatoes, and cucumbers. I hope you enjoyed it. Thanks for stopping by! God bless you🙏 ![IMG_20260504_130057_528.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/EpCAQnZKsuRPbTVDpEq2nTsD5mkBRJ4aGQed7VvPra6za92n7eAWGTsDUTavFVwtZqo.jpg)

title.title: Forgetfulness
title.body: https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUUmt354b9zz2SgbhexjUNG5u7f5NFtfuCAejATfmPk8z/17779527822266119668067770708565.png [source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/depth-ocean-silhouette-darkness-10210903/) Would the birds be searching for that tree where they first built their nest? Or would the infinite sky of flight give the gift of forgetfulness? Nature forgets. Earth, sky, trees, flowers, birds all create the new, and sweep away the old Nature has been granted the gift of forgetfulness It relives the past for a moment and moves on But we? We are humans shaped by memories, every touch, every sound, every separation is etched on our souls like letters Nature has been blessed with the gift of forgetfulness, humanity has been blessed with the curse of memory This same curse is the originator of art, of poetry, of the restlessness to paint pictures, of weaving stories We are cursed to forget nothing But this is also our blessing For memories are the fire that transforms us from the ordinary to the extraordinary, that separates us from earth and sky, and gives meaning to being human Thank you so much for reading. Have a great day 😊🙏 @vikbuddy Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@vikbuddy/forgetfulness--578)

title.title: A 38 días del Mundial | La última tarantella italiana
title.body:
El 09 de julio del año 2006, y con el Estadio Olímpico de Berlín como escenario, fue la última vez que se escuchó la tarantella italiana en un Mundial FIFA, fue el día que consiguió su cuarta estrella y se convirtió en el segundo tetracampeón en la historia de las Copas del Mundo.

Italia superó en penales a una Francia que avanzó durante la Fase Final del Mundial 2006, con un rotmo arrollador, con un aroma a campeón y sobretodo, un Zinedine Zidane que mostró una de las actuaciones individuales más memorables en la historia del fútbol.

Sin embargo, después de los goles de Zidane y Marco Materazzi en el primer tiempo del encuentro, el factor clave en aquel partido fue el polémico cabezazo de la estrella francesa tras las palabras que le hizo el defensor de la 'azzurra'.

Y más allá de esta acción, que sacó al partido de su guión original, Italia también hizo méritos para alcanzar la final, y tener opciones de levantar la copa, tras haber llegado invicta al último partido y con una heroica clasificación en semifinales ante la local Alemania.

Aquel 2006, fue el último gran triunfo de Italia en un Mundial FIFA, puesto que en Sudáfrica 2010 y Brasil 2014 no superó la Fase de Grupos, y desde entonces se quedó sin clasificar a Rusia 2018, Qatar 2022 y nuevamente, a Norteamérica 2026.

¿Cuánto tiempo pasará para volver a ver brillar a Italia en una Copa del Mundo? ¡Los leo en los comentarios! Déjanos un like si te gustó esta publicación.


### *English Version*
## *38 days until the World Cup | The last Italian tarantella*

Aquí tienes una traducción fiel y con un toque periodístico para que mantenga ese impacto emocional:

On July 9, 2006, with Berlin’s Olympic Stadium as the stage, the Italian tarantella was heard for the last time at a FIFA World Cup. It was the day Italy earned its fourth star, becoming only the second four-time champion in World Cup history.

Italy overcame a France side that had stormed through the 2006 knockout stages with an unstoppable rhythm and the aura of a champion—driven, above all, by a Zinedine Zidane who delivered one of the most memorable individual performances in football history.

However, after goals from Zidane and Marco Materazzi in the first half, the turning point of the match was the French star’s controversial headbutt, triggered by words from the Azzurra defender.

Beyond that moment, which completely derailed the original script, Italy had earned its place in the final. They arrived at the title match undefeated after a heroic semifinal victory against the hosts, Germany.

That 2006 victory marked Italy’s last great World Cup triumph. In South Africa 2010 and Brazil 2014, they failed to make it past the Group Stage, and since then, they have missed out on qualifying for Russia 2018, Qatar 2022, and once again, North America 2026.

How long will it be until we see Italy shine again on the world stage? Let us know in the comments! Leave a like if you enjoyed this post.

She was contemplating a post office box….. Liz tells me they cost $186 a year to rent a PO Box!😳 Linda doesn’t have much money, and she doesn’t need to spend what she has on a PO Box rental!😮 Last weekend someone from Church brought her firewood for next winter, the Mrs thought we would give her a locking Mailbox………. One less bill to pay………😇 I started removing the old Mail Box, and Liz went inside to spend some time with our friend!😍 Kendall is a beautiful little community, only 13 minutes from our home going up the Mountain, but it’s such a different world!😮 Twenty six years ago, the Russian mafia was prevalent in this community…………… Today …. Liz tells me she can still “Feel a Darkness” that surrounds parts of this community, but for the most part this Mountain town has changed for the better!😇 New neighborhoods are being built, with homes starting in the mid $450,000……… Prices are rising everywhere my friends! See the second to last photo, that’s the old neighborhood country club. Liz and I would make this drive twice a week every week, no matter the weather!🥶 The Mrs lead our Worship band with vocals and Silvertop was on acoustic guitar. It was a full band with several other good friends playing electric guitar, drum kit, and back up vocals!☺️ I remember the Pastor saying…….. “You sound good BUT……. You’re a little too loud!” If it’s too loud, you’re too old my friends Lol!🤣😇 Our Church was looking for a location to buy/ build, and this was our temporary home! We had a practice night, and then Worship on Sunday morning from 2006 to 2014!😊 We definitely have history in this community!😇 “Silvertop I think Linda likes her new Mailbox!”🥰 “It was good to see her, and this community…… it’s been a long time since I have been up here honey!”😍 Till tomorrow Silvertop Mike😊
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@silvertop/actifit-silvertop-20260505t034456396z)_

I can only imagine how intense that radiation is up there as opposed to that on the ground where we were hiking and the signs were! 😳 Not the job for me by any means! I hope they have brains left by the time they quit that job and decide to do something else! The morning was spent up the mountain at Linda’s house. @silvertop installed the locking mailbox we gifted her with. A couple of weeks or so ago when I was up visiting her, she’d mentioned that she was going to rent a PO Box. I know they run around $93 every six months as that’s what we were paying prior to our own purchase of a locking mailbox. She’d said that people were stealing mail. I couldn’t see the expense for her as she’s lost part of her social security income due to the death of her husband recently. Money is tight and that added expense wasn’t necessary. We gifted it to her. I ordered on from Amazon at less than the cost of a rental at the post office, so now her mail is secure. 😎👍 It was a nice visit and time well spent. 😊 Otherwise, nothing much new going on. body.title: Monetizing a blog domain I had built up for 3 years by selling it was not easy.
body.body:
I tried selling my domain on godaddy.com.

I ran it through their automated quote service back then, and they said they would sell it on consignment for $100.

I’ve been paying 25,000 won a month just for Cloudyways for the past three years,

but I thought this wasn't right, so I quit.

However, a year later, I sent an automated quote to another famous domain consignment site,

and I still got a quote of $100. ^^;;

I’m not actually planning to sell it off.

But when I think about the market value of the articles I write,

I started wondering what direction I should take.

Americans buy small sites, grow them up themselves, and resell them,

and they sell them for tens of millions to hundreds of millions of won, haha.

Anyway, something like this happened...

I plan to grow this into a specialized asset allocation blog for the next 10 years or so, and when the day truly comes for me to retire, I might sell the domain and the blog and go on a trip. Until then, I intend to spend my days happily, researching diligently, writing, and communicating with the members of leofinance.

body.title: Making arepas with green plantains and chia seeds.[Esp-Eng]
body.body:
>    
<hr>
Feliz y bendecido inicio de semana, un gusto compartir una vez más con ustedes, hoy les quiero compartir la receta de unas arepas de plátano y chia muy nutritivas y son rápidas y fáciles de preparar, las pueden acompañar con el relleno de su preferencia pars disfrutar en el desayuno o cena aquí les dejo el paso a paso de esta sencilla receta.

>Happy and blessed start to the week! It’s a pleasure to share with you once again. Today I’d like to share a recipe for some very nutritious plantain and chia arepas that are quick and easy to make. You can fill them with whatever you like and enjoy them for breakfast or dinner. Here’s the step-by-step guide to this simple recipe.

<hr>


![GridArt_20260502_221343217.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoGzmSvAFd3N9tytdm2KDVATszHySpFPiLJ4FXQH552ktpqcunh7GNVQp8hriMkk7pL.jpg)


<hr>

# <center> *INGREDIENTES/INGREDIENTS* </center>

<div class = \

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/Eos2GM9Ldf7KAnjDv8akKPEmK8c68Sqz7KLAvLEh3AJfh8xTof4dpJfzr6frWQdX9cK.jpg - - 1 plátano verde - 1 taza de harina de maiz - 1 cucharada de chía - 1 taza de agua aproximadamente - Sal al gusto >- 1 green plantain >- 1 cup cornmeal >- 1 tablespoon chia seeds >- About 1 cup water >- Salt to taste
#
*PREPARACIÓN/PREPARATION*
Para preparar estas arepas lo primero que haremos es hidratar la chía en dos cucharadas de agua por 15 minutos aproximadamente, pelamos el plátano y lo rallamos por el lado fino del rallo. >To make these arepas, the first thing we’ll do is soak the chia seeds in two tablespoons of water for about 15 minutes. Peel the plantain and grate it using the fine side of the grater.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoeFuoAs2rz3Q74Ew9EGLu6S3STxtLDnNkpB5VTPkpG2mccQyMkWDKZumZ2PRqjH3cF.jpg
En un bol colocamos el agua, el plátano rallado, sal, la harina de maíz y la chía y vamos amasando hasta integrar bien los ingredientes y nos quede una masa suave. >In a bowl, combine the water, grated banana, salt, cornmeal, and chia seeds, and knead until the ingredients are well combined and you have a smooth dough.
![GridArt_20260502_221748318.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/Eoke8VmiUkiz513R2V4FFjH1wd7jfdxZPRDrf1qEHxgtdZ9bwobE9S8pedmsagAzC3R.jpg)
Vamos tomando porciones de masa y formamos bolitas, luego la aplastamos hasta darle forma de disco del tamaño y el grosor deseado, en un budare caliente y ligeramente engrasado ponemos las arepas y la cocinamos hasta que dore la volteamos y doramos por el otro lado. >Take small portions of the dough and roll them into balls, then flatten them into discs of the desired size and thickness. Place the arepas on a hot, lightly greased griddle and cook until golden brown; flip them over and brown the other side.

body.body:

---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

---

body.title: A short tour of San Antonio del Golfo and discovering a beautiful purple orchid (Eng - Esp)
body.body:
> **
INGLÉS
** Hello fellow travelers, I wish you an excellent and blessed week with your loved ones. Today I'm sharing a short tour of San Antonio del Golfo, a beautiful coastal town in the state of Sucre, located a few kilometers from Cumaná on Highway 9, the Cumaná-Paria Peninsula national highway. This picturesque town is known for its beautiful beaches and a mountainous area towards the town of Pericantar. The tour took place in the morning with the first rays of sunlight. On one side of the road, you can see part of the mountain, trees, and vegetation dry due to the season. On the other side of the road are several very beautiful beaches and the headquarters of some institutions such as the police, fire department, and educational center, among others. During this visit, I was able to observe a beautiful purple flower called an orchid. The petals are round and pointed at the top end. The flower is made up of five deep purple petals; the smaller ones are light purple with white lines on the back. I liked the color of this flower. Also, the orchid is the national flower of Venezuela, and there is a great variety of this beautiful plant in the country. This is the first time I've seen this flower. Its color is definitely vibrant and beautiful, and it makes it stand out among the other plants in the garden, which are also flowering and come in a variety of colors. This shade of purple certainly makes it stand out and beautifies the garden. From the moment I saw it, I wanted to take pictures, but first I asked permission from the owner, a lovely grandmother. People there are usually very careful with their gardens; there are even times when taking photos isn't allowed because of the intensity of the sun's rays. So I waited until the afternoon to take a picture of this beautiful plant. This is my entry for the [Qurator's Photo Quest | Purple](https://peakd.com/qurator/@qurator/qurators-photo-quest-or-purple-tedpz3)

> **
ESPAÑOL
** Hola amigos viajeros, les deseo una excelente y bendecida semana en unión de sus seres queridos. Hoy les comparto un pequeño recorrido por San Antonio del Golfo, un hermoso pueblo costero del estado de Sucre, ubicado a pocos kilómetros de Cumaná por la Carretera Nacional Troncal 9, que conecta la Península de Paria con Cumaná. Este pintoresco pueblo es conocido por sus hermosas playas y su zona montañosa cerca de Pericantar. El recorrido se realizó por la mañana, con los primeros rayos de sol. A un lado de la carretera, se puede apreciar parte de la montaña, árboles y vegetación seca debido a la estación. Al otro lado se encuentran varias playas muy hermosas y las sedes de algunas instituciones como la policía, los bomberos y el centro educativo, entre otras. Durante esta visita, pude observar una hermosa flor morada llamada orquídea. Los pétalos son redondos y puntiagudos en el extremo superior. La flor está compuesta por cinco pétalos de color morado intenso; los más pequeños son de color morado claro con líneas blancas en el envés. Me encantó el color de esta flor. Además, la orquídea es la flor nacional de Venezuela, y existe una gran variedad de esta hermosa planta en el país. Es la primera vez que veo esta flor, su su color definitivamente es vibrante y hermoso, además la hace resaltar entre las otras plantas del jardín, que también son florales y con variados colores pero este tono de morado sin duda resalta y embellece el jardín; desde que la vi quise tomar fotos, pero primero le pedí permiso a la dueña, una linda abuela, las personas suelen ser muy cuidadosas con sus jardines, incluso hay horas en las cuales no está permitido tomar fotos por la incidencia de los rayos solares, así que esperé la hora de la tarde para tomarle una foto a esta hermosa planta, esta es mi entrada para el [Qurator's Photo Quest | Purple](https://peakd.com/qurator/@qurator/qurators-photo-quest-or-purple-tedpz3) ![orquídea (7).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23wCG59iFZhn6vteB68694uJn59wqvLb1FjLAuTWCjxjbkvsnpcnYc2d1WFDriJA1qVZd.jpeg) ![morado (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqSWYVV4K2fSweAB4rFnDJEqHv1gpJJ757FNfjP6pvpBXVfwijp9786x2NXAenFrsfe.jpeg) ![morado (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Eqd8bCGzRRvhuLfSoCcELfgW62zyRNKKHCX3Jeh5Z8CLxZ3CYdcS7hqe5fV2oEPA5DA.jpeg) ![morado (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqDj5xprGZAWFaFiP3Dco4iZFyuFyXLiQfDSp8dTDwwEodF9u8BaNSTc8DfNgaxnbUg.jpeg) ![morado (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EoMDoC93ABrxTpwgkxEuuf9Q8fQd4J5maX4iKkoAmsQQCiE1zGFHaBBCPY82VZwUH4t.jpeg)

body.title: Pancakes made with love for my son ❤️
body.body: >Buenas noches a todos. Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes la cena de hoy para mi hijo. Es una de sus comidas favoritas, desde que era bebé le encantan los pancakes y con el tiempo he mejorado bastante en la receta, siempre aprendí a hacerlos gracias a mi mama que siempre me preparaba, pero al principio me salían un poco mal, aunque parezca facil hacer pancakes es todo un arte, he notado muchas cosas que hay que tomar en cuenta al prepararlos. Pero definitivamente, aunque reconozco que hacer pancakes puede ser complicado, me ha tocado ver como otras personas preparan pancakes haciendo una mezcla asquerosa, insípida y desabrida y donde no agregan los ingredientes completos que debería llevar un pancake > Good evening, everyone. Today I want to share with you what I made for my son’s dinner. It’s one of his favorite meals—he’s loved pancakes ever since he was a baby, and over time I’ve really perfected the recipe. I learned how to make them from my mom, who always used to make them for me, but at first they didn’t turn out quite right. Even though making pancakes might seem easy, it’s actually quite an art—I’ve noticed there are many things you have to keep in mind when preparing them. But definitely, even though I admit that making pancakes can be tricky, I’ve seen other people make pancakes with a gross, bland, and tasteless batter—and they don’t even add all the ingredients a pancake should have. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23tvm3ELD7CCpEwqqMM5DLT9k9dJ4jtbC8Dg2BFEoyYhZSJk531URpse3h7WRBv4rM66B.png)

>Un claro ejemplo es esta imagen donde les muestro pancakes que prepararon en la escuela de mi hijo, no deje que comiera eso porque realmente tenia muy mal aspecto, olía muchísimo a harina con agua, la textura era asquerosa, parecía un pan mojado… Y he visto varias personas hacer los pancakes de esta forma, realmente no entiendo cual es el concepto de pancake en este país. > A clear example is this photo, where I’m showing you the pancakes they made at my son’s school. I didn’t let him eat them because they really looked terrible—they smelled strongly of flour and water, the texture was disgusting, and they looked like soggy bread… And I’ve seen several people make pancakes this way; I really don’t understand what the concept of a pancake is in this country. ![Corazón banner (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23uFgAbHNHepcyH3o8wH15M4pR8K7Jsf3tw4TsSj65zyY1UyQpKRK2L9tGpjABj48Qxzb.png)

>Esta es una preparación pequeña ya que solo era para mi hijo, para saber que no hare masa demás utilizo siempre una taza para preparar la mezcla, comenzando por agregar un huevo, luego agrego dos cucharadas de leche en polvo seguido de dos cucharadas pequeñas de azúcar, una pizca de sal y finalmente esencia de vainilla al gusto. > This is a small batch since it was just for my son. To make sure I don’t make too much batter, I always use a cup to prepare the mixture, starting by adding an egg, then two tablespoons of powdered milk, followed by two teaspoons of sugar, a pinch of salt, and finally vanilla extract to taste. ![collage.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23vhwfCrgoxUbMwhBMKFrdG46RgZYuVb8y4XwkgP8NW2iKip1yNCnHiD388eBF1NpwsDe.png)

>Luego agrego agua y con un tenedor comienzo a mezclar todos estos ingredientes, al principio se vera bastante mal, ya que no se integran por completo, pero después agregaremos harina de trigo y comenzaremos a batir nuevamente hasta que desaparezcan los grumos y además tengamos una consistencia espesa pero moldeable. > Then I add water and use a fork to mix all these ingredients together. At first, it will look pretty rough, since they won’t blend completely, but then we’ll add wheat flour and start mixing again until the lumps disappear and we have a thick but malleable consistency. ![collage1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23tvibyunphxtFqcKnsLaQXV1EYimUZpetNB2wvT1RqsYcVovdZy535nEAaJjiEp1Ycna.png)

>Algo importante para que nuestros pancakes queden bien es que el sartén este bastante caliente, con una llama media es suficiente sin exagerar. Normalmente hago una prueba antes de hacer la primera pancake, agrego un poco de mezcla para ver que tal se cocina, luego comienzo a hacer cada pancake y los volteo cuando comienzan a hacer burbujas. Me encanta cuando al voltearlos quedan lisos y dorados, se ven perfectos, luego de sacarlos le agrego mantequilla y queso, normalmente suelo agregarle miel pero se me acabo hace poco. > One important thing to ensure our pancakes turn out well is that the pan is nice and hot; a medium heat is enough—no need to overdo it. I usually do a test before making the first pancake: I add a little batter to see how it cooks, then I start making each pancake and flip them when they start to bubble. I love it when they come out smooth and golden brown—they look perfect. After taking them off the pan, I add butter and cheese; I usually add honey too, but I ran out recently. ![IMG_20260504_204336.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23vsX8DXz1EhDTVLSiXWWfZkmL1ww2jAUJTer1XUJbHnLsW4AfH1h1xcRNaTf3Kw7QWT7.jpg) ![IMG_20260504_204424.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23wWpwp1uRBiL5tGhcA1VXVTUV4KBFwC5XmMuUTL3kSQJM6Ac4oYEDmYXu16rr1ksdLVE.jpg)

body.title: Noche 1✍️
body.body:
Después del cine caminé hasta la plaza, era una noche fría y la ruta estaba tranquila, creo que eran las 10 de la noche y tu estabas llegando al mismo tiempo que yo al punto de encuentro, sonreí de manera nerviosa sin saber que nos preparaban las horas.

Caminé junto a ti por las calles de valdivia húmeda con un rocío de lluvia leve y una platica casual hasta la puerta de tu casa, abriste y sentí un hormigueo... sin duda no estaba preparado para esto, entramos al recibidor de tu casa y podía sentir la vida en cada esquina de aquel lugar, las paredes me hablaban y hasta los himanes y dibujos de tu nevera me contaban historias de quien eras, tenía anteriormente una imagen misteriosa de ti, me causabas cierta desconfianza pero el deseo era más grande, sentado en el mueble de la sala con mis manos en las piernas y mis ojos detallando cada uno de tus gestos... pude entender que tu rostro podía ser serio pero que me regalabas ciertas sonrisas momentáneas qué me demostraban qué no tenía que preocuparme, Roma también puso de su parte y me dio una gran bienvenida pasando su cola por mis piernas, preparaste la cena y nos sentamos a conversar, habían comentarios graciosos y otros que insinuaban o directamente delataban tus intenciones de invitarme a tu cuarto a desnudarnos, no di mucha batalla para negarme y subimos las escaleras, me encanto el olor, la sensación de tranquilidad y el ambiente que se fue creando por la atmósfera en la que tu y yo nos envolvimos, hablamos mil y un cosas y apagaste la luz, encendiste las bombillas de colores y con un babasonicos de fondo dimos rienda suelta a los besos prometidos, el cuarto estaba tibio por el calentador qué encendiste y aun así entre mis nervios mi cuerpo estaba frío, quizás temblaba mucho pero tus piernas me abrigaron, me tomé mi tiempo para quitarte el pantalón y paso lo que ansiabamos, fue maravilloso y aun así lo que más disfrute fueron los momentos que decoraron el antes y el después de hacerte el amor, las diezmil caricias de esa noche, las copas de vino y mi perfume mezclado con el tuyo por la madrugada, sudados, abrigados piel con piel y sin señal de celulares, no había tecnología que cubriera nuestro interés, sencillamente un momento que se volvió sempiterno, tu mirada y la mía como un melao'. Me desperté aquella mañana, me vesti y me fui, no porque no quisiera seguir ahí, si no porque había cumplido nuestro pacto e involucrarme más allá de aquella noche perfecta... habría sido el paso para enamorarme de aquella mujer que me dijo que la única regla era no hacerlo. 

Pdt: antes de irme me emperfume y llene tu bufanda de perfume también. En una jugada tramposa de que te quedaras con mi recuerdo en la mente.

body.title: Arepas with a double serving of plantain and cheese (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> I like to mix up my breakfasts, so this time I decided to make plantain arepas with cheese—both ingredients mixed into the dough—and fill them with plantain slices, shredded cheese, and fried eggs. The combination of flavors sounds amazing to me because of the balance between sweet and savory in a single recipe—something I’ve learned to appreciate thanks to my mother, who makes them so delicious.
![1000113438.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23uQpCfJx3NLWTJWM2fUJWLUymT69o8rQ4VsiYTbxmQQN8aTJhiAhEmiJsP8JoarUKp7C.png)
## Ingredients: - Two ripe plantains - 50 grams of hard cheese for grating - 150 grams of white corn flour - 2 eggs - 2 tablespoons of sugar - 2 cups of water - Oil
![1000113425.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xVW81ve887H2KfFkej6FWGSypJze8Zmj4vxpm3oFpz93XpijLMc1R8Jb4AJ9rFxEhK6.jpg)
## Instructions: I peeled the two bananas, cutting one into chunks and the other into slices. I placed the chopped banana along with two cups of water in the blender and blended until smooth. I poured the mixture into a bowl, then added the cornmeal and sugar, kneaded it well, and finally added a little grated cheese.
![1000113439.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23ywwhPeotnU6WE47E1csvGZU3cwHEfvpCwTkuqpt19PRtT3Yyo9u3ZYwGjKzQPjpEJRd.jpg)
![1000113429.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wqu2uUCgPPDrmBRaniZEm9tMW27pHuSegBsqJFhPFkbZWF18WdAB4CpdUktWRcQcTeL.jpg)
The next step is to heat a budare or griddle, oil the surface, and cook the arepas over low heat. Meanwhile, on another burner, I placed a skillet with a touch of oil and first fried the banana slices, then the egg. You have to pay close attention here because this process is very quick, and you want everything to be just right.
![1000113432.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23y92XtcnjAiwqmSckGAUZarCBRGxs7RR12aCycABoakKeYbmngTs1LUUYqSoajLzFfnx.jpg)
![1000113435.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23vsbLCmyE1mr6UgngesdLLUNJsoU5MHyihvL34xuCrWrjmanyDg11UHWBMCDLhUr5Pqp.jpg)
The last step was to fill the plantain arepas: first a dollop of butter, then the grated cheese so it melts, and finally the plantain slices with the egg. Incredible—once again, my mornings are brightened by these breakfasts. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Me agrada variar mis desayunos, así que esta vez opté por preparar arepas de plátano con queso, ambos ingredientes integrados en la masa, para rellenarlas con tajadas, queso rallado y huevos fritos. La combinación de sabores se me antoja espectacular por el equilibrio entre dulce y salado en una misma receta, aspectos que he aprendido a valorar gracias a mi madre, quien las hace muy sabrosas.
![1000113438.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23uQpCfJx3NLWTJWM2fUJWLUymT69o8rQ4VsiYTbxmQQN8aTJhiAhEmiJsP8JoarUKp7C.png)
## Ingredientes: - Dos plátanos maduros - 50 gramos de queso duro para rallar - 150 gramos de harina de maíz blanca - 2 huevos - 2 cucharadas de azúcar - 2 tazas de agua - Aceite
![1000113425.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xVW81ve887H2KfFkej6FWGSypJze8Zmj4vxpm3oFpz93XpijLMc1R8Jb4AJ9rFxEhK6.jpg)
## Procedimiento: Quité la cáscara a los dos plátanos, uno lo corté en pedazos y el otro en tajadas. El primero lo coloqué junto con dos tazas de agua en el vaso de la licuadora y batí hasta obtener una mezcla homogénea, la cual coloqué en un envase, después agregué la harina de maíz y el azúcar, amasé muy bien y por último puse un poco de queso rallado.
![1000113439.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23ywwhPeotnU6WE47E1csvGZU3cwHEfvpCwTkuqpt19PRtT3Yyo9u3ZYwGjKzQPjpEJRd.jpg)
![1000113429.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wqu2uUCgPPDrmBRaniZEm9tMW27pHuSegBsqJFhPFkbZWF18WdAB4CpdUktWRcQcTeL.jpg)
El próximo paso es calentar un budare o plancha, aceitar la superficie y allí colocar las arepas a cocinar a fuego bajo. Mientras tanto, y en otra hornilla, puse un sartén con un toque de aceite y allí frité primero las tajadas y posteriormente el huevo. Acá hay que estar muy pendiente porque este proceso es muy rápido y se quiere que todo esté en su punto.

body.title: Cerrando un ciclo con una firma en el registro  [Spa/Eng]
body.body:
>

   

*This post is both in English and Spanish, you can go directly to english by clicking [HERE](#english)*
Saludos y bendiciones, mis queridos amigos. Tenía tiempo que no pasaba por aquí; espero que hayan iniciado una semana maravillosa. Hoy ha sido un día de trabajo algo tranquilo a la espera de algunos cambios, de un trabajo que hemos estado realizando que nos lleva al borde de la locura, porque siempre quieren que les estén haciendo cambios y estamos a la espera de algunas otras modificaciones con las que no estamos muy de acuerdo. Así que mientras no nos digan nada, muchísimo mejor; es algo que de verdad no nos beneficiaría en nada. Pero como dice el dicho, donde manda capitán no manda marinero; sin embargo, nosotros nos hemos mantenido firmes en nuestra convicción de hacer las cosas bien hasta donde se pueda.
![1001675907.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/242rs2G6gQ9MakaZAGmSMKaa7vE8jjjEj6wCFRqoMmP7sFnZrmi4oCJguTBJpoke2Jbgp.jpg)

>

Por otro lado, les muestro estas fotos por aquí que me tomé el jueves pasado, en donde tenía una cita muy importante que era la firma de la venta de un apartamento, que junto a mi esposo tenemos años cuidando, y también estuve gestionando todo lo que se refiere a su venta y todos los procedimientos a seguir en cuántos documentos y mudanzas de las cosas que había en el inmueble. En este día por fin se dio a cabo el último paso, que era la firma del documento de compraventa con el que finiquitaba este compromiso que tenía con mi prima. El comprador estaba más que feliz de firmar y yo también porque era un compromiso adquirido que estaba llevando bastante tiempo y quería ya salir de eso. Por acá les dejo una foto cuando hicimos la entrega del apartamento dos días antes de la firma, ya que el nuevo dueño ya había pagado el inmueble.

![1001675908.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23zknCWHY4i7qxC8B66cA26yiH9VY52fyLHg9t94djyCVWu3VizNS2s9h5tL7F21gPkmM.jpg)

>

Este día también teníamos un compartir de cumpleaños en la oficina y, como siempre para estas fechas, que siempre estamos celebrando a final de mes, trato de arreglarme un poquito más de lo normal y mis compañeros de trabajo se reían y me decían que yo parecía la cumpleañera porque estaba muy linda. Por lo pronto, ya he hecho la venta de dos apartamentos que he estado cuidando con mi esposo y espero que cuando vuelva a venir al registro sea para tramitar los documentos de una propiedad que sea de nosotros, con el favor de Dios. Así que estamos decretando, manifestando, dando gracias y trabajando para que podamos un día tener nuestro propio hogar.

![1001675923.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23xVTMYibc7paY2fYiy8rgETzLikqXMfSyNVuVZa981onoUXg2YNp8ouK2JGzFstdD19L.jpg) ![1001675913.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23wgPr2pahX2xUtGFU9UUrobXE9wY2N7mhByGHSjrRmrqPYhJET2bTmwgNxyxf8krN4u5.jpg) ![1001675924.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23vi62F3XQdm6gUcsw5rTBWvAcyvazDe9ZWcbjurjVcpJrNJENh4NpqaqVHR1xrj6fG17.jpg)

>

Bueno, amigos, esto ha sido todo por hoy. Espero pasar por aquí pronto para mostrarles más cositas que he venido realizando y que, por múltiples actividades y también porque no me he sentido muy motivada para escribir, no les he contado, pero tengo bastante material en mi galería para compartirles próximamente. Gracias por visitarme y leerme. Hasta la próxima. ******

![Adobe_Express_20230102_1612060_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23w2sJvBcHBCPY8JjSirrP6WS9kXYNX1comRoVGZKWYTGCHAvnYfyHacxopoxasyiZZhQ.png)

>
![Adobe_Express_20230102_1612060_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23w2sJvBcHBCPY8JjSirrP6WS9kXYNX1comRoVGZKWYTGCHAvnYfyHacxopoxasyiZZhQ.png) # ***Closing a chapter with a signature in the registry*** ![1001675926.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23wgYjoXSaWUF3YtFiCiogH9ip7o1vxnTkQUyeCssJFBF5DmB9rMTzgon2yhuUrumL31e.png)

>

Greetings and blessings, my dear friends. It’s been a while since I’ve stopped by here; I hope you’ve had a wonderful start to the week. Today has been a somewhat quiet day at work as we await some changes—changes to a project we’ve been working on that’s driving us to the brink of madness, because they always want us making changes, and we’re waiting for some other modifications we don’t really agree with. So as long as they don’t tell us anything, all the better; it’s something that really wouldn’t benefit us at all. But as the saying goes, the captain’s word is law; nevertheless, we’ve remained steadfast in our conviction to do things right as much as possible.

![1001675907.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/242rs2G6gQ9MakaZAGmSMKaa7vE8jjjEj6wCFRqoMmP7sFnZrmi4oCJguTBJpoke2Jbgp.jpg)

>

On another note, here are some photos I took last Thursday, when I had a very important appointment to sign the sale of an apartment that my husband and I have been taking care of for years. I’ve also been handling everything related to the sale and all the procedures involved, including paperwork and moving the belongings out of the property. On this day, the final step was finally taken: signing the sales contract, which concluded this commitment I had with my cousin. The buyer was more than happy to sign, and so was I, because it was a long-standing commitment that had been taking quite a while, and I wanted to be done with it. Here’s a photo from when we handed over the apartment two days before the signing, since the new owner had already paid for the property.

![1001675908.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23zknCWHY4i7qxC8B66cA26yiH9VY52fyLHg9t94djyCVWu3VizNS2s9h5tL7F21gPkmM.jpg)

>

We also had a birthday celebration at the office that day, and as is always the case around this time—since we’re always celebrating at the end of the month—I tried to dress up a little more than usual, and my coworkers laughed and told me I looked like the birthday girl because I looked so pretty. For now, I’ve already sold two apartments that my husband and I have been managing, and I hope that the next time I come to the registry office, it will be to process the documents for a property that belongs to us, God willing. So we’re declaring, manifesting, giving thanks, and working so that one day we can have our own home.

![1001675923.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23xVTMYibc7paY2fYiy8rgETzLikqXMfSyNVuVZa981onoUXg2YNp8ouK2JGzFstdD19L.jpg) ![1001675913.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23wgPr2pahX2xUtGFU9UUrobXE9wY2N7mhByGHSjrRmrqPYhJET2bTmwgNxyxf8krN4u5.jpg) ![1001675924.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23vi62F3XQdm6gUcsw5rTBWvAcyvazDe9ZWcbjurjVcpJrNJENh4NpqaqVHR1xrj6fG17.jpg)

>

Well, friends, that’s all for today. I hope to stop by soon to show you more little things I’ve been working on—things I haven’t told you about yet because of my busy schedule and also because I haven’t felt very motivated to write—but I have plenty of material in my gallery to share with you soon. Thank you for visiting and reading. Until next time. **********

![Adobe_Express_20230102_1612060_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23w2sJvBcHBCPY8JjSirrP6WS9kXYNX1comRoVGZKWYTGCHAvnYfyHacxopoxasyiZZhQ.png)

body.title: Actitudes al descubierto # 14. El momento en que entiendes que no era amistad. [ES/EN]
body.body:
---

**Serie:** Actitudes al descubierto  
**Capítulo 14**  
**Título:** El momento en que entiendes que no era amistad  

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdQr4KmpEiV5shfrX6YXBPahcBb5XjwCmKQAbf68dwCJF/icsilviu_workers_6562119_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/workers-men-blue-uniform-6562119/)

---

A veces no hace falta una traición grande… basta un detalle para entenderlo todo.

Hola querida comunidad de @holos-lotus,

Continúo con *Actitudes al descubierto*, esta serie donde observo escenas cotidianas que, con el tiempo, terminan revelando algo más profundo de lo que uno creía entender.

Esta vez no fue una escena breve ni un momento observado al pasar.

Fue una experiencia.

Durante un tiempo compartí trabajo con alguien a quien, en ese momento, consideraba más que un compañero. Venía de esa etapa en la que uno todavía cree que las relaciones laborales pueden tener la misma lealtad que las amistades de juventud. Donde ayudar no se calcula y donde confiar es casi automático.

Yo estaba al frente de una brigada. Él era el chofer del camión.

En nuestro contexto, eso no era un detalle menor. Tener acceso a un vehículo significaba resolver problemas que, de otra forma, eran casi imposibles. Era una ventaja, una herramienta… y también una responsabilidad.

Pero entre nosotros no existía esa distancia rígida de jefe y subordinado.

Cuando él necesitaba algo, yo accedía sin problema. Si tenía que moverse, lo hacía. Si necesitaba transportar materiales, contaba con el camión. Más de una vez incluso ayudé personalmente a cargar.

No lo veía como un favor.

Lo veía como parte de una relación donde ambos contábamos el uno con el otro.

Y, en apariencia, era recíproco.

El tiempo pasó.

Y como ocurre muchas veces, las dinámicas empiezan a cambiar sin que uno lo note de inmediato.

Hubo un momento que lo dejó claro.

Yo tenía que viajar a La Habana por una consulta médica. Era algo necesario, periódico, y como suele pasar, no había muchas opciones para hacerlo sin recurrir al transporte del trabajo. Lo planifiqué. Organicé todo. Dejé resuelto lo necesario.

No era algo excepcional.

De la misma forma en que, en otras ocasiones, le había facilitado viajes mucho más largos. Incluso le había permitido ir a su lugar de origen, bastante distante, quedarse varios días, reorganizando el trabajo para que eso fuera posible.

Ese día, todo estaba listo.

El combustible asignado.

El horario claro.

Ningún inconveniente aparente.

Pero cuando llegó el momento de salir, apareció el primer cambio.

Llegó tarde.

Y dijo que el camión estaba roto.

No había forma de ir.

No había alternativa.

La situación, en cuestión de minutos, pasó de estar resuelta a no tener salida.

Y sin embargo, poco después, el camión salió.

No hacia el destino previsto.

Hacia otro lugar.

Como si nada hubiera pasado.

El combustible tampoco regresó.

Y lo que quedó no fue una discusión.

Ni un enfrentamiento.

Fue algo más silencioso.

Más definitivo.

En ese momento entendí algo que hasta entonces no había querido ver con claridad.

No todas las relaciones que funcionan bien son lo que creemos que son.

No todo lo que parece cercanía es lealtad.

Y no todo lo que damos se recibe desde el mismo lugar.

No fue una gran traición.

No hubo palabras duras.

No hubo necesidad de explicaciones.

Pero bastó.

Porque a veces no es un gran golpe lo que cambia la forma en que ves a alguien.

A veces es un gesto pequeño, en el momento preciso, el que te muestra la realidad sin adornos.

Seguimos trabajando juntos durante mucho tiempo.

Las cosas continuaron.

Pero no fueron iguales.

No hubo ruptura visible.

Pero sí una distancia nueva.

Una forma distinta de entender el vínculo.

Porque hay momentos en los que uno deja de ver a alguien como pensaba…  
y empieza a verlo como realmente es.

---

En los próximos capítulos de *Actitudes al descubierto* seguiré explorando estos momentos donde una experiencia concreta cambia la forma en que entendemos a los demás.

---

## English Version

---

**Series:** Attitudes Uncovered  
**Chapter 14**  
**Title:** The Moment You Realize It Wasn’t Friendship  

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdQr4KmpEiV5shfrX6YXBPahcBb5XjwCmKQAbf68dwCJF/icsilviu_workers_6562119_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/workers-men-blue-uniform-6562119/)

---

Sometimes it doesn’t take a major betrayal… just a small moment to understand everything.

Hello dear @holos-lotus community,

I continue with *Attitudes Uncovered*, this series where I reflect on everyday situations that, over time, reveal something deeper than we initially perceive.

This time, it wasn’t a brief scene or something observed in passing.

It was an experience.

For a period of time, I worked with someone I considered more than just a colleague. I came from that stage in life where one still believes that work relationships can carry the same loyalty as early friendships. Where helping isn’t calculated, and trust is almost automatic.

I was leading a team. He was the truck driver.

In our context, that wasn’t a small detail. Having access to a vehicle meant solving problems that otherwise would have been nearly impossible. It was an advantage, a tool… and also a responsibility.

But between us, there wasn’t that rigid distance between boss and subordinate.

When he needed something, I agreed without hesitation. If he had to go somewhere, he could. If he needed to transport materials, the truck was available. More than once, I even helped load things myself.

I didn’t see it as a favor.

I saw it as part of a relationship where both of us could rely on each other.

And, apparently, it was mutual.

Time passed.

And as it often happens, dynamics begin to shift without us noticing immediately.

There was a moment that made everything clear.

I had to travel to Havana for a medical appointment. It was necessary, periodic, and like many things, there weren’t many options without relying on work transportation. I planned it. Organized everything. Left things in order.

It wasn’t exceptional.

Just as, on other occasions, I had made it possible for him to travel much farther, even allowing him to stay several days away, adjusting work plans to make it happen.

That day, everything was ready.

Fuel assigned.

Schedule clear.

No apparent issues.

But when the time came to leave, something changed.

He arrived late.

And said the truck was broken.

There was no way to go.

No alternative.

In a matter of minutes, what had been solved turned into a dead end.

And yet, shortly after, the truck left.

Not to the intended destination.

But somewhere else.

As if nothing had happened.

The fuel never came back.

And what remained wasn’t an argument.

Nor a confrontation.

It was something quieter.

More definitive.

In that moment, I understood something I hadn’t wanted to see clearly before.

Not every relationship that works well is what we think it is.

Not everything that looks like closeness is loyalty.

And not everything we give is received from the same place.

It wasn’t a major betrayal.

There were no harsh words.

No need for explanations.

But it was enough.

Because sometimes it’s not a big event that changes how you see someone.

Sometimes it’s a small action, at the exact moment, that shows you reality without filters.

We continued working together for a long time.

Things went on.

But they were not the same.

There was no visible break.

But there was a new distance.

A different way of understanding the connection.

Because there are moments when you stop seeing someone the way you used to…  
and start seeing them as they really are.

---

In the next chapters of *Attitudes Uncovered*, I will continue exploring these moments where a real experience reshapes how we understand others.

---

Las imágenes son de Pixabay y para la versión en inglés utilicé el traductor de Google.  
The images are from Pixabay, and for the English version I used Google Translate.

body.title: Hearing But Not Listening To The Word Of God. MCGI TOPIC REVIEW
body.body:
https://youtu.be/6RPVkpuiddU?si=mLjdGULxg7AW-LP8
Hearing and listening. These two words with very distinct meanings. To hear mean to receive the sound waves as it comes into our ears. When someone hears , the words that he or she is hearing does not make any meaning of him or her. It is when we listen to what we have heard that we can actually understand what we have heard. Hearing alone does not confer the information to someone. Listening make someone to actually receive the information. There have been many people talking around us and heard all those noises when we are in public places. It is only when we are listening to someone that we can repeat what he or she said to us.

We should not just hear the word of God, we should listen to it. We should not lose concentration when we are in the audience where the Bible is taught. Let everything in us be attentive to the teachings of the Word of God. The power of the Word of God will not work in us when we are not listening to the teachings of God's word properly. Faith can only come when someone has been taught and he or she tightly understand what the word of God says. Such a person begins to act according to what he or she has heard. It is when we act on the word of God that we can receive the results as the Bible tells us

body.body:
When the Celtics (my team) were up 3-1 I was feeling great because throughout the existence of the NBA only a handful for teams have ever come back from being down 3 games to 1 and advanced.   It is so unlikely that perhaps the Boston Celtics sat on their hands and didn't give it their all because well, Philly (who I loathe) managed to scrap their way back for 3 games in a row and win the dern thing 4-3.   


<center> https://cdn-media.theathletic.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=1200,height=900,fit=cover/bL8nsTwD0CKR_eCQ8ng6G0WrE_1440x960.jpg
[src](https://cdn-media.theathletic.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=1200,height=900,fit=cover/bL8nsTwD0CKR_eCQ8ng6G0WrE_1440x960.jpg) </center>

When it happens once it is something to really get excited about but the cases of it happening two times in the same tournament are astronomically low.   There has only ever been a single team in the near 100 years of NBA playoff history that did it twice in the same tournament and when we are talking about all teams playing, the chances of two teams pulling off this feat in the same year, in the same tournament, is really really low.  There had only been two other seasons in the history of the NBA, until this year, that this feat has ever been accomplished.   Oddly enough, all of the instances of this happening took place in the past 10 years.

<center> https://img.ksl.com/slc/3155/315538/31553801.jpg?filter=kslv2/responsive_story_lg
[src](https://img.ksl.com/slc/3155/315538/31553801.jpg?filter=kslv2/responsive_story_lg)</center>

Now I have to admit hat when Orlando won a game vs the Pistons, I thought it was a fluke.  I figured that the Pistons would just crush the number 8 ranked Orlando Magic and cruise on through to the semi-finals.   But then when Orlando won 3 to Detroit's 1, I think everyone who is an NBA fan was shocked.   That business does a team that barely even made it into the playoffs have defeating a near perfect Detroit Pistons who many believed were going to ease their way to the final and play against (and most likely lose to) the OKC Thunder.

Despite being down 3-1, the bookies had the Pistons favored in every game, often to the tune of 10 points or more.   These bookies definately can see something that us regular people cannot, because outside of one singular game, their predictions were correct as far as the spread was concerned.   

With their backs against the wall, I guess the 76ers and the Pistons play much better.   The final game of both series wasn't even close with both Philly and Detroit winning with what appeared to be relative ease.  

While this was disappointing to me because it looked like my Celtics were finally going to not let us down this year (they find a way!) but yet, they did.  But I also will give credit where credit is due, even if it is the team I dislike the most in the 76ers.   Them and the Pistons have made history in this rather exciting tournament!  What other records will be broken this year?  

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sports.guy55/23swgMwgQHzWgCkNpyNo9VsEkbVjopuwrLMsyLsSRH3c7n9A78m9FPc9DWfgyBk1wV69n.png)
</center>

There's still plenty of excitement remaining but do not pay any attention to the start times of those games, that's just my VPN talking.  

I predict an OKC and Detroit final but if anything has to be learned this year, strange things can and will happen so who knows?  I think the number 1 teams from both sides making it to the final dance is kind of the most boring possible outcome and wouldn't mind seeing an underdog making their way through.

title.title: A 25K step day on a date with my wife.  My Actifit Report Card: May 4 2026
title.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/58cb90fa-7f43-4b53-afb4-bc46c51e2b79.jpg)

Today I went on a date with my wife.  Now I have a whole bunch of pictures but I think I'll spread them across two days because..well, this was yesterday and today I didn't get many interesting pictures.

Yesterday of course it started out with walking the dog and of course it ended with walking the dog.  That rarely changes.  The difference was that my wife wanted to go on a date with me so I only had one real choice.  

Say yes.

Now I'm not entirely sure it was actually wanting to go on a date with me.  I think she may have actually just wanted to go to an eyebrow threading appointment in a specialty place far from home and she didn't know the area so I got roped into driving her.

Or she wanted to spend time with me.  

Take your pick.

Driving was about 45 minutes and I thought we were going to a spa type studio.  In reality?  The place was a medical office where they also did aesthetics.

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6d8f8814-6699-47fb-8f75-efde5427e04e.jpg)

With a room like this I kind of thought \

But she wants to do it and I had to wait an hour while she getting the treatment. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8c1aace7-485f-4fb8-b3e0-d16277fcb19e.jpg) Does this look like the kind of place that I wanted to sit for an hour? Nah... So I went for a walk and found a cool looking game shop. If I was 20 years younger I totally would have wanted to hang out there. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e09f0bb5-9686-4640-ad83-57002039106a.jpg) But no. I went for a walk instead. It was a pretty long walk and when I got back? My wife wanted to go on a pretty long walk. Yeah, I will put that walk in tomorrow's post :) Saving pictures for later :). After the walk it was time for lunch with my wife. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2fe5a40a-ed4c-4197-af9f-92eada4bff37.jpg) Steak and eggs were actually really good and the potatoes were truly excellent, As for taking a picture of my wife? Well, the sun was in my eyes so that didn't work quite so well. I was so sleepy during the lunch but had to drive home (ugh) when I got home? My wife had slept the whole way so she was ready to go. I needed to take a nap. After the nap? Time to do yardwork with my wife. It seems some ivy that she planted had started pulling down the fence between our house and the neighbors. My task. Pull down ivy (and after that mow the yard).. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/409c499d-4b52-4995-bf73-e0a8fbc58723.jpg) There was a LOT of ivy but at the end? We could see our fence again :) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4d3cc539-836d-4a2f-a840-009489dd1a64.jpg) And that... Was most of my day today :) Until tomorrow :)
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@terganftp/actifit-terganftp-20260505t031857677z)_

title.title: 滿地的食材
title.body: >Unsplash 最近看了一個旅遊影片，UP主跟著他在南美洲秘魯認的乾媽，回到乾媽出生的家鄉，是一個蠻偏遠的山區，連乾媽自己的小孩也才第二次才回去過，中間可能飛機巴士都搭了，最後還要開車40分鐘。 影片中有一段讓我比較新奇的地方，就是UP主進到廚房的時候，滿地都是天竺鼠，雖然知道南美洲部分地區有食用天竺鼠的習慣，但沒想到是這樣在廚房直接養著，餐桌上再吃天竺鼠，餐桌下也是天竺鼠。 當然我們這邊可能會認為天竺鼠是寵物類的，很多人會覺得不忍，但當地會有這種傳統，也是因為高山地形影響，古代技術不發達的時候，其他牲口飼養在效率來說不划算，所以就會飼養天竺鼠來食用。 看影片裡的呈現，的確好像很好養，去外面找一綑草丟在地上，天竺鼠就\

的叫圍上來就吃，養在家裡也不怕走失，或著怕其他動物來偷吃，記得以前在小說裡看的，養雞都會被偷，或著被黃鼠狼吃掉。

我雖然覺得這些天竺鼠很可愛，但也能理解吃他們的原因，我同樣也覺得雞啊豬啊牛啊都很可愛，但我自己也是在吃😂，聽說這些農家在家裡養食用動物，都會避免對動物產生感情，不然可能家裡生計都沒有著落了。

title.title: ✨ Conéctate contigo, y la vida adulta [ES/EN]
title.body:
>
![1000027975.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/48EJrUjXr6vkFngXDQ9XSoYfkWJXhBnE6Ns3gsQMmc5vyvFGTWcNWqcadUgJJrsaGV.jpg) Portada hecha en Canva
¡Hola amigos de esta hermosa comunidad de Womentribe! Espero que se encuentren todos muy bien. Hoy me paso por acá tras leer la publicación de @eldiariodelys en donde nos habla de conectar con nuestra adultez, y es un tema que me llegó.  Bueno, ya estoy en la adultez hace rato, pero a veces reniego con la idea de que no me siento lo suficiente adulta a pesar de tener 33 años. Hago y vivo cosas de adulta, pero por momentos es difícil identificarme como una cuando no tengo nada estable, todavía no forme una familia y vivo con mis padres. Ya sé que es una realidad muy común y que nadie me corre más que yo misma, además de que no hay una formula exacta de como debería ser la adultez, cada uno la vive a su manera. También caigo en eso de compararme, incluso con mi entorno cercano. Pero bueno, supongo que eso es humano.   De todos modos, aunque me siento estancada en varias áreas de mi vida, sé que me sigo moviendo hacía dónde quiero estar. Sé que mi ritmo es más lento que el común, ya no reniego de eso, o intento no hacerlo. A veces no me doy cuenta de todo lo que crecí, construí y cambié para bien, pero miro hacía atrás y puedo notar la diferencia. Así que estoy contenta, aunque sí, puede ser agotadora esta idea de que a cierta edad ya deberías tener la vida resuelta o estar encaminada a hacerlo y ver que te cuesta.  Por otro lado, sé que soy adulta y actuó en consecuencia. Como tal, también suelo tener culpa de que me sigan gustando cosas que pueden no verse tan adultas. A mis ojos están bien, soy de la idea de que uno no abandona sus gustos por más que crezca, me sigue gustando jugar juegos de mesa y videojuegos, también mirar anime o leer libros juveniles. Pero sé que a los ojos de los demás soy juzgada si me quedo un sábado a la noche haciendo alguna de estas actividades en lugar de salir con amigos o estar teniendo citas. Me gustan esos planes y soy feliz haciéndolos, mis gustos no me hacen menos adulta. Lo que pesa siempre es la mirada ajena, creo que si no existiera o si no nos importara de verdad, nos animaríamos a mostrarnos tal cual somos sin miedos. Eso nos haría más libres y felices. También es cierto que sigo renegando de esa parte adulta que tiene responsabilidades y poco tiempo para dedicarle a las cosas que me gustan. Pero es parte de la vida, y al final la recompensa es más grande y satisfactoria. Así como también soy consciente que no soy lo suficiente adulta y que todavía me queda mucho por experimentar y animarme a realizar para mi crecimiento. A mis 33 años tampoco tengo las respuestas y no creo que las tenga alguna vez. No sé cómo se supone que tenga que hacer o ser, pero esa es un poco la gracia de vivir.  Ya hable en otras oportunidades de que vinimos a experimentar todas las emociones y sentimientos posibles, y a trazar el camino a nuestra manera. Cada uno tendrá sus propias vivencias, y ninguna es mejor que la otra, todas son valiosas. 
![Separador flores.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/23wgoZopiHNX1ebGWL5athK3UidSkfNjaiHUQLxsXxzCByxighLnHXwMdgiwbR6HWMpZn.png)
Bueno amigos, hasta acá mi reflexión acerca de este tema. Espero que les haya gustado y los invitó a participar a todos. Gracias por llegar hasta acá y apoyar mi contenido. ¡Hasta la próxima! 
![Separador flores.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/23wgoZopiHNX1ebGWL5athK3UidSkfNjaiHUQLxsXxzCByxighLnHXwMdgiwbR6HWMpZn.png)
![1000027976.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/48DptvjeZXTbbeiADEHUKhe9j337PcQzqML9NaJtd5oYVNqEWTUGbub5XeH8Q7WmP2.jpg) Cover made in Canva
Hello, friends of this wonderful Womentribe community! I hope you’re all doing great. I’m stopping by today after reading @eldiariodelys’s post, where she talks about connecting with our adulthood—it’s a topic that really resonated with me. Well, I’ve been an adult for quite a while now, but sometimes I struggle with the idea that I don’t feel “adult” enough, even though I’m 33. I do and experience things that adults do, but at times it’s hard to identify as one when I don’t have anything stable, haven’t started a family yet, and still live with my parents. I know this is a very common reality and that no one is pushing me harder than I am, plus there’s no exact formula for what adulthood should look like—everyone experiences it in their own way. I also fall into the trap of comparing myself, including to those around me. But hey, I guess that’s just human nature. Anyway, even though I feel stuck in several areas of my life, I know I’m still moving toward where I want to be. I know my pace is slower than most people’s; I don’t complain about it anymore—or at least I try not to. Sometimes I don’t realize how much I’ve grown, built, and changed for the better, but when I look back, I can see the difference. So I’m happy, although yes, it can be exhausting to think that by a certain age you should already have your life figured out or be on your way to doing so, and to see that it’s hard for you. On the other hand, I know I’m an adult and I act accordingly. That said, I also tend to feel guilty about still enjoying things that might not seem very “adult.” In my eyes, they’re fine—I believe that you don’t abandon your tastes just because you grow up. I still enjoy playing board games and video games, watching anime, and reading young adult books. But I know that in the eyes of others, I’m judged if I stay in on a Saturday night doing any of these activities instead of going out with friends or going on dates. I like those plans and I’m happy doing them; my tastes don’t make me any less of an adult. What always weighs on me is other people’s judgment. I think that if it didn’t exist—or if we didn’t really care about it—we’d dare to show ourselves exactly as we are, without fear. That would make us freer and happier. It’s also true that I still resent that adult side of me that has responsibilities and little time to devote to the things I enjoy. But that’s part of life, and in the end, the reward is greater and more fulfilling. I’m also aware that I’m not quite grown up enough yet and that I still have a lot left to experience and dare to do for my own growth. At 33, I still don’t have the answers, and I don’t think I ever will. I don’t know how I’m supposed to act or be, but that’s kind of the beauty of life. I’ve mentioned before that we came here to experience every possible emotion and feeling, and to forge our own path. Everyone will have their own experiences, and none is better than the other—they’re all valuable.
![Separador flores.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/23wgoZopiHNX1ebGWL5athK3UidSkfNjaiHUQLxsXxzCByxighLnHXwMdgiwbR6HWMpZn.png)
Well, friends, that wraps up my thoughts on this topic. I hope you enjoyed it, and I invite you all to join in. Thank you for reading this far and supporting my content. See you next time!
![Separador flores.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erigm/23wgoZopiHNX1ebGWL5athK3UidSkfNjaiHUQLxsXxzCByxighLnHXwMdgiwbR6HWMpZn.png)
