title.title: Student mistakes in the classroom.
title.body:
Greetings students. How are you all. I hope you are all doing well and your education is going well. Today I want to inform you about a wonderful thing. 

Although I am currently a parent, I was once a student. I still want to point out to you the mistakes I made while I was a student. Because this world runs on a specific rule. The first car passes through the road, the second car has to pass through that road. So the time we have passed through in life will happen to you now, it is real. So I have prepared this post for you so that you do not make the same mistakes that we made in life.


https://img.leopedia.io/DQmU9eUZjouj4sTNGXJ5qgQbofiwsYzgPcnAULguGtAV4fc/pexels-gustavo-fring-4173335.jpg 

[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/upset-little-girl-sitting-near-crop-woman-in-classroom-4173335/)


Basically, we make various mistakes in the classroom. And because of all those mistakes, we cannot do the learning activities properly and become unpopular with the teacher. 

There are many students among us who are late to school. Basically, the most disliked thing by students is not being able to manage time. There are some students who arrive at school before the time. And there are some students who cannot arrive at school until after the time. This is a very unfortunate thing for them. When students arrive late at school, teachers get very angry. So if we want to be good students for the teacher, then we must arrive at school very quickly. That is, we must arrive at school time to time, otherwise we will not be able to attract the teacher's attention. 

The second thing is, above all, we have to be attentive in the classroom. On one hand, the students are making a fuss and on the other hand, the teacher is teaching the class. That is, the students are not paying attention in the class. This is very bad. 

When the teacher tries to explain something to you, the students, then you must be attentive to the teacher.  If you do not understand the matter, you should repeat it again and ask the teacher. The teacher is trying to explain a matter and you just say yes without understanding. The matter can never be correct. Always try to understand the educational program from the teacher.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWhJ1PJBUUEcKMeaDoXz7wpsqu52Z7R1yoP8vuHoSk4zD/pexels-2158518894-35783673.jpg 


[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/stressed-student-studying-in-classroom-setting-35783673/)


Always enter the classroom clean and tidy. There are many students who enter the classroom dirty. They do not clean their fingernails and do not bathe regularly. Their school uniform is dirty and their hair is messy. Basically, I want to spread this episode among the parents. Always try to send your child to school clean and tidy. Parents should definitely see whether your child's clothes are clean, whether their fingernails are clean and whether their hair is in order.

We must always keep a close eye on our students. It is especially important that our students do well in their studies. Every student helps build a bright future for the nation. So let us all be active and start our educational activities. We will never do anything that angers the teachers in the classroom. We will always follow the teacher's orders and advice and try to stay clean and tidy. Above all, our main characteristic as students is to study well. We will study every day and try to practice knowledge on time. 

 If we follow the above rules, we can be a good student. We will definitely try to avoid all the mistakes that are made in the classroom. Because mistakes lead people astray. It is important to keep this in mind so that we can walk on the right path without going astray. 

Thank you very much for being with the education community. Thank you very much for reading my educational post today. Have a nice day.

title.title: Aiden and Hunter: Their Cute and Funny Moments
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRx4fyBP22zdYafYzKDd7moyU96nasAStvagVGrU9Jv16/1777943064463.png)

Hello everyone!
‎
‎Today I want to share a sweet story about my little boy Aiden and our cat named Hunter.
‎
‎Every single time Aiden sees Hunter, he just cannot help but run towards him. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRAaztUbfeGVmaRMCMHXKsaWNr4Xingk5ifPawMEQsoRK/1777943124297.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTZwLvse2TwofCF3uA5rAwGZ54c7qwsJ3hqgVhCAv1kjR/1777943124456.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf4vCzKJoLUKSiRXGb6Ak1G1raxEJpeMw7rXngcn4VpXB/1777943124583.jpg)
‎
‎He really loves cats and he wants to touch and play with them so much! 
‎
‎But you know how babies are, right? 
‎
‎Their hands are so curious and they hold on really tight. 
‎
‎I am worried that his little grasp might hurt Hunter, or maybe the cat might get annoyed and bite him suddenly. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfUt9y8btY4EtPH8K81ZUpWsfXtmS6hBXd1fN6JUfxuiH/1777943151607.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRvTNHmSzCvJzrcg3TgguzS9fM9RwuLUZCJhJRJVTpCEq/1777943151723.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPaFYF2f2jybVmMri6VJgwtbfVXwLbw1ZsrvCGfr9KPvy/1777943151866.jpg)
‎
‎So I always have to warn Aiden not to go too close. 
‎
‎Safety first! 
‎
‎Well, Hunter is a special cat. 
‎
‎He actually has two homes... 
‎
‎Sometimes he stays here with us, and sometimes he likes to stay at my mother-in-law's house.
‎
‎But do you know what I love most about him? 
‎
‎He is so good at catching cockroaches! 💪🏻 
‎
‎Whenever we see one at night, we just call Hunter and he runs to eat it right away. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUVzDigUbeWtrE5nS8ShRstpC2BPQvxupxeTgiknN8a9D/1777943183653.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWe983RzQwk35WjLv97cfYiaqTP5vozi9WWX1MHsbr15s/1777943183817.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ9HCAJyatW5ebvoLjRD7NPrWReJqNPSt23JtTpoQWt5z/1777943183981.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdB7DFKYKrr4uKiQpKpqvLnxqMaQMKNBoWKYkhdoRt9PQ/1777943184136.jpg)
‎
‎He is really fast and good at his job. No problem at all getting rid of those pests! 
‎
‎But, Aiden is just so \

. He really doesn't want to let Hunter rest! 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUPVCJzxKCk6S95wgZLzJYNsQaehxGu6n8dqtXRx5PJ44/1777943215949.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXwhgt8L8gtsk6g8fq36HbzCYBpVj3i29wjr34mscxQyA/1777943216041.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPkjgBa5xPDtiCtC97xSToFT57MVBnnTEEEkciA5rtBV5/1777943216157.jpg)
‎
‎Even if the cat just wants to sleep or stay quiet, Aiden keeps following him around and trying to play. 🤦🏻‍♀️
‎
‎It is really funny and cute to watch them, but of course, I always have to keep an eye on them. 
‎
‎Until our next cute moments...
‎
‎**Thanks for the visit! Have a lovely day. Buh-bye. 💗🌸**
‎
‎*All images used in this post are my own unless stated otherwise.*
‎

title.title: Television Review: The Benefactor (Mad Men, S2x03, 2008)
title.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/mEWOMeaYVBfcq78XLTqzDLEO7Kt.jpg)


**The Benefactor (S2x03)**

Airdate: 10 August 2008

Written by: Matthew Weiner & Rick Cleveland
Directed by: Leslie Glinka Glatter

Running Time: 48 minutes


Matthew Weiner’s choice to depict the tumultuous decade of the 1960s from the perspective of advertising industry executives and employees proved to be an exceptionally astute creative decision. These individuals were not merely passive observers of momentous cultural shifts; they were, by virtue of their profession, on the forefront of shaping consumer desire and, via the creative class, firmly connected with the entertainment industry. This vantage point allows *Mad Men* to serve a dual purpose: as a penetrating insight into a transformative past and as a veritable treasure trove of pop culture references, where the mechanics of selling products intertwine with the era’s defining media. One such exemplary fusion is found in *The Benefactor*, the third episode of the show’s second season. This instalment masterfully leverages a real television controversy to hold a mirror to the personal and professional machinations of its characters, revealing the brittle facades of control they maintain in a world on the cusp of radical change.

The episode’s engine of conflict is ignited in a utilitarian studio, where the crudely popular comedian Jimmy Barrett (Patrick Fischler) is filming a commercial for Utz Potato Chips. The arrival of the company’s owner, Hunt Schilling (Steve Stapenhorst), and his wife Edith (Jan Hoag)—an ardent fan—sets the stage for disaster. Barrett, unable to resist the lowest-hanging fruit, unleashes a series of brutally insensitive jokes about Edith’s obesity. This represents a catastrophic failure for Sterling Cooper, which had the Utz account. The cardinal sin, as Roger Sterling later elucidates, was allowing the clients near the combustible Barrett, a man whose reputation for offence preceded him. The ensuing scramble for accountability finds Don Draper peculiarly absent, having chosen to spend the afternoon in a cinema watching a pretentious French art film—a futile attempt to connect with a “cool” new world that remains elusive to him. Don’s solution to the crisis is both swift and cowardly: he deflects blame onto his secretary, Lois, demoting her back to the pool of switchboard operators, thus providing a sacrificial lamb to appease the gods of corporate hierarchy.

This professional fiasco, however, also presents an opportunity for Don to reassert his value as a fixer. His plan is to compel a humiliating apology from Barrett to the Schillings. The path to this goal leads him to Bobbie Barrett (Melinda McGraw), Jimmy’s wife and manager, a character of formidable and unapologetic sexual agency. Their initial meeting is a tense negotiation; Bobbie is dismissive of the need for an apology, viewing the incident as trivial client hypersensitivity. The dynamic shifts, however, when they have sex—a transaction of power as much as desire. Don’s strategy culminates in a staged reconciliation at Lutèce, New York’s most elite restaurant, where the Barretts and Schillings are to dine with Don and his wife, Betty. Betty’s participation is secured through immense reluctance, yet once at the table, she performs her wifely duty with devastating efficiency, charming everyone present. Jimmy, emboldened by alcohol and his own nature, shamelessly flirts with her. When he still refuses to apologise, Don follows Bobbie to the restroom. In a chilling display of coercive power, he grabs her and threatens to destroy her husband’s career. The apology is swiftly delivered. Don’s mission is accomplished, but the cost is laid bare in the final scene:As he returns home, he finds Betty weeping, her composure shattered by the evening’s degrading spectacle.

Running parallel to this central drama is the episode’s second major storyline, which serves as a superb study of corporate envy and opportunistic ambition. Harry Crane, feeling undervalued and financially stagnant, accidentally opens a piece of mail intended for Ken Cosgrove and discovers the vast disparity in their salaries. This moment of private humiliation fuels a crisis of confidence. He explores a move to CBS, but a fruitless phone call yields an unexpected prize: intelligence about an upcoming episode of the prestigious legal drama *The Defenders*. Titled “The Benefactors,” the episode deals with the taboo subject of abortion, rendering it so controversial that the show’s regular sponsors have withdrawn. Harry, seeing a chance to prove his worth, attempts to secure a new sponsor through Sterling Cooper. His pitch to Belle Jolie fails, but in the process, he earns the public admiration of the company’s executive, Paul Keeley, for his resourcefulness and bravery. This display of initiative does not go unnoticed. Roger Sterling, impressed, rewards Harry by promoting him to head of a newly created Television Department, complete with a modest raise. This subplot is a perfectly calibrated piece of storytelling, illustrating how personal grievance can be channelled into professional advancement within the mercurial logic of the corporate world.

*The Benefactor* is firmly anchored in television history. *The Defenders*, created by Reginald Rose of *[12 Angry Men](https://peakd.com/film/@drax/retro-film-review-12-angry-men-1957)* fame, was a critically acclaimed series, and the episode “The Benefactors” was indeed pulled from its initial broadcast schedule in May 1962 due to sponsor revolt over its abortion storyline, only airing later after a replacement sponsor was found. The episode’s use of actual footage from the 1962 broadcast is not mere period dressing; it provides a potent meta-commentary. Just as the fictional Sterling Cooper navigates the fallout from Barrett’s offensive humour, the real-life television industry was grappling with the limits of acceptable discourse. The episode smartly parallels these two realms, suggesting that the anxieties about content and sponsorship in entertainment are inextricably linked to the broader cultural anxieties the ad men both exploit and embody.

Co-written by Matthew Weiner and Rick Cleveland and directed with assured clarity by Leslie Linka Glatter, the episode is a model of narrative focus, weaving together only three primary storylines with precision. The Harry Crane plot is a quintessential *Mad Men* exploration of office politics and the slow, often accidental, shifting of cultural attitudes. The minor thread concerning Betty’s struggle with adulterous temptation—she is simultaneously repulsed by Don’s world and drawn to the crude validation offered by Jimmy Barrett’s flirtation—serves to deepen the main narrative, highlighting the emotional collateral damage of Don’s transactional existence.

The episode’s success is significantly bolstered by its casting. Patrick Fischler embodies Jimmy Barrett with a pathetic, wounding energy, channelling the aggressive, insecure humour of era comedians like Jerry Lewis. Even more compelling is Melinda McGraw’s Bobbie Barrett, a revelation as a sexual manipulator who, despite being arguably older than Don, exerts a formidable and unsettling power over the men around her. Their dynamic serves as a fascinating study in layered frustration: Jimmy, presumably henpecked and emasculated by Bobbie’s management, lashes out through alcohol and cruelty; Don, feeling inferior to Roger Sterling’s effortless authority, reasserts control by bullying an innocent subordinate and manipulating his own wife into a degrading performance.

*The Benefactor* also occupies a curious place in *Mad Men* lore due to an unresolved mystery. Matthew Weiner has deliberately never identified the pretentious French art film Don watches in the cinema, leading to years of fervent fan speculation. The prevailing theory suggests the footage was either from an extremely obscure picture or created specifically for the series, a deliberate void that amplifies the episode’s themes of elusive authenticity and Don’s futile pursuit of a sophistication that remains just out of reach.

*The Benefactor* is particularly rich and cohesive entry in the series’ canon. It functions brilliantly as a case study in crisis management and personal compromise, utilising a real-world television controversy to illuminate the fragile ecosystems of advertising, marriage, and corporate ambition. The episode demonstrates how *Mad Men* consistently finds the profound within the professional, revealing the quiet desperation and opportunistic grit that fuelled the American machine on the eve of its most dramatic upheaval.



RATING: 8/10 (+++)

</center>
</liketuimages>

5月3号那天，我上午连上早自习一共五节课。遇上法定假期，我们高三即便有课也不用坐班，整个下午和晚上都能自由放松。于是我和表姐约好，再去上次去过的茉白咖啡厅坐坐。咖啡厅在山上，空气清新，当天天气也不热，我们一拍即合，约好下午两点一起过去。

中午上完课到家已经快一点了，婆婆早就做好了午饭。我们匆匆吃完，下楼买了些零食，又带上家里的水果，就往茉白咖啡厅出发。上次没带Sheya过来，这次特意带上她一起感受氛围。出发前我让她自己收拾东西，她装了爱看的书、点读笔和画画本，之前新买的小书包刚好派上用场。

咖啡厅在老城区，离住处不算远，开车大概十分钟。可和上次一样，我们又走错了路，顺着山坡一直往上开，才发现咖啡厅在另一头，只好原路折返。好在路边停车方便，虽是节假日，空位却不少，应该是我们来得比较早。

我们依旧选了户外遮阳伞下的位置。天气介于阴天和晴天之间，偶尔透一点日光，温度宜人，完全没有那种闷热感，体感特别舒服。店里大部分顾客也和我们一样，都偏爱坐户外，很少有人待在室内。

点餐的还是那位大叔，我们又打趣了他一番。没想到他居然还记得我们，说我们上次就笑过他的点单方式很特别：没有对讲机，我们说一句，他就发一条微信语音，还会外放一遍，样子特别喜感。我觉得桌上要是有点餐二维码会方便很多，大叔却觉得自己这样操作也挺好。

这次我们点了一杯美式、两杯拿铁，再加两份小吃，已经足够了，我们自己还带了不少水果、坚果之类的零食。

这里物价不算便宜，一杯咖啡就要38元，对比瑞幸特价时9块9的黄油拿铁，差价不小。不过这家咖啡店胜在氛围和独特的地理位置，定价偏高也情有可原。

坐定之后，我拿出第二天要上的课程内容备课许久。毕竟第二天一早就要上课，只能提前准备。好在在这样惬意的环境里备课，整个人都很放松。

Sheya很快就找到了玩伴，隔壁桌有个小弟弟，两人一起画画，时不时到处跑动玩耍，一下午的时光过得特别惬意。

---

title.title: ✨Reinventando mi nuevo estilo en la confección 🪡,\
//✨Reinventing my new style in sewing 🪡,\
[Esp~Eng]
title.body: >¿No han escuchado decir la frase, borrón y cuentas nuevas?** # > Haven't you heard the phrase, \

>Esa frase es la que me dió el impulso de hacer un cambio en mi emprendimiento de confección y costura en mi hogar,y la verdad les digo que ya Sido muy tedioso este nuevo comienzo, porque por más que quisiera expandir mi negocio,no se ha podido dar como lo imagino,pero siempre está ese pensamiento de quieren aventurarse,de hacer algo sin pensarlo tanto y eso es lo que les voy a contar aquí con detalles,y fotos de mis ideas en costura que he venido haciendo desde que hice borrón y cuentas nuevas.** # > That phrase is what gave me the impetus to make a change in my home-based sewing and tailoring business, and the truth is that this new beginning has been very tedious, because as much as I would like to expand my business, it hasn't been possible as I imagined, but there's always that thought of wanting to venture out, to do something without thinking too much, and that's what I'm going to tell you here in detail, with photos of my sewing ideas that I've been working on since I started from scratch. --- #
![1000267552.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdb58qp88wNWesoBwCkFVvPC3bmPbsFkNhwpK7ZH9dG9T/1000267552.jpg)
![1000267549.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRLYgQZaxSQZAoKgJ1FGo2QMfk95uq3bhAJmibMVxoKKM/1000267549.jpg)
![1000267546.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRyt8pnskFBgCem41RCsvmUVzntoFgGoBtAfmVgzqBAxv/1000267546.jpg)
![1000267541.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbU4TPoCMoetkT3z7mt1Y9bCcAHWdCh9fJRdVtYodrswF/1000267541.jpg)
# **

>Para comenzar con un nuevo comienzo,me tuve que hacer un nuevo inventario,para hacer prendas de ropa más a la moda,y también algo que más personas le llame la atención,y me quise enfocar en la ropa deportiva,y casual. También pensé en comenzar a hacer también uniformes para enfermería,y suéteres personalizados para cuando comience en frio y la lluvia en mi localidad. Pero antes debía comenzar con el adelanto que ya tenía y con el presupuesto con el que contaba en el momento.** # > To start anew, I had to create a new inventory to make more fashionable clothing items, something that would appeal to more people. I wanted to focus on sportswear and casual wear. I also thought about starting to make nursing uniforms and custom sweaters for when the cold and rainy weather arrives in my area. But first, I had to work with the advance I already had and the budget I had at the time. --- # **

>Como materiales seguí usando la tela microdurasno. Entre las prendas que quise agregar mi creatividad,fueron las franelillas con capuchas,y también se me ocurrió mandar a hacer diseños en dtf personalizados ,pero que cada franelillas tuviera un diseño diferente.** # > For materials, I continued using microdurano fabric. Among the garments where I wanted to add my creativity were the hooded tank tops, and I also thought of having custom DTF designs made, but with each tank top having a different design. --- #
![1000267554.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbyB6Ssvmd84J8BAte8wWM4tGX91HVk5tApAm4yfsRCBT/1000267554.jpg)
# **

>Al igual que las franelillas,se me ocurrió la idea de hacer los mismo en franelas también,ero solo en franelas en color blanco,y así también tener más variedad que ofrecer a las personas.** # > Just like with the flannel shirts, I had the idea to do the same with flannel shirts too, but only with white flannel shirts, and that way I would also have more variety to offer people. --- #
![1000267559.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdL79Akh1mqyPRHZKeJDFF1nG69iMidfpf1GvC3tFQpGQ/1000267559.jpg) ![1000264852.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme4kbFya8aS88FJTN3BhY93Gy6hGLRGBWqGqbbdhRGkYe/1000264852.jpg)
# **

>También de una tela de mallas,hice un chaleco tipo deportivo,y si,pensé en enfocarme en ropa deportiva. Además también hice una bermuda muy bonita con mi toque personal en el que le agregué una cinta decorativa de puma y detalles extras para que sea una prenda totalmente diferente.Aquí en dónde vivo hay varios gimnasio y también conozco a varioa personas que van al gimnasio y posiblemente me puedan comprar.** # > I also made a sporty vest from mesh fabric, and yes, I decided to focus on sportswear. I also made a really nice pair of shorts with my own personal touch, adding a decorative Puma ribbon and other details to make them unique. There are several gyms where I live, and I know a few people who go to the gym and might be able to buy some from me. --- # **

>Estar aquí y haber compartido con ustedes este comienzo a un nuevo paso en mi camino,en el que quiero continuar y no desistir,ya que mi sueño es tener mi marca de ropa y tienda,pero para eso debo esforzarse y no desanimarme en el intento. Si pasaste por mi post te doy las gracias por haberte detenido un momento aquí y haberme acompañado en este momento tan importante para mí hasta pronto 🌹👋✨** # > Being here and sharing this new beginning with you all is wonderful. I want to continue on this path and not give up, because my dream is to have my own clothing brand and store. But to achieve that, I must work hard and not get discouraged. If you've read my post, thank you for taking a moment to be here and for joining me during this important time. Until next time! 🌹👋✨ --- # **

title.title: Chicken Stew with Bell Peppers (Eng/Esp)
title.body:
> My lunch today was a delicious chicken stew. Although I’ve made it several times, I always try to vary the ingredients or the preparation method because it can enhance the flavor. In this case, the change was in the bell peppers, which have a distinctive flavor—very different from that of sweet peppers—that brings out the aroma and vegetable-like taste.
![1000113421.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xAVYWZkKGZCjjqGiKTAy5GusnCKKkNFH4Q7pusYt6rzFyqoknMSdNaqnS837uHLw3rt.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 3 pieces of chicken - 2 onions - 2 medium green bell peppers - 7 sweet peppers - Salt to taste - Oil
![1000113412.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23wgHUJk7BdTucWvUuJGuvfzTpVjEpQakCdu5W2jHauzpn29ECoCY5cPyjH54Ab8pQLai.jpg)
## Preparation: I removed the skin from the chicken, cut it into pieces, grated an onion, and rubbed it over the chicken along with a pinch of salt. This process helps enhance the flavor, which is especially noticeable if the chicken has been thawed.
![1000113408.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/EoyNz5yPGPWcnyCVZTuABFLH6zaZn2GgaU3b5E2RNzmuKQnpXjS6h7YRk6inaAVN79d.jpg)
![1000113415.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23u5ztmJMLkZ3NozDGtHZD243DEi93PMe72msjTm7SP71z89g1LWJHQ497eyVGR5LiHBV.jpg)
Next, I removed the seeds from the chili peppers and bell peppers to avoid making the dish too spicy, then cut them into small pieces. I also peeled the outer layer of the other onion and chopped it in the same way. I used more bell peppers than the other vegetables. I poured two tablespoons of oil into a skillet and sautéed the seasonings. Once they were soft, I added the three pieces of chicken and 1/2 cup of water, then covered the pan to let it cook.
![1000113419.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23tmMvrzCbPWEAFjU3o6tSki3nGC8zDcBTHg5xF4UwPXaX2ZJdpDVH3ewaa8WTAKG1eoe.jpg)
In twenty minutes, it was ready: a chicken stew with a delicious paprika flavor. I served it with white rice, which I also sautéed with onion, bell pepper, and paprika—a combination that complemented the dish perfectly, making for a delightful lunch. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Mi almuerzo de hoy fue un delicioso pollo guisado, si bien lo he realizado en varias ocasiones, siempre busco variedad en los ingredientes o en la preparación pues el sabor puede mejorar. En este caso, el cambio estuvo en los pimentones, los cuales poseen un sabor particular, muy distinto al del ají dulce, que acentúa el aroma y el gusto a vegetal.
![1000113421.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xAVYWZkKGZCjjqGiKTAy5GusnCKKkNFH4Q7pusYt6rzFyqoknMSdNaqnS837uHLw3rt.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 3 piezas de pollo - 2 cebollas - 2 pimentones medianos y verdes - 7 ajíes dulces - Sal al gusto - Aceite
![1000113412.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23wgHUJk7BdTucWvUuJGuvfzTpVjEpQakCdu5W2jHauzpn29ECoCY5cPyjH54Ab8pQLai.jpg)
## Preparación: Retiré el cuero del pollo, corté en pedazos, rallé una cebolla y se la unté, al igual que una pizca de sal. Este proceso contribuye a dar más sabor, lo que se aprecia si la pieza de pollo es descongelada.
![1000113408.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/EoyNz5yPGPWcnyCVZTuABFLH6zaZn2GgaU3b5E2RNzmuKQnpXjS6h7YRk6inaAVN79d.jpg)
![1000113415.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23u5ztmJMLkZ3NozDGtHZD243DEi93PMe72msjTm7SP71z89g1LWJHQ497eyVGR5LiHBV.jpg)
Después retiré las semillas de los ajíes y los pimentones, para evitar el riesgo de una comida picante, luego dividí en pedazos pequeños. También quité la primera capa de la otra cebolla y piqué de la misma forma. La proporción de los pimentones era mayor al del resto de vegetales. En un sartén coloqué dos cucharadas de aceite y sofreí los aliños, cuando estuvieron blandos, agregué las tres piezas de pollo y la 1/2 de taza de agua, tapé para que se cocinara.
![1000113419.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23tmMvrzCbPWEAFjU3o6tSki3nGC8zDcBTHg5xF4UwPXaX2ZJdpDVH3ewaa8WTAKG1eoe.jpg)
En veinte minutos estuvo listo, un pollo guisado con un exquisito gusto a pimentones. Lo acompañé con un arroz blanco el cual también sofreí con cebolla, ají dulce y pimentón, combinación que se complementó muy bien, ofreciendo una grata experiencia en el almuerzo. *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

Una dolorosa  temática universal que está latente cuando los buenos consejos faltan y la soledad, quizás acompañada con la pobreza, aumentar las víctimas. A pesar de todo, Arrepentida, tiene un final feliz pero con un camino muy doloroso hacia la vida, hacia lograr el gran tesoro de que un hijo vea la luz, que sienta la vida.

In the video you will be able to appreciate details of the artwork where the color and the atmosphere that overwhelm the drawing represent the mystery of its gloomy theme. A painful universal theme that emerges when good advice is absent and loneliness, perhaps accompanied by poverty, increases the victims. Despite everything, Repentant has a happy ending, though with a very painful path toward life, toward achieving the great treasure of a child seeing the light, of feeling life.

title.title: Ranma ½ (2024) - Season 2 | Nattosheru Review [ENG/SPA]
title.body: >\n\nHello, anime fans. We’re back with more gems from last year’s anime world, this time featuring the return of one of the most popular and controversial remakes of recent times. A return that didn’t generate as much excitement as its first season did when it premiered almost two years ago. Based on the manga series of the same name written and illustrated by the great
>Rumiko Takahashi, Ranma ½ was produced by the famous
>MAPPA studio. Let’s talk again about the anime of the boy who turns into a girl when he gets wet.

>
Hola, fanáticos del anime. Volvemos con más joyas del mundo del anime del año pasado, esta vez con el regreso de uno de los remakes más populares y polémicos que han existido en la actualidad. Un regreso que no causó tanta emoción como lo tuvo con su primera temporada estrenada hace casi dos años. Basada en la serie de manga homónima escrita e ilustrada por la gran Rumiko Takahashi, Ranma ½ fue producida por el famoso estudio MAPPA. Volvamos a hablar del anime del chico que se convierte en mujer cuando se moja.

>

Plot

The second season begins with the return of Akane Tendo and Ranma Saotome, who, after learning that their parents have arranged their engagement, have no choice but to live together while attending school. After some time, one of Ranma’s romantic rivals, Hikaru Goensuki, returns to pursue his goal of marrying Akane. However, seeing that she pays him no attention, he decides to declare war on Ranma, her current fiancé. Despite all his efforts, Hikaru cannot defeat him in any way. That is when the eccentric Kasumi appears to him and reveals Ranma’s weakness so he can use it against him.

>

Trama

La segunda temporada inicia con el regreso de Akane Tendo y Saotome Ranma quienes, después de enterarse de que están comprometidos por decisión de sus padres, no tienen otra opción que vivir juntos mientras van a la escuela. Luego de un tiempo así, uno de los rivales amorosos de Ranma, Hikaru Goensuki, vuelve para cumplir con su objetivo de casarse con Akane. Sin embargo, al ver que ella no le presta atención, decide declararle la guerra a Ranma, su actual prometido. A pesar de todos sus esfuerzos, Hikaru no consigue vencerlo de ningún modo. Es así como el rarito de Kasumi se le aparece y le cuenta la debilidad de Ranma para utilizarlo en su contra.

/> Here’s the trailer for the second season of this anime: https://youtu.be/qf_pRksXtTw?si=FyZdae5IK6AyBlQV

By:
>\n\nThis isn’t the first time I’ve talked about this anime; as you can see at the beginning, I already reviewed the <strong><a href=\

>previous season when it aired in 2024. Exactly one year later, toward the end of last year, this remake of Ranma ½ returned, produced by the same team as before. Despite its highly anticipated return, it didn’t make as big an impact as before due to the fierce competition that season and because the remake was geared more toward fans of the original series. But even so, despite all the criticism it received—whether for its animation, production, or character designs—I personally found it to be a very entertaining anime. I admit I’ve never been able to watch the first anime adaptation from the late ’80s and early ’90s by Studio Deen. So, whatever my opinion of this recent remake may be, I’ll never be able to compare one adaptation to the other. The same goes for the manga of the same name, which I haven’t read either, so I can’t tell you how faithful this new anime adaptation is to the original work.

>
No es la primera vez que hablo de este anime ya que, como pueden leer al principio, ya les había hecho una reseña a la temporada anterior cuando fue emitida en el 2024. Justo un año después, para finales del año pasado, regresó este remake de Ranma ½ del cual estuvo a cargo los mismo productores de antes. A pesar del regreso tan esperado que tuvo, no consiguió un impacto similar al que tuvo anteriormente debido a la alta competencia que hubo en aquella temporada y porque dicho remake estuvo más hecho para los que son más fans de la obra original. Pero aún así, con todas las críticas que tuvo ya sea por su animación, producción o diseño de algunos personajes; para mí fue un anime muy entretenido, en lo personal. Admito que nunca he podido ver la primera adaptación animada que tuvo a finales de los 80 y principios de los 90 con Studio Deen. Así que, sea lo que sea que opine de este reciente remake, nunca podré comparar una adaptación con otra. Lo mismo sucede con el manga homónimo, el cual tampoco he leído, así que no puedo asegurarles qué tan fiel a la obra original es esta nueva adaptación animada.

> This second season of Ranma ½ kicks off with a bang, delivering the same kind of events we’ve come to expect from the previous season. To avoid spoilers, I’ll just say that every episode of this anime is a unique blend of comedy and action (mostly martial arts), with a touch of romance and fantasy. I say “a touch of romance” because this animated series isn’t really romantic in the traditional sense. What stands out most is both the comedy and the action it features. Remember, we’re talking about the story of two young people from families that practice martial arts. On one hand, we have Akane Tendo, the third daughter of Soun Tendo, who runs a dojo where “Musabetsu Kakutō Ryū” (Anything-Goes School of Martial Arts) is practiced. On the other hand, there’s Ranma Saotome, the son of Gemma Saotome, with whom he has traveled the world in search of different fighting styles. And as if that weren’t enough, the other supporting characters we see in this anime—who are always trailing after the main couple—also each practice some form of martial arts. In this second season, we also see the introduction and development of some new characters.

>
Esta segunda temporada de Ranma ½ empieza con todo, dándonos los típicos eventos que ya nos acostumbró ver en la temporada anterior. Para no darles ningún spoiler, solo les diré que cada episodio de este anime es una mezcla única de comedia con acción (principalmente artes marciales), un toque de romance y fantasía. Digo un toque de romance ya que de romántico como tal no tiene casi esta obra animada. Lo que se destaca principalmente es tanto la comedia como la acción que posee. Recordemos que estamos hablando de la historia de dos jóvenes de familias que practican artes marciales. Por un lado tenemos a Akane Tendo, la tercera hija de Soun Tendo quien tiene un dojo donde se practica “Musabetsu Kakutō Ryū” (Anything-Goes School of Martial Arts). Por otro lado, está Ranma Saotome, hijo de Gemma Saotome con quien ha viajado por todo el mundo en busca de distintos estilos de pelea. Y como si no fuera suficiente con esto, los demás personajes secundarios que vemos en este anime y que andan detrás de esta pareja de protagonistas también practican algún estilo de arte marcial cada uno. En esta segunda temporada vemos también la aparición y desarrollo de algunos nuevos personajes.

> One of them is the strange and antisocial Hikaru Goensuki, who is in love with Akane Tendo and seeks revenge on Ranma by forcing him to reveal his secrets to the school. Another character who stood out a lot in this new season is the grandmother of the beautiful Shampoo, the elderly Cologne, who puts Ranma’s skills to the test because he is supposedly her granddaughter’s future fiancé. Another rival of Ranma’s is the nearsighted and scruffy Mousse, who is also in love with Akane and always ends up fighting Ranma for her hand. But there aren’t just new characters; we also see the return of familiar faces like Ryoga Hibiki, who also appears in this second season, though not as much as in the previous one. What makes this anime entertaining is that each episode is dedicated to a particular secondary character who has a romantic interest in one of the protagonists: Akane and Ranma. Because yes, not only does Akane have a line of suitors who constantly fight with Ranma over her, but our resourceful protagonist also has his own admirers (both as a man and when he turns into a woman).

>
Uno de ellos es el extraño y asocial Hikaru Goensuki, quien está enamorado de Akane Tendo y busca vengarse de Ranma obligándolo a revelar sus secretos ante la escuela. Otro personaje que destacó mucho en esta nueva temporada es la abuela de la hermosa Shampoo, la vieja Cologne quien pone a prueba las habilidades de Ranma debido a que, supuestamente, es el futuro prometido de su nieta. Otro rival de Ranma es el miope y sucio Mousse quien también está enamorado de Akane y siempre termina peleando con Ranma por su mano. Pero no solo hay personajes nuevos, sino que también vemos el regreso de otros personajes ya conocidos como lo es Ryoga Hibiki quien también tiene su participación en esta segunda temporada, pero no fue tanto como en la temporada pasada. Lo entretenido de este anime es que cada episodio es dedicado a algún personaje secundario en particular quien tiene algún interés amoroso con uno de los protagonistas: Akane y Ranma. Porque sí, no solo Akane tiene una fila de enamorados que pelean constantemente con Ranma por ella, sino que también nuestro hábil protagonista tiene sus enamoradas (tanto como hombre como también cuando se convierte en mujer).

> First off, we have Shampoo, whom we already know from last season and who has become a beloved character (for obvious reasons) among her fans. After being defeated by Ranma while traveling through China with her father, Shampoo sets out in search of her future fiancé and uses some rather dangerous methods to achieve this. Another girl who appears in this second season of Ranma ½ is Ukyo Kuonji, who was a childhood friend of Ranma’s. I love all the variety of characters this anime brings, as they offer us different short and entertaining stories. I also enjoy seeing how the protagonists interact with and/or clash against their rivals and love interests, as if we were constantly watching a martial arts competition—but with young, headstrong, and eccentric lovers. This blend of action, comedy, and romance is one of the most entertaining aspects this anime has to offer, and I think that’s why it became so popular at the end of the last century. It’s no surprise that many people were excited at the time to learn that this anime gem would be getting a Netflix remake.

>
Para empezar, tenemos a Shampoo quien ya conocemos de la temporada pasada y que se ha vuelto un personaje muy querido (por obvias razones) entre su fandom. Luego de ser derrotada por Ranma mientras estaba de viaje con su padre por China, Shampoo va en busca de su futuro prometido y utiliza métodos un tanto peligrosos para lograr esto. Otra chica que aparece en esta segunda temporada de Ranma ½ es Ukyo Kuonji quien fue una amiga de la infancia de Ranma. Me gusta toda esta variedad de personajes que nos trae este anime ya que nos ofrecen distintas historias cortas y entretenidas. También me gusta ver cómo los protagonistas se relacionan y/o se enfrentan con sus rivales e intereses amorosos como si todo el tiempo estuviéramos viendo una competencia de artes marciales, pero con jóvenes enamorados, tercos y extravagantes. Dicha manera de mezclar la acción con la comedia y el romance es de lo más entretenido que tiene este anime para ofrecer y creo que por eso es que se volvió muy popular a finales del siglo pasado. No me extraña que a mucha gente le emocionó en su momento saber que ésta joya de anime tendría un remake por parte de Netflix.

> Now, as for the story itself in this anime, I do have some complaints. I understand that, in terms of the romance, it takes time to develop the complicated relationship between Akane and Ranma, starting from their arranged engagement at the beginning. But all we see in both the first and this second season are just different events involving secondary characters who constantly get in the way of their relationship. This is good, on one hand, since we get to see a variety of characters who help develop both the protagonists and their relationship. One thing worth noting about Akane and Ranma’s relationship is that neither of them agrees with the engagement their parents arranged. I’m reminding you of this because it’s what we see from the very beginning of the anime. That’s why it’s striking how they both argue, fight, and even scheme to find a way to end their engagement so they can “be happy.” But over time, and with all the things and situations they go through in these two seasons (especially in this second one), we see how they reconsider their relationship and gradually grow closer. That’s why I understand a little why their relationship takes time to develop.

>
Ahora, en cuanto a la historia como tal de este anime tengo mis quejas al respecto. Entiendo que, en cuanto a lo romántico, tenga su tiempo para desarrollar la complicada relación que tienen Akane y Ranma desde su compromiso arreglado al principio. Pero todo lo que vemos tanto en la primera como en esta segunda temporada son solo eventos diferentes de personajes secundarios que se interponen constantemente en la relación de ambos. Esto es bueno, por un lado, ya que podemos ver una variedad de personajes que ayudarán a desarrollar tanto a los protagonistas como la relación que tienen. Algo a destacar de la relación de Akane y Ranma es que ninguno de los dos está de acuerdo con dicho compromiso que arreglaron sus padres. Les recuerdo esto ya que es lo que vemos desde un inicio del anime. Es por eso que llama la atención cómo ambos discuten, pelean y hasta maquinan alguna forma de terminar con su compromiso y así “ser felices”. Pero con el tiempo y la cantidad de cosas y situaciones que viven ambos en estas dos temporadas (sobre todo en esta segunda) vemos cómo reconsideran su relación y se unen poco a poco. Es por eso que comprendo un poco que su relación se tome su tiempo para desarrollarse.

> As I mentioned at the beginning, this anime focuses more on action and comedy than on romance per se. Another thing I like about this anime is the fantastical ability some characters have to transform into animals—or, in Ranma’s case, into a woman. At first, it seems like a basic narrative device to add some drama and humor to the story, with the mystery of whether or not the female version of Ranma is actually a different person. Aside from the Fanservice they throw in, this trope becomes a bit cliché over time as we see that other characters also have a similar curse. And speaking of Fanservice, I overlooked another new character we meet in this second season: the old man Haposai. His entire personality is completely designed to be one of the most despicable and disgusting we’ve seen in this anime. Honestly, I don’t quite get the suggestive and absurd humor this anime sometimes has, but hey, we’re talking about a remake of a 90s comedy anime. Let’s remember that back then, humor was very different from what we see now.

>
Como les dije al principio, es más acción y comedia lo que vemos en este anime que romance como tal. Otra cosa que me gusta de este anime es el recurso fantástico que tienen algunos personajes para que se conviertan en animales o, en el caso de Ranma, en mujer. Al principio se ve como un recurso narrativo básico para darle algo de drama y humor a la historia con el misticismo de que la versión mujer de Ranma es o no es otra persona. Aparte del Fanservice que le agregan, este recurso se vuelve un poco cliché con el paso del tiempo al ver que otros personajes también tienen una maldición parecida. Y hablando de Fanservice, se me pasó por alto otro personaje nuevo que conocemos en esta segunda temporada como lo es el viejo Haposai. Toda su personalidad está completamente diseñada para ser de los más despreciable y asqueroso que hayamos visto en este anime. Sinceramente no comprendo bien el estilo de humor tan sugerente y absurdo que a veces tiene este anime, pero bueno, estamos hablando de un remake de un anime de comedia de los años 90. Recordemos que en aquella época el humor era muy diferente que el que vemos ahora.

> But despite all that, I won’t deny that I still had fun watching it. Even though it has plenty of absurd moments, it’s entertaining for the most part, and its story—even if it doesn’t seem like it—does have a somewhat progressive development. Especially when it comes to the main characters, we see some growth from one season to the next. As much as I might complain about how slow they’re moving with the romance, everything else isn’t bad at all, honestly. Especially when it comes to the audiovisuals, it manages to maintain a standard of quality without straying too far from the classic and iconic style of the original work. This is something many have complained about, especially since we’re talking about MAPPA, one of the largest studios in all of Japan. But I think they’ve done a good job of balancing an animation style that reminds us more of the original work, but with a quality and fluidity that really stands out, especially in battle or chase scenes. I also like the character designs, regardless of what people think. The light and varied color palette is also excellent, as is the use of lighting, shadows, and visual and motion effects.

>
Pero a pesar de todo eso, no voy a negar que me he divertido viéndolo igualmente. A pesar de tener muchos momentos absurdos, es entretenido en gran parte y su historia, por mucho que no lo aparente, sí tiene un desarrollo medianamente progresivo. Sobre todo en lo que respecta a sus personajes principales vemos un cierto avance entre una temporada y otra. Por mucho que me llegue a quejar de lo lento que van con lo que respecta al romance, todo lo demás no está para nada mal, honestamente. Sobre todo en cuanto a lo audiovisual se refiere, logra mantener un estándar de calidad sin alejarse mucho del estilo clásico e icónico que posee la obra original. Esto es algo que muchos se han quejado, sobre todo porque estamos hablando de MAPPA, uno de los estudios más grandes de todo Japón. Pero considero que han hecho bien en equilibrar un estilo de animación que nos recuerda más a la obra original, pero con una calidad y fluidez que resalta mucho, sobre todo en escenas de batallas o persecuciones. Los diseños de los personajes también me gustan, indiferentemente de lo que opine la gente. La paleta de colores claros y variados también es excelente, al igual que el uso de luces, sombras y efectos visuales y de movimiento.

> What I like most is that they’ve always stuck to a very traditional animation style, rarely resorting to computer-generated animation—something I really hate. Another aspect I really like is the visual detail in this modern adaptation. The sound effects also stand out, especially during action scenes and explosions. The soundtrack is good too, though it doesn’t really stand out as much as you’d expect, to be honest. A lot of the time, it even takes a back seat. Anyway, here’s an anime that might interest you.
Personally, I’d give it a 8.5/10 in terms of the action, comedy, and romance genres.

>
Lo que más me gusta es que han mantenido siempre un estilo de animación de lo más tradicional, sin necesidad de recurrir casi nunca a la animación hecha por computadora, cosa que deteste bastante. Otro detalle que me gusta mucho son los detalles visuales que tiene esta adaptación moderna. Los efectos de sonido también destacan por su parte, sobre todo cuando vamos a ver escenas de acción y explosiones. La banda sonora también es buena, aunque no destaca tanto como uno esperaría, la verdad. Muchas veces hasta queda en segundo o tercer plano. En fin, aquí les dejo un anime que podría interesarte.
Personalmente, le doy una calificación de 8.5/10 en lo que respecta al género de acción, comedia y romance.

>
Tell me, have you seen this anime yet? What did you think of it? Feel free to leave your thoughts in the comments.

>
Dime, ¿ya has visto este anime? ¿Qué te ha parecido? Puedes dejarme tu respuesta en los comentarios.

![GridArt_20260502_215409394.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AKHzuw7S6UihvJEXDAY5gZua2c3YFAC2xHBkGReNktDiDBjyHcYPUzqfSAL4wUh.jpg)
Hola hola mis queridísimos lectores, espero que tengas un excelente inicio de semana y sea de mucho provecho, la noche de hoy aprovecho para compartirles un nuevo contenido resaltando las diferentes actividades que presento en mi lugar de trabajo, una mañana de baile cultural resaltando las tradiciones folklóricas de nuestro país. La semana pasada como parte de las actividades y orientaciones que son emanadas por el Ministerio de Poder Popular para la Educación, de manera semanal toca resaltar las diferentes efemérides que forman parte del calendario escolar, donde se busca resaltar la importancia de las costumbres tradiciones como parte de nuestra cultura a las nuevas generaciones, por tal motivo constantemente tengo que estar montando diferentes actividades pedagógicas/ culturales como bailes, dramatizaciones, monólogo, radio pasillo, entre otros con la intencionalidad de darle a conocer a los niños las diferentes estilos y técnicas del joropo venezolano, esto gracias a la preparación del grupo de niñas que forman parte de los grupos de crp del área de danza y teatro.
![GridArt_20260502_215247703.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AKPkBsVDbk5VfDSQJnLGJzMHnjJDx8LWssNwX6JPx76vo24PwSWT9jyFoKy5iMA.jpg)

The aim is to emphasize the importance of traditional customs as part of our culture to new generations. For this reason, I constantly organize different educational/cultural activities such as dances, dramatizations, monologues, and storytelling sessions, among others, with the intention of introducing children to the different styles and techniques of Venezuelan joropo. Hoy, mi caminata fue realmente revitalizante. Comencé mi recorrido en el parque, donde encontré a un grupo de jóvenes artistas pintando murales. Sus colores vibrantes y la energía creativa que emanaban me llenaron de inspiración. Hablé con una de las artistas, que me contó que estaban trabajando en un proyecto para embellecer espacios públicos y dar visibilidad a temas sociales importantes. Me pareció una iniciativa maravillosa. Al continuar mi caminata, pasé por un mercado local que estaba lleno de vida. Conocí a un anciano que vendía frutas frescas y tenía un sentido del humor encantador. Me ofreció una fresa y me contó que tenía un pequeño huerto en su casa, donde cultivaba su propia fruta. Su pasión por la agricultura era contagiosa, y me quedé con una sonrisa en el rostro al recordar su entusiasmo. En general, fue un día lleno de colores, risas y una conexión genuina con las personas de mi ciudad. Cada caminata me recuerda lo hermoso que es compartir momentos, aunque sea brevemente, con los demás. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). body.title: De mi
body.body:
No fue fácil, pero valió cada paso.
Hubo días en los que quise rendirme, noches en las que dudé de todo, momentos en los que el miedo pesó más que las ganas. Pero aprendí que rendirse no era opción.

Vencí obstáculos que parecían muros, transformé heridas en lecciones y silencios en fuerza. Hoy, lo que tengo no es solo logros o metas cumplidas: es una versión de mí que nunca creí posible.

Sigo en construcción, pero ya no soy la misma persona que empezó este camino. Gracias a cada caída, a cada victoria pequeña, a cada persona que creyó en mí cuando yo todavía no lo hacía.

Esto es solo el comienzo
